Said she "It is from God; Verily God provideth whomsoever He liketh without measure" The desire of Lady Hanna to dedicate a son to…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ hunālika daʿā zakariyyā rabbahu qāla rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan innaka samīʿu l-duʿāi Thereat Zechariah supplicated his Lord. He said, 'My Lord! Grant me a good offspring from You! Indeed You hear all supplications.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ hunālika daʿā zakariyyā rabbahu qāla rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan innaka samīʿu l-duʿāi At that, Zakariyya called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication." At that time Zakariyya invoked his Lord, saying: "O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation (3:38). Then the angels called him, while he was standing in prayer in the Mihrab, (saying): "Allah gives you glad tidings of Yahya, believing in the Word from Allah, and Sayyidan, and Hasuran, a Prophet, from among the righteous (3:39). He said: "O my Lord! How can I have a son when I am very old, and my wife is barren?"…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ hunālika daʿā zakariyyā rabbahu qāla rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan innaka samīʿu l-duʿāi There did Zachariah pray (Refer to: 19:5, 19:7.) to his Lord; said he "Lord! grant me from unto Thee a good (Ar. Thayyab, i.e virtuous or blessed, pure-good.) offspring; Verily, Thou art the Hearer of Prayer" When Zachariah found clear evidence of the extraordinary benevolence of the All-Merciful Lord, he also desired to pray for something for which he longed all his age, i.e., an issue. The action on the part of Zachariah was quite a natural reaction to his witnessing the miraculous provision for the sustenance of Mary. It is obvious that the passage tends miraculously to assert the unusual means of Mary being heavenly fed when she was…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِي الْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَى مُصَدِّقًا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ fanādathu l-malāikatu wahuwa qāimun yuṣallī fī l-miḥ'rābi anna l-laha yubashiruka biyaḥyā muṣaddiqan bikalimatin mina l-lahi wasayyidan waḥaṣūran wanabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīna Then the angels called out to him, as he stood praying in the sanctuary: 'Allah gives you the good news of John, as a confirmer of a Word of Allah,1 eminent and chaste, a prophet, among the righteous.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِي الْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَى مُصَدِّقًا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ fanādathu l-malāikatu wahuwa qāimun yuṣallī fī l-miḥ'rābi anna l-laha yubashiruka biyaḥyā muṣaddiqan bikalimatin mina l-lahi wasayyidan waḥaṣūran wanabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīna So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of Yahya, confirming a word1 from Allah and (who will be) honorable, abstaining (from women), and a prophet from among the righteous." See 3:38

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِي الْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَى مُصَدِّقًا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ fanādathu l-malāikatu wahuwa qāimun yuṣallī fī l-miḥ'rābi anna l-laha yubashiruka biyaḥyā muṣaddiqan bikalimatin mina l-lahi wasayyidan waḥaṣūran wanabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīna Then (Refer to: 19:5, 19:7 4:171. See also Verse 45.) called unto him the angels while he stood praying in the sanctuary (Ar. 'Mehrab' Chaneel - The private chamber of a prayer house partitioned and safe from public eye.) ; "Verily, God giveth thee the glad tidings of (a son) Yahya (John) (who shall be) the confirmer of a Word (Jesus.) from God and (besides, he shall be) the honourable and the chaste, and a Prophet from among the virtuous ones" Zachariah's prayer was granted, and the glad tidings were about the birth of John (the Baptist). Thus, John was…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِيَ الْكِبَرُ وَامْرَأَتِي عَاقِرٌ قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun waqad balaghaniya l-kibaru wa-im'ra-atī ʿāqirun qāla kadhālika l-lahu yafʿalu mā yashāu He said, 'My Lord, how shall I have a son while old age has overtaken me and my wife is barren?' He said, 'So it is that Allah does whatever He wishes.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِيَ الْكِبَرُ وَامْرَأَتِي عَاقِرٌ قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun waqad balaghaniya l-kibaru wa-im'ra-atī ʿāqirun qāla kadhālika l-lahu yafʿalu mā yashāu He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He (the angel) said, "Such is Allah; He does what He wills." See 3:38

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِيَ الْكِبَرُ وَامْرَأَتِي عَاقِرٌ قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun waqad balaghaniya l-kibaru wa-im'ra-atī ʿāqirun qāla kadhālika l-lahu yafʿalu mā yashāu Said he (Zachariah. Refer to: Verse 46, and 19:8 19:9.) "O' My Lord! How can there be a son (born) to me, when indeed old age hath affected me and my wife is barren?" Said he (God.) "Even so God doeth whatsoever He liketh" According to Ibn-Abbas, Zachariah was 120 years of age, and his wife was 98 years old (M.S.). The word 'Anna' signifies the surprise on the part of Zachariah as to how himself and his wife who were of such an advanced age could ever in the ordinary course of nature have any issue at all. Zachariah did not till then have, or…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي اٰیَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalāthata ayyāmin illā ramzan wa-udh'kur rabbaka kathīran wasabbiḥ bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kāri He said, 'My Lord, grant me a sign.' He said, 'Your sign is that you will not speak to people for three days except in gestures. And remember Your Lord greatly, and glorify Him morning and evening.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي اٰیَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalāthata ayyāmin illā ramzan wa-udh'kur rabbaka kathīran wasabbiḥ bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kāri He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not (be able to) speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt (Him with praise) in the evening and the morning." See 3:38

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي اٰیَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalāthata ayyāmin illā ramzan wa-udh'kur rabbaka kathīran wasabbiḥ bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kāri Said he (Zachariah.) "My Lord! appoint (Fix.) Thou a sign for me;" Said He (God.) "The Sign for Thee shall be that thou shalt not speak unto men for three days except by signs; and remember God much and glorify Him in the evening and (early) (in) the day break. (Refer to: 19:10.)" Zachariah in his surprise wanted a sign of God's promise being actually fulfilled in his hopeless age. He was informed that the sign would be that he would not be able to speak for three days. The demand for a sign was not due to any incredulity…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَامَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفَاكِ عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ wa-idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha iṣ'ṭafāki waṭahharaki wa-iṣ'ṭafāki ʿalā nisāi l-ʿālamīna And when the angels said, 'O Mary, Allah has chosen you and purified you, and He has chosen you above the world's women.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَامَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفَاكِ عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ wa-idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha iṣ'ṭafāki waṭahharaki wa-iṣ'ṭafāki ʿalā nisāi l-ʿālamīna And (mention) when the angels said, "O Maryam, indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. And (remember) when the angels said: "O Maryam! Verily, Allah has chosen you, purified you, and chosen you above the women of the nations (3:42). "O Maryam! Submit yourself with obedience (Aqnuti) to your Lord and prostrate yourself, and bow down along with Ar-Raki'in (3:43). This is a part of the news of the Ghayb (Unseen) which We reveal to you. You were not with them, when they cast lots with their pens as to which of them should be charged with the care of Maryam; nor were you with them…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَامَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفَاكِ عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ wa-idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha iṣ'ṭafāki waṭahharaki wa-iṣ'ṭafāki ʿalā nisāi l-ʿālamīna And (recall O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) when said the Angels "O' Mary! Verily, God hath chosen thee and purified (Includes the clearing of the doubts or the Jewish allegations against her, through the Holy Qur'an and through the Holy Prophet See note. 362, 363) thee and chosen thee above the women of the worlds" The distinction conferred upon Mary referred to in this verse, applies to her position among the women of only her own age. It is universally acknowledged by all Muslim scholars that the Holy Prophet had said that Mary was the most blessed or the choicest of the women of her own age, but my daughter Fatimah is the most blessed and the…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَامَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ yāmaryamu uq'nutī lirabbiki wa-us'judī wa-ir'kaʿī maʿa l-rākiʿīna O Mary, be obedient to your Lord, and prostrate and bow down with those who bow [in worship].'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَامَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ yāmaryamu uq'nutī lirabbiki wa-us'judī wa-ir'kaʿī maʿa l-rākiʿīna O Maryam, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow (in prayer)." See 3:42

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَامَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ yāmaryamu uq'nutī lirabbiki wa-us'judī wa-ir'kaʿī maʿa l-rākiʿīna O' Mary! (for this great grace of thy Lord upon thee) be devout unto thy Lord and prostrate thyself and bow thee down (in prayers) with those who bow down (unto Him) Mary enjoined by God to pray along with the praying ones, i.e., to be among those devoted to God.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh yul'qūna aqlāmahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wamā kunta ladayhim idh yakhtaṣimūna These accounts are from the Unseen, which We reveal to you, and you were not with them when they were casting lots [to see] which of them would take charge of Mary's care, nor were you with them when they were contending.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh yul'qūna aqlāmahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wamā kunta ladayhim idh yakhtaṣimūna That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, (O Muḥammad). And you were not with them when they cast their pens1 as to which of them should be responsible for Maryam. Nor were you with them when they disputed. See 3:42

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh yul'qūna aqlāmahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wamā kunta ladayhim idh yakhtaṣimūna This is of the news about the (things) unseen which We reveal (The knowledge which the Holy Prophet possessed was that which was revealed to him by the Lord and not acquired from anyone in this World. Refer to: 53:3; 53:4.) unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!)', for thou wast not with them when they did cast their lots with their pens as to which of them should have the charge of Mary; nor wast thou with them when among themselves they disputed (Refer to: 3:38; 19:8; 66:12; 4:171.) 'Al-Ghaib', i.e., things unseen, mystic, spiritual, something unknown or unknowable through…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَامَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِنْهُ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha yubashiruki bikalimatin min'hu us'muhu l-masīḥu ʿīsā ub'nu maryama wajīhan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamina l-muqarabīna When the angels said, 'O Mary, Allah gives you the good news of a Word from Him whose name is Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, distinguished in the world and the Hereafter, and one of those brought near [to Allah].

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَامَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِنْهُ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha yubashiruki bikalimatin min'hu us'muhu l-masīḥu ʿīsā ub'nu maryama wajīhan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamina l-muqarabīna (And mention) when the angels said, "O Maryam, indeed Allah gives you good tidings of a word1 from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Isa, the son of Maryam - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near (to Allah). (Remember) when the angels said: O Maryam! Verily, Allah gives you the glad tidings of a Word from Him, his name will be Al-Masih, Isa, the son of Maryam, held in honor in this world and in the Hereafter, and he will be one of those who are near to Allah (3:45). "He will speak…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَامَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِنْهُ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha yubashiruki bikalimatin min'hu us'muhu l-masīḥu ʿīsā ub'nu maryama wajīhan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamina l-muqarabīna (Recall) (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) when said the Angels "O' Mary! Verily, God giveth thee the glad tidings of a Word from Him; whose name shall be Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary (Note Jesus is called by God Himself as the son of the Virgin Mary as he was given birth without a male partner to his mother.) ; illustrious (Prominent.) in this world and in the Hereafter and (shall be) of those near (to God") 'Kalimah', i.e., word1. The Holy Prophet Muhammad has been called 'Zikr', i.e., a Reminder or a Sermon2. 'Al-Masih' - The title of Jesus -…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wayukallimu l-nāsa fī l-mahdi wakahlan wamina l-ṣāliḥīna He will speak to people in the cradle and in adulthood, and will be one of the righteous.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wayukallimu l-nāsa fī l-mahdi wakahlan wamina l-ṣāliḥīna He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous." See 3:45

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wayukallimu l-nāsa fī l-mahdi wakahlan wamina l-ṣāliḥīna And (Refer to: 5:110; 19:29; 19:30.) he shall speak to men (alike when) in cradle (While still a baby, as a miracle.) and when aged; and (he shall be) of the righteous ones One of the commentators, does not regard the speaking of Jesus while a Baby in the cradle as any miracle. He somehow wants to deny Jesus even the least extraordinary gift from God because no such grace of God could ever be assigned to some self-made Christ. First of all the prattling of a child in the cradle can never be called or compared to the speaking of a fully grown human being, even drat of an apostle of God. Secondly, if the event was that of the ordinary speaking of a child,…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ قَالَ كَذَلِكِ اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ qālat rabbi annā yakūnu lī waladun walam yamsasnī basharun qāla kadhāliki l-lahu yakhluqu mā yashāu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu She said, 'My Lord, how shall I have a child seeing that no human has ever touched me?' He said, 'So it is that Allah creates whatever He wishes. When He decides on a matter He just says to it "Be!" and it is.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ قَالَ كَذَلِكِ اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ qālat rabbi annā yakūnu lī waladun walam yamsasnī basharun qāla kadhāliki l-lahu yakhluqu mā yashāu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" (The angel) said, "Such is Allah; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is. See 3:45

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ قَالَ كَذَلِكِ اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ qālat rabbi annā yakūnu lī waladun walam yamsasnī basharun qāla kadhāliki l-lahu yakhluqu mā yashāu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu Said (Refer to: 3:40; 66:12; 19:17 - 19:22.) she "O' My Lord! How can I have a son when, hath not touched me (any) man?" He (God.) said "Even so doth God create whatsoever He willeth; When He decreeth a thing then He only saith unto it BE and it IS (Comes into existence.)" 'Anna' - the wonder or surprise expressed by Mary is similar to that of Zachariah in Verse 40. 'Lum Yamsas ni' - Clearly indicates that the prophecy or the tidings about the birth of Jesus was given in her virginity,…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ wayuʿallimuhu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wal-tawrāta wal-injīla And He will teach him the Book and wisdom, the Torah and the Evangel,

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ wayuʿallimuhu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wal-tawrāta wal-injīla And He will teach him writing and wisdom1 and the Torah and the Gospel. And He will teach him the Book and Al-Hikmah, and the Tawrah and the Injil (3:48). And will make him a Messenger to the Children of Israel (saying): I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, that I design for you out of clay, a figure like that of a bird, and breathe into it, and it becomes a bird by Allah's leave; and I heal the blind, and the leper, and I bring the dead to life by Allah's leave. And I inform you of what you eat, and what you store in your houses. Surely, therein is a sign for you, if you believe (3:49). "(And I have come) confirming that…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ wayuʿallimuhu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wal-tawrāta wal-injīla And (Refer to: 5:110.) He (God.) will teach (This indicates that the apostles are taught by God Himself and not by anyone else.) him the Book and the Wisdom, and the Torah and the Evangel (Ar. 'Injeel' - The Scripture given to Jesus. Refer to: 5:110.) 'Yu'allimuhul Kitab' - i.e. He (alone i.e., God Himself) will teach him (Jesus) the Book and Wisdom, and Torah (The Law) and the Evangel. A question arises as to when did Jesus receive the education promised in this verse. It cannot but be unquestionably acknowledged that Jesus was sent into this world with the knowledge of the Book, Wisdom, and the knowledge of Torah and the Evangel. If Jesus the forerunner of the Holy Prophet had his knowledge and wisdom with him from his…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَسُولًا إِلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ أَنِّي قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ أَنِّي أَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ مِنَ الطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ فَأَنْفُخُ فِیْهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَأُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ warasūlan ilā banī is'rāīla annī qad ji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum annī akhluqu lakum mina l-ṭīni kahayati l-ṭayri fa-anfukhu fīhi fayakūnu ṭayran bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-ub'ri-u l-akmaha wal-abraṣa wa-uḥ'yī l-mawtā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-unabbi-ukum bimā takulūna wamā taddakhirūna fī buyūtikum inna fī dhālika laāyatan lakum in kuntum mu'minīna and [he will be] an apostle to the Children of Israel, [and he will declare,] 'I have certainly brought you a sign from your Lord: I will create for you out of clay the form of a bird, then I will breathe into it, and it will become a bird…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَسُولًا إِلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ أَنِّي قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ أَنِّي أَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ مِنَ الطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ فَأَنْفُخُ فِیْهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَأُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ warasūlan ilā banī is'rāīla annī qad ji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum annī akhluqu lakum mina l-ṭīni kahayati l-ṭayri fa-anfukhu fīhi fayakūnu ṭayran bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-ub'ri-u l-akmaha wal-abraṣa wa-uḥ'yī l-mawtā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-unabbi-ukum bimā takulūna wamā taddakhirūna fī buyūtikum inna fī dhālika laāyatan lakum in kuntum mu'minīna And (make him) a messenger to the Children of Israel, (who will say), 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay (that which is) like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَسُولًا إِلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ أَنِّي قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ أَنِّي أَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ مِنَ الطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ فَأَنْفُخُ فِیْهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَأُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ warasūlan ilā banī is'rāīla annī qad ji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum annī akhluqu lakum mina l-ṭīni kahayati l-ṭayri fa-anfukhu fīhi fayakūnu ṭayran bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-ub'ri-u l-akmaha wal-abraṣa wa-uḥ'yī l-mawtā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-unabbi-ukum bimā takulūna wamā taddakhirūna fī buyūtikum inna fī dhālika laāyatan lakum in kuntum mu'minīna And (appoint him) an Apostle to the children of Israel (Refer to: Math 22/26) (and who will declare) "that now I have come unto you with a sign from your Lord; Out of clay (Refer to: 2:260.) will I make for you like the figure of a bird, and I…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَجِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ wamuṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayya mina l-tawrāti wali-uḥilla lakum baʿḍa alladhī ḥurrima ʿalaykum waji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni And [I come] to confirm [the truth of] that which is before me of the Torah, and to make lawful for you some of the things that were forbidden you. I have brought you a sign from your Lord; so be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَجِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ wamuṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayya mina l-tawrāti wali-uḥilla lakum baʿḍa alladhī ḥurrima ʿalaykum waji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni And (I have come) confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. And I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear Allah and obey me. See 3:48

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَجِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ wamuṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayya mina l-tawrāti wali-uḥilla lakum baʿḍa alladhī ḥurrima ʿalaykum waji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni And (I come) Confirming that which is before me of the Torah: and to allow you some of that which has been forbidden unto you: And I come unto you with a sign from your Lord: take shelter in God, and obey me Indicate that Jesus had no new message other than what had already been delivered by Moses. He had come to renew faith in the only true God. Jesus, confirming the previous revelations, asserts the exercise of his own authority to repeal some of the prohibitory orders and restrictions already imposed on them. This shows that Jesus had actually repealed…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path.'" See 3:48

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Verily (Jesus preached only the unity of God and so did the ancient Scriptures - not Trinity. James 2/19, John 20/17, Tim 2/5, 17, Jude 25, Ed 2/3, Duet 6/4, Ed 6/3, Is 44/6, Jer 10/10, Isa 42/8 44/8, Math 19/17, Mark 12/29. Refer to: 61:14.) God (HE) is my Lord and (also) your Lord: therefore worship (only) Him; This is the Right Path (To God - to salvation.) See 3:50

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ عِيسٰی مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنْصَارُ اللَّهِ اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ falammā aḥassa ʿīsā min'humu l-kuf'ra qāla man anṣārī ilā l-lahi qāla l-ḥawāriyūna naḥnu anṣāru l-lahi āmannā bil-lahi wa-ish'had bi-annā mus'limūna And when Jesus sensed their faithlessness, he said, 'Who will be my helpers toward Allah?' The Disciples said, 'We will be helpers of Allah. We have faith in Allah, and bear witness that we are muslims.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ عِيسٰی مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنْصَارُ اللَّهِ اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ falammā aḥassa ʿīsā min'humu l-kuf'ra qāla man anṣārī ilā l-lahi qāla l-ḥawāriyūna naḥnu anṣāru l-lahi āmannā bil-lahi wa-ish'had bi-annā mus'limūna But when Isa felt (persistence in) disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for (the cause of) Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters for Allah. We have believed in Allah and testify that we are Muslims (submitting to Him). Then when Isa came to know of their disbelief, he said: "Who will be my helpers in Allah's cause?" Al-Hawariyyun said: "We are the helpers of Allah; we believe in Allah, and bear witness that we are Muslims (3:52). "Our Lord! We believe in what You have sent down, and we follow the Messenger (Isa); so write us…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ عِيسٰی مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنْصَارُ اللَّهِ اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ falammā aḥassa ʿīsā min'humu l-kuf'ra qāla man anṣārī ilā l-lahi qāla l-ḥawāriyūna naḥnu anṣāru l-lahi āmannā bil-lahi wa-ish'had bi-annā mus'limūna And when Jesus perceived disbelief on their part: said he, "Who are (there) to be my helpers towards God?" The disciples (The puritans - true believers.) said "We are the helpers (towards) God! We believe in God! and bear thou witness that we are the 'Muslims' (Those who have Submitted themselves (to God).) unto Him" 'Kufr' or the disbelief on the part of the Jews as a result of which they had determined to kill Jesus. 'Hawari' (i.e., Witness) refers to the disciples of Jesus who usually dressed in white garments or referring to the purity of their heart or…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wa-ittabaʿnā l-rasūla fa-uk'tub'nā maʿa l-shāhidīna Our Lord, we believe in what You have sent down, and we follow the apostle, so write us among the witnesses.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wa-ittabaʿnā l-rasūla fa-uk'tub'nā maʿa l-shāhidīna Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger (i.e., Isa), so register us among the witnesses (to truth)." See 3:52

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wa-ittabaʿnā l-rasūla fa-uk'tub'nā maʿa l-shāhidīna (And prayed they (Faithful devotees of God.) unto God saying) "O' Our Lord! we believe in what Thou hast sent down and we follow the Apostle (Jesus); record us then with those who bear witness (unto him)" See 3:52

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ wamakarū wamakara l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīna Then they1 plotted [against Jesus], and Allah also devised, and Allah is the best of devisers.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ wamakarū wamakara l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīna And they (i.e., the disbelievers) planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners. See 3:52

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ wamakarū wamakara l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīna And they (the Jews) planned, and God (also) planned and verily, God is the best of planners 'Makr' means gaining an object against another contestant for it, through a device not known to the opponent or a device or plan used by one to gain an object contested for, which did not strike the other contestant. The device may be for an evil purpose, in which case it is condemnable and if that be a wholesome purpose, it is natural and commendable. The Jews devised to kill Jesus and God through His own device rescued him. A similar but unsuccessful attempt was made by the hypocrites on the life of the Holy Prophet on his return journey from 'Tabuk' and also on his return after the Hajjat ul-Wida…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَاعِيسٰی اِنِّیْ مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَجَاعِلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ idh qāla l-lahu yāʿīsā innī mutawaffīka warāfiʿuka ilayya wamuṭahhiruka mina alladhīna kafarū wajāʿilu alladhīna ittabaʿūka fawqa alladhīna kafarū ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-aḥkumu baynakum fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna When Allah said, 'O Jesus, I shall take you[r soul],1 and I shall raise you up toward Myself, and I shall clear you of [the calumnies of] the faithless, and I shall set those who follow you above the faithless until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me will be your return, whereat I will judge between you concerning that about which you used to differ.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَاعِيسٰی اِنِّیْ مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَجَاعِلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ idh qāla l-lahu yāʿīsā innī mutawaffīka warāfiʿuka ilayya wamuṭahhiruka mina alladhīna kafarū wajāʿilu alladhīna ittabaʿūka fawqa alladhīna kafarū ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-aḥkumu baynakum fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna (Mention) when Allah said, "O Isa, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify (i.e., free) you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you (in submission to Allah alone) superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ. And (remember) when Allah said: "O Isa! I will take you and raise you…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَاعِيسٰی اِنِّیْ مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَجَاعِلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ idh qāla l-lahu yāʿīsā innī mutawaffīka warāfiʿuka ilayya wamuṭahhiruka mina alladhīna kafarū wajāʿilu alladhīna ittabaʿūka fawqa alladhīna kafarū ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-aḥkumu baynakum fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna Recall (Refer to: 4:157, 4:158, 5:117.) (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) when God said: O' Jesus, I will take thee away (Complete thy term.) and lift thee up unto Me; and purify (Clear.) thee of those that disbelieve, and make those who follow thee (This promise was to the sincere believers in Jesus, of his time, before the advent of the Holy Prophet and thereafter to those good Christians who with then faith in what Jesus prophesied, embraced Islam.) triumphant upon…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ fa-ammā alladhīna kafarū fa-uʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamā lahum min nāṣirīna As for the faithless, I will punish them with a severe punishment in the world and the Hereafter; and they will have no helpers.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ fa-ammā alladhīna kafarū fa-uʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamā lahum min nāṣirīna And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers." See 3:55

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ fa-ammā alladhīna kafarū fa-uʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamā lahum min nāṣirīna And as to those who (Refers to those who disbelieved during Jesus time and thereafter disbelieved in the Holy Prophet.) disbelieve, I will chastise them with a severe chastisement in this world and the hereafter and for them shall not be any of the helpers (This clearly establishes that there will be helpers for the sinners among the sincere believers. On the Day of Judgement - i.e. the divinely permitted intercessors.) See 3:55

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayuwaffīhim ujūrahum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīna But as for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, He will pay them in full their rewards, and Allah does not like the wrongdoers.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayuwaffīhim ujūrahum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīna But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards, and Allah does not like the wrongdoers. See 3:55

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayuwaffīhim ujūrahum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīna But to those who believe and do good deeds, He will pay them in full their recompense; and God loveth not the unjust. (Refer to: 2:254, 4:85, 34:23, 19:86, 39:44, 20:109, 74:48, 21:28, 10:3, 43:86.) Note the decree of the All-Just Lord that He does not love the unjust or the tyrants whoever they may be. Anybody who is unjust or tyrannical, let him call himself a Muslim, shall not be loved by God. What about those among the Muslims who were tyrannical to the members of the Holy family of the Holy Prophet, i.e., the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيمِ dhālika natlūhu ʿalayka mina l-āyāti wal-dhik'ri l-ḥakīmi These that We recite to you are from the signs and the Wise Reminder.1

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيمِ dhālika natlūhu ʿalayka mina l-āyāti wal-dhik'ri l-ḥakīmi This is what We recite to you, (O Muḥammad), of (Our) verses and the precise (and wise) message (i.e., the Qur’ān). See 3:55

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيمِ dhālika natlūhu ʿalayka mina l-āyāti wal-dhik'ri l-ḥakīmi This, We recite unto thee of the signs and the Wise Reminder (Quran.) 'Aayaat', i.e., signs-the miracles-meaning the miracle of Jesus immaculate birth and the miracles that manifested from the various apostles of God including what Jesus worked. "Reminder"- another name given to Qur'an1 - The "Book" 'Hakim' the word standing alone will mean Wise. Here qualifying the Word 'Zikr'-the Book of the All-Wise God, i.e., the Book or the Qur'an which is nothing, but Wisdom clothed in words-or the Book free from incongruity or imperfection or unsoundness.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسٰی عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَ خَلَقَهُ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ inna mathala ʿīsā ʿinda l-lahi kamathali ādama khalaqahu min turābin thumma qāla lahu kun fayakūnu Indeed the case of Jesus with Allah is like the case of Adam: He created him from dust, then said to him, 'Be,' and he was.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسٰی عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَ خَلَقَهُ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ inna mathala ʿīsā ʿinda l-lahi kamathali ādama khalaqahu min turābin thumma qāla lahu kun fayakūnu Indeed, the example of Isa to Allah1 is like that of Adam. He created him from dust; then He said to him, "Be," and he was. Verily, the likeness of Isa before Allah is the likeness of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him: Be!" and he was (3:59). (This is) the truth from your Lord, so be not of those who doubt (3:60). Then whoever disputes with you concerning him after the knowledge that has come to you, say: "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then we pray and we invoke Allah's curse upon the…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسٰی عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَ خَلَقَهُ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ inna mathala ʿīsā ʿinda l-lahi kamathali ādama khalaqahu min turābin thumma qāla lahu kun fayakūnu Verily, similitude of Jesus with God is as the similitude of Adam; He created him out of dust then said He unto him BE, and he became The Christians of Najran came in a deputation to the Holy Prophet and asked him as to why he abuses Jesus by calling him a man. The Holy Prophet replied, "Far be it from me to abuse Jesus the Word of God communicated through the Chaste and pure Holy Lady Mary" The Christians asked the Holy Prophet 'Then, What do thou sayest, hast thou seen any man born without a father?" The reply to the question is accommodated in this verse, i.e., Adam…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ al-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takun mina l-mum'tarīna This is the truth from your Lord, so do not be among the skeptics.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ al-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takun mina l-mum'tarīna The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters. See 3:59

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ al-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takun mina l-mum'tarīna The Truth is from thy Lord, therefore be not thou (The Prophet addressed for the people.) of those of the doubters (Disputants.) The address in this verse is to the people through the Holy Prophet. This refers to a general principle, if adhered to, one would be saved from the sceptic tendencies, i.e., God is the Absolute Truth and Reality. Anything real and true proceeds only from Him, and it should be explained in the term of His Truth and Reality and not in the natural or the material process known to us. This principle is laid down here as the answer to the people and not to the Holy Prophet, and to warn that doubting against the unusual event because of its seeming unusual, would…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ حَاجَّكَ فِیْهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ أَبْنَاءَنَا وَأَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَنِسَاءَنَا وَنِسَاءَكُمْ وَأَنْفُسَنَا وَأَنْفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَلْ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْكٰذِبِیْنَ faman ḥājjaka fīhi min baʿdi mā jāaka mina l-ʿil'mi faqul taʿālaw nadʿu abnāanā wa-abnāakum wanisāanā wanisāakum wa-anfusanā wa-anfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajʿal laʿnata l-lahi ʿalā l-kādhibīna Should anyone argue with you concerning him, after the knowledge that has come to you, say, 'Come! Let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, our souls and your souls, then let us pray earnestly and call down Allah's curse upon the liars.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ حَاجَّكَ فِیْهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ أَبْنَاءَنَا وَأَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَنِسَاءَنَا وَنِسَاءَكُمْ وَأَنْفُسَنَا وَأَنْفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَلْ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْكٰذِبِیْنَ faman ḥājjaka fīhi min baʿdi mā jāaka mina l-ʿil'mi faqul taʿālaw nadʿu abnāanā wa-abnāakum wanisāanā wanisāakum wa-anfusanā wa-anfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajʿal laʿnata l-lahi ʿalā l-kādhibīna Then whoever argues with you about it after (this) knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly (together) and invoke the curse of Allah upon the liars (among us)." See 3:59

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ حَاجَّكَ فِیْهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ أَبْنَاءَنَا وَأَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَنِسَاءَنَا وَنِسَاءَكُمْ وَأَنْفُسَنَا وَأَنْفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَلْ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْكٰذِبِیْنَ faman ḥājjaka fīhi min baʿdi mā jāaka mina l-ʿil'mi faqul taʿālaw nadʿu abnāanā wa-abnāakum wanisāanā wanisāakum wa-anfusanā wa-anfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajʿal laʿnata l-lahi ʿalā l-kādhibīna And unto him who disputeth with thee therein (Jesus or the argument forwarded.) after the knowledge hath come unto thee, Say! (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) (Unto them!) "come ye, let us summon our sons, and (ye summon) your sons, and (we summon) our women and (ye) your women, and (we summon) ourselves (The nearest or the dearest as the very soul itself.) and (ye) your selves and then let us invoke (Supplicate.) and lay the curse of God on the liars! (Note This Verse is a reference to the historic…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-qaṣaṣu l-ḥaqu wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu wa-inna l-laha lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu This is indeed the true account, for sure. There is no god but Allah, and indeed Allah is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-qaṣaṣu l-ḥaqu wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu wa-inna l-laha lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Indeed, this is the true narration. And there is no deity except Allah. And indeed, Allah is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 3:59

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-qaṣaṣu l-ḥaqu wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu wa-inna l-laha lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Verily, this (The whole argument.) is the true narrative; there is no god but God; and verily, God is All-Mighty (Ar. 'Azeez'.) , All-Wise Reasoning the story of Jesus and Mary and the actual position of Jesus as an apostle of God and nothing more than that are the facts, i.e., other legends about Jesus being the son of God or God Himself, are false legends and fabricated folklore for there is no god but the One God and none else besides Him.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ fa-in tawallaw fa-inna l-laha ʿalīmun bil-muf'sidīna But if they turn away, indeed Allah knows best the agents of corruption.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ fa-in tawallaw fa-inna l-laha ʿalīmun bil-muf'sidīna But if they turn away, then indeed - Allah is Knowing of the corrupters. See 3:59

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ fa-in tawallaw fa-inna l-laha ʿalīmun bil-muf'sidīna But if they turn back, then (Behold that.) , verily, God knoweth the mischief makers An open warning to the mischief-mongers.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُولُوْۤا اشْهَدُوْۤا بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ qul yāahla l-kitābi taʿālaw ilā kalimatin sawāin baynanā wabaynakum allā naʿbuda illā l-laha walā nush'rika bihi shayan walā yattakhidha baʿḍunā baʿḍan arbāban min dūni l-lahi fa-in tawallaw faqūlū ish'hadū bi-annā mus'limūna Say, 'O People of the Book! Come to a word common between us and you: that we will worship no one but Allah, and that we will not ascribe any partner to Him, and that we will not take each other as lords besides Allah.' But if they turn away, say, 'Be witnesses that we are muslims.' 1

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُولُوْۤا اشْهَدُوْۤا بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ qul yāahla l-kitābi taʿālaw ilā kalimatin sawāin baynanā wabaynakum allā naʿbuda illā l-laha walā nush'rika bihi shayan walā yattakhidha baʿḍunā baʿḍan arbāban min dūni l-lahi fa-in tawallaw faqūlū ish'hadū bi-annā mus'limūna Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allah and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allah."1 But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims (submitting to Him)." Say: O people of the Scripture: Come to a word that is just between us and you, that we worship none…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُولُوْۤا اشْهَدُوْۤا بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ qul yāahla l-kitābi taʿālaw ilā kalimatin sawāin baynanā wabaynakum allā naʿbuda illā l-laha walā nush'rika bihi shayan walā yattakhidha baʿḍunā baʿḍan arbāban min dūni l-lahi fa-in tawallaw faqūlū ish'hadū bi-annā mus'limūna Say; "O' people of the Book, come ye to a Word (Term.) Common (Equally agreeable.) between us and you, that we worship (Supplicate - pray - in absolute Submission.) none but God and shall not associate (Submission to - as an authority.) anything with Him and some of us take not any others for lords (Ar. 'Rabb'.) other than God;" and if they turn back; then say ye: "Bear ye witness that we are Muslims (Those Submitted themselves…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِي اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمَا أُنْزِلَتِ التَّوْرَاةُ وَالْإِنْجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima tuḥājjūna fī ib'rāhīma wamā unzilati l-tawrātu wal-injīlu illā min baʿdihi afalā taʿqilūna O People of the Book! Why do you argue concerning Abraham? Neither the Torah nor the Evangel were sent down until [long] after him. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِي اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمَا أُنْزِلَتِ التَّوْرَاةُ وَالْإِنْجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima tuḥājjūna fī ib'rāhīma wamā unzilati l-tawrātu wal-injīlu illā min baʿdihi afalā taʿqilūna O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Ibrahim while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason? O people of the Scripture! Why do you dispute about Ibrahim, while the Tawrah and the Injil were not revealed till after him? Have you then no sense (3:65). Verily, you are those who have disputed about that of which you have knowledge. Why do you then dispute concerning that of which you have no knowledge? It is Allah Who knows, and you know not (3:66). Ibrahim was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was a true Muslim Hanifa and…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِي اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمَا أُنْزِلَتِ التَّوْرَاةُ وَالْإِنْجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima tuḥājjūna fī ib'rāhīma wamā unzilati l-tawrātu wal-injīlu illā min baʿdihi afalā taʿqilūna O' ye People of the BOOK! Why dispute ye about Abraham when the Law (The Torah - the Scripture given to Moses.) and the Evangel (The Injeel - The Scripture given to Jesus.) were not sent down till after him? (what?) Do ye not then understand (so much)? The dispute referred to in this verse is of the Jews and the Christians claiming that the faith of Abraham was the same as theirs. "The Jewish belief is also difficult to define. Time was when it was grossly anthropomorphic and 'monolatros' (as Charles expressively calls it) The Yahweh was only the tribal God of Israel, the gods of other nations were…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَاأَنْتُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ حَاجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ hāantum hāulāi ḥājajtum fīmā lakum bihi ʿil'mun falima tuḥājjūna fīmā laysa lakum bihi ʿil'mun wal-lahu yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna Ah! You are the very ones who argue about that of which you have knowledge. Why then do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allah knows and you do not know.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَاأَنْتُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ حَاجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ hāantum hāulāi ḥājajtum fīmā lakum bihi ʿil'mun falima tuḥājjūna fīmā laysa lakum bihi ʿil'mun wal-lahu yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have (some) knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allah knows, while you know not. See 3:65

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَاأَنْتُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ حَاجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ hāantum hāulāi ḥājajtum fīmā lakum bihi ʿil'mun falima tuḥājjūna fīmā laysa lakum bihi ʿil'mun wal-lahu yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna Lo! ye are those who disputed about which ye had knowledge; but why dispute ye about which ye have no knowledge? And God knoweth and ye know not! Beware, you, (the Jews and the Christians) are those who dispute about the knowledge which you have about the identity of our Prophet Muhammad, the details about whom you know from your own scriptures which you possess. How can you know about Abraham whom you do not know, and God alone knows him, i.e., about the faith of Abraham.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَكِنْ كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ mā kāna ib'rāhīmu yahūdiyyan walā naṣrāniyyan walākin kāna ḥanīfan mus'liman wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīna Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian. Rather he was a ḥanīf, a muslim, and he was not one of the polytheists.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَكِنْ كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ mā kāna ib'rāhīmu yahūdiyyan walā naṣrāniyyan walākin kāna ḥanīfan mus'liman wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīna Ibrahim was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim (submitting to Allah). And he was not of the polytheists.1 See 3:65

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَكِنْ كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ mā kāna ib'rāhīmu yahūdiyyan walā naṣrāniyyan walākin kāna ḥanīfan mus'liman wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīna Abraham was neither Jew nor Christian; but upright in faith (was he) a Muslim; and he was not of the polytheists (Those who associate others with God in authority.) The position of Abraham with regard to his faith is made clear. The word 'Muslim' used for Abraham indicates that Islam is not a new religion, and the word 'Muslim' has been the term used for everyone who submits himself to God irrespective of the age even prior to the advent of the Holy Prophet Muhammad. Thus, submission to God, done in any part of the world in any age, by any people, if done duly, was Islam. 'Islam' is only an Arabic…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِاِبْرَاهِیْمَ لَلَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna awlā l-nāsi bi-ib'rāhīma lalladhīna ittabaʿūhu wahādhā l-nabiyu wa-alladhīna āmanū wal-lahu waliyyu l-mu'minīna Indeed the nearest of all people to Abraham are those who follow him, and this prophet and those who have faith, and Allah is the guardian of the faithful.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِاِبْرَاهِیْمَ لَلَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna awlā l-nāsi bi-ib'rāhīma lalladhīna ittabaʿūhu wahādhā l-nabiyu wa-alladhīna āmanū wal-lahu waliyyu l-mu'minīna Indeed, the most worthy of Ibrahim among the people are those who followed him (in submission to Allah) and this prophet (i.e., Muḥammad SAW) and those who believe (in his message). And Allah is the Ally1 of the believers. See 3:65

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِاِبْرَاهِیْمَ لَلَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna awlā l-nāsi bi-ib'rāhīma lalladhīna ittabaʿūhu wahādhā l-nabiyu wa-alladhīna āmanū wal-lahu waliyyu l-mu'minīna Verily, of men the nearest (Note - nearness Vests in faithful following - while the son of Noah was disowned. Refer to Verses 11:45, 11:46.) to Abraham, are surely those who followed him and this (Our) Prophet (Muhammad) and those who believe; and verily, God is the Guardian (Ar. – 'Wali') of the faithful (Refer to: 42:48.) i.e., The nearest of the people to Abraham during his time were those who followed him, and in this age this Prophet (i.e., the Holy Prophet Muhammad) and those who believe as the Holy Prophet Muhammad does. Amirul-Momineen Ali-Ibn-Abi Talib says that the nearest to the Holy Prophet is he who obeys God though he might not…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَّتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ waddat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi law yuḍillūnakum wamā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūna A group of the People of the Book were eager to lead you astray; yet they lead no one astray except themselves, but they are not aware.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَّتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ waddat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi law yuḍillūnakum wamā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūna A faction of the People of the Scripture wish they could mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they perceive (it) not. A party of the People of the Scripture wish to lead you astray. But they shall not lead astray anyone except themselves, and they perceive not (3:69). O People of the Scripture! Why do you disbelieve in the Ayat of Allah, while you bear witness (3:70). "O People of the Scripture! Why do you mix truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know? (3:71). And a party of the People of the Scripture say: "Believe in the morning in that which is revealed to the believers, and…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَّتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ waddat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi law yuḍillūnakum wamā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūna A group among the people of the Book would fain mislead you; while they mislead not but themselves, but they sense it not The Jews were always inviting Huzaif al-Yamani and Ammar Yasir and other faithful followers of the Holy Prophet to join their faith (i.e. Judaism). But these great Muslims never paid any heed to the invitations. It needs to be considered a little seriously that perfect obedience to God means the perfect obedience to the Holy Prophet. And perfect obedience to the Holy Prophet means the unconditional love, perfect love of the Holy Prophet and everything he loves. How can those who sat quite in a safe place without taking part in…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima takfurūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-antum tashhadūna O People of the Book! Why do you defy Allah's signs while you testify [to their truth]?

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima takfurūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-antum tashhadūna O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah1 while you witness (to their truth)? See 3:69

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima takfurūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-antum tashhadūna O' People of the Book why do ye disbelieve the signs of God while ye yourselves witness (them)? This verse speaks of the appeal to reason and to the conscience, which Islam always makes in inviting the people to the Truth.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ الْحَقَّ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima talbisūna l-ḥaqa bil-bāṭili wataktumūna l-ḥaqa wa-antum taʿlamūna O People of the Book! Why do you mix the truth with falsehood, and conceal the truth while you know [it]?

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ الْحَقَّ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima talbisūna l-ḥaqa bil-bāṭili wataktumūna l-ḥaqa wa-antum taʿlamūna O People of the Scripture, why do you mix (i.e., confuse) the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know (it)? See 3:69

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ الْحَقَّ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yāahla l-kitābi lima talbisūna l-ḥaqa bil-bāṭili wataktumūna l-ḥaqa wa-antum taʿlamūna O' people of the Book: Why confound ye the truth with falsehood, and why hide ye the truth while ye know (it)? It is made clear by this verse that the Jews and the Christians knew the truth about the apostleship of the Holy Prophet and the main doctrine of the Unity of God which Islam re-preached, but they had been confounding the Truth with falsehood of their own.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَجْهَ النَّهَارِ وَاكْفُرُوا ءَاخِرَهُ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ waqālat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi āminū bi-alladhī unzila ʿalā alladhīna āmanū wajha l-nahāri wa-uk'furū ākhirahu laʿallahum yarjiʿūna A group of the People of the Book say, 'Believe in what has been sent down to the faithful at the beginning of the day, and disbelieve at its end, so that they may turn back [from their religion].'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَجْهَ النَّهَارِ وَاكْفُرُوا ءَاخِرَهُ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ waqālat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi āminū bi-alladhī unzila ʿalā alladhīna āmanū wajha l-nahāri wa-uk'furū ākhirahu laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And a faction of the People of the Scripture say (to each other), "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will return (i.e., abandon their religion). See 3:69

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَجْهَ النَّهَارِ وَاكْفُرُوا ءَاخِرَهُ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ waqālat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi āminū bi-alladhī unzila ʿalā alladhīna āmanū wajha l-nahāri wa-uk'furū ākhirahu laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And said a group of the people of the Book, "Believe in what hath been sent down to the believers (The Muslims.) at daybreak and deny it at its close perchance (by this device) they may return (to disbelief)" To make a show of belief for some time and then to avow that they were mistaken; this was one of the tactics which the Jews had been adopting to at least create doubts in the minds of the simple-minded ignorant people about Islam. But they were never successful in this device also, as in their other plans and intrigues. This tactic of the opponents of posing…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِلَّا لِمَنْ تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ الْهُدَى هُدَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُؤْتٰی أَحَدٌ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَاجُّوكُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِیْمٌ walā tu'minū illā liman tabiʿa dīnakum qul inna l-hudā hudā l-lahi an yu'tā aḥadun mith'la mā ūtītum aw yuḥājjūkum ʿinda rabbikum qul inna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu wāsiʿun ʿalīmun 'And do not believe anyone except him who follows your religion.' Say, 'Indeed [true] guidance is the guidance of Allah.' '[And do not believe] that anyone may be given the like of what you were given, or that he may argue with you before your Lord.'1 Say, 'Indeed all grace is in Allah's hand; He grants it to whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِلَّا لِمَنْ تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ الْهُدَى هُدَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُؤْتٰی أَحَدٌ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَاجُّوكُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِیْمٌ walā tu'minū illā liman tabiʿa dīnakum qul inna l-hudā hudā l-lahi an yu'tā aḥadun mith'la mā ūtītum aw yuḥājjūkum ʿinda rabbikum qul inna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu wāsiʿun ʿalīmun And do not trust except those who follow your religion." Say, "Indeed, the (true) guidance is the guidance of Allah. (Do you fear) lest someone be given (knowledge) like you were given or that they would (thereby) argue with you before your Lord?" Say, "Indeed, (all) bounty is in the hand1 of Allah - He grants it to whom He wills. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Wise." See 3:69

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِلَّا لِمَنْ تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ الْهُدَى هُدَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُؤْتٰی أَحَدٌ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَاجُّوكُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِیْمٌ walā tu'minū illā liman tabiʿa dīnakum qul inna l-hudā hudā l-lahi an yu'tā aḥadun mith'la mā ūtītum aw yuḥājjūkum ʿinda rabbikum qul inna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu wāsiʿun ʿalīmun (And they say) And believe not in any but those who follow your religion; Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Verily, the (true) guidance is the guidance from God; '(envy ye) that to any other (also) hath been given the like of what hath been given to you; or (fear ye that) they (would) dispute you in the presence of your Lord". Say, Thou, - "Grace is in the hands of God; He granteth (Refer to: 2:269,…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi He singles out for His mercy whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi He selects for His mercy whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty. See 3:69

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi He singleth (Chooseth. See 2:105.) out for His mercy whomsoever He liketh; and verily, God is (the Lord) of Great Grace Mercy here means Prophethood, Islam or the revelation, i.e. of the Holy Quran. (UB. M.S.). From 'Man Yasha'... (i.e., whomsoever He likes, some commentators infer that God's blessings is not based on merit but at His will. This does not mean that His will is arbitrary, not based on His wisdom. His will is not restricted by any external condition, but it cannot be denied that His wisdom dominates His will, and His wisdom and His justice do not give any room for any arbitrary action. (A.P.)

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنْطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَا يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَائِمًا ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ wamin ahli l-kitābi man in tamanhu biqinṭārin yu-addihi ilayka wamin'hum man in tamanhu bidīnārin lā yu-addihi ilayka illā mā dum'ta ʿalayhi qāiman dhālika bi-annahum qālū laysa ʿalaynā fī l-umiyīna sabīlun wayaqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūna And among the People of the Book is he who if you entrust him with a quintal1 will repay it to you, and among them is he who, if you entrust him with a dinar will not repay it to you unless you stand persistently over him. That is because they say, 'We have no obligation to the non-Jews.' But they attribute lies to Allah, and they know…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنْطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَا يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَائِمًا ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ wamin ahli l-kitābi man in tamanhu biqinṭārin yu-addihi ilayka wamin'hum man in tamanhu bidīnārin lā yu-addihi ilayka illā mā dum'ta ʿalayhi qāiman dhālika bi-annahum qālū laysa ʿalaynā fī l-umiyīna sabīlun wayaqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūna And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount (of wealth), he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a (single) coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him (demanding it). That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنْطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَا يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَائِمًا ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ wamin ahli l-kitābi man in tamanhu biqinṭārin yu-addihi ilayka wamin'hum man in tamanhu bidīnārin lā yu-addihi ilayka illā mā dum'ta ʿalayhi qāiman dhālika bi-annahum qālū laysa ʿalaynā fī l-umiyīna sabīlun wayaqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūna And from among the people of the Book are such whom if thou entrust (even) a heap of Gold, he will restore it unto thee: and from among them are such whom if thou entrust (even) a dinar, he will not restore it unto thee unless thou keepeth standing firmly upon him demanding it; This because they say "It is not incumbent on us" (to be faithful) to…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى مَنْ أَوْفَى بِعَهْدِهِ وَاتَّقَى فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ balā man awfā biʿahdihi wa-ittaqā fa-inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna Yes, whoever fulfills his commitments and is wary of Allah —Allah indeed loves the Godwary.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى مَنْ أَوْفَى بِعَهْدِهِ وَاتَّقَى فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ balā man awfā biʿahdihi wa-ittaqā fa-inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna But yes, whoever fulfills his commitment and fears Allah - then indeed, Allah loves those who fear Him. See 3:75

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى مَنْ أَوْفَى بِعَهْدِهِ وَاتَّقَى فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ balā man awfā biʿahdihi wa-ittaqā fa-inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna Yea, whoso keepeth his promise (Applicable to the Covenant or the Bait or the promise taken at Ghadir Khumm under Verse 5:67.) and guardeth himself (against evil), for (This is the reply understood.) verily, God loveth those who guard themselves (against evil) Fulfilment of a covenant or a promise and piety is preached on condition for one to be loved by God. 'Bait' or allegiance to the Holy Prophet or the acceptance of the faith, is a covenant or a promise of fidelity to him, which is actually a covenant with God. Those who desert the Holy Prophet on every occasion and particularly in battles deciding the fate of the faith, have actually broken the Covenant. Piety means guarding one's self against…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna yashtarūna biʿahdi l-lahi wa-aymānihim thamanan qalīlan ulāika lā khalāqa lahum fī l-ākhirati walā yukallimuhumu l-lahu walā yanẓuru ilayhim yawma l-qiyāmati walā yuzakkīhim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Those who sell Allah's covenant and their oaths for a paltry gain— there shall be no share for them in the Hereafter and Allah will not speak to them nor will He [so much as] look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna yashtarūna biʿahdi l-lahi wa-aymānihim thamanan qalīlan ulāika lā khalāqa lahum fī l-ākhirati walā yukallimuhumu l-lahu walā yanẓuru ilayhim yawma l-qiyāmati walā yuzakkīhim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their (own) oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allah will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment. Verily, those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter (Paradise). Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
