item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَقَالُوْۤا لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ إِذَا ضَرَبُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَوْ كَانُوْۤا غُزًّى لَوْ كَانُوْۤا عِنْدَنَا مَا مَاتُوْۤا وَمَا قُتِلُوْۤا لِيَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ ذٰلِكَ حَسْرَةً فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takūnū ka-alladhīna kafarū waqālū li-ikh'wānihim idhā ḍarabū fī l-arḍi aw kānū ghuzzan law kānū ʿindanā mā mātū wamā qutilū liyajʿala l-lahu dhālika ḥasratan fī qulūbihim wal-lahu yuḥ'yī wayumītu wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun O you who have believed, do not be like those who disbelieved and said about their brothers when they traveled through the land or went out to fight, "If they had been with us, they would not have died or have been killed," so Allah makes that (misconception) a regret within their hearts. And it is Allah who gives life and causes death, and Allah is Seeing of…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:156 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَقَالُوْۤا لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ إِذَا ضَرَبُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَوْ كَانُوْۤا غُزًّى لَوْ كَانُوْۤا عِنْدَنَا مَا مَاتُوْۤا وَمَا قُتِلُوْۤا لِيَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ ذٰلِكَ حَسْرَةً فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takūnū ka-alladhīna kafarū waqālū li-ikh'wānihim idhā ḍarabū fī l-arḍi aw kānū ghuzzan law kānū ʿindanā mā mātū wamā qutilū liyajʿala l-lahu dhālika ḥasratan fī qulūbihim wal-lahu yuḥ'yī wayumītu wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun O' Ye who believe! be ye not like the disbelievers who said of their brethren when they travel in the earth or engaged in fight (in the way of God) "Had they been with us they would not have died and had not been slain" so that God may make this an intense regret in their hearts; and it is God Who giveth life and causeth to die;…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:157 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ قُتِلْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ مُتُّمْ لَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ wala-in qutil'tum fī sabīli l-lahi aw muttum lamaghfiratun mina l-lahi waraḥmatun khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna If you are slain in the way of Allah, or die, surely forgiveness and mercy from Allah are better than what they amass.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:157 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ قُتِلْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ مُتُّمْ لَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ wala-in qutil'tum fī sabīli l-lahi aw muttum lamaghfiratun mina l-lahi waraḥmatun khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna And if you are killed in the cause of Allah or die - then forgiveness from Allah and mercy are better than whatever they accumulate (in this world). See 3:156

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:157 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ قُتِلْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ مُتُّمْ لَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ wala-in qutil'tum fī sabīli l-lahi aw muttum lamaghfiratun mina l-lahi waraḥmatun khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna And if ye be slain in the way of God or die, then pardon from God and mercy is better than all that they amass. The reward promised for dying in the cause of truth, is for the life after death. This indicates how much a Muslim has to be sure and convinced of the faith in God and the return for supporting God's cause, even at the cost of his own life. This is clear evidence of the actual realistic effect the teachings of the Holy Prophet had impressed upon the hearts of his followers within the few years of his mission. The true Muslims were now ready to lay down…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:158 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ مُتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ wala-in muttum aw qutil'tum la-ilā l-lahi tuḥ'sharūna And if you die or are slain, you will surely be mustered toward Allah.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:158 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ مُتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ wala-in muttum aw qutil'tum la-ilā l-lahi tuḥ'sharūna And whether you die or are killed, unto Allah you will be gathered. See 3:156

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:158 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ مُتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ wala-in muttum aw qutil'tum la-ilā l-lahi tuḥ'sharūna For if ye die or be slain, Verily unto God (only) shall ye be gathered. See 3:157

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:159 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ لِنْتَ لَهُمْ وَلَوْ كُنْتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ fabimā raḥmatin mina l-lahi linta lahum walaw kunta faẓẓan ghalīẓa l-qalbi la-infaḍḍū min ḥawlika fa-uʿ'fu ʿanhum wa-is'taghfir lahum washāwir'hum fī l-amri fa-idhā ʿazamta fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutawakilīna It is by Allah's mercy that you are gentle to them; and had you been harsh and hardhearted, surely they would have scattered from around you. So excuse them, and plead for forgiveness for them, and consult them in the affairs, and once you are resolved, put your trust in Allah. Indeed Allah loves those who trust in Him.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:159 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ لِنْتَ لَهُمْ وَلَوْ كُنْتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ fabimā raḥmatin mina l-lahi linta lahum walaw kunta faẓẓan ghalīẓa l-qalbi la-infaḍḍū min ḥawlika fa-uʿ'fu ʿanhum wa-is'taghfir lahum washāwir'hum fī l-amri fa-idhā ʿazamta fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutawakilīna So by mercy from Allah, (O Muḥammad), you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude (in speech) and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely (upon Him). And by the mercy of Allah, you dealt with them gently. And had you been severe and harsh-hearted,…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:159 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ لِنْتَ لَهُمْ وَلَوْ كُنْتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ fabimā raḥmatin mina l-lahi linta lahum walaw kunta faẓẓan ghalīẓa l-qalbi la-infaḍḍū min ḥawlika fa-uʿ'fu ʿanhum wa-is'taghfir lahum washāwir'hum fī l-amri fa-idhā ʿazamta fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutawakilīna Thus it is a mercy of God that thou (The Holy Prophet.) art lenient unto them: Hadst thou been severe and hard-hearted, they would surely have dispersed away from around thee; Therefore forgive them and seek pardon for them; and take (Just to please them. Refer to Verse 42:38.) their counsel in the affair; But when thou art resolved, then put thou thy trust in God (And act.) ; For God loveth those who trust (in Him). The deserters in…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:160 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ in yanṣur'kumu l-lahu falā ghāliba lakum wa-in yakhdhul'kum faman dhā alladhī yanṣurukum min baʿdihi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna If Allah helps you, no one can overcome you, but if He forsakes you, who will help you after Him? So in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:160 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ in yanṣur'kumu l-lahu falā ghāliba lakum wa-in yakhdhul'kum faman dhā alladhī yanṣurukum min baʿdihi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna If Allah should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him? And upon Allah let the believers rely. See 3:159

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:160 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ in yanṣur'kumu l-lahu falā ghāliba lakum wa-in yakhdhul'kum faman dhā alladhī yanṣurukum min baʿdihi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna (Remember O' ye Believers!) If God helpeth you, none shall overcome you; but if He forsaketh you, who is he that would help you after that? On God then should the believers rely. The concluding word of the Verse is a suggestive statement about the believers depending upon none else but God.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:161 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَغُلَّ وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wamā kāna linabiyyin an yaghulla waman yaghlul yati bimā ghalla yawma l-qiyāmati thumma tuwaffā kullu nafsin mā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna A prophet may not breach his trust, and whoever breaches his trust will bring his breaches on the Day of Resurrection; then every soul shall be recompensed fully for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:161 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَغُلَّ وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wamā kāna linabiyyin an yaghulla waman yaghlul yati bimā ghalla yawma l-qiyāmati thumma tuwaffā kullu nafsin mā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna It is not (attributable) to any prophet that he would act unfaithfully (in regard to war booty). And whoever betrays, (taking unlawfully), will come with what he took on the Day of Resurrection. Then will every soul be (fully) compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged. See 3:159

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:161 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَغُلَّ وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wamā kāna linabiyyin an yaghulla waman yaghlul yati bimā ghalla yawma l-qiyāmati thumma tuwaffā kullu nafsin mā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna It is not (Attributable to.) for any prophet (of God) to defraud; and he who defraudeth shall bring with him what he hath defrauded on the day of the Resurrection; Then shall every soul be paid what he hath earned and they shall not be dealt with unjustly. A cloth of some value was found missing from the booty collected at Badr. The hypocrites wanted to insinuate saying that the Holy Prophet might have appropriated it for himself without the knowledge of his people. This Verse is said to have been revealed on this occasion, but it is…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:162 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ كَمَنْ بَاءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَأْوَاهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ afamani ittabaʿa riḍ'wāna l-lahi kaman bāa bisakhaṭin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru Is he who follows [the course of] Allah's pleasure like him who earns Allah's displeasure and whose refuge is hell, an evil destination?

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:162 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ كَمَنْ بَاءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَأْوَاهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ afamani ittabaʿa riḍ'wāna l-lahi kaman bāa bisakhaṭin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru So is one who pursues the pleasure of Allah like one who brings upon himself the anger of Allah and whose refuge is Hell? And wretched is the destination. See 3:159

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:162 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ كَمَنْ بَاءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَأْوَاهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ afamani ittabaʿa riḍ'wāna l-lahi kaman bāa bisakhaṭin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru Is then he who abideth by the pleasure of God, like him who hath brought on himself the wrath from God, and whose abode shall be Hell? What an evil destination (it is). He who tenaciously follows the pleasure of God must necessarily in all arguments of logic be the one described in: "And of mankind is he who would sell himself, seeking the pleasure of God; and God hath compassion on (His) bond-men." (2:207) The one who stood by the Holy Prophet fighting in the cause of God to the end. And he who has made himself deserving of the wrath of God must naturally be those who fled away from the battle-field…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:163 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ hum darajātun ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā yaʿmalūna They have ranks with Allah, and Allah sees best what they do.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:163 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ hum darajātun ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā yaʿmalūna They are (varying) degrees in the sight of Allah, and Allah is Seeing of whatever they do. See 3:159

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:163 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ hum darajātun ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā yaʿmalūna They are of diverse ranks with God; and verily God beholdeth what (all) they do. Faith as well as infidelity has varying degrees of reward and punishment from God. As all the righteous are not of one and the same level, infidelity or evil has also got various degrees of gravity.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:164 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ laqad manna l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna idh baʿatha fīhim rasūlan min anfusihim yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wa-in kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālin mubīnin Allah certainly favoured the faithful when He raised up among them an apostle from among themselves to recite to them His signs and to purify them, and to teach them the Book and wisdom, and earlier they had indeed been in manifest error.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:164 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ laqad manna l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna idh baʿatha fīhim rasūlan min anfusihim yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wa-in kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālin mubīnin Certainly did Allah confer (great) favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) and wisdom,1 although they had been before in manifest error. See 3:159

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:164 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ laqad manna l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna idh baʿatha fīhim rasūlan min anfusihim yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wa-in kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālin mubīnin Indeed God hath conferred His favour upon the believers when He raised up an apostle Recite (Muhammad) among them from their own selves, to rehearse (Recite.) unto them His signs, and to purify them (Ahl Al-Bayt not included were purified by the God himself. Refer to Verse 33:33.) , and to teach them the Book (Qur'an) and Wisdom; though before this they were in manifest error (Refer to Verses 2:129, 2:151, 49:17, 62:2.) . The people who assist the Holy Prophet and suffer for the cause of Islam need not…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:165 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّى هَذَا قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ awalammā aṣābatkum muṣībatun qad aṣabtum mith'layhā qul'tum annā hādhā qul huwa min ʿindi anfusikum inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun What, when an affliction visits you —while you have inflicted twice as much— do you say, 'How is this?'! Say, 'This is from your own souls.' Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:165 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّى هَذَا قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ awalammā aṣābatkum muṣībatun qad aṣabtum mith'layhā qul'tum annā hādhā qul huwa min ʿindi anfusikum inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Why (is it that) when a (single) disaster struck you (on the day of Uḥud), although you had struck (the enemy in the battle of Badr) with one twice as great, you said, "From where is this?" Say, "It is from yourselves (i.e., due to your sin)." Indeed, Allah is over all things competent. (What is the matter with you?) When a single disaster smites you, although you smote (your enemies) with one twice as great, you say: From where does this come to us?" Say, "It is from yourselves." And Allah has power over all things (3:165). And what…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:165 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّى هَذَا قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ awalammā aṣābatkum muṣībatun qad aṣabtum mith'layhā qul'tum annā hādhā qul huwa min ʿindi anfusikum inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun What! When a misfortune befell you (at Uhud) while ye had already inflicted twice as much (on the disbelievers)', ye said "Whence is this?" Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "this is from your selves; Verily God hath power over all things." The infidels had suffered twice as much-once in Badr and again at Uhud. There were many half-hearted converts to Islam who began to waver after the disaster of Uhud. Their faith resembled that of those who followed Moses who doubted and returned to infidelity at the slightest untoward happening or at their facing any difficult situation. The disaster was…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:166 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā aṣābakum yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni fabi-idh'ni l-lahi waliyaʿlama l-mu'minīna What befell you on the day when the two hosts met, was by Allah's permission, so that He may ascertain the faithful,

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:166 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā aṣābakum yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni fabi-idh'ni l-lahi waliyaʿlama l-mu'minīna And what struck you on the day the two armies met (at Uḥud) was by permission of Allah that He might make evident the (true) believers. See 3:165

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:166 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā aṣābakum yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni fabi-idh'ni l-lahi waliyaʿlama l-mu'minīna And what befell you on the day when the two hosts met, was by God's permission and that He might know (Distinguish.) (test) the believers. ('That God may know')-i.e., that God might make it known-or obvious to the others.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:167 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوْۤا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا قَاتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوِ ادْفَعُوْۤا قَالُوْا لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَاتَّبَعْنَاكُمْ هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمَانِ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْواهِهِمْ مَا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُونَ waliyaʿlama alladhīna nāfaqū waqīla lahum taʿālaw qātilū fī sabīli l-lahi awi id'faʿū qālū law naʿlamu qitālan la-ittabaʿnākum hum lil'kuf'ri yawma-idhin aqrabu min'hum lil'īmāni yaqūlūna bi-afwāhihim mā laysa fī qulūbihim wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yaktumūna and ascertain the hypocrites. [When] they were told: 'Come, fight in the way of Allah, or defend [yourselves], they said, 'If we knew any fighting, surely we would have followed you.' That day they were nearer to unfaith than to faith. They say with their mouths what is not in their hearts, and Allah knows best whatever they conceal.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:167 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوْۤا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا قَاتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوِ ادْفَعُوْۤا قَالُوْا لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَاتَّبَعْنَاكُمْ هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمَانِ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْواهِهِمْ مَا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُونَ waliyaʿlama alladhīna nāfaqū waqīla lahum taʿālaw qātilū fī sabīli l-lahi awi id'faʿū qālū law naʿlamu qitālan la-ittabaʿnākum hum lil'kuf'ri yawma-idhin aqrabu min'hum lil'īmāni yaqūlūna bi-afwāhihim mā laysa fī qulūbihim wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yaktumūna And that He might make evident those who are hypocrites. For it was said to them, "Come, fight in the way of Allah or (at least) defend." They said, "If we had known (there would be) battle, we would have followed you." They were nearer to disbelief that day than to faith, saying with their mouths what was not in their hearts. And Allah is most knowing of what they conceal. See 3:165

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:167 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوْۤا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا قَاتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوِ ادْفَعُوْۤا قَالُوْا لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَاتَّبَعْنَاكُمْ هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمَانِ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْواهِهِمْ مَا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُونَ waliyaʿlama alladhīna nāfaqū waqīla lahum taʿālaw qātilū fī sabīli l-lahi awi id'faʿū qālū law naʿlamu qitālan la-ittabaʿnākum hum lil'kuf'ri yawma-idhin aqrabu min'hum lil'īmāni yaqūlūna bi-afwāhihim mā laysa fī qulūbihim wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yaktumūna And that He might know (Distinguish.) the hypocrites (There were three groups of the people 1) The believers 2) The Dis-believers 3) The Hypocrites. But there is no mention at all of the third group the hypocrites after the Holy prophet. There is a complete chapter on the hypocrites' chap 63. Is it that they waited for the departure of the Holy Prophet and at it they all became sincere believers or at any…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:168 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالُوْا لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ وَقَعَدُوْۤا لَوْ أَطَاعُونَا مَا قُتِلُوْۤا قُلْ فَادْرَءُوا عَنْ أَنْفُسِكُمُ الْمَوْتَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ alladhīna qālū li-ikh'wānihim waqaʿadū law aṭāʿūnā mā qutilū qul fa-id'raū ʿan anfusikumu l-mawta in kuntum ṣādiqīna Those who said of their brethren, while they themselves sat back: 'Had they obeyed us, they would not have been killed.' Say, 'Then keep death off from yourselves, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:168 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالُوْا لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ وَقَعَدُوْۤا لَوْ أَطَاعُونَا مَا قُتِلُوْۤا قُلْ فَادْرَءُوا عَنْ أَنْفُسِكُمُ الْمَوْتَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ alladhīna qālū li-ikh'wānihim waqaʿadū law aṭāʿūnā mā qutilū qul fa-id'raū ʿan anfusikumu l-mawta in kuntum ṣādiqīna Those who said about their brothers while sitting (at home), "If they had obeyed us, they would not have been killed." Say, "Then prevent death from yourselves, if you should be truthful." See 3:165

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:168 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالُوْا لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ وَقَعَدُوْۤا لَوْ أَطَاعُونَا مَا قُتِلُوْۤا قُلْ فَادْرَءُوا عَنْ أَنْفُسِكُمُ الْمَوْتَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ alladhīna qālū li-ikh'wānihim waqaʿadū law aṭāʿūnā mā qutilū qul fa-id'raū ʿan anfusikumu l-mawta in kuntum ṣādiqīna (These are those) who said unto their brethren while themselves sat (at home) "Had they (the Martyrs) obeyed us, they had not been slain;" Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Ward off' from yourselves death if ye be truthful." The hypocrites taunted against the martyrs of Uhud that if they (the martyrs) had stayed behind with them obeying them (the hypocrites) they would not have been killed. It is obvious by these verses, under what a hostile atmosphere, both openly and concealed, the Holy Prophet carried out his mission.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:169 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يُرْزَقُونَ walā taḥsabanna alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi amwātan bal aḥyāon ʿinda rabbihim yur'zaqūna Do not suppose those who were slain in the way of Allah to be dead; rather they are living and provided for near their Lord,

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:169 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يُرْزَقُونَ walā taḥsabanna alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi amwātan bal aḥyāon ʿinda rabbihim yur'zaqūna And never think of those who have been killed in the cause of Allah as dead. Rather, they are alive with their Lord, receiving provision. (169. Think not of those as dead who are killed in the way of Allah. Nay, they are alive, with their Lord, and they have provision.)(170. They rejoice in what Allah has bestowed upon them of His bounty and rejoice for the sake of those who have not yet joined them, but are left behind (not yet martyred) that on them no fear shall come, nor shall they grieve.)(171. They rejoice in a grace and a bounty from Allah, and that Allah will not waste the reward of the…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:169 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يُرْزَقُونَ walā taḥsabanna alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi amwātan bal aḥyāon ʿinda rabbihim yur'zaqūna Reckon not those who are slain in the way of God, to be dead; Nay! alive (Thus, the honour or Salutation to the martyrs is not the honour and salutation to the dead but to the alive.) they are with their Lord being sustained. This Verse establishes beyond all doubts, the immortality of those who lay down their lives in the way of God, their being alive and getting their sustenance from their Lord. It is a clear and a plain reply to answer the critics against honouring those who have died in God's way. The Ahmadi commentator has quietly passed over this Verse without any interpretation for the meaning is too obvious and…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:170 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرِحِينَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَيَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَلْحَقُوْۤا بِهِمْ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ fariḥīna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi wayastabshirūna bi-alladhīna lam yalḥaqū bihim min khalfihim allā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna exulting in what Allah has given them out of His grace, and rejoicing for those who have not yet joined them from [those left] behind them that they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:170 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرِحِينَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَيَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَلْحَقُوْۤا بِهِمْ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ fariḥīna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi wayastabshirūna bi-alladhīna lam yalḥaqū bihim min khalfihim allā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Rejoicing in what Allah has bestowed upon them of His bounty, and they receive good tidings about those (to be martyred) after them who have not yet joined them - that there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve. See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:170 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرِحِينَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَيَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَلْحَقُوْۤا بِهِمْ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ fariḥīna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi wayastabshirūna bi-alladhīna lam yalḥaqū bihim min khalfihim allā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Rejoicing in what God of His Grace hath granted them, rejoicing for those who have not yet joined them from behind them, that no fear shall come on them nor shall they grieve. See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:171 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ yastabshirūna biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin wa-anna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-mu'minīna They rejoice in Allah's blessing and grace, and that Allah does not waste the reward of the faithful.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:171 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ yastabshirūna biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin wa-anna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-mu'minīna They receive good tidings of favor from Allah and bounty and (of the fact) that Allah does not allow the reward of believers to be lost. See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:171 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ yastabshirūna biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin wa-anna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-mu'minīna They rejoice in the Grace (What they have received from the Lord.) from God and (His) bounty (The realisation of God's reward for all believers.) and in fact, God suffereth not to be lost the reward of the Believers. See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:172 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّقَوْا أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ alladhīna is'tajābū lillahi wal-rasūli min baʿdi mā aṣābahumu l-qarḥu lilladhīna aḥsanū min'hum wa-ittaqaw ajrun ʿaẓīmun Those who responded to Allah and the Apostle [even] after they had been wounded —for those of them who have been virtuous and Godwary there shall be a great reward.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:172 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّقَوْا أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ alladhīna is'tajābū lillahi wal-rasūli min baʿdi mā aṣābahumu l-qarḥu lilladhīna aḥsanū min'hum wa-ittaqaw ajrun ʿaẓīmun Those (believers) who responded to Allah and the Messenger after injury had struck them. For those who did good among them and feared Allah is a great reward. See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:172 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّقَوْا أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ alladhīna is'tajābū lillahi wal-rasūli min baʿdi mā aṣābahumu l-qarḥu lilladhīna aḥsanū min'hum wa-ittaqaw ajrun ʿaẓīmun (As far) those who did respond (Read this in the light of Verses 3:138, 3:143 and 3:152 with the notes thereon.) to the call of God and the Apostle (Muhammad) (even) after wounds inflicted on them; such of those who do good (to others) and guard (them-selves) against evil, shall have a great reward. The Muslims pursued the Meccan army to about eight miles away to a place, 'Hamra al-Asad.' The Meccans in spite of their overwhelming numbers, dared not to encounter the Muslims, this could not be but by the heavenly awe caused for the purpose.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:173 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوْۤا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوْۤا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ alladhīna qāla lahumu l-nāsu inna l-nāsa qad jamaʿū lakum fa-ikh'shawhum fazādahum īmānan waqālū ḥasbunā l-lahu waniʿ'ma l-wakīlu Those to whom the people said, 'All the people have gathered against you; so fear them.' That only increased them in faith, and they said, 'Allah is sufficient for us, and He is an excellent trustee.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:173 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوْۤا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوْۤا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ alladhīna qāla lahumu l-nāsu inna l-nāsa qad jamaʿū lakum fa-ikh'shawhum fazādahum īmānan waqālū ḥasbunā l-lahu waniʿ'ma l-wakīlu Those to whom people (i.e., hypocrites) said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it (merely) increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allah, and (He is) the best Disposer of affairs."1 See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:173 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوْۤا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوْۤا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ alladhīna qāla lahumu l-nāsu inna l-nāsa qad jamaʿū lakum fa-ikh'shawhum fazādahum īmānan waqālū ḥasbunā l-lahu waniʿ'ma l-wakīlu Those unto whom said the people (Read this in the light of Verses 3:138, 3:143 and 3:152 with the notes thereon.) , "Verily have the people mustered (strong) against you, therefore fear them!" It only increased their faith; and said they, "God is (quite) sufficient for us and the most excellent Protector is (He)." While retreating Abu-Sufyan the chief of the Meccan army had challenged to attack next year at Badr. The challenge was accepted by 'Ali saying, 'God is sufficient for us.' At the appointed time the Holy Prophet went out with his followers to meet the Meccans, but they did not appear.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:174 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْقَلَبُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ وَاتَّبَعُوا رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَظِيمٍ fa-inqalabū biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin lam yamsashum sūon wa-ittabaʿū riḍ'wāna l-lahi wal-lahu dhū faḍlin ʿaẓīmin So they returned with Allah's blessing and grace, untouched by any evil. They pursued the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:174 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْقَلَبُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ وَاتَّبَعُوا رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَظِيمٍ fa-inqalabū biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin lam yamsashum sūon wa-ittabaʿū riḍ'wāna l-lahi wal-lahu dhū faḍlin ʿaẓīmin So they returned with favor from Allah and bounty, no harm having touched them. And they pursued the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty. See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:174 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْقَلَبُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ وَاتَّبَعُوا رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَظِيمٍ fa-inqalabū biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin lam yamsashum sūon wa-ittabaʿū riḍ'wāna l-lahi wal-lahu dhū faḍlin ʿaẓīmin They returned, therefore, with the favour from God and (His) Grace. Without any evil even touching them and they followed the pleasure of God; and God is the Lord of Mighty Grace. See 3:173

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:175 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا ذَلِكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ innamā dhālikumu l-shayṭānu yukhawwifu awliyāahu falā takhāfūhum wakhāfūni in kuntum mu'minīna That is only Satan frightening his followers! So fear them not, and fear Me, should you be faithful.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:175 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا ذَلِكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ innamā dhālikumu l-shayṭānu yukhawwifu awliyāahu falā takhāfūhum wakhāfūni in kuntum mu'minīna That is only Satan who frightens (you) of his supporters. So fear them not, but fear Me, if you are (indeed) believers. See 3:169

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:175 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا ذَلِكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ innamā dhālikumu l-shayṭānu yukhawwifu awliyāahu falā takhāfūhum wakhāfūni in kuntum mu'minīna It is only that Satan frighteneth (Against Supporting the Holy Prophet.) his friends (against supporting the Prophet), Fear them not! but fear ye Me! If ye be (true) believers (Refer to Verses 3:138, 3:143 and 3:152.) . See 3:173

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:176 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ walā yaḥzunka alladhīna yusāriʿūna fī l-kuf'ri innahum lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan yurīdu l-lahu allā yajʿala lahum ḥaẓẓan fī l-ākhirati walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Do not grieve for those who are active in unfaith; they will not hurt Allah in the least: Allah desires to give them no share in the Hereafter, and there is a great punishment for them.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:176 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ walā yaḥzunka alladhīna yusāriʿūna fī l-kuf'ri innahum lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan yurīdu l-lahu allā yajʿala lahum ḥaẓẓan fī l-ākhirati walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun And do not be grieved, (O Muḥammad), by those who hasten into disbelief. Indeed, they will never harm Allah at all. Allah intends that He should give them no share in the Hereafter, and for them is a great punishment. (176. And let not those grieve you who rush with haste to disbelieve; verily, not the least harm will they do to Allah. It is Allah's will to give them no portion in the Hereafter. For them there is a great torment.)(177. Verily, those who purchase disbelief at the price of faith, not the least harm…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:176 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ walā yaḥzunka alladhīna yusāriʿūna fī l-kuf'ri innahum lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan yurīdu l-lahu allā yajʿala lahum ḥaẓẓan fī l-ākhirati walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Let not those grieve thee, who vie in haste in infidelity, verily, never shall they harm God one whit; God intendeth that He assigneth not for them any share in the life hereafter; For them is a great chastisement. This is a prophetic assurance to the Holy Prophet that the people who aid the infidels will never be successful in inflicting any loss either to the cause of God, i.e., Islam or to the Holy Prophet himself.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:177 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الْكُفْرَ بِالْإِيمَانِ لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna ish'tarawū l-kuf'ra bil-īmāni lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Those who have bought unfaith for faith will not hurt Allah in the least, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:177 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الْكُفْرَ بِالْإِيمَانِ لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna ish'tarawū l-kuf'ra bil-īmāni lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Indeed, those who purchase disbelief (in exchange) for faith - never will they harm Allah at all, and for them is a painful punishment. See 3:176

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:177 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الْكُفْرَ بِالْإِيمَانِ لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna ish'tarawū l-kuf'ra bil-īmāni lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Verily those who purchase (Refer to Verse 3:185.) infidelity at the cost of faith, never shall they harm God one whit! For them is a painful chastisement. See 3:176

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:178 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّمَا نُمْلِي لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ إِنَّمَا نُمْلِي لَهُمْ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِثْمًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū annamā num'lī lahum khayrun li-anfusihim innamā num'lī lahum liyazdādū ith'man walahum ʿadhābun muhīnun Let the faithless not suppose that the respite that We grant them is good for their souls: We give them respite only that they may increase in sin, and there is a humiliating punishment for them.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:178 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّمَا نُمْلِي لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ إِنَّمَا نُمْلِي لَهُمْ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِثْمًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū annamā num'lī lahum khayrun li-anfusihim innamā num'lī lahum liyazdādū ith'man walahum ʿadhābun muhīnun And let not those who disbelieve ever think that (because) We extend their time (of enjoyment) it is better for them. We only extend it for them so that they may increase in sin, and for them is a humiliating punishment. See 3:176

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:178 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّمَا نُمْلِي لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ إِنَّمَا نُمْلِي لَهُمْ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِثْمًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū annamā num'lī lahum khayrun li-anfusihim innamā num'lī lahum liyazdādū ith'man walahum ʿadhābun muhīnun Let not those who disbelieve think that our giving them respite is good for their selves; We only give respite to them that they may increase in sins, and for them is a disgraceful chastisement. Let not the believers be beguiled by the infidels prospering in any way in this world, if they do, thinking that they are blessed by God, or their infidelity has been neglected by God. Their prosperity is nothing but an opportunity to them, to increase their infidelity as much as they might like to do. The ultimate end of all that, will be a disgraceful chastisement. It is just to allow…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:179 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ حَتّٰی يَمِيزَ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْتَبِي مِنْ رُسُلِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا فَلَكُمْ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ mā kāna l-lahu liyadhara l-mu'minīna ʿalā mā antum ʿalayhi ḥattā yamīza l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wamā kāna l-lahu liyuṭ'liʿakum ʿalā l-ghaybi walākinna l-laha yajtabī min rusulihi man yashāu faāminū bil-lahi warusulihi wa-in tu'minū watattaqū falakum ajrun ʿaẓīmun Allah will not leave the faithful in your present state, until He has separated the bad ones from the good. Allah will not acquaint you with the Unseen, but Allah chooses from His apostles whomever He wishes. So have faith in Allah and His apostles; and if you are faithful and Godwary, there shall be a great reward for you.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:179 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ حَتّٰی يَمِيزَ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْتَبِي مِنْ رُسُلِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا فَلَكُمْ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ mā kāna l-lahu liyadhara l-mu'minīna ʿalā mā antum ʿalayhi ḥattā yamīza l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wamā kāna l-lahu liyuṭ'liʿakum ʿalā l-ghaybi walākinna l-laha yajtabī min rusulihi man yashāu faāminū bil-lahi warusulihi wa-in tu'minū watattaqū falakum ajrun ʿaẓīmun Allah would not leave the believers in that (state) you are in (presently) until He separates the evil from the good. Nor would Allah reveal to you the unseen. But (instead), Allah chooses of His messengers whom He wills, so believe in Allah and His messengers. And if you believe and fear Him, then for you is a great reward. See 3:176

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:179 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ حَتّٰی يَمِيزَ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْتَبِي مِنْ رُسُلِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا فَلَكُمْ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ mā kāna l-lahu liyadhara l-mu'minīna ʿalā mā antum ʿalayhi ḥattā yamīza l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wamā kāna l-lahu liyuṭ'liʿakum ʿalā l-ghaybi walākinna l-laha yajtabī min rusulihi man yashāu faāminū bil-lahi warusulihi wa-in tu'minū watattaqū falakum ajrun ʿaẓīmun It is not for God to leave the believers in the state in which ye are, until He hath distinguished (Refer to Verse 8:37.) the wicked (Ar. 'Khabees' The impure.) from the good (Ar. 'Tayyab' The pure.) and it is not for God to acquaint you with the unseen; But God chooseth from the Apostles whomsoever He pleaseth. So ye believe then in God and His apostles: and…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:180 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ بَلْ هُوَ شَرٌّ لَهُمْ سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُوْۤا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna yabkhalūna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi huwa khayran lahum bal huwa sharrun lahum sayuṭawwaqūna mā bakhilū bihi yawma l-qiyāmati walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun Let the stingy not suppose that [their grudging] what Allah has given them out of His grace is good for them; rather it is bad for them. They will be collared with what they grudge on the Day of Resurrection. To Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:180 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ بَلْ هُوَ شَرٌّ لَهُمْ سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُوْۤا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna yabkhalūna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi huwa khayran lahum bal huwa sharrun lahum sayuṭawwaqūna mā bakhilū bihi yawma l-qiyāmati walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun And let not those who (greedily) withhold what Allah has given them of His bounty ever think that it is better for them. Rather, it is worse for them. Their necks will be encircled by what they withheld on the Day of Resurrection. And to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, of what you do, is (fully) Aware. See 3:176

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:180 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ بَلْ هُوَ شَرٌّ لَهُمْ سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُوْۤا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna yabkhalūna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi huwa khayran lahum bal huwa sharrun lahum sayuṭawwaqūna mā bakhilū bihi yawma l-qiyāmati walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun And let not those who are niggardly in giving what God hath granted them of His Grace, reckon it is good for them; Nay! it is bad for them; That which they have been niggardly of, shall shortly be clung to their necks on the Day of Resurrection; And God's (alone) is the heritage of the heavens and the earth, And Verily God, of what ye do, is fully aware (Refer to Verses 3:115; 3:183; 9:36.) . The condemnation of…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:181 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَقِيرٌ وَنَحْنُ أَغْنِيَاءُ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَالُوْا وَقَتْلَهُمُ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَنَقُولُ ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ laqad samiʿa l-lahu qawla alladhīna qālū inna l-laha faqīrun wanaḥnu aghniyāu sanaktubu mā qālū waqatlahumu l-anbiyāa bighayri ḥaqqin wanaqūlu dhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi Allah has certainly heard the remark of those who said, 'Allah is poor and we are rich.' We will record what they have said, and their killing of the prophets unjustly,1 and We shall say, 'Taste the punishment of the burning.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:181 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَقِيرٌ وَنَحْنُ أَغْنِيَاءُ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَالُوْا وَقَتْلَهُمُ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَنَقُولُ ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ laqad samiʿa l-lahu qawla alladhīna qālū inna l-laha faqīrun wanaḥnu aghniyāu sanaktubu mā qālū waqatlahumu l-anbiyāa bighayri ḥaqqin wanaqūlu dhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi Allah has certainly heard the statement of those (Jews) who said, "Indeed, Allah is poor, while we are rich." We will record what they said and their killing of the prophets without right and will say, "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire. Indeed, Allah has heard the statement of those who say: "Truly, Allah is poor and we are rich!" We shall record what they have said and their killing of the Prophets unjustly, and We shall say: "Taste you the torment of the burning (Fire) (3:181). This is because of that which your hands…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:181 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَقِيرٌ وَنَحْنُ أَغْنِيَاءُ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَالُوْا وَقَتْلَهُمُ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَنَقُولُ ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ laqad samiʿa l-lahu qawla alladhīna qālū inna l-laha faqīrun wanaḥnu aghniyāu sanaktubu mā qālū waqatlahumu l-anbiyāa bighayri ḥaqqin wanaqūlu dhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi Surely hath God heard the saying of those who say "Aye, God is poor, and we are rich (This is the Jewish mentality and attitude which is true of people attaching importance to temporal possessions, power and wealth who fail to value the Spiritual and Godly force and power. Refer to Verses 2:247; 5:64; 47:38.) " Certainly, shall we record what they say and their slaying the Prophets unjustly and We shall say "Taste ye the torment of burning." Charity or spending money to help the cause of truth or to help the needy is metaphysically…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:182 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi That is because of what your hands have sent ahead, and because Allah is not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:182 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to (His) servants." See 3:181

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:182 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi This, is for what your (own) hands have forwarded before you and because God is not (in the least) unjust to (the) servants. Here the infidels are warned saying: 'do not think that your evil deeds end here and have no echo in your life hereafter. God is All-Just every evil doer shall be duly punished.' "Whoso doeth right it is for his self and who doeth wrong it is against it. And thy Lord is not at all a tyrant to His slaves." (41:46) "Whoso doeth right, it is for his self, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And then unto your Lord ye will be brought back." (45:15) "And whoso doeth good of an atom's weight will see…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:183 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتّٰی يَأْتِيَنَا بِقُرْبَانٍ تَأْكُلُهُ النَّارُ قُلْ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِي بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالَّذِي قُلْتُمْ فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوهُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ alladhīna qālū inna l-laha ʿahida ilaynā allā nu'mina lirasūlin ḥattā yatiyanā biqur'bānin takuluhu l-nāru qul qad jāakum rusulun min qablī bil-bayināti wabi-alladhī qul'tum falima qataltumūhum in kuntum ṣādiqīna [To] those who say, 'Allah has pledged us not to believe in any apostle unless he brings us an offering consumed by fire,' say, 'Apostles before me certainly brought you manifest signs and what you speak of. Then why did you kill them, should you be truthful?'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:183 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتّٰی يَأْتِيَنَا بِقُرْبَانٍ تَأْكُلُهُ النَّارُ قُلْ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِي بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالَّذِي قُلْتُمْ فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوهُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ alladhīna qālū inna l-laha ʿahida ilaynā allā nu'mina lirasūlin ḥattā yatiyanā biqur'bānin takuluhu l-nāru qul qad jāakum rusulun min qablī bil-bayināti wabi-alladhī qul'tum falima qataltumūhum in kuntum ṣādiqīna (They are) those who said, "Indeed, Allah has taken our promise not to believe any messenger until he brings us an offering which fire (from heaven) will consume." Say, "There have already come to you messengers before me with clear proofs and (even) that of which you speak. So why did you kill them, if you should be truthful?" See 3:181

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:183 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتّٰی يَأْتِيَنَا بِقُرْبَانٍ تَأْكُلُهُ النَّارُ قُلْ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِي بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالَّذِي قُلْتُمْ فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوهُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ alladhīna qālū inna l-laha ʿahida ilaynā allā nu'mina lirasūlin ḥattā yatiyanā biqur'bānin takuluhu l-nāru qul qad jāakum rusulun min qablī bil-bayināti wabi-alladhī qul'tum falima qataltumūhum in kuntum ṣādiqīna (To those) who say, "Verily God hath covenanted with us that we believe not in any apostle until he presenteth to us an offering which is devoured by fire (from heaven)', Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Indeed did come unto you apostles before me with miracles and with that which ye (now) said; Why then did ye slay them? if ye be truthful (Refer to Verse 35:25.) ." The Mosaic law had burnt offerings Lev. 1/9. Lev. 8/18, Deut. 33/10. "But his inwards and…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:184 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ جَاءُو بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ fa-in kadhabūka faqad kudhiba rusulun min qablika jāū bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wal-kitābi l-munīri But if they deny you, then before you [other] apostles have been denied, who came with manifest signs, holy writs, and an illuminating scripture.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:184 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ جَاءُو بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ fa-in kadhabūka faqad kudhiba rusulun min qablika jāū bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wal-kitābi l-munīri Then if they deny you, (O Muḥammad) - so were messengers denied before you, who brought clear proofs and written ordinances and the enlightening Scripture.1 See 3:181

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:184 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ جَاءُو بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ fa-in kadhabūka faqad kudhiba rusulun min qablika jāū bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wal-kitābi l-munīri And if they belie thee; then verily have already been belied apostles before thee (who) came with clear evidences (miracles) and the scriptures and the illuminating Book (The Book of one and the same. All the different Scriptures are the various aspects or the versions of one and the same Universal Book. Refer to verse 15:1.) . 'Zabur', the Scriptures given to Apostles of God and the illuminating Book may be the 'Torah' given to Moses and 'Evangel' given to Jesus which contained clear guidance.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:185 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ أُجُورَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wa-innamā tuwaffawna ujūrakum yawma l-qiyāmati faman zuḥ'ziḥa ʿani l-nāri wa-ud'khila l-janata faqad fāza wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri Every soul shall taste death, and you will indeed be paid your full rewards on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever is delivered from the Fire and admitted to paradise has certainly succeeded. The life of this world is nothing but the wares of delusion.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:185 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ أُجُورَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wa-innamā tuwaffawna ujūrakum yawma l-qiyāmati faman zuḥ'ziḥa ʿani l-nāri wa-ud'khila l-janata faqad fāza wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri Every soul will taste death, and you will only be given your (full) compensation on the Day of Resurrection. So he who is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has attained (his desire). And what is the life of this world except the enjoyment of delusion. Everyone shall taste death. And only on the Day of Resurrection shall you be paid your wages in full. And whoever is moved away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise, he indeed is successful. The life of this world is only the enjoyment of…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:185 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ أُجُورَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wa-innamā tuwaffawna ujūrakum yawma l-qiyāmati faman zuḥ'ziḥa ʿani l-nāri wa-ud'khila l-janata faqad fāza wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri Every self-tastes (Everything besides God is ever undergoing change after change. Thus, everything save God is ever tasting death. Nothing besides God is permanent or stationary in its existence. Permanence absolute is only for God and for none besides Him.) death; and verily ye shall be paid in full your recompenses on the Day of Resurrection; and whoso is removed away from the (Hell) fire and admitted into Paradise, has indeed gained his object; and the life of this world is not, but a provision of vanity (Ar. 'Ghoroor'.) . 'Kullu nafsin' - A…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:186 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَتُبْلَوُنَّ فِي أَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا أَذًى كَثِيرًا وَإِنْ تَصْبِرُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا فَإِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ latub'lawunna fī amwālikum wa-anfusikum walatasmaʿunna mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum wamina alladhīna ashrakū adhan kathīran wa-in taṣbirū watattaqū fa-inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūri You will surely be tested in your possessions and your souls, and you will surely hear from those who were given the Book before you and from the polytheists much affront; but if you are patient and Godwary, that is indeed the steadiest of courses.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:186 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَتُبْلَوُنَّ فِي أَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا أَذًى كَثِيرًا وَإِنْ تَصْبِرُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا فَإِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ latub'lawunna fī amwālikum wa-anfusikum walatasmaʿunna mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum wamina alladhīna ashrakū adhan kathīran wa-in taṣbirū watattaqū fa-inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūri You will surely be tested in your possessions and in yourselves. And you will surely hear from those who were given the Scripture before you and from those who associate others with Allah much abuse. But if you are patient and fear Allah - indeed, that is of the matters (worthy) of resolve. See 3:185

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:186 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَتُبْلَوُنَّ فِي أَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا أَذًى كَثِيرًا وَإِنْ تَصْبِرُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا فَإِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ latub'lawunna fī amwālikum wa-anfusikum walatasmaʿunna mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum wamina alladhīna ashrakū adhan kathīran wa-in taṣbirū watattaqū fa-inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūri Certainly ye shall be tried in your possessions and in your (own) selves; and certainly ye shall hear from those who have been given the Book before you and those who join other gods with God, much annoyance; and if ye be patient and guard yourselves (against evil) then verily that is a matter of (very great) resolve (Result of firm determination of affairs.) . This happened and is still happening in a constitutional way-Muslims are still persecuted and their properties confiscated, their lives have been mercilessly taken for their merely being…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:187 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَكْتُمُونَهُ فَنَبَذُوهُ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَاشْتَرَوْا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَبِئْسَ مَا يَشْتَرُونَ wa-idh akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba latubayyinunnahu lilnnāsi walā taktumūnahu fanabadhūhu warāa ẓuhūrihim wa-ish'taraw bihi thamanan qalīlan fabi'sa mā yashtarūna When Allah made a covenant with those who were given the Book: 'You shall explain it for the people, and you shall not conceal it,' they cast it behind their backs and sold it for a paltry gain. How evil is what they buy!

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:187 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَكْتُمُونَهُ فَنَبَذُوهُ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَاشْتَرَوْا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَبِئْسَ مَا يَشْتَرُونَ wa-idh akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba latubayyinunnahu lilnnāsi walā taktumūnahu fanabadhūhu warāa ẓuhūrihim wa-ish'taraw bihi thamanan qalīlan fabi'sa mā yashtarūna And (mention, O Muḥammad), when Allah took a covenant from those who were given the Scripture, (saying), "You must make it clear (i.e., explain it) to the people and not conceal it." But they threw it away behind their backs and exchanged it for a small price. And wretched is that which they purchased. (And remember) when Allah took a covenant from those who were given the Scripture (Jews and Christians) to make it (the truth) known and clear to mankind, and not to hide it, but they threw it away behind their backs, and purchased with it…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:187 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَكْتُمُونَهُ فَنَبَذُوهُ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَاشْتَرَوْا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَبِئْسَ مَا يَشْتَرُونَ wa-idh akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba latubayyinunnahu lilnnāsi walā taktumūnahu fanabadhūhu warāa ẓuhūrihim wa-ish'taraw bihi thamanan qalīlan fabi'sa mā yashtarūna And (Recall thou O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) when God took a pledge (Compare this to the pledge taken from the Muslims at 'Ghadir Khumm' under Verse 5:67.) from those who were given the Book; "Ye shall surely make it known to mankind and ye shall not hide it (The Book.) ; then they cast it behind their backs and bought (Exchanged it for a small return.) therewith a small price (See Verse 176.) ; How bad (then is what they purchase (Bargain.) )." Refers to those who had been given the Scriptures viz. the Jews and Christians. The…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:188 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوْۤا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوْۤا فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّهُمْ بِمَفَازَةٍ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ lā taḥsabanna alladhīna yafraḥūna bimā ataw wayuḥibbūna an yuḥ'madū bimā lam yafʿalū falā taḥsabannahum bimafāzatin mina l-ʿadhābi walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Do not suppose those who exult in what they have done, and love to be praised for what they have not done —do not suppose them saved from punishment, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:188 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوْۤا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوْۤا فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّهُمْ بِمَفَازَةٍ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ lā taḥsabanna alladhīna yafraḥūna bimā ataw wayuḥibbūna an yuḥ'madū bimā lam yafʿalū falā taḥsabannahum bimafāzatin mina l-ʿadhābi walahum ʿadhābun alīmun And never think that those who rejoice in what they have perpetrated and like to be praised for what they did not do - never think them (to be) in safety from the punishment, and for them is a painful punishment. See 3:187

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:188 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوْۤا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوْۤا فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّهُمْ بِمَفَازَةٍ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ lā taḥsabanna alladhīna yafraḥūna bimā ataw wayuḥibbūna an yuḥ'madū bimā lam yafʿalū falā taḥsabannahum bimafāzatin mina l-ʿadhābi walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Think not that those who rejoice for what they have brought on and love that they be praised for what they have not done, and think not that they would escape the chastisement; for them is a grievous torment (Compare to Verse 3:177.) . See 3:187

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:189 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:189 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things competent. See 3:187

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:189 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And God's (alone) is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and God hath power over all things (Refer to Verse 3:179.) . This Verse is a repeated assertion of the idea given in the concluding words of Verse 179. This idea has been repeatedly mentioned at the end of many other verses to sink it deep into the minds of men and women that there is none for them to worship except God who alone is the Creator Lord Master of the whole universe.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:190 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ inna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri laāyātin li-ulī l-albābi Indeed in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those who possess intellects.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:190 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ inna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri laāyātin li-ulī l-albābi Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding. Verily, in the creation of the heavens and the Earth, and in the alternation of night and day, there are indeed signs for men of understanding (3:190). Those who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying down on their sides, and think deeply about the creation of the heavens and the earth, (saying): "Our Lord! You have not created this without purpose, glory to You! Give us salvation from the torment of the Fire (3:191). "Our Lord! Verily, whom You admit to the Fire, indeed, You have disgraced him; and never will the wrongdoers…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:190 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ inna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri laāyātin li-ulī l-albābi Verily, in the creation of the heavens and the earth a nd the alternation of the night and the day, there are signs for men who possess wisdom. Though the attention insisted towards the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the change with night and day, seem to be very simple but the awakened mind, particularly of the scientists with the knowledge of the heavenly bodies and the constellations and those who are busy in their study of the deposits of the earth etc., know the significance of this drawing of the attention towards the factors mentioned in this Verse.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:191 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَى جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ alladhīna yadhkurūna l-laha qiyāman waquʿūdan waʿalā junūbihim wayatafakkarūna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan sub'ḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāba l-nāri Those who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth [and say], 'Our Lord, You have not created this in vain! Immaculate are You! Save us from the punishment of the Fire.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:191 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَى جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ alladhīna yadhkurūna l-laha qiyāman waquʿūdan waʿalā junūbihim wayatafakkarūna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan sub'ḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāba l-nāri Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or (lying) on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, (saying), "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You (above such a thing); then protect us from the punishment of the Fire. See 3:190

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:191 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَى جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ alladhīna yadhkurūna l-laha qiyāman waquʿūdan waʿalā junūbihim wayatafakkarūna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan sub'ḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāba l-nāri Those who remember God standing, and sitting and reclining on their sides and think (seriously) in the creation of the heaven and the earth, saying "O' Our Lord! Thou hast not created (all) this in vain! Glory be to Thee! Save us then from the torment of the (Hell) fire." Mark the high position of the sincerity and the adoration these worshippers have, in the view of God that the words of their utterance of His glory, have been absorbed as it were in the revelation. They remain so much wholly engrossed in remembering the Lord that every…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:192 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ rabbanā innaka man tud'khili l-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā lilẓẓālimīna min anṣārin Our Lord, whoever that You make enter the Fire will surely have been disgraced by You, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:192 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ rabbanā innaka man tud'khili l-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā lilẓẓālimīna min anṣārin Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. See 3:190

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:192 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ rabbanā innaka man tud'khili l-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā lilẓẓālimīna min anṣārin O' Our Lord! Whomsoever Thou causeth to enter the (Hell) fire, surely, Thou hast put him to disgrace; there is not, for the unjust, any of the helpers. These verses contain the words of the prayer of those mentioned in the preceding Verse.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:193 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَءَامَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ rabbanā innanā samiʿ'nā munādiyan yunādī lil'īmāni an āminū birabbikum faāmannā rabbanā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā wakaffir ʿannā sayyiātinā watawaffanā maʿa l-abrāri Our Lord, we have indeed heard a summoner calling to faith, declaring, "Have faith in your Lord!" So we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins and absolve us of our misdeeds, and make us die with the pious.

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:193 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَءَامَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ rabbanā innanā samiʿ'nā munādiyan yunādī lil'īmāni an āminū birabbikum faāmannā rabbanā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā wakaffir ʿannā sayyiātinā watawaffanā maʿa l-abrāri Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW) calling to faith, (saying), 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous. See 3:190

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:193 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَءَامَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ rabbanā innanā samiʿ'nā munādiyan yunādī lil'īmāni an āminū birabbikum faāmannā rabbanā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā wakaffir ʿannā sayyiātinā watawaffanā maʿa l-abrāri O' Our Lord! We have indeed heard the voice of a Crier (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) (Apostle), calling (us) unto faith, saying "Believe ye in your Lord!" and we did believe. O' Our Lord! therefore "Forgive us then our sins and remove away from us our evil deeds, and cause (Fulfil or conclude the term of life.) us to die with the virtuous ones. (Refer to Verses 23:109; 40:7; 3:16.) " See 3:192

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:194 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ rabbanā waātinā mā waʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukh'zinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukh'lifu l-mīʿāda Our Lord, give us what You have promised us through Your apostles, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed You do not break Your promise.'

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:194 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ rabbanā waātinā mā waʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukh'zinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukh'lifu l-mīʿāda Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in (Your) promise." See 3:190

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:194 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ rabbanā waātinā mā waʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukh'zinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukh'lifu l-mīʿāda O' Our Lord! and give us what Thou didst promise us through thy apostles, and disgrace us not on the Day of Resurrection; Verily, Thou breakest not Thy promise. See 3:192

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:195 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لَا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى بَعْضُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا وَأُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُوا وَقُتِلُوْۤا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ثَوَابًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ fa-is'tajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilin minkum min dhakarin aw unthā baʿḍukum min baʿḍin fa-alladhīna hājarū wa-ukh'rijū min diyārihim waūdhū fī sabīlī waqātalū waqutilū la-ukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiātihim wala-ud'khilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru thawāban min ʿindi l-lahi wal-lahu ʿindahu ḥus'nu l-thawābi Then their Lord answered them, 'I do not waste the work of any worker among you, whether male or female; you are all on the same footing. So those who migrated and were expelled from their homes, and were tormented in My way, and those who fought and were killed —I will surely absolve…

item.title: Aal-i-Imraan:195 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
