item.description: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ wazurūʿin wamaqāmin karīmin Fields and splendid places,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ wazurūʿin wamaqāmin karīmin And crops and noble sites. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ wazurūʿin wamaqāmin karīmin And cornfields and dwellings noble! See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْۤا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ wanaʿmatin kānū fīhā fākihīna and the bounties wherein they rejoiced!

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْۤا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ wanaʿmatin kānū fīhā fākihīna And comfort wherein they were amused. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْۤا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ wanaʿmatin kānū fīhā fākihīna And pleasant things in which they took delight! See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā qawman ākharīna So it was; and We bequeathed them to another people.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā qawman ākharīna Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā qawman ākharīna So was it: and We gave them as a heritage unto another people; See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْظَرِينَ famā bakat ʿalayhimu l-samāu wal-arḍu wamā kānū munẓarīna So neither the sky wept for them, nor the earth; nor were they granted any respite.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْظَرِينَ famā bakat ʿalayhimu l-samāu wal-arḍu wamā kānū munẓarīna And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْظَرِينَ famā bakat ʿalayhimu l-samāu wal-arḍu wamā kānū munẓarīna So wept (Note - heaven and earth weep but they do not weep on the wicked i.e., on the righteous they do - & they have done.) not on them the heavens and the earth nor were they respited. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ walaqad najjaynā banī is'rāīla mina l-ʿadhābi l-muhīni Certainly We delivered the Children of Israel from a humiliating torment,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ walaqad najjaynā banī is'rāīla mina l-ʿadhābi l-muhīni And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ walaqad najjaynā banī is'rāīla mina l-ʿadhābi l-muhīni And indeed delivered We the children of Israel from the degrading affliction, See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ min fir'ʿawna innahu kāna ʿāliyan mina l-mus'rifīna from Pharaoh. Indeed he was a tyrant among the profligates.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ min fir'ʿawna innahu kāna ʿāliyan mina l-mus'rifīna From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ min fir'ʿawna innahu kāna ʿāliyan mina l-mus'rifīna From Pharaoh: verily he was haughty, (and was one) of the extravagants. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ walaqadi ikh'tarnāhum ʿalā ʿil'min ʿalā l-ʿālamīna Certainly We chose them knowingly above all the nations.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ walaqadi ikh'tarnāhum ʿalā ʿil'min ʿalā l-ʿālamīna And We certainly chose them by knowledge over (all) the worlds. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ walaqadi ikh'tarnāhum ʿalā ʿil'min ʿalā l-ʿālamīna And indeed We chose them, with prescience, (With knowledge.) above all creatures (of their times); In choosing prophets from among them and having a greater number of prophets from among them. However this verse is governed and restricted by the verse 21:107. (A.P.)

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِیْهِ بَلَؤٌا مُبِينٌ waātaynāhum mina l-āyāti mā fīhi balāon mubīnun And We gave them some signs in which there was a manifest test.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِیْهِ بَلَؤٌا مُبِينٌ waātaynāhum mina l-āyāti mā fīhi balāon mubīnun And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial. See 44:17

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِیْهِ بَلَؤٌا مُبِينٌ waātaynāhum mina l-āyāti mā fīhi balāon mubīnun And gave We unto them of the signs wherein was a clear trial. See 44:32

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ inna hāulāi layaqūlūna Indeed these ones say,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ inna hāulāi layaqūlūna Indeed, these (disbelievers) are saying. Verily, these people are saying (44:34). "There is nothing but our first death, and we shall not be resurrected (44:35). "Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth! (44:36). Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them We destroyed them because they were indeed criminals (44:37). Refutation of Those Who Deny the Resurrection Here Allah denounces the idolators for their denial of the Resurrection and their belief that there is nothing after this life and no life or resurrection after death, which they based on the fact that their forefathers had died and had not returned. They said, If the resurrection is true: فَأْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth! This is false evidence and…

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ inna hāulāi layaqūlūna Verily these do say, See 44:32

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِينَ in hiya illā mawtatunā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīna 'It will be just our first death, and we shall not be resurrected.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِينَ in hiya illā mawtatunā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīna "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected. See 44:34

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِينَ in hiya illā mawtatunā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīna There (i.e., they disbelieved in resurrection.) is naught save our first death and we shall not be raised again. This is what the disbelievers claimed saying that there is nothing beyond death; there is no life after the death of this body.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ fatū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna Bring our fathers back [to life], should you be truthful.'

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ fatū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna Then bring (back) our forefathers, if you should be truthful." See 44:34

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ fatū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna Then bring (This was the challenge from the disbelievers to the apostles.) ye (back) our fathers, if ye be truthful. See 44:35

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿin wa-alladhīna min qablihim ahlaknāhum innahum kānū muj'rimīna Are they better, or the people of Tubba',1 and those who were before them? We destroyed them; indeed they were guilty.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿin wa-alladhīna min qablihim ahlaknāhum innahum kānū muj'rimīna Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ1 and those before them? We destroyed them, (for) indeed, they were criminals. See 44:34

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿin wa-alladhīna min qablihim ahlaknāhum innahum kānū muj'rimīna Are they better or the people of Tubba, and those before them? We destroyed them, for verily they were the guilty ones. 'Tubba' - The singular of 'Tabayet' the Himyarite kings were called 'Tabayah.' Asad Ibn Malka, called Abu-Ayyoob - was a Himyarite king who lived about 1040 years before the advent of the Holy Prophet. Some say he was the apostle of God and according to some he was a righteous man. He was a very powerful king with huge armies at his command and had conquered many towns. Whenever he wrote any letter he began 'In the name of Allah the Lord of the land and the seas, the sun and the wind'. When…

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them for play.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play. This World was Created for a Wisdom Here Allah tells us of His justice, and that He is far above mere play, folly and falsehood. This is like the Ayah: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالاٌّرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـطِلاً ذَلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ النَّارِ And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire! (38:27) أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـكُمْ عَبَثاً وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لاَ تُرْجَعُونَ - فَتَعَـلَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ Did you think that We had created you in play,…

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna And We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them both, in sport. See 44:37

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna We did not create them except with reason; but most of them do not know.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know. See 44:38

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna We created them not but with the truth, (The appropriateness of the purpose.) but most of them know not. See 44:37

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ inna yawma l-faṣli mīqātuhum ajmaʿīna Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst for them all,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ inna yawma l-faṣli mīqātuhum ajmaʿīna Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all. See 44:38

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ inna yawma l-faṣli mīqātuhum ajmaʿīna Verily the day of sorting (Decisive – discriminating.) out is the appointed term for all of them, See 44:37

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ yawma lā yugh'nī mawlan ʿan mawlan shayan walā hum yunṣarūna the day when a friend will not avail a friend in any way, nor will they be helped,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ yawma lā yugh'nī mawlan ʿan mawlan shayan walā hum yunṣarūna The Day when no relation1 will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped. See 44:38

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ yawma lā yugh'nī mawlan ʿan mawlan shayan walā hum yunṣarūna The day when a friend shall avail not (his) friend aught, nor shall they be helped, See 44:37

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ illā man raḥima l-lahu innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu except for him on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed He is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ illā man raḥima l-lahu innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Except those (believers) on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 44:38

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ illā man raḥima l-lahu innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Save those on whom God shall have mercy; Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful. The exception - and here asserts the availability of the intercession of those who have been blessed by God or who represent the blessings of God, for their friends.1 (A.P.)

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ inna shajarata l-zaqūmi Indeed the tree of Zaqqūm

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ inna shajarata l-zaqūmi Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm. Verily, the tree of Zaqqu (44:43). Will be the food of the sinners (44:44). Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies (44:45). Like the boiling of scalding water (44:46). (It will be said:) "Seize him and drag him into the midst of blazing Fire, (44:47). "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water (44:48). "Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous (44:49). "Verily, this is that whereof you used to doubt! (44:50). The Condition of the Idolators and Their Punishment on the Day of Resurrection Allah tells us how He will punish the disbelievers who deny the meeting with Him: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ - طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ Verily, the tree of Zaqqum will be the food of the sinners. Those…

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ inna shajarata l-zaqūmi Verily, the tree of Zaqqum, (Refer to verse 37:62 - 37:68.) See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ ṭaʿāmu l-athīmi will be the food of the sinful.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ ṭaʿāmu l-athīmi Is food for the sinful. See 44:43

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ ṭaʿāmu l-athīmi Shall be the food of the sinful, See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ kal-muh'li yaghlī fī l-buṭūni Like molten copper it will boil in the bellies,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ kal-muh'li yaghlī fī l-buṭūni Like murky oil, it boils within bellies. See 44:43

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ kal-muh'li yaghlī fī l-buṭūni Like the molten brass; shall it boil in (their) bellies, See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ kaghalyi l-ḥamīmi boiling like boiling water.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ kaghalyi l-ḥamīmi Like the boiling of scalding water. See 44:43

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ kaghalyi l-ḥamīmi Like the boiling of hot water. See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَى سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ khudhūhu fa-iʿ'tilūhu ilā sawāi l-jaḥīmi 'Seize him and drag him to the middle of hell,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَى سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ khudhūhu fa-iʿ'tilūhu ilā sawāi l-jaḥīmi (It will be commanded), "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire. See 44:43

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَى سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ khudhūhu fa-iʿ'tilūhu ilā sawāi l-jaḥīmi (There will be a cry (From the angels.) saying) "Seize ye him, then drag ye him down into the midst (Refer to verse 37:62 - 37:68.) of Hell," See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْۤا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ thumma ṣubbū fawqa rasihi min ʿadhābi l-ḥamīmi then pour over his head the punishment of boiling water.'

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْۤا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ thumma ṣubbū fawqa rasihi min ʿadhābi l-ḥamīmi Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water." See 44:43

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْۤا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ thumma ṣubbū fawqa rasihi min ʿadhābi l-ḥamīmi Then pour on his head of the torment of the boiling water. See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ dhuq innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-karīmu 'Taste! Indeed you are the [self-styled] mighty and noble!

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ dhuq innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-karīmu (It will be said), "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!1 See 44:43

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ dhuq innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-karīmu (It will be said again) "Taste thou; Verily thou was forsooth the mighty, the honourable (A reference to the arrogant aristocrats who considered themselves as such.) ," See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūna This is indeed what you used to doubt!'

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūna Indeed, this is what you used to dispute." See 44:43

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūna Verily, this is what ye dispute about. See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī maqāmin amīnin Indeed the Godwary will be in a secure place,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī maqāmin amīnin Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place. Verily, those who have Taqwa, will be in place of security (44:51). Among Gardens and Springs (44:52). Dressed in Sundus and Istabraq, facing each other (44:53). So (it will be). And We shall marry them to Hur (fair females) with wide lovely eyes (44:54). They will call therein for every kind of fruit in peace and security (44:55). They will never taste death therein except the first death, and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire (44:56). As a bounty from your Lord! That will be the supreme success (44:57). Certainly, We have made this easy in your tongue, in order that they may remember (44:58). Wait then; verily, they (too) are waiting (44:59). The State of…

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī maqāmin amīnin Verily, the pious ones (Those who guard themselves against evil.) will be in a secure place, See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fī jannātin waʿuyūnin amid gardens and springs,

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Within gardens and springs. See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fī jannātin waʿuyūnin In gardens and spring, See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَلْبَسُونَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ yalbasūna min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin mutaqābilīna dressed in fine silk and brocade, sitting face to face.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَلْبَسُونَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ yalbasūna min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin mutaqābilīna Wearing (garments of) fine silk and brocade, facing each other. See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَلْبَسُونَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ yalbasūna min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin mutaqābilīna Attired in fine silk and in rich brocade, (sitting) face to face; See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin So shall it be, and We shall wed them to black-eyed houris.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, (beautiful) eyes. See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin So shall it be, and We will unite them with fair ones; with wide, lovely eyes. See 44:42

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihatin āminīna There they will call for every fruit, in safety.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihatin āminīna They will call therein for every (kind of) fruit - safe and secure. See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihatin āminīna They shall call therein for every (kind of) fruit, (being) in security, Already pointed out that these are metaphorical presentations of the incomparable heavenly the bliss in the life hereafter. (A.P.)

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَى وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi There they will not taste death except the first death, and He will save them from the punishment of hell

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَى وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire. See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَى وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi They shall taste not death therein save the first (This verse and verse 44:35 refers to the materialists who deny the Resurrection after death.) death, and He will save them from the chastisement of the hell, The life in the heavens after the Final Judgment, i.e., in Paradise shall be eternal. There will be no other death for the inmates to taste it again. Difference between this verse and verse 44:35 is that in this the materialists denied any resurrections after death. (A.P.)

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّكَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ faḍlan min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu —a grace from your Lord. That is the great success.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّكَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ faḍlan min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment. See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّكَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ faḍlan min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu A grace from thy Lord; this is the great achievement. See 44:56

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna Indeed We have made it simple in your language, so that they may take admonition.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna And indeed, We have eased it (i.e., the Qur’ān) in your tongue that they might be reminded. See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna So have We made it (Qur'an) easy in thy tongue that they may be admonished. The truth in this is proved by the evidence of the millions and the millions of the people throughout the ages and recite it correctly without knowing the contents and yet are moved by its mysterious music of the recital. (A.P.)

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُمْ مُرْتَقِبُونَ fa-ir'taqib innahum mur'taqibūna So wait! Indeed they [too] are waiting.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُمْ مُرْتَقِبُونَ fa-ir'taqib innahum mur'taqibūna So watch, (O Muḥammad); indeed, they are watching (for your end). See 44:51

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُمْ مُرْتَقِبُونَ fa-ir'taqib innahum mur'taqibūna Therefore wait thou: Verily, they (too) are waiting. See 44:58

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا wal-dhāriyāti dharwan By the scattering [winds] that scatter [the clouds];

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا wal-dhāriyāti dharwan By the (winds) scattering (dust), dispersing (it). يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ (It will be) a Day when they will be Yuftanun in the Fire! Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, Al-Hasan and several others said that Yuftanun means punished. Mujahid said: "Just as gold is forged in the fire." A group of others also including Mujahid, 'Ikrimah, Ibrahim An-Nakha'i, Zayd bin Aslam, and Sufyan Ath-Thawri said, "They will be burnt." ذُوقُوا فِتْنَتَكُمْ Taste you your trial! Mujahid said, "Your burning" while others said, "Your punishment." هَٰذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ This is what you used to ask to be hastened! This will be said admonishing, chastising, humiliating and belittling them. Allah knows best.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا wal-dhāriyāti dharwan By the scatterers (The winds.) that Scatter, As in the case of Chapter 37 this Chapter also starts with a swearing in the name of the things or the energies of nature, discharging different functions in the working of the universe - mentioned in Verses 51:1 - 51:4. It is said that once the First Holy Imam 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib was asked while he was delivering a sermon from the pulpit, by a critic (a Kharaji) What is 'Zarriat'? He said, 'the winds' - What is the 'Hamilat'? He said, 'the Clouds' carrying rain - What is the 'Jariat' that travel easily? He said, the ships - and what is 'Muqassimat?' He said, the angels. But 'Ali's interpretation is to be taken as the simplest example of this phenomena in the Universe - otherwise the…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْحَامِلَاتِ وِقْرًا fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ran by the [rain] bearing [clouds] laden [with water];

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْحَامِلَاتِ وِقْرًا fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ran And the (clouds) carrying a load (of water). See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْحَامِلَاتِ وِقْرًا fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ran Then those which bear their load, (The rain.) See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا fal-jāriyāti yus'ran by [the ships] which move gently [on the sea];

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا fal-jāriyāti yus'ran And the ships sailing with ease. See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا fal-jāriyāti yus'ran Then by those which speed (Travel or move.) lightly along, See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا fal-muqasimāti amran by [the angels] who dispense [livelihood] by [His] command:

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا fal-muqasimāti amran And the (angels) apportioning (each) matter. See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا fal-muqasimāti amran Then by those distribute the affair, See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqun indeed what you are promised is true,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqun Indeed, what you are promised is true. See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqun Verily what ye are threatened with, is certainly true, The promise that death is not the end of the life. There is Resurrection on the Day of the Final Judgment with mercy and forgiveness to the penitent and justice and punishment to the rebellious - with an eternal life of bliss for the righteous and similarly everlasting punishment to the disbelievers and the wicked.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ الدِّينَ لَوَاقِعٌ wa-inna l-dīna lawāqiʿun and indeed the retribution1 will surely come to pass!

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ الدِّينَ لَوَاقِعٌ wa-inna l-dīna lawāqiʿun And indeed, the recompense is to occur. See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ الدِّينَ لَوَاقِعٌ wa-inna l-dīna lawāqiʿun And verily the Judgment shall surely come to pass. See 51:5

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuki By the sky full of adornment [with stars],1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuki By the heaven containing pathways.1 See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuki And by the heaven with its starry highways, At a time, even centuries after which, the world did not know that the earth was round, it was not a difficulty but an impossibility for any one save the All-Knowing Author of the Universe to disclose the knowledge about the ways or orbits in the heavens. Let any intelligent seeker of knowledge from the Holy Qur'an reflect on the time taken by the non-Muslim world with all their scientific efforts and exertions to enquire into the elementary phenomenon of the working of the nature in the heavens visible over our own heads. How many centuries after, we are informed by our greatest scientists about the stars in the heavens, that there are the orbit around which revolve the planets, even this our sun being the…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِیْ قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ innakum lafī qawlin mukh'talifin indeed you are of different opinions!

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِیْ قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ innakum lafī qawlin mukh'talifin Indeed, you are in differing speech.1 See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِیْ قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ innakum lafī qawlin mukh'talifin Verily ye are in discordance in what ye say, The variance referred to, is in their false imagination about the Holy Prophet and the Holy Qur'an, some said that the Holy Prophet was sorcerer, a mad-man, one overcome by a jinn and about the Holy Qur'an they said it was an enchanting poetry, it was the collection of the stories of the ancient people borrowed from the old people. About the Resurrection they believed it to be an impossibility.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ yu'faku ʿanhu man ufika He is turned away from it1 who has been turned away [from the truth].

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ yu'faku ʿanhu man ufika Deluded away from it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is he who is deluded. See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ yu'faku ʿanhu man ufika He will be turned away from it who is to be turned away. See 51:8

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُونَ qutila l-kharāṣūna Perish the liars,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُونَ qutila l-kharāṣūna Destroyed are the misinformers.1 See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُونَ qutila l-kharāṣūna Accursed be the conjecturers, (Those who conject (about God and godly affairs) and those who believe in the conjectures. Submerged into ignorance) See 51:8

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūna who are heedless in a stupor!

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūna Who are within a flood (of confusion) and heedless. See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūna Who in the abyss (of ignorance) are wandering (bewildered), See 51:8

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ yasalūna ayyāna yawmu l-dīni They ask, 'When will be the Day of Retribution?'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ yasalūna ayyāna yawmu l-dīni They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?" See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ yasalūna ayyāna yawmu l-dīni Ask they: "When is the Day of Judgment?" See 51:8

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ yawma hum ʿalā l-nāri yuf'tanūna It is the day when they will be tormented in the Fire,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ yawma hum ʿalā l-nāri yuf'tanūna (It is) the Day they will be tormented over the Fire. See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ yawma hum ʿalā l-nāri yuf'tanūna On that day shall they be tried at the fire. See 51:8

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذُوقُوْۤا فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna [and will be told]: 'Taste your torment. This is what you used to hasten.'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذُوقُوْۤا فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna (And will be told), "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient." See 51:1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذُوقُوْۤا فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna (It will be said) "Taste ye (now) your trial (on the fire); This is what ye did seek to hasten on!" See 51:8

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs. Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (51:15). Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this doers of good (51:16). They used to sleep but little by night (51:17). And in the hours before dawn, they were asking for forgiveness (51:18). And in their wealth there was the right of the Sa'il and the Mahrum (51:19). And on the earth are signs for those who have faith with certainty (51:20). And also in yourselves. Will you not then see (51:21). And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised (51:22). Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Verily the pious ones shall be in gardens and (among the) springs, See 51:8

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَاخِذِينَ مَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīna receiving what their Lord has given them, for they had been virtuous aforetime.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَاخِذِينَ مَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīna Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good. See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَاخِذِينَ مَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīna Receiving (the enjoyment) what giveth them their Lord; Verily, they were ere that the doers of good. Note the qualities of the really righteous and the pious ones. These and the many other qualities of superb excellence in the maximum degree possible, could be found in the holy Ahl Al-Bayt, in view of which we are asked to follow them, holding them as our guides and not the others with no such qualities or with defective character and conduct. It was for our own benefit that it was commanded by the Holy Prophet. "I leave behind me Two very important things, the Word of God (the Holy Qur'an) and my Ahl Al-Bayt. Should ye be attached to these Two, never, never shall…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَانُوْۤا قَلِيلًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūna They used to sleep a little during the night,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَانُوْۤا قَلِيلًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūna They used to sleep but little of the night.1 See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَانُوْۤا قَلِيلًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūna Little of the night was it that they used to sleep. See 51:16

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūna and at dawns they would plead for forgiveness,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūna And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness. See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūna And in the (hours) ere the dawn they prayed for forgiveness. See 51:16

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi and there was a share in their wealth for the beggar and the deprived.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi And from their properties was (given) the right of the (needy) petitioner and the deprived. See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi And in their property was a share due to the beggar and the destitute. See 51:16

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِلْمُوقِنِينَ wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīna In the earth are signs for those who have conviction,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِلْمُوقِنِينَ wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīna And on the earth are signs for the certain (in faith). See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِلْمُوقِنِينَ wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīna And in the earth are signs for those who are sure in faith, See 51:16

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūna and in your souls [as well]. Will you not then perceive?

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūna And in yourselves. Then will you not see? See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūna And (also) in your own selves; will ye not then see? Reference to the wonderful endowment in the nature and the creation of man, the differences of sex - their mysterious attachment to each other, the mental faculties by which the human mind goes on discerning the secrets of the natural forces and invents newer and newer scientific implements for further progress in knowledge and its application.1 Refers to the subjective and the objective phenomena giving evidence of the Truth. (A.P.)

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūna And in the sky is your provision and what you are promised.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūna And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised. See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūna And in the heaven (Refers not to the physical heavens but to the sublime regions proceeding from the Absolute in the Arc of Descent. A.P.) is your sustenance and what ye are promised with. Refers to not the physical heavens but to the sublime regions proceeding from the Absolute in the Arc of Descent. (A.P.)

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُونَ fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūna By the Lord of the sky and the earth, it is indeed the truth, just as [it is a fact that] you speak.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُونَ fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūna Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as (sure as) it is that you are speaking. See 51:15

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُونَ fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūna And by the Lord of the heavens (Refer to note on verse on heavens.) and the earth! verily It (the Qur'an) is certainly the truth, just as ye speak, Truth is so doubtless as the people talk to each other with the surety of their ability to do it. Asma'yu says that once he was returning from the Mosque at Basra. He met a Bedouin Arab on the way who was a highway robber, with his sword and bow. The Arab asked Asma'yu his identity and the place he was coming from. Asma'yu said "I come from the place where the Word of God is recited." The Arab asked "What, is the Word of God such that men could recite it?" Asma'yu…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīna Did you receive the story of Abraham's honoured guests?

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīna Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Ibrahim?1. Has the story reached you, of the honored guests of Ibrahim (51:24). When they came in to him and said: "Salaman!" He answered: "Salamun" and said: "You are a people unknown to me (51:25). Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf (51:26). And placed it before them (saying): "Will you not eat? (51:27). Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge (51:28). Then his wife came forward with a loud voice; she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman! (51:29). They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise,…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīna Has there come unto thee [O Muhammad] the story of Abraham's honoured guests (Refer to Verses 11:69 - 11:83.) ? Refer to the commentary of Hud 11:69 - 11:83 and Hijr, 15:51 - 15:77 for prophets Ibrahim and Lut and the people of Lut.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmun munkarūna When they entered into his presence, they said, 'Peace!' 'Peace!' He answered, '[You are] an unfamiliar folk.'1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmun munkarūna When they entered upon him and said, "(We greet you with) peace." He answered, "(And upon you) peace; (you are) a people unknown." See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmun munkarūna When entered they (The Angels.) upon him said they: 'Peace!'. 'Peace! Said he [and deemed] A strange people [these are] (Compare with Gen 18/1-7 and 18/10-12.) ' See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَجَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīnin Then he retired to his family and brought a fat [roasted] calf,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَجَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīnin Then he went to his family and came with a fat (roasted) calf. See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَجَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīnin Then turned he aside unto his family, and brought a fat (roasted) calf See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūna and put it near them. He said, 'Will you not eat?'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūna And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?" See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūna And set it near them (The Angels.) . He said: 'What! Eat ye not?' See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmin Then he felt a fear of them. They said, 'Do not be afraid!' and they gave him the good news of a wise son.1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmin And he felt from them apprehension.1 They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy. See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmin And he conceived of them a fear; Said they: "Fear thou not (Don't be surprised.) !" and gave they the glad tidings unto him of a son blessed with knowledge See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmun Then his wife came forward crying [with joy]. She beat her face, and said, 'A barren old woman!'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmun And his wife approached with a cry (of alarm) and struck her face and said, "(I am) a barren old woman!" See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmun Then came forward his wife in grief, she smote her face and said she (what! I) an old barren woman (Clearly indicates that the birth of the son Isaac was miraculous to prove the Omnipotence of God to affect issues from barren women &. even virgins, if He wills.) ? See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu They said, 'So has your Lord said. Indeed He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing." See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu Said they: "Thus sayeth thy Lord: 'Verily He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing'" See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna He said, 'O messengers, what is now your errand?'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna (Ibrahim) said, "Then what is your business (here), O messengers?" (Ibrahim) said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O messengers? (51:31). They said: "We have been sent to a people who are criminals (51:32). "To send down upon them stones of clay (51:33). "Marked by your Lord for transgressors (51:34). So We brought out from therein the believers (51:35). But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one (51:36). And We have left there a sign for those who fear the painful torment (51:37). The Angels were Sent to Destroy the People of the Prophet Lut Allah the Exalted said about Ibrahim (AS): فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ - إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ - يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَا…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna He (Abraham) said "What then is your errand, O' ye Messengers (The Angels.) ?" See 51:24

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna They said, 'We have been sent toward a guilty people,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals.1 See 51:31

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna Said they: 'We are sent unto a criminal people' Concerning the people of Lut, see the commentary of Verses 7:80 - 7:84 and Hijr, 15:51 - 15:77. As said in the commentary of al-'Araf, Verses 7:80 - 7:84, the two angels first came to Ibrahim and informed him that they were sent to the people of Lut. They gave Ibrahim and his wife, Sarah, the glad tidings from Allah that in spite of their advanced age soon they would have a son, Is-haq, and a grandson, Yaqub, Is-haq's son.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ طِينٍ linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min ṭīnin that We may rain upon them stones of clay,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ طِينٍ linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min ṭīnin To send down upon them stones of clay. See 51:31

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ طِينٍ linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min ṭīnin That We may send down upon them (The people of Lut, Sodom and Gomorrah.) stones of clay" (Refer to Verses 7:84; 11:82.) See 51:32

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīna marked with your Lord for the profligate.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīna Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors." See 51:31

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīna Marked out from unto thy Lord for the guilty ones of excesses (Refer to Verses 11:813; 11:84.) See 51:32

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīna So We picked out those who were in it of the faithful,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīna So We brought out whoever was in them (i.e., the cities) of the believers. See 51:31

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīna And We brought forth (those) who were there in (the town) of the believers See 51:32

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mina l-mus'limīna but We did not find there other than one house of muslims,

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mina l-mus'limīna And We found not within them other than a (single) house of Muslims.1 See 51:31

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mina l-mus'limīna But We found not there in (the town) save one house of the Muslims (Those who submit themselves to God) " (Refer to Verse 11:81.)" Compare with commentary of Verse 11:81. The wife of Lot was a faithless woman, hence a wife, unless she happens to have some blood relation with him, could never be the Ahl Al-Bayt of the man.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا اٰیَةً لِلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ wataraknā fīhā āyatan lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīma and We have left therein a sign for those who fear a painful punishment.'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا اٰیَةً لِلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ wataraknā fīhā āyatan lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīma And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment. See 51:31

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا اٰیَةً لِلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ wataraknā fīhā āyatan lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīma And left We therein a sign (Portent.) for those who dread the painful chastisement (In the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.) See 51:32

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي مُوسٰی إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānin mubīnin And in Moses [too there is a sign] when We sent him to Pharaoh with a manifest authority.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي مُوسٰی إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānin mubīnin And in Musa (was a sign), when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.1 And in Musa, when We sent him to Fir'awn with a manifest authority (51:38). But (he) turned away along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer or a madman (51:39). So We took him and his armies, and dumped them into the sea (Yamm), for he was blameworthy (51:40). And in 'Ad when We sent against them the barren wind (51:41). It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins (51:42). And in Thamud, when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while! (51:43). But they insolently defied the command of their Lord, so the Sa'iqah overtook them while they were looking (51:44).…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي مُوسٰی إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānin mubīnin And in Moses, when We sent him unto Pharaoh with manifest authority (Refer to Verses 44:17 - 44:31.) Refer to the commentary of Sura ad-Dukhan, 44:17 - 44:31; Sura al-'Araf, 7:104 - 7:137; Sura Ta Ha, 20:9 to 20:98 and other references mentioned therein for Musa, Fir'awn and the people of Firawn.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnun But he turned away assured of his might, and said, 'A magician or a crazy man!'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnun But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman." See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnun But (Pharaoh) turned away with his forces (Might hosts.) and said (pointing to Moses): '(This is) a sorcerer or a madman' See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmun So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea, while he was blameworthy.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmun So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmun So, We seized him and his hosts and We cast them into the sea, for he was reprobate See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-rīḥa l-ʿaqīma And in 'Ād when We unleashed upon them a barren wind.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-rīḥa l-ʿaqīma And in ʿAad (was a sign), when We sent against them the barren wind.1 See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-rīḥa l-ʿaqīma And in 'Ad: when sent We upon them the desolating (Unproductive, futile.) (blast of violent') wind (Refer to Verses 46:21 - 46:26.) Refer to the commentary of Sura ad-Dukhan, 44:21 - 44:26 for the people of Ad.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīmi It left nothing that it came upon without making it like decayed bones.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīmi It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins. See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīmi It left not aught upon which it came, but turned it like (rotten) dust See 51:41

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتّٰی حِينٍ wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīnin And in Thamūd, when they were told, 'Enjoy for a while.'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتّٰی حِينٍ wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīnin And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time." See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتّٰی حِينٍ wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīnin And in Thamood: when it was said unto them; "Avail ye your- selves for a while (Refer to Verses 7:73 - 7:79; 11:65.)" See commentary of Sura al-'Araf, 7:73 - 7:79 for the people of Thamud.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūna Then they defied the command of their Lord; so the thunderbolt seized them as they looked on.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūna But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on. See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūna But rebelled they against the command of their Lord, so seized them the rumbling, while they were yet looking on (Refer to Verses 7:70; 11:67.) See 51:43

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْتَصِرِينَ famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmin wamā kānū muntaṣirīna So they were neither able to rise up, nor to come to one another's aid.1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْتَصِرِينَ famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmin wamā kānū muntaṣirīna And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves. See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْتَصِرِينَ famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmin wamā kānū muntaṣirīna Then they could not even rise (on their feet), nor could they help themselves See 51:43

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna And the people of Noah aforetime. Indeed they were a transgressing lot.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna And (We destroyed) the people of Nuh before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient. See 51:38

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna And the people of Noah before (that)', Verily they were wicked people Refer to the commentary of Sura al-'Araf, 7:59 to 7:64 for the people of Nuh.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūna We have built the sky with might, and indeed it is We who are its expanders.1

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūna And the heaven We constructed with strength,1 and indeed, We are (its) expander. With Hands We constructed the heaven. Verily, We are able to expand the vastness of space thereof (51:47). And We have made the earth a Firash; how excellent spreader (thereof) are We (51:48). And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (51:49). So, flee to Allah. Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him (51:50). And set not up any other god along with Allah. Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him (51:51). Proofs of Allah's Oneness Abound in the Creation of the Heavens and the Earth Allah reminds us of the creating of the higher and lower worlds: وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا We constructed the heaven. Meaning: 'We made it…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūna And the heaven, We did raise it up with (Our) Might, and verily We are the expanders (of it) expanse (This indicates the expandability of the Space - discarding the fixity of the present limitations (AP).) ? This indicates that although the frontiers of space are confined, they are not fixed. They can be expanded (A.P.).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūna And the earth We have spread it out, so how excellent spreaders We have been!

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūna And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer. See 51:47

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūna And the earth, We did spread it out (like a carpet), how Excellent (are We) the Spreaders (thereof)? (Refer to Verse 2:22.) See 51:47

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūna In all things We have created pairs so that you may take admonition.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūna And of all things We created two mates (i.e., counterparts); perhaps you will remember. See 51:47

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūna And of everything have We created in pairs, that ye may reflect (Refer to Verse 36:36.) ? What is created is in pairs. The parity may refer to the composite nature of the created beings or the positive and the negative in phenomenon in the order of creation (A.P.).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفِرُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun [Say,] 'So flee toward Allah. Indeed I am a manifest warner to you from Him.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفِرُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun So flee to Allah.1 Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner. See 51:47

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفِرُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun So fly (Seek refuge, Turn to.) ye unto God! Verily I am unto you a plain (Open.) Warner So that ye may remember that the Absolute One from all respects and aspects, is God (A.P.).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun Do not set up another god besides Allah. Indeed I am a manifest warner to you from Him.'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun And do not make (as equal) with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner. See 51:47

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun Set ye not with God any other god; Verily I am unto you a plain (Open.) Warner See 51:50

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ مَا أَتٰی الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim min rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnun So it was that there did not come to those who were before them any apostle but they said, 'A magician,' or 'A crazy man!'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ مَا أَتٰی الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim min rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnun Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman." Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: A sorcerer or a madman! (51:52). Have they transmitted this saying to these? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (51:53). So turn away from them, you are not blameworthy (51:54). And remind, for verily, the reminding profits the believers (51:55). And I created not the Jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me (51:56). I seek not any provision from them nor do I ask that they should feed Me (51:57). Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of power, the…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ مَا أَتٰی الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim min rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnun Even so there came not unto those before them an apostle but said they (of him): 'A sorcerer or a mad man' (Refer to Verses 38:4; 44:14 and 51:39.) The ways of evil in dealing with the messengers of Allah were similar in all ages1.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
