item.description: أَتَوَاصَوْا بِهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūna Did they enjoin this upon one another?! Rather they were a rebellious lot.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَوَاصَوْا بِهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūna Did they suggest it to them?1 Rather, they (themselves) are a transgressing people. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَوَاصَوْا بِهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūna Have they charged this unto one another? Nay! they are rebellious (Inordinate transgressors of the law – applicable also to those who break the Islamic Laws.) people See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmin So turn away from them, for you will not be blameworthy.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmin So leave them, (O Muḥammad), for you are not to be blamed. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmin Then turn thou thy back upon them for thou art not to be blamed Verse 54 gives the impression that Allah might send a destructive visitation as manifestation of His wrath, but the next verse quells this apprehension. The guidance may be general in appearance, but it is directed towards man as an individual so that free from collective opinion or pressure, he may submit to the commands of Allah according to his ability and achieve success by following the divine plan (A.P.).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wadhakkir fa-inna l-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīna And admonish, for admonition indeed benefits the faithful.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wadhakkir fa-inna l-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīna And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wadhakkir fa-inna l-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīna And remind thou, for verily reminding profiteth the believers (Refer to Verses 21:16; 38:27; 67:2.) This indicates that the guidance may be general in appearance but actually meant for particular persons who get benefited (A.P.).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūni I did not create the jinn and the humans except that they may worship Me.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūni And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūni And created not I, the Jinn and the humans, but that they may worship (To live in submission to the Lord.) (Me) The Sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq said that God did not create men but to know, mho with the proper knowledge, automatically surrenders himself to Him – and without knowledge the adoration could never, in the true sense of it, be an adoration. Besides the actual meaning of adoration, is not the performance of any rituals or only the few prescribed formal prayers recited by the mouth but the actual surrender of the ego in an individual, disciplining it, to act only in consonance with the expressed will of the Lord, through abiding with His prescribed law. The whole life-activity of the individual, should…

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ يُطْعِمُونِ mā urīdu min'hum min riz'qin wamā urīdu an yuṭ'ʿimūni I desire no provision from them, nor do I desire that they should feed Me.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ يُطْعِمُونِ mā urīdu min'hum min riz'qin wamā urīdu an yuṭ'ʿimūni I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ يُطْعِمُونِ mā urīdu min'hum min riz'qin wamā urīdu an yuṭ'ʿimūni I desire (Demand.) not from them any sustenance, nor do I desire that they should feed Me Providing sustenance for the creatures, is equal to feeding God Himself for the creatures, all put together, constitute one family of God's creation. Hence serving the creation is serving God. It clears that the object of creation - worship and obedience, is of no advantage or benefit to God. On the contrary, it is in the interest of the creatures to become the manifestation, of His will and Command (A.P.).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ inna l-laha huwa l-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīnu Indeed it is Allah who is the All-provider, Powerful, All-strong.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ inna l-laha huwa l-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīnu Indeed, it is Allah who is the (continual) Provider,1 the firm possessor of strength. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ inna l-laha huwa l-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīnu Verily, God He (alone) is the Bestower of sustenance, the Lord of the unbreakable strength See 51:57

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūban mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūni Indeed the lot of those who do wrong [now] will be like the lot of their [earlier] counterparts. So let them not ask Me to hasten on [that fate].

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūban mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūni And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion (of punishment) like the portion of their companions (i.e., predecessors), so let them not impatiently urge Me. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūban mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūni So, verily those who are unjust shall have a share (of the burden) like unto the share (of the burden) which had their fellows (of old), Therefore, let them ask Me not to hasten it on (Those who do not comply to the requirement of perfect obedience.) Those who did not comply to the requirement of obedience. 'Dhanoob' literally a bucket full of water tied to the end of a rope like a tale figuratively used as the consequence of misdeeds and disobedience tied to the rope of one's life (A.P.).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūna Woe to the faithless for the day they are promised!

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūna And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised. See 51:52

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūna Therefore, Woe unto those who disbelieve because of their day which they are promised! See 51:59

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا wal-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥan By the snorting chargers,

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا wal-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥan By the racers, panting.1 إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌ Verily, that Day their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them. Meaning: He knows all of that they used to do, and He will compensate them for it with the most deserving reward. He does not do even the slightest amount of injustice. This is the end of the Tafsir of Surat Al-'Adiyat, and all praise and thanks are due to Allah.

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا wal-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥan By the snorting chargers! Verses 1-5 are the mystic symbols of some event of special importance. Commentators have given some imaginary interpretation to the symbolic use of the words. The truth is that the Surah as a whole was revealed on a particular occasion of special importance. The Sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq says that the tribes of Bani Saleem collected a huge force to make a sudden and a very heavy attack on Madina, to kill the Muslims and to arrest the Holy Prophet and then to torture him. On receiving the news of this gathering of the hostile forces the Holy Prophet sent an army under one of his companions who ran away from the field and returned utterly defeated suffering a heavy loss and owing to his running away from the…

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا fal-mūriyāti qadḥan by the strikers of sparks [with their hoofs],

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا fal-mūriyāti qadḥan And the producers of sparks (when) striking.1 See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا fal-mūriyāti qadḥan And those that dash off (their hoofs) striking fire The march being in the night, creating bright sparks of fire by the striking of the hoofs of the chargers on the rocky soil on which they marched. The reference is to the expedition of the believers led by 'Ali, surrounding the enemy by surprise in the early hours of dawn - for this justification of the action explains the ungrateful attitude of the enemy who treacherously violated the Treaty of Peace with the Holy Prophet and killed in cold blood several Muslims (Ghazwa al-Zatus-Salasal). (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا fal-mughīrāti ṣub'ḥan by the raiders at dawn,

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا fal-mughīrāti ṣub'ḥan And the chargers at dawn.1 See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا fal-mughīrāti ṣub'ḥan And those that scour to the attack at morn! The chargers of those who attacked the enemy at dawn, for Ali had made the attack on the enemy in the early hours of dawn and had taken the enemy by surprise.

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا fa-atharna bihi naqʿan raising therein a trail of dust,

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا fa-atharna bihi naqʿan Stirring up thereby (clouds of) dust. See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا fa-atharna bihi naqʿan And stir thereby the dust aloft The dust raised by the rush of the chargers, on the enemy, all of a sudden.

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا fawasaṭna bihi jamʿan and cleaving therein a host!

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا fawasaṭna bihi jamʿan Arriving thereby in the center1 collectively. See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا fawasaṭna bihi jamʿan And penetrate through (the foe) all of them The actual fall of the believers on the enemy's forces, with the consolidated heaviest pressure on them.

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ inna l-insāna lirabbihi lakanūdun Indeed man is ungrateful to his Lord,

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ inna l-insāna lirabbihi lakanūdun Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful. See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ inna l-insāna lirabbihi lakanūdun Verily, man unto his Lord is ungrateful The Holy Prophet said the 'Kanud' is the one who eats alone and obstructs others receiving anything from anybody, i.e., grossly selfish - He who receives gifts and wages, war against the benefactor himself - reference to the enemies of Islam - who though under the obligation of the grace of God, reject the belief in Him and wage war on the believers.

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى ذٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ wa-innahu ʿalā dhālika lashahīdun and indeed he is [himself] witness to that!

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى ذٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ wa-innahu ʿalā dhālika lashahīdun And indeed, he is to that a witness.1 See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى ذٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ wa-innahu ʿalā dhālika lashahīdun And verily, He (God.) is a witness unto that The selfish and the ungrateful disbeliever proves his selfishness and ingratitude by his own deeds without the necessity of evidence from anybody else.

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ wa-innahu liḥubbi l-khayri lashadīdun He is indeed avid in the love of wealth.

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ wa-innahu liḥubbi l-khayri lashadīdun And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense. See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ wa-innahu liḥubbi l-khayri lashadīdun And verily, in the love of wealth, he is violent (Vehement – Hard. The Arabs called a Niggard 'Shadeed' (MS).) See 100:7

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūri Does he not know, when what is in the graves is turned over,

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūri But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered. See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūri What! Knoweth he not when, what is in the graves is raised (to life) The interrogation is for an emphatic assertion that man will surely be raised from the grave and let man know and remember that everything will be resurrected. Grave stands for the place which covers the corpse from the sight of mankind. And the verse shows that whatever may be the nature of the grave, it retains something of the deceased one - whether it is soul or body - is subject to the resurrection. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ waḥuṣṣila mā fī l-ṣudūri and what is in the breasts is divulged,

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ waḥuṣṣila mā fī l-ṣudūri And that within the breasts is obtained.1 See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ waḥuṣṣila mā fī l-ṣudūri And shall be made manifest whatever is in the breasts (hearts)? Whatever is hidden, be that the motives and the thoughts concealed in the minds, will be made manifest. 'Sodoor' used by Qur'an is the seat of the feelings and emotion. The passage shows that our feelings and emotions develop into concrete form in the life form. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّهُمْ بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَخَبِيرٌ inna rabbahum bihim yawma-idhin lakhabīrun indeed their Lord will be best aware of them on that day?

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّهُمْ بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَخَبِيرٌ inna rabbahum bihim yawma-idhin lakhabīrun Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is (fully) Aware.1 See 100:1

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّهُمْ بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَخَبِيرٌ inna rabbahum bihim yawma-idhin lakhabīrun Verily, their Lord, that day concerning them, will be fully aware! On the Day of Judgment everything will be open and known to the Lord Who is ever Vigilant and Knowing everything, manifest and concealed.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Mīm.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Meem.1 وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ And when mankind are gathered, they will become their enemies and will deny their worship. This is similar to Allah's saying: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا - كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا They have taken gods beside Allah, that they might give them dignity. No! They will deny their worship of them, and will be opponents to them. (19:81-82) Meaning: they will betray them when they need them the most. (Ibrahim) Al-Khalil (AS), said: إِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا مَوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ You have taken only idols besides Allah! The love between you is only in the life of this world. On the…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ha Mim (H. M.) (Refer to note about the verse 2:1.) See 46:3

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 46:1

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The descent (of the revelation) of this Book (Qur'an) (is) from God, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise See 46:3

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَمَّا أُنْذِرُوْۤا مُعْرِضُونَ mā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-alladhīna kafarū ʿammā undhirū muʿ'riḍūna We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with reason and for a specified term. Yet the faithless are disregardful of what they are warned.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَمَّا أُنْذِرُوْۤا مُعْرِضُونَ mā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-alladhīna kafarū ʿammā undhirū muʿ'riḍūna We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and (for) a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away. See 46:1

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَمَّا أُنْذِرُوْۤا مُعْرِضُونَ mā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-alladhīna kafarū ʿammā undhirū muʿ'riḍūna We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them two, save with truth and (for) a determined term; But those who disbelieve turn away from what they are warned of Everything created by God the All-Wise Lord of the Universe, must naturally have a purpose which shall be fulfilled. Thus, everything has a fixed age to exist. Nothing is permanent and shall pass away with the fulfilment of the purpose of the Creator. As the Universe had a beginning, there shall also be an end of it. But the disbelievers turn aside from what they are warned of. The previous Sura begins with the presentation of…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ ائْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ qul ara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti i'tūnī bikitābin min qabli hādhā aw athāratin min ʿil'min in kuntum ṣādiqīna Say, 'Tell me about what you invoke besides Allah. Show me what [part] of the earth have they created. Do they have any share in the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this, or some vestige of [divine] knowledge, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ ائْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ qul ara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti i'tūnī bikitābin min qabli hādhā aw athāratin min ʿil'min in kuntum ṣādiqīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in (creation of) the heavens? Bring me a scripture (revealed) before this or a (remaining) trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful." See 46:1

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ ائْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ qul ara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti i'tūnī bikitābin min qabli hādhā aw athāratin min ʿil'min in kuntum ṣādiqīna Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "Have ye seen what ye called upon besides God? Show me what of the earth did they create; or for them is there any share in the heavens? (i.e. in the creation of the heavens.) Bring me a book ere this (Qur'an.) or traces of knowledge, if ye be truthful." When the false gods have neither created anything in the earth nor have they any share in the heaven on what right should they be worshipped. Most…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُمْ عَنْ دُعَائِهِمْ غَافِلُونَ waman aḍallu mimman yadʿū min dūni l-lahi man lā yastajību lahu ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wahum ʿan duʿāihim ghāfilūna Who is more astray than him who invokes besides Allah such as would not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and who are oblivious of their invocation?

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُمْ عَنْ دُعَائِهِمْ غَافِلُونَ waman aḍallu mimman yadʿū min dūni l-lahi man lā yastajību lahu ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wahum ʿan duʿāihim ghāfilūna And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection (i.e., never), and they, of their invocation, are unaware. See 46:1

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُمْ عَنْ دُعَائِهِمْ غَافِلُونَ waman aḍallu mimman yadʿū min dūni l-lahi man lā yastajību lahu ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wahum ʿan duʿāihim ghāfilūna And who is more astray than he who calleth upon besides God, unto such who (The false deities.) will respond not unto him till the Day of Judgment, and they, (The false deities.) of their invocations are not conscious See 46:4

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوْۤا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوْۤا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ wa-idhā ḥushira l-nāsu kānū lahum aʿdāan wakānū biʿibādatihim kāfirīna When mankind are mustered [on Judgement's Day] they will be their enemies, and they will disavow their worship.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوْۤا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوْۤا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ wa-idhā ḥushira l-nāsu kānū lahum aʿdāan wakānū biʿibādatihim kāfirīna And when the people are gathered (that Day), they (who were invoked) will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship. See 46:1

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوْۤا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوْۤا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ wa-idhā ḥushira l-nāsu kānū lahum aʿdāan wakānū biʿibādatihim kāfirīna And when people shall be gathered together (on the Day of Reckoning) they shall be hostile unto them, and shall be the deniers of their (The devotees-the heathens.) worship (unto them) See 46:4

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāahum hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun When Our manifest signs are recited to them, the faithless say of the truth when it comes to them: 'This is plain magic.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāahum hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic." And when Our Clear Ayat are recited to them, the disbelievers say of the truth when it reaches them: This is plain magic! (46:7). Or say they: "He has fabricated it." Say: "If I have fabricated it, still you have no power to support me against Allah. He knows best of what you say among yourselves concerning it! Sufficient is He as a witness between me and you! And He is the Oft–Forgiving, the Most Merciful (46:8). Say: "I am not a new thing…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāahum hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun And when Our clear signs are recited unto them, say those who disbelieve about the truth when it cometh unto them, this is an open sorcery (Refer to verses 6:125; 37:14, 37:15.) Whenever truth was conveyed to them, they called it sorcery and treated it with derision and ridicule.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ كَفَى بِهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu falā tamlikūna lī mina l-lahi shayan huwa aʿlamu bimā tufīḍūna fīhi kafā bihi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Should I have fabricated it, you would not avail me anything against Allah. He best knows what you gossip concerning it. He suffices as a witness between me and you, and He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ كَفَى بِهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu falā tamlikūna lī mina l-lahi shayan huwa aʿlamu bimā tufīḍūna fīhi kafā bihi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me (the power of protection) from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved.1 Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful." See 46:7

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ كَفَى بِهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu falā tamlikūna lī mina l-lahi shayan huwa aʿlamu bimā tufīḍūna fīhi kafā bihi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Or they do say: "He hath forged it?" Say thou (then O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "If I have forged it, then ye have not aught for me against (the wrath of) God. He knoweth best what (all) ye utter (pass through - go deep into discussion.) (in mocking) about it; Sufficeth He a witness between me and you; and He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful" This is an argument based on what is laid down in 69:44 - 69:47, i.e., God will never allow any imposter to flourish -…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا كُنْتُ بِدْعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qul mā kuntu bid'ʿan mina l-rusuli wamā adrī mā yuf'ʿalu bī walā bikum in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya wamā anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun Say, 'I am not a novelty among the apostles, nor do I know what will be done with me, or with you. I just follow whatever is revealed to me, and I am just a manifest warner.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا كُنْتُ بِدْعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qul mā kuntu bid'ʿan mina l-rusuli wamā adrī mā yuf'ʿalu bī walā bikum in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya wamā anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun Say, "I am not something new among the messengers,1 nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner." See 46:7

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا كُنْتُ بِدْعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qul mā kuntu bid'ʿan mina l-rusuli wamā adrī mā yuf'ʿalu bī walā bikum in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya wamā anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "I am not the first (6:50, 7:188, 10:49, 46:9. Refer to verses 40:78, 6:84 - 6:88.) of the apostles (from God), I know not what will be done unto me (Refer to verse 7:188.) , nor (what will be done) unto you; I follow not anything save what hath been revealed unto me, and I am not but an open warner (Thus, every action of the Holy Prophet was the execution of the divine will, as every word of his was the revelation from the Lord. Refer…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ عَلَى مِثْلِهِ فَءَامَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi wakafartum bihi washahida shāhidun min banī is'rāīla ʿalā mith'lihi faāmana wa-is'takbartum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna Say, 'Tell me, if it is from Allah and you disbelieve in it, and a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to its like and believed [in it], while you are disdainful [of it]?'1 Indeed Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ عَلَى مِثْلِهِ فَءَامَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi wakafartum bihi washahida shāhidun min banī is'rāīla ʿalā mith'lihi faāmana wa-is'takbartum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna Say, "Have you considered: if it (i.e., the Qur’ān) was from Allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar1 and believed while you were arrogant...?"2 Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people. Say: Tell me! If it was from Allah and you disbelieved it, (at the same time), a witness from among the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you rejected (the truth)!" Verily, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people (46:10). And those who…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ عَلَى مِثْلِهِ فَءَامَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi wakafartum bihi washahida shāhidun min banī is'rāīla ʿalā mith'lihi faāmana wa-is'takbartum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna Say thou: "See ye? If (this Qur'an) be from God and ye disbelieve in it, (although) hath borne witness a witness from among the children (OT. Deut. 18/18,18/19.) of Israel, on its similarity (with the previous scriptures), and hath (also him-self) believed (in it), and yet ye in pride exalt yourselves; Verily God guideth not the unjust people." 'The witness from among the Children of Israel' (46:10). Some commentators think that a reference to Abdullah Ibn Salam, an Israelite scholar who embraced Islam of his own accord. Reference is to Moses who…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَا سَبَقُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوْۤا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū law kāna khayran mā sabaqūnā ilayhi wa-idh lam yahtadū bihi fasayaqūlūna hādhā if'kun qadīmun The faithless say about the faithful, 'Had it been [anything] good, they would not have taken the lead over us toward [accepting] it.' And since they could not find the way to it, they will say, 'It is an ancient lie.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَا سَبَقُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوْۤا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū law kāna khayran mā sabaqūnā ilayhi wa-idh lam yahtadū bihi fasayaqūlūna hādhā if'kun qadīmun And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had (truly) been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood." See 46:10

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَا سَبَقُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوْۤا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū law kāna khayran mā sabaqūnā ilayhi wa-idh lam yahtadū bihi fasayaqūlūna hādhā if'kun qadīmun And say those who disbelieve about those who believe; "Had it been good, they would have gone not ahead of us unto it: "Since they seek not to be guided aright by it; say they: "This is a lie of old:" (Reference to the usual arrogance of the aristocratic class.)" When the tribes of Jehniah, Mehniah, Alama and Gaffar embraced Islam, the tribes of Banu-Admir, Ghatfan, Asad and Ashja said if there had been any truth in Islam we would not have allowed others to supersede us in embracing it. "We would have been the first to accept the faith." This verse…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً وَهَذَا كِتَابٌ مُصَدِّقٌ لِسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِيُنْذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan wahādhā kitābun muṣaddiqun lisānan ʿarabiyyan liyundhira alladhīna ẓalamū wabush'rā lil'muḥ'sinīna Yet before it the Book of Moses was a guide and a mercy, and this is a Book which confirms it, in the Arabic language, to warn those who do wrong, and is a [bearer of] good news for the virtuous.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً وَهَذَا كِتَابٌ مُصَدِّقٌ لِسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِيُنْذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan wahādhā kitābun muṣaddiqun lisānan ʿarabiyyan liyundhira alladhīna ẓalamū wabush'rā lil'muḥ'sinīna And before it was the scripture of Musa to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good. See 46:10

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً وَهَذَا كِتَابٌ مُصَدِّقٌ لِسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِيُنْذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan wahādhā kitābun muṣaddiqun lisānan ʿarabiyyan liyundhira alladhīna ẓalamū wabush'rā lil'muḥ'sinīna And before it (i.e., before the Qur'an.) the Book of Moses (the Pentateuch ('Taurat' i.e. the Law.) ) was a guide and a mercy: and this (Qur'an) is a Book confirmeth (the previous scriptures), in the Arabic language that it may warn those who are unjust; and (contains) glad-tidings for the doers of good The Holy Qur'an has the same regard for the Laws given to Moses as had Jesus - Math. 5-17. "Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil." Math. 5/17 The Holy Qur'an is the exposition of the truth in the…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Indeed those who say, 'Our Lord is Allah,' and then remain steadfast, they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve. See 46:10

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Verily, those who say: "Our Lord is God," (This is what said Jesus: "Hear O' Israel! the Lord our God is one Lord" N. T. Mark 12/29.) and are firm aright, then no fear shall be on them nor shall they grieve; The faith in God has to be declared in words and also proved by its practice in the daily life which means, the confirmation of the faith. One has not only to pronounce the belief in words but also to be steadfast on it, in the hours of trials in this life. The greatest example of faith and the steadfastness on it, could be found nowhere in the world, save in Husayn…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati khālidīna fīhā jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna They shall be the inhabitants of paradise, remaining in it [forever] —a reward for what they used to do.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati khālidīna fīhā jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do. See 46:10

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati khālidīna fīhā jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna These shall be inmates of the garden, abiding in it; a recompense for what they did See 46:13

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي اِنِّیْ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi iḥ'sānan ḥamalathu ummuhu kur'han wawaḍaʿathu kur'han waḥamluhu wafiṣāluhu thalāthūna shahran ḥattā idhā balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaʿīna sanatan qāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī innī tub'tu ilayka wa-innī mina l-mus'limīna We have enjoined man to be kind to his parents. His mother has carried him in travail, and bore him in travail, and his gestation and weaning take thirty months. When he comes of age and reaches forty years, he says, 'My Lord! Inspire me to give thanks for Your…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي اِنِّیْ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi iḥ'sānan ḥamalathu ummuhu kur'han wawaḍaʿathu kur'han waḥamluhu wafiṣāluhu thalāthūna shahran ḥattā idhā balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaʿīna sanatan qāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī innī tub'tu ilayka wa-innī mina l-mus'limīna And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning (period) is thirty months. (He grows) until, when he reaches maturity and reaches (the age of) forty years, he says, "My…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي اِنِّیْ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi iḥ'sānan ḥamalathu ummuhu kur'han wawaḍaʿathu kur'han waḥamluhu wafiṣāluhu thalāthūna shahran ḥattā idhā balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaʿīna sanatan qāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī innī tub'tu ilayka wa-innī mina l-mus'limīna And We have enjoined on man goodness unto his parents; Did bear him his mother with pain and she delivered him with pain; And bearing him and weaning him is thirty months (Refer to verse 2:233.) ; Until when he attaineth his maturity and reacheth forty years, sayeth he: "My…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَنَتَجاوَزُ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ فِي أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ ulāika alladhīna nataqabbalu ʿanhum aḥsana mā ʿamilū wanatajāwazu ʿan sayyiātihim fī aṣḥābi l-janati waʿda l-ṣid'qi alladhī kānū yūʿadūna Such are the ones from whom We accept the best of what they do, and overlook their misdeeds, [who will be] among the inhabitants of paradise —a true promise which they had been given.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَنَتَجاوَزُ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ فِي أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ ulāika alladhīna nataqabbalu ʿanhum aḥsana mā ʿamilū wanatajāwazu ʿan sayyiātihim fī aṣḥābi l-janati waʿda l-ṣid'qi alladhī kānū yūʿadūna Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, (their being) among the companions of Paradise. (That is) the promise of truth which they had been promised. See 46:15

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَنَتَجاوَزُ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ فِي أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ ulāika alladhīna nataqabbalu ʿanhum aḥsana mā ʿamilū wanatajāwazu ʿan sayyiātihim fī aṣḥābi l-janati waʿda l-ṣid'qi alladhī kānū yūʿadūna These are they from whom We accept the best of what they have done and pass by their evils, (they shall be) among the inmates of the Garden; (this is that) promise of truth which they were used to be promised (Note: Even the best deeds will be accepted only from the pious ones and not from all.) . See 46:15

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِنْ قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-alladhī qāla liwālidayhi uffin lakumā ataʿidāninī an ukh'raja waqad khalati l-qurūnu min qablī wahumā yastaghīthāni l-laha waylaka āmin inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fayaqūlu mā hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna As for him who says to his parents, 'Fie on you! Do you promise me that I shall be raised [from the dead] when generations have passed away before me?' And they invoke Allah's help [and say]: 'Woe to you! Believe! Indeed Allah's promise is true.' But he says, 'These are nothing but myths of the ancients.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِنْ قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-alladhī qāla liwālidayhi uffin lakumā ataʿidāninī an ukh'raja waqad khalati l-qurūnu min qablī wahumā yastaghīthāni l-laha waylaka āmin inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fayaqūlu mā hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna But one who says to his parents, "Uff1 to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth (from the earth) when generations before me have already passed on (into oblivion)?" while they call to Allah for help (and to their son), "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples". But he who says to his parents: "Uff to you! Do you promise me that I will…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِنْ قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-alladhī qāla liwālidayhi uffin lakumā ataʿidāninī an ukh'raja waqad khalati l-qurūnu min qablī wahumā yastaghīthāni l-laha waylaka āmin inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fayaqūlu mā hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna And he who sayeth unto his parents: "Fie on ye both! Promise ye me that I shall be brought forth (from the grave alive) when have passed away generations before me?" and they both implore for God's aid, (saying): "Woe unto thee! Believe thou; for verily the promise of God is true;" Then will he say: "This is naught but stories of the ancients." This is a reference to the disbelief in the Resurrection. They held the truth about it as the legends of…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ ulāika alladhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna Such are the ones against whom the word became due concerning the nations that have passed away before them of jinn and humans. They were indeed the losers.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ ulāika alladhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna Those are the ones upon whom the word (i.e., decree) has come into effect, (who will be) among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they (all) were losers. See 46:17

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ ulāika alladhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna These are they against whom the sentence hath been proved among the peoples of the jinn and the men that have passed away before them; verily they were the losers. See 46:17

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِمَّا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walikullin darajātun mimmā ʿamilū waliyuwaffiyahum aʿmālahum wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna For each [person] there will be degrees [of merit] pertaining to what he has done, that He may recompense them fully for their works, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِمَّا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walikullin darajātun mimmā ʿamilū waliyuwaffiyahum aʿmālahum wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And for all there are degrees (of reward and punishment) for what they have done, and (it is) so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged. See 46:17

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِمَّا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walikullin darajātun mimmā ʿamilū waliyuwaffiyahum aʿmālahum wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And for all (are ranks) (assigned) according to what they did, and that He (God.) may (fully) recompense their deeds, and they shall not be done any injustice. Though the return for evil would be equal to the degree of the evil but the reward for good will be far more than its merit and this would be due to the infinite mercy of God1.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri adhhabtum ṭayyibātikum fī ḥayātikumu l-dun'yā wa-is'tamtaʿtum bihā fal-yawma tuj'zawna ʿadhāba l-hūni bimā kuntum tastakbirūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tafsuqūna The day when the faithless are exposed to the Fire, [they will be told,] 'You have exhausted your good things in the life of the world and enjoyed them. So today you will be requited with a humiliating punishment for your acting arrogantly in the earth unduly, and because you used to transgress.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri adhhabtum ṭayyibātikum fī ḥayātikumu l-dun'yā wa-is'tamtaʿtum bihā fal-yawma tuj'zawna ʿadhāba l-hūni bimā kuntum tastakbirūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tafsuqūna And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire (it will be said), "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of (extreme) humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient." See 46:17

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri adhhabtum ṭayyibātikum fī ḥayātikumu l-dun'yā wa-is'tamtaʿtum bihā fal-yawma tuj'zawna ʿadhāba l-hūni bimā kuntum tastakbirūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tafsuqūna And on the day when shall be exposed those who dis-believed to the fire: (it will be said unto them): "Ye did away with your good things in your life of the world and ye took your fill of pleasure in them; This day therefore ye shall be recompensed with shameful chastisement for what ye used to act in arrogance (Prided unjustly.) in the earth without any right, and for what ye used to transgress." On the Day of Judgment when the disbelievers would be at…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنْذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ wa-udh'kur akhā ʿādin idh andhara qawmahu bil-aḥqāfi waqad khalati l-nudhuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin And mention [Hūd] the brother of 'Ād, when he warned his people at Aḥqāf —and warners have passed away before and after him— saying, 'Do not worship anyone but Allah. Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنْذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ wa-udh'kur akhā ʿādin idh andhara qawmahu bil-aḥqāfi waqad khalati l-nudhuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin And mention, (O Muḥammad), the brother of ʿAad,1 when he warned his people in (the region of) al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - (saying), "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."2 And remember the brother of 'Ad, when he warned his people in Al-Ahqaf. And surely, warners had already passed on before him and after him (saying): Worship none but Allah; truly, I fear for you the torment of a mighty Day (46:21).…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنْذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ wa-udh'kur akhā ʿādin idh andhara qawmahu bil-aḥqāfi waqad khalati l-nudhuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin And remember (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) of the brother of 'Ad when he warned his people of 'Al-Ahqaf' (The Sandhills.) and (while) indeed warners have been before him and after him (saying) "Worship ye not but God! Verily, I fear for you the chastisement of a grievous day. (Refer to verse 7:65.)" 'Hiqf' means a raised spot in the desert – 'Ahqaf' is the plural. The place under reference is said to have been located in Yeman near Hadramut at the shores of the Sea of Omman. The reference is…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū aji'tanā litafikanā ʿan ālihatinā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna They said, 'Have you come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring us what you threaten us with, should you be truthful.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū aji'tanā litafikanā ʿan ālihatinā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." See 46:21

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū aji'tanā litafikanā ʿan ālihatinā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Said they: "What! Come thou unto us to turn us away from our gods? Then bring (The Chastisement.) thou on us what thou threateneth us with, if thou art of the truthful ones." See 46:21

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ qāla innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-uballighukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna He said, 'The knowledge is with Allah alone. I communicate to you what I have been sent with. But I see that you are a senseless lot.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ qāla innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-uballighukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna He said, "Knowledge (of its time) is only with Allah, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you (to be) a people behaving ignorantly." See 46:21

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ qāla innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-uballighukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna Said he: "The knowledge (of it) is only with God, I only convey unto you the message which I am sent with, but I see you a people who are ignorant." See 46:21

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوْا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ falammā ra-awhu ʿāriḍan mus'taqbila awdiyatihim qālū hādhā ʿāriḍun mum'ṭirunā bal huwa mā is'taʿjaltum bihi rīḥun fīhā ʿadhābun alīmun When they saw it as a cloud advancing toward their valleys, they said, 'This cloud brings us rain.' 'Rather it is what you sought to hasten: a hurricane carrying a painful punishment,

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوْا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ falammā ra-awhu ʿāriḍan mus'taqbila awdiyatihim qālū hādhā ʿāriḍun mum'ṭirunā bal huwa mā is'taʿjaltum bihi rīḥun fīhā ʿadhābun alīmun And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient:1 a wind, within it a painful punishment. See 46:21

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوْا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ falammā ra-awhu ʿāriḍan mus'taqbila awdiyatihim qālū hādhā ʿāriḍun mum'ṭirunā bal huwa mā is'taʿjaltum bihi rīḥun fīhā ʿadhābun alīmun So when they saw (the punishment in the form of) a cloud advancing (Spreading.) unto their valleys, they said: "This is a cloud which will give us rain;" Nay! it is (the calamity) what ye sought to hasten on; a blast of a violent wind in which is a painful chastisement, The people were punished with a drought for three or seven years. Hud used to continuously admonish the people saying: "Believe ye in God and repent ye for your sins, ye mill have rain from God." The people increased only in adamance. A man named Qais Ibn Ghurrus even ridiculed Hud and said,…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا لَا يُرٰی إِلَّا مَسَاكِنُهُمْ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ tudammiru kulla shayin bi-amri rabbihā fa-aṣbaḥū lā yurā illā masākinuhum kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīna destroying everything by its Lord's command.' So they became such that nothing could be seen except their dwellings. Thus do We requite the guilty lot.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا لَا يُرٰی إِلَّا مَسَاكِنُهُمْ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ tudammiru kulla shayin bi-amri rabbihā fa-aṣbaḥū lā yurā illā masākinuhum kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīna Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen (of them) except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. See 46:21

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا لَا يُرٰی إِلَّا مَسَاكِنُهُمْ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ tudammiru kulla shayin bi-amri rabbihā fa-aṣbaḥū lā yurā illā masākinuhum kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīna Destroying every thing by the command of its Lord; So became they not to be seen save their dwellings; Thus do We recompense the guilty people (Totally destroyed – nothing but their ruined dwellings to be seen – No trace of theirs.) . The whole habitation with all its inhabitants, men and animals and even the houses of the people, were blown out, and the place became totally desolated. Heaps of sand were thrown over the habitation with its inmates. The blast continued for seven nights and eight days and ultimately the whole habitation turned into mounds of sand with the inhabitants in their dwellings, buried underneath.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِيمَا إِنْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِیْهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَارًا وَأَفْئِدَةً فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَا أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوْۤا يَجْحَدُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ walaqad makkannāhum fīmā in makkannākum fīhi wajaʿalnā lahum samʿan wa-abṣāran wa-afidatan famā aghnā ʿanhum samʿuhum walā abṣāruhum walā afidatuhum min shayin idh kānū yajḥadūna biāyāti l-lahi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna Certainly We had granted them power in respects that We have not granted you, and We had vested them with hearing and sight and hearts. But neither their hearing availed them nor did their sight, nor their hearts, in any way when they used to impugn the signs of Allah. So they were besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِيمَا إِنْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِیْهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَارًا وَأَفْئِدَةً فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَا أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوْۤا يَجْحَدُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ walaqad makkannāhum fīmā in makkannākum fīhi wajaʿalnā lahum samʿan wa-abṣāran wa-afidatan famā aghnā ʿanhum samʿuhum walā abṣāruhum walā afidatuhum min shayin idh kānū yajḥadūna biāyāti l-lahi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts (i.e., intellect). But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything (of the punishment) when they were (continually) rejecting the signs of Allah; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule. And indeed We had firmly established them with that wherewith We have not established you! We…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِيمَا إِنْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِیْهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَارًا وَأَفْئِدَةً فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَا أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوْۤا يَجْحَدُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ walaqad makkannāhum fīmā in makkannākum fīhi wajaʿalnā lahum samʿan wa-abṣāran wa-afidatan famā aghnā ʿanhum samʿuhum walā abṣāruhum walā afidatuhum min shayin idh kānū yajḥadūna biāyāti l-lahi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And certainly had We firmly established them, what We established not ye in it, and We had given them ears, and eyes and hearts; but availed not them aught their ears nor their eyes nor their hearts, (The Centre of intellect & emotions.) since they gainsaid the signs of God, and they were encircled by what they used to mock at (Refer to verse 45:33.) . See 46:25

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُمْ مِنَ الْقُرٰی وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ walaqad ahlaknā mā ḥawlakum mina l-qurā waṣarrafnā l-āyāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna Certainly We destroyed towns that were around you, and We have paraphrased the signs so that they may come back.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُمْ مِنَ الْقُرٰی وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ walaqad ahlaknā mā ḥawlakum mina l-qurā waṣarrafnā l-āyāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of (those) cities, and We have diversified the signs (or verses) that perhaps they might return (from disbelief). See 46:26

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُمْ مِنَ الْقُرٰی وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ walaqad ahlaknā mā ḥawlakum mina l-qurā waṣarrafnā l-āyāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And indeed We destroyed of the towns which are around you, and We did display (Repeat.) Our signs that they might turn (Repent and amend.) (unto Us). May refer to the ancient habitations in the Arabian Peninsula or around it. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا آلِهَةً بَلْ ضَلُّوْۤا عَنْهُمْ وَذٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ falawlā naṣarahumu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi qur'bānan ālihatan bal ḍallū ʿanhum wadhālika if'kuhum wamā kānū yaftarūna So why did not those [false gods] help them whom they had taken, besides Allah, as gods, as means of nearness [to Him]? Rather they forsook them; and that was their lie and what they used to fabricate.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا آلِهَةً بَلْ ضَلُّوْۤا عَنْهُمْ وَذٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ falawlā naṣarahumu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi qur'bānan ālihatan bal ḍallū ʿanhum wadhālika if'kuhum wamā kānū yaftarūna Then why did those they took besides Allah as deities by which to approach (Him)1 not aid them? But they had strayed (i.e., departed) from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing. See 46:26

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا آلِهَةً بَلْ ضَلُّوْۤا عَنْهُمْ وَذٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ falawlā naṣarahumu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi qur'bānan ālihatan bal ḍallū ʿanhum wadhālika if'kuhum wamā kānū yaftarūna unto God? Nay! but they failed them, and this was their lie and what they used to forge. See 46:27

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوْا أَنْصِتُوْۤا فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ wa-idh ṣarafnā ilayka nafaran mina l-jini yastamiʿūna l-qur'āna falammā ḥaḍarūhu qālū anṣitū falammā quḍiya wallaw ilā qawmihim mundhirīna When We dispatched toward you a team of jinn listening to the Qur'ān, when they were in its presence, they said, 'Be silent!' When it was finished, they went back to their people as warners.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوْا أَنْصِتُوْۤا فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ wa-idh ṣarafnā ilayka nafaran mina l-jini yastamiʿūna l-qur'āna falammā ḥaḍarūhu qālū anṣitū falammā quḍiya wallaw ilā qawmihim mundhirīna And (mention, O Muḥammad), when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners. And (remember) when We sent toward you a group of the Jinn, to listen to the Qur'an. When they attended it, they said: Listen quietly!" And when it was concluded, they returned to their people, as warners (46:29). They said: "O our people! Verily, we have heard a Book sent down after Musa, confirming what came before it, it guides to the truth and…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوْا أَنْصِتُوْۤا فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ wa-idh ṣarafnā ilayka nafaran mina l-jini yastamiʿūna l-qur'āna falammā ḥaḍarūhu qālū anṣitū falammā quḍiya wallaw ilā qawmihim mundhirīna And when turned We unto thee a party of jinn (Refer to note about verse on Jinn.) who (quietly) listened to the Qur'an when came they unto it, said they: "Be ye silent! (and listen)?" then when was finished (the recital), returned they unto their people warning (them against (Or against evil living. This clearly indicates that Jinn were also a generation like mankind and are influenced by the Word of God. See Note on jinn, and the other reference to them in the Qur'an.) the wrath of God) (Refer to verses 72:1, 55:33, 6:130.) About the people worshipping the jinn in the place…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاقَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مُوسٰی مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَى طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ qālū yāqawmanā innā samiʿ'nā kitāban unzila min baʿdi mūsā muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi wa-ilā ṭarīqin mus'taqīmin They said, 'O our people! Indeed we have heard a Book which has been sent down after Moses, confirming what was before it. It guides to the truth and to a straight path.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاقَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مُوسٰی مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَى طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ qālū yāqawmanā innā samiʿ'nā kitāban unzila min baʿdi mūsā muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi wa-ilā ṭarīqin mus'taqīmin They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a (recited) Book revealed after Musa confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path. See 46:29

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاقَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مُوسٰی مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَى طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ qālū yāqawmanā innā samiʿ'nā kitāban unzila min baʿdi mūsā muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi wa-ilā ṭarīqin mus'taqīmin Said (the Jinns): "O' ye our people! Verily, have we listened unto a Book sent down (from God) after Moses, verifying what is before it, guiding unto the truth and unto a path straight aright." Ibn Abbas says once the Holy Prophet said that he was commanded by God to recite the Holy Qur'an to the jinns and to warn them. He asked his companions as to who would like to accompany him to the recital. None uttered a word save Ibn Mas'ood. The Holy Prophet asked thrice but every time there was silence and none replied - Ibn Mas'ood says that…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوْۤا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yāqawmanā ajībū dāʿiya l-lahi waāminū bihi yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayujir'kum min ʿadhābin alīmin O our people! Respond to Allah's summoner and have faith in Him. He will forgive you some of your sins and shelter you from a painful punishment.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوْۤا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yāqawmanā ajībū dāʿiya l-lahi waāminū bihi yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayujir'kum min ʿadhābin alīmin O our people, respond to the Caller (i.e., Messenger) of Allah1 and believe in him; He (i.e., Allah) will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment. See 46:29

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوْۤا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yāqawmanā ajībū dāʿiya l-lahi waāminū bihi yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayujir'kum min ʿadhābin alīmin O' ye our people! Respond ye (all) unto the Summoner unto God and believe ye in Him, He will forgive you of your sins, and guard you against a painful chastisement. See 46:30

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ لَا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ waman lā yujib dāʿiya l-lahi falaysa bimuʿ'jizin fī l-arḍi walaysa lahu min dūnihi awliyāu ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin Those who do not respond to Allah's summoner cannot thwart [Allah] on the earth, and they will not find any protectors besides Him. They are in manifest error.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ لَا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ waman lā yujib dāʿiya l-lahi falaysa bimuʿ'jizin fī l-arḍi walaysa lahu min dūnihi awliyāu ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allah will not cause failure (to Him) upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error." See 46:29

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ لَا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ waman lā yujib dāʿiya l-lahi falaysa bimuʿ'jizin fī l-arḍi walaysa lahu min dūnihi awliyāu ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin And whosoever respondeth not unto the Summoner unto God, yet he can frustrate not God's will in the earth, and there shall not be for him, other than Him (God.) , any guardians; these are in manifest error Qummi says that the Holy Prophet once went to the market place, Akkaza, along with Zaid Ibn Haritha to preach the message of Islam, on his way back to Mecca he stayed in the valley of Najbah for the night and when he recited the Holy Qur'an, there also assembled some jinns, one of the groups carried the message of Islam to his kind. (MS. UB).…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
