item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی بَلَى إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa walam yaʿya bikhalqihinna biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā balā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and [who] was not exhausted by their creation, is able to revive the dead? Yes, indeed He has power over all things.

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی بَلَى إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa walam yaʿya bikhalqihinna biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā balā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent. Do they not see that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead Yes, He surely is Able to do all things (46:33). And on the Day when those who disbelieve will be exposed to the Fire (it will be said to them): Is this not…

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی بَلَى إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa walam yaʿya bikhalqihinna biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā balā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun What! Have they not seen that God Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, hath power to give life unto the dead? Aye! Verily, He is over all things powerful. (Refer to verses 2:255, 50:15, 3:78 - 3:83.) See 46:32

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna The day when the faithless are exposed to the Fire, [He will say,] 'Is this not a fact?' They will say, 'Yes, by our Lord!' He will say, 'So taste the punishment because of what you used to disbelieve.'

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire (it will be said), "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."1 See 46:33

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna them): "Is this not the truth?" They shall say: "Aye! By our Lord!" then He (God.) will say: "Taste ye (now) the chastisement for what ye used to disbelieve" (Refer to note about verses 36:63 & 36:64.) See 46:32

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُولُوْۤا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ بَلَاغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ fa-iṣ'bir kamā ṣabara ulū l-ʿazmi mina l-rusuli walā tastaʿjil lahum ka-annahum yawma yarawna mā yūʿadūna lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan min nahārin balāghun fahal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-fāsiqūna So be patient just as the resolute among the apostles were patient, and do not seek to hasten [the punishment] for them. The day when they see what they are promised, [it will be] as though they had remained only an hour of a day. This is a proclamation. So shall anyone be destroyed except the transgressing lot?

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُولُوْۤا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ بَلَاغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ fa-iṣ'bir kamā ṣabara ulū l-ʿazmi mina l-rusuli walā tastaʿjil lahum ka-annahum yawma yarawna mā yūʿadūna lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan min nahārin balāghun fahal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-fāsiqūna So be patient, (O Muḥammad), as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them.1 It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained (in the world) except an hour of a day. (This is) notification. And will (any) be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people? See 46:33

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُولُوْۤا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ بَلَاغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ fa-iṣ'bir kamā ṣabara ulū l-ʿazmi mina l-rusuli walā tastaʿjil lahum ka-annahum yawma yarawna mā yūʿadūna lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan min nahārin balāghun fahal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-fāsiqūna Therefore (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) bear thou up with patience, as did the apostles endowed with constancy (Fortitude.) and seek thou not to hasten for them (their doom); On the day when they will see what they have been promised, (it shall be unto them) as if they tarried not but (for only) an hour of the day; (a clear) Deliverance! (this is)! then shall be destroyed (Not total annihilation but the loss of happiness (A.P.).) any but the transgressing people. The duty of the apostle…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ittaqi l-laha walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman O Prophet! Be wary of Allah and do not obey the faithless and the hypocrites. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ittaqi l-laha walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise. وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ ۚ And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Meaning: of the Qur'an and Sunnah. إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا Verily, Allah is Well-Acquainted with what you do. means, nothing at all is hidden from Him, and put your trust in Allah, i.e., in all your affairs and situations. وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا and sufficient is Allah as a Wakil. means, sufficient is He as a Trustee for the one who puts his trust in Him and turns to Him.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ittaqi l-laha walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman O' Our Prophet (Muhammad!): "Fear thou (The Prophet addressed for the followers.) God (alone), and obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites; Verily God is All-Knowing, All-Wise," After the migration of the Holy Prophet and the Muslims from Mecca and their settling down at Medina, the Jews in Medina got envious of the wonderful progress Islam was making and the hold of the city and its affairs along with the leadership of the people passing into the hands of the Holy Prophet. Some of them who were proven to be treacherous, had to be expelled out of the city and the rest who embraced Islam were only hypocrites under Abdullah ibn Ubayy who was…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka min rabbika inna l-laha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīran And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka min rabbika inna l-laha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīran And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is ever, of what you do, Aware. See 33:1

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka min rabbika inna l-laha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīran And follow thou (Refer to note on verse 53:3 & 53:4. This clearly indicates that whatever the Holy Prophet utters or acts was the revealed will of the Lord.) what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord; Verily God is, of what ye do, well-aware, Man under any circumstances should not give up fearing evil, for man is apt to misjudge. The full knowledge of the facts is only with God who knows everything hidden and manifest.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīlan And put your trust in Allah; Allah suffices as trustee.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīlan And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.1 See 33:1

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīlan And rely thou on God (alone), and God is sufficient a Protector. Man should always depend upon God and believe in the sufficiency of God's protection and help.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللَّائِي تُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ ذَلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِي السَّبِيلَ mā jaʿala l-lahu lirajulin min qalbayni fī jawfihi wamā jaʿala azwājakumu allāī tuẓāhirūna min'hunna ummahātikum wamā jaʿala adʿiyāakum abnāakum dhālikum qawlukum bi-afwāhikum wal-lahu yaqūlu l-ḥaqa wahuwa yahdī l-sabīla Allah has not put two hearts within any man, nor has He made your wives whom you repudiate by ẓihār1 your mothers, nor has he made your adopted sons your sons. These are mere utterances of your mouths. But Allah speaks the truth and He guides to the way.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللَّائِي تُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ ذَلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِي السَّبِيلَ mā jaʿala l-lahu lirajulin min qalbayni fī jawfihi wamā jaʿala azwājakumu allāī tuẓāhirūna min'hunna ummahātikum wamā jaʿala adʿiyāakum abnāakum dhālikum qawlukum bi-afwāhikum wal-lahu yaqūlu l-ḥaqa wahuwa yahdī l-sabīla Allah has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful1 your mothers. And He has not made your claimed (i.e., adopted) sons your (true) sons. That is (merely) your saying by your mouths, but Allah says the truth, and He guides to the (right) way. Allah has not made for any man two hearts inside his body. Neither has He made your wives whom you declare to be like your mothers'…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللَّائِي تُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ ذَلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِي السَّبِيلَ mā jaʿala l-lahu lirajulin min qalbayni fī jawfihi wamā jaʿala azwājakumu allāī tuẓāhirūna min'hunna ummahātikum wamā jaʿala adʿiyāakum abnāakum dhālikum qawlukum bi-afwāhikum wal-lahu yaqūlu l-ḥaqa wahuwa yahdī l-sabīla God hath made not for any man two hearts in his breast; nor hath He made your wives whom ye declare (to be your mothers, are in fact also) your mothers; nor hath he made whom ye call (as your sons in real also) your sons; These are (mere) words of your mouths; and God speaketh the truth and He guideth unto the (right) way. The believers are told that they can not be faithful to God and His Apostle and also love and…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْعُوهُمْ لِءَابَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا ءَابَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَكِنْ مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا id'ʿūhum liābāihim huwa aqsaṭu ʿinda l-lahi fa-in lam taʿlamū ābāahum fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wamawālīkum walaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun fīmā akhṭatum bihi walākin mā taʿammadat qulūbukum wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman Call them after their fathers. That is more just with Allah. And if you do not know their fathers, then they are your brethren in the faith and your kinsmen. There will be no sin upon you for any mistake that you may make therein, barring what your hearts may premeditate. And Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْعُوهُمْ لِءَابَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا ءَابَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَكِنْ مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا id'ʿūhum liābāihim huwa aqsaṭu ʿinda l-lahi fa-in lam taʿlamū ābāahum fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wamawālīkum walaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun fīmā akhṭatum bihi walākin mā taʿammadat qulūbukum wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman Call them1 by (the names of) their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are (still) your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but (only for) what your hearts intended. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful. See 33:4

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْعُوهُمْ لِءَابَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا ءَابَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَكِنْ مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا id'ʿūhum liābāihim huwa aqsaṭu ʿinda l-lahi fa-in lam taʿlamū ābāahum fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wamawālīkum walaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun fīmā akhṭatum bihi walākin mā taʿammadat qulūbukum wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman Call them (Those held as adopted ones.) after their fathers; this is more just with God; but if ye know not their fathers, then they are your brethren in faith and your friends; and it shall not be on you any crime concerning that in which ye mistake, but what ye do with intent of heart; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. The people used to call Zayd as a taunt, Zayd ibn Muhammad, i.e., Zayd son of Muhammad. In this verse, it…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ وَأُولُوْۤا الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَفْعَلُوْۤا إِلَى أَوْلِيَائِكُمْ مَعْرُوفًا كَانَ ذٰلِكَ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا al-nabiyu awlā bil-mu'minīna min anfusihim wa-azwājuhu ummahātuhum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi mina l-mu'minīna wal-muhājirīna illā an tafʿalū ilā awliyāikum maʿrūfan kāna dhālika fī l-kitābi masṭūran The Prophet is closer to the faithful than their own souls,1 and his wives are their mothers. The blood relatives are more entitled to inherit from one another in the Book of Allah2 than the [other] faithful and Emigrants,3 barring any favour you may do your comrades.4 This has been written in the Book.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ وَأُولُوْۤا الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَفْعَلُوْۤا إِلَى أَوْلِيَائِكُمْ مَعْرُوفًا كَانَ ذٰلِكَ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا al-nabiyu awlā bil-mu'minīna min anfusihim wa-azwājuhu ummahātuhum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi mina l-mu'minīna wal-muhājirīna illā an tafʿalū ilā awliyāikum maʿrūfan kāna dhālika fī l-kitābi masṭūran The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves,1 and his wives are (in the position of) their mothers. And those of (blood) relationship are more entitled (to inheritance) in the decree of Allah than the (other) believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness (through bequest). That was in the Book2 inscribed. The Prophet is closer to the believers than themselves, and his wives are their mothers. And blood relations among each other…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ وَأُولُوْۤا الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَفْعَلُوْۤا إِلَى أَوْلِيَائِكُمْ مَعْرُوفًا كَانَ ذٰلِكَ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا al-nabiyu awlā bil-mu'minīna min anfusihim wa-azwājuhu ummahātuhum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi mina l-mu'minīna wal-muhājirīna illā an tafʿalū ilā awliyāikum maʿrūfan kāna dhālika fī l-kitābi masṭūran The Prophet (Muhammad) hath a greater claim (Refer to verse 42:48. Lit. Nearer.) on the believers than they have on their own selves, and his wives are (as) their mothers; and blood relations have the better claim in respect of one to the other, according to the book (This is the written ordinance.) of God, than the (other) believers and the emigrants, save that ye do some good unto your friends; This in the Book (of God) is prescribed. When the Holy…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِيثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنْكَ وَمِنْ نُوحٍ وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی وَعِيسٰی ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا wa-idh akhadhnā mina l-nabiyīna mīthāqahum waminka wamin nūḥin wa-ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā ib'ni maryama wa-akhadhnā min'hum mīthāqan ghalīẓan [Recall] when We took a pledge from the prophets, and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus son of Mary, and We took from them a solemn pledge,

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِيثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنْكَ وَمِنْ نُوحٍ وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی وَعِيسٰی ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا wa-idh akhadhnā mina l-nabiyīna mīthāqahum waminka wamin nūḥin wa-ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā ib'ni maryama wa-akhadhnā min'hum mīthāqan ghalīẓan And (mention, O Muḥammad), when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Nuh and Ibrahim and Musa and Isa, the son of Maryam; and We took from them a solemn covenant. And when We took from the Prophets their covenant, and from you, and from Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, and Isa son of Maryam. We took from them a strong covenant (33:7). That He may ask the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful torment (33:8). The Covenant of the Prophets Allah tells us about the five Mighty Messengers with strong resolve and the other Prophets,…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِيثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنْكَ وَمِنْ نُوحٍ وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی وَعِيسٰی ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا wa-idh akhadhnā mina l-nabiyīna mīthāqahum waminka wamin nūḥin wa-ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā ib'ni maryama wa-akhadhnā min'hum mīthāqan ghalīẓan And (Recollect) when took We a covenant from the prophets and from thee and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, son of Mary, and took We from them a firm covenant, When the Scriptures were given to the Apostles of God and they were commissioned with the ministry, and they were also asked if they undertake the mission and they all undertook the task they were charged with.1 And the Covenant entered into with the Holy Prophet was to testify that which was already revealed through all the apostles preceding him.2 The Covenants with previous apostles were not only to fulfil the duties of…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَسْءَلَ الصَّادِقِينَ عَنْ صِدْقِهِمْ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا liyasala l-ṣādiqīna ʿan ṣid'qihim wa-aʿadda lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāban alīman so that He may question the truthful concerning their truthfulness. And He has prepared for the faithless a painful punishment.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَسْءَلَ الصَّادِقِينَ عَنْ صِدْقِهِمْ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا liyasala l-ṣādiqīna ʿan ṣid'qihim wa-aʿadda lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāban alīman That He may question the truthful about their truth.1 And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment. See 33:7

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَسْءَلَ الصَّادِقِينَ عَنْ صِدْقِهِمْ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا liyasala l-ṣādiqīna ʿan ṣid'qihim wa-aʿadda lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāban alīman That He (God.) may question the truthful of their truth, and hath prepared He for the disbelievers a painful chastisement. Every apostle would be asked on the Day of Judgment about his discharging the duties assigned to him and the response he received from his people and the Holy Prophet Muhammad would be called to bear witness upon the statements of all the other apostles.1 This discloses a very great mystic factor that if the Holy Prophet was not present or had not witnessed the ministries of his predecessor apostles, how could he reasonably be a witness over them. Thus, this discloses the unique position of the Holy Prophet as the First of God's creation as he declared: 'Kuntu nabiyyan wa Adamu bayna al-ma'i…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَمْ تَرَوْهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh jāatkum junūdun fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan wajunūdan lam tarawhā wakāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīran O you who have faith! Remember Allah's blessing upon you when the hosts came at you, and We sent against them a gale and hosts whom you did not see. And Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَمْ تَرَوْهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh jāatkum junūdun fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan wajunūdan lam tarawhā wakāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīran O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to (attack) you and We sent upon them a wind and armies (of angels) you did not see. And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing. O you who believe! Remember Allah's favor to you, when there came against you hosts, and We sent against them a wind and forces that you saw not. And Allah is Ever All-Seer of what you do (33:9). When they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when the eyes grew wild…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَمْ تَرَوْهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh jāatkum junūdun fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan wajunūdan lam tarawhā wakāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīran O' ye who believe! Remember ye the bounty of God unto you when came upon you the hosts, then sent We upon them a strong wind and hosts that ye saw them not; and seeth God what (all) ye do. This verse refers to God's help bestowed upon the Muslims at the event of the great defensive battle of the Ditch which the Muslims had to fight in the month of Shawwal 5 A.H. (February 627 A.D.) The Jews at Medina getting envious of the march of Islam by leaps and bounds and the rise of the Muslim…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا idh jāūkum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa-idh zāghati l-abṣāru wabalaghati l-qulūbu l-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna bil-lahi l-ẓunūnā When they came at you from above and below you,1 and when the eyes rolled [with fear] and the hearts leapt to the throats, and you entertained misgivings about Allah,

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا idh jāūkum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa-idh zāghati l-abṣāru wabalaghati l-qulūbu l-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna bil-lahi l-ẓunūnā (Remember) when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted (in fear), and hearts reached the throats, and you assumed about Allah (various) assumptions. See 33:9

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا idh jāūkum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa-idh zāghati l-abṣāru wabalaghati l-qulūbu l-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna bil-lahi l-ẓunūnā When came they upon you from above (Openly, i.e., the heathens.) you and from below (The hidden enemies i.e. the Hypocrites and those of the wavering converts.) you, and were turned dull the eyes, and reached to the throats the hearts, and ye did imagine about God diverse thoughts. This verse refers to the awe-stricken state of the Muslims at the sight of the formidable forces of the enemy. The reference is to the battle of 'Ahzab' known as 'Khandaq' which was one of the great trials as referred by this verse (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا hunālika ub'tuliya l-mu'minūna wazul'zilū zil'zālan shadīdan it was there that the faithful were tested and jolted with a severe agitation.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا hunālika ub'tuliya l-mu'minūna wazul'zilū zil'zālan shadīdan There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking. There, the believers were tried and shaken with a mighty shaking (33:11). And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease said: Allah and His Messenger promised us nothing but delusion! (33:12). And when a party of them said: "O people of Yathrib! There is no postition for you. Therefore go back!" And a band of them ask for permission of the Prophet saying: "Truly, our homes lie open." And they lay not open. They but wished to flee (33:13). How the Believers were tested, and the Position of the Hypocrites during the Battle of Al-Khandaq Allah tells us what happened when the Confederates surrounded Al-Madinah and the Muslims were besieged and found themselves…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا hunālika ub'tuliya l-mu'minūna wazul'zilū zil'zālan shadīdan There were tried (Refer to note on verses 3:139, 9:64, 29:2 - 29:4 & 67:2.) the believers and they were shaken a tremendous shaking. The reference here is to the event of the battle of the Ditch which was a trial or a test for the believers, in which every Muslim was shaken by the awful situation. It is now for the intelligent students of the Holy Qur'an to judge about the faith of those who stood dumb and lifeless like statues when 'Amr ibn 'Abd Wudd challenged to fight him and the Holy Prophet repeatedly asked the Muslims if any one of them would fight the enemy of Islam. It is a fact of history that in the ranks there were all the companions and none stirred…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا wa-idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu illā ghurūran And when the hypocrites were saying, as well as those in whose hearts is a sickness, 'Allah and His Apostle did not promise us [anything] except delusion.'

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا wa-idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu illā ghurūran And (remember) when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion." See 33:11

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا wa-idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu illā ghurūran And when began to say the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease that: "Promised us not God and His Apostle but (it was only) a deception." (Similar was the doubt at Sulh-e-Hudaybiyyah.) The hypocrites had doubted about the assurance given to them by the Holy Prophet about the ultimate victory Islam would have. The weak in faith, were led by the circumstances which had no indication of the least success against the most formidable forces of the enemy and thus had said that the promise of victory extended to them was only a deceptive measure merely to encourage them to face the hopeless situation.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ يَاأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوا وَيِسْتَءْذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمُ النَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِنْ يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا wa-idh qālat ṭāifatun min'hum yāahla yathriba lā muqāma lakum fa-ir'jiʿū wayastadhinu farīqun min'humu l-nabiya yaqūlūna inna buyūtanā ʿawratun wamā hiya biʿawratin in yurīdūna illā firāran And when a group of them said, 'O people of Yathrib! [This is] not a place for you,1 so go back!'2 And a group of them sought the Prophet's permission, saying, 'Our homes lie exposed3 [to the enemy],' although they were not exposed. They only sought to flee.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ يَاأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوا وَيِسْتَءْذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمُ النَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِنْ يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا wa-idh qālat ṭāifatun min'hum yāahla yathriba lā muqāma lakum fa-ir'jiʿū wayastadhinu farīqun min'humu l-nabiya yaqūlūna inna buyūtanā ʿawratun wamā hiya biʿawratin in yurīdūna illā firāran And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib,1 there is no stability for you (here), so return (home)." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are exposed (i.e., unprotected)," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee. See 33:11

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ يَاأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوا وَيِسْتَءْذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمُ النَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِنْ يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا wa-idh qālat ṭāifatun min'hum yāahla yathriba lā muqāma lakum fa-ir'jiʿū wayastadhinu farīqun min'humu l-nabiya yaqūlūna inna buyūtanā ʿawratun wamā hiya biʿawratin in yurīdūna illā firāran And when said a party of them: "O' ye the people of Yathrib! (The former name of the town which after the Migration of the Holy Prophet to it, was renamed Medinat al-Nabi - Now called only Medina.) There is no place for you to stand, so return ye," and a party of them asked permission of the Prophet saying: "Verily our houses are exposed (to destruction)," and they were not exposed (to destruction): they only intended to flee away. A group of the Muslims, misled by the defeatist rumours…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوْۤا الْفِتْنَةَ لَءَاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا بِهَا إِلَّا يَسِيرًا walaw dukhilat ʿalayhim min aqṭārihā thumma su-ilū l-fit'nata laātawhā wamā talabbathū bihā illā yasīran Had they been invaded from its flanks1 and had they been asked to apostatize, they would have done so with only a mild hesitation,

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوْۤا الْفِتْنَةَ لَءَاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا بِهَا إِلَّا يَسِيرًا walaw dukhilat ʿalayhim min aqṭārihā thumma su-ilū l-fit'nata laātawhā wamā talabbathū bihā illā yasīran And if they had been entered upon from all its (surrounding) regions and fitnah (i.e., disbelief) had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly. And if the enemy had entered from all sides, and they had been exhorted to Al-Fitnah, they would surely have committed it and would have hesitated thereupon but little (33:14). And indeed they had already made a covenant with Allah not to turn their backs, and a covenant with Allah must be answered for (33:15). Say: Flight will not avail you if you flee from death or killing and then you will enjoy no more than a little while!…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوْۤا الْفِتْنَةَ لَءَاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا بِهَا إِلَّا يَسِيرًا walaw dukhilat ʿalayhim min aqṭārihā thumma su-ilū l-fit'nata laātawhā wamā talabbathū bihā illā yasīran And had the entry been made upon them from all sides (of the City), and had they been incited to treachery, they would certainly have brought it to pass, with only a short time had they stayed. The hearts of the weak in faith had been so otherwise much affected by the dejection that had dawned upon them by the disheartening rumours and they had been reduced to so much of unfaithfulness that if the enemy had by chance penetrated into the city and called them to fight the Muslims, they were so much degenerated in faith that they would not have in the least delayed in doing it.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوْۤا عَاهَدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْأَدْبَارَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ مَسْءُولًا walaqad kānū ʿāhadū l-laha min qablu lā yuwallūna l-adbāra wakāna ʿahdu l-lahi masūlan though they had certainly pledged to Allah before that they would not turn their backs [to flee], and pledges given to Allah are accountable.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوْۤا عَاهَدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْأَدْبَارَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ مَسْءُولًا walaqad kānū ʿāhadū l-laha min qablu lā yuwallūna l-adbāra wakāna ʿahdu l-lahi masūlan And they had already promised Allah before not to turn their backs (i.e., flee). And ever is the promise to Allah (that about which one will be) questioned. See 33:14

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوْۤا عَاهَدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْأَدْبَارَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ مَسْءُولًا walaqad kānū ʿāhadū l-laha min qablu lā yuwallūna l-adbāra wakāna ʿahdu l-lahi masūlan And indeed they had made a covenant with God before (that) they would turn (Reference to the Companions of the Holy Prophet and the others running away from the battlefield at Uhud.) not their backs; And the covenant with God shall be inquired of. After their desertion at the battle of Uhud, they had repented and had promised never again to desert the faith and they had solemnly promised to fight for Islam. The reference here alluding to deserters at the battle of Uhud, indicates that the group of such weak in faith and the hypocrites consisted of also those who had run away from the battle of Uhud, leaving the Holy Prophet to…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا qul lan yanfaʿakumu l-firāru in farartum mina l-mawti awi l-qatli wa-idhan lā tumattaʿūna illā qalīlan Say, 'Flight will not avail you should you flee from death or from being killed, and then you will be let to enjoy only for a little while.'

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا qul lan yanfaʿakumu l-firāru in farartum mina l-mawti awi l-qatli wa-idhan lā tumattaʿūna illā qalīlan Say, (O Muḥammad), "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then (if you did), you would not be given enjoyment (of life) except for a little." See 33:14

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا qul lan yanfaʿakumu l-firāru in farartum mina l-mawti awi l-qatli wa-idhan lā tumattaʿūna illā qalīlan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad) "Never shall benefit you the flight, if ye flee away from death or slaughter, and (even) then ye will not be allowed to enjoy yourselves but (only) a little" Ali says: "Ayyu yawmayya min al-mawt afriru? Yawmun la yuqaddar am yawmun qad quddir?" i.e., Which of the two days I should run away from death - the day not destined or the day destined? (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْصِمُكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا qul man dhā alladhī yaʿṣimukum mina l-lahi in arāda bikum sūan aw arāda bikum raḥmatan walā yajidūna lahum min dūni l-lahi waliyyan walā naṣīran Say, 'Who is it that can protect you from Allah should He desire to cause you ill, or desire to grant you mercy?' They will not find for themselves any protector or helper besides Allah.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْصِمُكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا qul man dhā alladhī yaʿṣimukum mina l-lahi in arāda bikum sūan aw arāda bikum raḥmatan walā yajidūna lahum min dūni l-lahi waliyyan walā naṣīran Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allah1 if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector or any helper. See 33:14

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْصِمُكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا qul man dhā alladhī yaʿṣimukum mina l-lahi in arāda bikum sūan aw arāda bikum raḥmatan walā yajidūna lahum min dūni l-lahi waliyyan walā naṣīran Say thou: "Who is he that can screen you from God if intendeth He unto you any evil or intendeth He unto you mercy?" And they will find not for themselves other than God any guardian or helper. See 33:16

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالْقَائِلِينَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا وَلَا يَأْتُونَ الْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا qad yaʿlamu l-lahu l-muʿawiqīna minkum wal-qāilīna li-ikh'wānihim halumma ilaynā walā yatūna l-basa illā qalīlan Allah knows those of you who discourage others, and those who say to their brethren, 'Come to us!' and they take little part in the battle,

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالْقَائِلِينَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا وَلَا يَأْتُونَ الْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا qad yaʿlamu l-lahu l-muʿawiqīna minkum wal-qāilīna li-ikh'wānihim halumma ilaynā walā yatūna l-basa illā qalīlan Already Allah knows the hinderers1 among you and those (hypocrites) who say to their brothers, "Come to us,"2 and do not go to battle, except for a few.3 Allah already knows those among you who keep back (men) from fighting (in Allah's cause), and those who say to their brethren, "Come here towards us," while they come not to the battle except a little (33:18). Being miserly towards you. Then when fear comes, you will see them looking to you, their eyes revolving like one over whom hovers death; but when the fear departs, they will smite you with sharp tongues, miserly towards good. Such have not believed. Therefore, Allah makes their…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالْقَائِلِينَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا وَلَا يَأْتُونَ الْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا qad yaʿlamu l-lahu l-muʿawiqīna minkum wal-qāilīna li-ikh'wānihim halumma ilaynā walā yatūna l-basa illā qalīlan Indeed knoweth God those who hinder others (Refers to the activities of the hypocrites on the day of the battle of Khandaq (The Ditch).) among you and those who say unto their brethren "Come hither unto us," and they come not to fight but a little, A man from the Muslim ranks who had been in the city, found one of his brothers sitting, enjoying the drink of wine. The man said: "You are enjoying at home while the Holy Prophet is facing the arrows and the swords of the enemy. I shall inform the Holy Prophet of your conduct." By the time the man came to the Holy Prophet the Messenger…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشٰی عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُمْ بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا ashiḥḥatan ʿalaykum fa-idhā jāa l-khawfu ra-aytahum yanẓurūna ilayka tadūru aʿyunuhum ka-alladhī yugh'shā ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-idhā dhahaba l-khawfu salaqūkum bi-alsinatin ḥidādin ashiḥḥatan ʿalā l-khayri ulāika lam yu'minū fa-aḥbaṭa l-lahu aʿmālahum wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīran grudging you [their help]. So when there is panic, you see them observing you, their eyes rolling, like someone fainting at death. Then, when the panic is over, they scald you with [their] sharp tongues in their greed for riches. They never have had faith. So Allah has made their works fail, and that is easy for Allah.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشٰی عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُمْ بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا ashiḥḥatan ʿalaykum fa-idhā jāa l-khawfu ra-aytahum yanẓurūna ilayka tadūru aʿyunuhum ka-alladhī yugh'shā ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-idhā dhahaba l-khawfu salaqūkum bi-alsinatin ḥidādin ashiḥḥatan ʿalā l-khayri ulāika lam yu'minū fa-aḥbaṭa l-lahu aʿmālahum wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīran Indisposed1 toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward (any) good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah, easy. See 33:18

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشٰی عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُمْ بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا ashiḥḥatan ʿalaykum fa-idhā jāa l-khawfu ra-aytahum yanẓurūna ilayka tadūru aʿyunuhum ka-alladhī yugh'shā ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-idhā dhahaba l-khawfu salaqūkum bi-alsinatin ḥidādin ashiḥḥatan ʿalā l-khayri ulāika lam yu'minū fa-aḥbaṭa l-lahu aʿmālahum wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīran Being niggardly unto you, but when cometh fear, thou wilt see them looking unto you, their eyes rolling (A pen picture of the people as a whole in the state of fright where Ali alone fought the enemy and won the victory for Islam.) like the one on whom death hath cast its shadow and when passeth away the fear, they smite you with sharp tongues, being niggardly of the…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَحْسَبُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوْۤا وَإِنْ يَأْتِ الْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوْۤا لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ يَسْءَلُونَ عَنْ أَنْبَائِكُمْ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا فِيكُمْ مَا قَاتَلُوْۤا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا yaḥsabūna l-aḥzāba lam yadhhabū wa-in yati l-aḥzābu yawaddū law annahum bādūna fī l-aʿrābi yasalūna ʿan anbāikum walaw kānū fīkum mā qātalū illā qalīlan They suppose the confederates have not left yet, and were the confederates to come [again], they would wish they were in the desert with the Bedouins asking about your news, and if they were with you they would fight but a little.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَحْسَبُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوْۤا وَإِنْ يَأْتِ الْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوْۤا لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ يَسْءَلُونَ عَنْ أَنْبَائِكُمْ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا فِيكُمْ مَا قَاتَلُوْۤا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا yaḥsabūna l-aḥzāba lam yadhhabū wa-in yati l-aḥzābu yawaddū law annahum bādūna fī l-aʿrābi yasalūna ʿan anbāikum walaw kānū fīkum mā qātalū illā qalīlan They think the companies have not (yet) withdrawn.1 And if the companies should come (again), they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring (from afar) about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little. See 33:18

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَحْسَبُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوْۤا وَإِنْ يَأْتِ الْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوْۤا لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ يَسْءَلُونَ عَنْ أَنْبَائِكُمْ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا فِيكُمْ مَا قَاتَلُوْۤا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا yaḥsabūna l-aḥzāba lam yadhhabū wa-in yati l-aḥzābu yawaddū law annahum bādūna fī l-aʿrābi yasalūna ʿan anbāikum walaw kānū fīkum mā qātalū illā qalīlan Think they the allies have not gone, and should the clans come (again) they would fain be dwelling with the wandering arabs in the desert, seeking news (Pictures the state of the mind of the hypocrites in Medina. They actually did it at Uhud and Hunayn.) about you; and had they been amidst you, they would fight not but a little. This verse draws a vivid picture of the state of mortal fright that had dawned on the hypocrites. The description starts from verse 33:12 in which it is said that they were so…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا laqad kāna lakum fī rasūli l-lahi us'watun ḥasanatun liman kāna yarjū l-laha wal-yawma l-ākhira wadhakara l-laha kathīran In the Apostle of Allah there is certainly for you a good exemplar, for those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day, and remember Allah greatly.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا laqad kāna lakum fī rasūli l-lahi us'watun ḥasanatun liman kāna yarjū l-laha wal-yawma l-ākhira wadhakara l-laha kathīran There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern1 for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day and (who) remembers Allah often. Indeed in the Messenger of Allah you have a good example to follow for him who hopes in Allah and the Last Day, and remembers Allah much (33:21). And when the believers saw the Confederates, they said: "This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us; and Allah and His Messenger had spoken the truth." And it only added to their faith and to their submissiveness (33:22). The Command to Follow the Messenger SAW This…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا laqad kāna lakum fī rasūli l-lahi us'watun ḥasanatun liman kāna yarjū l-laha wal-yawma l-ākhira wadhakara l-laha kathīran Indeed (there) is for you in the Apostle of God (Muhammad) an excellent pattern (Believes in God and seeks His pleasure.) (of conduct) for him who hopeth in God and the latter day (The life hereafter - the day of judgment.) and remembereth God much. From this verse starts the description of the minds of the sincere believers. In the Holy Prophet, God has presented a beautiful pattern of conduct and character for the one who aspires for the mercy of the Lord and hopes in the success or victory in the ultimate. When the enemy advanced towards Medina, the Holy Prophet told the Muslims never…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا رَءَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوْا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا إِيمَانًا وَتَسْلِيمًا walammā raā l-mu'minūna l-aḥzāba qālū hādhā mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu waṣadaqa l-lahu warasūluhu wamā zādahum illā īmānan wataslīman But when the faithful saw the confederates, they said, 'This is what Allah and His Apostle had promised us, and Allah and His Apostle were true.' And it only increased them in faith and submission.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا رَءَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوْا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا إِيمَانًا وَتَسْلِيمًا walammā raā l-mu'minūna l-aḥzāba qālū hādhā mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu waṣadaqa l-lahu warasūluhu wamā zādahum illā īmānan wataslīman And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance. See 33:21

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا رَءَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوْا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا إِيمَانًا وَتَسْلِيمًا walammā raā l-mu'minūna l-aḥzāba qālū hādhā mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu waṣadaqa l-lahu warasūluhu wamā zādahum illā īmānan wataslīman And when saw the believers the allies, said they: "This is what God promised unto us and His Apostle and God and His Apostle had spoken the truth;" and it increased not in them but faith and submission. Here it is given as to how the mind of the sincere ones in faith in contrast to that of the hypocrites and the weak in faith, viewed the situation of the enemy's attack. The faithful ones seeing the enemy's presence, instead of getting dejected and perturbed, awaited the fulfilment of the promise of God about the ultimate triumph of Islam over all its enemies.1 Every…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوْۤا مَا عَاهَدُوْۤا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوْۤا تَبْدِيلًا mina l-mu'minīna rijālun ṣadaqū mā ʿāhadū l-laha ʿalayhi famin'hum man qaḍā naḥbahu wamin'hum man yantaẓiru wamā baddalū tabdīlan Among the faithful are men who fulfill what they have pledged to Allah. Of them are some who have fulfilled their pledge, and of them are some who still wait, and they have not changed in the least,

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوْۤا مَا عَاهَدُوْۤا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوْۤا تَبْدِيلًا mina l-mu'minīna rijālun ṣadaqū mā ʿāhadū l-laha ʿalayhi famin'hum man qaḍā naḥbahu wamin'hum man yantaẓiru wamā baddalū tabdīlan Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allah. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow (to the death), and among them is he who awaits (his chance). And they did not alter (the terms of their commitment) by any alteration. Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah; of them some have fulfilled their Nahbah; and some of them are still waiting, but they have never changed in the least (33:23). That Allah may reward the men of truth for their truth, and punish the hypocrites, if He wills, or accept their repentance…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوْۤا مَا عَاهَدُوْۤا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوْۤا تَبْدِيلًا mina l-mu'minīna rijālun ṣadaqū mā ʿāhadū l-laha ʿalayhi famin'hum man qaḍā naḥbahu wamin'hum man yantaẓiru wamā baddalū tabdīlan Of the believers are the men who are true to what they covenanted with God; of them is he who hath fulfilled (Refers to those who stood fast with the Holy Prophet up to the end - and those who ran away from the battlefields do not come under this category.) his vow and of them is he who awaiteth (its fulfilment); and they have changed not in the least, The Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, in the interpretation of this verse said, that those who had fulfilled their promise to be steadfast in defending the truth and had become martyrs, were…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ الصَّادِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا liyajziya l-lahu l-ṣādiqīna biṣid'qihim wayuʿadhiba l-munāfiqīna in shāa aw yatūba ʿalayhim inna l-laha kāna ghafūran raḥīman that Allah may reward the true for their truthfulness, and punish the hypocrites, if He wishes, or accept their repentance. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ الصَّادِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا liyajziya l-lahu l-ṣādiqīna biṣid'qihim wayuʿadhiba l-munāfiqīna in shāa aw yatūba ʿalayhim inna l-laha kāna ghafūran raḥīman That Allah may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful. See 33:23

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ الصَّادِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا liyajziya l-lahu l-ṣādiqīna biṣid'qihim wayuʿadhiba l-munāfiqīna in shāa aw yatūba ʿalayhim inna l-laha kāna ghafūran raḥīman That God may recompense the truthful ones for their truth, and chastise the hypocrites if He willeth or turn unto them (merciful); Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. This is one of the clear proofs that the companions of the Holy Prophet were of different grades in faith. The first and the foremost are the true believers as depicted in verse 33:23 whose success in the life hereafter is assured beyond doubt in verse 33:24 and the hypocrites who are subject to punishment or forgiveness. However, all the companions cannot be the Guiding Stars to be followed. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَدَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوْۤا خَيْرًا وَكَفَى اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا waradda l-lahu alladhīna kafarū bighayẓihim lam yanālū khayran wakafā l-lahu l-mu'minīna l-qitāla wakāna l-lahu qawiyyan ʿazīzan Allah sent back the faithless in their rage, without their attaining any advantage, and Allah spared the faithful of fighting, and Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَدَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوْۤا خَيْرًا وَكَفَى اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا waradda l-lahu alladhīna kafarū bighayẓihim lam yanālū khayran wakafā l-lahu l-mu'minīna l-qitāla wakāna l-lahu qawiyyan ʿazīzan And Allah repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allah for the believers in battle, and ever is Allah Powerful and Exalted in Might. And Allah drove back those who disbelieved in their rage: they gained no advantage. Allah sufficed for the believers in the fighting. And Allah is Ever All-Strong, All-Mighty (33:25). Allah Drove back the Confederates Disappointed and Lost Allah tells us how he drove the Confederates away from Al-Madinah by sending against them a wind and troops of angels. If Allah had not made his Messenger SAW a Mercy to the Worlds, this wind would have been…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَدَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوْۤا خَيْرًا وَكَفَى اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا waradda l-lahu alladhīna kafarū bighayẓihim lam yanālū khayran wakafā l-lahu l-mu'minīna l-qitāla wakāna l-lahu qawiyyan ʿazīzan And God turned back those who disbelieve in their rage, they achieved not any advantage; and God did suffice for the believers in fighting; for God is All-Strong, the Almighty. The Omnipotent Lord made the furious enemy to avail of nothing, in spite of the joint efforts of all the allies together viz. the Bedouins of the interior, the envious and the hostile Jews from Medina and the treacherous hypocrites. All plans, intrigues and plots were frustrated, though on the occasion every one of the Muslims was awfully dreading the very sight of the formidable strength of the enemy the one single-handed combat of Ali with Amr ibn…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْزَلَ الَّذِينَ ظَاهَرُوهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِنْ صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا wa-anzala alladhīna ẓāharūhum min ahli l-kitābi min ṣayāṣīhim waqadhafa fī qulūbihimu l-ruʿ'ba farīqan taqtulūna watasirūna farīqan And He dragged down those who had backed them from among the People of the Book from their strongholds, and He cast terror into their hearts, [so that] you killed a part of them, and took captive [another] part of them.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْزَلَ الَّذِينَ ظَاهَرُوهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِنْ صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا wa-anzala alladhīna ẓāharūhum min ahli l-kitābi min ṣayāṣīhim waqadhafa fī qulūbihimu l-ruʿ'ba farīqan taqtulūna watasirūna farīqan And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture1 from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts (so that) a party (i.e., their men) you killed, and you took captive a party (i.e., the women and children). And those of the People of the Scripture who backed them, Allah brought them down from their forts and cast terror into their hearts; a group you killed, and a group you made captives (33:26). And He caused you to inherit their lands, and their houses, and their riches, and a land which you had not trodden. And Allah is able to do all things…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْزَلَ الَّذِينَ ظَاهَرُوهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِنْ صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا wa-anzala alladhīna ẓāharūhum min ahli l-kitābi min ṣayāṣīhim waqadhafa fī qulūbihimu l-ruʿ'ba farīqan taqtulūna watasirūna farīqan And He drove down those of the people of the Book who backed them (The Meccan polytheists - Reference to the Battle of Banu Qurayza.) from their fortresses, and He cast awe into their hearts, some ye killed and took ye captives of the other part (of them) When the confederates had fled away in chaos and dismay the Holy Prophet could have ordered to chase the fleeing enemy and effect a wholesale slaughter but he commanded quiet return to Medina and when he had just returned home and had not yet washed his face, the Messenger Angel Gabriel appeared and conveyed the will of the Lord not…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَمْ تَطَئُوهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا wa-awrathakum arḍahum wadiyārahum wa-amwālahum wa-arḍan lam taṭaūhā wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīran And He bequeathed you their land, their houses and their possessions, and a territory you had not trodden, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَمْ تَطَئُوهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا wa-awrathakum arḍahum wadiyārahum wa-amwālahum wa-arḍan lam taṭaūhā wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīran And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden.1 And ever is Allah, over all things, competent. See 33:26

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَمْ تَطَئُوهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا wa-awrathakum arḍahum wadiyārahum wa-amwālahum wa-arḍan lam taṭaūhā wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīran And He made you to inherit their land and their dwellings and their properties, and a land (Refer to verses 59:2 - 59:7.) which ye have not yet set your foot; And God is Powerful over all things. See 33:26

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika in kuntunna turid'na l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā fataʿālayna umattiʿ'kunna wa-usarriḥ'kunna sarāḥan jamīlan O Prophet! Say to your wives, 'If you desire the life of the world and its glitter, come, I will provide for you and release you in a graceful manner.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika in kuntunna turid'na l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā fataʿālayna umattiʿ'kunna wa-usarriḥ'kunna sarāḥan jamīlan O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release. O Prophet! Say to your wives: "If you desire the life of this world, and its glitter, then come! I will make a provision for you and set you free in a handsome manner (33:28). "But if you desire Allah and His Messenger, and the Home of the Hereafter, then verily, Allah has prepared for the doers of good among you an enormous reward (33:29). Giving the Wives of the Prophet SAW the Choice Here Allah commands His Messenger SAW to…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika in kuntunna turid'na l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā fataʿālayna umattiʿ'kunna wa-usarriḥ'kunna sarāḥan jamīlan O' Our Prophet (Muhammad!) Say thou unto thy wives: "If ye desire (the enjoyment of) the life of this world and its adornment, come then I will provide for you and allow you to depart (For they had become intolerably troublesome to the Holy Prophet, the separation was offered to these.) a goodly departing." When the Holy Prophet returned home after the victory at Khaybar, his wives asked him to distribute the booty among them. The Holy Prophet said that he had distributed it as commanded by God. They said, "Dost thou not know that after thy death we could not be married to anyone else?" God desired the Holy…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنْكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا wa-in kuntunna turid'na l-laha warasūlahu wal-dāra l-ākhirata fa-inna l-laha aʿadda lil'muḥ'sināti minkunna ajran ʿaẓīman But if you desire Allah and His Apostle and the abode of the Hereafter, then Allah has indeed prepared for the virtuous among you a great reward.'

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنْكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا wa-in kuntunna turid'na l-laha warasūlahu wal-dāra l-ākhirata fa-inna l-laha aʿadda lil'muḥ'sināti minkunna ajran ʿaẓīman But if you should desire Allah and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allah has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward." See 33:28

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنْكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا wa-in kuntunna turid'na l-laha warasūlahu wal-dāra l-ākhirata fa-inna l-laha aʿadda lil'muḥ'sināti minkunna ajran ʿaẓīman And if ye desire God and His Apostle and the abode in the hereafter, then verily God hath prepared for the good (Refer to note on verse 33:28.) among you a great recompense. In this verse there is the promise of the great heavenly reward to the righteous and the faithful ones among the wives of the Holy Prophet the object of whose alliance with the Holy Prophet was not owning any riches or any fortune but to please God and His Holy Apostle Muhammad and to achieve the blissful life in the ultimate.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَانِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ مَنْ يَأْتِ مِنْكُنَّ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَاعَفْ لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا yānisāa l-nabiyi man yati minkunna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin yuḍāʿaf lahā l-ʿadhābu ḍiʿ'fayni wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīran O wives of the Prophet! Whoever of you commits a gross indecency, her punishment shall be doubled, and that is easy for Allah.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَانِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ مَنْ يَأْتِ مِنْكُنَّ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَاعَفْ لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا yānisāa l-nabiyi man yati minkunna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin yuḍāʿaf lahā l-ʿadhābu ḍiʿ'fayni wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīran O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allah, easy. O wives of the Prophet! Whoever of you commits an open Fahishah, the torment for her will be doubled, and that is ever easy for Allah (33:30). And whosoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger, and does righteous good deeds, We shall give her, her reward twice over, and We have prepared for her a noble provision (33:31). The Wives of the Prophet SAW are Not like Other Women This Ayah is addressed to the…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَانِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ مَنْ يَأْتِ مِنْكُنَّ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَاعَفْ لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا yānisāa l-nabiyi man yati minkunna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin yuḍāʿaf lahā l-ʿadhābu ḍiʿ'fayni wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīran O' wives of the Prophet! whosoever of you committeth an open (Not adultery as they have been cleared of their charge. Refer to note on verse 33:28.) indecency double will be the chastisement for her; and this for God is easy. It is to be noted by the critics of the Holy Prophet and Islam that whatever the Holy Prophet got as the booty in the several defensive battles was in his hands; and at his independent and exclusive disposal he could have appropriated everything to his personal use or for the use of his wives and the other relatives. Any indecency on the part of his wives…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَقْنُتْ مِنْكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا نُؤْتِهَا أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا waman yaqnut minkunna lillahi warasūlihi wataʿmal ṣāliḥan nu'tihā ajrahā marratayni wa-aʿtadnā lahā riz'qan karīman But whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Apostle and acts righteously, We shall give her a twofold reward, and We hold a noble provision in store for her.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَقْنُتْ مِنْكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا نُؤْتِهَا أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا waman yaqnut minkunna lillahi warasūlihi wataʿmal ṣāliḥan nu'tihā ajrahā marratayni wa-aʿtadnā lahā riz'qan karīman And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allah and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision. See 33:30

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَقْنُتْ مِنْكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا نُؤْتِهَا أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا waman yaqnut minkunna lillahi warasūlihi wataʿmal ṣāliḥan nu'tihā ajrahā marratayni wa-aʿtadnā lahā riz'qan karīman And whoever of you is obedient to God and His Apostle and doeth good, We will give her recompense twice, and We have prepared for her an honour able sustenance. The term double reward mentioned here does not mean twice but a greater reward. They earn this grace of God for their denying themselves the ordinary comforts of life and their remaining faithful to the Holy Prophet abiding by his guidance. As they are entitled to an increased punishment for any ordinary indecency, similar increase they are also entitled to a similar increase in the reward for their virtues.1 This indicates that some of the wives of the Holy Prophet were not…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَانِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِي فِي قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا yānisāa l-nabiyi lastunna ka-aḥadin mina l-nisāi ini ittaqaytunna falā takhḍaʿna bil-qawli fayaṭmaʿa alladhī fī qalbihi maraḍun waqul'na qawlan maʿrūfan O wives of the Prophet! You are not like any other women: if you are wary [of Allah], then do not be complaisant in your speech, lest he in whose heart is a sickness should aspire, and speak honourable words.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَانِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِي فِي قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا yānisāa l-nabiyi lastunna ka-aḥadin mina l-nisāi ini ittaqaytunna falā takhḍaʿna bil-qawli fayaṭmaʿa alladhī fī qalbihi maraḍun waqul'na qawlan maʿrūfan O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allah, then do not be soft in speech (to men),1 lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech. O wives of the Prophet! You are not like any other women. If you keep you have Taqwa, then be not soft in speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease should be moved with desire, but speak in an honorable manner (33:32). And stay in your houses, and do not Tabarruj yourselves like the Tabarruj of the times of ignorance, and…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَانِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِي فِي قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا yānisāa l-nabiyi lastunna ka-aḥadin mina l-nisāi ini ittaqaytunna falā takhḍaʿna bil-qawli fayaṭmaʿa alladhī fī qalbihi maraḍun waqul'na qawlan maʿrūfan O' ye wives of the Prophet! ye are not like any other women if ye guard (yourselves) against evil, and be not soft in (your) speech lest lusteth after you he in whose heart is a disease, and speak ye a plain speech. The wives of the Holy Prophet are informed of their unique position to be the models of righteousness among the women. It has been made quite clear that mere alliance with the Holy Prophet will never suffice them without the righteousness expected of their position. They are warned to be guarded when they talk gently to any people lest…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْأُولَى وَأَقِمْنَ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتِينَ الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِعْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا waqarna fī buyūtikunna walā tabarrajna tabarruja l-jāhiliyati l-ūlā wa-aqim'na l-ṣalata waātīna l-zakata wa-aṭiʿ'na l-laha warasūlahu innamā yurīdu l-lahu liyudh'hiba ʿankumu l-rij'sa ahla l-bayti wayuṭahhirakum taṭhīran Stay in your houses and do not display your finery with the display of the former [days of] ignorance. Maintain the prayer and pay the zakāt and obey Allah and His Apostle. Indeed Allah desires to repel all impurity from you, O People of the Household, and purify you with a thorough purification.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْأُولَى وَأَقِمْنَ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتِينَ الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِعْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا waqarna fī buyūtikunna walā tabarrajna tabarruja l-jāhiliyati l-ūlā wa-aqim'na l-ṣalata waātīna l-zakata wa-aṭiʿ'na l-laha warasūlahu innamā yurīdu l-lahu liyudh'hiba ʿankumu l-rij'sa ahla l-bayti wayuṭahhirakum taṭhīran And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as (was) the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah intends only to remove from you the impurity (of sin), O people of the (Prophet's) household, and to purify you with (extensive) purification. See 33:32

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْأُولَى وَأَقِمْنَ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتِينَ الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِعْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا waqarna fī buyūtikunna walā tabarrajna tabarruja l-jāhiliyati l-ūlā wa-aqim'na l-ṣalata waātīna l-zakata wa-aṭiʿ'na l-laha warasūlahu innamā yurīdu l-lahu liyudh'hiba ʿankumu l-rij'sa ahla l-bayti wayuṭahhirakum taṭhīran And stay ye in your abodes and display not your finery like the display of the ignorance of yore, and establish ye prayer and give away the poor-rate, and obey God and His Apostle; Verily, verily God intendeth but to keep off (Not allowed even to approach.) from you (every kind of) uncleanness O' ye the People of the House, and purify you (with) a thorough purification. (With the event of 'Kisa' (the Mantle) reported also by Umm al-Mu'minin – A'isha & Umm Salamah - and at the historic 'Mubahila'…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَى فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا wa-udh'kur'na mā yut'lā fī buyūtikunna min āyāti l-lahi wal-ḥik'mati inna l-laha kāna laṭīfan khabīran And remember what is recited in your homes of the signs of Allah and wisdom. Indeed Allah is all-attentive, all-aware.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَى فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا wa-udh'kur'na mā yut'lā fī buyūtikunna min āyāti l-lahi wal-ḥik'mati inna l-laha kāna laṭīfan khabīran And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allah and wisdom.1 Indeed, Allah is ever Subtle2 and Aware. See 33:32

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
