item.description: وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَى فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا wa-udh'kur'na mā yut'lā fī buyūtikunna min āyāti l-lahi wal-ḥik'mati inna l-laha kāna laṭīfan khabīran And remember ye what is recited in your abodes of the signs of God and wisdom; verily God is Benignant, All-Aware. Here the wives of the Holy Prophet in particular are admonished to remember what is recited in their houses, i.e., what the Holy Prophet preaches to them in particular, and also the Word of God, the Qur'an, specially about the discipline prescribed for women. One has to refer to history to know which of the wives of the Holy Prophet violated this ordinance. The concluding words of the verse are a warning saying that whatever the wives of the Holy Prophet in particular and the women in general do, is always…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْقَانِتِينَ وَالْقَانِتَاتِ وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالصَّادِقَاتِ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّابِرَاتِ وَالْخَاشِعِينَ وَالْخَاشِعَاتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقَاتِ وَالصَّائِمِينَ وَالصَّائِمَاتِ وَالْحَافِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَالْحَافِظَاتِ وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا inna l-mus'limīna wal-mus'limāti wal-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-qānitīna wal-qānitāti wal-ṣādiqīna wal-ṣādiqāti wal-ṣābirīna wal-ṣābirāti wal-khāshiʿīna wal-khāshiʿāti wal-mutaṣadiqīna wal-mutaṣadiqāti wal-ṣāimīna wal-ṣāimāti wal-ḥāfiẓīna furūjahum wal-ḥāfiẓāti wal-dhākirīna l-laha kathīran wal-dhākirāti aʿadda l-lahu lahum maghfiratan wa-ajran ʿaẓīman Indeed the muslim men and the muslim women, the faithful men and the faithful women, the obedient men and the obedient women, the truthful men and the truthful women, the patient men and the patient women, the humble1 men and the humble women, the charitable men and the charitable women, the men who fast and the women who fast, the men who guard their private parts and the women who guard, the men who remember Allah greatly and the women…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْقَانِتِينَ وَالْقَانِتَاتِ وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالصَّادِقَاتِ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّابِرَاتِ وَالْخَاشِعِينَ وَالْخَاشِعَاتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقَاتِ وَالصَّائِمِينَ وَالصَّائِمَاتِ وَالْحَافِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَالْحَافِظَاتِ وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا inna l-mus'limīna wal-mus'limāti wal-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-qānitīna wal-qānitāti wal-ṣādiqīna wal-ṣādiqāti wal-ṣābirīna wal-ṣābirāti wal-khāshiʿīna wal-khāshiʿāti wal-mutaṣadiqīna wal-mutaṣadiqāti wal-ṣāimīna wal-ṣāimāti wal-ḥāfiẓīna furūjahum wal-ḥāfiẓāti wal-dhākirīna l-laha kathīran wal-dhākirāti aʿadda l-lahu lahum maghfiratan wa-ajran ʿaẓīman Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so - for them Allah has…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْقَانِتِينَ وَالْقَانِتَاتِ وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالصَّادِقَاتِ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّابِرَاتِ وَالْخَاشِعِينَ وَالْخَاشِعَاتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقَاتِ وَالصَّائِمِينَ وَالصَّائِمَاتِ وَالْحَافِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَالْحَافِظَاتِ وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا inna l-mus'limīna wal-mus'limāti wal-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-qānitīna wal-qānitāti wal-ṣādiqīna wal-ṣādiqāti wal-ṣābirīna wal-ṣābirāti wal-khāshiʿīna wal-khāshiʿāti wal-mutaṣadiqīna wal-mutaṣadiqāti wal-ṣāimīna wal-ṣāimāti wal-ḥāfiẓīna furūjahum wal-ḥāfiẓāti wal-dhākirīna l-laha kathīran wal-dhākirāti aʿadda l-lahu lahum maghfiratan wa-ajran ʿaẓīman Verily the Muslim men and the Muslim women and the believing men and the believing women and obedient men and the obedient women, and the truthful men and the truthful women, and the patient men, and the patient women, and the humble men and the humble women, and the alms-giving men and the alms-giving women, and the fasting men and the fasting women, and the men who guard their private parts and the women who guard (their private parts), and…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُبِينًا wamā kāna limu'minin walā mu'minatin idhā qaḍā l-lahu warasūluhu amran an yakūna lahumu l-khiyaratu min amrihim waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu faqad ḍalla ḍalālan mubīnan A faithful man or woman may not, when Allah and His Apostle have decided on a matter, have any option in their matter, and whoever disobeys Allah and His Apostle has certainly strayed into manifest error.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُبِينًا wamā kāna limu'minin walā mu'minatin idhā qaḍā l-lahu warasūluhu amran an yakūna lahumu l-khiyaratu min amrihim waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu faqad ḍalla ḍalālan mubīnan It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should (thereafter) have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error. It is not for a believer, man or woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decreed a matter that they should have any option in their decision. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, he has indeed strayed into a plain error (33:36). The Reason for Revelation Imam Ahmad…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُبِينًا wamā kāna limu'minin walā mu'minatin idhā qaḍā l-lahu warasūluhu amran an yakūna lahumu l-khiyaratu min amrihim waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu faqad ḍalla ḍalālan mubīnan And it is not for a believer man or woman to have any choice in their affair when God and His Apostle have decided a matter; and whoever disobeyeth God and His Apostle, indeed he hath strayed off a manifest straying. Ibne Abbas relates that when the Holy Prophet demanded the hand of Zaynab bint Jahesh, the daughter of his paternal uncle, thinking that it was for the Holy Prophet himself, the demand was readily accepted but it was for Zayd ibn Harithah who was a liberated slave of the Holy Prophet…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشٰی النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَاهُ فَلَمَّا قَضَى زَيْدٌ مِنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا wa-idh taqūlu lilladhī anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhi wa-anʿamta ʿalayhi amsik ʿalayka zawjaka wa-ittaqi l-laha watukh'fī fī nafsika mā l-lahu mub'dīhi watakhshā l-nāsa wal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshāhu falammā qaḍā zaydun min'hā waṭaran zawwajnākahā likay lā yakūna ʿalā l-mu'minīna ḥarajun fī azwāji adʿiyāihim idhā qaḍaw min'hunna waṭaran wakāna amru l-lahi mafʿūlan When you said to him whom Allah had blessed, and whom you [too] had blessed, 'Retain your wife for yourself, and be wary of Allah,' and you had hidden in your heart what Allah was to divulge, and you feared the people though Allah…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشٰی النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَاهُ فَلَمَّا قَضَى زَيْدٌ مِنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا wa-idh taqūlu lilladhī anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhi wa-anʿamta ʿalayhi amsik ʿalayka zawjaka wa-ittaqi l-laha watukh'fī fī nafsika mā l-lahu mub'dīhi watakhshā l-nāsa wal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshāhu falammā qaḍā zaydun min'hā waṭaran zawwajnākahā likay lā yakūna ʿalā l-mu'minīna ḥarajun fī azwāji adʿiyāihim idhā qaḍaw min'hunna waṭaran wakāna amru l-lahi mafʿūlan And (remember, O Muḥammad), when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor,1 "Keep your wife and fear Allah," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is to disclose.2 And you feared the people,3 while Allah has…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشٰی النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَاهُ فَلَمَّا قَضَى زَيْدٌ مِنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا wa-idh taqūlu lilladhī anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhi wa-anʿamta ʿalayhi amsik ʿalayka zawjaka wa-ittaqi l-laha watukh'fī fī nafsika mā l-lahu mub'dīhi watakhshā l-nāsa wal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshāhu falammā qaḍā zaydun min'hā waṭaran zawwajnākahā likay lā yakūna ʿalā l-mu'minīna ḥarajun fī azwāji adʿiyāihim idhā qaḍaw min'hunna waṭaran wakāna amru l-lahi mafʿūlan And when thou didst say on him whom God hath bestowed (His) bounty and unto whom thou hast shown (thy) favour "Keep unto thyself thy wife and fear God," But thou didst hide in thy self what God wouldst bring to light, and thou…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَقْدُورًا mā kāna ʿalā l-nabiyi min ḥarajin fīmā faraḍa l-lahu lahu sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu wakāna amru l-lahi qadaran maqdūran There is no blame on the Prophet in respect of that which Allah has made lawful for him:1 Allah's precedent with those who passed away earlier —and Allah's commands are ordained by a precise ordaining—

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَقْدُورًا mā kāna ʿalā l-nabiyi min ḥarajin fīmā faraḍa l-lahu lahu sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu wakāna amru l-lahi qadaran maqdūran There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allah has imposed upon him.1 (This is) the established way of Allah with those (prophets) who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allah a destiny decreed. There is no blame on the Prophet in that which Allah has made legal for him. That has been Allah's way with those who have passed away of old. And the command of Allah is a decree determined (33:38). مَا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ۖ There is no…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَقْدُورًا mā kāna ʿalā l-nabiyi min ḥarajin fīmā faraḍa l-lahu lahu sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu wakāna amru l-lahi qadaran maqdūran On the Prophet is no blame in doing what hath been ordained by God unto him, and such hath been the way of God with those who have passed before, and the behest of God is a decree irrevocable, Having more than one wife was not peculiar only with the Holy Prophet, but his predecessors were also allowed to have a great number of wives viz. David, Solomon and the other apostles of God and even the great rishis1 - including the father of Rama and Lakshman had more than one wife. Islam on the other…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا alladhīna yuballighūna risālāti l-lahi wayakhshawnahu walā yakhshawna aḥadan illā l-laha wakafā bil-lahi ḥasīban such as deliver the messages of Allah and fear Him, and fear no one except Allah, and Allah suffices as reckoner.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا alladhīna yuballighūna risālāti l-lahi wayakhshawnahu walā yakhshawna aḥadan illā l-laha wakafā bil-lahi ḥasīban (Allah praises) those who convey the messages of Allah1 and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant. Those who convey the Message of Allah and fear Him, and fear none save Allah. And sufficient is Allah as a Reckoner (33:39). Muhammad is not the father of any of your men, but he is the Messenger of Allah and the last of the Prophets. And Allah is Ever All-Aware of everything (33:40). Praise for Those Who convey the Message. Allah says: الَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّهِ Those who convey the Message of Allah Meaning: to His creation, and fulfil that with which they have been entrusted. وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ and…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا alladhīna yuballighūna risālāti l-lahi wayakhshawnahu walā yakhshawna aḥadan illā l-laha wakafā bil-lahi ḥasīban Those who convey the messages of God and fear Him, and fear not any one but God; and sufficient is God to take account. Man's responsibility, particularly that of the apostle, is to God and not to anybody else. None has any option of using his wisdom or discretion in executing the will of God viz. while discharging the duty of conveying God's message, the apostle has to fear none but God. What the Holy Prophet apprehended in regard to receiving Zaynab in wedlock was not his fear of the people but the people being misled by the false propaganda of the hypocrites against Islam and himself and waited for the revelation of the…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا mā kāna muḥammadun abā aḥadin min rijālikum walākin rasūla l-lahi wakhātama l-nabiyīna wakāna l-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīman Muḥammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the Apostle of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets, and Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا mā kāna muḥammadun abā aḥadin min rijālikum walākin rasūla l-lahi wakhātama l-nabiyīna wakāna l-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīman Muḥammad is not the father of (any) one of your men, but (he is) the Messenger of Allah and seal (i.e., last) of the prophets. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing. See 33:39

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا mā kāna muḥammadun abā aḥadin min rijālikum walākin rasūla l-lahi wakhātama l-nabiyīna wakāna l-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīman Muhammad is not the father of any of your men, but an apostle of God and the seal of the prophets; And God is of all things - ever the Knower. This verse refers also to the actual position of the Holy Prophet with reference to bis connection with his people saying that he was not the actual father of Zayd, not to marry the woman Zayd divorces but an apostle of God, to carry out the command of God and act upon it, to set the correct example against the fanciful taboo of the people under which an adopted son was considered to be a…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū l-laha dhik'ran kathīran O you who have faith! Remember Allah with frequent remembrance,

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū l-laha dhik'ran kathīran O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance. O you who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance (33:41). And glorify His praises morning and Asila (33:42). He it is Who sends Salah on you, and His angels too, that He may bring you out from darkness into light. And He is Ever Most Merciful to the believers (33:43). Their greeting on the Day they shall meet Him will be "Salam (Peace!)" And He has prepared for them a generous reward (33:44). The Virtue of Remembering Allah Much Allah commands His believing servants to remember their Lord much, Who has bestowed upon them all kinds of blessings and favors, because this will bring them a great reward and a wonderful destiny. Imam Ahmad recorded that…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū l-laha dhik'ran kathīran O' ye who believe! Remember ye God by remembering (Him) frequently, The Sixth Holy Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq says that there is a limit to everything, there is no limit to the remembrance of God and the excess in anything is disliked by God but God loves his remembrance to any extent, and says the same Holy Imam "Our Shias (those belonging to the group of their devotees) are those mho whenever they are free from their legitimate duties, remember God in abundance," 'Tasbih-e-Zahra' i.e., 'Subhana Allah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illa Allah wa Allahu Akbar', i.e., (Pure is God and all praise and gratitude is only for God and there is no god but God and God is the Most High, is included…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا wasabbiḥūhu buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan and glorify Him morning and evening.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا wasabbiḥūhu buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan And exalt Him morning and afternoon. See 33:41

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا wasabbiḥūhu buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan And glorify Him morning and evening. Remember God with purity, i.e., being clean and pure in thought and action and remembering God's purity. This ordinance indicates that a Muslim is wanted by, the Lord to be always clean and pure in spirit, body, thought, word and action and to go on purifying his soul, being aloof from every kind of physical as well as moral pollution.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا huwa alladhī yuṣallī ʿalaykum wamalāikatuhu liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wakāna bil-mu'minīna raḥīman It is He who blesses you, and so do His angels, that He may bring you out from darkness into light, and He is most merciful to the faithful.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا huwa alladhī yuṣallī ʿalaykum wamalāikatuhu liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wakāna bil-mu'minīna raḥīman It is He who confers blessing upon you,1 and His angels (ask Him to do so) that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful. See 33:41

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا huwa alladhī yuṣallī ʿalaykum wamalāikatuhu liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wakāna bil-mu'minīna raḥīman He it is Who confereth upon you His blessings, and (likewise do) the angels, that He may bring you forth from the darkness (of infidelity) into the light (of faith); and He is unto the believers, All-Merciful. The greatest mercy and blessings from God is His guidance which could be had only through the Holy Prophet and the Holy Ahl al-Bayt whom God himself has purified1 and the mental inclination on our behalf called 'Tawfiq' to avail of the divine guidance against the wrong inclinations of our self from within and the devilish attractions from without. Those who believe in God and remember Him in abundance are led out of the darkness of ignorance…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَامٌ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا taḥiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salāmun wa-aʿadda lahum ajran karīman The day they encounter Him, their greeting will be, 'Peace,' and He holds in store for them a noble reward.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَامٌ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا taḥiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salāmun wa-aʿadda lahum ajran karīman Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward. See 33:41

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَامٌ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا taḥiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salāmun wa-aʿadda lahum ajran karīman Their greeting on the day when they shall meet Him shall be 'Peace!' and He hath prepared for them an honourable recompense. It is said that when the angel of death approaches a believer in God, he first conveys his salutation to him before he detaches the soul from the body of the believer.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu innā arsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīran O Prophet! Indeed We have sent you as a witness, as a bearer of good news and as a warner

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu innā arsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīran O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner. O Prophet! Verily, We have sent you as witness, and a bearer of glad tidings, and a warner (33:45). And as one who invites to Allah by His leave, and as a lamp spreading light (33:46). And announce to the believers the glad tidings, that they will have from Allah a great bounty (33:47). And obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and harm them not. And put your trust in Allah, and sufficient is Allah as a Trustee (33:48). The Attributes of the Messenger of Allah SAW Imam Ahmad recorded that 'Ata' bin Yasar said that he met 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (RA), and said…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu innā arsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīran O' (Our) Prophet (Muhammad!) Verily We have sent thee as a Witness, and as a Bearer of Glad Tidings and as a Warner, 'Shahid' - a witness on the truth against falsehood, and the belief and the infidelity and the goodness and the badness of the people.1'Mubashshir' the bearer of glad tidings of the reward to the believers in God who do good and lead a righteous life in this world. 'Nazir', i.e., A Warner against infidelity and wicked life and the chastisement in store for it.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا wadāʿiyan ilā l-lahi bi-idh'nihi wasirājan munīran and as a summoner to Allah by His permission, and as a radiant lamp.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا wadāʿiyan ilā l-lahi bi-idh'nihi wasirājan munīran And one who invites to Allah, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp. See 33:45

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا wadāʿiyan ilā l-lahi bi-idh'nihi wasirājan munīran And as the Inviter (Refer to note verses 3:60, 16:125, 25:61 & 71:61.) unto God by His command, and an illuminating (Or lamp.) torch. 'Sirajan Munir' - An ever-lighted lamp, ever radiating its light, always illuminating the right way for any one and everyone who seeks it. The same word, 'Siraj', i.e., a lamp, is used for the sun.1 The Holy Prophet is defined as the sun which will illuminate the world as a whole continuously until the end of the world.2 The Holy Prophet is presented as the one who calls the people to the Path of God, with His permission therefore, wherever he has called any person to the Right Path, it was by God's command. Therefore years the question that what was the value of…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا wabashiri l-mu'minīna bi-anna lahum mina l-lahi faḍlan kabīran Announce to the faithful the good news that there will be for them a great grace from Allah.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا wabashiri l-mu'minīna bi-anna lahum mina l-lahi faḍlan kabīran And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allah great bounty. See 33:45

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا wabashiri l-mu'minīna bi-anna lahum mina l-lahi faḍlan kabīran And give thou the glad tidings unto the believers that there shall be for them from God, a great grace. The grace promised here is the recompense for the pure, righteous life in the world. When the Almighty Himself terms the grace to be great, its greatness would naturally be unimaginable for the finite ones.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَاهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna wadaʿ adhāhum watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīlan And do not obey the faithless and the hypocrites, and disregard their torments, and put your trust in Allah, and Allah suffices as trustee.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَاهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna wadaʿ adhāhum watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīlan And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard their annoyance, and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs. See 33:45

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَاهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna wadaʿ adhāhum watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīlan And comply not with (the desires of) the infidels and the hypocrites, and leave off (heedless) their annoying talk, and rely on God; and God is sufficient a Protector. Leave the infidels and the hypocrites who tease and hurt, to themselves, and depend upon God's help and God is self-sufficient to mind the troublesome elements. Ibn Abbas says that this verse has been superseded by the command to defend facing any aggression with physical force - like the verses 2:216, 2:244, 4:75, 76, 4:84, 9:35, 9:41, 9:73, 9:123, 23:78, 47:4. Criticising the Holy Prophet for the battles he had to fight, will be the betrayal of one's own ignorance of what the apostles of God preceding…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nakaḥtumu l-mu'mināti thumma ṭallaqtumūhunna min qabli an tamassūhunna famā lakum ʿalayhinna min ʿiddatin taʿtaddūnahā famattiʿūhunna wasarriḥūhunna sarāḥan jamīlan O you who have faith! When you marry faithful women and then divorce them before you touch them, there shall be no period for you to reckon. But provide for them and release them in a graceful manner.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nakaḥtumu l-mu'mināti thumma ṭallaqtumūhunna min qabli an tamassūhunna famā lakum ʿalayhinna min ʿiddatin taʿtaddūnahā famattiʿūhunna wasarriḥūhunna sarāḥan jamīlan O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them (i.e., consummated the marriage), then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release. O you who believe! When you marry believing women, and then divorce them before you have sexual intercourse with them, no 'Iddah have you to count in respect of them. So, give them a present, and set them free in a handsome manner (33:49). A Gift and No (Iddah) for…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nakaḥtumu l-mu'mināti thumma ṭallaqtumūhunna min qabli an tamassūhunna famā lakum ʿalayhinna min ʿiddatin taʿtaddūnahā famattiʿūhunna wasarriḥūhunna sarāḥan jamīlan O' ye who believe! when ye wed the believing women, then ye divorce them before ye touch them, there is not for you any 'Iddat' (The waiting term.) (term) on them which ye should reckon; so make some provisions for them and send them away (with) a goodly send- off. When a woman is divorced before the husband goes to her, then there shall be no restriction of 'Iddat' for her, before her marrying some one else. If the 'Mahr' or dower had been fixed, she shall be entitled to half of it and even if…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran

Verily We have made lawful unto thee thy wives whom thou hast given their…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تُرْجِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُءْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَنْ تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَا ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًا tur'jī man tashāu min'hunna watu'wī ilayka man tashāu wamani ib'taghayta mimman ʿazalta falā junāḥa ʿalayka dhālika adnā an taqarra aʿyunuhunna walā yaḥzanna wayarḍayna bimā ātaytahunna kulluhunna wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā fī qulūbikum wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥalīman You may put off whichever of them you wish and consort with whichever of them you wish, and as for any whom you may seek [to consort with] from among those you have set aside [earlier], there is no sin upon you [in receiving her again]. That makes it likelier that they will be comforted and not feel unhappy, all of them being pleased with what you give them. Allah…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تُرْجِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُءْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَنْ تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَا ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًا tur'jī man tashāu min'hunna watu'wī ilayka man tashāu wamani ib'taghayta mimman ʿazalta falā junāḥa ʿalayka dhālika adnā an taqarra aʿyunuhunna walā yaḥzanna wayarḍayna bimā ātaytahunna kulluhunna wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā fī qulūbikum wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥalīman You, (O Muḥammad), may put aside whom you will of them1 or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those (wives) from whom you had (temporarily) separated - there is no blame upon you (in returning her). That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them.…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ بَعْدُ وَلَا أَنْ تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَقِيبًا lā yaḥillu laka l-nisāu min baʿdu walā an tabaddala bihinna min azwājin walaw aʿjabaka ḥus'nuhunna illā mā malakat yamīnuka wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin raqīban Beyond that, women are not lawful for you, nor that you should change them for other wives even though their beauty should impress you, except those whom your right hand owns. And Allah is watchful over all things.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran

And ever is Allah, over all things, an Observer.1 It is not lawful for you (to marry other) women after this, nor to change them for other wives even though their beauty attracts you, except those whom your right hand possesses. And Allah is Ever a Watcher over all things (33:52). The Reward…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ بَعْدُ وَلَا أَنْ تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَقِيبًا lā yaḥillu laka l-nisāu min baʿdu walā an tabaddala bihinna min azwājin walaw aʿjabaka ḥus'nuhunna illā mā malakat yamīnuka wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin raqīban It is not allowed unto thee to take women afterwards, nor shouldst thou change them for other wives, though their beauty may charm thee, save what their right hand possesseth; and God is, over all things watchful. Taking this verse into consideration, it means that the Holy Prophet is not allowed to have more wives beyond what he already had. But so far as his followers are concerned, though they cannot have more than four at one time but as 'Muta', i.e., a Temporary Marriage, the limit has not been…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَدْخُلُوْۤا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُوا فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانْتَشِرُوا وَلَا مُسْتَءْنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ فَيَسْتَحْيِي مِنْكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَاعًا فَسْءَلُوهُنَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ ذَلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْذُوْۤا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَنْ تَنْكِحُوْۤا أَزْوَاجَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ أَبَدًا إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tadkhulū buyūta l-nabiyi illā an yu'dhana lakum ilā ṭaʿāmin ghayra nāẓirīna ināhu walākin idhā duʿītum fa-ud'khulū fa-idhā ṭaʿim'tum fa-intashirū walā mus'tanisīna liḥadīthin inna dhālikum kāna yu'dhī l-nabiya fayastaḥyī minkum wal-lahu lā yastaḥyī mina l-ḥaqi wa-idhā sa-altumūhunna matāʿan fasalūhunna min warāi ḥijābin dhālikum aṭharu liqulūbikum waqulūbihinna wamā kāna lakum an tu'dhū rasūla l-lahi walā an tankiḥū azwājahu min baʿdihi abadan inna dhālikum kāna ʿinda l-lahi ʿaẓīman O you…

item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَدْخُلُوْۤا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُوا فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانْتَشِرُوا وَلَا مُسْتَءْنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ فَيَسْتَحْيِي مِنْكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَاعًا فَسْءَلُوهُنَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ ذَلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْذُوْۤا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَنْ تَنْكِحُوْۤا أَزْوَاجَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ أَبَدًا إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tadkhulū buyūta l-nabiyi illā an yu'dhana lakum ilā ṭaʿāmin ghayra nāẓirīna ināhu walākin idhā duʿītum fa-ud'khulū fa-idhā ṭaʿim'tum fa-intashirū walā mus'tanisīna liḥadīthin inna dhālikum kāna yu'dhī l-nabiya fayastaḥyī minkum wal-lahu lā yastaḥyī mina l-ḥaqi wa-idhā sa-altumūhunna matāʿan fasalūhunna min warāi ḥijābin dhālikum aṭharu liqulūbikum waqulūbihinna wamā kāna lakum an tu'dhū rasūla l-lahi walā an tankiḥū azwājahu min baʿdihi abadan inna dhālikum kāna ʿinda l-lahi ʿaẓīman O' ye…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تُبْدُوْۤا شَيْئًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا in tub'dū shayan aw tukh'fūhu fa-inna l-laha kāna bikulli shayin ʿalīman Whether you disclose anything or hide it, Allah indeed knows all things.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تُبْدُوْۤا شَيْئًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا in tub'dū shayan aw tukh'fūhu fa-inna l-laha kāna bikulli shayin ʿalīman Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allah is ever, of all things, Knowing. See 33:53

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تُبْدُوْۤا شَيْئًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا in tub'dū shayan aw tukh'fūhu fa-inna l-laha kāna bikulli shayin ʿalīman If ye manifest any thing or hide it, then verily God of all things is Well-Aware. See 33:53

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِي ءَابَائِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَائِهِنَّ وَلَا إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَائِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ وَاتَّقِينَ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدًا lā junāḥa ʿalayhinna fī ābāihinna walā abnāihinna walā ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi akhawātihinna walā nisāihinna walā mā malakat aymānuhunna wa-ittaqīna l-laha inna l-laha kāna ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdan There is no sin on them1 [in socializing freely] with their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or the sons of their sisters, or their own womenfolk,2 or what their right hands own.3 Be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is witness to all things.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِي ءَابَائِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَائِهِنَّ وَلَا إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَائِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ وَاتَّقِينَ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدًا lā junāḥa ʿalayhinna fī ābāihinna walā abnāihinna walā ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi akhawātihinna walā nisāihinna walā mā malakat aymānuhunna wa-ittaqīna l-laha inna l-laha kāna ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdan There is no blame upon them (i.e., women) concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess (i.e., slaves).1 And fear Allah. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, Witness. It is no sin on them before their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brother's sons, or the sons of their sisters, or their own (believing) women, or their (female)…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِي ءَابَائِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَائِهِنَّ وَلَا إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَائِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ وَاتَّقِينَ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدًا lā junāḥa ʿalayhinna fī ābāihinna walā abnāihinna walā ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi akhawātihinna walā nisāihinna walā mā malakat aymānuhunna wa-ittaqīna l-laha inna l-laha kāna ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdan There is no blame on them about their fathers, nor their sons, nor their brothers, nor their brothers' sons, nor their sisters' sons, nor their own women, nor of what their right hands possess; fear ye God! Verily God, on all things is a witness. When the verse 33:53 above about the observance of veil was revealed, the parents and the other nearest relatives of women asked the Holy Prophet if, even they should observe the Purdah imposed by verse…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا صَلُّوْۤا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا inna l-laha wamalāikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā l-nabiyi yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wasallimū taslīman Indeed Allah and His angels bless the Prophet; O you who have faith! Invoke blessings on him and invoke Peace upon him in a worthy manner.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا صَلُّوْۤا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا inna l-laha wamalāikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā l-nabiyi yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wasallimū taslīman Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels (ask Him to do so). O you who have believed, ask (Allah to confer) blessing upon him and ask (Allah to grant him) peace. Allah sends His Salah on the Prophet, and also His angels (do so). O you who believe! Send your Salah on him, and greet him with Taslim (33:56). The Command to Say Salah upon the Prophet SAW Al-Bukhari said: "Abu Al-'Aliyah said: "Allah's Salah is His praising him before the angels, and the Salah of the angels is their supplication." Ibn 'Abbas said: "They send blessings." Abu Isa At-Tirmidhi said: "This was narrated from Sufyan Ath-Thawri and other scholars, who…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا صَلُّوْۤا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا inna l-laha wamalāikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā l-nabiyi yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wasallimū taslīman Verily God and His angels bless the Prophet! O' ye who believe! send ye blessings on him and ye greet him with a salutation worthy of the respect (due to him). God and the angels send their 'Salawat' i.e., in the case of God, He sends His blessings and the angels invoke the blessings of the Lord, for him. The believers are commanded to send their prayers for the blessings along with their salutation to him. When this verse was revealed someone asked the Holy Prophet as how, i.e., in what words, should the believers recite 'Salawat' or 'Darud', i.e., the Salutation to him. He said "Allahumma ṣalli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala ali Muḥammad,…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُهِينًا inna alladhīna yu'dhūna l-laha warasūlahu laʿanahumu l-lahu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wa-aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban muhīnan Indeed those who torment Allah and His Apostle are cursed by Allah in the world and the Hereafter, and He has prepared a humiliating punishment for them.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُهِينًا inna alladhīna yu'dhūna l-laha warasūlahu laʿanahumu l-lahu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wa-aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban muhīnan Indeed, those who abuse Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment. Verily, those who annoy Allah and His Messenger, Allah has cursed them in this world and in the Hereafter, and has prepared for them a humiliating torment (33:57). And those who annoy believing men and women undeservedly, they bear the crime of slander and plain sin (33:58). Whoever Annoys Allah and His Messenger SAW, is Cursed in this World and the Hereafter Here, Allah warns and threatens those who annoy Him by going against His commands and doing that which He has forbidden, and who persist…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُهِينًا inna alladhīna yu'dhūna l-laha warasūlahu laʿanahumu l-lahu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wa-aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban muhīnan Verily those who annoy God and His Apostle (Muhammad), God, hath cursed them in this world and the hereafter, and He hath prepared for them a chastisement disgraceful. Let every intelligent student of the Holy Qur'an judge the position of those who had incurred the displeasure of the Holy Prophet while he was about to leave this world, by saying that he uttered nonsense in the agony of the disease, and who annoyed his soul by teasing the one dearest to him, i.e., his daughter, the Holy Lady Fatima, and made her life miserable, for the Holy Prophet had openly declared that, "Whosoever hurts the feelings of Fatima, has hurt me (the…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُوا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوا بُهْتَانًا وَإِثْمًا مُبِينًا wa-alladhīna yu'dhūna l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti bighayri mā ik'tasabū faqadi iḥ'tamalū buh'tānan wa-ith'man mubīnan Those who torment faithful men and women undeservedly, certainly bear the guilt of slander and flagrant sin.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُوا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوا بُهْتَانًا وَإِثْمًا مُبِينًا wa-alladhīna yu'dhūna l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti bighayri mā ik'tasabū faqadi iḥ'tamalū buh'tānan wa-ith'man mubīnan And those who harm believing men and believing women for (something) other than what they have earned (i.e., deserved) have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin. See 33:57

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُوا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوا بُهْتَانًا وَإِثْمًا مُبِينًا wa-alladhīna yu'dhūna l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti bighayri mā ik'tasabū faqadi iḥ'tamalū buh'tānan wa-ith'man mubīnan And those who annoy believing men and believing women without their having earned it, then indeed they bear the guilt of slander and a manifest sin. When annoying an ordinary believer man or woman is condemned by God so much and is held by Him as a manifest sin, one might imagine what it would mean, annoying the divinely chosen ones among the believers viz. Holy Ahl al-Bayt, particularly those who were mercilessly massacred at Karbala, Kufa and Damascus. (Refer to the details of the sufferings of the holy Imam Husayn and his holy family and friends). This includes all the false charges which the Pro-Umayyad and Pro-Abbasids and the other ruling class, alleged against the…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ جَلَابِيبِهِنَّ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَنْ يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika wabanātika wanisāi l-mu'minīna yud'nīna ʿalayhinna min jalābībihinna dhālika adnā an yuʿ'rafna falā yu'dhayna wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman O Prophet! Tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the faithful to draw closely over themselves their chadors [when going out]. That makes it likely for them to be recognized and not be troubled, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ جَلَابِيبِهِنَّ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَنْ يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika wabanātika wanisāi l-mu'minīna yud'nīna ʿalayhinna min jalābībihinna dhālika adnā an yuʿ'rafna falā yu'dhayna wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves (part) of their outer garments.1 That is more suitable that they will be known2 and not be abused. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.3 O Prophet! Tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to draw their Jalabib over their bodies. That will be better that they should be known so as not to be annoyed. And Allah is Ever Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (33:59). If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ جَلَابِيبِهِنَّ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَنْ يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika wabanātika wanisāi l-mu'minīna yud'nīna ʿalayhinna min jalābībihinna dhālika adnā an yuʿ'rafna falā yu'dhayna wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman O' (Our) Prophet (Muhammad)! say thou unto thy wives and thy daughters and the women of the believers that they let down upon them their cover garments; that they may be known, so that they will not be troubled, God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. Under this injunction every believer woman has been commanded to wear an over-garment or a covering mantle so that their feminine beauty might not attract the attention of men to stimulate evil intentions for a covering on the body of a woman would also indicate that the woman is pure, chaste, modest and…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا la-in lam yantahi l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-mur'jifūna fī l-madīnati lanugh'riyannaka bihim thumma lā yujāwirūnaka fīhā illā qalīlan If the hypocrites do not relinquish and [also] those in whose hearts is a sickness, and the rumourmongers in the city [do not give up], We will surely urge you [to take action] against them, then they will not be your neighbours in it except for a little [while].

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا la-in lam yantahi l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-mur'jifūna fī l-madīnati lanugh'riyannaka bihim thumma lā yujāwirūnaka fīhā illā qalīlan If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease1 and those who spread rumors in al-Madīnah do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little. See 33:59

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا la-in lam yantahi l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-mur'jifūna fī l-madīnati lanugh'riyannaka bihim thumma lā yujāwirūnaka fīhā illā qalīlan If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease and the agitators in the city desist not, We shall certainly rouse thee up against them, they shall not be allowed to be thy neighbour in it, but a little while, This is a prophecy with the promise as to what God would do to the mischief-mongers. Before the conclusion of the mission of the Holy Prophet, the hypocrite element surrounding him was brought under his control. But the wonder is, to what happened to the hypocrites that since the departure of the Holy Prophet from this world, there is no…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَلْعُونِينَ أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوْۤا أُخِذُوْۤا وَقُتِّلُوا تَقْتِيلًا malʿūnīna aynamā thuqifū ukhidhū waquttilū taqtīlan Accursed, they will be seized wherever they are confronted and slain violently:

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَلْعُونِينَ أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوْۤا أُخِذُوْۤا وَقُتِّلُوا تَقْتِيلًا malʿūnīna aynamā thuqifū ukhidhū waquttilū taqtīlan Accursed wherever they are found, (being) seized and massacred completely. See 33:59

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَلْعُونِينَ أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوْۤا أُخِذُوْۤا وَقُتِّلُوا تَقْتِيلًا malʿūnīna aynamā thuqifū ukhidhū waquttilū taqtīlan (They are) cursed (driven off) wherever (The mischievous heathens.) they are found they shall be seized and slain (and it shall be a horrible) slaughter! See 33:60

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan Allah's precedent with those who passed away before, and you will never find any change in Allah's precedent.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan (This is) the established way of Allah with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allah any change. See 33:59

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan (Such has been) the way of God concerning those who have passed away before; and never shalt thou find in the way of God any change. It has been the divine law prescribed by God for every apostle of God preceding the Holy Prophet that the enemies of truth, i.e., the disbelievers and the hypocrites should be fought and be done away with. The course prescribed by God never suffers any change at the will or the choice of anyone else. History does not give any single instance of the Holy Prophet fighting or killing any of the hypocrites during his life-time but the order was enacted by Ali, who was one with the Holy Prophet…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُكَ النَّاسُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا yasaluka l-nāsu ʿani l-sāʿati qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata takūnu qarīban The people question you concerning the Hour. Say, 'Its knowledge is only with Allah.' What do you know, maybe the Hour is near.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُكَ النَّاسُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا yasaluka l-nāsu ʿani l-sāʿati qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata takūnu qarīban People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allah. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near." People ask you concerning the Hour, say: "The knowledge of it is with Allah only. What do you know? It may be that the Hour is near! (33:63). Verily, Allah has cursed the disbelievers, and has prepared for them a flaming Fire (33:64). Wherein they will abide forever, and they will find neither a a protector nor a helper (33:65). On the Day when their faces will be turned over in the Fire, they will say: "Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and obeyed…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُكَ النَّاسُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا yasaluka l-nāsu ʿani l-sāʿati qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata takūnu qarīban Ask thee the people about the Hour (of Judgment). Say thou: "The knowledge of it is only with God, and what will make thee know? happly the Hour (of Judgment) may be nigh." Even Jesus has said the same thing about the coming of the Hour of the Final Judgment.1 "But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father," Mark 13/32. "But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only." Math. 24/36.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ الْكَافِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا inna l-laha laʿana l-kāfirīna wa-aʿadda lahum saʿīran Indeed Allah has cursed the faithless and prepared for them a blaze,

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ الْكَافِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا inna l-laha laʿana l-kāfirīna wa-aʿadda lahum saʿīran Indeed, Allah has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze. See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ الْكَافِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا inna l-laha laʿana l-kāfirīna wa-aʿadda lahum saʿīran Verily God hath cursed the disbelievers and hath prepared for them a flaming fire, See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا khālidīna fīhā abadan lā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīran in which they will remain forever. They will not find any guardian or helper.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا khālidīna fīhā abadan lā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīran Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper. See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا khālidīna fīhā abadan lā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīran For ever shall they abide therein they shall find not a protector nor a helper. See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَالَيْتَنَا أَطَعْنَا اللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا الرَّسُولَا yawma tuqallabu wujūhuhum fī l-nāri yaqūlūna yālaytanā aṭaʿnā l-laha wa-aṭaʿnā l-rasūlā The day when their faces are turned about in the Fire, they will say, 'We wish we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Apostle!'

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَالَيْتَنَا أَطَعْنَا اللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا الرَّسُولَا yawma tuqallabu wujūhuhum fī l-nāri yaqūlūna yālaytanā aṭaʿnā l-laha wa-aṭaʿnā l-rasūlā The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger." See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَالَيْتَنَا أَطَعْنَا اللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا الرَّسُولَا yawma tuqallabu wujūhuhum fī l-nāri yaqūlūna yālaytanā aṭaʿnā l-laha wa-aṭaʿnā l-rasūlā On that day when their faces shall be turned into the fire, they shall say: "Oh! would that we had obeyed God and obeyed the Apostle!" See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا إِنَّا أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَاءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا السَّبِيلَا waqālū rabbanā innā aṭaʿnā sādatanā wakubarāanā fa-aḍallūnā l-sabīlā And they will say, 'Our Lord! We obeyed our leaders and elders, and they led us astray from the way.'

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا إِنَّا أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَاءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا السَّبِيلَا waqālū rabbanā innā aṭaʿnā sādatanā wakubarāanā fa-aḍallūnā l-sabīlā And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries,1 and they led us astray from the (right) way. See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا إِنَّا أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَاءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا السَّبِيلَا waqālū rabbanā innā aṭaʿnā sādatanā wakubarāanā fa-aḍallūnā l-sabīlā And they shall say: "O' Our Lord! verily we obeyed our chiefs and our elders, and they led us astray from the path:" This shall be the fate of those who follow any one and every one who claims to be the leader of the faith without the necessary scrutiny of his personal character, conduct and his title to his assumption. This shows that the troubles developed after the last Covenant referred to in verse 5:7 by the chiefs, and the masses only followed them. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا rabbanā ātihim ḍiʿ'fayni mina l-ʿadhābi wal-ʿanhum laʿnan kabīran Our Lord! Give them a double punishment and curse them with a mighty curse.'

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا rabbanā ātihim ḍiʿ'fayni mina l-ʿadhābi wal-ʿanhum laʿnan kabīran Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse." See 33:63

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا rabbanā ātihim ḍiʿ'fayni mina l-ʿadhābi wal-ʿanhum laʿnan kabīran O' our Lord! give them a double chastisement, and curse them a great curse. See 33:67

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا مُوسٰی فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوْا وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takūnū ka-alladhīna ādhaw mūsā fabarra-ahu l-lahu mimmā qālū wakāna ʿinda l-lahi wajīhan O you who have faith! Do not be like those who tormented Moses, whereat Allah absolved him of what they alleged, and he was distinguished in Allah's sight.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا مُوسٰی فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوْا وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takūnū ka-alladhīna ādhaw mūsā fabarra-ahu l-lahu mimmā qālū wakāna ʿinda l-lahi wajīhan O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Musa; then Allah cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allah, was distinguished. O you who believe! Be not like those who annoyed Musa, but Allah cleared him of that which they alleged, and he was honorable before Allah (33:69). The Fabrications of the Jews against Musa Al-Bukhari recorded in the Book of Hadiths about the Prophets, that Abu Hurayrah said that the Messenger of Allah SAW said: إِنَّ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ كَانَ رَجُلًا حَيِيًّا سِتِّيرًا لَا يُرَى مِنْ جِلْدِهِ شَيْءٌ اسْتِحْيَاءً مِنْهُ، فَآذَاهُ مَنْ آذَاهُ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَقَالُوا: مَا يَتَسَتَّرُ…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا مُوسٰی فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوْا وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takūnū ka-alladhīna ādhaw mūsā fabarra-ahu l-lahu mimmā qālū wakāna ʿinda l-lahi wajīhan O' ye who believe! be not like those who afflicted Moses (with a slander), but God cleared him of what they said, and he was with God in high esteem. Refer to O.T. Number 12/1-13. But it is the story of the Old Testament. It is said that Moses was extremely shy and would not expose his body fully even while he took a bath. People spread the false report of his being impotent or not having the male genetic organ or had defective organs. He used to bathe far away from the sight of the people. Once when he kept his clothes on a stone and went…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوْۤا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waqūlū qawlan sadīdan O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah, and speak upright words.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوْۤا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waqūlū qawlan sadīdan O you who have believed, fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice. O you who believe! Have Taqwa of Allah and speak (always) the truth (33:70). He will direct you to do righteous good deeds and will forgive you your sins. And whosoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, he has indeed achieved a great victory (33:71). The Command to the Believers to have Taqwa and Speak the Truth Here Allah commands His servants to have Taqwa of Him, worshipping Him as if they can see Him, and to: قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا speak (always) the truth. Meaning: to speak in a straightforward manner, with no crookedness or distortion. He promises them that if they do that, He will reward them by making their deeds righteous,…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوْۤا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waqūlū qawlan sadīdan O' ye who believe! Guard yourselves (against the wrath of God) and speak ye the right word, See 33:69

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا yuṣ'liḥ lakum aʿmālakum wayaghfir lakum dhunūbakum waman yuṭiʿi l-laha warasūlahu faqad fāza fawzan ʿaẓīman He shall rectify your conduct for you and He shall forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle has certainly achieved a great success.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا yuṣ'liḥ lakum aʿmālakum wayaghfir lakum dhunūbakum waman yuṭiʿi l-laha warasūlahu faqad fāza fawzan ʿaẓīman He will (then) amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment. See 33:70

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا yuṣ'liḥ lakum aʿmālakum wayaghfir lakum dhunūbakum waman yuṭiʿi l-laha warasūlahu faqad fāza fawzan ʿaẓīman He will set right for you your deeds, and forgive you your faults; and whoever obeyeth God and His Apostle, then indeed he hath achieved a great success. See 33:69

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا innā ʿaraḍnā l-amānata ʿalā l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-jibāli fa-abayna an yaḥmil'nahā wa-ashfaqna min'hā waḥamalahā l-insānu innahu kāna ẓalūman jahūlan Indeed We presented the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were apprehensive of it; but man undertook it. Indeed he is most unfair and senseless.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا innā ʿaraḍnā l-amānata ʿalā l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-jibāli fa-abayna an yaḥmil'nahā wa-ashfaqna min'hā waḥamalahā l-insānu innahu kāna ẓalūman jahūlan Indeed, We offered the Trust1 to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man (undertook to) bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.2 Truly, We did offer the Amanah to the heavens and the earth, and the mountains, but they declined to bear it and were afraid of it. But man bore it. Verily, he was unjust and ignorant (33:72). So that Allah will punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the men and women who are idolators. And Allah will pardon the believers, men and women. And Allah is Ever Oft-Forgiving,…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا innā ʿaraḍnā l-amānata ʿalā l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-jibāli fa-abayna an yaḥmil'nahā wa-ashfaqna min'hā waḥamalahā l-insānu innahu kāna ẓalūman jahūlan Verily We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were afraid thereof; and man undertook it, verily he was (proved) unjust, ignorant, 'al-Amanat', i.e., Trust - this verse needs a serious study of its matter with the application of the knowledge of the spirit of the Holy Qur'an. What God offered to the heavens and the earth and the mountains rejecting it, could not be anything simple or ordinary. It must be something very serious, grave and important, the acceptance of which would naturally carry a great reward and the failure to…

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُعَذِّبَ اللَّهُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ وَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا liyuʿadhiba l-lahu l-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-mush'rikīna wal-mush'rikāti wayatūba l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman Allah will surely punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the polytheists, men and women, and Allah will turn clemently to the faithful, men and women, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُعَذِّبَ اللَّهُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ وَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا liyuʿadhiba l-lahu l-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-mush'rikīna wal-mush'rikāti wayatūba l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman [It1 was] so that Allah may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allah may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful. See 33:72

item.title: Al-Ahzaab:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُعَذِّبَ اللَّهُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ وَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا liyuʿadhiba l-lahu l-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-mush'rikīna wal-mush'rikāti wayatūba l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman So will God chastise the hypocrite-men and the hypocrite-women and the polytheist men and the polytheist-women and God will turn (merciful) unto the believer-men and the believer women; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. The breach of the undertaken covenant would naturally carry its own punishment. But those who are sincere in their regard to the covenant and remain firm and steadfast in their faith, but fail unintentionally, shall justly deserve the aid from God's grace and mercy and would surely have it and be made worthy of the exalted destiny as the recompense for their sincerity in faith and perseverance in their toil to fulfil the undertaking, for…

item.title: Al-A'laa:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْاَعْلٰی sabbiḥi is'ma rabbika l-aʿlā Celebrate the Name of your Lord, the Most Exalted,

item.title: Al-A'laa:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْاَعْلٰی sabbiḥi is'ma rabbika l-aʿlā Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High. فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَىٰ Therefore remind in case the reminder profits. Meaning: remind where reminding is beneficial. From here we get the etiquette of spreading knowledge, that it should not be wasted upon those who are not suitable or worthy of it. The Commander of the believers, Ali said, "You do not tell people any statement that their intellects do not grasp except that it will be a Fitnah (trial) for some of them." He also said, "Tell people that which they know. Would you like for Allah and His Messenger to be rejected?" Allah said: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ The reminder will be received by him who fears, Meaning: 'he whose heart fears Allah and who knows that he is going to meet…

item.title: Al-A'laa:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْاَعْلٰی sabbiḥi is'ma rabbika l-aʿlā Hallow thou the name of thy Lord, the Most High The word "Rabb" in the Arabic language covers a very wide field implying: nourishing, sustaining, protecting from harm, providing opportunities and means for the fullest possible development and taking care as the Owner and the Guardian of a being. The word 'Lord' of the English language is to be used helplessly for the unavailability of any other word to suit the sense of the term "Rabb" . Hence, wherever 'Lord' has been used in the place of the Arabic "Rabb" it is to mean all the qualities of the "Rabb" as used in the Qur'anic language. This verse pleased the Holy Prophet so much that very often he repeated it and the First Holy Imam, Ali Ibn Abu Talib, used often to…

item.title: Al-A'laa:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّى alladhī khalaqa fasawwā who created and proportioned,

item.title: Al-A'laa:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّى alladhī khalaqa fasawwā Who created and proportioned. See 87:1

item.title: Al-A'laa:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّى alladhī khalaqa fasawwā He Who createth and fashioneth (Refer to: 15:28, 15:29, 18:37, 6:2, 82:8.) (all things) The existence of man has several different aspects1. Each time a reference has been made in the Holy Qur'an to the creation of man, it refers to a particular aspect of it. Man has been referred to, as having been brought into existence from nothing. His creation being passed through process after process in his being endowed with the various faculties and then being endowed with the conscience. Here the reference is to the perfect proportion in which everything is given to man.

item.title: Al-A'laa:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَى wa-alladhī qaddara fahadā who determined and guided,

item.title: Al-A'laa:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَى wa-alladhī qaddara fahadā And who destined and (then) guided. See 87:1

item.title: Al-A'laa:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَى wa-alladhī qaddara fahadā And He Who planned, and guideth them Everything has been provided in the degree essential to suit the need of every individual. Everything in the world has been controlled by fixed laws of growth and decay, and affected the necessary guidance through instincts, conscience, revealed scriptures, Apostles and the Holy Imam. The divine guidance is according to a planned process. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-A'laa:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَى wa-alladhī akhraja l-marʿā who brought forth the pasture,

item.title: Al-A'laa:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَى wa-alladhī akhraja l-marʿā And who brings out the pasture. See 87:1

item.title: Al-A'laa:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَى wa-alladhī akhraja l-marʿā And He Who bringeth forth the herbage See 87:3

item.title: Al-A'laa:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَى fajaʿalahu ghuthāan aḥwā then turned it into a black scum.

item.title: Al-A'laa:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَى fajaʿalahu ghuthāan aḥwā And (then) makes it black stubble. See 87:1

item.title: Al-A'laa:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَى fajaʿalahu ghuthāan aḥwā And then reduceth it to dusty stubble In the decay of the vegetable world, a regular resurrection of the decayed matter has also been ordained by preserving the seeds and the roots to keep the supply of the stuff continuous.

item.title: Al-A'laa:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنْسٰی sanuq'ri-uka falā tansā We shall have you recite [the Qur'ān], then you will not forget [any of it]

item.title: Al-A'laa:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنْسٰی sanuq'ri-uka falā tansā We will make you recite, (O Muḥammad), and you will not forget. See 87:1
