item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذْ وُقِفُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ walaw tarā idh wuqifū ʿalā rabbihim qāla alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna Were you to see when they are stationed before their Lord. He will say, 'Is this not a fact?' They will say, 'Yes, by our Lord!' He will say, 'So taste the punishment because of what you used to disbelieve.'

item.title: Al-An'aam:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذْ وُقِفُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ walaw tarā idh wuqifū ʿalā rabbihim qāla alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will (then) say, "So taste the punishment for what you used to deny." See 6:27

item.title: Al-An'aam:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذْ وُقِفُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ walaw tarā idh wuqifū ʿalā rabbihim qāla alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna And couldst thou see when they are made to stand before their Lord ('Ba'eb' i.e. resurrection is an evolutionary stage from the Terrestrial life into a heavenly and a non-physical or non-material realm in which one feels his pretence before God (A.P.).) , He will say: "Is this not the truth?" They will say: "Yes! by Our Lord!" He will say: "Taste ye then the chastisement for what ye did (Used to.) disbelieve." See 6:25

item.title: Al-An'aam:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوْا يَاحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَى ظُهُورِهِمْ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi ḥattā idhā jāathumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan qālū yāḥasratanā ʿalā mā farraṭnā fīhā wahum yaḥmilūna awzārahum ʿalā ẓuhūrihim alā sāa mā yazirūna They are certainly losers who deny the encounter with Allah. When the Hour overtakes them suddenly, they will say, 'Alas for us, for what we neglected in it!' And they will bear their burdens on their backs. Look! Evil is what they bear!

item.title: Al-An'aam:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوْا يَاحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَى ظُهُورِهِمْ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi ḥattā idhā jāathumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan qālū yāḥasratanā ʿalā mā farraṭnā fīhā wahum yaḥmilūna awzārahum ʿalā ẓuhūrihim alā sāa mā yazirūna Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allah, until when the Hour (of resurrection) comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, (how great is) our regret over what we neglected concerning it (i.e., the Hour)," while they bear their burdens (i.e., sins) on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear. They indeed are losers who denied their meeting with Allah, until all of a sudden, the Hour (signs of death) is upon them, and they say: "Alas for us that we gave no…

item.title: Al-An'aam:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوْا يَاحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَى ظُهُورِهِمْ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi ḥattā idhā jāathumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan qālū yāḥasratanā ʿalā mā farraṭnā fīhā wahum yaḥmilūna awzārahum ʿalā ẓuhūrihim alā sāa mā yazirūna Indeed, are losers, they who disbelieved the meeting (Not seeing, but Communion in some way appropriate to his absoluteness and our finiteness.) of God, until cometh suddenly upon them the hour ('Sa'a' i.e. the Hour i.e. of the Doom.) (of Resurrection)', They will say: "O' Our grief for our neglecting it!" And they shall bear their burdens on their backs; Is it not evil indeed what they shall bear. Feeling of sorrow or pleasure for the past actions, is one of the main features of the life here…

item.title: Al-An'aam:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ الْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā laʿibun walahwun walalddāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūna The life of the world is nothing but play and diversion, and the abode of the Hereafter is surely better for those who are Godwary. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: Al-An'aam:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ الْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā laʿibun walahwun walalddāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūna And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah, so will you not reason? See 6:31

item.title: Al-An'aam:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ الْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā laʿibun walahwun walalddāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūna And the life of this world is naught but play and vain sport; and certainly the abode of the hereafter, is the best for those who guard (themselves against evil); Do ye not then understand (Refer to Verses 29:64; 47:36; 57:20.) ? See 6:31

item.title: Al-An'aam:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ الَّذِي يَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَكِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ qad naʿlamu innahu layaḥzunuka alladhī yaqūlūna fa-innahum lā yukadhibūnaka walākinna l-ẓālimīna biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūna We certainly know that what they say grieves you. Yet it is not you that they deny, but it is Allah's signs that the wrongdoers impugn.

item.title: Al-An'aam:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ الَّذِي يَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَكِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ qad naʿlamu innahu layaḥzunuka alladhī yaqūlūna fa-innahum lā yukadhibūnaka walākinna l-ẓālimīna biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūna We know that you, (O Muḥammad), are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject. We know indeed the grief which their words cause you; it is not you that they deny, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers deny (6:33). Verily, (many) Messengers were denied before you, but with patience they bore the denial, and they were hurt, till Our help reached them, and none can alter the Words of Allah. Surely, there has reached you the information about the Messengers (before you) (6:34). If their aversion is hard on you, then…

item.title: Al-An'aam:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ الَّذِي يَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَكِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ qad naʿlamu innahu layaḥzunuka alladhī yaqūlūna fa-innahum lā yukadhibūnaka walākinna l-ẓālimīna biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūna Indeed, We know, it certainly grieveth thee that which they say, but verily it is not thee (The Holy Prophet) (that) they belie, but (it is) the signs of God, the wrong doers deny. The Holy Prophet had already impressed even upon the worst of his enemies, his truthfulness, and everyone, be he his foe or a friend, had acknowledged him as 'Sadiq', i.e., the Truthful and 'Al-Ameen' - the Trustworthy. He had already earned from the people as a whole these titles even from the very beginning of his life, before his declaring his apostleship. Hence the people's now rejecting his message, is not that they mean him a liar, but…

item.title: Al-An'aam:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوْۤا عَلَى مَا كُذِّبُوْۤا وَأُوذُوْۤا حَتّٰی أَتَاهُمْ نَصْرُنَا وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكَ مِنْ نَّبَإِى الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika faṣabarū ʿalā mā kudhibū waūdhū ḥattā atāhum naṣrunā walā mubaddila likalimāti l-lahi walaqad jāaka min naba-i l-mur'salīna Apostles were certainly denied before you, yet they patiently bore being denied and tormented until Our help came to them. Nothing can change the words of Allah, and there have certainly come to you some of the accounts of the apostles.

item.title: Al-An'aam:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوْۤا عَلَى مَا كُذِّبُوْۤا وَأُوذُوْۤا حَتّٰی أَتَاهُمْ نَصْرُنَا وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكَ مِنْ نَّبَإِى الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika faṣabarū ʿalā mā kudhibū waūdhū ḥattā atāhum naṣrunā walā mubaddila likalimāti l-lahi walaqad jāaka min naba-i l-mur'salīna And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over the denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words (i.e., decrees) of Allah. And there has certainly come to you some information about the (previous) messengers. See 6:33

item.title: Al-An'aam:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوْۤا عَلَى مَا كُذِّبُوْۤا وَأُوذُوْۤا حَتّٰی أَتَاهُمْ نَصْرُنَا وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكَ مِنْ نَّبَإِى الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika faṣabarū ʿalā mā kudhibū waūdhū ḥattā atāhum naṣrunā walā mubaddila likalimāti l-lahi walaqad jāaka min naba-i l-mur'salīna And most certainly were belied (Our) apostles before thee, but they were patient on their being belied and were persecuted until came to them Our help; and none can alter the words ('Words' stands here for God's will Creative or Legislative. Here refers to the decision about His Prophets. Refer to Verses 58:21; 37:171; 37:172.) of God; And most certainly hath come to thee the tidings about the apostles (from Us) (Refer to Verses 6:116; 37:171; 37:172; 38:21.) . 'There is none to change the Words of God.' The word of God means God's promises of…

item.title: Al-An'aam:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَبْتَغِيَ نَفَقًا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِي السَّمَاءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى الْهُدَى فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ wa-in kāna kabura ʿalayka iʿ'rāḍuhum fa-ini is'taṭaʿta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fī l-arḍi aw sullaman fī l-samāi fatatiyahum biāyatin walaw shāa l-lahu lajamaʿahum ʿalā l-hudā falā takūnanna mina l-jāhilīna And should their aversion be hard on you, find, if you can, a tunnel into the ground, or a ladder into sky, that you may bring them a sign. Had Allah wished, He would have brought them together on guidance. So do not be one of the ignorant.

item.title: Al-An'aam:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَبْتَغِيَ نَفَقًا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِي السَّمَاءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى الْهُدَى فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ wa-in kāna kabura ʿalayka iʿ'rāḍuhum fa-ini is'taṭaʿta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fī l-arḍi aw sullaman fī l-samāi fatatiyahum biāyatin walaw shāa l-lahu lajamaʿahum ʿalā l-hudā falā takūnanna mina l-jāhilīna And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, (then do so). But if Allah had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant. See 6:33

item.title: Al-An'aam:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَبْتَغِيَ نَفَقًا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِي السَّمَاءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى الْهُدَى فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ wa-in kāna kabura ʿalayka iʿ'rāḍuhum fa-ini is'taṭaʿta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fī l-arḍi aw sullaman fī l-samāi fatatiyahum biāyatin walaw shāa l-lahu lajamaʿahum ʿalā l-hudā falā takūnanna mina l-jāhilīna And if their turning away be hard upon thee (The address though apparently is to the Holy Prophet, but it is obvious that it cannot be a man of realisation like the Holy Prophet will never feel straitened. The address in fact is to the followers of the Holy Prophet who felt straitened for the people's turning away.) , then if thou canst seek an opening (to go down) into the earth or a ladder (to ascend up) to heaven so that thou bringeth…

item.title: Al-An'aam:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ وَالْمَوْتَى يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ innamā yastajību alladhīna yasmaʿūna wal-mawtā yabʿathuhumu l-lahu thumma ilayhi yur'jaʿūna Only those who listen will respond [to you]. As for the dead, Allah will resurrect them, then they will be brought back to Him.

item.title: Al-An'aam:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ وَالْمَوْتَى يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ innamā yastajību alladhīna yasmaʿūna wal-mawtā yabʿathuhumu l-lahu thumma ilayhi yur'jaʿūna Only those who hear will respond. But the dead1 - Allah will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned. See 6:33

item.title: Al-An'aam:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ وَالْمَوْتَى يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ innamā yastajību alladhīna yasmaʿūna wal-mawtā yabʿathuhumu l-lahu thumma ilayhi yur'jaʿūna Verily, only those will accept thee, who listen (to the Word of God); and (as to) the dead, God will raise them, then unto Him will they return (Refer to Verses 39:17; 39:18.) . Only those who listen, sincerely interested in knowing the truth, will believe. As for those who do not listen, they are like the dead and God will surely raise the dead on the Day of Resurrection. Then they will believe but it will be of no avail to them. Refers to the actual purpose of the apostolic preaching in spite of its being universal but the object is the guidance of those who have aptitude for development and progress. The sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad…

item.title: Al-An'aam:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يُنَزِّلَ اٰیَةً وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ waqālū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi qul inna l-laha qādirun ʿalā an yunazzila āyatan walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna They say, 'Why has not a sign been sent down to him from his Lord?' Say, 'Allah is indeed able to send down a sign,' but most of them do not know.

item.title: Al-An'aam:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يُنَزِّلَ اٰیَةً وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ waqālū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi qul inna l-laha qādirun ʿalā an yunazzila āyatan walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allah is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know." And they said: Why is not a sign sent down to him from his Lord?" Say: "Allah is certainly able to send down a sign, but most of them know not (6:37). There is not a moving creature on earth, nor a bird that flies with its two wings, but are Umam like you. We have neglected nothing in the Book, then unto their Lord they (all) shall be…

item.title: Al-An'aam:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يُنَزِّلَ اٰیَةً وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ waqālū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi qul inna l-laha qādirun ʿalā an yunazzila āyatan walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna And they say: "Why is not a sign sent down unto him from his Lord?" Say! "Verily God is able to send down a sign but most (Majority Condemned.) of them know not (The Sign referred to in this Verse is the same adverted to in Verse 6:35.) ." See 6:36

item.title: Al-An'aam:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَائِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّا أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِي الْكِتَابِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi walā ṭāirin yaṭīru bijanāḥayhi illā umamun amthālukum mā farraṭnā fī l-kitābi min shayin thumma ilā rabbihim yuḥ'sharūna There is no animal on land, nor a bird that flies with its wings, but they are communities like yourselves. We have not omitted anything from the Book. Then they will be mustered toward their Lord.

item.title: Al-An'aam:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَائِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّا أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِي الْكِتَابِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi walā ṭāirin yaṭīru bijanāḥayhi illā umamun amthālukum mā farraṭnā fī l-kitābi min shayin thumma ilā rabbihim yuḥ'sharūna And there is no creature on (or within) the earth or bird that flies with its wings except (that they are) communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register1 a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered. See 6:37

item.title: Al-An'aam:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَائِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّا أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِي الْكِتَابِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi walā ṭāirin yaṭīru bijanāḥayhi illā umamun amthālukum mā farraṭnā fī l-kitābi min shayin thumma ilā rabbihim yuḥ'sharūna There is not an animal that walketh upon the earth, not a bird that flieth with its two wings, but they are communities the like of you; We have not neglected ('Tafreet' Overstepping by total negligence or by misplacing it. Everything has been in its proper place in the Book of Creation of which Qur'an is the microform (A.P.). Refer to Verses 7:57; 7:58.) in the Book (The Qur'an), anything, then unto their Lord shall they (all) be gathered (in the end). Even the animals that walk on earth as well as those who fly, i.e.,…

item.title: Al-An'aam:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ مَنْ يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَنْ يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā ṣummun wabuk'mun fī l-ẓulumāti man yasha-i l-lahu yuḍ'lil'hu waman yasha yajʿalhu ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Those who deny Our signs are deaf and dumb, in a manifold darkness. Allah leads astray whomever He wishes, and whomever He wishes He puts him on a straight path.

item.title: Al-An'aam:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ مَنْ يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَنْ يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā ṣummun wabuk'mun fī l-ẓulumāti man yasha-i l-lahu yuḍ'lil'hu waman yasha yajʿalhu ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allah wills - He sends astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path. See 6:37

item.title: Al-An'aam:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ مَنْ يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَنْ يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā ṣummun wabuk'mun fī l-ẓulumāti man yasha-i l-lahu yuḍ'lil'hu waman yasha yajʿalhu ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin And they who belied Our signs are deaf (The preaching will not avail them.) and dumb, in utter darkness; whom God pleaseth He alloweth them to go astray; and whom He pleaseth (Refer to Verse. 3:1. God's pleasure is conditioned with the aptitude of every individual. (A.P.).) , He doth put them on the straight (Right.) path. See 6:38

item.title: Al-An'aam:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ السَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi aw atatkumu l-sāʿatu aghayra l-lahi tadʿūna in kuntum ṣādiqīna Say, 'Tell me, should Allah's punishment overtake you, or should the Hour overtake you, will you supplicate anyone other than Allah, should you be truthful?

item.title: Al-An'aam:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ السَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi aw atatkumu l-sāʿatu aghayra l-lahi tadʿūna in kuntum ṣādiqīna Say, "Have you considered:1 if there came to you the punishment of Allah or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allah you would invoke, if you should be truthful?" Say: Tell me if Allah's torment comes upon you, or the Hour comes upon you, would you then call upon any one other than Allah? (Reply) if you are truthful! (6:40). Nay! To Him alone you call, and, if He willed, He would remove that (distress) for which you call upon Him, and you forget at that time whatever partners you joined with Him (in worship) (6:41). Verily, We sent (Messengers) to many nations before you.…

item.title: Al-An'aam:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ السَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi aw atatkumu l-sāʿatu aghayra l-lahi tadʿūna in kuntum ṣādiqīna Say: (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Think ye that if cometh to you the chastisement (Any unexpected hardship even in this life.) of God, or cometh to you the Hour (hour of hardship even in this life.) (of resurrection), will ye call (for help) other than God, (say ye it out) if ye are truthful." See 6:38

item.title: Al-An'aam:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِنْ شَاءَ وَتَنْسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ bal iyyāhu tadʿūna fayakshifu mā tadʿūna ilayhi in shāa watansawna mā tush'rikūna Rather, Him you will supplicate, and He will remove that for which you supplicated Him, if He wishes, and you will forget what you ascribe [to Him] as [His] partners.'

item.title: Al-An'aam:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِنْ شَاءَ وَتَنْسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ bal iyyāhu tadʿūna fayakshifu mā tadʿūna ilayhi in shāa watansawna mā tush'rikūna No, it is Him (alone) you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate (with Him). See 6:40

item.title: Al-An'aam:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِنْ شَاءَ وَتَنْسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ bal iyyāhu tadʿūna fayakshifu mā tadʿūna ilayhi in shāa watansawna mā tush'rikūna Nay, Him (God.) will ye call (At the time of distress.) upon, and He cleareth (Deliver - give an opening relief.) away which ye pray for unto Him if He pleaseth, and ye would forget (the false gods') ye set up (with Him). This Verse gives out an inherent characteristic in every human being, be he a believer in God or an unbeliever, a Unitarian or a polytheist, that in the state of a total helplessness while in distress, when one finds none to help him, the inner self in him, is liberated from the restrictions of the individual's personal views, and commands him to call upon the ever-present Omnipotent One and the liberated mind automatically…

item.title: Al-An'aam:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ walaqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fa-akhadhnāhum bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yataḍarraʿūna We have certainly sent [apostles] to nations before you, then We seized them with stress and distress so that they might entreat [Us].

item.title: Al-An'aam:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ walaqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fa-akhadhnāhum bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yataḍarraʿūna And We have already sent (messengers) to nations before you, (O Muḥammad); then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves (to Us). See 6:40

item.title: Al-An'aam:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ walaqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fa-akhadhnāhum bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yataḍarraʿūna And most certainly We sent (apostles) unto peoples before thee, then We caught them in distress and adversity, in order they might humble themselves (Refer to Verses 4:164; 10:47; 16:36; 15:24; 13:7; 40:78.) . Islam is the only religion in the world which recognizes and pays equal regard to all the apostles of God preceding the Holy Prophet1.

item.title: Al-An'aam:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا وَلَكِنْ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falawlā idh jāahum basunā taḍarraʿū walākin qasat qulūbuhum wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu mā kānū yaʿmalūna Why did they not entreat when Our punishment overtook them! But their hearts had hardened, and Satan had made to seem decorous to them what they had been doing.

item.title: Al-An'aam:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا وَلَكِنْ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falawlā idh jāahum basunā taḍarraʿū walākin qasat qulūbuhum wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu mā kānū yaʿmalūna Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing. See 6:40

item.title: Al-An'aam:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا وَلَكِنْ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falawlā idh jāahum basunā taḍarraʿū walākin qasat qulūbuhum wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu mā kānū yaʿmalūna Yet why did they not, when our punishment came to them, humble themselves? but their hearts were hardened and the devil made fair-seeming for them, what they did act (Refer to Verse 26:4.) . See 6:42

item.title: Al-An'aam:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْۤا مَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَابَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی إِذَا فَرِحُوْۤا بِمَا أُوتُوْۤا أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْلِسُونَ falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi fataḥnā ʿalayhim abwāba kulli shayin ḥattā idhā fariḥū bimā ūtū akhadhnāhum baghtatan fa-idhā hum mub'lisūna So when they forgot what they had been admonished of, We opened for them the gates of all [good] things. When they rejoiced in what they were given, We seized them suddenly, whereat, behold, they were despondent.

item.title: Al-An'aam:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْۤا مَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَابَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی إِذَا فَرِحُوْۤا بِمَا أُوتُوْۤا أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْلِسُونَ falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi fataḥnā ʿalayhim abwāba kulli shayin ḥattā idhā fariḥū bimā ūtū akhadhnāhum baghtatan fa-idhā hum mub'lisūna So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded,1 We opened to them the doors of every (good) thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were (then) in despair. See 6:40

item.title: Al-An'aam:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْۤا مَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَابَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی إِذَا فَرِحُوْۤا بِمَا أُوتُوْۤا أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْلِسُونَ falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi fataḥnā ʿalayhim abwāba kulli shayin ḥattā idhā fariḥū bimā ūtū akhadhnāhum baghtatan fa-idhā hum mub'lisūna And when they forgot that which they had been admonished (Reminded of.) , We opened for them the doors of all things (of enjoyments); until when they rejoiced in what they were given, We caught them suddenly, when lo! they were in utter despair. Opening of the doors of all things, meaning bounties, were bestowed on them in abundance and when surrounded by the abundant provision, they forgot the Lord. They were visited by a sudden visitation, and they were completely destroyed. It is reported of the Holy Prophet that he said: 'When ye see anyone in spite of his…

item.title: Al-An'aam:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ faquṭiʿa dābiru l-qawmi alladhīna ẓalamū wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna Thus the wrongdoing lot were rooted out, and all praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-An'aam:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ faquṭiʿa dābiru l-qawmi alladhīna ẓalamū wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds. See 6:40

item.title: Al-An'aam:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ faquṭiʿa dābiru l-qawmi alladhīna ẓalamū wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna So, the roots (Even the last remnant removed.) of the people who were unjust (Wrong doers.) were cut (Removed from the existence.) off; and all praise is God's the Lord of the worlds. Dabir is the root - meaning the fast man. They were so completely destroyed to the last one of them that not a single one of them was spared.

item.title: Al-An'aam:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَارَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ مَنْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ qul ara-aytum in akhadha l-lahu samʿakum wa-abṣārakum wakhatama ʿalā qulūbikum man ilāhun ghayru l-lahi yatīkum bihi unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti thumma hum yaṣdifūna Say, 'Tell me, should Allah take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal on your hearts, which god other than Allah can bring it [back] to you?' Look, how We paraphrase the signs variously; nevertheless they turn away.

item.title: Al-An'aam:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَارَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ مَنْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ qul ara-aytum in akhadha l-lahu samʿakum wa-abṣārakum wakhatama ʿalā qulūbikum man ilāhun ghayru l-lahi yatīkum bihi unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti thumma hum yaṣdifūna Say, "Have you considered:1 if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allah could bring them (back) to you?" Look how We diversify2 the verses; then they (still) turn away. Say: Tell me, if Allah took away your hearing and your sight, and sealed up your hearts, is there a god other than Allah who could restore them to you?" See how variously We explain the Ayat, yet they turn aside (6:46). Say: "Tell me, if the punishment of Allah comes…

item.title: Al-An'aam:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَارَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ مَنْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ qul ara-aytum in akhadha l-lahu samʿakum wa-abṣārakum wakhatama ʿalā qulūbikum man ilāhun ghayru l-lahi yatīkum bihi unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti thumma hum yaṣdifūna Say: "Think ye, that if God taketh away your hearing and your sight and sealeth on your hearts, who is the god other than God that can bring (Restore.) it (again) to you?" See thou, how We display (explaining) the signs yet they turn aside. 'Nasarrifu' i.e., How' we argue to admonish in variant ways, sometimes with advice, and sometimes with warnings, i.e., in diversified ways.

item.title: Al-An'aam:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الظَّالِمُونَ qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-ẓālimūna Say, 'Tell me, should Allah's punishment overtake you suddenly or visibly, will anyone be destroyed except the wrongdoing lot?'

item.title: Al-An'aam:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الظَّالِمُونَ qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-ẓālimūna Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allah should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly,1 will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people?" See 6:46

item.title: Al-An'aam:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الظَّالِمُونَ qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-ẓālimūna Say: (O' Our Apostle Muhammad) "Think ye, if the chastisement (When the calamities come even the good are also enveloped along with the evil ones, but for being recompensed in the here-after the calamity is not destructive for the good ones as it is for the evil ones.) of God cometh to you suddenly or openly, will any be destroyed but the unjust (The wrong doers.) people?" See 6:46

item.title: Al-An'aam:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ فَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ wamā nur'silu l-mur'salīna illā mubashirīna wamundhirīna faman āmana wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna We do not send the apostles except as bearers of good news and warners. As for those who are faithful and righteous, they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: Al-An'aam:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ فَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ wamā nur'silu l-mur'salīna illā mubashirīna wamundhirīna faman āmana wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve. See 6:46

item.title: Al-An'aam:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ فَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ wamā nur'silu l-mur'salīna illā mubashirīna wamundhirīna faman āmana wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna And We send not messengers but (as) heralds with glad tidings and warners; then whoever believeth and acteth (Note that acting aright or amending one's own conduct has been essential with the faith or belief.) aright, they shall have no fear (For having the eternal bliss and security.) , nor shall they grieve. See 6:46

item.title: Al-An'aam:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā yamassuhumu l-ʿadhābu bimā kānū yafsuqūna But as for those who deny Our signs, the punishment shall befall them because of the transgressions they used to commit.

item.title: Al-An'aam:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā yamassuhumu l-ʿadhābu bimā kānū yafsuqūna But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch1 them for their defiant disobedience. See 6:46

item.title: Al-An'aam:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā yamassuhumu l-ʿadhābu bimā kānū yafsuqūna And (as for) those who belie our signs, chastisement shall afflict them for what they used to transgress. See 6:46

item.title: Al-An'aam:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ qul lā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu lakum innī malakun in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya qul hal yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru afalā tatafakkarūna Say, 'I do not say to you that I possess the treasuries of Allah, nor do I know the Unseen, nor do I say to you that I am an angel. I follow only what is revealed to me.' Say, 'Are the blind one and the seer equal? So do you not reflect?'

item.title: Al-An'aam:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ qul lā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu lakum innī malakun in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya qul hal yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru afalā tatafakkarūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "I do not tell you that I have the depositories (containing the provision) of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought?" Say: I don't tell you that with me are the treasures of Allah, nor (that) I know the Unseen; nor do I tell you that I am an…

item.title: Al-An'aam:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ qul lā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu lakum innī malakun in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya qul hal yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru afalā tatafakkarūna Say: (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "I do not say unto you (that) with (All that was possessed by the Holy Prophet, was God's and not his.) me are the treasures (Refer to Verses 52:37; 52:38; 7:187.) of God, nor do I know the unseen, nor do I say unto you that I am an angel; I follow not but what is revealed unto me;" Say, "Are the blind and the seeing (Refer to Verses 5:100; 13:16; 39:9; 47:14.) alike; Do ye not then reflect?"…

item.title: Al-An'aam:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يُحْشَرُوْۤا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wa-andhir bihi alladhīna yakhāfūna an yuḥ'sharū ilā rabbihim laysa lahum min dūnihi waliyyun walā shafīʿun laʿallahum yattaqūna And warn by its1 means those who fear being mustered toward their Lord, besides whom they shall have neither any guardian nor any intercessor, so that they may be Godwary.

item.title: Al-An'aam:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يُحْشَرُوْۤا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wa-andhir bihi alladhīna yakhāfūna an yuḥ'sharū ilā rabbihim laysa lahum min dūnihi waliyyun walā shafīʿun laʿallahum yattaqūna And warn by it (i.e., the Qur’ān) those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous. See 6:50

item.title: Al-An'aam:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يُحْشَرُوْۤا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wa-andhir bihi alladhīna yakhāfūna an yuḥ'sharū ilā rabbihim laysa lahum min dūnihi waliyyun walā shafīʿun laʿallahum yattaqūna And warn thou with it (What is revealed. Refer to Verse 6:50.) , the Qur'an those who fear that they shall be gathered unto their Lord (Thinking that) there shall not be for them, besides Him, any guardian or an intercessor, happily they may guard (themselves against evil). This passage indicates that the prophetic warning, avails only those who are afraid of being brought to the presence of God, with none besides Him to help or intercede. People with such bent of mind are apt to develop piety in them. The negation of a helper or an intercessor besides God, does not negate the help and…

item.title: Al-An'aam:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَوةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā taṭrudi alladhīna yadʿūna rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ʿashiyi yurīdūna wajhahu mā ʿalayka min ḥisābihim min shayin wamā min ḥisābika ʿalayhim min shayin fataṭrudahum fatakūna mina l-ẓālimīna Do not drive away those who supplicate their Lord morning and evening desiring His face.1 Neither are you accountable for them in any way, nor are they accountable for you in any way, so that you may drive them away and thus become one of the wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-An'aam:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَوةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā taṭrudi alladhīna yadʿūna rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ʿashiyi yurīdūna wajhahu mā ʿalayka min ḥisābihim min shayin wamā min ḥisābika ʿalayhim min shayin fataṭrudahum fatakūna mina l-ẓālimīna And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His face (i.e., favor). Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account.1 So were you to send them away, you would (then) be of the wrongdoers. See 6:50

item.title: Al-An'aam:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَوةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā taṭrudi alladhīna yadʿūna rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ʿashiyi yurīdūna wajhahu mā ʿalayka min ḥisābihim min shayin wamā min ḥisābika ʿalayhim min shayin fataṭrudahum fatakūna mina l-ẓālimīna And drive (Prophet addressed for the people.) not away those who call upon their Lord, in the morning and the evening, they seek His countenance (Face.) ; neither it is on thee to answer for anything on their account nor is it on them to answer for anything on thine account so that thou driveth them away and thus be of the unjust (Reference to the aristocratic view of the common man which Islam was to abolish and bring those who prided over the others to the level of the…

item.title: Al-An'aam:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِيَقُولُوْۤا أَهَؤُلَاءِ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِالشَّاكِرِينَ wakadhālika fatannā baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin liyaqūlū ahāulāi manna l-lahu ʿalayhim min bayninā alaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bil-shākirīna Thus do We test them by means of one another so that they should say, 'Are these the ones whom Allah has favoured from among us?!' Does not Allah know best the grateful?!

item.title: Al-An'aam:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِيَقُولُوْۤا أَهَؤُلَاءِ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِالشَّاكِرِينَ wakadhālika fatannā baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin liyaqūlū ahāulāi manna l-lahu ʿalayhim min bayninā alaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bil-shākirīna And thus We have tried some of them through others that they (i.e., the disbelievers) might say, "Is it these whom Allah has favored among us?" Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful?1 See 6:50

item.title: Al-An'aam:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِيَقُولُوْۤا أَهَؤُلَاءِ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِالشَّاكِرِينَ wakadhālika fatannā baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin liyaqūlū ahāulāi manna l-lahu ʿalayhim min bayninā alaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bil-shākirīna Thus, did We try some of them by others so that they say: "Are these they upon whom God hath conferred (Obliged with blessings.) (His) favours, from among us? Doth (This is an answer to the question) not God know best the grateful?" It was a trial for the arrogant wealthy Quraish who valued and regarded only wealth and nothing else and never treated the poor even as human beings.

item.title: Al-An'aam:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَقُلْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ أَنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوءًا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-idhā jāaka alladhīna yu'minūna biāyātinā faqul salāmun ʿalaykum kataba rabbukum ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥmata annahu man ʿamila minkum sūan bijahālatin thumma tāba min baʿdihi wa-aṣlaḥa fa-annahu ghafūrun raḥīmun When those who have faith in Our signs come to you, say, 'Peace to you! Your Lord has made mercy incumbent upon Himself: whoever of you commits an evil [deed] out of ignorance and then repents after that and reforms, then He is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: Al-An'aam:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَقُلْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ أَنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوءًا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-idhā jāaka alladhīna yu'minūna biāyātinā faqul salāmun ʿalaykum kataba rabbukum ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥmata annahu man ʿamila minkum sūan bijahālatin thumma tāba min baʿdihi wa-aṣlaḥa fa-annahu ghafūrun raḥīmun And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful." See 6:50

item.title: Al-An'aam:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَقُلْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ أَنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوءًا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-idhā jāaka alladhīna yu'minūna biāyātinā faqul salāmun ʿalaykum kataba rabbukum ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥmata annahu man ʿamila minkum sūan bijahālatin thumma tāba min baʿdihi wa-aṣlaḥa fa-annahu ghafūrun raḥīmun And when come unto thee, those who believe in Our signs, say: "Salamun-alaikum" (Peace be on you) your Lord hath prescribed (Took upon Himself to be merciful.) mercy on Himself, (so that) if anyone of you doth evil in ignorance, then turneth (repentant) after that and amendeth (himself), then verily He (An answer to the repentance (The Sixth Holy Imam).) is the Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful. This Verse conveys a very great note of mercy of the Lord. The offering of 'Peace' to the believers is not…

item.title: Al-An'aam:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walitastabīna sabīlu l-muj'rimīna Thus do We elaborate1 the signs, so that the way of the guilty may be exposed.

item.title: Al-An'aam:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walitastabīna sabīlu l-muj'rimīna And thus do We detail the verses, and (thus) the way of the criminals will become evident. And thus do We explain the Ayat in detail, that the way of the criminals, may become manifest (6:55). Say: I have been forbidden to worship those whom you invoke (worship) besides Allah." Say: "I will not follow your vain desires. If I did, I would go astray, and I would not be one of the rightly guided (6:56). Say: "I am on clear proof from my Lord, but you deny it. I do not have what you are hastily seeking (the torment). The decision is only for Allah, He declares the truth, and He is the best of judges (6:57). Say: "If I had that which you are asking for…

item.title: Al-An'aam:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walitastabīna sabīlu l-muj'rimīna And thus We explain the signs in details so that the way of the sinners may be manifest (By comparing it with the way of the repentants.) . See 6:54

item.title: Al-An'aam:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُلْ لَا أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَاءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qul lā attabiʿu ahwāakum qad ḍalaltu idhan wamā anā mina l-muh'tadīna Say, 'I have been forbidden to worship those whom you invoke besides Allah.' Say, 'I do not follow your desires, for then I will have gone astray, and I will not be among the [rightly] guided.'

item.title: Al-An'aam:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُلْ لَا أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَاءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qul lā attabiʿu ahwāakum qad ḍalaltu idhan wamā anā mina l-muh'tadīna Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allah." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the (rightly) guided." See 6:55

item.title: Al-An'aam:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُلْ لَا أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَاءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qul lā attabiʿu ahwāakum qad ḍalaltu idhan wamā anā mina l-muh'tadīna Say! (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "I am forbidden to worship those whom ye call besides God;" Say Thou: "I follow not your inclinations for then indeed I should have gone astray and I will not be of those who are guided (aright)." See 6:54

item.title: Al-An'aam:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِهِ مَا عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْفَاصِلِينَ qul innī ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī wakadhabtum bihi mā ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi ini l-ḥuk'mu illā lillahi yaquṣṣu l-ḥaqa wahuwa khayru l-fāṣilīna Say, 'Indeed I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord and you have denied it. What you seek to hasten is not up to me. Judgement belongs only to Allah; He expounds the truth and He is the best of judges.'

item.title: Al-An'aam:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِهِ مَا عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْفَاصِلِينَ qul innī ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī wakadhabtum bihi mā ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi ini l-ḥuk'mu illā lillahi yaquṣṣu l-ḥaqa wahuwa khayru l-fāṣilīna Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient.1 The decision is only for Allah. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders." See 6:55

item.title: Al-An'aam:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِهِ مَا عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْفَاصِلِينَ qul innī ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī wakadhabtum bihi mā ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi ini l-ḥuk'mu illā lillahi yaquṣṣu l-ḥaqa wahuwa khayru l-fāṣilīna Say thou: "Verily I have manifest proof from my Lord and you belied it; I have not with me that (chastisement) which ye hasten (Asked to be hastened.) for; the judgment belongeth (to none) but unto God; Who declareth the truth and He is the best decider." See 6:54

item.title: Al-An'aam:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِالظَّالِمِينَ qul law anna ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi laquḍiya l-amru baynī wabaynakum wal-lahu aʿlamu bil-ẓālimīna Say, 'If what you seek to hasten were with me, the matter would surely have been decided between you and me, and Allah knows best the wrongdoers.'

item.title: Al-An'aam:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِالظَّالِمِينَ qul law anna ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi laquḍiya l-amru baynī wabaynakum wal-lahu aʿlamu bil-ẓālimīna Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers." See 6:55

item.title: Al-An'aam:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِالظَّالِمِينَ qul law anna ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi laquḍiya l-amru baynī wabaynakum wal-lahu aʿlamu bil-ẓālimīna Say thou, "If it were with me (The Chastisement.) , what ye hasten for, certainly would have been decided the matter between me and you (But it is with God.) ; and God knoweth best the unjust." That which you desire to hasten, i.e., the chastisement from God.

item.title: Al-An'aam:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَا إِلَّا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ waʿindahu mafātiḥu l-ghaybi lā yaʿlamuhā illā huwa wayaʿlamu mā fī l-bari wal-baḥri wamā tasquṭu min waraqatin illā yaʿlamuhā walā ḥabbatin fī ẓulumāti l-arḍi walā raṭbin walā yābisin illā fī kitābin mubīnin With Him are the treasures of the Unseen;1 no one knows them except Him. He knows whatever there is in land and sea. No leaf falls without His knowing it, nor is there a grain in the darkness of the earth, nor anything fresh or withered but it is in a manifest Book.

item.title: Al-An'aam:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَا إِلَّا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ waʿindahu mafātiḥu l-ghaybi lā yaʿlamuhā illā huwa wayaʿlamu mā fī l-bari wal-baḥri wamā tasquṭu min waraqatin illā yaʿlamuhā walā ḥabbatin fī ẓulumāti l-arḍi walā raṭbin walā yābisin illā fī kitābin mubīnin And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry (thing) but that it is (written) in a clear record. See 6:55

item.title: Al-An'aam:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَا إِلَّا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ waʿindahu mafātiḥu l-ghaybi lā yaʿlamuhā illā huwa wayaʿlamu mā fī l-bari wal-baḥri wamā tasquṭu min waraqatin illā yaʿlamuhā walā ḥabbatin fī ẓulumāti l-arḍi walā raṭbin walā yābisin illā fī kitābin mubīnin And with Him are the keys (of the treasures) of the unseen - knoweth it not anyone but He; and He (alone) knoweth what is in the land and the sea; and (there) falleth not (even) a leaf (of a tree) but He knoweth it, nor a grain in the darkness (in the deepest parts) of the earth, nor anything wet or dry but (it is) in a clear Book (Refers - that besides his knowledge, there is…

item.title: Al-An'aam:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِیْهِ لِيُقْضَى أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yatawaffākum bi-al-layli wayaʿlamu mā jaraḥtum bil-nahāri thumma yabʿathukum fīhi liyuq'ḍā ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marjiʿukum thumma yunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna It is He who takes your souls by night, and He knows what you do by day, then He reanimates you therein so that a specified term may be completed. Then to Him will be your return, whereat He will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: Al-An'aam:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِیْهِ لِيُقْضَى أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yatawaffākum bi-al-layli wayaʿlamu mā jaraḥtum bil-nahāri thumma yabʿathukum fīhi liyuq'ḍā ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marjiʿukum thumma yunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna And it is He who takes your souls by night1 and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein (i.e., by day) that a specified term2 may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do. It is He, Who takes your souls by night (when you are asleep), and has knowledge of all that you have done by day, then he raises (wakes) you up again, that a term appointed be fulfilled, then (in the end), unto Him will be…

item.title: Al-An'aam:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِیْهِ لِيُقْضَى أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yatawaffākum bi-al-layli wayaʿlamu mā jaraḥtum bil-nahāri thumma yabʿathukum fīhi liyuq'ḍā ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marjiʿukum thumma yunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna And He it is who taketh you away at night (in sleep), and He knoweth what ye acquire (Do or act in the day.) in the day, then He raiseth you up therein that a pre-fixed term (of life) be fulfilled; then unto Him is your (ultimate) return, then He will declare unto you what ye were doing (Refer to Verse 39:42; 5:117.) . 'Yatawaffakum', i.e., takes you away. This Verse clearly indicates that 'Tawaffa' cannot always mean death. It does not always mean taking away of the soul or the spirit. If the word is…

item.title: Al-An'aam:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ wahuwa l-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihi wayur'silu ʿalaykum ḥafaẓatan ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadakumu l-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunā wahum lā yufarriṭūna He is the All-dominant over His servants, and He sends guards to [protect] you. When death approaches anyone of you, Our messengers take him away and they do not neglect [their duty].

item.title: Al-An'aam:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ wahuwa l-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihi wayur'silu ʿalaykum ḥafaẓatan ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadakumu l-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunā wahum lā yufarriṭūna And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers (i.e., angels of death) take him, and they do not fail (in their duties). See 6:60

item.title: Al-An'aam:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ wahuwa l-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihi wayur'silu ʿalaykum ḥafaẓatan ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadakumu l-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunā wahum lā yufarriṭūna And He is the All-dominant above His subservient ones, and He sendeth over you the guard; until cometh death unto one of you, Our messengers (angels) take (Refer to Verse 5:117.) him away, and they are not remiss (Neglect not - neither exceed nor fall short of the limits.) . In continuation of the previous Verse 6:60, here is asserted the All-Dominating Authority over His creatures, held and sustained by Him, pointing out that the angelical or any other agencies active in the mechanism of the universe are various aspects of His dominance and absolute sovereignty. Thus, whether the activities are attributed to the subordinate agencies…

item.title: Al-An'aam:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ رُدُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ أَلَا لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ الْحَاسِبِينَ thumma ruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi alā lahu l-ḥuk'mu wahuwa asraʿu l-ḥāsibīna Then they are returned to Allah, their real master. Look! All judgement belongs to Him, and He is the swiftest of reckoners.

item.title: Al-An'aam:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ رُدُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ أَلَا لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ الْحَاسِبِينَ thumma ruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi alā lahu l-ḥuk'mu wahuwa asraʿu l-ḥāsibīna Then they (i.e., His servants) are returned to Allah, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants. See 6:60

item.title: Al-An'aam:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ رُدُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ أَلَا لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ الْحَاسِبِينَ thumma ruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi alā lahu l-ḥuk'mu wahuwa asraʿu l-ḥāsibīna Then (Both the guards and the guarded ones.) they are returned unto God, their Maula (In Arabic 'Maula' Master, or Lord, or Guardian - as exactly this same word was used for ''Ali in the place of the Holy Prophet, at 'Ghadir Khumm'. Refer to Verses 5:3; 5:67; 4:65; 33:35; 6:57. All commentators take it as 'Master', 'Authority' unanimously. It means the same as used by the Holy Prophet at 'Ghadir Khumm' - but the antagonists of the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt purposefully interpret it wrongly as friend.) (Master), the (only) Real One; Beware! (Now surely), His (alone) (as the Master) is the Judgment (The Holy Prophet as God's Vicegerent or the Master on the earth holds…

item.title: Al-An'aam:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَئِنْ أَنْجَانَا مِنْ هَذِهِ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ qul man yunajjīkum min ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri tadʿūnahu taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan la-in anjānā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna Say, 'Who delivers you from the darkness of land and sea, [when] You invoke Him suppliantly and secretly: "If He delivers us from this, we will surely be among the grateful"?'

item.title: Al-An'aam:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَئِنْ أَنْجَانَا مِنْ هَذِهِ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ qul man yunajjīkum min ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri tadʿūnahu taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan la-in anjānā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea (when) you call upon Him imploring (aloud) and privately, 'If He should save us from this (crisis), we will surely be among the thankful.'" Say: "Who rescues you from the dark recesses of the land and the sea, when you call upon Him begging and in secret (saying): 'If He (Allah) only saves us from these (dangers), we shall truly be grateful (6:63). Say: "Allah rescues you from these (dangers) and from all distress, and yet you commit Shirk (6:64). Say: "He has the power to send torment on you from above or from…

item.title: Al-An'aam:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَئِنْ أَنْجَانَا مِنْ هَذِهِ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ qul man yunajjīkum min ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri tadʿūnahu taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan la-in anjānā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna Say thou: "Who delivereth you from the (dread of the) darkness (In Arabic 'Adh-Dhulumaat' i.e. Darkness, difficulties, dangers and risks.) of the land and the sea, (when) ye pray to Him (openly) humiliating yourselves, and secretly (saying)"; "If He delivereth us from this, certainly we shall he of the grateful ones." See 6:62

item.title: Al-An'aam:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ quli l-lahu yunajjīkum min'hā wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tush'rikūna Say, 'It is Allah who delivers you from them and from every agony, [but] then you ascribe partners [to Him].'

item.title: Al-An'aam:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ quli l-lahu yunajjīkum min'hā wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tush'rikūna Say, "It is Allah who saves you from it and from every distress; then you (still) associate others with Him." See 6:63

item.title: Al-An'aam:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ quli l-lahu yunajjīkum min'hā wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tush'rikūna Say Thou: "God delivereth you from them, and from every distress, yet again ye associate (others) with Him." See 6:62

item.title: Al-An'aam:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى أَنْ يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُمْ بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ qul huwa l-qādiru ʿalā an yabʿatha ʿalaykum ʿadhāban min fawqikum aw min taḥti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiyaʿan wayudhīqa baʿḍakum basa baʿḍin unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti laʿallahum yafqahūna Say, 'He is able to send upon you a punishment from above you or from under your feet, or confound you as [hostile] factions, and make you taste one another's violence.' Look, how We paraphrase the signs variously so that they may understand!

item.title: Al-An'aam:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى أَنْ يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُمْ بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ qul huwa l-qādiru ʿalā an yabʿatha ʿalaykum ʿadhāban min fawqikum aw min taḥti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiyaʿan wayudhīqa baʿḍakum basa baʿḍin unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti laʿallahum yafqahūna Say, "He is the (one) Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you (so you become) sects1 and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand. See 6:63

item.title: Al-An'aam:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى أَنْ يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُمْ بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ qul huwa l-qādiru ʿalā an yabʿatha ʿalaykum ʿadhāban min fawqikum aw min taḥti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiyaʿan wayudhīqa baʿḍakum basa baʿḍin unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti laʿallahum yafqahūna Say thou: "He hath power that He may send on you a chastisement (Refers to wars and earthquakes, floods & the pestilences like the epidemics - political quarrels - Famines - and the other similar calamities.) from above you or from under your feet or He should involve you in confusion (in) party (dissensions) and make some of you taste the fighting of others;" Behold! how repeatedly do We display (The Variety of the Signs.) the signs, that they may understand (Refer to Verse 29:55.) .…

item.title: Al-An'aam:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ قُلْ لَسْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ wakadhaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa l-ḥaqu qul lastu ʿalaykum biwakīlin Your people have denied it, though it is the truth. Say, 'It is not my business to watch over you.'

item.title: Al-An'aam:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ قُلْ لَسْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ wakadhaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa l-ḥaqu qul lastu ʿalaykum biwakīlin But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager (i.e., authority)." But your people have denied it (the Qur'an) though it is the truth. Say: I am not responsible for your affairs (6:66). For every news there is a reality and you will come to know (6:67). And when you see those who engage in false conversation about Our verses (of the Qur'an) by mocking at them, stay away from them till they turn to another topic. And if Shaytan causes you to forget, then after the remembrance, sit not you in the company of those people who are the wrongdoers (6:68). There is no responsibility for them upon those who have…

item.title: Al-An'aam:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ قُلْ لَسْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ wakadhaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa l-ḥaqu qul lastu ʿalaykum biwakīlin And belied it thy people and it is the very truth. Say: (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "I am not a guard upon you." See 6:62

item.title: Al-An'aam:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ likulli naba-in mus'taqarrun wasawfa taʿlamūna For every prophecy there is a [preordained] setting, and soon you will know.

item.title: Al-An'aam:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ likulli naba-in mus'taqarrun wasawfa taʿlamūna For every news (i.e., happening) is a finality;1 and you are going to know. See 6:66

item.title: Al-An'aam:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ likulli naba-in mus'taqarrun wasawfa taʿlamūna For every prophecy (Every prophecy referred to here or elsewhere in the Qur'an shall happen at its fixed time. Mankind shall know it here and hereafter. Refer to Verse 78:2.) is (prefixed) time, And soon shall ye know it. See 6:62

item.title: Al-An'aam:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی يَخُوضُوْۤا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ وَإِمَّا يُنْسِيَنَّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ الذِّكْرٰی مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idhā ra-ayta alladhīna yakhūḍūna fī āyātinā fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum ḥattā yakhūḍū fī ḥadīthin ghayrihi wa-immā yunsiyannaka l-shayṭānu falā taqʿud baʿda l-dhik'rā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna When you see those who gossip impiously about Our signs, avoid them until they engage in some other discourse; but if Satan makes you forget, then, after remembering, do not sit with the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: Al-An'aam:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی يَخُوضُوْۤا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ وَإِمَّا يُنْسِيَنَّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ الذِّكْرٰی مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idhā ra-ayta alladhīna yakhūḍūna fī āyātinā fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum ḥattā yakhūḍū fī ḥadīthin ghayrihi wa-immā yunsiyannaka l-shayṭānu falā taqʿud baʿda l-dhik'rā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when you see those who engage in (offensive) discourse1 concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people. See 6:66

item.title: Al-An'aam:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی يَخُوضُوْۤا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ وَإِمَّا يُنْسِيَنَّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ الذِّكْرٰی مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idhā ra-ayta alladhīna yakhūḍūna fī āyātinā fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum ḥattā yakhūḍū fī ḥadīthin ghayrihi wa-immā yunsiyannaka l-shayṭānu falā taqʿud baʿda l-dhik'rā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when thou seest those cavilling (Occupying themselves arguing with false arguments maliciously.) about Our signs, get thee away from them until they enter into (some) other discourse; And if the devil causeth thee to forget (this), then sit not after recollection, with the unjust people (Refer to Verses 4:140; 6:68; 6:70.) . Though the address is to the Holy Prophet, but the followers are meant as is asserted by Qur'an that no devilish power has ever influence over the true servants of God, of whom His apostles as His Vicegerents on earth are…

item.title: Al-An'aam:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَلَكِنْ ذِكْرٰی لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wamā ʿalā alladhīna yattaqūna min ḥisābihim min shayin walākin dhik'rā laʿallahum yattaqūna Those who are Godwary are in no way accountable for them,1 but this is merely for admonition's sake, so that they may beware.2

item.title: Al-An'aam:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَلَكِنْ ذِكْرٰی لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wamā ʿalā alladhīna yattaqūna min ḥisābihim min shayin walākin dhik'rā laʿallahum yattaqūna And those who fear Allah are not held accountable for them (i.e., the disbelievers) at all, but (only for) a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him. See 6:66

item.title: Al-An'aam:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَلَكِنْ ذِكْرٰی لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wamā ʿalā alladhīna yattaqūna min ḥisābihim min shayin walākin dhik'rā laʿallahum yattaqūna And nothing of the reckoning of their (People involved in malicious discourses - the pious ones not accountable for the malicious talk of the people. Refer to Verse 6:63.) (deed) shall be upon those who guard (The pious ones.) (themselves against evil), but only to remind, so that they may guard (themselves against evil). See 6:68

item.title: Al-An'aam:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَذَكِّرْ بِهِ أَنْ تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِنْ تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوْۤا بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ wadhari alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnahum laʿiban walahwan wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā wadhakkir bihi an tub'sala nafsun bimā kasabat laysa lahā min dūni l-lahi waliyyun walā shafīʿun wa-in taʿdil kulla ʿadlin lā yu'khadh min'hā ulāika alladhīna ub'silū bimā kasabū lahum sharābun min ḥamīmin waʿadhābun alīmun bimā kānū yakfurūna Leave alone those who take their religion for play and diversion and whom the life of this world has deceived, and admonish with it, lest any soul should perish because of what it has earned: It shall not have any guardian besides Allah, nor any intercessor; and though it should…

item.title: Al-An'aam:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَذَكِّرْ بِهِ أَنْ تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِنْ تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوْۤا بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ wadhari alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnahum laʿiban walahwan wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā wadhakkir bihi an tub'sala nafsun bimā kasabat laysa lahā min dūni l-lahi waliyyun walā shafīʿun wa-in taʿdil kulla ʿadlin lā yu'khadh min'hā ulāika alladhīna ub'silū bimā kasabū lahum sharābun min ḥamīmin waʿadhābun alīmun bimā kānū yakfurūna And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with it (i.e., the Qur’ān), lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allah no protector and no intercessor. And if…

item.title: Al-An'aam:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
