item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَالِحِينَ wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba nāfilatan wakullan jaʿalnā ṣāliḥīna And We gave him (To Abraham.) Isaac, and Jacob, as a further gift, and made We all of them righteous ones. See 21:70

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَإِقَامَ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءَ الزَّكَوةِ وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا عَابِدِينَ wajaʿalnāhum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā wa-awḥaynā ilayhim fiʿ'la l-khayrāti wa-iqāma l-ṣalati waītāa l-zakati wakānū lanā ʿābidīna We made them _imam_s, guiding by Our command, and We revealed to them the performance of good deeds, the maintenance of prayers, and the giving of zakāt, and they used to worship Us.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَإِقَامَ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءَ الزَّكَوةِ وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا عَابِدِينَ wajaʿalnāhum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā wa-awḥaynā ilayhim fiʿ'la l-khayrāti wa-iqāma l-ṣalati waītāa l-zakati wakānū lanā ʿābidīna And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us. See 21:71

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَإِقَامَ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءَ الزَّكَوةِ وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا عَابِدِينَ wajaʿalnāhum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā wa-awḥaynā ilayhim fiʿ'la l-khayrāti wa-iqāma l-ṣalati waītāa l-zakati wakānū lanā ʿābidīna And We made them (Imams.) leaders, guiding (the people) by Our command, and revealed We unto them the doing of good, and the establishing of prayer, and the giving of alms, and (only) unto Us did they worship, See 21:70

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ الْخَبَائِثَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَاسِقِينَ walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wanajjaynāhu mina l-qaryati allatī kānat taʿmalu l-khabāitha innahum kānū qawma sawin fāsiqīna We gave judgement and knowledge to Lot, and We delivered him from the town which used to commit vicious acts. Indeed they were an evil and profligate lot.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ الْخَبَائِثَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَاسِقِينَ walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wanajjaynāhu mina l-qaryati allatī kānat taʿmalu l-khabāitha innahum kānū qawma sawin fāsiqīna And to Lut We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient. See 21:71

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ الْخَبَائِثَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَاسِقِينَ walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wanajjaynāhu mina l-qaryati allatī kānat taʿmalu l-khabāitha innahum kānū qawma sawin fāsiqīna And Lot, We gave him wisdom, the knowledge; and We delivered him from the town which were doing filthiness; for they were people evil, perverse, See 21:70

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā innahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed he was one of the righteous.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā innahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous. See 21:71

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā innahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We admitted him into Our mercy; verily he was of the righteous ones. See 21:70

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَى مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fa-is'tajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi And before that Noah, when he called out, We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great agony.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَى مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fa-is'tajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi And (mention) Nuh, when he called (to Allah)1 before (that time), so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction (i.e., the flood). And (remember) Nuh, when he cried (to Us) aforetime. We answered to his invocation and saved him and his family from the great distress (21:76). We helped him against the people who denied Our Ayat. Verily, they were a people given to evil. So We drowned them all (21:77). Nuh and His People Allah tells us how He responded to His servant and Messenger Nuh (AS), when he prayed to Him against his people for their disbelief in him: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ Then he invoked…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَى مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fa-is'tajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi And (remember) Noah, when he cried aforetime, then We responded unto him and delivered him and his companions from the great calamity. See 21:70

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَصَرْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ wanaṣarnāhu mina l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawma sawin fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna And We helped him against the people who denied Our signs. They were indeed an evil lot; so We drowned them all.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَصَرْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ wanaṣarnāhu mina l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawma sawin fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna And We aided (i.e., saved) him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together. See 21:76

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَصَرْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ wanaṣarnāhu mina l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawma sawin fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna And We helped him against his people who belied Our signs; verily they were an evil people, so We drowned them all. See 21:70

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِي الْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِیْهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَاهِدِينَ wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fī l-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamu l-qawmi wakunnā liḥuk'mihim shāhidīna And David and Solomon when they gave judgement concerning the tillage when the sheep of some people strayed into it by night, and We were witness to their judgement.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِي الْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِیْهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَاهِدِينَ wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fī l-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamu l-qawmi wakunnā liḥuk'mihim shāhidīna And (mention) Dawud and Sulayman, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it (at night),1 and We were witness to their judgement. And (remember) Dawud and Sulayman, when they gave judgement in the case of the field in which the sheep of certain people had Nafashat; and We were witness to their judgement (21:78). And We made Sulayman to understand (the case); and to each of them We gave wisdom (Hukm) and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains and the birds to glorify Our praises along with Dawud. And it was We Who were the doer (of all these things) (21:79). And We taught him…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِي الْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِیْهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَاهِدِينَ wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fī l-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamu l-qawmi wakunnā liḥuk'mihim shāhidīna And David and Solomon when they were judging about the corn-field when the sheep of the people pastured in it by night, and We unto their judgment were among the witnesses, (We were witnessing.) Two men quarrelled and approached the holy Apostle David for judgment; one was Elia the cultivator and the other was Yohanna (John) the herdsman. Elia complained that John, his neighbour, had grazed his sheep in his cornfield or the vineyard in the night and the sheep had eaten away the plants causing him a great loss. David asked John, and John submitted that it happened when he was asleep, and he confessed himself to be guilty. The estimate…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا سُلَيْمَانَ وَكُلًّا اٰتَیْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُدَ الْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَ وَكُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna wakullan ātaynā ḥuk'man waʿil'man wasakharnā maʿa dāwūda l-jibāla yusabbiḥ'na wal-ṭayra wakunnā fāʿilīna We gave its understanding to Solomon, and to each We gave judgement and knowledge. And We disposed the mountains and the birds to glorify [Us] with David, and We have been the doer [of such things].

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا سُلَيْمَانَ وَكُلًّا اٰتَیْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُدَ الْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَ وَكُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna wakullan ātaynā ḥuk'man waʿil'man wasakharnā maʿa dāwūda l-jibāla yusabbiḥ'na wal-ṭayra wakunnā fāʿilīna And We gave understanding of it (i.e., the case) to Sulayman, and to each (of them) We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt (Us), along with Dawud and (also) the birds. And We were doing (that).1 See 21:78

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا سُلَيْمَانَ وَكُلًّا اٰتَیْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُدَ الْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَ وَكُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna wakullan ātaynā ḥuk'man waʿil'man wasakharnā maʿa dāwūda l-jibāla yusabbiḥ'na wal-ṭayra wakunnā fāʿilīna Then We made Solomon to understand it; and unto each one gave We wisdom and knowledge, and We made subservient with (Subservient to David.) David the mountains and the birds; to sing hymns of (Our praise) And We were the doers. This verse refers to the revelation which Solomon got about the better judgment he suggested in the case, for the apostles of God neither speak nor act but according to the revelation they receive from the Lord; but what David had decreed was also the revelation which was given before to David which was only superseded by the one now given to Solomon. Both the apostles had acted only upon the…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ مِنْ بَأْسِكُمْ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ شَاكِرُونَ waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsin lakum lituḥ'ṣinakum min basikum fahal antum shākirūna We taught him the making of coats of mail for you, to protect you from your [own] violence. Will you then be grateful?

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ مِنْ بَأْسِكُمْ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ شَاكِرُونَ waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsin lakum lituḥ'ṣinakum min basikum fahal antum shākirūna And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your (enemy in) battle. So will you then be grateful? See 21:78

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ مِنْ بَأْسِكُمْ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ شَاكِرُونَ waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsin lakum lituḥ'ṣinakum min basikum fahal antum shākirūna And We taught him (David.) the art of making the coat of mail for you that ye might protect yourselves in your wars; Will ye then be grateful? As a return for the piety and the righteousness of David iron was made soft like wax, in his hand. David did not take from the public treasury, anything for his sustenance. He used to make articles like the weapons of defence by moulding iron with his hands and David was taught by God to make coats of mail for his men.1 The teaching of the art of making the means of protection and not the means of destruction such as sword. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَالِمِينَ walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī bi-amrihi ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā wakunnā bikulli shayin ʿālimīna And for Solomon [We disposed] the tempestuous wind which blew by his command toward the land which We have blessed, and We have knowledge of all things.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَالِمِينَ walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī bi-amrihi ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā wakunnā bikulli shayin ʿālimīna And to Sulayman (We subjected) the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. See 21:78

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَالِمِينَ walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī bi-amrihi ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā wakunnā bikulli shayin ʿālimīna And unto Solomon (We subjected) the wind blowing violent, blowing at his command unto the land wherein We had blessed; And We are, of all things the Knowers. Solomon was endowed with an authority over the winds which carried his throne to distant lands in the shortest time. There is no reason to wonder if the forces of nature are made by God to serve His chosen servants as and when they need in their services. Those who believed in the Omnipotence of God can by no means doubt anything done by God's Will, and to those who know only of nature and do not know the absolute powers of the Omnipotent…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَنْ يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَافِظِينَ wamina l-shayāṭīni man yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīna Among the devils were some who dived for him and performed tasks other than that, and We were watchful over them.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَنْ يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَافِظِينَ wamina l-shayāṭīni man yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīna And of the devils (i.e., jinn) were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.1 See 21:78

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَنْ يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَافِظِينَ wamina l-shayāṭīni man yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīna And of the satans there were those who used to dive for him and to do other work besides that; and We were guardians over them, Solomon was given to rule over the devilish forces of evil and tame the supernatural beings to serve him in the cause of righteousness.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ wa-ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-ḍuru wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna And Job, when he called out to his Lord, 'Indeed distress has befallen me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ wa-ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-ḍuru wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna And (mention) Ayyub, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful." And (remember) Ayyub, when he cried to his Lord: Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy (21:83). So We answered his call, and We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his family to him, and the like thereof along with them as a mercy from Ourselves and a Reminder for all those who worship Us (21:84). The Prophet Ayyub Allah tells us about Ayyub, and the trials that struck him, affecting his wealth, children and physical health. He had plenty of livestock, cattle…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ wa-ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-ḍuru wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna And (Remember) Job (Ayyub), when he cried unto his Lord (saying); "Verily hath touched me distress, and Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful ones!" The Holy Prophet is reminded of the apostle Ayyub, i.e., Job's life. Job used most of his time in prayer and meditation. Job's patience has passed into a proverb. Job's mother is said to be a descendant of the apostle Lot, and his father was in the line from Ishmael and he was endowed with enormous wealth. He was tested with the loss of all his wealth, his children and his health to a very miserable extent and yet Ayyub did not falter in his patience and his prayers to the Lord. Job was…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَذِكْرٰی لِلْعَابِدِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurrin waātaynāhu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan min ʿindinā wadhik'rā lil'ʿābidīna So We answered his prayer and removed his distress, and We gave him [back] his family along with others like them, as a mercy from Us, and an admonition for the devout.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَذِكْرٰی لِلْعَابِدِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurrin waātaynāhu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan min ʿindinā wadhik'rā lil'ʿābidīna So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him (back) his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers (of Allah). See 21:83

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَذِكْرٰی لِلْعَابِدِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurrin waātaynāhu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan min ʿindinā wadhik'rā lil'ʿābidīna So We responded unto him and We removed what he was distressed with, and We gave him and his family and the like of them with them, a mercy from unto Us, and a reminder unto the worshippers (of Ours). Job was at last relieved of all the miseries that were inflicted on him which was only a test.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ wa-is'māʿīla wa-id'rīsa wadhā l-kif'li kullun mina l-ṣābirīna And Ishmael, Idris, and Dhul-Kifl —each of them was among the patient.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ wa-is'māʿīla wa-id'rīsa wadhā l-kif'li kullun mina l-ṣābirīna And (mention) Ismail and Idrees and Dhul-Kifli; all were of the patient. And (remember) Ismail, Idris and Dhul-Kifli: All were from among the patient (21:85). And We admitted them to Our mercy. Verily, they were of the righteous (21:86). Ismail, Idris and Dhul-Kifli Ismail was the son of Ibrahim Al-Khalil (AS). He has already been mentioned in Surah Maryam, where mention was also made of Idris. From the context and the fact that Dhul-Kifli is mentioned alongside Prophets, it appears that he was also a Prophet. Others say that he was a righteous man, a just king and a fair judge. Ibn Jarir refrained from making any decisive comment. And Allah knows best.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ wa-is'māʿīla wa-id'rīsa wadhā l-kif'li kullun mina l-ṣābirīna And (remember) Ishmael and Idris and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient ones. For Idris - See 19:56 and for Dhu 'l-Kifl literary meaning, the possessor of Double Requital. He is also known for his patience.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā innahum mina l-ṣāliḥīna We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed they were among the righteous.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā innahum mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. See 21:85

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā innahum mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We admitted them into Our Mercy; Verily they were of the righteous. See 21:85

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَى فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّیْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ wadhā l-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna an lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fī l-ẓulumāti an lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina l-ẓālimīna And the Man of the Fish, when he left in a rage, thinking that We would not put him to hardship. Then he cried out in the darkness, 'There is no god except You! You are immaculate! I have indeed been among the wrongdoers!'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَى فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّیْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ wadhā l-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna an lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fī l-ẓulumāti an lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina l-ẓālimīna And (mention) the man of the fish (i.e., Yunus), when he went off in anger1 and thought that We would not decree (anything) upon him.2 And he called out within the darknesses,3 "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers." And (remember) Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger, and imagined that We shall not punish him! But he cried through the darknesses (Zulumat) (saying): There is no God but You, Glorified be You! Truly, I have been of the Zalimin wrongdoers (21:87). So We answered…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَى فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّیْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ wadhā l-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna an lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fī l-ẓulumāti an lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina l-ẓālimīna And (remember) Yunus i.e. Zunnun when went he in anger, (Refer to verse 37:139 for the people not responding.) and imagined he that never would We (Put him into hardship.) straiten him; Then he cried out from the darkness: "There is no god but "Thou (O' my Lord!), Glory be to Thee, verily I was of (Belonged to.) the unjust ones!" The statement that Jonah was wrath with God is a blasphemy for it is far from any apostle of God at any time to disagree with the Will of the Lord.1 When he…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina l-ghami wakadhālika nunjī l-mu'minīna So We answered his prayer and delivered him from the agony; and thus do We deliver the faithful.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina l-ghami wakadhālika nunjī l-mu'minīna So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers. See 21:87

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina l-ghami wakadhālika nunjī l-mu'minīna Then responded We unto him and delivered him from the grief, thus do We deliver the believers. See 21:87

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزَكَرِيَّا إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa-anta khayru l-wārithīna And Zechariah, when he cried out to his Lord, 'My Lord! Do not leave me without an heir, and You are the best of inheritors.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزَكَرِيَّا إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa-anta khayru l-wārithīna And (mention) Zakariyya, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone (with no heir), while You are the best of inheritors." And (remember) Zakariyya, when he cried to his Lord: O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors (21:89). So We answered his call, and We bestowed upon him Yahya, and cured his wife for him. Verily, they used to hasten on to do good deeds, and they used to call on Us with hope and fear, and they were Khashi'in before Us (21:90). Zakariyya and Yahya Allah tells us of His servant Zakariyya, who asked Allah to grant him a son who would be…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزَكَرِيَّا إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa-anta khayru l-wārithīna And (remember) Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: "O' my Lord! Leave me not alone (without an issue) though Thou art the Best of heirs!" See verse 19:5. 'Khayr al-Warithin', i.e., The Best Inheritors, i.e., the one who would remain even after every one else is perished - The Everlasting One.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَى وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا خَاشِعِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghaban warahaban wakānū lanā khāshiʿīna So We answered his prayer, and gave him John, and remedied his wife['s infertility] for him. Indeed they were active in [performing] good works, and they would supplicate Us with eagerness and awe and were humble before Us.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَى وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا خَاشِعِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghaban warahaban wakānū lanā khāshiʿīna So We responded to him, and We gave to him Yahya, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate1 Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive. See 21:89

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَى وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا خَاشِعِينَ fa-is'tajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghaban warahaban wakānū lanā khāshiʿīna Then responded We unto him and gifted unto him John (Yahya), and adjusted (Cured.) his wife (of her barrenness) for him; verily, they did vie in goodness and did call unto Us, with love and reverence, and were unto Us humbled The wife of Zachariah who was proved barren her whole life and had crossed the age of bearing a child, who herself thought it impossible for her at any time in the future to be a mother1 was made fit to bear John the Baptist.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا اٰیَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wa-allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā min rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wa-ib'nahā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna And her who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her Our spirit,1 and made her and her son a sign for all the nations.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا اٰیَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wa-allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā min rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wa-ib'nahā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna And (mention) the one who guarded her chastity (i.e., Maryam), so We blew into her (garment) through Our angel (i.e., Jibril), and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds. And she who guarded her chastity, We breathed into her through Our Ruh, and We made her and her son a sign for nations (21:91). Isa and Maryam the True Believer Here Allah mentions the story of Maryam and her son Isa, just after mentioning Zakariyya and his son Yahya (AS). He mentions the story of Zakariyya first, followed by the story of Maryam because the one is connected to the other. The former is the story of a child being born to an old…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا اٰیَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wa-allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā min rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wa-ib'nahā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna And (O' Our Apostle Muhammad! remember) her (Mary) who guarded her chastity We breathed into her Our Spirit, and We made her and her son a sign unto all peoples. The reference is to Virgin Mary being made to bear Jesus, without any male partner in the parentage.1

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūni Indeed this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord. So worship Me.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūni Indeed this, your religion, is one religion,1 and I am your Lord, so worship Me. Truly, this, your Ummah is one, and I am your Lord, therefore worship Me (21:92). But they have broken up and differed in their religion among themselves. (And) they all shall return to Us (21:93). So whoever does righteous good deeds while he is a believer, his efforts will not be rejected. Verily, We record it for him (in his Book of deeds) (21:94). Mankind is One Ummah إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً Truly, this, your Ummah is one, Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, Sa'id bin Jubayr, Qatadah and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Zayd bin Aslam said, "Your religion is one religion." Al-Hasan Al-Basri said: "In this Ayah, Allah explains to them what…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūni Verily, this (Islam) is your group, one group (Single one.) and I am your Lord! therefore worship ye Me (alone)! 'Ummah' stands for nation, community, religion, brotherhood and also religion, here to mean that Islam revealed through the Holy Prophet was one Universal Religion demanding faith in the Perfect Unity of God. 'Ummah' has been interpreted by some commentators as 'Religion' which is only figurative with no clear evidence to support it. The proper meaning of the word, i.e., 'Group' is the appropriate meaning. This is your group - i.e., the group for the faithful to follow - The group distinguished with the unity of purpose and ideology as the group of the apostles mentioned afore. There is full justification for interpreting 'Ummah' here…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَاجِعُونَ wataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynā rājiʿūna They1 have fragmented their religion among themselves. Everyone of them will return to Us.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَاجِعُونَ wataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynā rājiʿūna And (yet) they divided their affair (i.e., that of their religion) among themselves,1 (but) all to Us will return. See 21:92

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَاجِعُونَ wataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynā rājiʿūna But they have rent asunder (this) their concern among them selves (into sects), (and yet) unto Us shall all of them return. The people later started their own divisions and got themselves divided into several sects and sub-sects. However much they might follow the different ways in thought and deeds, all of them are marching towards one and the same destination, i.e., their return to their Lord.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ وَإِنَّا لَهُ كَاتِبُونَ faman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā kuf'rāna lisaʿyihi wa-innā lahu kātibūna Whoever does righteous deeds, should he be faithful, his endeavour shall not go unappreciated, and We will indeed write it for him.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ وَإِنَّا لَهُ كَاتِبُونَ faman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā kuf'rāna lisaʿyihi wa-innā lahu kātibūna So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort,1 and indeed We (i.e., Our angels), of it, are recorders. See 21:92

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ وَإِنَّا لَهُ كَاتِبُونَ faman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā kuf'rāna lisaʿyihi wa-innā lahu kātibūna So whosoever shall do of good deeds and he be a believer, there shall not be any rejection (Denial.) of his endeavour, and verily, We will write it down for him. Mere righteousness without the correct faith in God, is of no value for the prerequisite for the acceptance of the good deeds of any one is the correct faith in God with which no virtue of anyone will go unrewarded. Every deed committed by man is then and there recorded.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَرَامٌ عَلَى قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryatin ahlaknāhā annahum lā yarjiʿūna It is forbidden for [the people of] any town that We have destroyed [to return to the world]: they shall not return.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَرَامٌ عَلَى قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryatin ahlaknāhā annahum lā yarjiʿūna And it is prohibited to (the people of) a city which We have destroyed that they will (ever) return.1 And a ban is laid on every town which We have destroyed that they shall not return (21:95). Until, when Ya'juj and Ma'juj (Gog and Magog people) are let loose, and they swoop down from every Hadab (21:96). And the true promise shall draw near. Then, you shall see the eyes of the disbelievers fixedly staring in horror. (They will say:) Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this – nay, but we were wrongdoers (21:97). Those who have been destroyed, will never return to this World. وَحَرَامٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ And a ban is laid on every town Ibn 'Abbas said, "it is enforced", i.e., it…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَرَامٌ عَلَى قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryatin ahlaknāhā annahum lā yarjiʿūna And is forbidden (Binding.) unto (the people of) the towns which We did destroy that they shall not return. It is forbidden for the people of the town which has been destroyed by the wrath of God to return to this life again with any more chance of amending their faith and deeds. It means that the people of those places which were not destroyed by any wrath from God will have a return, and this is the doctrine of 'Raj'ah' when the Last Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn al-Hasan al-Mahdi would reappear. (MS and UB)1 give a long and detailed statement explaining what is actually meant by this verse and the question of 'Raj'ah', i.e., the return of the dead to this world before the final…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ ḥattā idhā futiḥat yajūju wamajūju wahum min kulli ḥadabin yansilūna When Gog and Magog are let loose, and they race down from every slope,1

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ ḥattā idhā futiḥat yajūju wamajūju wahum min kulli ḥadabin yansilūna Until when (the dam of) Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend. See 21:95

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ ḥattā idhā futiḥat yajūju wamajūju wahum min kulli ḥadabin yansilūna Until are let loose the Gog and the Magog and they shall from every elevation hasten forth. See verse 18:94. Among the prognostic signs of the approach of the Day of Judgment, will be that Dajjal, the Antichrist, the Imposter, will appear and then the barrier withholding Gog and Magog will be broken and they would be freed to roam playing havoc all-round the earth following the coming out of the Monstrous Beast called 'Dabbat al-Arḍ'. Then will appear the Last Imam Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Mahdi - who will rule for a long time, when Jesus also will return to earth. The Holy Prophet said that: "If there be left even a single day for the end of the world…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ أَبْصَارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ wa-iq'taraba l-waʿdu l-ḥaqu fa-idhā hiya shākhiṣatun abṣāru alladhīna kafarū yāwaylanā qad kunnā fī ghaflatin min hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīna and the true promise draws near [to its fulfillment], behold, the faithless will look on with a fixed gaze: 'Woe to us! We have certainly been oblivious of this! Rather we have been wrongdoers!'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ أَبْصَارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ wa-iq'taraba l-waʿdu l-ḥaqu fa-idhā hiya shākhiṣatun abṣāru alladhīna kafarū yāwaylanā qad kunnā fī ghaflatin min hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīna And (when) the true promise (i.e., the resurrection) has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring (in horror, while they say), "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers." See 21:95

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ أَبْصَارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ wa-iq'taraba l-waʿdu l-ḥaqu fa-idhā hiya shākhiṣatun abṣāru alladhīna kafarū yāwaylanā qad kunnā fī ghaflatin min hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīna And the true promise shall draw nigh, then lo! stare amazedly, the eyes of those who disbelieve; (and they shall say): "Woe unto us! Indeed were we in heedlessness as to this; Nay! we were unjust ones." This refers to what the disbelievers would repent and say, having seen the wrath of God ready to overtake them. The signs of total resurrection given in Qur'an do not necessarily mean that after the appearance of the signs the Resurrection Day will follow immediately. The timing of the events in relation to the ultimate resurrection is beyond the human grasp. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنْتُمْ لَهَا وَارِدُونَ innakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi ḥaṣabu jahannama antum lahā wāridūna Indeed you and what you worship besides Allah shall be fuel for hell, and you will come to it

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنْتُمْ لَهَا وَارِدُونَ innakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi ḥaṣabu jahannama antum lahā wāridūna Indeed, you (disbelievers) and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to (enter) it. Certainly you and that which you are worshipping now besides Allah, are (but) fuel (Hasab) for Hell! (Surely) you will enter it (21:98). Had these been gods, they would not have entered there (Hell), and all of them will abide therein forever (21:99). Therein they will be breathing out with deep sighs and roaring and therein they will hear not (21:100). Verily, those for whom the good has preceded from Us, they will be removed far therefrom (Hell) (21:101). They shall not hear the slightest sound of it (Hell), while they abide in that which their…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنْتُمْ لَهَا وَارِدُونَ innakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi ḥaṣabu jahannama antum lahā wāridūna Verily, ye and what ye worship beside God, shall be the fuel for hell; unto ye shall arrive. (To go therein.) One day while talking to the Holy Prophet about their 360 idol-gods, the chieftains of the idolatrous Quraysh who were totally defeated, and inspite of their helplessness out of their adamance and arrogance said "O' Muhammad! We are firm in following our ancestors in their belief, (i.e., idolatry) and we shall remain steadfast to it and never change our thoughts and the ways of life." Nasr bin Harith who was one among the people began to quarrel with the Holy Prophet. Then the Holy Prophet read out this verse which was revealed to him. The infidels fired…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ كَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ آلِهَةً مَا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ law kāna hāulāi ālihatan mā waradūhā wakullun fīhā khālidūna —had they been gods, they would not have come to it— and they will all remain in it [forever].

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ كَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ آلِهَةً مَا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ law kāna hāulāi ālihatan mā waradūhā wakullun fīhā khālidūna Had these (false deities) been (actual) gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein. See 21:98

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ كَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ آلِهَةً مَا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ law kāna hāulāi ālihatan mā waradūhā wakullun fīhā khālidūna Were these been gods they would not have come unto it and all shall abide therein. See 21:98

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ lahum fīhā zafīrun wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūna Their lot therein will be groaning, and they will not hear anything in it.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ lahum fīhā zafīrun wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūna For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear. See 21:98

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ lahum fīhā zafīrun wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūna For them therein shall be groaning, and they therein shall not hear (any other sound) See 21:98

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِنَّا الْحُسْنَى اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ inna alladhīna sabaqat lahum minnā l-ḥus'nā ulāika ʿanhā mub'ʿadūna Indeed those to whom there has gone beforehand [the promise of] the best reward from Us will be kept away from it.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِنَّا الْحُسْنَى اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ inna alladhīna sabaqat lahum minnā l-ḥus'nā ulāika ʿanhā mub'ʿadūna Indeed, those for whom the best (reward) has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed. See 21:98

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِنَّا الْحُسْنَى اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ inna alladhīna sabaqat lahum minnā l-ḥus'nā ulāika ʿanhā mub'ʿadūna Verily those for whom hath went forth (Those the first and the foremost to receive the blessings.) from Us goodness, those from it (Hell) shall be kept away, This was revealed in reply to the question about Jesus, Uzair, Jesus and the angels in the previous verse - saying that these including the others like them are those about whom the grace of the Lord has already been promised and they will be in Paradise so far away from the Hell-fire that they would not even hear any faintest sound from it. They shall have everything they desire for, and that will be what was promised to them in their life on earth. Abu Sayeed Khudri relates that the Holy Prophet said…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِي مَا اشْتَهَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ خَالِدُونَ lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā wahum fī mā ish'tahat anfusuhum khālidūna They will not hear even its faint sound and they will remain [forever] in what their souls desire.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِي مَا اشْتَهَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ خَالِدُونَ lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā wahum fī mā ish'tahat anfusuhum khālidūna They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally. See 21:98

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِي مَا اشْتَهَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ خَالِدُونَ lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā wahum fī mā ish'tahat anfusuhum khālidūna They will hear not (even) the slightest sound of it (Hell), and they in what their souls desire, shall abide. See 21:101

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ هَذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ lā yaḥzunuhumu l-fazaʿu l-akbaru watatalaqqāhumu l-malāikatu hādhā yawmukumu alladhī kuntum tūʿadūna The Great Terror will not upset them, and the angels will receive them [saying]: 'This is your day which you were promised.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ هَذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ lā yaḥzunuhumu l-fazaʿu l-akbaru watatalaqqāhumu l-malāikatu hādhā yawmukumu alladhī kuntum tūʿadūna They will not be grieved by the greatest terror,1 and the angels will meet them, (saying), "This is your Day which you have been promised". See 21:98

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ هَذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ lā yaḥzunuhumu l-fazaʿu l-akbaru watatalaqqāhumu l-malāikatu hādhā yawmukumu alladhī kuntum tūʿadūna Shall grieve them not the great terror and the angels shall meet them (saying): "This is your Day, which ye were promised" See 21:101

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ yawma naṭwī l-samāa kaṭayyi l-sijili lil'kutubi kamā badanā awwala khalqin nuʿīduhu waʿdan ʿalaynā innā kunnā fāʿilīna The day We shall roll up the sky, like the rolling of the scrolls for writings. We will bring it back as We began the first creation —a promise [binding] on Us. [That] indeed We will do.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ yawma naṭwī l-samāa kaṭayyi l-sijili lil'kutubi kamā badanā awwala khalqin nuʿīduhu waʿdan ʿalaynā innā kunnā fāʿilīna The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a (written) sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. (That is) a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.1 And (remember) the Day when We shall roll up the heaven like a Sijill for books. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise binding upon Us. Truly, We shall do it (21:104). The Heavens will be Rolled up on the Day of Resurrection Allah says: this will happen on the Day of Resurrection: يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ And (remember)…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ yawma naṭwī l-samāa kaṭayyi l-sijili lil'kutubi kamā badanā awwala khalqin nuʿīduhu waʿdan ʿalaynā innā kunnā fāʿilīna On that day will We roll up the heaven, as is rolled up the written scroll; As we caused the first creation, (Creature.) so will We get it return. (It is) a promise binding Us, Verily We were doing (Indicates the process to be continuous.) it. Like a scroll of parchment, the Universe will be folded up. For those who doubt about the whole Universe being brought to an end, another phase of life being created by the Almighty Lord, there can not be a better answer than the following verse of the Holy Qur'an: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ walaqad katabnā fī l-zabūri min baʿdi l-dhik'ri anna l-arḍa yarithuhā ʿibādiya l-ṣāliḥūna Certainly We wrote in the Psalms, after the Torah: 'Indeed My righteous servants shall inherit the earth.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ walaqad katabnā fī l-zabūri min baʿdi l-dhik'ri anna l-arḍa yarithuhā ʿibādiya l-ṣāliḥūna And We have already written in the book (of Psalms)1 after the (previous) mention2 that the land (of Paradise) is inherited by My righteous servants. And indeed We have written in Az-Zabur after Adh-Dhikr that My righteous servants shall inherit the land (21:105). Verily, in this there is a plain Message for people who worship Allah (21:106). And We have sent you (O Muhammad SAW) not but as a mercy for the 'Alamin (21:107). The Earth will be Inherited by the Righteous Allah tells us of His decree for His righteous servants who are the blessed in this world and in the Hereafter, those who will inherit the earth in this world and in the Hereafter.…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ walaqad katabnā fī l-zabūri min baʿdi l-dhik'ri anna l-arḍa yarithuhā ʿibādiya l-ṣāliḥūna And indeed We did write in the Psalms (Zabur) (given to David) after the Reminder (at-Tawrat given to Moses), that the earth, shall inherit it My servants righteous. (The Righteous ones.) About the righteous ones inheriting the earth mentioned in the scriptures given to the apostles of God gone before the Holy Prophet - Psalms 25/11, 37/29; and Math. 5/3 and Exod. 32/13. "His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth." Ps. 25/13. "But the men shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace." Ps. 36/11. "The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein forever." Ps. 37/29. "Blessed are the poor in spirit; for theirs…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ inna fī hādhā labalāghan liqawmin ʿābidīna There is indeed in this a proclamation for a devout people.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ inna fī hādhā labalāghan liqawmin ʿābidīna Indeed, in this (Qur’ān) is notification for a worshipping people. See 21:105

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ inna fī hādhā labalāghan liqawmin ʿābidīna Verily in this is a conveyance for a people who worship (Us). See 21:105

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan lil'ʿālamīna We did not send you but as a mercy to all the nations.1

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan lil'ʿālamīna And We have not sent you, (O Muḥammad), except as a mercy to the worlds. See 21:105

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan lil'ʿālamīna And We sent thee not (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) but a Mercy unto (all) the worlds. Sages had come to India for the local need of the guidance of the people of the place and the age. Similarly, apostles of God had visited all parts of the earth, some for a particular community and some for a larger group of the tribes and the people put together. Jesus had come for the lost house of Israel. Now the Holy Prophet had brought a message - the Book and the religion perfected by God Himself having in itself all the good that was endowed in the various previous messages, with the truth to its maximum fullness. This Universal Message and its Holy Messenger was nothing but the Mercy of the Lord,…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fahal antum mus'limūna Say, 'It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So will you submit?'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fahal antum mus'limūna Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims (in submission to Him)?" Say: It is revealed to me that your God is only one God. Will you then be Muslims? (21:108). But if they turn away say: "I give you a notice to be known to us all alike. And I know not whether that which you are promised is near or far (21:109). "Verily, He knows that which is spoken aloud and He knows that which you conceal (21:110). "And I know not, perhaps it may be a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while (21:111). He said:"My Lord! Judge You in truth! Our…

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fahal antum mus'limūna Say: "It hath only been revealed unto me that your God is One God: Will ye then submit (unto Him i.e. be Muslims)" It means that God is not the Lord Master of any particular people but of the Universe as a whole. This verse speaks of the Universal Authority and Lordship of God.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ ءَاذَنْتُكُمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ أَمْ بَعِيدٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ fa-in tawallaw faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāin wa-in adrī aqarībun am baʿīdun mā tūʿadūna But if they turn away, say, 'I have proclaimed to you all alike, and I do not know whether what you have been promised is far or near.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ ءَاذَنْتُكُمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ أَمْ بَعِيدٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ fa-in tawallaw faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāin wa-in adrī aqarībun am baʿīdun mā tūʿadūna But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to (all of) you equally.1 And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised. See 21:108

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ ءَاذَنْتُكُمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ أَمْ بَعِيدٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ fa-in tawallaw faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāin wa-in adrī aqarībun am baʿīdun mā tūʿadūna And if they turn back say: "I have warned you all alike; and I know not whether nigh or far, is that which ye are (Threatened.) promised." The knowledge of the Day of Judgment and the decision about effecting the requital which the people were warned with, rests, wholly with God and not the concern of the Holy Prophet, to say when it would actually come to pass. Similarly did Jesus say: that none, not even the angels and neither he, but God alone knows about the Hour.1

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra mina l-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūna Indeed He knows whatever is spoken aloud, and He knows whatever you conceal.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra mina l-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūna Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal. See 21:108

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra mina l-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūna Verily, He knoweth what is spoken aloud, and He knoweth (too) what ye hide See 21:109

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ wa-in adrī laʿallahu fit'natun lakum wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin I do not know —maybe it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a while.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ wa-in adrī laʿallahu fit'natun lakum wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin And I know not; perhaps it1 is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time." See 21:108

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ wa-in adrī laʿallahu fit'natun lakum wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin And I know not (also) happly this (respite) may be a trial for you and a provision until a time. The good of the world enjoyed by the disbelievers need not worry the believers or grieve them for that it is only a tempting passing show, only a fleeting pleasure or enjoyment destined to end but that which is in store for the faithful, in the hereafter is the real and the everlasting. The Second Holy Imam Hasan quoted this verse in his sermon at the eve of giving up the reigns of the rule of the Caliphate to Muawiyah. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:112 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ qāla rabbi uḥ'kum bil-ḥaqi warabbunā l-raḥmānu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna He said,1 'My Lord! Judge with justice.' 'Our Lord is the All-beneficent; [He is our] resort against what you allege.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:112 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ qāla rabbi uḥ'kum bil-ḥaqi warabbunā l-raḥmānu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna (The Prophet SAW) has said, "My Lord, judge (between us) in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."1 See 21:108

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:112 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ qāla rabbi uḥ'kum bil-ḥaqi warabbunā l-raḥmānu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna Said (the Apostle Muhammad praying): "O' my Lord! Judge Thou with truth; And Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is sought against what ye (Unto God or to His apostles.) ascribe (unto Him)" See 21:111

item.title: Al-Anfaal:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الْأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ فَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ yasalūnaka ʿani l-anfāli quli l-anfālu lillahi wal-rasūli fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṣliḥū dhāta baynikum wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu in kuntum mu'minīna They ask you concerning the anfāl.1 Say, 'The anfāl belong to Allah and the Apostle.' So be wary of Allah and settle your differences, and obey Allah and His Apostle, should you be faithful.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الْأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ فَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ yasalūnaka ʿani l-anfāli quli l-anfālu lillahi wal-rasūli fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṣliḥū dhāta baynikum wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu in kuntum mu'minīna They ask you, (O Muḥammad), about the bounties (of war). Say, "The (decision concerning) bounties is for Allah and the Messenger." So fear Allah and amend that which is between you and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you should be believers.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الْأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ فَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ yasalūnaka ʿani l-anfāli quli l-anfālu lillahi wal-rasūli fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṣliḥū dhāta baynikum wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu in kuntum mu'minīna They ask thee about 'Anfaal' (Accessions) (Spoils of war.) Say (O' Our Apostle)! "The 'Anfaal' (Accessions) are for God and the Apostle; So ye fear God and set aright (This indicates that there was some dispute about owning the accessions. The people thought that it was theirs and the result was a quarrel and a dispute - Its application is valid for ever and it is a part of Divine Sovereignty. The believers were asked to accept without any hitch.) matters between yourselves and obey God and His Apostle (The Holy Prophet.) if ye be believers." 'Al-Anfaal', a plural drawn from 'Nafl', literally meaning…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ innamā l-mu'minūna alladhīna idhā dhukira l-lahu wajilat qulūbuhum wa-idhā tuliyat ʿalayhim āyātuhu zādathum īmānan waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna The faithful are only those whose hearts tremble [with awe] when Allah is mentioned, and when His signs are recited to them, they1 increase their faith, and who put their trust in their Lord,

item.title: Al-Anfaal:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ innamā l-mu'minūna alladhīna idhā dhukira l-lahu wajilat qulūbuhum wa-idhā tuliyat ʿalayhim āyātuhu zādathum īmānan waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely. The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, feel a fear in their hearts and when His Ayat are recited unto them, they increase their faith; and they put their trust in their Lord (8:2). Who perform the Salah and spend out of what We have provided them (8:3). It is they who are the believers in truth. For them are grades of dignity with their Lord, and forgiveness and a…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ innamā l-mu'minūna alladhīna idhā dhukira l-lahu wajilat qulūbuhum wa-idhā tuliyat ʿalayhim āyātuhu zādathum īmānan waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Verily believers are only those who when God is mentioned their hearts get thrilled (Refer to verse 39:23. All these qualities are found to the maximum limits possible besides the Holy Prophet in his Ahl Al-Bayt.) , and when unto them are recited His signs they increase them in faith, and on God (alone) do they rely, See 8:1

item.title: Al-Anfaal:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna maintain the prayer and spend out of what We have provided them.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend. See 8:2

item.title: Al-Anfaal:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna Those who establish prayer and of what God hath provided them with, they spend (Benevolently in the way of their Lord.) See 8:1

item.title: Al-Anfaal:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum darajātun ʿinda rabbihim wamaghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun It is they who are truly the faithful. They shall have ranks near their Lord, forgiveness and a noble provision.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum darajātun ʿinda rabbihim wamaghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees (of high position) with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision. See 8:2

item.title: Al-Anfaal:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum darajātun ʿinda rabbihim wamaghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun These, (and) they (only) are the believers in truth; for them are (exalted) grades with their Lord, and forgiveness and a graceful sustenance. See 8:1

item.title: Al-Anfaal:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَا أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَارِهُونَ kamā akhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bil-ḥaqi wa-inna farīqan mina l-mu'minīna lakārihūna As your Lord brought you out from your home with a just cause, a part of the faithful were indeed reluctant.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَا أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَارِهُونَ kamā akhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bil-ḥaqi wa-inna farīqan mina l-mu'minīna lakārihūna [It1 is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home (for the battle of Badr) in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling. As your Lord caused you to go out from your home with the truth; and verily, a party among the believers disliked it (8:5). Disputing with you concerning the truth after it was made manifest, as if they were being driven to death, while they were looking (at it) (8:6). And (remember) when Allah promised you (Muslims) one of the two parties, that it should be yours; you wished that the one not armed should be yours, but Allah willed to justify the truth by His Words and to…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَا أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَارِهُونَ kamā akhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bil-ḥaqi wa-inna farīqan mina l-mu'minīna lakārihūna Even as thy Lord caused thee out of thy house with the truth, though a party of the believers were certainly averse, The reference is to the Battle of Badr - when the Muslims numbering only 313 had to defend themselves against the onslaught of the huge army of thousands fully armed and equipped men of the heathens of Mecca headed by Abu Sufyan, the Arch-enemy of the Holy Prophet and Islam, the father of Mu'awiyah and the grandfather of Yazid. When the Holy Prophet asked the opinion of some of his companions, Umar and Abu Bakr objected to going out of Madina to meet the enemy outside the city, but Sa'd Ibn Ma'az and Miqdad said, 'We…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُجَادِلُونَكَ فِي الْحَقِّ بَعْدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى الْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ yujādilūnaka fī l-ḥaqi baʿdamā mā tabayyana ka-annamā yusāqūna ilā l-mawti wahum yanẓurūna They disputed with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven towards death as they looked on.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُجَادِلُونَكَ فِي الْحَقِّ بَعْدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى الْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ yujādilūnaka fī l-ḥaqi baʿdamā mā tabayyana ka-annamā yusāqūna ilā l-mawti wahum yanẓurūna Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on. See 8:5

item.title: Al-Anfaal:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُجَادِلُونَكَ فِي الْحَقِّ بَعْدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى الْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ yujādilūnaka fī l-ḥaqi baʿdamā mā tabayyana ka-annamā yusāqūna ilā l-mawti wahum yanẓurūna They dispute (This suggests the existence of a party which was not wholeheartedly submissive to the divine orders. Indicates the hopelessness with which the Muslims had to defend against the huge onslaught of the formidably strong enemy.) with thee about the truth after it had been made manifest, as if they were (helplessly) being driven unto death while they see it. See 8:5

item.title: Al-Anfaal:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ اللَّهُ إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ الشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ الْكَافِرِينَ wa-idh yaʿidukumu l-lahu iḥ'dā l-ṭāifatayni annahā lakum watawaddūna anna ghayra dhāti l-shawkati takūnu lakum wayurīdu l-lahu an yuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi wayaqṭaʿa dābira l-kāfirīna When Allah promised you [victory over] one of the two companies, [saying], 'It is for you,' you were eager that it should be the one that was unarmed.1 But Allah desires to confirm the truth with His words, and to root out the faithless,

item.title: Al-Anfaal:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ اللَّهُ إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ الشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ الْكَافِرِينَ wa-idh yaʿidukumu l-lahu iḥ'dā l-ṭāifatayni annahā lakum watawaddūna anna ghayra dhāti l-shawkati takūnu lakum wayurīdu l-lahu an yuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi wayaqṭaʿa dābira l-kāfirīna (Remember, O believers), when Allah promised you one of the two groups1 - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allah intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers. See 8:5

item.title: Al-Anfaal:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ اللَّهُ إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ الشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ الْكَافِرِينَ wa-idh yaʿidukumu l-lahu iḥ'dā l-ṭāifatayni annahā lakum watawaddūna anna ghayra dhāti l-shawkati takūnu lakum wayurīdu l-lahu an yuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi wayaqṭaʿa dābira l-kāfirīna And when God promised unto you one of the two (enemy) parties that it should be yours and ye loved that the one unarmed should be yours, and intended God to establish the truth with His words, (His orders.) and to cut off the roots of the infidels. Referring to the attack on the Caravan under Abu Sufyan, contemplated by the people, which the Holy Prophet stopped and prophesied and loudly announced that the decree of the Lord is passed that the hosts shall soon return totally routed which was at first laughed at1…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ الْبَاطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ liyuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa wayub'ṭila l-bāṭila walaw kariha l-muj'rimūna so that He may confirm the truth and bring falsehood to naught, though the guilty should be averse.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ الْبَاطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ liyuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa wayub'ṭila l-bāṭila walaw kariha l-muj'rimūna That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it. See 8:5

item.title: Al-Anfaal:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ الْبَاطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ liyuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa wayub'ṭila l-bāṭila walaw kariha l-muj'rimūna That He may establish the truth of what was true and to bring to naught what was false, though disliked (it) the guilty (ones). See 8:7

item.title: Al-Anfaal:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُمْ بِأَلْفٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ idh tastaghīthūna rabbakum fa-is'tajāba lakum annī mumiddukum bi-alfin mina l-malāikati mur'difīna When you appealed to your Lord for help, He answered you: 'I will aid you with a thousand angels in a file.'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُمْ بِأَلْفٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ idh tastaghīthūna rabbakum fa-is'tajāba lakum annī mumiddukum bi-alfin mina l-malāikati mur'difīna (Remember) when you were asking help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another." (Remember) when you sought help of your Lord and He answered you (saying): I will help you with a thousand of the angels Murdifin (8:9). Allah made it only as glad tidings, and that your hearts be at rest therewith. And there is no victory except from Allah. Verily, Allah is Almighty, All-Wise (8:10). Muslims Invoke Allah for Help, Allah Sends the Angels to Help Them Al-Bukhari wrote in the book of battles (in his Sahih) under Chapter; Allah's statement: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ (Remember) when you sought help of…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُمْ بِأَلْفٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ idh tastaghīthūna rabbakum fa-is'tajāba lakum annī mumiddukum bi-alfin mina l-malāikati mur'difīna (And remember) when ye implored (Sought.) for help from your Lord, so answered He unto you (saying): "Verily, I will help you with a thousand of the angels in rank behind rank." See 8:7

item.title: Al-Anfaal:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
