item.description: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرٰی وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wamā jaʿalahu l-lahu illā bush'rā walitaṭma-inna bihi qulūbukum wamā l-naṣru illā min ʿindi l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun Allah did not appoint it but as a good news, and to reassure your hearts. Victory1 comes only from Allah. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرٰی وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wamā jaʿalahu l-lahu illā bush'rā walitaṭma-inna bihi qulūbukum wamā l-naṣru illā min ʿindi l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun And Allah made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allah. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise. See 8:9

item.title: Al-Anfaal:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرٰی وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wamā jaʿalahu l-lahu illā bush'rā walitaṭma-inna bihi qulūbukum wamā l-naṣru illā min ʿindi l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun And caused it (Help with the angels.) not God but as good tidings (unto you) and that your hearts thereby be convinced; and no (Emphasises the fact that blessings in any form is God's and the other agencies - angelical or non-angelical are only the means.) help is there save from God; Verily God is Ever-Triumphant, Wise. God blessed the believers with a conviction of their victory and cast a dreadful fright in the hearts of the enemy.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ بِهِ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدَامَ idh yughashīkumu l-nuʿāsa amanatan min'hu wayunazzilu ʿalaykum mina l-samāi māan liyuṭahhirakum bihi wayudh'hiba ʿankum rij'za l-shayṭāni waliyarbiṭa ʿalā qulūbikum wayuthabbita bihi l-aqdāma When He covered you with a trance as a [sense of] security from Him, and He sent down water from the sky to purify you with it, and to repel from you the defilement of Satan, and to fortify your hearts, and to make [your] feet steady with it.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ بِهِ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدَامَ idh yughashīkumu l-nuʿāsa amanatan min'hu wayunazzilu ʿalaykum mina l-samāi māan liyuṭahhirakum bihi wayudh'hiba ʿankum rij'za l-shayṭāni waliyarbiṭa ʿalā qulūbikum wayuthabbita bihi l-aqdāma (Remember) when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness (giving) security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil (suggestions) of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet. (Remember) when He covered you with a slumber as a security from Him, and He caused water (rain) to descend on you from the sky, to clean you thereby and to remove from you the Rijz (whispering or dirt) of Shaytan, and to strengthen your hearts, and make your feet…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ بِهِ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدَامَ idh yughashīkumu l-nuʿāsa amanatan min'hu wayunazzilu ʿalaykum mina l-samāi māan liyuṭahhirakum bihi wayudh'hiba ʿankum rij'za l-shayṭāni waliyarbiṭa ʿalā qulūbikum wayuthabbita bihi l-aqdāma (Recollect ye) When He caused upon you a slumber as a security from Him and sent down water from heaven that He might purify (A physical purification by means of water but the purification in 33:33 is direct and universal - thorough. Internal and External- i.e. of Body and Soul.) you with it and take away from you the uncleanliness of Satan and that He might fortify your hearts and plant firmly with it your feet. Abu Jahl had cunningly encamped his forces on a hard soil, and the desert before the Muslims was of very…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا سَأُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا الرُّعْبَ فَاضْرِبُوا فَوْقَ الْأَعْنَاقِ وَاضْرِبُوا مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ idh yūḥī rabbuka ilā l-malāikati annī maʿakum fathabbitū alladhīna āmanū sa-ul'qī fī qulūbi alladhīna kafarū l-ruʿ'ba fa-iḍ'ribū fawqa l-aʿnāqi wa-iḍ'ribū min'hum kulla banānin Then your Lord signaled to the angels: 'I am indeed with you; so steady the faithful. I will cast terror into the hearts of the faithless. So strike their necks, and strike each of their fingertips!'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا سَأُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا الرُّعْبَ فَاضْرِبُوا فَوْقَ الْأَعْنَاقِ وَاضْرِبُوا مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ idh yūḥī rabbuka ilā l-malāikati annī maʿakum fathabbitū alladhīna āmanū sa-ul'qī fī qulūbi alladhīna kafarū l-ruʿ'ba fa-iḍ'ribū fawqa l-aʿnāqi wa-iḍ'ribū min'hum kulla banānin (Remember) when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike (them) upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."1 See 8:11

item.title: Al-Anfaal:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا سَأُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا الرُّعْبَ فَاضْرِبُوا فَوْقَ الْأَعْنَاقِ وَاضْرِبُوا مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ idh yūḥī rabbuka ilā l-malāikati annī maʿakum fathabbitū alladhīna āmanū sa-ul'qī fī qulūbi alladhīna kafarū l-ruʿ'ba fa-iḍ'ribū fawqa l-aʿnāqi wa-iḍ'ribū min'hum kulla banānin When thy Lord revealed unto the angels saying: "Verily, I am with you, make ye firm then those who believe. Soon will I cast dread into the hearts of those who disbelieve, therefore strike ye off their necks; and strike off then every fingertip of them." This verse clearly explains how God helped the Muslims through the Angels - by Himself casting fright in the hearts of the enemy and the Angels fighting the foe on behalf of the Muslims. The Holy Qur'an clearly indicates how helpless were the Muslims against the unprovoked huge…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَمَنْ يُشَاقِقِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ dhālika bi-annahum shāqqū l-laha warasūlahu waman yushāqiqi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi That, because they defied Allah and His Apostle. And whoever defies Allah and His Apostle, Allah is indeed severe in retribution.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَمَنْ يُشَاقِقِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ dhālika bi-annahum shāqqū l-laha warasūlahu waman yushāqiqi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - indeed, Allah is severe in penalty. See 8:11

item.title: Al-Anfaal:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَمَنْ يُشَاقِقِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ dhālika bi-annahum shāqqū l-laha warasūlahu waman yushāqiqi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi This because they opposed (Waged war.) God and His Apostle (Muhammad), and whosoever opposeth God and His Apostle (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) then verily God is severe in punishment. The concluding words of this verse, clearly lays down the punishment for acting against God and the Holy Prophet. This law has to be remembered against the conduct of the people with the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt immediately as the Holy Prophet departed from this world. How they behaved with 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib, the first Holy Imam about whom the Holy Prophet had declared on the memorable historic day at Ghadir Khumm on his way returning from the 'Hajjat al-Wida'. "Of whomsoever I am the…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ dhālikum fadhūqūhu wa-anna lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāba l-nāri 'Taste this, and [know] that for the faithless is the punishment of the Fire.'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ dhālikum fadhūqūhu wa-anna lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāba l-nāri "That (is yours), so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire. See 8:11

item.title: Al-Anfaal:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ dhālikum fadhūqūhu wa-anna lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāba l-nāri This, (The cause of the punishment.) then ye taste it, and (Beware!) that for the infidels is the torment of the (Hell) fire. See 8:13

item.title: Al-Anfaal:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ الْأَدْبَارَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū zaḥfan falā tuwallūhumu l-adbāra O you who have faith! When you encounter the faithless advancing [for battle], do not turn your backs [to flee] from them.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ الْأَدْبَارَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū zaḥfan falā tuwallūhumu l-adbāra O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing (in battle), do not turn to them your backs (in flight). O you who believe! When you meet those who disbelieve, in a battlefield, never turn your backs to them (8:15). And whoever turns his back to them on such a day – unless it be a stratagem of war, or to retreat to a troop (of his own) – he indeed has drawn upon himself wrath from Allah. And his abode is Hell, and worst indeed is that destination (8:16). Fleeing from Battle is Prohibited, and its Punishment Allah said, while warning against fleeing from the battlefield and threatening those who do it with the…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ الْأَدْبَارَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū zaḥfan falā tuwallūhumu l-adbāra O' ye who believe! When ye meet those who disbelieve (to attack) in battle, turn ye not to them your backs. When the battle at Badr was being fought, some people sat quiet in the shade, merely witnessing and watching the trend of the events to join the triumphant party. And consider the position of those who turned their backs against the enemies at Uhud and ran away deserting the Holy Prophet in the midst of the overwhelming forces of the enemy, and disappeared for days together - Read authorities like, Tabari, Tarikh al-Khamis, Tafsir al-Kabir, Minhaj al-Nubuwwat, Early History of Islam by S. Husayn, which say, that the companions like Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman and Abu Ubayda…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَى فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَأْوَاهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ waman yuwallihim yawma-idhin duburahu illā mutaḥarrifan liqitālin aw mutaḥayyizan ilā fi-atin faqad bāa bighaḍabin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru Whoever turns his back [to flee] from them that day —unless [he is] diverting to fight or retiring towards another troop— shall certainly earn Allah's wrath, and his refuge shall be hell, an evil destination.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَى فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَأْوَاهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ waman yuwallihim yawma-idhin duburahu illā mutaḥarrifan liqitālin aw mutaḥayyizan ilā fi-atin faqad bāa bighaḍabin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving (as a strategy) for war or joining (another) company, has certainly returned with anger (upon him) from Allah, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination. See 8:15

item.title: Al-Anfaal:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَى فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَأْوَاهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ waman yuwallihim yawma-idhin duburahu illā mutaḥarrifan liqitālin aw mutaḥayyizan ilā fi-atin faqad bāa bighaḍabin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru And whoever turneth his back to them on that day except if he turneth aside (in a stratagem) for the fighting or in joining (another) contingent then he deserveth himself the wrath from God, and his abode is Hell; and what an evil destination shall it be. See note on Verse 8:15 and decide about those who had deserted the Holy Prophet at Uhud and the other battle-fields (Hunayn).

item.title: Al-Anfaal:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمَى وَلِيُبْلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَاءً حَسَنًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ falam taqtulūhum walākinna l-laha qatalahum wamā ramayta idh ramayta walākinna l-laha ramā waliyub'liya l-mu'minīna min'hu balāan ḥasanan inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun You did not kill them; rather it was Allah who killed them; and you did not throw when you threw,1 rather it was Allah who threw, that He might test the faithful with a good test from Himself.2 Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمَى وَلِيُبْلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَاءً حَسَنًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ falam taqtulūhum walākinna l-laha qatalahum wamā ramayta idh ramayta walākinna l-laha ramā waliyub'liya l-mu'minīna min'hu balāan ḥasanan inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun And you did not kill them, but it was Allah who killed them.1 And you threw not, (O Muḥammad), when you threw, but it was Allah who threw2 that He might test the believers with a good test.3 Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing. You killed them not, but Allah killed them. And you threw not when you did throw, but Allah threw, that He might test the believers by a fair trial from Him. Verily, Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower (8:17). This (is the fact) and surely Allah weakens the deceitful plots of the disbelievers (8:18). Allah's Signs…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمَى وَلِيُبْلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَاءً حَسَنًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ falam taqtulūhum walākinna l-laha qatalahum wamā ramayta idh ramayta walākinna l-laha ramā waliyub'liya l-mu'minīna min'hu balāan ḥasanan inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun So ye slew them not but God slew them, and thou (The Holy Prophet.) threw not when you threw it (the dust) but God threw it, that He might test (By the order to fight.) the believers by a gracious trial from Him; Verily God is All Hearing, All-Knowing. This verse clearly indicates that in the battles which the Holy Prophet fought for Islam, the hand of God was actually at work. The word 'Yubla' means gifting or conferring. Here it means that God willed to gift the Muslims with a good gift, i.e., the unexpectable victory over…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ الْكَافِرِينَ dhālikum wa-anna l-laha mūhinu kaydi l-kāfirīna Such is the case, and [know] that Allah undermines the stratagems of the faithless.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ الْكَافِرِينَ dhālikum wa-anna l-laha mūhinu kaydi l-kāfirīna That (is so), and (also) that Allah will weaken the plot of the disbelievers. See 8:17

item.title: Al-Anfaal:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ الْكَافِرِينَ dhālikum wa-anna l-laha mūhinu kaydi l-kāfirīna This (This is one cause and the other is that God weakens the crafty plans of the infidels.) (is the cause) and that God weakeneth the crafty plans of the infidels. See 8:17

item.title: Al-Anfaal:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَسْتَفْتِحُوا فَقَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْفَتْحُ وَإِنْ تَنْتَهُوْۤا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ تَعُودُوْۤا نَعُدْ وَلَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ in tastaftiḥū faqad jāakumu l-fatḥu wa-in tantahū fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in taʿūdū naʿud walan tugh'niya ʿankum fi-atukum shayan walaw kathurat wa-anna l-laha maʿa l-mu'minīna If you sought a verdict, the verdict has certainly come to you;1 and if you relinquish [faithlessness], it is better for you, but if you revert, We [too] shall return and your troops will never avail you though they should be ever so many, and [know] that Allah is with the faithful.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَسْتَفْتِحُوا فَقَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْفَتْحُ وَإِنْ تَنْتَهُوْۤا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ تَعُودُوْۤا نَعُدْ وَلَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ in tastaftiḥū faqad jāakumu l-fatḥu wa-in tantahū fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in taʿūdū naʿud walan tugh'niya ʿankum fi-atukum shayan walaw kathurat wa-anna l-laha maʿa l-mu'minīna If you (disbelievers) seek the decision (i.e., victory) - the decision (i.e., defeat) has come to you. And if you desist (from hostilities), it is best for you; but if you return (to war), We will return, and never will you be availed by your (large) company at all, even if it should increase; and (that is) because Allah is with the believers. (O disbelievers) if you ask for a judgement, now has the judgement come unto you; and if you cease (to do wrong), it will be better for you, and…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَسْتَفْتِحُوا فَقَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْفَتْحُ وَإِنْ تَنْتَهُوْۤا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ تَعُودُوْۤا نَعُدْ وَلَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ in tastaftiḥū faqad jāakumu l-fatḥu wa-in tantahū fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in taʿūdū naʿud walan tugh'niya ʿankum fi-atukum shayan walaw kathurat wa-anna l-laha maʿa l-mu'minīna (Know ye O' Infidels!) If ye demanded a victory then indeed hath come unto you (But not for you.) the victory, and if ye desist (from attacking the faithful) it will be better for you; and if ye return (to attack), We also shall return (to assist the believers), and never shall your forces avail you of anything, though they may be many, and (know ye) that God is with the believers. It is reported when the infidels left Mecca to attack the Muslims in Madina, it was Abu Jehl who held…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَأَنْتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tawallaw ʿanhu wa-antum tasmaʿūna O you who have faith! Obey Allah and His Apostle, and do not turn away from him while you hear [him].

item.title: Al-Anfaal:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَأَنْتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tawallaw ʿanhu wa-antum tasmaʿūna O you who have believed, obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear (his order). O you who believe! Obey Allah and His Messenger, and turn not away from him while you are hearing (8:20). And be not like those who say: "We have heard," but they hear not (8:21). Verily, the worst of living creatures with Allah are the deaf and the dumb (the disbelievers), who understand not (8:22). Had Allah known of any good in them, He would indeed have made them listen; and even if He had made them listen, they would but have turned away with aversion (8:23). The Command to Obey Allah and His Messenger SAW Allah…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَأَنْتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tawallaw ʿanhu wa-antum tasmaʿūna O' Ye who believe! Obey God and His Apostle (Muhammad!), and turn ye not away from him while ye hear (him) (This discredits the tradition which gives license to the participants of the battle of Badr among the Muslims to do whatever they like for God has already forgiven their sins. (A.P.).) . See 8:19

item.title: Al-Anfaal:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna qālū samiʿ'nā wahum lā yasmaʿūna Do not be like those who say, 'We hear,' though they do not hear.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna qālū samiʿ'nā wahum lā yasmaʿūna And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear. See 8:20

item.title: Al-Anfaal:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna qālū samiʿ'nā wahum lā yasmaʿūna And be not like those who said: "We heard" while they listen not. See 8:19

item.title: Al-Anfaal:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الصُّمُّ الْبُكْمُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi l-ṣumu l-buk'mu alladhīna lā yaʿqilūna Indeed the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the deaf and the dumb who do not apply reason.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الصُّمُّ الْبُكْمُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi l-ṣumu l-buk'mu alladhīna lā yaʿqilūna Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason (i.e., the disbelievers). See 8:20

item.title: Al-Anfaal:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الصُّمُّ الْبُكْمُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi l-ṣumu l-buk'mu alladhīna lā yaʿqilūna Verily the vilest of animals (The infidels. Lit. anything that walks, creeps, or crawls on earth.) in God's view are the deaf and the dumb who understand not. See 8:19

item.title: Al-Anfaal:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَأَسْمَعَهُمْ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوْا وَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ walaw ʿalima l-lahu fīhim khayran la-asmaʿahum walaw asmaʿahum latawallaw wahum muʿ'riḍūna Had Allah known any good in them, surely He would have made them hear, and were He to make them hear, surely they would turn away, being disregardful.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَأَسْمَعَهُمْ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوْا وَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ walaw ʿalima l-lahu fīhim khayran la-asmaʿahum walaw asmaʿahum latawallaw wahum muʿ'riḍūna Had Allah known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would (still) have turned away, while they were refusing. See 8:20

item.title: Al-Anfaal:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَأَسْمَعَهُمْ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوْا وَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ walaw ʿalima l-lahu fīhim khayran la-asmaʿahum walaw asmaʿahum latawallaw wahum muʿ'riḍūna And if God had found in them any good, indeed He would have made them listen, and (even) if He makes them listen (With the absence of goodness in them.) , they would turn back while they swerve aside. See 8:19

item.title: Al-Anfaal:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَأَنَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū is'tajībū lillahi walilrrasūli idhā daʿākum limā yuḥ'yīkum wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yaḥūlu bayna l-mari waqalbihi wa-annahu ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna O you who have faith! Answer Allah and the Apostle when he summons you to that which will give you life. Know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that toward Him you will be mustered.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَأَنَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū is'tajībū lillahi walilrrasūli idhā daʿākum limā yuḥ'yīkum wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yaḥūlu bayna l-mari waqalbihi wa-annahu ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered. O you who believe! Answer Allah and (His) Messenger when he (the Messenger) calls you to that which will give you life, and know that Allah comes between a person and his heart. And verily to Him you shall (all) be gathered (8:24). The Command to Answer and Obey Allah and His Messenger SAW Al-Bukhari said: اسْتَجِيبُوا Answer Which…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَأَنَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū is'tajībū lillahi walilrrasūli idhā daʿākum limā yuḥ'yīkum wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yaḥūlu bayna l-mari waqalbihi wa-annahu ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna O' ye who believe! Respond ye to God and to His Apostle (Muhammad) when He calleth you to that which giveth you life; and know ye that God getteth (always there) in between man and his heart (Intentions.) , and that it is unto Him ye shall (all) be (ultimately) gathered. By this verse the response to the call of the Holy Prophet is the same as the response to the call from God, thus the immediate response to the call of the Holy Prophet becomes compulsory. It is said that by the call of the Holy Prophet, is meant…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوْۤا فِتْنَةً لَا تُصِيبَنَّ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْكُمْ خَاصَّةً وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ wa-ittaqū fit'natan lā tuṣībanna alladhīna ẓalamū minkum khāṣṣatan wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi And beware of a punishment which shall not visit the wrongdoers among you exclusively, and know that Allah is severe in retribution.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوْۤا فِتْنَةً لَا تُصِيبَنَّ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْكُمْ خَاصَّةً وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ wa-ittaqū fit'natan lā tuṣībanna alladhīna ẓalamū minkum khāṣṣatan wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi And fear a trial1 which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allah is severe in penalty. And fear the Fitnah (affliction and trial) which affects not in particular (only) those of you who do wrong, and know that Allah is severe in punishment (8:25). Warning against an Encompassing Fitnah Allah warns His believing servants of a Fitnah, trial and test, that encompasses the wicked and those around them. Therefore, such Fitnah will not be restricted to the sinners and evildoers. Rather, it will reach the others if the sins are not stopped and prevented. Imam Ahmad recorded that Mutarrif said, We asked Az-Zubayr, 'O Abu 'Abdullah! What…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوْۤا فِتْنَةً لَا تُصِيبَنَّ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْكُمْ خَاصَّةً وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ wa-ittaqū fit'natan lā tuṣībanna alladhīna ẓalamū minkum khāṣṣatan wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi And guard ye (yourselves) against an affliction (A troublesome trial.) which may smite not (only) those who committed injustice among you in particular (but all of you); and know ye that God is severe in the requital (of evil); It is related from the Second Holy Imam Hasan Ibn 'Ali that he said that this verse was revealed as a prophecy about the Battle of Jamal, which was fought by Talha, Zubayr and Ammar, under A'isha, one of the wives of the Holy Prophet. This battle was fought at Basra. Tafsir al-Kashaf says that once Zubayr was going along with the Holy Prophet and 'Ali was coming in front of them. Zubayr pointing to…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ أَنْتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَءَاوَاكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُمْ بِنَصْرِهِ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wa-udh'kurū idh antum qalīlun mus'taḍʿafūna fī l-arḍi takhāfūna an yatakhaṭṭafakumu l-nāsu faāwākum wa-ayyadakum binaṣrihi warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti laʿallakum tashkurūna Remember when you were few, abased in the land, and feared lest the people should despoil you, and He gave you refuge, and strengthened you with His help, and provided you with all the good things so that you may give thanks.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ أَنْتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَءَاوَاكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُمْ بِنَصْرِهِ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wa-udh'kurū idh antum qalīlun mus'taḍʿafūna fī l-arḍi takhāfūna an yatakhaṭṭafakumu l-nāsu faāwākum wa-ayyadakum binaṣrihi warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti laʿallakum tashkurūna And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful. And remember when you were few and were reckoned weak in the land, and were afraid that men might kidnap you, but He provided a safe place for you, strengthened you with His help, and provided you with good things (for livelihood) so that you might be grateful (8:26). Reminding Muslims of Their Previous State of Weakness and Subjugation which Changed into Might and…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ أَنْتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَءَاوَاكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُمْ بِنَصْرِهِ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wa-udh'kurū idh antum qalīlun mus'taḍʿafūna fī l-arḍi takhāfūna an yatakhaṭṭafakumu l-nāsu faāwākum wa-ayyadakum binaṣrihi warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti laʿallakum tashkurūna And remember ye, when ye were few and deemed weak in the earth, fearing that people may carry you away by force but He strengthened (This is a heartening warning to the believers not to be afraid of being a minority and thus to join the wrong-doers.) you with His aid and provided you of the good things (of sustenance) that ye may give thanks. See 8:25

item.title: Al-Anfaal:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَخُونُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوا أَمَانَاتِكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takhūnū l-laha wal-rasūla watakhūnū amānātikum wa-antum taʿlamūna O you who have faith! Do not betray Allah and the Apostle, and do not betray your trusts knowingly.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَخُونُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوا أَمَانَاتِكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takhūnū l-laha wal-rasūla watakhūnū amānātikum wa-antum taʿlamūna O you who have believed, do not betray Allah and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know (the consequence). O you who believe! Betray not Allah and His Messenger, nor betray knowingly your Amanat (things entrusted to you) (8:27). And know that your possessions and your children are but a trial and that surely, with Allah is a mighty reward (8:28). Reason behind Revealing This Ayah, and the Prohibition of Betrayal The Two Sahihs mention the story of Hatib bin Abi Balta'ah. In the year of the victory of Makkah he wrote to the Quraysh alerting them that the Messenger of Allah SAW intended to march towards them. Allah informed His Messenger SAW of this, and…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَخُونُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوا أَمَانَاتِكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takhūnū l-laha wal-rasūla watakhūnū amānātikum wa-antum taʿlamūna O' ye who believe! Be ye not unfaithful to God and the Apostle (Muhammad), nor be ye unfaithful to (the) trusts (The Book of God (Qur'an) and the Ahl Al-Bayt, with which the Muslims were trusted.) with you while ye know, Unfaithfulness or treachery here relates to disclosing the secrets of God, of the Holy Prophet and also of the people themselves. It is reported by Jabir Ibn Abdullah al-Ansari that the Messenger Angel Gabriel appeared before the Holy Prophet and informed him that Abu Sufyan, the arch enemy of Islam, had secretly camped, and counselled to prepare to forestall the enemy and keep this a secret. When the Holy Prophet informed his closest lieutenants to prepare for…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ wa-iʿ'lamū annamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wa-anna l-laha ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmun Know that your possessions and children are only a test, and that Allah—with Him is a great reward.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ wa-iʿ'lamū annamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wa-anna l-laha ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmun And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allah has with Him a great reward. See 8:27

item.title: Al-Anfaal:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ wa-iʿ'lamū annamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wa-anna l-laha ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmun And know ye! that your wealth and your children, are a temptation (Ar. 'Fitna' Refer to note on verse 64:14 & 64:15.) , and that, God, with Him is a mighty reward. See 8:27

item.title: Al-Anfaal:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ تَتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tattaqū l-laha yajʿal lakum fur'qānan wayukaffir ʿankum sayyiātikum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi O you who have faith! If you are wary of Allah, He shall appoint a criterion1 for you, and absolve you of your misdeeds, and forgive you, for Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ تَتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tattaqū l-laha yajʿal lakum fur'qānan wayukaffir ʿankum sayyiātikum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi O you who have believed, if you fear Allah, He will grant you a criterion1 and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty. O you who believe! If you obey and fear Allah, He will grant you Furqan, and will expiate for you your sins, and forgive you; and Allah is the Owner of the great bounty (8:29). Ibn 'Abbas, As-Suddi, Mujahid, 'Ikrimah, Ad-Dahhak, Qatadah, Muqatil bin Hayyan and several others said that: فُرْقَانًا Furqan Means, 'a way out'; Mujahid added, "In this life and the Hereafter." In another narration, Ibn 'Abbas is reported…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ تَتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tattaqū l-laha yajʿal lakum fur'qānan wayukaffir ʿankum sayyiātikum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi O' ye who believe! If ye fear God He will grant you a distinctive (standard) (To enable distinguishing the right from the wrong.) and remove from you (all) your evils, (sins) and forgive you; and God is the Lord of Mighty grace. This verse speaks of the quite reasonable and practical way Islam wants mankind to be kept warned against sinning, as well as encouraging piety and with the promise of the pardon for the evils already committed, if duly repented with amendment.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ wa-idh yamkuru bika alladhīna kafarū liyuth'bitūka aw yaqtulūka aw yukh'rijūka wayamkurūna wayamkuru l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīna When the faithless plotted against you to take you captive, or to kill or expel you. They plotted and Allah devised, and Allah is the best of devisers.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ wa-idh yamkuru bika alladhīna kafarū liyuth'bitūka aw yaqtulūka aw yukh'rijūka wayamkurūna wayamkuru l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīna And (remember, O Muḥammad), when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you (from Makkah). But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners. And (remember) when the disbelievers plotted against you to imprison you, or to kill you, or to expel you (from your home, Makkah); they were plotting and Allah too was plotting; and Allah is the best of plotters (8:30). The Makkans Plot to Kill the Prophet SAW, Imprison Him or Expel Him from Makkah Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid and Qatadah said: لِيُثْبِتُوكَ 'Liyuthbitūka' means "to imprison you." As-Suddi said, "Ithbāt is to confine or…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ wa-idh yamkuru bika alladhīna kafarū liyuth'bitūka aw yaqtulūka aw yukh'rijūka wayamkurūna wayamkuru l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīna And when planned they against thee, those who disbelieved, that they might imprison thee, or slay thee or drive thee away; and they devise plans and God (too) hath a plan; and God is the Best of the planners. When some people from Yathrib (later known as Madina) came to Mecca and invited the Holy Prophet to their place and promised faithfulness to him, the heathens of Mecca got alerted and apprehended that the Holy Prophet would soon be out of their hold. An urgent meeting of the elders of the tribes was hurriedly summoned at the Dar al-Nadwah, where the Meccans used to meet whenever they needed…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا قَالُوْا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَذَا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā qālū qad samiʿ'nā law nashāu laqul'nā mith'la hādhā in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna When Our signs are recited to them, they say, 'We have heard already. If we want, we [too] can say like this. These are nothing but myths of the ancients.'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا قَالُوْا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَذَا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā qālū qad samiʿ'nā law nashāu laqul'nā mith'la hādhā in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say (something) like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples." And when Our Ayat are recited to them, they say: "We have heard (the Qur'an); if we wish we can say the like of this. This is nothing but the tales of the ancients (8:31). And (remember) when they said: "O Allah! If this (the Qur'an) is indeed the truth (revealed) from You, then rain down stones on us from the sky or bring on us a painful torment (8:32). And Allah would not punish…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا قَالُوْا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَذَا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā qālū qad samiʿ'nā law nashāu laqul'nā mith'la hādhā in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna And (remember) when are recited unto them Our signs, say they: "Indeed we have heard" if we please we could say the like of this (Qur'an), It is nothing but the tales of the ancients. It is a reference to the empty boastings of the infidels. There is already the challenge of the Holy Qur'an to produce at least a chapter of its kind. Yet the world till now could not respond to this everlasting and ever-current challenge. The people sometimes used to say that they, if they only like it, can bring the like of this, (Qur'an) and they resorted to all means against the…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالُوْا اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-idh qālū l-lahuma in kāna hādhā huwa l-ḥaqa min ʿindika fa-amṭir ʿalaynā ḥijāratan mina l-samāi awi i'tinā biʿadhābin alīmin And when they said, 'O Allah, if this be the truth from You, rain down upon us stones from the sky, or bring us a painful punishment.'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالُوْا اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-idh qālū l-lahuma in kāna hādhā huwa l-ḥaqa min ʿindika fa-amṭir ʿalaynā ḥijāratan mina l-samāi awi i'tinā biʿadhābin alīmin And (remember) when they said, "O Allah, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment." See 8:31

item.title: Al-Anfaal:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالُوْا اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-idh qālū l-lahuma in kāna hādhā huwa l-ḥaqa min ʿindika fa-amṭir ʿalaynā ḥijāratan mina l-samāi awi i'tinā biʿadhābin alīmin And (remember) when said they: (The infidels.) "O' God! If this (Qur'an) be the truth from Thee, then rain Thou upon us stones from heaven or inflict on us a painful chastisement." Nu'man Ibn al-Harith had been to Iran for the purpose of trade. He purchased the stories of Rustom and Sohrab and translating them into Arabic, said, that like the Qur'an he had also fabricated some stories of the eminent people. Uthman Ibn Math said, "O' Nu'man! fear God for Muhammad is the true Apostle of God and what he says is truth. He says, There is no God but (the…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنْتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿadhibahum wa-anta fīhim wamā kāna l-lahu muʿadhibahum wahum yastaghfirūna But Allah will not punish them while you are in their midst, nor will Allah punish them while they plead for forgiveness.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنْتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿadhibahum wa-anta fīhim wamā kāna l-lahu muʿadhibahum wahum yastaghfirūna But Allah would not punish them while you, (O Muḥammad), are among them, and Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness. See 8:31

item.title: Al-Anfaal:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنْتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿadhibahum wa-anta fīhim wamā kāna l-lahu muʿadhibahum wahum yastaghfirūna And God is not to chastise them while thou (The Holy Prophet.) art among them (Refers to the people mentioned in the previous two verses: 8:31& 8:32 which shows that the people referred to were only professing Islam.) , nor is God to chastise them while yet they seek forgiveness. Allamah Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani al-Makki, a revered Sunni scholar in his well-known book 'Sawa'iq al-Muhriqa' says that this verse is also about the superiority and excellence of the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt. There are many traditions of the Holy Prophet saying, "as I am the source of peace and protection for mankind on earth, my Ahl Al-Bayt are also the same for them. (M.F.A.). This verse gives…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا أَوْلِيَاءَهُ إِنْ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wamā lahum allā yuʿadhibahumu l-lahu wahum yaṣuddūna ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wamā kānū awliyāahu in awliyāuhu illā l-mutaqūna walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna What [excuse] have they that Allah should not punish them, when they bar [the faithful] from the Holy Mosque, and they are not its custodians? Its custodians are only the Godwary, but most of them do not know.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا أَوْلِيَاءَهُ إِنْ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wamā lahum allā yuʿadhibahumu l-lahu wahum yaṣuddūna ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wamā kānū awliyāahu in awliyāuhu illā l-mutaqūna walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna But why should Allah not punish them while they obstruct (people) from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and they were not (fit to be) its guardians? Its (true) guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know. And why should not Allah punish them while they hinder (men) from Al-Masjid Al-Haram, and they are not its guardians? None can be its guardians except those who have Taqwa, but most of them know not (8:34). Their Salah at the House was nothing but Muka' and Tasdiyah. Therefore taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve (8:35). The Idolators…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا أَوْلِيَاءَهُ إِنْ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wamā lahum allā yuʿadhibahumu l-lahu wahum yaṣuddūna ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wamā kānū awliyāahu in awliyāuhu illā l-mutaqūna walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna And what plea have they that God should not chastise them while they obstruct (men) from the Sacred Mosque, and they are not (also) its guardians; Its guardians are not but only those who guard themselves (against evil) (The pious) but most of them know not. Guardians of the Mosque can be interpreted as the guardians of the faith, Islam, and according to this verse the guardians of Islam, i.e., the Imams, could be only those who were themselves the strictest observers of it and in this regard, none could even be equalised to the Twelve Holy Imams…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَاءً وَتَصْدِيَةً فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ wamā kāna ṣalātuhum ʿinda l-bayti illā mukāan wataṣdiyatan fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna Their prayer at the House is nothing but whistling and clapping. So taste the punishment because of what you used to defy.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَاءً وَتَصْدِيَةً فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ wamā kāna ṣalātuhum ʿinda l-bayti illā mukāan wataṣdiyatan fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna And their prayer at the House (i.e., the Kaʿbah) was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved (i.e., practiced of deviations). See 8:34

item.title: Al-Anfaal:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَاءً وَتَصْدِيَةً فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ wamā kāna ṣalātuhum ʿinda l-bayti illā mukāan wataṣdiyatan fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna And their prayer near the (Sacred) House (of God) is nothing but whistling and clasping of hands; Taste ye then the chastisement for what ye were disbelieving. There can never be any Islamic prayer acceptable to God and the Holy Prophet, with music. The innovation of the institution of 'Sama' which is conducted with music by some who call themselves Sufis (the mystics) could reasonably be termed as the legacy or the copy of some non-Muslim creeds.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَسَيُنْفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ inna alladhīna kafarū yunfiqūna amwālahum liyaṣuddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi fasayunfiqūnahā thumma takūnu ʿalayhim ḥasratan thumma yugh'labūna wa-alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama yuḥ'sharūna Indeed the faithless spend their wealth to bar from the way of Allah. Soon they will have spent it, then it will be a cause of regret to them, then they will be overcome, and the faithless will be gathered toward Hell,

item.title: Al-Anfaal:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَسَيُنْفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ inna alladhīna kafarū yunfiqūna amwālahum liyaṣuddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi fasayunfiqūnahā thumma takūnu ʿalayhim ḥasratan thumma yugh'labūna wa-alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama yuḥ'sharūna Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert (people) from the way of Allah. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a (source of) regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered. Verily, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to hinder (men) from the path of Allah, and so will they continue to spend it; but in the end it will become an anguish for them. Then they will be overcome. And those who disbelieve will be gathered unto Hell (8:36). In order…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَسَيُنْفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ inna alladhīna kafarū yunfiqūna amwālahum liyaṣuddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi fasayunfiqūnahā thumma takūnu ʿalayhim ḥasratan thumma yugh'labūna wa-alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama yuḥ'sharūna Verily those who disbelieve spend of their wealth to obstruct (men) from the way of God, so will they spend it, then (in the end) it shall be against them (a matter of) regret; and those who disbelieve, unto the Hell shall they be driven. See 8:35

item.title: Al-Anfaal:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَمِيزَ اللَّهُ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ الْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ liyamīza l-lahu l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wayajʿala l-khabītha baʿḍahu ʿalā baʿḍin fayarkumahu jamīʿan fayajʿalahu fī jahannama ulāika humu l-khāsirūna so that Allah may separate the bad ones from the good, and place the bad on one another, and pile them up together, and cast them into hell. It is they who are the losers.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَمِيزَ اللَّهُ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ الْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ liyamīza l-lahu l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wayajʿala l-khabītha baʿḍahu ʿalā baʿḍin fayarkumahu jamīʿan fayajʿalahu fī jahannama ulāika humu l-khāsirūna (It is) so that Allah may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers. See 8:36

item.title: Al-Anfaal:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَمِيزَ اللَّهُ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ الْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ liyamīza l-lahu l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wayajʿala l-khabītha baʿḍahu ʿalā baʿḍin fayarkumahu jamīʿan fayajʿalahu fī jahannama ulāika humu l-khāsirūna That God might distinguish the impure (Refer to verse 3:178. Shows that the distinction referred to in this Verse is the object of the apostolic mission of every prophet - its application extending even to the disbelievers. (A.P.).) from the pure, and put the impure, some of it upon the other, and pile it up together, then cast it into the Hell; These are they the losers. See 8:35

item.title: Al-Anfaal:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ يَنْتَهُوْۤا يُغْفَرْ لَهُمْ مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِنْ يَعُودُوْۤا فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ الْأَوَّلِينَ qul lilladhīna kafarū in yantahū yugh'far lahum mā qad salafa wa-in yaʿūdū faqad maḍat sunnatu l-awalīna Say to the faithless, if they relinquish [faithlessness], what is already past shall be forgiven them. But if they revert [to faithlessness], then the precedent of the ancients has already passed.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ يَنْتَهُوْۤا يُغْفَرْ لَهُمْ مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِنْ يَعُودُوْۤا فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ الْأَوَّلِينَ qul lilladhīna kafarū in yantahū yugh'far lahum mā qad salafa wa-in yaʿūdū faqad maḍat sunnatu l-awalīna Say to those who have disbelieved (that) if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return (to hostility) - then the precedent of the former (rebellious) peoples has already taken place.1 Say to those who have disbelieved, if they cease, their past will be forgiven. But if they return (thereto), then the examples of those (punished) before them have already preceded (as a warning) (8:38). And fight them until there is no more Fitnah, and the religion (worship) will all be for Allah alone. But if they cease, then certainly, Allah is All-Seer of what they do (8:39). And if they…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ يَنْتَهُوْۤا يُغْفَرْ لَهُمْ مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِنْ يَعُودُوْۤا فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ الْأَوَّلِينَ qul lilladhīna kafarū in yantahū yugh'far lahum mā qad salafa wa-in yaʿūdū faqad maḍat sunnatu l-awalīna Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) to those who disbelieve: If they desist (from their disbelief and the enmity of the Apostle), will be forgiven for them (their sins) what hath past, (This is explained by the Holy Prophet who said: "Islam cuts off man from his past" (A.P.).) and if they return (to their disbelief) then indeed shall pass against them what hath already passed (against) the ancients. Note the mercifulness of Islam and the Holy Prophet that in spite of what has been done to torture the Holy Prophet and the faithful ones, the only condition for forgiveness, is the return from evil and embracing the truth,…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتّٰی لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ كُلُّهُ لِلَّهِ فَإِنِ انْتَهَوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ waqātilūhum ḥattā lā takūna fit'natun wayakūna l-dīnu kulluhu lillahi fa-ini intahaw fa-inna l-laha bimā yaʿmalūna baṣīrun Fight them until faithlessness1 is no more, and religion becomes exclusively for Allah. But if they relinquish, Allah indeed sees best what they do.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتّٰی لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ كُلُّهُ لِلَّهِ فَإِنِ انْتَهَوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ waqātilūhum ḥattā lā takūna fit'natun wayakūna l-dīnu kulluhu lillahi fa-ini intahaw fa-inna l-laha bimā yaʿmalūna baṣīrun And fight against them until there is no fitnah1 and (until) the religion (i.e., worship), all of it, is for Allah.2 And if they cease - then indeed, Allah is Seeing of what they do. See 8:38

item.title: Al-Anfaal:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتّٰی لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ كُلُّهُ لِلَّهِ فَإِنِ انْتَهَوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ waqātilūhum ḥattā lā takūna fit'natun wayakūna l-dīnu kulluhu lillahi fa-ini intahaw fa-inna l-laha bimā yaʿmalūna baṣīrun And fight ye with them until (So that.) there be no mischief (Mischief - Object of the fight to stop mischief and to defend against unprovoked aggression.) and the religion be wholly for God; but if they desist, then Verily seest God what (all) they do. See 8:38

item.title: Al-Anfaal:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَاكُمْ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ wa-in tawallaw fa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha mawlākum niʿ'ma l-mawlā waniʿ'ma l-naṣīru And if they turn away, then know that Allah is your master: an excellent master and an excellent helper!

item.title: Al-Anfaal:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَاكُمْ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ wa-in tawallaw fa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha mawlākum niʿ'ma l-mawlā waniʿ'ma l-naṣīru But if they turn away - then know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper. See 8:38

item.title: Al-Anfaal:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَاكُمْ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ wa-in tawallaw fa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha mawlākum niʿ'ma l-mawlā waniʿ'ma l-naṣīru And if they turn back, then know ye! that God is your Lord; (Protector – Master.) The Most Excellent Lord and the Most Excellent Helper. And if in spite of the amnesty and forgiveness offered, the heathens return to enmity and fight, then God promises the believers His protection and help. It is a prophecy that the infidels would never thereafter be able to succeed against Islam or the Holy Prophet. This proves 'Jihad'1 is valid on all parts of the earth until God fills the world with justice, peace, and no trouble or injustice is practised anywhere in the world, i.e., the day of the re-appearance of the Last Imam of the Ahl Al-Bayt - Muhammad al-Mahdi. For details…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبٰی وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ wa-iʿ'lamū annamā ghanim'tum min shayin fa-anna lillahi khumusahu walilrrasūli walidhī l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni wa-ib'ni l-sabīli in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi wamā anzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā yawma l-fur'qāni yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Know that whatever thing you may come by, a fifth of it is for Allah and the Apostle, for the relatives and the orphans, for the needy and the traveller, if you have faith in Allah and what We sent down to Our servant on the Day of Separation,1 the day when the two hosts met; and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبٰی وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ wa-iʿ'lamū annamā ghanim'tum min shayin fa-anna lillahi khumusahu walilrrasūli walidhī l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni wa-ib'ni l-sabīli in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi wamā anzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā yawma l-fur'qāni yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allah is one fifth of it and for the Messenger1 and for (his) near relatives2 and the orphans, the needy, and the (stranded) traveler,3 if you have believed in Allah and in that which We sent down to Our Servant4 on the day of criterion (i.e., decisive encounter) - the day when the two armies met (at Badr). And Allah, over…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبٰی وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ wa-iʿ'lamū annamā ghanim'tum min shayin fa-anna lillahi khumusahu walilrrasūli walidhī l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni wa-ib'ni l-sabīli in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi wamā anzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā yawma l-fur'qāni yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And know ye (O' believers) that whatever of a thing ye acquire a fifth of it is for God, and for the Apostle and for the (Apostle's) near relatives and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, if ye believe in God and that which We sent down unto Our servant (Muhammad), on the Day of distinction, on the day when met the two parties; And verily God hath power over all things.…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ أَنْتُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الْقُصْوَى وَالرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدْتُمْ لَاخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي الْمِيعَادِ وَلَكِنْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا لِيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَى مَنْ حَيَّ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ idh antum bil-ʿud'wati l-dun'yā wahum bil-ʿud'wati l-quṣ'wā wal-rakbu asfala minkum walaw tawāʿadttum la-ikh'talaftum fī l-mīʿādi walākin liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan liyahlika man halaka ʿan bayyinatin wayaḥyā man ḥayya ʿan bayyinatin wa-inna l-laha lasamīʿun ʿalīmun When you were on the nearer side,1 and they2 on the farther side, while the caravan was below you, and had you agreed together on an encounter, you would have certainly failed to keep the tryst,3 but in order that Allah may carry through a matter that was bound to be fulfilled, so that he who perishes might perish by a manifest proof, and he who lives may live on…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ أَنْتُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الْقُصْوَى وَالرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدْتُمْ لَاخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي الْمِيعَادِ وَلَكِنْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا لِيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَى مَنْ حَيَّ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ idh antum bil-ʿud'wati l-dun'yā wahum bil-ʿud'wati l-quṣ'wā wal-rakbu asfala minkum walaw tawāʿadttum la-ikh'talaftum fī l-mīʿādi walākin liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan liyahlika man halaka ʿan bayyinatin wayaḥyā man ḥayya ʿan bayyinatin wa-inna l-laha lasamīʿun ʿalīmun (Remember) when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower (in position) than you. If you had made an appointment (to meet), you would have missed the appointment. But (it was) so that Allah might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished (through disbelief) would perish upon evidence and those who lived (in faith)…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ أَنْتُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الْقُصْوَى وَالرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدْتُمْ لَاخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي الْمِيعَادِ وَلَكِنْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا لِيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَى مَنْ حَيَّ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ idh antum bil-ʿud'wati l-dun'yā wahum bil-ʿud'wati l-quṣ'wā wal-rakbu asfala minkum walaw tawāʿadttum la-ikh'talaftum fī l-mīʿādi walākin liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan liyahlika man halaka ʿan bayyinatin wayaḥyā man ḥayya ʿan bayyinatin wa-inna l-laha lasamīʿun ʿalīmun (Remember) When ye were on the near side (of the valley) and they were on the farthest side (of it), while the caravan (of the enemy) was in a lower ground than you; and had you mutually made an appointment (To assume the described position.) certainly had you broken away (failed) in the fulfilment, but (ye were made to meet) in order that God might enact a matter which was…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا وَلَوْ أَرَاكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ سَلَّمَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ idh yurīkahumu l-lahu fī manāmika qalīlan walaw arākahum kathīran lafashil'tum walatanāzaʿtum fī l-amri walākinna l-laha sallama innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri When Allah showed them1 to you as few in your dream, and had He shown them as many, you would have lost heart, and disputed about the matter. But Allah spared you. Indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا وَلَوْ أَرَاكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ سَلَّمَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ idh yurīkahumu l-lahu fī manāmika qalīlan walaw arākahum kathīran lafashil'tum walatanāzaʿtum fī l-amri walākinna l-laha sallama innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri (Remember, O Muḥammad), when Allah showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you (believers) would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter (of whether to fight), but Allah saved (you from that). Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. (And remember) when Allah showed them to you as few in your dream; if He had shown them to you as many, you would surely have been discouraged, and you would surely have disputed in making a decision. But Allah saved (you). Certainly, He…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا وَلَوْ أَرَاكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ سَلَّمَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ idh yurīkahumu l-lahu fī manāmika qalīlan walaw arākahum kathīran lafashil'tum walatanāzaʿtum fī l-amri walākinna l-laha sallama innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri (Remember) When God showed them to thee in thy dream as few; and had He shown them to thee as many (then) certainly would ye have become disheartened and certainly ye would have disputed in the matter, but God did save you; verily He is the All-Knower of what is in your breasts. (Hearts.) See 8:42

item.title: Al-Anfaal:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ الْتَقَيْتُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ wa-idh yurīkumūhum idhi l-taqaytum fī aʿyunikum qalīlan wayuqallilukum fī aʿyunihim liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru And when He showed them to you —when you met them [on the battlefield]— as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] few in their eyes in order that Allah may carry through a matter that was bound to be fulfilled, and to Allah all matters are returned.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ الْتَقَيْتُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ wa-idh yurīkumūhum idhi l-taqaytum fī aʿyunikum qalīlan wayuqallilukum fī aʿyunihim liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru And (remember) when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you (appear) as few in their eyes so that Allah might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allah are (all) matters returned. See 8:43

item.title: Al-Anfaal:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ الْتَقَيْتُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ wa-idh yurīkumūhum idhi l-taqaytum fī aʿyunikum qalīlan wayuqallilukum fī aʿyunihim liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru And (remember) when He showed them to you when ye met, as few in your eyes and He reduced you to appear as few in their eyes in order God may enact the matter which had been destined to be done; and unto God (alone) will return all matters. If the believers had been shown to the infidels in the hugeness in the beginning itself as they were done later on, the heathens would have fled and the victory which was decreed by God would not have been achieved as it was made quite obvious to the infidels that God was with…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītum fi-atan fa-uth'butū wa-udh'kurū l-laha kathīran laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna O you who have faith! When you meet a host [in battle], then stand firm, and remember Allah greatly so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītum fi-atan fa-uth'butū wa-udh'kurū l-laha kathīran laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna O you who have believed, when you encounter a company (from the enemy forces), stand firm and remember Allah much that you may be successful. O you who believe! When you meet (an enemy) force, take a firm stand against them and remember Allah much, so that you may be successful (8:45). And obey Allah and His Messenger, and do not dispute (with one another) lest you lose courage and your strength departs, and be patient. Surely, Allah is with the patients (8:46). Manners of War Allah instructs His faithful servants in the manners of fighting and methods of courage when meeting the enemy in battle: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا O you…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītum fi-atan fa-uth'butū wa-udh'kurū l-laha kathīran laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna O' ye who believe! when ye meet a party (the contingent of the infidels) then be firm, and remember God much (This indicates that (jehad) is one of the devotional rites which needs the ('Neeyat al-Qurbat'). Refer to note to verses 8:45 3:12, 8:66.) , that ye be successful. See 8:44

item.title: Al-Anfaal:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَنَازَعُوْۤا فَتَفْشَلُوا وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ وَاصْبِرُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tanāzaʿū fatafshalū watadhhaba rīḥukum wa-iṣ'birū inna l-laha maʿa l-ṣābirīna And obey Allah and His Apostle, and do not dispute, or you will lose heart and your power will be gone. And be patient; indeed Allah is with the patient.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَنَازَعُوْۤا فَتَفْشَلُوا وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ وَاصْبِرُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tanāzaʿū fatafshalū watadhhaba rīḥukum wa-iṣ'birū inna l-laha maʿa l-ṣābirīna And obey Allah and His Messenger, and do not dispute and (thus) lose courage and (then) your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allah is with the patient. See 8:45

item.title: Al-Anfaal:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَنَازَعُوْۤا فَتَفْشَلُوا وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ وَاصْبِرُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tanāzaʿū fatafshalū watadhhaba rīḥukum wa-iṣ'birū inna l-laha maʿa l-ṣābirīna And obey ye God and His Apostle (Muhammad) and quarrel (Outcome of the disobedience to God and the Holy Prophet.) ye not, for then ye will be weakened in heart, and will depart your power and be patient; Verily God is with the patient ones. See 8:44

item.title: Al-Anfaal:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ خَرَجُوْۤا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بَطَرًا وَرِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna kharajū min diyārihim baṭaran wariāa l-nāsi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wal-lahu bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭun Do not be like those who left their homes vainly and to show off to the people, and to bar [other people] from the way of Allah, and Allah comprehends what they do.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ خَرَجُوْۤا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بَطَرًا وَرِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna kharajū min diyārihim baṭaran wariāa l-nāsi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wal-lahu bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭun And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert (them) from the way of Allah. And Allah is encompassing1 of what they do. And be not like those who come out of their homes boastfully and to be seen of men, and hinder (men) from the path of Allah; and Allah is 'Muhīt' (eneompassing and thoroughly comprehending) all that they do (8:47). And (remember) when Shaytan made their (evil) deeds seem fair to them and said, No one of mankind can overcome you this day (of the battle of Badr) and verily, I am…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ خَرَجُوْۤا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بَطَرًا وَرِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna kharajū min diyārihim baṭaran wariāa l-nāsi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wal-lahu bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭun And (The Holy Prophet said: I am not afraid of my followers becoming open polytheists (Shirk al-jali), but I am afraid of their becoming victims of the Shirk al-Khafi i.e. the hidden polytheism of 'Ria' - i.e. doing good for show and not for God. Another tradition says, 'Shirk' in my followers is more concealed than the movement of the black ant on a black rock in a dark night.) be ye not like those who got out from their homes boastfully to be seen of men and (yet) who obstruct others from the way of God; and verily God encompasseth what they do. On the…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَإِنِّي جَارٌ لَكُمْ فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَتِ الْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِنْكُمْ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ اللَّهَ وَاللَّهُ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ wa-idh zayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum waqāla lā ghāliba lakumu l-yawma mina l-nāsi wa-innī jārun lakum falammā tarāati l-fi-atāni nakaṣa ʿalā ʿaqibayhi waqāla innī barīon minkum innī arā mā lā tarawna innī akhāfu l-laha wal-lahu shadīdu l-ʿiqābi When Satan made their deeds seem decorous to them, and said, 'No one shall overcome you today from among all mankind, and I will stand by you.' But when the two hosts sighted each other, he took to his heels, saying, 'Indeed I am quit of you. I see what you do not see. Indeed I fear Allah, and Allah is severe in retribution.'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَإِنِّي جَارٌ لَكُمْ فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَتِ الْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِنْكُمْ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ اللَّهَ وَاللَّهُ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ wa-idh zayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum waqāla lā ghāliba lakumu l-yawma mina l-nāsi wa-innī jārun lakum falammā tarāati l-fi-atāni nakaṣa ʿalā ʿaqibayhi waqāla innī barīon minkum innī arā mā lā tarawna innī akhāfu l-laha wal-lahu shadīdu l-ʿiqābi And (remember) when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed, I fear Allah. And Allah is severe in penalty." See…
