item.title: Al-Anfaal:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَإِنِّي جَارٌ لَكُمْ فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَتِ الْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِنْكُمْ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ اللَّهَ وَاللَّهُ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ wa-idh zayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum waqāla lā ghāliba lakumu l-yawma mina l-nāsi wa-innī jārun lakum falammā tarāati l-fi-atāni nakaṣa ʿalā ʿaqibayhi waqāla innī barīon minkum innī arā mā lā tarawna innī akhāfu l-laha wal-lahu shadīdu l-ʿiqābi And (remember) when made Satan seem alluring to them their (sinful) deeds and said (unto them) "None among men shall triumph over you today, while I am a protector for you," but when the two parties came in sight of each other, he turned upon his heels and said: "Verily I disassociate (myself) from you; Verily, I see what ye see not; and Verily God is severe in…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ غَرَّ هَؤُلَاءِ دِينُهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun gharra hāulāi dīnuhum waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fa-inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun When the hypocrites said, and [also] those in whose hearts is a sickness, 'Their religion has deceived them.' But whoever puts his trust in Allah, then Allah is indeed all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ غَرَّ هَؤُلَاءِ دِينُهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun gharra hāulāi dīnuhum waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fa-inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun (Remember) when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease (i.e., arrogance and disbelief) said, "Their religion has deluded those (Muslims)." But whoever relies upon Allah - then indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise. See 8:47

item.title: Al-Anfaal:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ غَرَّ هَؤُلَاءِ دِينُهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun gharra hāulāi dīnuhum waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fa-inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun When say the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease: "Their religion hath beguiled these (Muslims)" And whoever relieth upon God, then God is All-Mighty, All-Wise. See 8:48

item.title: Al-Anfaal:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ وَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ walaw tarā idh yatawaffā alladhīna kafarū l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi Were you to see when the angels take away the faithless, striking their faces and their backs, [saying], 'Taste the punishment of the burning.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ وَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ walaw tarā idh yatawaffā alladhīna kafarū l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved...1 They are striking their faces and their backs and (saying), "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire. And if you could see when the angels take away the souls of those who disbelieve (at death); they smite their faces and their backs, (saying): "Taste the punishment of the blazing Fire (8:50). "This is because of that which your hands forwarded. And verily, Allah is not unjust to His servants (8:51). The Angels Smite the Disbelievers upon Capturing Their Souls Allah says, if you witnessed the angels capturing the souls of the disbelievers, you would witness a tremendous, terrible,…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ وَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ walaw tarā idh yatawaffā alladhīna kafarū l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi And hadst thou seen when the angels take away the souls (Refers to the heavenly help given to the Muslims) of those who disbelieve, smiting their faces and their backs, (and saying)-. "Taste ye the torment of burning (Hell-fire)." See 8:48

item.title: Al-Anfaal:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi That is because of what your hands have sent ahead, and because Allah is not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi That is for what your hands have put forth (of evil) and because Allah is not ever unjust to (His) servants." See 8:50

item.title: Al-Anfaal:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi This is for what sent forth your own hands, and that God is not unjust unto the servants. See 8:48

item.title: Al-Anfaal:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kafarū biāyāti l-lahi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim inna l-laha qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqābi Like the precedent of Pharaoh's clan and those who were before them, who defied Allah's signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. Indeed Allah is all-strong, severe in retribution.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kafarū biāyāti l-lahi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim inna l-laha qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqābi (Theirs is) like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allah, so Allah seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and severe in penalty. Similar to the behavior of the people of Fir'awn, and of those before them – they rejected the Ayat of Allah, so Allah punished them for their sins. Verily, Allah is All-Strong, severe in punishment (8:52). Allah says, 'The behavior of these rebellious disbelievers against what I sent you with, O Muhammad, is similar to the behavior of earlier disbelieving nations. So We behaved with them according to Our…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kafarū biāyāti l-lahi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim inna l-laha qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqābi (Because they acted) like the people of Pharaoh and those before them; disbelieved they in the signs of God, so did God seize them for their sins; Verily God is Strong, severe in punishment. The comparison (of the disbelievers of Mecca to those of the people of Pharaoh is an indication to the likeness of the Holy Prophet to Moses. It is also a prophecy of the total destruction of the infidels as was done to the people of Pharaoh. 'Aal', i.e., the nearest relation is a wide term which includes any person who is connected with the person in some way or other. Hence 'Aali-Fir'awn'…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَى قَوْمٍ حَتّٰی يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ dhālika bi-anna l-laha lam yaku mughayyiran niʿ'matan anʿamahā ʿalā qawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā bi-anfusihim wa-anna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun That is because Allah never changes a blessing that He has bestowed on a people unless they change what is in their own souls, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing:

item.title: Al-Anfaal:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَى قَوْمٍ حَتّٰی يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ dhālika bi-anna l-laha lam yaku mughayyiran niʿ'matan anʿamahā ʿalā qawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā bi-anfusihim wa-anna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun That is because Allah would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing. That is so because Allah will never change a grace which He has bestowed on a people until they change what is in themselves. And verily, Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower (8:53). Similar to the behavior of the people of Fir'awn, and those before them. They belied the Ayat of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Fir'awn for they were all wrongdoers (8:54). Allah affirms His…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَى قَوْمٍ حَتّٰی يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ dhālika bi-anna l-laha lam yaku mughayyiran niʿ'matan anʿamahā ʿalā qawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā bi-anfusihim wa-anna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun This because God changeth not any favour (which) He bestoweth upon a people until they (themselves) change their own selves (This indicates that people's choice and deeds are responsible for their misfortunes) , and that God is All- Seeing, All-Hearing. See 8:52

item.title: Al-Anfaal:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kadhabū biāyāti rabbihim fa-ahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim wa-aghraqnā āla fir'ʿawna wakullun kānū ẓālimīna Like the precedent of Pharaoh's clan and those who were before them, who denied the signs of their Lord; so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned Pharaoh's clan; and they were all wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kadhabū biāyāti rabbihim fa-ahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim wa-aghraqnā āla fir'ʿawna wakullun kānū ẓālimīna (Theirs is) like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all (of them) were wrongdoers. See 8:53

item.title: Al-Anfaal:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kadhabū biāyāti rabbihim fa-ahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim wa-aghraqnā āla fir'ʿawna wakullun kānū ẓālimīna (Because they acted) like the people of Pharaoh and those before them; they belied the signs of their Lord, so did We destroy them for their sins, and We did drown the people of Pharaoh; and all (of them) were unjust (tyrants). See 8:52

item.title: Al-Anfaal:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi alladhīna kafarū fahum lā yu'minūna Indeed the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are those who are faithless; so they will not have faith.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi alladhīna kafarū fahum lā yu'minūna Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are those who have disbelieved, and they will not (ever) believe. Verily, the worst of living creatures before Allah are those who disbelieve, – so they shall not believe (8:55). They are those with whom you made a covenant, but they break their covenant every time and they do not have Taqwa (8:56). So if you gain the mastery over them in war, then disperse those who are behind them, so that they may learn a lesson (8:57). Striking Hard against Those Who Disbelieve and Break the Covenants Allah states here that the worst moving creatures on the face of the earth are those who disbelieve, who do not…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi alladhīna kafarū fahum lā yu'minūna Verily the vilest of animals (Disbelievers compared to vilest animals, and in 25:44 said to be worse than the animals. Refer to verses 25:44, 47:12 .) in God's view are those who disbelieve, for they would not believe. See Verses 25:44, 8:55, 47:12.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتَ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ alladhīna ʿāhadtta min'hum thumma yanquḍūna ʿahdahum fī kulli marratin wahum lā yattaqūna —Those with whom you made a treaty, and who violated their treaty every time, and who are not Godwary.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتَ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ alladhīna ʿāhadtta min'hum thumma yanquḍūna ʿahdahum fī kulli marratin wahum lā yattaqūna The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allah. See 8:55

item.title: Al-Anfaal:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتَ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ alladhīna ʿāhadtta min'hum thumma yanquḍūna ʿahdahum fī kulli marratin wahum lā yattaqūna Those (O' Our Apostle!) with whom thou didst make a covenant (Indicates what a severe crime is the violation of the covenant made with God - Compare with the Covenant made with the Muslims at 'Ghadir Khumm'.) then they break their covenant every time, and they guard not themselves (against evil). The Jewish tribe Bani Quraiza had entered into a treaty with the Muslims that they would not assist the infidels, but in Badr they helped the heathens with arms. When brought to account for their treacherous conduct, they said that they had forgotten but they again allied themselves with the heathens at Khandaq. The reference here is to their conduct.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ fa-immā tathqafannahum fī l-ḥarbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum laʿallahum yadhakkarūna So if you confront them in battle, treat them [in such a wise] as to disperse those who are behind them, so that they may take admonition.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ fa-immā tathqafannahum fī l-ḥarbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum laʿallahum yadhakkarūna So if you, (O Muḥammad), gain dominance over them in war, disperse by (means of) them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.1 See 8:55

item.title: Al-Anfaal:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ fa-immā tathqafannahum fī l-ḥarbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum laʿallahum yadhakkarūna So, when thou taketh them in fighting, scatter (by punishing) them (making them an example) for those who come after them, that they may remember (Be mindful – warned. To stop the enemy front any further treachery or mischief and bloodshed - with an exemplary punishment.) . See 8:56

item.title: Al-Anfaal:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِنْ قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانْبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْخَائِنِينَ wa-immā takhāfanna min qawmin khiyānatan fa-inbidh ilayhim ʿalā sawāin inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-khāinīna And if you fear treachery from a people, break off [the treaty] with them in a like manner. Indeed Allah does not like the treacherous.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِنْ قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانْبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْخَائِنِينَ wa-immā takhāfanna min qawmin khiyānatan fa-inbidh ilayhim ʿalā sawāin inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-khāinīna If you (have reason to) fear from a people betrayal, throw (their treaty) back to them, (putting you) on equal terms.1 Indeed, Allah does not like traitors. If you fear treachery from any people, throw back (their covenant) to them (so as to be) on equal terms. Certainly Allah likes not the treacherous.) make a heading, Allah says to His Prophet (SAW (58) وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ If you fear from any people Which is with whom you have a treaty of peace: خِيَانَةً treachery And betrayal of peace treaties and agreements that you have conducted with them: فَانبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ then throw back (their covenant) to them Which is meaning their treaty…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِنْ قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانْبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْخَائِنِينَ wa-immā takhāfanna min qawmin khiyānatan fa-inbidh ilayhim ʿalā sawāin inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-khāinīna And if thou fearest treachery from a people, then throw (Justly i.e. to inform them of the giving up of the Covenant so that they may not accuse him of treachery. (A.P.).) back unto them (their covenant) on equal terms; Verily God loveth not the treacherous ones. Even repudiation to unfaithfulness on the part of the enemy has to be only in equal measure. Note, it is only a defensive measure and not offensive. Islam under the Holy Prophet has never inflicted on any one any unprovoked aggression at any time.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا سَبَقُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū sabaqū innahum lā yuʿ'jizūna Let the faithless not suppose that they have outmaneuvered [Allah]. Indeed they cannot thwart [His power].

item.title: Al-Anfaal:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا سَبَقُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū sabaqū innahum lā yuʿ'jizūna And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure (to Allah). And let not those who disbelieve think that they can outstrip (escape from the punishment). Verily, they will never be able to save themselves (from Allah's punishment) (8:59). And make ready against them all you can of power, including steeds of war to threaten the enemy of Allah and your enemy, and others besides them, whom you may not know but whom Allah does know. And whatever you shall spend in the cause of Allah shall be repaid unto you, and you shall not be treated unjustly (8:60). Making Preparations for War to Strike Fear in the Hearts of the Enemies of Allah Allah says to…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا سَبَقُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū sabaqū innahum lā yuʿ'jizūna And let not those who disbelieve think that they have excelled (Or they are ahead of.) (the Muslims): verily they shall not weaken (God). See 8:58

item.title: Al-Anfaal:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَمِنْ رِبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ وَمَا تُنْفِقُوْۤا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ wa-aʿiddū lahum mā is'taṭaʿtum min quwwatin wamin ribāṭi l-khayli tur'hibūna bihi ʿaduwwa l-lahi waʿaduwwakum waākharīna min dūnihim lā taʿlamūnahumu l-lahu yaʿlamuhum wamā tunfiqū min shayin fī sabīli l-lahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa-antum lā tuẓ'lamūna Prepare against them whatever you can of [military] power and war-horses, awing thereby the enemy of Allah, and your enemy, and others besides them, whom you do not know, but Allah knows them. And whatever you spend in the way of Allah will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَمِنْ رِبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ وَمَا تُنْفِقُوْۤا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ wa-aʿiddū lahum mā is'taṭaʿtum min quwwatin wamin ribāṭi l-khayli tur'hibūna bihi ʿaduwwa l-lahi waʿaduwwakum waākharīna min dūnihim lā taʿlamūnahumu l-lahu yaʿlamuhum wamā tunfiqū min shayin fī sabīli l-lahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa-antum lā tuẓ'lamūna And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war1 by which you may terrify the enemy of Allah and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know (but) whom Allah knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allah will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged. See 8:59

item.title: Al-Anfaal:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَمِنْ رِبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ وَمَا تُنْفِقُوْۤا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ wa-aʿiddū lahum mā is'taṭaʿtum min quwwatin wamin ribāṭi l-khayli tur'hibūna bihi ʿaduwwa l-lahi waʿaduwwakum waākharīna min dūnihim lā taʿlamūnahumu l-lahu yaʿlamuhum wamā tunfiqū min shayin fī sabīli l-lahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa-antum lā tuẓ'lamūna And prepare ye against them whatever (force) ye can (To your utmost ability in any form or manner - economically, physically, spiritually.) and steeds of war at the garrison to frighten the enemy of God thereby and your enemy and others besides them, whom ye know not, (but) God knoweth them; and whatever things ye spend (This indicates that any effort or wealth subscribed for the defence forces with pure intention is counted as…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ جَنَحُوْۤا لِلسَّلْمِ فَاجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ wa-in janaḥū lilssalmi fa-ij'naḥ lahā watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And if they incline toward peace, then you [too] incline toward it, and put your trust in Allah. Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ جَنَحُوْۤا لِلسَّلْمِ فَاجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ wa-in janaḥū lilssalmi fa-ij'naḥ lahā watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And if they incline to peace, then incline to it (also) and rely upon Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing. But if they incline to peace, you also incline to it, and trust in Allah. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower (8:61). And if they intend to deceive you, then verily, Allah is All-Sufficient for you. He it is Who has supported you with His help and with the believers (8:62). And He has united their (believers') hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have united their hearts, but Allah has united them. Certainly He is All-Mighty, All-Wise (8:63). The Command to Facilitate…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ جَنَحُوْۤا لِلسَّلْمِ فَاجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ wa-in janaḥū lilssalmi fa-ij'naḥ lahā watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And if they lean to peace, then leaneth thou too to it, and trust in God; Verily He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing (Refer to verse 4:90.) . If the enemy be inclined to peace, to grant them peace depending upon (God's help). This verse clears the position of Islam and the Holy Prophet to show whether they were defensive or offensive in their attitude towards the non-Muslims.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُرِيدُوْۤا أَنْ يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ اللَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِي أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِ وَبِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-in yurīdū an yakhdaʿūka fa-inna ḥasbaka l-lahu huwa alladhī ayyadaka binaṣrihi wabil-mu'minīna But if they desire to deceive you, Allah is indeed sufficient for you. It is He who strengthened you with His help and with the means of the faithful,

item.title: Al-Anfaal:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُرِيدُوْۤا أَنْ يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ اللَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِي أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِ وَبِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-in yurīdū an yakhdaʿūka fa-inna ḥasbaka l-lahu huwa alladhī ayyadaka binaṣrihi wabil-mu'minīna But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allah. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers. See 8:61

item.title: Al-Anfaal:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُرِيدُوْۤا أَنْ يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ اللَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِي أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِ وَبِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-in yurīdū an yakhdaʿūka fa-inna ḥasbaka l-lahu huwa alladhī ayyadaka binaṣrihi wabil-mu'minīna And if they intend to deceive thee, then verily God sufficeth for thee (Refer to verse 33:25.) ; He it is Who strengthened thee with His help and with the believers (Those who never deserted him - like 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib.) . Mullah Jalahuddin Suyuti in his renowned commentary on the Holy Qur'an 'al-Durr al-Manthur' relates that Ibn Asakir reported that the Holy Prophet said that the following words were written on the Arsh or the Central Seat of the Divinity of God: "God, I am alone, there is no partner with Me, Muhammad My servant and Apostle, I helped him with 'Ali." And this is the meaning of this verse (D.M.). The same statement…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ لَوْ أَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-allafa bayna qulūbihim law anfaqta mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan mā allafta bayna qulūbihim walākinna l-laha allafa baynahum innahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmun and united their hearts. Had you spent all that is in the earth, you could not have united their hearts, but Allah united them together. Indeed He is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ لَوْ أَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-allafa bayna qulūbihim law anfaqta mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan mā allafta bayna qulūbihim walākinna l-laha allafa baynahum innahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmun And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allah brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise. See 8:61

item.title: Al-Anfaal:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ لَوْ أَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-allafa bayna qulūbihim law anfaqta mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan mā allafta bayna qulūbihim walākinna l-laha allafa baynahum innahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmun Caused He affection (Refers to - The unity and the power achieved by the believers as the result of which they overcame the most formidable enemies, which was not based on any terrestrial resources but purely spiritual. It is a warning to the Muslims to always resort to this unsurmountable force (i.e. God's).) between their hearts; had thou spent all that is in the earth thou couldst not have caused that affection between their hearts, but God caused affection between them; Verily He is All-Mighty, All-Wise. See 8:62

item.title: Al-Anfaal:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسْبُكَ اللَّهُ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥasbuka l-lahu wamani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna O Prophet! Sufficient for you is Allah and those of the faithful who follow you.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسْبُكَ اللَّهُ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥasbuka l-lahu wamani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allah and for whoever follows you of the believers. O Prophet! Allah is sufficient for you and for the believers who follow you (8:64). O Prophet! Urge the believers to fight. If there are twenty steadfast persons among you, they will overcome two hundred, and if there be a hundred steadfast persons they will overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they (the disbelievers) are people who do not understand (8:65). Now Allah has lightened your (task), for He knows that there is weakness in you. So if there are of you a hundred steadfast persons, they shall overcome two hundred, and if there are a thousand of you, they shall overcome two thousand by the leave…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسْبُكَ اللَّهُ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥasbuka l-lahu wamani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna O'(Our) Apostle (Muhammad!) Sufficeth for thee God and those of the believers who follow thee. Mullah Abdur Razzaq Muhaddis Hambali says that this verse was revealed specially about 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib. A knowledge of the true history of Islam is needed to know fully about the truth in this statement.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوْۤا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا أَلْفًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥarriḍi l-mu'minīna ʿalā l-qitāli in yakun minkum ʿish'rūna ṣābirūna yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum mi-atun yaghlibū alfan mina alladhīna kafarū bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūna O Prophet! Urge on the faithful to fight: If there be twenty patient men among you, they shall overcome two hundred; and if there be a hundred of you, they shall overcome a thousand of the faithless, for they are a lot who do not understand.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوْۤا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا أَلْفًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥarriḍi l-mu'minīna ʿalā l-qitāli in yakun minkum ʿish'rūna ṣābirūna yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum mi-atun yaghlibū alfan mina alladhīna kafarū bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūna O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty (who are) steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred (who are steadfast), they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand. See 8:64

item.title: Al-Anfaal:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوْۤا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا أَلْفًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥarriḍi l-mu'minīna ʿalā l-qitāli in yakun minkum ʿish'rūna ṣābirūna yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum mi-atun yaghlibū alfan mina alladhīna kafarū bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūna O' (Our) Apostle (Muhammad!) Urge the believers to war; if there be of you twenty patient ones, they shall overcome two hundred (of the infidels), and if there be of you a hundred (such ones) they shall overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve for they are a people who understand not (This Verse is supported by the following Verse. The physical strength of the Muslims particularly at Badr was so poor that the Muslims naturally needed an encouragement) . The reference to the ratio of the believers…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْءَانَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا فَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ al-āna khaffafa l-lahu ʿankum waʿalima anna fīkum ḍaʿfan fa-in yakun minkum mi-atun ṣābiratun yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum alfun yaghlibū alfayni bi-idh'ni l-lahi wal-lahu maʿa l-ṣābirīna Now Allah has lightened your burden, knowing that there is weakness in you. So if there be a hundred patient men among you, they shall overcome two hundred; and if there be a thousand, they shall overcome two thousand, by Allah's leave; and Allah is with the patient.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْءَانَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا فَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ al-āna khaffafa l-lahu ʿankum waʿalima anna fīkum ḍaʿfan fa-in yakun minkum mi-atun ṣābiratun yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum alfun yaghlibū alfayni bi-idh'ni l-lahi wal-lahu maʿa l-ṣābirīna Now, Allah has lightened (the hardship) for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred (who are) steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allah. And Allah is with the steadfast. See 8:64

item.title: Al-Anfaal:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْءَانَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا فَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا مِائَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوْۤا أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ al-āna khaffafa l-lahu ʿankum waʿalima anna fīkum ḍaʿfan fa-in yakun minkum mi-atun ṣābiratun yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum alfun yaghlibū alfayni bi-idh'ni l-lahi wal-lahu maʿa l-ṣābirīna For the present God hath lightened your burden and knoweth He that in you there is weakness; and if there be of you a hundred patient ones, they shall overcome two hundred (of the infidels) and if there be of you a thousand (patient ones), they shall overcome two thousand (of the infidels) with God's permission; and (verily) God is with the patient ones (Refer to verses 3:12, 8:44.) . See 8:65

item.title: Al-Anfaal:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرٰی حَتّٰی يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ mā kāna linabiyyin an yakūna lahu asrā ḥattā yuth'khina fī l-arḍi turīdūna ʿaraḍa l-dun'yā wal-lahu yurīdu l-ākhirata wal-lahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmun A prophet may not take captives until he has thoroughly decimated [the enemy] in the land. You desire the transitory gains of this world, while Allah desires [for you] [the reward of] the Hereafter, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرٰی حَتّٰی يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ mā kāna linabiyyin an yakūna lahu asrā ḥattā yuth'khina fī l-arḍi turīdūna ʿaraḍa l-dun'yā wal-lahu yurīdu l-ākhirata wal-lahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmun It is not for a prophet to have captives (of war) until he inflicts a massacre (upon Allah's enemies) in the land. You (i.e., some Muslims) desire the commodities of this world,1 but Allah desires (for you) the Hereafter. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise. It is not (fitting) for a Prophet that he should have prisoners of war until he has fought (his enemies thoroughly) in the land. You desire the goods of this world, but Allah desires (for you) the Hereafter. And Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise (8:67). Were it not a previous ordainment from Allah, a…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرٰی حَتّٰی يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ mā kāna linabiyyin an yakūna lahu asrā ḥattā yuth'khina fī l-arḍi turīdūna ʿaraḍa l-dun'yā wal-lahu yurīdu l-ākhirata wal-lahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmun It befitteth not an apostle (of God) that there be for him captives unless he hath fought (the infidels in war) in the earth; ye desire the frail goods of this world, while God desireth (for you) the hereafter; And God is All-Mighty, All-Wise (Refer to verses 47:4, 8:7.) . The Holy Prophet is said to have consulted his companions about the captives of the heathens at Badr. Abu Bakr said since most of them were the relatives of the Holy Prophet, blood-money be collected from them and they might be set free. Hamza, the uncle of the Holy Prophet,…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ lawlā kitābun mina l-lahi sabaqa lamassakum fīmā akhadhtum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Had it not been for a prior decree of Allah, surely there would have befallen you a great punishment for what you took.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ lawlā kitābun mina l-lahi sabaqa lamassakum fīmā akhadhtum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun If not for a decree from Allah that preceded,1 you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment. See 8:67

item.title: Al-Anfaal:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ lawlā kitābun mina l-lahi sabaqa lamassakum fīmā akhadhtum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Had it not been for an ordinance from God that hath already gone before, surely would have afflicted you, for what ye took (The ransom from the captives of Badr.) , a great chastisement (Refer to note to verses 8:67, 9:43.) . While leaving Mecca for the battle of Badr, Abbas had secretly left his wealth with his wife and carried with him only too coins of gold which he had surrendered as the booty. When the question of the payment of the ransom money came, the ransom for Aqeel, Naofil-Ibn-Harth Ibn Abdul Malik also was demanded from Abbas. Abbas told the Holy Prophet that he had embraced Islam, and the heathens had forced him to accompany them to the…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلُوْۤا مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ fakulū mimmā ghanim'tum ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun Avail yourselves of the spoils you have taken as lawful and good, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلُوْۤا مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ fakulū mimmā ghanim'tum ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun So consume what you have taken of war booty (as being) lawful and good, and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. See 8:67

item.title: Al-Anfaal:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلُوْۤا مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ fakulū mimmā ghanim'tum ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun Eat then of what ye acquired in war, of things (which be) lawful and good, and fear ye God; Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful (Refer to note to verse 8:67.) . Since the preceding verse indicating the displeasure of God on receiving the ransom money from the captives had come, some faithful ones had refused to receive anything from that amount. It was for such people this verse was revealed. (M.F.A.).

item.title: Al-Anfaal:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِمَنْ فِي أَيْدِيكُمْ مِنَ الْأَسْرٰی إِنْ يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِمَّا أُخِذَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul liman fī aydīkum mina l-asrā in yaʿlami l-lahu fī qulūbikum khayran yu'tikum khayran mimmā ukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O Prophet! Say to the captives who are in your hands, 'If Allah finds any good in your hearts, He will give you [something which is] better than what has been taken away from you, and He will forgive you, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: Al-Anfaal:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِمَنْ فِي أَيْدِيكُمْ مِنَ الْأَسْرٰی إِنْ يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِمَّا أُخِذَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul liman fī aydīkum mina l-asrā in yaʿlami l-lahu fī qulūbikum khayran yu'tikum khayran mimmā ukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allah knows (any) good in your hearts, He will give you (something) better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful." O Prophet! Say to the captives that are in your hands: If Allah knows any good in your hearts, He will give you something better than what has been taken from you, and He will forgive you, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (8:70). But if they intend to…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِمَنْ فِي أَيْدِيكُمْ مِنَ الْأَسْرٰی إِنْ يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِمَّا أُخِذَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul liman fī aydīkum mina l-asrā in yaʿlami l-lahu fī qulūbikum khayran yu'tikum khayran mimmā ukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O' (Our) Apostle (Muhammad!) Say unto the captives in your hands; "If knoweth God any good in your hearts, He will give you better than what hath been taken away from you (This tone of leniency and toleration towards the captives is a clear indication that God never intended their lives to be ended but to give them respite.) , and (He) will forgive you; and verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful." Once when some wealth had come from some place, the Holy Prophet told Abbas to spread his cloak and…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُرِيدُوْۤا خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوْۤا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-in yurīdū khiyānataka faqad khānū l-laha min qablu fa-amkana min'hum wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun But if they seek to betray you, then they have already betrayed Allah earlier, and He gave [you] power over them; and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُرِيدُوْۤا خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوْۤا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-in yurīdū khiyānataka faqad khānū l-laha min qablu fa-amkana min'hum wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allah before, and He empowered (you) over them. And Allah is Knowing and Wise. See 8:70

item.title: Al-Anfaal:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُرِيدُوْۤا خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوْۤا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-in yurīdū khiyānataka faqad khānū l-laha min qablu fa-amkana min'hum wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun And if they intend to be un-faithful towards thee, so indeed have they been unfaithful to God from before, but He gave you power over them (Even for the repetition of treachery on the part of the captured enemy, killing has not been ordered.) ; and verily God is the All Knowing, The All-Wise. See 8:70

item.title: Al-Anfaal:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ ءَاوَوْا وَنَصَرُوْۤا اُولٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوْۤا مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ وَلَايَتِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی يُهَاجِرُوْۤا وَإِنِ اسْتَنْصَرُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ النَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَى قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ مِيثَاقٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ inna alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wa-alladhīna āmanū walam yuhājirū mā lakum min walāyatihim min shayin ḥattā yuhājirū wa-ini is'tanṣarūkum fī l-dīni faʿalaykumu l-naṣru illā ʿalā qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mīthāqun wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Indeed those who have believed and migrated and waged jihād with their possessions and persons in the way of Allah, and those who gave [them] shelter and help —they are heirs of one another. As for those who have believed but did not migrate, you have no heirdom in relation…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ ءَاوَوْا وَنَصَرُوْۤا اُولٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوْۤا مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ وَلَايَتِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی يُهَاجِرُوْۤا وَإِنِ اسْتَنْصَرُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ النَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَى قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ مِيثَاقٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ inna alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wa-alladhīna āmanū walam yuhājirū mā lakum min walāyatihim min shayin ḥattā yuhājirū wa-ini is'tanṣarūkum fī l-dīni faʿalaykumu l-naṣru illā ʿalā qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mīthāqun wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allah and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no support of them…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ ءَاوَوْا وَنَصَرُوْۤا اُولٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوْۤا مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ وَلَايَتِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی يُهَاجِرُوْۤا وَإِنِ اسْتَنْصَرُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ النَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَى قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ مِيثَاقٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ inna alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wa-alladhīna āmanū walam yuhājirū mā lakum min walāyatihim min shayin ḥattā yuhājirū wa-ini is'tanṣarūkum fī l-dīni faʿalaykumu l-naṣru illā ʿalā qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mīthāqun wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Verily those who believed and migrated and strove with their properties and their selves (Lives.) in the way of God, and those who gave shelter and helped, these are the guardians of one another; and those who believed and they did not migrate, not yours is their guardianship until they…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ wa-alladhīna kafarū baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin illā tafʿalūhu takun fit'natun fī l-arḍi wafasādun kabīrun As for the faithless, they are allies of one another. Unless you do the same, there will be turmoil on the earth and great corruption.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ wa-alladhīna kafarū baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin illā tafʿalūhu takun fit'natun fī l-arḍi wafasādun kabīrun And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so (i.e., ally yourselves with other believers), there will be fitnah (i.e., disbelief and oppression) on earth and great corruption. And those who disbelieve are allies of one another, (and) if you (Muslims) do not do so (protect one another), there will be Fitnah on the earth, and great corruption (8:73). The Disbelievers are Allies of Each Other; the Muslims are Not their Allies After Allah mentioned that the believers are the supporters of one another, He severed all ties of support between them and the disbelievers. In his Mustadrak, Al-Hakim recorded that Usamah said that the Prophet SAW said:…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ wa-alladhīna kafarū baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin illā tafʿalūhu takun fit'natun fī l-arḍi wafasādun kabīrun And those who disbelieve, some of them are the guardians of the others; unless ye do (To protect or help each other. Refer to verse 8:72.) this, there will be discord in the earth and a great mischief. The Brotherhood among the believers is given in two stages: The brotherhood: Between 'MuHajjir' and 'Ansar'. Between the believers 'MuHajjirs' and those who had embraced the faith but not migrated and joined the faithful later. There is no brotherhood between these two groups but if the believers who stayed back needed any help the believer emigrants and the helpers shall render the help, but this also should be against infidels with whom the believers had not…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ ءَاوَوْا وَنَصَرُوْۤا اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun Those who have believed, migrated, and waged jihād in the way of Allah, and those who gave them shelter and help, it is they who are truly the faithful. For them shall be forgiveness and a noble provision.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ ءَاوَوْا وَنَصَرُوْۤا اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allah and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision. And those who believed, and emigrated and strove hard in the cause of Allah (Al-Jihad), as well as those who gave (them) asylum and aid – these are the believers in truth, for them is forgiveness and a generous provision (8:74). And those who believed afterwards, and emigrated and strove hard along with you, they are of you. But kindred by blood are nearer to one another…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ ءَاوَوْا وَنَصَرُوْۤا اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun And those who believed and migrated (Refer to verse 9:20. The main consideration is faith, and the migration an endeavour for faith. If migration is to be taken as deserting the society of the infidels and joining the society of the believers, the application of this Verse remains valid forever.) and strove in the way of God, and those who gave shelter and helped, those are the believers truly; for them is forgiveness and an honourable provision. This verse lays down the qualities which entitle one to be in fact a believer. One should satisfy all the conditions laid down in this verse. One…

item.title: Al-Anfaal:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا مَعَكُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ مِنْكُمْ وَأُولُوْۤا الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū min baʿdu wahājarū wajāhadū maʿakum fa-ulāika minkum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun And those who believed afterwards and migrated, and waged jihād along with you, they belong to you; but the blood relatives are more entitled to inherit from one another in the Book of Allah.1 Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: Al-Anfaal:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا مَعَكُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ مِنْكُمْ وَأُولُوْۤا الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū min baʿdu wahājarū wajāhadū maʿakum fa-ulāika minkum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun And those who believed after (the initial emigration) and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of (blood) relationship are more entitled (to inheritance) in the decree of Allah.1 Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things. See 8:74

item.title: Al-Anfaal:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا مَعَكُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ مِنْكُمْ وَأُولُوْۤا الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū min baʿdu wahājarū wajāhadū maʿakum fa-ulāika minkum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun And those who believed later and migrated and strove with you, they are of you; and the blood relations are nearer to each other in the Book of God; Verily God, knoweth everything (Refer to verses 8:72, 33:60.) . See 8:74

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lām, Mīm.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lām, Meem.1 أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ Or think those who do evil deeds that they can outstrip Us Meaning: "escape" from Us. سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ Evil is that which they judge! what they think is evil.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif Lam Meem (A. L. M.). See 29:2

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يُتْرَكُوْۤا أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ aḥasiba l-nāsu an yut'rakū an yaqūlū āmannā wahum lā yuf'tanūna Do the people suppose that they will be let off because they say, 'We have faith,' and they will not be tested?

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يُتْرَكُوْۤا أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ aḥasiba l-nāsu an yut'rakū an yaqūlū āmannā wahum lā yuf'tanūna Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried? See 29:1

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يُتْرَكُوْۤا أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ aḥasiba l-nāsu an yut'rakū an yaqūlū āmannā wahum lā yuf'tanūna What! Do people imagine that they will be left off on (their) saying: "We believe!" and they will not be tried? This verse makes it quite clear that Islam aims at the reality and not mere verbal declaration. There is no illusion in Islam of any unconditional promise for the salvation of any individual at the mere profession of faith in any apostle of God or any saint without the individual disciplining his self according to the dictates of the faith, i.e., translating his faith into action in his practical life on earth and without the individual proving his conviction about the truth, by his bearing every Hardship and trial for it and remaining firm in his faith never yielding…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوْۤا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ walaqad fatannā alladhīna min qablihim falayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna ṣadaqū walayaʿlamanna l-kādhibīna Certainly We tested those who were before them. So Allah shall surely ascertain those who are truthful, and He shall surely ascertain the liars.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوْۤا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ walaqad fatannā alladhīna min qablihim falayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna ṣadaqū walayaʿlamanna l-kādhibīna But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars. See 29:1

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوْۤا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ walaqad fatannā alladhīna min qablihim falayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna ṣadaqū walayaʿlamanna l-kādhibīna And indeed We did try those before them, so God certainly knoweth (May make known.) those who are true, and certainly knoweth He the liars. Ali the First Holy Imam said that 'God's knowing' means the sifting of the true believers from the bogus ones, i.e., by distinguishing the righteous from the wicked. The Holy Prophet said that with this ministry the course of guidance through revelation by means of the Messenger Angel Gabriel will also end but the sword of mischief-mongers will remain and there will remain to the last, the differences and dissensions among the people through which the muslims will be tried and tested and the genuine among the believers will be distinguished from the…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَسْبِقُونَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ am ḥasiba alladhīna yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti an yasbiqūnā sāa mā yaḥkumūna Do those who commit misdeeds suppose that they can outmaneuver Us? Evil is the judgement that they make.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَسْبِقُونَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ am ḥasiba alladhīna yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti an yasbiqūnā sāa mā yaḥkumūna Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun (i.e., escape) Us? Evil is what they judge. See 29:1

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَسْبِقُونَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ am ḥasiba alladhīna yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti an yasbiqūnā sāa mā yaḥkumūna Or imagine they who work evil that they will escape Us? Ill it is what they judge. See 29:3

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ لَءَاتٍ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ man kāna yarjū liqāa l-lahi fa-inna ajala l-lahi laātin wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Whoever expects to encounter Allah [should know that] Allah's [appointed] time will indeed come, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ لَءَاتٍ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ man kāna yarjū liqāa l-lahi fa-inna ajala l-lahi laātin wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term (decreed by) Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing. Whoever hopes in meeting with Allah, then Allah's term is surely coming, and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower (29:5). And whosoever strives, he strives only for himself. Verily, Allah stands not in need of any of the creatures (29:6). Those who believe, and do righteous good deeds, surely, We shall expiate from them their evil deeds and We shall indeed reward them according to the best of that which they used to do (29:7). Allah will Fulfill the Hopes of the Righteous Allah's saying; مَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ Whoever hopes…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ لَءَاتٍ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ man kāna yarjū liqāa l-lahi fa-inna ajala l-lahi laātin wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Whoever hopeth to meet God and then verily the doom decreed by God shall certainly come (to pass); and He is the All Hearing, the All-Knowing. The meeting of God does not mean seeing Him. It means whosoever is sure of being resurrected for the Final Judgment of the Lord, which decree of the Lord is certain to come to pass.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ جَاهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ waman jāhada fa-innamā yujāhidu linafsihi inna l-laha laghaniyyun ʿani l-ʿālamīna Whoever strives, strives only for his own sake.1 Indeed Allah has no need of the creatures.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ جَاهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ waman jāhada fa-innamā yujāhidu linafsihi inna l-laha laghaniyyun ʿani l-ʿālamīna And whoever strives only strives for (the benefit of) himself. Indeed, Allah is Free from need of the worlds. See 29:5

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ جَاهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ waman jāhada fa-innamā yujāhidu linafsihi inna l-laha laghaniyyun ʿani l-ʿālamīna And whoever striveth hard, he striveth only for his own self; verily (As otherwise.) God is Self- Sufficient (Independent of the needs) of (all) the worlds. Jihad does not mean only fight with sword against any enemy. It actually means striving. 'Jihad' against one's own self is the greatest 'Jihad', while 'Jihad' with sword against any enemy is only the lesser crusade. Here it means he who fights against the desires of his own self.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiātihim walanajziyannahum aḥsana alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, We will absolve them of their misdeeds and We will surely reward them by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiātihim walanajziyannahum aḥsana alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do. See 29:5

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiātihim walanajziyannahum aḥsana alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna And (as to) those who believe and do good, certainly will We blot out from them their evil deeds and certainly will We recompense them the best of what they were doing. Here is the greatest incentive and encouragement for the sinners to amend themselves and become righteous. Compare this offer of the infinite mercy of the All-Merciful Lord to the belief in the vicarious atonement by merely believing in a prophet or a saint by which one, getting sure of being saved by his hero even though he commits the gravest acts of sin and crimes, might remain a habitual sinner. The Christian doctrine of the vicarious atonement through the blood of Jesus means God…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥus'nan wa-in jāhadāka litush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna We have enjoined man to be good to his parents. But if they urge you to ascribe to Me as partner that of which you have no knowledge, then do not obey them. To Me will be your return, whereat I will inform you concerning that which you used to do.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥus'nan wa-in jāhadāka litush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge,1 do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do. And We have enjoined on man to be dutiful to his parents; but if they strive to make you associate with Me, which you have no knowledge of, then obey them not. Unto Me is your return and I shall tell you what you used to do (29:8). And for those who…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥus'nan wa-in jāhadāka litush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna And We have enjoined on man goodness unto his parents; and if they (either of them) strive (to force) thee to (In authority.) associate (others) with Me (in worship) of which thou hast no knowledge, (This includes any order by parents which is against the Command of God.) then thou obey them not; Unto Me is the return of ye (all) and then will I inform you of what ye were doing. While Islam makes obedience to parents incumbent upon the children, it also says that in case the parents demand obedience against the truth (i.e., against God),…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِي الصَّالِحِينَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanud'khilannahum fī l-ṣāliḥīna Those who have faith and do righteous deeds, We will surely admit them among the righteous.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِي الصَّالِحِينَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanud'khilannahum fī l-ṣāliḥīna And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous (into Paradise). See 29:8

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِي الصَّالِحِينَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanud'khilannahum fī l-ṣāliḥīna And those who believe and do good, certainly We will admit them among the righteous, See 29:8

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَئِنْ جَاءَ نَصْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ أَوَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الْعَالَمِينَ wamina l-nāsi man yaqūlu āmannā bil-lahi fa-idhā ūdhiya fī l-lahi jaʿala fit'nata l-nāsi kaʿadhābi l-lahi wala-in jāa naṣrun min rabbika layaqūlunna innā kunnā maʿakum awalaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bimā fī ṣudūri l-ʿālamīna Among the people there are those who say, 'We have faith in Allah,' but if such a one is tormented in Allah's cause, he takes persecution by the people for Allah's punishment. Yet if there comes any help1 from your Lord, they will say for sure, 'We were indeed with you.' Does not Allah know best what is in the breasts of the creatures?

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَئِنْ جَاءَ نَصْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ أَوَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الْعَالَمِينَ wamina l-nāsi man yaqūlu āmannā bil-lahi fa-idhā ūdhiya fī l-lahi jaʿala fit'nata l-nāsi kaʿadhābi l-lahi wala-in jāa naṣrun min rabbika layaqūlunna innā kunnā maʿakum awalaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bimā fī ṣudūri l-ʿālamīna And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one (of them) is harmed for (the cause of) Allah, he considers the trial (i.e., harm) of the people as (if it were) the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of the worlds (i.e., all creatures)? Of mankind are some who say:…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَئِنْ جَاءَ نَصْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ أَوَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الْعَالَمِينَ wamina l-nāsi man yaqūlu āmannā bil-lahi fa-idhā ūdhiya fī l-lahi jaʿala fit'nata l-nāsi kaʿadhābi l-lahi wala-in jāa naṣrun min rabbika layaqūlunna innā kunnā maʿakum awalaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bimā fī ṣudūri l-ʿālamīna And among the people are those who say: "We believe in God;" and when they are persecuted (Such were those who deserted the muslim ranks and the Holy Prophet in the battles. These were hypocrites who, with the departure of the Holy Prophet disappeared. Not even a mention of them is made thereafter.) in the (way of) God they think the persecution from the people as the chastisement from God; and yet if cometh the help from thy…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ walayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna āmanū walayaʿlamanna l-munāfiqīna Allah shall surely ascertain those who have faith, and He shall surely ascertain the hypocrites.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ walayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna āmanū walayaʿlamanna l-munāfiqīna And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites. See 29:10

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ walayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna āmanū walayaʿlamanna l-munāfiqīna And certainly (Refer to verse 29:2.) well-knoweth God those who believe and certainly well-knoweth He the hypocrites. (Refer to verse 63:1.) See verse 3:139. See verse 29:3 above - This verse was revealed about those who had joined the muslim ranks and since Islam had not entered in them deeper than their skin1 their hearts were also dwindling and some even deserted the Holy Prophet and ran away, disappearing from the city for days together and those who considered the persecution inflicted upon them by the disbelievers as the chastisement for their embracing the truth.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبِعُوْۤا سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ وَمَا هُمْ بِحَامِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ittabiʿū sabīlanā walnaḥmil khaṭāyākum wamā hum biḥāmilīna min khaṭāyāhum min shayin innahum lakādhibūna The faithless say to the faithful, 'Follow our way and we will bear [responsibility for] your iniquities.' They will not bear anything of their iniquities. They are indeed liars.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبِعُوْۤا سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ وَمَا هُمْ بِحَامِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ittabiʿū sabīlanā walnaḥmil khaṭāyākum wamā hum biḥāmilīna min khaṭāyāhum min shayin innahum lakādhibūna And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins."1 But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars. And those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Follow our way and let us bear your sins." Never will they bear anything of their sins. Surely, they are liars (29:12). And verily, they shall bear their own loads, and other loads besides their own; and verily, they shall be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about that which they used to fabricate (29:13). The Arrogant Claim of the Disbelievers that They would…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبِعُوْۤا سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ وَمَا هُمْ بِحَامِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ittabiʿū sabīlanā walnaḥmil khaṭāyākum wamā hum biḥāmilīna min khaṭāyāhum min shayin innahum lakādhibūna And those who disbelieve say unto those who believe; "Follow ye our path and we will certainly bear (the burden of) your sins." And they shall not be bearers (Refer to note on verses 2:48, 6:165, 17:15, 35:18, 39:7 & 53:38.) of any thing of their sins; Verily, they are liars. See 29:11

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ وَلَيُسْءَلُنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ walayaḥmilunna athqālahum wa-athqālan maʿa athqālihim walayus'alunna yawma l-qiyāmati ʿammā kānū yaftarūna But surely they will carry their own burdens and other burdens along with their own burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning that which they used to fabricate.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ وَلَيُسْءَلُنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ walayaḥmilunna athqālahum wa-athqālan maʿa athqālihim walayus'alunna yawma l-qiyāmati ʿammā kānū yaftarūna But they will surely carry their (own) burdens and (other) burdens along with their burdens,1 and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent. See 29:12

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ وَلَيُسْءَلُنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ walayaḥmilunna athqālahum wa-athqālan maʿa athqālihim walayus'alunna yawma l-qiyāmati ʿammā kānū yaftarūna And certainly they shall bear their own burdens, and (other) burdens with their own burdens, and certainly, shall they be questioned on the Day of Judgment as to what they were forging. See 29:11

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi falabitha fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ʿāman fa-akhadhahumu l-ṭūfānu wahum ẓālimūna Certainly We sent Noah to his people, and he remained with them for a thousand-less-fifty years. Then the flood overtook them while they were wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi falabitha fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ʿāman fa-akhadhahumu l-ṭūfānu wahum ẓālimūna And We certainly sent Nuh to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers. And indeed We sent Nuh to his people, and he stayed among them a thousand years less fifty years; so the Deluge overtook them while they were wrongdoers (29:14). Then We saved him and the Companions of the Boat, and made it an Ayah for all people (29:15).
