Nuh and His People Here Allah consoles His servant and Messenger Muhammad SAW by telling him that Nuh (AS), stayed among his people for this long period of time, calling them night…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi falabitha fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ʿāman fa-akhadhahumu l-ṭūfānu wahum ẓālimūna And indeed sent We Noah unto his people, and he did stay amidst them a thousand years but (Noah lived for 950 years. i.e., 1000 - 50 i.e., 950 years.) fifty years; and seized them the Deluge while they were unjust. It is clearly said here that Noah lived for 950 years which fact is testified by the version of the Bible which also says that Noah lived such a long life.1 But a commentator interprets the words 'Noah remained' as the law presented by Noah abiding for 950 years which interpretation is only a conjecture fanciful and besides Noah had not brought any definite laws for he…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا اٰیَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-aṣḥāba l-safīnati wajaʿalnāhā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna Then We delivered him and the occupants of the Ark, and made it a sign for all the nations.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا اٰیَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-aṣḥāba l-safīnati wajaʿalnāhā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it1 a sign for the worlds. See 29:14

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا اٰیَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-aṣḥāba l-safīnati wajaʿalnāhā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna And We delivered him and the inmates of the Ark, and We made it a sign unto the people of the worlds. Similar to the Ark of Noah is the Ahl al-Bayt as declared by the Holy Prophet. 'The likeness of my Ahl al-Bayt is that of the Ark of Noah. He who got into it was saved and he who turned away from it was lost.' (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ wa-ib'rāhīma idh qāla liqawmihi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna And Abraham, when he said to his people, 'Worship Allah and be wary of Him. That is better for you, should you know.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ wa-ib'rāhīma idh qāla liqawmihi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna And (We sent) Ibrahim, when he said to his people, "Worship Allah and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know. And (remember) Ibrahim when he said to his people: Worship Allah, and have Taqwa of Him, that is better for you if you know (29:16). You worship besides Allah only idols, and you only invent falsehood. Verily, those whom you worship besides Allah have no power to give you provision, so seek from Allah your provision, and worship Him, and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be brought back (29:17). And if you deny, then nations before you have denied. And the duty of the Messenger is only…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ wa-ib'rāhīma idh qāla liqawmihi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna And (recollect) Abraham when he said unto his people; "Worship ye God and fear Him; This is best for you, if ye but know." See 29:15

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَابْتَغُوا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الرِّزْقَ وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ innamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi awthānan watakhluqūna if'kan inna alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi lā yamlikūna lakum riz'qan fa-ib'taghū ʿinda l-lahi l-riz'qa wa-uʿ'budūhu wa-ush'kurū lahu ilayhi tur'jaʿūna In fact, instead of Allah you worship idols, and you invent a lie. Indeed those whom you worship besides Allah have no control over your provision. So seek all [your] provision from Allah, and worship Him and thank Him, and to Him you shall be brought back.'1

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَابْتَغُوا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الرِّزْقَ وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ innamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi awthānan watakhluqūna if'kan inna alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi lā yamlikūna lakum riz'qan fa-ib'taghū ʿinda l-lahi l-riz'qa wa-uʿ'budūhu wa-ush'kurū lahu ilayhi tur'jaʿūna You only worship, besides Allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allah do not possess for you (the power of) provision. So seek from Allah provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned." See 29:16

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَابْتَغُوا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الرِّزْقَ وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ innamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi awthānan watakhluqūna if'kan inna alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi lā yamlikūna lakum riz'qan fa-ib'taghū ʿinda l-lahi l-riz'qa wa-uʿ'budūhu wa-ush'kurū lahu ilayhi tur'jaʿūna Ye only worship idols besides God, and create a lie; verily those whom ye worship besides God, own not for you any sustenance, so seek ye from God (your) sustenance and worship ye (only) Him, and give ye thanks (only) unto Him; unto Him (only) shall ye (all) be returned. See 29:15

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تُكَذِّبُوا فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ wa-in tukadhibū faqad kadhaba umamun min qablikum wamā ʿalā l-rasūli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu And if you impugn [the Apostle's teaching], then [other] nations have impugned [likewise] before you, and the Apostle's duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تُكَذِّبُوا فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ wa-in tukadhibū faqad kadhaba umamun min qablikum wamā ʿalā l-rasūli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu And if you (people) deny (the message) - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except (the duty of) clear notification.1 See 29:16

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تُكَذِّبُوا فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ wa-in tukadhibū faqad kadhaba umamun min qablikum wamā ʿalā l-rasūli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu And if ye belie (Or the Apostle.) (the truth)! then indeed did belie (Or the Apostle.) (the truth) the people before you; and nothing is incumbent on the Apostle but a (Without any ambiguity.) clear delivery (of the message). Here and elsewhere, it has been asserted that the people's believing or not believing, is not the concern of the Apostle of God. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ awalam yaraw kayfa yub'di-u l-lahu l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun Have they not regarded how Allah originates the creation? Then He will bring it back. That is indeed easy for Allah.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ awalam yaraw kayfa yub'di-u l-lahu l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allah, is easy. See they not how Allah originates the creation, then repeats it. Verily, that is easy for Allah (29:19). Say: Travel in the land and see how He originated the creation, and then Allah will bring forth the creation of the Hereafter. Verily, Allah is able to do all things (29:20). He punishes whom He wills, and shows mercy to whom He wills; and to Him you will be returned (29:21). And you cannot escape in the earth or in the heaven. And besides Allah you have neither any protector nor any helper (29:22). And those who…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ awalam yaraw kayfa yub'di-u l-lahu l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun What! see they not? How God originateth the creation then causeth it to return again? Verily this is easy for God. See 29:18

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ يُنْشِئُ النَّشْأَةَ الْاٰخِرَةَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa bada-a l-khalqa thumma l-lahu yunshi-u l-nashata l-ākhirata inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Say, 'Travel over the land and then observe how He has originated the creation.' Then Allah shall bring about the genesis of the Hereafter. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ يُنْشِئُ النَّشْأَةَ الْاٰخِرَةَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa bada-a l-khalqa thumma l-lahu yunshi-u l-nashata l-ākhirata inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Say, (O Muḥammad), "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allah will produce the final creation (i.e., development). Indeed Allah, over all things, is competent." See 29:19

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ يُنْشِئُ النَّشْأَةَ الْاٰخِرَةَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa bada-a l-khalqa thumma l-lahu yunshi-u l-nashata l-ākhirata inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "Travel ye in the earth and see how He hath originated the creation (For the first time.) so will God bringeth forth the later development (on the Day of Resurrection); Verily God hath power over all things." From this verse it is obvious that this journey cannot be of a physical nature; none can see the beginning of the creation or any new development. This journey is purely intellectual which shows that history does not mean only the succession of the events, one after another but the development of past into present and present into future…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ yuʿadhibu man yashāu wayarḥamu man yashāu wa-ilayhi tuq'labūna He will punish whomever He wishes and have mercy on whomever He wishes, and to Him you will be returned.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ yuʿadhibu man yashāu wayarḥamu man yashāu wa-ilayhi tuq'labūna He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned. See 29:19

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ yuʿadhibu man yashāu wayarḥamu man yashāu wa-ilayhi tuq'labūna Chastiseth He whomsoever He willeth and bestoweth mercy on whomsoever He willeth, and unto Him ye shall be turned back. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīrin You cannot thwart Him on the earth or in the sky, nor do you have besides Allah any guardian or any helper.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīrin And you will not cause failure (to Allah) upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper. See 29:19

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīrin And ye shall frustrate not His power in the earth nor in the heaven, and there is not for you other than Him, any protector, nor a helper. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلِقَائِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوْۤا مِنْ رَحْمَتِي وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi waliqāihi ulāika ya-isū min raḥmatī wa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun Those who deny the signs of Allah and the encounter with Him, they have despaired of My mercy, and for such there is a painful punishment.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلِقَائِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوْۤا مِنْ رَحْمَتِي وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi waliqāihi ulāika ya-isū min raḥmatī wa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment. See 29:19

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلِقَائِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوْۤا مِنْ رَحْمَتِي وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi waliqāihi ulāika ya-isū min raḥmatī wa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun And those who disbelieved in the signs of God and His meeting, these are despaired of My mercy, and these it is who shall have a painful chastisement. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنْجَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū uq'tulūhu aw ḥarriqūhu fa-anjāhu l-lahu mina l-nāri inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna But the only answer of his people was that they said, 'Kill him, or burn him.' Then Allah delivered him from the fire. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنْجَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū uq'tulūhu aw ḥarriqūhu fa-anjāhu l-lahu mina l-nāri inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna And the answer of his (i.e., Ibrahim's) people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe. So nothing was the answer of people except that they said: Kill him or burn him." Then Allah saved him from the fire. Verily, in this are indeed signs for a people who believe (29:24). And (Ibrahim) said: "You have taken idols instead of Allah. The love between you is only in the life of this world, but on the Day of Resurrection, you…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنْجَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū uq'tulūhu aw ḥarriqūhu fa-anjāhu l-lahu mina l-nāri inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna So naught was the answer of his people except that they said: "Slay him (Abraham.) or burn him;" Then God delivered him from the fire; verily in this there are signs for a people who believe. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا مَوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ waqāla innamā ittakhadhtum min dūni l-lahi awthānan mawaddata baynikum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yakfuru baʿḍukum bibaʿḍin wayalʿanu baʿḍukum baʿḍan wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna He said, 'You have taken idols [for worship] besides Allah for the sake of [mutual] affection amongst yourselves in the life of the world. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will disown one another and curse one another,1 and the Fire will be your abode, and you will not have any helpers.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا مَوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ waqāla innamā ittakhadhtum min dūni l-lahi awthānan mawaddata baynikum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yakfuru baʿḍukum bibaʿḍin wayalʿanu baʿḍukum baʿḍan wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna And (Ibrahim) said, "You have only taken, other than Allah, idols as (a bond of) affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers." See 29:24

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا مَوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ waqāla innamā ittakhadhtum min dūni l-lahi awthānan mawaddata baynikum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yakfuru baʿḍukum bibaʿḍin wayalʿanu baʿḍukum baʿḍan wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna And said (Abraham): "Ye have only taken for yourselves idols besides God in (As the result of the love among yourselves.) friendship between you in the life of this world, then on the Day of Judgment some of you shall deny the others, and shall curse some of you the others and your abode shall be the (Hell) fire, and for you shall not be any helpers," See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامَنَ لَهُ لُوطٌ وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَى رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ faāmana lahu lūṭun waqāla innī muhājirun ilā rabbī innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Thereupon Lot believed in him, and he said, 'Indeed I am migrating toward my Lord. Indeed He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامَنَ لَهُ لُوطٌ وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَى رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ faāmana lahu lūṭun waqāla innī muhājirun ilā rabbī innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu And Lut believed him. (Ibrahim) said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to (the service of) my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise." So, Lut believed in him. He said: I will emigrate for the sake of my Lord. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise (29:26). And We bestowed on him, Ishaq and Ya'qub, and We ordained among his offspring prophethood and the Book, and We granted him his reward in this world; and verily, in the Hereafter he is indeed among the righteous (29:27). The Faith of Lut and His Emigration with Ibrahim Allah tells us that Lut believed in Ibrahim. It was said that he was the son of Ibrahim's brother,…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامَنَ لَهُ لُوطٌ وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَى رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ faāmana lahu lūṭun waqāla innī muhājirun ilā rabbī innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Then believed in him (In Abraham.) Lut and said he: "I (Travel.) betake me unto my Lord, for verily He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise" See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ أَجْرَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihi l-nubuwata wal-kitāba waātaynāhu ajrahu fī l-dun'yā wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīna And We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and We ordained among his descendants prophethood and the Book, and We gave him his reward in the world, and in the Hereafter he will indeed be among the Righteous.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ أَجْرَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihi l-nubuwata wal-kitāba waātaynāhu ajrahu fī l-dun'yā wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīna And We gave to him Ishaq and Ya'qub and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous. See 29:26

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ أَجْرَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihi l-nubuwata wal-kitāba waātaynāhu ajrahu fī l-dun'yā wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīna And We granted him (Abraham.) Isaac and Jacob, and made the prophethood and the Book to be in his ("And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant" Old Testament Gen. 17/7.) seed, and We gave him his recompense in this world; and verily he in the hereafter will certainly be among the righteous ones. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi innakum latatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīna And Lot, when he said to his people, 'You indeed commit an indecency none in the world has ever committed before you!

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi innakum latatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīna And (mention) Lut, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds. And (remember) Lut, when he said to his people: You commit immoral sins which none has preceded you in (committing) it in all creatures (29:28). "Verily, you practice sodomy with men, and rob the wayfarer! And practice Al-Munkar in your meetings." But his people gave no answer except that they said: "Bring Allah's torment upon us if you are one of the truthful (29:29). He said: "My Lord! Give me victory over the people who are corrupt (29:30). The Preaching of Lut and what Happened between Him…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi innakum latatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīna And (recollect) Lut when said he unto his people: "Verily ye commit a lewdness, which not one of the people of the worlds gone before you did ever commit." See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنْكَرَ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla wataqṭaʿūna l-sabīla watatūna fī nādīkumu l-munkara famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū i'tinā biʿadhābi l-lahi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna What! Do you come to men, and cut off the way,1 and commit outrages in your gatherings?' But the only answer of his people was that they said, 'Bring us Allah's punishment should you be truthful.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنْكَرَ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla wataqṭaʿūna l-sabīla watatūna fī nādīkumu l-munkara famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū i'tinā biʿadhābi l-lahi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road1 and commit in your meetings (every) evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allah, if you should be of the truthful." See 29:28

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنْكَرَ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla wataqṭaʿūna l-sabīla watatūna fī nādīkumu l-munkara famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū i'tinā biʿadhābi l-lahi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna What! Proceed ye unto men? and cut ye the highway (to plunder the wayfarers)? and commit ye evil deeds in your assemblies; But nothing was the answer from his people except that they said: "Bring thou unto us the chastisement from God, if thou art of the truthful (ones)." See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī ʿalā l-qawmi l-muf'sidīna He said, 'My Lord! Help me against this corruptive lot.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī ʿalā l-qawmi l-muf'sidīna He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people." See 29:28

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī ʿalā l-qawmi l-muf'sidīna Said (Lut): "O' My Lord! Help me against the mischievous people!" See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوْا إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوْۤا أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ walammā jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū innā muh'likū ahli hādhihi l-qaryati inna ahlahā kānū ẓālimīna And when Our messengers1 came to Abraham with the good news, they said, 'We are indeed going to destroy the people of this town. Its people are indeed wrongdoers.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوْا إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوْۤا أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ walammā jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū innā muh'likū ahli hādhihi l-qaryati inna ahlahā kānū ẓālimīna And when Our messengers (i.e., angels) came to Ibrahim with the good tidings,1 they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that (i.e., Lut's) city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers." And when Our messengers came to Ibrahim with the glad tidings they said: "Verily, we are going to destroy the people of this town; truly, its people have been wrongdoers (29:31). Ibrahim said: "But there is Lut in it." They said: "We know better who is there. We will verily, save him and his family – except his wife, she will be of those who remain behind (29:32). And when Our messengers came to Lut, he was grieved…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوْا إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوْۤا أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ walammā jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū innā muh'likū ahli hādhihi l-qaryati inna ahlahā kānū ẓālimīna And when came Our messengers unto Abraham with glad tidings (of a son (Isaac.) unto him) said they: "Verily we are going to destroy the people of this town, for verily its people are unjust." See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا قَالُوْا نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ فِيهَا لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ qāla inna fīhā lūṭan qālū naḥnu aʿlamu biman fīhā lanunajjiyannahu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīna He said, 'Lot is indeed in it.' They said, 'We know better those who are in it. We will surely deliver him and his family, except his wife: she shall be one of those who remain behind.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا قَالُوْا نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ فِيهَا لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ qāla inna fīhā lūṭan qālū naḥnu aʿlamu biman fīhā lanunajjiyannahu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīna (Ibrahim) said, "Indeed, within it is Lut." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind." See 29:31

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا قَالُوْا نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ فِيهَا لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ qāla inna fīhā lūṭan qālū naḥnu aʿlamu biman fīhā lanunajjiyannahu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīna Said (Abraham unto the messenger angels): "Verily in it is (Lut and Abraham were related to each other and were contemporaries.) Lut." They said: "We know it well who is in it; We shall certainly deliver him and his (Faithful followers.) people; save his (Note: the wife of a prophet is not recognised as his Ahl al-Bayt. She is cursed and destroyed. Refer to note on verse 33:33.) wife: she shall be of those who stay behind." See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوْۤا لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ walammā an jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqālū lā takhaf walā taḥzan innā munajjūka wa-ahlaka illā im'ra-ataka kānat mina l-ghābirīna And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed on their account and in a predicament for their sake. But they said, 'Do not be afraid, nor grieve! We shall deliver you and your family, except your wife: she will be one of those who remain behind.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوْۤا لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ walammā an jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqālū lā takhaf walā taḥzan innā munajjūka wa-ahlaka illā im'ra-ataka kānat mina l-ghābirīna And when Our messengers (i.e., angels) came to Lut, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort.1 They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind. See 29:31

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوْۤا لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ walammā an jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqālū lā takhaf walā taḥzan innā munajjūka wa-ahlaka illā im'ra-ataka kānat mina l-ghābirīna And when came Our Messengers unto Lut, he was grieved for them, and was straitened (at heart) for the (weakness of his) arm (to protect them): and they said "Fear thou not, nor grieve thou; verily we will deliver thee and thy people (Faithful followers.) except thy wife; she shall be of those who stay behind." See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مُنْزِلُونَ عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ innā munzilūna ʿalā ahli hādhihi l-qaryati rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yafsuqūna We are indeed going to bring down upon the people of this town a punishment from the sky because of the transgressions they used to commit.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مُنْزِلُونَ عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ innā munzilūna ʿalā ahli hādhihi l-qaryati rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yafsuqūna Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." See 29:31

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مُنْزِلُونَ عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ innā munzilūna ʿalā ahli hādhihi l-qaryati rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yafsuqūna Verily We are bringing down upon the people of this town a punishment from heaven for what they were transgressing. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَا مِنْهَا اٰیَةً بَيِّنَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ walaqad taraknā min'hā āyatan bayyinatan liqawmin yaʿqilūna Certainly We have left of it a manifest sign for a people who apply reason.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَا مِنْهَا اٰیَةً بَيِّنَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ walaqad taraknā min'hā āyatan bayyinatan liqawmin yaʿqilūna And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason. See 29:31

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَا مِنْهَا اٰیَةً بَيِّنَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ walaqad taraknā min'hā āyatan bayyinatan liqawmin yaʿqilūna And indeed We have left a clear sign of it for a people who understand. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَارْجُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ir'jū l-yawma l-ākhira walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And to Midian We sent Shu'ayb, their brother. He said, 'O my people! Worship Allah, and expect [to encounter] the Last Day, and do not act wickedly on the earth causing corruption.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَارْجُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ir'jū l-yawma l-ākhira walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And to Madyan (We sent) their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." And to Madyan, We sent their brother Shu'ayb. He said: O my people! Worship Allah and hope for the last Day, and commit no mischief on the earth as mischief-makers (29:36). And they denied him; so the earthquake seized them, and they lay, prostrate in their dwellings (29:37). Shu'ayb and His People Allah tells us that His servant and Messenger Shu'ayb (AS), warned his people, the people of Madyan, and commanded them to worship Allah Alone with…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَارْجُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ir'jū l-yawma l-ākhira walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And to Midian (We did send) their brother Shu'ayb and he said: "O' my people! worship ye God (alone) and fear the Last day (of Judgment) and enact not evil in the earth making mischief (therein)." See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna But they impugned him, whereupon the earthquake seized them, and they lay lifeless prostrate in their homes.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home (corpses) fallen prone. See 29:36

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna But they belied him, so seized them an earthquake, and they lay (dead) in their abodes motionless. See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَقَدْ تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوْۤا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ waʿādan wathamūdā waqad tabayyana lakum min masākinihim wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli wakānū mus'tabṣirīna And 'Ād and Thamūd, [whose fate] is evident to you from their habitations. Satan made their deeds seem decorous to them, thus he barred them from the way [of Allah], though they used to be perceptive.1

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَقَدْ تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوْۤا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ waʿādan wathamūdā waqad tabayyana lakum min masākinihim wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli wakānū mus'tabṣirīna And (We destroyed) ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their (ruined) dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception. And 'Ad and Thamud! And indeed (their destruction) is clearly apparent to you from their (ruined) dwellings. Shaytan made their deeds fair seeming to them, and turned them away from the path, though they were intelligent (29:38). And Qarun, Fir'awn, and Haman. And indeed Musa came to them with clear Ayat, but they were arrogant in the land, yet they could not outstrip Us (29:39). So, We punished each for…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَقَدْ تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوْۤا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ waʿādan wathamūdā waqad tabayyana lakum min masākinihim wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli wakānū mus'tabṣirīna And We (destroyed) 'Ad and Thamud, and indeed it had been made manifest unto you from (the ruins of) their dwellings; and Satan made their deeds fair-seeming unto them, so he kept them back from the (right) path, though they were endued with sight, See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مُوسٰی بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا سَابِقِينَ waqārūna wafir'ʿawna wahāmāna walaqad jāahum mūsā bil-bayināti fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi wamā kānū sābiqīna And Korah, Pharaoh, and Hāmān. Certainly Moses brought them manifest proofs, but they acted arrogantly in the land; though they could not outmaneuver [Allah].

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مُوسٰی بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا سَابِقِينَ waqārūna wafir'ʿawna wahāmāna walaqad jāahum mūsā bil-bayināti fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi wamā kānū sābiqīna And (We destroyed) Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Musa had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners (of Our punishment). See 29:38

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مُوسٰی بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا سَابِقِينَ waqārūna wafir'ʿawna wahāmāna walaqad jāahum mūsā bil-bayināti fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi wamā kānū sābiqīna And (We destroyed) Korah and Pharaoh and Haman: and indeed came unto them Moses with clear proofs but they behaved haughtily in the land, but they could not outstrip (Us). See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنْبِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَغْرَقْنَا وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ fakullan akhadhnā bidhanbihi famin'hum man arsalnā ʿalayhi ḥāṣiban wamin'hum man akhadhathu l-ṣayḥatu wamin'hum man khasafnā bihi l-arḍa wamin'hum man aghraqnā wamā kāna l-lahu liyaẓlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna So We seized each [of them] for his sin: among them were those upon whom We unleashed a rain of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the Cry, and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. It was not Allah who wronged them, but it was they who used to wrong themselves.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنْبِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَغْرَقْنَا وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ fakullan akhadhnā bidhanbihi famin'hum man arsalnā ʿalayhi ḥāṣiban wamin'hum man akhadhathu l-ṣayḥatu wamin'hum man khasafnā bihi l-arḍa wamin'hum man aghraqnā wamā kāna l-lahu liyaẓlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast (from the sky), and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves. See 29:38

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنْبِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَغْرَقْنَا وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ fakullan akhadhnā bidhanbihi famin'hum man arsalnā ʿalayhi ḥāṣiban wamin'hum man akhadhathu l-ṣayḥatu wamin'hum man khasafnā bihi l-arḍa wamin'hum man aghraqnā wamā kāna l-lahu liyaẓlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna So each (one of them) We did seize for his sin; and of them was he on whom We sent a stone-charged violent wind; and of them was he whom seized the blast; and of them was he whom We caused to be swallowed up by the earth; and of them was he whom We drowned; and it was not God to do injustice to them, but they unto their own selves did injustice, (They hurt themselves.) See 29:20

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ mathalu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa kamathali l-ʿankabūti ittakhadhat baytan wa-inna awhana l-buyūti labaytu l-ʿankabūti law kānū yaʿlamūna The parable of those who take guardians instead of Allah is that of the spider that takes a home, and indeed the frailest of homes is the home of a spider, had they known!

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ mathalu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa kamathali l-ʿankabūti ittakhadhat baytan wa-inna awhana l-buyūti labaytu l-ʿankabūti law kānū yaʿlamūna The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes (i.e., constructs) a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew. The parable of those who seek protectors from other than Allah is that of a spider who builds a house; but indeed, the weakest of houses is the spider's house – if they but knew (29:41). Verily, Allah knows what things they invoke instead of Him. He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise (29:42). And these are the examples We give for mankind; but none…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ mathalu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa kamathali l-ʿankabūti ittakhadhat baytan wa-inna awhana l-buyūti labaytu l-ʿankabūti law kānū yaʿlamūna The likeness of those who take to themselves guardians (Lords - Master – friends.) besides God, is the likeness of the spider that maketh for itself a house; but verily the frailest of all houses is the house of the spider; if they but know (this). The position of belief in falsehood or in false deities, is like the extreme frailty of the spider's web which cannot stand the slightest gush of a wind or which could, be destroyed in no time even by the weakest hand. When the reason of any logical argument is brought to bear upon the false dogmas…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yadʿūna min dūnihi min shayin wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Allah indeed knows whatever thing they invoke besides Him, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yadʿūna min dūnihi min shayin wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon1 other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 29:41

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yadʿūna min dūnihi min shayin wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Verily, God knoweth whatever thing they call upon besides Him: and He is the All-Mighty, All-Wise. See 29:41

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَا إِلَّا الْعَالِمُونَ watil'ka l-amthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi wamā yaʿqiluhā illā l-ʿālimūna And We draw these parables for mankind; but no one grasps them except those who have knowledge.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَا إِلَّا الْعَالِمُونَ watil'ka l-amthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi wamā yaʿqiluhā illā l-ʿālimūna And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge. See 29:41

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَا إِلَّا الْعَالِمُونَ watil'ka l-amthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi wamā yaʿqiluhā illā l-ʿālimūna And these similitudes We do set forth unto people, but understand them none but the learned (ones) The heathens used to ridicule the parables of the spider's web. It is said, in this verse that the parables cannot be understood but by the learned ones endowed with the power of understanding. The whole physical realm with all its amazing and fascinating phenomena is nothing more than a similitude and a figurative expression of the realities beyond the realm of external senses. The Holy Prophet says: "Men in the worldly life are in a dream, when they die then they awake." And the Qur'an says: "Certainly, you were heedless of it, but now We have removed from you your veil, so your sight today is…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ khalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna Allah created the heavens and the earth with reason. There is indeed a sign in that for the faithful.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ khalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers. Allah created the heavens and the earth with truth. Verily, therein is surely a sign for those who believe (29:44). Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book, and perform the Salah. Verily, the Salah prevents from Al-Fahsha' (immoral sins) and Al-Munkar (evil deeds) and the remembering (praising) of Allah is greater indeed. And Allah knows what you do.) Allah tells us of His immense power, that He created the heavens and the earth with truth, meaning for a higher purpose than mere pla (29:45). لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ that every person may be rewarded for that which he…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ khalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna God created the heavens and the earth with truth; Verily in this there is a sign for the believers. See 29:43

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ تَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ ut'lu mā ūḥiya ilayka mina l-kitābi wa-aqimi l-ṣalata inna l-ṣalata tanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari waladhik'ru l-lahi akbaru wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā taṣnaʿūna Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book, and maintain the prayer. Indeed the prayer prevents indecencies and wrongs, and the remembrance of Allah is surely greater. And Allah knows whatever [deeds] you do.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ تَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ ut'lu mā ūḥiya ilayka mina l-kitābi wa-aqimi l-ṣalata inna l-ṣalata tanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari waladhik'ru l-lahi akbaru wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā taṣnaʿūna Recite, (O Muḥammad), what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do. See 29:44

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ تَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ ut'lu mā ūḥiya ilayka mina l-kitābi wa-aqimi l-ṣalata inna l-ṣalata tanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari waladhik'ru l-lahi akbaru wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā taṣnaʿūna Recite thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) that which hath been revealed unto thee of the Book and establish prayer; verily prayer restraineth (one) from filth and evil; and certainly the remembrance of God is the greatest (The Holy Prophet said that "the likeness of the prescribed Five Daily Prayers is that of a River flowing at every door and he who bathes five times in it (i.e., offers prayers regularly five times every day) no dirt of any sin will remain on him.") (duty of the believers), and God knoweth what ye do. Though the address here is…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَهُنَا وَإِلَهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ walā tujādilū ahla l-kitābi illā bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu illā alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum waqūlū āmannā bi-alladhī unzila ilaynā wa-unzila ilaykum wa-ilāhunā wa-ilāhukum wāḥidun wanaḥnu lahu mus'limūna Do not dispute with the People of the Book except in a manner which is best, barring such of them as are wrongdoers, and say, 'We believe in that which has been sent down to us and has been sent down to you; our God and your God is one [and the same], and to Him do we submit.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَهُنَا وَإِلَهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ walā tujādilū ahla l-kitābi illā bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu illā alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum waqūlū āmannā bi-alladhī unzila ilaynā wa-unzila ilaykum wa-ilāhunā wa-ilāhukum wāḥidun wanaḥnu lahu mus'limūna And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims (in submission) to Him." And argue not with the People of the Scripture, except with that which is better – except with such of them as do wrong; and say (to them): We believe in that which…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَهُنَا وَإِلَهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ walā tujādilū ahla l-kitābi illā bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu illā alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum waqūlū āmannā bi-alladhī unzila ilaynā wa-unzila ilaykum wa-ilāhunā wa-ilāhukum wāḥidun wanaḥnu lahu mus'limūna And dispute (People directed through the Prophet.) not with the people of the Book save what is best, (Such was the course of the Mission of the Holy Prophet in preaching the truth and never the sword.) except those of them who act unjustly, and say ye (unto the people): "Believe we in that which hath been sent down unto us and sent down unto you, and our God and your God is One, and we unto Him do submit" It is to be noted that Islam holds mere disputation…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ فَالَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَمِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا الْكَافِرُونَ wakadhālika anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba fa-alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yu'minūna bihi wamin hāulāi man yu'minu bihi wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-kāfirūna Thus have We sent down the Book to you; and those to whom We have given the Book believe in it, and of these1 there are some who believe in it, and none contests Our signs except the faithless.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ فَالَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَمِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا الْكَافِرُونَ wakadhālika anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba fa-alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yu'minūna bihi wamin hāulāi man yu'minu bihi wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-kāfirūna And thus We have sent down to you the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān). And those to whom We (previously) gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these (people of Makkah) are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers. And thus We have sent down the Book to you, and those whom We gave the Scripture believe therein as also do some of these and none but the disbelievers reject Our Ayat (29:47). Neither did you read any book before it nor did you write any book with your right hand. In that case, indeed, the…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ فَالَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَمِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا الْكَافِرُونَ wakadhālika anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba fa-alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yu'minūna bihi wamin hāulāi man yu'minu bihi wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-kāfirūna And thus have We sent down unto thee the Book (The Qur'an); and those (The fairminded Jews and the Christians.) whom We have given the (The scriptures given to Moses and Jesus.) Book believe in it; and of these (The heathens.) there are those who believe in it; and dispute not against Our signs but the disbelievers. Those who have been given the Book, and who believe in the Holy Qur'an, can naturally and reasonably be the Holy Ahl al-Bayt who believed in the Holy Qur'an implicitly and not the Jews and the Christians who contested and did not believe in it…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ إِذًا لَارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ wamā kunta tatlū min qablihi min kitābin walā takhuṭṭuhu biyamīnika idhan la-ir'tāba l-mub'ṭilūna You did not use to recite any scripture before it, nor did you write it with your right hand, for then the impugners would have been skeptical.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ إِذًا لَارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ wamā kunta tatlū min qablihi min kitābin walā takhuṭṭuhu biyamīnika idhan la-ir'tāba l-mub'ṭilūna And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then (i.e., otherwise) the falsifiers would have had (cause for) doubt. See 29:47

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ إِذًا لَارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ wamā kunta tatlū min qablihi min kitābin walā takhuṭṭuhu biyamīnika idhan la-ir'tāba l-mub'ṭilūna And thou didst not recite any book before it (the Qur'an) and thou didst not transcribe one with that right hand of thine, for then would have doubted those who utter falsehood. Before the revelation of the Holy Qur'an the Holy Prophet could neither write with his own hand nor could he read anything written by the others and this is a fact vouched by one and all of the age of the Holy Prophet. With this fact in view it would be sheer absurdity to say that what he delivered as the Holy Qur'an was not the revelation from God but a reproduction of what he read in the other scriptures and what…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ هُوَ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِي صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا الظَّالِمُونَ bal huwa āyātun bayyinātun fī ṣudūri alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-ẓālimūna Rather it is [present as] manifest signs in the breasts of those who have been given knowledge, and none contests Our signs except wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ هُوَ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِي صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا الظَّالِمُونَ bal huwa āyātun bayyinātun fī ṣudūri alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-ẓālimūna Rather, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is distinct verses (preserved) within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers. See 29:47

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ هُوَ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِي صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا الظَّالِمُونَ bal huwa āyātun bayyinātun fī ṣudūri alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-ẓālimūna Nay! it (Qur'an) is the clear signs in the breast of those who have been granted the knowledge; (Said the Holy Prophet 'I am the City of Knowledge and Ali is its Gate.') and dispute not against Our signs except the unjust (ones) The Holy Ahl al-Bayt who were the heavenly depositories of the knowledge of the Word of God which was revealed through the Holy Qur'an as well as through the previous scriptures. The famous announcement of the Holy Prophet 'I am the City of Knowledge and Ali is its Gate' proves the above statement.1 Besides, there is the unique distinction gifted to the Holy Qur'an, i.e., no previously revealed scripture…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ waqālū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyātun min rabbihi qul innamā l-āyātu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun They say, 'Why has not some sign1 been sent down to him from his Lord?' Say, 'The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a manifest warner.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ waqālū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyātun min rabbihi qul innamā l-āyātu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner." And they say: Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say: "The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a plain warner (29:50). Is it not sufficient for them that We have sent down to you the Book which is recited to them? Verily, herein is mercy and a reminder for a people who believe (29:51). Say: "Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. He knows what is in the heavens…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ waqālū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyātun min rabbihi qul innamā l-āyātu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun And say they: "Why have not been sent down upon him the signs from the Lord?" Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "The signs are with God (alone); And I am only a plain warner" Signs i.e., miracles the people demanded, but what about the signs previously shown to them, and yet they believed not, and now the Holy Prophet was sent not to repeat the signs or the wonders of any physical world but to present the Word of God itself as said in verse 29:48 above which by itself is a great sign, and to warn that God is not there to go on working out…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرٰی لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yakfihim annā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba yut'lā ʿalayhim inna fī dhālika laraḥmatan wadhik'rā liqawmin yu'minūna Does it not suffice them that We have sent down to you the Book which is recited to them? There is indeed a mercy and admonition in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرٰی لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yakfihim annā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba yut'lā ʿalayhim inna fī dhālika laraḥmatan wadhik'rā liqawmin yu'minūna And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe. See 29:50

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرٰی لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yakfihim annā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba yut'lā ʿalayhim inna fī dhālika laraḥmatan wadhik'rā liqawmin yu'minūna What! Is it not enough for them that We have sent down unto thee the Book which is recited unto them? Verily in this there is mercy and a reminder for a people who believe. This verse answers the demand for miracles in the previous one. Now it is God who has granted a merciful respite to allow time for the people to repent and amend their faith and their practical life.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِالْبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ qul kafā bil-lahi baynī wabaynakum shahīdan yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-bāṭili wakafarū bil-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūna Say, 'Allah suffices as a witness between me and you: He knows whatever there is in the heavens and the earth. Those who put faith in falsehood and defy Allah, —it is they who are the losers.'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِالْبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ qul kafā bil-lahi baynī wabaynakum shahīdan yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-bāṭili wakafarū bil-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūna Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers." See 29:50

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِالْبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ qul kafā bil-lahi baynī wabaynakum shahīdan yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-bāṭili wakafarū bil-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "Sufficient is God as a witness between me and you; He knoweth what is in the heavens and the earth; and those who believe in the falsehood and disbelieve in God; these it is who are the losers." See 29:51

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَوْلَا أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى لَجَاءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walawlā ajalun musamman lajāahumu l-ʿadhābu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna They ask you to hasten the punishment. Yet were it not for a specified time, the punishment would have surely overtaken them. Surely it will overtake them suddenly while they are unaware.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَوْلَا أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى لَجَاءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walawlā ajalun musamman lajāahumu l-ʿadhābu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for (the decree of) a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not. And they ask you to hasten on the torment, and had it not been for a term appointed, the torment would certainly have come to them. And surely, it will come upon them suddenly while they perceive not (29:53). They ask you to hasten on the torment. And verily, Hell, of a surety, will encompass the disbelievers (29:54). On the Day when the torment shall cover them from above them and from beneath their feet, and it will be said: Taste…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَوْلَا أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى لَجَاءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walawlā ajalun musamman lajāahumu l-ʿadhābu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna And they challenge (Seek – ask.) thee to hasten on the chastisement; and had not the term been decreed, the chastisement would certainly have come unto them; and certainly, it will come unto them suddenly while they perceive not. God's Plan is worked by God Himself. It could neither be hastened by anyone nor could it be deferred at anybody's fancy. It will come to pass exactly when God wills it without any previous notice1.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ yastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi wa-inna jahannama lamuḥīṭatun bil-kāfirīna They ask you to hasten the punishment, and indeed hell will besiege the faithless

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ yastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi wa-inna jahannama lamuḥīṭatun bil-kāfirīna They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers. See 29:53

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ yastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi wa-inna jahannama lamuḥīṭatun bil-kāfirīna And they challenge (Lit. seek – ask.) thee to hasten on the chastisement, and verily the Hell will encompass the disbelievers, The respite for repentance is granted and when at the end of it the doom comes to pass, it will surely overtake the disbelievers from all around them.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَغْشَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوْۤا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ yawma yaghshāhumu l-ʿadhābu min fawqihim wamin taḥti arjulihim wayaqūlu dhūqū mā kuntum taʿmalūna on the day when the punishment envelopes them, from above them and from under their feet, and He will say, 'Taste what you used to do!'

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَغْشَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوْۤا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ yawma yaghshāhumu l-ʿadhābu min fawqihim wamin taḥti arjulihim wayaqūlu dhūqū mā kuntum taʿmalūna On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste (the result of) what you used to do." See 29:53

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَغْشَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوْۤا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ yawma yaghshāhumu l-ʿadhābu min fawqihim wamin taḥti arjulihim wayaqūlu dhūqū mā kuntum taʿmalūna On the day when shall cover them the chastisement, from above them, and from beneath their feet; and shall say He; "Taste ye what ye were doing." See 29:54

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَاعْبُدُونِ yāʿibādiya alladhīna āmanū inna arḍī wāsiʿatun fa-iyyāya fa-uʿ'budūni O My servants who have faith! My earth is indeed vast. So worship [only] Me.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَاعْبُدُونِ yāʿibādiya alladhīna āmanū inna arḍī wāsiʿatun fa-iyyāya fa-uʿ'budūni O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me. O My servants who believe! Certainly, spacious is My earth. Therefore worship Me (29:56). Everyone shall taste death. Then unto Us you shall be returned (29:57). And those who believe and do righteous good deeds, to them We shall surely give lofty dwellings in Paradise, beneath which rivers flow, to live therein forever. Excellent is the reward for the workers (29:58). Those who are patient, and put their trust in their Lord (29:59). And so many a moving creature carries not its own provision! Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower (29:60). Advice to Migrate and the Promise of Provision and a…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَاعْبُدُونِ yāʿibādiya alladhīna āmanū inna arḍī wāsiʿatun fa-iyyāya fa-uʿ'budūni O' My servants who believe! verily My earth is (If persecuted at one place for their faith the Muslim may take shelter in some other part of the earth - and be worshipful to God.) vast, therefore Me alone should ye worship! A group of the believers who stayed at Mecca passed their life in a miserable state of persecution. This verse was revealed to say that if they were persecuted at Mecca they might migrate away from it to a place like Medina where they would be safe and free. One cannot have the false excuse of one's inability to be true to his faith in God, owing to his unfavourable environment. One must share danger and evil and seek safety and good.…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti thumma ilaynā tur'jaʿūna Every soul shall taste death. Then you shall be brought back to Us.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti thumma ilaynā tur'jaʿūna Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned. See 29:56

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti thumma ilaynā tur'jaʿūna Every soul shall taste of death; Then unto Us (only) ye shall (all) be returned. See 29:56

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanubawwi-annahum mina l-janati ghurafan tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā niʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīna Those who have faith and do righteous deeds, We will surely settle them in lofty abodes of paradise with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. How excellent is the reward of the workers!

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanubawwi-annahum mina l-janati ghurafan tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā niʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīna And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise (elevated) chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the (righteous) workers. See 29:56

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanubawwi-annahum mina l-janati ghurafan tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā niʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīna And those who believe and do good, certainly will We lodge them in the exalted places in the gardens beneath which flow rivers, they shall abide therein; How excellent is the recompense of those who act (aright), See 29:56

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna —Those who are patient and who put their trust in their Lord.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely. See 29:56

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Those who are steadfast and, on their Lord, do they rely, See 29:56
