item.title: Al-Ankaboot:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ waka-ayyin min dābbatin lā taḥmilu riz'qahā l-lahu yarzuquhā wa-iyyākum wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu How many an animal there is that does not carry its own provision. Allah provides for it, and for you, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ waka-ayyin min dābbatin lā taḥmilu riz'qahā l-lahu yarzuquhā wa-iyyākum wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And how many a creature carries not its (own) provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing. See 29:56

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ waka-ayyin min dābbatin lā taḥmilu riz'qahā l-lahu yarzuquhā wa-iyyākum wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And how many a moving creature that doth not carry (along with it or does not own.) its sustenance; God sustaineth it and yourselves; And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. Among the moving beings there are few or none which carry its sustenance. God provides all the sustenance, so it is sheer lack of faith that man started to control the reproduction on the basis of family planning for economical consideration.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna If you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth, and disposed the sun and the moon?' They will surely say, 'Allah.' Then where do they stray?

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allah." Then how are they deluded? And if you were to ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" They will surely reply: "Allah." How then are they deviating (29:61). Allah expands the provision for whom He wills of His servants, and straitens it for whom (He wills). Verily, Allah is the All-Knower of everything (29:62). And if you were to ask them: "Who sends down water from the sky, and gives life therewith to the earth after its death?" They will surely reply:…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna And if thou ask them: "Who created the heavens and the earth and made subservient the sun and the moon?" Certainly will they say: "God!" Whence are they then turned away? In order to remove man's economical apprehensions, Qur'an draws man's attention to the fact that the creation of the heavens, the earth and the other terrestrial and heavenly bodies including man himself and their destruction and death, all are beyond the human will and choice. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ al-lahu yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun Allah expands the provision for whomever He wishes of His servants, and tightens it for him. Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ al-lahu yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing. See 29:61

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ al-lahu yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun God (it is Who) maketh abundant the sustenance for whomsoever He willeth of His servants, and (similarly) He causeth it to be straitened for him (whomsoever He willeth); Verily God is Well-Cognizant of all things. See 29:61

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man nazzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa min baʿdi mawtihā layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna And if you ask them, 'Who sends down water from the sky, with which He revives the earth after its death?' They will surely say, 'Allah.' Say, 'All praise belongs to Allah!' But most of them do not apply reason.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man nazzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa min baʿdi mawtihā layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Praise to Allah"; but most of them do not reason. See 29:61

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man nazzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa min baʿdi mawtihā layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna And if thou ask them, "Who sendeth down from heaven the water, and giveth life with it unto the earth after its death?" Certainly, will they say: "God!" Say, "all praise is His;" Nay! most of them understand not. See 29:61

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ wamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā lahwun walaʿibun wa-inna l-dāra l-ākhirata lahiya l-ḥayawānu law kānū yaʿlamūna The life of this world is nothing but diversion and play, but the abode of the Hereafter is indeed Life, had they known!

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ wamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā lahwun walaʿibun wa-inna l-dāra l-ākhirata lahiya l-ḥayawānu law kānū yaʿlamūna And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the (eternal) life, if only they knew. And this life of the world is only an amusement and a play! Verily, the home of the Hereafter – that is the life indeed, if they but knew (29:64). And when they embark on a ship, they invoke Allah, making their faith pure for Him only, but when He brings them safely to land, behold, they give a share of their worship to others (29:65). So that they become ingrate for that which We have given them, and that they take their…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ wamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā lahwun walaʿibun wa-inna l-dāra l-ākhirata lahiya l-ḥayawānu law kānū yaʿlamūna And nothing is this life of the world but a vain sport and play; and verily the abode of the hereafter, is certainly the life: if they but know. This reduces the importance and the value of this worldly life and its comforts and miseries. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوْۤا فِي الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ fa-idhā rakibū fī l-ful'ki daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari idhā hum yush'rikūna When they board the ship, they invoke Allah putting exclusive faith in Him, but when He delivers them to land, behold, they ascribe partners [to Him],

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوْۤا فِي الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ fa-idhā rakibū fī l-ful'ki daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari idhā hum yush'rikūna And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion (i.e., faith and hope). But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him. See 29:64

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوْۤا فِي الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ fa-idhā rakibū fī l-ful'ki daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari idhā hum yush'rikūna And when embark they on ships, call they upon God sincerely vowing worship (only) unto Him, and when He bringeth them safe to land, behold! they associate (others with Him), See 29:64

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum waliyatamattaʿū fasawfa yaʿlamūna being ungrateful for what We have given them! So let them enjoy. Soon they will know!

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum waliyatamattaʿū fasawfa yaʿlamūna So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.1 See 29:64

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum waliyatamattaʿū fasawfa yaʿlamūna (Then) let them thank not for what We have given them, and let them enjoy; (as they chose.) but soon shall they know. See 29:64

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ awalam yaraw annā jaʿalnā ḥaraman āminan wayutakhaṭṭafu l-nāsu min ḥawlihim afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yakfurūna Have they not seen that We have appointed a safe sanctuary,1 while the people are despoiled all around them? Would they then believe in falsehood and be ungrateful toward the blessing of Allah?

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ awalam yaraw annā jaʿalnā ḥaraman āminan wayutakhaṭṭafu l-nāsu min ḥawlihim afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yakfurūna Have they not seen that We made (Makkah) a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away1 all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve? Have they not seen that We have made a secure sanctuary, while men are being snatched away from all around them? Then do they believe in falsehood, and deny the graces of Allah (29:67). And who does more wrong than he who invents a lie against Allah or denies the truth, when it comes to him? Is there not a dwelling in Hell for the disbelievers (29:68). As for those who strive hard for Us, We…

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ awalam yaraw annā jaʿalnā ḥaraman āminan wayutakhaṭṭafu l-nāsu min ḥawlihim afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yakfurūna What! See they not that We have established a Sacred Precinct Secure, while people are ravaged all around them? Will they yet believe in the falsehood and in the bounty of God disbelieve? See 29:64

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīna Who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah, or denies the truth when it comes to him? Is not the [final] abode of the faithless in hell?

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīna And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a (sufficient) residence for the disbelievers? See 29:67

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīna And who is more unjust than he who forgeth a lie against God, or belieth the truth when it hath come unto him? Is not in the Hell the abode for the disbelievers? See 29:64

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوْۤا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-alladhīna jāhadū fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā wa-inna l-laha lamaʿa l-muḥ'sinīna As for those who strive in Us, We shall surely guide them in Our ways, and Allah is indeed with the virtuous.

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوْۤا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-alladhīna jāhadū fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā wa-inna l-laha lamaʿa l-muḥ'sinīna And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.1 And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good. See 29:67

item.title: Al-Ankaboot:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوْۤا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-alladhīna jāhadū fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā wa-inna l-laha lamaʿa l-muḥ'sinīna And those who strive hard in (About – or to serve or to know.) Us, certainly will We guide them in Our ways; And verily God is (always) with those who do good. God is always with those who do good to others. This is the most promising assurance for those who sincerely strive in the Way of the Lord. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-A'raaf:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: المص alif-lam-meem-sad Alif, Lām, Mīm, Ṣād.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: المص alif-lam-meem-sad Alif, Lām, Meem, Ṣād.1 كِتَابٌ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ (This is the) Book (the Qur'an) sent down unto you (O Muhammad) Which is from your Lord: فَلَا يَكُن فِي صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِّنْهُ so let not your breast be narrow therefrom, Meaning: having doubt about it according to Mujahid, Qatadah and As-Suddi. It was also said that the meaning here is: 'do not hesitate to convey the Qur'an and warn with it,' فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُولُو الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ Therefore be patient as did the Messengers of strong will (46:35) Allah said here: لِتُنذِرَ بِهِ that you warn thereby Meaning: 'We sent down the Qur'an so that you may warn the disbelievers with it,' وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ and a reminder unto the believers Allah then said to the world: اتَّبِعُوا مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ Follow what has been sent down unto…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: المص alif-lam-meem-sad Alif, Laam, Meem, Saad. Alif, Lam, Meem, Saad - (A, I., M, S). The first three letters are the same which appeared in the beginning of the Second Chapter. The fourth letter, Saad, is supposed by the commentators to stand for 'Sadiq'- the truthful. According to (M.F.A.)- 'An Allah ul-Muqtadir us-Sadiq', i.e., I am God the Omnipotent True One. The truth about the symbolic letters with which certain chapters of the Holy Qur'an start, which are divinely sealed secrets confided only with the Holy Prophet and his Divinely commissioned Deputies the Holy Imams. All the various explanations given by the various commentators are only conjectures1. However, when God Himself destined it to be a secret, there is no use or there can be no point in any one unnecessarily endeavouring to manifest His genius in perplexing the public…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُنْ فِي صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِنْهُ لِتُنْذِرَ بِهِ وَذِكْرٰی لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ kitābun unzila ilayka falā yakun fī ṣadrika ḥarajun min'hu litundhira bihi wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīna [This is] a Book that has been sent down to you —so let there be no disquiet in your heart on its account that you may warn thereby— and as an admonition for the faithful.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُنْ فِي صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِنْهُ لِتُنْذِرَ بِهِ وَذِكْرٰی لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ kitābun unzila ilayka falā yakun fī ṣadrika ḥarajun min'hu litundhira bihi wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīna (This is) a Book revealed to you, (O Muḥammad) - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers. See 7:1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُنْ فِي صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِنْهُ لِتُنْذِرَ بِهِ وَذِكْرٰی لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ kitābun unzila ilayka falā yakun fī ṣadrika ḥarajun min'hu litundhira bihi wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīna (The) Book (The Holy Qur'an.) (the Qur'an) hath been sent down unto thee so that there be no (Should not be.) straintendness or narrowness in thy (The Prophet addressed for the people.) breast about it, that thou mayest warn thereby (and it be) a reminder to the believers. See 7:1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّبِعُوْۤا مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ittabiʿū mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum walā tattabiʿū min dūnihi awliyāa qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna Follow what has been sent down to you from your Lord, and do not follow any masters besides Him. Little is the admonition that you take!

item.title: Al-A'raaf:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّبِعُوْۤا مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ittabiʿū mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum walā tattabiʿū min dūnihi awliyāa qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna Follow, (O mankind), what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies. Little do you remember. See 7:1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّبِعُوْۤا مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ittabiʿū mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum walā tattabiʿū min dūnihi awliyāa qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna (O' people!) Follow ye what hath been sent down unto you from your Lord, and follow ye not (any) other than Him (Any one, or anything else. This discredits 'Ijtihad' against any revelation.) , as (Your) guardians (or friends)', How little do ye mind. See 7:1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا فَجَاءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَائِلُونَ wakam min qaryatin ahlaknāhā fajāahā basunā bayātan aw hum qāilūna How many a town We have destroyed! Our punishment came to it at night, or while they were taking a midday nap.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا فَجَاءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَائِلُونَ wakam min qaryatin ahlaknāhā fajāahā basunā bayātan aw hum qāilūna And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon. And a great number of towns We destroyed. Our torment came upon them by night or while they were taking their midday nap (7:4). No cry did they utter when Our torment came upon them but this: Verily, we were wrongdoers (7:5). Then surely, We shall question those (people) to whom it was sent and verily, We shall question the Messengers (7:6). Then surely, We shall narrate unto them (their whole story) with knowledge, and indeed We have not been absent (7:7). Nations that were Destroyed Allah said: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا And a great number of towns…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا فَجَاءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَائِلُونَ wakam min qaryatin ahlaknāhā fajāahā basunā bayātan aw hum qāilūna And how many a town have We destroyed, Our wrath came unto them by night or while they reposed themselves at noonday (Refer to Verse 7:159.) . A living instance to prove the truth in this statement are the findings of the recent excavations in the various parts of the world where even flourishing cities have been found to be buried under hundreds of feet of earth covering them, from ages unknown to human history on earth.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوَاهُمْ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ famā kāna daʿwāhum idh jāahum basunā illā an qālū innā kunnā ẓālimīna Then their cry, when Our punishment overtook them, was only that they said, 'We have indeed been wrongdoers!'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوَاهُمْ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ famā kāna daʿwāhum idh jāahum basunā illā an qālū innā kunnā ẓālimīna And their declaration when Our punishment came to them was only that they said, "Indeed, we were wrongdoers!" See 7:4

item.title: Al-A'raaf:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوَاهُمْ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ famā kāna daʿwāhum idh jāahum basunā illā an qālū innā kunnā ẓālimīna So their cry, when Our wrath came unto them, was not but said they; "Verily we were unjust." See 7:4

item.title: Al-A'raaf:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنَسْءَلَنَّ الَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْءَلَنَّ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ falanasalanna alladhīna ur'sila ilayhim walanasalanna l-mur'salīna We will surely question those to whom the apostles were sent, and We will surely question the apostles.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنَسْءَلَنَّ الَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْءَلَنَّ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ falanasalanna alladhīna ur'sila ilayhim walanasalanna l-mur'salīna Then We will surely question those to whom (a message) was sent, and We will surely question the messengers. See 7:4

item.title: Al-A'raaf:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنَسْءَلَنَّ الَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْءَلَنَّ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ falanasalanna alladhīna ur'sila ilayhim walanasalanna l-mur'salīna Then certainly will We question those unto whom (Our apostles) were sent, and certainly will We also question the sent (i.e., The Apostles.) ones. The people concerned in this Verse are those to whom apostles were sent. They will be questioned as to how they treated the apostles from God-and their messages.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ بِعِلْمٍ وَمَا كُنَّا غَائِبِينَ falanaquṣṣanna ʿalayhim biʿil'min wamā kunnā ghāibīna Then We will surely recount to them with knowledge, for We had not been absent.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ بِعِلْمٍ وَمَا كُنَّا غَائِبِينَ falanaquṣṣanna ʿalayhim biʿil'min wamā kunnā ghāibīna Then We will surely relate (their deeds) to them with knowledge, and We were not (at all) absent. See 7:4

item.title: Al-A'raaf:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ بِعِلْمٍ وَمَا كُنَّا غَائِبِينَ falanaquṣṣanna ʿalayhim biʿil'min wamā kunnā ghāibīna Then certainly will We relate to them with knowledge for We were not absent. To know how the conduct of the people will be related to them refer to 36:65. The mouths of the people will be sealed, and the various organs of their body will be caused to relate what all they did.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ wal-waznu yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna The weighing [of deeds] on that Day is a truth. As for those whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales —it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ wal-waznu yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna And the weighing (of deeds) that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful. And the weighing on that Day will be the true (weighing). So, as for those whose scale (of good deeds) will be heavy, they will be the successful (by entering Paradise) (7:8). And as for those whose scale will be light, they are those who will lose themselves for their wrongful behavior with Our Ayat (7:9). The Meaning of Weighing the Deeds Allah said: وَالْوَزْنُ And the weighing Which is of deeds on the Day of Resurrection: الْحَقُّ will be the true (weighing) For Allah will not wrong anyone. Allah said in other Ayat: وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِينَ…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ wal-waznu yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna And the measuring (Of the deeds of every individual. Stands for the effectivity of the actions in the order of the Universe. (A.P.). Refer to Verses 18:105; 21:47.) (of the deeds) that day will be just; so whomsoever's weight be heavy those are they who shall be successful. 'Wazan', literally meaning weight or weightage, means justice-or the means of knowing or valuing the correct weightage or measure or worth of a thing. Weighing by God means that every matter will be dealt with, with perfect justice. It was asked of the Seventh Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq whether the deeds of the people will be weighed on the Day of Judgment. He replied, "deeds are not material things to be measured…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَظْلِمُونَ waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum bimā kānū biāyātinā yaẓlimūna As for those whose deeds weigh light in the scales, —it is they who have ruined their souls, because they used to wrong Our signs.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَظْلِمُونَ waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum bimā kānū biāyātinā yaẓlimūna And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses. See 7:8

item.title: Al-A'raaf:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَظْلِمُونَ waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum bimā kānū biāyātinā yaẓlimūna And those whose measure (of the deeds) is light, those are they whose souls suffer loss for what they, with Our signs, did behave unjustly (Indicates that the actions will be weighed with the attitude of the mind towards the signs and not according to the quantity of the actions. The 6th Holy Imam Ja'far as-Sadiq says that even if a man stands the whole night in prayer and fasted the whole of his life, it will avail him of nothing if his deeds are not duly guided by the authority appointed by God. (A.P.).) . The meaning of this Verse is made clear by the previous Verse, i.e., those whose evils will be more than their virtues,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ walaqad makkannākum fī l-arḍi wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha qalīlan mā tashkurūna Certainly We have established you on the earth, and made in it [various] means of livelihood for you. Little do you thank.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ walaqad makkannākum fī l-arḍi wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha qalīlan mā tashkurūna And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful. And surely, We gave you authority on the earth and appointed for you therein livelihoods. Little thanks do you give (7:10). All Bounties in the Heavens and Earth are for the Benefit of Mankind Allah reminds of His favor on His servants in that He made the earth a fixed place for dwelling, placed firm mountains and rivers on it and made homes and allowed them to utilize its benefits. Allah made the clouds work for them (bringing rain) so that they may produce their sustenance from them. He also created the ways and means of earnings,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ walaqad makkannākum fī l-arḍi wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha qalīlan mā tashkurūna And indeed, We have made you inhabit in the earth, and have made We, the means of livelihood for you in it; little it is that ye give thanks. Ma-ayish means the means for the fulfilment of life. In addition to all the material things necessary to sustain life, it also refers to all those powers and faculties which help man to rise to a higher plane to prepare for his spiritual destiny, on account of which the angels were asked to prostrate themselves before Adam. Iblis refused to be of those who bowed down, because he arrogantly despised the angels who bowed down as well as man to whom they bowed down. Arrogance, envy and rebellion were…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ walaqad khalaqnākum thumma ṣawwarnākum thumma qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa lam yakun mina l-sājidīna Certainly We created you, then We formed you, then We said to the angels, 'Prostrate before Adam.' So they [all] prostrated, but not Iblis: he was not among those who prostrated.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ walaqad khalaqnākum thumma ṣawwarnākum thumma qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa lam yakun mina l-sājidīna And We have certainly created you, (O mankind), and given you (human) form. Then We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees.1 He was not of those who prostrated. And surely, We created you and then gave you shape; then We told the angels, "Prostrate yourselves to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblis (Shaytan), he refused to be of those who prostrated (7:11). Prostration of the Angels to Adam and Shaytan's Arrogance Allah informs the Children of Adam about the honor of their father and the enmity of Shaytan, who still has envy for them and for their father Adam. So they…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ walaqad khalaqnākum thumma ṣawwarnākum thumma qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa lam yakun mina l-sājidīna And indeed We did create (Start creating and fashioning - not a simultaneous action - but under a gradual process mentioned (A.P.).) you, then We did fashion you, then said We unto the angels; "Prostrate yourselves unto Adam;" so they all did prostrate themselves except Iblees; he was not of the prostrating ones (Refer to Verses 2:30; 2:34; 15:28; 38:73; 18:50; 40:67.) . As said above under Verse 10, the spiritual destiny of man put him above the angels and jinn, so the refusal of Shaytan (Iblis) to accept man's superiority was unreasonable. It was egotism which prompted him to impertinent rebellion. Allah created man with His own…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ qāla mā manaʿaka allā tasjuda idh amartuka qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin Said He, 'What prevented you from prostrating, when I commanded you?' 'I am better than him,' he said. 'You created me from fire and You created him from clay.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ qāla mā manaʿaka allā tasjuda idh amartuka qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin (Allah) said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?" (Satan) said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay (i.e., earth)." (Allah) said: "What prevented you (O Iblis) that you did not prostrate, when I commanded you?" Iblis said: "I am better than him (Adam), You created me from fire, and him You created from clay.") Allah sai (7:12). مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ What prevented you (O Iblis) that you did not prostrate (7:12) Meaning: what stopped and hindered you from prostrating after I ordered you to do so, according to Ibn Jarir. This meaning is sound,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ qāla mā manaʿaka allā tasjuda idh amartuka qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin Said He (God.) : "What preventeth thee that thou didst not prostrate when I did command thee?" said he (Iblees.) "I am better than him, me hast thou created of fire while thou didst create him (Adam.) (Adam) of clay (Refer to Verses: 28:76; 40:67; 55:15.) ." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَاخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ qāla fa-ih'biṭ min'hā famā yakūnu laka an tatakabbara fīhā fa-ukh'ruj innaka mina l-ṣāghirīna 'Get down from it!' He said. 'It is not for you to be arrogant therein. Begone! You are indeed among the degraded ones.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَاخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ qāla fa-ih'biṭ min'hā famā yakūnu laka an tatakabbara fīhā fa-ukh'ruj innaka mina l-ṣāghirīna (Allah) said, "Descend from it (i.e., Paradise), for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased." (Allah) said: "(O Iblis) get down from this (Paradise), it is not for you to be arrogant here. Get out, for you are of those humiliated and disgraced (7:13). (Iblis) said: "Allow me respite till the Day they are raised up (the Day of Resurrection) (7:14). (Allah) said: "You are of those respited.") Allah ordered Ibli (7:15). فَاهْبِطْ مِنْهَا Get down from this "because you defied My command and disobeyed Me. Get out, it is not for you to be arrogant here," in Paradise, according to the scholars…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَاخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ qāla fa-ih'biṭ min'hā famā yakūnu laka an tatakabbara fīhā fa-ukh'ruj innaka mina l-ṣāghirīna Said He (Means degradation in the state, Loss of rank rather than the change of place. (A.P.).) : Get thee down hence for it doth not befit thee to behave proudly therein. Get thee out; verily thou art of the despised ones. See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He said, 'Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna (Satan) said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected." See 7:13

item.title: Al-A'raaf:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna Said he: "Grant me respite until the day when they are raised up (resurrected)." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla innaka mina l-munẓarīna Said He, 'You are indeed among the reprieved.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla innaka mina l-munẓarīna (Allah) said, "Indeed, you are of those reprieved." See 7:13

item.title: Al-A'raaf:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla innaka mina l-munẓarīna He said: "Verily thou shalt be of the respited (This indicates that the life here is the life of conflict and not of compulsion but of free choice. (A.P.).) ones (Refer to Verses 38:80; 15:37.) ." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَبِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ qāla fabimā aghwaytanī la-aqʿudanna lahum ṣirāṭaka l-mus'taqīma 'As You have consigned me to perversity,' he said, 'I will surely lie in wait for them on Your straight path.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَبِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ qāla fabimā aghwaytanī la-aqʿudanna lahum ṣirāṭaka l-mus'taqīma (Satan) said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them (i.e., mankind) on Your straight path. (Iblis) said: "Because You have 'Aghwaytni', surely, I will sit in wait against them (human beings) on Your straight pat (7:16). "Then I will come to them from before them and behind them, from their right and from their left, and You will not find most of them to be thankful (7:17). Allah said that after He gave respite to Shaytan: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ till the Day they are raised up (resurrected) and Iblis was sure that he got what he wanted, he went on in defiance and rebellion. He said: فَبِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ "Because You have 'Aghwaytani', surely, I…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَبِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ qāla fabimā aghwaytanī la-aqʿudanna lahum ṣirāṭaka l-mus'taqīma Said he: "As Thou hast deprived me, surely will I lay wait for them (The issues of Adam.) in Thy straight (The Right Path.) (right) path." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَءَاتِيَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِهِمْ وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِهِمْ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَاكِرِينَ thumma laātiyannahum min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim waʿan aymānihim waʿan shamāilihim walā tajidu aktharahum shākirīna Then I will come at them from their front and from their rear, and from their right and their left, and You will not find most of them to be grateful.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَءَاتِيَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِهِمْ وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِهِمْ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَاكِرِينَ thumma laātiyannahum min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim waʿan aymānihim waʿan shamāilihim walā tajidu aktharahum shākirīna Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful (to You)." See 7:16

item.title: Al-A'raaf:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَءَاتِيَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِهِمْ وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِهِمْ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَاكِرِينَ thumma laātiyannahum min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim waʿan aymānihim waʿan shamāilihim walā tajidu aktharahum shākirīna Then will I surely come upon them from before them, and from behind them and from their right side and from their left side; and Thou (God.) wilt not find most of them thankful. See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُومًا مَدْحُورًا لَمَنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla ukh'ruj min'hā madhūman madḥūran laman tabiʿaka min'hum la-amla-anna jahannama minkum ajmaʿīna Said He, 'Begone hence, blameful, banished! Whoever of them follows you, I will surely fill hell with you all.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُومًا مَدْحُورًا لَمَنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla ukh'ruj min'hā madhūman madḥūran laman tabiʿaka min'hum la-amla-anna jahannama minkum ajmaʿīna (Allah) said, "Depart from it (i.e., Paradise), reproached and expelled. Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together." (Allah) said (to Iblis): Get out from this (Paradise), Madh'uman Madhura. Whoever of them (mankind) will follow you, then surely, I will fill Hell with you all (7:18). Allah emphasized His cursing, expelling, banishing and turning Shaytan away from the uppermost heights, saying; Ibn Jarir said, "As for Madh'um, it is disgraced." And he said, "Madhur is the distanced, that is, he is banished and expelled." 'Abdur-Rahman bin Zayd bin Aslam said, "We do not know of any who is Madh'uh and Madhmum except for one." Sufyan Ath-Thawri narrated from Abu…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُومًا مَدْحُورًا لَمَنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla ukh'ruj min'hā madhūman madḥūran laman tabiʿaka min'hum la-amla-anna jahannama minkum ajmaʿīna He said (God.) ; "Get thee out of this (state), despised, driven away; whosoever of them (The issues of Adam.) followeth thee, certainly will I fill the hell with you all." The story of the fall of Satan has been differently given in the Bible: Isaiah 14/12-20. For the details of the creation of Adam and Iblis declining to prostrate before Adam, and the fall of Satan, refer to Verses 2:30 - 2:34. Iblis argued saying that he was created of fire and Adam of dust, and it will not be justifiable for a superior being to adore an inferior one, but Satan failed to consider the three factors in favour of the creation of Adam.…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاءَادَمُ اسْكُنْ أَنْتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ wayāādamu us'kun anta wazawjuka l-janata fakulā min ḥaythu shi'tumā walā taqrabā hādhihi l-shajarata fatakūnā mina l-ẓālimīna [Then He said to Adam,] 'O Adam, dwell with your mate in paradise, and eat thereof whence you wish; but do not approach this tree, lest you should be among the wrongdoers.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاءَادَمُ اسْكُنْ أَنْتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ wayāādamu us'kun anta wazawjuka l-janata fakulā min ḥaythu shi'tumā walā taqrabā hādhihi l-shajarata fatakūnā mina l-ẓālimīna And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers." And O Adam! Dwell you and your wife in Paradise, and eat thereof as you both wish, but approach not this tree otherwise you both will be of the wrongdoers (7:19). Then Shaytan whispered suggestions to them both in order to uncover that which was hidden from them of their private parts (before); he said: "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree save you should become angels or become of the immortals (7:20). And he 'Qāsamahuma': "Verily, I am…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاءَادَمُ اسْكُنْ أَنْتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ wayāādamu us'kun anta wazawjuka l-janata fakulā min ḥaythu shi'tumā walā taqrabā hādhihi l-shajarata fatakūnā mina l-ẓālimīna And O' Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the garden (State of enjoyment and bliss without any want or endeavour.) , so eat ye two from wherever ye two desire, but go (As already pointed out, this order to Adam was not imperative but explanatory to the requirement of the State in which Adam then was stationed (A.P.). Refer to Verse 2:35.) not ye two nigh into this tree for then ye two will be of the unjust (In relation to the state and not any disobedience to any definite order of God - In short Adam was informed that he will lose the state of comfort…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ لِيُبْدِيَ لَهُمَا مَا وُورِيَ عَنْهُمَا مِنْ سَوْءَاتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهَاكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَا مَلَكَيْنِ أَوْ تَكُونَا مِنَ الْخَالِدِينَ fawaswasa lahumā l-shayṭānu liyub'diya lahumā mā wūriya ʿanhumā min sawātihimā waqāla mā nahākumā rabbukumā ʿan hādhihi l-shajarati illā an takūnā malakayni aw takūnā mina l-khālidīna Then Satan tempted them, to expose to them what was hidden from them of their nakedness, and he said, 'Your Lord has only forbidden you from this tree lest you should become angels, or lest you become immortal.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ لِيُبْدِيَ لَهُمَا مَا وُورِيَ عَنْهُمَا مِنْ سَوْءَاتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهَاكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَا مَلَكَيْنِ أَوْ تَكُونَا مِنَ الْخَالِدِينَ fawaswasa lahumā l-shayṭānu liyub'diya lahumā mā wūriya ʿanhumā min sawātihimā waqāla mā nahākumā rabbukumā ʿan hādhihi l-shajarati illā an takūnā malakayni aw takūnā mina l-khālidīna But Satan whispered to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal." See 7:19

item.title: Al-A'raaf:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ لِيُبْدِيَ لَهُمَا مَا وُورِيَ عَنْهُمَا مِنْ سَوْءَاتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهَاكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَا مَلَكَيْنِ أَوْ تَكُونَا مِنَ الْخَالِدِينَ fawaswasa lahumā l-shayṭānu liyub'diya lahumā mā wūriya ʿanhumā min sawātihimā waqāla mā nahākumā rabbukumā ʿan hādhihi l-shajarati illā an takūnā malakayni aw takūnā mina l-khālidīna Then whispered Satan evil suggestions unto the two (Adam and Eve) that he might display unto them what hath been kept hidden from them of their shame, and said he (Satan.) : "Forbade not ye two, your Lord from this tree save lest ye two may become angels or lest ye two may become (Remain or live forever.) the immortals." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَاسَمَهُمَا اِنِّیْ لَكُمَا لَمِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ waqāsamahumā innī lakumā lamina l-nāṣiḥīna And he swore to them, 'I am indeed your well-wisher.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَاسَمَهُمَا اِنِّیْ لَكُمَا لَمِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ waqāsamahumā innī lakumā lamina l-nāṣiḥīna And he swore (by Allah) to them, "Indeed, I am to you from among the sincere advisors." See 7:19

item.title: Al-A'raaf:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَاسَمَهُمَا اِنِّیْ لَكُمَا لَمِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ waqāsamahumā innī lakumā lamina l-nāṣiḥīna And he (Satan.) swore unto them both: "Verily I am unto you a sincere adviser." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَدَلَّاهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَاتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنْ وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَنَادَاهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَنْ تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُلْ لَكُمَا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ fadallāhumā bighurūrin falammā dhāqā l-shajarata badat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi l-janati wanādāhumā rabbuhumā alam anhakumā ʿan til'kumā l-shajarati wa-aqul lakumā inna l-shayṭāna lakumā ʿaduwwun mubīnun Thus he brought about their fall by deception. So when they tasted of the tree, their nakedness became exposed to them, and they began to stitch over themselves with the leaves of paradise. Their Lord called out to them, 'Did I not forbid you from that tree, and tell you, "Satan is indeed your manifest enemy?" '

item.title: Al-A'raaf:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَدَلَّاهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَاتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنْ وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَنَادَاهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَنْ تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُلْ لَكُمَا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ fadallāhumā bighurūrin falammā dhāqā l-shajarata badat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi l-janati wanādāhumā rabbuhumā alam anhakumā ʿan til'kumā l-shajarati wa-aqul lakumā inna l-shayṭāna lakumā ʿaduwwun mubīnun So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?" So he misled them with deception. Then when they tasted of the tree, that which was hidden from them of their shame (private parts) became…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَدَلَّاهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَاتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنْ وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَنَادَاهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَنْ تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُلْ لَكُمَا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ fadallāhumā bighurūrin falammā dhāqā l-shajarata badat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi l-janati wanādāhumā rabbuhumā alam anhakumā ʿan til'kumā l-shajarati wa-aqul lakumā inna l-shayṭāna lakumā ʿaduwwun mubīnun Then he (Satan.) instigated them both by deceit (Aiming something and telling something else Refer to Verse 7:20. i.e. aiming at the first sentence of the Verse 7:20 and telling the concluding words of Verse 7:20.) so when they (Adam and Eve.) tasted (of) the tree their shameful things got displayed unto them, and they both began covering themselves with the leaves of the Garden; and called out unto them their Lord (saying): "Did I not forbid ye two that tree, and (did I…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ qālā rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa-in lam taghfir lanā watarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna They said, 'Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves! If You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ qālā rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa-in lam taghfir lanā watarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." See 7:22

item.title: Al-A'raaf:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ qālā rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa-in lam taghfir lanā watarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna Said (Prayed Saying.) they (Adam and Eve.) "O' Our Lord! Unjust (In losing the state which was given - This is not the actual loss - The actual loss will be only if Thou forgive not. (A.P.).) have we been unto ourselves, and if Thou forgive us not and deal (not) with mercy unto us (then), We will certainly be of the losers." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اهْبِطُوْۤا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ وَلَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ qāla ih'biṭū baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun walakum fī l-arḍi mus'taqarrun wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin He said, 'Get down, being enemies of one another! On the earth shall be your abode and sustenance for a time.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اهْبِطُوْۤا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ وَلَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ qāla ih'biṭū baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun walakum fī l-arḍi mus'taqarrun wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin (Allah) said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment (i.e., provision) for a time." (Allah) said: "Get down, one of you an enemy to the other. On earth will be a dwelling place for you and an enjoyment for a time (7:24). He said: "Therein you shall live, and therein you shall die, and from it you shall be brought out (resurrected) (7:25). Sending Them All Down to Earth It was said that: اهْبِطُوا Get down Which is was addressed to Adam, Hawwa', Iblis and the snake. Some scholars did not mention the snake, and Allah knows best. The enmity is primarily between Adam…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اهْبِطُوْۤا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ وَلَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ qāla ih'biṭū baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun walakum fī l-arḍi mus'taqarrun wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin He (God.) said: "Get ye (Adam and Eve.) down (In State. This again establishes the present life as a state of conflict. Refer to Verse 7:17.) , some of you (being) the enemies of the others; and for you there is in the earth an abode and a provision (of sustenance) for a (fixed) time (Term.) ." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ qāla fīhā taḥyawna wafīhā tamūtūna wamin'hā tukh'rajūna He said, 'In it you will live, and in it you will die; and from it you will be raised [from the dead].'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ qāla fīhā taḥyawna wafīhā tamūtūna wamin'hā tukh'rajūna He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth." See 7:24

item.title: Al-A'raaf:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ qāla fīhā taḥyawna wafīhā tamūtūna wamin'hā tukh'rajūna (And) said He (God.) : "Therein ye shall live, and therein shall ye die, and from it ye shall be brought (Resurrected.) out." See 7:11

item.title: Al-A'raaf:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ قَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْءَاتِكُمْ وَرِيشًا وَلِبَاسُ التَّقْوَى ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ yābanī ādama qad anzalnā ʿalaykum libāsan yuwārī sawātikum warīshan walibāsu l-taqwā dhālika khayrun dhālika min āyāti l-lahi laʿallahum yadhakkarūna 'O Children of Adam! We have certainly sent down to you garments to cover your nakedness, and for adornment. Yet the garment of Godwariness—that is the best.' That is [one] of Allah's signs, so that they may take admonition.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ قَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْءَاتِكُمْ وَرِيشًا وَلِبَاسُ التَّقْوَى ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ yābanī ādama qad anzalnā ʿalaykum libāsan yuwārī sawātikum warīshan walibāsu l-taqwā dhālika khayrun dhālika min āyāti l-lahi laʿallahum yadhakkarūna O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember. O Children of Adam! We have bestowed Libas (raiment) upon you to cover yourselves with, and as Rish (adornment); and the Libas (raiment) of Taqwa, that is better. Such are among the Ayat of Allah, that they may remember (7:26). Bestowing Raiment and Adornment on Mankind Allah reminds His servants that He has given them Libas and Rish. Libas refers to the clothes…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ قَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْءَاتِكُمْ وَرِيشًا وَلِبَاسُ التَّقْوَى ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ yābanī ādama qad anzalnā ʿalaykum libāsan yuwārī sawātikum warīshan walibāsu l-taqwā dhālika khayrun dhālika min āyāti l-lahi laʿallahum yadhakkarūna O' children of Adam! Indeed We have sent down unto you raiment to cover your shame and (for) adornment (Including all means of comfort.) and the raiment of piety, that is the best; this (Refers to the provision of the means of the physical and the spiritual development.) is of the signs of God that ye may be mindful (In using the said mean; healthily and harmoniously and constructively.) . See 7:19

item.title: Al-A'raaf:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ كَمَا أَخْرَجَ أَبَوَيْكُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْءَاتِهِمَا إِنَّهُ يَرَاكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ yābanī ādama lā yaftinannakumu l-shayṭānu kamā akhraja abawaykum mina l-janati yanziʿu ʿanhumā libāsahumā liyuriyahumā sawātihimā innahu yarākum huwa waqabīluhu min ḥaythu lā tarawnahum innā jaʿalnā l-shayāṭīna awliyāa lilladhīna lā yu'minūna 'O Children of Adam! Do not let Satan tempt you, like he expelled your parents from paradise, stripping them of their garments to expose to them their nakedness. Indeed he sees you—he and his hosts— whence you do not see them. We have indeed made the devils friends of those who have no faith.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ كَمَا أَخْرَجَ أَبَوَيْكُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْءَاتِهِمَا إِنَّهُ يَرَاكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ yābanī ādama lā yaftinannakumu l-shayṭānu kamā akhraja abawaykum mina l-janati yanziʿu ʿanhumā libāsahumā liyuriyahumā sawātihimā innahu yarākum huwa waqabīluhu min ḥaythu lā tarawnahum innā jaʿalnā l-shayāṭīna awliyāa lilladhīna lā yu'minūna O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise, stripping them of their clothing1 to show them their private parts. Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them. Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe. O Children of Adam! Let not Shaytan deceive you, as he got your parents out of Paradise, stripping them of their raiment, to show them…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ كَمَا أَخْرَجَ أَبَوَيْكُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْءَاتِهِمَا إِنَّهُ يَرَاكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ yābanī ādama lā yaftinannakumu l-shayṭānu kamā akhraja abawaykum mina l-janati yanziʿu ʿanhumā libāsahumā liyuriyahumā sawātihimā innahu yarākum huwa waqabīluhu min ḥaythu lā tarawnahum innā jaʿalnā l-shayāṭīna awliyāa lilladhīna lā yu'minūna O' children of Adam! Let (A warning to mankind against the mischievous aim of Satan in the field of the conflicts, though his activities might result in some physical progress for man. Refer to Verses 7:14 - 7:17.) not Satan involve you into affliction as he got your parents out, from the garden (of the blissful life) stripping off their raiment, that he may expose unto them their shame; He watcheth you, he and (also) his tribe, from whence ye…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا فَعَلُوْۤا فَاحِشَةً قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهَا ءَابَاءَنَا وَاللَّهُ أَمَرَنَا بِهَا قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wa-idhā faʿalū fāḥishatan qālū wajadnā ʿalayhā ābāanā wal-lahu amaranā bihā qul inna l-laha lā yamuru bil-faḥshāi ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna When they commit an indecency, they say, 'We found our fathers practising it, and Allah has enjoined it upon us.' Say, 'Indeed Allah does not enjoin indecencies. Do you attribute to Allah what you do not know?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا فَعَلُوْۤا فَاحِشَةً قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهَا ءَابَاءَنَا وَاللَّهُ أَمَرَنَا بِهَا قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wa-idhā faʿalū fāḥishatan qālū wajadnā ʿalayhā ābāanā wal-lahu amaranā bihā qul inna l-laha lā yamuru bil-faḥshāi ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna And when they commit an immorality, they say, "We found our fathers doing it, and Allah has ordered us to do it." Say, "Indeed, Allah does not order immorality. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know?" And when they commit a 'Fāḥishah', they say: "We found our fathers doing it, and Allah has commanded it for us." Say: "Nay, Allah never commands 'Fāḥishah'. Do you say about Allah what you know not (7:28). Say: "My Lord has commanded justice and that you should face Him only, in every Masjid and invoke Him…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا فَعَلُوْۤا فَاحِشَةً قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهَا ءَابَاءَنَا وَاللَّهُ أَمَرَنَا بِهَا قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wa-idhā faʿalū fāḥishatan qālū wajadnā ʿalayhā ābāanā wal-lahu amaranā bihā qul inna l-laha lā yamuru bil-faḥshāi ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna And when they act lewdness say they: "We found (This is a common excuse with all the wrong doers.) our fathers (acting) upon this, and God hath enjoined it on us," Say: (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Verily God enjoineth not lewdness ('Fawahish' indecencies including nakedness - while circuiting round the 'Ka'ba'- as the pagans did while worshipping the idols- Other sins and crimes.) ; Do ye say against God what ye know not?" See 7:19

item.title: Al-A'raaf:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَمَرَ رَبِّي بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَقِيمُوْۤا وُجُوهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ كَمَا بَدَأَكُمْ تَعُودُونَ qul amara rabbī bil-qis'ṭi wa-aqīmū wujūhakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna kamā bada-akum taʿūdūna Say, 'My Lord has enjoined justice,' and [He has enjoined,] 'Set your heart [on Him] at every occasion of prayer, and invoke Him, putting your exclusive faith in Him. Even as He brought you forth in the beginning, so will you return.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَمَرَ رَبِّي بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَقِيمُوْۤا وُجُوهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ كَمَا بَدَأَكُمْ تَعُودُونَ qul amara rabbī bil-qis'ṭi wa-aqīmū wujūhakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna kamā bada-akum taʿūdūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "My Lord has ordered justice and that you direct yourselves (to the Qiblah) at every place (or time) of prostration, and invoke Him, sincere to Him in religion." Just as He originated you, you will return (to life). See 7:28

item.title: Al-A'raaf:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَمَرَ رَبِّي بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَقِيمُوْۤا وُجُوهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ كَمَا بَدَأَكُمْ تَعُودُونَ qul amara rabbī bil-qis'ṭi wa-aqīmū wujūhakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna kamā bada-akum taʿūdūna Say thou: "My Lord hath enjoined justice and set (Wherever ye be and stand for prayer-to turn to the 'Ka'ba' as the 'Qiblah'.) ye upright your faces at (each time and place) of prostration, and call (With full concentration and the presence of mind- Beseech.) upon Him, being sincere (With devout submission.) exclusively unto Him in religion; even as He brought (In accordance with the tendency with which life began, they will go back.) you forth (in the beginning) so unto Him shall ye also return." See 7:19

item.title: Al-A'raaf:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرِيقًا هَدَى وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلَالَةُ إِنَّهُمُ اتَّخَذُوا الشَّيَاطِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ farīqan hadā wafarīqan ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-ḍalālatu innahumu ittakhadhū l-shayāṭīna awliyāa min dūni l-lahi wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna A part [of mankind] He has guided and a part has deserved [to be consigned to] error, for they took devils for guardians instead of Allah, and supposed they were guided.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرِيقًا هَدَى وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلَالَةُ إِنَّهُمُ اتَّخَذُوا الشَّيَاطِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ farīqan hadā wafarīqan ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-ḍalālatu innahumu ittakhadhū l-shayāṭīna awliyāa min dūni l-lahi wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna A group (of you) He guided, and a group deserved (to be in) error. Indeed, they (i.e., the latter) had taken the devils as allies instead of Allah while they thought that they were guided. See 7:28

item.title: Al-A'raaf:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرِيقًا هَدَى وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلَالَةُ إِنَّهُمُ اتَّخَذُوا الشَّيَاطِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ farīqan hadā wafarīqan ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-ḍalālatu innahumu ittakhadhū l-shayāṭīna awliyāa min dūni l-lahi wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna A party He hath guided aright, and (the other) party entitled themselves to error; (for) verily they took the devils for their guardians other than God, and think they, that they are the ones guided aright. (Refer to Verse 17:16, 36:7.) A part of them owing to their getting astray has earned perdition. This Verse clearly says that the friends of the devils thought themselves to be guided aright. Hence the mere imagination of any people without the truth in it, to be on the right, is also a satanic delusion.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ خُذُوْۤا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَكُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا وَلَا تُسْرِفُوْۤا إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ yābanī ādama khudhū zīnatakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wakulū wa-ish'rabū walā tus'rifū innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'rifīna O Children of Adam! Put on your adornment on every occasion of prayer, and eat and drink, but do not waste; indeed He does not like the wasteful.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ خُذُوْۤا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَكُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا وَلَا تُسْرِفُوْۤا إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ yābanī ādama khudhū zīnatakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wakulū wa-ish'rabū walā tus'rifū innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'rifīna O children of Adam, take your adornment (i.e., wear your clothing) at every masjid,1 and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess. O Children of Adam! Take your adornment to every Masjid, and eat and drink, but waste not by extravagance, certainly He (Allah) likes not the wasteful (7:31). Allah Commands Taking Adornment When Going to the Masjid This honorable Ayah refutes the idolators' practice of performing Tawaf around the Sacred House while naked. Muslim, An-Nasa'i and Ibn Jarir, (the following wording is that of Ibn Jarir) recorded that Shu'bah said that Salamah bin Kuhayl said that Muslim Al-Batin said that Sa'id…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ خُذُوْۤا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَكُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا وَلَا تُسْرِفُوْۤا إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ yābanī ādama khudhū zīnatakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wakulū wa-ish'rabū walā tus'rifū innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'rifīna O' children of Adam! Be ye adorned at every time of prostration and eat ye and drink ye and commit ye not excesses; Verily He (God) loveth not the extravagants (This encourages the devotees to be well dressed and adorned as if they are going in festivity to meet the Lord. Condemns austerity, asceticism and luxury of extravagance in life.) . 'Zeenat' or embellishment refers to the cleanliness and decency of apparel specially against the pagan practice of going naked round the Ka'ba but the order is not restricted against any particular practice, but it has a wider significance. The second Holy Imam Hasan Ibn Ali al-Mujtaba used to put…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ وَالطَّيِّبَاتِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ قُلْ هِيَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ qul man ḥarrama zīnata l-lahi allatī akhraja liʿibādihi wal-ṭayibāti mina l-riz'qi qul hiya lilladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā khāliṣatan yawma l-qiyāmati kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna Say, 'Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has brought forth for His servants, and the good things of [His] provision?' Say, 'These are for the faithful in the life of this world, and exclusively for them on the Day of Resurrection.' Thus do We elaborate the signs for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ وَالطَّيِّبَاتِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ قُلْ هِيَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ qul man ḥarrama zīnata l-lahi allatī akhraja liʿibādihi wal-ṭayibāti mina l-riz'qi qul hiya lilladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā khāliṣatan yawma l-qiyāmati kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of (i.e., from) Allah which He has produced for His servants and the good (lawful) things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believed during the life of this world, exclusively (for them) on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know. Say: "Who has forbidden the adornment with clothes given by Allah, which He has produced for His servants, and At-Tayyibat (good things) of sustenance?" Say: "They are, in the life of this…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ وَالطَّيِّبَاتِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ قُلْ هِيَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ qul man ḥarrama zīnata l-lahi allatī akhraja liʿibādihi wal-ṭayibāti mina l-riz'qi qul hiya lilladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā khāliṣatan yawma l-qiyāmati kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna Say: (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Who hath prohibited (Rn. Or. the economical and the prohibitory problems in Islam. Every-thing on the earth is made for mankind provided it is acquired and used within the prescribed way and the limit.) the adornment (granted) of God, which He hath brought forth for His servants and the good things of the provisions?" Say: "These are for those who believe, in the (short) life of this world (to he) exclusively theirs on the Day of Judgment;" Thus do We explain in details…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالْإِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَأَنْ تُشْرِكُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَأَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qul innamā ḥarrama rabbiya l-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara min'hā wamā baṭana wal-ith'ma wal-baghya bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-an tush'rikū bil-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wa-an taqūlū ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna Say, 'My Lord has only forbidden indecencies, the outward among them and the inward ones, and sin and undue aggression, and that you should ascribe to Allah partners for which He has not sent down any authority, and that you should attribute to Allah what you do not know.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالْإِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَأَنْ تُشْرِكُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَأَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qul innamā ḥarrama rabbiya l-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara min'hā wamā baṭana wal-ith'ma wal-baghya bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-an tush'rikū bil-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wa-an taqūlū ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed - and sin,1 and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allah that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allah that which you do not know." Say: (But) the things that my Lord has indeed forbidden are the Fawahish (immoral deeds) whether committed openly or secretly, and Ithm, and transgression without right, and joining partners with Allah…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالْإِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَأَنْ تُشْرِكُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَأَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qul innamā ḥarrama rabbiya l-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara min'hā wamā baṭana wal-ith'ma wal-baghya bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-an tush'rikū bil-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wa-an taqūlū ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna Say: "Verily did prohibit my Lord only shameful (Includes all kinds of indecencies.) deeds, those apparent of them and those concealed, and sin and rebellion without (any) right, and that ye associate (not) with God for which hath not been sent down any authority, and that ye say (This is a clear warning against the unwarranted conjectures of the modern irreligious ones, against the ordinances of the Qur'an and the Holy Prophet.) (not) against God what ye know not (Refer to Verse…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ walikulli ummatin ajalun fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna There is a [preordained] time for every nation: when their time comes, they shall not defer it by a single hour nor shall they advance it.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ walikulli ummatin ajalun fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna And for every nation is a (specified) term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede (it). And every Ummah has its appointed term; when their term comes, neither can they delay it nor can they advance it an hour (or a moment) (7:34). O Children of Adam! If there come to you Messengers from among you, reciting to you My Ayat, then whosoever has Taqwa and becomes righteous, on them shall be no fear nor shall they grieve (7:35). But those who reject Our Ayat and treat them with arrogance, they are the dwellers of the Fire, they will abide therein forever (7:36). Allah said: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ And…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
