item.description: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ walikulli ummatin ajalun fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna And for every people (Community.) is (an appointed) term, so when cometh their (appointed) term, they shall not remain (Tarry.) behind an hour (even for the least while) nor can they go before (Refer to Verse 63:11.) . See 7:32

item.title: Al-A'raaf:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ إِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَاتِي فَمَنِ اتَّقَى وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ yābanī ādama immā yatiyannakum rusulun minkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātī famani ittaqā wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna O Children of Adam! If there come to you apostles from among yourselves, recounting to you My signs, then those who are Godwary and righteous will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ إِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَاتِي فَمَنِ اتَّقَى وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ yābanī ādama immā yatiyannakum rusulun minkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātī famani ittaqā wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna O children of Adam, if there come to you messengers from among you relating to you My verses (i.e., scriptures and laws), then whoever fears Allah and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve. See 7:34

item.title: Al-A'raaf:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ إِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَاتِي فَمَنِ اتَّقَى وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ yābanī ādama immā yatiyannakum rusulun minkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātī famani ittaqā wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna O' children of Adam! When come unto you apostles from among you, relating unto you My signs, then whosoever guardeth himself against evil and amendeth (The criterion of piety and amending is to follow the revealed guidance and the divinely appointed guide be that an Apostle or an Imam.) (himself), then no fear shall come upon them, nor shall they be grieved (Refer to Verse 2:38.) . See 7:32

item.title: Al-A'raaf:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna But those who deny Our signs and are disdainful of them, they shall be the inmates of the Fire and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: Al-A'raaf:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna But the ones who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally. See 7:34

item.title: Al-A'raaf:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna And those who belie our signs (the divinely appointed guides and their guidance.) and in pride turn away from them, these are the inmates of the (Hell) fire, and they shall abide therein. 'Wa 'stakbaru' declaring proudly against the signs, indicates the behaviour of the people with the Holy Prophet and the Holy Imams who are the greatest and the direct signs of God. The punishment which the people who misbehaved and annoyed the holy ones, is also mentioned as their being in the Hell for ever.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِءَايَاتِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُمْ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ قَالُوْا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْۤا عَنَّا وَشَهِدُوْۤا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا كَافِرِينَ faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi ulāika yanāluhum naṣībuhum mina l-kitābi ḥattā idhā jāathum rusulunā yatawaffawnahum qālū ayna mā kuntum tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā washahidū ʿalā anfusihim annahum kānū kāfirīna So who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah, or denies His signs? Their share, as decreed in the Book, shall reach them. When Our messengers1 come to take them away, they will say, 'Where is that which you used to invoke besides Allah?' They will say, 'They have forsaken us,' and they will testify against themselves that they were faithless.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِءَايَاتِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُمْ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ قَالُوْا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْۤا عَنَّا وَشَهِدُوْۤا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا كَافِرِينَ faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi ulāika yanāluhum naṣībuhum mina l-kitābi ḥattā idhā jāathum rusulunā yatawaffawnahum qālū ayna mā kuntum tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā washahidū ʿalā anfusihim annahum kānū kāfirīna And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Those will attain their portion of the decree1 until, when Our messengers (i.e., angels) come to them to take them in death, they will say, "Where are those you used to invoke besides Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us," and will bear witness against themselves that…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِءَايَاتِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُمْ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ قَالُوْا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْۤا عَنَّا وَشَهِدُوْۤا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا كَافِرِينَ faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi ulāika yanāluhum naṣībuhum mina l-kitābi ḥattā idhā jāathum rusulunā yatawaffawnahum qālū ayna mā kuntum tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā washahidū ʿalā anfusihim annahum kānū kāfirīna Who is then more unjust than he who orget (Accepting unauthorised opinions as the divine ones or actually belying the divine authorities like those of apostles or the Imams.) a lie against God or belieth His signs? Those (are they) unto whom shall reach their share (as decreed) in the Book; until come unto them Our messengers (The appearance of the angels may be to the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ادْخُلُوْۤا فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ فِي النَّارِ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ لَعَنَتْ أُخْتَهَا حَتّٰی إِذَا ادَّارَكُوْۤا فِيهَا جَمِيعًا قَالَتْ أُخْرَاهُمْ لِأُولَاهُمْ رَبَّنَا هَؤُلَاءِ أَضَلُّونَا فَءَاتِهِمْ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا مِنَ النَّارِ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَلَكِنْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qāla ud'khulū fī umamin qad khalat min qablikum mina l-jini wal-insi fī l-nāri kullamā dakhalat ummatun laʿanat ukh'tahā ḥattā idhā iddārakū fīhā jamīʿan qālat ukh'rāhum liūlāhum rabbanā hāulāi aḍallūnā faātihim ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan mina l-nāri qāla likullin ḍiʿ'fun walākin lā taʿlamūna He will say, 'Enter, along with the nations who passed before you of jinn and humans, into the Fire!' Every time that a nation enters [hell], it will curse its sister [nation]. When they all rejoin in it, the last of them will say about the first of them, 'Our Lord, it was they who led us astray; so give…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ادْخُلُوْۤا فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ فِي النَّارِ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ لَعَنَتْ أُخْتَهَا حَتّٰی إِذَا ادَّارَكُوْۤا فِيهَا جَمِيعًا قَالَتْ أُخْرَاهُمْ لِأُولَاهُمْ رَبَّنَا هَؤُلَاءِ أَضَلُّونَا فَءَاتِهِمْ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا مِنَ النَّارِ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَلَكِنْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qāla ud'khulū fī umamin qad khalat min qablikum mina l-jini wal-insi fī l-nāri kullamā dakhalat ummatun laʿanat ukh'tahā ḥattā idhā iddārakū fīhā jamīʿan qālat ukh'rāhum liūlāhum rabbanā hāulāi aḍallūnā faātihim ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan mina l-nāri qāla likullin ḍiʿ'fun walākin lā taʿlamūna (Allah) will say, "Enter among nations which had passed on before you of jinn and mankind into the Fire." Every time a nation enters, it will curse its sister1 until, when they have all overtaken one another therein, the last of them2 will say about the first of them,3 "Our Lord, these had misled us, so give them a double…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ادْخُلُوْۤا فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ فِي النَّارِ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ لَعَنَتْ أُخْتَهَا حَتّٰی إِذَا ادَّارَكُوْۤا فِيهَا جَمِيعًا قَالَتْ أُخْرَاهُمْ لِأُولَاهُمْ رَبَّنَا هَؤُلَاءِ أَضَلُّونَا فَءَاتِهِمْ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا مِنَ النَّارِ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَلَكِنْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qāla ud'khulū fī umamin qad khalat min qablikum mina l-jini wal-insi fī l-nāri kullamā dakhalat ummatun laʿanat ukh'tahā ḥattā idhā iddārakū fīhā jamīʿan qālat ukh'rāhum liūlāhum rabbanā hāulāi aḍallūnā faātihim ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan mina l-nāri qāla likullin ḍiʿ'fun walākin lā taʿlamūna He will say: "Enter ye among the people who indeed have passed away before you, of jinn and men into the (Hell) fire; Every time a (new) (A fresh batch of the Sinners.) people entereth (it) it shall curse its sister (Fellows in faith- Companions.) (people); until they have all come together into it, the later of them shall say…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتْ أُولَاهُمْ لِأُخْرَاهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ waqālat ūlāhum li-ukh'rāhum famā kāna lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum taksibūna And the first of them will say to the last of them, 'You have no advantage over us! So taste the punishment because of what you used to earn.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتْ أُولَاهُمْ لِأُخْرَاهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ waqālat ūlāhum li-ukh'rāhum famā kāna lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum taksibūna And the first of them will say to the last of them, "Then you had not any favor over us, so taste the punishment for what you used to earn." See 7:38

item.title: Al-A'raaf:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتْ أُولَاهُمْ لِأُخْرَاهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ waqālat ūlāhum li-ukh'rāhum famā kāna lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum taksibūna And the former of them will say to the later of them "So (now) there is not for you any advantage over us, therefore taste ye the chastisement for what ye earned." See 7:36

item.title: Al-A'raaf:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتّٰی يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ inna alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā lā tufattaḥu lahum abwābu l-samāi walā yadkhulūna l-janata ḥattā yalija l-jamalu fī sammi l-khiyāṭi wakadhālika najzī l-muj'rimīna Indeed, those who deny Our signs and are disdainful of them— the gates of the heaven will not be opened for them, nor shall they enter paradise until the camel passes through the needle's eye,1 and thus do We requite the guilty.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتّٰی يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ inna alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā lā tufattaḥu lahum abwābu l-samāi walā yadkhulūna l-janata ḥattā yalija l-jamalu fī sammi l-khiyāṭi wakadhālika najzī l-muj'rimīna Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle (i.e., never). And thus do We recompense the criminals. Verily, those who belie Our Ayat and treat them with arrogance, for them the gates of the heavens will not be opened, and they will not enter Paradise until the Jamal goes through the eye of the needle. Thus do We recompense the criminals (7:40). Theirs will be…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتّٰی يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ inna alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā lā tufattaḥu lahum abwābu l-samāi walā yadkhulūna l-janata ḥattā yalija l-jamalu fī sammi l-khiyāṭi wakadhālika najzī l-muj'rimīna Verily those who belie Our signs and in pride turn away from them, shall not open for them the gates of heaven nor shall they enter the Garden (of Paradise) until the camel passeth through the eye of the needle; thus do We recompense the guilty. The example of the passing of a camel through the eye of the needle stands for the impossibility of the action. A similar example is given in the Bible. Math. 19/24. "And again, I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَمِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ lahum min jahannama mihādun wamin fawqihim ghawāshin wakadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīna They shall have hell for their resting place, and over them shall be sheets [of fire], and thus do We requite the wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَمِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ lahum min jahannama mihādun wamin fawqihim ghawāshin wakadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīna They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings (of fire). And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers. See 7:40

item.title: Al-A'raaf:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَمِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ lahum min jahannama mihādun wamin fawqihim ghawāshin wakadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīna For them shall be the bed of the (Hell) fire and from above them the covering (of it); Thus do We recompense the unjust (Refer to Verses 15:41 - 15:53.) . See 7:40

item.title: Al-A'raaf:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds —We task no soul except according to its capacity— they shall be the inhabitants of paradise, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: Al-A'raaf:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna But those who believed and did righteous deeds - We charge no soul except (within) its capacity. Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally. But those who believed, and worked righteousness – We burden not any person beyond his scope – such are the dwellers of Paradise. They will abide therein (7:42). And We shall remove from their breasts any Ghill; rivers flowing under them, and they will say: All the praises and thanks be to Allah, Who has guided us to this, and never could we have found guidance, were it not that Allah had guided us! Indeed, the Messengers of our Lord did come…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna And those who believe and do good deeds, task We not any soul but to its ability, they are the dwellers of the Garden of (Bliss); They, in it shall abide. See 7:40

item.title: Al-A'raaf:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا لِهَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلَا أَنْ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَنُودُوْۤا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī hadānā lihādhā wamā kunnā linahtadiya lawlā an hadānā l-lahu laqad jāat rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqi wanūdū an til'kumu l-janatu ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna We will remove whatever rancour there is in their breasts, and streams will run for them. They will say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who guided us to this. We would have never been guided had not Allah guided us. Our Lord's apostles had certainly brought the truth.' And the call would be made to them: 'This is paradise, which you have been given to inherit because of…

And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us. Certainly the messengers of our Lord had come with the truth." And they will be called, "This is Paradise, which you have been made…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا لِهَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلَا أَنْ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَنُودُوْۤا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī hadānā lihādhā wamā kunnā linahtadiya lawlā an hadānā l-lahu laqad jāat rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqi wanūdū an til'kumu l-janatu ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna And We will remove whatever rancour be in their breast, there shall flow beneath their abodes rivers, and they will say: "All praise be (only) to God who guided us to this and We would not have been guided had not God guided us; Indeed, did come the apostles of Our Lord with the truth;" and it shall be cried out unto them that: "(Behold!) This is the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ أَنْ قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا قَالُوْا نَعَمْ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ أَنْ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ wanādā aṣḥābu l-janati aṣḥāba l-nāri an qad wajadnā mā waʿadanā rabbunā ḥaqqan fahal wajadttum mā waʿada rabbukum ḥaqqan qālū naʿam fa-adhana mu-adhinun baynahum an laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīna The inhabitants of paradise will call out to the inmates of the Fire, 'We found what our Lord promised us to be true; did you find what your Lord promised you to be true?' 'Yes,' they will say. Then a caller will announce in their midst, 'May Allah's curse be on the wrongdoers!'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ أَنْ قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا قَالُوْا نَعَمْ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ أَنْ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ wanādā aṣḥābu l-janati aṣḥāba l-nāri an qad wajadnā mā waʿadanā rabbunā ḥaqqan fahal wajadttum mā waʿada rabbukum ḥaqqan qālū naʿam fa-adhana mu-adhinun baynahum an laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīna And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire, "We have already found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?" They will say, "Yes." Then an announcer will announce among them, "The curse of Allah shall be upon the wrongdoers. And the dwellers of Paradise will call out to the dwellers of the Fire (saying): We have indeed found true what our Lord had promised us; have you…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ أَنْ قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا قَالُوْا نَعَمْ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ أَنْ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ wanādā aṣḥābu l-janati aṣḥāba l-nāri an qad wajadnā mā waʿadanā rabbunā ḥaqqan fahal wajadttum mā waʿada rabbukum ḥaqqan qālū naʿam fa-adhana mu-adhinun baynahum an laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīna And will call out of the inmates of the Garden (of Paradise) unto the inmates of the (Hell) fire (saying); "Indeed we have found what promised us Our Lord to be true; have ye too found what promised your Lord, to be true?" They will say: "Yes." Then a crier (The first Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abu Talib (See Kashf al-Ghumma) of Mardwaih.) will cry out between them that "The curse of God is on the unjust (This is a very brief description of…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati kāfirūna —Those who bar [others] from the way of Allah, and seek to make it crooked, and disbelieve in the Hereafter.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati kāfirūna Who averted (people) from the way of Allah and sought to make it (seem) deviant while they were, concerning the Hereafter, disbelievers." See 7:44

item.title: Al-A'raaf:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati kāfirūna Those who hinder (Misinterpreting the Holy Qur'an and the sayings of the Holy Prophet, thus hinder others from the right course of faith and its practice.) (People) from the path of God and seek to make it crooked (Misinterpreting the Holy Qur'an and the sayings of the Holy Prophet, thus hinder others from the right course of faith and its practice. Refer to Verses 18:1, 39:28.) , and they in the hereafter (Applicable to those who would do this will call them-selves as believers (Muslims) in this life.) disbelieve. See 7:44

item.title: Al-A'raaf:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ وَعَلَى الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَعْرِفُونَ كُلًّا بِسِيمَاهُمْ وَنَادَوْا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ wabaynahumā ḥijābun waʿalā ErAf#(7:46:4)">l-aʿrāfi rijālun yaʿrifūna kullan bisīmāhum wanādaw aṣḥāba l-janati an salāmun ʿalaykum lam yadkhulūhā wahum yaṭmaʿūna And there will be a veil between them. And on the Elevations will be certain men who recognize each of them by their mark. They will call out to the inhabitants of paradise, 'Peace be to you!' (They1 will not have entered it, though they would be eager to do so.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ وَعَلَى الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَعْرِفُونَ كُلًّا بِسِيمَاهُمْ وَنَادَوْا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ wabaynahumā ḥijābun waʿalā ErAf#(7:46:4)">l-aʿrāfi rijālun yaʿrifūna kullan bisīmāhum wanādaw aṣḥāba l-janati an salāmun ʿalaykum lam yadkhulūhā wahum yaṭmaʿūna And between them will be a partition (i.e., wall), and on (its) elevations are men1 who recognize all2 by their mark. And they call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not (yet) entered it, but they long intensely. And between them will be a (barrier) screen and on Al-A'raf will be men, who would recognize all, by their marks. And they will call out to the dwellers of Paradise, Peace be on you" and at that time they will not yet have entered it (Paradise), but they will hope to enter (it) (7:46). And when their eyes will…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ وَعَلَى الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَعْرِفُونَ كُلًّا بِسِيمَاهُمْ وَنَادَوْا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ wabaynahumā ḥijābun waʿalā ErAf#(7:46:4)">l-aʿrāfi rijālun yaʿrifūna kullan bisīmāhum wanādaw aṣḥāba l-janati an salāmun ʿalaykum lam yadkhulūhā wahum yaṭmaʿūna And between the two shall be a veil (a curtain.) and on the heights (Overlooking both sides of the curtain.) shall be men who know all (Everyone.) by their marks, and they (Those on the heights.) shall call out to the inmates of the Garden (Paradise) "Peace be on you," They (Those addressed by those on the heights.) shall not have yet entered it, though they do hope (thereof). See 7:44

item.title: Al-A'raaf:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَارُهُمْ تِلْقَاءَ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idhā ṣurifat abṣāruhum til'qāa aṣḥābi l-nāri qālū rabbanā lā tajʿalnā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when their look is turned toward the inmates of the Fire, they will say, 'Our Lord, do not put us among the wrongdoing lot!')

item.title: Al-A'raaf:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَارُهُمْ تِلْقَاءَ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idhā ṣurifat abṣāruhum til'qāa aṣḥābi l-nāri qālū rabbanā lā tajʿalnā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people." See 7:46

item.title: Al-A'raaf:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَارُهُمْ تِلْقَاءَ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idhā ṣurifat abṣāruhum til'qāa aṣḥābi l-nāri qālū rabbanā lā tajʿalnā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when (they) (Those not yet entered the Garden.) will turn their eyes towards the inmates of the (Hell) fire, they shall say: "O' Our Lord! cause us not to be with the unjust people." See 7:44

item.title: Al-A'raaf:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ قَالُوْا مَا أَغْنَى عَنْكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ wanādā aṣḥābu ErAf#(7:48:3)">l-aʿrāfi rijālan yaʿrifūnahum bisīmāhum qālū mā aghnā ʿankum jamʿukum wamā kuntum tastakbirūna And the occupants of the Elevations will call out to certain men whom they recognize by their marks, 'Your rallying1 did not avail you, nor what you used to disdain.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ قَالُوْا مَا أَغْنَى عَنْكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ wanādā aṣḥābu ErAf#(7:48:3)">l-aʿrāfi rijālan yaʿrifūnahum bisīmāhum qālū mā aghnā ʿankum jamʿukum wamā kuntum tastakbirūna And the companions of the Elevations will call to men (within Hell) whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering1 and (the fact) that you were arrogant." And the men on Al-A'raf will call unto the men whom they would recognize by their marks, saying: "Of what benefit to you was your gathering, and your arrogance? (7:48). "Are they those, of whom you swore that Allah would never show them mercy? (Behold! It has been said to them): 'Enter Paradise, no fear shall be on you, nor shall you grieve.' (7:49). Allah states that the people of Al-A'raf will admonish some of the chiefs of…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ قَالُوْا مَا أَغْنَى عَنْكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ wanādā aṣḥābu ErAf#(7:48:3)">l-aʿrāfi rijālan yaʿrifūnahum bisīmāhum qālū mā aghnā ʿankum jamʿukum wamā kuntum tastakbirūna And will call the occupants of the heights (Ar. 'Araaf' A middle place between Hell and Paradise.) unto the inmates of the Hell who can recognise them by their marks; They will say: "Of (A clear warning to those who get puffed up because of their wealth and their worldly position. The first Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abu Talib says: 'What ye give birth is for dust. What ye amass is to go away. What ye build to be demolished. But what ye act is recorded and stored for the day of accounting or the Final judgment'. Though this is a description of the future-Quran gives us the past for the future,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ادْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ ahāulāi alladhīna aqsamtum lā yanāluhumu l-lahu biraḥmatin ud'khulū l-janata lā khawfun ʿalaykum walā antum taḥzanūna Are these1 the ones concerning whom you swore that Allah will not extend them any mercy?' 'Enter paradise!2 You shall have no fear, nor shall you grieve.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ادْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ ahāulāi alladhīna aqsamtum lā yanāluhumu l-lahu biraḥmatin ud'khulū l-janata lā khawfun ʿalaykum walā antum taḥzanūna (Allah will say), "Are these1 the ones whom you (inhabitants of Hell) swore that Allah would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, (O people of the Elevations). No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve." See 7:48

item.title: Al-A'raaf:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ادْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ ahāulāi alladhīna aqsamtum lā yanāluhumu l-lahu biraḥmatin ud'khulū l-janata lā khawfun ʿalaykum walā antum taḥzanūna (Behold ye!) "Are these they whom ye swear that God will bestow not His mercy on them? (whom God now sayeth) Enter ye into the Garden (Paradise)! No fear shall be on you nor shall ye grieve." The people of 'A'raaf will ask the infidels in the Hell pointing to people like Bilal, Ammar, Salman, Sohail, Habab and the similar others, are these the people you used to say that God will not bestow mercy on them, look they have been admitted to Paradise without any fear or grief enjoying the heavenly bliss.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَفِيضُوْۤا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ أَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ wanādā aṣḥābu l-nāri aṣḥāba l-janati an afīḍū ʿalaynā mina l-māi aw mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qālū inna l-laha ḥarramahumā ʿalā l-kāfirīna The inmates of the Fire will call out to the inhabitants of paradise, 'Pour on us some water, or something of what Allah has provided you.' They will say, 'Allah has indeed forbidden these two to the faithless!'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَفِيضُوْۤا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ أَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ wanādā aṣḥābu l-nāri aṣḥāba l-janati an afīḍū ʿalaynā mina l-māi aw mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qālū inna l-laha ḥarramahumā ʿalā l-kāfirīna And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allah has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allah has forbidden them both to the disbelievers. And the dwellers of the Fire will call to the dwellers of Paradise: Pour on us some water or anything that Allah has provided you with." They will say: "Both (water and provision) Allah has forbidden for the disbelievers (7:50). "Who took their religion as amusement and play, and the life of the world deceived them." So this Day We shall forget them…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَفِيضُوْۤا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ أَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ wanādā aṣḥābu l-nāri aṣḥāba l-janati an afīḍū ʿalaynā mina l-māi aw mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qālū inna l-laha ḥarramahumā ʿalā l-kāfirīna And shall call the inmates of the (Hell) fire unto the inmates of the Garden (of bliss) saying: "Pour on us of the water or of what God hath provided you with; "They shall say: "Verily God hath forbidden both to the infidels." See 7:49

item.title: Al-A'raaf:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَلَعِبًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوْۤا لِقَاءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هَذَا وَمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnahum lahwan walaʿiban wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma nansāhum kamā nasū liqāa yawmihim hādhā wamā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna Those who took their religion for diversion and play and whom the life of the world had deceived. So today We will forget them as they forgot the encounter of this day of theirs, and as they used to impugn Our signs.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَلَعِبًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوْۤا لِقَاءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هَذَا وَمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnahum lahwan walaʿiban wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma nansāhum kamā nasū liqāa yawmihim hādhā wamā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses. See 7:50

item.title: Al-A'raaf:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَلَعِبًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوْۤا لِقَاءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هَذَا وَمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnahum lahwan walaʿiban wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma nansāhum kamā nasū liqāa yawmihim hādhā wamā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna (Those) Who made their religion a past time and play and whom the life of the world hath deceived. So today We neglect (Ar. 'Nisyan' used in the case of God-means neglecting & not forgetting. This is a caution to all those who neglect the life hereafter and take religion lightly or even ridicule religiousness and scoff at the devout religionists.) them as they did neglect this day of theirs, and as they did deny Our signs. See 7:49

item.title: Al-A'raaf:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِكِتَابٍ فَصَّلْنَاهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ walaqad ji'nāhum bikitābin faṣṣalnāhu ʿalā ʿil'min hudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna Certainly We have brought them a Book, which We have elaborated with knowledge, as a guidance and mercy for a people who have faith.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِكِتَابٍ فَصَّلْنَاهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ walaqad ji'nāhum bikitābin faṣṣalnāhu ʿalā ʿil'min hudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna And We had certainly brought them a Book which We detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe. Certainly, We have brought to them a Book (the Qur'an) which We have explained in detail with knowledge, a guidance and a mercy to a people who believe (7:52). Await they just for the final fulfillment of the event? On the Day the event is finally fulfilled, those who neglected it before will say: "Verily, the Messengers of our Lord did come with the truth, now are there any intercessors for us that they might intercede on our behalf? Or could we be sent back (to the first life of the world) so that we might do…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِكِتَابٍ فَصَّلْنَاهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ walaqad ji'nāhum bikitābin faṣṣalnāhu ʿalā ʿil'min hudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna And indeed, We have brought unto them a Book (The Qur'an.) , which We have explained it with know-ledge a guidance (Refer to Verses 2:2, 2:23, 3:177, 10:37, 45:20.) and a mercy for people who believe. See 7:49

item.title: Al-A'raaf:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأْوِيلَهُ يَوْمَ يَأْتِي تَأْوِيلُهُ يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ نَسُوهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّ فَهَلْ لَنَا مِنْ شُفَعَاءَ فَيَشْفَعُوا لَنَا أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ قَدْ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā tawīlahu yawma yatī tawīluhu yaqūlu alladhīna nasūhu min qablu qad jāat rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqi fahal lanā min shufaʿāa fayashfaʿū lanā aw nuraddu fanaʿmala ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu qad khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna Do they await anything but its fulfillment? The day when its fulfillment comes, those who had forgotten it before will say, 'Our Lord's apostles had certainly brought the truth. If only we had some intercessors to intercede for us, or we would be returned, so that we may do differently from what we did!' They have certainly ruined their souls, and what they used…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأْوِيلَهُ يَوْمَ يَأْتِي تَأْوِيلُهُ يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ نَسُوهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّ فَهَلْ لَنَا مِنْ شُفَعَاءَ فَيَشْفَعُوا لَنَا أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ قَدْ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā tawīlahu yawma yatī tawīluhu yaqūlu alladhīna nasūhu min qablu qad jāat rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqi fahal lanā min shufaʿāa fayashfaʿū lanā aw nuraddu fanaʿmala ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu qad khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna Do they await except its result?1 The Day its result comes, those who had ignored it before will say, "The messengers of our Lord had come with the truth, so are there (now) any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than what we used to do?" They will have lost themselves, and lost from them is…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأْوِيلَهُ يَوْمَ يَأْتِي تَأْوِيلُهُ يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ نَسُوهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّ فَهَلْ لَنَا مِنْ شُفَعَاءَ فَيَشْفَعُوا لَنَا أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ قَدْ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā tawīlahu yawma yatī tawīluhu yaqūlu alladhīna nasūhu min qablu qad jāat rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqi fahal lanā min shufaʿāa fayashfaʿū lanā aw nuraddu fanaʿmala ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu qad khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna Do they wait (The Book is Complete so far as guidance and the blessing for the believers is concerned. Nothing has been left to be awaited except the final actuation. And when it comes, those who have neglected the Book before, will say this. Refer to Verse 35:37.) for anything but the final fulfilment (the resurrection)? On the day the final fulfilment cometh, those…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yugh'shī al-layla l-nahāra yaṭlubuhu ḥathīthan wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūma musakharātin bi-amrihi alā lahu l-khalqu wal-amru tabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna Indeed your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days, and then settled on the Throne. He draws the night's cover over the day, which pursues it swiftly, and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, [all of them] disposed by His command. Look! All creation and command belong to Him. Blessed is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yugh'shī al-layla l-nahāra yaṭlubuhu ḥathīthan wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūma musakharātin bi-amrihi alā lahu l-khalqu wal-amru tabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.1 He covers the night with the day, (another night) chasing it rapidly; and (He created) the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds. Indeed, your Lord is Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth in Six…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yugh'shī al-layla l-nahāra yaṭlubuhu ḥathīthan wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūma musakharātin bi-amrihi alā lahu l-khalqu wal-amru tabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna Verily your Lord is God who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then established Himself upon the Arsh (throne) (Of Power, Knowledge and Authority.) . He throweth the veil of night over the day, which pursueth it incessantly, and the sun and the moon and the stars, made (absolutely) subservient to His command; Be it known! (that) His is the creation and the command; Blessed is God, the Lord of the worlds (Refer…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْعُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ id'ʿū rabbakum taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan innahu lā yuḥibbu l-muʿ'tadīna Supplicate your Lord, beseechingly and secretly. Indeed He does not like the transgressors.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْعُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ id'ʿū rabbakum taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan innahu lā yuḥibbu l-muʿ'tadīna Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.1 Invoke your Lord Tadarru'an and Khufyah. He likes not the aggressors (7:55). And do not do mischief on the earth, after it has been set in order, and invoke Him with fear and hope. Surely, Allah's mercy is (ever) near unto the good-doers (7:56). Encouraging Supplicating to Allah Allah commands His servants to supplicate to Him, for this will ensure their welfare in this life and the Hereafter. Allah said: ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً Invoke your Lord Tadarru'an and Khufyah Meaning: in humbleness and humility. Allah said in a similar Ayah: وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ And remember your Lord within yourself (7:205) It is recorded in the Two Sahihs that…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْعُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ id'ʿū rabbakum taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan innahu lā yuḥibbu l-muʿ'tadīna Call ye on your Lord, humbly and secretly; Verily loveth not God the transgressors (Those who remain aloof from supplication or disturb the peace and harmony of the others.) . See 7:54

item.title: Al-A'raaf:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā wa-id'ʿūhu khawfan waṭamaʿan inna raḥmata l-lahi qarībun mina l-muḥ'sinīna And do not cause corruption on the earth after its restoration, and supplicate Him with fear and hope: indeed Allah's mercy is close to the virtuous.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā wa-id'ʿūhu khawfan waṭamaʿan inna raḥmata l-lahi qarībun mina l-muḥ'sinīna And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good. See 7:55

item.title: Al-A'raaf:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā wa-id'ʿūhu khawfan waṭamaʿan inna raḥmata l-lahi qarībun mina l-muḥ'sinīna And make ye not mischief in the earth after its reformation, and call ye on Him (God.) fearing (His wrath) and Hoping (for His mercy), verily the mercy ('Rahimiat'.) of God is well-nigh unto those who do good. See 7:54

item.title: Al-A'raaf:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقْنَاهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَنْزَلْنَا بِهِ الْمَاءَ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ كَذٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتٰی لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ wahuwa alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi ḥattā idhā aqallat saḥāban thiqālan suq'nāhu libaladin mayyitin fa-anzalnā bihi l-māa fa-akhrajnā bihi min kulli l-thamarāti kadhālika nukh'riju l-mawtā laʿallakum tadhakkarūna It is He who sends forth the winds as harbingers of His mercy. When they bear [rain-]laden clouds, We drive them toward a dead land and send down water on it, and with it We bring forth all kinds of crops. Thus shall We raise the dead; maybe you will take admonition.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقْنَاهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَنْزَلْنَا بِهِ الْمَاءَ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ كَذٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتٰی لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ wahuwa alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi ḥattā idhā aqallat saḥāban thiqālan suq'nāhu libaladin mayyitin fa-anzalnā bihi l-māa fa-akhrajnā bihi min kulli l-thamarāti kadhālika nukh'riju l-mawtā laʿallakum tadhakkarūna And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy (i.e., rainfall) until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby (some) of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded. And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy (rain). Till when they have carried a heavy-laden…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقْنَاهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَنْزَلْنَا بِهِ الْمَاءَ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ كَذٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتٰی لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ wahuwa alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi ḥattā idhā aqallat saḥāban thiqālan suq'nāhu libaladin mayyitin fa-anzalnā bihi l-māa fa-akhrajnā bihi min kulli l-thamarāti kadhālika nukh'riju l-mawtā laʿallakum tadhakkarūna And He it is Who sendeth forth the (heralding) winds bearing good tidings before His mercy (The rain.) ; until they bring up laden clouds, We drive it to a land which is dead, then We send down water thereon, then bring forth with it of fruits of all kinds; Thus will we bring forth the dead (Example of the process which God's grace and blessings assume till the last stage of the fruit coming forth. The same process is applicable to…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهُ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ وَالَّذِي خَبُثَ لَا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدًا كَذٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَشْكُرُونَ wal-baladu l-ṭayibu yakhruju nabātuhu bi-idh'ni rabbihi wa-alladhī khabutha lā yakhruju illā nakidan kadhālika nuṣarrifu l-āyāti liqawmin yashkurūna The good land—its vegetation comes out by the permission of its Lord, and as for that which is bad, it does not come out except sparsely. Thus do We paraphrase the signs variously for a people who give thanks.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهُ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ وَالَّذِي خَبُثَ لَا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدًا كَذٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَشْكُرُونَ wal-baladu l-ṭayibu yakhruju nabātuhu bi-idh'ni rabbihi wa-alladhī khabutha lā yakhruju illā nakidan kadhālika nuṣarrifu l-āyāti liqawmin yashkurūna And the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its Lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. Thus do We diversify the signs for a people who are grateful. See 7:57

item.title: Al-A'raaf:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهُ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ وَالَّذِي خَبُثَ لَا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدًا كَذٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَشْكُرُونَ wal-baladu l-ṭayibu yakhruju nabātuhu bi-idh'ni rabbihi wa-alladhī khabutha lā yakhruju illā nakidan kadhālika nuṣarrifu l-āyāti liqawmin yashkurūna And the good land, springeth forth its vegetation (in abundance) at the will of its Lord; and that which is bad cometh not forth (from it), (herbage); but scantily Thus do we display (In Varieties.) Our signs to people who give thanks (React thankfully.) . See 7:57

item.title: Al-A'raaf:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ laqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Certainly We sent Noah to his people. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ laqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin We had certainly sent Nuh to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day." Indeed, We sent Nuh to his people and he said: O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other god but Him. Certainly, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day! (7:59). The leaders of his people said: "Verily, we see you in plain error (7:60). (Nuh) said: "O my people! There is no error in me, but I am a Messenger from the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ laqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Indeed, We did send Noah unto his people, so said he: "O' my people! Worship ye God (alone)', ye have no god other than Him; Verily I fear for you the chastisement of a dreadful day (Refer to Verse 11:25, 23:23.) ." The reference to what took place with the other apostles, is only to remind the people of what happened to the disbelievers in the previous ages. The following Verses refer to the people of Noah 3:33; 6:84; 7:59; 7:64; 10:71 - 10:73; 11:25 - 11:48; 14:9; 17:3; 21:76; 21:77; 23:23 - 23:29; 25:37; 26:105 - 26:122; 29:14; 29:15;…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ qāla l-mala-u min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī ḍalālin mubīnin The elite of his people said, 'Indeed we see you in manifest error.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ qāla l-mala-u min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī ḍalālin mubīnin Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error." See 7:59

item.title: Al-A'raaf:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ qāla l-mala-u min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī ḍalālin mubīnin Said the chiefs of his people, "Verily we do see thee in obvious error." See 7:59

item.title: Al-A'raaf:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي ضَلَالَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla yāqawmi laysa bī ḍalālatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna He said, 'O my people, I am not in error. Rather I am an apostle from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي ضَلَالَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla yāqawmi laysa bī ḍalālatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna (Nuh) said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds. See 7:59

item.title: Al-A'raaf:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي ضَلَالَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla yāqawmi laysa bī ḍalālatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna Said he: "O' my people! No error is in me, but I am an apostle from the Lord of the worlds." See 7:59

item.title: Al-A'raaf:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنْصَحُ لَكُمْ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anṣaḥu lakum wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna I communicate to you the messages of my Lord, and I am your well-wisher, and I know from Allah what you do not know.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنْصَحُ لَكُمْ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anṣaḥu lakum wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna I convey to you the messages of my Lord and advise you; and I know from Allah what you do not know. See 7:59

item.title: Al-A'raaf:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنْصَحُ لَكُمْ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anṣaḥu lakum wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna I deliver unto you the messages from my Lord and advise unto you and know from God what ye know not. See 7:59

item.title: Al-A'raaf:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَلِتَتَّقُوا وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum walitattaqū walaʿallakum tur'ḥamūna Do you consider it odd that a reminder from your Lord should come to you through a man from among yourselves, to warn you so that you may be Godwary and so that you may receive His mercy?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَلِتَتَّقُوا وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum walitattaqū walaʿallakum tur'ḥamūna Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allah so you might receive mercy?" Do you wonder that there has come to you a Reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you, so that you may fear Allah and that you may receive (His) mercy? (7:63). But they belied him, so We saved him and those along with him in the Fulk, and We drowned those who belied Our Ayat. They were indeed a blind people (7:64). Allah said that Nuh proclaimed to his…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَلِتَتَّقُوا وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum walitattaqū walaʿallakum tur'ḥamūna Or (Or is it that you wonder.) wonder ye that an admonition hath come unto you from your Lord through a man from among you, that he might warn you and that ye guard (yourselves against evil) and that mercy be done unto you? See 7:59

item.title: Al-A'raaf:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا عَمِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawman ʿamīna But they denied him. So We delivered him and those who were with him in the ark, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed they were a blind lot.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا عَمِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawman ʿamīna But they denied him, so We saved him and those who were with him in the ship. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people.1 See 7:63

item.title: Al-A'raaf:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا عَمِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawman ʿamīna But they belied him, so We delivered him and those with him in the Ark (This denotes the reaction and the consequences to the reaction. Said the Holy Prophet: 'The likeness of my Ahl Al-Bayt is that of the Ark of Noah. He who got into it was saved and he who turned away from it, was drowned and lost'.) , and drowned those who belied Our signs; "Verily they were a blind (Blind at heart.) people (Refer to Verses 11:37 - 11:48 23:27 - 23:29 29:40, 37:76.) ." For a detailed reference to the Deluge Refer to Verse 11:37 - 11:48 and 23:27 - 23:29. It is reported that the original…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna And to [the people of] 'Ād, Hūd, their brother. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna And to the ʿAad (We sent) their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Then will you not fear Him?" And to 'Ad (the people, We sent) their brother Hud. He said: O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other god but Him. Will you then not have Taqwa? (7:65). The leaders of those who disbelieved among his people said: "Verily, we see you in foolishness, and verily, we think you are one of the liars (7:66). (Hud) said: "O my people! There is no foolishness in me, but (I am) a Messenger from the Lord of all that exists…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna And unto (the people of) Ad (we did send) their brother Hud. He said: "O' my people Serve ye God (alone), ye have no god other than Him; What! will ye not then guard (yourselves against evil (Refer to Verses 11:60, 38:12, 53:50, 89:6, 46:21.) ?" There is the mention of the tribe of 'Ad' with the apostle of God, Hud, in the following places in the Holy Qur'an: 7:65 - 15:72, 11:50 - 15:60, 14:9, 26:123 - 15:139, 29:38, 38:12, 40:31, 41:13 - 15:16, 46:21 - 15:26, 50:13, 51:41 - 15:42, 53:50, 54:18 - 15:21, 69:6 - 15:8, 89:6 - 15:8. The Holy Apostle Hud is of the children…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī safāhatin wa-innā lanaẓunnuka mina l-kādhibīna The elite of his people who were faithless said, 'Indeed we see you to be in folly, and indeed we consider you to be a liar.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī safāhatin wa-innā lanaẓunnuka mina l-kādhibīna Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars." See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī safāhatin wa-innā lanaẓunnuka mina l-kādhibīna Said the chiefs (The rich or the Leaders Refer to Verse 7:75, the mischief mongers.) of those who disbelieved among his people: "Verily we do see thee in folly; and verily we do think thee to be of the liars." See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla yāqawmi laysa bī safāhatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna He said, 'O my people, I am not in folly. Rather I am an apostle from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla yāqawmi laysa bī safāhatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna (Hūd) said, "O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds. See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla yāqawmi laysa bī safāhatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna Said he: "O' my people! There is no folly in me, but I am an apostle of the Lord of the worlds." See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anā lakum nāṣiḥun amīnun I communicate to you the messages of my Lord and I am a trustworthy well-wisher for you.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anā lakum nāṣiḥun amīnun I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser. See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anā lakum nāṣiḥun amīnun I deliver unto you the messages of my Lord and I unto you, am a trusted adviser. See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَزَادَكُمْ فِي الْخَلْقِ بَسْطَةً فَاذْكُرُوا ءَالَاءَ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi qawmi nūḥin wazādakum fī l-khalqi baṣ'ṭatan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna Do you consider it odd that there should come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among yourselves, so that he may warn you? Remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah, and increased you vastly in creation. So remember Allah's bounties so that you may be felicitous.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَزَادَكُمْ فِي الْخَلْقِ بَسْطَةً فَاذْكُرُوا ءَالَاءَ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi qawmi nūḥin wazādakum fī l-khalqi baṣ'ṭatan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Nuh and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allah that you might succeed." See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَزَادَكُمْ فِي الْخَلْقِ بَسْطَةً فَاذْكُرُوا ءَالَاءَ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi qawmi nūḥin wazādakum fī l-khalqi baṣ'ṭatan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna Do ye wonder that an admonition hath come unto you from your Lord through a man from among you, that he might warn you? And remember ye when He made you successors after Noah's people, and increased you in stature (In strength.) , so remember ye the bounties of God that ye may be successful. See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū aji'tanā linaʿbuda l-laha waḥdahu wanadhara mā kāna yaʿbudu ābāunā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna They said, 'Have you come to [tell] us that we should worship Allah alone and abandon what our fathers have been worshiping? Then bring us what you threaten us with, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū aji'tanā linaʿbuda l-laha waḥdahu wanadhara mā kāna yaʿbudu ābāunā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna They said, "Have you come to us that we should worship Allah alone and leave what our fathers have worshipped? Then bring us what you promise us,1 if you should be of the truthful." They said: "You have come to us that we should worship Allah Alone and forsake that which our fathers used to worship. So bring us that wherewith you have threatened us if you are of the truthful (7:70). (Hud) said: "Rijs (torment) and wrath have already fallen on you from your Lord. Dispute you with me over names which you have named – you and your fathers – with no authority from…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū aji'tanā linaʿbuda l-laha waḥdahu wanadhara mā kāna yaʿbudu ābāunā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Said they: "Come (Must thou come?) thou unto us that we may serve God alone and we give up what used our fathers to serve? Then bring that down unto us what thou doth threaten (Clearly indicate that the sign demanded by that adamant to the preaching of the apostles, was not the sign to prove the truth in the preachings but the destruction with which the Prophet bad warned and threatened them-The demand was only in mockery.) us with, if thou be of the truthful ones." See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ أَتُجَادِلُونَنِي فِي أَسْمَاءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمْ مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ qāla qad waqaʿa ʿalaykum min rabbikum rij'sun waghaḍabun atujādilūnanī fī asmāin sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā nazzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna He said, 'There has become due against you a punishment and wrath from your Lord. Do you dispute with me regarding names which you have named —you and your fathers— for which Allah has not sent down any authority? So wait! I too am waiting along with you.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ أَتُجَادِلُونَنِي فِي أَسْمَاءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمْ مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ qāla qad waqaʿa ʿalaykum min rabbikum rij'sun waghaḍabun atujādilūnanī fī asmāin sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā nazzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna (Hūd) said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning (mere) names you have named them,1 you and your fathers, for which Allah has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait." See 7:70

item.title: Al-A'raaf:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ أَتُجَادِلُونَنِي فِي أَسْمَاءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمْ مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ qāla qad waqaʿa ʿalaykum min rabbikum rij'sun waghaḍabun atujādilūnanī fī asmāin sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā nazzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna Said he: "Indeed hath fallen upon you, from your Lord (His punishment and wrath); what! Dispute ye with me about the names which ye have named (Refer to Verses 12:40; 53:23.) them (your idols), ye and your fathers? For which hath not been sent any authority from God; Wait then, and verily I too, with you be of those who wait." See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā waqaṭaʿnā dābira alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wamā kānū mu'minīna Then We delivered him and those who were with him by a mercy from Us, and We rooted out those who denied Our signs and were not faithful.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā waqaṭaʿnā dābira alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wamā kānū mu'minīna So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not (at all) believers. See 7:70

item.title: Al-A'raaf:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā waqaṭaʿnā dābira alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wamā kānū mu'minīna So We delivered him and those with him by mercy from us, and We did cut away the roots (Destroyed even the last one of them stopping even their progeny.) of those who belied Our signs, and (they) were not believers. See 7:65

item.title: Al-A'raaf:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun alīmun And to [the people of] Thamūd, Ṣāliḥ, their brother. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. There has certainly come to you a manifest proof from your Lord. This she-camel of Allah is a sign for you. Let her alone to graze [freely] in Allah's land, and do not cause her any harm,1 for then you shall be seized by a painful punishment.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun alīmun And to the Thamūd (We sent) their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allah (sent) to you as a sign. So leave her to eat within Allah's land and do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you a painful punishment. And to Thamud (people, We…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun alīmun And unto (the people of) Thamud (We did send) their brother Saleh, He said: "O' my people! Worship ye God (alone) Ye have no god other than Him; Indeed came unto you a clear proof from your Lord; This is the She-camel (Refer to Verses 11:61, 91:11 - 91:15. Even today there are people who, if not the 'She-Camel' the miracle wrought by Saleh, mock the other signs, the miracles by the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَبَوَّأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْ سُهُولِهَا قُصُورًا وَتَنْحِتُونَ الْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا فَاذْكُرُوا ءَالَاءَ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi ʿādin wabawwa-akum fī l-arḍi tattakhidhūna min suhūlihā quṣūran watanḥitūna l-jibāla buyūtan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna Remember when He made you successors after [the people of] 'Ād, and settled you in the land: you build palaces in its plains, and hew houses out of the mountains. So remember Allah's bounties, and do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَبَوَّأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْ سُهُولِهَا قُصُورًا وَتَنْحِتُونَ الْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا فَاذْكُرُوا ءَالَاءَ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi ʿādin wabawwa-akum fī l-arḍi tattakhidhūna min suhūlihā quṣūran watanḥitūna l-jibāla buyūtan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And remember when He made you successors after the ʿAad and settled you in the land, (and) you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes. Then remember the favors of Allah and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
