item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَبَوَّأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْ سُهُولِهَا قُصُورًا وَتَنْحِتُونَ الْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا فَاذْكُرُوا ءَالَاءَ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi ʿādin wabawwa-akum fī l-arḍi tattakhidhūna min suhūlihā quṣūran watanḥitūna l-jibāla buyūtan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And remember when He made you successors after the (people) 'Ad' and settled you in the earth, ye build mansions on its plain and hew the mountains into dwellings; So remember ye the bounties of God, and seek ye not evil in the earth, making mischief (Mischief invites perdition.) . See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِمَنْ اٰمَنَ مِنْهُمْ أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ صَالِحًا مُرْسَلٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قَالُوْا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلَ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lilladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū liman āmana min'hum ataʿlamūna anna ṣāliḥan mur'salun min rabbihi qālū innā bimā ur'sila bihi mu'minūna The elite of his people who were arrogant said to those who were abased —to those among them who had faith— 'Do you know that Ṣāliḥ has been sent by his Lord?' They said, 'We indeed believe in what he has been sent with.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِمَنْ اٰمَنَ مِنْهُمْ أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ صَالِحًا مُرْسَلٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قَالُوْا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلَ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lilladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū liman āmana min'hum ataʿlamūna anna ṣāliḥan mur'salun min rabbihi qālū innā bimā ur'sila bihi mu'minūna Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people to those who were oppressed - to those who believed among them, "Do you (actually) know that Ṣāliḥ is sent from his Lord?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which he was sent, are believers." See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِمَنْ اٰمَنَ مِنْهُمْ أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ صَالِحًا مُرْسَلٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قَالُوْا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلَ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lilladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū liman āmana min'hum ataʿlamūna anna ṣāliḥan mur'salun min rabbihi qālū innā bimā ur'sila bihi mu'minūna Said the chiefs (The rich ones or the leaders, who had always been the mischief-mongers.) of those who were puffed up with pride among his people to those who were reckoned weak, to those who believed from among them; "Know ye that Saleh is sent by his Lord?" Said they (The weak or the poor.) : "Verily, in what he hath been sent with, we are believers." See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا بِالَّذِي ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā bi-alladhī āmantum bihi kāfirūna Those who were arrogant said, 'We indeed disbelieve in what you have believed.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا بِالَّذِي ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā bi-alladhī āmantum bihi kāfirūna Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers." See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا بِالَّذِي ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā bi-alladhī āmantum bihi kāfirūna Said those who were puffed up with pride; "Verily we, in that which ye believe are disbelievers." See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوْۤا النَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوْۤا يَاصَالِحُ ائْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ faʿaqarū l-nāqata waʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim waqālū yāṣāliḥu i'tinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-mur'salīna So they hamstrung the She-camel and defied the command of their Lord, and they said, 'O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you threaten us with, if you are one of the apostles.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوْۤا النَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوْۤا يَاصَالِحُ ائْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ faʿaqarū l-nāqata waʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim waqālū yāṣāliḥu i'tinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-mur'salīna So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوْۤا النَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوْۤا يَاصَالِحُ ائْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ faʿaqarū l-nāqata waʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim waqālū yāṣāliḥu i'tinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-mur'salīna They ham-strung the She-Camel and rebelled against the command of their Lord, and they said (A challenge from the people to prophet Saleh to bring down the chastisement they were threatened with.) : "O' Saleh! Bring us what thou didst threaten us with, if thou art of the apostles." See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna So the earthquake seized them, and they lay lifeless prostrate in their homes.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home (corpses) fallen prone. See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna Then seized them (unawares) the earthquake, so became they in their dwellings, motionless (dead) (Refer to Verse 51:44.) . See 7:73

item.title: Al-A'raaf:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّي وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَلَكِنْ لَا تُحِبُّونَ النَّاصِحِينَ fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālata rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum walākin lā tuḥibbūna l-nāṣiḥīna So he abandoned them [to their fate], and said, 'O my people! Certainly I communicated to you the message of my Lord, and I was your well-wisher, but you did not like well-wishers.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّي وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَلَكِنْ لَا تُحِبُّونَ النَّاصِحِينَ fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālata rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum walākin lā tuḥibbūna l-nāṣiḥīna And he (i.e., Ṣāliḥ) turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the message of my Lord and advised you, but you do not like advisors." Then he (Salih) turned from them, and said: O my people! I have indeed conveyed to you the Message of my Lord, and have given you good advice, but you like not good advisers (7:79). These are the words of admonishment that Salih conveyed to his people after Allah destroyed them for defying Him, rebelling against Him, refusing to accept the truth, avoiding guidance, and preferring misguidance instead. Salih said these words of admonishment and criticism to them after…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّي وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَلَكِنْ لَا تُحِبُّونَ النَّاصِحِينَ fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālata rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum walākin lā tuḥibbūna l-nāṣiḥīna Then he turned away from them and said: "O' my people! Indeed I did deliver unto you the message of my Lord, and did admonish you, but ye love not the admonishers." This is what Saleh after the destruction of the people, returning to the place and addressing the dead said: It is not that the address was to any survivors as some commentator says-A similar event had taken place in the start of Islam. The Holy Prophet addressing the dead at Badr had likewise addressed saying: 'Did ye see that what the Lord had said was true?' It is reported in the Tafsir of Tha'alabi that the Holy Prophet once asked…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīna And Lot, when he said to his people, 'What! Do you commit an outrage none in the world ever committed before you?!

item.title: Al-A'raaf:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīna And (We had sent) Lut when he said to his people, "Do you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds (i.e., peoples)? Allah said, We sent: وَ And لُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ Lut, when he said to his people.. Lut is the son of Haran the son of Azar (Terah), and he was the nephew of Ibrahim (AS). Lut had believed in Ibrahim and migrated with him to the Sham area. Allah then sent Lut to the people of Sadum (Sodom) and the surrounding villages, to call them to Allah, enjoin righteousness and forbid them from their evil practices, their sin, and wickedness. It this area, they…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīna And (We did send) Lot, when said he to his people: "What! Commit ye a lewdness, which did not commit before you, anyone in the worlds (Refer to Verses 11:77, 15:61 - 15:74, 21:71 - 21:74, 38:13.) ?" Lot was Abraham's cousin. Lot has been referred to in the following Verses in the Holy Qur'an 7:80 - 15:84; 11:77 - 15:83; 15:61 - 15:74; 21:74; 21:75; 26:160 - 15:173; 27:54 - 15:58; 29:32 - 15:35; 37:133 - 15:136; 38:13; 50:13; 51:31 - 15:32; 51:33 - 15:37; 53:53; 54:33 - 15:39; 66:10. Even according to Gen. 18/23 Lot has been regarded an apostle of God, a righteous man but in the same book Genesis in…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُسْرِفُونَ innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun mus'rifūna Indeed you come to men with desire1 instead of women! Rather you are a profligate lot.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُسْرِفُونَ innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun mus'rifūna Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people." See 7:80

item.title: Al-A'raaf:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُسْرِفُونَ innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun mus'rifūna Verily ye come to men in lust instead of women; nay, ye are a transgressor people. See 7:80

item.title: Al-A'raaf:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَخْرِجُوهُمْ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ wamā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijūhum min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūna But the only answer of his people was that they said, 'Expel them from your town! They are indeed a puritanical lot.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَخْرِجُوهُمْ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ wamā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijūhum min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūna But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure." And the answer of his people was only that they said: Drive them out of your town, these are indeed men who want to be pure (from sins)! (7:82). So they answered Prophet Lut by trying to expel and banish him from their village, along with those who believed with him. Allah indeed removed Prophet Lut safely from among them, and He destroyed them in their land in disgrace and humiliation. They said (about Lut and the believers): إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ ("These are indeed men who want to be pure…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَخْرِجُوهُمْ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ wamā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijūhum min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūna And (there) was not any answer of his people except that they said: "Turn ye them out of your town, verily they are a people who seek to purify (themselves)." See 7:80

item.title: Al-A'raaf:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīna So We delivered him and his family, except his wife; she was one of those who remained behind.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīna So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained (with the evildoers). Then We saved him and his family, except his wife; she was of the Ghabirin (those who lagged behind) (7:83). And We rained down on them a rain (of stones). Then see what was the end of the criminals (7:84). Allah says, We saved Lut and his family, for only his household believed in him. Allah said in another Ayah: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ - فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ So We brought out from therein the believers. But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one (of Lut and his daughters) (51:35-36) Only his wife (from his family)…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīna So did We deliver him and his family, except his wife, she was of those who remained behind (Refer to Verse 26:171.) . See 7:80

item.title: Al-A'raaf:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīna Then We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. So observe how was the fate of the guilty!

item.title: Al-A'raaf:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīna And We rained upon them a rain (of stones). Then see how was the end of the criminals. See 7:83

item.title: Al-A'raaf:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīna And We rained down on them a shower (of stones); Behold (Consider.) ! then, what had been the end of the criminals (The last word of this Verse clearly titles the shameful act not as a sin but as a crime. Refer to Verse 29:40.) . See 7:80

item.title: Al-A'raaf:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَأَوْفُوْۤا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوْۤا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum fa-awfū l-kayla wal-mīzāna walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna And to [the people of] Midian, Shu'ayb, their brother. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. There has certainly come to you a manifest proof from your Lord. Observe fully the measure and the balance, and do not cheat the people of their goods,1 and do not cause corruption on the earth after its restoration. That is better for…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَأَوْفُوْۤا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوْۤا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum fa-awfū l-kayla wal-mīzāna walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna And to (the people of) Madyan (We sent) their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. So fulfill the measure and weight and do not deprive people of their due and cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. That is better for you, if you…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَأَوْفُوْۤا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوْۤا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum fa-awfū l-kayla wal-mīzāna walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna And unto (the people of) Madyan (We did send) their brother Shu'aib; said he: "O' my people! worship ye God (alone), ye have no god other than Him; Indeed hath come unto you from your Lord a clear proof, so give ye full measure and weight, and diminish ye not to men their things, and make ye no mischief in the earth, after its reform; This…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَقْعُدُوْۤا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوعِدُونَ وَتَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِهِ وَتَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْ وَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ walā taqʿudū bikulli ṣirāṭin tūʿidūna wataṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi man āmana bihi watabghūnahā ʿiwajan wa-udh'kurū idh kuntum qalīlan fakatharakum wa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna And do not lie in wait on every road to threaten and bar from the way of Allah those who have faith in Him, seeking to make it crooked. And remember when you were few, and He multiplied you, and observe how was the fate of the agents of corruption.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَقْعُدُوْۤا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوعِدُونَ وَتَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِهِ وَتَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْ وَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ walā taqʿudū bikulli ṣirāṭin tūʿidūna wataṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi man āmana bihi watabghūnahā ʿiwajan wa-udh'kurū idh kuntum qalīlan fakatharakum wa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allah those who believe in Him, seeking to make it (seem) deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters. "And sit not on every road, threatening, and hindering from the path of Allah those who believe in Him, and seeking to make it crooked. And remember when you were but few, and He multiplied you. And see what was the end of the mischief-makers (7:86). "And…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَقْعُدُوْۤا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوعِدُونَ وَتَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِهِ وَتَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْ وَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ walā taqʿudū bikulli ṣirāṭin tūʿidūna wataṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi man āmana bihi watabghūnahā ʿiwajan wa-udh'kurū idh kuntum qalīlan fakatharakum wa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna And sit ye not in every path, threatening and hindering (Refer to note to verse 7:45.) from the path of God, him who believeth in Him, and seeking to make it crooked; And remember ye, when ye were few He multiplied you, and behold (Observe - Consider - ponder over – Remember - be mindful.) ye what had been the end of the mischief-makers. See 7:85

item.title: Al-A'raaf:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْكُمْ اٰمَنُوْا بِالَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَطَائِفَةٌ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَاصْبِرُوا حَتّٰی يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wa-in kāna ṭāifatun minkum āmanū bi-alladhī ur'sil'tu bihi waṭāifatun lam yu'minū fa-iṣ'birū ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu baynanā wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna If a group of you have believed in what I have been sent with, and a group have not believed, be patient until Allah judges between us, and He is the best of judges.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْكُمْ اٰمَنُوْا بِالَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَطَائِفَةٌ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَاصْبِرُوا حَتّٰی يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wa-in kāna ṭāifatun minkum āmanū bi-alladhī ur'sil'tu bihi waṭāifatun lam yu'minū fa-iṣ'birū ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu baynanā wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna And if there should be a group among you who has believed in that with which I have been sent and a group that has not believed, then be patient until Allah judges between us. And He is the best of judges." See 7:86

item.title: Al-A'raaf:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْكُمْ اٰمَنُوْا بِالَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَطَائِفَةٌ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَاصْبِرُوا حَتّٰی يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wa-in kāna ṭāifatun minkum āmanū bi-alladhī ur'sil'tu bihi waṭāifatun lam yu'minū fa-iṣ'birū ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu baynanā wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna And if there be a party of you who believe in what I am sent with, and another party who believe not, then wait ye with patience until judgeth God between us; and He is the Best of the judges. See 7:85

item.title: Al-A'raaf:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يَاشُعَيْبُ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَكَ مِنْ قَرْيَتِنَا أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَا قَالَ أَوَلَوْ كُنَّا كَارِهِينَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lanukh'rijannaka yāshuʿaybu wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿaka min qaryatinā aw lataʿūdunna fī millatinā qāla awalaw kunnā kārihīna The elite of his people who were arrogant said, 'O Shu'ayb, we will surely expel you and the faithful who are with you from our town, or else you shall revert to our creed.' He said, 'What! Even if we should be unwilling?!

item.title: Al-A'raaf:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يَاشُعَيْبُ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَكَ مِنْ قَرْيَتِنَا أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَا قَالَ أَوَلَوْ كُنَّا كَارِهِينَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lanukh'rijannaka yāshuʿaybu wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿaka min qaryatinā aw lataʿūdunna fī millatinā qāla awalaw kunnā kārihīna Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people, "We will surely evict you, O Shuʿayb, and those who have believed with you from our city, or you must return to our religion." He said, "Even if we were unwilling? The chiefs of those who were arrogant among his people said: "We shall certainly drive you out, O Shu'ayb and those who have believed with you from our town, or else you (all) shall return to our religion." He said: "Even though we hate it? (7:88). "We should have invented a lie against Allah if we returned…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يَاشُعَيْبُ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَكَ مِنْ قَرْيَتِنَا أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَا قَالَ أَوَلَوْ كُنَّا كَارِهِينَ qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lanukh'rijannaka yāshuʿaybu wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿaka min qaryatinā aw lataʿūdunna fī millatinā qāla awalaw kunnā kārihīna Said the chief of those puffed with pride from among his people: "Certainly we will turn thee out O' Shu'aib, and those who believe with thee, from our town, or ye shall return into our faith" Said he: "What! Even though we be those who detest (The faith of the people i.e., polytheism.) (it)?" See 7:85

item.title: Al-A'raaf:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدِ افْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِي مِلَّتِكُمْ بَعْدَ إِذْ نَجَّانَا اللَّهُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَعُودَ فِيهَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ qadi if'taraynā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban in ʿud'nā fī millatikum baʿda idh najjānā l-lahu min'hā wamā yakūnu lanā an naʿūda fīhā illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbunā wasiʿa rabbunā kulla shayin ʿil'man ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā if'taḥ baynanā wabayna qawminā bil-ḥaqi wa-anta khayru l-fātiḥīna We would be fabricating a lie against Allah should we revert to your creed after Allah had delivered us from it. It does not behoove us to return to it, unless Allah, our Lord, should wish so. Our Lord embraces all things in [His] knowledge. In Allah we have put our trust.' 'Our Lord! Judge justly…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدِ افْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِي مِلَّتِكُمْ بَعْدَ إِذْ نَجَّانَا اللَّهُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَعُودَ فِيهَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ qadi if'taraynā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban in ʿud'nā fī millatikum baʿda idh najjānā l-lahu min'hā wamā yakūnu lanā an naʿūda fīhā illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbunā wasiʿa rabbunā kulla shayin ʿil'man ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā if'taḥ baynanā wabayna qawminā bil-ḥaqi wa-anta khayru l-fātiḥīna We would have invented against Allah a lie if we returned to your religion after Allah had saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it except that Allah, our Lord, should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allah we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدِ افْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِي مِلَّتِكُمْ بَعْدَ إِذْ نَجَّانَا اللَّهُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَعُودَ فِيهَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ qadi if'taraynā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban in ʿud'nā fī millatikum baʿda idh najjānā l-lahu min'hā wamā yakūnu lanā an naʿūda fīhā illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbunā wasiʿa rabbunā kulla shayin ʿil'man ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā if'taḥ baynanā wabayna qawminā bil-ḥaqi wa-anta khayru l-fātiḥīna Indeed we shall have forged a lie against God if we return in your faith after when delivered us God from it; it fitteth us not that we return into it, save if it willeth (Willeth – Compulsion.) God our Lord; our Lord comprehendeth everything in His knowledge; on God (alone) do we rely; O' Our…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ waqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi la-ini ittabaʿtum shuʿayban innakum idhan lakhāsirūna The elite of his people who were faithless said, 'If you follow Shu'ayb, you will indeed be losers.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ waqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi la-ini ittabaʿtum shuʿayban innakum idhan lakhāsirūna Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shuʿayb, indeed, you would then be losers." The chiefs of those who disbelieved among his people said (to their people): If you follow Shu'ayb, be sure then you will be the losers! (7:90). So the earthquake seized them and they lay (dead), prostrate in their homes (7:91). Those who belied Shu'ayb, became as if they had never dwelt there (in their homes). Those who belied Shu'ayb, they were the losers (7:92). Allah describes the enormity of disbelief, rebellion, transgression and misguidance (of Shu'ayb's people) and the defiance of truth encrypted in their hearts. They vowed, saying: لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَاسِرُونَ "If…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ waqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi la-ini ittabaʿtum shuʿayban innakum idhan lakhāsirūna And said the chiefs of those who disbelieved from among his people: "(Beware!) If ye follow Shu'aib, certainly then ye shall surely be losers." See 7:85

item.title: Al-A'raaf:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna So the earthquake seized them, and they lay lifeless prostrate in their homes.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home (corpses) fallen prone. See 7:90

item.title: Al-A'raaf:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīna Then seized them (unawares) the earthquake, so became they in their dwellings, motionless bodies (dead). See 7:85

item.title: Al-A'raaf:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا شُعَيْبًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا شُعَيْبًا كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْخَاسِرِينَ alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban kānū humu l-khāsirīna Those who impugned Shu'ayb became as if they had never lived there. Those who impugned Shu'ayb were themselves the losers.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا شُعَيْبًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا شُعَيْبًا كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْخَاسِرِينَ alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban kānū humu l-khāsirīna Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was they who were the losers. See 7:90

item.title: Al-A'raaf:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا شُعَيْبًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا شُعَيْبًا كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْخَاسِرِينَ alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban kānū humu l-khāsirīna Those who belied Shu'aib became as if they never dwelt therein; Those who belied Shu'aib (it is) they (who) were the losers. See 7:85

item.title: Al-A'raaf:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ فَكَيْفَ ءَاسٰی عَلَى قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālāti rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum fakayfa āsā ʿalā qawmin kāfirīna So he abandoned them [to their fate] and said, 'O my people! Certainly I communicated to you the messages of my Lord, and I was your well-wisher. So how should I grieve for a faithless lot?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ فَكَيْفَ ءَاسٰی عَلَى قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālāti rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum fakayfa āsā ʿalā qawmin kāfirīna And he (i.e., Shuʿayb) turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the messages of my Lord and advised you, so how could I grieve for a disbelieving people?" Then he (Shu'ayb) turned from them and said: O my people! I have indeed conveyed my Lord's Messages unto you and I have given you good advice. Then how can I grieve over people who are disbelievers (7:93). Prophet Shu'ayb (AS), turned away from his people after the torment, punishment and destruction struck them, admonishing and censuring them by saying to them: يَا قَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ "O my people! I…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ فَكَيْفَ ءَاسٰی عَلَى قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālāti rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum fakayfa āsā ʿalā qawmin kāfirīna So turned he away from them and said he: "O' Ye people! Indeed I delivered unto you the messages of my Lord, and did admonish unto you; so how then shall I be sorry for a disbelieving people?" See 7:85

item.title: Al-A'raaf:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا أَخَذْنَا أَهْلَهَا بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُونَ wamā arsalnā fī qaryatin min nabiyyin illā akhadhnā ahlahā bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yaḍḍarraʿūna We did not send a prophet to any town without visiting its people with stress and distress so that they might entreat [for Allah's forgiveness].

item.title: Al-A'raaf:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا أَخَذْنَا أَهْلَهَا بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُونَ wamā arsalnā fī qaryatin min nabiyyin illā akhadhnā ahlahā bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yaḍḍarraʿūna And We sent to no city a prophet (who was denied) except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves (to Allah). And We sent no Prophet unto any town (and they denied him), but We seized its people with Ba'sā' and Ḍarrā', so that they might humble themselves (to Allah) (7:94). Then We changed the evil for the good, until they 'Afaw (increased), and said: "Our fathers were touched with evil and with good." So We seized them all of a sudden while they were unaware (7:95). Afflictions that Struck Earlier Nations Allah mentions the Ba'sā' and Ḍarrā' that struck the earlier nations to whom He sent…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا أَخَذْنَا أَهْلَهَا بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُونَ wamā arsalnā fī qaryatin min nabiyyin illā akhadhnā ahlahā bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yaḍḍarraʿūna We sent not in a town an apostle, but seized We its people, with distress and adversity, that they might humble themselves. As regards the outlook of the other Apostles of God towards the adamant offenders, the Holy Prophet greatly differs and definitely distinguishes himself in his mercy to the sinners. While all the previous apostles, after playing their role as best as they could, left the people to their fate and in some cases like Noah, even prayed for the people to be chastised, the Holy Prophet notwithstanding a much severer and a more terrible opposition from his people, was so much mercifully disposed towards them that he felt for them to the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتّٰی عَفَوْا وَقَالُوْۤا قَدْ مَسَّ ءَابَاءَنَا الضَّرَّاءُ وَالسَّرَّاءُ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ thumma baddalnā makāna l-sayi-ati l-ḥasanata ḥattā ʿafaw waqālū qad massa ābāanā l-ḍarāu wal-sarāu fa-akhadhnāhum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Then We changed the ill [conditions] to good until they multiplied [in numbers] and said, 'Adversity and ease befell our fathers [too].' Then We seized them suddenly while they were unaware.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتّٰی عَفَوْا وَقَالُوْۤا قَدْ مَسَّ ءَابَاءَنَا الضَّرَّاءُ وَالسَّرَّاءُ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ thumma baddalnā makāna l-sayi-ati l-ḥasanata ḥattā ʿafaw waqālū qad massa ābāanā l-ḍarāu wal-sarāu fa-akhadhnāhum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Then We exchanged in place of the bad (condition), good, until they increased (and prospered) and said, "Our fathers (also) were touched with hardship and ease."1 So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive.2 See 7:94

item.title: Al-A'raaf:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتّٰی عَفَوْا وَقَالُوْۤا قَدْ مَسَّ ءَابَاءَنَا الضَّرَّاءُ وَالسَّرَّاءُ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ thumma baddalnā makāna l-sayi-ati l-ḥasanata ḥattā ʿafaw waqālū qad massa ābāanā l-ḍarāu wal-sarāu fa-akhadhnāhum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Then changed We, in the place of evil, good (Evil and good i.e., distress and ease.) , until they grew multiplied (To the extent that they were left to themselves – in the sense of having been given the respite.) and said they: "Indeed did touch (befall) our fathers (also) adversity and happiness; "We seized them suddenly (by surprise) while they were not aware." See 7:94

item.title: Al-A'raaf:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُرٰی اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّقَوْا لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَرَكَاتٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبُوْۤا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ walaw anna ahla l-qurā āmanū wa-ittaqaw lafataḥnā ʿalayhim barakātin mina l-samāi wal-arḍi walākin kadhabū fa-akhadhnāhum bimā kānū yaksibūna If the people of the towns had been faithful and Godwary, We would have opened to them blessings from the heaven and the earth. But they denied; so We seized them because of what they used to earn.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُرٰی اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّقَوْا لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَرَكَاتٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبُوْۤا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ walaw anna ahla l-qurā āmanū wa-ittaqaw lafataḥnā ʿalayhim barakātin mina l-samāi wal-arḍi walākin kadhabū fa-akhadhnāhum bimā kānū yaksibūna And if only the people of the cities had believed and feared Allah, We would have opened (i.e., bestowed) upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth; but they denied (the messengers), so We seized them for what they were earning.1 And if the people of the towns had believed and had Taqwa, certainly, We should have opened for them blessings from the heaven and the earth, but they belied (the Messengers). So We took them (with punishment) for what they used to earn (7:96). Did the people of the towns then feel secure against the coming of Our punishment by night while…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُرٰی اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّقَوْا لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَرَكَاتٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبُوْۤا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ walaw anna ahla l-qurā āmanū wa-ittaqaw lafataḥnā ʿalayhim barakātin mina l-samāi wal-arḍi walākin kadhabū fa-akhadhnāhum bimā kānū yaksibūna And if the people of the towns had believed and guarded (practiced piety.) (themselves against evil) We would have opened up for them blessings from the heavens and the earth, but they belied, so We seized them for what they did earn. See 7:94

item.title: Al-A'raaf:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرٰی أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ afa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā bayātan wahum nāimūna Do the people of the towns feel secure from Our punishment overtaking them at night while they are asleep?

item.title: Al-A'raaf:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرٰی أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ afa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā bayātan wahum nāimūna Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep? See 7:96

item.title: Al-A'raaf:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرٰی أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ afa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā bayātan wahum nāimūna What! Do the people of the towns then feel secure from coming unto them Our torment by night, while they are asleep? See 7:94

item.title: Al-A'raaf:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرٰی أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا ضُحًى وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ awa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā ḍuḥan wahum yalʿabūna Do the people of the towns feel secure from Our punishment overtaking them at midday while they are playing around?

item.title: Al-A'raaf:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرٰی أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا ضُحًى وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ awa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā ḍuḥan wahum yalʿabūna Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play?1 See 7:96

item.title: Al-A'raaf:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرٰی أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا ضُحًى وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ awa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā ḍuḥan wahum yalʿabūna Or feel secure the people of the towns from coming unto them Our torment in the morning, while they are disporting? See 7:94

item.title: Al-A'raaf:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنُوا مَكْرَ اللَّهِ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ afa-aminū makra l-lahi falā yamanu makra l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-khāsirūna Do they feel secure from Allah's devising? No one feels secure from Allah's devising except the people who are losers.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنُوا مَكْرَ اللَّهِ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ afa-aminū makra l-lahi falā yamanu makra l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-khāsirūna Then, did they feel secure from the plan of Allah? But no one feels secure from the plan of Allah except the losing people. See 7:96

item.title: Al-A'raaf:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنُوا مَكْرَ اللَّهِ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ afa-aminū makra l-lahi falā yamanu makra l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-khāsirūna What! Do they then feel (Feeling secure against God's planning is considered in Islam as one of the major sins and the same is to feel despaired of the mercy of God.) secure against the plan of God? But feeleth not secure any one save the people (who are the) losers. See 7:94

item.title: Al-A'raaf:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَهْلِهَا أَنْ لَوْ نَشَاءُ أَصَبْنَاهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَنَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ awalam yahdi lilladhīna yarithūna l-arḍa min baʿdi ahlihā an law nashāu aṣabnāhum bidhunūbihim wanaṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yasmaʿūna Does it not dawn upon those who inherited the earth after its [former] inhabitants that if We wish We will punish them for their sins, and set a seal on their hearts so they would not hear?

item.title: Al-A'raaf:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَهْلِهَا أَنْ لَوْ نَشَاءُ أَصَبْنَاهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَنَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ awalam yahdi lilladhīna yarithūna l-arḍa min baʿdi ahlihā an law nashāu aṣabnāhum bidhunūbihim wanaṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yasmaʿūna Has it not become clear to those who inherited the earth after its (previous) people that if We willed, We could afflict them for their sins? But We seal over their hearts so they do not hear.1 Is it not a guidance for those who inherit the earth from its previons inhabitants that had We willed, We would have punished them for their sins. And We seal up their hearts so that they hear not (7:100). Ibn 'Abbas commented on Allah's statement. أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِ أَهْلِهَا Is it not a guidance for those who inherit the earth from…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَهْلِهَا أَنْ لَوْ نَشَاءُ أَصَبْنَاهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَنَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ awalam yahdi lilladhīna yarithūna l-arḍa min baʿdi ahlihā an law nashāu aṣabnāhum bidhunūbihim wanaṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yasmaʿūna Is it not (a lesson) guiding (enough) for those who inherit the earth after its former people that if We please We would afflict (too) for their sins, and set a seal on their hearts that they would not hearken? Setting of seal, is the natural consequence of the sinners being adamant and rejecting the guidance from God and being persistent in their misdeeds in spite of the guidance afforded and the repeated or the continuous warnings issued to them. The matter is further clarified by the subsequent verses.1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ الْقُرٰی نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَائِهَا وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْكَافِرِينَ til'ka l-qurā naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāihā walaqad jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū min qablu kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi l-kāfirīna These are the towns some of whose accounts We recount to you. Their apostles certainly brought them manifest proofs, but they were not the ones to believe in what they had denied earlier. Thus does Allah put a seal on the hearts of the faithless.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ الْقُرٰی نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَائِهَا وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْكَافِرِينَ til'ka l-qurā naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāihā walaqad jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū min qablu kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi l-kāfirīna Those cities - We relate to you, (O Muḥammad), some of their news. And certainly did their messengers come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before.1 Thus does Allah seal over the hearts of the disbelievers. Those were the towns whose story We relate unto you. And there came indeed to them their Messengers with clear proofs, but they were not such who would believe in what they rejected before. Thus Allah does seal up the hearts of the disbelievers (7:101). And most…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ الْقُرٰی نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَائِهَا وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْكَافِرِينَ til'ka l-qurā naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāihā walaqad jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū min qablu kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi l-kāfirīna These towns - We relate unto thee (some) of their events (Stories.) , and (that) indeed did come unto them their apostles with clear evidences (miracles), but they would believe not in what they belied (Reference to the similarity of the attitude in the other people.) from before; Thus doth setteth God a seal on the hearts of the infidels. See 7:100

item.title: Al-A'raaf:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا وَجَدْنَا لِأَكْثَرِهِمْ مِنْ عَهْدٍ وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفَاسِقِينَ wamā wajadnā li-aktharihim min ʿahdin wa-in wajadnā aktharahum lafāsiqīna We did not find in most of them any [loyalty to] covenants. Indeed We found most of them to be transgressors.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا وَجَدْنَا لِأَكْثَرِهِمْ مِنْ عَهْدٍ وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفَاسِقِينَ wamā wajadnā li-aktharihim min ʿahdin wa-in wajadnā aktharahum lafāsiqīna And We did not find for most of them any covenant;1 but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient. See 7:101

item.title: Al-A'raaf:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا وَجَدْنَا لِأَكْثَرِهِمْ مِنْ عَهْدٍ وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفَاسِقِينَ wamā wajadnā li-aktharihim min ʿahdin wa-in wajadnā aktharahum lafāsiqīna We found not in most of them any (faithfulness to the) covenant, and only found We most of them to be transgressors. See 7:100

item.title: Al-A'raaf:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَظَلَمُوْۤا بِهَا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faẓalamū bihā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna Then after them We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his elite, but they wronged them. So observe how was the fate of the agents of corruption!

item.title: Al-A'raaf:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَظَلَمُوْۤا بِهَا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faẓalamū bihā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna Then We sent after them Musa with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were unjust toward them.1 So see how was the end of the corrupters. Then after them We sent Musa with Our signs to Fir'awn and his chiefs, but they wrongfully rejected them. So see how was the end of the mischief-maker (7:103). Story of Prophet Musa, upon him be Peace, and Fir'awn Allah said: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم Then after them We sent After the Messengers whom We mentioned, such as Nuh, Hud, Salih Lut and Shu'ayb (may Allah's peace and blessings be on them and the rest of Allah's Prophets), We…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَظَلَمُوْۤا بِهَا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faẓalamū bihā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna Then raised (Sent.) We, after them Moses with Our signs unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they were aggressive with it, see (Consider.) then what was the end of the mischief-makers. The instances and the examples of Moses' mission and the conduct of the Israelites are very often given in the Holy Qur'an; it is mainly because of the fact that the Holy Prophet had more in common with Moses than with any other apostle of God and it was destined to be so.1 The events about Moses and his experiences with the Israelites are given in these following Verses.2 Fir'awn or Pharaoh's name was Walid, son of…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی يَافِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّیْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ waqāla mūsā yāfir'ʿawnu innī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna And Moses said, 'O Pharaoh, I am indeed an apostle from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی يَافِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّیْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ waqāla mūsā yāfir'ʿawnu innī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna And Musa said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds. And Musa said: O Fir'awn! Verily, I am a Messenger from the Lord of all that exists (7:104). "Proper it is for me that I say nothing concerning Allah but the truth. Indeed I have come unto you from your Lord with a clear proof. So let the Children of Israel depart along with me (7:105). (Fir'awn) said: "If you have come with a sign, show it forth, if you are one of those who tell the truth (7:106). Allah mentions a debate that took place between Musa and Fir'awn, and Musa's refuting Fir'awn with the unequivocal proof and clear miracles, in the presence of Fir'awn and his people,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی يَافِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّیْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ waqāla mūsā yāfir'ʿawnu innī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna And said Moses: "O' Pharaoh! Verily I am an apostle from the Lord of the worlds," See 7:103

item.title: Al-A'raaf:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَقِيقٌ عَلَى أَنْ لَا أَقُولَ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ ḥaqīqun ʿalā an lā aqūla ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa qad ji'tukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum fa-arsil maʿiya banī is'rāīla It behooves me to say nothing about Allah except the truth. I certainly bring you a manifest proof from your Lord. So let the Children of Israel go with me.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَقِيقٌ عَلَى أَنْ لَا أَقُولَ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ ḥaqīqun ʿalā an lā aqūla ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa qad ji'tukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum fa-arsil maʿiya banī is'rāīla (Who is) obligated not to say about Allah except the truth. I have come to you with clear evidence from your Lord, so send with me the Children of Israel."1 See 7:104

item.title: Al-A'raaf:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَقِيقٌ عَلَى أَنْ لَا أَقُولَ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ ḥaqīqun ʿalā an lā aqūla ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa qad ji'tukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum fa-arsil maʿiya banī is'rāīla (It is) incumbent upon (me) that I say not anything about God save the truth; indeed I have brought unto you with clear signs (miracles) from your Lord, so send Thou (Pharaoh.) with me the children of Israel. See 7:103

item.title: Al-A'raaf:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ جِئْتَ بِاٰیَةٍ فَأْتِ بِهَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qāla in kunta ji'ta biāyatin fati bihā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna He said, 'If you have brought a sign, produce it, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ جِئْتَ بِاٰیَةٍ فَأْتِ بِهَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qāla in kunta ji'ta biāyatin fati bihā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna (Pharaoh) said, "If you have come with a sign, then bring it forth, if you should be of the truthful." See 7:104

item.title: Al-A'raaf:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ جِئْتَ بِاٰیَةٍ فَأْتِ بِهَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qāla in kunta ji'ta biāyatin fati bihā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna He said: "If thou hast come with a sign, then bring it, if thou art of the truthful ones." See 7:103

item.title: Al-A'raaf:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnun Thereat he threw down his staff, and behold, it became a manifest python.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnun So he (i.e., Musa) threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.1 Then (Musa) threw his staff and behold! it was a (Thu'ban) serpent, manifest (7:107). And he drew out his hand, and behold! it was white (with radiance) for the beholders (7:108). Ali bin Abi Talhah reported that Ibn 'Abbas commented on Allah's statement: ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ a (Thu'ban) serpent, manifest Refers to "The male snake." As-Suddi and Ad-Dahhak said similarly. A report from Ibn 'Abbas said: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ "(Then (Musa) threw his staff), and it turned into a huge snake that opened its mouth and rushed towards Fir'awn. When Fir'awn saw the snake rushing towards him, he jumped from his throne and cried to Musa for help, so that Musa would remove the snake from…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnun So he (Moses) threw (down) his rod, and lo! It was a serpent clearly seen. See 7:103

item.title: Al-A'raaf:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīna Then he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to the onlookers.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīna And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white (with radiance) for the observers. See 7:107

item.title: Al-A'raaf:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīna Then drew he (Moses) forth his hand (out of his bosom) and lo! it was white (shining bright) to (all) beholders. Moses had been gifted by God with two miraculous signs, one the staff which used to become a serpent and the other his hand shining white when it was put into his bosom and brought out. When Moses threw his staff before Pharaoh, he showed to him his hand shining bright. The Old Testament also says that Moses was given the two great signs vide: 1. And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say. The Lord hath not appeared unto thee. 2. "And the Lord said unto him, what is that in thine hand?…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌ qāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun The elite of Pharaoh's people said, 'This is indeed an expert magician;

item.title: Al-A'raaf:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌ qāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun Said the eminent among the people of Pharaoh, "Indeed, this is a learned magician. The chiefs of the people of Fir'awn said: "This is indeed a well-versed sorcerer (7:109). "He wants to get you out of your land, so what do you advise? (7:110). Fir'awn's People Say that Musa is a Magician! The chiefs and noblemen of the people of Fir'awn agreed with Fir'awn's statement about Musa. After Fir'awn felt safe and returned to his throne, he said to the chiefs of his people: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ This is indeed a well-versed sorcerer and they agreed. They held counsel to decide what they should do about Musa. They conspired to extinguish the light that he brought and bring down his word.…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌ qāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun Said the chiefs of the people of Pharaoh: "Verily this indeed is an enchanter (most) learned." See 7:108

item.title: Al-A'raaf:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum famādhā tamurūna he seeks to expel you from your land.' 'So what do you advise?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum famādhā tamurūna Who wants to expel you from your land (through magic), so what do you instruct?" See 7:109

item.title: Al-A'raaf:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum famādhā tamurūna He intendeth to turn you (Pharaoh addressing his chiefs.) out of your land; What is it then ye counsel? See 7:108

item.title: Al-A'raaf:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَأَرْسِلْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-arsil fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna They said, 'Put him and his brother off for a while, and send heralds to the cities,

item.title: Al-A'raaf:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَأَرْسِلْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-arsil fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna They said,1 "Postpone (the matter of) him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers. They said: "Put him and his brother off (for a time), and send callers to the cities to collect (7:111). "That they bring to you all well-versed sorcerers (7:112). Ibn 'Abbas commented: أَرْجِهْ "Put him off" Which is means, "delay him (for a time)." وَأَرْسِلْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ "and send to the cities" Which is areas and provinces of your kingdom – O Fir'awn: حَاشِرِينَ "to collect" to gather magicians from various lands. At this time, magic was the trade of the day and it was widespread and popular. They had the idea that what Musa brought was a type of magic similar to the magic that the sorcerers of their…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَأَرْسِلْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-arsil fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna Said they: (The chiefs.) "Put him off and his brother, and send thou into the cities, collectors," See 7:108

item.title: Al-A'raaf:112 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ yatūka bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin to bring you every expert magician.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:112 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ yatūka bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin Who will bring you every learned magician." See 7:111

item.title: Al-A'raaf:112 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ yatūka bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin That they may (collect and) bring unto thee every enchanter (who is most) learned. See 7:108

item.title: Al-A'raaf:113 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ wajāa l-saḥaratu fir'ʿawna qālū inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīna And the magicians came to Pharaoh. They said, 'We shall indeed have a reward if we were to be the victors?'1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:113 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ wajāa l-saḥaratu fir'ʿawna qālū inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīna And the magicians came to Pharaoh. They said, "Indeed for us is a reward if we are the predominant." And so the sorcerers came to Fir'awn. They said: "Indeed there will be a (good) reward for us if we are the victors (7:113). He said: "Yes, and moreover you will (in that case) be of the nearest (to me) (7:114). The Magicians Convene and Change Their Ropes into Snakes before Musa Allah describes the conversation that took place between Fir'awn and the magicians he collected to defeat Musa (AS). Fir'awn told them that he will reward them and give them tremendous provisions. He made them hope in acquiring what they wished for and to make them among his…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:113 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ wajāa l-saḥaratu fir'ʿawna qālū inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīna And came the enchanters unto Pharaoh and said they: "Verily for us must be a reward if we be the triumphants." It is reported that about twelve thousand magicians had assembled. There were four master magicians among them, named: Sadoor, Khadoor, Khatat and Musafi and there was a master of these four named Sham'oon. Soon after their arrival in Egypt the magicians had come to know that the staff of Moses remained a serpent and guarded Moses while he was asleep. The magicians got despaired; for a magical effect did not remain to act when the magician was asleep. It is said that this contest of the magic and the miracle took place in Alexandria and there was…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:114 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ qāla naʿam wa-innakum lamina l-muqarabīna He said, 'Of course! And indeed you shall be among those near [to me].'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:114 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ qāla naʿam wa-innakum lamina l-muqarabīna He said, "Yes, and, (moreover), you will be among those made near (to me)." See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:114 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ qāla naʿam wa-innakum lamina l-muqarabīna Said he: (Pharaoh.) "Yea! (even more) and Verily ye shall certainly be of those nearest (to me)." See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:115 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی إِمَّا أَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ نَكُونَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِينَ qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an nakūna naḥnu l-mul'qīna They said, 'O Moses, will you throw [first], or shall we throw?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:115 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی إِمَّا أَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ نَكُونَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِينَ qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an nakūna naḥnu l-mul'qīna They said, "O Musa, either you throw (your staff), or we will be the ones to throw (first)." They said: O Musa! Either you throw (first), or shall we have the (first) throw? (7:115). He (Musa) said: "Throw you (first)." So when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people, and struck terror into them, and they displayed a great trick (7:116). The magicians challenged Musa, when they said: إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِينَ Either you throw (first), or shall we have the (first) throw? before you. In another Ayah, they said: وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ Or we be the first to throw (20:65) Musa said to them, you throw first. It was said…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:115 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی إِمَّا أَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ نَكُونَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِينَ qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an nakūna naḥnu l-mul'qīna They (Pharaoh's enchanters.) (the enchanters) said: "O' Moses! Wilt thou cast (thy rod first) or shall We be the (first) casters." See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:116 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلْقُوْۤا فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا سَحَرُوْۤا أَعْيُنَ النَّاسِ وَاسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَآءُوْ بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍ qāla alqū falammā alqaw saḥarū aʿyuna l-nāsi wa-is'tarhabūhum wajāū bisiḥ'rin ʿaẓīmin He said, 'Throw [yours].' So when they threw, they bewitched the people's eyes and overawed them, producing a tremendous magic.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:116 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلْقُوْۤا فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا سَحَرُوْۤا أَعْيُنَ النَّاسِ وَاسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَآءُوْ بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍ qāla alqū falammā alqaw saḥarū aʿyuna l-nāsi wa-is'tarhabūhum wajāū bisiḥ'rin ʿaẓīmin He said, "Throw," and when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people and struck terror into them, and they presented a great (feat of) magic.1 See 7:115

item.title: Al-A'raaf:116 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلْقُوْۤا فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا سَحَرُوْۤا أَعْيُنَ النَّاسِ وَاسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَآءُوْ بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍ qāla alqū falammā alqaw saḥarū aʿyuna l-nāsi wa-is'tarhabūhum wajāū bisiḥ'rin ʿaẓīmin Said he: (Moses) "Cast ye (first)! So when they did cast they bewitched the eyes of the people and terrified them, and produced they a great enchantment." See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:117 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an alqi ʿaṣāka fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūna And We signalled to Moses: 'Throw down your staff.' And behold, it was swallowing what they had faked.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:117 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an alqi ʿaṣāka fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūna And We inspired to Musa, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying. And We revealed to Musa (saying): "Throw your stick," and behold! It swallowed up straight away all the falsehood which they showed (7:117). Thus truth was confirmed, and all that they did was made of no effect (7:118). So they were defeated there and returned disgraced (7:119). And the sorcerers fell down prostrate (7:120). They said: "We believe in the Lord of all that exists (7:121). "The Lord of Musa and Harun (7:122). Musa Defeats the Magicians, Who Believe in Him Allah states that at that tremendous moment, in which Allah differentiated between Truth and Falsehood, He sent a revelation to…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:117 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an alqi ʿaṣāka fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūna And revealed We unto Moses saying: "Cast thou thy rod!" then (When Moses did cast the Rod.) lo! it swallowed (one after another all), that they falsely demonstrated. See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:118 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ fawaqaʿa l-ḥaqu wabaṭala mā kānū yaʿmalūna So the truth came out, and what they had wrought was reduced to naught.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:118 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ fawaqaʿa l-ḥaqu wabaṭala mā kānū yaʿmalūna So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing. See 7:117

item.title: Al-A'raaf:118 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ fawaqaʿa l-ḥaqu wabaṭala mā kānū yaʿmalūna So was established the truth and was made vain what (all) they were doing See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:119 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانْقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ faghulibū hunālika wa-inqalabū ṣāghirīna Thereat they were vanquished, and they retreated, humiliated.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:119 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانْقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ faghulibū hunālika wa-inqalabū ṣāghirīna And they (i.e., Pharaoh and his people) were overcome right there and became debased. See 7:117

item.title: Al-A'raaf:119 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانْقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ faghulibū hunālika wa-inqalabū ṣāghirīna So (Pharaoh and his enchanters) were defeated on the spot, and returned humbled (Abased.) down. See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:120 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ wa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīna And the magicians fell down in prostration.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:120 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ wa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīna And the magicians fell down in prostration (to Allah). See 7:117

item.title: Al-A'raaf:120 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ wa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīna And the enchanters threw (themselves) down prostrating (in adoration) See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:121 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīna They said, 'We have believed in the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: Al-A'raaf:121 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīna They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds. See 7:117

item.title: Al-A'raaf:121 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīna Said they: "We believe in the Lord of the worlds," See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:122 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ rabbi mūsā wahārūna the Lord of Moses and Aaron.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:122 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ rabbi mūsā wahārūna The Lord of Musa and Harun." See 7:117

item.title: Al-A'raaf:122 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ rabbi mūsā wahārūna The Lord of Moses and Aaron. See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:123 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّ هَذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَكَرْتُمُوهُ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لِتُخْرِجُوا مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ qāla fir'ʿawnu āmantum bihi qabla an ādhana lakum inna hādhā lamakrun makartumūhu fī l-madīnati litukh'rijū min'hā ahlahā fasawfa taʿlamūna Pharaoh said, 'Do you profess faith in Him before I may permit you? It is indeed a plot you have devised in the city to expel its people from it. Soon you will know [the consequences]!

item.title: Al-A'raaf:123 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّ هَذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَكَرْتُمُوهُ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لِتُخْرِجُوا مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ qāla fir'ʿawnu āmantum bihi qabla an ādhana lakum inna hādhā lamakrun makartumūhu fī l-madīnati litukh'rijū min'hā ahlahā fasawfa taʿlamūna Said Pharaoh, "You believed in him1 before I gave you permission. Indeed, this is a conspiracy which you conspired in the city to expel therefrom its people. But you are going to know. Fir'awn said: "You have believed in him (Musa) before I gave you permission. Surely, this is a plot which you have plotted in the city to drive out its people, but you shall come to know (7:123). "Surely, I will cut off your hands and your feet from opposite sides, then I will crucify you all (7:124). They said: "Verily, we are returning to our Lord (7:125). "And you…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:123 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّ هَذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَكَرْتُمُوهُ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لِتُخْرِجُوا مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ qāla fir'ʿawnu āmantum bihi qabla an ādhana lakum inna hādhā lamakrun makartumūhu fī l-madīnati litukh'rijū min'hā ahlahā fasawfa taʿlamūna Said Pharaoh (Addressing the enchanters.) : "What? Believe ye in Him ere - I give permission unto you? Verily, this is a plot ye have plotted in the city, that ye may turn out of it its people, but soon ye shall know (the consequences)." See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:124 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ ثُمَّ لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin thumma la-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna Surely I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and then I will surely crucify all of you.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:124 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ ثُمَّ لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin thumma la-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all." See 7:123

item.title: Al-A'raaf:124 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ ثُمَّ لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin thumma la-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna Surely will I cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, then will I crucify you all together. See 7:113

item.title: Al-A'raaf:125 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ qālū innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna They said, 'Indeed we shall return to our Lord.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:125 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ qālū innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna They said, "Indeed, to our Lord we will return. See 7:123

item.title: Al-A'raaf:125 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ qālū innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna Said they: "Verily unto Our Lord we return." The reply given by the believers to Pharaoh was the same which the faithful companions of the Holy Imam Husayn gave at Karbala saying that they preferred death and destruction rather than desert Husayn in the hour of the trial.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:126 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
