item.description: وَمَا تَنْقِمُ مِنَّا إِلَّا أَنْ اٰمَنَّا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَاءَتْنَا رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ wamā tanqimu minnā illā an āmannā biāyāti rabbinā lammā jāatnā rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran watawaffanā mus'limīna You are vindictive toward us only because we have believed in the signs of our Lord, when they came to us.' 'Our Lord! Pour patience upon us, and grant us to die as muslims.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:126 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَنْقِمُ مِنَّا إِلَّا أَنْ اٰمَنَّا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَاءَتْنَا رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ wamā tanqimu minnā illā an āmannā biāyāti rabbinā lammā jāatnā rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran watawaffanā mus'limīna And you do not resent us except because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience1 and let us die as Muslims (in submission to You)." See 7:123

item.title: Al-A'raaf:126 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَنْقِمُ مِنَّا إِلَّا أَنْ اٰمَنَّا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَاءَتْنَا رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ wamā tanqimu minnā illā an āmannā biāyāti rabbinā lammā jāatnā rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran watawaffanā mus'limīna And thou dost not wreak vengeance on us except because believed we in the signs of our Lord when they came unto us: O' Our Lord! pour (Grant us.) out upon us patience and cause us to die submitting (unto Thee, i.e., as Muslims). See 7:125

item.title: Al-A'raaf:127 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسٰی وَقَوْمَهُ لِيُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَآلِهَتَكَ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَاهِرُونَ waqāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna atadharu mūsā waqawmahu liyuf'sidū fī l-arḍi wayadharaka waālihataka qāla sanuqattilu abnāahum wanastaḥyī nisāahum wa-innā fawqahum qāhirūna The elite of Pharaoh's people said, 'Will you leave Moses and his people to cause corruption in the land, and to abandon you and your gods?' He said, 'We will kill their sons and spare their women, and indeed we are dominant over them.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:127 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسٰی وَقَوْمَهُ لِيُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَآلِهَتَكَ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَاهِرُونَ waqāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna atadharu mūsā waqawmahu liyuf'sidū fī l-arḍi wayadharaka waālihataka qāla sanuqattilu abnāahum wanastaḥyī nisāahum wa-innā fawqahum qāhirūna And the eminent among the people of Pharaoh said, "Will you leave Musa and his people to cause corruption in the land and abandon you and your gods?" (Pharaoh) said, "We will kill their sons and keep their women alive; and indeed, we are subjugators over them." The chiefs of Fir'awn's people said: Will you leave Musa and his people to spread mischief in the land, and to abandon you and your gods?" He said: "We will kill their sons, and let their women live, and we have indeed irresistible power over them (7:127). Musa said to his…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:127 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسٰی وَقَوْمَهُ لِيُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَآلِهَتَكَ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَاهِرُونَ waqāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna atadharu mūsā waqawmahu liyuf'sidū fī l-arḍi wayadharaka waālihataka qāla sanuqattilu abnāahum wanastaḥyī nisāahum wa-innā fawqahum qāhirūna And said the chiefs of the people of Pharaoh: What! leavest thou Moses and his people to make mischief in the earth and to desert thee and thy gods? Said He: (Pharaoh.) "Soon will we slay their sons and suffer their women alive; Verily we, over them have hold (Ar. 'Qahir'- Here means Conqueror – Triumphant - One having supreme mastery or hold.) ." See 7:125

item.title: Al-A'raaf:128 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مُوسٰی لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِينُوا بِاللَّهِ وَاصْبِرُوا إِنَّ الْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ qāla mūsā liqawmihi is'taʿīnū bil-lahi wa-iṣ'birū inna l-arḍa lillahi yūrithuhā man yashāu min ʿibādihi wal-ʿāqibatu lil'muttaqīna Moses said to his people, 'Turn to Allah for help and be patient. The earth indeed belongs to Allah, and He gives its inheritance to whomever He wishes of His servants, and the outcome will be in favour of the Godwary.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:128 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مُوسٰی لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِينُوا بِاللَّهِ وَاصْبِرُوا إِنَّ الْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ qāla mūsā liqawmihi is'taʿīnū bil-lahi wa-iṣ'birū inna l-arḍa lillahi yūrithuhā man yashāu min ʿibādihi wal-ʿāqibatu lil'muttaqīna Said Musa to his people, "Seek help through Allah and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allah. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the (best) outcome is for the righteous." See 7:127

item.title: Al-A'raaf:128 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مُوسٰی لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِينُوا بِاللَّهِ وَاصْبِرُوا إِنَّ الْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ qāla mūsā liqawmihi is'taʿīnū bil-lahi wa-iṣ'birū inna l-arḍa lillahi yūrithuhā man yashāu min ʿibādihi wal-ʿāqibatu lil'muttaqīna Moses said unto his people: "Seek ye help from God and be patient: Verily the earth is God's, granteth He as heritage (in Vicissitude.) unto whomsoever He pleaseth among His servants." And the end is (only) for those who guard against evil. See 7:125

item.title: Al-A'raaf:129 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أُوذِينَا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا قَالَ عَسٰۤی رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ qālū ūdhīnā min qabli an tatiyanā wamin baʿdi mā ji'tanā qāla ʿasā rabbukum an yuh'lika ʿaduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fī l-arḍi fayanẓura kayfa taʿmalūna They said, 'We were tormented before you came to us and [also] after you came to us.' He said, 'Maybe your Lord will destroy your enemy and make you successors in the land, and then He will see how you act.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:129 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أُوذِينَا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا قَالَ عَسٰۤی رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ qālū ūdhīnā min qabli an tatiyanā wamin baʿdi mā ji'tanā qāla ʿasā rabbukum an yuh'lika ʿaduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fī l-arḍi fayanẓura kayfa taʿmalūna They said, "We have been harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us." He said, "Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy and grant you succession in the land and see how you will do." See 7:127

item.title: Al-A'raaf:129 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أُوذِينَا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا قَالَ عَسٰۤی رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ qālū ūdhīnā min qabli an tatiyanā wamin baʿdi mā ji'tanā qāla ʿasā rabbukum an yuh'lika ʿaduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fī l-arḍi fayanẓura kayfa taʿmalūna Said they: "We have been persecuted before camest thou unto us and since thou hath come unto us;" Said he (Moses); "Maybe that your Lord will destroy your enemy and make ye the inheritors in the earth so that He may see how ye act (therein)." See 7:125

item.title: Al-A'raaf:130 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ walaqad akhadhnā āla fir'ʿawna bil-sinīna wanaqṣin mina l-thamarāti laʿallahum yadhakkarūna Certainly We afflicted Pharaoh's clan with droughts and loss of produce, so that they may take admonition.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:130 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ walaqad akhadhnā āla fir'ʿawna bil-sinīna wanaqṣin mina l-thamarāti laʿallahum yadhakkarūna And We certainly seized1 the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded. And indeed We punished the people of Fir'awn with years of drought and lack of fruits (crops), that they might remember (take heed) (7:130). But whenever good came to them, they said: "This is for us." And if evil afflicted them, they considered it an omen about Musa and those with him. Be informed! Verily, their omens are with Allah but most of them know not (7:131). Fir'awn and His People Suffer Years of Drought Allah said: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ And indeed We punished the people of Fir'awn We tested and tried them: بِالسِّنِينَ with years…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:130 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ walaqad akhadhnā āla fir'ʿawna bil-sinīna wanaqṣin mina l-thamarāti laʿallahum yadhakkarūna Indeed seized We the people of Pharaoh with (years long) droughts and diminution of fruits that they may be admonished. (to be mindful.) See 7:125

item.title: Al-A'raaf:131 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوْا لَنَا هَذِهِ وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا بِمُوسٰی وَمَنْ مَعَهُ أَلَا إِنَّمَا طَائِرُهُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-idhā jāathumu l-ḥasanatu qālū lanā hādhihi wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun yaṭṭayyarū bimūsā waman maʿahu alā innamā ṭāiruhum ʿinda l-lahi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna But whenever any good came to them, they would say, 'This is our due.' And if any ill visited them, they took it for ill omens attending Moses and those who were with him. (Look! Indeed the cause of their ill omens is with Allah, but most of them do not know.)

item.title: Al-A'raaf:131 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوْا لَنَا هَذِهِ وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا بِمُوسٰی وَمَنْ مَعَهُ أَلَا إِنَّمَا طَائِرُهُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-idhā jāathumu l-ḥasanatu qālū lanā hādhihi wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun yaṭṭayyarū bimūsā waman maʿahu alā innamā ṭāiruhum ʿinda l-lahi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna But when good (i.e., provision) came to them, they said, "This is ours (by right)." And if a bad (condition) struck them, they saw an evil omen in Musa and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allah, but most of them do not know. See 7:130

item.title: Al-A'raaf:131 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوْا لَنَا هَذِهِ وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا بِمُوسٰی وَمَنْ مَعَهُ أَلَا إِنَّمَا طَائِرُهُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-idhā jāathumu l-ḥasanatu qālū lanā hādhihi wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun yaṭṭayyarū bimūsā waman maʿahu alā innamā ṭāiruhum ʿinda l-lahi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna But when reached them any good said they "This is due to us;" and when any evil did smite them, they ascribed it to ill-luck due to Moses and those with him; Be it known! Verily their ill-luck (Man's own misbehaviour is explained in 4:78, but every one's misfortune is with God i.e., in His Knowledge.) is only with God; but most of them know not. (Ar. 'Ta'ir' - Lit., bird - here Omen, Augury. The people of Pharaoh used to draw Omens from the flight of the birds into a particular direction - As some…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:132 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ لِتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ waqālū mahmā tatinā bihi min āyatin litasḥaranā bihā famā naḥnu laka bimu'minīna And they said, 'Whatever sign you may bring us to bewitch us, we are not going to believe you.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:132 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ لِتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ waqālū mahmā tatinā bihi min āyatin litasḥaranā bihā famā naḥnu laka bimu'minīna And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you." They said (to Musa): "Whatever Ayat you may bring to us, to work therewith your sorcery on us, we shall never believe in you (7:132). So We sent on them: the Tuwfan, the locusts, the Qummal, the frogs, and the blood (as a succession of) manifest signs, yet they remained arrogant, and they were of those people who were criminals (7:133). And when the punishment struck them, they said: "O Musa! Invoke your Lord for us because of His promise to you. If you remove the punishment from us, we indeed shall believe in…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:132 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ لِتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ waqālū mahmā tatinā bihi min āyatin litasḥaranā bihā famā naḥnu laka bimu'minīna And said they: "Whatever thou mayest bring unto us of any sign to enchant us with it, we will not believe in thee." See 7:125

item.title: Al-A'raaf:133 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطُّوفَانَ وَالْجَرَادَ وَالْقُمَّلَ وَالضَّفَادِعَ وَالدَّمَ ءَايَاتٍ مُفَصَّلَاتٍ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ fa-arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-ṭūfāna wal-jarāda wal-qumala wal-ḍafādiʿa wal-dama āyātin mufaṣṣalātin fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīna So We sent against them a flood and locusts, lice, frogs and blood, as distinct signs. But they acted arrogantly, and they were a guilty lot.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:133 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطُّوفَانَ وَالْجَرَادَ وَالْقُمَّلَ وَالضَّفَادِعَ وَالدَّمَ ءَايَاتٍ مُفَصَّلَاتٍ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ fa-arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-ṭūfāna wal-jarāda wal-qumala wal-ḍafādiʿa wal-dama āyātin mufaṣṣalātin fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīna So We sent upon them the flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood as distinct signs, but they were arrogant and were a criminal people. See 7:132

item.title: Al-A'raaf:133 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطُّوفَانَ وَالْجَرَادَ وَالْقُمَّلَ وَالضَّفَادِعَ وَالدَّمَ ءَايَاتٍ مُفَصَّلَاتٍ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ fa-arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-ṭūfāna wal-jarāda wal-qumala wal-ḍafādiʿa wal-dama āyātin mufaṣṣalātin fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīna So We sent upon them widespread calamities, (of wholesale death), and the locust and the lice, and the frogs and the blood, clear signs (miracles.) , yet they behaved proudly (arrogantly.) and so they were a guilty people. There is a mention also in the Bible, of these pestilences sent on the people. Visitation of Pestilence on Egypt. The river turned into blood – Exodus 7/19, 20 Frogs sent – Exodus 8/2-6 Dust turned into lice – Exodus 8/16-17 Swarms of flies – Exodus 8/21-24 The murrain of beasts – Exodus 9/3-6 The plague of boils and blains – Exodus 9/9-11 The plague of hail – Exodus 9/22-24 Locusts – Exodus 10/12-14 Darkness –…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:134 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ لَئِنْ كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا الرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ walammā waqaʿa ʿalayhimu l-rij'zu qālū yāmūsā ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka la-in kashafta ʿannā l-rij'za lanu'minanna laka walanur'silanna maʿaka banī is'rāīla Whenever a plague fell upon them, they would say, 'O Moses, invoke your Lord for us by the covenant He has made with you. If you remove the plague from us, we will certainly believe in you and let the Children of Israel go along with you.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:134 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ لَئِنْ كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا الرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ walammā waqaʿa ʿalayhimu l-rij'zu qālū yāmūsā ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka la-in kashafta ʿannā l-rij'za lanu'minanna laka walanur'silanna maʿaka banī is'rāīla And when the punishment descended upon them, they said, "O Musa, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. If you (can) remove the punishment from us, we will surely believe you, and we will send with you the Children of Israel." See 7:132

item.title: Al-A'raaf:134 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ لَئِنْ كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا الرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ walammā waqaʿa ʿalayhimu l-rij'zu qālū yāmūsā ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka la-in kashafta ʿannā l-rij'za lanu'minanna laka walanur'silanna maʿaka banī is'rāīla And whenever fell upon them the torment (The shocking and the shaking torment making them shiver.) said they: "O' Moses! pray unto thy Lord as He covenanted with thee, if thou removeth from us the torment, surely will we believe in thee, and surely will we send with thee the children of Israel." See 7:133

item.title: Al-A'raaf:135 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْزَ إِلَى أَجَلٍ هُمْ بَالِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-rij'za ilā ajalin hum bālighūhu idhā hum yankuthūna But when We had removed the plague from them until a term that they should have completed, behold, they broke their promise.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:135 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْزَ إِلَى أَجَلٍ هُمْ بَالِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-rij'za ilā ajalin hum bālighūhu idhā hum yankuthūna But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach,1 then at once they broke their word. See 7:132

item.title: Al-A'raaf:135 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْزَ إِلَى أَجَلٍ هُمْ بَالِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-rij'za ilā ajalin hum bālighūhu idhā hum yankuthūna But whenever removed We the torment from them till a fixed term which they should reach, lo! they broke (their promise). There is a mention of Pharaoh's people breaking promises to Moses. Pharaoh and his people breaking promises: Exodus 8/29 Exodus 8/8, 28, 32 Exodus 9/8, 27, 28, 34 and 25 Exodus 10/27. When the magicians were turned into believers a great number of the Egyptians also embraced the faith in the True God but Pharaoh at the instigation of his Vizier Haman imprisoned all such believers. When in spite of repeated counselling, Pharaoh did not release the poor people, Moses with his men camped outside the city and God sent upon the people of Pharaoh a storm…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:136 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا غَافِلِينَ fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum fī l-yami bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīna So We took vengeance on them and drowned them in the sea, for they denied Our signs and were oblivious to them.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:136 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا غَافِلِينَ fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum fī l-yami bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīna So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. So We took retribution from them. We drowned them in the sea, because they belied Our Ayat and were heedless with them (7:136). And We made the people who were considered weak to inherit the eastern parts of the land and the western parts thereof which We have blessed. And the fair Word of your Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel, because of their endurance. And We destroyed what Fir'awn and his people produced, and what they erected (7:137). The People of Fir'awn Drown in the Sea; the Children of Israel Inherit the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:136 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا غَافِلِينَ fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum fī l-yami bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīna So We did inflict retribution on them, and drowned them in the sea, because they belied Our signs and were heedless of them. See 7:135

item.title: Al-A'raaf:137 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ الْحُسْنَى عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا وَدَمَّرْنَا مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَوْمُهُ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْرِشُونَ wa-awrathnā l-qawma alladhīna kānū yus'taḍʿafūna mashāriqa l-arḍi wamaghāribahā allatī bāraknā fīhā watammat kalimatu rabbika l-ḥus'nā ʿalā banī is'rāīla bimā ṣabarū wadammarnā mā kāna yaṣnaʿu fir'ʿawnu waqawmuhu wamā kānū yaʿrishūna We made the people who were abased the heirs to the east and west of the land which We had blessed, and your Lord's best word [of promise] was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of their patience, and We destroyed what Pharaoh and his people had built and what they used to erect.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:137 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ الْحُسْنَى عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا وَدَمَّرْنَا مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَوْمُهُ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْرِشُونَ wa-awrathnā l-qawma alladhīna kānū yus'taḍʿafūna mashāriqa l-arḍi wamaghāribahā allatī bāraknā fīhā watammat kalimatu rabbika l-ḥus'nā ʿalā banī is'rāīla bimā ṣabarū wadammarnā mā kāna yaṣnaʿu fir'ʿawnu waqawmuhu wamā kānū yaʿrishūna And We caused the people who had been oppressed to inherit the eastern regions of the land and the western ones, which We had blessed. And the good word (i.e., decree) of your Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of what they had patiently endured. And We destroyed (all) that Pharaoh and his people were producing and what they had been building. See 7:136

item.title: Al-A'raaf:137 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ الْحُسْنَى عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا وَدَمَّرْنَا مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَوْمُهُ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْرِشُونَ wa-awrathnā l-qawma alladhīna kānū yus'taḍʿafūna mashāriqa l-arḍi wamaghāribahā allatī bāraknā fīhā watammat kalimatu rabbika l-ḥus'nā ʿalā banī is'rāīla bimā ṣabarū wadammarnā mā kāna yaṣnaʿu fir'ʿawnu waqawmuhu wamā kānū yaʿrishūna And made We inheritors the people who were deemed weak (to inherit) the eastern (The Western and Eastern sides of the Holy Land is not that of the Red Sea.) parts of the earth and the western parts of it, which we had blessed therein (with fertility); and the good (The promise made to the Israelites.) word of thy Lord was fulfilled in the children of Israel for what they did endure; and destroyed We, what Pharaoh and his people had wrought,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:138 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا عَلَى قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَى أَصْنَامٍ لَهُمْ قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی اجْعَلْ لَنَا إِلَهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-ataw ʿalā qawmin yaʿkufūna ʿalā aṣnāmin lahum qālū yāmūsā ij'ʿal lanā ilāhan kamā lahum ālihatun qāla innakum qawmun tajhalūna We carried the Children of Israel across the sea, whereat they came upon a people cleaving to certain idols that they had. They said, 'O Moses, make for us a god like the gods that they have.' He said, 'You are indeed an ignorant lot.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:138 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا عَلَى قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَى أَصْنَامٍ لَهُمْ قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی اجْعَلْ لَنَا إِلَهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-ataw ʿalā qawmin yaʿkufūna ʿalā aṣnāmin lahum qālū yāmūsā ij'ʿal lanā ilāhan kamā lahum ālihatun qāla innakum qawmun tajhalūna And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to (some) idols of theirs. They (the Children of Israel) said, "O Musa, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly. And We brought the Children of Israel (with safety) across the sea, and they came upon a people devoted to some of their idols (in worship). They said: "O Musa! Make for us a god as they have gods." He said: "Verily, you…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:138 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا عَلَى قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَى أَصْنَامٍ لَهُمْ قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی اجْعَلْ لَنَا إِلَهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-ataw ʿalā qawmin yaʿkufūna ʿalā aṣnāmin lahum qālū yāmūsā ij'ʿal lanā ilāhan kamā lahum ālihatun qāla innakum qawmun tajhalūna And We caused the children of Israel to cross (safely) the sea, then they came upon a people devoted (themselves) to the worship of the idols of their own; said they (the children of Israel): "O' Moses! Make thou for us a god as they have gods of their own. Said he, "Verily ye are a people behaving ignorantly." The Israelites had been so much accustomed to idolatry they wanted Moses also to make an idol-god for them. Idolatry had become a national characteristic of the Israelites, a mention of which is found in…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:139 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ inna hāulāi mutabbarun mā hum fīhi wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūna What they are engaged in is indeed bound to perish, and what they have been doing shall come to naught.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:139 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ inna hāulāi mutabbarun mā hum fīhi wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūna Indeed, those (worshippers) - destroyed is that in which they are (engaged), and worthless is whatever they were doing." See 7:138

item.title: Al-A'raaf:139 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ inna hāulāi mutabbarun mā hum fīhi wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūna As to these people, surely in what (Idol worship.) they are, shall be destroyed (brought to naught.) , and vain it is what they do. See 7:138

item.title: Al-A'raaf:140 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلَهًا وَهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ qāla aghayra l-lahi abghīkum ilāhan wahuwa faḍḍalakum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna He said, 'Shall I find you a god other than Allah, while He has graced you over all the nations?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:140 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلَهًا وَهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ qāla aghayra l-lahi abghīkum ilāhan wahuwa faḍḍalakum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna He said, "Is it other than Allah I should desire for you as a god1 while He has preferred you over the worlds?" He said: Shall I seek for you an ilah (a god) other than Allah, while He has given you superiority over the nations (7:140). And (remember) when We rescued you from Fir'awn's people, who were afflicting you with the worst torment, killing your sons and letting your women live. And in that was a great trial from your Lord (7:141). Reminding the Children of Israel of Allah's Blessings for Them Musa reminded the Children of Israel of Allah's blessings, such as saving them from Fir'awn, his tyranny and the humiliation and disgrace they suffered. He reminded them of the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:140 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلَهًا وَهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ qāla aghayra l-lahi abghīkum ilāhan wahuwa faḍḍalakum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna (And) said he: "What! Other than (the true) God, shall I seek for you a god, while He hath exalted (Preferred.) you over (the people of the) worlds?" See 7:138

item.title: Al-A'raaf:141 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ وَفِي ذَلِكُمْ بَلَاءٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ wa-idh anjaynākum min āli fir'ʿawna yasūmūnakum sūa l-ʿadhābi yuqattilūna abnāakum wayastaḥyūna nisāakum wafī dhālikum balāon min rabbikum ʿaẓīmun And when We delivered you from Pharaoh's clan who inflicted on you a terrible torment, slaughtering your sons and sparing your women, and there was a great test in that from your Lord.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:141 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ وَفِي ذَلِكُمْ بَلَاءٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ wa-idh anjaynākum min āli fir'ʿawna yasūmūnakum sūa l-ʿadhābi yuqattilūna abnāakum wayastaḥyūna nisāakum wafī dhālikum balāon min rabbikum ʿaẓīmun And (recall, O Children of Israel), when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, (who were) afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord. See 7:140

item.title: Al-A'raaf:141 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ وَفِي ذَلِكُمْ بَلَاءٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ wa-idh anjaynākum min āli fir'ʿawna yasūmūnakum sūa l-ʿadhābi yuqattilūna abnāakum wayastaḥyūna nisāakum wafī dhālikum balāon min rabbikum ʿaẓīmun And (remember ye) when We rescued you, from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted (Subjected.) you with grievous torment, slaying your sons and leaving alive your women, and in this, for you was a great trial from your Lord. See 7:138

item.title: Al-A'raaf:142 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَاعَدْنَا مُوسٰی ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً وَقَالَ مُوسٰی لِأَخِيهِ هَارُونَ اخْلُفْنِي فِي قَوْمِي وَأَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ wawāʿadnā mūsā thalāthīna laylatan wa-atmamnāhā biʿashrin fatamma mīqātu rabbihi arbaʿīna laylatan waqāla mūsā li-akhīhi hārūna ukh'luf'nī fī qawmī wa-aṣliḥ walā tattabiʿ sabīla l-muf'sidīna And We made an appointment with Moses for thirty nights, and completed them with ten [more]; thus the tryst of his Lord was completed in forty nights. And Moses said to Aaron, his brother, 'Be my successor among my people, and set things right and do not follow the way of the agents of corruption.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:142 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَاعَدْنَا مُوسٰی ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً وَقَالَ مُوسٰی لِأَخِيهِ هَارُونَ اخْلُفْنِي فِي قَوْمِي وَأَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ wawāʿadnā mūsā thalāthīna laylatan wa-atmamnāhā biʿashrin fatamma mīqātu rabbihi arbaʿīna laylatan waqāla mūsā li-akhīhi hārūna ukh'luf'nī fī qawmī wa-aṣliḥ walā tattabiʿ sabīla l-muf'sidīna And We made an appointment with Musa for thirty nights and perfected them by (the addition of) ten; so the term of his Lord was completed as forty nights. And Musa said to his brother Harun, "Take my place among my people, do right (by them),1 and do not follow the way of the corrupters." And We appointed for Musa thirty nights and added ten, and he completed the term, appointed by his Lord, of forty nights. And Musa said to his brother Harun: Replace me among my people, act in the right way…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:142 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَاعَدْنَا مُوسٰی ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً وَقَالَ مُوسٰی لِأَخِيهِ هَارُونَ اخْلُفْنِي فِي قَوْمِي وَأَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ wawāʿadnā mūsā thalāthīna laylatan wa-atmamnāhā biʿashrin fatamma mīqātu rabbihi arbaʿīna laylatan waqāla mūsā li-akhīhi hārūna ukh'luf'nī fī qawmī wa-aṣliḥ walā tattabiʿ sabīla l-muf'sidīna And We made appointment with Moses for thirty nights and completed it with ten (more), Thus was completed the term of his Lord forty nights, and (before he went up) said Moses unto his brother Aaron: "Take (Exactly so did the Holy Prophet leave 'Ali in his place - when he left Mecca on the Divinely Commanded Immigration to Madina and also when he left on the expedition to 'Tabuk'.) thou my place among my people, Act rightly and follow not the path of the mischief-makers" "And Moses went into the midst of the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:143 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسٰی لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنْظُرْ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَنْ تَرَانِي وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّى رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسٰی صَعِقًا فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walammā jāa mūsā limīqātinā wakallamahu rabbuhu qāla rabbi arinī anẓur ilayka qāla lan tarānī walākini unẓur ilā l-jabali fa-ini is'taqarra makānahu fasawfa tarānī falammā tajallā rabbuhu lil'jabali jaʿalahu dakkan wakharra mūsā ṣaʿiqan falammā afāqa qāla sub'ḥānaka tub'tu ilayka wa-anā awwalu l-mu'minīna When Moses arrived at Our tryst and his Lord spoke to him, he said, 'My Lord, show [Yourself] to me, that I may look at You!' He said, 'You shall not see Me. But look at the mountain: if it abides in its place, then you will see Me.' So when his Lord disclosed Himself to the mountain,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:143 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسٰی لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنْظُرْ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَنْ تَرَانِي وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّى رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسٰی صَعِقًا فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walammā jāa mūsā limīqātinā wakallamahu rabbuhu qāla rabbi arinī anẓur ilayka qāla lan tarānī walākini unẓur ilā l-jabali fa-ini is'taqarra makānahu fasawfa tarānī falammā tajallā rabbuhu lil'jabali jaʿalahu dakkan wakharra mūsā ṣaʿiqan falammā afāqa qāla sub'ḥānaka tub'tu ilayka wa-anā awwalu l-mu'minīna And when Musa arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me (Yourself) that I may look at You." (Allah) said, "You will not see Me,1 but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:143 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسٰی لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنْظُرْ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَنْ تَرَانِي وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّى رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسٰی صَعِقًا فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walammā jāa mūsā limīqātinā wakallamahu rabbuhu qāla rabbi arinī anẓur ilayka qāla lan tarānī walākini unẓur ilā l-jabali fa-ini is'taqarra makānahu fasawfa tarānī falammā tajallā rabbuhu lil'jabali jaʿalahu dakkan wakharra mūsā ṣaʿiqan falammā afāqa qāla sub'ḥānaka tub'tu ilayka wa-anā awwalu l-mu'minīna And when came Moses at Our appointment and spake unto him his Lord, said: he (Moses.) "O' My Lord! Show (Thyself) unto me, that I may look towards Thee;" He (God) said: (O' Moses!) never shalt thou see me, but look towards the mountain, if it remaineth firm in its place, then soon wilt thou see me, but…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:144 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَامُوسٰی اِنِّیْ اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسَالَاتِي وَبِكَلَامِي فَخُذْ مَا ءَاتَيْتُكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ qāla yāmūsā innī iṣ'ṭafaytuka ʿalā l-nāsi birisālātī wabikalāmī fakhudh mā ātaytuka wakun mina l-shākirīna He said, 'O Moses, I have chosen you over the people with My messages and My speech. So take what I give you, and be among the grateful.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:144 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَامُوسٰی اِنِّیْ اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسَالَاتِي وَبِكَلَامِي فَخُذْ مَا ءَاتَيْتُكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ qāla yāmūsā innī iṣ'ṭafaytuka ʿalā l-nāsi birisālātī wabikalāmī fakhudh mā ātaytuka wakun mina l-shākirīna (Allah) said, "O Musa, I have chosen you over the people with My messages and My words (to you). So take what I have given you and be among the grateful." (Allah) said: O Musa I have chosen you above men by My Messages, and by My speaking (to you). So hold that which I have given you and be of the grateful (7:144). And We wrote for him on the Tablets the exhortation all things and the explanation for all things (and said): Hold unto these with firmness, and enjoin your people to take the better therein. I shall show you the home of the rebellious (7:145). Allah Chooses Musa and…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:144 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَامُوسٰی اِنِّیْ اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسَالَاتِي وَبِكَلَامِي فَخُذْ مَا ءَاتَيْتُكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ qāla yāmūsā innī iṣ'ṭafaytuka ʿalā l-nāsi birisālātī wabikalāmī fakhudh mā ātaytuka wakun mina l-shākirīna He (God.) said: "O' Moses! Verily I have chosen thee above the people with My messages and with My words (discourse); take then what (The 'Torah'.) I give thee and be thou of the grateful ones." See 7:143

item.title: Al-A'raaf:145 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَخُذْهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَأْخُذُوْۤا بِأَحْسَنِهَا سَأُورِيكُمْ دَارَ الْفَاسِقِينَ wakatabnā lahu fī l-alwāḥi min kulli shayin mawʿiẓatan watafṣīlan likulli shayin fakhudh'hā biquwwatin wamur qawmaka yakhudhū bi-aḥsanihā sa-urīkum dāra l-fāsiqīna And We wrote for him in the Tablets advice concerning all things and an elaboration of all things, [and We said], 'Hold on to them with power, and bid your people to hold on to the best of [what is in] them. Soon I shall show you the abode of the transgressors.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:145 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَخُذْهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَأْخُذُوْۤا بِأَحْسَنِهَا سَأُورِيكُمْ دَارَ الْفَاسِقِينَ wakatabnā lahu fī l-alwāḥi min kulli shayin mawʿiẓatan watafṣīlan likulli shayin fakhudh'hā biquwwatin wamur qawmaka yakhudhū bi-aḥsanihā sa-urīkum dāra l-fāsiqīna And We wrote for him on the tablets (something) of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, (saying), "Take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. I will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient."1 See 7:144

item.title: Al-A'raaf:145 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَخُذْهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَأْخُذُوْۤا بِأَحْسَنِهَا سَأُورِيكُمْ دَارَ الْفَاسِقِينَ wakatabnā lahu fī l-alwāḥi min kulli shayin mawʿiẓatan watafṣīlan likulli shayin fakhudh'hā biquwwatin wamur qawmaka yakhudhū bi-aḥsanihā sa-urīkum dāra l-fāsiqīna And wrote We for him, in the Tablets lessons of every kind and explanation of every thing; and (said unto Moses): "Hold (To stick firmly.) thou these with firmness and bid thy people to hold fast what is best (The Best of the Lessons thereof.) thereof; Soon will I show you the abode of the wicked." See 7:143

item.title: Al-A'raaf:146 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ ءَايَاتِيَ الَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كُلَّ اٰیَةٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِهَا وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الرُّشْدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الْغَيِّ يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا غَافِلِينَ sa-aṣrifu ʿan āyātiya alladhīna yatakabbarūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-in yaraw kulla āyatin lā yu'minū bihā wa-in yaraw sabīla l-rush'di lā yattakhidhūhu sabīlan wa-in yaraw sabīla l-ghayi yattakhidhūhu sabīlan dhālika bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīna Soon I shall turn away from My signs those who are unduly arrogant in the earth: [even] though they should see every sign, they will not believe in it, and if they see the way of rectitude they will not take it as [their] way, and if they see the way of error they will take it as [their] way. That is because they deny Our signs and…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:146 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ ءَايَاتِيَ الَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كُلَّ اٰیَةٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِهَا وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الرُّشْدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الْغَيِّ يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا غَافِلِينَ sa-aṣrifu ʿan āyātiya alladhīna yatakabbarūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-in yaraw kulla āyatin lā yu'minū bihā wa-in yaraw sabīla l-rush'di lā yattakhidhūhu sabīlan wa-in yaraw sabīla l-ghayi yattakhidhūhu sabīlan dhālika bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīna I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness,1 they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:146 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ ءَايَاتِيَ الَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كُلَّ اٰیَةٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِهَا وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الرُّشْدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الْغَيِّ يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا غَافِلِينَ sa-aṣrifu ʿan āyātiya alladhīna yatakabbarūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-in yaraw kulla āyatin lā yu'minū bihā wa-in yaraw sabīla l-rush'di lā yattakhidhūhu sabīlan wa-in yaraw sabīla l-ghayi yattakhidhūhu sabīlan dhālika bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīna Soon will I (allow to) turn away from my signs those (who) unjustly pride (Consider themselves great without justification. With arrogance.) in the earth; while (even) if they see all the signs they will not believe in it; and (even) if they see the right way, they will not adopt it for a way; And if they see the way of error, they will adopt (Refers to the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:147 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَلِقَاءِ الْاٰخِرَةُ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā waliqāi l-ākhirati ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum hal yuj'zawna illā mā kānū yaʿmalūna Those who deny Our signs and the encounter of the Hereafter, their works have failed. Shall they be requited except for what they used to do?

item.title: Al-A'raaf:147 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَلِقَاءِ الْاٰخِرَةُ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā waliqāi l-ākhirati ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum hal yuj'zawna illā mā kānū yaʿmalūna Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do? See 7:146

item.title: Al-A'raaf:147 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَلِقَاءِ الْاٰخِرَةُ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā waliqāi l-ākhirati ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum hal yuj'zawna illā mā kānū yaʿmalūna And those who belie Our signs and the meeting of the hereafter, vain shall be their (good) deeds; shall they be recompensed save for what they have wrought? See 7:143

item.title: Al-A'raaf:148 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوسٰی مِنْ بَعْدِهِ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَهُ خُوَارٌ أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَلَا يَهْدِيهِمْ سَبِيلًا اتَّخَذُوهُ وَكَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ wa-ittakhadha qawmu mūsā min baʿdihi min ḥuliyyihim ʿij'lan jasadan lahu khuwārun alam yaraw annahu lā yukallimuhum walā yahdīhim sabīlan ittakhadhūhu wakānū ẓālimīna The people of Moses took up in his absence a calf [cast] from their ornaments —a body that gave out a lowing sound. Did they not regard that it did not speak to them, nor did it guide them to any way? They took it up [for worship] and they were wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:148 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوسٰی مِنْ بَعْدِهِ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَهُ خُوَارٌ أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَلَا يَهْدِيهِمْ سَبِيلًا اتَّخَذُوهُ وَكَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ wa-ittakhadha qawmu mūsā min baʿdihi min ḥuliyyihim ʿij'lan jasadan lahu khuwārun alam yaraw annahu lā yukallimuhum walā yahdīhim sabīlan ittakhadhūhu wakānū ẓālimīna And the people of Musa made, after (his departure), from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it (for worship), and they were wrongdoers. And the people of Musa made in his absence, out of their ornaments, the image of a calf (for worship). It had a sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to the way? They took it (for worship) and they were…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:148 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوسٰی مِنْ بَعْدِهِ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَهُ خُوَارٌ أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَلَا يَهْدِيهِمْ سَبِيلًا اتَّخَذُوهُ وَكَانُوْۤا ظَالِمِينَ wa-ittakhadha qawmu mūsā min baʿdihi min ḥuliyyihim ʿij'lan jasadan lahu khuwārun alam yaraw annahu lā yukallimuhum walā yahdīhim sabīlan ittakhadhūhu wakānū ẓālimīna The people of Moses after him (in his absence) made of their ornaments, a calf, (Refer to verse 20:88.) a (mere) body which seemed to low; Could they see not, it neither speaketh to them, and nor it guideth them in the way? They adopted it (for worship) and they were unjust. See 7:143

item.title: Al-A'raaf:149 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ وَرَأَوْا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوْۤا قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغْفِرْ لَنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walammā suqiṭa fī aydīhim wara-aw annahum qad ḍallū qālū la-in lam yarḥamnā rabbunā wayaghfir lanā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna But when they became remorseful and realised they had gone astray, they said, 'Should our Lord have no mercy on us, and forgive us, we will be surely among the losers.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:149 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ وَرَأَوْا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوْۤا قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغْفِرْ لَنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walammā suqiṭa fī aydīhim wara-aw annahum qad ḍallū qālū la-in lam yarḥamnā rabbunā wayaghfir lanā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna And when regret overcame them1 and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "If our Lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers." See 7:148

item.title: Al-A'raaf:149 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ وَرَأَوْا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوْۤا قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغْفِرْ لَنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walammā suqiṭa fī aydīhim wara-aw annahum qad ḍallū qālū la-in lam yarḥamnā rabbunā wayaghfir lanā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna And when they repented (Felt their failure against the argument.) and saw that they had gone astray, said they: "If Our Lord be not merciful unto us and forgive us (not), surely we shall be of the losers." See 7:143

item.title: Al-A'raaf:150 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسٰی إِلَى قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا قَالَ بِئْسَمَا خَلَفْتُمُونِي مِنْ بَعْدِي أَعَجِلْتُمْ أَمْرَ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَلْقَى الْأَلْوَاحَ وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ ابْنَ أُمَّ إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ اسْتَضْعَفُونِي وَكَادُوْۤا يَقْتُلُونَنِي فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِيَ الْأَعْدَاءَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ walammā rajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifan qāla bi'samā khalaftumūnī min baʿdī aʿajil'tum amra rabbikum wa-alqā l-alwāḥa wa-akhadha birasi akhīhi yajurruhu ilayhi qāla ib'na umma inna l-qawma is'taḍʿafūnī wakādū yaqtulūnanī falā tush'mit biya l-aʿdāa walā tajʿalnī maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when Moses returned to his people, angry and indignant, he said, 'Evil has been your conduct in my absence! Would you hasten on the edict of your Lord?' He threw down the tablets and seized his brother by the head, pulling him towards himself. He said, 'Son of my mother, indeed this people thought me to be weak, and they were…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:150 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسٰی إِلَى قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا قَالَ بِئْسَمَا خَلَفْتُمُونِي مِنْ بَعْدِي أَعَجِلْتُمْ أَمْرَ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَلْقَى الْأَلْوَاحَ وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ ابْنَ أُمَّ إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ اسْتَضْعَفُونِي وَكَادُوْۤا يَقْتُلُونَنِي فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِيَ الْأَعْدَاءَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ walammā rajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifan qāla bi'samā khalaftumūnī min baʿdī aʿajil'tum amra rabbikum wa-alqā l-alwāḥa wa-akhadha birasi akhīhi yajurruhu ilayhi qāla ib'na umma inna l-qawma is'taḍʿafūnī wakādū yaqtulūnanī falā tush'mit biya l-aʿdāa walā tajʿalnī maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when Musa returned to his people, angry and grieved, he said, "How wretched is that by which you have replaced me after (my departure). Were you impatient over the matter of your Lord?" And he threw down the tablets and seized his brother by (the hair of) his head, pulling him toward him. (Harun) said, "O son of my mother, indeed…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:150 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسٰی إِلَى قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا قَالَ بِئْسَمَا خَلَفْتُمُونِي مِنْ بَعْدِي أَعَجِلْتُمْ أَمْرَ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَلْقَى الْأَلْوَاحَ وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ ابْنَ أُمَّ إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ اسْتَضْعَفُونِي وَكَادُوْۤا يَقْتُلُونَنِي فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِيَ الْأَعْدَاءَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ walammā rajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifan qāla bi'samā khalaftumūnī min baʿdī aʿajil'tum amra rabbikum wa-alqā l-alwāḥa wa-akhadha birasi akhīhi yajurruhu ilayhi qāla ib'na umma inna l-qawma is'taḍʿafūnī wakādū yaqtulūnanī falā tush'mit biya l-aʿdāa walā tajʿalnī maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when returned Moses unto his people, wrathful and grieved, said he: "evil is it that ye have neglected (Thrown one behind, after I left you.) me; after me ye did make haste about the matter of your Lord?" and he threw down the tablets and seized his brother (Aaron) by the head, dragging him unto him; Said he (Aaron): "O' Son…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:151 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wali-akhī wa-adkhil'nā fī raḥmatika wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna He said, 'My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:151 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wali-akhī wa-adkhil'nā fī raḥmatika wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna (Musa) said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful." See 7:150

item.title: Al-A'raaf:151 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wali-akhī wa-adkhil'nā fī raḥmatika wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna Said he (Moses) (praying) "O' My Lord! Forgive me and my Brother and admit us into Thy mercy, and Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful ones." See 7:150

item.title: Al-A'raaf:152 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ سَيَنَالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَذِلَّةٌ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُفْتَرِينَ inna alladhīna ittakhadhū l-ʿij'la sayanāluhum ghaḍabun min rabbihim wadhillatun fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wakadhālika najzī l-muf'tarīna Indeed those who took up the calf [for worship] shall be overtaken by their Lord's wrath and abasement in the life of the world.' Thus do We requite the fabricators [of lies].

item.title: Al-A'raaf:152 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ سَيَنَالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَذِلَّةٌ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُفْتَرِينَ inna alladhīna ittakhadhū l-ʿij'la sayanāluhum ghaḍabun min rabbihim wadhillatun fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wakadhālika najzī l-muf'tarīna Indeed, those who took the calf (for worship) will obtain anger from their Lord and humiliation in the life of this world, and thus do We recompense the inventors (of falsehood). Certainly, those who took the calf (for worship), wrath from their Lord and humiliation will come upon them in the life of this world. Thus do We recompense those who invent lies (7:152). But those who committed evil deeds and then repented afterwards and believed, verily, your Lord after (all) that is indeed Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (7:153). The 'wrath' mentioned here that struck the Children of Israel because of their worshipping the calf, means, Allah did not accept their…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:152 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ سَيَنَالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَذِلَّةٌ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُفْتَرِينَ inna alladhīna ittakhadhū l-ʿij'la sayanāluhum ghaḍabun min rabbihim wadhillatun fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wakadhālika najzī l-muf'tarīna Verily those who adopted the calf (for a god) soon shall reach them a wrath from their Lord and an indignation in the life of (this) world; and thus do We recompense the forgers of lies. See 7:150

item.title: Al-A'raaf:153 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ عَمِلُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهَا وَءَامَنُوْۤا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-alladhīna ʿamilū l-sayiāti thumma tābū min baʿdihā waāmanū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun Yet [to] those who commit misdeeds but repent after that, and believe, —indeed, after that, your Lord shall surely be all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:153 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ عَمِلُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهَا وَءَامَنُوْۤا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-alladhīna ʿamilū l-sayiāti thumma tābū min baʿdihā waāmanū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun But those who committed misdeeds and then repented after them and believed - indeed your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful. See 7:152

item.title: Al-A'raaf:153 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ عَمِلُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهَا وَءَامَنُوْۤا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-alladhīna ʿamilū l-sayiāti thumma tābū min baʿdihā waāmanū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun And those who do evil deeds, then repent (Condition for pardon is sincere repentance - with the determination to amend - not to repeat the sin thereafter.) they after that, while (in fact) believed Verily thy Lord after that is certainly Oft-Forgiving, Merciful. See 7:150

item.title: Al-A'raaf:154 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَنْ مُوسٰی الْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ وَفِي نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ walammā sakata ʿan mūsā l-ghaḍabu akhadha l-alwāḥa wafī nus'khatihā hudan waraḥmatun lilladhīna hum lirabbihim yarhabūna And when Moses' indignation abated, he picked up the tablets whose inscriptions contained guidance and mercy for those who are in awe of their Lord.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:154 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَنْ مُوسٰی الْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ وَفِي نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ walammā sakata ʿan mūsā l-ghaḍabu akhadha l-alwāḥa wafī nus'khatihā hudan waraḥmatun lilladhīna hum lirabbihim yarhabūna And when the anger subsided in Musa, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord. And when the anger of Musa calmed, he took up the Tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who fear their Lord (7:154). Musa Picked up the Tablets When His Anger Subsided Allah said next: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ And when calmed and subsided: عَن مُّوسَى الْغَضَبُ the anger of Musa with his people: أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ he took up the Tablets Which is which he had thrown out of jealousy for Allah and anger for His sake, because of his…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:154 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَنْ مُوسٰی الْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ وَفِي نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ walammā sakata ʿan mūsā l-ghaḍabu akhadha l-alwāḥa wafī nus'khatihā hudan waraḥmatun lilladhīna hum lirabbihim yarhabūna And when was appeased Moses' anger, he took up the Tablets and, in the writings therein was guidance and mercy for those who fear for the sake of their Lord. It is a clear blasphemy against the Holy Apostle Moses which is related in Exod. 32/19 saying Moses broke (the tablets, in his anger.) An Apostle of God like Moses, to have so much overpowered by anger, not to care for the security of the Holy Tablets he received from God Himself, is unimaginable. The biblical narrative is by all means rejectable. And the Tablets of Stone said to have been written by God's finger to be so easily broken…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:155 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْتَارَ مُوسٰی قَوْمَهُ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِمِيقَاتِنَا فَلَمَّا أَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِيَّايَ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَّا إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ wa-ikh'tāra mūsā qawmahu sabʿīna rajulan limīqātinā falammā akhadhathumu l-rajfatu qāla rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa-iyyāya atuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-sufahāu minnā in hiya illā fit'natuka tuḍillu bihā man tashāu watahdī man tashāu anta waliyyunā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-ghāfirīna Moses chose seventy men from his people for Our tryst, and when the earthquake seized them, he said, 'My Lord, had You wished, You would have destroyed them and me before. Will You destroy us because of what the fools amongst us have done? It is only Your test by which You lead astray whomever You wish and…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:155 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْتَارَ مُوسٰی قَوْمَهُ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِمِيقَاتِنَا فَلَمَّا أَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِيَّايَ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَّا إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ wa-ikh'tāra mūsā qawmahu sabʿīna rajulan limīqātinā falammā akhadhathumu l-rajfatu qāla rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa-iyyāya atuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-sufahāu minnā in hiya illā fit'natuka tuḍillu bihā man tashāu watahdī man tashāu anta waliyyunā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-ghāfirīna And Musa chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment.1 And when the earthquake seized them,2 he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me (as well). Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:155 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْتَارَ مُوسٰی قَوْمَهُ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِمِيقَاتِنَا فَلَمَّا أَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِيَّايَ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَّا إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ wa-ikh'tāra mūsā qawmahu sabʿīna rajulan limīqātinā falammā akhadhathumu l-rajfatu qāla rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa-iyyāya atuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-sufahāu minnā in hiya illā fit'natuka tuḍillu bihā man tashāu watahdī man tashāu anta waliyyunā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-ghāfirīna And chose Moses, of his people seventy men for Our appointment, then when seized them a shocking, prayed he: (Moses.) "O' My Lord! Hadst Thou pleased Thou hadst destroyed them and me (too) before; wouldst Thou destroy us for what have done the fools (May refer to the story of 'Samari' or those who wanted to see God…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:156 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِنَّا هُدْنَا إِلَيْكَ قَالَ عَذَابِي أُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-uk'tub lanā fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wafī l-ākhirati innā hud'nā ilayka qāla ʿadhābī uṣību bihi man ashāu waraḥmatī wasiʿat kulla shayin fasa-aktubuhā lilladhīna yattaqūna wayu'tūna l-zakata wa-alladhīna hum biāyātinā yu'minūna And appoint goodness for us in this world and the Hereafter, for indeed we have come back to You.' Said He, 'I visit My punishment on whomever I wish, but My mercy embraces all things.1 Soon I shall appoint it for those who are Godwary and give the zakāt and those who believe in Our signs

item.title: Al-A'raaf:156 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِنَّا هُدْنَا إِلَيْكَ قَالَ عَذَابِي أُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-uk'tub lanā fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wafī l-ākhirati innā hud'nā ilayka qāla ʿadhābī uṣību bihi man ashāu waraḥmatī wasiʿat kulla shayin fasa-aktubuhā lilladhīna yattaqūna wayu'tūna l-zakata wa-alladhīna hum biāyātinā yu'minūna And decree for us in this world (that which is) good and (also) in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." (Allah) said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it (especially) for those who fear Me and give zakāh and those who believe in Our verses. See 7:155

item.title: Al-A'raaf:156 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِنَّا هُدْنَا إِلَيْكَ قَالَ عَذَابِي أُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-uk'tub lanā fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wafī l-ākhirati innā hud'nā ilayka qāla ʿadhābī uṣību bihi man ashāu waraḥmatī wasiʿat kulla shayin fasa-aktubuhā lilladhīna yattaqūna wayu'tūna l-zakata wa-alladhīna hum biāyātinā yu'minūna And ordain Thou for us good in this world and in the hereafter; (for) Verily we turn unto Thee;" Said He (God.) "My chastisement, will I afflict with it, whomsoever I will (He Willeth not but for the wicked.) and My mercy ('Rahmaniyat'. Refer to note on Sura 1.) embraceth unto all things, therefore soon will I ordain it ('Rahimiyat'. Refer to note on Sura 1.) (particularly) for those who guard (against evil) and pay the poor-rate, and those who…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:157 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولَ النَّبِيَّ الْأُمِّيَّ الَّذِي يَجِدُونَهُ مَكْتُوبًا عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَاهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبَائِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إِصْرَهُمْ وَالْأَغْلَالَ الَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِهِ وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا النُّورَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ مَعَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ alladhīna yattabiʿūna l-rasūla l-nabiya l-umiya alladhī yajidūnahu maktūban ʿindahum fī l-tawrāti wal-injīli yamuruhum bil-maʿrūfi wayanhāhum ʿani l-munkari wayuḥillu lahumu l-ṭayibāti wayuḥarrimu ʿalayhimu l-khabāitha wayaḍaʿu ʿanhum iṣ'rahum wal-aghlāla allatī kānat ʿalayhim fa-alladhīna āmanū bihi waʿazzarūhu wanaṣarūhu wa-ittabaʿū l-nūra alladhī unzila maʿahu ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna —those who follow the Apostle, the uninstructed prophet, whose mention they find written with them in the Torah and the Evangel, who bids them to do what is right and forbids them from what is wrong, makes lawful to them all the good things and forbids them from all vicious things, and relieves them…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:157 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولَ النَّبِيَّ الْأُمِّيَّ الَّذِي يَجِدُونَهُ مَكْتُوبًا عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَاهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبَائِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إِصْرَهُمْ وَالْأَغْلَالَ الَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِهِ وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا النُّورَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ مَعَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ alladhīna yattabiʿūna l-rasūla l-nabiya l-umiya alladhī yajidūnahu maktūban ʿindahum fī l-tawrāti wal-injīli yamuruhum bil-maʿrūfi wayanhāhum ʿani l-munkari wayuḥillu lahumu l-ṭayibāti wayuḥarrimu ʿalayhimu l-khabāitha wayaḍaʿu ʿanhum iṣ'rahum wal-aghlāla allatī kānat ʿalayhim fa-alladhīna āmanū bihi waʿazzarūhu wanaṣarūhu wa-ittabaʿū l-nūra alladhī unzila maʿahu ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written (i.e., described) in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and prohibits them from what is wrong and makes lawful for them what is good and forbids them from what is evil and…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:157 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولَ النَّبِيَّ الْأُمِّيَّ الَّذِي يَجِدُونَهُ مَكْتُوبًا عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَاهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبَائِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إِصْرَهُمْ وَالْأَغْلَالَ الَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِهِ وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا النُّورَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ مَعَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ alladhīna yattabiʿūna l-rasūla l-nabiya l-umiya alladhī yajidūnahu maktūban ʿindahum fī l-tawrāti wal-injīli yamuruhum bil-maʿrūfi wayanhāhum ʿani l-munkari wayuḥillu lahumu l-ṭayibāti wayuḥarrimu ʿalayhimu l-khabāitha wayaḍaʿu ʿanhum iṣ'rahum wal-aghlāla allatī kānat ʿalayhim fa-alladhīna āmanū bihi waʿazzarūhu wanaṣarūhu wa-ittabaʿū l-nūra alladhī unzila maʿahu ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Those who follow the Apostle, Prophet the 'Ummi' (The Holy Prophet Muhammad. This word is used in the Holy Qur'an with reference to the apostles of God in general and the Holy Prophet in particular – meaning - that respect and reverence to be paid to them - and to this effect the Holy…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:158 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ الَّذِي يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَكَلِمَاتِهِ وَاتَّبِعُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu innī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum jamīʿan alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi l-nabiyi l-umiyi alladhī yu'minu bil-lahi wakalimātihi wa-ittabiʿūhu laʿallakum tahtadūna Say, 'O mankind! I am the Apostle of Allah to you all, [of Him] to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. There is no god except Him. He gives life and brings death.' So have faith in Allah and His Apostle, the uninstructed prophet, who has faith in Allah and His words, and follow him so that you may be guided.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:158 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ الَّذِي يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَكَلِمَاتِهِ وَاتَّبِعُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu innī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum jamīʿan alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi l-nabiyi l-umiyi alladhī yu'minu bil-lahi wakalimātihi wa-ittabiʿūhu laʿallakum tahtadūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of Allah to you all, (from Him) to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death." So believe in Allah and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in Allah and His words, and follow him that you may be guided. Say: O mankind! Verily, I am sent to you all as the Messenger…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:158 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ الَّذِي يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَكَلِمَاتِهِ وَاتَّبِعُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu innī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum jamīʿan alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi l-nabiyi l-umiyi alladhī yu'minu bil-lahi wakalimātihi wa-ittabiʿūhu laʿallakum tahtadūna Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "O' ye people, Verily I am the apostle of God unto you all, of Him unto Whom belongeth the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; No god is there but He. He giveth life and causeth death, so believe ye in God and His Apostle, Prophet (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) , the 'Ummi' who believeth in God and His Words, (Both of Creation and the Legislature.) So ye follow him that ye…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:159 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ قَوْمِ مُوسٰی أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ wamin qawmi mūsā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūna Among the people of Moses is a nation who guide [the people] by the truth and do justice thereby.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:159 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ قَوْمِ مُوسٰی أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ wamin qawmi mūsā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūna And among the people of Musa is a community1 which guides by truth and by it establishes justice. And of the people of Musa there is a community who lead (the men) with truth and establish justice therewith (7:159). Allah stated that of the Children of Israel there are some who follow the truth and judge by it, just as He said in another Ayah: مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ أُمَّةٌ قَائِمَةٌ يَتْلُونَ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ A party of the people of the Scripture stand for the right, they recite the verses of Allah during the hours of the night, prostrating themselves in prayer (3:113) وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:159 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ قَوْمِ مُوسٰی أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ wamin qawmi mūsā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūna And of Moses' people is a party who guide (people) with the Truth and thereby do justice. See 7:158

item.title: Al-A'raaf:160 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمُ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أَسْبَاطًا أُمَمًا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی إِذِ اسْتَسْقَاهُ قَوْمُهُ أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ فَانْبَجَسَتْ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَشْرَبَهُمْ وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْغَمَامَ وَأَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَى كُلُوْۤا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ waqaṭṭaʿnāhumu ith'natay ʿashrata asbāṭan umaman wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā idhi is'tasqāhu qawmuhu ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-ḥajara fa-inbajasat min'hu ith'natā ʿashrata ʿaynan qad ʿalima kullu unāsin mashrabahum waẓallalnā ʿalayhimu l-ghamāma wa-anzalnā ʿalayhimu l-mana wal-salwā kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum wamā ẓalamūnā walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna We split them up into twelve tribal communities, and We revealed to Moses, when his people asked him for water, [saying], 'Strike the rock with your staff,' whereat twelve fountains gushed forth from it. Every tribe came to know its drinking-place. And We shaded them with clouds, and We sent down to them manna…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:160 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمُ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أَسْبَاطًا أُمَمًا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی إِذِ اسْتَسْقَاهُ قَوْمُهُ أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ فَانْبَجَسَتْ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَشْرَبَهُمْ وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْغَمَامَ وَأَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَى كُلُوْۤا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ waqaṭṭaʿnāhumu ith'natay ʿashrata asbāṭan umaman wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā idhi is'tasqāhu qawmuhu ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-ḥajara fa-inbajasat min'hu ith'natā ʿashrata ʿaynan qad ʿalima kullu unāsin mashrabahum waẓallalnā ʿalayhimu l-ghamāma wa-anzalnā ʿalayhimu l-mana wal-salwā kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum wamā ẓalamūnā walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes1 (as distinct) nations. And We inspired to Musa when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people (i.e., tribe) knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:160 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمُ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أَسْبَاطًا أُمَمًا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی إِذِ اسْتَسْقَاهُ قَوْمُهُ أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ فَانْبَجَسَتْ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَشْرَبَهُمْ وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْغَمَامَ وَأَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَى كُلُوْۤا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ waqaṭṭaʿnāhumu ith'natay ʿashrata asbāṭan umaman wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā idhi is'tasqāhu qawmuhu ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-ḥajara fa-inbajasat min'hu ith'natā ʿashrata ʿaynan qad ʿalima kullu unāsin mashrabahum waẓallalnā ʿalayhimu l-ghamāma wa-anzalnā ʿalayhimu l-mana wal-salwā kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum wamā ẓalamūnā walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna And We divided them into twelve tribes (or) nations; and revealed We unto Moses, when asked him, his people for water: "Strike thou, with thy rod, the rock:" so gushed (As a miracle. Refer to verse 2:60.) forth out of it twelve springs; each tribe knew its drinking place; and We caused the clouds…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:161 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْكُنُوْۤا هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ وَكُلُوْۤا مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا حِطَّةٌ وَادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطِيءَاتِكُمْ سَنَزِيدُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-idh qīla lahumu us'kunū hādhihi l-qaryata wakulū min'hā ḥaythu shi'tum waqūlū ḥiṭṭatun wa-ud'khulū l-bāba sujjadan naghfir lakum khaṭīātikum sanazīdu l-muḥ'sinīna And when they were told, 'Settle in this town and eat thereof whence you wish; and say, "Relieve [us of the burden of our sins]," and enter prostrating at the gate, that We may forgive your iniquities, and soon We shall enhance the virtuous.'1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:161 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْكُنُوْۤا هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ وَكُلُوْۤا مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا حِطَّةٌ وَادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطِيءَاتِكُمْ سَنَزِيدُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-idh qīla lahumu us'kunū hādhihi l-qaryata wakulū min'hā ḥaythu shi'tum waqūlū ḥiṭṭatun wa-ud'khulū l-bāba sujjadan naghfir lakum khaṭīātikum sanazīdu l-muḥ'sinīna And (mention, O Muḥammad), when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city (i.e., Jerusalem) and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens (i.e., sins),' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will (then) forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good (in goodness and reward)." See 7:160

item.title: Al-A'raaf:161 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْكُنُوْۤا هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ وَكُلُوْۤا مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا حِطَّةٌ وَادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطِيءَاتِكُمْ سَنَزِيدُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-idh qīla lahumu us'kunū hādhihi l-qaryata wakulū min'hā ḥaythu shi'tum waqūlū ḥiṭṭatun wa-ud'khulū l-bāba sujjadan naghfir lakum khaṭīātikum sanazīdu l-muḥ'sinīna And when it was said unto them; "Dwell ye in this town and eat ye thereof as ye wish", and say: "Put down from us our burden (of sins)''' and enter ye the gates making obeisance, We will forgive you, your faults; Soon will We give more to the doers of good to others." See 7:160

item.title: Al-A'raaf:162 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
