item.description: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَظْلِمُونَ fabaddala alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum qawlan ghayra alladhī qīla lahum fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yaẓlimūna But the wrongdoers changed the saying with other than what they had been told. So We sent against them a plague from the sky because of the wrongs they used to commit.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:162 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَظْلِمُونَ fabaddala alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum qawlan ghayra alladhī qīla lahum fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yaẓlimūna But those who wronged among them changed (the words) to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing. See 7:160

item.title: Al-A'raaf:162 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَظْلِمُونَ fabaddala alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum qawlan ghayra alladhī qīla lahum fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yaẓlimūna But changed those who did injustice among them a word other than that which was spoken unto them, so We did send upon them a pestilence from heaven for they had been doing injustice. See 7:160

item.title: Al-A'raaf:163 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ الْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِي السَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ wasalhum ʿani l-qaryati allatī kānat ḥāḍirata l-baḥri idh yaʿdūna fī l-sabti idh tatīhim ḥītānuhum yawma sabtihim shurraʿan wayawma lā yasbitūna lā tatīhim kadhālika nablūhum bimā kānū yafsuqūna Ask them1 about the town that was situated on the seaside, when they violated the Sabbath, when their fish would come to them on the Sabbath day, visibly on the shore, but on days when they were not keeping Sabbath they would not come to them. Thus did We test them because of the transgressions they used to commit.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:163 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ الْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِي السَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ wasalhum ʿani l-qaryati allatī kānat ḥāḍirata l-baḥri idh yaʿdūna fī l-sabti idh tatīhim ḥītānuhum yawma sabtihim shurraʿan wayawma lā yasbitūna lā tatīhim kadhālika nablūhum bimā kānū yafsuqūna And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in (the matter of) the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. And ask them about the town that was by the sea; when they transgressed in the matter of the Sabbath: when their fish came to them openly on the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:163 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ الْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِي السَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ wasalhum ʿani l-qaryati allatī kānat ḥāḍirata l-baḥri idh yaʿdūna fī l-sabti idh tatīhim ḥītānuhum yawma sabtihim shurraʿan wayawma lā yasbitūna lā tatīhim kadhālika nablūhum bimā kānū yafsuqūna And (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) ask them about the town which was beside the sea; when they did exceed (the limits) in the Sabbath when their fish did come unto them on the day of their Sabbath, appearing on the surface of the water; and on the day they observed not the Sabbath, they (the fish) did not come unto them; Thus did We try them for they were transgressing. The prohibition of fishing on the Sabath night has been based on economical consideration to give…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:164 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا اللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا قَالُوْا مَعْذِرَةً إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wa-idh qālat ummatun min'hum lima taʿiẓūna qawman l-lahu muh'likuhum aw muʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan qālū maʿdhiratan ilā rabbikum walaʿallahum yattaqūna When a group of them said, 'Why do you advise a people whom Allah will destroy or punish with a severe punishment?' They said, 'As an excuse before your Lord, and [with the hope] that they may be Godwary.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:164 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا اللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا قَالُوْا مَعْذِرَةً إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wa-idh qālat ummatun min'hum lima taʿiẓūna qawman l-lahu muh'likuhum aw muʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan qālū maʿdhiratan ilā rabbikum walaʿallahum yattaqūna And when a community among them said, "Why do you advise (or warn) a people whom Allah is (about) to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they (the advisors) said, "To be absolved before your Lord and perhaps they may fear Him." And when a community among them said: "Why do you preach to a people whom Allah is about to destroy or to punish with a severe torment?" (The preachers) said: "In order to be free from guilt before your Lord (Allah), and perhaps they may fear Allah (7:164). So when they forgot the reminder that had been given…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:164 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا اللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا قَالُوْا مَعْذِرَةً إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ wa-idh qālat ummatun min'hum lima taʿiẓūna qawman l-lahu muh'likuhum aw muʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan qālū maʿdhiratan ilā rabbikum walaʿallahum yattaqūna And when a party of them said: "Why admonish ye a people whom God would destroy or whom He would chastise with a severe chastisement?" said they "To be free from blame before your Lord, perchance they may guard (themselves against evil)." (Become pious.) See 7:163

item.title: Al-A'raaf:165 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْۤا مَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ أَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوءِ وَأَخَذْنَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا بِعَذَابٍ بَئِيسٍ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi anjaynā alladhīna yanhawna ʿani l-sūi wa-akhadhnā alladhīna ẓalamū biʿadhābin baīsin bimā kānū yafsuqūna So when they forgot what they had been reminded of We delivered those who forbade evil [conduct] and seized the wrongdoers with a terrible punishment because of the transgressions they used to commit.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:165 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْۤا مَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ أَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوءِ وَأَخَذْنَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا بِعَذَابٍ بَئِيسٍ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi anjaynā alladhīna yanhawna ʿani l-sūi wa-akhadhnā alladhīna ẓalamū biʿadhābin baīsin bimā kānū yafsuqūna And when they (i.e., those advised) forgot that by which they had been reminded, We saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying. See 7:164

item.title: Al-A'raaf:165 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْۤا مَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ أَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوءِ وَأَخَذْنَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا بِعَذَابٍ بَئِيسٍ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْسُقُونَ falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi anjaynā alladhīna yanhawna ʿani l-sūi wa-akhadhnā alladhīna ẓalamū biʿadhābin baīsin bimā kānū yafsuqūna So when they did forget what they were warned with, We delivered those who forbade evil and seized those who were unjust with a dreadful chastisement because they were transgressing. (This Commands those who favour 'Amr bi 'l-Ma'ruf' and 'Nahy 'an il-Munkar'.) See 7:163

item.title: Al-A'raaf:166 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا عَنْ مَا نُهُوْۤا عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوْۤا قِرَدَةً خَاسِئِينَ falammā ʿataw ʿan mā nuhū ʿanhu qul'nā lahum kūnū qiradatan khāsiīna When they defied [the command pertaining to] what they were forbidden from, We said to them, 'Be you spurned apes.'1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:166 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا عَنْ مَا نُهُوْۤا عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوْۤا قِرَدَةً خَاسِئِينَ falammā ʿataw ʿan mā nuhū ʿanhu qul'nā lahum kūnū qiradatan khāsiīna So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised." See 7:164

item.title: Al-A'raaf:166 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا عَنْ مَا نُهُوْۤا عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوْۤا قِرَدَةً خَاسِئِينَ falammā ʿataw ʿan mā nuhū ʿanhu qul'nā lahum kūnū qiradatan khāsiīna So when they proudly (Revoltingly. Refer to verses 2:65, 5:60.) defied what they had been forbidden, We said unto them; "Be ye apes despised, spurned (away from the human society)." See 7:163

item.title: Al-A'raaf:167 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ يَسُومُهُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-idh ta-adhana rabbuka layabʿathanna ʿalayhim ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati man yasūmuhum sūa l-ʿadhābi inna rabbaka lasarīʿu l-ʿiqābi wa-innahu laghafūrun raḥīmun And when your Lord proclaimed that He would surely send against them,1 until the Day of Resurrection, those who would inflict on them a terrible punishment. Indeed your Lord is swift in retribution, and indeed He is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:167 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ يَسُومُهُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-idh ta-adhana rabbuka layabʿathanna ʿalayhim ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati man yasūmuhum sūa l-ʿadhābi inna rabbaka lasarīʿu l-ʿiqābi wa-innahu laghafūrun raḥīmun And (mention) when your Lord declared that He would surely (continue to) send upon them until the Day of Resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful. And (remember) when your Lord declared that He would certainly keep on sending against them, till the Day of Resurrection, those who would afflict them with a humiliating torment. Verily, your Lord is quick in retribution and certainly He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (7:167). Eternal Humiliation Placed on the Jews تَأَذَّنَ Ta'dhdhana means 'declared', according to Mujahid, or 'ordained',…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:167 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ يَسُومُهُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-idh ta-adhana rabbuka layabʿathanna ʿalayhim ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati man yasūmuhum sūa l-ʿadhābi inna rabbaka lasarīʿu l-ʿiqābi wa-innahu laghafūrun raḥīmun And (recollect O' Our Apostle!) when declared thy Lord that He would surely send against them (The Jews.) until the day of resurrection those who would afflict them with a grievous torment; Verily thy Lord is certainly quick to requite (evil) and Verily He is the Oft-Forgiving and the Most Merciful. See 7:163

item.title: Al-A'raaf:168 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أُمَمًا مِنْهُمُ الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنْهُمْ دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَبَلَوْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ waqaṭṭaʿnāhum fī l-arḍi umaman min'humu l-ṣāliḥūna wamin'hum dūna dhālika wabalawnāhum bil-ḥasanāti wal-sayiāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna We dispersed them into communities around the earth: some of them were righteous, and some of them otherwise, and We tested them with good and bad [times] so that they may come back.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:168 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أُمَمًا مِنْهُمُ الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنْهُمْ دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَبَلَوْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ waqaṭṭaʿnāhum fī l-arḍi umaman min'humu l-ṣāliḥūna wamin'hum dūna dhālika wabalawnāhum bil-ḥasanāti wal-sayiāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good (times) and bad that perhaps they would return (to obedience). And We have broken them (the Jews) up into various separate groups on the earth: some of them are righteous and some are away from that. And We tried them with good (blessings) and evil (calamities) in order that they might turn (to Allah) (7:168). Then after them succeeded an (evil) generation, which inherited the Book, but they chose (for themselves) the goods of this low life saying: "(Everything) will be forgiven to us." And if…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:168 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أُمَمًا مِنْهُمُ الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنْهُمْ دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَبَلَوْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ waqaṭṭaʿnāhum fī l-arḍi umaman min'humu l-ṣāliḥūna wamin'hum dūna dhālika wabalawnāhum bil-ḥasanāti wal-sayiāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And We did cut (scattered) them in the earth into (different) peoples; of them (some) are righteous, and of them (some) are otherwise, and We did try them with good (The blessings) and (also with) evil (Misfortunes.) that they might return (to the Right path). See 7:163

item.title: Al-A'raaf:169 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَرِثُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ يَأْخُذُونَ عَرَضَ هَذَا الْأَدْنَى وَيَقُولُونَ سَيُغْفَرُ لَنَا وَإِنْ يَأْتِهِمْ عَرَضٌ مِثْلُهُ يَأْخُذُوهُ أَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِيثَاقُ الْكِتَابِ أَنْ لَا يَقُولُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ وَدَرَسُوْۤا مَا فِیْهِ وَالدَّارُ الْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun warithū l-kitāba yakhudhūna ʿaraḍa hādhā l-adnā wayaqūlūna sayugh'faru lanā wa-in yatihim ʿaraḍun mith'luhu yakhudhūhu alam yu'khadh ʿalayhim mīthāqu l-kitābi an lā yaqūlū ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa wadarasū mā fīhi wal-dāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūna Then they were succeeded by an evil posterity which inherited the Book: they grab the transitory gains of this lower world,1 and say, 'It will be forgiven us.' And if similar transitory gains were to come their way, they would grab them too. Was not the covenant of the Book taken with them that they shall not attribute anything to…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:169 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَرِثُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ يَأْخُذُونَ عَرَضَ هَذَا الْأَدْنَى وَيَقُولُونَ سَيُغْفَرُ لَنَا وَإِنْ يَأْتِهِمْ عَرَضٌ مِثْلُهُ يَأْخُذُوهُ أَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِيثَاقُ الْكِتَابِ أَنْ لَا يَقُولُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ وَدَرَسُوْۤا مَا فِیْهِ وَالدَّارُ الْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun warithū l-kitāba yakhudhūna ʿaraḍa hādhā l-adnā wayaqūlūna sayugh'faru lanā wa-in yatihim ʿaraḍun mith'luhu yakhudhūhu alam yu'khadh ʿalayhim mīthāqu l-kitābi an lā yaqūlū ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa wadarasū mā fīhi wal-dāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūna And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture (while) taking the commodities1 of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it2 comes to them, they will (again) take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture (i.e., the Torah) taken from them that they would not say about Allah except…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:169 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَرِثُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ يَأْخُذُونَ عَرَضَ هَذَا الْأَدْنَى وَيَقُولُونَ سَيُغْفَرُ لَنَا وَإِنْ يَأْتِهِمْ عَرَضٌ مِثْلُهُ يَأْخُذُوهُ أَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِيثَاقُ الْكِتَابِ أَنْ لَا يَقُولُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ وَدَرَسُوْۤا مَا فِیْهِ وَالدَّارُ الْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun warithū l-kitāba yakhudhūna ʿaraḍa hādhā l-adnā wayaqūlūna sayugh'faru lanā wa-in yatihim ʿaraḍun mith'luhu yakhudhūhu alam yu'khadh ʿalayhim mīthāqu l-kitābi an lā yaqūlū ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa wadarasū mā fīhi wal-dāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūna Then succeeded after them (an evil) posterity who inherited the Book, taking the goods (Vanities.) of this low life saying: "It will be forgiven us;" And if come unto them the like goods they would seize it (too); Was not a covenant of the Book (of Law) taken from them that they would speak not about God save the truth,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:170 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِالْكِتَابِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ wa-alladhīna yumassikūna bil-kitābi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra l-muṣ'liḥīna As for those who hold fast to the Book and maintain the prayer —indeed We do not waste the reward of those who bring about reform.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:170 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِالْكِتَابِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ wa-alladhīna yumassikūna bil-kitābi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra l-muṣ'liḥīna But those who hold fast to the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers. See 7:168

item.title: Al-A'raaf:170 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِالْكِتَابِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ wa-alladhīna yumassikūna bil-kitābi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra l-muṣ'liḥīna And those who hold fast by the Book (As the Holy Prophet left it with the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt.) and establish prayer; verily We waste not the recompense of those who amend (Also, the doers of good.) (themselves). 'Holding fast the Book', i.e., following faithfully and closely the Holy Qur'an. If one only sticks faithfully to the guidance of the Qur'an, there can never be any going astray in any matter, be that secular or religious. There is in the Holy Qur'an the promise of guiding aright everyone who strives in God's way.1 Even if the meaning of 'Kitab', i.e., Book, be taken in an indefinite sense the purpose is not less served. By sticking to any of the ancient…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:171 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ خُذُوْۤا مَا ءَاتَيْنَاكُمْ بِقُوَّةٍ وَاذْكُرُوا مَا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ wa-idh nataqnā l-jabala fawqahum ka-annahu ẓullatun waẓannū annahu wāqiʿun bihim khudhū mā ātaynākum biquwwatin wa-udh'kurū mā fīhi laʿallakum tattaqūna When We plucked the mountain [and held it]above them as if it were a canopy (and they thought it was about to fall on them): 'Hold on with power to what We have given you and remember that which is in it, so that you may be Godwary.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:171 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ خُذُوْۤا مَا ءَاتَيْنَاكُمْ بِقُوَّةٍ وَاذْكُرُوا مَا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ wa-idh nataqnā l-jabala fawqahum ka-annahu ẓullatun waẓannū annahu wāqiʿun bihim khudhū mā ātaynākum biquwwatin wa-udh'kurū mā fīhi laʿallakum tattaqūna And (mention) when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud and they were certain that it would fall upon them,1 (and Allah said), "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that you might fear Allah." And (remember) when We Nataqna the mountain over them as if it had been a canopy, and they thought that it was going to fall on them. (We said): Hold firmly to what We have given you (the Tawrah), and remember that which is therein (act on its commandments), so that you may fear…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:171 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ خُذُوْۤا مَا ءَاتَيْنَاكُمْ بِقُوَّةٍ وَاذْكُرُوا مَا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ wa-idh nataqnā l-jabala fawqahum ka-annahu ẓullatun waẓannū annahu wāqiʿun bihim khudhū mā ātaynākum biquwwatin wa-udh'kurū mā fīhi laʿallakum tattaqūna And when We shook the Mountain over them as if it were a covering, and thought they that it was going to fall down upon them; (Said We) "Hold ye firmly what We give you and be mindful of what is (there) in it, that ye may guard (yourself against evil)." Verse 2:63 gives the details of the event. It is clearly stated by the wording of the verses themselves that the Almighty God, made the mountain hang in the air over the heads of the people. The word 'Fawq' mentioned in both the verses, clearly speaks of the mountain having been…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:172 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَنِي اٰدَمَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَى شَهِدْنَا أَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّا كُنَّا عَنْ هَذَا غَافِلِينَ wa-idh akhadha rabbuka min banī ādama min ẓuhūrihim dhurriyyatahum wa-ashhadahum ʿalā anfusihim alastu birabbikum qālū balā shahid'nā an taqūlū yawma l-qiyāmati innā kunnā ʿan hādhā ghāfilīna When your Lord took from the Children of Adam, from their loins, their descendants and made them bear witness over themselves, [He said to them,] 'Am I not your Lord?' They said, 'Yes indeed! We bear witness.' [This,] lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, 'Indeed we were unaware of this,'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:172 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَنِي اٰدَمَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَى شَهِدْنَا أَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّا كُنَّا عَنْ هَذَا غَافِلِينَ wa-idh akhadha rabbuka min banī ādama min ẓuhūrihim dhurriyyatahum wa-ashhadahum ʿalā anfusihim alastu birabbikum qālū balā shahid'nā an taqūlū yawma l-qiyāmati innā kunnā ʿan hādhā ghāfilīna And (mention) when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, (saying to them), "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." (This) - lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware." And (remember) when your Lord brought forth from the Children of Adam, from their loins, their seed and made them testify as to themselves (saying): "Am I not your Lord?" They said: "Yes!…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:172 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَنِي اٰدَمَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَى شَهِدْنَا أَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّا كُنَّا عَنْ هَذَا غَافِلِينَ wa-idh akhadha rabbuka min banī ādama min ẓuhūrihim dhurriyyatahum wa-ashhadahum ʿalā anfusihim alastu birabbikum qālū balā shahid'nā an taqūlū yawma l-qiyāmati innā kunnā ʿan hādhā ghāfilīna When brought forth thy Lord from the children of Adam, from their backs, their descendants and (when) made them bear witness upon their own selves (saying): "Am I not your Lord?" replied they "Yea! We do bear witness." (This We did) lest ye should say on the Day of Judgment "Verily we were of this (fact) unaware." It is reported that God the Lord Creator, and the Omnipotent, Master of the Universe, creating Adam in the earthly form, questioned the soul of Adam and of every one of…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:173 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولُوْۤا إِنَّمَا أَشْرَكَ ءَابَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ أَفَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ aw taqūlū innamā ashraka ābāunā min qablu wakunnā dhurriyyatan min baʿdihim afatuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-mub'ṭilūna or lest you should say, 'Our fathers ascribed partners [to Allah] before [us] and we were descendants after them. Will You then destroy us because of what the falsifiers have done?'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:173 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولُوْۤا إِنَّمَا أَشْرَكَ ءَابَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ أَفَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ aw taqūlū innamā ashraka ābāunā min qablu wakunnā dhurriyyatan min baʿdihim afatuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-mub'ṭilūna Or (lest) you say, "It was only that our fathers associated (others in worship) with Allah before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?" See 7:172

item.title: Al-A'raaf:173 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولُوْۤا إِنَّمَا أَشْرَكَ ءَابَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ أَفَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ aw taqūlū innamā ashraka ābāunā min qablu wakunnā dhurriyyatan min baʿdihim afatuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-mub'ṭilūna Or lest ye should say: "Verily associated (Practiced polytheism.) (with God) only our fathers (Fathers & fore-fathers.) from before (us) and we are their descendants after them (following them): wilt Thou then destroy us for what the vain doers did?" See 7:172

item.title: Al-A'raaf:174 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walaʿallahum yarjiʿūna Thus do We elaborate the signs, so that they may come back.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:174 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walaʿallahum yarjiʿūna And thus do We (explain in) detail the verses, and perhaps they will return.1 See 7:172

item.title: Al-A'raaf:174 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walaʿallahum yarjiʿūna And thus do We explain the signs in details and that ye might return (from the error). See 7:172

item.title: Al-A'raaf:175 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ الَّذِي اٰتَیْنٰهُ ءَايَاتِنَا فَانْسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَأَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a alladhī ātaynāhu āyātinā fa-insalakha min'hā fa-atbaʿahu l-shayṭānu fakāna mina l-ghāwīna Relate to them an account of him to whom We gave Our signs, but he cast them off. Thereupon Satan pursued him, and he became one of the perverse.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:175 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ الَّذِي اٰتَیْنٰهُ ءَايَاتِنَا فَانْسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَأَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a alladhī ātaynāhu āyātinā fa-insalakha min'hā fa-atbaʿahu l-shayṭānu fakāna mina l-ghāwīna And recite to them, (O Muḥammad), the news of him1 to whom We gave (knowledge of) Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators.2 And recite to them the story of him to whom We gave Our Ayat, but he threw them away; so Shaytan followed him up, and he became of those who went astray (7:175). And had We willed, We would surely have elevated him therewith, but he clung to the earth and followed his own vain desires. So his parable is the parable of a dog: if you drive him away, he pants, or if you leave him alone, he (still)…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:175 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ الَّذِي اٰتَیْنٰهُ ءَايَاتِنَا فَانْسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَأَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a alladhī ātaynāhu āyātinā fa-insalakha min'hā fa-atbaʿahu l-shayṭānu fakāna mina l-ghāwīna Relate unto them the news of him whom We gave Our signs, but he (See note to verse 7:175.) withdrew (himself) from them, so Satan followed (Joined.) him; so he was one of those who went astray. The news referred to in this verse, is about the man of the time of Pharaoh who knew the 'Ism al-Adham' or the Greatest Name of God, through which anything and everything sought for is immediately granted by God and it is a very closed secret. A man of the time Pharaoh called Balam Ba'ur knew it and Pharaoh desired the man to pray that Moses might fall into his clutches. The man agreed and got over…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:176 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَاهُ بِهَا وَلَكِنَّهُ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ إِنْ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَثْ ذٰلِكَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَاقْصُصِ الْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ walaw shi'nā larafaʿnāhu bihā walākinnahu akhlada ilā l-arḍi wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu famathaluhu kamathali l-kalbi in taḥmil ʿalayhi yalhath aw tatruk'hu yalhath dhālika mathalu l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-uq'ṣuṣi l-qaṣaṣa laʿallahum yatafakkarūna Had We wished, We would have surely raised him by their means, but he clung to the earth and followed his [base] desires. So his parable is that of a dog: if you make for it, it lolls out its tongue, and if you let it alone, it lolls out its tongue. Such is the parable of the people who deny Our signs. So recount these narratives, so that they may reflect.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:176 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَاهُ بِهَا وَلَكِنَّهُ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ إِنْ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَثْ ذٰلِكَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَاقْصُصِ الْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ walaw shi'nā larafaʿnāhu bihā walākinnahu akhlada ilā l-arḍi wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu famathaluhu kamathali l-kalbi in taḥmil ʿalayhi yalhath aw tatruk'hu yalhath dhālika mathalu l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-uq'ṣuṣi l-qaṣaṣa laʿallahum yatafakkarūna And if We had willed, We could have elevated him thereby,1 but he adhered (instead) to the earth2 and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he (still) pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs.3 So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought. See 7:175

item.title: Al-A'raaf:176 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَاهُ بِهَا وَلَكِنَّهُ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ إِنْ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَثْ ذٰلِكَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَاقْصُصِ الْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ walaw shi'nā larafaʿnāhu bihā walākinnahu akhlada ilā l-arḍi wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu famathaluhu kamathali l-kalbi in taḥmil ʿalayhi yalhath aw tatruk'hu yalhath dhālika mathalu l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-uq'ṣuṣi l-qaṣaṣa laʿallahum yatafakkarūna And had We willed, We would certainly have exalted him thereby (With the Signs.) , but he inclined (Clung to the material world - unmindful of refining the self-neglecting God and godliness -having no regard for religion or religiousness in life.) towards the earth and followed his vain inclinations, so his similitude is like the parable of a dog, if thou attacketh him he lolleth out his tongue, or leaveth him alone he lolleth out his tongue; such is the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:177 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَاءَ مَثَلًا الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَأَنْفُسَهُمْ كَانُوْۤا يَظْلِمُونَ sāa mathalan l-qawmu alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-anfusahum kānū yaẓlimūna Evil is the parable of the people who deny Our signs and wrong themselves.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:177 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَاءَ مَثَلًا الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَأَنْفُسَهُمْ كَانُوْۤا يَظْلِمُونَ sāa mathalan l-qawmu alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-anfusahum kānū yaẓlimūna How evil an example (is that of) the people who denied Our signs and used to wrong themselves. See 7:175

item.title: Al-A'raaf:177 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَاءَ مَثَلًا الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَأَنْفُسَهُمْ كَانُوْۤا يَظْلِمُونَ sāa mathalan l-qawmu alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-anfusahum kānū yaẓlimūna How evil is the similitude of the people who belie Our signs and unto their own selves they are unjust. (Doing wrong.) See 7:176

item.title: Al-A'raaf:178 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِي وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ man yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadī waman yuḍ'lil fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūna Whomever Allah guides is rightly guided, and whomever He leads astray —it is they who are the losers.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:178 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِي وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ man yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadī waman yuḍ'lil fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūna Whoever Allah guides - he is the (rightly) guided; and whoever He sends astray1 - it is those who are the losers. Whomsoever Allah guides, he is the guided one, and whomsoever He sends astray, – then those! They are the losers (7:178). Allah says, whomever He leads aright, then none can lead him to misguidance, and whomever He leads astray, will have acquired failure, loss and sure misguidance. Verily, whatever Allah wills occurs; and whatever He does not will, does not occur. A Hadith narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud reads: إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ للهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَهْدِيهِ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا، مَنْ يَهْدِ اللهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:178 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِي وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ man yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadī waman yuḍ'lil fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūna Whomsoever God doth guide He is the one who is guided aright, and whomsoever He suffereth to stray, these are they the losers. See 7:176

item.title: Al-A'raaf:179 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ walaqad dharanā lijahannama kathīran mina l-jini wal-insi lahum qulūbun lā yafqahūna bihā walahum aʿyunun lā yub'ṣirūna bihā walahum ādhānun lā yasmaʿūna bihā ulāika kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu ulāika humu l-ghāfilūna Certainly We have created for hell many of the jinn and humans: they have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, they have ears with which they do not hear. They are like cattle; rather they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless.1

item.title: Al-A'raaf:179 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ walaqad dharanā lijahannama kathīran mina l-jini wal-insi lahum qulūbun lā yafqahūna bihā walahum aʿyunun lā yub'ṣirūna bihā walahum ādhānun lā yasmaʿūna bihā ulāika kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu ulāika humu l-ghāfilūna And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray.1 It is they who are the heedless. And surely, We have created many of the Jinn and mankind for Hell. They have hearts wherewith they understand not, and they have…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:179 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ walaqad dharanā lijahannama kathīran mina l-jini wal-insi lahum qulūbun lā yafqahūna bihā walahum aʿyunun lā yub'ṣirūna bihā walahum ādhānun lā yasmaʿūna bihā ulāika kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu ulāika humu l-ghāfilūna Indeed We have created (The justification for the allotment of Hell is the misuse or the neglect of the faculties and the consequent deterioration to the animal state.) for hell many of the jinn and the men; They have hearts (but) they understand not with it; and they have eyes (but) they see not with it; and they have ears (but) they hear not with it; they are like cattle, nay, more astray; These are they the heedless ones. The…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:180 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا وَذَرُوْۤا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمَائِهِ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ walillahi l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā fa-id'ʿūhu bihā wadharū alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī asmāihi sayuj'zawna mā kānū yaʿmalūna To Allah belong the Best Names, so supplicate Him by them, and abandon those who commit sacrilege in His names. Soon they shall be requited for what they used to do.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:180 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا وَذَرُوْۤا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمَائِهِ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ walillahi l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā fa-id'ʿūhu bihā wadharū alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī asmāihi sayuj'zawna mā kānū yaʿmalūna And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave (the company of) those who practice deviation concerning His names.1 They will be recompensed for what they have been doing. And (all) the Most Beautiful Names belong to Allah, so call on Him by them, and leave the company of those who belie His Names. They will be requited for what they used to do (7:180). Allah's Most Beautiful Names Abu Hurayrah narrated that the Messenger of Allah SAW said: إِنَّ للهِ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ اسْمًا مِائَةً إِلَّا وَاحِدًا، مَنْ أَحْصَاهَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَهُوَ وِتْرٌ يُحِبُّ الْوِتْرَ Verily, Allah has ninety-nine Names, a hundred less one; whoever counts (and…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:180 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا وَذَرُوْۤا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمَائِهِ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ walillahi l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā fa-id'ʿūhu bihā wadharū alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī asmāihi sayuj'zawna mā kānū yaʿmalūna And to God (alone) belong (all) the most beautiful names, so call on Him thereby, and leave alone those who use profanity (Vain use of or playing with.) in His names; soon shall they be recompensed for what they were doing. Excellent Names of God are these which indicate the various aspects of God's Excellence. People are commanded to have such names of God's Excellence in view and call Him, i.e., whenever addressing Him, use only such names of His Excellence and not use the improvised names to attribute Him with anything not allowed by Him viz., calling God as the Father of Jesus, etc. Violating the sanctity of the holy names…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:181 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ wamimman khalaqnā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūna Among those We have created are a nation who guide by the truth and do justice thereby.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:181 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ wamimman khalaqnā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūna And among those We created is a community1 which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice. And of those whom We have created, there is a community who guides (others) with the truth, and establishes justice therewith.) Allah sai (7:181). وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا And of those whom We have created Which is in reference to some nations: أُمَّةٌ a community Which is that stands in truth, in words and action: يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ who guides (others) with the truth They proclaim it and call to it: وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ and establishes justice therewith Adhere to it themselves and judge by it. It was reported that this Ayah refers to the Ummah of Muhammad SAW. In the Two Sahihs, it is recorded that Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan said that the…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:181 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ wamimman khalaqnā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūna And of those whom We did create are a people (Refer to verse 7:159. A distinguished group - these can be no others save those whom God Himself purified.) who guide (others) with truth and themselves justly adhere to it. 'Ayashi' on the authority of the fifth Holy Imam Baqir Ibn Muhammad reports that the Holy Imam said that by the Ummat (People) mentioned in this verse are meant the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt. This statement fully suits the holy personalities for the godly quality of perfect justice could be found only in the Holy Prophet and his divinely purified Ahl Al-Bayt whose purity has been vouchsafed by the 'Ayat at-Tathir' in the Holy Qur'an.1 This clearly indicates that after the creation of man there had been…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:182 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna As for those who deny Our signs, We will draw them imperceptibly [into ruin], whence they do not know.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:182 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them (to destruction)1 from where they do not know. Those who reject Our Ayat, We shall gradually seize them with punishment in ways they perceive not (7:182). And I respite them; certainly My plan is strong.) Allah sai (7:183). وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ Those who reject Our Ayat, We shall gradually seize them in ways they perceive not Meaning: the doors of provisions will be opened for them and also the means of livelihood, in this life. They will be deceived by all this and think that they are on the correct path. Allah said in another instance: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَابَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:182 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna And those who belie Our signs, (One of the most prominent Signs of God is what is referred to in the previous verse 7:181.) soon shall We gradually draw them to ruin from whence they know not. See 7:181

item.title: Al-A'raaf:183 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnun And I will grant them respite, for My devising is indeed sure.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:183 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnun And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm. See 7:182

item.title: Al-A'raaf:183 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnun And I grant them; (Those who belie the signs.) respite. Verily My scheme is (unfailingly) strong. (Effective.) See 7:181

item.title: Al-A'raaf:184 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا مَا بِصَاحِبِهِمْ مِنْ جِنَّةٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ awalam yatafakkarū mā biṣāḥibihim min jinnatin in huwa illā nadhīrun mubīnun Have they not reflected that there is no madness in their companion,1 [and that] he is just a manifest warner?

item.title: Al-A'raaf:184 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا مَا بِصَاحِبِهِمْ مِنْ جِنَّةٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ awalam yatafakkarū mā biṣāḥibihim min jinnatin in huwa illā nadhīrun mubīnun Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion (i.e., Muḥammad SAW) no madness. He is not but a clear warner. Do they not reflect? There is no madness in their companion. He is but a plain warner.) Allah sai (7:184). أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا Do they not reflect? 'those who deny Our Ayat,' مَا بِصَاحِبِهِم there is not in their companion Who is Muhammad SAW: مِّن جِنَّةٍ madness Muhammad is not mad, rather, he is truly the Messenger of Allah, calling to Truth: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ but he is a plain warner And this is clear for those who have a mind and a heart by which they understand and comprehend. Allah said in another…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:184 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا مَا بِصَاحِبِهِمْ مِنْ جِنَّةٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ awalam yatafakkarū mā biṣāḥibihim min jinnatin in huwa illā nadhīrun mubīnun What! reflect they not that their companion (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) (Our Apostle Muhammad) is not seized with madness, He is but only a plain Warner. The total absorption in meditation every now and then made his opponents to allege about him to be in fits or seized. Qur'an refutes this here in one single brief clause proceeding with a warning to reflect on his lofty teachings and clear warning which never allow any possibility of any seizure as the teachings of Qur'an are the self-evident testimony of their divine origin, if he is seized, he is seized by God Himself. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-A'raaf:185 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْۤا فِي مَلَكُوتِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَأَنْ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yanẓurū fī malakūti l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin wa-an ʿasā an yakūna qadi iq'taraba ajaluhum fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūna Have they not contemplated the dominions of the heavens and the earth, and whatever things Allah has created, and that maybe their time1 has already drawn near? So what discourse will they believe after this?!2

item.title: Al-A'raaf:185 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْۤا فِي مَلَكُوتِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَأَنْ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yanẓurū fī malakūti l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin wa-an ʿasā an yakūna qadi iq'taraba ajaluhum fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūna Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allah has created and (think) that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement (i.e., message) hereafter will they believe? Do they not look in the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all things that Allah has created; and that it may be that the end of their lives is near. In what message after this will they then believe (7:185). Allah asks, those who denied faith, did they not contemplate about Our Ayat in…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:185 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْۤا فِي مَلَكُوتِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَأَنْ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yanẓurū fī malakūti l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin wa-an ʿasā an yakūna qadi iq'taraba ajaluhum fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūna Or look (Consider the instability of the transitory state and infer their terms coming nigh to the end.) they not into the kingdoms of the heavens and the earth and whatever things (God) created, and maybe that their term (End.) hath drawn nigh; then in what other words after this would they believe? See 7:184

item.title: Al-A'raaf:186 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ وَيَذَرُهُمْ فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ man yuḍ'lili l-lahu falā hādiya lahu wayadharuhum fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna Whomever Allah leads astray has no guide, and He leaves them bewildered in their rebellion.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:186 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ وَيَذَرُهُمْ فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ man yuḍ'lili l-lahu falā hādiya lahu wayadharuhum fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna Whoever Allah sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly. Whomsoever Allah sends astray, none can guide him; and He lets them wander blindly in their transgressions (7:186). Allah says, those who were destined to be misguided, then none can lead them to guidance, and even if they try their best effort to gain such guidance, this will not avail them: وَمَن يُرِدِ اللَّهُ فِتْنَتَهُ فَلَن تَمْلِكَ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا And whomsoever Allah wants to put in Fitnah (error, because of his rejecting of Faith, or trial), you can do nothing for him against Allah (5:41) And: قُلِ انظُرُوا مَاذَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُغْنِي الْآيَاتُ وَالنُّذُرُ عَن قَوْمٍ…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:186 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ وَيَذَرُهُمْ فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ man yuḍ'lili l-lahu falā hādiya lahu wayadharuhum fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna Whomsoever God suffereth to stray (One who is not benefited or availed of the guidance of the Word of God.) there is no guide for him, and He leaveth them alone in their transgression, blindly wandering (bewildered). See 7:184

item.title: Al-A'raaf:187 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي لَا يُجَلِّيهَا لِوَقْتِهَا إِلَّا هُوَ ثَقُلَتْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا تَأْتِيكُمْ إِلَّا بَغْتَةً يَسْءَلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ yasalūnaka ʿani l-sāʿati ayyāna mur'sāhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī lā yujallīhā liwaqtihā illā huwa thaqulat fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā tatīkum illā baghtatan yasalūnaka ka-annaka ḥafiyyun ʿanhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna They question you concerning the Hour, when will it set in? Say, 'Its knowledge is only with my Lord: none except Him shall manifest it at its time. It will weigh heavy on the heavens and the earth. It will not overtake you but suddenly.' They ask you as if you were in the know of it. Say, 'Its knowledge is only with Allah, but most…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:187 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي لَا يُجَلِّيهَا لِوَقْتِهَا إِلَّا هُوَ ثَقُلَتْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا تَأْتِيكُمْ إِلَّا بَغْتَةً يَسْءَلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ yasalūnaka ʿani l-sāʿati ayyāna mur'sāhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī lā yujallīhā liwaqtihā illā huwa thaqulat fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā tatīkum illā baghtatan yasalūnaka ka-annaka ḥafiyyun ʿanhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna They ask you, (O Muḥammad), about the Hour: when is its arrival?1 Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him. It lays heavily2 upon the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except unexpectedly." They ask you as if you are familiar with it. Say, "Its knowledge is only with Allah, but most of the people…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:187 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي لَا يُجَلِّيهَا لِوَقْتِهَا إِلَّا هُوَ ثَقُلَتْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا تَأْتِيكُمْ إِلَّا بَغْتَةً يَسْءَلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ yasalūnaka ʿani l-sāʿati ayyāna mur'sāhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī lā yujallīhā liwaqtihā illā huwa thaqulat fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā tatīkum illā baghtatan yasalūnaka ka-annaka ḥafiyyun ʿanhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna They ask thee about the Hour (of Resurrection) when will be its fixed time; Say: "The knowledge of it is only with my Lord (Refer to Mark 13/32. But that day and that hour knoweth no man no, not the angels, which are in heaven, neither the Son but the Father. N. T. Math 13/32. But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:188 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَاسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِيَ السُّوءُ إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ qul lā amliku linafsī nafʿan walā ḍarran illā mā shāa l-lahu walaw kuntu aʿlamu l-ghayba la-is'takthartu mina l-khayri wamā massaniya l-sūu in anā illā nadhīrun wabashīrun liqawmin yu'minūna Say, 'I have no control over any benefit for myself nor [over] any harm except what Allah may wish. Had I known the Unseen, I would have acquired much good, and no ill would have befallen me. I am only a warner and a bearer of good news to a people who have faith.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:188 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَاسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِيَ السُّوءُ إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ qul lā amliku linafsī nafʿan walā ḍarran illā mā shāa l-lahu walaw kuntu aʿlamu l-ghayba la-is'takthartu mina l-khayri wamā massaniya l-sūu in anā illā nadhīrun wabashīrun liqawmin yu'minūna Say, "I hold not for myself (the power of) benefit or harm, except what Allah has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe." Say : I possess no power over benefit or harm to myself except as Allah wills. If I had the knowledge of the Ghayb (Unseen), I should have secured for myself…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:188 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَاسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِيَ السُّوءُ إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ qul lā amliku linafsī nafʿan walā ḍarran illā mā shāa l-lahu walaw kuntu aʿlamu l-ghayba la-is'takthartu mina l-khayri wamā massaniya l-sūu in anā illā nadhīrun wabashīrun liqawmin yu'minūna Say: 'neither I (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) own for myself any benefit nor harm except what willeth God; and had I known the unseen (Refer to note on verse 6:50.) indeed I would have had much of good and evil had touched me not, and I am not but a Warner and the bearer of good news for a people who believe? This verse exemplifies the Holy Prophet with the matchless simplicity and charity of the declaration about his personality as an Apostle of…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:189 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا لِيَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّاهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيفًا فَمَرَّتْ بِهِ فَلَمَّا أَثْقَلَتْ دَعَوَا اللَّهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنْ ءَاتَيْتَنَا صَالِحًا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ huwa alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wajaʿala min'hā zawjahā liyaskuna ilayhā falammā taghashāhā ḥamalat ḥamlan khafīfan famarrat bihi falammā athqalat daʿawā l-laha rabbahumā la-in ātaytanā ṣāliḥan lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna It is He who created you from a single soul, and made from it its mate, that he might find comfort with her. So when he had covered1 her, she bore a light burden and passed [some time] with it. When she had grown heavy, they both invoked Allah, their Lord: 'If You give us a healthy [child], we will be surely grateful.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:189 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا لِيَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّاهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيفًا فَمَرَّتْ بِهِ فَلَمَّا أَثْقَلَتْ دَعَوَا اللَّهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنْ ءَاتَيْتَنَا صَالِحًا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ huwa alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wajaʿala min'hā zawjahā liyaskuna ilayhā falammā taghashāhā ḥamalat ḥamlan khafīfan famarrat bihi falammā athqalat daʿawā l-laha rabbahumā la-in ātaytanā ṣāliḥan lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he1 might dwell in security with her. And when he (i.e., man) covers her,2 she carries a light burden (i.e., a pregnancy) and continues therein. And when it becomes heavy, they both invoke Allah, their Lord, "If You should give us a good3 (child), we will surely be among the grateful." It is He Who has created you from a single person, and (then) He has…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:189 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا لِيَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّاهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيفًا فَمَرَّتْ بِهِ فَلَمَّا أَثْقَلَتْ دَعَوَا اللَّهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنْ ءَاتَيْتَنَا صَالِحًا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ huwa alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wajaʿala min'hā zawjahā liyaskuna ilayhā falammā taghashāhā ḥamalat ḥamlan khafīfan famarrat bihi falammā athqalat daʿawā l-laha rabbahumā la-in ātaytanā ṣāliḥan lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna He it is who created you from a single self (Being.) and from it did He make his mate that he may dwell resting unto her, when he covereth her, she beareth a light burden and carrieth it, when it groweth more heavy they both pray to their Lord; ''If Thou givest us a good child, certainly we shall be of the grateful ones. See also Verses: 4:1 and 16:72 for the creation of mankind of one self or soul. By his…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:190 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ءَاتَاهُمَا صَالِحًا جَعَلَا لَهُ شُرَكَاءَ فِيمَا ءَاتَاهُمَا فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ falammā ātāhumā ṣāliḥan jaʿalā lahu shurakāa fīmā ātāhumā fataʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūna Then when He gave them a healthy [child], they ascribed partners to Him in what He had given them. Exalted is Allah above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: Al-A'raaf:190 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ءَاتَاهُمَا صَالِحًا جَعَلَا لَهُ شُرَكَاءَ فِيمَا ءَاتَاهُمَا فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ falammā ātāhumā ṣāliḥan jaʿalā lahu shurakāa fīmā ātāhumā fataʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūna But when He gives them a good (child), they1 ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allah above what they associate with Him. See 7:189

item.title: Al-A'raaf:190 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ءَاتَاهُمَا صَالِحًا جَعَلَا لَهُ شُرَكَاءَ فِيمَا ءَاتَاهُمَا فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ falammā ātāhumā ṣāliḥan jaʿalā lahu shurakāa fīmā ātāhumā fataʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūna But when He giveth them a good child they ascribe unto Him partners in what He hath given them; but most exalted is God above what they associate (with Him). See 7:189

item.title: Al-A'raaf:191 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ ayush'rikūna mā lā yakhluqu shayan wahum yukh'laqūna Do they ascribe [to Him] partners that create nothing and have been created themselves,

item.title: Al-A'raaf:191 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ ayush'rikūna mā lā yakhluqu shayan wahum yukh'laqūna Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are (themselves) created? Do they attribute as partners to Allah those who created nothing but they themselves are created (7:191). No help can they give them, nor can they help themselves (7:192). And if you call them to guidance, they follow you not. It is the same for you whether you call them or you keep silent (7:193). Verily, those whom you call upon besides Allah are servants like you. So call upon them and let them answer you if you are truthful (7:194). Have they feet wherewith they walk? Or have they hands wherewith they hold? Or have they eyes wherewith they see? Or have they ears wherewith they hear? Say: Call your (so-called)…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:191 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ ayush'rikūna mā lā yakhluqu shayan wahum yukh'laqūna What! Do they associate (with Him) that which createth not anything, and while they are themselves the created (ones)? See 7:189

item.title: Al-A'raaf:192 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًا وَلَا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُونَ walā yastaṭīʿūna lahum naṣran walā anfusahum yanṣurūna and can neither help them, nor help themselves?

item.title: Al-A'raaf:192 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًا وَلَا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُونَ walā yastaṭīʿūna lahum naṣran walā anfusahum yanṣurūna And they (i.e., the false deities) are unable to (give) them help, nor can they help themselves. See 7:191

item.title: Al-A'raaf:192 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًا وَلَا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُونَ walā yastaṭīʿūna lahum naṣran walā anfusahum yanṣurūna And they cannot help them, nor themselves can they help. See 7:189

item.title: Al-A'raaf:193 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ أَمْ أَنْتُمْ صَامِتُونَ wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yattabiʿūkum sawāon ʿalaykum adaʿawtumūhum am antum ṣāmitūna And if you call them to guidance, they will not follow you: it is the same to you whether you call them or whether you are silent.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:193 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ أَمْ أَنْتُمْ صَامِتُونَ wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yattabiʿūkum sawāon ʿalaykum adaʿawtumūhum am antum ṣāmitūna And if you (believers) invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent. See 7:191

item.title: Al-A'raaf:193 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ أَمْ أَنْتُمْ صَامِتُونَ wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yattabiʿūkum sawāon ʿalaykum adaʿawtumūhum am antum ṣāmitūna If ye invite them unto guidance they will not follow you; it is the same to you if ye invite them or ye be quiet. The reference is to those adamant ones in infidelity that they would neither care for the warnings against their infidelity nor would they ever consider at all the promises of the heavenly reward for goodness1.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:194 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ عِبَادٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ فَادْعُوهُمْ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ inna alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi ʿibādun amthālukum fa-id'ʿūhum falyastajībū lakum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Indeed those whom you invoke besides Allah are creatures like you. So invoke them: they should answer you, if you are truthful.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:194 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ عِبَادٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ فَادْعُوهُمْ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ inna alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi ʿibādun amthālukum fa-id'ʿūhum falyastajībū lakum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Indeed, those you (polytheists) call upon besides Allah are servants (i.e., creations) like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful. See 7:191

item.title: Al-A'raaf:194 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ عِبَادٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ فَادْعُوهُمْ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ inna alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi ʿibādun amthālukum fa-id'ʿūhum falyastajībū lakum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Verily, those whom ye call upon other than God are subservient (to God) like unto your own selves, so call ye on them, then let them answer (Grant your prayers.) if ye be truthful. See 7:193

item.title: Al-A'raaf:195 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَهُمْ أَرْجُلٌ يَمْشُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ أَيْدٍ يَبْطِشُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا قُلِ ادْعُوْۤا شُرَكَاءَكُمْ ثُمَّ كِيدُونِ فَلَا تُنْظِرُونِ alahum arjulun yamshūna bihā am lahum aydin yabṭishūna bihā am lahum aʿyunun yub'ṣirūna bihā am lahum ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā quli id'ʿū shurakāakum thumma kīdūni falā tunẓirūni Do they have any feet to walk with? Do they have any hands to grasp with? Do they have any eyes to see with? Do they have any ears to hear with? Say, 'Invoke your partners [that you ascribe to Allah] and try out your stratagems1 against me without granting me any respite.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:195 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَهُمْ أَرْجُلٌ يَمْشُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ أَيْدٍ يَبْطِشُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا قُلِ ادْعُوْۤا شُرَكَاءَكُمْ ثُمَّ كِيدُونِ فَلَا تُنْظِرُونِ alahum arjulun yamshūna bihā am lahum aydin yabṭishūna bihā am lahum aʿyunun yub'ṣirūna bihā am lahum ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā quli id'ʿū shurakāakum thumma kīdūni falā tunẓirūni Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, (O Muḥammad), "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite. See 7:191

item.title: Al-A'raaf:195 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَهُمْ أَرْجُلٌ يَمْشُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ أَيْدٍ يَبْطِشُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا قُلِ ادْعُوْۤا شُرَكَاءَكُمْ ثُمَّ كِيدُونِ فَلَا تُنْظِرُونِ alahum arjulun yamshūna bihā am lahum aydin yabṭishūna bihā am lahum aʿyunun yub'ṣirūna bihā am lahum ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā quli id'ʿū shurakāakum thumma kīdūni falā tunẓirūni What! are there for them feet which they walk with, Or for them are hands which they hold with, Or for them are eyes which they see with, or for them are ears which they hear with? Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Call (The reference may seem to be to the idols but with profound reflections proves that it is applicable to the living entities other than God.) ye all your associates and then scheme ye (your worst) against me (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) and give me no…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:196 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ وَلِيِّيَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِينَ inna waliyyiya l-lahu alladhī nazzala l-kitāba wahuwa yatawallā l-ṣāliḥīna My guardian is indeed Allah who sent down the Book, and He takes care of the righteous.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:196 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ وَلِيِّيَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِينَ inna waliyyiya l-lahu alladhī nazzala l-kitāba wahuwa yatawallā l-ṣāliḥīna Indeed, my protector is Allah, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous. See 7:191

item.title: Al-A'raaf:196 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ وَلِيِّيَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِينَ inna waliyyiya l-lahu alladhī nazzala l-kitāba wahuwa yatawallā l-ṣāliḥīna Verily my Protector is God Who sent down the Book (Qur'an) and He guardeth the virtuous ones. It is clear prophecy of the helplessness of the idolaters against the onward march of Islam. This verse clearly warns the polytheists that none of their idol-gods will ever be of any help to them at all. It is a prophecy as well to say that all their power and authority would be frustrated.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:197 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَكُمْ وَلَا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُونَ wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrakum walā anfusahum yanṣurūna Those whom you invoke besides Him can neither help you, nor help themselves.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:197 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَكُمْ وَلَا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُونَ wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrakum walā anfusahum yanṣurūna And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves." See 7:191

item.title: Al-A'raaf:197 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَكُمْ وَلَا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُونَ wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrakum walā anfusahum yanṣurūna And those whom ye call upon other than Him are not able to help you, nor can they help themselves. See 7:196

item.title: Al-A'raaf:198 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى لَا يَسْمَعُوْۤا وَتَرَاهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yasmaʿū watarāhum yanẓurūna ilayka wahum lā yub'ṣirūna If you call them to guidance, they will not hear. You see them observing you, but they do not perceive.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:198 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى لَا يَسْمَعُوْۤا وَتَرَاهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yasmaʿū watarāhum yanẓurūna ilayka wahum lā yub'ṣirūna And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see. See 7:191

item.title: Al-A'raaf:198 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى لَا يَسْمَعُوْۤا وَتَرَاهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yasmaʿū watarāhum yanẓurūna ilayka wahum lā yub'ṣirūna And if ye invite them unto guidance, they hear not; and thou seest them looking towards thee, while they see not. See 7:196

item.title: Al-A'raaf:199 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ khudhi l-ʿafwa wamur bil-ʿur'fi wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-jāhilīna Adopt [a policy of] excusing [the faults of people], bid what is right, and turn away from the ignorant.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:199 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ khudhi l-ʿafwa wamur bil-ʿur'fi wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-jāhilīna Take what is given freely,1 enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant. Show forgiveness, enjoin Al-'Urf (the good), and turn away from the foolish (don't punish them) (7:199). And if an evil whisper comes to you from Shaytan, then seek refuge with Allah. Verily, He is All-Hearer, All-Knower (7:200). Showing Forgiveness Abdur-Rahman bin Zayd bin Aslam commented on Allah's statement: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ Show forgiveness "Allah commanded (Prophet Muhammad SAW) to show forgiveness and turn away from the idolators for ten years. Afterwards Allah ordered him to be harsh with them." And more than one narration from Mujahid says, "From the (bad) behavior and actions of the people, of those who have not committed espionage." And Hashim bin 'Urwah said that his father said,…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:199 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ khudhi l-ʿafwa wamur bil-ʿur'fi wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-jāhilīna Adopt thou moderation (In all respects.) , and enjoin (To do good.) virtue and turn (Give up arguing with them.) thou away from the ignorant (Those adamant in disbelief.) ones. See 7:196

item.title: Al-A'raaf:200 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu samīʿun ʿalīmun Should a temptation from Satan disturb you, invoke the protection of Allah; indeed He is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:200 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu samīʿun ʿalīmun And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing. See 7:199

item.title: Al-A'raaf:200 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu samīʿun ʿalīmun And if an incitement from the Satan inciteth thee (The Prophet addressed for the people.) , then seek thou refuge in God; Verily He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing. See 7:196

item.title: Al-A'raaf:201 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَائِفٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ تَذَكَّرُوا فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْصِرُونَ inna alladhīna ittaqaw idhā massahum ṭāifun mina l-shayṭāni tadhakkarū fa-idhā hum mub'ṣirūna When those who are Godwary are touched by a visitation1 of Satan, they remember [Allah] and, behold, they perceive.

item.title: Al-A'raaf:201 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَائِفٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ تَذَكَّرُوا فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْصِرُونَ inna alladhīna ittaqaw idhā massahum ṭāifun mina l-shayṭāni tadhakkarū fa-idhā hum mub'ṣirūna Indeed, those who fear Allah - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember (Him) and at once they have insight. Verily, those who have Taqwa, when an evil thought comes to them from Shaytan, they remember (Allah), and (indeed) they then see (aright) (7:201). But (as for) their brothers (the devils' brothers) they (the devils) plunge them deeper into error, and they never stop short (7:202). The Whispering of Shaytan and the People of Taqwa Allah mentions His servants who have Taqwa, obeying His orders, and avoid what He forbade: إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ when comes to them an evil thought, or anger, or the whispers of Shaytan cross their mind, or intend to err, or…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:201 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَائِفٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ تَذَكَّرُوا فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْصِرُونَ inna alladhīna ittaqaw idhā massahum ṭāifun mina l-shayṭāni tadhakkarū fa-idhā hum mub'ṣirūna Verily those who guard (themselves against evil) when an evil thought from the Satan (Including Impious one - the evil doers.) afflicteth them, they become mindful (of God and get awakened) then lo! they see (aright). See 7:196

item.title: Al-A'raaf:202 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِخْوَانُهُمْ يَمُدُّونَهُمْ فِي الْغَيِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُونَ wa-ikh'wānuhum yamuddūnahum fī l-ghayi thumma lā yuq'ṣirūna But their brethren,1 they draw them into error, and then they do not spare [any harm].

item.title: Al-A'raaf:202 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِخْوَانُهُمْ يَمُدُّونَهُمْ فِي الْغَيِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُونَ wa-ikh'wānuhum yamuddūnahum fī l-ghayi thumma lā yuq'ṣirūna But their brothers1 - they (i.e., the devils) increase them in error; then they do not stop short. See 7:201

item.title: Al-A'raaf:202 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِخْوَانُهُمْ يَمُدُّونَهُمْ فِي الْغَيِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُونَ wa-ikh'wānuhum yamuddūnahum fī l-ghayi thumma lā yuq'ṣirūna And their brethren (Of Satan - i.e. the impious ones.) drag them deeper into the error, so they cease not their efforts. See 7:196

item.title: Al-A'raaf:203 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِمْ بِاٰیَةٍ قَالُوْا لَوْلَا اجْتَبَيْتَهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ مِنْ رَبِّي هَذَا بَصَائِرُ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-idhā lam tatihim biāyatin qālū lawlā ij'tabaytahā qul innamā attabiʿu mā yūḥā ilayya min rabbī hādhā baṣāiru min rabbikum wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yu'minūna When you do not bring them a sign, they say, 'Why do you not improvise one?' Say, 'I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord; these are insights from your Lord, and a guidance and mercy for a people who have faith.'

item.title: Al-A'raaf:203 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِمْ بِاٰیَةٍ قَالُوْا لَوْلَا اجْتَبَيْتَهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ مِنْ رَبِّي هَذَا بَصَائِرُ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-idhā lam tatihim biāyatin qālū lawlā ij'tabaytahā qul innamā attabiʿu mā yūḥā ilayya min rabbī hādhā baṣāiru min rabbikum wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yu'minūna And when you, (O Muḥammad), do not bring them a sign (i.e., miracle), they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This (Qur’ān) is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe." And if you do not bring them a miracle, they say: Why have you not brought it" Say: "I but follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This (the Qur'an) is nothing but evidences from your Lord, and a guidance and a mercy…

item.title: Al-A'raaf:203 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِمْ بِاٰیَةٍ قَالُوْا لَوْلَا اجْتَبَيْتَهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ مِنْ رَبِّي هَذَا بَصَائِرُ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-idhā lam tatihim biāyatin qālū lawlā ij'tabaytahā qul innamā attabiʿu mā yūḥā ilayya min rabbī hādhā baṣāiru min rabbikum wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yu'minūna And when thou bringest not unto them a sign say they: "Why not thou forge it?"
