item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا إِفْكٌ افْتَرَاهُ وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ فَقَدْ جَاءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا waqāla alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā if'kun if'tarāhu wa-aʿānahu ʿalayhi qawmun ākharūna faqad jāū ẓul'man wazūran And say those who disbelieve: "This (Qur'an) is nothing but a lie which he (Our Apostle) hath forged (Forged.) and have helped him at it other people;" So indeed have they produced iniquity and uttered a slander. The disbelievers say that the Qur'an is only a fabrication of the Holy Prophet containing stories composed by the help of the other people viz. the Jews and the Christians.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلَى عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا waqālū asāṭīru l-awalīna ik'tatabahā fahiya tum'lā ʿalayhi buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan They say, 'He has taken down myths of the ancients, and they are dictated to him morning and evening.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلَى عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا waqālū asāṭīru l-awalīna ik'tatabahā fahiya tum'lā ʿalayhi buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon." See 25:4

item.title: Al-Furqaan:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلَى عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا waqālū asāṭīru l-awalīna ik'tatabahā fahiya tum'lā ʿalayhi buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan And say they: "(they are the) tales of the ancient he hath got them written, so these are recited on him morn and even." See 25:4

item.title: Al-Furqaan:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِي يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا qul anzalahu alladhī yaʿlamu l-sira fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu kāna ghafūran raḥīman Say, 'It has been sent down by Him who knows the hidden in the heavens and the earth. Indeed He is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِي يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا qul anzalahu alladhī yaʿlamu l-sira fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu kāna ghafūran raḥīman Say, (O Muḥammad), "It has been revealed by He who knows (every) secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful." See 25:4

item.title: Al-Furqaan:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِي يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا qul anzalahu alladhī yaʿlamu l-sira fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu kāna ghafūran raḥīman Say thou: "Hath sent it down He who knoweth the secrets of the heavens and the earth; Verily He is Oft-Forgiving, All- Merciful." From this verse is obvious that his opponents were confused in accusation - Whether to say he hath forged and the others helped or others were the forgers who would dictate to him. His consideration and the clarity of his mind with utmost certitude on one hand and the perplexity and doubts and the shaky attitude of his opponents, were the best evidence of his truthfulness. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَالِ هَذَا الرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِي فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا waqālū māli hādhā l-rasūli yakulu l-ṭaʿāma wayamshī fī l-aswāqi lawlā unzila ilayhi malakun fayakūna maʿahu nadhīran And they say, 'What sort of apostle is this who eats food and walks in the marketplaces? Why has not an angel been sent down to him so as to be a warner along with him?'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَالِ هَذَا الرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِي فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا waqālū māli hādhā l-rasūli yakulu l-ṭaʿāma wayamshī fī l-aswāqi lawlā unzila ilayhi malakun fayakūna maʿahu nadhīran And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner? And they say: "Why does this Messenger eat food, and walk about in the markets. Why is not an angel sent down to him to be a warner with him (25:7). "Or (why) has not a treasure been granted to him, or why has he not a garden whereof he may eat" And the wrongdoers say: "You follow none but a man bewitched (25:8). See how they coin similitudes for you, so they have gone…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَالِ هَذَا الرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِي فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا waqālū māli hādhā l-rasūli yakulu l-ṭaʿāma wayamshī fī l-aswāqi lawlā unzila ilayhi malakun fayakūna maʿahu nadhīran And say they: "What sort of an apostle is this? He eateth food and he walketh about in the marts! Why hath not been sent unto him an angel that he be a warner with him?" The Holy Prophet Muhammad, unlike his predecessors, had come into the world to set practical examples of the simplest godly life of a human being on earth. His simplicity is an ideal and a model for mankind. His attending himself to every kind of the daily routine of his life, sets the best examples of self-help and the dignity of labour. His walking in the streets, helping the helpless instead of being…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُلْقَى إِلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ الظَّالِمُونَ إِنْ تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَسْحُورًا aw yul'qā ilayhi kanzun aw takūnu lahu jannatun yakulu min'hā waqāla l-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulan masḥūran Or, '[Why is not] a treasure thrown to him, or [why does] he [not] have a garden from which he may eat?' And the wrongdoers say, 'You are just following a bewitched man.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُلْقَى إِلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ الظَّالِمُونَ إِنْ تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَسْحُورًا aw yul'qā ilayhi kanzun aw takūnu lahu jannatun yakulu min'hā waqāla l-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulan masḥūran Or (why is not) a treasure presented to him (from heaven), or does he (not) have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic." See 25:7

item.title: Al-Furqaan:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُلْقَى إِلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ الظَّالِمُونَ إِنْ تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَسْحُورًا aw yul'qā ilayhi kanzun aw takūnu lahu jannatun yakulu min'hā waqāla l-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulan masḥūran Or be thrown down unto him a treasure, or there be for him a garden that he may eat of it?" and say the iniquitous: "Ye follow but a man bewitched The people sunk deep into materialism and intoxicated with the love and the lust for the luxuries of the life of this world, judge men according to their wealth and property but that was not necessary for an apostle from God who comes to invite men to raise themselves from the material degradation to the spiritual heights of the heavenly bliss. The people had been accustomed to demand miracles from the previous apostles and even…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوْۤا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْۤا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا unẓur kayfa ḍarabū laka l-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlan Look, how they draw comparisons for you; so they go astray, and cannot find the way.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوْۤا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْۤا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا unẓur kayfa ḍarabū laka l-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlan Look how they strike for you comparisons;1 but they have strayed, so they cannot (find) a way. See 25:7

item.title: Al-Furqaan:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوْۤا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْۤا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا unẓur kayfa ḍarabū laka l-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlan See thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) how they coin comparisons for thee! But they have gone astray, so they shall not be able to find the (right) way, Having gone astray and being adamant in their false belief, the disbelievers shall not have any way to escape from the chastisement which they have themselves earned.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذٰلِكَ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكَ قُصُورًا tabāraka alladhī in shāa jaʿala laka khayran min dhālika jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wayajʿal laka quṣūran Blessed is He who will grant you better than that if He wishes —gardens with streams running in them, and He will make for you palaces.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذٰلِكَ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكَ قُصُورًا tabāraka alladhī in shāa jaʿala laka khayran min dhālika jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wayajʿal laka quṣūran Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you (something) better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces. See 25:7

item.title: Al-Furqaan:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذٰلِكَ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكَ قُصُورًا tabāraka alladhī in shāa jaʿala laka khayran min dhālika jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wayajʿal laka quṣūran Blessed is He who, if He pleaseth, will give thee what is better than this {what all they say), gardens 'neath which flow rivers, and give thee mansions. See 25:9

item.title: Al-Furqaan:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالسَّاعَةِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا bal kadhabū bil-sāʿati wa-aʿtadnā liman kadhaba bil-sāʿati saʿīran Rather they deny the Hour, and We have prepared a Blaze for those who deny the Hour.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالسَّاعَةِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا bal kadhabū bil-sāʿati wa-aʿtadnā liman kadhaba bil-sāʿati saʿīran But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze. See 25:7

item.title: Al-Furqaan:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالسَّاعَةِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا bal kadhabū bil-sāʿati wa-aʿtadnā liman kadhaba bil-sāʿati saʿīran Nay! they belie the Hour (of Resurrection) and We have, ready for him who belieth the Hour, the burning fire. This asserts the actual reason for their aversion, i.e., their denial of the ultimate object and the end of life, i.e., the life hereafter. The consequence of it is what is mentioned in the succeeding verse. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا رَأَتْهُمْ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا idhā ra-athum min makānin baʿīdin samiʿū lahā taghayyuẓan wazafīran When it1 sights them from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا رَأَتْهُمْ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا idhā ra-athum min makānin baʿīdin samiʿū lahā taghayyuẓan wazafīran When it (i.e., the Hellfire) sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring. See 25:7

item.title: Al-Furqaan:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا رَأَتْهُمْ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا idhā ra-athum min makānin baʿīdin samiʿū lahā taghayyuẓan wazafīran When it beholdeth (When it will be cited.) them from afar, they shall hear its raging and roaring. See 25:11

item.title: Al-Furqaan:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا wa-idhā ul'qū min'hā makānan ḍayyiqan muqarranīna daʿaw hunālika thubūran And when they are cast into a narrow place in it, bound together [in chains], they will pray for [their own] annihilation.1

item.title: Al-Furqaan:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا wa-idhā ul'qū min'hā makānan ḍayyiqan muqarranīna daʿaw hunālika thubūran And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction. See 25:7

item.title: Al-Furqaan:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا wa-idhā ul'qū min'hā makānan ḍayyiqan muqarranīna daʿaw hunālika thubūran And when they shall be flung into a narrow place therein, bound, they shall there call out for death; (They would wish destruction.) See 25:11

item.title: Al-Furqaan:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَدْعُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَاحِدًا وَادْعُوْۤا ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا lā tadʿū l-yawma thubūran wāḥidan wa-id'ʿū thubūran kathīran [They will be told:] 'Do not pray for a single annihilation today, but pray for many annihilations!'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَدْعُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَاحِدًا وَادْعُوْۤا ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا lā tadʿū l-yawma thubūran wāḥidan wa-id'ʿū thubūran kathīran (They will be told), "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction." See 25:7

item.title: Al-Furqaan:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَدْعُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَاحِدًا وَادْعُوْۤا ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا lā tadʿū l-yawma thubūran wāḥidan wa-id'ʿū thubūran kathīran (It shall be said unto them) "Call ye not for this day for one death but call ye for death multiple!" See 25:11

item.title: Al-Furqaan:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً وَمَصِيرًا qul adhālika khayrun am jannatu l-khul'di allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna kānat lahum jazāan wamaṣīran Say, 'Is that better, or the everlasting paradise promised to the Godwary, which will be their reward and destination?'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً وَمَصِيرًا qul adhālika khayrun am jannatu l-khul'di allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna kānat lahum jazāan wamaṣīran Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination. Say: "Is that better or the Paradise of Eternity which is promised to those who have Taqwa" It will be theirs as a reward and final destination (25:15). For them there will be therein all that they desire, and they will abide (therein forever). It is upon your Lord a Wa'dan Mas'ula (25:16). Is the Fire Better, or Paradise? Here Allah says: 'O Muhammad, this that We have described to you about the state of those who are doomed, who will be dragged on their faces to Hell, which will…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً وَمَصِيرًا qul adhālika khayrun am jannatu l-khul'di allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna kānat lahum jazāan wamaṣīran Say (Ask.) thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad): "Is this better or the eternal garden which hath been promised to the pious (Those who guard them selves against evil.) ones? that shall be for them a recompense and (their) destination." See 25:11

item.title: Al-Furqaan:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ خَالِدِينَ كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَسْءُولًا lahum fīhā mā yashāūna khālidīna kāna ʿalā rabbika waʿdan masūlan There they will have whatever they wish, abiding [forever], a promise [much] besought, [binding] on your Lord.1

item.title: Al-Furqaan:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ خَالِدِينَ كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَسْءُولًا lahum fīhā mā yashāūna khālidīna kāna ʿalā rabbika waʿdan masūlan For them therein is whatever they wish, (while) abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise (worthy to be) requested.1 See 25:15

item.title: Al-Furqaan:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ خَالِدِينَ كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَسْءُولًا lahum fīhā mā yashāūna khālidīna kāna ʿalā rabbika waʿdan masūlan For them shall be therein whatever they desire abiding (in it)-, It is a promise from thy Lord worth to be prayed for. See 25:11

item.title: Al-Furqaan:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنْتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَؤُلَاءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوْۤا السَّبِيلَ wayawma yaḥshuruhum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi fayaqūlu a-antum aḍlaltum ʿibādī hāulāi am hum ḍallū l-sabīla On the day that He will muster them and those whom they worship besides Allah, He will say, 'Was it you who led astray these servants of Mine, or did they themselves stray from the way?'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنْتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَؤُلَاءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوْۤا السَّبِيلَ wayawma yaḥshuruhum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi fayaqūlu a-antum aḍlaltum ʿibādī hāulāi am hum ḍallū l-sabīla And (mention) the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they (themselves) stray from the way?" And on the Day when He will gather them together and that which they worship besides Allah. He will say: "Was it you who misled these My servants or did they stray from the path (25:17). They will say: "Glorified be You! It was not for us to take any Awliya' besides You, but You gave them and their fathers comfort till they forgot the warning, and became a lost people (25:18). Thus they will deny…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنْتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَؤُلَاءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوْۤا السَّبِيلَ wayawma yaḥshuruhum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi fayaqūlu a-antum aḍlaltum ʿibādī hāulāi am hum ḍallū l-sabīla And on the day when He shall gather them, and what they serve besides God, He shall say: "Was it ye who beguiled these My servants, or themselves strayed they from the right path?" See 25:11

item.title: Al-Furqaan:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا سُبْحَانَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَكِنْ مَتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی نَسُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا بُورًا qālū sub'ḥānaka mā kāna yanbaghī lanā an nattakhidha min dūnika min awliyāa walākin mattaʿtahum waābāahum ḥattā nasū l-dhik'ra wakānū qawman būran They will say, 'Immaculate are You! It does not behoove us to take any guardians in Your stead! But You provided for them and their fathers until they forgot the Reminder, and they were a ruined lot.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا سُبْحَانَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَكِنْ مَتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی نَسُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا بُورًا qālū sub'ḥānaka mā kāna yanbaghī lanā an nattakhidha min dūnika min awliyāa walākin mattaʿtahum waābāahum ḥattā nasū l-dhik'ra wakānū qawman būran They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies (i.e., protectors). But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined." See 25:17

item.title: Al-Furqaan:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا سُبْحَانَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَكِنْ مَتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی نَسُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا بُورًا qālū sub'ḥānaka mā kāna yanbaghī lanā an nattakhidha min dūnika min awliyāa walākin mattaʿtahum waābāahum ḥattā nasū l-dhik'ra wakānū qawman būran They will say, "Glory be to Thee! It behoved not for us that we take any friends besides Thee, but Thou didst provide them and their fathers to enjoy until they forsook Thy remembrance, while they were people to suffer perdition." 'Wali' and its derivations are used in opposite senses as already pointed out, 'Wali' is one who is near. A master near to the slave, is called 'Wali' and the slave near to the master is 'Wali'. Two friends, two neighbours, the guardian and his ward is Wali and God is the 'Wali' of the believers and…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُمْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا وَمَنْ يَظْلِمْ مِنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا faqad kadhabūkum bimā taqūlūna famā tastaṭīʿūna ṣarfan walā naṣran waman yaẓlim minkum nudhiq'hu ʿadhāban kabīran So they will certainly impugn you in what you say, and you will neither be able to circumvent [punishment] nor find help, and whoever of you does wrong, We shall make him taste a terrible punishment.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُمْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا وَمَنْ يَظْلِمْ مِنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا faqad kadhabūkum bimā taqūlūna famā tastaṭīʿūna ṣarfan walā naṣran waman yaẓlim minkum nudhiq'hu ʿadhāban kabīran So they will deny you, (disbelievers), in what you say,1 and you cannot avert (punishment) or (find) help. And whoever commits injustice2 among you - We will make him taste a great punishment. See 25:17

item.title: Al-Furqaan:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُمْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا وَمَنْ يَظْلِمْ مِنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا faqad kadhabūkum bimā taqūlūna famā tastaṭīʿūna ṣarfan walā naṣran waman yaẓlim minkum nudhiq'hu ʿadhāban kabīran (Then will be said unto the idolaters) "so (now) indeed shall they belie you of what ye say, so ye shall not be able to avert (the doom) or to succour (yourselves) and whosoever be unjust of you, We shall cause taste great (Grievous.) torment." See 25:18

item.title: Al-Furqaan:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا wamā arsalnā qablaka mina l-mur'salīna illā innahum layakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wayamshūna fī l-aswāqi wajaʿalnā baʿḍakum libaʿḍin fit'natan ataṣbirūna wakāna rabbuka baṣīran We did not send any apostles before you but that they indeed ate food and walked in marketplaces. We have made you a trial for one another, [to see] if you will be patient, and your Lord is all-seeing.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا wamā arsalnā qablaka mina l-mur'salīna illā innahum layakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wayamshūna fī l-aswāqi wajaʿalnā baʿḍakum libaʿḍin fit'natan ataṣbirūna wakāna rabbuka baṣīran And We did not send before you, (O Muḥammad), any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you (people) as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing. And We never sent before you any of the Messengers but verily, they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you as a trial for others; will you have patience And your Lord is Ever All-Seer (25:20). All of the Previous Messengers Were Human Allah tells us about…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا wamā arsalnā qablaka mina l-mur'salīna illā innahum layakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wayamshūna fī l-aswāqi wajaʿalnā baʿḍakum libaʿḍin fit'natan ataṣbirūna wakāna rabbuka baṣīran And We sent not any apostles before thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) but they certainly ate food and walked in the markets; and We have made some of you a trial for the others; will ye bear patiently? Your Lord is Ever-Seeing. This verse has an answer to the criticism of the disbelievers - in verse 25:7 above. The concluding words constitute an injunction to the believers to bear the hardship and the miseries of the persecution in the way of the Lord. This is in refutation of the statement of the disbelievers in verse 25:7. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرٰی رَبَّنَا لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْا عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا waqāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā lawlā unzila ʿalaynā l-malāikatu aw narā rabbanā laqadi is'takbarū fī anfusihim waʿataw ʿutuwwan kabīran Those who do not expect to encounter Us say, 'Why have angels not been sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord?' Certainly they are full of arrogance within their souls and have become terribly defiant.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرٰی رَبَّنَا لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْا عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا waqāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā lawlā unzila ʿalaynā l-malāikatu aw narā rabbanā laqadi is'takbarū fī anfusihim waʿataw ʿutuwwan kabīran And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or (why) do we (not) see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves1 and (become) insolent with great insolence. And those who expect not a meeting with Us said: Why are not the angels sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord" Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and are scornful with great pride (25:21). On the Day they will see the angels – no good news will there be for the criminals that day. And…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرٰی رَبَّنَا لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْا عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا waqāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā lawlā unzila ʿalaynā l-malāikatu aw narā rabbanā laqadi is'takbarū fī anfusihim waʿataw ʿutuwwan kabīran And say those who hope not of Our meeting: "Why have not angels been sent down (Unto.) upon us, or see we not Our Lord?" Indeed think they too high of themselves and have (Revolted a great revolt against reason.) exceeded a great excess. The cause of the rebellion or the revolt on the part of the people, insisting upon an angel being sent down to them or the Lord Himself manifesting Himself to them, is that the people having polluted their selves with the disbelief in God and the belief in false gods, in spite of the signs or miracles repeatedly…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرٰی يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا yawma yarawna l-malāikata lā bush'rā yawma-idhin lil'muj'rimīna wayaqūlūna ḥij'ran maḥjūran The day when they see the angels, there will be no good news for the guilty that day, and they1 will say, 'Keep off [from paradise]!'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرٰی يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا yawma yarawna l-malāikata lā bush'rā yawma-idhin lil'muj'rimīna wayaqūlūna ḥij'ran maḥjūran The day they see the angels1 - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and (the angels) will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."2 See 25:21

item.title: Al-Furqaan:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرٰی يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا yawma yarawna l-malāikata lā bush'rā yawma-idhin lil'muj'rimīna wayaqūlūna ḥij'ran maḥjūran On the day when see they the angels, no glad tidings shall there be that day for the guilty, and they (the angels) shall say: "Forbidden it (the enjoyment) is, totally forbidden!" The seeing of the angels refers to the dawn of the Day of Requital - 'Hijran Mahjura', i.e., Paradise shall be forbidden for the guilty ones - The denial of the blissful life has been made emphatic and definite.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَى مَا عَمِلُوْۤا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا waqadim'nā ilā mā ʿamilū min ʿamalin fajaʿalnāhu habāan manthūran Then We shall attend to the works they have done and then turn them into scattered dust.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَى مَا عَمِلُوْۤا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا waqadim'nā ilā mā ʿamilū min ʿamalin fajaʿalnāhu habāan manthūran And We will approach (i.e., regard)1 what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed. See 25:21

item.title: Al-Furqaan:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَى مَا عَمِلُوْۤا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا waqadim'nā ilā mā ʿamilū min ʿamalin fajaʿalnāhu habāan manthūran And (then) will We proceed unto what they have wrought of deeds, and We shall render them like unto the dust scattered in air. This verse clearly indicates that deeds however good they may be in their nature they shall not be of any avail to the people who lack the proper faith in God, i.e., the impious in their faith and conduct. People might seem to be righteous but at heart they might be hypocrites or disbelievers. We are informed through this verse that all the good deeds of such persons shall be rendered as the scattered motes. The Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn Ali al-Baqir says that this verse is applicable also to those who in their lives might have…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا aṣḥābu l-janati yawma-idhin khayrun mus'taqarran wa-aḥsanu maqīlan On that day the inhabitants of paradise will be in the best abode and an excellent resting place.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا aṣḥābu l-janati yawma-idhin khayrun mus'taqarran wa-aḥsanu maqīlan The companions of Paradise, that Day, are (in) a better settlement and better resting place. See 25:21

item.title: Al-Furqaan:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا aṣḥābu l-janati yawma-idhin khayrun mus'taqarran wa-aḥsanu maqīlan The dwellers of the Garden {Paradise} that day shall be in a better abode and a better resting place. See 25:23

item.title: Al-Furqaan:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنْزِيلًا wayawma tashaqqaqu l-samāu bil-ghamāmi wanuzzila l-malāikatu tanzīlan The day when the sky with its clouds will split open, and the angels will be sent down [in a majestic] descent,

item.title: Al-Furqaan:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنْزِيلًا wayawma tashaqqaqu l-samāu bil-ghamāmi wanuzzila l-malāikatu tanzīlan And (mention) the Day when the heaven will split open with (emerging) clouds,1 and the angels will be sent down in successive descent. And (remember) the Day when the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down, with a grand descending (25:25). The sovereignty on that Day will be the true (sovereignty) of the Most Gracious, and it will be a hard Day for the disbelievers (25:26). And (remember) the Day when the wrongdoer will bite at his hands, he will say: Oh! Would that I had taken a path with the Messenger (25:27). "Ah! Woe to me! Would that I had never taken so-and-so as an intimate friend! (25:28). "He indeed led me astray from the Reminder after it…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنْزِيلًا wayawma tashaqqaqu l-samāu bil-ghamāmi wanuzzila l-malāikatu tanzīlan And on the day when the heavens shall burst asunder with cloud and the angels be sent down, descending (in ranks) This verse refers to what will happen at the dawn of the Day of Judgment when it would be proved that the kingdom in fact belonged to none but God. And it is then that the infidels would realise their position when the Day would be a Day of Hardship and Trial for them. What we cannot see with our material limitations, would then be seen. The sky which appears blank to us, shall be rent asunder and the Holy Spirits of all grades of excellence shall appear and the world will be quite new in comparison and contrast to the one of our present…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَسِيرًا al-mul'ku yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu lilrraḥmāni wakāna yawman ʿalā l-kāfirīna ʿasīran on that day true sovereignty will belong to the All-beneficent, and it will be a hard day for the faithless.1

item.title: Al-Furqaan:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَسِيرًا al-mul'ku yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu lilrraḥmāni wakāna yawman ʿalā l-kāfirīna ʿasīran True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day. See 25:25

item.title: Al-Furqaan:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَسِيرًا al-mul'ku yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu lilrraḥmāni wakāna yawman ʿalā l-kāfirīna ʿasīran The kingdom that day in truth shall belong to the Beneficent Lord; and the day for the infidels shall be very hard. See 25:25

item.title: Al-Furqaan:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا wayawma yaʿaḍḍu l-ẓālimu ʿalā yadayhi yaqūlu yālaytanī ittakhadhtu maʿa l-rasūli sabīlan A day when the wrongdoer will bite his hands, saying, 'I wish I had followed the Apostle's way!

item.title: Al-Furqaan:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا wayawma yaʿaḍḍu l-ẓālimu ʿalā yadayhi yaqūlu yālaytanī ittakhadhtu maʿa l-rasūli sabīlan And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands (in regret) he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.1 See 25:25

item.title: Al-Furqaan:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا wayawma yaʿaḍḍu l-ẓālimu ʿalā yadayhi yaqūlu yālaytanī ittakhadhtu maʿa l-rasūli sabīlan And on the day when the unjust one shall bite his hands saying: "Oh! would that I had taken with the Apostle the (same right) path!" Here it is said what the disbelievers in their helplessness would do, i.e., biting their hands as the realisation of their own folly and repentance. The unjust referred to here is one who had gone astray after receiving the guidance, i.e., the unjust among the believers and not of the disbelievers - and the reference is to the rift from the divine guidance after its coming into clear evidence. The fact which is asserted in 3:18. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاوَيْلَتَى لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا yāwaylatā laytanī lam attakhidh fulānan khalīlan Woe to me! I wish I had not taken so and so as a friend!

item.title: Al-Furqaan:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاوَيْلَتَى لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا yāwaylatā laytanī lam attakhidh fulānan khalīlan Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one1 as a friend. See 25:25

item.title: Al-Furqaan:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاوَيْلَتَى لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا yāwaylatā laytanī lam attakhidh fulānan khalīlan Oh! woe is me! would that I had not taken such a (This a warning or a caution against taking as friends anybody and everybody as the leaders of the faith. Those who were not faithful to the Holy Prophet can not be faithful to anyone; only those purified by God (33:33) should be taken as friends for none but the pure can be a medium to reach the Absolute Pure One (God).) one as my friend! To an intelligent student of the Holy Qur'an, these two verses are sufficiently eloquent in the one as warning they contain against holding any such one as a friend who misleads from the Right Path of the faithful attachment to the Holy Prophet Muhammad. A true Muslim has to definitely shun…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْاِنْسَانِ خَذُولًا laqad aḍallanī ʿani l-dhik'ri baʿda idh jāanī wakāna l-shayṭānu lil'insāni khadhūlan Certainly he led me astray from the Reminder after it had come to me, and Satan is a deserter of man.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْاِنْسَانِ خَذُولًا laqad aḍallanī ʿani l-dhik'ri baʿda idh jāanī wakāna l-shayṭānu lil'insāni khadhūlan He led me away from the remembrance1 after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."2 See 25:25

item.title: Al-Furqaan:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْاِنْسَانِ خَذُولًا laqad aḍallanī ʿani l-dhik'ri baʿda idh jāanī wakāna l-shayṭānu lil'insāni khadhūlan He did lead me astray from the Reminder after it had come unto me; and the Satan unto man was ever a detester! See 25:28

item.title: Al-Furqaan:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا waqāla l-rasūlu yārabbi inna qawmī ittakhadhū hādhā l-qur'āna mahjūran And the Apostle will say, 'O my Lord! Indeed my people consigned this Qur'ān to oblivion.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا waqāla l-rasūlu yārabbi inna qawmī ittakhadhū hādhā l-qur'āna mahjūran And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as (a thing) abandoned."1 And the Messenger will say: O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Qur'an (25:30). Thus have We made for every Prophet an enemy among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper (25:31). The Messenger SAW will Complain against His Opponents Allah tells how His Messenger and Prophet Muhammad will say: "O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Qur'an." The idolators would not listen to the Qur'an, as Allah says: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَسْمَعُوا لِهَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَالْغَوْا فِيهِ And those who disbelieve say: "Listen not to this Qur'an, and make noise in the midst of it."…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا waqāla l-rasūlu yārabbi inna qawmī ittakhadhū hādhā l-qur'āna mahjūran And shall say (out) the Apostle (that day) "O' my Lord! Verily my people have held this Qur'an as a vain forsaken (Treated as a thing useless, discarded it) thing!" This is what the Holy Prophet would say on the Day of Judgment about the people becoming indifferent to his teachings. Moses wanted Aaron not only to be merely his aid but also a partner in bearing the burden of the ministry he was charged with, which means Aaron would naturally be entitled to share also the return or the reward from God which the mission would earn for its faithful discharge. And it is said in verse 20:36 that the prayer of Moses was granted,1 that the prayer to God to…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ وَكَفَى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabiyyin ʿaduwwan mina l-muj'rimīna wakafā birabbika hādiyan wanaṣīran That is how for every prophet We assigned an enemy from among the guilty, and your Lord suffices as helper and guide.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ وَكَفَى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabiyyin ʿaduwwan mina l-muj'rimīna wakafā birabbika hādiyan wanaṣīran And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper. See 25:30

item.title: Al-Furqaan:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ وَكَفَى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabiyyin ʿaduwwan mina l-muj'rimīna wakafā birabbika hādiyan wanaṣīran And thus We did appoint for every apostle an enemy from among the guilty ones; But sufficient is thy Lord as a Guide and a Helper (for thee). This is said in the consolation of the Holy Prophet's anxiety for the people abiding themselves by the Word of God (The Holy Qur'an), saying that every apostle of God had his own enemy for only by a contrast with the counter, the excellence of a thing, manifests its sublimity.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً كَذٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا waqāla alladhīna kafarū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi l-qur'ānu jum'latan wāḥidatan kadhālika linuthabbita bihi fuādaka warattalnāhu tartīlan The faithless say, 'Why has not the Qur'ān been sent down to him all at once?' So it is, that We may strengthen your heart with it, and We have recited it [to you] in a measured tone.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً كَذٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا waqāla alladhīna kafarū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi l-qur'ānu jum'latan wāḥidatan kadhālika linuthabbita bihi fuādaka warattalnāhu tartīlan And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus (it is) that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.1 And those who disbelieve say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once" Thus, that We may strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you gradually, in stages (25:32). And no example or parable do they bring, but We reveal to you the truth, and the better explanation thereof (25:33). Those who will be gathered to Hell on their faces, such will be in an evil state, and most astray from the…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً كَذٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا waqāla alladhīna kafarū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi l-qur'ānu jum'latan wāḥidatan kadhālika linuthabbita bihi fuādaka warattalnāhu tartīlan And say those who disbelieve: "Why hast not the Qur'an been sent down upon him all (In a complete form at once.) at one (time)?" Thus (is it revealed) that We may strengthen by it thy (Refers to the Ummah i.e. the Muslims.) heart, and We have recited it (Refer to verse 73:4.) (unto thee) in well-arranged gradual stages. The purpose of the gradual revelation given here is that the peoples' heart may properly understand the meaning and be acquainted with it and follow the divine method of the recitation. Besides, the advantage of the gradual revelation, We shall meet their fallacies1 with the truth and a presentation of the…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا walā yatūnaka bimathalin illā ji'nāka bil-ḥaqi wa-aḥsana tafsīran They do not bring you any poser but that We bring you the truth [in reply to them] and the best exposition.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا walā yatūnaka bimathalin illā ji'nāka bil-ḥaqi wa-aḥsana tafsīran And they do not come to you with an example (i.e., argument) except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation. See 25:32

item.title: Al-Furqaan:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا walā yatūnaka bimathalin illā ji'nāka bil-ḥaqi wa-aḥsana tafsīran And they (the infidels) shall bring not unto thee any (Puzzling argument.) argument, but We shall bring unto thee the truth and the best explanation (of it). See 25:32

item.title: Al-Furqaan:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا alladhīna yuḥ'sharūna ʿalā wujūhihim ilā jahannama ulāika sharrun makānan wa-aḍallu sabīlan Those who will be mustered on their faces toward hell, they are the worse situated and further astray from the [right] way.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا alladhīna yuḥ'sharūna ʿalā wujūhihim ilā jahannama ulāika sharrun makānan wa-aḍallu sabīlan The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in (their) way. See 25:32

item.title: Al-Furqaan:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا alladhīna yuḥ'sharūna ʿalā wujūhihim ilā jahannama ulāika sharrun makānan wa-aḍallu sabīlan Those who shall be gathered upon their faces unto Hell, those shall have the worst place, and straying farther away from the (right) path. See 25:32

item.title: Al-Furqaan:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba wajaʿalnā maʿahu akhāhu hārūna wazīran Certainly We gave Moses the Book and We made Aaron, his brother, accompany him as a minister.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba wajaʿalnā maʿahu akhāhu hārūna wazīran And We had certainly given Musa the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Harun as an assistant. And indeed We gave Musa the Scripture, and placed his brother Harun with him as a helper (25:35). And We said: "Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayat." Then We destroyed them with utter destruction (25:36). And Nuh's people, when they denied the Messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful torment for the wrongdoers (25:37). And (also) 'Ad and Thamud, and the Dwellers of Ar-Rass, and many generations in between (25:38). And for each We put forward examples, and each We brought to utter ruin (25:39). And indeed…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba wajaʿalnā maʿahu akhāhu hārūna wazīran And indeed We gave Moses the Book and We did appoint with him his brother Aaron (as his) assistant (Aider.) . See verse 19:53 in which God by His Mercy gave Moses the aid of Aaron while He commissioned him with apostleship. In verses 20:29 - 20:33, is given the prayer of Moses to grant him the Aid from his own 'Ahl,' i.e., one who is of his own mettle and capacity, i.e., one of his own stock of spiritual excellence. The Holy Prophet was commanded to do it, when he summoned the first assembly of his kith and kin at the command1 and accordingly he appointed Ali as his 'Wazir' and Wasi. Mark, that the words which the Holy Prophet used,…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا faqul'nā idh'habā ilā l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fadammarnāhum tadmīran Then We said, 'Let the two of you go to the people who have denied Our signs.' Then We destroyed them utterly.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا faqul'nā idh'habā ilā l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fadammarnāhum tadmīran And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with (complete) destruction. See 25:35

item.title: Al-Furqaan:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا faqul'nā idh'habā ilā l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fadammarnāhum tadmīran And said We: "Go ye both unto the people who belie Our signs!" so We did destroy them with utter destruction. See 25:35

item.title: Al-Furqaan:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَمَّا كَذَّبُوْۤا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ اٰیَةً وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا waqawma nūḥin lammā kadhabū l-rusula aghraqnāhum wajaʿalnāhum lilnnāsi āyatan wa-aʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna ʿadhāban alīman And Noah's people, We drowned them when they impugned the apostles, and We made them a sign for mankind, and We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَمَّا كَذَّبُوْۤا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ اٰیَةً وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا waqawma nūḥin lammā kadhabū l-rusula aghraqnāhum wajaʿalnāhum lilnnāsi āyatan wa-aʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna ʿadhāban alīman And the people of Nuh - when they denied the messengers,1 We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment. See 25:35

item.title: Al-Furqaan:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَمَّا كَذَّبُوْۤا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ اٰیَةً وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا waqawma nūḥin lammā kadhabū l-rusula aghraqnāhum wajaʿalnāhum lilnnāsi āyatan wa-aʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna ʿadhāban alīman And the people of Noah, when they belied the apostles, We drowned them, and made them a sign for mankind; and We have prepared for the unjust, a painful chastisement. See 25:35

item.title: Al-Furqaan:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا waʿādan wathamūdā wa-aṣḥāba l-rasi waqurūnan bayna dhālika kathīran And 'Ād and Thamūd, and the inhabitants of Rass, and many generations between them.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا waʿādan wathamūdā wa-aṣḥāba l-rasi waqurūnan bayna dhālika kathīran And (We destroyed) ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well1 and many generations between them. See 25:35

item.title: Al-Furqaan:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا waʿādan wathamūdā wa-aṣḥāba l-rasi waqurūnan bayna dhālika kathīran And the (tribes of) 'Ad and Thamud and the inhabitants of Ar-Rass, and generations between them, in a great number. For the people of 'Ad, see verses 7:65 - 7:72, 11:50 - 11:60, 14:9, 25:38, 26:123 - 26:140, 29:38, 41:13 - 41:16, 46:21 - 46:26, 51:41 - 51:42, 53:20, 54:18 - 54:21, 69:4,6-8, 89:6 - 89:8. For the people of Thamud, see verses 7:73 - 7:79, 11:61 - 11:68, 14:9, 15:80 - 15:84, 25:38, 26:141 - 26:159, 27:45 - 27:53, 29:38, 4':i3-i4, 17-18, 5i:43-45, 53:5b 54:2.3-3L 69:4 - 69:5, 89:9, 91:11 - 91:15. 'ar-Rass' lit. well - The commentators have given various accounts of the well and the people attached to it. However, they were people who disobeyed their prophet and were destroyed. (A.P).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا wakullan ḍarabnā lahu l-amthāla wakullan tabbarnā tatbīran For each of them We drew examples, and each We destroyed utterly.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا wakullan ḍarabnā lahu l-amthāla wakullan tabbarnā tatbīran And for each We presented examples (as warnings), and each We destroyed with (total) destruction. See 25:35

item.title: Al-Furqaan:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا wakullan ḍarabnā lahu l-amthāla wakullan tabbarnā tatbīran And unto each of them We did give examples (Lessons – warnings.) and every one (of them) We did destroy with utter extermination. Commentators differ a lot about the stories about the people 'ar-Rass'. Leaving away all the variant legendary about the people of 'ar-Rass' by the other commentators, let us turn to what the Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib says about them, for it is about Ali that the Holy Prophet declared: "I am the City of Knowledge and Ali its Gate." The Eighth Holy Imam Ali Ibn Musa ar-Ridha relates of the Third Holy Imam Husayn Ibn Ali, having said that a man of the Tribe of Tamim came over to Ali and asked: "Who were the people of 'ar-Rass'? Where did they…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَرَوْنَهَا بَلْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا walaqad ataw ʿalā l-qaryati allatī um'ṭirat maṭara l-sawi afalam yakūnū yarawnahā bal kānū lā yarjūna nushūran Certainly they must have passed the town on which an evil shower was rained. Have they not seen it? Rather they did not expect resurrection.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَرَوْنَهَا بَلْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا walaqad ataw ʿalā l-qaryati allatī um'ṭirat maṭara l-sawi afalam yakūnū yarawnahā bal kānū lā yarjūna nushūran And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil (i.e., stones). So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.1 See 25:35

item.title: Al-Furqaan:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَرَوْنَهَا بَلْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا walaqad ataw ʿalā l-qaryati allatī um'ṭirat maṭara l-sawi afalam yakūnū yarawnahā bal kānū lā yarjūna nushūran And indeed they have passed (They have seen – observed.) by the town on which was rained a fatal rain; did they not then see it? (They saw it.) Nay! they hope not to be raised again (after their death). See verses 5:74 - 5:76. About the fate the people of Sodom met as a consequence of their rebellion against the guidance which was given to them through the Apostle Lut. The Quraysh (Qurayshi) used to pass by the ruins of those towns when they go on their commercial journeys beyond the place.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِنْ يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا wa-idhā ra-awka in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī baʿatha l-lahu rasūlan When they see you they just take you in derision: 'Is this the one whom Allah has sent as an apostle!?

item.title: Al-Furqaan:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِنْ يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا wa-idhā ra-awka in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī baʿatha l-lahu rasūlan And when they see you, (O Muḥammad), they take you not except in ridicule, (saying), "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger? And when they see you, they treat you only in mockery (saying): Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a Messenger (25:41). "He would have nearly misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were patient and constant in their worship!" And they will know, when they see the torment, who it is that is most astray from the path (25:42). Have you seen him who has taken as his god his own vain desire Would you then be a guardian over hi (25:43). Or do you…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِنْ يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا wa-idhā ra-awka in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī baʿatha l-lahu rasūlan And when they see thee, they take thee not for aught (Any thing.) but in ridicule; (saying) "What! Is this he whom God hath raised to be an apostle?" See 25:40

item.title: Al-Furqaan:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا in kāda layuḍillunā ʿan ālihatinā lawlā an ṣabarnā ʿalayhā wasawfa yaʿlamūna ḥīna yarawna l-ʿadhāba man aḍallu sabīlan Indeed he was about to lead us astray from our gods, had we not stood by them.' Soon they will know, when they sight the punishment, who is further astray from the [right] way.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا in kāda layuḍillunā ʿan ālihatinā lawlā an ṣabarnā ʿalayhā wasawfa yaʿlamūna ḥīna yarawna l-ʿadhāba man aḍallu sabīlan He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in (worship of) them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in (his) way. See 25:41

item.title: Al-Furqaan:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا in kāda layuḍillunā ʿan ālihatinā lawlā an ṣabarnā ʿalayhā wasawfa yaʿlamūna ḥīna yarawna l-ʿadhāba man aḍallu sabīlan He hath well-nigh led us astray from our gods had we not been adhered to them steadfastly!" And they will know when they see the chastisement, who is straying farther (More.) away from the (right) path. See 25:40

item.title: Al-Furqaan:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنْتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا ara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu afa-anta takūnu ʿalayhi wakīlan Have you seen him who has taken his desire to be his god? Is it your duty to watch over him?

item.title: Al-Furqaan:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنْتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا ara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu afa-anta takūnu ʿalayhi wakīlan Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him? See 25:41

item.title: Al-Furqaan:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنْتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا ara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu afa-anta takūnu ʿalayhi wakīlan Hast thou seen him who taketh his vain inclinations for his god? Wouldst thou then be a guardian over him? See 25:40

item.title: Al-Furqaan:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا am taḥsabu anna aktharahum yasmaʿūna aw yaʿqilūna in hum illā kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu sabīlan Do you suppose that most of them listen or apply reason? They are just like cattle; rather they are further astray from the way.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا am taḥsabu anna aktharahum yasmaʿūna aw yaʿqilūna in hum illā kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu sabīlan Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock.1 Rather, they are (even) more astray in (their) way. See 25:41

item.title: Al-Furqaan:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا am taḥsabu anna aktharahum yasmaʿūna aw yaʿqilūna in hum illā kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu sabīlan Thinkest thou that most of them do hear or understand? they are not but like the cattle; Nay! they are farther astray from the (right) path. See verses 8:55 & 8:56. Those who hear the Word of God and do not believe and those who make the covenant of the belief in God and subsequently break it, are compared to the vilest of the animals - and here it is said to be more straying from the right path than even the animals. Apply this verse to those who knew the Holy Qur'an and the position of the Holy Prophet and yet the moment the Holy Prophet departed from this…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا alam tara ilā rabbika kayfa madda l-ẓila walaw shāa lajaʿalahu sākinan thumma jaʿalnā l-shamsa ʿalayhi dalīlan Have you not regarded how your Lord spreads the twilight?1 (Had He wished He would have made it still.) Then We made the sun a beacon for it.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا alam tara ilā rabbika kayfa madda l-ẓila walaw shāa lajaʿalahu sākinan thumma jaʿalnā l-shamsa ʿalayhi dalīlan Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.1 Have you not seen how your Lord spread the shadow. If He willed, He could have made it still – but We have made the sun its guide (25:45). Then We withdraw it towards Ourselves – a gradual withdrawal (25:46). And it is He Who makes the night a covering for you, and the sleep (as) a repose, and makes the day Nushur (25:47). Evidence of the Existence of the Creator and the Extent of His Power…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا alam tara ilā rabbika kayfa madda l-ẓila walaw shāa lajaʿalahu sākinan thumma jaʿalnā l-shamsa ʿalayhi dalīlan Seest thou (The Prophet addressed for the people.) not unto (the might of) thy Lord, how He extendeth the shadow? And had He willed He would certainly have made it stationary, then We have made the sun to be its guide, (An indication.) The shadow is not absolute darkness or the negation of light. Shadow is the decrease of light caused by opaque object facing the light and due to the movement of the light-giving object the shadow changes in length as otherwise the shadow would retain its length for ever.1 Therefore the gradual rise of the source of light like the sun shortens the length of the…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا thumma qabaḍnāhu ilaynā qabḍan yasīran Then We retract it toward Ourselves, with a gentle retracting.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا thumma qabaḍnāhu ilaynā qabḍan yasīran Then We (retract and) hold it with Us for a brief grasp.1 See 25:45

item.title: Al-Furqaan:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا thumma qabaḍnāhu ilaynā qabḍan yasīran Then We draw it in unto Us, by an easy (gradual) contraction. Some commentators say that the withdrawal of the light of the sun refers to the period of suspension of the heavenly guidance during the period, since the departure of Jesus until the advent of the Holy Prophet, during which period no apostle of God appeared and people were allowed to suffer the consequence of their own rebellious character and conduct particularly against Jesus. And some take this verse as a reference to the miraculous event when the Holy Prophet by the will of the Lord caused the light of the day returned until the people offered their afternoon prayers. (M.S., U.B.)1

item.title: Al-Furqaan:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا wahuwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla libāsan wal-nawma subātan wajaʿala l-nahāra nushūran It is He who made for you the night as a covering and sleep for rest and He made the day a recall to life.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا wahuwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla libāsan wal-nawma subātan wajaʿala l-nahāra nushūran And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing1 and sleep (a means for) rest and has made the day a resurrection.2 See 25:45

item.title: Al-Furqaan:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا wahuwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla libāsan wal-nawma subātan wajaʿala l-nahāra nushūran And He it is who hath made for you the night as a covering, and the sleep a rest, and made the day to rise up again. (45:47) See 25:46

item.title: Al-Furqaan:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا wahuwa alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan ṭahūran And it is He who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy, and We send down from the sky purifying water,

item.title: Al-Furqaan:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا wahuwa alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan ṭahūran And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy (i.e., rainfall), and We send down from the sky pure water. And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy; and We send down pure water from the sky (25:48). That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give to drink thereof many of the cattle and men that We have created (25:49). And indeed We have distributed it among them in order that they may remember the grace of Allah, but most men refuse (out of) gratitude (25:50). This is Also Part of His Complete Power and…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا wahuwa alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan ṭahūran And He it is Who sendeth the winds as the herald of the glad tidings going before His mercy (rain), and We send down from heaven water (Distilled.) pure, 'Thahur' is an exaggerative of 'Tahir,' i.e., pure. The exaggerative gives extra meaning as a thing pure in itself and purifying other things. Thus, it means water, i.e., 'Tahir' pure and 'Mutah'hhir' and purifier. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا linuḥ'yiya bihi baldatan maytan wanus'qiyahu mimmā khalaqnā anʿāman wa-anāsiyya kathīran with which We revive a dead country and provide water to many of the cattle and humans We have created.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا linuḥ'yiya bihi baldatan maytan wanus'qiyahu mimmā khalaqnā anʿāman wa-anāsiyya kathīran That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men. See 25:48

item.title: Al-Furqaan:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا linuḥ'yiya bihi baldatan maytan wanus'qiyahu mimmā khalaqnā anʿāman wa-anāsiyya kathīran That We may give life by it to a dead land, and We give it for drink, out of what We have created, to cattle and men in numbers multiple. See 25:48

item.title: Al-Furqaan:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبٰی أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا walaqad ṣarrafnāhu baynahum liyadhakkarū fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran Certainly We distribute it among them so that they may take admonition. But most people are only intent on ingratitude.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبٰی أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا walaqad ṣarrafnāhu baynahum liyadhakkarū fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded,1 but most of the people refuse except disbelief. See 25:48

item.title: Al-Furqaan:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبٰی أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا walaqad ṣarrafnāhu baynahum liyadhakkarū fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran And indeed We distribute (Lit. 'Sarrasnah' displayed - but the display of the water among mankind is distributing it between them – This stands for the display or the divine grace for the benefit of mankind.) it (water) to them that they may be (thankfully) mindful, but content not the great number of the people but to be thankless. See 25:48

item.title: Al-Furqaan:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَذِيرًا walaw shi'nā labaʿathnā fī kulli qaryatin nadhīran Had We wished, We would have sent a warner to every town.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَذِيرًا walaw shi'nā labaʿathnā fī kulli qaryatin nadhīran And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.1 And had We willed, We would have raised a warner in every town (25:51). So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost endeavor with it (25:52). And it is He Who has let free the two seas, this is palatable and sweet, and that is salty and bitter; and He has set a barrier and a complete partition between them (25:53). And it is He Who has created man from water, and has appointed for him kindred by blood, and kindred by marriage. And your Lord is Ever All-Powerful to do what He wills (25:54). The Universality of the Prophet's Message, How He Was Supported in His Mission…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَذِيرًا walaw shi'nā labaʿathnā fī kulli qaryatin nadhīran And had We willed, certainly had We raised up a warner in every town. See 25:48

item.title: Al-Furqaan:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا falā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wajāhid'hum bihi jihādan kabīran So do not obey the faithless, but wage against them a great jihād with it.1

item.title: Al-Furqaan:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا falā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wajāhid'hum bihi jihādan kabīran So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it (i.e., the Qur’ān) a great striving. See 25:51

item.title: Al-Furqaan:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا falā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wajāhid'hum bihi jihādan kabīran So yield thou (The Prophet addressed for the people.) not to infidels, and strive against them with it a strenuous strife. See 25:48

item.title: Al-Furqaan:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا wahuwa alladhī maraja l-baḥrayni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wajaʿala baynahumā barzakhan waḥij'ran maḥjūran It is He who merged the two seas: this one sweet and agreeable, and that one briny and bitter, and between the two He set a barrier and a forbidding hindrance.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا wahuwa alladhī maraja l-baḥrayni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wajaʿala baynahumā barzakhan waḥij'ran maḥjūran And it is He who has released (simultaneously) the two seas (i.e., bodies of water), one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition. See 25:51

item.title: Al-Furqaan:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا wahuwa alladhī maraja l-baḥrayni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wajaʿala baynahumā barzakhan waḥij'ran maḥjūran And He it is Who hath made the two seas join and flow together, one palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; and yet hath made He between the two a (Refer to verse 27:61. Ar. Barzakh.) barrier, and a barrage impassable. 'Barzakh' is used as in verse 23:100 - meaning a barrier and distance between two extremes. It has been used in three other places here and verse 55:20 to be taken as a line of demarcation. For which there are examples of the flow of the saltish and the sweet water flowing together side by side in the oceans. It may also refer to the mystic…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا wahuwa alladhī khalaqa mina l-māi basharan fajaʿalahu nasaban waṣih'ran wakāna rabbuka qadīran It is He who created the human being from water, then invested him with ties of blood and marriage, and your Lord is all-powerful.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا wahuwa alladhī khalaqa mina l-māi basharan fajaʿalahu nasaban waṣih'ran wakāna rabbuka qadīran And it is He who has created from water (i.e., semen) a human being and made him (a relative by) lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent (concerning creation). See 25:51

item.title: Al-Furqaan:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا wahuwa alladhī khalaqa mina l-māi basharan fajaʿalahu nasaban waṣih'ran wakāna rabbuka qadīran And He it is Who hath created man of water, and made him related in blood and in wedlock; and thy Lord is All- Powerful. One of the famous Sunni commentators states that this verse was revealed about the wedding of the Holy Imam Ali with the Holy Lady Fatima, the daughter of the Holy Prophet. He says that when Fatima reached the marriageable age, besides the other nobles of the town, Abu Bakr, and then Umar and then Abdur Rahtnan, one after another approached the Holy Prophet coveting for the hand of the Holy Prophet's daughter in marriage, but the approach of every one, the Holy Prophet resented; and, at last he said, the question…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuhum walā yaḍurruhum wakāna l-kāfiru ʿalā rabbihi ẓahīran They worship besides Allah that which neither brings them any benefit nor causes them any harm, and the faithless one is ever an abettor against his Lord.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuhum walā yaḍurruhum wakāna l-kāfiru ʿalā rabbihi ẓahīran But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant (to Satan). And they worship besides Allah, that which can neither profit them nor harm them; and the disbeliever is ever a helper against his Lord (25:55). And We have sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner (25:56). Say: No reward do I ask of you for this, save that whosoever wills may take a path to his Lord (25:57). And put your trust in the Ever Living One Who dies not, and glorify His praises, and sufficient is He as the…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
