item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuhum walā yaḍurruhum wakāna l-kāfiru ʿalā rabbihi ẓahīran And yet worship they besides God, (things) which neither profit them nor harm them; And the infidel had (ever) been an aider (of evil) against thy Lord. See 25:54

item.title: Al-Furqaan:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran We did not send you except as a bearer of good news and as a warner.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran And We have not sent you, (O Muḥammad), except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. See 25:55

item.title: Al-Furqaan:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran And We sent thee not (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) but a Bearer of glad tidings and a Warner. See 25:54

item.title: Al-Furqaan:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin illā man shāa an yattakhidha ilā rabbihi sabīlan Say, 'I do not ask you any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes should take the way to his Lord.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin illā man shāa an yattakhidha ilā rabbihi sabīlan Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way." See 25:55

item.title: Al-Furqaan:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin illā man shāa an yattakhidha ilā rabbihi sabīlan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "I ask ye not aught of any recompense (for my (Services of the apostleship.) ministry) save that he, who will, take the way unto his Lord!" It was the case with all other prophets that they had to declare to their people that they did not expect from them any reward or return for their preachings. But in the case of the Holy Prophet an exception has been made in verse 42:23 in making the love of the Near Relative of the Holy Prophet as the reward or the return for his apostolic service. Here makes it clear that the reward asked for is not from…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ وَكَفَى بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا watawakkal ʿalā l-ḥayi alladhī lā yamūtu wasabbiḥ biḥamdihi wakafā bihi bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīran Put your trust in the Living One who does not die, and celebrate His praise. He suffices as one all-aware of the sins of His servants.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ وَكَفَى بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا watawakkal ʿalā l-ḥayi alladhī lā yamūtu wasabbiḥ biḥamdihi wakafā bihi bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīran And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt (Allah) with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, (fully) Aware. See 25:55

item.title: Al-Furqaan:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ وَكَفَى بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا watawakkal ʿalā l-ḥayi alladhī lā yamūtu wasabbiḥ biḥamdihi wakafā bihi bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīran And rely thou on the (Ever) Living One who dieth not, and (Glorify – hallow.) celebrate thou with His praise; and sufficient is He as being All-Aware of the faults of His servants. See 25:57

item.title: Al-Furqaan:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ الرَّحْمَنُ فَسْءَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi l-raḥmānu fasal bihi khabīran He, who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days, and then settled on the Throne, the All-beneficent; so ask someone who is well aware about Him.1

item.title: Al-Furqaan:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ الرَّحْمَنُ فَسْءَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi l-raḥmānu fasal bihi khabīran He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne1 - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed (i.e., the Prophet SAW). See 25:55

item.title: Al-Furqaan:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ الرَّحْمَنُ فَسْءَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi l-raḥmānu fasal bihi khabīran (He) Who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, (Periods.) and is firmly established on the Throne (Ar. the 'Arsh'.) (of Supreme Authority); the Beneficent (God); Ask (The Prophet addressed for the people.) thou about Him (only) from (the one who is) aware. (Refer to verses 3:17 & 14:162.) See 25:57

item.title: Al-Furqaan:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِلرَّحْمَنِ قَالُوْا وَمَا الرَّحْمَنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا wa-idhā qīla lahumu us'judū lilrraḥmāni qālū wamā l-raḥmānu anasjudu limā tamurunā wazādahum nufūran When they are told: 'Prostrate yourselves before the All-beneficent,' they say, 'What is "the All-beneficent"? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whatever you bid us?' And it increases their aversion.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِلرَّحْمَنِ قَالُوْا وَمَا الرَّحْمَنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا wa-idhā qīla lahumu us'judū lilrraḥmāni qālū wamā l-raḥmānu anasjudu limā tamurunā wazādahum nufūran And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion. See 25:55

item.title: Al-Furqaan:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِلرَّحْمَنِ قَالُوْا وَمَا الرَّحْمَنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا wa-idhā qīla lahumu us'judū lilrraḥmāni qālū wamā l-raḥmānu anasjudu limā tamurunā wazādahum nufūran And when it is said unto them: "Prostrate ye in obeisance unto 'Rahman' (the Beneficent, i.e., God)," say they: "Who is 'Rahman' (the Beneficent, i.e., God)? Shall we (Prostration Sunnah.) prostrate in obeisance unto what thou biddest us?" and it (only) addeth to their flight (from the Truth) it is 'Sunnah' that one who recites this verse to get into 'Sijdah' prostration, i.e., bringing the physical body of the individual in line with the state of the submission of the soul.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُنِيرًا tabāraka alladhī jaʿala fī l-samāi burūjan wajaʿala fīhā sirājan waqamaran munīran Blessed is He who appointed houses in the sky and set in it a lamp and a shining moon.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُنِيرًا tabāraka alladhī jaʿala fī l-samāi burūjan wajaʿala fīhā sirājan waqamaran munīran Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a (burning) lamp and luminous moon. Blessed be He Who has placed in the heaven Al-Buruj, and has placed therein a great lamp, and a moon giving light (25:61). And He it is Who has put the night and the day in succession (Khilfatan), for such who desires to remember or desires to show his gratitude (25:62). Mentioning the Might and Power of Allah Here Allah glorifies Himself and praises the beauty He created in the heavens of Al-Buruj, the giant stars, according to the view of Mujahid, Sa'id bin Jubayr, Abu Salih, Al-Hasan and Qatadah. This is like the Ayah: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُنِيرًا tabāraka alladhī jaʿala fī l-samāi burūjan wajaʿala fīhā sirājan waqamaran munīran Blessed is He who made in the heavens the constellations (The Zodiac lines.) and made in it a lamp (the sun) and the moon illuminating. 'Buruj' - obviously the reference is to the twelve Zodiac signs - Though the sun and the moon are not actually moving in them - The line of their movements coincide with those signs - Thus the figurative use of 'Therein.' (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا wahuwa alladhī jaʿala al-layla wal-nahāra khil'fatan liman arāda an yadhakkara aw arāda shukūran It is He who made the night and the day alternate for one who desires to take admonition, or desires to give thanks.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا wahuwa alladhī jaʿala al-layla wal-nahāra khil'fatan liman arāda an yadhakkara aw arāda shukūran And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude. See 25:61

item.title: Al-Furqaan:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا wahuwa alladhī jaʿala al-layla wal-nahāra khil'fatan liman arāda an yadhakkara aw arāda shukūran And He it is who hath made the night and the day to succeed each other for him who desireth to reflect or desireth to be thankful. See 25:61

item.title: Al-Furqaan:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوْا سَلَامًا waʿibādu l-raḥmāni alladhīna yamshūna ʿalā l-arḍi hawnan wa-idhā khāṭabahumu l-jāhilūna qālū salāman The servants of the All-beneficent are those who walk humbly on the earth, and when the ignorant address them, say, 'Peace!'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوْا سَلَامًا waʿibādu l-raḥmāni alladhīna yamshūna ʿalā l-arḍi hawnan wa-idhā khāṭabahumu l-jāhilūna qālū salāman And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily,1 and when the ignorant address them (harshly), they say (words of) peace.2 And the servants of the Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth Hawna, and when the foolish address them they say; "Salama (25:63). And those who spend the night in worship of their Lord, prostrate and standing (25:64). And those who say: "Our Lord! Avert from us the torment of Hell. Verily, its torment is ever an inseparable, permanent punishment (25:65). Evil indeed it is as an abode and as a place to rest in (25:66). And those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor stingy,…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوْا سَلَامًا waʿibādu l-raḥmāni alladhīna yamshūna ʿalā l-arḍi hawnan wa-idhā khāṭabahumu l-jāhilūna qālū salāman And the servants of the Beneficent (God) are they who walk on the earth humbly; and when address them the ignorants, say they: Salam (Note the Best answer to the 'jahil' i.e., the adamnat ignorant ones.) (Peace). The Sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq said, here is meant the man who walks with his natural gait without the least affectation of pride or any show of his physical stature or his costly costumes. Note that a Muslim has been ordained to return the goodness of wishing the one who might, out of ignorance, insult him. Once a ruffian sort of a man met the Fourth Holy Imam Ali Ibn al Husayn al-Zain al-Abidin and began…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا wa-alladhīna yabītūna lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyāman Those who spend the night for their Lord, prostrating and standing [in worship].

item.title: Al-Furqaan:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا wa-alladhīna yabītūna lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyāman And those who spend (part of) the night to their Lord prostrating and standing (in prayer). See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا wa-alladhīna yabītūna lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyāman And those who pass the night in prostrating (Minimum is the 'Tahajjud' prayers - How much it is commended by the Lord.) (in obeisance) unto their Lord and standing. See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā iṣ'rif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannama inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāman Those who say, 'Our Lord! Turn away from us the punishment of hell. Indeed its punishment is enduring.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā iṣ'rif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannama inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāman And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering. See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā iṣ'rif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannama inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāman And those who say (pray): "O' Our Lord! Turn Thou away from us the torment of the Hell, verily the torment of it is a lasting affliction." See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا innahā sāat mus'taqarran wamuqāman Indeed it is an evil abode and place.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا innahā sāat mus'taqarran wamuqāman Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence." See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا innahā sāat mus'taqarran wamuqāman Verily, it is an evil abode and (an evil) station. See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوْۤا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوْۤا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا wa-alladhīna idhā anfaqū lam yus'rifū walam yaqturū wakāna bayna dhālika qawāman Those who, when spending, are neither wasteful nor tightfisted, and moderation lies between these [extremes].

item.title: Al-Furqaan:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوْۤا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوْۤا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا wa-alladhīna idhā anfaqū lam yus'rifū walam yaqturū wakāna bayna dhālika qawāman And (they are) those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, (justly) moderate. See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوْۤا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوْۤا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا wa-alladhīna idhā anfaqū lam yus'rifū walam yaqturū wakāna bayna dhālika qawāman And those who when they spend, are neither extravagant (Moderation in spending one's own well earned wealth avoiding waste.) and nor niggardly but are stationed between the two (extremes). See 25:63

item.title: Al-Furqaan:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا wa-alladhīna lā yadʿūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara walā yaqtulūna l-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi walā yaznūna waman yafʿal dhālika yalqa athāman Those who do not invoke another god besides Allah, and do not kill a soul [whose life] Allah has made inviolable, except with due cause, and do not commit fornication. (Whoever does that shall encounter its retribution,

item.title: Al-Furqaan:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا wa-alladhīna lā yadʿūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara walā yaqtulūna l-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi walā yaznūna waman yafʿal dhālika yalqa athāman And those who do not invoke1 with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden (to be killed), except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty. And those who invoke not any other god along with Allah, nor kill such person as Allah has forbidden, except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse – and whoever does this shall receive Athama (25:68). The torment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا wa-alladhīna lā yadʿūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara walā yaqtulūna l-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi walā yaznūna waman yafʿal dhālika yalqa athāman And those who call not with God any other gods, and slay not a soul which God hath forbidden (to do it) save with a right (to do so), and who commit not adultery; and whosoever doeth this shall find a requital of the sin, From this clause up to verse 25:71 should be taken as parenthetic. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِیْهِ مُهَانًا yuḍāʿaf lahu l-ʿadhābu yawma l-qiyāmati wayakhlud fīhi muhānan the punishment being doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection. In it he will abide in humiliation forever,

item.title: Al-Furqaan:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِیْهِ مُهَانًا yuḍāʿaf lahu l-ʿadhābu yawma l-qiyāmati wayakhlud fīhi muhānan Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated. See 25:68

item.title: Al-Furqaan:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِیْهِ مُهَانًا yuḍāʿaf lahu l-ʿadhābu yawma l-qiyāmati wayakhlud fīhi muhānan For him shall be doubled, the torment on the Day of Resurrection, and for ever shall they abide in it, in ignominy See 25:68

item.title: Al-Furqaan:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ʿamalan ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yubaddilu l-lahu sayyiātihim ḥasanātin wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman excepting those who repent, attain faith, and act righteously. For such, Allah will replace their misdeeds with good deeds,1 and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ʿamalan ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yubaddilu l-lahu sayyiātihim ḥasanātin wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful. See 25:68

item.title: Al-Furqaan:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ʿamalan ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yubaddilu l-lahu sayyiātihim ḥasanātin wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman Save he who turneth repentant (Repents.) and believeth and doeth good deeds; then (Repentant ones.) these are they who, God changeth (their) evil deeds to good ones; And God is Oft-Forgiving, All-Merciful. This verse gives out the value of repentance on the part of a sinner and how far the All-Merciful Lord turns merciful to the sinner, not only to wipe out the sins of a repentant sinner but also to grant goodness in the place of those sins, provided one repents and amends his conduct - God by His mercy transforms the repentants nature from being vicious to virtuous.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًا waman tāba waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-innahu yatūbu ilā l-lahi matāban And whoever repents and acts righteously indeed turns to Allah with due penitence).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًا waman tāba waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-innahu yatūbu ilā l-lahi matāban And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with (accepted) repentance. See 25:68

item.title: Al-Furqaan:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًا waman tāba waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-innahu yatūbu ilā l-lahi matāban And whosoever repenteth and doeth good and verily turneth he unto God a (sincere) turning, See 25:70

item.title: Al-Furqaan:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوْۤا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوْۤا كِرَامًا wa-alladhīna lā yashhadūna l-zūra wa-idhā marrū bil-laghwi marrū kirāman Those who do not give false testimony,1 and when they come upon vain talk, pass by nobly.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوْۤا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوْۤا كِرَامًا wa-alladhīna lā yashhadūna l-zūra wa-idhā marrū bil-laghwi marrū kirāman And (they are) those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity. And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity (25:72). And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayat of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat (25:73). And those who say: Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of those who have Taqwa (25:74). More Attributes of the Servants of the Most Gracious These are further attributes of the servants of the Most Gracious. They do not…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوْۤا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوْۤا كِرَامًا wa-alladhīna lā yashhadūna l-zūra wa-idhā marrū bil-laghwi marrū kirāman And those who bear not witness to what is false, and when pass they by what is vain, pass they in dignity. From here downward it is conjunctive in continuation of verse 25:63. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوْۤا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا wa-alladhīna idhā dhukkirū biāyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrū ʿalayhā ṣumman waʿum'yānan Those who, when reminded of the signs of their Lord, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوْۤا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا wa-alladhīna idhā dhukkirū biāyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrū ʿalayhā ṣumman waʿum'yānan And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind. See 25:72

item.title: Al-Furqaan:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوْۤا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا wa-alladhīna idhā dhukkirū biāyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrū ʿalayhā ṣumman waʿum'yānan And those who, when admonish ed by the signs of their Lord, fall not down thereat deaf and blind. See 25:72

item.title: Al-Furqaan:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wadhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wa-ij'ʿalnā lil'muttaqīna imāman And those who say, 'Our Lord! Grant us comfort in our spouses and descendants, and make us _imam_s of the Godwary.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wadhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wa-ij'ʿalnā lil'muttaqīna imāman And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes1 and make us a leader (i.e., example) for the righteous." See 25:72

item.title: Al-Furqaan:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wadhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wa-ij'ʿalnā lil'muttaqīna imāman And those who (Pray.) say "O' Our Lord! Grant us from our wives and our offspring the joy of our eyes, and make us for the pious (The pious ones. Refer to verse 2:124.) ones (their) (Those who guard themselves against evil.) Imams" The Sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq said, by this verse are meant the holy Ahl al-Bayt of whose issues one after another were raised the Imams. From verse 25:63 up to here the descriptions given are of such virtuous and righteous personalities who have all the right to pray to God to appoint them as leaders (Imams) or the pious ones. This is in conformity with the prayer of…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا ulāika yuj'zawna l-ghur'fata bimā ṣabarū wayulaqqawna fīhā taḥiyyatan wasalāman Those shall be rewarded with sublime abodes for their patience, and they shall be met there with greetings and 'Peace,'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا ulāika yuj'zawna l-ghur'fata bimā ṣabarū wayulaqqawna fīhā taḥiyyatan wasalāman Those will be awarded the Chamber1 for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and (words of) peace. Those will be rewarded with the highest place because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect (25:75). Abiding therein – excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to rest in (25:76). Say: My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied. So the torment will be yours forever (25:77). The Reward of the Servants of the Most Gracious, and a Warning to the People of Makkah After mentioning the beautiful attributes of His believing servants, and…

item.title: Al-Furqaan:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا ulāika yuj'zawna l-ghur'fata bimā ṣabarū wayulaqqawna fīhā taḥiyyatan wasalāman These shall be rewarded with the high stations (in Paradise) for their patience, and they shall meet therein with honours and salutation, See 25:74

item.title: Al-Furqaan:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا khālidīna fīhā ḥasunat mus'taqarran wamuqāman to abide in them [forever], an excellent abode and place.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا khālidīna fīhā ḥasunat mus'taqarran wamuqāman Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence. See 25:75

item.title: Al-Furqaan:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا khālidīna fīhā ḥasunat mus'taqarran wamuqāman Abiding therein; Excellent the abode, and the resting place. See 25:74

item.title: Al-Furqaan:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا qul mā yaʿba-u bikum rabbī lawlā duʿāukum faqad kadhabtum fasawfa yakūnu lizāman Say, 'What store my Lord would set by you were it not for your supplication?1 But you impugned [me and my advice], so that will continue to haunt you.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا qul mā yaʿba-u bikum rabbī lawlā duʿāukum faqad kadhabtum fasawfa yakūnu lizāman Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?"1 For you (disbelievers) have denied, so it (i.e., your denial) is going to be adherent.2 See 25:75

item.title: Al-Furqaan:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا qul mā yaʿba-u bikum rabbī lawlā duʿāukum faqad kadhabtum fasawfa yakūnu lizāman Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto the disbelievers: "My Lord would (also) care not for you had it not been your prayer (unto Him), but ye indeed have belied (the Truth), and soon ye shall be (in) the grip (of the inevitable) (Of the punishment.)" The grace and the excellence of a man depends upon his or her being prayerful and suppliant to the Lord. It is said that God addresses the human beings saying, "O' Man, I created not thee for My needs but to bless thee with thy needs." At the end of each prayer man must be asking for the bounties of the Lord. In this brief statement Qur'an points out the…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Mīm:

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Meem.1 غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ The Forgiver of sin, the Acceptor of repentance, means, He forgives sins that have been committed in the past, and He accepts repentance for sins that may be committed in the future, from the one who repents and submits to Him. شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ the Severe in punishment, means, to the one who persists in transgression and prefers the life of this world, who stubbornly turns away from the commands of Allah and commits sin. This is like the Ayah: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ - وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ Declare unto My servants that truly I am the Oft-Forgiving, the Most-Merciful. And that My torment is indeed the most painful torment. (15:49-50) These two attributes (mercy and punishment) are often mentioned together in the Qur'an, so that people will remain…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ha. Mim. (H. M.) Ha Mim (H. M.) This Sura and the following six other suras begin with these two letter symbols (Ha Mim - H. M.) Interpretations of 'Ḥuruf al-Muqatta'at' the letter-symbols, the use of which is peculiar only to Qur'an, are mere conjectures.1 They are close secrets known only to God's chosen ones. The Holy Prophet on being asked by a man about these two letters Ha Mim, said - It is a secret between 'Rahman' (The Beneficent God) and His Apostle 'Muhammad'. However, it is universally acknowledged that the regular recital of this chapter has been highly commended by the Holy Prophet and the holy Imams saying that the reciter of this sura will be blessed with protection against his enemies, with abundance in his sustenance and the pardon of his sins.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-knowing,

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi The revelation of the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing. See 40:1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi The descent (Revelation) of the Book is from God, the Almighty, All-Knowing, See 40:1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ ghāfiri l-dhanbi waqābili l-tawbi shadīdi l-ʿiqābi dhī l-ṭawli lā ilāha illā huwa ilayhi l-maṣīru forgiver of sins and acceptor of repentance, severe in retribution, [yet] all-bountiful, there is no god except Him, [and] toward Him is the destination.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ ghāfiri l-dhanbi waqābili l-tawbi shadīdi l-ʿiqābi dhī l-ṭawli lā ilāha illā huwa ilayhi l-maṣīru The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination. See 40:1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ ghāfiri l-dhanbi waqābili l-tawbi shadīdi l-ʿiqābi dhī l-ṭawli lā ilāha illā huwa ilayhi l-maṣīru The Forgiver of (every) sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Severe to chastise, the Lord of bounty; There is no god but He; unto Him is the ultimate end of the (life) journey (of everything). See 40:1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلَادِ mā yujādilu fī āyāti l-lahi illā alladhīna kafarū falā yaghrur'ka taqallubuhum fī l-bilādi No one disputes the signs of Allah except the faithless. So do not be misled by their bustle in the towns.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلَادِ mā yujādilu fī āyāti l-lahi illā alladhīna kafarū falā yaghrur'ka taqallubuhum fī l-bilādi No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their (uninhibited) movement throughout the land. None disputes in the Ayat of Allah but those who disbelieve. So let not their ability of going about here and there through the land (for their purposes) deceive you (40:4). The people of Nuh and the groups after them denied before these; and every nation plotted against their Messenger to seize him, and disputed by means of falsehood to refute therewith the truth. So I seized them, and how was My punishment (40:5). Thus has the Word of your Lord been justified against those who disbelieved, that they will be…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلَادِ mā yujādilu fī āyāti l-lahi illā alladhīna kafarū falā yaghrur'ka taqallubuhum fī l-bilādi Dispute not about the signs of God save those who disbelieve, so (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) let not their going (In pomp and show.) to and from in the cities deceive thee! (The Prophet addressed for his followers.) See 40:1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَالْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ وَجَادَلُوْۤا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wal-aḥzābu min baʿdihim wahammat kullu ummatin birasūlihim liyakhudhūhu wajādalū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa fa-akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna ʿiqābi The people of Noah denied before them and the [heathen] factions [who came] after them. Every nation attempted to lay hands on their apostle, and disputed erroneously to refute the truth. Then I seized them; so how was My retribution?!

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَالْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ وَجَادَلُوْۤا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wal-aḥzābu min baʿdihim wahammat kullu ummatin birasūlihim liyakhudhūhu wajādalū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa fa-akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna ʿiqābi The people of Nuh denied before them and the (disbelieving) factions after them, and every nation intended (a plot) for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by (using) falsehood to (attempt to) invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how (terrible) was My penalty. See 40:4

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَالْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ وَجَادَلُوْۤا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wal-aḥzābu min baʿdihim wahammat kullu ummatin birasūlihim liyakhudhūhu wajādalū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa fa-akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna ʿiqābi Did belie the people of Noah before them and the parties after them, and did scheme (design – plotted.) every people against their apostle that they may seize him and they disputed by the falsehood that they might by it render into naught the truth, so I did seize them; and how (terrible) was then My retribution? See 40:1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ wakadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna kafarū annahum aṣḥābu l-nāri That is how the word of your Lord became due concerning the faithless, that they shall be inmates of the Fire.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ wakadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna kafarū annahum aṣḥābu l-nāri And thus has the word (i.e., decree) of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire. See 40:4

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ wakadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna kafarū annahum aṣḥābu l-nāri And thus did prove true the sentence (The word.) of thy Lord against those who did disbelieve that they are the inmates of the fire. See 40:1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوْۤا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ alladhīna yaḥmilūna l-ʿarsha waman ḥawlahu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayu'minūna bihi wayastaghfirūna lilladhīna āmanū rabbanā wasiʿ'ta kulla shayin raḥmatan waʿil'man fa-igh'fir lilladhīna tābū wa-ittabaʿū sabīlaka waqihim ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi Those who bear the Throne, and those around it, celebrate the praise of their Lord and have faith in Him, and they plead for forgiveness for the faithful: 'Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your way and save them from the punishment of hell.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوْۤا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ alladhīna yaḥmilūna l-ʿarsha waman ḥawlahu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayu'minūna bihi wayastaghfirūna lilladhīna āmanū rabbanā wasiʿ'ta kulla shayin raḥmatan waʿil'man fa-igh'fir lilladhīna tābū wa-ittabaʿū sabīlaka waqihim ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi Those (angels) who carry the Throne and those around it exalt (Allah) with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, (saying), "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire. Those (angels) who bear the Throne (of Allah) and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, and believe in Him, and ask forgiveness for those…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوْۤا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ alladhīna yaḥmilūna l-ʿarsha waman ḥawlahu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayu'minūna bihi wayastaghfirūna lilladhīna āmanū rabbanā wasiʿ'ta kulla shayin raḥmatan waʿil'man fa-igh'fir lilladhīna tābū wa-ittabaʿū sabīlaka waqihim ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi Those who bear the 'Arsh' (The Throne of Supreme Authority.) and those around it celebrate (Hallow.) the praise of their Lord and believe in Him and seek forgiveness for those who believe in Him (saying): "O' Our Lord! Thou comprehendeth all things in (Thy) mercy and knowledge, therefore forgive Thou those who turn (unto Thee) and follow Thy way, and save them from the torment of the Hell:" 'Arsh' i.e., The Throne or the Seat or the Centre of God's Supreme Authority. The throne of a…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ rabbanā wa-adkhil'hum jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿadttahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Our Lord! Admit them into the Gardens of Eden, which You have promised them, along with whoever is righteous among their forebears, their spouses and their descendants.1 Indeed You are the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ rabbanā wa-adkhil'hum jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿadttahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 40:7

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ rabbanā wa-adkhil'hum jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿadttahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu O' Our Lord! Admit them into the ever-blissful gardens which Thou hast promised unto them and those who do good from their fathers, and, their wives, and their children; for Thou art the Almighty, the All-Wise! See 40:7

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَنْ تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ waqihimu l-sayiāti waman taqi l-sayiāti yawma-idhin faqad raḥim'tahu wadhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu Save them from the ills; and whomever You save from the ills that day,1 You will have had mercy upon him, and that is the great success.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَنْ تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ waqihimu l-sayiāti waman taqi l-sayiāti yawma-idhin faqad raḥim'tahu wadhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu And protect them from the evil consequences (of their deeds). And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment." See 40:7

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَنْ تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ waqihimu l-sayiāti waman taqi l-sayiāti yawma-idhin faqad raḥim'tahu wadhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu And keep (Protect.) them from evil: and whomsoever keepest thou from evil, this day indeed Thou hast bestowed mercy on him, and that, it is a Mighty Achievement. See 40:7

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ مَقْتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ inna alladhīna kafarū yunādawna lamaqtu l-lahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'ʿawna ilā l-īmāni fatakfurūna Indeed it will be proclaimed to the faithless: 'Surely Allah's outrage [towards you] is greater than your outrage towards yourselves, as you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ مَقْتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ inna alladhīna kafarū yunādawna lamaqtu l-lahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'ʿawna ilā l-īmāni fatakfurūna Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allah for you was (even) greater than your hatred of yourselves (this Day in Hell) when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved (i.e., refused)." Those who disbelieve will be addressed: Indeed, Allah's aversion was greater towards you than your aversion toward yourselves, when you were called to the Faith but you used to refuse (40:10). They will say: "Our Lord! You have made us to die twice, and You have given us life twice! Now we confess our sins, then is there any way to get out? (40:11). (It will be said): "This is because, when Allah Alone…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ مَقْتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ inna alladhīna kafarū yunādawna lamaqtu l-lahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'ʿawna ilā l-īmāni fatakfurūna Verily, those who disbelieve, unto them shall a voice cry: "Certainly, God's hatred (of you) is greater than your hatred of yourselves when ye were called upon unto the faith and ye did disbelieve!" Hatred of yourselves means the hatred of one another or it refers to the psychological state when one realises his failure due to his misdeeds, when he feels a sort of hatred towards himself. Such a case in this life sometimes causes suicide. This kind of hatred may refer to what the individual would feel at his disappointment in the life hereafter. The closing adverbial clause, refers to the time of hatred, then it supports the…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَى خُرُوجٍ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ qālū rabbanā amattanā ith'natayni wa-aḥyaytanā ith'natayni fa-iʿ'tarafnā bidhunūbinā fahal ilā khurūjin min sabīlin They will say, 'Our Lord! Twice did You make us die, and twice did You give us life. We admit our sins. Is there any way out [from this plight]?'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَى خُرُوجٍ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ qālū rabbanā amattanā ith'natayni wa-aḥyaytanā ith'natayni fa-iʿ'tarafnā bidhunūbinā fahal ilā khurūjin min sabīlin They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?" See 40:10

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَى خُرُوجٍ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ qālū rabbanā amattanā ith'natayni wa-aḥyaytanā ith'natayni fa-iʿ'tarafnā bidhunūbinā fahal ilā khurūjin min sabīlin They shall say: "O' our Lord! Twice didst thou cause us to die, and twice didst Thou give us life, and (now) we do confess our sins: Is there then a way to get out (of this)?" The 'First death' refers to the nothingness or the state of non-existence from which man was first brought into existence1 and the 'Second death' is the cessation of the life in this world. The 'First life' is the life in this world and the 'Second life'. The Resurrection after death.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِنْ يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ dhālikum bi-annahu idhā duʿiya l-lahu waḥdahu kafartum wa-in yush'rak bihi tu'minū fal-ḥuk'mu lillahi l-ʿaliyi l-kabīri This [plight of yours] is because, when Allah was invoked alone, you would disbelieve, but if partners were ascribed to Him you would believe. So the judgment belongs to Allah, the All-exalted, the All-great.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِنْ يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ dhālikum bi-annahu idhā duʿiya l-lahu waḥdahu kafartum wa-in yush'rak bihi tu'minū fal-ḥuk'mu lillahi l-ʿaliyi l-kabīri (They will be told), "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah, the Most High, the Grand." See 40:10

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِنْ يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ dhālikum bi-annahu idhā duʿiya l-lahu waḥdahu kafartum wa-in yush'rak bihi tu'minū fal-ḥuk'mu lillahi l-ʿaliyi l-kabīri This (hath befallen you) for when God alone was called (To submit to God's Absolute Sovereignty and Authority.) upon, ye did disbelieve, and when associates were assigned unto Him, ye believed; And (all) authority (Today His absolute authority is manifested.) is God's, the Highest, the Greatest. See 40:11

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ رِزْقًا وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُنِيبُ huwa alladhī yurīkum āyātihi wayunazzilu lakum mina l-samāi riz'qan wamā yatadhakkaru illā man yunību It is He who shows you His signs and sends down for you provision from the sky. Yet no one takes admonition except him who returns penitently [to Allah].

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ رِزْقًا وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُنِيبُ huwa alladhī yurīkum āyātihi wayunazzilu lakum mina l-samāi riz'qan wamā yatadhakkaru illā man yunību It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back (in repentance). See 40:10

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ رِزْقًا وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُنِيبُ huwa alladhī yurīkum āyātihi wayunazzilu lakum mina l-samāi riz'qan wamā yatadhakkaru illā man yunību He it is Who showeth you His signs and sendeth down for you from the heaven - sustenance; but payeth not heed save he who turneth (unto Him). See 40:11

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَادْعُوْۤا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ fa-id'ʿū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna walaw kariha l-kāfirūna So supplicate Allah, putting exclusive faith in Him, though the faithless should be averse.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَادْعُوْۤا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ fa-id'ʿū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna walaw kariha l-kāfirūna So invoke Allah, (being) sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it. See 40:10

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَادْعُوْۤا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ fa-id'ʿū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna walaw kariha l-kāfirūna So call ye upon God, devoting religion exclusively unto Him, though averse (Refer to verse 9:33.) be the dis believers. See 40:11

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ rafīʿu l-darajāti dhū l-ʿarshi yul'qī l-rūḥa min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi liyundhira yawma l-talāqi Raiser of ranks, Lord of the Throne, He casts the Spirit of His command upon whomever of His servants that He wishes, that he may warn [people] of the Day of Encounter.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ rafīʿu l-darajāti dhū l-ʿarshi yul'qī l-rūḥa min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi liyundhira yawma l-talāqi (He is) the Exalted above (all) degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command (i.e., revelation) upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting. (He is Allah) Owner of high ranks and degrees, the Owner of the Throne. He sends the revelation by His command to any of His servants He wills, that he may warn of the Day of Mutual Meeting (40:15). The Day when they will come out, nothing of them will be hidden from Allah. Whose is the kingdom this Day? It is Allah's, the One, the Irresistible (40:16). This Day shall every person be…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ rafīʿu l-darajāti dhū l-ʿarshi yul'qī l-rūḥa min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi liyundhira yawma l-talāqi The Exalter of the ranks, the Lord of 'Arsh' (Refer to verse 58:11.) (the Supreme Authority); Causeth (Refer to verse 42:52.) forth He the spirit at His own behest on whomsoever He willeth of His servants, that he (i.e., His Servant i.e., the Apostle.) may warn (men) of the day of meeting, Here and in verse 42:52 - means the divine light proceeding from God's command, (i.e., attention) cast on the heart of the servant whom He wills. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ هُمْ بَارِزُونَ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ yawma hum bārizūna lā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min'hum shayon limani l-mul'ku l-yawma lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri The day when they will emerge [from their graves], nothing about them will be hidden from Allah. 'To whom does the sovereignty belong today?' 'To Allah, the One, the All-paramount!'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ هُمْ بَارِزُونَ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ yawma hum bārizūna lā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min'hum shayon limani l-mul'ku l-yawma lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah. To whom belongs (all) sovereignty this Day? To Allah, the One, the Prevailing.1 See 40:15

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ هُمْ بَارِزُونَ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ yawma hum bārizūna lā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min'hum shayon limani l-mul'ku l-yawma lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri (Of) the Day when they shall come forth (from their graves), when naught about them shall be hidden from God. (A voice shall ask): "Whose is the kingdom this day? (It is) God's, the One, the Subduer (absolute)!" This is true of all creatures on the Total Resurrection and it is also true about the individuals who have reached the state of direct communion with God before the Total Resurrection viz. the apostles. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ al-yawma tuj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat lā ẓul'ma l-yawma inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi 'Today every soul shall be requited for what it has earned. There will be no injustice today. Indeed Allah is swift at reckoning.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ al-yawma tuj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat lā ẓul'ma l-yawma inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account. See 40:15

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ al-yawma tuj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat lā ẓul'ma l-yawma inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi This day shall every soul be recompensed for what it hath earned; No injustice (shall be done on the Day); Verily God is quick in reckoning. 'Swift in taking account' - Once a man asked the First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib as to how God would take account of all men at one and the same time. The Holy Imam replied, "As He provides all men and also every other living being with their sustenance at one and the same time."

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْءَازِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-āzifati idhi l-qulūbu ladā l-ḥanājiri kāẓimīna mā lilẓẓālimīna min ḥamīmin walā shafīʿin yuṭāʿu Warn them of the Imminent Day1 when the hearts will be at the throats, choking with suppressed agony, [and] the wrongdoers will have no sympathizer, nor any intercessor who might be heard.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْءَازِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-āzifati idhi l-qulūbu ladā l-ḥanājiri kāẓimīna mā lilẓẓālimīna min ḥamīmin walā shafīʿin yuṭāʿu And warn them, (O Muḥammad), of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled (with distress). For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor (who is) obeyed. And warn them of the Day that is drawing near, when the hearts will be at the throats Kazimin. There will be no friend, nor an intercessor for the wrongdoers, who could be given heed to (40:18). Allah knows the fraud of the eyes, and all that the breasts conceal (40:19). And Allah judges with truth, while those to whom they invoke besides Him, cannot judge anything. Certainly, Allah! He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer (40:20). Warning…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْءَازِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-āzifati idhi l-qulūbu ladā l-ḥanājiri kāẓimīna mā lilẓẓālimīna min ḥamīmin walā shafīʿin yuṭāʿu And (thou) warn them, then, of the approaching Day, when (men's) hearts shall rise (A figurative expression of utmost fear. (A.P.).) up to their throats choking; For the unjust (i.e., Those not unjust will have friends and intercessors.) there shall not be any sincere friend nor an intercessor who shall prevail. See 40:17

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ yaʿlamu khāinata l-aʿyuni wamā tukh'fī l-ṣudūru He knows the treachery of the eyes,1 and what the breasts hide.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ yaʿlamu khāinata l-aʿyuni wamā tukh'fī l-ṣudūru He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal. See 40:18

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ yaʿlamu khāinata l-aʿyuni wamā tukh'fī l-ṣudūru He knoweth the deceit (Treacherous look.) of the eye, and what the breasts conceal. 'Deceiving with the eye' God's All-Comprehending and All-Pervading knowledge penetrates through all hidden mysteries. God knows even the movement of the eye which could see things stealthily which it should not see.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَقْضِي بِالْحَقِّ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَيْءٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ wal-lahu yaqḍī bil-ḥaqi wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yaqḍūna bishayin inna l-laha huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru Allah judges with justice,1 while those whom they invoke besides Him do not judge by anything. Indeed it is Allah who is the All-hearing, the All-seeing.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَقْضِي بِالْحَقِّ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَيْءٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ wal-lahu yaqḍī bil-ḥaqi wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yaqḍūna bishayin inna l-laha huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru And Allah judges with truth, while those they invoke1 besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allah - He is the Hearing, the Seeing. See 40:18

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَقْضِي بِالْحَقِّ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَيْءٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ wal-lahu yaqḍī bil-ḥaqi wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yaqḍūna bishayin inna l-laha huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru And God judgeth with truth; and those whom they call upon besides Him can judge not any thing; Verily God is the All-Hearing, (The Hearer.) the All-Seeing. (The Seer.) See 40:19

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوْۤا هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَاقٍ awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna kānū min qablihim kānū hum ashadda min'hum quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim wamā kāna lahum mina l-lahi min wāqin Have they not traveled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? They were greater than them in might and with respect to the effects [they left] in the land. But then Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no defender against Allah['s punishment].

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوْۤا هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَاقٍ awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna kānū min qablihim kānū hum ashadda min'hum quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim wamā kāna lahum mina l-lahi min wāqin Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allah seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allah any protector. Have they not traveled in the land and seen what was the end of those who were before them? They were superior to them in strength, and in the traces in the land.…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوْۤا هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَاقٍ awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna kānū min qablihim kānū hum ashadda min'hum quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim wamā kāna lahum mina l-lahi min wāqin What! Have not they travelled in the earth and seen how (destructive) hath been the end of those who were before them? (though) They were mightier in strength than these and in their relics (Traces.) in the earth, but God seized them (with destruction) for their sins; and there was not for them any shelter (Refuge.) against (the wrath of) God. See 40:19

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَكَفَرُوْۤا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ dhālika bi-annahum kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti fakafarū fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu innahu qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqābi That was because their apostles used to bring them manifest proofs, but they defied [them]. So Allah seized them. Indeed He is all-strong, severe in retribution.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَكَفَرُوْۤا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ dhālika bi-annahum kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti fakafarū fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu innahu qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqābi That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allah seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment. See 40:21

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَكَفَرُوْۤا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ dhālika bi-annahum kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti fakafarū fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu innahu qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqābi This, because there hath come unto them their apostles with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so did seize them God; Verily He is All-Strong, Vehement in retribution. See 40:19

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs and a manifest authority

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin And We did certainly send Musa with Our signs and a clear authority.1 And indeed We sent Musa with Our Ayat, and a manifest authority (40:23). To Fir'awn, Haman and Qarun, but they called (him): A sorcerer, a liar! (40:24). Then, when he brought them the Truth from Us, they said: "Kill with him the sons of those who believe and let their women live;" but the plots of disbelievers are nothing but in vain (40:25). Fir'awn said: "Leave me to kill Musa, and let him call his Lord! I fear that he may change your religion, or that he may cause mischief to appear in the land! (40:26). Musa said: "Verily, I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant who believes not in…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin And indeed sent We Moses with Our signs and a clear authority See 40:19

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوْۤا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ ilā fir'ʿawna wahāmāna waqārūna faqālū sāḥirun kadhābun to Pharaoh, Hāmān and Korah, but they said, 'A magician, a mendacious liar.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوْۤا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ ilā fir'ʿawna wahāmāna waqārūna faqālū sāḥirun kadhābun To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "(He is) a magician and a liar." See 40:23

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوْۤا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ ilā fir'ʿawna wahāmāna waqārūna faqālū sāḥirun kadhābun Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Qarun, but they said: "(This is a) great lying sorcerer!" The mention of these three personalities though Moses' mission was to the people, is to point out the ring-leaders of the aristocratic class who always opposed the prophets and the godly reformers. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوْۤا أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِسَاءَهُمْ وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ falammā jāahum bil-ḥaqi min ʿindinā qālū uq'tulū abnāa alladhīna āmanū maʿahu wa-is'taḥyū nisāahum wamā kaydu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin So when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, 'Kill the sons of the faithful who are with him, and spare their women.' But the stratagems1 of the faithless only go awry.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوْۤا أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِسَاءَهُمْ وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ falammā jāahum bil-ḥaqi min ʿindinā qālū uq'tulū abnāa alladhīna āmanū maʿahu wa-is'taḥyū nisāahum wamā kaydu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error. See 40:23

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوْۤا أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِسَاءَهُمْ وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ falammā jāahum bil-ḥaqi min ʿindinā qālū uq'tulū abnāa alladhīna āmanū maʿahu wa-is'taḥyū nisāahum wamā kaydu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin And he brought unto them the truth from unto Us, said they: "Slay ye the sons of those who believe with him and leave their women alive;" but the plot of the disbelievers is nothing but a failure. See 40:24

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِي أَقْتُلْ مُوسٰی وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَنْ يُظْهِرَ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu dharūnī aqtul mūsā walyadʿu rabbahu innī akhāfu an yubaddila dīnakum aw an yuẓ'hira fī l-arḍi l-fasāda And Pharaoh said, 'Let me slay Moses, and let him invoke his Lord. Indeed I fear that he will change your religion, or bring forth corruption in the land.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِي أَقْتُلْ مُوسٰی وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَنْ يُظْهِرَ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu dharūnī aqtul mūsā walyadʿu rabbahu innī akhāfu an yubaddila dīnakum aw an yuẓ'hira fī l-arḍi l-fasāda And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Musa and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption1 in the land." See 40:23

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِي أَقْتُلْ مُوسٰی وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَنْ يُظْهِرَ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu dharūnī aqtul mūsā walyadʿu rabbahu innī akhāfu an yubaddila dīnakum aw an yuẓ'hira fī l-arḍi l-fasāda And said Pharaoh: "Let me alone I will slay Moses, and let him call upon his Lord; Verily I fear that he may change your religion, or he may cause mischief to appear in the land." See 40:24

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی اِنِّیْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ waqāla mūsā innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin lā yu'minu biyawmi l-ḥisābi Moses said, 'Indeed I seek the protection of my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی اِنِّیْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ waqāla mūsā innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin lā yu'minu biyawmi l-ḥisābi But Musa said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account." See 40:23

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی اِنِّیْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ waqāla mūsā innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin lā yu'minu biyawmi l-ḥisābi And Moses said: "Verily, I take refuge with my Lord and your (As said Jesus: 'my father and your father' John 20/17.) Lord from every arrogant one who believeth not in the Day of Reckoning!" See 40:24

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَانَهُ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَنْ يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَإِنْ يَكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُ وَإِنْ يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي يَعِدُكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ waqāla rajulun mu'minun min āli fir'ʿawna yaktumu īmānahu ataqtulūna rajulan an yaqūla rabbiya l-lahu waqad jāakum bil-bayināti min rabbikum wa-in yaku kādhiban faʿalayhi kadhibuhu wa-in yaku ṣādiqan yuṣib'kum baʿḍu alladhī yaʿidukum inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa mus'rifun kadhābun Said a man of faith from Pharaoh's clan, who concealed his faith, 'Will you kill a man for saying, "My Lord is Allah," while he has already brought you manifest proofs from your Lord? Should he be lying, his falsehood will be to his own detriment; but if he is truthful, there shall visit you some of what he promises you. Indeed…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَانَهُ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَنْ يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَإِنْ يَكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُ وَإِنْ يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي يَعِدُكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ waqāla rajulun mu'minun min āli fir'ʿawna yaktumu īmānahu ataqtulūna rajulan an yaqūla rabbiya l-lahu waqad jāakum bil-bayināti min rabbikum wa-in yaku kādhiban faʿalayhi kadhibuhu wa-in yaku ṣādiqan yuṣib'kum baʿḍu alladhī yaʿidukum inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa mus'rifun kadhābun And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man (merely) because he says, 'My Lord is Allah' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is (the consequence of) his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَانَهُ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَنْ يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَإِنْ يَكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُ وَإِنْ يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي يَعِدُكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ waqāla rajulun mu'minun min āli fir'ʿawna yaktumu īmānahu ataqtulūna rajulan an yaqūla rabbiya l-lahu waqad jāakum bil-bayināti min rabbikum wa-in yaku kādhiban faʿalayhi kadhibuhu wa-in yaku ṣādiqan yuṣib'kum baʿḍu alladhī yaʿidukum inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa mus'rifun kadhābun And said a man who was a Believer, from among the people of Pharaoh: who used to conceal (This is 'Taqiyah' which is hiding the faith in heart & professing something otherwise, to save life and life-interest. Whereas hypocrisy is the reverse - i.e., to be a disbeliever or an infidel at heart & to profess faith mere verbally.) his faith: "What!…
