item.title: Al-Ghaafir:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَاهِرِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنَا مِنْ بَأْسِ اللَّهِ إِنْ جَاءَنَا قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَا أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَرٰی وَمَا أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ yāqawmi lakumu l-mul'ku l-yawma ẓāhirīna fī l-arḍi faman yanṣurunā min basi l-lahi in jāanā qāla fir'ʿawnu mā urīkum illā mā arā wamā ahdīkum illā sabīla l-rashādi O my people! Today sovereignty belongs to you,1 and you are dominant in the land. But who will save us from Allah's punishment should it overtake us?' Pharaoh said, 'I just point out to you what I see [to be advisable for you], and I guide you only to the way of rectitude.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَاهِرِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنَا مِنْ بَأْسِ اللَّهِ إِنْ جَاءَنَا قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَا أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَرٰی وَمَا أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ yāqawmi lakumu l-mul'ku l-yawma ẓāhirīna fī l-arḍi faman yanṣurunā min basi l-lahi in jāanā qāla fir'ʿawnu mā urīkum illā mā arā wamā ahdīkum illā sabīla l-rashādi O my people, sovereignty is yours today, (your being) dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allah if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct." See 40:28

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَاهِرِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنَا مِنْ بَأْسِ اللَّهِ إِنْ جَاءَنَا قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَا أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَرٰی وَمَا أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ yāqawmi lakumu l-mul'ku l-yawma ẓāhirīna fī l-arḍi faman yanṣurunā min basi l-lahi in jāanā qāla fir'ʿawnu mā urīkum illā mā arā wamā ahdīkum illā sabīla l-rashādi O' my people! Yours is the kingdom this day, being prevailing in the land, but who will help us against the wrath of God if it cometh upon us?" Pharaoh said: "I show you not aught but what I (myself) see, and I guide you not but in a right way. Pointing out the mastery of the earth by the people, as transitory. The same tone used by the modern despots. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِثْلَ يَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum mith'la yawmi l-aḥzābi And he who had faith said, 'O my people! Indeed I fear for you [a day] like the day of the [heathen] factions;

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِثْلَ يَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum mith'la yawmi l-aḥzābi And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you (a fate) like the day of the companies1. And he who believed said: O my people! Verily, I fear for you an end like that day (of disaster) of the groups (of old)! (40:30). "Like the end of the people of Nuh, and 'Ad, and Thamud and those who came after them. And Allah wills no injustice for (His) servants (40:31). "And, O my people! Verily, I fear for you the Day when there will be mutual calling (40:32). A Day when you will turn your backs and flee having no protector from Allah. And whomsoever Allah sends astray, for him there is no guide (40:33). And…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِثْلَ يَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum mith'la yawmi l-aḥzābi And said he who believed: "O' my people! verily, I fear, (that it may fall) on you the like of that (In the same manner.) (what befell) the parties," See 40:29

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَمَا اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِلْعِبَادِ mith'la dabi qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda wa-alladhīna min baʿdihim wamā l-lahu yurīdu ẓul'man lil'ʿibādi like the case of the people of Noah, of 'Ād and Thamūd, and those who were after them, and Allah does not desire any wrong for [His] servants.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَمَا اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِلْعِبَادِ mith'la dabi qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda wa-alladhīna min baʿdihim wamā l-lahu yurīdu ẓul'man lil'ʿibādi Like the custom of the people of Nuh and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allah wants no injustice for (His) servants. See 40:30

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَمَا اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِلْعِبَادِ mith'la dabi qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda wa-alladhīna min baʿdihim wamā l-lahu yurīdu ẓul'man lil'ʿibādi The like of that (what befell) the people of Noah and 'Ad and Thamud and those (who came) after them; and God intendeth not injustice unto (His) servants See 40:29

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ wayāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum yawma l-tanādi O my people! Indeed I fear for you a day of mutual distress calls,

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ wayāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum yawma l-tanādi And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling1. See 40:30

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ wayāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum yawma l-tanādi And O' my people! I fear for you the Day of Calling out (each other)" (May refer to verse 7:44 - 7:46 & 48:50.) See 40:29

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ yawma tuwallūna mud'birīna mā lakum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin a day when you will turn back [to flee], not having anyone to protect you from Allah, and whomever Allah leads astray has no guide.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ yawma tuwallūna mud'birīna mā lakum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allah any protector. And whoever Allah sends astray - there is not for him any guide. See 40:30

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ yawma tuwallūna mud'birīna mā lakum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin The Day on which ye shall be turned back (from the Judgment unto the Hell), (when) for you there shall not be any saviour from (the wrath of) God; and whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him shall not be any guide, See 40:29

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِنْ قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا جَاءَكُمْ بِهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رَسُولًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُرْتَابٌ walaqad jāakum yūsufu min qablu bil-bayināti famā zil'tum fī shakkin mimmā jāakum bihi ḥattā idhā halaka qul'tum lan yabʿatha l-lahu min baʿdihi rasūlan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man huwa mus'rifun mur'tābun Certainly Joseph brought you manifest proofs earlier, but you continued to remain in doubt concerning what he had brought you. When he died, you said, "Allah will never send any apostle after him." That is how Allah leads astray those who are profligate, skeptical.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِنْ قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا جَاءَكُمْ بِهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رَسُولًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُرْتَابٌ walaqad jāakum yūsufu min qablu bil-bayināti famā zil'tum fī shakkin mimmā jāakum bihi ḥattā idhā halaka qul'tum lan yabʿatha l-lahu min baʿdihi rasūlan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man huwa mus'rifun mur'tābun And Yusuf had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allah send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allah leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." See 40:30

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِنْ قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا جَاءَكُمْ بِهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رَسُولًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُرْتَابٌ walaqad jāakum yūsufu min qablu bil-bayināti famā zil'tum fī shakkin mimmā jāakum bihi ḥattā idhā halaka qul'tum lan yabʿatha l-lahu min baʿdihi rasūlan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man huwa mus'rifun mur'tābun And indeed came unto you Yusuf before, with clear proofs (of his mission), but ye ever doubted about what he brought; until when he died ye said: 'Never will God raise any apostle after him;' Thus doth God allow him to stray, who is an extravagant, a doubter. It asserts that Yusuf was an apostle to the Egyptians who after assuming the administration of Egypt1 introduced many reforms in the public interest which the ruling class after him did not…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda alladhīna āmanū kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbārin Those who dispute the signs of Allah without any authority that may have come to them —[that is] greatly outrageous to Allah and to those who have faith. That is how Allah seals the heart of every arrogant tyrant.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda alladhīna āmanū kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbārin Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without an authority1 having come to them - great is hatred (of them) in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allah seal over every heart (belonging to) an arrogant tyrant. See 40:30

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda alladhīna āmanū kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbārin Those who dispute about the Signs of God without any authority having come unto them; are greatly hated by God and by those who believe; Thus God setteth a seal over every heart which is arrogant and haughty. See 40:34

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَاهَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا لَعَلِّي أَبْلُغُ الْأَسْبَابَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu yāhāmānu ib'ni lī ṣarḥan laʿallī ablughu l-asbāba And Pharaoh said, 'O Hāmān! Build me a tower so that I may reach the routes1

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَاهَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا لَعَلِّي أَبْلُغُ الْأَسْبَابَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu yāhāmānu ib'ni lī ṣarḥan laʿallī ablughu l-asbāba And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways1. How Fir'awn Mocked the Lord of Musa Allah tells us of the arrogant and hostile defiance of Fir'awn and his rejection of Musa, when he commanded his minister Haman to build him a tower, i.e., a tall, high, strong fortress. He built it of bricks made from baked clay, as Allah says: فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَهَـمَـنُ عَلَى الطِّينِ فَاجْعَل لِّى صَرْحاً So kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake (bricks out of) clay, and set up for me a lofty tower (28:38) لَّعَـلِّى أَبْلُغُ الاٌّسْبَـبَ - أَسْبَـبَ السَّمَـوَتِ that I may arrive at the ways -- the ways of the heavens, Sa'id bin Jubayr and…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَاهَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا لَعَلِّي أَبْلُغُ الْأَسْبَابَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu yāhāmānu ib'ni lī ṣarḥan laʿallī ablughu l-asbāba And said Pharaoh: "O' Haman! Build thou for me a tower that I may reach the means of access," See 40:34

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْبَابَ السَّمَاوَاتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسٰی وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٍ asbāba l-samāwāti fa-aṭṭaliʿa ilā ilāhi mūsā wa-innī la-aẓunnuhu kādhiban wakadhālika zuyyina lifir'ʿawna sūu ʿamalihi waṣudda ʿani l-sabīli wamā kaydu fir'ʿawna illā fī tabābin —the routes of the heavens— and take a look at the God of Moses, and indeed I consider him a liar.' To Pharaoh was thus presented as decorous the evil of his conduct, and he was kept from the way [of Allah], and Pharaoh's stratagems1 only led him into ruin.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْبَابَ السَّمَاوَاتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسٰی وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٍ asbāba l-samāwāti fa-aṭṭaliʿa ilā ilāhi mūsā wa-innī la-aẓunnuhu kādhiban wakadhālika zuyyina lifir'ʿawna sūu ʿamalihi waṣudda ʿani l-sabīli wamā kaydu fir'ʿawna illā fī tabābin The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Musa; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the (right) way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. See 40:36

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْبَابَ السَّمَاوَاتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسٰی وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٍ asbāba l-samāwāti fa-aṭṭaliʿa ilā ilāhi mūsā wa-innī la-aẓunnuhu kādhiban wakadhālika zuyyina lifir'ʿawna sūu ʿamalihi waṣudda ʿani l-sabīli wamā kaydu fir'ʿawna illā fī tabābin The means of access unto heavens, so that I (may) mount up to reach unto God of Moses, and verily I think him (Moses.) to be a liar;" and thus was made fair-seeming unto Pharaoh the evil of his deed and he was turned away from the (right) way; and the plot (Device – scheme – plan.) of Pharaoh was not but (to end) into (his own) ruin. The same is the attitude of some of the materialists of modern days - mocking at the believers in God saying that they could not find…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi ittabiʿūni ahdikum sabīla l-rashādi And he who had faith said, 'O my people! Follow me, I will guide you to the way of rectitude.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi ittabiʿūni ahdikum sabīla l-rashādi And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct. And the man who believed said: O my people! Follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct (40:38). "O my people! Truly, this life of the world is nothing but an enjoyment, and verily, the Hereafter that is the home that will remain forever (40:39). "Whoever does an evil deed, will not be requited except the like thereof; and whosoever does a righteous deed, whether male or female and is a true believer, such will enter Paradise, where they will be provided therein without limit (40:40). More of what the Believer from Fir'awn's Family said This believer said to his…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi ittabiʿūni ahdikum sabīla l-rashādi And said he who hath believed: "O' my people! follow me, I will show you the way to the right guidance" See 40:37

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْاٰخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ yāqawmi innamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā matāʿun wa-inna l-ākhirata hiya dāru l-qarāri O my people! This life of the world is only a [passing] enjoyment, and indeed the Hereafter is the abiding home.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْاٰخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ yāqawmi innamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā matāʿun wa-inna l-ākhirata hiya dāru l-qarāri O my people, this worldly life is only (temporary) enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of (permanent) settlement. See 40:38

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْاٰخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ yāqawmi innamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā matāʿun wa-inna l-ākhirata hiya dāru l-qarāri O' my people! the life of this world is only (a passing (Transitory.) ) enjoyment, and verily, the hereafter is the abode to last. This is an answer to what Pharaoh's claim in verse 36:37 that the life of this world and all its means are too short to reach the sphere of the non-physical realm, which alone is the stable one. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَى إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ man ʿamila sayyi-atan falā yuj'zā illā mith'lahā waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata yur'zaqūna fīhā bighayri ḥisābin Whoever commits a misdeed shall not be requited except with its like, but whoever acts righteously, whether male or female, should he be faithful —such shall enter paradise, provided therein without any reckoning.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَى إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ man ʿamila sayyi-atan falā yuj'zā illā mith'lahā waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata yur'zaqūna fīhā bighayri ḥisābin Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account. See 40:38

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَى إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ man ʿamila sayyi-atan falā yuj'zā illā mith'lahā waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata yur'zaqūna fīhā bighayri ḥisābin Whosoever shall have wrought an evil shall not be recompensed but the like of it, and whosoever shall have wrought good, whether a male or a female, and he be a believer, these shall enter the Garden, wherein they shall be provided with sustenance with out measure. See 40:39

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَوةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ wayāqawmi mā lī adʿūkum ilā l-najati watadʿūnanī ilā l-nāri O my people! [Think,] what makes me invite you to deliverance while you invite me toward the Fire?

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَوةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ wayāqawmi mā lī adʿūkum ilā l-najati watadʿūnanī ilā l-nāri And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire? And O my people! How is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire! (40:41). "You invite me to disbelieve in Allah, and to join partners in worship with Him of which I have no knowledge; and I invite you to the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving! (40:42). "'La Jarama', you call me to one that does not have a claim in this world or in the Hereafter. And our return will be to Allah, and the transgressors, they shall be the dwellers of the Fire! (40:43). "And you will remember what I am telling you, and my…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَوةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ wayāqawmi mā lī adʿūkum ilā l-najati watadʿūnanī ilā l-nāri O' my people! how is it that I invite you unto salvation and ye call me unto fire? See 40:39

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَدْعُونَنِي لِأَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ tadʿūnanī li-akfura bil-lahi wa-ush'rika bihi mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-anā adʿūkum ilā l-ʿazīzi l-ghafāri You invite me to defy Allah and to ascribe to Him partners of which I have no knowledge, while I call you to the All-mighty, the All-forgiver.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَدْعُونَنِي لِأَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ tadʿūnanī li-akfura bil-lahi wa-ush'rika bihi mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-anā adʿūkum ilā l-ʿazīzi l-ghafāri You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.1 See 40:41

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَدْعُونَنِي لِأَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ tadʿūnanī li-akfura bil-lahi wa-ush'rika bihi mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-anā adʿūkum ilā l-ʿazīzi l-ghafāri Ye call on me that I should disbelieve in God and associate with Him that I have no knowledge of, and I invite you unto the Almighty, and the Oft-Forgiving (Lord) See 40:39

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ lā jarama annamā tadʿūnanī ilayhi laysa lahu daʿwatun fī l-dun'yā walā fī l-ākhirati wa-anna maraddanā ilā l-lahi wa-anna l-mus'rifīna hum aṣḥābu l-nāri Undoubtedly, that to which you invite me has no invitation in the world nor in the Hereafter, and indeed our return will be to Allah, and indeed it is the profligates who will be inmates of the Fire.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ lā jarama annamā tadʿūnanī ilayhi laysa lahu daʿwatun fī l-dun'yā walā fī l-ākhirati wa-anna maraddanā ilā l-lahi wa-anna l-mus'rifīna hum aṣḥābu l-nāri Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no (response to a) supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allah, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire. See 40:41

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ lā jarama annamā tadʿūnanī ilayhi laysa lahu daʿwatun fī l-dun'yā walā fī l-ākhirati wa-anna maraddanā ilā l-lahi wa-anna l-mus'rifīna hum aṣḥābu l-nāri No doubt is there that what ye call me unto, hath no right to be invoked in this world nor in the hereafter, and our return is unto God, and that the extravagants shall be the inmates of the (Hell) fire. See 40:39

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ fasatadhkurūna mā aqūlu lakum wa-ufawwiḍu amrī ilā l-lahi inna l-laha baṣīrun bil-ʿibādi Soon you will remember what I tell you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed Allah sees best the servants.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ fasatadhkurūna mā aqūlu lakum wa-ufawwiḍu amrī ilā l-lahi inna l-laha baṣīrun bil-ʿibādi And you will remember what I (now) say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of (His) servants." See 40:41

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ fasatadhkurūna mā aqūlu lakum wa-ufawwiḍu amrī ilā l-lahi inna l-laha baṣīrun bil-ʿibādi And ye shall remember what I say unto you, and I entrust my affair unto God: verily, God seeth well (His) servants The Believer among Pharaoh's people refers to the believer.1 This discourse mostly ends with maximum universal value which adds beauty and strength to the arguments in the discourse. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَقَاهُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِ مَا مَكَرُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِآلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ fawaqāhu l-lahu sayyiāti mā makarū waḥāqa biāli fir'ʿawna sūu l-ʿadhābi Then Allah saved him from their evil schemes, while a terrible punishment besieged Pharaoh's clan:

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَقَاهُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِ مَا مَكَرُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِآلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ fawaqāhu l-lahu sayyiāti mā makarū waḥāqa biāli fir'ʿawna sūu l-ʿadhābi So Allah protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment. See 40:41

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَقَاهُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِ مَا مَكَرُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِآلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ fawaqāhu l-lahu sayyiāti mā makarū waḥāqa biāli fir'ʿawna sūu l-ʿadhābi And God preserved him from the evils of what they planned; and the woe of the chastisement encompassed the people of Pharaoh. See 40:44

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوْۤا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ al-nāru yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā ghuduwwan waʿashiyyan wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu adkhilū āla fir'ʿawna ashadda l-ʿadhābi the Fire, to which they are exposed morning and evening. And on the day when the Hour sets in Pharaoh's clan will enter the severest punishment.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوْۤا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ al-nāru yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā ghuduwwan waʿashiyyan wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu adkhilū āla fir'ʿawna ashadda l-ʿadhābi The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening.1 And the Day the Hour appears (it will be said), "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment." See 40:41

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوْۤا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ al-nāru yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā ghuduwwan waʿashiyyan wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu adkhilū āla fir'ʿawna ashadda l-ʿadhābi The fire: they shall be exposed unto it (every) morning and evening and on the Day when shall be established the 'Hour (of Reckoning)' (the sentence shall be) "Admit ye the people of Pharaoh to the severest of the chastisement." This is after death and before the Final Resurrection in the lower stages of the intermediary realm wherein the glimpse of the morning and evening of this life is still felt. This is what the Sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq asserts that the state resembles the prison wherein the morning and the evening, the prisoner will be shown the punishment awaiting him. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَتَحَاجُّونَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِنَ النَّارِ wa-idh yataḥājjūna fī l-nāri fayaqūlu l-ḍuʿafāu lilladhīna is'takbarū innā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal antum mugh'nūna ʿannā naṣīban mina l-nāri When they argue in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant, 'Indeed we used to follow you; so will you avail us against any portion of the Fire?'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَتَحَاجُّونَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِنَ النَّارِ wa-idh yataḥājjūna fī l-nāri fayaqūlu l-ḍuʿafāu lilladhīna is'takbarū innā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal antum mugh'nūna ʿannā naṣīban mina l-nāri And (mention) when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were (only) your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?" And, when they will dispute in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant: "Verily, we followed you, can you then take from us some portion of the Fire? (40:47). Those who were arrogant will say: "We are all (together) in this (Fire)! Verily, Allah has judged between (His) servants! (40:48). And those in the Fire will say to the keepers (angels)…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ يَتَحَاجُّونَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِنَ النَّارِ wa-idh yataḥājjūna fī l-nāri fayaqūlu l-ḍuʿafāu lilladhīna is'takbarū innā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal antum mugh'nūna ʿannā naṣīban mina l-nāri And when they shall wrangle together in the fire, then shall say the weak unto those who were arrogant: (Those who considered themselves as great or superior.) "Verily we were unto you the followers; will ye then relieve us from something of the fire?" See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā kullun fīhā inna l-laha qad ḥakama bayna l-ʿibādi Those who were arrogant will say, 'Indeed we are all [together] in it. Indeed Allah has judged between [His] servants.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā kullun fīhā inna l-laha qad ḥakama bayna l-ʿibādi Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all (of us) are in it. Indeed, Allah has judged between the servants." See 40:47

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā kullun fīhā inna l-laha qad ḥakama bayna l-ʿibādi Shall say those who were arrogant: (Those who considered themselves as great or superior.) "Verily, we are all in it; Verily, God hath indeed judged (Decree passed.) between (His) servants," See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِنَ الْعَذَابِ waqāla alladhīna fī l-nāri likhazanati jahannama id'ʿū rabbakum yukhaffif ʿannā yawman mina l-ʿadhābi Those in the Fire will say to the keepers of hell, 'Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us [at least] a day's punishment.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِنَ الْعَذَابِ waqāla alladhīna fī l-nāri likhazanati jahannama id'ʿū rabbakum yukhaffif ʿannā yawman mina l-ʿadhābi And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment." See 40:47

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِنَ الْعَذَابِ waqāla alladhīna fī l-nāri likhazanati jahannama id'ʿū rabbakum yukhaffif ʿannā yawman mina l-ʿadhābi And shall say those in the fire unto the guards of hell: "Call ye upon your Lord that He may lighten unto us (at least for) a day, of the chastisement." See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوْا بَلَى قَالُوْا فَادْعُوْۤا وَمَا دُعَؤُا الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ qālū awalam taku tatīkum rusulukum bil-bayināti qālū balā qālū fa-id'ʿū wamā duʿāu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin They will say, 'Did not your apostles use to bring you manifest proofs?' They will say, 'Yes.' They will say, 'Then supplicate [Him] yourselves.' But the supplications of the faithless only go awry.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوْا بَلَى قَالُوْا فَادْعُوْۤا وَمَا دُعَؤُا الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ qālū awalam taku tatīkum rusulukum bil-bayināti qālū balā qālū fa-id'ʿū wamā duʿāu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate (yourselves), but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error (i.e., futility)." See 40:47

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوْا بَلَى قَالُوْا فَادْعُوْۤا وَمَا دُعَؤُا الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ qālū awalam taku tatīkum rusulukum bil-bayināti qālū balā qālū fa-id'ʿū wamā duʿāu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin They (The guards of hell.) shall say: "Came not unto you your apostles with clear proofs (of their mission)? They shall say: "Yea!" They shall say: "(why not yourselves) Cry ye then (for help)?" but the cry of the disbelievers shall not be but in vain." See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْأَشْهَادُ innā lananṣuru rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wayawma yaqūmu l-ashhādu Indeed We shall help Our apostles and those who have faith in the life of the world and on the day when the witnesses rise up

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْأَشْهَادُ innā lananṣuru rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wayawma yaqūmu l-ashhādu Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand. The Victory of the Messengers and the Believers إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فِى الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا Verily, We will indeed make victorious Our Messengers and those who believe in this world's life As-Suddi, "Allah never sends a Messenger to a people and they kill him or some of the believers who call them to the truth, then that generation passes away, but He then sends them someone who will support their call and will seek vengeance for their blood from those who did that to them in this world. So the Prophets and…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْأَشْهَادُ innā lananṣuru rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wayawma yaqūmu l-ashhādu Verily, We do help Our apostles, and those who believe, in the life of this world and on the day when shall stand forth the witnesses, See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ yawma lā yanfaʿu l-ẓālimīna maʿdhiratuhum walahumu l-laʿnatu walahum sūu l-dāri —the day when the excuses of the wrongdoers will not benefit them, and the curse will lie on them, and for them will be the ills of the [ultimate] abode.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ yawma lā yanfaʿu l-ẓālimīna maʿdhiratuhum walahumu l-laʿnatu walahum sūu l-dāri The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home (i.e., Hell). See 40:51

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ yawma lā yanfaʿu l-ẓālimīna maʿdhiratuhum walahumu l-laʿnatu walahum sūu l-dāri The day when shall benefit not the unjust their excuses, and for them shall be the curse, and for them shall be the evil abode (in Hell). See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْهُدَى وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-hudā wa-awrathnā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba Certainly We gave Moses the guidance and We made the Children of Israel heirs to the Book,

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْهُدَى وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-hudā wa-awrathnā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba And We had certainly given Musa guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture. See 40:51

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْهُدَى وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-hudā wa-awrathnā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba And indeed We gave Moses the guidance, and We made the children of Israel inherit the Book, See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُدًى وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ hudan wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi as a guidance and an admonition for those who possess intellect.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُدًى وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ hudan wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding. See 40:51

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُدًى وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ hudan wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi A guidance and a reminder unto the men endued with understanding. See 40:46

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kāri So be patient! Allah's promise is indeed true. And plead for [Allah's] forgiveness for your sin, and celebrate the praise of your Lord morning and evening.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kāri So be patient, (O Muḥammad). Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin1 and exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning. See 40:51

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kāri So be thou patient; verily, the promise of God is true; and seek protection for thy (followers') shortcomings ('Dhanb' also means 'following'. Thus, seek protection for thy followers. The Holy Prophet was one of those already protected. Refer to note on verse 33:33 & 55:2.) , and celebrate the praise of thy Lord in the evening and the morning. This verse needs to be studied intelligently. Taking the words 'Wa'staghfir li-dhanbika' isolated, torn away from its context and interpreting them under the influence of wishful thinking and their preconceived antagonistic complex, the Christian commentators in their missionary zeal, to keep away the just and unprejudiced minds in their folds, from embracing the Truth, present the divine…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ إِنْ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَا هُمْ بِبَالِغِيهِ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ inna alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum in fī ṣudūrihim illā kib'run mā hum bibālighīhi fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru Indeed those who dispute the signs of Allah without any authority that may have come to them —there is only vanity in their breasts, which they will never satisfy. So seek the protection of Allah; indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ إِنْ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَا هُمْ بِبَالِغِيهِ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ inna alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum in fī ṣudūrihim illā kib'run mā hum bibālighīhi fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without (any) evidence having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, (the extent of) which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing. See 40:51

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ إِنْ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَا هُمْ بِبَالِغِيهِ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ inna alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum in fī ṣudūrihim illā kib'run mā hum bibālighīhi fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru Verily, those who dispute about the signs of God without any authority having come unto them, naught is there in their breast but (a vain desire (Ambition.) ) to become great, which they shall attain not; therefore seek (thou) refuge in God, verily He is the All Hearing, the All-Seeing. See 40:55

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ lakhalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi akbaru min khalqi l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is more prodigious than the creation of mankind,1 but most people do not know.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ lakhalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi akbaru min khalqi l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know. The creation of the heavens and the earth is indeed greater than the creation of mankind; yet, most of the people do not know (40:57). And not equal are the blind and those who see; nor those who believe, and do righteous good deeds, and those who do evil. Little do you remember (40:58). Verily, the Hour is surely coming, there is no doubt about it, yet most men believe not (40:59). Life after Death Allah tells us that He will bring back His creation on the Day of Resurrection. That is very easy…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ lakhalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi akbaru min khalqi l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna Surely, the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of the people, but most people know not. This is another figurative verse of guidance towards the right persons one has to follow. The blind here is the blind at heart and seeing stands for those endowed with knowledge. For similar guiding factors in the Holy Qur'an, see verses 10:35, 39:9, 67:22 & 11:24.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَلَا الْمُسِيءُ قَلِيلًا مَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti walā l-musīu qalīlan mā tatadhakkarūna The blind one and the seer are not equal, neither are those who have faith and do righteous deeds and the evildoing. Little is the admonition that you take!

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَلَا الْمُسِيءُ قَلِيلًا مَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti walā l-musīu qalīlan mā tatadhakkarūna And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember. See 40:57

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَلَا الْمُسِيءُ قَلِيلًا مَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti walā l-musīu qalīlan mā tatadhakkarūna Not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor those who believe and do good and the doers of evil (are equal); little is it that ye reflect. See 40:57

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun lā rayba fīhā walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna Indeed the Hour is bound to come; there is no doubt in it. But most people do not believe.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun lā rayba fīhā walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe. See 40:57

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun lā rayba fīhā walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna Verily, the Hour (The ultimate end.) (of Reckoning) is to come, there is no doubt therein, but most people believe not. See 40:57

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ waqāla rabbukumu id'ʿūnī astajib lakum inna alladhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatī sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīna Your Lord has said, 'Call Me, and I will hear you!' Indeed those who are disdainful of My worship will enter hell in utter humility.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ waqāla rabbukumu id'ʿūnī astajib lakum inna alladhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatī sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīna And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell (rendered) contemptible. And your Lord said: "Call upon Me, I will answer you. Verily, those who scorn My worship they will surely enter Hell in humiliation! (40:60). The Command to call upon Allah By His grace and kindness, Allah encourages His servants to call upon Him, and He guarantees to respond. Sufyan Ath-Thawri used to say: "O You Who love most those who ask of You, and O You Who hate most those who do not ask of You, and there is no one like that apart from You, O Lord." This was…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ waqāla rabbukumu id'ʿūnī astajib lakum inna alladhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatī sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīna And sayeth your Lord: "Call (Pray.) ye unto Me, I will answer (Response.) you;" Verily those who are arrogant to serve Me, shall soon enter Hell, disgraced. This indicates that no prayer from man is without the response from God. The response may be in complete accord to what man has prayed for or it may be a blessing in other shape and form depending upon, and in God's knowledge what is advantageous to the supplicant. On this basis, the Fifth Holy Imam's 'Du'a' itself is one of the best forms of devotion to God and no devotion will be left without reward. And he said that there is nothing more loved by God…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yashkurūna It is Allah who made the night for you, that you may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. Indeed Allah is gracious to mankind, but most people do not give thanks.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yashkurūna It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight.1 Indeed, Allah is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful. Allah, it is He Who has made the night for you that you may rest therein and the day for you to see. Truly, Allah is full of bounty to mankind; yet, most of mankind give no thanks (40:61). That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, La ilaha ila Huwa. How then are you turning away (40:62). Thus were turned away…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yashkurūna God is He who hath made for you the night that ye may rest in it and the day to give you light; Verily God is gracious unto the people, but most people thank not. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum khāliqu kulli shayin lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna That is Allah, your Lord, the creator of all things, there is no god except Him. Then where do you stray?

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum khāliqu kulli shayin lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna That is Allah, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded? See 40:61

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum khāliqu kulli shayin lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna That is God, your Lord, the Creator of everything; there is no god but He; why then are ye turned away? See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ kadhālika yu'faku alladhīna kānū biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūna Thus are made to stray those who are used to impugning the signs of Allah.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ kadhālika yu'faku alladhīna kānū biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūna Thus were those (before you) deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allah. See 40:61

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ kadhālika yu'faku alladhīna kānū biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūna Thus were turned away those who denied the signs of God. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa qarāran wal-samāa bināan waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fatabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna It is Allah who made the earth an abode for you, and the sky a canopy, and He formed you and perfected your forms, and provided you with all the good things. That is Allah, your Lord! Blessed is Allah, Lord of all the worlds!

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa qarāran wal-samāa bināan waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fatabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna It is Allah who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure (i.e., ceiling) and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allah, your Lord; then blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds. See 40:61

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa qarāran wal-samāa bināan waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fatabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna God is He Who made for you the earth to stay and the heaven a canopy, and shapened you, and made goodly your forms, and provided you with sustenance with goodly things; that is God your Lord; Hallowed (Blessed.) is then God the Lord of the worlds. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الْحَيُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ huwa l-ḥayu lā ilāha illā huwa fa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna He is the Living One, there is no god except Him. So supplicate Him, putting exclusive faith in Him. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الْحَيُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ huwa l-ḥayu lā ilāha illā huwa fa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna He is the Ever-Living;1 there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, (being) sincere to Him in religion. (All) praise is (due) to Allah, Lord of the worlds. See 40:61

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الْحَيُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ huwa l-ḥayu lā ilāha illā huwa fa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna He is the (Ever) Living, (Arabic 'Hai'.) there is no god but He so call ye upon Him, devoting (The faith and the practice of it being exclusively for God's sake.) unto Him the religion; All praise is God's, the Lord of the worlds. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَمَّا جَاءَنِيَ الْبَيِّنَاتُ مِنْ رَبِّي وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lammā jāaniya l-bayinātu min rabbī wa-umir'tu an us'lima lirabbi l-ʿālamīna Say, 'I have been forbidden to worship those whom you invoke besides Allah, since there have come to me manifest proofs from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَمَّا جَاءَنِيَ الْبَيِّنَاتُ مِنْ رَبِّي وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lammā jāaniya l-bayinātu min rabbī wa-umir'tu an us'lima lirabbi l-ʿālamīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds." Say: I have been forbidden to worship those whom you worship besides Allah, since there have come to me evidences from my Lord; and I am commanded to submit to the Lord of all that exists (40:66). It is He, Who has created you from dust, then from a Nutfah then from a clot (a piece of coagulated blood), then…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَمَّا جَاءَنِيَ الْبَيِّنَاتُ مِنْ رَبِّي وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lammā jāaniya l-bayinātu min rabbī wa-umir'tu an us'lima lirabbi l-ʿālamīna Say: "Verily I am forbidden to worship those whom ye call upon besides God when clear proofs have come unto me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit myself unto the Lord of the worlds." See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا شُيُوخًا وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا أَجَلًا مُسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ huwa alladhī khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma yukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum thumma litakūnū shuyūkhan waminkum man yutawaffā min qablu walitablughū ajalan musamman walaʿallakum taʿqilūna It is He who created you from dust, then from a drop of [seminal] fluid, then from a clinging mass, then He brings you forth as infants, then [He nourishes you] so that you may come of age, then that you may become aged —though there are some of you who die earlier— and that you may complete a specified term, and so that you may apply reason.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا شُيُوخًا وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا أَجَلًا مُسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ huwa alladhī khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma yukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum thumma litakūnū shuyūkhan waminkum man yutawaffā min qablu walitablughū ajalan musamman walaʿallakum taʿqilūna It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then (He develops you) that you reach your (time of) maturity, then (further) that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before (that), so that you reach a specified term;1 and perhaps you will use reason. See 40:66

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا شُيُوخًا وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا أَجَلًا مُسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ huwa alladhī khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma yukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum thumma litakūnū shuyūkhan waminkum man yutawaffā min qablu walitablughū ajalan musamman walaʿallakum taʿqilūna He it is Who created you from dust, then from a life-germ, then from a clot, then He bringeth you forth as a babe, then that ye may reach your full strength, then that ye may be old, and of you are those who are caused to die early and that ye may reach the appointed term, and (all this is related) that happly ye may understand. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ فَإِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ huwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu fa-idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu It is He who gives life and brings death. So when He decides on a matter, He just says to it, 'Be!' and it is.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ فَإِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ huwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu fa-idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is. See 40:66

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ فَإِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ huwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu fa-idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and when He decreeth an affair, He only sayeth unto it 'BE' and it IS. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّى يُصْرَفُونَ alam tara ilā alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi annā yuṣ'rafūna Have you not regarded those who dispute the signs of Allah, where they are being led away [from Allah's way]?

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّى يُصْرَفُونَ alam tara ilā alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi annā yuṣ'rafūna Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted? See you not those who dispute about the Ayat of Allah How are they turning away (40:69). Those who deny the Book, and that with which We sent Our Messengers they will come to know (40:70). When iron collars will be rounded over their necks, and the chains, they shall be dragged along (40:71). In the boiling water, then they will be burned in the Fire (40:72). Then it will be said to them: Where are (all) those whom you used to consider partners (40:73). "Besides Allah?" They will say: "They have vanished from us. Nay, we did not call upon anything before."…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّى يُصْرَفُونَ alam tara ilā alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi annā yuṣ'rafūna Seest thou not those who dispute about the signs of God; how they are turned away? See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْكِتَابِ وَبِمَا أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِ رُسُلَنَا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ alladhīna kadhabū bil-kitābi wabimā arsalnā bihi rusulanā fasawfa yaʿlamūna —Those who deny the Book and what we have sent with Our apostles. Soon they will know

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْكِتَابِ وَبِمَا أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِ رُسُلَنَا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ alladhīna kadhabū bil-kitābi wabimā arsalnā bihi rusulanā fasawfa yaʿlamūna Those who deny the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know. See 40:69

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْكِتَابِ وَبِمَا أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِ رُسُلَنَا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ alladhīna kadhabū bil-kitābi wabimā arsalnā bihi rusulanā fasawfa yaʿlamūna Those who belie the Book and what We sent Our Apostles with; then soon shall they know, See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذِ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَالسَّلَاسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ idhi l-aghlālu fī aʿnāqihim wal-salāsilu yus'ḥabūna when, [with] iron collars around their necks and chains, they are dragged

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذِ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَالسَّلَاسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ idhi l-aghlālu fī aʿnāqihim wal-salāsilu yus'ḥabūna When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged. See 40:69

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذِ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَالسَّلَاسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ idhi l-aghlālu fī aʿnāqihim wal-salāsilu yus'ḥabūna When the fetters shall be in their necks and the chains; they will be dragged, See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي الْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ fī l-ḥamīmi thumma fī l-nāri yus'jarūna into scalding waters and then set aflame in the Fire.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي الْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ fī l-ḥamīmi thumma fī l-nāri yus'jarūna In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled (with flame). See 40:69

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي الْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ fī l-ḥamīmi thumma fī l-nāri yus'jarūna Into the boiling water, then in the fire shall they be burned; See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ thumma qīla lahum ayna mā kuntum tush'rikūna Then they will be told, 'Where are those you used to take as partners

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ thumma qīla lahum ayna mā kuntum tush'rikūna Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate (with Him in worship). See 40:69

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ thumma qīla lahum ayna mā kuntum tush'rikūna Then it shall be said unto them; "Where are those whom ye used to associate (as gods)," See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْۤا عَنَّا بَلْ لَمْ نَكُنْ نَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ شَيْئًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الْكَافِرِينَ min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā bal lam nakun nadʿū min qablu shayan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu l-kāfirīna besides Allah?' They will say, 'They have forsaken us. Rather, we did not invoke anything before.' That is how Allah leads astray the faithless.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْۤا عَنَّا بَلْ لَمْ نَكُنْ نَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ شَيْئًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الْكَافِرِينَ min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā bal lam nakun nadʿū min qablu shayan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu l-kāfirīna Other than Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers. See 40:69

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْۤا عَنَّا بَلْ لَمْ نَكُنْ نَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ شَيْئًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الْكَافِرِينَ min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā bal lam nakun nadʿū min qablu shayan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu l-kāfirīna Besides God?" They shall say: "They have gone away from us, nay, we used not to call upon anything before;" Thus doth God leave the disbelievers to stray. (In their confusion.) See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ dhālikum bimā kuntum tafraḥūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tamraḥūna 'That is because you used to exult unduly on the earth and because you used to walk exultantly.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ dhālikum bimā kuntum tafraḥūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tamraḥūna (The angels will say), "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently. See 40:69

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ dhālikum bimā kuntum tafraḥūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tamraḥūna (It will be said unto them) "This because ye exulted in the land without any right, and because ye were insolent." See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna Enter the gates of hell, to remain in it [forever].' Evil is the [final] abode of the arrogant.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant." See 40:69

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna Enter ye the gates of Hell to abide therein." Wretched then shall be the abode of the arrogant (Haughty.) ones. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna So be patient! Allah's promise is indeed true. Whether We show you a part of what We promise them, or take you away [before that], [in any case] they will be brought back to Us.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna So be patient, (O Muḥammad); indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned. So be patient, verily, the promise of Allah is true and whether We show you some part of what We have promised them, or We cause you to die, then still it is to Us they all shall be returned (40:77). And, indeed We have sent Messengers before you, of some of them We have related to you their story. And of some We have not related to you their story, and it was…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna So be patient thou, verily the promise of God is true; And whether We let thee see of what We threaten them with, or We cause thee to die (before that), unto Us shall they be returned. See 40:60

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِاٰیَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ walaqad arsalnā rusulan min qablika min'hum man qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka wamin'hum man lam naqṣuṣ ʿalayka wamā kāna lirasūlin an yatiya biāyatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi fa-idhā jāa amru l-lahi quḍiya bil-ḥaqi wakhasira hunālika l-mub'ṭilūna Certainly We have sent apostles before you. Of them are those We have recounted to you, and of them are those We have not recounted to you. An apostle may not bring any sign except by Allah's permission. Hence when Allah's edict comes, judgment is made with justice, and it is thence that the falsifiers become losers.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِاٰیَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ walaqad arsalnā rusulan min qablika min'hum man qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka wamin'hum man lam naqṣuṣ ʿalayka wamā kāna lirasūlin an yatiya biāyatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi fa-idhā jāa amru l-lahi quḍiya bil-ḥaqi wakhasira hunālika l-mub'ṭilūna And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those (whose stories) We have related to you, and among them are those (whose stories) We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign (or verse) except by permission of Allah. So when the command of Allah comes, it will be concluded (i.e., judged) in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose (all). See 40:77

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِاٰیَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ walaqad arsalnā rusulan min qablika min'hum man qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka wamin'hum man lam naqṣuṣ ʿalayka wamā kāna lirasūlin an yatiya biāyatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi fa-idhā jāa amru l-lahi quḍiya bil-ḥaqi wakhasira hunālika l-mub'ṭilūna And verily sent We apostles before thee, of them there are those whom We have mentioned unto thee; and of them are those whom We have mentioned (Note the wide range of the recognition of the apostles sent to the other people in the different parts of the earth, though their names might not be found in the Qur'an. No other religion has done this.) not unto thee; and it was not given to any apostle…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْعَامَ لِتَرْكَبُوا مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-anʿāma litarkabū min'hā wamin'hā takulūna It is Allah who created the cattle for you that you may ride some of them, and some of them you eat;

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْعَامَ لِتَرْكَبُوا مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-anʿāma litarkabū min'hā wamin'hā takulūna It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat. Allah, it is He Who has made cattle for you, that you may ride on some of them, and of some you eat (40:79). And you have (many other) benefits from them, and that you may reach by their means a desire that is in your breasts, and on them and on ships you are carried (40:80). And He shows you His Ayat. Which, then of the Ayat of Allah do you deny (40:81). The Cattle are Also a Blessing from Allah and a Sign from Him Allah reminds His servants of His blessing in that He created the cattle (Al-An'am) for…

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
