item.description: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْءَاخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ huwa l-awalu wal-ākhiru wal-ẓāhiru wal-bāṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayin ʿalīmun He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Hidden: and He is the Knower of all things (The All-Knowing.) Note how brief is the statement, within only four of the divine attributes of the Absolute viz., the External, the Manifest and the Hidden Existence of the Reality of the All-Divine Being is presented. These attributes in their true sense cannot be applicable but to an Absolute and Unlimited and All-embracing One about Whom nothing can be said actually except negation of the ideas and the concepts which are applicable to beings of composite nature (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Hadid:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ huwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa maʿakum ayna mā kuntum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days; then settled on the Throne. He knows whatever enters the earth and whatever emerges from it and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends to it, and He is with you wherever you may be, and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: Al-Hadid:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ huwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa maʿakum ayna mā kuntum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.1 He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you2 wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing. He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in…

item.title: Al-Hadid:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ huwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa maʿakum ayna mā kuntum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun He it is who created the heavens and the earth in six periods, then firmly established (Himself) over the 'Arsh' (Refer to the note on the process of creation and the absolute hold on the Arsh) (the Seat of supreme authority)', knoweth He whatever entereth the earth, and whatever goeth forth from it, and whatever descendeth from the heaven, and whatever goeth up into it; and He is…

item.title: Al-Hadid:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned.1

item.title: Al-Hadid:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned (all) matters. See 57:4

item.title: Al-Hadid:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and unto God (alone) arc returned (all) affairs (Refer to Verse 57:2.) See 57:4

item.title: Al-Hadid:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wahuwa ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri He makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night, and He knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: Al-Hadid:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wahuwa ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 57:4

item.title: Al-Hadid:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wahuwa ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri He causeth the night to enter in upon the day, and causeth (He) the day to enter in upon the night, and He (alone) is the Knower of whatever is in the breasts (Hearts.) See 57:4

item.title: Al-Hadid:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَٰمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنْفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُمْ مُسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِیْهِ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَأَنْفَقُوا لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ āminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wa-anfiqū mimmā jaʿalakum mus'takhlafīna fīhi fa-alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-anfaqū lahum ajrun kabīrun Have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and spend out of that wherein He has made you successors.1 Those of you who have faith and spend [in Allah's way] —there is a great reward for them.

item.title: Al-Hadid:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَٰمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنْفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُمْ مُسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِیْهِ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَأَنْفَقُوا لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ āminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wa-anfiqū mimmā jaʿalakum mus'takhlafīna fīhi fa-alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-anfaqū lahum ajrun kabīrun Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent,1 there will be a great reward. Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend of that whereof He has made you trustees. And such of you as believe and spend, theirs will be a great reward (57:7). And what is the matter with you that you believe not in Allah! While the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord; and He has indeed taken your covenant, if you are real believers (57:8). It is He Who sends down manifest Ayat to…

item.title: Al-Hadid:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَٰمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنْفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُمْ مُسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِیْهِ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَأَنْفَقُوا لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ āminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wa-anfiqū mimmā jaʿalakum mus'takhlafīna fīhi fa-alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-anfaqū lahum ajrun kabīrun Believe ye in God and His Apostle (Muhammad)! and spend ye (in charity) of whatever He hath made you the successors thereof; for whosoever among you believe and spend (in charity), for them is a recompense very great (Includes every kind of gift - intellectual as well as physical (A.P.).) Any intelligent student of the Holy Qur'an would not fail to note and appreciate Islam associating alms or charity with the faith. In fact, the sincerity of the believer in Islam, is proved by his attitude to his possessions in the material world. One who loves God, would surrender himself with all his interest, to Him. The verse means -…

item.title: Al-Hadid:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ wamā lakum lā tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-rasūlu yadʿūkum litu'minū birabbikum waqad akhadha mīthāqakum in kuntum mu'minīna Why should you not have faith in Allah while the Apostle invites you to have faith in your Lord, and He has certainly made a covenant with you, should you be faithful?

item.title: Al-Hadid:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ wamā lakum lā tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-rasūlu yadʿūkum litu'minū birabbikum waqad akhadha mīthāqakum in kuntum mu'minīna And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should (truly) be believers? See 57:7

item.title: Al-Hadid:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ wamā lakum lā tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-rasūlu yadʿūkum litu'minū birabbikum waqad akhadha mīthāqakum in kuntum mu'minīna And what reasons have ye that ye believe not in God? And the Apostle (The Holy Prophet.) inviteth you to believe in your Lord, and hath indeed taken a covenant from you if ye are believers Some commentator says that the 'Covenant' stands for the promise taken by God from each soul in the pregenital spiritual state, that the souls would serve God and none else.

item.title: Al-Hadid:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ huwa alladhī yunazzilu ʿalā ʿabdihi āyātin bayyinātin liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wa-inna l-laha bikum laraūfun raḥīmun It is He who sends down manifest signs to His servant that He may bring you out of darkness into light, and indeed Allah is most kind and merciful to you.

item.title: Al-Hadid:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ huwa alladhī yunazzilu ʿalā ʿabdihi āyātin bayyinātin liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wa-inna l-laha bikum laraūfun raḥīmun It is He who sends down upon His Servant (Muḥammad SAW) verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful. See 57:7

item.title: Al-Hadid:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ huwa alladhī yunazzilu ʿalā ʿabdihi āyātin bayyinātin liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wa-inna l-laha bikum laraūfun raḥīmun He it is Who sendeth down unto His Servant (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) signs manifest, so that He may bring you out of the darkness (of infidelity) into the light (of faith)' (Refer to Verse 2:257.) , and verily God unto you is the Most Kind and the Most Merciful! See 57:8

item.title: Al-Hadid:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنْفِقُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا يَسْتَوِي مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَنْفَقُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُوا وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْحُسْنَى وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wamā lakum allā tunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā yastawī minkum man anfaqa min qabli l-fatḥi waqātala ulāika aʿẓamu darajatan mina alladhīna anfaqū min baʿdu waqātalū wakullan waʿada l-lahu l-ḥus'nā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun Why should you not spend in the way of Allah, while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal [to others] are those of you who spent and fought before the victory.1 They are greater in rank than those who have spent and fought afterwards. Yet Allah has promised the best reward to each and Allah is well aware of what…

item.title: Al-Hadid:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنْفِقُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا يَسْتَوِي مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَنْفَقُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُوا وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْحُسْنَى وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wamā lakum allā tunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā yastawī minkum man anfaqa min qabli l-fatḥi waqātala ulāika aʿẓamu darajatan mina alladhīna anfaqū min baʿdu waqātalū wakullan waʿada l-lahu l-ḥus'nā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest (of Makkah) and fought (and those who did so after it). Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best (reward).…

item.title: Al-Hadid:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنْفِقُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا يَسْتَوِي مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَنْفَقُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُوا وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْحُسْنَى وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wamā lakum allā tunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā yastawī minkum man anfaqa min qabli l-fatḥi waqātala ulāika aʿẓamu darajatan mina alladhīna anfaqū min baʿdu waqātalū wakullan waʿada l-lahu l-ḥus'nā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun And what reasons have ye that ye spend not in the way of God, and God's is the heritage of the heavens and the earth; alike are not among you those who spent before the victory and fought and (those who did not), they are more exalted in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards; and unto all hath promised God goodness; And verily God,…

item.title: Al-Hadid:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ man dhā alladhī yuq'riḍu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahu lahu walahu ajrun karīmun Who is it that will lend Allah a good loan, that He may multiply it for him and [that] there may be a noble reward for him?

item.title: Al-Hadid:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ man dhā alladhī yuq'riḍu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahu lahu walahu ajrun karīmun Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward? See 57:7

item.title: Al-Hadid:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ man dhā alladhī yuq'riḍu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahu lahu walahu ajrun karīmun Who is he who would loan unto God a goodly loan? so that He may double it for him, and for him shall be a noble recompense (Refer to Verses 2:245; 5:12.) The goodly loan to God is charity, i.e., spending of the wealth in God's way. It is hound by the following conditions for its acceptance: That which is given away or spent in the way of the Lord must have been well-earned, i.e., through lawful means. The thing given must be defectless. That which is given, must be needed by the giver for himself and not the stuff not needed by the giver. Not that which is given away at the point of death…

item.title: Al-Hadid:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَرٰی الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَسْعَى نُورُهُمْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ بُشْرَاكُمُ الْيَوْمَ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yawma tarā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti yasʿā nūruhum bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim bush'rākumu l-yawma jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu The day you will see the faithful, men and women, with their light moving swiftly before them and on their right, [and greeted with the words:] 'There is good news for you today! Gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. That is the great success.'

item.title: Al-Hadid:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَرٰی الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَسْعَى نُورُهُمْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ بُشْرَاكُمُ الْيَوْمَ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yawma tarā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti yasʿā nūruhum bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim bush'rākumu l-yawma jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, (it will be said), "Your good tidings today are (of) gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment. On the Day you shall see the believing men and the believing women – their light running forward before them and in their right hands. Glad tidings for you this Day! Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise), to dwell therein forever! Truly, this is the great success (57:12). On…

item.title: Al-Hadid:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَرٰی الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَسْعَى نُورُهُمْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ بُشْرَاكُمُ الْيَوْمَ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yawma tarā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti yasʿā nūruhum bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim bush'rākumu l-yawma jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu The Day thou shalt see the faithful men and faithful women, with their light (The Light of faith and righteousness.) running before them, and on their right hand (shall be given) glad tidings for you of that Day! Gardens 'neath which flow rivers, to abide therein; That is the great achievement (Refer to Verse 7:44.) Ibn Mas'ood says that on the Day of Judgment everybody will have the light of his own righteousness to the extent of the degree of his or her own individual faith and goodness in his life. When the righteous ones -…

item.title: Al-Hadid:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتُ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا انْظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِنْ نُورِكُمْ قِيلَ ارْجِعُوْۤا وَرَاءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُوا نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِسُورٍ لَهُ بَابٌ بَاطِنُهُ فِیْهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظَاهِرُهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ الْعَذَابُ yawma yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wal-munāfiqātu lilladhīna āmanū unẓurūnā naqtabis min nūrikum qīla ir'jiʿū warāakum fal-tamisū nūran faḍuriba baynahum bisūrin lahu bābun bāṭinuhu fīhi l-raḥmatu waẓāhiruhu min qibalihi l-ʿadhābu The day the hypocrites, men and women, will say to the faithful, 'Please let up on us, that we may glean something from your light!' They will be told: 'Go back and grope for light!'1 Then there will be set up between them a wall with a gate, with mercy on its interior and punishment toward its exterior.

item.title: Al-Hadid:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتُ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا انْظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِنْ نُورِكُمْ قِيلَ ارْجِعُوْۤا وَرَاءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُوا نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِسُورٍ لَهُ بَابٌ بَاطِنُهُ فِیْهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظَاهِرُهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ الْعَذَابُ yawma yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wal-munāfiqātu lilladhīna āmanū unẓurūnā naqtabis min nūrikum qīla ir'jiʿū warāakum fal-tamisū nūran faḍuriba baynahum bisūrin lahu bābun bāṭinuhu fīhi l-raḥmatu waẓāhiruhu min qibalihi l-ʿadhābu On the (same) Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you1 and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment. See 57:12

item.title: Al-Hadid:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتُ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا انْظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِنْ نُورِكُمْ قِيلَ ارْجِعُوْۤا وَرَاءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُوا نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِسُورٍ لَهُ بَابٌ بَاطِنُهُ فِیْهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظَاهِرُهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ الْعَذَابُ yawma yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wal-munāfiqātu lilladhīna āmanū unẓurūnā naqtabis min nūrikum qīla ir'jiʿū warāakum fal-tamisū nūran faḍuriba baynahum bisūrin lahu bābun bāṭinuhu fīhi l-raḥmatu waẓāhiruhu min qibalihi l-ʿadhābu On the Day will say the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women unto those who believe: "Tarry ('Look ye' unto us.) ye for us, that we may borrow (To have a share from.) light from your light;" It shall be said: "Turn (Turn to - or reflect on what you have done and borrow from your own deeds what you left behind you.) ye back and seek ye (some other) light!" So there will be set between them a wall (a harrier) with a door therein;…

item.title: Al-Hadid:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُنْ مَعَكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنْتُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَارْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْأَمَانِيُّ حَتّٰی جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yunādūnahum alam nakun maʿakum qālū balā walākinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbaṣtum wa-ir'tabtum wagharratkumu l-amāniyu ḥattā jāa amru l-lahi wagharrakum bil-lahi l-gharūru They will call out to them, 'Did we not use to be with you?' They will say, 'Yes! But you cast yourselves into temptation, and you awaited1 and were doubtful, and [false] hopes deceived you until the edict of Allah2 arrived, and the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.

item.title: Al-Hadid:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُنْ مَعَكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنْتُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَارْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْأَمَانِيُّ حَتّٰی جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yunādūnahum alam nakun maʿakum qālū balā walākinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbaṣtum wa-ir'tabtum wagharratkumu l-amāniyu ḥattā jāa amru l-lahi wagharrakum bil-lahi l-gharūru They (i.e., the hypocrites) will call to them (i.e., the believers), "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves1 and awaited (misfortune for us) and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver (i.e., Satan) deceived you concerning Allah. See 57:12

item.title: Al-Hadid:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُنْ مَعَكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنْتُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَارْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْأَمَانِيُّ حَتّٰی جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yunādūnahum alam nakun maʿakum qālū balā walākinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbaṣtum wa-ir'tabtum wagharratkumu l-amāniyu ḥattā jāa amru l-lahi wagharrakum bil-lahi l-gharūru They will cry out unto them: 'Were we not with you?' They shall say: 'Yea! but ye cast yourself into temptation, and ye waited (for us to be beguiled) and ye doubted (in God's warning), and deceived you your vain desires till came the decree of God (to pass) and deceived you about God the (Arch) Deceiver (Satan.) ' By the word 'amr' meant the command for their death. The Deceiver, i.e., Satan. This shows the mere physical companionship in this life is that, even with the Holy Prophet - be of no avail (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Hadid:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ هِيَ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ fal-yawma lā yu'khadhu minkum fid'yatun walā mina alladhīna kafarū mawākumu l-nāru hiya mawlākum wabi'sa l-maṣīru So today no ransom shall be taken from you, nor from the faithless. The Fire will be your abode: it is your [ultimate] refuge and an evil destination.'

item.title: Al-Hadid:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ هِيَ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ fal-yawma lā yu'khadhu minkum fid'yatun walā mina alladhīna kafarū mawākumu l-nāru hiya mawlākum wabi'sa l-maṣīru So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination." See 57:12

item.title: Al-Hadid:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ هِيَ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ fal-yawma lā yu'khadhu minkum fid'yatun walā mina alladhīna kafarū mawākumu l-nāru hiya mawlākum wabi'sa l-maṣīru So this day shall not be accepted from you any ransom nor from those who disbelieved; your abode shall be the fire; it is your guardian (Has a right over you.) , and what a wretched resort it shall be! (Refer to Verses 2:48; 2:54; 2:123; 6:165; 17:15; 17:38; 17:52; 35:18.) See 57:14

item.title: Al-Hadid:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنْ تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ alam yani lilladhīna āmanū an takhshaʿa qulūbuhum lidhik'ri l-lahi wamā nazala mina l-ḥaqi walā yakūnū ka-alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablu faṭāla ʿalayhimu l-amadu faqasat qulūbuhum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna Is it not time yet for those who have faith that their hearts should be humbled for Allah's remembrance and to the truth which has come down [to them], and to be not like those who were given the Book before?1 Time took its toll on them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are transgressors.

item.title: Al-Hadid:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنْ تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ alam yani lilladhīna āmanū an takhshaʿa qulūbuhum lidhik'ri l-lahi wamā nazala mina l-ḥaqi walā yakūnū ka-alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablu faṭāla ʿalayhimu l-amadu faqasat qulūbuhum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient. Has not the time yet come for the believers that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah? And that which…

item.title: Al-Hadid:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنْ تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ alam yani lilladhīna āmanū an takhshaʿa qulūbuhum lidhik'ri l-lahi wamā nazala mina l-ḥaqi walā yakūnū ka-alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablu faṭāla ʿalayhimu l-amadu faqasat qulūbuhum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna Hath not the time yet come, for those who believe that their hearts become humble for the remembrance of God and what hath come down of the Truth? And (that) they should not be like unto those who were given the Book before, but (when) lengthened the ages passed over them (In arrogance and disobedience.) , so it hardened their hearts; and many of them are transgressors According to Ibn Abbas, 13 years, and according to Ibn Mas'ood 14 years after the revelation of…

item.title: Al-Hadid:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā qad bayyannā lakumu l-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna Know that Allah revives the earth after its death. We have certainly made the signs clear for you so that you may apply reason.

item.title: Al-Hadid:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā qad bayyannā lakumu l-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.1 See 57:16

item.title: Al-Hadid:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā qad bayyannā lakumu l-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna Know ye! that God enliveneth the earth after its death (To show how the dead will be resurrected.) . Indeed, have We made the signs clear unto you, that ye may understand See 57:16

item.title: Al-Hadid:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَاتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ inna l-muṣadiqīna wal-muṣadiqāti wa-aqraḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum walahum ajrun karīmun Indeed the charitable men and charitable women, and those who lend Allah a good loan —it shall be multiplied for them, and there is a noble reward for them.

item.title: Al-Hadid:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَاتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ inna l-muṣadiqīna wal-muṣadiqāti wa-aqraḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum walahum ajrun karīmun Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and (they who) have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward. Verily, those who give Sadaqat, men and women, and lend Allah handsome loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and theirs shall be an honorable good reward (57:18). And those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. they are the Siddiqun (true believers) and the martyrs with their Lord. They shall have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve and deny Our Ayat – they shall be the dwellers of the blazing Fire (57:19). Reward for the…

item.title: Al-Hadid:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَاتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ inna l-muṣadiqīna wal-muṣadiqāti wa-aqraḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum walahum ajrun karīmun Verily charitable men and charitable women and those who offer a goodly loan unto God, doubled shall it be unto them, and for them shall be a noble recompense (Refer to Verses 2:245; 5:12; 64:17; 73:20 and 57:11.) See 57:16

item.title: Al-Hadid:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi ulāika humu l-ṣidīqūna wal-shuhadāu ʿinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanūruhum wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi Those who have faith in Allah and His apostles —it is they who are the truthful and the witnesses1 with their Lord; they shall have their reward and their light. But as for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, they shall be the inmates of hell.

item.title: Al-Hadid:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi ulāika humu l-ṣidīqūna wal-shuhadāu ʿinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanūruhum wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are (in the ranks of) the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light.1 But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire. See 57:18

item.title: Al-Hadid:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi ulāika humu l-ṣidīqūna wal-shuhadāu ʿinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanūruhum wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi And those who believe in God and His Apostle, these it is who are the truthful ones (Those who doubted the bonafide of the Holy Prophet at Hudaibiyya and those who deserted him in the battles can never be the 'Siddiqun' – i.e., the truthful ones.) , and the witnesses with their Lord. For them shall be their recompense and their light; And those who disbelieve and belie Our signs, these are the inmates of hell The people are divided into groups - the one consisting of those who believe in God and the Holy Prophet - and the others…

item.title: Al-Hadid:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ iʿ'lamū annamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wazīnatun watafākhurun baynakum watakāthurun fī l-amwāli wal-awlādi kamathali ghaythin aʿjaba l-kufāra nabātuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yakūnu ḥuṭāman wafī l-ākhirati ʿadhābun shadīdun wamaghfiratun mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānun wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri Know that the life of this world is just play and diversion, and glitter, and mutual vainglory among you and covetousness1 for wealth and children —like the rain whose vegetation impresses the farmer; then it withers and you see it turn yellow, then it becomes chaff, while in the Hereafter there is a severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and His pleasure;…

item.title: Al-Hadid:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ iʿ'lamū annamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wazīnatun watafākhurun baynakum watakāthurun fī l-amwāli wal-awlādi kamathali ghaythin aʿjaba l-kufāra nabātuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yakūnu ḥuṭāman wafī l-ākhirati ʿadhābun shadīdun wamaghfiratun mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānun wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose (resulting) plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes (scattered) debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment…

item.title: Al-Hadid:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ iʿ'lamū annamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wazīnatun watafākhurun baynakum watakāthurun fī l-amwāli wal-awlādi kamathali ghaythin aʿjaba l-kufāra nabātuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yakūnu ḥuṭāman wafī l-ākhirati ʿadhābun shadīdun wamaghfiratun mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānun wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri Know ye! That the life of this world (The instability of which is like vegetation) is only a sport and play, a gaiety and a boasting and the lustful-vying (Rivalry.) in the multi-plication of wealth and children, is like unto the rain therewith springeth up the vegetation, it pleaseth the husbandmen (May refer to ungodly peasants.) ; then it is withered away,…

item.title: Al-Hadid:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَابِقُوْۤا إِلَى مَغْفِرَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ sābiqū ilā maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhā kaʿarḍi l-samāi wal-arḍi uʿiddat lilladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi dhālika faḍlu l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi Take the lead towards forgiveness from your Lord and a paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who have faith in Allah and His apostles. That is Allah's grace, which He grants to whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: Al-Hadid:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَابِقُوْۤا إِلَى مَغْفِرَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ sābiqū ilā maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhā kaʿarḍi l-samāi wal-arḍi uʿiddat lilladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi dhālika faḍlu l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi Race (i.e., compete) toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty. See 57:20

item.title: Al-Hadid:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَابِقُوْۤا إِلَى مَغْفِرَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ sābiqū ilā maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhā kaʿarḍi l-samāi wal-arḍi uʿiddat lilladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi dhālika faḍlu l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi Vie ye in hastening unto forgiveness from your Lord and unto a garden whose extent is like the extent of the heaven and the earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His Apostles; that is the grace of God, He bestoweth it upon whomsoever He willeth; and God is the Lord of Mighty Grace (Refer to Verse 3:132.) It is said that his deputy from Heracles asked the Holy Prophet, "If Paradise is to be extensive in the heavens and the earth, where would then be the hell?"…

item.title: Al-Hadid:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ نَبْرَأَهَا إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ mā aṣāba min muṣībatin fī l-arḍi walā fī anfusikum illā fī kitābin min qabli an nabra-ahā inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun No affliction visits the earth or yourselves but it is in a Book before We bring it about —that is indeed easy for Allah—

item.title: Al-Hadid:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ نَبْرَأَهَا إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ mā aṣāba min muṣībatin fī l-arḍi walā fī anfusikum illā fī kitābin min qabli an nabra-ahā inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register1 before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy. No calamity occurs in the earth nor in yourselves but it is inscribed in the Book of Decrees before We bring it into existence. Verily, that is easy for Allah (57:22). In order that you may not grieve at the things over that you fail to get, nor rejoice over that which has been given to you. And Allah likes not prideful boasters (57:23). Those who are misers and…

item.title: Al-Hadid:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ نَبْرَأَهَا إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ mā aṣāba min muṣībatin fī l-arḍi walā fī anfusikum illā fī kitābin min qabli an nabra-ahā inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun Befalleth not any disaster in the earth or in your own selves save it is in a Book, ere We cause it to be, verily that is easy for God 'Kitab' referred to in this verse is the secured Tablet. 'Lawh al-Mahfooz' which is the record of everything that is willed by God to be enacted. When it has been said that nothing takes effect without God's Will, i.e., everything is done when it is willed by God, man should resign himself to the will of the Lord both in pain and pleasure in loss and gain. In…

item.title: Al-Hadid:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا عَلَى مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوْۤا بِمَا ءَاتَاكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ likaylā tasaw ʿalā mā fātakum walā tafraḥū bimā ātākum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin so that you may not grieve for what escapes you, nor exult for what comes your way, and Allah does not like any swaggering braggart.

item.title: Al-Hadid:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا عَلَى مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوْۤا بِمَا ءَاتَاكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ likaylā tasaw ʿalā mā fātakum walā tafraḥū bimā ātākum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult (in pride) over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful. See 57:22

item.title: Al-Hadid:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا عَلَى مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوْۤا بِمَا ءَاتَاكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ likaylā tasaw ʿalā mā fātakum walā tafraḥū bimā ātākum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin Lest distress ye yourselves for what escapeth you, and be over- joyous for what He hath granted you; and God lovcth not an arrogant boaster See 57:22

item.title: Al-Hadid:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ alladhīna yabkhalūna wayamurūna l-nāsa bil-bukh'li waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu Such as are [themselves] stingy and bid [other] people to be stingy. And whoever refuses to comply [should know that] indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: Al-Hadid:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ alladhīna yabkhalūna wayamurūna l-nāsa bil-bukh'li waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu (Those) who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away1 - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy. See 57:22

item.title: Al-Hadid:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ alladhīna yabkhalūna wayamurūna l-nāsa bil-bukh'li waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu Those who are niggardly and enjoin upon people niggardliness; and whosoever turneth away (from charity) then verily God is He who is Self-Sufficient (In Arabic, Ghani.) , the Most Praise-Worthy (In Arabic, Hameed.) See 57:22

item.title: Al-Hadid:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِیْهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ laqad arsalnā rusulanā bil-bayināti wa-anzalnā maʿahumu l-kitāba wal-mīzāna liyaqūma l-nāsu bil-qis'ṭi wa-anzalnā l-ḥadīda fīhi basun shadīdun wamanāfiʿu lilnnāsi waliyaʿlama l-lahu man yanṣuruhu warusulahu bil-ghaybi inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun Certainly We sent Our apostles with manifest proofs, and We sent down with them the Book and the Balance, so that mankind may maintain justice; and We sent down1 iron, in which there is great might and uses for mankind, and so that Allah may know those who help Him and His apostles in [their] absence. Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: Al-Hadid:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِیْهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ laqad arsalnā rusulanā bil-bayināti wa-anzalnā maʿahumu l-kitāba wal-mīzāna liyaqūma l-nāsu bil-qis'ṭi wa-anzalnā l-ḥadīda fīhi basun shadīdun wamanāfiʿu lilnnāsi waliyaʿlama l-lahu man yanṣuruhu warusulahu bil-ghaybi inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain (their affairs) in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might. Indeed We have sent Our Messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Mizan…

item.title: Al-Hadid:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِیْهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ laqad arsalnā rusulanā bil-bayināti wa-anzalnā maʿahumu l-kitāba wal-mīzāna liyaqūma l-nāsu bil-qis'ṭi wa-anzalnā l-ḥadīda fīhi basun shadīdun wamanāfiʿu lilnnāsi waliyaʿlama l-lahu man yanṣuruhu warusulahu bil-ghaybi inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun Indeed, sent We Our apostles with clear proofs, and sent We down (Revealed, through the Messenger Angel.) with them the Book and the scale that people may establish themselves in justice; and sent We down iron wherein is latent (in its use) mighty power (Violence - Strength.) and also benefits for mankind (It is worth imagining for a while as to what will happen to human life on earth if God only commands the iron to become soft instead of being hard.) and that…

item.title: Al-Hadid:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ فَمِنْهُمْ مُهْتَدٍ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan wa-ib'rāhīma wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihimā l-nubuwata wal-kitāba famin'hum muh'tadin wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna Certainly We sent Noah and Abraham and We ordained among their descendants prophethood and the Book. Some of them are [rightly] guided, and many of them are transgressors.

item.title: Al-Hadid:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ فَمِنْهُمْ مُهْتَدٍ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan wa-ib'rāhīma wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihimā l-nubuwata wal-kitāba famin'hum muh'tadin wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna And We have already sent Nuh and Ibrahim and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient. And indeed, We sent Nuh and Ibrahim, and placed in their offspring prophethood and Scripture. And among them there are some who are guided; but many of them are rebellious (57:26). Then, We sent after them Our Messengers, and We sent Isa the son of Maryam, and gave him the Injil. And We ordained in the hearts of those who followed him, compassion and mercy. But the monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them, but (they…

item.title: Al-Hadid:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ فَمِنْهُمْ مُهْتَدٍ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan wa-ib'rāhīma wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihimā l-nubuwata wal-kitāba famin'hum muh'tadin wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna And indeed sent We Noah and Abraham, and endowed We in their seed the Prophethood and the Book, so among them are some who are guided aright; and most of them are transgressors This passage asserts the 'Nubuwah' and the Book will not go out of the issues of Noah and Abraham but it does not mean that all issues will be righteous and on the contrary most of them will be wicked1. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Hadid:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسٰی ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنْجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ابْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَاهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا فَءَاتَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ thumma qaffaynā ʿalā āthārihim birusulinā waqaffaynā biʿīsā ib'ni maryama waātaynāhu l-injīla wajaʿalnā fī qulūbi alladhīna ittabaʿūhu rafatan waraḥmatan warahbāniyyatan ib'tadaʿūhā mā katabnāhā ʿalayhim illā ib'tighāa riḍ'wāni l-lahi famā raʿawhā ḥaqqa riʿāyatihā faātaynā alladhīna āmanū min'hum ajrahum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna Then We followed them up with Our apostles and We followed [them] with Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him the Evangel, and We put in the hearts of those who followed him kindness and mercy. But as for monasticism, they innovated it —We had not prescribed it for them— only seeking Allah's pleasure. Yet they did not observe it with…

item.title: Al-Hadid:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسٰی ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنْجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ابْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَاهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا فَءَاتَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ thumma qaffaynā ʿalā āthārihim birusulinā waqaffaynā biʿīsā ib'ni maryama waātaynāhu l-injīla wajaʿalnā fī qulūbi alladhīna ittabaʿūhu rafatan waraḥmatan warahbāniyyatan ib'tadaʿūhā mā katabnāhā ʿalayhim illā ib'tighāa riḍ'wāni l-lahi famā raʿawhā ḥaqqa riʿāyatihā faātaynā alladhīna āmanū min'hum ajrahum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna Then We sent following their footsteps (i.e., traditions) Our messengers and followed (them) with Isa, the son of Maryam, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except (that they did so) seeking the approval of Allah. But they…

item.title: Al-Hadid:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسٰی ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنْجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ابْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَاهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا فَءَاتَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ thumma qaffaynā ʿalā āthārihim birusulinā waqaffaynā biʿīsā ib'ni maryama waātaynāhu l-injīla wajaʿalnā fī qulūbi alladhīna ittabaʿūhu rafatan waraḥmatan warahbāniyyatan ib'tadaʿūhā mā katabnāhā ʿalayhim illā ib'tighāa riḍ'wāni l-lahi famā raʿawhā ḥaqqa riʿāyatihā faātaynā alladhīna āmanū min'hum ajrahum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna We made Our apostles to follow in their footsteps, and sent We after them Jesus, son of Mary, and We gave him the Evangel; and We put into the hearts of those who followed him kindness and compassion; but (as to) the monastic life, they invented (The Christian monasticism is only an innovation. There is no monasticism in Islam.) it themselves. We…

item.title: Al-Hadid:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waāminū birasūlihi yu'tikum kif'layni min raḥmatihi wayajʿal lakum nūran tamshūna bihi wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah and have faith in His Apostle. He will grant you a double share of His mercy and give you a light to walk by, and forgive you, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful;

item.title: Al-Hadid:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waāminū birasūlihi yu'tikum kif'layni min raḥmatihi wayajʿal lakum nūran tamshūna bihi wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will (then) give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. O you who believe! Have Taqwa of Allah, and believe in His Messenger, He will give you a double portion of His mercy, and He will give you a light by which you shall walk (straight). And He will forgive you. And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (57:28). So that the People of the Scriptures…

item.title: Al-Hadid:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waāminū birasūlihi yu'tikum kif'layni min raḥmatihi wayajʿal lakum nūran tamshūna bihi wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O' ye who believe! Fear ye (the wrath of) God and believe in His Apostle; He will give you a twofold ('Rabtnaniyat', 'Rahemiyat'. See Note on 'Rahman' & 'Rahim' under S.I.) of His Mercy, He will appoint (Make.) for you a light wherein ye shall walk (straight on the Right Path) and He will forgive you; and God is Oft- Forgiving, the Most Merciful (Refer to Verse 7:156.) See 57:26

item.title: Al-Hadid:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ li-allā yaʿlama ahlu l-kitābi allā yaqdirūna ʿalā shayin min faḍli l-lahi wa-anna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi so that the People of the Book may know that they have no power over anything of Allah's grace, and that all grace is in Allah's hand which He grants to whomever He wishes and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: Al-Hadid:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ li-allā yaʿlama ahlu l-kitābi allā yaqdirūna ʿalā shayin min faḍli l-lahi wa-anna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi (This is) so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able (to obtain) anything from the bounty of Allah1 and that (all) bounty is in the hand2 of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty. See 57:28

item.title: Al-Hadid:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ li-allā yaʿlama ahlu l-kitābi allā yaqdirūna ʿalā shayin min faḍli l-lahi wa-anna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi So that may know the people of the Book that they control not aught of the grace of God, and that grace is in God's hand, He bestoweth it upon whosoever He willeth; and God is the Lord of Mighty Grace See 57:26

item.title: Al-Hajj:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum inna zalzalata l-sāʿati shayon ʿaẓīmun O mankind! Be wary of your Lord! Indeed the quake of the Hour is a terrible thing.

item.title: Al-Hajj:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum inna zalzalata l-sāʿati shayon ʿaẓīmun O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the (final) Hour is a terrible thing. يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ The Day you shall see it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling, means, she will be distracted by the horror of what she is seeing, which will make her forget the one who is the dearest of all to her and to whom she shows the most compassion. Her shock will make her neglect her infant at the very moment of breastfeeding, Allah says: كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ every nursing mother And He did not say a mother who has an infant of breastfeeding age. عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ her nursling means, her nursing infant that has not yet been weaned. وَتَضَعُ…

item.title: Al-Hajj:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum inna zalzalata l-sāʿati shayon ʿaẓīmun O' ye People! Fear ye your Lord! Verily, the quake of the Hour (of Doom) is a thing tremendous! (Grievous.) The reference here is to the end of the world. The address is to every man and woman as a warning against infidelity and wickedness. Inviting them to the faith in God and to lead a righteous life - The terrible happening of the convulsion or the quaking of the earth marking the beginning of the Hour of Judgment will be a terror only to the disbelievers and to those who have rebelled against the authority of the Lord by disobeying the prescribed laws (Shariah) and not for the faithful. The righteous ones are told of the bliss they would enjoy. The…

item.title: Al-Hajj:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرٰی النَّاسَ سُكَارٰی وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارٰی وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ yawma tarawnahā tadhhalu kullu mur'ḍiʿatin ʿammā arḍaʿat wataḍaʿu kullu dhāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā watarā l-nāsa sukārā wamā hum bisukārā walākinna ʿadhāba l-lahi shadīdun The day that you will see it, every suckling female will neglect what she suckled, and every pregnant female will deliver her burden, and you will see the people drunk, yet they will not be drunken, but Allah's punishment is severe.

item.title: Al-Hajj:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرٰی النَّاسَ سُكَارٰی وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارٰی وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ yawma tarawnahā tadhhalu kullu mur'ḍiʿatin ʿammā arḍaʿat wataḍaʿu kullu dhāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā watarā l-nāsa sukārā wamā hum bisukārā walākinna ʿadhāba l-lahi shadīdun On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that (child) she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people (appearing) intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe. See 22:1

item.title: Al-Hajj:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرٰی النَّاسَ سُكَارٰی وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارٰی وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ yawma tarawnahā tadhhalu kullu mur'ḍiʿatin ʿammā arḍaʿat wataḍaʿu kullu dhāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā watarā l-nāsa sukārā wamā hum bisukārā walākinna ʿadhāba l-lahi shadīdun On the day ye shall behold it, every suckling mother shall forsake (Will be so much perplexed.) her suckling babe; and every pregnant female shall drop her load, (The child in the womb.) and thou shalt behold the people (as) intoxicated; But the wrath of God will be (so) terrible. The matter pictures the terror and awe the hour will create in the minds of the disbelievers and the sinners.

item.title: Al-Hajj:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattabiʿu kulla shayṭānin marīdin Among the people are those who dispute about Allah without any knowledge, and follow every froward devil,

item.title: Al-Hajj:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattabiʿu kulla shayṭānin marīdin And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil. And among mankind is he who disputes about Allah, without knowledge, and follows every rebellious Shaytan (22:3). For him (the devil) it is decreed that whosoever follows him, he will mislead him, and will drive him to the torment of the Fire (22:4). Condemnation of the Followers of the Shaytan Allah condemns those who deny the Resurrection and who deny that Allah is able to restore life to the dead, those who turn away from that which Allah has revealed to His Prophets and, in their views – denial and disbelief – follow every rebellious Shaytan among men and…

item.title: Al-Hajj:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattabiʿu kulla shayṭānin marīdin And among the people there is he who disputeth about God without knowledge, and followeth every rebellious Satan, The word 'Shaytan', i.e., Devil, need not always refer to any spirit. 'Shayatin', i.e., devils are of two kinds - 'Shayatin al-Ins', i.e., devils among men and the 'Shayatin al-Jinn', i.e., the devils among the spirits. Here in this verse men are warned against two things: (1) Disputing about God without the necessary knowledge, (2) Blindly following those who have rebelled against God and godliness. This is the case with most people that they dispute about the truth without its knowledge and they, blindly follow their ancestral belief and traditions, and they identify themselves with the leaders of…

item.title: Al-Hajj:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ kutiba ʿalayhi annahu man tawallāhu fa-annahu yuḍilluhu wayahdīhi ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīri about whom it has been decreed that should anyone take him for a friend, he will lead him astray, and conduct him toward the punishment of the Blaze.

item.title: Al-Hajj:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ kutiba ʿalayhi annahu man tawallāhu fa-annahu yuḍilluhu wayahdīhi ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīri It has been decreed for him (i.e., every devil) that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze. See 22:3

item.title: Al-Hajj:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ kutiba ʿalayhi annahu man tawallāhu fa-annahu yuḍilluhu wayahdīhi ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīri Against him is decreed that whosoever taketh him as his friend, then verily shall he beguile him and lead him unto the torment of the burning fire. Refers to the fate of those who follow the Devil, i.e., the devilish instigations and the devilish characters - i.e., the satans among men and the devilish spirits.

item.title: Al-Hajj:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُضْغَةٍ مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا وَتَرٰی الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī raybin mina l-baʿthi fa-innā khalaqnākum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma min muḍ'ghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fī l-arḥāmi mā nashāu ilā ajalin musamman thumma nukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffā waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likaylā yaʿlama min baʿdi ʿil'min shayan watarā l-arḍa hāmidatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat wa-anbatat min kulli zawjin bahījin O people!…

item.title: Al-Hajj:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُضْغَةٍ مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا وَتَرٰی الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī raybin mina l-baʿthi fa-innā khalaqnākum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma min muḍ'ghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fī l-arḥāmi mā nashāu ilā ajalin musamman thumma nukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffā waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likaylā yaʿlama min baʿdi ʿil'min shayan watarā l-arḍa hāmidatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat wa-anbatat min kulli zawjin bahījin O people,…

item.title: Al-Hajj:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُضْغَةٍ مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا وَتَرٰی الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī raybin mina l-baʿthi fa-innā khalaqnākum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma min muḍ'ghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fī l-arḥāmi mā nashāu ilā ajalin musamman thumma nukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffā waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likaylā yaʿlama min baʿdi ʿil'min shayan watarā l-arḍa hāmidatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat wa-anbatat min kulli zawjin bahījin O' people!…

item.title: Al-Hajj:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَأَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-annahu yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wa-annahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun That is because Allah is the Reality and it is He who revives the dead, and He has power over all things,

item.title: Al-Hajj:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَأَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-annahu yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wa-annahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun That is because Allah is the True Reality and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent. See 22:5

item.title: Al-Hajj:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَأَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-annahu yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wa-annahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun This is because Verily God, He is the (Reality absolute.) Reality, and because verily He giveth life unto the dead, and because verily He, over all things hath power. The conclusion in verse 22:6 proves that there is One Absolute Reality behind this phenomenon of change and rise which prove His Almightiness.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Hajj:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ wa-anna l-sāʿata ātiyatun lā rayba fīhā wa-anna l-laha yabʿathu man fī l-qubūri and the Hour is bound to come, there is no doubt in it, and Allah will resurrect those who are in the graves.

item.title: Al-Hajj:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ wa-anna l-sāʿata ātiyatun lā rayba fīhā wa-anna l-laha yabʿathu man fī l-qubūri And (that they may know) that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allah will resurrect those in the graves. See 22:5

item.title: Al-Hajj:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ wa-anna l-sāʿata ātiyatun lā rayba fīhā wa-anna l-laha yabʿathu man fī l-qubūri And that the Hour (of Resurrection) is coming there is no doubt therein (in its coming.) and that God will raise up those in the graves. The Hour of Resurrection for the Final Judgment is declared not to be doubted at all. This asserts another conclusion, i.e., continuous approach of the end of the movement and every subsequent stage of development is latent in the preceding one. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Hajj:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīrin Among the people are those who dispute concerning Allah without any knowledge or guidance, or an enlightening Book,

item.title: Al-Hajj:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīrin And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book (from Him). And among men is he who disputes about Allah, without knowledge or guidance, or a Book giving light (from Allah) (22:8). Bending his neck in pride, and leading (others) too (far) astray from the path of Allah. For him there is disgrace in this worldly life, and on the Day of Resurrection We shall make him taste the torment of burning (22:9). That is because of what your hands have sent forth, and verily, Allah is not unjust to servants (22:10). Clarifying the State of the Leaders of the Innovators and Those Who Lead…

item.title: Al-Hajj:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīrin And among the people there is he who disputeth about God without knowledge and without any guidance and without any enlightening (A clear and logical proof.) book, 'Hudan' i.e., guidance, stands for the Divine guidance through an apostle or his successor (Imam) and 'Kitab-ul-Munir', i.e., The Illuminating Book stands for a revealed Book from God.

item.title: Al-Hajj:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَنُذِيقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ thāniya ʿiṭ'fihi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahu fī l-dun'yā khiz'yun wanudhīquhu yawma l-qiyāmati ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi turning aside disdainfully to lead [others] astray from the way of Allah. For such there is disgrace in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make him taste the punishment of the burning:

item.title: Al-Hajj:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَنُذِيقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ thāniya ʿiṭ'fihi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahu fī l-dun'yā khiz'yun wanudhīquhu yawma l-qiyāmati ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi Twisting his neck (in arrogance) to mislead (people) from the way of Allah. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire (while it is said). See 22:8

item.title: Al-Hajj:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَنُذِيقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ thāniya ʿiṭ'fihi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahu fī l-dun'yā khiz'yun wanudhīquhu yawma l-qiyāmati ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi Turning away haughtily (Proudly, arrogantly.) that he may beguile (others) from the way of God; For him in this world is disgrace and We shall make him taste on the Day of Judgment the punishment of the burning (Hell fire) See 22:8

item.title: Al-Hajj:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat yadāka wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi 'That is because of what your hands have sent ahead,1 and because Allah is not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: Al-Hajj:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat yadāka wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to (His) servants." See 22:8

item.title: Al-Hajj:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat yadāka wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi (And unto him will be said): "This is for (what thou worked in your life.) what sent before thy two hands, and that (verily) God is not unjust to His servants." Man's sufferings could be what he had himself earned by his own sinful deeds. God is never unjust to anyone.

item.title: Al-Hajj:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَأَنَّ بِهِ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ انْقَلَبَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ wamina l-nāsi man yaʿbudu l-laha ʿalā ḥarfin fa-in aṣābahu khayrun iṭ'ma-anna bihi wa-in aṣābathu fit'natun inqalaba ʿalā wajhihi khasira l-dun'yā wal-ākhirata dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu And among the people are those who worship Allah on the [very] fringe: if good fortune befalls him, he is content with it; but if an ordeal visits him he makes a turnabout, to become a loser in the world and the Hereafter. That is the manifest loss.

item.title: Al-Hajj:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَأَنَّ بِهِ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ انْقَلَبَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ wamina l-nāsi man yaʿbudu l-laha ʿalā ḥarfin fa-in aṣābahu khayrun iṭ'ma-anna bihi wa-in aṣābathu fit'natun inqalaba ʿalā wajhihi khasira l-dun'yā wal-ākhirata dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu And of the people is he who worships Allah on an edge.1 If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face (to unbelief). He has lost (this) world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss. And among mankind is he who worships Allah as it were upon the edge: if good befalls him, he is content therewith; but if a Fitnah strikes him, he turns back on his face. He loses both this…

item.title: Al-Hajj:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَأَنَّ بِهِ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ انْقَلَبَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ wamina l-nāsi man yaʿbudu l-laha ʿalā ḥarfin fa-in aṣābahu khayrun iṭ'ma-anna bihi wa-in aṣābathu fit'natun inqalaba ʿalā wajhihi khasira l-dun'yā wal-ākhirata dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu And of the people is he who worshippeth God (standing) on the verge, so if befalleth unto him good he is satisfied, and if afflicteth him a trial, he turneth back his face; loses (He has lost.) he both this world and (also) the here after; That is a loss (which is) manifest. (Clear.)
