item.description: لَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرًى مُحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ جُدُرٍ بَأْسُهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّى ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ lā yuqātilūnakum jamīʿan illā fī quran muḥaṣṣanatin aw min warāi judurin basuhum baynahum shadīdun taḥsabuhum jamīʿan waqulūbuhum shattā dhālika bi-annahum qawmun lā yaʿqilūna They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence (i.e., enmity) among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason. See 59:11

item.title: Al-Hashr:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرًى مُحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ جُدُرٍ بَأْسُهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّى ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ lā yuqātilūnakum jamīʿan illā fī quran muḥaṣṣanatin aw min warāi judurin basuhum baynahum shadīdun taḥsabuhum jamīʿan waqulūbuhum shattā dhālika bi-annahum qawmun lā yaʿqilūna They will fight not against you in a body except in towns fortified or from behind walls; Their fighting among themselves is severe; thou mayest deem them united, but their hearts are divided; That is because they are a people who understand not. See 59:11

item.title: Al-Hashr:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَثَلِ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ذَاقُوْۤا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ kamathali alladhīna min qablihim qarīban dhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun like those who, recently before them, tasted the evil consequences of their conduct, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: Al-Hashr:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَثَلِ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ذَاقُوْۤا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ kamathali alladhīna min qablihim qarīban dhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun (Theirs is) like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment. See 59:11

item.title: Al-Hashr:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَثَلِ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ذَاقُوْۤا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ kamathali alladhīna min qablihim qarīban dhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun They are like unto those who preceded lately, (who also) tasted the evil result of their (own) doings; and for them is a painful chastisement (Refer to Verse 64:5. Refers to the infidels being defeated and suffering losses of life and property in the previous battles brought about by themselves. AP.) . Refers to the disbelievers being defeated at Badr and the Bani Quraiza who consequent upon their violating their covenant with the Apostle of God and for their being busy intriguing with the enemy, had been ordered to quit their habitation. Abdullah Ibn Obai had promised to help them by mediating between them and the Holy Prophet or to help them in their fortress, and did neither,…

item.title: Al-Hashr:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَثَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ اكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِنْكَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ اللَّهَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ kamathali l-shayṭāni idh qāla lil'insāni uk'fur falammā kafara qāla innī barīon minka innī akhāfu l-laha rabba l-ʿālamīna [Or] like Satan, when he prompts man to renounce faith, then, when he renounces faith, he says, 'Indeed I am absolved of you. Indeed I fear Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: Al-Hashr:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَثَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ اكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِنْكَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ اللَّهَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ kamathali l-shayṭāni idh qāla lil'insāni uk'fur falammā kafara qāla innī barīon minka innī akhāfu l-laha rabba l-ʿālamīna (The hypocrites are) like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds." See 59:11

item.title: Al-Hashr:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَثَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ اكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِنْكَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ اللَّهَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ kamathali l-shayṭāni idh qāla lil'insāni uk'fur falammā kafara qāla innī barīon minka innī akhāfu l-laha rabba l-ʿālamīna Like unto satan who sayeth unto man; "Disbelieve thou!" and when he disbelieveth sayeth he: "Verily I disassociate from thee, verily I fear God, the Lord of the worlds!" Satan stands for the Devil and 'Insan,' i.e., man, for Abu-Jahl. On the eve of the departure for the battle of Badr, Satan appearing in the form of Soraqa the chief of the Bani Kannah promised Abu-Jahl saying, "O' Abu Hakam, none can triumph against you today - I shall he there to keep you." But at Badr, when Satan saw the angels descending down from heaven to help the Holy Prophet and the Muslims, ran away…

item.title: Al-Hashr:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَانَ عَاقِبَتَهُمَا أَنَّهُمَا فِي النَّارِ خَالِدَيْنِ فِيهَا وَذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الظَّالِمِينَ fakāna ʿāqibatahumā annahumā fī l-nāri khālidayni fīhā wadhālika jazāu l-ẓālimīna So the fate of both is that they will be in the Fire, to remain in it [forever]. Such is the requital of the wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-Hashr:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَانَ عَاقِبَتَهُمَا أَنَّهُمَا فِي النَّارِ خَالِدَيْنِ فِيهَا وَذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الظَّالِمِينَ fakāna ʿāqibatahumā annahumā fī l-nāri khālidayni fīhā wadhālika jazāu l-ẓālimīna So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers. See 59:11

item.title: Al-Hashr:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَانَ عَاقِبَتَهُمَا أَنَّهُمَا فِي النَّارِ خَالِدَيْنِ فِيهَا وَذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الظَّالِمِينَ fakāna ʿāqibatahumā annahumā fī l-nāri khālidayni fīhā wadhālika jazāu l-ẓālimīna So the end of both of those two (Satan and the disbeliever or the hypocrites and the disbelievers. Refer to Verse 11. AP.) (Satan as well as the disbeliever man) is that the two shall be in fire to abide therein; and that shall be the recompense of the unjust. Refers to the fate of both Satan who misled and Abu Jahl who got himself astray. This verse along with the previous one has its general application as well in the cases wherever Satan plays his role and the people allow themselves to be misled by him, i.e., the Tempter and those who allow themselves to be tempted. Satan and the disbeliever or the hypocrites and the disbeliever in verse…

item.title: Al-Hashr:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنْظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waltanẓur nafsun mā qaddamat lighadin wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah, and let every soul consider what it sends ahead1 for tomorrow, and be wary of Allah. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: Al-Hashr:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنْظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waltanẓur nafsun mā qaddamat lighadin wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Aware of what you do. O you who believe! Have Taqwa of Allah and let every person look to what he has sent forth for tomorrow, and fear Allah. Verily, Allah is All-Aware of what you do (59:18). And be not like those who forgot Allah, and He caused them to forget themselves. Those are the rebellious (59:19). Not equal are the dwellers of the Fire and the dwellers of the Paradise. It is the dwellers of Paradise that…

item.title: Al-Hashr:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنْظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waltanẓur nafsun mā qaddamat lighadin wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna 'O' ye who believe! Fear ye (the wrath of) God! Let every soul (carefully) look well to what (Good or evil.) it hath sent on for the morrow (This life is the season for sowing and the hereafter the season for reaping - as we sow so will one reap.) (the Day of Reckoning); and fear ye (the wrath of) God; Verily God is All-Aware of whatsoever ye do (Refer to Verse 57:13.) . 'Tomorrow', i.e., the hereafter and the last day of the Final Judgment. 'Taqwa' consists of abstaining from evil, i.e., guarding the self from getting polluted by evil, and at the same time…

item.title: Al-Hashr:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ نَسُوْۤا اللَّهَ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ أَنْفُسَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna nasū l-laha fa-ansāhum anfusahum ulāika humu l-fāsiqūna And do not be like those who forget Allah, so He makes them forget their own souls. It is they who are the transgressors.

item.title: Al-Hashr:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ نَسُوْۤا اللَّهَ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ أَنْفُسَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna nasū l-laha fa-ansāhum anfusahum ulāika humu l-fāsiqūna And be not like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient. See 59:18

item.title: Al-Hashr:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ نَسُوْۤا اللَّهَ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ أَنْفُسَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ walā takūnū ka-alladhīna nasū l-laha fa-ansāhum anfusahum ulāika humu l-fāsiqūna And be not like unto those who forsook God! so He made them forsake their own selves; these are the transgressors. The remembrance of God and the observing His command is in the interest of man himself, otherwise God does not heed our devotion. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Hashr:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْتَوِي أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ وَأَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ lā yastawī aṣḥābu l-nāri wa-aṣḥābu l-janati aṣḥābu l-janati humu l-fāizūna Not equal are the inmates of the Fire and the inhabitants of paradise. It is the inhabitants of paradise who are the successful ones.

item.title: Al-Hashr:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْتَوِي أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ وَأَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ lā yastawī aṣḥābu l-nāri wa-aṣḥābu l-janati aṣḥābu l-janati humu l-fāizūna Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers (of success). See 59:18

item.title: Al-Hashr:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْتَوِي أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ وَأَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ lā yastawī aṣḥābu l-nāri wa-aṣḥābu l-janati aṣḥābu l-janati humu l-fāizūna Equal are not the fellows of the fire and dwellers of the garden: the dwellers of the garden are they that are the achievers See 59:19

item.title: Al-Hashr:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ لَرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ law anzalnā hādhā l-qur'āna ʿalā jabalin lara-aytahu khāshiʿan mutaṣaddiʿan min khashyati l-lahi watil'ka l-amthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi laʿallahum yatafakkarūna Had We sent down this Qur'ān upon a mountain, you would have surely seen it humbled [and] go to pieces with the fear of Allah. We draw such comparisons for mankind, so that they may reflect.

item.title: Al-Hashr:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ لَرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ law anzalnā hādhā l-qur'āna ʿalā jabalin lara-aytahu khāshiʿan mutaṣaddiʿan min khashyati l-lahi watil'ka l-amthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi laʿallahum yatafakkarūna If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought. Had We sent down this Qur'an on a mountain, you would surely have seen it humbling itself and rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such are the parables which We put forward to mankind that they may reflect (59:21). He is Allah, beside Whom La ilaha illa Huwa, the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen. He is the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful (59:22). He is…

item.title: Al-Hashr:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ لَرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ law anzalnā hādhā l-qur'āna ʿalā jabalin lara-aytahu khāshiʿan mutaṣaddiʿan min khashyati l-lahi watil'ka l-amthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi laʿallahum yatafakkarūna Had We sent down this Qur'an, on mountain, thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) wouldst certainly have seen it (the mountain (Even the mountain with the hard stones would have yielded or submitted.) ) humbled itself, and rent asunder for the fear (Lit. Awe - caused by the feeling for the might and the grace of the object (Qur'an).) of God; And We set forth these similitudes unto mankind that they may reflect. See 7:143. When a mere reflection of the divine glory on the Mountain reduced the mount to dust, and in 33:72 when everything else save man, feared the responsibility of holding the…

item.title: Al-Hashr:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ huwa l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati huwa l-raḥmānu l-raḥīmu He is Allah—there is no god except Him— Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, He is the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

item.title: Al-Hashr:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ huwa l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati huwa l-raḥmānu l-raḥīmu He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed.1 He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. See 59:21

item.title: Al-Hashr:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ huwa l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati huwa l-raḥmānu l-raḥīmu He is God, There is no god (Refer to Verse 112:1.) , save He: The Knower of the unseen and the seen; He is the Beneficent, the Most Merciful. These verses contain the most beautiful of God's names using which in his supplication any sincere believer can invoke the infinite mercy of the Lord for the blessings desired by the adorer.

item.title: Al-Hashr:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ huwa l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa l-maliku l-qudūsu l-salāmu l-mu'minu l-muhayminu l-ʿazīzu l-jabāru l-mutakabiru sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna He is Allah—there is no god except Him— the Sovereign, the All-holy, the All-benign,1 the Securer, the All-conserver, the All-mighty, the All-compeller, the All-magnanimous. Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: Al-Hashr:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ huwa l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa l-maliku l-qudūsu l-salāmu l-mu'minu l-muhayminu l-ʿazīzu l-jabāru l-mutakabiru sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign,1 the Pure,2 the Perfection,3 the Grantor of Security,4 the Overseer,5 the Exalted in Might,6 the Compeller,7 the Superior.8 Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. See 59:21

item.title: Al-Hashr:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ huwa l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa l-maliku l-qudūsu l-salāmu l-mu'minu l-muhayminu l-ʿazīzu l-jabāru l-mutakabiru sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna He is God, There is no god save He; the King, the Holy, the Peaceloving (the Bestower of) conviction, the Guardian (over all), the Ever-Prevalent, the Supreme, the Great Absolute! Hallowed is God from what they associate (with Him). 'Salaam' God the Author of Peace, i.e., He is the Absolute One and the sole unifying factor in the system of existence. 'Mo'min' - Lit. Mo'min is the one who is firm in belief and as a usage in Qur'an means one who firmly believers in the unity of God and in this sense - God Himself, is the Self-realisation1- and the bestower…

item.title: Al-Hashr:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ huwa l-lahu l-khāliqu l-bāri-u l-muṣawiru lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā yusabbiḥu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu He is Allah, the Creator, the Maker, the Former. To Him belong the Best Names. Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Him and [whatever there is in] the earth, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Al-Hashr:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ huwa l-lahu l-khāliqu l-bāri-u l-muṣawiru lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā yusabbiḥu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu He is Allah, the Creator,1 the Producer,2 the Fashioner;3 to Him belong the best names.4 Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.5 See 59:21

item.title: Al-Hashr:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ huwa l-lahu l-khāliqu l-bāri-u l-muṣawiru lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā yusabbiḥu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu He is God, the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner, His are all the Excellent names; Halloweth Him whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth; and He is the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise. The excellence found in the creatures all are His as the Creator, Maker or Fashioner- and all are His in the real sense held by Him. Meanwhile it must be clear that none of the divine attributes of His, in any way or any extent resemble the qualities in any of His creatures. Thus, He is the unique unit in all respects in the Absolute sense of the term. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Hijr:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُبِينٍ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīnin Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the signs of the Book and a manifest Qur'ān.

item.title: Al-Hijr:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُبِينٍ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīnin Alif, Lām, Rā.1 These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān (i.e., recitation). رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا How much would those who disbelieved wish Here Allah tells us that they will regret having lived in disbelief, and will wish that they had been Muslims in this world. Regarding Allah's saying: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ How much would those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims. Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported from Salamah bin Kuhayl, who reported from Abi Az-Za'ra', from 'Abdullah, who said: "This is about the Jahannamiyyun (the sinners among the believers who will stay in Hell for some time), when they (the disbelievers) see them being brought out of Hell." رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ How much would those…

item.title: Al-Hijr:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُبِينٍ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīnin Alif, Lam, Ra, (A. L. R.) These are the verses of the Book and (of) a (Recital.) Qur'an (that maketh things) (Expansive.) manifest. Alif Lam Ra (A. L. R.)1 These few verses differentiate the truth from falsehood and guide towards the right belief and correct conduct. It has already been said that Qur'an can never serve the purpose of guidance without the prerequisite or the essential need in each individual reader, i.e., Piety.2 It is only a statement for ordinary men but a Guidance and Admonition to the Pious.3 and for the description of a true or perfect piety refer to verse 2:177. Besides, the correct interpretation of the verses in which has been treasured the fuller knowledge and the higher thoughts about the Absolute divinity, can never…

item.title: Al-Hijr:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْ كَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīna Much will the faithless wish that they had been muslims.

item.title: Al-Hijr:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْ كَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīna Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish1 that they had been Muslims. See 15:1

item.title: Al-Hijr:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْ كَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīna Often will wish those who disbelieved that had they been (This will be the desire of the disbelievers when they will be Convicted to Hell.) Muslims. (Those resigned unto God's will.) See 15:1

item.title: Al-Hijr:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوْۤا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūna Leave them to eat and enjoy and to be diverted by longings. Soon they will know.

item.title: Al-Hijr:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوْۤا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūna Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by (false) hope, for they are going to know. See 15:1

item.title: Al-Hijr:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوْۤا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūna Leave them (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) that they may eat and enjoy themselves and (that) beguileth them the (False hope.) hope, for soon will they know. The Holy Prophet is desired by God to leave the disbelievers to themselves for their lust for the enjoyment of this world in their lengthy ages of respite, to intoxicate them further against the consequences that await them. This is to indicate that the people are so deeply sunk in their infidelity and wickedness that they would never be guided aright hence no amount of preaching on the part of the Holy Prophet would be of any avail to them. God does not want the Holy Prophet to unnecessarily worry himself about the arrogant ones who are persistent in their…

item.title: Al-Hijr:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَعْلُومٌ wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābun maʿlūmun We did not destroy any town but that it had a known term.

item.title: Al-Hijr:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَعْلُومٌ wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābun maʿlūmun And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree. And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it (15:4). No nation can advance its term, nor delay it (15:5). Every Township has its Allotted Time Allah is informing us that He never destroys a township until He has established evidences for it and its allotted time has ended. When the time for a nation's destruction has come, He never delays it, and He never moves its appointed time forward. This was a message and a warning to the people of Makkah, telling them to give up their Shirk, their stubbornness and disbelief for which they deserved to be destroyed.

item.title: Al-Hijr:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَعْلُومٌ wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābun maʿlūmun And We destroyed not any town but it had an (already) fixed term. It is already there in the knowledge of God as to how far a respite is to be given to a people and when at last they would meet their perdition.

item.title: Al-Hijr:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna No nation can advance its time nor can it defer it.

item.title: Al-Hijr:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter. See 15:4

item.title: Al-Hijr:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna Neither can hasten on any of the people their doom, and nor can they delay (it). See 15:4

item.title: Al-Hijr:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūnun They said, 'O you, to whom the Reminder has been sent down, you are indeed crazy.

item.title: Al-Hijr:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūnun And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.1 And they say: "O you (Muhammad) to whom the Dhikr (the Qur'an) has been revealed! Verily, you are a madman (15:6). "Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful? (15:7). We do not send the angels down except with the truth, and in that case, they (the disbelievers) would have no respite (15:8). Verily, We, it is We Who revealed the Dhikr (i.e. the Qur'an) and surely We will guard it (from corruption) (15:9). The Accusation that the Prophet SAW was a Madman and Demands for Him to Bring down Angels Allah tells us about the disbelief, arrogance and stubbornness of…

item.title: Al-Hijr:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūnun And say they, "O' thou! (Our Apostle Muhammad) on whom hath come down the (Lit. Dhikr i.e. Qur'an.) Reminder (the Qur'an) verily thou art insane." See 15:4

item.title: Al-Hijr:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Why do you not bring us the angels should you be truthful?!'

item.title: Al-Hijr:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?" See 15:6

item.title: Al-Hijr:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Why dost thou bring not unto us the angels, if thou art of the truthful ones? The people used to ask the apostles to bring down the angels to bear witness to their really being the apostles of God. In reply it was said that the angels are not sent as and when they are demanded by the people but to execute the decision of the Lord viz. the doom of the people, and once the angels are sent there shall be no respite against the doom. It is a great blessing of God that the chastisement is delayed and it is delayed in spite of the people's hastening to have it.

item.title: Al-Hijr:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا إِذًا مُنْظَرِينَ mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idhan munẓarīna We do not send down the angels except with due reason, and then they will not be granted any respite.

item.title: Al-Hijr:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا إِذًا مُنْظَرِينَ mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idhan munẓarīna We do not send down the angels except with truth;1 and they (i.e., the disbelievers) would not then be reprieved. See 15:6

item.title: Al-Hijr:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا إِذًا مُنْظَرِينَ mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idhan munẓarīna We send not down the angels, but with truth, and they would not then be respited. See 15:7

item.title: Al-Hijr:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ innā naḥnu nazzalnā l-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna Indeed We have sent down the Reminder,1 and indeed We will preserve it.

item.title: Al-Hijr:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ innā naḥnu nazzalnā l-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna Indeed, it is We who sent down the message (i.e., the Qur’ān), and indeed, We will be its guardian. See 15:6

item.title: Al-Hijr:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ innā naḥnu nazzalnā l-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna Verily We have sent down the Reminder (the Qur'an), and verily We (Ourself) unto it will certainly be the Guardian. It is one of the challenging announcements as well as a prophecy which stands today already proved. God Himself undertakes the task of securing the Holy Qur'an, his Final Word to mankind in its original form and meaning. The Holy Scriptures revealed through the several other apostles of God in the past, were either corrupted or made all together extinct. God would not allow a similar fate to befall His Final Word, for no other apostle had to come nor any other book had to be revealed. Hence the security of the Last and the Final Word of God becomes necessary and it could be done…

item.title: Al-Hijr:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ الْأَوَّلِينَ walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīna Certainly We sent [apostles] before you to former communities,

item.title: Al-Hijr:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ الْأَوَّلِينَ walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīna And We had certainly sent (messengers) before you, (O Muḥammad), among the sects of the former peoples. Indeed, We sent (Messengers) before you (O Muhammad) amongst the earlier communities (15:10). And there never came a Messenger to them but that they mocked him (15:11). Thus We allow it to enter the hearts of the guilty (15:12). They would not believe in it (the Qur'an); and already the example of the ancients has gone forth (15:13). The Idolators of Every Nation Made a Mockery of their Messengers Consoling His Messenger SAW for the rejection of the disbelieving Quraysh, Allah says that He has sent Messengers before him to the nations of the past, and no Messenger came to a nation but they rejected him and mocked him.…

item.title: Al-Hijr:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ الْأَوَّلِينَ walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīna And indeed We did send apostles before thee among the people of yore. (Old - Ancient.) 'Shiaya', i.e., sects or nations, is the plural of 'Shia' which is derived from 'Mushaiat', i.e., following. The 'Shia's' of Ali, means those who are attached to Ali Ibn Abi Talib following him as their guide immediately succeeding the Holy Prophet. The renowned Sunni authority of the 'al-Ṣawa'iq al-Muḥriqah' says that the Holy Prophet said: "O' Ali! Thou and thy Shias shall he in Paradise." Here in this verse the word 'Shiaya' stands for the previous nations.

item.title: Al-Hijr:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wamā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna and there did not come to them any apostle but that they used to deride him.

item.title: Al-Hijr:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wamā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him. See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wamā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna And there came not unto them any apostle but they used to mock (Refers to the adamance of the disbelievers - applicable to the modern people who mock at religion and religiousness.) (at him). See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna That is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty:

item.title: Al-Hijr:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna Thus do We insert it (i.e., denial) into the hearts of the criminals. See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna Even (Indicates the determination not to believe at all even after witnessing manifest Signs proving the truth.) so do We cause it to traverse into the hearts of the guilty ones, See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīna they do not believe in it, and the precedent of the ancients has already passed.

item.title: Al-Hijr:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīna They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples. See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīna (That) (Same as above.) They believe not in it, and indeed hath already gone before, the example of the people of yore. See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوْۤا فِیْهِ يَعْرُجُونَ walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mina l-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūna Were We to open for them a gate of the sky, so that they could go on ascending through it,

item.title: Al-Hijr:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوْۤا فِیْهِ يَعْرُجُونَ walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mina l-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūna And (even) if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend. And even if We opened to them a gate to the heavens and they were to continue ascending through it (all day long) (15:14). They would surely say (in the evening): Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled (we have not seen any angel or heaven). Nay, we are a people bewitched (15:15). The Stubborn Disbelievers will Never Believe, No Matter what Signs and Wonders They See Allah explains the extent of their disbelief and stubborn resistance to the truth by stating that even if a door to heaven were to be opened for them, and they were to be taken up through it,…

item.title: Al-Hijr:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوْۤا فِیْهِ يَعْرُجُونَ walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mina l-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūna And (Same as above.) even if We open unto them a gateway of the heaven, that they all the while (Continuously.) may ascend into it, See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَسْحُورُونَ laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun masḥūrūna they would surely say, 'Indeed a spell has been cast on our eyes; rather we are a bewitched lot.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَسْحُورُونَ laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun masḥūrūna They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic." See 15:14

item.title: Al-Hijr:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَسْحُورُونَ laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun masḥūrūna Certainly would they say: "(It is) only (that) our eyes have been intoxicated (Enchanted.) rather we are a people bewitched (by some sorcery)." See 15:10

item.title: Al-Hijr:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ walaqad jaʿalnā fī l-samāi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīna Certainly We have appointed houses1 in the sky and adorned them for the onlookers,

item.title: Al-Hijr:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ walaqad jaʿalnā fī l-samāi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīna And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers. And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders (15:16). And We have guarded it (near heaven) from every outcast Shaytan (devil) (15:17). Except him (devil) who steals the hearing, then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire (15:18). And We have spread out the earth, and have placed firm mountains in it, and caused all kinds of things to grow in it, in due proportion (15:19). And in it We have provided means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not (15:20). The Power of Allah and His Signs in the Heavens and on Earth To…

item.title: Al-Hijr:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ walaqad jaʿalnā fī l-samāi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīna And indeed We have made in the heavens (outstanding) Constellations, (The Zodiac Stars. Refer to verse 85:1.) and We have beautified them for the beholders, 'Burooj', i.e., Mansions - or the stations through which the sun completes its circuit every year, The marvellously settled order, and the unchangeable and the undisturbable harmony, the strictly regulated cycle of seasons helping cultivation on land, the sure seasonal winds and the tides dependable for navigation, etc., the regulated constellations of the heavenly bodies and the other wonderful factors about the working of the laws of nature, are such marvels that the knowledge of which as it increases wonder in us, makes more and more than we could appreciate and admire it. All these which are vitally concerned and are…

item.title: Al-Hijr:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānin rajīmin and We have guarded them from every outcast Satan,

item.title: Al-Hijr:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānin rajīmin And We have protected it from every devil expelled (from the mercy of Allah). See 15:16

item.title: Al-Hijr:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānin rajīmin And We have guarded it from every accursed (Devil - Evil Spirits. Refer to verse 37:7.) Satan, See 15:16

item.title: Al-Hijr:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ illā mani is'taraqa l-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mubīnun except someone who may eavesdrop, whereat there pursues him a manifest flame.1

item.title: Al-Hijr:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ illā mani is'taraqa l-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mubīnun Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame. See 15:16

item.title: Al-Hijr:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ illā mani is'taraqa l-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mubīnun Except he who stealeth a hearing, so pursueth him a visible flame. (Refer to verses 72:8 & 67:5.) The beauties and the bliss of the heavens are denied to the forces of evil for these regions are reserved only for the godly and the virtuous ones who are invited to the blissful life in these beautiful and blissful regions. Simply because the materialistic mind would not conceive facts spiritual, the facts would not cease to exist for their sake. In fact, the spiritual world is a great ocean to which the material world can not be compared even as a drop. The shooting stars are said to be the repulsion, to stop disturbing elements from entering into the heavenly regions. Qummi in his commentary says that…

item.title: Al-Hijr:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayin mawzūnin And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and We grew in it every kind of balanced thing,

item.title: Al-Hijr:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayin mawzūnin And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein (something) of every well-balanced thing. See 15:16

item.title: Al-Hijr:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayin mawzūnin And the (Refer to verses 13:3 & 50:7.) earth, We have spread it out and thrown thereon firm mountains, and caused We to grow in it every thing well- measured See 15:18

item.title: Al-Hijr:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman lastum lahu birāziqīna and made in it [various] means of livelihood for you and for those whom you do not provide for.

item.title: Al-Hijr:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman lastum lahu birāziqīna And We have made for you therein means of living and (for) those for whom you are not providers.1 See 15:16

item.title: Al-Hijr:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman lastum lahu birāziqīna And We have made for you therein means of sustenance, and for him (i.e. every other creature) whom ye are not the sustainers. See 15:18

item.title: Al-Hijr:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ wa-in min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarin maʿlūmin There is not a thing but that its sources are with Us, and We do not send it down except in a known measure.

item.title: Al-Hijr:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ wa-in min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarin maʿlūmin And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known (i.e., specified) measure. And there is not a thing, but the supplies for it are with Us, and We do not send it down but in a known measure (15:21). And We send the winds fertilizing, then We cause the water to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its supply (15:22). And certainly We! It is We Who give life, and cause death, and We are the Inheritors (15:23). And indeed, We know the first generations of…

item.title: Al-Hijr:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ wa-in min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarin maʿlūmin And there is not a thing but with Us are its treasures, and We do not send it down but in a known (Fixed.) measure (i.e., According to the respective needs of the time, space and individuals to enable the execution of the divine plan.) See 15:18

item.title: Al-Hijr:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ wa-arsalnā l-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīna And We send the fertilizing winds and send down water from the sky providing it for you to drink and you are not maintainers of its resources.

item.title: Al-Hijr:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ wa-arsalnā l-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīna And We have sent the fertilizing winds1 and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers. See 15:21

item.title: Al-Hijr:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ wa-arsalnā l-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīna And We send the winds fertilizing, (Carrying the fertilising sperm from the male plant to the female one.) and then (We) send down water from heaven, thus We give it unto you to drink of it; and it is not ye that are its storers. (Storing water both in the heavens & in the clouds in heaven & in the reservoirs on earth.) See 15:18

item.title: Al-Hijr:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūna Indeed it is We who give life and bring death and We are the inheritors.

item.title: Al-Hijr:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūna And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.1 See 15:21

item.title: Al-Hijr:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūna And verily, only We (and none else) cause life and cause death and We are the (only) (Lit 'Warith' - heir One who inherits - The one who has passed away - Here means God - Who is the only Self - and Ever-Existent One and all others besides Him are perishable.) Heirs (Who would remain after all else passeth away.) See 15:18

item.title: Al-Hijr:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَءْخِرِينَ walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīna Certainly We know the predecessors among you and certainly We know the successors,

item.title: Al-Hijr:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَءْخِرِينَ walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīna And We have already known the preceding (generations) among you, and We have already known the later (ones to come). See 15:21

item.title: Al-Hijr:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَءْخِرِينَ walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīna And indeed We know those eager to be foremost among you and We know those who like to lag behind. The verse refers to the faithful who used always to be in the forefront or the first to respond at the event of Jihad, (i.e., the battle to save the faith and the faithful), and those who stayed behind in the ranks, avoiding the notice of the enemy and saving themselves from being hurt, while the faithful in the front risked their lives. This verse would apply more and specially to those who absented themselves altogether from the battlefield and even if they ever joined the march of the faithful towards such an expedition they did not stay long there in the field but ran away…

item.title: Al-Hijr:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِیْمٌ۠ عَلِیْمٌ wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmun and indeed it is your Lord who will resurrect them. Indeed He is all-wise, all-knowing.

item.title: Al-Hijr:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِیْمٌ۠ عَلِیْمٌ wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmun And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing. See 15:21

item.title: Al-Hijr:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِیْمٌ۠ عَلِیْمٌ wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmun And verily thy Lord, He will gather them together; Verily He is All-Wise, All-Knowing. See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin Certainly We created man out of a dry clay1 [drawn] from an aging mud,

item.title: Al-Hijr:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud. And indeed, We created man from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud (15:26). And the Jinn, We created earlier from the smokeless flame of fire (15:27). The Substances from which Mankind and Jinns were Created Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid and Qatadah said that Salsal means dry mud. The apparent meaning is similar to the Ayah: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ - وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the potter's clay, And He created the Jinns from a smokeless flame of fire. (55:14-15) It was also reported from Mujahid that: صَلْصَالٍ dried (sounding) clay means "putrid", but it is more appropriate to interpret an…

item.title: Al-Hijr:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin And indeed We created man of clay that giveth sound, of black mud moulded into shape. See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْجَانَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ مِنْ نَارِ السَّمُومِ wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāri l-samūmi and We created the jinn earlier out of a piercing fire.

item.title: Al-Hijr:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْجَانَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ مِنْ نَارِ السَّمُومِ wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāri l-samūmi And the jinn We created before from scorching fire. See 15:26

item.title: Al-Hijr:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْجَانَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ مِنْ نَارِ السَّمُومِ wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāri l-samūmi And the jinn We created before of intense hot (smokeless ) fire. See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin When your Lord said to the angels, 'Indeed I am going to create a human out of a dry clay [drawn] from an aging mud.

item.title: Al-Hijr:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin And (mention, O Muḥammad), when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud. And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "I am going to create a man (Adam) from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud (15:28). "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) of My spirit (the soul which I created for him,) then fall down, prostrating yourselves before him (15:29). So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together (15:30). Except Iblis (Shaytan) - he refused to be among the prostrate (15:31). (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What is your reason for not being among the prostrate?…

item.title: Al-Hijr:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin And remember when thy Lord said unto the angels: "Verily I create man (A mortal.) of the essence of black mud fashioned into shape." See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My (created) soul,1 then fall down to him in prostration." See 15:28

item.title: Al-Hijr:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna So when I complete him and breathe into him My spirit, fall ye down unto him prostrating (in obeisance). See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together,

item.title: Al-Hijr:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely. See 15:28

item.title: Al-Hijr:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna So prostrated (in obeisance) (unto him) the angels all of them. See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبٰی أَنْ يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ illā ib'līsa abā an yakūna maʿa l-sājidīna but not Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated.

item.title: Al-Hijr:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبٰی أَنْ يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ illā ib'līsa abā an yakūna maʿa l-sājidīna Except Iblees;1 he refused to be with those who prostrated. See 15:28

item.title: Al-Hijr:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبٰی أَنْ يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ illā ib'līsa abā an yakūna maʿa l-sājidīna Except 'Iblis; Refused he to be with those who prostrated in obeisance. See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa l-sājidīna He said, 'O Iblis! What kept you from being among those who have prostrated?'

item.title: Al-Hijr:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa l-sājidīna (Allah) said, "O Iblees, what is (the matter) with you that you are not with those who prostrate?" See 15:28

item.title: Al-Hijr:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa l-sājidīna Said He (God.) O' Iblees! "What hindereth thee that thou art not with those who prostrate in obeisance?" See 15:24

item.title: Al-Hijr:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ qāla lam akun li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin Said he, 'I will not prostrate before a human whom You have created out of a dry clay [drawn] from an aging mud.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ qāla lam akun li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud." See 15:28

item.title: Al-Hijr:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ qāla lam akun li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin He said: "I am not one to prostrate in obeisance unto man (A mortal.) (for) Thou created him of the essence of black mud fashioned in shape." The argument of 'Iblis' or Satan was that Adam was created of clay and clay is the basest of the elements, (i.e., an earthly being), and he (Iblis) was created of fire which is a superior and subtler element; how could a superior being adore an inferior one. The fact is Iblis could have only the external view of the physical existence of Adam and did not consider the superior-most and of the unique excellence endowed in him (i.e., of the Sublime Spirit, even that of God's own). The Sixth Holy…

item.title: Al-Hijr:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun He said, 'Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast,

item.title: Al-Hijr:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun (Allah) said, "Then depart from it,1 for indeed, you are expelled. (Allah) said: Then leave, for verily, you are an outcast (15:34). "And verily, the curse shall be upon you until the Day of Recompense (15:35). (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! Then give me respite until the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected (15:36). Allah said: "Then verily, you are of those reprieved, (15:37). "Until the Day of the time appointed (15:38). The Expulsion of Iblis from Jannah, and His Reprieve until the Day of Resurrection Allah tells us how He issued an unconditional command to Iblis to leave the position he held among the highest of heights. He told him that he was an outcast, i.e., cursed, and that he would be followed by a curse that would…

item.title: Al-Hijr:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun Said He: (Refer to verse 38:77.) "Then get thou out of it, for verily thou art the driven away accursed," When Iblis refused to do obeisance to Adam he was dismissed and made an accursed outcast from the Lord's Mercy and Grace. 'Rajeem' is the one driven away.

item.title: Al-Hijr:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi l-dīni and indeed the curse shall lie on you until the Day of Retribution.'1

item.title: Al-Hijr:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi l-dīni And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense." See 15:34

item.title: Al-Hijr:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi l-dīni And verily on thee is (My) curse until the Judgment Day. See 15:34

item.title: Al-Hijr:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He said, 'My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected." See 15:34

item.title: Al-Hijr:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He (Iblis – Satan.) said: "My Lord! Respite me till the day when they are raised." See 15:34

item.title: Al-Hijr:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna Said He, 'You are indeed among the reprieved

item.title: Al-Hijr:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna (Allah) said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved. See 15:34

item.title: Al-Hijr:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna Said He: "Then verily thou art of the respited ones," It is said that Iblis has been granted respite until the blowing of the Trumpet which will be given for the total annihilation of all living beings before the Final Judgment. He will meet death between the first and the second blow of the Trumpet.

item.title: Al-Hijr:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi until the day of the known time.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi Until the Day of the time well-known." See 15:34

item.title: Al-Hijr:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi Till the day (Period.) of the time made known. See 15:37

item.title: Al-Hijr:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna He said, 'My Lord! As You have consigned me to perversity, I will surely glamorize [evil] for them on the earth, and I will surely pervert them, all

item.title: Al-Hijr:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna (Iblees) said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make (disobedience) attractive to them (i.e., mankind) on earth, and I will mislead them all. (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! Because You misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all (15:39). "Except Your chosen (guided) servants among them (15:40). (Allah) said: "This is the way which will lead straight to Me (15:41). "Certainly, you shall have no authority over My servants, except those of the astray who follow you (15:42). And surely, Hell is the place promised for them all (15:43). It has seven gates, for each of those gates is a…

item.title: Al-Hijr:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna He said: "My Lord! because Thou hast left me to stray, certainly will I (Shall make fair-seeming the wrong and the false things and way to mislead mankind on earth.) adorn unto them the path of error, and certainly will I cause them all to go astray," See 15:37

item.title: Al-Hijr:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna except Your exclusive servants among them.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna Except, among them, Your chosen servants." See 15:39

item.title: Al-Hijr:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna Save Thy (devoted) servants, of them the freed ones. 'Mukhlus', i.e., the purified ones freed. To know who the purified ones are see verse 33:33. It is clearly indicated that even Iblis being hopeless of his success against beguiling any one of the holy Ahl al-Bayt, he himself very gracefully puts an exception in his challenge to beguile the issues of Adam on earth. It is quite obvious that though these purified ones (i.e., the Mukhlasin) were sent into this world through the progeny of Adam, they were beings with special excellence of quality and matter, quite different from the children of Adam which under no circumstances could have been imagined even by the Arch-Deceiver Iblis, to be ever subject to any temptation at all. Any intelligent reader can easily judge how…

item.title: Al-Hijr:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mus'taqīmun He said, 'This is the path [leading] straight to Me.1

item.title: Al-Hijr:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mus'taqīmun (Allah) said, "This is a path (of return) to Me (that is) straight. See 15:39

item.title: Al-Hijr:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mus'taqīmun Said He (God.) : "This is a right way unto (In the matter of My freed Servants. Any other recitation is wrong. Refer to note on 'Tahrif' in the introduction – A.P.) Me" The word 'Aliyya' used here is a subject of serious consideration. It is a question created by the various 'Qurra' of the earliest reciters of the Holy Qur'an, whether this word is 'Aliyan' or 'Aliyun' or 'ilayya'. Some have taken it as 'Aliyya' and interpret the verse as 'my path which, is high'. Those who contest this view-point say that a way could rightly be praised if it is straight for the quality, praiseworthy in a way, is always its being straight or direct and not high or low as the height of the road is in…

item.title: Al-Hijr:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun illā mani ittabaʿaka mina l-ghāwīna Indeed as for My servants you do not have any authority over them, except the perverse who follow you,

item.title: Al-Hijr:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun illā mani ittabaʿaka mina l-ghāwīna Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators. See 15:39

item.title: Al-Hijr:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun illā mani ittabaʿaka mina l-ghāwīna Verily, (as regards) My (devoted) servants, There is not for thee over them any (Refer to note on verse 6:68.) authority except the one who followeth thee, of the (Arabic 'Ghaween' Those who deviate and go forward leaving the right course. There is not for thee.) deviators This declaration fully justifies the attitude which should naturally be towards the purified ones for evil could never have any authority or hold upon them. This position of the Devil is borne out by his own statement in verse 14:22.

item.title: Al-Hijr:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīna and indeed hell is the tryst of them all.

item.title: Al-Hijr:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīna And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all. See 15:39

item.title: Al-Hijr:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīna And verily Hell is certainly the promised abode for them all, See 15:42

item.title: Al-Hijr:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَقْسُومٌ lahā sabʿatu abwābin likulli bābin min'hum juz'on maqsūmun It has seven gates, and to each gate belongs a separate portion of them.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَقْسُومٌ lahā sabʿatu abwābin likulli bābin min'hum juz'on maqsūmun It has seven gates; for every gate is of them (i.e., Satan's followers) a portion designated." See 15:39

item.title: Al-Hijr:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَقْسُومٌ lahā sabʿatu abwābin likulli bābin min'hum juz'on maqsūmun For it (the Hell) are seven gates; for each of those (gates) shall be a separate party (of the sinners) assigned. The Seven Doors have been mentioned with seven different names of the Seven Stages of Hell, which stages according to the statement of the First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib, are one over the other - The Seven Doors or the stages of Hell are: Jahunnam i.e., the hell. Sa'yur i.e., the burning fire. Saqar i.e., the scorching fire. Jahim i.e., the fierce fire. Luza i.e., the flaming fire.1 Hatamah i.e., the crushing disaster.2 Huwiyah i.e., the abyss.3 The last stage containing the most intense sufferings would be of the hypocrites for it is said in the Holy Qur'an: 'Verily the hypocrites…

item.title: Al-Hijr:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs.

item.title: Al-Hijr:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs. Truly, those who have Taqwa, will dwell in Gardens and water springs (15:45). (It will be said to them): Enter it in peace and security (15:46). And We shall remove any deep feeling of bitterness from their breasts. (So they will be like) brothers facing each other on thrones (15:47). No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they be asked to leave i (15:48). Declare to My servants that I am truly the Forgiving, the Most Merciful (15:49). And that My torment is indeed the most painful torment (15:50). Description of the People of Paradise Since Allah mentioned the condition of the people of Hell, He followed that by mentioning the people of Paradise. He tells us that they…

item.title: Al-Hijr:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Verily the pious (Those who guard themselves against evil.) ones shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains; See 15:44

item.title: Al-Hijr:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ءَامِنِينَ ud'khulūhā bisalāmin āminīna "Enter it in peace and safety!"

item.title: Al-Hijr:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ءَامِنِينَ ud'khulūhā bisalāmin āminīna (Having been told), "Enter it in peace, safe (and secure)." See 15:45

item.title: Al-Hijr:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ءَامِنِينَ ud'khulūhā bisalāmin āminīna (The angels saying unto them:) "Enter ye therein in Peace, Secure" See 15:44

item.title: Al-Hijr:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَانًا عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikh'wānan ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna We will remove whatever rancour there is in their breasts; [intimate like] brothers, [they will be reclining] on couches, facing one another.

item.title: Al-Hijr:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَانًا عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikh'wānan ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment,1 (so they will be) brothers, on thrones facing each other. See 15:45

item.title: Al-Hijr:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَانًا عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikh'wānan ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna And We will root out whatever rancour be in their hearts, (they shall be} as brothers, on dignified couches, (In rejoicing assemblies - This asserts the social pleasures in the life hereafter – mirroring their love for each other.) face to face. See 15:44

item.title: Al-Hijr:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُمْ مِنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabun wamā hum min'hā bimukh'rajīna Therein neither weariness shall touch them, nor will they [ever] be expelled from it.

item.title: Al-Hijr:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُمْ مِنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabun wamā hum min'hā bimukh'rajīna No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they (ever) be removed. See 15:45

item.title: Al-Hijr:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُمْ مِنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabun wamā hum min'hā bimukh'rajīna Shall not touch them therein any weariness, nor shall they ever be cast out of it. See 15:44

item.title: Al-Hijr:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ nabbi ʿibādī annī anā l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Inform my servants that I am indeed the All-forgiving, the All-merciful,

item.title: Al-Hijr:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ nabbi ʿibādī annī anā l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu (O Muḥammad), inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful. See 15:45

item.title: Al-Hijr:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ nabbi ʿibādī annī anā l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Announce thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto My servants that Verily I, am the most Oft-Forgiving, The Most Merciful, Note the gracious way in which the sinners are invited to repentance seeking pardon and mercy of the Lord for it is voluntarily announced by the Lord Himself.

item.title: Al-Hijr:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ wa-anna ʿadhābī huwa l-ʿadhābu l-alīmu and that My punishment is a painful punishment.

item.title: Al-Hijr:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ wa-anna ʿadhābī huwa l-ʿadhābu l-alīmu And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment. See 15:45

item.title: Al-Hijr:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ wa-anna ʿadhābī huwa l-ʿadhābu l-alīmu And that My chastisement that is the chastisement grievous. See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ wanabbi'hum ʿan ḍayfi ib'rāhīma And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

item.title: Al-Hijr:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ wanabbi'hum ʿan ḍayfi ib'rāhīma And inform them about the guests of Ibrahim. And tell them about the guests (i. e., the angels) of Ibrahim (15:51). When they entered upon him, and said: Salaman (peace!)." He said: "Indeed we are frightened of you (15:52).
