They said: "Do not be afraid! We bring you the good news of a boy possessing much knowledge and wisdom (15:53). He said: "Do you give me this good news while old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your news about? (15:54). They said: "We give you good news in truth. So do not be of those who despair (15:55). He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except those who are astray? (15:56). The Guests of Ibrahim and their Good News of a Son for Him Allah…

item.title: Al-Hijr:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ wanabbi'hum ʿan ḍayfi ib'rāhīma And inform them of the guests of Abraham See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla innā minkum wajilūna when they entered into his presence and said, 'Peace!' He said, 'We are indeed afraid of you.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla innā minkum wajilūna When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." (Ibrahim) said, "Indeed, we are fearful (i.e., apprehensive) of you." See 15:51

item.title: Al-Hijr:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla innā minkum wajilūna When they entered in unto him, said they: "Peace." He said: "Verily we feel afraid of you!" See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ qālū lā tawjal innā nubashiruka bighulāmin ʿalīmin They said, 'Do not be afraid. Indeed we give you the good news of a wise son.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ qālū lā tawjal innā nubashiruka bighulāmin ʿalīmin (The angels) said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy." See 15:51

item.title: Al-Hijr:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ qālū lā tawjal innā nubashiruka bighulāmin ʿalīmin Said they: "Fear thou not! Verily we bear unto thee the glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge." See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَى أَنْ مَسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ qāla abashartumūnī ʿalā an massaniya l-kibaru fabima tubashirūna He said, 'Do you give me good news though old age has befallen me? What is the good news that you bring me?'

item.title: Al-Hijr:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَى أَنْ مَسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ qāla abashartumūnī ʿalā an massaniya l-kibaru fabima tubashirūna He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what (wonder) do you inform?" See 15:51

item.title: Al-Hijr:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَى أَنْ مَسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ qāla abashartumūnī ʿalā an massaniya l-kibaru fabima tubashirūna He said: "Bear ye unto me the glad tidings (of a son) (In spite of.) while, old age hath touched me? of what then bear ye unto me the glad tidings?" See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْقَانِطِينَ qālū basharnāka bil-ḥaqi falā takun mina l-qāniṭīna They said, 'We bring you good news in truth; so do not be among the despondent.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْقَانِطِينَ qālū basharnāka bil-ḥaqi falā takun mina l-qāniṭīna They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing." See 15:51

item.title: Al-Hijr:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْقَانِطِينَ qālū basharnāka bil-ḥaqi falā takun mina l-qāniṭīna They (The angels.) said: "We bear unto thee the glad tidings in truth, so be thou not of the despairing ones." See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ qāla waman yaqnaṭu min raḥmati rabbihi illā l-ḍālūna He said, 'Who despairs of his Lord's mercy except those who are astray?!'

item.title: Al-Hijr:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ qāla waman yaqnaṭu min raḥmati rabbihi illā l-ḍālūna He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?" See 15:51

item.title: Al-Hijr:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ qāla waman yaqnaṭu min raḥmati rabbihi illā l-ḍālūna Said he: (Abraham.) "And who (Being despaired of God's mercy is considered a major Sin in Islam.) despaireth of the mercy of his Lord but those who are astray?" See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna He said, 'O messengers, what is now your errand?'

item.title: Al-Hijr:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna (Ibrahim) said, "Then what is your business (here), O messengers?" He said: "What then is the business for which you have come, O messengers? (15:57). They said: "We have been sent to a guilty people (15:58). "(All) except the family of Lut, all of whom we are to save (from the destruction) (15:59). "Except for his wife, of whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind (15:60). The Reason Why the Angels Came Allah tells us that after Ibrahim had calmed down from the excitement of this good news, he started to ask them why they had come to him. They said: إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ We have been sent to a guilty people. meaning the people of Lut. They told him that they…

item.title: Al-Hijr:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna He (Abraham.) said: "What is your business, then, O' messengers (of God)?" See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna They said, 'We have been sent toward a guilty people,

item.title: Al-Hijr:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals. See 15:57

item.title: Al-Hijr:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna Said they: "Verily we are sent unto a guilty people," See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ illā āla lūṭin innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīna [who shall perish] except the family of Lot. We will indeed deliver all of them,

item.title: Al-Hijr:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ illā āla lūṭin innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīna Except the family of Lut; indeed, we will save them all. See 15:57

item.title: Al-Hijr:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ illā āla lūṭin innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīna Except the family of Lot; Verily we will deliver them all See 15:49

item.title: Al-Hijr:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnā innahā lamina l-ghābirīna except his wife, [who], We have ordained, will indeed be among those who remain behind.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnā innahā lamina l-ghābirīna Except his wife." We (i.e., Allah) decreed that she is of those who remain behind.1 See 15:57

item.title: Al-Hijr:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnā innahā lamina l-ghābirīna Except his (Lot's.) wife; we are certain that she shall be of those who remain behind (in the wrath of God). Referring to Lot the Holy Qur'an repeatedly says that Lot was rescued and his 'Aal', i.e., family in general and 'Ahl' and relatives in particular, i.e., the closest members of the house. Wife is not included from those who were blessed with the delivery from the wrath. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Hijr:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ اٰلَ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلُونَ falammā jāa āla lūṭin l-mur'salūna So when the messengers came to Lot's family,

item.title: Al-Hijr:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ اٰلَ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلُونَ falammā jāa āla lūṭin l-mur'salūna And when the messengers came to the family of Lut. Then when the messengers (the angels) came to the family of Lu (15:61). He (Lut) said: Verily, you are people unknown to me (15:62). They said: "Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting (15:63). "And we have brought you the truth and certainly we tell the truth (15:64). The Angels Coming to Lut Allah tells us about when the angels came to Lut in the form of young men with handsome faces. When they entered his home, he said: إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ - قَالُوا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ "Verily, you are people unknown to me." They said: "Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting."…

item.title: Al-Hijr:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ اٰلَ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلُونَ falammā jāa āla lūṭin l-mur'salūna So when came the messenger unto the family of Lot, See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ qāla innakum qawmun munkarūna he said, 'You are indeed strangers [to me].'

item.title: Al-Hijr:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ qāla innakum qawmun munkarūna He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown." See 15:61

item.title: Al-Hijr:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ qāla innakum qawmun munkarūna He (Lot.) said: "Verily ye are people unknown." (Strangers.) See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūna They said, 'Rather we bring you what they used to doubt.

item.title: Al-Hijr:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūna They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing. See 15:61

item.title: Al-Hijr:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūna Said they: (The angels.) "Nay, come we unto thee with that (The torment.) in which they have been doubting" See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ wa-ataynāka bil-ḥaqi wa-innā laṣādiqūna We bring you the truth, and indeed we speak truly.

item.title: Al-Hijr:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ wa-ataynāka bil-ḥaqi wa-innā laṣādiqūna And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful. See 15:61

item.title: Al-Hijr:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ wa-ataynāka bil-ḥaqi wa-innā laṣādiqūna And come we unto thee with the truth, and verily we are certainly truthful See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَامْضُوْۤا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli wa-ittabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun wa-im'ḍū ḥaythu tu'marūna Take your family in a watch of the night; and follow in their rear, and none of you should turn round, and proceed as you are bidden.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَامْضُوْۤا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli wa-ittabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun wa-im'ḍū ḥaythu tu'marūna So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded." Then travel for a portion of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered (15:65). And We made this decree known to him that those (sinners) would be rooted out in the early morning (15:66). Lut is Ordered to Leave with His Family during the Night Allah tells us that His angels ordered Lut to set out after part…

item.title: Al-Hijr:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَامْضُوْۤا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli wa-ittabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun wa-im'ḍū ḥaythu tu'marūna So go thou forth with thy followers in a part of the (Refer to verses 11:77 - 11:83.) night and thyself follow their rear, and let not any one of you turn back, and go ye forth whither ye are bidden See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ ذٰلِكَ الْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālika l-amra anna dābira hāulāi maqṭūʿun muṣ'biḥīna We apprised him of the matter that these1 will be rooted out by dawn.

item.title: Al-Hijr:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ ذٰلِكَ الْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālika l-amra anna dābira hāulāi maqṭūʿun muṣ'biḥīna And We conveyed to him (the decree) of that matter: that those (sinners) would be eliminated by early morning. See 15:65

item.title: Al-Hijr:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ ذٰلِكَ الْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālika l-amra anna dābira hāulāi maqṭūʿun muṣ'biḥīna And We revealed unto him this decree (of Ours) that the roots (Even the last one of them to be destroyed.) of these shall be cut off in the morning. See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ wajāa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūna The people of the city came, rejoicing.

item.title: Al-Hijr:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ wajāa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūna And the people of the city came rejoicing.1 And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing (15:67). (Lut) said: "Verily, these are my guests, so do not shame me (15:68). "And have Taqwa of Allah, and do not disgrace me (15:69). They said: "Did we not forbid you from entertaining any of the 'Alamin? (15:70). Lut ]said: "These are my daughters, if you must act (so) (15:71). Verily, by your life, in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly (15:72). The People of the City Arrive upon the Angels, Thinking that they are Men Allah tells us about how Lut's people came to him when they found out about his handsome guests, and they came happily rejoicing about them. قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ - وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ (Lut) said:…

item.title: Al-Hijr:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ wajāa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūna And came the people of the town rejoicing See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ qāla inna hāulāi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūni He said, 'These are indeed my guests. Do not bring dishonour on me.

item.title: Al-Hijr:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ qāla inna hāulāi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūni (Lut) said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me. See 15:67

item.title: Al-Hijr:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ qāla inna hāulāi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūni He said: "Verily these are my guests, therefore disgrace me not," See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ wa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni Be wary of Allah and do not humiliate me.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ wa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni And fear Allah and do not disgrace me." See 15:67

item.title: Al-Hijr:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ wa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni Fear ye (the wrath of) God, and put me not to shame. See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū awalam nanhaka ʿani l-ʿālamīna They said, 'Did we not forbid you from [defending1] strangers?'

item.title: Al-Hijr:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū awalam nanhaka ʿani l-ʿālamīna They said, "Have we not forbidden you from (protecting) people?" See 15:67

item.title: Al-Hijr:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū awalam nanhaka ʿani l-ʿālamīna Said (The people.) they: "Have we not for bidden thee against (Entertaining.) (protecting) other people." See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ qāla hāulāi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīna He said, 'These are my daughters, [marry them] if you should do anything.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ qāla hāulāi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīna (Lut) said, "These are my daughters1 - if you would be doers (of lawful marriage)." See 15:67

item.title: Al-Hijr:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ qāla hāulāi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīna Said he: (Lot.) (Here) are these my daughters (ye may wed them) if ye desire to do so;" (This was said by the people to Lot before knowing that his guests were angels.) See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūna By your life, they were bewildered in their drunkenness.

item.title: Al-Hijr:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūna By your life, (O Muḥammad), indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly. See 15:67

item.title: Al-Hijr:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūna And verily by thy life (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) certainly they were in their intoxication (of their lust) wandering bewildered (Absence of mind.) See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu mush'riqīna So the Cry seized them at sunrise,

item.title: Al-Hijr:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu mush'riqīna So the shriek1 seized them at sunrise. So the Sayhah overtook them at the time of sunrise (15:73). And We turned them upside down and rained stones of baked clay upon them (15:74). Surely, in this are signs for those who see (15:75). And verily, they were right on the highroad (15:76). Surely, there is indeed a sign in that for the believers (15:77). The Destruction of the People of Lut Allah said; فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ So the Sayhah overtook them This is the piercing sound that came to them when the sun rose, which was accompanied by the city being flipped upside down, and stones of baked clay (As-Sijjil) raining down upon them. The discussion of As-Sijjil in Surah Hud is a sufficient explanation. Allah said: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ Surely, in this…

item.title: Al-Hijr:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu mush'riqīna So the (violent) blast seized them (while) entering upon the dawn, (The day was breaking.) See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min sijjīlin and We made its1 topmost part its nethermost, and rained on them stones of shale.

item.title: Al-Hijr:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min sijjīlin And We made the highest part (of the city) its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay. See 15:73

item.title: Al-Hijr:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min sijjīlin Thus did We turn it upside down and rained down on them stones of baked (Refer to verses 105:4 & 11:82.) clay; See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'mutawassimīna There are indeed signs in that for the percipient.

item.title: Al-Hijr:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'mutawassimīna Indeed in that are signs for those who discern. See 15:73

item.title: Al-Hijr:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'mutawassimīna Verily in this are signs for those who scan (Examine - Readers of signs who decipher the features.) heedfully. See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ wa-innahā labisabīlin muqīmin Indeed it is on a standing road,

item.title: Al-Hijr:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ wa-innahā labisabīlin muqīmin And indeed, they (i.e., those cities) are (situated) on an established road. See 15:73

item.title: Al-Hijr:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ wa-innahā labisabīlin muqīmin And verily it is on a (high) way that (still) (Exist - The towns.) stands. See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna and there is indeed a sign in that for the faithful.

item.title: Al-Hijr:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna Indeed in that is a sign for the believers. See 15:73

item.title: Al-Hijr:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna Verily in this there is a sign for the believers. See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ wa-in kāna aṣḥābu l-aykati laẓālimīna Indeed the inhabitants of Aykah1 were wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-Hijr:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ wa-in kāna aṣḥābu l-aykati laẓālimīna And the companions of the thicket (i.e., the people of Madyan) were (also) wrongdoers. And the Dwellers of Al-Aykah, were also wrongdoers (15:78). So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open route, plain to see (15:79). The Destruction of the Dwellers of Al-Aykah, the People of Shu'ayb The Dwellers of Al-Aykah, were the people of Shu'ayb. Ad-Dahhak, Qatadah and others said that Al-Aykah refers to intertwined trees. Their evildoing included associating partners with Allah (Shirk), banditry and cheating in weights and measures. Allah punished them with the Sayhah (the awful cry or torment), the earthquake, and the torment of the Day of Shadow. They lived near the people of Lut, but at a later time, and the people of Lut were known to them, which is…

item.title: Al-Hijr:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ wa-in kāna aṣḥābu l-aykati laẓālimīna And verily the inhabitants of El-Aika ('Shu'aib' was the apostle of God sent to 'Midyan' and Aika' - The people who were destroyed by a Violent Sound. Refer to verses 26:176, 38:12 - 38:13 & 50:14.) too were most surely unjust ones. See 15:60

item.title: Al-Hijr:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُبِينٍ fa-intaqamnā min'hum wa-innahumā labi-imāmin mubīnin So We took vengeance on them, and indeed the two of them1 are on an open highway.

item.title: Al-Hijr:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُبِينٍ fa-intaqamnā min'hum wa-innahumā labi-imāmin mubīnin So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both (cities) are on a clear highway. See 15:78

item.title: Al-Hijr:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُبِينٍ fa-intaqamnā min'hum wa-innahumā labi-imāmin mubīnin We inflicted retribution on them, and indeed they were both (The Two Towns - viz Sodom & Midian.) on a (high) way, (still) open. (Followed - Open still to traffic.) Often the caravans of the people which passed the place lying between Hejaz and Syria saw the punishment the people had met in the total destruction of the places lying in ruins.

item.title: Al-Hijr:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad kadhaba aṣḥābu l-ḥij'ri l-mur'salīna Certainly the inhabitants of Ḥijr denied the apostles.

item.title: Al-Hijr:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad kadhaba aṣḥābu l-ḥij'ri l-mur'salīna And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr1 (i.e., the Thamūd) deny the messengers. And verily, the Dwellers of Al-Hijr denied the Messengers (15:80). And We gave them Our signs, but they were averse to them (15:81). And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains, (feeling) secure (15:82). But the Sayhah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in the early morning (15:83). And all that they used to earn availed them not (15:84). The Destruction of the Dwellers of Al-Hijr, Who are the People Called Thamud The Dwellers of the Al Hijr were the people of Thamud who rejected their Prophet, Salih. Whoever denies even one Messenger, then he has disbelieved in all of the Messengers, thus they are described as rejecting "the Messengers". Allah tells us that he…

item.title: Al-Hijr:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad kadhaba aṣḥābu l-ḥij'ri l-mur'salīna And indeed the inhabitants of Hijr (the (The people of 'Thamud'.) Rock), belied the messengers (of God), See 15:79

item.title: Al-Hijr:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ waātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna We had given them Our signs but they disregarded them.

item.title: Al-Hijr:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ waātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away. See 15:80

item.title: Al-Hijr:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ waātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna And We brought forth unto them Our signs, but from them they turned away, See 15:79

item.title: Al-Hijr:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ wakānū yanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan āminīna They used to hew out dwellings from mountains feeling secure.

item.title: Al-Hijr:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ wakānū yanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan āminīna And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure. See 15:80

item.title: Al-Hijr:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ wakānū yanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan āminīna And they hewed in the mountains abodes and felt (themselves) secure. See 15:79

item.title: Al-Hijr:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu muṣ'biḥīna So the Cry seized them at dawn,

item.title: Al-Hijr:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu muṣ'biḥīna But the shriek seized them at early morning. See 15:80

item.title: Al-Hijr:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu muṣ'biḥīna So seized them the (violent) blast in the morning, See 15:79

item.title: Al-Hijr:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna and what they used to earn did not avail them.

item.title: Al-Hijr:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna So nothing availed them (from) what they used to earn. See 15:80

item.title: Al-Hijr:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna And availed them not what they did earn (Their art and care.) ; See 15:79

item.title: Al-Hijr:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun fa-iṣ'faḥi l-ṣafḥa l-jamīla We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with reason, and indeed the Hour is bound to come. So forbear with a graceful forbearance.

item.title: Al-Hijr:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun fa-iṣ'faḥi l-ṣafḥa l-jamīla And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness. And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with the truth, and the Hour is surely coming, so overlook their faults with gracious forgiveness (15:85). Verily, your Lord is the Knowing Creator (15:86). The World has been Created for Some Purpose, Then the Hour will Come Allah says: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them…

item.title: Al-Hijr:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun fa-iṣ'faḥi l-ṣafḥa l-jamīla And We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them two but with truth; and verily the hour (of reckoning) is certainly to come, so (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) forgive (the people) with gracious forgiveness. In this Verse and in the verses 3:191; 23:115; 30:8; 38:27 it is clear that Qur'an means by the term Truth, with reference to the creation of the heavens, the earth and what is in between. The purpose the life hereafter. and aim of the creation is beyond them, i.e., the life hereafter. As it is obvious that if the life is limited to this physical and temporal one and there is no…

item.title: Al-Hijr:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ inna rabbaka huwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

item.title: Al-Hijr:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ inna rabbaka huwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator. See 15:85

item.title: Al-Hijr:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ inna rabbaka huwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu Verily thy Lord, He is the Great Creator, the All-Knowing. See 15:85

item.title: Al-Hijr:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīma Certainly We have given you [the sūrah of] the seven oft-repeated verses1 and the great Qur'ān.

item.title: Al-Hijr:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīma And We have certainly given you, (O Muḥammad), seven of the often repeated (verses)1 and the great Qur’ān. And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of the Mathani, and the Grand Qur'an (15:87). Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have given to certain classes of them, nor grieve over them. And lower your wings to the believers (15:88). A Reminder of the Blessing of the Qur'an and the Command to Focus on its Message Allah is saying to His Prophet SAW: Since We have given you the Grand Qur'an, then do not look at this world and its attractions, or the transient delights that we have given to its people in order to test them. Do not envy what they have in…

item.title: Al-Hijr:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīma And indeed We have given thee (the) seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Great Qur'an. The seven Verses of the Sura-e-Fateha or the Opening Chapter which it is said was revealed twice: once in Mecca and once again at Madina. The Sura 'Fateha' is called 'Mathani' or 'the repeated ones', also because the Sura is repeatedly used in every prayer. The Holy Prophet said: "By God in Whose hands are the lives of every one in the universe, neither in Torah, nor in Zabur nor in Injil and nor in any other heavenly book did God reveal a grander Sura than the Sura Fateha." Sura-e-Fateha is called the 'Great Qur'an', for it contains in it the essence of the whole Qur'an. The Sura is divided into parts,…

item.title: Al-Hijr:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka lil'mu'minīna Do not extend your glance toward what We have provided to certain groups of them, and do not grieve for them, and lower your wing to the faithful,1

item.title: Al-Hijr:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka lil'mu'minīna Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to (certain) categories of them (i.e., the disbelievers), and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing (i.e., show kindness) to the believers. See 15:87

item.title: Al-Hijr:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka lil'mu'minīna Strain not thine eyes at what We have provided with some of them pairs among them to enjoy, and grieve not for them (For their not believing.) and lower thy wing (be gentle) unto the believers. Referring to the wealth given to the Jews and the Christians and the heathens - for whatever natural wealth one might have possessed it is nothing in value or worth compared to the apostleship and the personal excellence endowed in the Holy Prophet. The Holy Prophet said that, 'should any one ever deem anything else as better than the Holy Qur'an, he has valued an insignificant thing more than that which God has made…

item.title: Al-Hijr:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ اِنِّیْ أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْمُبِينُ waqul innī anā l-nadhīru l-mubīnu and say, 'I am indeed a manifest warner.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ اِنِّیْ أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْمُبِينُ waqul innī anā l-nadhīru l-mubīnu And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner". And say (O Muhammad): I am indeed a plain warner (15:89). As We have sent down on the Muqtasimin (conspiring confederates) (15:90). Who have made the Qur'an into parts (15:91). So, by your Lord, We shall certainly call all of them to account (15:92). For all that they used to do (15:93). The Messenger SAW is a Plain Warner Allah commanded His Prophet SAW to tell the people: إِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْمُبِينُ I am indeed a plain warner coming to warn the people of a severe punishment that they will suffer if they reject him, as happened to those nations before them who disbelieved in their Messengers, upon whom Allah sent His punishment and vengeance. In the two Sahihs it is reported…

item.title: Al-Hijr:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ اِنِّیْ أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْمُبِينُ waqul innī anā l-nadhīru l-mubīnu And say thou: "Verily, I am an open warner (from God)" See 15:88

item.title: Al-Hijr:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ kamā anzalnā ʿalā l-muq'tasimīna Even as We sent down on the dividers,1

item.title: Al-Hijr:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ kamā anzalnā ʿalā l-muq'tasimīna Just as We had revealed (scriptures) to the separators.1 See 15:89

item.title: Al-Hijr:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ kamā anzalnā ʿalā l-muq'tasimīna Even so as We did send (The chastisement the like of it.) down on those who did foster divisions, See 15:88

item.title: Al-Hijr:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوْۤا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ alladhīna jaʿalū l-qur'āna ʿiḍīna who reduced the Qur'ān into pieces,

item.title: Al-Hijr:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوْۤا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ alladhīna jaʿalū l-qur'āna ʿiḍīna Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.1 See 15:89

item.title: Al-Hijr:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوْۤا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ alladhīna jaʿalū l-qur'āna ʿiḍīna Those rendered the Qur'an into parts. Those who rendered the Qur'an into parts and treated them differently. The Jews and the Christians accepted such parts of the Qur'an which suit their own purposes and rejected the other parts.

item.title: Al-Hijr:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْءَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaʿīna by your Lord, We will question them all

item.title: Al-Hijr:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْءَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaʿīna So by your Lord, We will surely question them all. See 15:89

item.title: Al-Hijr:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْءَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaʿīna So, by thy Lord, certainly We would question them all, See 15:91

item.title: Al-Hijr:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَمَّا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūna concerning what they used to do.

item.title: Al-Hijr:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَمَّا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūna About what they used to do. See 15:89

item.title: Al-Hijr:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَمَّا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūna As to what they used to do. See 15:91

item.title: Al-Hijr:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ fa-iṣ'daʿ bimā tu'maru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīna So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.

item.title: Al-Hijr:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ fa-iṣ'daʿ bimā tu'maru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīna Then declare what you are commanded1 and turn away from the polytheists.2 Therefore openly proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the idolators (15:94). Truly, We will suffice you against the mockers (15:95). Who make another god along with Allah; but they will come to know (15:96). Indeed, We know that your breast becomes tight because of what they say (15:97). So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him) (15:98). And worship your Lord until the certainty (i.e. death) comes to you (15:99). The Command to Proclaim the Truth Openly Allah commanded His Messenger SAW to convey what He sent him with, to proclaim and spread the Message, which means confronting the idolators with it. Ibn 'Abbas…

item.title: Al-Hijr:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ fa-iṣ'daʿ bimā tu'maru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīna Therefore declare thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) openly what thou art bidden, and turn thou away from the polytheists. See 15:91

item.title: Al-Hijr:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ innā kafaynāka l-mus'tahziīna Indeed We will suffice you against the deriders

item.title: Al-Hijr:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ innā kafaynāka l-mus'tahziīna Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers. See 15:94

item.title: Al-Hijr:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ innā kafaynāka l-mus'tahziīna Verily, We are sufficient for thee against the scoffers, In the beginning of his ministry when the Holy Prophet preached the Unity of God and admonished people against polytheism and the other infidelity, the pagans of Mecca ridiculed him. At last the people became more and more violent and did not allow the Holy Prophet to move about freely and consequently he had to stay indoors. Though the actually turbulent crowd of the people was huge but their ring-leaders were only the following five and all the five were finished by death the same day and in the same hour. They were: (1). al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah. (2). al-'As ibn Wa'il. (3). al-Aswad ibn al-Muttalib ibn Asad (4). al-Aswad ibn 'Abd Yaghuth. (5). al-Ḥarith ibn al-Talatilah.1 Thus God cleared the way for the Holy Prophet…

item.title: Al-Hijr:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ alladhīna yajʿalūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fasawfa yaʿlamūna —those who set up besides Allah another god. Soon they will know!

item.title: Al-Hijr:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ alladhīna yajʿalūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fasawfa yaʿlamūna Who make (equal) with Allah another deity. But they are going to know. See 15:94

item.title: Al-Hijr:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ alladhīna yajʿalūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fasawfa yaʿlamūna Those who set up with God another god, presently they shall know. See 15:95

item.title: Al-Hijr:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūna Certainly We know that you become upset because of what they say.

item.title: Al-Hijr:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūna And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say. See 15:94

item.title: Al-Hijr:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūna And indeed We know that straiteneth thy breast at what they say, See 15:95

item.title: Al-Hijr:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakun mina l-sājidīna So celebrate the praise of your Lord and be among those who prostrate,

item.title: Al-Hijr:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakun mina l-sājidīna So exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate (to Him). See 15:94

item.title: Al-Hijr:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakun mina l-sājidīna But celebrate thou the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves (unto God) in obeisance, See 15:95

item.title: Al-Hijr:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰی يَأْتِيَكَ الْيَقِينُ wa-uʿ'bud rabbaka ḥattā yatiyaka l-yaqīnu and worship your Lord until certainty1 comes to you.

item.title: Al-Hijr:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰی يَأْتِيَكَ الْيَقِينُ wa-uʿ'bud rabbaka ḥattā yatiyaka l-yaqīnu And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (i.e., death). See 15:94

item.title: Al-Hijr:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰی يَأْتِيَكَ الْيَقِينُ wa-uʿ'bud rabbaka ḥattā yatiyaka l-yaqīnu And worship thou thy Lord until there cometh unto thee what is certain. (Death – see note.) 'Yaqeen' - meaning certainty. The greatest certainty is Death. The First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib said: 'There is nothing greater in certainty than Death.' Here meaning, until one meets death, i.e., the whole life until its end. 'Yaqeen', certainty, is used in two senses, as an infinitive and as a past participle, i.e., what is certain or inevitable. If used as past participle it means death, which is certain and inevitable, then 'Hatta' means until. And if it means infinitive, then it will be - worship thy Lord in order that you obtain the certainty or the realisation, meaning that the result of worship is realisation. In any case none can…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuqaddimū bayna yadayi l-lahi warasūlihi wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun O you who have faith! Do not venture ahead of Allah and His Apostle, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuqaddimū bayna yadayi l-lahi warasūlihi wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun O you who have believed, do not put (yourselves) before Allah and His Messenger1 but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuqaddimū bayna yadayi l-lahi warasūlihi wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun O' ye who believe! Be ye not forward (in any affair) in the presence of God and His Apostle and fear ye (the wrath of) God; verily God is All Hearing, All-Knowing. This verse ordains perfect and implicit obedience and reverence to the Holy Prophet. Muslims are enjoined not to take any initiative whether in words or in action, of their own accord in the presence of God and the Holy Prophet, i.e., in reverence to God and the Holy Prophet, i.e., before they are definitely ordered to act in any matter. It is implied also that none should sit before the Holy Prophet but in a respectable posture and…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَرْفَعُوْۤا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوْۤا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَنْ تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tarfaʿū aṣwātakum fawqa ṣawti l-nabiyi walā tajharū lahu bil-qawli kajahri baʿḍikum libaʿḍin an taḥbaṭa aʿmālukum wa-antum lā tashʿurūna O you who have faith! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak aloud to him as you shout to one another, lest your works should fail without your being aware.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَرْفَعُوْۤا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوْۤا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَنْ تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tarfaʿū aṣwātakum fawqa ṣawti l-nabiyi walā tajharū lahu bil-qawli kajahri baʿḍikum libaʿḍin an taḥbaṭa aʿmālukum wa-antum lā tashʿurūna O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not. See 49:1

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَرْفَعُوْۤا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوْۤا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَنْ تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tarfaʿū aṣwātakum fawqa ṣawti l-nabiyi walā tajharū lahu bil-qawli kajahri baʿḍikum libaʿḍin an taḥbaṭa aʿmālukum wa-antum lā tashʿurūna O' ye who believe! raise ye not your voices (Compare this to the conduct of those who were expelled from the presence of the Holy Prophet for their shouting at the eve of his departure from this world – Refer to history for names.) above the voice of the Prophet, and speak ye not loud unto him as speak aloud some of you to the others, lest (all) your (good) deeds become null (See note to verse 49:2.) while ye perceive not. People used to come and stand out of the apartment in which the Holy…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَى لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ inna alladhīna yaghuḍḍūna aṣwātahum ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ulāika alladhīna im'taḥana l-lahu qulūbahum lilttaqwā lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun Indeed those who lower their voices in the presence of the Apostle of Allah —they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for Godwariness. For them will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَى لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ inna alladhīna yaghuḍḍūna aṣwātahum ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ulāika alladhīna im'taḥana l-lahu qulūbahum lilttaqwā lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward. See 49:1

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَى لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ inna alladhīna yaghuḍḍūna aṣwātahum ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ulāika alladhīna im'taḥana l-lahu qulūbahum lilttaqwā lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun Verily those who lower their voices in the presence of the Apostle of God, they are those whose hearts God hath proved for their guarding (themselves against evil); for them shall be forgiveness and a great recompense. The ordinance about the behaviour in the movement of the people with the Holy Prophet, is more a test of the fidelity or the sincerity of a believer in his personal regard to the Holy Prophet. Faithfulness or the regard for the leader, suggests the regard for the cause. This shows that there were also the men of the character of this excellence who opposed those referred to in…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ inna alladhīna yunādūnaka min warāi l-ḥujurāti aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna Indeed those who call you from behind the apartments, most of them do not apply reason.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ inna alladhīna yunādūnaka min warāi l-ḥujurāti aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna Indeed, those who call you, (O Muḥammad), from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason. Verily, those who call you from behind the dwellings, most of them have no sense (49:4). And if they had patience till you could come out to them, it would have been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Most Merciful (49:5). Admonishing Those Who Call the Prophet (ٰٰٰSAW) from behind Dwellings Allah the Exalted and Most Blessed admonished those, such as the uncivilized bedouins, who used to call to the Prophet SAW from behind the dwellings which belong to his wives: أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ most of them have no sense. Allah the Exalted and Most Honored then ordains the better behavior in…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ inna alladhīna yunādūnaka min warāi l-ḥujurāti aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna Verily, those who call out to thee from out of the private chambers, most of them understand not. See 49:3

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوْۤا حَتّٰی تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ walaw annahum ṣabarū ḥattā takhruja ilayhim lakāna khayran lahum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun Had they been patient until you came out for them, it would have been better for them, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوْۤا حَتّٰی تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ walaw annahum ṣabarū ḥattā takhruja ilayhim lakāna khayran lahum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun And if they had been patient until you (could) come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. See 49:4

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوْۤا حَتّٰی تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ walaw annahum ṣabarū ḥattā takhruja ilayhim lakāna khayran lahum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun And if they wait patiently until thou come out unto them, it would certainly be better for them; and verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. The people have been ordered by God not to shout to the Holy Prophet or to call him out until he himself comes out to give audience to them.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوْۤا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in jāakum fāsiqun binaba-in fatabayyanū an tuṣībū qawman bijahālatin fatuṣ'biḥū ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīna O you who have faith! If a profligate [person] should bring you some news, verify it, lest you should visit [harm] on some people out of ignorance, and then become regretful for what you have done.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوْۤا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in jāakum fāsiqun binaba-in fatabayyanū an tuṣībū qawman bijahālatin fatuṣ'biḥū ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīna O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful. See 49:4

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوْۤا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in jāakum fāsiqun binaba-in fatabayyanū an tuṣībū qawman bijahālatin fatuṣ'biḥū ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīna O' ye who believe! if cometh unto you a wicked man with a news, ascertain (This was revealed against the conduct of Walid Ibn Uqbah who was one of the companions. Hence reports even from the companions must be scrutinised. See note to verse 49:6.) carefully, lest ye harm a people in ignorance, and then repent ye for what ye have done. Once the Holy Prophet had sent Walid Ibn Uqba towards the tribe Bani Mustalaq to collect the poor-rate. Since the tribesmen once before their conversion to Islam were ill-disposed towards Walid but after his becoming their brother-in-faith they wanted to honour him as a…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ wa-iʿ'lamū anna fīkum rasūla l-lahi law yuṭīʿukum fī kathīrin mina l-amri laʿanittum walākinna l-laha ḥabbaba ilaykumu l-īmāna wazayyanahu fī qulūbikum wakarraha ilaykumu l-kuf'ra wal-fusūqa wal-ʿiṣ'yāna ulāika humu l-rāshidūna Know that the Apostle of Allah is among you. Should he obey you in many matters, you would surely suffer. But Allah has endeared faith to you and made it appealing in your hearts, and He has made hateful to you faithlessness, transgression and disobedience. It is such who are the right-minded

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ wa-iʿ'lamū anna fīkum rasūla l-lahi law yuṭīʿukum fī kathīrin mina l-amri laʿanittum walākinna l-laha ḥabbaba ilaykumu l-īmāna wazayyanahu fī qulūbikum wakarraha ilaykumu l-kuf'ra wal-fusūqa wal-ʿiṣ'yāna ulāika humu l-rāshidūna And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the (rightly) guided. النَّبِىُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ The Prophet is closer to the believers than themselves (33:6) Then He clarifies that they fall short in overseeing their own benefit;…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ wa-iʿ'lamū anna fīkum rasūla l-lahi law yuṭīʿukum fī kathīrin mina l-amri laʿanittum walākinna l-laha ḥabbaba ilaykumu l-īmāna wazayyanahu fī qulūbikum wakarraha ilaykumu l-kuf'ra wal-fusūqa wal-ʿiṣ'yāna ulāika humu l-rāshidūna And know ye that amidst you is the Apostle of God, should he obey you in most of the matters, ye would certainly be in distress, but God hath endeared the faith unto you, and made it attractive in your hearts and made abhorrent unto you disbelief and transgression; They are they who are on the Right guidance, The people believing the report of Walid about Bani Mustalaq had insisted upon the tribesmen being punished and wanted the Holy Prophet also to believe Walid…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ faḍlan mina l-lahi waniʿ'matan wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun —a grace and blessing from Allah, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ faḍlan mina l-lahi waniʿ'matan wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun (It is) as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise. See 49:7

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ faḍlan mina l-lahi waniʿ'matan wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun By grace from God and as a bounty; And God is All-Knowing, All-Wise. See 49:7

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا فَإِنْ بَغَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الْأُخْرٰی فَقَاتِلُوْۤا الَّتِي تَبْغِي حَتّٰی تَفِيءَ إِلَى أَمْرِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ فَاءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ wa-in ṭāifatāni mina l-mu'minīna iq'tatalū fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā fa-in baghat iḥ'dāhumā ʿalā l-ukh'rā faqātilū allatī tabghī ḥattā tafīa ilā amri l-lahi fa-in fāat fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā bil-ʿadli wa-aqsiṭū inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīna If two groups of the faithful fight one another, make peace between them. But if one party of them aggresses against the other, fight the one which aggresses until it returns to Allah's ordinance. Then, if it returns, make peace between them fairly, and do justice. Indeed Allah loves the just.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا فَإِنْ بَغَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الْأُخْرٰی فَقَاتِلُوْۤا الَّتِي تَبْغِي حَتّٰی تَفِيءَ إِلَى أَمْرِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ فَاءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ wa-in ṭāifatāni mina l-mu'minīna iq'tatalū fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā fa-in baghat iḥ'dāhumā ʿalā l-ukh'rā faqātilū allatī tabghī ḥattā tafīa ilā amri l-lahi fa-in fāat fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā bil-ʿadli wa-aqsiṭū inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīna And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly. And if two parties among the believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them both. But if one of them…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا فَإِنْ بَغَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الْأُخْرٰی فَقَاتِلُوْۤا الَّتِي تَبْغِي حَتّٰی تَفِيءَ إِلَى أَمْرِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ فَاءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ wa-in ṭāifatāni mina l-mu'minīna iq'tatalū fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā fa-in baghat iḥ'dāhumā ʿalā l-ukh'rā faqātilū allatī tabghī ḥattā tafīa ilā amri l-lahi fa-in fāat fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā bil-ʿadli wa-aqsiṭū inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīna And if two parties of the believers fall into a quarrel (among themselves), restore ye peace between them two; but if one of the two transgresseth against the other, (then) fight ye (all against) that which transgresseth (Note how far Islam wants peace and fair play sticking fast to justice.) until it complieth with the command of God; and if it complieth then restore ye peace between the two with justice, and act ye justly; Verily, God loveth the just…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ innamā l-mu'minūna ikh'watun fa-aṣliḥū bayna akhawaykum wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna The faithful are indeed brothers. Therefore make peace between your brothers and be wary of Allah, so that you may receive [His] mercy.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ innamā l-mu'minūna ikh'watun fa-aṣliḥū bayna akhawaykum wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy. See 49:9

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ innamā l-mu'minūna ikh'watun fa-aṣliḥū bayna akhawaykum wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna The believers are but brethren, (Islam as a religious fellowship is unique and inimitable.) so make ye peace among the brethren and fear ye (the wrath of) God that ye be blessed with mercy. The brotherhood in faith which Islam established, is nothing short of a miracle and a great miracle too. There is no parallel to the wonderful social equality or brotherhood of Islam, in any other faith or any religious order in the world. There is no caste system, colour bar, distinction of any financial status or communal restrictions. Once an individual embraces Islam, all the social distinctions he suffered in his former faith, are once for all annihilated. He becomes a member of the All-World International human…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِنْ قَوْمٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونُوْۤا خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَاءٌ مِنْ نِسَاءٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِنْهُنَّ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ الْإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَتُبْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā yaskhar qawmun min qawmin ʿasā an yakūnū khayran min'hum walā nisāon min nisāin ʿasā an yakunna khayran min'hunna walā talmizū anfusakum walā tanābazū bil-alqābi bi'sa l-s'mu l-fusūqu baʿda l-īmāni waman lam yatub fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna O you who have faith! Let not any people ridicule another people: it may be that they are better than they are; nor let women [ridicule] women: it may be that they are better than they are. And do not defame one another, nor insult one another by [calling] nicknames. How evil are profane names subsequent to faith! And whoever is not…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِنْ قَوْمٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونُوْۤا خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَاءٌ مِنْ نِسَاءٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِنْهُنَّ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ الْإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَتُبْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā yaskhar qawmun min qawmin ʿasā an yakūnū khayran min'hum walā nisāon min nisāin ʿasā an yakunna khayran min'hunna walā talmizū anfusakum walā tanābazū bil-alqābi bi'sa l-s'mu l-fusūqu baʿda l-īmāni waman lam yatub fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule (another) people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule (other) women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by (offensive) nicknames. Wretched is the name (i.e., mention) of disobedience after (one's) faith. And whoever does not…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِنْ قَوْمٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونُوْۤا خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَاءٌ مِنْ نِسَاءٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِنْهُنَّ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ الْإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَتُبْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā yaskhar qawmun min qawmin ʿasā an yakūnū khayran min'hum walā nisāon min nisāin ʿasā an yakunna khayran min'hunna walā talmizū anfusakum walā tanābazū bil-alqābi bi'sa l-s'mu l-fusūqu baʿda l-īmāni waman lam yatub fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna O' ye who believe! let not a people laugh at (another) people (to scorn) who happily may be better than them; nor let women laugh at other women who happily may be better than these and find not fault with your own selves nor call ye one another by nick names; evil is a bad name (for any one) after his accepting…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَبْ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ij'tanibū kathīran mina l-ẓani inna baʿḍa l-ẓani ith'mun walā tajassasū walā yaghtab baʿḍukum baʿḍan ayuḥibbu aḥadukum an yakula laḥma akhīhi maytan fakarih'tumūhu wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha tawwābun raḥīmun O you who have faith! Avoid much suspicion. Indeed some suspicions are sins. And do not spy on or backbite one another. Will any of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would hate it. And be wary of Allah; indeed Allah is all-clement, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَبْ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ij'tanibū kathīran mina l-ẓani inna baʿḍa l-ẓani ith'mun walā tajassasū walā yaghtab baʿḍukum baʿḍan ayuḥibbu aḥadukum an yakula laḥma akhīhi maytan fakarih'tumūhu wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha tawwābun raḥīmun O you who have believed, avoid much (negative) assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful. O you who believe! Avoid much suspicion; indeed some suspicion is sin. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you like to eat the…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَبْ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ij'tanibū kathīran mina l-ẓani inna baʿḍa l-ẓani ith'mun walā tajassasū walā yaghtab baʿḍukum baʿḍan ayuḥibbu aḥadukum an yakula laḥma akhīhi maytan fakarih'tumūhu wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha tawwābun raḥīmun O' ye who believe! avoid such suspicion, for verily suspicions (in) some (cases) is a sin, and spy ye not, and let not some of you backbite the others; What! likest one of you to eat the flesh of his dead brother? But ye abhor it; and fear ye (the wrath of) God; Verily, God is Oft- returning (to mercy unto the repentants), the Most Merciful. It is in the commentary of Tha'labi that once people reported to…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ وَأُنْثَى وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ خَبِيرٌ yāayyuhā l-nāsu innā khalaqnākum min dhakarin wa-unthā wajaʿalnākum shuʿūban waqabāila litaʿārafū inna akramakum ʿinda l-lahi atqākum inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīrun O mankind! Indeed We created you from a male and a female, and made you nations and tribes that you may identify yourselves with one another. Indeed the noblest1 of you in the sight of Allah is the most Godwary among you. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-aware.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ وَأُنْثَى وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ خَبِيرٌ yāayyuhā l-nāsu innā khalaqnākum min dhakarin wa-unthā wajaʿalnākum shuʿūban waqabāila litaʿārafū inna akramakum ʿinda l-lahi atqākum inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīrun O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous1 of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Aware. O mankind! We have created you from a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes that you may know one another. Verily, the most honorable of you with Allah is that (believer) who has At-Taqwa. Verily, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware (49:13). All of Mankind are the Children of 'Adam and…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ وَأُنْثَى وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ خَبِيرٌ yāayyuhā l-nāsu innā khalaqnākum min dhakarin wa-unthā wajaʿalnākum shuʿūban waqabāila litaʿārafū inna akramakum ʿinda l-lahi atqākum inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīrun O' ye people! Verily We have created you of a male and a female, and made you in nations and tribes, that ye may recognise each other; Verily the most honoured of you with God is the one of you who guardeth (himself) the most (against evil), verily God is All-Knowing, the All-Aware. Note the address here, is to mankind or the human race as a whole and not to the Muslims. This verse deals with the natural brotherhood of man. It establishes the fact that men and women, be they of any tribe or clan or colour, occupying any…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ اٰمَنَّا قُلْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَلَكِنْ قُولُوْۤا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْاِیْمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَإِنْ تُطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُمْ مِنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ qālati l-aʿrābu āmannā qul lam tu'minū walākin qūlū aslamnā walammā yadkhuli l-īmānu fī qulūbikum wa-in tuṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu lā yalit'kum min aʿmālikum shayan inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun The Bedouins say, 'We have faith.' Say, 'You do not have faith yet; rather say, "We have embraced Islam,"1 for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. Yet if you obey Allah and His Apostle, He will not stint anything of [the reward of] your works. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ اٰمَنَّا قُلْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَلَكِنْ قُولُوْۤا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْاِیْمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَإِنْ تُطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُمْ مِنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ qālati l-aʿrābu āmannā qul lam tu'minū walākin qūlū aslamnā walammā yadkhuli l-īmānu fī qulūbikum wa-in tuṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu lā yalit'kum min aʿmālikum shayan inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not (yet) believed; but say (instead), 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds1 of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful." The bedouins say: "We believe." Say: "You do not believe. But say, 'We have submitted,' for Faith has not yet entered your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not decrease anything…

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
