item.description: إِذًا لَأَذَقْنَاكَ ضِعْفَ الْحَيَوةِ وَضِعْفَ الْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًا idhan la-adhaqnāka ḍiʿ'fa l-ḥayati waḍiʿ'fa l-mamāti thumma lā tajidu laka ʿalaynā naṣīran In that case We would surely have caused thee (The people.) taste a double (torment) in this life and a double (torment) after death, (and) then thou wouldst not have found for thee against Us any helper. See 17:73

item.title: Al-Israa:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَادُوْۤا لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا وَإِذًا لَا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَافَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا wa-in kādū layastafizzūnaka mina l-arḍi liyukh'rijūka min'hā wa-idhan lā yalbathūna khilāfaka illā qalīlan They were about to hound you out of the land, to expel you from it, but then they would not have stayed after you but a little.

item.title: Al-Israa:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَادُوْۤا لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا وَإِذًا لَا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَافَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا wa-in kādū layastafizzūnaka mina l-arḍi liyukh'rijūka min'hā wa-idhan lā yalbathūna khilāfaka illā qalīlan And indeed, they were about to provoke (i.e., drive) you from the land (i.e., Makkah) to evict you therefrom. And then (when they do), they will not remain (there) after you, except for a little.1 And verily, they were about to frighten you so much as to drive you out from the land. But in that case, they would not have stayed (therein) after you, except for a little while (17:76). A Sunnah with which We sent Our Messengers before you and you will not find any alteration in Our Sunnah (17:77). The Reason Why these Ayat were Revealed This was revealed concerning the disbelievers among the Quraysh, when they wanted to expel the…

item.title: Al-Israa:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَادُوْۤا لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا وَإِذًا لَا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَافَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا wa-in kādū layastafizzūnaka mina l-arḍi liyukh'rijūka min'hā wa-idhan lā yalbathūna khilāfaka illā qalīlan And verily well-nigh they purposed to tare (by Boycotting.) these away from the land, that they might drive thee out from it, but then, they would not have tarried (This may refer to the Interdict of the 'Shi'b Abi Talib' and the Non-Co-operation of the heathens forcing the Holy Prophet to leave Mecca. Qur'an prophecies that after that, they themselves would not stay there long.) (therein) after thee, but a little. Refers to the plot of the Quraysh to expel the Holy Prophet from Mecca. The latter part of the verse is a prophecy about Mecca being captured shortly after the Holy Prophet migrated from it.

item.title: Al-Israa:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سُنَّةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنْ رُسُلِنَا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا sunnata man qad arsalnā qablaka min rusulinā walā tajidu lisunnatinā taḥwīlan A precedent of those We have sent from among Our apostles before you, and you will not find any change in Our precedent.

item.title: Al-Israa:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سُنَّةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنْ رُسُلِنَا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا sunnata man qad arsalnā qablaka min rusulinā walā tajidu lisunnatinā taḥwīlan (That is Our) established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration. See 17:76

item.title: Al-Israa:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سُنَّةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنْ رُسُلِنَا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا sunnata man qad arsalnā qablaka min rusulinā walā tajidu lisunnatinā taḥwīlan This was Our way with those of Our apostles whom We did send before thee, and thou shalt find not in Our way any change. See 17:76

item.title: Al-Israa:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَى غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا aqimi l-ṣalata lidulūki l-shamsi ilā ghasaqi al-layli waqur'āna l-fajri inna qur'āna l-fajri kāna mashhūdan Maintain the prayer from the sun's decline1 till the darkness of the night, and [observe particularly] the dawn recital. Indeed the dawn recital is attended [by angels].

item.title: Al-Israa:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَى غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا aqimi l-ṣalata lidulūki l-shamsi ilā ghasaqi al-layli waqur'āna l-fajri inna qur'āna l-fajri kāna mashhūdan Establish prayer at the decline of the sun (from its meridian) until the darkness of the night1 and (also) the Qur’ān (i.e., recitation) of dawn.2 Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed. Perform the Salah from midday till the darkness of the night, and recite the Qur'an in the early dawn. Verily, the recitation of the Qur'an in the early dawn is ever witnessed (17:78). And in some parts of the night (also) offer the Salah with it as an additional prayer for you. It may be that your Lord will raise you to Maqam Mahmud (17:79). The Command to Offer the Prayers at their Appointed Times Allah says, commanding His…

item.title: Al-Israa:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَى غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا aqimi l-ṣalata lidulūki l-shamsi ilā ghasaqi al-layli waqur'āna l-fajri inna qur'āna l-fajri kāna mashhūdan Establish prayer (regularly) from the declension of the sun till the darkness of the night, and the recital at the morn; verily the recital at the morn is witnessed. This verse comprehends all five daily prayers prescribed by Islam. From the declining of the Sun to Sunset - there are two prayers. (1) 'Zuhr' - the noon prayer. (2) 'Asr' - the afternoon prayer. And from the Sunset to the full darkness there are two prayers. (1) 'Maghrib' - the evening prayer (2) 'Isha' - the night prayer. At the break of the dawn one prayer (1) 'Fajr' - the morning prayer.

item.title: Al-Israa:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَكَ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا wamina al-layli fatahajjad bihi nāfilatan laka ʿasā an yabʿathaka rabbuka maqāman maḥmūdan And keep vigil for a part of the night, as a supererogatory [devotion] for you. It may be that your Lord will raise you to a praiseworthy station.

item.title: Al-Israa:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَكَ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا wamina al-layli fatahajjad bihi nāfilatan laka ʿasā an yabʿathaka rabbuka maqāman maḥmūdan And from (part of) the night, pray1 with it (i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān) as additional (worship) for you; it is expected that2 your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.3 See 17:78

item.title: Al-Israa:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَكَ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا wamina al-layli fatahajjad bihi nāfilatan laka ʿasā an yabʿathaka rabbuka maqāman maḥmūdan And (in a part) of the night, forsake sleep for prayer, in addition to (what is incumbent on) thee; Maybe that exalteth thee thy Lord unto a position praised. (All-Glorious.) 'Tahajjud' or getting wakeful in the night. This prayer is to be offered after midnight but before dawn. This is not compulsory but very strongly commended. The glorious position mentioned is the highest exaltation to which a mortal could rise. The Holy Prophet said that on the Day of Judgment he would be in the 'Maqam al-Maḥmud' (the position of the great Praise and Glory) and from there he would seek intercession for the sinners and the Lord will grant whatever he would command. 'Asa' means…

item.title: Al-Israa:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا waqul rabbi adkhil'nī mud'khala ṣid'qin wa-akhrij'nī mukh'raja ṣid'qin wa-ij'ʿal lī min ladunka sul'ṭānan naṣīran And say, 'My Lord! 'Admit me with a worthy entrance, and bring me out with a worthy departure, and render me a favourable authority from Yourself.'

item.title: Al-Israa:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا waqul rabbi adkhil'nī mud'khala ṣid'qin wa-akhrij'nī mukh'raja ṣid'qin wa-ij'ʿal lī min ladunka sul'ṭānan naṣīran And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance1 and to exit a sound exit2 and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority." And say: "My Lord! Let my entry be good, and (likewise) my exit be good. And grant me from You a helping authority, (17:80). And say: "Truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Surely, falsehood is ever bound to vanish (17:81). The Command to Emigrate Imam Ahmad recorded that Ibn 'Abbas said: The Prophet SAW was in Makkah, then he was commanded to emigrate, and Allah revealed the words: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا And say: "My Lord!…

item.title: Al-Israa:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا waqul rabbi adkhil'nī mud'khala ṣid'qin wa-akhrij'nī mukh'raja ṣid'qin wa-ij'ʿal lī min ladunka sul'ṭānan naṣīran And say (Or pray, saying.) thou (praying): "O' My Lord! cause me to enter a goodly entrance and cause me to go out (of) a goodly exit, and grant me from unto Thee an authority to assist (me)" This is the declaration of the establishment of Islam and the subjection of falsehood and a prophecy also to say that one day falsehood shall be wiped out forever. The fulfilment of this, will be only at the appearance of the Last Imam Muhammad al-Mahdi when Jesus also will return to earthly life. The most appropriate interpretation is to take it in a very wide sense to mean to ask help in all movements,…

item.title: Al-Israa:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا waqul jāa l-ḥaqu wazahaqa l-bāṭilu inna l-bāṭila kāna zahūqan And say, 'The truth has come, and falsehood has vanished. Indeed falsehood is bound to vanish.'

item.title: Al-Israa:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا waqul jāa l-ḥaqu wazahaqa l-bāṭilu inna l-bāṭila kāna zahūqan And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, (by nature), ever bound to depart." See 17:80

item.title: Al-Israa:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا waqul jāa l-ḥaqu wazahaqa l-bāṭilu inna l-bāṭila kāna zahūqan And say thou "The truth hath come and the falsehood hath vanished; Verily falsehood is (a thing by nature) vanishing." See 17:80

item.title: Al-Israa:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا wanunazzilu mina l-qur'āni mā huwa shifāon waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna walā yazīdu l-ẓālimīna illā khasāran We send down in the Qur'ān that which is a cure and mercy for the faithful; and it increases the wrongdoers only in loss.

item.title: Al-Israa:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا wanunazzilu mina l-qur'āni mā huwa shifāon waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna walā yazīdu l-ẓālimīna illā khasāran And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss. And We send down of the Qur'an that which is a cure and a mercy to the believers, and it increases the wrongdoers in nothing but loss (17:82). The Qur'an is a Cure and a Mercy Allah tells us that His Book, which He has revealed to His Messenger Muhammad SAW, the Qur'an to which falsehood cannot come, from before it or behind it, (it is) sent down by the All-Wise, Worthy of all praise, is a cure and a mercy for the believers, meaning that it takes…

item.title: Al-Israa:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا wanunazzilu mina l-qur'āni mā huwa shifāon waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna walā yazīdu l-ẓālimīna illā khasāran And We sent down of the Qur'an which is a healing (Refer to verses 10:57 & 41:44.) and a mercy unto the believers, but it addeth not to the unjust but perdition. See 17:80

item.title: Al-Israa:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَءَا بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَئُوسًا wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu kāna yaūsan When We bless man, he is disregardful and turns aside; but when an ill befalls him, he is despondent.

item.title: Al-Israa:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَءَا بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَئُوسًا wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu kāna yaūsan And when We bestow favor upon man (i.e., the disbeliever), he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing. And when We bestow Our grace on man, he turns away and becomes arrogant. And when evil touches him, he is in great despair (17:83). Say: Each one does according to Shakilatihi, and your Lord knows best of him whose path is right (17:84). Turning Away from Allah at Times of Ease and Despairing at Times of Calamity Allah tells us about the weakness that is inherent in man, except for those whom He protects at both times of ease and calamity. If Allah blesses a man with wealth, good health,…

item.title: Al-Israa:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَءَا بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَئُوسًا wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu kāna yaūsan And when bestow We our bounties on man, he turneth aside and goeth away (on the reverse) and when toucheth him any evil, he is despondent. See 17:80

item.title: Al-Israa:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَى شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَى سَبِيلًا qul kullun yaʿmalu ʿalā shākilatihi farabbukum aʿlamu biman huwa ahdā sabīlan Say, 'Everyone acts according to his character. Your Lord knows best who is better guided with regard to the way.'

item.title: Al-Israa:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَى شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَى سَبِيلًا qul kullun yaʿmalu ʿalā shākilatihi farabbukum aʿlamu biman huwa ahdā sabīlan Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way." See 17:83

item.title: Al-Israa:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَى شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَى سَبِيلًا qul kullun yaʿmalu ʿalā shākilatihi farabbukum aʿlamu biman huwa ahdā sabīlan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad! unto the people): (Refer to verse 2:256.) "Every one acteth after his own (The manner or the bent of mind.) mould; thus your Lord best knoweth (as to) who (among you) is the best guide of the right path." See 17:80

item.title: Al-Israa:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا wayasalūnaka ʿani l-rūḥi quli l-rūḥu min amri rabbī wamā ūtītum mina l-ʿil'mi illā qalīlan They question you concerning the Spirit. Say, 'The Spirit is of the command of my Lord,1 and you have not been given of the knowledge except a few [of you].'2

item.title: Al-Israa:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا wayasalūnaka ʿani l-rūḥi quli l-rūḥu min amri rabbī wamā ūtītum mina l-ʿil'mi illā qalīlan And they ask you, (O Muḥammad), about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair (i.e., concern) of my Lord. And you (i.e., mankind) have not been given of knowledge except a little." And they ask you concerning the Ruh (the spirit). Say: The Ruh (the spirit) is one of the things, the knowledge of which is only with my Lord. And of knowledge, you (mankind) have been given only a little (17:85). The Ruh (Spirit) Al-Bukhari recorded in his Tafsir of this Ayah that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said, While I was walking with the Prophet SAW on a farm, and he was resting on a palm-leaf stalk, some Jews passed…

item.title: Al-Israa:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا wayasalūnaka ʿani l-rūḥi quli l-rūḥu min amri rabbī wamā ūtītum mina l-ʿil'mi illā qalīlan And they ask thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) about the spirit, Say thou "The spirit is, from the command of my Lord, and ye are not given of the knowledge but a little." 'Ruh' – Spirit - has been used in Qur'an in several senses: The life or spirit blown into Adam... (15:29). The life in every conscious individual being man or animal. Jesus - is termed as a Word of God and a spirit from him... (4:171). Qur'an as a revelation… (42:52). Spirit which along with the angels come down at the 'Shab-e-Qadr' (Planning Night)… (97:4). The Spirit which along with the angels will stand on the Resurrection Day… (79:38). The…

item.title: Al-Israa:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا wala-in shi'nā lanadhhabanna bi-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka thumma lā tajidu laka bihi ʿalaynā wakīlan If We wish, We would take away what We have revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself any defender against Us,

item.title: Al-Israa:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا wala-in shi'nā lanadhhabanna bi-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka thumma lā tajidu laka bihi ʿalaynā wakīlan And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us. And if We willed, We could surely take away that which We have revealed to you. Then you would find no protector for you against Us in that respect (17:86). Except as a mercy from your Lord. Verily, His grace unto you is ever great (17:87). Say: If mankind and the Jinn were together to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof, even if they helped one another (17:88). And indeed We have fully explained to mankind, in this…

item.title: Al-Israa:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا wala-in shi'nā lanadhhabanna bi-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka thumma lā tajidu laka bihi ʿalaynā wakīlan And if We please, We would certainly take away that which We revealed unto thee, then thou wouldst find not for thee against Us any pleader, See 17:85

item.title: Al-Israa:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا illā raḥmatan min rabbika inna faḍlahu kāna ʿalayka kabīran except a mercy from your Lord. Indeed His grace has been great upon you.

item.title: Al-Israa:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا illā raḥmatan min rabbika inna faḍlahu kāna ʿalayka kabīran Except (We have left it with you) as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great. See 17:86

item.title: Al-Israa:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا illā raḥmatan min rabbika inna faḍlahu kāna ʿalayka kabīran Save the mercy from thy Lord: Verily, His grace on thee is (ever) great. See 17:85

item.title: Al-Israa:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى أَنْ يَأْتُوْۤا بِمِثْلِ هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا qul la-ini ij'tamaʿati l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā an yatū bimith'li hādhā l-qur'āni lā yatūna bimith'lihi walaw kāna baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ẓahīran Say, 'Should all humans and jinn rally to bring the like of this Qur'ān, they will not bring the like of it, even if they assisted one another.'

item.title: Al-Israa:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى أَنْ يَأْتُوْۤا بِمِثْلِ هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا qul la-ini ij'tamaʿati l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā an yatū bimith'li hādhā l-qur'āni lā yatūna bimith'lihi walaw kāna baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ẓahīran Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants." See 17:86

item.title: Al-Israa:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى أَنْ يَأْتُوْۤا بِمِثْلِ هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا qul la-ini ij'tamaʿati l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā an yatū bimith'li hādhā l-qur'āni lā yatūna bimith'lihi walaw kāna baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ẓahīran Say thou "(Even) if men and the jinn get united (with the object) that they bring the like of this Qur'an, they would bring not the like of it, even though some of them to the others be helpers." See 17:85

item.title: Al-Israa:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبٰی أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا walaqad ṣarrafnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran We have certainly interspersed for the people this Qur'ān with every [kind of] parable, but most people are only intent on ingratitude.1

item.title: Al-Israa:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبٰی أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا walaqad ṣarrafnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every (kind of) example, but most of the people refused except disbelief. See 17:86

item.title: Al-Israa:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبٰی أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا walaqad ṣarrafnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran And indeed have We displayed unto the people, in this Qur'an, every (kind of) example but incline not (Decline.) most of the people save denying. See 17:85

item.title: Al-Israa:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰی تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ يَنْبُوعًا waqālū lan nu'mina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā mina l-arḍi yanbūʿan They say, 'We will not believe you until you make a spring gush forth for us from the ground.

item.title: Al-Israa:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰی تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ يَنْبُوعًا waqālū lan nu'mina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā mina l-arḍi yanbūʿan And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring. And they say: "We shall not believe in you, until you cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us; (17:90). "Or you have a garden of date palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth in their midst abundantly; (17:91). "Or you cause the heaven to fall upon us in pieces, as you have pretended, or you bring Allah and the angels before (us) face to face; (17:92). "Or you have a house of Zukhruf, or you ascend up into the sky, and even then we will put no faith in your ascension until you bring down…

item.title: Al-Israa:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰی تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ يَنْبُوعًا waqālū lan nu'mina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā mina l-arḍi yanbūʿan And said they: "Never will we believe in thee until thou causeth a spring for us from the earth to gush forth," See 17:85

item.title: Al-Israa:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْأَنْهَارَ خِلَالَهَا تَفْجِيرًا aw takūna laka jannatun min nakhīlin waʿinabin fatufajjira l-anhāra khilālahā tafjīran Or until you have a garden of date palms and vines and you make streams gush through it.

item.title: Al-Israa:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْأَنْهَارَ خِلَالَهَا تَفْجِيرًا aw takūna laka jannatun min nakhīlin waʿinabin fatufajjira l-anhāra khilālahā tafjīran Or (until) you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force (and abundance). See 17:90

item.title: Al-Israa:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْأَنْهَارَ خِلَالَهَا تَفْجِيرًا aw takūna laka jannatun min nakhīlin waʿinabin fatufajjira l-anhāra khilālahā tafjīran Or (cause it to) be for thee a garden of date-palms and grapes, and (cause) rivers in their midst, gushing forth, See 17:85

item.title: Al-Israa:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَاءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِيَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ قَبِيلًا aw tus'qiṭa l-samāa kamā zaʿamta ʿalaynā kisafan aw tatiya bil-lahi wal-malāikati qabīlan Or until you cause the sky to fall in fragments upon us, just as you would aver. Or until you bring Allah and the angels [right] in front of us.

item.title: Al-Israa:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَاءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِيَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ قَبِيلًا aw tus'qiṭa l-samāa kamā zaʿamta ʿalaynā kisafan aw tatiya bil-lahi wal-malāikati qabīlan Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before (us). See 17:90

item.title: Al-Israa:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَاءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِيَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ قَبِيلًا aw tus'qiṭa l-samāa kamā zaʿamta ʿalaynā kisafan aw tatiya bil-lahi wal-malāikati qabīlan Or cause the heavens to fall as thou didst assert upon us, in pieces, or bring thou God and the angels (to vouch for thee) face to face (with us), See 17:85

item.title: Al-Israa:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِنْ زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَى فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتّٰی تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابًا نَقْرَؤُهُ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي هَلْ كُنْتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَسُولًا aw yakūna laka baytun min zukh'rufin aw tarqā fī l-samāi walan nu'mina liruqiyyika ḥattā tunazzila ʿalaynā kitāban naqra-uhu qul sub'ḥāna rabbī hal kuntu illā basharan rasūlan Or until you have a house of gold, or you ascend into the sky. And we will not believe your ascension until you bring down for us a book that we may read.' Say, 'Immaculate is my Lord! Am I anything but a human, an apostle?!'

item.title: Al-Israa:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِنْ زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَى فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتّٰی تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابًا نَقْرَؤُهُ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي هَلْ كُنْتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَسُولًا aw yakūna laka baytun min zukh'rufin aw tarqā fī l-samāi walan nu'mina liruqiyyika ḥattā tunazzila ʿalaynā kitāban naqra-uhu qul sub'ḥāna rabbī hal kuntu illā basharan rasūlan Or you have a house of ornament (i.e., gold) or you ascend into the sky. And (even then), we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?" See 17:90

item.title: Al-Israa:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِنْ زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَى فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتّٰی تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابًا نَقْرَؤُهُ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي هَلْ كُنْتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَسُولًا aw yakūna laka baytun min zukh'rufin aw tarqā fī l-samāi walan nu'mina liruqiyyika ḥattā tunazzila ʿalaynā kitāban naqra-uhu qul sub'ḥāna rabbī hal kuntu illā basharan rasūlan Or there be for thee a house of (Ornament.) gold, or ascend thou into the heaven; and never will we believe in thy ascending until thou causeth to be sent down unto us a book that we may read it. "Say: thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!)" "Glory be to my Lord; am I aught save a man (sent by God as) Apostle." 'Imam or a human apostle of God', the working of a miracle depends totally upon the Will of the Lord and not upon the fancy of…

item.title: Al-Israa:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَى إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَسُولًا wamā manaʿa l-nāsa an yu'minū idh jāahumu l-hudā illā an qālū abaʿatha l-lahu basharan rasūlan Nothing kept the people from believing when guidance came to them, but their saying, 'Has Allah sent a human as an apostle?!'

item.title: Al-Israa:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَى إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَسُولًا wamā manaʿa l-nāsa an yu'minū idh jāahumu l-hudā illā an qālū abaʿatha l-lahu basharan rasūlan And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger?" And nothing prevented men from believing when the guidance came to them, except that they said: "Has Allah sent a man as (His) Messenger? (17:94). Say: "If there were on the earth, angels walking about in peace and security, We should certainly have sent down for them from the heaven an angel as a Messenger (17:95). The Refusal of the Idolators to Believe Because the Messenger SAW was a Human, and its Refutation وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ And nothing prevented men means, most of them: أَن يُؤْمِنُوا from believing…

item.title: Al-Israa:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَى إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَسُولًا wamā manaʿa l-nāsa an yu'minū idh jāahumu l-hudā illā an qālū abaʿatha l-lahu basharan rasūlan And nothing prevented the people from believing, when came unto them the guidance (from their Lord), save that they said: "What! hath God sent a man (like unto us to be) (His) Apostle." Even after presenting the intellectual everlasting miracle (Qur'an) as the testimony to the bonafides of his ministry, they started demanding such foolish signs which would satisfy their sensual desires, or they would display their aversion to accept the proper guidance to which the answer was given in the last sentence of verse 17:93; and Qur'an also gives the reason for the adamant attitude in verse 17:94 and again refers to the Divine witness which is between the…

item.title: Al-Israa:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَلَائِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَلَكًا رَسُولًا qul law kāna fī l-arḍi malāikatun yamshūna muṭ'ma-innīna lanazzalnā ʿalayhim mina l-samāi malakan rasūlan Say, 'Had there been angels in the earth, walking around and residing [in it like humans do], We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel as apostle.'

item.title: Al-Israa:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَلَائِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَلَكًا رَسُولًا qul law kāna fī l-arḍi malāikatun yamshūna muṭ'ma-innīna lanazzalnā ʿalayhim mina l-samāi malakan rasūlan Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely,1 We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel (as a) messenger." See 17:94

item.title: Al-Israa:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَلَائِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَلَكًا رَسُولًا qul law kāna fī l-arḍi malāikatun yamshūna muṭ'ma-innīna lanazzalnā ʿalayhim mina l-samāi malakan rasūlan Say thou: "If there were in the earth angels walking, settled in security, surely We would have sent down unto them, from the heaven, an angel as an apostle." See 17:94

item.title: Al-Israa:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا qul kafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum innahu kāna biʿibādihi khabīran baṣīran Say, 'Allah suffices as a witness between me and you. Indeed He is well aware and percipient of His servants.'

item.title: Al-Israa:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا qul kafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum innahu kāna biʿibādihi khabīran baṣīran Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing." Say: Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. Verily, He is Ever the All-Knower, the All-Seer of His servants (17:96). Allah tells His Prophet SAW how to prove that what he has brought is true, saying to him to tell them: "He (Allah) is a witness over me and over you. He knows what I have brought to you. If I were lying to you, He would take revenge on me in the severest manner," as Allah says: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ - لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ - ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ And if he…

item.title: Al-Israa:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا qul kafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum innahu kāna biʿibādihi khabīran baṣīran Say thou: "Sufficeth God as a witness between me and you; Verily He of His servants is All- Aware and All-Seeing." See 17:94

item.title: Al-Israa:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَاهُمْ سَعِيرًا waman yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadi waman yuḍ'lil falan tajida lahum awliyāa min dūnihi wanaḥshuruhum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿalā wujūhihim ʿum'yan wabuk'man waṣumman mawāhum jahannamu kullamā khabat zid'nāhum saʿīran Whomever Allah guides is rightly guided, and whomever He leads astray you will never find them any guardians besides Him. On the Day of Resurrection, We shall muster them [scrambling] on their faces,1 blind, dumb, and deaf. Their refuge shall be hell. Whenever it subsides, We shall intensify the blaze for them.

item.title: Al-Israa:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَاهُمْ سَعِيرًا waman yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadi waman yuḍ'lil falan tajida lahum awliyāa min dūnihi wanaḥshuruhum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿalā wujūhihim ʿum'yan wabuk'man waṣumman mawāhum jahannamu kullamā khabat zid'nāhum saʿīran And whoever Allah guides - he is the (rightly) guided; and whoever He sends astray1 - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection (fallen) on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides, We increase (for) them blazing fire. And he whom Allah guides, he is led aright; and whomever He leaves astray can never find helpers other than Him, and We shall gather them together on…

item.title: Al-Israa:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَاهُمْ سَعِيرًا waman yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadi waman yuḍ'lil falan tajida lahum awliyāa min dūnihi wanaḥshuruhum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿalā wujūhihim ʿum'yan wabuk'man waṣumman mawāhum jahannamu kullamā khabat zid'nāhum saʿīran And whomsoever God guideth, then he is guided aright; and whomsoever He leaveth to stray, thou shalt never find for him any guardians other than (God.) Him; and We will gather them together on the Day of Resurrection on their faces, (Lying prone.) blind (Refer to verse 2:18.) dumb and deaf; their abode shall be Hell; so oft as it abateth, We shall increase for them the blaze. See 17:94

item.title: Al-Israa:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَقَالُوْۤا أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا dhālika jazāuhum bi-annahum kafarū biāyātinā waqālū a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan a-innā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdan That is their requital because they defied Our signs and said, 'What, when we have become bones and dust, shall we really be raised in a new creation?'

item.title: Al-Israa:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَقَالُوْۤا أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا dhālika jazāuhum bi-annahum kafarū biāyātinā waqālū a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan a-innā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdan That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we (truly) be resurrected (in) a new creation?" That is their recompense, because they denied Our Ayat and said: When we are bones and fragments, shall we really be raised up as a new creation? (17:98). See they not that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, is able to create the like of them. And He has decreed for them an appointed term, whereof there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse but disbelief (17:99). Allah says: This punishment, being resurrected blind, dumb and deaf, is what they deserve, because…

item.title: Al-Israa:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَقَالُوْۤا أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا dhālika jazāuhum bi-annahum kafarū biāyātinā waqālū a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan a-innā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdan This is their recompense for they disbelieved in Our signs and said they: "What! when we become (mere) bones and decayed dust, (even) then shall we (in fact) be raised into a new creation?" See 17:94

item.title: Al-Israa:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ فَأَبٰی الظَّالِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa qādirun ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum wajaʿala lahum ajalan lā rayba fīhi fa-abā l-ẓālimūna illā kufūran Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth, is able to create the like of them? He has appointed for them a term, in which there is no doubt; yet the wrongdoers are only intent on ingratitude.1

item.title: Al-Israa:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ فَأَبٰی الظَّالِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa qādirun ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum wajaʿala lahum ajalan lā rayba fīhi fa-abā l-ẓālimūna illā kufūran Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth, is (the one) Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse except disbelief. See 17:98

item.title: Al-Israa:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ فَأَبٰی الظَّالِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa qādirun ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum wajaʿala lahum ajalan lā rayba fīhi fa-abā l-ẓālimūna illā kufūran What! See they not that God Who created the heavens and the earth, is (certainly) able to create the like of them, and He hath decreed for them a term in which there is no doubt; but incline not the unjust save (to) denying. See 17:94

item.title: Al-Israa:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ أَنْتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَائِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّي إِذًا لَأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ الْإِنْفَاقِ وَكَانَ الْإِنْسَانُ قَتُورًا qul law antum tamlikūna khazāina raḥmati rabbī idhan la-amsaktum khashyata l-infāqi wakāna l-insānu qatūran Say, 'Even if you possessed the treasuries of my Lord's mercy, you would withhold them for the fear of being spent, and man is very niggardly.'

item.title: Al-Israa:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ أَنْتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَائِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّي إِذًا لَأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ الْإِنْفَاقِ وَكَانَ الْإِنْسَانُ قَتُورًا qul law antum tamlikūna khazāina raḥmati rabbī idhan la-amsaktum khashyata l-infāqi wakāna l-insānu qatūran Say (to them), "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy. Say: If you possessed the treasure of the mercy of my Lord, then you would surely hold back for fear of spending, and man is ever miserly! (17:100). Holding back is Part of Man's Nature Allah says to His Messenger SAW: "Tell them, O Muhammad, even if you had authority over the treasures of Allah, you would refrain from spending for fear of exhausting it." Ibn 'Abbas and Qatadah said, "This means for fear of poverty," lest it run out, despite the fact…

item.title: Al-Israa:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ أَنْتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَائِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّي إِذًا لَأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ الْإِنْفَاقِ وَكَانَ الْإِنْسَانُ قَتُورًا qul law antum tamlikūna khazāina raḥmati rabbī idhan la-amsaktum khashyata l-infāqi wakāna l-insānu qatūran Say thou: If ye own the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, (even) then will ye certainly withhold them for fear of spending; and man is ever (Owing to the lack of the power of reproduction of what is spent away.) niggardly. See 17:94

item.title: Al-Israa:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی تِسْعَ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ فَسْءَلْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ فِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّیْ لَأَظُنُّكَ يَامُوسٰی مَسْحُورًا walaqad ātaynā mūsā tis'ʿa āyātin bayyinātin fasal banī is'rāīla idh jāahum faqāla lahu fir'ʿawnu innī la-aẓunnuka yāmūsā masḥūran Certainly We gave Moses nine manifest signs. So ask the Children of Israel. When he came to them, Pharaoh said to him, 'O Moses, indeed I think you are bewitched.'

item.title: Al-Israa:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی تِسْعَ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ فَسْءَلْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ فِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّیْ لَأَظُنُّكَ يَامُوسٰی مَسْحُورًا walaqad ātaynā mūsā tis'ʿa āyātin bayyinātin fasal banī is'rāīla idh jāahum faqāla lahu fir'ʿawnu innī la-aẓunnuka yāmūsā masḥūran And We had certainly given Musa nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel (about) when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Musa, that you are affected by magic." And indeed We gave Musa nine clear signs. Ask then the Children of Israel, when he came to them, then Fir'awn said to him: O Musa! I think you are indeed bewitched (17:101). He said: "Verily, you know that these signs have been sent down by none but the Lord of the heavens and the earth. And I think you are indeed, O Fir'awn, doomed to destruction!…

item.title: Al-Israa:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی تِسْعَ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ فَسْءَلْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ فِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّیْ لَأَظُنُّكَ يَامُوسٰی مَسْحُورًا walaqad ātaynā mūsā tis'ʿa āyātin bayyinātin fasal banī is'rāīla idh jāahum faqāla lahu fir'ʿawnu innī la-aẓunnuka yāmūsā masḥūran And indeed We gave Moses nine clear signs (miracles); so ask the children of Israel when he came unto them, Pharaoh said unto him; "Verily I deem thee O' Moses one (Lost sense of reasoning.) bewitched" The following nine signs are given in the Old Testament: (1) Turning of water into blood, (2) Frogs, (3) Lice, (4) Flies, (5) The plague, (6) Hail, (7) Locusts, (8) Darkness, (9) Plague on the first born.1

item.title: Al-Israa:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا أَنْزَلَ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ بَصَائِرَ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ يَافِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا qāla laqad ʿalim'ta mā anzala hāulāi illā rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi baṣāira wa-innī la-aẓunnuka yāfir'ʿawnu mathbūran He said, 'You certainly know that no one has sent these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as eye-openers, and I, O Pharaoh, indeed think you are doomed.'

item.title: Al-Israa:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا أَنْزَلَ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ بَصَائِرَ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ يَافِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا qāla laqad ʿalim'ta mā anzala hāulāi illā rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi baṣāira wa-innī la-aẓunnuka yāfir'ʿawnu mathbūran (Musa) said, "You have already known that none has sent down these (signs) except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think,1 O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed." See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا أَنْزَلَ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ بَصَائِرَ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ يَافِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا qāla laqad ʿalim'ta mā anzala hāulāi illā rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi baṣāira wa-innī la-aẓunnuka yāfir'ʿawnu mathbūran Said he (Moses.) Indeed, thou knowest that none hath sent these down save the Lord of the heavens and the earth (as) eye opening proofs; and I think thou O' Pharaoh is doomed to perdition. See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْتَفِزَّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ جَمِيعًا fa-arāda an yastafizzahum mina l-arḍi fa-aghraqnāhu waman maʿahu jamīʿan He desired to exterminate them from the land, so We drowned him and all those who were with him.

item.title: Al-Israa:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْتَفِزَّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ جَمِيعًا fa-arāda an yastafizzahum mina l-arḍi fa-aghraqnāhu waman maʿahu jamīʿan So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together. See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْتَفِزَّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ جَمِيعًا fa-arāda an yastafizzahum mina l-arḍi fa-aghraqnāhu waman maʿahu jamīʿan And resolved he (Pharaoh.) to tare them away out of the land, so We drowned him and those with him, all together, See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ اسْكُنُوْۤا الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ الْاٰخِرَةُ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا waqul'nā min baʿdihi libanī is'rāīla us'kunū l-arḍa fa-idhā jāa waʿdu l-ākhirati ji'nā bikum lafīfan After him We said to the Children of Israel, 'Take up residence in the land, and when the occasion of the other [promise] comes,1 We shall gather you in mixed company.'2

item.title: Al-Israa:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ اسْكُنُوْۤا الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ الْاٰخِرَةُ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا waqul'nā min baʿdihi libanī is'rāīla us'kunū l-arḍa fa-idhā jāa waʿdu l-ākhirati ji'nā bikum lafīfan And We said after him (i.e., Pharaoh) to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise (i.e., appointment) of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in (one) gathering." See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ اسْكُنُوْۤا الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ الْاٰخِرَةُ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا waqul'nā min baʿdihi libanī is'rāīla us'kunū l-arḍa fa-idhā jāa waʿdu l-ākhirati ji'nā bikum lafīfan And said We after that, unto the children of Israel: "Abide ye in peace in the land, but when cometh the later (Refer to verses 17:101 & 17:4 - 17:8.) promise, We shall bring you all rolled up (collected together)" See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا wabil-ḥaqi anzalnāhu wabil-ḥaqi nazala wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran With the truth did We send it down, and with the truth did it descend, and We did not send you except as a bearer of good news and as a warner.

item.title: Al-Israa:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا wabil-ḥaqi anzalnāhu wabil-ḥaqi nazala wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran And with the truth We have sent it (i.e., the Qur’ān) down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, (O Muḥammad), except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And with truth We have sent it down, and with truth it has descended. And We have sent you as nothing but a bearer of glad tidings, and a warner (17:105). And a Qur'an which We have divided (into parts), in order that you might recite it to men at intervals. And We have revealed it by stages (17:106). The Revelation of the Qur'an in Stages Allah tells us that His Book, the Glorious Qur'an, has been sent with truth, i.e., it contains the truth,…

item.title: Al-Israa:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا wabil-ḥaqi anzalnāhu wabil-ḥaqi nazala wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran And with truth have We sent it down and with truth it hath come down; and We sent not thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) but as a Giver of glad tidings and as a Warner. See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَى مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنْزِيلًا waqur'ānan faraqnāhu litaqra-ahu ʿalā l-nāsi ʿalā muk'thin wanazzalnāhu tanzīlan We have sent the Qur'ān in [discrete] parts so that you may read it to the people a little at a time, and We have sent it down piecemeal.

item.title: Al-Israa:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَى مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنْزِيلًا waqur'ānan faraqnāhu litaqra-ahu ʿalā l-nāsi ʿalā muk'thin wanazzalnāhu tanzīlan And (it is) a Qur’ān which We have separated (by intervals) that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively. See 17:105

item.title: Al-Israa:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَى مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنْزِيلًا waqur'ānan faraqnāhu litaqra-ahu ʿalā l-nāsi ʿalā muk'thin wanazzalnāhu tanzīlan And it is Qur'an which We have apportioned it (Or made distinct.) so that thou mayest recite it unto the people with deliberation (by degrees), and We have sent it down, gradually in portions. See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِهِ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ إِذَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا qul āminū bihi aw lā tu'minū inna alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma min qablihi idhā yut'lā ʿalayhim yakhirrūna lil'adhqāni sujjadan Say, 'Whether you believe in it, or do not believe in it, indeed those who were given knowledge before it when it is recited to them, fall down in prostration on their faces,

item.title: Al-Israa:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِهِ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ إِذَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا qul āminū bihi aw lā tu'minū inna alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma min qablihi idhā yut'lā ʿalayhim yakhirrūna lil'adhqāni sujjadan Say, "Believe in it or do not believe." Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it1 - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration. Say: "Believe in it or do not believe (in it). Verily, those who were given knowledge before it, when it is recited to them, fall down on their chins (faces) in humble prostration (17:107). And they say: "Glory be to our Lord! Truly, the promise of our Lord must be fulfilled (17:108). And they fall down on their chins (faces) weeping and it increases their humility (17:109). Those Who were Given Knowledge before Truly…

item.title: Al-Israa:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اٰمِنُوْۤا بِهِ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ إِذَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا qul āminū bihi aw lā tu'minū inna alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma min qablihi idhā yut'lā ʿalayhim yakhirrūna lil'adhqāni sujjadan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "Believe ye in it or believe ye not; Verily those who are (already) given (Refer to verse 29:46.) the knowledge from before it, when it is recited unto them they fall down on their faces prostrating in obeisance," See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا wayaqūlūna sub'ḥāna rabbinā in kāna waʿdu rabbinā lamafʿūlan and say, "Immaculate is our Lord! Indeed Our Lord's promise is bound to be fulfilled."

item.title: Al-Israa:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا wayaqūlūna sub'ḥāna rabbinā in kāna waʿdu rabbinā lamafʿūlan And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled." See 17:107

item.title: Al-Israa:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا wayaqūlūna sub'ḥāna rabbinā in kāna waʿdu rabbinā lamafʿūlan And say they: "Glorious is our Lord! verily the promise of our Lord was (a certainty) to be fulfilled." See 17:101

item.title: Al-Israa:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا wayakhirrūna lil'adhqāni yabkūna wayazīduhum khushūʿan Weeping, they fall down on their faces, and it increases them in humility.'

item.title: Al-Israa:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا wayakhirrūna lil'adhqāni yabkūna wayazīduhum khushūʿan And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it (i.e., the Qur’ān) increases them in humble submission. See 17:107

item.title: Al-Israa:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا wayakhirrūna lil'adhqāni yabkūna wayazīduhum khushūʿan And they fall down on their faces weeping and it (the listening to the Qur'an) increaseth their humility. (Devotional humility.) After exposing the adamance of the contemporary infidels and comparing them to the repulsive attitude of Pharaoh and his people towards Moses and their ultimate destiny, God gives the utmost assurance of the truth of the Qur'an and the success of the Holy Prophet and thus gives the confidence to the Holy Prophet that whether they accept the truth or not, the people gifted with the knowledge1 will submit with utmost devotional humility to it. In support of this refer to verses 29:47 - 29:52. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Israa:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ ادْعُوْۤا اللَّهَ أَوِ ادْعُوْۤا الرَّحْمَنَ أَيًّا مَا تَدْعُوْۤا فَلَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا quli id'ʿū l-laha awi id'ʿū l-raḥmāna ayyan mā tadʿū falahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā walā tajhar biṣalātika walā tukhāfit bihā wa-ib'taghi bayna dhālika sabīlan Say, 'Invoke "Allah" or invoke "the All-beneficent." Whichever [of His Names] you may invoke, to Him belong the Best Names.' Be neither loud in your prayer, nor murmur it, but follow a middle course between these,

item.title: Al-Israa:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ ادْعُوْۤا اللَّهَ أَوِ ادْعُوْۤا الرَّحْمَنَ أَيًّا مَا تَدْعُوْۤا فَلَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا quli id'ʿū l-laha awi id'ʿū l-raḥmāna ayyan mā tadʿū falahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā walā tajhar biṣalātika walā tukhāfit bihā wa-ib'taghi bayna dhālika sabīlan Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful (ar-Raḥmān). Whichever (name) you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite (too) loudly in your prayer or (too) quietly but seek between that an (intermediate) way. Say: "Invoke Allah or invoke Ar-Rahman (the Most Gracious), by whatever name you invoke Him (it is the same), for to Him belong the Best Names. And offer your Salah (prayer) neither aloud nor in a low voice, but follow a way between (17:110). And say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah, Who…

item.title: Al-Israa:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ ادْعُوْۤا اللَّهَ أَوِ ادْعُوْۤا الرَّحْمَنَ أَيًّا مَا تَدْعُوْۤا فَلَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا quli id'ʿū l-laha awi id'ʿū l-raḥmāna ayyan mā tadʿū falahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā walā tajhar biṣalātika walā tukhāfit bihā wa-ib'taghi bayna dhālika sabīlan Say: "Call upon 'Allah' (God) or call upon (Refer to verses 25:60 & 20:8.) 'Rahman' (the Beneficent); whichever ye call upon, for Him (alone) are all the best names; and say thou not thy prayer too aloud, nor say it in too low a voice, but seek between these (extremes) a middle course." The Holy Prophet told Ali Ibn Abi Talib that the recitation of the last two verses of this chapter are a guarantee for my people against theft.

item.title: Al-Israa:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا waquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lam yattakhidh waladan walam yakun lahu sharīkun fī l-mul'ki walam yakun lahu waliyyun mina l-dhuli wakabbir'hu takbīran and say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who has neither taken any son, nor has He any partner in sovereignty, nor has He [taken] any ally out of weakness,' and magnify Him with a magnification [worthy of Him].

item.title: Al-Israa:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا waquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lam yattakhidh waladan walam yakun lahu sharīkun fī l-mul'ki walam yakun lahu waliyyun mina l-dhuli wakabbir'hu takbīran And say, "Praise to Allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in (His) dominion and has no (need of a) protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with (great) glorification." See 17:110

item.title: Al-Israa:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا waquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lam yattakhidh waladan walam yakun lahu sharīkun fī l-mul'ki walam yakun lahu waliyyun mina l-dhuli wakabbir'hu takbīran And say thou: "(All) Praise is God's, Who hath not taken unto Him a son and Who hath not a partner in the kingdom, and there is not for Him any helper against any humility, and proclaim thou His Greatness magnifying (His Glory)." See 17:110

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Mīm.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Meem.1

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ha. Mim. (H. M.) See 45:2

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, All-wise.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 45:1

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The descent (or revealed) of the Book (Qur'an) from God, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. By the revelation of the Book, the Holy Qur'an, from God the Almighty and the All-Wise. Verses 39:2, 40:2, 41:2 present God, i.e., 42:2, 44:2, 46:2. From verse 39-46 in almost identical terms is asserted the revelation of the Qur'an in the form of a complete Book. The highly expressive and eloquent Arabic language from the Almighty, All-Wise God and that this is a revealed form of what is contained in the Mother Book which is High and Firm, 43:4. Considering all these assertions one would realise that Qur'an was not a fragment of any Arabic composition uttered by the Holy Prophet to meet the requirement of any particular occasion, left to the people…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin lil'mu'minīna Indeed in the heavens and the earth there are signs for the faithful.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin lil'mu'minīna Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers. See 45:1

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin lil'mu'minīna Verily in the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers. To any intelligent seeker of the Truth, there are volumes of knowledge in the manifest universe about the unity of its Maker, His Existence, Power, Authority and Knowledge. The Unity of God, is manifestly declared in the perfect unity of the will, working in the diversity of the creation and the perfect harmony in the functioning of the forces of nature. The uniformity of the laws, regulating the life in the universe, obviously proves the unity of the purpose of the One and the only Creator Lord of everything in existence. His self-Existent Being, His Omnipotence to execute His Will and His Infinite Knowledge and Unlimited Wisdom. Today, more than at any time before, as the…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ wafī khalqikum wamā yabuthu min dābbatin āyātun liqawmin yūqinūna And in your creation [too], and whatever animals that He scatters abroad, there are signs for a people who have certainty.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ wafī khalqikum wamā yabuthu min dābbatin āyātun liqawmin yūqinūna And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain (in faith). See 45:1

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ wafī khalqikum wamā yabuthu min dābbatin āyātun liqawmin yūqinūna And in your (own) creation, and what He scattereth in the earth, of the animals, (Arabic – 'Daabba' Lit. Moving beings.) are signs for a people sure in faith, See 45:3

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَاحِ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā anzala l-lahu mina l-samāi min riz'qin fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wataṣrīfi l-riyāḥi āyātun liqawmin yaʿqilūna And in the alternation of night and day and what Allah sends down from the sky of [His] provision with which He revives the earth after its death, and in the changing of the winds there are signs for a people who apply reason.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَاحِ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā anzala l-lahu mina l-samāi min riz'qin fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wataṣrīfi l-riyāḥi āyātun liqawmin yaʿqilūna And (in) the alternation of night and day and (in) what Allah sends down from the sky of provision (i.e., rain) and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and (in His) directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason. See 45:1

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَاحِ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā anzala l-lahu mina l-samāi min riz'qin fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wataṣrīfi l-riyāḥi āyātun liqawmin yaʿqilūna And in the alternation of the night and the day, and what God sendeth down from heaven, of the sustenance, and (in His) giving life thereby to the earth after its death, and (in) the changing of the winds, are signs for a people who understand. See 45:3

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَءَايَاتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ til'ka āyātu l-lahi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqi fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿda l-lahi waāyātihi yu'minūna These are the signs of Allah that We recite for you in truth. So what discourse will they believe after Allah and His signs?

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَءَايَاتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ til'ka āyātu l-lahi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqi fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿda l-lahi waāyātihi yu'minūna These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe? These are the Ayat of Allah, which We recite to you with truth. Then in which speech after Allah and His Ayat will they believe (45:6). Woe to every sinful liar (45:7). Who hears the Ayat of Allah Tutla (recited) to him, yet persists with pride as if he heard them not. So announce to him a painful torment (45:8). And when he learns something of Our Ayat, he makes them a jest. For such there will be a humiliating torment (45:9). In front of them there is Hell. And that…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَءَايَاتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ til'ka āyātu l-lahi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqi fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿda l-lahi waāyātihi yu'minūna These are the signs of God recite We unto thee with truth; then in what (other) argument (Lit. Discourse – Statement – announcement – Exposition.) after (rejecting) God and His signs, would they believe? If people do not accept such manifest and obvious proofs about God, what other exposition would they need to believe in Him. Lit. discourse – statement – announcement - exposition, taken in any sense, indicates that Qur'an is uncreated as some schools of thought think. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ waylun likulli affākin athīmin Woe to every sinful liar,

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ waylun likulli affākin athīmin Woe to every sinful liar. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ waylun likulli affākin athīmin Woe unto every liar, (and every) sinner, See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْمَعُ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yasmaʿu āyāti l-lahi tut'lā ʿalayhi thumma yuṣirru mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin who hears the signs of Allah being recited to him, yet persists disdainfully, as if he had not heard them. So inform him of a painful punishment.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْمَعُ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yasmaʿu āyāti l-lahi tut'lā ʿalayhi thumma yuṣirru mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْمَعُ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yasmaʿu āyāti l-lahi tut'lā ʿalayhi thumma yuṣirru mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin He (The disbeliever.) heareth the signs of God recited unto him, yet persisteth he arrogantly, as if he hath heard them not; so announce thou unto them a painful chastisement. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَاتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ wa-idhā ʿalima min āyātinā shayan ittakhadhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun Should he learn anything about Our signs, he takes them in derision. For such there is a humiliating punishment.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَاتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ wa-idhā ʿalima min āyātinā shayan ittakhadhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَاتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ wa-idhā ʿalima min āyātinā shayan ittakhadhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun And when he cometh to know any of Our signs he taketh it in jest; (Even today people with modern education disbelieve in miracles and ridicule.) These shall have a disgracing chastisement. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا شَيْئًا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ min warāihim jahannamu walā yugh'nī ʿanhum mā kasabū shayan walā mā ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Ahead of them is hell and what they have earned will not avail them in any way, nor what they had taken as guardians besides Allah, and there is a great punishment for them.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا شَيْئًا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ min warāihim jahannamu walā yugh'nī ʿanhum mā kasabū shayan walā mā ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Before them1 is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا شَيْئًا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ min warāihim jahannamu walā yugh'nī ʿanhum mā kasabū shayan walā mā ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Behind them is hell, and shall avail them not aught of what they did earn, nor those whom they took as guardians besides God, and for them shall be a grievous chastisement. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا هُدًى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِنْ رِجْزٍ اَلِیْمٌ hādhā hudan wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmun This is a guidance, and as for those who defy the signs of their Lord, for them is a painful punishment due to defilement.1

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا هُدًى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِنْ رِجْزٍ اَلِیْمٌ hādhā hudan wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmun This (Qur’ān) is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا هُدًى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِنْ رِجْزٍ اَلِیْمٌ hādhā hudan wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmun This (Qur'an) is guidance, and those who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord, for them shall be the most painful chastisement. See 45:6

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِیْهِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ al-lahu alladhī sakhara lakumu l-baḥra litajriya l-ful'ku fīhi bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna It is Allah who disposed the sea for you[r benefit] so that the ships may sail in it by His command, and that you may seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِیْهِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ al-lahu alladhī sakhara lakumu l-baḥra litajriya l-ful'ku fīhi bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful. Allah, it is He Who has subjected to you the sea, that ships may sail through it by His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, and that you may be thankful (45:12). And has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth; it is all (as a favor and kindness) from Him. Verily, in it are signs for a people who think deeply (45:13). Say to the believers…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِیْهِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ al-lahu alladhī sakhara lakumu l-baḥra litajriya l-ful'ku fīhi bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna God is He Who made subservient unto you the sea that may traverse the ships therein by His command, and that ye may seek of His grace and that ye may be thankful. Is it not God who made the Oceans encircle the earth with its salt water absorbing in it all the unhealthy matter to be constantly and continuously washed into it by the rivers from the various parts of the earth and thus maintain the global sanitation. Does not the sea produce fish, animal food for man? Is it not that in the beds of high seas are manufactured pearls and the other valuable and useful corals for the use…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِنْهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ wasakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan min'hu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna And He has disposed for you[r benefit] whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth; all is from Him. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِنْهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ wasakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan min'hu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought. See 45:12

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِنْهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ wasakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan min'hu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna And made subservient unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, all, on His behalf: Verily in this are signs for people who reflect.
