(Who ponder intelligently.) As regards the things in heaven and the earth being made subservient to man, no detailed note is necessary specially for the educated ones among the people. What is it then, that man needs for his life and happiness, which is not provided either from above, i.e., the skies or from within the earth. The air without which life can never exist on earth, the water with which the dead earth is repeatedly quickened, the change…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَغْفِرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ qul lilladhīna āmanū yaghfirū lilladhīna lā yarjūna ayyāma l-lahi liyajziya qawman bimā kānū yaksibūna Say to the faithful to forgive those who do not expect Allah's days, that He may [Himself] requite a people for what they used to earn.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَغْفِرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ qul lilladhīna āmanū yaghfirū lilladhīna lā yarjūna ayyāma l-lahi liyajziya qawman bimā kānū yaksibūna Say, (O Muḥammad), to those who have believed that they (should) forgive those who expect not the days of Allah (i.e., of His retribution) so that He may recompense a people1 for what they used to earn. See 45:12

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَغْفِرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ qul lilladhīna āmanū yaghfirū lilladhīna lā yarjūna ayyāma l-lahi liyajziya qawman bimā kānū yaksibūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto those (that) they may forgive those who hope not the days (The days of requital - here in this life or in the hereafter.) of God, that He may recompense the people for what they earn The believers are commanded to be patient against the disbelievers who do not remember the days of their predecessors or their contemporaries suffering the chastisement from God, and do not fear a similar requital taking place against them also. God commands the Muslims to leave them to God to be taken to task by Himself.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own soul, and whoever does evil, it is to its own detriment, then you will be brought back to your Lord.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it (i.e., the self or soul). Then to your Lord you will be returned. See 45:12

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna Whoever doeth good, it is for his own self, and whoever doeth evil, it is against his own self; then unto your Lord ye shall be returned. See 45:14

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ walaqad ātaynā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna Certainly We gave the Children of Israel the Book, judgement and prophethood and We provided them with all the good things, and We gave them an advantage over all the nations,

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ walaqad ātaynā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement1 and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds. And indeed We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, and the understanding of the Scripture and its laws, and the prophethood; and provided them with good things, and preferred them above the nations (45:16). And gave them clear proofs in matters. And they differed not until after the knowledge came to them, through envy among themselves. Verily, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection about that wherein they used to differ (45:17). Then We have put you on a (legal) way…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ walaqad ātaynā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna And indeed, gave We the children of Israel, the Book, and Wisdom and the Prophethood, and provided them with sustenance from the goodly things, and We favoured (Refer to verse 44:32.) them above all peoples. The Holy Qur'an is only an argument or proof for ordinary men - but it is a guidance and a mercy from the Lord for those who are of assured conviction in the faith - which means it is not the same for one and all - The same fact is borne by verse 2:2. It is a guidance only for the pious and as to who those pious ones are, it is given in 2:3 - 2:4. Again…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ بَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ waātaynāhum bayyinātin mina l-amri famā ikh'talafū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna and We gave them manifest precepts. But they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves. Indeed your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ بَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ waātaynāhum bayyinātin mina l-amri famā ikh'talafū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna And We gave them clear proofs of the matter (of religion). And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ. See 45:16

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ بَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ waātaynāhum bayyinātin mina l-amri famā ikh'talafū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna And We gave them clear arguments (Hence the argument that their differing was after the knowledge, due to their rebellious tendency & not due to ignorance. (A.P.).) of the affair but they differed not until knowledge hath come unto them, through rivalry among themselves; Verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Reckoning, about that wherein they differ. See 45:16

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَى شَرِيعَةٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ thumma jaʿalnāka ʿalā sharīʿatin mina l-amri fa-ittabiʿ'hā walā tattabiʿ ahwāa alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Then We set you upon a clear course of the Law; so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَى شَرِيعَةٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ thumma jaʿalnāka ʿalā sharīʿatin mina l-amri fa-ittabiʿ'hā walā tattabiʿ ahwāa alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Then We put you, (O Muḥammad), on an ordained way concerning the matter (of religion); so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know. See 45:16

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَى شَرِيعَةٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ thumma jaʿalnāka ʿalā sharīʿatin mina l-amri fa-ittabiʿ'hā walā tattabiʿ ahwāa alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Then have We set thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) on a (definite) course of Law, so follow it, and follow not the vain desires of those who know not. (the Prophet addressed for the people.) See 45:16

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُغْنُوْۤا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ innahum lan yugh'nū ʿanka mina l-lahi shayan wa-inna l-ẓālimīna baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wal-lahu waliyyu l-mutaqīna Indeed they will not avail you in any way against Allah. Indeed the wrongdoers are allies of one another, but Allah is the guardian1 of the Godwary.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُغْنُوْۤا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ innahum lan yugh'nū ʿanka mina l-lahi shayan wa-inna l-ẓālimīna baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wal-lahu waliyyu l-mutaqīna Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous. See 45:16

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُغْنُوْۤا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ innahum lan yugh'nū ʿanka mina l-lahi shayan wa-inna l-ẓālimīna baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wal-lahu waliyyu l-mutaqīna Verily, they shall avail not thee (The Prophet addressed for the people.) aught against God; And verily, the unjust are the friends of one another; and God is the guardian of the pious ones. (Those who guard themselves against evil.) See 45:16

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا بَصَائِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ hādhā baṣāiru lilnnāsi wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yūqinūna These are eye-openers for mankind, and guidance and mercy for a people who have certainty.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا بَصَائِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ hādhā baṣāiru lilnnāsi wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yūqinūna This (Qur’ān) is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain (in faith). See 45:16

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا بَصَائِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ hādhā baṣāiru lilnnāsi wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yūqinūna These are proofs for the people and a guidance and a mercy unto a people who are sure in faith. There is another similar saying "The likeness of my Ahl Al-Bayt is that of the Ark of Noah, he who got into it, was saved and he who turned away from it, was drowned and lost."

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ نَجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ am ḥasiba alladhīna ij'taraḥū l-sayiāti an najʿalahum ka-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sawāan maḥyāhum wamamātuhum sāa mā yaḥkumūna Do those who have perpetrated misdeeds suppose that We shall treat them as those who have faith and do righteous deeds, their life and death being equal? Evil is the judgement that they make!

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ نَجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ am ḥasiba alladhīna ij'taraḥū l-sayiāti an najʿalahum ka-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sawāan maḥyāhum wamamātuhum sāa mā yaḥkumūna Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - (make them) equal in their life and their death?1 Evil is that which they judge (i.e., assume). Or do those who earn evil deeds think that We shall hold them equal with those who believe and do righteous good deeds, in their present life and after their death? Worst is the judgement that they make (45:21). And Allah has created the heavens and the earth with truth, in order that each person may be recompensed what he has earned, and they will not be wronged…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ نَجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ am ḥasiba alladhīna ij'taraḥū l-sayiāti an najʿalahum ka-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sawāan maḥyāhum wamamātuhum sāa mā yaḥkumūna What! deem those who have wrought evils that We will make them like unto those who believe and do good, that equal shall be their life and their death? (Nay!) ill it is what they judge. The evil ones shall not receive the same treatment which the righteous ones will have. The wicked shall not have the same enjoyable life, they had in this life; it would be a life of torment and punishment whereas the righteous ones would naturally be blessed with a blissful life. When the wicked die, the angels of awe terrorise them with the news of torment and suffering that awaits them…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wakhalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi walituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna Allah created the heavens and the earth with reason, so that every soul may be requited for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wakhalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi walituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged. See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wakhalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi walituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And created (With purpose.) God, the heavens and the earth with the truth, and that be recompensed every soul for what it hath earned, and they shall not be done (the least) injustice. See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَى سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَى بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً فَمَنْ يَهْدِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ اللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu wa-aḍallahu l-lahu ʿalā ʿil'min wakhatama ʿalā samʿihi waqalbihi wajaʿala ʿalā baṣarihi ghishāwatan faman yahdīhi min baʿdi l-lahi afalā tadhakkarūna Have you seen him who has taken his desire to be his god and whom Allah has led astray knowingly, and set a seal upon his hearing and his heart, and put a blindfold on his sight? So who will guide him after Allah? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَى سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَى بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً فَمَنْ يَهْدِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ اللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu wa-aḍallahu l-lahu ʿalā ʿil'min wakhatama ʿalā samʿihi waqalbihi wajaʿala ʿalā baṣarihi ghishāwatan faman yahdīhi min baʿdi l-lahi afalā tadhakkarūna Have you seen he who has taken as his god his (own) desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge1 and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded? See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَى سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَى بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً فَمَنْ يَهْدِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ اللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu wa-aḍallahu l-lahu ʿalā ʿil'min wakhatama ʿalā samʿihi waqalbihi wajaʿala ʿalā baṣarihi ghishāwatan faman yahdīhi min baʿdi l-lahi afalā tadhakkarūna Hast thou then seen him who taketh as his god his vain desires, and God hath allowed him to be astray (Refer to verses 7:75, 7:76, 91:7 - 91:10.) (with his), knowing (it), and set a seal upon his ear and his heart and caused upon his eyes a veil; who can guide him after (his being allowed to stray by) God? What! Will ye not then reflect? See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ وَمَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ waqālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā yuh'likunā illā l-dahru wamā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yaẓunnūna They say, 'There is nothing but the life of this world: we live and we die, and nothing but time destroys us.' But they do not have any knowledge of that, and they only make conjectures.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ وَمَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ waqālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā yuh'likunā illā l-dahru wamā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yaẓunnūna And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live,1 and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming. And they say: There is nothing but our life of this world, we die and we live and nothing destroys us except Ad-Dahr (time). And they have no knowledge of it, they only presume (45:24). And when Our Clear Ayat are recited to them, their argument is no other than that they say: "Bring back our (dead) fathers, if you are truthful! (45:25). Say (to them): "Allah…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ وَمَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ waqālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā yuh'likunā illā l-dahru wamā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yaẓunnūna And say they: "Naught it is save our life in this world; we die and live and destroyeth us not but time." For them there is no knowledge of that; they do but (merely) guess. See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ مَا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا ائْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālū i'tū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna And when Our manifest signs are recited to them, their only argument is to say, 'Bring our fathers back [to life], should you be truthful.'

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ مَا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا ائْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālū i'tū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring (back) our forefathers, if you should be truthful." See 45:24

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ مَا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا ائْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālū i'tū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna And when are recited unto them Our clear signs, nothing is their argument but they only say: "Bring ye our fathers (back) if ye be truthful." See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ quli l-lahu yuḥ'yīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajmaʿukum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna Say, 'It is Allah who gives you life, then He makes you die. Then He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.'

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ quli l-lahu yuḥ'yīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajmaʿukum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know." See 45:24

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ quli l-lahu yuḥ'yīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajmaʿukum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "God giveth you life then he causeth you to die, then will He gather you unto the Day of Reckoning, about which there is no doubt, but most people know not." See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yawma-idhin yakhsaru l-mub'ṭilūna To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and when the Hour sets in, the falsifiers will be losers on that day.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yawma-idhin yakhsaru l-mub'ṭilūna And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose. And to Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And on the Day that the Hour will be established – on that Day the followers of falsehood shall lose (45:27). And you will see each nation humbled to their knees (Jathiyah), each nation will be called to its Record (of deeds). This Day you shall be recompensed for what you used to do (45:28). This Our Record speaks about you with truth. Verily, We were recording what you used to do (45:29). Some of the Conditions of the Day of Resurrection and…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yawma-idhin yakhsaru l-mub'ṭilūna And God's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour (of Reckoning) shall be established, on that Day shall lose the believers in the falsehood. See 45:21

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَى إِلَى كِتَابِهَا الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ watarā kulla ummatin jāthiyatan kullu ummatin tud'ʿā ilā kitābihā l-yawma tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna And you will see every nation fallen on its knees. Every nation will be summoned to its book: 'Today you will be requited for what you used to do.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَى إِلَى كِتَابِهَا الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ watarā kulla ummatin jāthiyatan kullu ummatin tud'ʿā ilā kitābihā l-yawma tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna And you will see every nation kneeling (from fear). Every nation will be called to its record (and told), "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do. See 45:27

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَى إِلَى كِتَابِهَا الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ watarā kulla ummatin jāthiyatan kullu ummatin tud'ʿā ilā kitābihā l-yawma tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna And thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) shalt see every people kneeling down; every people shall be called unto its Book; (Of deeds.) Today ye shall be recompensed for what all ye used to do. 'The Book', i.e., the record of the individual's deeds in this life. Every nation shall be humbled - they will be kneeling.1

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا كِتَابُنَا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ hādhā kitābunā yanṭiqu ʿalaykum bil-ḥaqi innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum taʿmalūna This is Our book, which speaks truly against you. Indeed We used to record what you used to do.'

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا كِتَابُنَا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ hādhā kitābunā yanṭiqu ʿalaykum bil-ḥaqi innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum taʿmalūna This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed1 whatever you used to do." See 45:27

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا كِتَابُنَا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ hādhā kitābunā yanṭiqu ʿalaykum bil-ḥaqi innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum taʿmalūna This is Our Book that speaketh against you with justice; verily, We used to record whatever ye used to do. Every deed is laid there, then and there recorded.1 Every limb and the organs of our body will bear witness to our deeds in this life.2

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayud'khiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatihi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-mubīnu As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is the manifest success!

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayud'khiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatihi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-mubīnu So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment. Then, as for those who believed and did good deeds, their Lord will admit them to His mercy. That will be the evident success (45:30). But as for those who disbelieved (it will be said to them): Were not Our Ayat recited to you? But you were proud, and you were a people who were criminals (45:31). And when it was said: "Verily, Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt about the coming of the Hour," you said: "We know not what is the Hour: we…

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayud'khiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatihi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-mubīnu And those who believed and did good deeds, so will admit them their Lord into His mercy, that is the manifest achievement. See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ wa-ammā alladhīna kafarū afalam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fa-is'takbartum wakuntum qawman muj'rimīna But as for the faithless, [they will be asked,] 'Were not My signs recited to you? But you were disdainful, and you were a guilty lot.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ wa-ammā alladhīna kafarū afalam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fa-is'takbartum wakuntum qawman muj'rimīna But as for those who disbelieved, (it will be said), "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people? See 45:30

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ wa-ammā alladhīna kafarū afalam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fa-is'takbartum wakuntum qawman muj'rimīna And those who disbelieved: (unto them will be said): "What! were not My signs recited unto you? But ye acted arrogantly and ye were a guilty people." See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُمْ مَا نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِنْ نَظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ wa-idhā qīla inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wal-sāʿatu lā rayba fīhā qul'tum mā nadrī mā l-sāʿatu in naẓunnu illā ẓannan wamā naḥnu bimus'tayqinīna And when it was said, "Allah's promise is indeed true, and there is no doubt about the Hour," you said, "We do not know what the Hour is. We know nothing beyond conjectures, and we do not possess any certainty." '

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُمْ مَا نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِنْ نَظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ wa-idhā qīla inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wal-sāʿatu lā rayba fīhā qul'tum mā nadrī mā l-sāʿatu in naẓunnu illā ẓannan wamā naḥnu bimus'tayqinīna And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour (is coming) - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'" See 45:30

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُمْ مَا نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِنْ نَظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ wa-idhā qīla inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wal-sāʿatu lā rayba fīhā qul'tum mā nadrī mā l-sāʿatu in naẓunnu illā ẓannan wamā naḥnu bimus'tayqinīna And it was said (unto them): "Verily, the promise of God is true and the Hour (of Reckoning), no doubt is there about it, ye said 'We know not what the Hour is,' we deem it naught but a mere guess, and we are not sure." See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna The evils of what they had done will appear to them, and they will be besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule. See 45:30

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And shall manifest unto them the evils of what they wrought, and shall surround them that which they used to mock at. See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ waqīla l-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna And it will be said, 'Today We will forget you, just as you forgot the encounter of this day of yours. The Fire will be your abode, and you will not have any helpers.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ waqīla l-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers. See 45:30

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ waqīla l-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna And it shall be said (unto them): "Today We neglect you even as ye neglected the meeting of this day of yours and your abode shall be the fire, and for you shall not be any of the helpers" See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ dhālikum bi-annakumu ittakhadhtum āyāti l-lahi huzuwan wagharratkumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma lā yukh'rajūna min'hā walā hum yus'taʿtabūna That is because you took the signs of Allah in derision, and the life of the world had deceived you.' So today they will not be brought out of it, nor will they be asked to propitiate [Allah].

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ dhālikum bi-annakumu ittakhadhtum āyāti l-lahi huzuwan wagharratkumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma lā yukh'rajūna min'hā walā hum yus'taʿtabūna That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease (Allah). See 45:30

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ dhālikum bi-annakumu ittakhadhtum āyāti l-lahi huzuwan wagharratkumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma lā yukh'rajūna min'hā walā hum yus'taʿtabūna That is for ye took the signs of God for a jest and deceived you, the life of this world "so on that day they shall not be taken out thence, nor shall they be granted any grace." See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ falillahi l-ḥamdu rabbi l-samāwāti warabbi l-arḍi rabbi l-ʿālamīna So all praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ falillahi l-ḥamdu rabbi l-samāwāti warabbi l-arḍi rabbi l-ʿālamīna Then, to Allah belongs (all) praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds. See 45:30

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ falillahi l-ḥamdu rabbi l-samāwāti warabbi l-arḍi rabbi l-ʿālamīna Therefore, God's (alone) is the praise, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, the Lord of the worlds. See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ walahu l-kib'riyāu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ walahu l-kib'riyāu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu And to Him belongs (all) grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 45:30

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ walahu l-kib'riyāu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu And His (only) is greatness in the heavens and the earth; and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. See 45:29

item.title: Al-Jinn:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarun mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajaban Say, 'It has been revealed to me that a team of the jinn listened [to the Qur'ān].' and they said, "Indeed we heard a wounderful qur'ān,1

item.title: Al-Jinn:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarun mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajaban Say, (O Muḥammad), "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān (i.e., recitation). وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا And they thought as you thought, that Allah will not send any Messenger. Meaning: Allah would never send a Messenger after this long period of time. This was said by Al-Kalbi and Ibn Jarir.

item.title: Al-Jinn:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarun mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajaban Say "It hast been revealed unto me that a party of the jinn hath heard (the Qur'an) and said: "Verily, we have heard a Recital (Qur'an) (which is) Wonderful (Refer to Verse 46:29.)" 'Jinn', i.e., the ethereal beings quite different from the angels. Angels are pure energies created for fixed duties allotted by God and 'Jinns' are similar beings created of the element of fire1 generally functioning as the agencies of evil while the angels are the actors of good. But the jinns are capable of getting their evil corrected and amending their activities for good. Though jinns are generally wicked or evil beings but there are good and the righteous ones also among…

item.title: Al-Jinn:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا yahdī ilā l-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan nush'rika birabbinā aḥadan which guides to rectitude. Hence we have believed in it and we will never ascribe any partner to our Lord.

item.title: Al-Jinn:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا yahdī ilā l-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan nush'rika birabbinā aḥadan It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. See 72:1

item.title: Al-Jinn:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا yahdī ilā l-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan nush'rika birabbinā aḥadan Guideth it unto the Right (Way), wherefore believe we in it; and never will we associate anyone with our Lord! The jinn compares the Islamic Unity preached by the Holy Qur'an which he heard for the first time in his life, to the polytheistic faith in the Trinity of the church started in the name of Jesus and the Jews associating Moses with God1.

item.title: Al-Jinn:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibatan walā waladan Exalted be the majesty of our Lord, He has taken neither any spouse nor son.

item.title: Al-Jinn:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibatan walā waladan And (it teaches) that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son. See 72:1

item.title: Al-Jinn:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibatan walā waladan And that He, exalted is the Majesty of our Lord! hath taken not a wife nor a son (Refer to Verse 6:101.) Here the jinn glorifies the Unity of God against the belief in, God having a wife and a son for Him for the Christian belief in a begotten son of God, necessitates also the partnership of a wife for the issue to be born of her1.

item.title: Al-Jinn:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭan Indeed the foolish ones among us used to utter atrocious lies concerning Allah.

item.title: Al-Jinn:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭan And that our foolish one (i.e., Iblees)1 has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression. See 72:1

item.title: Al-Jinn:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭan And that want to speak the foolish ones amongst us, against God, atrocious (False belief etc.) things See 72:3

item.title: Al-Jinn:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ تَقُولَ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا wa-annā ẓanannā an lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban Indeed we thought that humans and jinn would never utter any falsehood concerning Allah.

item.title: Al-Jinn:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ تَقُولَ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا wa-annā ẓanannā an lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie. See 72:1

item.title: Al-Jinn:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ تَقُولَ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا wa-annā ẓanannā an lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban And that thought we that never utter the humans and jinn any falsehood against God See 72:3

item.title: Al-Jinn:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا wa-annahu kāna rijālun mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālin mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqan Indeed some persons from the humans would seek the protection of some persons from the jinn, thus only adding to their rebellion.

item.title: Al-Jinn:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا wa-annahu kāna rijālun mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālin mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqan And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they (only) increased them in burden (i.e., sin). See 72:1

item.title: Al-Jinn:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا wa-annahu kāna rijālun mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālin mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqan And that individuals from among the humans used to seek protection of the individuals from among the jinn so they increased them (only) in rebellion (against God) People believed in the protection of the Jinn and used to seek it. Whenever they happened to be in the wilderness or in any dreadful forest, they used to invoke the protection of their own imaginary jinn as the chief of the jinns of the place saying: "O' Chief of this wilderness, I seek refuge in thee, against the mischief of any of thy wicked subjects" By saying so the people thought that they were safe. Such false praises had infatuated the jinns and made them proud to foolishly think that…

item.title: Al-Jinn:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْۤا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum an lan yabʿatha l-lahu aḥadan They1 thought, just as you think, that Allah will not raise anyone from the dead.

item.title: Al-Jinn:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْۤا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum an lan yabʿatha l-lahu aḥadan And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone (as a messenger). See 72:1

item.title: Al-Jinn:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْۤا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum an lan yabʿatha l-lahu aḥadan And that they (too) thought, as ye think, never would God raise (from the dead) any one! People did not expect anyone from among their own brethren being raised as an apostle of God, to admonish them against their false belief and wicked life. A sect among the Jews did not believe in the Resurrection.

item.title: Al-Jinn:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا wa-annā lamasnā l-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdan washuhuban Indeed We made for the heaven and found it full of mighty sentries and flames.1

item.title: Al-Jinn:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا wa-annā lamasnā l-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdan washuhuban And we have sought (to reach) the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames. 'And we have sought to reach the heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires (72:8). 'And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush (72:9). 'And we know not whether evil is intended for those on the earth, or whether their Lord intends for them guidance (72:10). The Jinns Stealing Information from the Sky before the Messenger SAW was Sent and Striking Them with Flaming Fire after His Coming Allah informs about the Jinns when He sent His Messenger Muhammad SAW and revealed…

item.title: Al-Jinn:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا wa-annā lamasnā l-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdan washuhuban And that we (The jinn.) sought the heavens, but we found it filled with strong guards and flaming darts (Meteors - Piercing rays. Refer to Verse 67:5, 37:7, 15:7.) How the unauthorised approach to the heavens, by the evil spirits, is repulsed by the shafts of the Meteoric lights from the skies1.

item.title: Al-Jinn:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَنْ يَسْتَمِعِ الْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَصَدًا wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi faman yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihāban raṣadan We used to sit in its positions to eavesdrop, but anyone listening now finds a flame waiting for him.

item.title: Al-Jinn:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَنْ يَسْتَمِعِ الْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَصَدًا wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi faman yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihāban raṣadan And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing,1 but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him. See 72:8

item.title: Al-Jinn:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَنْ يَسْتَمِعِ الْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَصَدًا wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi faman yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihāban raṣadan And that sat we (The Jinn.) on some of the seats (there) to (steal) a hearing; but any who would (try now to) listen, findeth a flaming dart in wait for him (Refer to Verses 15:17; 15:18; 37:7; 67:5.) See 72:8

item.title: Al-Jinn:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadan We do not know whether ill is intended for those who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intends good for them.

item.title: Al-Jinn:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadan And we do not know (therefore) whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course. See 72:8

item.title: Al-Jinn:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadan And that we understand not (by this) whether evil be meant for them that are on the earth, or whether willeth their Lord to guide them aright See 72:8

item.title: Al-Jinn:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا wa-annā minnā l-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidadan Among us some are righteous and some of us are otherwise: we are multifarious sects.

item.title: Al-Jinn:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا wa-annā minnā l-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidadan And among us are the righteous, and among us are (others) not so; we were (of) divided ways.1 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways (72:11). 'And we think that we cannot escape Allah in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight (72:12). 'And indeed when we heard the Guidance, we believed therein, and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins (72:13). 'And of us some are Muslims, and of us some are Al-Qasitun. And whosoever has embraced Islam, then such have sought the right path.' (72:14).…

item.title: Al-Jinn:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا wa-annā minnā l-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidadan And that some amongst us are good ones (Among the jinns there good and also bad ones - the troublesome.) , and the others of us are other than that; we are sects following different ways See 72:8

item.title: Al-Jinn:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ نُعجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا wa-annā ẓanannā an lan nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan nuʿ'jizahu haraban We know that we cannot thwart Allah on the earth, nor can we thwart Him by fleeing.

item.title: Al-Jinn:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ نُعجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا wa-annā ẓanannā an lan nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan nuʿ'jizahu haraban And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight. See 72:11

item.title: Al-Jinn:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ نُعجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا wa-annā ẓanannā an lan nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan nuʿ'jizahu haraban And that knew we that never can we defeat (Frustrate His plan.) (the will of) God in the earth, and never can we defeat Him (in His will) by flight See 72:8

item.title: Al-Jinn:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَى اٰمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi faman yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsan walā rahaqan When we heard the [message of] guidance, we believed in it. Whoever that has faith in his Lord shall neither fear any detraction nor oppression.

item.title: Al-Jinn:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَى اٰمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi faman yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsan walā rahaqan And when we heard the guidance (i.e., the Qur’ān), we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.1 See 72:11

item.title: Al-Jinn:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَى اٰمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi faman yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsan walā rahaqan And that, when heard we the guidance, believed we in it; and whosoever believeth in his Lord, he thereafter feareth neither loss nor oppression, Everyone shall have the recompense in full. It is this conviction that a true believer suffers the worst of miseries and tortures and even drinks the cup of death cheerfully in the way of the Lord for he is sure and certain that in the ultimate, the return for all his suffering, will be in full measure and none can ever deny or deprive him of anything which he has earned.

item.title: Al-Jinn:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashadan Among us some are muslims and some of us are perverse.1 Yet those who submit [to Allah] —it is they who pursue rectitude.

item.title: Al-Jinn:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashadan And among us are Muslims (in submission to Allah), and among us are the unjust.1 And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course. See 72:11

item.title: Al-Jinn:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashadan And that, of us some are Muslims (Those who submit themselves to God's will. Among the jinns there are Muslims and also kafirs – disbelievers.) and of us are the others who are the deviators (from the right path), and whoever submit these pursue the right guidance See 72:13

item.title: Al-Jinn:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوْۤا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭaban As for the perverse, they will be firewood for hell." '

item.title: Al-Jinn:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوْۤا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭaban But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.' See 72:11

item.title: Al-Jinn:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوْۤا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭaban And as for the deviators, they shall be for the hell, a fuel See 72:13

item.title: Al-Jinn:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُمْ مَاءً غَدَقًا wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā l-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqan If they are steadfast on the path [of Allah], We shall provide them with abundant water,

item.title: Al-Jinn:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُمْ مَاءً غَدَقًا wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā l-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqan And (Allah revealed) that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain (i.e., provision). See 72:11

item.title: Al-Jinn:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُمْ مَاءً غَدَقًا wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā l-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqan And that if they be steadfast on the right way, We would certainly give them water (Knowledge of the truth.) (A sustenance) in abundance (Refer to Verse 7:96; 5:69; 3:84; 2:62.) According to the commentary of the Ahl Al-Bayt, Abu Basir says: "I asked the Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn Ali Al-Baqir about the application of the Verses 41:30, he said that is the path on which thou art and quoted this Verse. And according to the Sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq, the water here means, abundance of pure knowledge of the truth which those who adhere to the Imams would receive. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Jinn:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ وَمَنْ يُعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا linaftinahum fīhi waman yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadan so that We may test them therein, and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will let him into an escalating punishment.

item.title: Al-Jinn:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ وَمَنْ يُعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا linaftinahum fīhi waman yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadan So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord1 He will put into arduous punishment. See 72:11

item.title: Al-Jinn:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ وَمَنْ يُعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا linaftinahum fīhi waman yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadan That we may prove them thereby, but whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord, him will He make undergo a severe chastisement See 72:16

item.title: Al-Jinn:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥadan The places of worship belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone along with Allah.

item.title: Al-Jinn:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥadan And (He revealed) that the masjids1 are for Allah, so do not invoke2 with Allah anyone. And the Masjids are for Allah, so invoke not anyone along with Allah (72:18). And when the servant of Allah stood up invoking Him in prayer they just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other (72:19). Say: "I invoke only my Lord, and I associate none as partners along with Him (72:20). Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the right path (72:21). Say: "None can protect me from Allah's punishment, nor can I find refuge except in Him (72:22). "(Mine is) but conveyance from Allah and His Messages, and whosoever disobeys Allah…

item.title: Al-Jinn:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥadan And that, the places for Sajdah (prostration) are for (the remembrance only of) God, so call ye not (therein) any one with God! 'Masajid' is the plural of 'Masjid', i.e., a place of 'Sijdak' or prostration, figuratively used for the places of worship, i.e., Mosque but here according to the interpretation of the Ahl Al-Bayt 'Masajid' includes even the parts of human body which ought to be used in the performance of 'Sajdah' - i.e., both two palms, two knees, two feet, and forehead (seven in all). There is a well-known anecdote - During the reign of Abbaside Khalif a dispute arose about the portion to be cut off of the hands of a thief. The Khalif asked the Ninth Imam about it. He…

item.title: Al-Jinn:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوْۤا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadan When the servant of Allah1 rose to pray to Him, they almost crowded around him.

item.title: Al-Jinn:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوْۤا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadan And that when the Servant (i.e., Prophet) of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."1 See 72:18

item.title: Al-Jinn:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوْۤا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadan And that, when the servant of God (Muhammad) standeth praying unto Him, they surrounded around him, almost stifling 'Abdullah', (i.e., the Servant of God) is the title with which the ''Holy Prophet was addressed - When God referred to him with this title it pleased the Holy Prophet the most for it was the acknowledgement and the acceptance of the services rendered by him. (MS.) The crowding around the Holy Prophet could be a reference to the Holy Prophet's being mobbed at Taif.

item.title: Al-Jinn:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥadan Say, 'I pray only to my Lord, and I do not ascribe any partner to Him.'

item.title: Al-Jinn:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥadan Say, (O Muḥammad), "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone." See 72:18

item.title: Al-Jinn:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥadan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "I only pray unto my Lord, and I associate not with Him, anyone" Reference to the Meccan period when the Holy Prophet was undergoing all sorts of torturous persecution. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Jinn:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarran walā rashadan Say, 'I have no power to bring you any harm or good [of my own accord].'

item.title: Al-Jinn:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarran walā rashadan Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you (the power of) harm or right direction." See 72:18

item.title: Al-Jinn:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarran walā rashadan Say thou "I own not for you any evil or good" The Holy Prophet was sent into this world to convey to mankind the Final Word of God for all times until the day of the final requital and not to change the individual nature of each one of the people or harm or profit any one, if the individual has not earned the gain or the loss by his own endeavour.

item.title: Al-Jinn:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَنْ يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا qul innī lan yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥadun walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥadan Say, 'Neither can anyone shelter me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge besides Him.

item.title: Al-Jinn:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَنْ يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا qul innī lan yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥadun walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥadan Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone (if I should disobey), nor will I find in other than Him a refuge. See 72:18

item.title: Al-Jinn:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَنْ يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا qul innī lan yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥadun walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥadan Say: "Never can protect me against God any one, and never find I besides Him, any place of refuge" See 72:21

item.title: Al-Jinn:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا illā balāghan mina l-lahi warisālātihi waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadan [I have no duty] except to transmit from Allah, and [to communicate] His messages; and whoever disobeys Allah and His apostle, indeed there will be for him the fire of hell, to remain in it forever.'

item.title: Al-Jinn:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا illā balāghan mina l-lahi warisālātihi waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadan But (I have for you) only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever. See 72:18

item.title: Al-Jinn:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا illā balāghan mina l-lahi warisālātihi waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadan Save a delivery (of the message) from God, and His messages; and whosoever disobeyeth God and His Apostle, verily, for him shall be the fire of hell, they shall abide in it for ever (Exception to Verse 21 the Verse 22 is parenthetic.) Exception to Verse 21, the Verses between 22 is paranthetic. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Jinn:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiran wa-aqallu ʿadadan When they see what they are promised, they will then know who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers.

item.title: Al-Jinn:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiran wa-aqallu ʿadadan (The disbelievers continue) until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number. See 72:18

item.title: Al-Jinn:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiran wa-aqallu ʿadadan Until when see they what they are promised, and then shall they know, who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number See 72:23

item.title: Al-Jinn:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا qul in adrī aqarībun mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amadan Say, 'I do not know if what you are promised is near, or if my Lord has set a term for it.'

item.title: Al-Jinn:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا qul in adrī aqarībun mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amadan Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a (long) period." Say: "I know not whether that which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term (72:25). "The All-Knower of the Unseen, and He reveals to none His Unseen (72:26). Except to a Messenger whom He has chosen, and then He makes a band of watching guards to march before him and behind him (72:27). Till he knows that they have conveyed the Messages of their Lord. And He surrounds all that which is with them, and He keeps count of all things (72:28). The Messenger of Allah…

item.title: Al-Jinn:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا qul in adrī aqarībun mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amadan Say: "I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh or if my Lord hath appointed for it a distant term" See 72:23

item.title: Al-Jinn:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَى غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا ʿālimu l-ghaybi falā yuẓ'hiru ʿalā ghaybihi aḥadan Knower of the Unseen, He does not disclose His Unseen to anyone,

item.title: Al-Jinn:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَى غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا ʿālimu l-ghaybi falā yuẓ'hiru ʿalā ghaybihi aḥadan (He is) Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His (knowledge of the) unseen to anyone. See 72:25

item.title: Al-Jinn:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَى غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا ʿālimu l-ghaybi falā yuẓ'hiru ʿalā ghaybihi aḥadan (He alone is) the "Knower of the unseen, and nor doth he reveal his secrets unto any (one else) (Refer to Verses 2:3; 13:39.)" These two Verses make it crystal clear that the knowledge of the unseen is only with God and with none else save the one of His apostles (the Holy Prophet Muhammad) whom God Himself of His own pleasure confides with it. The Eighth Holy Imam Ali Ibn Musa Ar-Ridha' says that it is the Holy Prophet whom God confides with, the secrets of the unseen and we the Imams are the rightful heir to him who receive the knowledge from him1. Refer to the note on the knowledge of the unseen (Ilm al-ghaib)2 and the note on 'Bada'3. Here it is enough…

item.title: Al-Jinn:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَى مِنْ رَسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا illā mani ir'taḍā min rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadan except to an apostle He approves of. Then He dispatches a sentinel before and behind him

item.title: Al-Jinn:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَى مِنْ رَسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا illā mani ir'taḍā min rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadan Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him (i.e., each messenger) and behind him observers.1 See 72:25

item.title: Al-Jinn:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَى مِنْ رَسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا illā mani ir'taḍā min rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadan Save unto that one of the Apostles whom He chooseth for verily He causeth a guard to march before him and after him See 72:26

item.title: Al-Jinn:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَعْلَمَ أَنْ قَدْ أَبْلَغُوْۤا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadadan so that He may ascertain that they have communicated the messages of their Lord, and He comprehends all that is with them, and He keeps count of all things.

item.title: Al-Jinn:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَعْلَمَ أَنْ قَدْ أَبْلَغُوْۤا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadadan That he (i.e., Muḥammad SAW) may know1 that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number. See 72:25

item.title: Al-Jinn:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَعْلَمَ أَنْ قَدْ أَبْلَغُوْۤا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadadan That He may know (Make known – declare.) that indeed they have delivered the messages of their Lord, and He encompasseth (by His knowledge) all that is with them, and taketh account of everything Note the independence of the Absolute Authority of the Universal Will which demands itself at any cost to be fulfilled - It was the message to be delivered, that is all and as regards the accounting, it is left to the Lord - with Him is the accounts of the number of the drops of the rain from heaven, of the leaves of the trees, even of the blades of the grass on the earth.

item.title: Al-Jumu'a:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ yusabbiḥu lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi l-maliki l-qudūsi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and whatever there is in the earth, the Sovereign, the All-holy, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Al-Jumu'a:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ yusabbiḥu lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi l-maliki l-qudūsi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah,1 the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.2 ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ That is the grace of Allah, which He bestows on whom He wills. And Allah is the Owner of mighty grace. refers to the great prophethood that He granted Muhammad SAW and the qualities that He favored his Ummah with, by sending Muhammad SAW to them.

item.title: Al-Jumu'a:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ yusabbiḥu lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi l-maliki l-qudūsi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi Halloweth the Glory of God whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, The King, the Most Holy, The Ever-Prevalent, The All Wise (Refer to Verses 17:44; 61:1; 64:1) . Refer to Verses17:44, 61:1.

item.title: Al-Jumu'a:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ huwa alladhī baʿatha fī l-umiyīna rasūlan min'hum yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wa-in kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālin mubīnin It is He who sent to the unlettered [people] an apostle from among themselves, to recite to them His signs, to purify them, and to teach them the Book and wisdom, and earlier they had indeed been in manifest error.

item.title: Al-Jumu'a:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ huwa alladhī baʿatha fī l-umiyīna rasūlan min'hum yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wa-in kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālin mubīnin It is He who has sent among the unlettered (Arabs) a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) and wisdom (i.e., the sunnah) - although they were before in clear error. See 62:1

item.title: Al-Jumu'a:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
