Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place. And say: "The truth is from your Lord." Then whosoever wills, let him believe; and whosoever wills, let him…

item.title: Al-Kahf:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلِ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيُؤْمِنْ وَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا وَإِنْ يَسْتَغِيثُوا يُغَاثُوْۤا بِمَاءٍ كَالْمُهْلِ يَشْوِي الْوُجُوهَ بِئْسَ الشَّرَابُ وَسَاءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا waquli l-ḥaqu min rabbikum faman shāa falyu'min waman shāa falyakfur innā aʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna nāran aḥāṭa bihim surādiquhā wa-in yastaghīthū yughāthū bimāin kal-muh'li yashwī l-wujūha bi'sa l-sharābu wasāat mur'tafaqan And say thou: "The truth is from your Lord; so let him who pleaseth believe; and let him who pleaseth disbelieve, verily We have prepared for the unjust (the Hell) fire, (Smoke and flames.) encompass (Entrap.) them its enclosures; and if cry they for water, they shall be given water like the molten brass which will scald their faces; (how) wretched will be the drink; and (how) ill will be the resting place." See 18:28

item.title: Al-Kahf:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra man aḥsana ʿamalan As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds —indeed We do not waste the reward of those who are good in deeds.

item.title: Al-Kahf:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra man aḥsana ʿamalan Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds. Verily, as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, certainly We shall not make the reward of anyone to be lost who does his (righteous) deeds in the most perfect manner (18:30). These! For them will be Jannatu 'Adn; wherein rivers flow beneath them; therein they will be adorned with bracelets of gold, and they will wear green garments of Sundus and Istabraq. They will be Muttaki'in therein on Ara'ik. How good is the reward, and what an excellent Murtafaq (18:31). The Reward of those Who Believe and…

item.title: Al-Kahf:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra man aḥsana ʿamalan Verily those who believe and do good deeds, verily We waste not the recompense of him who doth good deeds. See 18:28

item.title: Al-Kahf:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا ulāika lahum jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin wayalbasūna thiyāban khuḍ'ran min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki niʿ'ma l-thawābu waḥasunat mur'tafaqan For such there will be the Gardens of Eden with streams running in them. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and wear green garments of silk and brocade, reclining therein on couches. How excellent a reward, and how good a resting place!

item.title: Al-Kahf:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا ulāika lahum jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin wayalbasūna thiyāban khuḍ'ran min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki niʿ'ma l-thawābu waḥasunat mur'tafaqan Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place. See 18:30

item.title: Al-Kahf:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا ulāika lahum jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin wayalbasūna thiyāban khuḍ'ran min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki niʿ'ma l-thawābu waḥasunat mur'tafaqan These, for them are the gardens of eternity beneath which flow rivers, they shall be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and they shall wear green robes of fine silk, and thick brocade woven with gold, reclining therein on raised couches; (What a) Blissful recompense (will it be); and (how) goodly (will be) the resting place. See 18:28

item.title: Al-Kahf:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا رَجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَحَفَفْنَاهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathalan rajulayni jaʿalnā li-aḥadihimā jannatayni min aʿnābin waḥafafnāhumā binakhlin wajaʿalnā baynahumā zarʿan Draw for them the parable of two men for each of whom We had made two gardens of vines, and We had surrounded them with date palms, and placed crops between them.

item.title: Al-Kahf:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا رَجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَحَفَفْنَاهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathalan rajulayni jaʿalnā li-aḥadihimā jannatayni min aʿnābin waḥafafnāhumā binakhlin wajaʿalnā baynahumā zarʿan And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them (fields of) crops. And put forward to them the example of two men: unto one of them We had given two gardens of grapes, and We had surrounded both with date palms; and had put between them green crops (cultivated fields) (18:32). Each of those two gardens brought forth its produce, and failed not in the least therein, and We caused a river to gush forth in the midst of both (18:33). And he had Thamar, and he said to his companion…

item.title: Al-Kahf:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا رَجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَحَفَفْنَاهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathalan rajulayni jaʿalnā li-aḥadihimā jannatayni min aʿnābin waḥafafnāhumā binakhlin wajaʿalnā baynahumā zarʿan And set forth unto them (Those enjoying the worldly pomp & show. Refer to verse 18:28.) a parable: Two men We made for one of them two gardens of grape-vines, and We surrounded the two (gardens) with date palms, and made We corn fields in the midst of the two (gardens) This verse and the following six verses comprise the parable of the one puffed up with his possessions, his sources of wealth, large family and his public status and position, while the other humble and modest one who is mindful of the ultimate end of man, and all authority, glory and praise being exclusively of God.

item.title: Al-Kahf:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِمْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَالَهُمَا نَهَرًا kil'tā l-janatayni ātat ukulahā walam taẓlim min'hu shayan wafajjarnā khilālahumā naharan Both gardens yielded their produce without stinting anything of it. And We had set a stream gushing through them.

item.title: Al-Kahf:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِمْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَالَهُمَا نَهَرًا kil'tā l-janatayni ātat ukulahā walam taẓlim min'hu shayan wafajjarnā khilālahumā naharan Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river. See 18:32

item.title: Al-Kahf:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِمْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَالَهُمَا نَهَرًا kil'tā l-janatayni ātat ukulahā walam taẓlim min'hu shayan wafajjarnā khilālahumā naharan Both the gardens brought forth its fruits and failed not aught in it, and We caused a river to gush forth in their midst, See 18:32

item.title: Al-Kahf:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَنَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا wakāna lahu thamarun faqāla liṣāḥibihi wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu anā aktharu minka mālan wa-aʿazzu nafaran He had abundant fruits, so he said to his companion, as he conversed with him: 'I have more wealth than you, and am stronger with respect to numbers.'1

item.title: Al-Kahf:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَنَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا wakāna lahu thamarun faqāla liṣāḥibihi wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu anā aktharu minka mālan wa-aʿazzu nafaran And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in (numbers of) men." See 18:32

item.title: Al-Kahf:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَنَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا wakāna lahu thamarun faqāla liṣāḥibihi wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu anā aktharu minka mālan wa-aʿazzu nafaran And he had fruits (in abundance), and said he unto his companion while talking to him: "I am greater than thee in wealth and am mightier in my clan." See 18:32

item.title: Al-Kahf:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ قَالَ مَا أَظُنُّ أَنْ تَبِيدَ هَذِهِ أَبَدًا wadakhala jannatahu wahuwa ẓālimun linafsihi qāla mā aẓunnu an tabīda hādhihi abadan He entered his garden while he wronged himself. He said, 'I do not think that this will ever perish,

item.title: Al-Kahf:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ قَالَ مَا أَظُنُّ أَنْ تَبِيدَ هَذِهِ أَبَدًا wadakhala jannatahu wahuwa ẓālimun linafsihi qāla mā aẓunnu an tabīda hādhihi abadan And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself.1 He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever. See 18:32

item.title: Al-Kahf:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ قَالَ مَا أَظُنُّ أَنْ تَبِيدَ هَذِهِ أَبَدًا wadakhala jannatahu wahuwa ẓālimun linafsihi qāla mā aẓunnu an tabīda hādhihi abadan And entered his garden he who was unjust to himself. Said he: "I think not that this will ever perish," The man of wealth and power who is puffed up of it, thinks in vain that what he owns shall last for ever, and there is no day of reckoning or requital to come and thinks the possessions and the pleasures of this world to be everlasting.

item.title: Al-Kahf:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِنْ رُدِدْتُ إِلَى رَبِّي لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِنْهَا مُنْقَلَبًا wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rudidttu ilā rabbī la-ajidanna khayran min'hā munqalaban and I do not think that the Hour will ever set in. And even if I am returned to my Lord I will surely find a resort better than this.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِنْ رُدِدْتُ إِلَى رَبِّي لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِنْهَا مُنْقَلَبًا wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rudidttu ilā rabbī la-ajidanna khayran min'hā munqalaban And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return." See 18:32

item.title: Al-Kahf:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِنْ رُدِدْتُ إِلَى رَبِّي لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِنْهَا مُنْقَلَبًا wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rudidttu ilā rabbī la-ajidanna khayran min'hā munqalaban And I think not that the Hour (of Resurrection and Judgment) will ever come, and even if I am returned unto my Lord, I will (ever) of a certainty find better than this a (Returning place.) resort. See 18:35

item.title: Al-Kahf:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّاكَ رَجُلًا qāla lahu ṣāḥibuhu wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu akafarta bi-alladhī khalaqaka min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma sawwāka rajulan His companion said to him, as he conversed with him: 'Do you disbelieve in Him who created you from dust, then from a drop of [seminal] fluid, then fashioned you as a man?

item.title: Al-Kahf:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّاكَ رَجُلًا qāla lahu ṣāḥibuhu wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu akafarta bi-alladhī khalaqaka min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma sawwāka rajulan His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you (as) a man? His companion said to him during his discussion: Do you disbelieve in Him Who created you out of dust, then out of Nutfah, then fashioned you into a man? (18:37). "But as for my part, (I believe) that He is Allah, my Lord, and none shall I associate as partner with my Lord (18:38). "It was better for you to say, when you entered your garden: 'That which Allah wills! There is no power but…

item.title: Al-Kahf:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّاكَ رَجُلًا qāla lahu ṣāḥibuhu wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu akafarta bi-alladhī khalaqaka min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma sawwāka rajulan Said unto him his companion while talking to him: "What! disbelievest thou in Him Who created thee from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then He fashioned thee (into) a complete man?" This is what the poor believer replies to the disbeliever puffed up with wealth and power. He reminds him of the origin of man.1

item.title: Al-Kahf:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكِنَّا هُوَ اللَّهُ رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا lākinnā huwa l-lahu rabbī walā ush'riku birabbī aḥadan But I [say], "He is Allah, my Lord," and I do not ascribe any partner to my Lord.

item.title: Al-Kahf:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكِنَّا هُوَ اللَّهُ رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا lākinnā huwa l-lahu rabbī walā ush'riku birabbī aḥadan But as for me, He is Allah, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone. See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكِنَّا هُوَ اللَّهُ رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا lākinnā huwa l-lahu rabbī walā ush'riku birabbī aḥadan But as for me He, God is my Lord, and I associate not with my Lord any one. See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ إِنْ تَرَنِ أَنَا أَقَلَّ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا walawlā idh dakhalta jannataka qul'ta mā shāa l-lahu lā quwwata illā bil-lahi in tarani anā aqalla minka mālan wawaladan Why did you not say, when you entered your garden, "[This is] as Allah has wished! There is no power except by Allah!" If you see that I have lesser wealth than you and children,

item.title: Al-Kahf:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ إِنْ تَرَنِ أَنَا أَقَلَّ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا walawlā idh dakhalta jannataka qul'ta mā shāa l-lahu lā quwwata illā bil-lahi in tarani anā aqalla minka mālan wawaladan And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed (has occurred); there is no power except in Allah'? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children. See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ إِنْ تَرَنِ أَنَا أَقَلَّ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا walawlā idh dakhalta jannataka qul'ta mā shāa l-lahu lā quwwata illā bil-lahi in tarani anā aqalla minka mālan wawaladan And why didst thou not say when thou didst enter thy garden: "(It is) as God willeth! there is no power but with God, if thou dost see me less than thee in wealth and children." See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَسٰی رَبِّي أَنْ يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِنْ جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا faʿasā rabbī an yu'tiyani khayran min jannatika wayur'sila ʿalayhā ḥus'bānan mina l-samāi fatuṣ'biḥa ṣaʿīdan zalaqan maybe my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden, and He will unleash upon it bolts from the sky, so that it becomes a bare plain.

item.title: Al-Kahf:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَسٰی رَبِّي أَنْ يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِنْ جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا faʿasā rabbī an yu'tiyani khayran min jannatika wayur'sila ʿalayhā ḥus'bānan mina l-samāi fatuṣ'biḥa ṣaʿīdan zalaqan It may be that my Lord will give me (something) better than your garden and will send upon it a (disastrous) penalty from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground. See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَسٰی رَبِّي أَنْ يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِنْ جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا faʿasā rabbī an yu'tiyani khayran min jannatika wayur'sila ʿalayhā ḥus'bānan mina l-samāi fatuṣ'biḥa ṣaʿīdan zalaqan Yet maybe my Lord may give me better than thy garden, and send on it (on thy garden) thunderbolts (as a reckoning) from heaven, that it becometh barren slippery dust, See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَاؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًا aw yuṣ'biḥa māuhā ghawran falan tastaṭīʿa lahu ṭalaban Or its water will sink down, so that you cannot obtain it.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَاؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًا aw yuṣ'biḥa māuhā ghawran falan tastaṭīʿa lahu ṭalaban Or its water will become sunken (into the earth), so you would never be able to seek it." See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَاؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًا aw yuṣ'biḥa māuhā ghawran falan tastaṭīʿa lahu ṭalaban Or get sunk underground its waters and thereafter never thou art able to search for it. See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى مَا أَنْفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَى عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا wa-uḥīṭa bithamarihi fa-aṣbaḥa yuqallibu kaffayhi ʿalā mā anfaqa fīhā wahiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ush'rik birabbī aḥadan And ruin closed in on his produce, and he began to wring his hands for what he had spent on it, as it lay fallen on its trellises. He was saying, 'I wish I had not ascribed any partner to my Lord.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى مَا أَنْفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَى عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا wa-uḥīṭa bithamarihi fa-aṣbaḥa yuqallibu kaffayhi ʿalā mā anfaqa fīhā wahiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ush'rik birabbī aḥadan And his fruits were encompassed (by ruin), so he began to turn his hands about (in dismay) over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."1 So his fruits were encircled (with ruin). And began Yuqallibu his hands over what he had spent upon it, while it was all destroyed on its trellises, and he could only say: Would that I had ascribed no partners to my Lord! (18:42). And he had no group of men to help him against Allah, nor could he…

item.title: Al-Kahf:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى مَا أَنْفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَى عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا wa-uḥīṭa bithamarihi fa-aṣbaḥa yuqallibu kaffayhi ʿalā mā anfaqa fīhā wahiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ush'rik birabbī aḥadan And his fruits were enwrapped into destruction, so he began wringing his hands for what he had spent in it, and it (his garden) lay fallen on its roofs, and said he: "Alas me! Would that I had not associated with my Lord any one!" See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ فِئَةٌ يَنْصُرُونَهُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنْتَصِرًا walam takun lahu fi-atun yanṣurūnahu min dūni l-lahi wamā kāna muntaṣiran He had no party to help him, besides Allah, nor could he help himself.

item.title: Al-Kahf:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ فِئَةٌ يَنْصُرُونَهُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنْتَصِرًا walam takun lahu fi-atun yanṣurūnahu min dūni l-lahi wamā kāna muntaṣiran And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor could he defend himself. See 18:42

item.title: Al-Kahf:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ فِئَةٌ يَنْصُرُونَهُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنْتَصِرًا walam takun lahu fi-atun yanṣurūnahu min dūni l-lahi wamā kāna muntaṣiran He had no force (Host.) to help him other than God, nor could he himself help. See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا hunālika l-walāyatu lillahi l-ḥaqi huwa khayrun thawāban wakhayrun ʿuq'ban There, all authority belongs to Allah, the Real. He is best in rewarding, and best in requiting.

item.title: Al-Kahf:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا hunālika l-walāyatu lillahi l-ḥaqi huwa khayrun thawāban wakhayrun ʿuq'ban There1 the authority is (completely) for Allah, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome. See 18:42

item.title: Al-Kahf:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا hunālika l-walāyatu lillahi l-ḥaqi huwa khayrun thawāban wakhayrun ʿuq'ban Here (in the event of such a helplessness) protection (Hold – Authority – Mastery.) is only God's the Truth; He is the Best to reward and the Best to requite. See 18:37

item.title: Al-Kahf:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقْتَدِرًا wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathala l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamāin anzalnāhu mina l-samāi fa-ikh'talaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi fa-aṣbaḥa hashīman tadhrūhu l-riyāḥu wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin muq'tadiran Draw for them the parable of the life of this world: [It is] like the water We send down from the sky. Then the earth's vegetation mingles with it. Then it becomes chaff, scattered by the wind. And Allah is omnipotent over all things.

item.title: Al-Kahf:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقْتَدِرًا wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathala l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamāin anzalnāhu mina l-samāi fa-ikh'talaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi fa-aṣbaḥa hashīman tadhrūhu l-riyāḥu wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin muq'tadiran And present to them the example of the life of this world, (its being) like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it1 and (then) it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability. And mention the parable of the worldly life: it is like the water which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it, and becomes fresh and green. But (later) it becomes dry and broken pieces,…

item.title: Al-Kahf:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقْتَدِرًا wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathala l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamāin anzalnāhu mina l-samāi fa-ikh'talaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi fa-aṣbaḥa hashīman tadhrūhu l-riyāḥu wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin muq'tadiran And set thou unto them the similitude of the life of this world, like the water which send We down from heaven, and the herbage of the earth mingleth with it, then it becometh dry stubble which the winds scatter; for God over all things hath power. Here is another parable to show how illusory are the luxuries and the enjoyments of this world. The rain water which comes from the heavens is no doubt a life-giving element but none can be proud and puffed up of merely having it, for it never tarries…

item.title: Al-Kahf:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا al-mālu wal-banūna zīnatu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun amalan Wealth and children are an adornment of the life of the world, but lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward and better in hope.

item.title: Al-Kahf:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا al-mālu wal-banūna zīnatu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun amalan Wealth and children are (but) adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord1 for reward and better for (one's) hope. See 18:45

item.title: Al-Kahf:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا al-mālu wal-banūna zīnatu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun amalan Wealth and children are the adornment of the life of this world; and the everlasting good works are best in view of thy Lord in (earning the) reward, and best as hopes (of His mercy). This verse makes obvious the view-point of life in Islam. Good deeds and deeds of continued charity like schools, hospitals, wells, bridges, orphanages, widow-homes and the other similar charitable services are commended and encouraged with the promise of a better and a lasting and an ever-increasing return, both in this life and also in the Hereafter. The Holy Prophet said, "There will be three kinds of people among my followers, i.e., the Muslims: Those who do not at all…

item.title: Al-Kahf:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ الْجِبَالَ وَتَرٰی الْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةً وَحَشَرْنَاهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا wayawma nusayyiru l-jibāla watarā l-arḍa bārizatan waḥasharnāhum falam nughādir min'hum aḥadan The day We shall set the mountains moving and you will see the earth in full view, We shall muster them, and We will not leave out anyone of them.

item.title: Al-Kahf:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ الْجِبَالَ وَتَرٰی الْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةً وَحَشَرْنَاهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا wayawma nusayyiru l-jibāla watarā l-arḍa bārizatan waḥasharnāhum falam nughādir min'hum aḥadan And (warn of) the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth exposed,1 and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone. And (remember) the Day We shall cause the mountains to pass away, and you will see the earth as a levelled plain, and We shall gather them so that We will leave not one of them behind (18:47). And they will be set before your Lord, aligned. (He will say:) Now indeed, you have come to Us as We created you the first time. Nay, but you thought that We had appointed no meeting for you (with Us) (18:48). And the Book will be produced, and you will…

item.title: Al-Kahf:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ الْجِبَالَ وَتَرٰی الْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةً وَحَشَرْنَاهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا wayawma nusayyiru l-jibāla watarā l-arḍa bārizatan waḥasharnāhum falam nughādir min'hum aḥadan And the day when We will cause the mountains to pass away, and thou seest the earth a levelled plain and We will gather them (and) then leave not behind, of them any one. See 18:46

item.title: Al-Kahf:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعُرِضُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّنْ نَجْعَلَ لَكُمْ مَوْعِدًا waʿuriḍū ʿalā rabbika ṣaffan laqad ji'tumūnā kamā khalaqnākum awwala marratin bal zaʿamtum allan najʿala lakum mawʿidan They will be presented before your Lord in ranks: 'Certainly you have come to Us just as We created you the first time. Rather you maintained that We shall not appoint a tryst for you.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعُرِضُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّنْ نَجْعَلَ لَكُمْ مَوْعِدًا waʿuriḍū ʿalā rabbika ṣaffan laqad ji'tumūnā kamā khalaqnākum awwala marratin bal zaʿamtum allan najʿala lakum mawʿidan And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, (and He will say), "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment." See 18:47

item.title: Al-Kahf:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعُرِضُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّنْ نَجْعَلَ لَكُمْ مَوْعِدًا waʿuriḍū ʿalā rabbika ṣaffan laqad ji'tumūnā kamā khalaqnākum awwala marratin bal zaʿamtum allan najʿala lakum mawʿidan And they shall set before thy Lord in ranks; (and it will be said unto them): "Now are ye come unto Us as We created you at first: and yet ye thought never We had made unto you a tryst." See 18:46

item.title: Al-Kahf:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ فَتَرٰی الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِیْهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَاوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصَاهَا وَوَجَدُوْۤا مَا عَمِلُوْۤا حَاضِرًا وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu fatarā l-muj'rimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā fīhi wayaqūlūna yāwaylatanā māli hādhā l-kitābi lā yughādiru ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan illā aḥṣāhā wawajadū mā ʿamilū ḥāḍiran walā yaẓlimu rabbuka aḥadan The Book will be set up. Then you will see the guilty apprehensive of what is in it. They will say, 'Woe to us! What a book is this! It omits nothing, big or small, without enumerating it.' They will find present whatever they had done, and your Lord does not wrong anyone.

item.title: Al-Kahf:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ فَتَرٰی الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِیْهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَاوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصَاهَا وَوَجَدُوْۤا مَا عَمِلُوْۤا حَاضِرًا وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu fatarā l-muj'rimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā fīhi wayaqūlūna yāwaylatanā māli hādhā l-kitābi lā yughādiru ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan illā aḥṣāhā wawajadū mā ʿamilū ḥāḍiran walā yaẓlimu rabbuka aḥadan And the record (of deeds) will be placed (open), and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present (before them). And your Lord does injustice to no one. See 18:47

item.title: Al-Kahf:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ فَتَرٰی الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِیْهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَاوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصَاهَا وَوَجَدُوْۤا مَا عَمِلُوْۤا حَاضِرًا وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu fatarā l-muj'rimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā fīhi wayaqūlūna yāwaylatanā māli hādhā l-kitābi lā yughādiru ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan illā aḥṣāhā wawajadū mā ʿamilū ḥāḍiran walā yaẓlimu rabbuka aḥadan And (when) the Book of (deeds) is placed then wilt thou see the guilty, dreadful (In fearful apprehension.) of what is (recorded) in it: and they will say: "Ah woe unto us! What a book is this! it leaveth not aught (of our sins) small or great but enumereth (each one of) them!" And will find they what ever they did, present (in it): and dealeth not thy Lord unjustly with any one. The record of the deeds is so complete as the same is referred…

item.title: Al-Kahf:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِي وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ بِئْسَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ بَدَلًا wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa kāna mina l-jini fafasaqa ʿan amri rabbihi afatattakhidhūnahu wadhurriyyatahu awliyāa min dūnī wahum lakum ʿaduwwun bi'sa lilẓẓālimīna badalan When We said to the angels, 'Prostrate before Adam,' they prostrated, but not Iblis. He was one of the jinn, so he transgressed against his Lord's command. Will you then take him and his offspring for guardians in My stead, though they are your enemies? How evil a substitute for the wrongdoers!

item.title: Al-Kahf:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِي وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ بِئْسَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ بَدَلًا wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa kāna mina l-jini fafasaqa ʿan amri rabbihi afatattakhidhūnahu wadhurriyyatahu awliyāa min dūnī wahum lakum ʿaduwwun bi'sa lilẓẓālimīna badalan And (mention) when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from (i.e., disobeyed) the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange. And (remember) when We said to the angels: "Prostrate yourselves unto Adam." So they prostrated themselves, except Iblis. He was one of the Jinn; he disobeyed the command…

item.title: Al-Kahf:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِي وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ بِئْسَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ بَدَلًا wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa kāna mina l-jini fafasaqa ʿan amri rabbihi afatattakhidhūnahu wadhurriyyatahu awliyāa min dūnī wahum lakum ʿaduwwun bi'sa lilẓẓālimīna badalan And when said We unto the angels: "Prostrate ye unto Adam!" then they (all) prostrated but 'Iblis'; he was of the jinn, and he transgressed the behest of his Lord; What! would ye then take him (Iblis i.e. Satan.) and his progeny as friends rather than Me, and they are enemies unto you! Evil for the unjust would be the (This.) exchange. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا mā ashhadttuhum khalqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walā khalqa anfusihim wamā kuntu muttakhidha l-muḍilīna ʿaḍudan I did not make them a witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor to their own creation, nor do I take those who mislead as assistants.

item.title: Al-Kahf:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا mā ashhadttuhum khalqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walā khalqa anfusihim wamā kuntu muttakhidha l-muḍilīna ʿaḍudan I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants. They did not witness the creation of the heavens and the earth nor their own creation, nor did I take those who mislead as 'Adudan (18:51). The Gods of the Idolators did Not Witness the Creation of Anything, Not Even Themselves Allah says: 'These whom you take as helpers instead of Me are creatures just like you. They do not possess anything and did not witness the creation of heaven and earth, because they did not exist at that time.' Allah says, 'I…

item.title: Al-Kahf:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا mā ashhadttuhum khalqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walā khalqa anfusihim wamā kuntu muttakhidha l-muḍilīna ʿaḍudan I called them (These taken as friends and guardians besides God.) not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor of the creation of their selves; nor am I he who taketh those who lead (people) astray, as helpers. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوْۤا شُرَكَاءِيَ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَوْبِقًا wayawma yaqūlu nādū shurakāiya alladhīna zaʿamtum fadaʿawhum falam yastajībū lahum wajaʿalnā baynahum mawbiqan The day He will say, 'Call those whom you maintained to be My partners,' they will call them, but they will not respond to them, for We shall place an abyss between them.

item.title: Al-Kahf:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوْۤا شُرَكَاءِيَ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَوْبِقًا wayawma yaqūlu nādū shurakāiya alladhīna zaʿamtum fadaʿawhum falam yastajībū lahum wajaʿalnā baynahum mawbiqan And (warn of) the Day when He will say, "Call My 'partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them (a valley of) destruction. And (remember) the Day He will say: "Call those (so-called) partners of Mine whom you claimed." Then they will cry unto them, but they will not answer them, and We shall put Mawbiq between them (18:52). And the criminals shall see the Fire and apprehend that they are to fall therein. And they will find no way of escape from it (18:53). Their Partners are Not Able to Respond and the Criminals are Brought to the Fire…

item.title: Al-Kahf:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوْۤا شُرَكَاءِيَ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَوْبِقًا wayawma yaqūlu nādū shurakāiya alladhīna zaʿamtum fadaʿawhum falam yastajībū lahum wajaʿalnā baynahum mawbiqan And the Day (of Judgment) when He will say: "Call ye on those whom ye thought to be my partners," and they will call on them, but they will not listen to them, and We will cause between them a valley of perdition. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَأَى الْمُجْرِمُونَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ مُوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوْۤا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا waraā l-muj'rimūna l-nāra faẓannū annahum muwāqiʿūhā walam yajidū ʿanhā maṣrifan The guilty will sight the Fire and know that they will fall into it, for they will find no means to circumvent it.

item.title: Al-Kahf:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَأَى الْمُجْرِمُونَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ مُوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوْۤا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا waraā l-muj'rimūna l-nāra faẓannū annahum muwāqiʿūhā walam yajidū ʿanhā maṣrifan And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere. See 18:52

item.title: Al-Kahf:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَأَى الْمُجْرِمُونَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ مُوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوْۤا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا waraā l-muj'rimūna l-nāra faẓannū annahum muwāqiʿūhā walam yajidū ʿanhā maṣrifan And shall see the guilty ones the fire, and apprehend that they are falling into it, and they will find (Any place of refuge to avoid it.) not any escape thence. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَكَانَ الْإِنْسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَيْءٍ جَدَلًا walaqad ṣarrafnā fī hādhā l-qur'āni lilnnāsi min kulli mathalin wakāna l-insānu akthara shayin jadalan Certainly We have made this Qur'ān interspersed with every kind of parable for mankind. But man is the most disputatious of creatures.

item.title: Al-Kahf:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَكَانَ الْإِنْسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَيْءٍ جَدَلًا walaqad ṣarrafnā fī hādhā l-qur'āni lilnnāsi min kulli mathalin wakāna l-insānu akthara shayin jadalan And We have certainly diversified in this Qur’ān for the people from every (kind of) example; but man has ever been, most of anything, (prone to) dispute. And indeed We have given every kind of example in this Qur'an for mankind. But, man is ever more quarrelsome than anything (18:54). Examples Put forth in the Qur'an Allah says, 'In this Qur'an, We have explained to mankind and given clear details of matters so that they will not stray from the truth or be misled from the path of guidance. Despite this explanation, man is very quarrelsome and opposes truth with falsehood,' except for those whom Allah guides to the path of salvation.…

item.title: Al-Kahf:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَكَانَ الْإِنْسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَيْءٍ جَدَلًا walaqad ṣarrafnā fī hādhā l-qur'āni lilnnāsi min kulli mathalin wakāna l-insānu akthara shayin jadalan And indeed have We (fully) displayed for mankind in this Qur'an every kind of (Examples – parables.) similitude; but man, of most things, is contentious. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَى وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا wamā manaʿa l-nāsa an yu'minū idh jāahumu l-hudā wayastaghfirū rabbahum illā an tatiyahum sunnatu l-awalīna aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu qubulan People do not refuse to have faith when guidance comes to them and to plead to their Lord for forgiveness, without being overtaken by the precedent of the ancients, or confronting the punishment.1

item.title: Al-Kahf:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَى وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا wamā manaʿa l-nāsa an yu'minū idh jāahumu l-hudā wayastaghfirū rabbahum illā an tatiyahum sunnatu l-awalīna aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu qubulan And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there (must) befall them the (accustomed) precedent of the former peoples1 or that the punishment should come (directly) before them. And nothing prevents men from believing, while the guidance has come to them, and from asking forgiveness of their Lord, except that the ways of the ancients be repeated with them, or the torment be brought to them face to face (18:55). And We send not the Messengers except as bearers of good news and warners. But those who disbelieve,…

item.title: Al-Kahf:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَى وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا wamā manaʿa l-nāsa an yu'minū idh jāahumu l-hudā wayastaghfirū rabbahum illā an tatiyahum sunnatu l-awalīna aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu qubulan And nothing preventeth the people from believing when the guidance came unto them, and from asking for the forgiveness from their Lord (Unless - i.e., they wish that.) except overtaketh them, the fate of the ancients or cometh face to face unto them the chastisement. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ وَاتَّخَذُوا ءَايَاتِي وَمَا أُنْذِرُوْۤا هُزُوًا wamā nur'silu l-mur'salīna illā mubashirīna wamundhirīna wayujādilu alladhīna kafarū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa wa-ittakhadhū āyātī wamā undhirū huzuwan We do not send the apostles except as bearers of good news and as warners, but those who are faithless dispute fallaciously to refute thereby the truth, having taken My signs and what they are warned of in derision.

item.title: Al-Kahf:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ وَاتَّخَذُوا ءَايَاتِي وَمَا أُنْذِرُوْۤا هُزُوًا wamā nur'silu l-mur'salīna illā mubashirīna wamundhirīna wayujādilu alladhīna kafarū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa wa-ittakhadhū āyātī wamā undhirū huzuwan And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by (using) falsehood to (attempt to) invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule. See 18:55

item.title: Al-Kahf:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ وَاتَّخَذُوا ءَايَاتِي وَمَا أُنْذِرُوْۤا هُزُوًا wamā nur'silu l-mur'salīna illā mubashirīna wamundhirīna wayujādilu alladhīna kafarū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa wa-ittakhadhū āyātī wamā undhirū huzuwan And We send not apostles but as bearers of glad tidings and warners; and dispute those who disbelieve with falsehood that they may refute with it the truth, and take they My signs and that they have been warned with, for a jest. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَنْ يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِنْ تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى فَلَنْ يَهْتَدُوْۤا إِذًا أَبَدًا waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biāyāti rabbihi fa-aʿraḍa ʿanhā wanasiya mā qaddamat yadāhu innā jaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan an yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqran wa-in tadʿuhum ilā l-hudā falan yahtadū idhan abadan Who is a greater wrongdoer than he who is reminded of the signs of his Lord, whereat he disregards them and forgets what his hands have sent ahead? Indeed We have cast veils on their hearts lest they should understand it, and a deafness into their ears; and if you invite them to guidance they will never [let themselves] be guided.

item.title: Al-Kahf:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَنْ يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِنْ تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى فَلَنْ يَهْتَدُوْۤا إِذًا أَبَدًا waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biāyāti rabbihi fa-aʿraḍa ʿanhā wanasiya mā qaddamat yadāhu innā jaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan an yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqran wa-in tadʿuhum ilā l-hudā falan yahtadū idhan abadan And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever. And who does more wrong than he who is reminded of the Ayat (signs) of his Lord, but…

item.title: Al-Kahf:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَنْ يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِنْ تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَى فَلَنْ يَهْتَدُوْۤا إِذًا أَبَدًا waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biāyāti rabbihi fa-aʿraḍa ʿanhā wanasiya mā qaddamat yadāhu innā jaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan an yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqran wa-in tadʿuhum ilā l-hudā falan yahtadū idhan abadan And who is more unjust than he who is reminded of the signs of his Lord, then he turneth away from them and (Heedeth not.) forgetteth what have sent forth (Sent in advance.) his two hands? Verily We have caused veils over their hearts lest they understand it and in their ears a heaviness; And if thou calleth them unto guidance, never will they in that case get guided aright at all. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُورُ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُمْ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابَ بَلْ لَهُمْ مَوْعِدٌ لَنْ يَجِدُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِهِ مَوْئِلًا warabbuka l-ghafūru dhū l-raḥmati law yuākhidhuhum bimā kasabū laʿajjala lahumu l-ʿadhāba bal lahum mawʿidun lan yajidū min dūnihi mawilan Your Lord is the All-forgiving dispenser of mercy. Were He to take them to task because of what they have committed, He would have surely hastened their punishment. But they have a tryst, [when] they will not find a refuge besides Him.1

item.title: Al-Kahf:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُورُ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُمْ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابَ بَلْ لَهُمْ مَوْعِدٌ لَنْ يَجِدُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِهِ مَوْئِلًا warabbuka l-ghafūru dhū l-raḥmati law yuākhidhuhum bimā kasabū laʿajjala lahumu l-ʿadhāba bal lahum mawʿidun lan yajidū min dūnihi mawilan And your Lord is the Forgiving, the possessor of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape. See 18:57

item.title: Al-Kahf:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُورُ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُمْ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابَ بَلْ لَهُمْ مَوْعِدٌ لَنْ يَجِدُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِهِ مَوْئِلًا warabbuka l-ghafūru dhū l-raḥmati law yuākhidhuhum bimā kasabū laʿajjala lahumu l-ʿadhāba bal lahum mawʿidun lan yajidū min dūnihi mawilan And thy Lord is Oft-Forgiving and the Lord of Mercy; were He to seize them for what they earn, surely He would have hastened for them the chastisement; but for them is a tryst never shall they find, besides it, a refuge. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْقُرٰی أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوْۤا وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِمْ مَوْعِدًا watil'ka l-qurā ahlaknāhum lammā ẓalamū wajaʿalnā limahlikihim mawʿidan Those are the towns that We destroyed when they were wrongdoers, and We appointed a tryst for their destruction.

item.title: Al-Kahf:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْقُرٰی أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوْۤا وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِمْ مَوْعِدًا watil'ka l-qurā ahlaknāhum lammā ẓalamū wajaʿalnā limahlikihim mawʿidan And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time. See 18:57

item.title: Al-Kahf:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْقُرٰی أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوْۤا وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِمْ مَوْعِدًا watil'ka l-qurā ahlaknāhum lammā ẓalamū wajaʿalnā limahlikihim mawʿidan And these towns, We did destroy them when they committed iniquities; but We had a tryst for their destruction. See 18:49

item.title: Al-Kahf:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتّٰی أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا wa-idh qāla mūsā lifatāhu lā abraḥu ḥattā ablugha majmaʿa l-baḥrayni aw amḍiya ḥuquban When Moses said to his lad, 'I will go on [journeying] until I have reached the confluence of the two seas, or have spent a long time [travelling].'

item.title: Al-Kahf:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتّٰی أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا wa-idh qāla mūsā lifatāhu lā abraḥu ḥattā ablugha majmaʿa l-baḥrayni aw amḍiya ḥuquban And (mention) when Musa said to his boy (i.e., servant), "I will not cease (traveling) until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period." And (remember) when Musa said to his boy-servant: I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two seas or a Huqub passes (18:60). But when they reached the junction of the two seas, they forgot their fish, and it took its way through the sea as in a tunnel (18:61). So when they passed further on, Musa said to his boy-servant: "Bring us our morning meal; truly, we have suffered Nasaban in this, our journey (18:62). He said: "Do you…

item.title: Al-Kahf:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتّٰی أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا wa-idh qāla mūsā lifatāhu lā abraḥu ḥattā ablugha majmaʿa l-baḥrayni aw amḍiya ḥuquban And (remember) when said Moses unto his (Disciple.) boy: "I will cease not until I reach the junction of the two rivers or I will go on (a non-stop march) for years." It is reported by (M.S.)1 that once Moses while preaching to his people thought himself to be the most learned one among the men and there being none equal to him in knowledge. God commanded Gabriel to go at once to Moses and tell him that what he imagined about himself was not a fact and there is one more learned than him living near the rock at the junction of the two rivers, and Moses should go and earn some knowledge…

item.title: Al-Kahf:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا falammā balaghā majmaʿa baynihimā nasiyā ḥūtahumā fa-ittakhadha sabīlahu fī l-baḥri saraban So when they reached the confluence between them, they forgot their fish, which found its way into the sea, sneaking away.

item.title: Al-Kahf:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا falammā balaghā majmaʿa baynihimā nasiyā ḥūtahumā fa-ittakhadha sabīlahu fī l-baḥri saraban But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away. See 18:60

item.title: Al-Kahf:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا falammā balaghā majmaʿa baynihimā nasiyā ḥūtahumā fa-ittakhadha sabīlahu fī l-baḥri saraban So when they reached the junction of the two (rivers), they forgot (Left away though the act of forgetting was of the boy but figuratively it is at tributed to both.) their fish and it took its way into the sea making a hole (in the earth). At last Moses and Joshua reached a spring. Moses sat on a rock beside the spring. It is said that Moses slept on the rock and Joshua placed the fish on a rock, when the roasted fish suddenly jumped and got into the river. The Junction of the Two Seas are interpreted as the joining of the two arms of the Red Sea viz. the Gulf of Aqaba and the Gulf…

item.title: Al-Kahf:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِنْ سَفَرِنَا هَذَا نَصَبًا falammā jāwazā qāla lifatāhu ātinā ghadāanā laqad laqīnā min safarinā hādhā naṣaban So when they had passed on, he said to his lad, 'Bring us our meal. We have certainly encountered much fatigue on this journey of ours.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِنْ سَفَرِنَا هَذَا نَصَبًا falammā jāwazā qāla lifatāhu ātinā ghadāanā laqad laqīnā min safarinā hādhā naṣaban So when they had passed beyond it, (Musa) said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, (much) fatigue." See 18:60

item.title: Al-Kahf:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِنْ سَفَرِنَا هَذَا نَصَبًا falammā jāwazā qāla lifatāhu ātinā ghadāanā laqad laqīnā min safarinā hādhā naṣaban But when they had gone (some distance) said he (Moses.) unto his boy "Bring unto us our morning meal, indeed we have met from this our journey weariness." When Moses and Joshua had passed the spring, Moses told Joshua to provide him with breakfast. When they did not find the fish along with the bread Joshua remembered the wonderful incident of the roasted fish springing into the river and passing through the water - and apologized for forgetting to report the incident to Moses for it was a satanic effect of forgetfulness that was cast on him. Moses said that was the Sign which they had to follow to reach the learned man of God. Moses…

item.title: Al-Kahf:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنْسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا qāla ara-ayta idh awaynā ilā l-ṣakhrati fa-innī nasītu l-ḥūta wamā ansānīhu illā l-shayṭānu an adhkurahu wa-ittakhadha sabīlahu fī l-baḥri ʿajaban He said, 'Did you see?! When we took shelter at the rock, indeed I forgot about the fish —and none but Satan made me forget to mention it!— and it made its way into the sea in an amazing manner!'

item.title: Al-Kahf:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنْسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا qāla ara-ayta idh awaynā ilā l-ṣakhrati fa-innī nasītu l-ḥūta wamā ansānīhu illā l-shayṭānu an adhkurahu wa-ittakhadha sabīlahu fī l-baḥri ʿajaban He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot (there) the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly." See 18:60

item.title: Al-Kahf:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنْسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا qāla ara-ayta idh awaynā ilā l-ṣakhrati fa-innī nasītu l-ḥūta wamā ansānīhu illā l-shayṭānu an adhkurahu wa-ittakhadha sabīlahu fī l-baḥri ʿajaban He said: "Didst thou see (what happened) when we took refuge on the rock, then verily I forgot ('Adhkuruhu' may refer to take back the fish in the sense that the boy tells Moses that he left the fish on the rock and forgot to take it back. (A.P.).) the fish, and nothing made me forget (Made me delayed to.) to mention of it but the devil; and it took its way into the sea, what a wonder it is!" See 18:62

item.title: Al-Kahf:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا qāla dhālika mā kunnā nabghi fa-ir'taddā ʿalā āthārihimā qaṣaṣan He said, 'That is what we were after!' So they returned, retracing their footsteps.

item.title: Al-Kahf:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا qāla dhālika mā kunnā nabghi fa-ir'taddā ʿalā āthārihimā qaṣaṣan (Musa) said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints. See 18:60

item.title: Al-Kahf:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا qāla dhālika mā kunnā nabghi fa-ir'taddā ʿalā āthārihimā qaṣaṣan He said: "That is (the place) what we were seeking for!" So they retraced their steps, See 18:62

item.title: Al-Kahf:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا اٰتَیْنٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا عِلْمًا fawajadā ʿabdan min ʿibādinā ātaynāhu raḥmatan min ʿindinā waʿallamnāhu min ladunnā ʿil'man [There] they found one of Our servants whom We had granted a mercy from Ourselves, and taught him a knowledge from Our own.

item.title: Al-Kahf:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا اٰتَیْنٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا عِلْمًا fawajadā ʿabdan min ʿibādinā ātaynāhu raḥmatan min ʿindinā waʿallamnāhu min ladunnā ʿil'man And they found a servant from among Our servants (i.e., al-Khiḍr) to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a (certain) knowledge. See 18:60

item.title: Al-Kahf:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا اٰتَیْنٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا عِلْمًا fawajadā ʿabdan min ʿibādinā ātaynāhu raḥmatan min ʿindinā waʿallamnāhu min ladunnā ʿil'man Then found they one, from among Our servants (The Holy Apostle 'Khidr'.) whom We had vouchsafed mercy (Apostle-ship & long life.) from unto Us and We had taught him knowledge (A kind of Knowledge of the unseen.) unto Ourselves. They found a man spreading his prayer mat on the water of the river and engaged in prayer. When Moses wished him, the man immediately returned the salutation saying "Peace be to thee Moses, the Apostle, and to the Children of Israel." Moses wondered at the man already knowing his and to the Children of Israel." Moses wondered at the man already knowing his name and his designation. This was Khidr who was specially blessed by God…

item.title: Al-Kahf:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُ مُوسٰی هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا qāla lahu mūsā hal attabiʿuka ʿalā an tuʿallimani mimmā ʿullim'ta rush'dan Moses said to him, 'May I follow you for the purpose that you teach me some of the probity you have been taught?'

item.title: Al-Kahf:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُ مُوسٰی هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا qāla lahu mūsā hal attabiʿuka ʿalā an tuʿallimani mimmā ʿullim'ta rush'dan Musa said to him, "May I follow you on (the condition) that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?" Musa said to him: May I follow you so that you teach me something of that knowledge which you have been taught (by Allah)? (18:66). He said: "Verily, you will not be able to have patience with me! (18:67). "And how can you have patience about a thing which you know not? (18:68). Musa said: "If Allah wills, you will find me patient, and I will not disobey you in aught (18:69). He said: "Then, if you follow me, ask me not about anything till I myself mention of it to you (18:70). Musa…

item.title: Al-Kahf:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُ مُوسٰی هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا qāla lahu mūsā hal attabiʿuka ʿalā an tuʿallimani mimmā ʿullim'ta rush'dan Said unto him Moses: "Shall I follow thee on condition that thou shouldst teach me aright of what thou hast been taught." See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran He said, 'Indeed you cannot have patience with me!

item.title: Al-Kahf:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience. See 18:66

item.title: Al-Kahf:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran Said he: (Khidr.) "Verily, thou canst not have patience with me." See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا wakayfa taṣbiru ʿalā mā lam tuḥiṭ bihi khub'ran And how can you have patience about something you are not in the know of?'

item.title: Al-Kahf:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا wakayfa taṣbiru ʿalā mā lam tuḥiṭ bihi khub'ran And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?" See 18:66

item.title: Al-Kahf:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا wakayfa taṣbiru ʿalā mā lam tuḥiṭ bihi khub'ran How canst thou be patient about what thou comprehendest not its knowledge. See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَا أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا qāla satajidunī in shāa l-lahu ṣābiran walā aʿṣī laka amran He said, 'You will find me, God willing, to be patient, and I will not disobey you in any matter.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَا أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا qāla satajidunī in shāa l-lahu ṣābiran walā aʿṣī laka amran (Musa) said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in (any) order." See 18:66

item.title: Al-Kahf:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَا أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا qāla satajidunī in shāa l-lahu ṣābiran walā aʿṣī laka amran He said: "Thou wilt find me patient if God willeth, and I shall not disobey thee in any matter." See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْءَلْنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا qāla fa-ini ittabaʿtanī falā tasalnī ʿan shayin ḥattā uḥ'ditha laka min'hu dhik'ran He said, 'If you follow me, do not question me concerning anything until I [myself] make a mention of it to you.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْءَلْنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا qāla fa-ini ittabaʿtanī falā tasalnī ʿan shayin ḥattā uḥ'ditha laka min'hu dhik'ran He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention (i.e., explanation)." See 18:66

item.title: Al-Kahf:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْءَلْنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتّٰی أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا qāla fa-ini ittabaʿtanī falā tasalnī ʿan shayin ḥattā uḥ'ditha laka min'hu dhik'ran Said he: (Khidr.) "If thou followest me, ask me not of aught until I myself unto thee make mention of it." See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا إِمْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā rakibā fī l-safīnati kharaqahā qāla akharaqtahā litugh'riqa ahlahā laqad ji'ta shayan im'ran So they went on. When they boarded the boat, he made a hole in it. He said, 'Did you make a hole in it to drown its people? You have certainly done a monstrous thing!'

item.title: Al-Kahf:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا إِمْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā rakibā fī l-safīnati kharaqahā qāla akharaqtahā litugh'riqa ahlahā laqad ji'ta shayan im'ran So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, he (i.e., al-Khiḍr) tore it open. (Musa) said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing." So they both proceeded, till, when they boarded the boat, he (Khidr) damaged it. Musa said: Have you damaged it wherein its people will drown? Verily, you have committed a thing Imr (18:71). He said: "Did I not tell you, that you would not be able to have patience with me? (18:72). He said: "Call me not to account for what I forgot, and be not hard upon me for my affair (with you)…

item.title: Al-Kahf:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا إِمْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā rakibā fī l-safīnati kharaqahā qāla akharaqtahā litugh'riqa ahlahā laqad ji'ta shayan im'ran Then they went (their way) until they embarked in the boat, he made a hole in it. (Moses) said: "Made thee a hole in it to drown its inmates? Indeed thou hast done a strange thing?" See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla alam aqul innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran He said, 'Did I not say, indeed you cannot have patience with me?'

item.title: Al-Kahf:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla alam aqul innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran (Al-Khiḍr) said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?" See 18:71

item.title: Al-Kahf:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla alam aqul innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran He said: "Said I not unto thee that thou canst not be with me in patience?" See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِي مِنْ أَمْرِي عُسْرًا qāla lā tuākhidh'nī bimā nasītu walā tur'hiq'nī min amrī ʿus'ran He said, 'Do not take me to task for my forgetting, and do not be hard upon me.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِي مِنْ أَمْرِي عُسْرًا qāla lā tuākhidh'nī bimā nasītu walā tur'hiq'nī min amrī ʿus'ran (Musa) said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not overwhelm me in my matter with difficulty." See 18:71

item.title: Al-Kahf:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِي مِنْ أَمْرِي عُسْرًا qāla lā tuākhidh'nī bimā nasītu walā tur'hiq'nī min amrī ʿus'ran Said he (Moses): "Chide (Blame for not observing the conditional promise.) me not that I forgot, and constrain me not to a difficulty in my affair." See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَامًا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُكْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā laqiyā ghulāman faqatalahu qāla aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad ji'ta shayan nuk'ran So they went on. When they encountered a boy, he slew him. He said, 'Did you slay an innocent soul, without [his having slain] anyone? You have certainly done a dire thing!'

item.title: Al-Kahf:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَامًا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُكْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā laqiyā ghulāman faqatalahu qāla aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad ji'ta shayan nuk'ran So they set out, until when they met a boy, he (i.e., al-Khiḍr) killed him. (Musa) said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than (having killed) a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing." Then they both proceeded till they met a boy, and he (Khidr) killed him. Musa said: Have you killed an innocent person without Nafs? Verily, you have committed a thing Nukr! (18:74). He said: "Did I not tell you that you can have no patience with me? (18:75). He said: "If I ask you anything after this, keep me not in your company, you have received an excuse from me (18:76).…

item.title: Al-Kahf:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَامًا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُكْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā laqiyā ghulāman faqatalahu qāla aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad ji'ta shayan nuk'ran Then they went on until they met a boy, he slew him. Said (Moses): "Slew thou an innocent person, who had slain none? Indeed thou hast done a horrible thing!" See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla alam aqul laka innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran He said, 'Did I not tell you, indeed you cannot have patience with me?'

item.title: Al-Kahf:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla alam aqul laka innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran (Al-Khiḍr) said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?" See 18:74

item.title: Al-Kahf:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا qāla alam aqul laka innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran He said: "Said I not unto thee that thou couldst not be with me in patience?" See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَاحِبْنِي قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِنْ لَدُنِّي عُذْرًا qāla in sa-altuka ʿan shayin baʿdahā falā tuṣāḥib'nī qad balaghta min ladunnī ʿudh'ran He said, 'If I question you about anything after this, do not keep me in your company. You have already got sufficient excuse on my part.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَاحِبْنِي قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِنْ لَدُنِّي عُذْرًا qāla in sa-altuka ʿan shayin baʿdahā falā tuṣāḥib'nī qad balaghta min ladunnī ʿudh'ran (Musa) said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse." See 18:74

item.title: Al-Kahf:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَاحِبْنِي قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِنْ لَدُنِّي عُذْرًا qāla in sa-altuka ʿan shayin baʿdahā falā tuṣāḥib'nī qad balaghta min ladunnī ʿudh'ran Said he (Moses.) : "If ever I ask thee about anything after this, then suffer me not to be in thy company; then indeed thou hast had an excuse (to do so) unto me (To send me out of your company.) ." See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَاتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā atayā ahla qaryatin is'taṭʿamā ahlahā fa-abaw an yuḍayyifūhumā fawajadā fīhā jidāran yurīdu an yanqaḍḍa fa-aqāmahu qāla law shi'ta lattakhadhta ʿalayhi ajran So they went on. When they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to extend them any hospitality. There they found a wall which was about to collapse, so he erected it. He said, 'Had you wished, you could have taken a wage for it.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَاتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā atayā ahla qaryatin is'taṭʿamā ahlahā fa-abaw an yuḍayyifūhumā fawajadā fīhā jidāran yurīdu an yanqaḍḍa fa-aqāmahu qāla law shi'ta lattakhadhta ʿalayhi ajran So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so he (i.e., al-Khiḍr) restored it. (Musa) said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment." Then they both proceeded till when they came to the people of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused to entertain them. Then they found therein a wall about to collapse and he set…

item.title: Al-Kahf:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰی إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَاتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا fa-inṭalaqā ḥattā idhā atayā ahla qaryatin is'taṭʿamā ahlahā fa-abaw an yuḍayyifūhumā fawajadā fīhā jidāran yurīdu an yanqaḍḍa fa-aqāmahu qāla law shi'ta lattakhadhta ʿalayhi ajran Then went they on until they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they declined to receive them as (their) guests, then they (Khizr & Moses.) found in it (the town) a wall about to fall, and he (Khizr) set it upright. Said he (Moses) : "If thou hadst wished, thou mightest surely have taken a return (payment) for it (Thy labour.) ". See 18:65

item.title: Al-Kahf:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنِكَ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْرًا qāla hādhā firāqu baynī wabaynika sa-unabbi-uka bitawīli mā lam tastaṭiʿ ʿalayhi ṣabran He said, 'This is where you and I shall part. I will inform you about the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience.

item.title: Al-Kahf:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
