item.description: قَالَ هَذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنِكَ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْرًا qāla hādhā firāqu baynī wabaynika sa-unabbi-uka bitawīli mā lam tastaṭiʿ ʿalayhi ṣabran (Al-Khiḍr) said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience. See 18:77

item.title: Al-Kahf:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنِكَ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْرًا qāla hādhā firāqu baynī wabaynika sa-unabbi-uka bitawīli mā lam tastaṭiʿ ʿalayhi ṣabran He said: "This shall be the parting point between me and thee, now I will acquaint thee of the interpretation of what thou couldst not bear with patience." The owners of the boat, though reduced to a miserable poverty, did not resort to any disrespectful means of earning their sustenance. They used to earn their livelihood by plying their boats but the cruel King wanted to commandeer the boats of his subjects. If these self-respecting poor souls lost the boat, which was the only means of their subsistence, they would have been reduced to beggary. Khizr simply made it useless for the time being and saved it from being snatched away from them. The damage done…

item.title: Al-Kahf:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُمْ مَلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا ammā l-safīnatu fakānat limasākīna yaʿmalūna fī l-baḥri fa-aradttu an aʿībahā wakāna warāahum malikun yakhudhu kulla safīnatin ghaṣban As for the boat, it belonged to some poor people who work on the sea. I wanted to make it defective, for behind them was a king seizing every ship usurpingly.

item.title: Al-Kahf:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُمْ مَلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا ammā l-safīnatu fakānat limasākīna yaʿmalūna fī l-baḥri fa-aradttu an aʿībahā wakāna warāahum malikun yakhudhu kulla safīnatin ghaṣban As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every (good) ship by force. As for the boat, it belonged to poor people working in the sea. So I wished to make a defective damage in it, as there was a king behind them who seized every boat by force (18:79). Interpretations of Why the Ship was Damaged This is an explanation of what Musa found so hard to understand, and the appearence of which he condemed. Allah showed Al-Khidr the hidden reasons, so he said,…

item.title: Al-Kahf:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُمْ مَلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا ammā l-safīnatu fakānat limasākīna yaʿmalūna fī l-baḥri fa-aradttu an aʿībahā wakāna warāahum malikun yakhudhu kulla safīnatin ghaṣban As for the boat, it was of (some) poor men they plied in the sea and I intended that I should damage it, for there was after them a king who seized every boat by force See 18:78

item.title: Al-Kahf:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَا أَنْ يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا wa-ammā l-ghulāmu fakāna abawāhu mu'minayni fakhashīnā an yur'hiqahumā ṭugh'yānan wakuf'ran As for the boy, his parents were faithful [persons], and We feared he would overwhelm them with rebellion and unfaith.

item.title: Al-Kahf:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَا أَنْ يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا wa-ammā l-ghulāmu fakāna abawāhu mu'minayni fakhashīnā an yur'hiqahumā ṭugh'yānan wakuf'ran And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief. "And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared he would oppress them by rebellion and disbelief (18:80). "So we intended that their Lord should exchange him for them for one better in righteousness and nearer to mercy (18:81). Interpretation of Why the Boy was Killed Ibn 'Abbas narrated from Ubayy bin Ka'b that the Prophet SAW said: الْغُلَامُ الَّذِي قَتَلَهُ الْخَضِرُ طُبِعَ يَوْمَ طُبِعَ كَافِرًا The boy Al-Khidr killed was destined to be a disbeliever from the day he was created. It was recorded by Ibn Jarir from Ibn 'Abbas. He said: فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ…

item.title: Al-Kahf:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَا أَنْ يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا wa-ammā l-ghulāmu fakāna abawāhu mu'minayni fakhashīnā an yur'hiqahumā ṭugh'yānan wakuf'ran And as for the boy, because his parents are believers and feared we that he should grieve them by rebellion (against them) and disbelieve (in God). The act of killing the youth seemed to be a definite cruelty. But it was not a secret for Khizr that the boy was practically lost to his parents as an outlaw, as such, was an encumbrance to the society, a danger to the life of the public and thus a source of a torturous grief to his gentle and righteous parents. The statement being in first person plural, indicates that Khizr did not act on his own but was guided by the Divine inspiration.

item.title: Al-Kahf:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَدْنَا أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ زَكَوةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا fa-aradnā an yub'dilahumā rabbuhumā khayran min'hu zakatan wa-aqraba ruḥ'man So We desired that their Lord should give them in exchange one better than him in respect of purity and closer in mercy.

item.title: Al-Kahf:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَدْنَا أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ زَكَوةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا fa-aradnā an yub'dilahumā rabbuhumā khayran min'hu zakatan wa-aqraba ruḥ'man So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy. See 18:80

item.title: Al-Kahf:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَدْنَا أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ زَكَوةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا fa-aradnā an yub'dilahumā rabbuhumā khayran min'hu zakatan wa-aqraba ruḥ'man So we did intend that their Lord giveth them instead one better than him in purity (of conduct) and closer in affection. The parents were promised in return, a better recompense through the gift of a better-behaved son who would be a source of pride and an asset to them. This incident like the first one indicates that the value of integrity and excellence in human character and conduct is greater than the value of a life of one or a few, and when the larger interest of the peace and security of the public at large needs it, the loss of the fewer in number is no loss.

item.title: Al-Kahf:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنْزٌ لَهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَنْ يَبْلُغَا أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنْزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي ذٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْرًا wa-ammā l-jidāru fakāna lighulāmayni yatīmayni fī l-madīnati wakāna taḥtahu kanzun lahumā wakāna abūhumā ṣāliḥan fa-arāda rabbuka an yablughā ashuddahumā wayastakhrijā kanzahumā raḥmatan min rabbika wamā faʿaltuhu ʿan amrī dhālika tawīlu mā lam tasṭiʿ ʿalayhi ṣabran As for the wall, it belonged to two boy orphans in the city. Under it there was a treasure belonging to them. Their father had been a righteous man. So your Lord desired that they should come of age and take out their treasure —as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do that out of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that over which you could…

item.title: Al-Kahf:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنْزٌ لَهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَنْ يَبْلُغَا أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنْزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي ذٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْرًا wa-ammā l-jidāru fakāna lighulāmayni yatīmayni fī l-madīnati wakāna taḥtahu kanzun lahumā wakāna abūhumā ṣāliḥan fa-arāda rabbuka an yablughā ashuddahumā wayastakhrijā kanzahumā raḥmatan min rabbika wamā faʿaltuhu ʿan amrī dhālika tawīlu mā lam tasṭiʿ ʿalayhi ṣabran And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience." And…

item.title: Al-Kahf:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنْزٌ لَهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَنْ يَبْلُغَا أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنْزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي ذٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْرًا wa-ammā l-jidāru fakāna lighulāmayni yatīmayni fī l-madīnati wakāna taḥtahu kanzun lahumā wakāna abūhumā ṣāliḥan fa-arāda rabbuka an yablughā ashuddahumā wayastakhrijā kanzahumā raḥmatan min rabbika wamā faʿaltuhu ʿan amrī dhālika tawīlu mā lam tasṭiʿ ʿalayhi ṣabran And as for the wall, it was of two orphan boys in the city, and was underneath it (depo-sited) a treasure (intended) for them two and their father was a righteous man; so willed thy Lord that they should attain their maturity and take out their treasure (which is) a mercy from thy Lord; and I did it not of my own will. This is the interpretation of what thou…

item.title: Al-Kahf:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنْ ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا wayasalūnaka ʿan dhī l-qarnayni qul sa-atlū ʿalaykum min'hu dhik'ran They question you concerning Dhul Qarnayn. Say, 'I will relate to you an account of him.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنْ ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا wayasalūnaka ʿan dhī l-qarnayni qul sa-atlū ʿalaykum min'hu dhik'ran And they ask you, (O Muḥammad), about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report." And they ask you about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say: I shall recite to you something of his story (18:83). Verily, We established him in the earth, and We gave him the means of everything (18:84). The Story of Dhul-Qarnayn Allah says to His Prophet SAW: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ And they ask you O Muhammad SAW: عَن ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ about Dhul-Qarnayn. i.e., about his story. We have already mentioned how the disbelievers of Makkah sent word to the People of the Book and asked them for some information with which they could test the Prophet SAW. They (the People of the Book) said, 'Ask him about a man who…

item.title: Al-Kahf:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنْ ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا wayasalūnaka ʿan dhī l-qarnayni qul sa-atlū ʿalaykum min'hu dhik'ran And they ask thee about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say thou: "I shall recite unto you of him a mention." (A recollection a reminder a memoir a lesson an admonition.) 'Dhu al-Qarnayn' literally means the one born twice. It is also interpreted that the name means the lord of two epochs. It is said that 'Dhu al-Qarnayn' was a very powerful king. God with His Divine Plan of supressing mischief and lawlessness, to help the weak and the oppressed and establish peace on earth and maintain order on it, had blessed 'Dhu al-Qarnayn' with the power to achieve the success in bringing under his sway the people of various characters and conduct of a vast part of the earth. It is said that Dhu…

item.title: Al-Kahf:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ سَبَبًا innā makkannā lahu fī l-arḍi waātaynāhu min kulli shayin sababan Indeed We had granted him power in the land and given him the means to all things.

item.title: Al-Kahf:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ سَبَبًا innā makkannā lahu fī l-arḍi waātaynāhu min kulli shayin sababan Indeed, We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way (i.e., means). See 18:83

item.title: Al-Kahf:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ سَبَبًا innā makkannā lahu fī l-arḍi waātaynāhu min kulli shayin sababan (Sayeth the Lord) Verily We did make him mighty in the earth, and We gave him the means of access to every thing, See 18:83

item.title: Al-Kahf:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا fa-atbaʿa sababan So he followed a means.

item.title: Al-Kahf:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا fa-atbaʿa sababan So he followed a way. So he followed a way (18:85). Until, when he reached the setting place of the sun, he found it setting in a spring of Hami'ah. And he found near it a people. We said: O Dhul-Qarnayn! Either you punish them or treat them with kindness (18:86). He said: "As for him who does wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with a terrible torment (Hell) (18:87). "But as for him who believes and works righteousness, he shall have the best reward, and we shall speak unto him mild words (18:88). His Traveling and Reaching the Place Where the Sun Sets (the West) فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا So he followed a way. Ibn 'Abbas said that he followed different routes to achieve…

item.title: Al-Kahf:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا fa-atbaʿa sababan So followed (Towards the West.) he a (Means of access – Westward.) route. Dhu al-Qarnayn followed a route (Towards the West).

item.title: Al-Kahf:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِي عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا قَوْمًا قُلْنَا يَاذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّا أَنْ تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا ḥattā idhā balagha maghriba l-shamsi wajadahā taghrubu fī ʿaynin ḥami-atin wawajada ʿindahā qawman qul'nā yādhā l-qarnayni immā an tuʿadhiba wa-immā an tattakhidha fīhim ḥus'nan When he reached the place where the sun sets, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and by it he found a people. We said, 'O Dhul Qarnayn! You may either punish them, or treat them with kindness.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِي عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا قَوْمًا قُلْنَا يَاذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّا أَنْ تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا ḥattā idhā balagha maghriba l-shamsi wajadahā taghrubu fī ʿaynin ḥami-atin wawajada ʿindahā qawman qul'nā yādhā l-qarnayni immā an tuʿadhiba wa-immā an tattakhidha fīhim ḥus'nan Until, when he reached the setting of the sun (i.e., the west), he found it (as if) setting in a body of dark water,1 and he found near it a people. We (i.e., Allah) said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish (them) or else adopt among them (a way of) goodness." See 18:85

item.title: Al-Kahf:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِي عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا قَوْمًا قُلْنَا يَاذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّا أَنْ تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا ḥattā idhā balagha maghriba l-shamsi wajadahā taghrubu fī ʿaynin ḥami-atin wawajada ʿindahā qawman qul'nā yādhā l-qarnayni immā an tuʿadhiba wa-immā an tattakhidha fīhim ḥus'nan Until when he reached the place where settest the sun (the Western most land) and found it (the sun) setting in a black muddy pool, and found by it a people. Said We: "O' Dhu al-Qarnayn! Either chastise them thou (for their infidelity) or treat them with kindness (if they correct themselves)." The first of three expeditions was towards the West, i.e., until he reached the shores of the sea on the Western side of his land. There is no such thing as the end of the earth from where starts the…

item.title: Al-Kahf:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَمَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَى رَبِّهِ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ عَذَابًا نُكْرًا qāla ammā man ẓalama fasawfa nuʿadhibuhu thumma yuraddu ilā rabbihi fayuʿadhibuhu ʿadhāban nuk'ran He said, 'As for him who is a wrongdoer, we will punish him. Then he shall be returned to his Lord and He will punish him with a dire punishment.

item.title: Al-Kahf:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَمَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَى رَبِّهِ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ عَذَابًا نُكْرًا qāla ammā man ẓalama fasawfa nuʿadhibuhu thumma yuraddu ilā rabbihi fayuʿadhibuhu ʿadhāban nuk'ran He said, "As for one who wrongs,1 we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment (i.e., Hellfire). See 18:85

item.title: Al-Kahf:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَمَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَى رَبِّهِ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ عَذَابًا نُكْرًا qāla ammā man ẓalama fasawfa nuʿadhibuhu thumma yuraddu ilā rabbihi fayuʿadhibuhu ʿadhāban nuk'ran (And) said He: "As to him who is unjust We will chastise him, then he shall be returned unto his Lord, and He will chastise him with a grievous (Awful, unprecedented.) chastisement." Though 'Dhu al-Qarnayn' was such a strong and powerful king to have overpowered the strongest and the most turbulent elements of the human race inhabiting the various places around him yet his belief in God was never affected. He believed that what he did to establish and maintain peace in the land, was a punishment to the wicked ones, but it was only tentative and the real punishment shall be meted out to them by the Real Lord of the Universe in…

item.title: Al-Kahf:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا مَنْ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُ جَزَاءً الْحُسْنَى وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا wa-ammā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan falahu jazāan l-ḥus'nā wasanaqūlu lahu min amrinā yus'ran But as for him who has faith and acts righteously, he shall have the best reward, and we will speak to him gently of our command.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا مَنْ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُ جَزَاءً الْحُسْنَى وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا wa-ammā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan falahu jazāan l-ḥus'nā wasanaqūlu lahu min amrinā yus'ran But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best (i.e., Paradise), and we (i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn) will speak to him from our command with ease." See 18:85

item.title: Al-Kahf:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا مَنْ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُ جَزَاءً الْحُسْنَى وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا wa-ammā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan falahu jazāan l-ḥus'nā wasanaqūlu lahu min amrinā yus'ran And as for him who believeth and doeth good, for him shall be a goodly recompense; and We will speak (Deliver.) unto him (only) of easy (Mild.) (one of) Our command. See 18:87

item.title: Al-Kahf:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا thumma atbaʿa sababan Then he followed a means.

item.title: Al-Kahf:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا thumma atbaʿa sababan Then he followed a way. Then he followed (another) way (18:89). Until, when he came to the rising place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We (Allah) had provided no shelter against the sun (18:90). So (it was)! And We knew all about him (Dhul-Qarnayn) (18:91). His Journey East Allah tells us that Dhul-Qarnayn then traveled from the west of the earth towards the east. Every time he passed a nation, he subjugated the people and called them to Allah. If they obeyed him, all well and good, otherwise he would humiliate them and take their wealth and possessions. From every nation he took what his armies needed to fight the next nation. When he reached the place where the sun rises, as Allah says: وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ…

item.title: Al-Kahf:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا thumma atbaʿa sababan Then he followed (another) (Another route toward East.) route. See 18:87

item.title: Al-Kahf:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهَا سِتْرًا ḥattā idhā balagha maṭliʿa l-shamsi wajadahā taṭluʿu ʿalā qawmin lam najʿal lahum min dūnihā sit'ran When he reached the place where the sun rises, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not provided any shield against it.

item.title: Al-Kahf:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهَا سِتْرًا ḥattā idhā balagha maṭliʿa l-shamsi wajadahā taṭluʿu ʿalā qawmin lam najʿal lahum min dūnihā sit'ran Until, when he came to the rising of the sun (i.e., the east), he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield. See 18:89

item.title: Al-Kahf:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهَا سِتْرًا ḥattā idhā balagha maṭliʿa l-shamsi wajadahā taṭluʿu ʿalā qawmin lam najʿal lahum min dūnihā sit'ran Until when he reached the place where (Eastward.) riseth the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided not any shelter, The people were totally ignorant of the art of erecting a shelter for them against the were nor were they conversant with making clothes or any covering to cover their bodies, nor did they know the use of any such things. They used to go into underground cells when the sun gets hot and get out when the sun sets. They were guided by Dhu al-Qarnayn and were taught to live in peace.

item.title: Al-Kahf:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا kadhālika waqad aḥaṭnā bimā ladayhi khub'ran So it was, and We comprehended whatever pertained to him.

item.title: Al-Kahf:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا kadhālika waqad aḥaṭnā bimā ladayhi khub'ran Thus.1 And We had encompassed (all) that he had in knowledge. See 18:89

item.title: Al-Kahf:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا kadhālika waqad aḥaṭnā bimā ladayhi khub'ran Even so; and indeed We had full knowledge of whatever was with him. See 18:90

item.title: Al-Kahf:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا thumma atbaʿa sababan Then he followed a means.

item.title: Al-Kahf:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا thumma atbaʿa sababan Then he followed a way. Then he followed (another) way (92)Until, when he reached between two mountains, he found before them a people who scarcely understood a word (93)They said: O Dhul-Qarnayn! Verily, Ya'juj and Ma'juj are doing great mischief in the land. Shall we then pay you a tribute in order that you might erect a barrier between us and them? (94)He said: "That in which my Lord had established me is better. So help me with strength, I will erect between you and them a barrier. (95)"Give me Zubar of iron;" then, when he had filled up the gap between the two mountain-cliffs, he said: "Blow;" then when he had made them (red as) fire, he said: "Bring me Qitran to pour over them. (96) His Journey to the Land of Ya'juj…

item.title: Al-Kahf:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا thumma atbaʿa sababan Then he followed (another) route. (Means of access Northward where the barbarous people of the North, every now & then attacked the Southerners.) See 18:90

item.title: Al-Kahf:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا ḥattā idhā balagha bayna l-sadayni wajada min dūnihimā qawman lā yakādūna yafqahūna qawlan When he reached [the place] between the two barriers, he found between them a people who could hardly understand a word.

item.title: Al-Kahf:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا ḥattā idhā balagha bayna l-sadayni wajada min dūnihimā qawman lā yakādūna yafqahūna qawlan Until, when he reached (a pass) between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand (his) speech. See 18:92

item.title: Al-Kahf:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا ḥattā idhā balagha bayna l-sadayni wajada min dūnihimā qawman lā yakādūna yafqahūna qawlan Until when he reached between two mountains he found on the hither side of the two (mountains) a people who could scarce understand a word. The two mountains are supposed by some commentators to be the mountains of Armenia and Azerbaijan. The people inhabited the place around the mountains, spoke a language totally new to Dhu al-Qarnayn, hence they could not understand what he said to them.

item.title: Al-Kahf:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا qālū yādhā l-qarnayni inna yajūja wamajūja muf'sidūna fī l-arḍi fahal najʿalu laka kharjan ʿalā an tajʿala baynanā wabaynahum saddan They said, 'O Dhul Qarnayn! Indeed Gog and Magog are causing corruption in the land. Shall we pay you a tribute on condition that you build a barrier between them and us?'

item.title: Al-Kahf:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا qālū yādhā l-qarnayni inna yajūja wamajūja muf'sidūna fī l-arḍi fahal najʿalu laka kharjan ʿalā an tajʿala baynanā wabaynahum saddan They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog1 are (great) corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" See 18:92

item.title: Al-Kahf:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا qālū yādhā l-qarnayni inna yajūja wamajūja muf'sidūna fī l-arḍi fahal najʿalu laka kharjan ʿalā an tajʿala baynanā wabaynahum saddan Said they: 'O' Dhu al-Qarnayn! Verily Gog and Magog cause mischief in the land, shall we collect for thee the (necessary) resources (from among ourselves) so that thou shalt raise between us and them a barrier? The 'Yajuj' (Gog) and 'Majuj' (Magog) are said to be labourers, people frequently troubling their neighbours. The Yajuj and the Majuj are supposed to be the issues of Yafus, son of Noah. The people wanted son of Noah. a barrier to be erected between the mountains through which the Yajuj and the Majuj used to attack them. The people seemed to be skilled in the art…

item.title: Al-Kahf:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِیْهِ رَبِّي خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا qāla mā makkannī fīhi rabbī khayrun fa-aʿīnūnī biquwwatin ajʿal baynakum wabaynahum radman He said, 'What my Lord has furnished me is better. Yet help me with some power, and I will make a bulwark between you and them.

item.title: Al-Kahf:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِیْهِ رَبِّي خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا qāla mā makkannī fīhi rabbī khayrun fa-aʿīnūnī biquwwatin ajʿal baynakum wabaynahum radman He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better (than what you offer), but assist me with strength (i.e., manpower); I will make between you and them a dam. See 18:92

item.title: Al-Kahf:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِیْهِ رَبِّي خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا qāla mā makkannī fīhi rabbī khayrun fa-aʿīnūnī biquwwatin ajʿal baynakum wabaynahum radman He said: "The power in which hath my Lord established me is better, so ye help me only with the strength (of labourers), I will make between you and them a barrier," Dhu al-Qarnayn was conscious of the strength and the power Divinely endowed in him and wanted to use it without any obligation on the people. He wanted the people only to help him with their personal labour

item.title: Al-Kahf:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ حَتّٰی إِذَا سَاوَى بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انْفُخُوْۤا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَعَلَهُ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِي أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا ātūnī zubara l-ḥadīdi ḥattā idhā sāwā bayna l-ṣadafayni qāla unfukhū ḥattā idhā jaʿalahu nāran qāla ātūnī uf'righ ʿalayhi qiṭ'ran Bring me pieces of iron!' When he had levelled up between the flanks, he said, 'Blow!' When he had turned it into fire, he said, 'Bring me molten copper to pour over it.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ حَتّٰی إِذَا سَاوَى بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انْفُخُوْۤا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَعَلَهُ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِي أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا ātūnī zubara l-ḥadīdi ḥattā idhā sāwā bayna l-ṣadafayni qāla unfukhū ḥattā idhā jaʿalahu nāran qāla ātūnī uf'righ ʿalayhi qiṭ'ran Bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled (them) between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow (with bellows)," until when he had made it (like) fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper." See 18:92

item.title: Al-Kahf:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ حَتّٰی إِذَا سَاوَى بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انْفُخُوْۤا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَعَلَهُ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِي أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا ātūnī zubara l-ḥadīdi ḥattā idhā sāwā bayna l-ṣadafayni qāla unfukhū ḥattā idhā jaʿalahu nāran qāla ātūnī uf'righ ʿalayhi qiṭ'ran Bring ye unto me blocks of iron," until when it filled the space between the mountain sides, said he: (Dhu al-Qarnayn.) "Ply your bellows," until he had made it red-hot with fire, he said: "Bring unto me molten brass which I may pour over it. See 18:95

item.title: Al-Kahf:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اسْطَاعُوْۤا أَنْ يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا لَهُ نَقْبًا famā is'ṭāʿū an yaẓharūhu wamā is'taṭāʿū lahu naqban So they could neither scale it, nor could they make a hole in it.

item.title: Al-Kahf:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اسْطَاعُوْۤا أَنْ يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا لَهُ نَقْبًا famā is'ṭāʿū an yaẓharūhu wamā is'taṭāʿū lahu naqban So they (i.e., Gog and Magog) were unable to pass over it, nor were they able (to effect) in it any penetration. So they could not scale it or dig through it (18:97). He said: This is a mercy from my Lord, but when the promise of my Lord comes, He shall Dakka' it down to the ground. And the promise of my Lord is ever true (18:98). And on that Day, We shall leave some of them to surge like waves on one another; and the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them (the creatures) all together (18:99). The Barrier Restrains Them, but It will be Breached When the Hour Draws Nigh Allah tells us that Ya'juj and Ma'juj could not…

item.title: Al-Kahf:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اسْطَاعُوْۤا أَنْ يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا لَهُ نَقْبًا famā is'ṭāʿū an yaẓharūhu wamā is'taṭāʿū lahu naqban So they could not scale it nor could they make a hole in it. The wall was high and strong that it could neither be scaled nor broken through by the invaders.

item.title: Al-Kahf:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّي فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ دَكَّاءَ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي حَقًّا qāla hādhā raḥmatun min rabbī fa-idhā jāa waʿdu rabbī jaʿalahu dakkāa wakāna waʿdu rabbī ḥaqqan He said, 'This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord is fulfilled, He will level it;1 and my Lord's promise is true.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّي فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ دَكَّاءَ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي حَقًّا qāla hādhā raḥmatun min rabbī fa-idhā jāa waʿdu rabbī jaʿalahu dakkāa wakāna waʿdu rabbī ḥaqqan (Dhul-Qarnayn) said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord1 comes (i.e., approaches), He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true." See 18:97

item.title: Al-Kahf:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّي فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ دَكَّاءَ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي حَقًّا qāla hādhā raḥmatun min rabbī fa-idhā jāa waʿdu rabbī jaʿalahu dakkāa wakāna waʿdu rabbī ḥaqqan Said he: "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord (the Resurrection) cometh to pass, He will level it with the ground; and the promise of my Lord is (always) true." Note the modesty of Dhu al-Qarnayn that having performed such a huge and a mighty task which looked impossible to be done by any one, he did not attribute the success to his own power and strength but he attributes it to the grace and the mercy of the Lord. He preached to the people by his declaration that the Word or the Will of the Lord shall be done and it is…

item.title: Al-Kahf:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعْضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا wataraknā baʿḍahum yawma-idhin yamūju fī baʿḍin wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fajamaʿnāhum jamʿan That day We shall let them surge over one another, and the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall gather them all,

item.title: Al-Kahf:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعْضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا wataraknā baʿḍahum yawma-idhin yamūju fī baʿḍin wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fajamaʿnāhum jamʿan And We will leave them that day1 surging over each other, and (then) the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in (one) assembly. See 18:97

item.title: Al-Kahf:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعْضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا wataraknā baʿḍahum yawma-idhin yamūju fī baʿḍin wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fajamaʿnāhum jamʿan And We will let some of them, that day, to dash (like the billows) one another and the Trumpet will be blown, then will We gather them all together, This exposes what a sweeping destruction would happen when the Trumpet would be blown when every human effort in the world would be rendered null and void and when everything in the world will be made to flow like the waves of water in tumultuous rush one over the other and every living being shall be collected and the Final Judgment will take effect.

item.title: Al-Kahf:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَرْضًا waʿaraḍnā jahannama yawma-idhin lil'kāfirīna ʿarḍan and that day We shall bring hell into view visibly for the faithless.

item.title: Al-Kahf:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَرْضًا waʿaraḍnā jahannama yawma-idhin lil'kāfirīna ʿarḍan And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display. And on that Day We shall present Hell to the disbelievers, plain to view (18:100). (To) those whose eyes had been under a covering from My Reminder, and they could not bear to hear (it) (18:101). Do then those who disbelieved think that they can take My servants as Awliya' (protectors) besides Me? Verily, We have prepared Hell as an entertainment for the disbelievers (18:102). Hell will be Displayed before the Disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection Allah tells us what He will do to the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection. He will show Hell to them, meaning He will bring it forth for them to see its punishment and torment before they enter it. This will…

item.title: Al-Kahf:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَرْضًا waʿaraḍnā jahannama yawma-idhin lil'kāfirīna ʿarḍan And We will present the hell that day, for the disbelievers, fully exposed to their view, The terrible consequence of disbelief and the evils done shall be placed before the disbelievers as the awful reality spread out to their fullest realization.

item.title: Al-Kahf:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِي غِطَاءٍ عَنْ ذِكْرِي وَكَانُوْۤا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا alladhīna kānat aʿyunuhum fī ghiṭāin ʿan dhik'rī wakānū lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿan —Those whose eyes were blindfolded to My remembrance and who could not hear.

item.title: Al-Kahf:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِي غِطَاءٍ عَنْ ذِكْرِي وَكَانُوْۤا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا alladhīna kānat aʿyunuhum fī ghiṭāin ʿan dhik'rī wakānū lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿan Those whose eyes had been within a cover (removed) from My remembrance,1 and they were not able to hear.2 See 18:100

item.title: Al-Kahf:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِي غِطَاءٍ عَنْ ذِكْرِي وَكَانُوْۤا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا alladhīna kānat aʿyunuhum fī ghiṭāin ʿan dhik'rī wakānū lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿan Those whose eyes were under a veil (Cover.) from My reminder, and who could not bear to (Hear it recited.) hear. Those who were not convinced of the several manifest signs of God's might and glory and who in spite of the open and the repeated declaration of the truth through God's Own Words, would not even listen to what was said, then will realize the result of their disbelief and consequence in such a manifest way that they would be filled with the realization of it.

item.title: Al-Kahf:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنْ يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِنْ دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ نُزُلًا afaḥasiba alladhīna kafarū an yattakhidhū ʿibādī min dūnī awliyāa innā aʿtadnā jahannama lil'kāfirīna nuzulan Do the faithless suppose that they have taken My servants for guardians in My stead? Indeed We have prepared hell for the hospitality of the faithless.

item.title: Al-Kahf:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنْ يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِنْ دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ نُزُلًا afaḥasiba alladhīna kafarū an yattakhidhū ʿibādī min dūnī awliyāa innā aʿtadnā jahannama lil'kāfirīna nuzulan Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging. See 18:100

item.title: Al-Kahf:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنْ يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِنْ دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ نُزُلًا afaḥasiba alladhīna kafarū an yattakhidhū ʿibādī min dūnī awliyāa innā aʿtadnā jahannama lil'kāfirīna nuzulan What! think those who disbelieve, that they can take My servants as their guardians besides Me? Verily We have got Hell ready for the infidels to be entertained (therein). Some commentators interpret the statement to refer specially to the Christians who worship Jesus who was one of the servants of God, as God, for, Jesus himself calls himself as the servant of God.1

item.title: Al-Kahf:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالًا qul hal nunabbi-ukum bil-akhsarīna aʿmālan Say, 'Shall we inform you about the biggest losers in regard to works?

item.title: Al-Kahf:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالًا qul hal nunabbi-ukum bil-akhsarīna aʿmālan Say, (O Muḥammad), "Shall we (believers) inform you of the greatest losers as to (their) deeds? Say: "Shall We tell you the greatest losers in respect of (their) deeds? (18:103). "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life while they thought that they were acquiring good by their deeds (18:104). "They are those who deny the Ayat of their Lord and the meeting with Him. So their works are in vain, and on the Day of Resurrection, We shall assign no weight for them (18:105). "That shall be their recompense, Hell; because they disbelieved and took My Ayat and My Messengers for jest (18:106). The Greatest Losers in Respect of (Their) Deeds Al-Bukhari recorded from 'Amr that Mus'ab who said: I asked my father – meaning Sa'd bin Abi…

item.title: Al-Kahf:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالًا qul hal nunabbi-ukum bil-akhsarīna aʿmālan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Shall We acquaint you of the greatest losers in (their) deeds?" Here is a clear warning to the disbelievers who are infatuated with some good deeds they had done. It has been made quite obvious here that the good deeds also will lose their weight if they have been done without the due faith in God and without the essential modesty and humility towards the Almighty Lord. The verse to6 clearly indicates that the reference is to those who ridicule the signs of the Lord and His Apostles. Among the signs of God, the greatest being the Hoy Qur'an, the apostles of God and the Divinely chosen guides or the Imams who are the custodians of the Holy Qur'an, the Final Word of the…

item.title: Al-Kahf:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا alladhīna ḍalla saʿyuhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wahum yaḥsabūna annahum yuḥ'sinūna ṣun'ʿan Those whose endeavour goes awry in the life of the world, while they suppose they are doing good.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا alladhīna ḍalla saʿyuhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wahum yaḥsabūna annahum yuḥ'sinūna ṣun'ʿan (They are) those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work." See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا alladhīna ḍalla saʿyuhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wahum yaḥsabūna annahum yuḥ'sinūna ṣun'ʿan (They are) those whose labour is lost in the life of this world and they deem that that they were acquiring good by their deeds. See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَائِهِ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا ulāika alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim waliqāihi faḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum falā nuqīmu lahum yawma l-qiyāmati waznan They are the ones who deny the signs of their Lord and the encounter with Him. So their works have failed. On the Day of Resurrection We will not set for them any weight.

item.title: Al-Kahf:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَائِهِ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا ulāika alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim waliqāihi faḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum falā nuqīmu lahum yawma l-qiyāmati waznan Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in (their) meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight (i.e., importance). See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَائِهِ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا ulāika alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim waliqāihi faḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum falā nuqīmu lahum yawma l-qiyāmati waznan These are they who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord and meeting Him so vain will be their deeds, nor will We on the Day of Judgment, assign unto them any weight. See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوْۤا وَاتَّخَذُوا ءَايَاتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا dhālika jazāuhum jahannamu bimā kafarū wa-ittakhadhū āyātī warusulī huzuwan That is their requital—hell— because of their faithlessness and taking My signs and My apostles in derision.

item.title: Al-Kahf:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوْۤا وَاتَّخَذُوا ءَايَاتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا dhālika jazāuhum jahannamu bimā kafarū wa-ittakhadhū āyātī warusulī huzuwan That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and (because) they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule. See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوْۤا وَاتَّخَذُوا ءَايَاتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا dhālika jazāuhum jahannamu bimā kafarū wa-ittakhadhū āyātī warusulī huzuwan Thus Hell is the recompense for what they disbelieved and held My signs and My Apostles with scorn. See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātu l-fir'dawsi nuzulan As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds they shall have the gardens of Firdaws1 for abode,2

item.title: Al-Kahf:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātu l-fir'dawsi nuzulan Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise1 as a lodging. "Verily, those who believe and do righteous deeds, shall have the Gardens of Al-Firdaws for their entertainment (18:107). "Wherein they shall dwell (forever). No desire will they have for removal therefrom (18:108). The Reward of the Righteous Believers Allah tells us about His blessed servants, those who believed in Allah and His Messengers and accepted as truth what the Messengers brought. He tells us that they will have the Gardens of Al-Firdaws (Paradise). Abu Umamah said, "Al-Firdaws is the center of Paradise." Qatadah said, "Al-Firdaws is a hill in Paradise, at its center, the best of it." This was also…

item.title: Al-Kahf:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātu l-fir'dawsi nuzulan Verily those who believe and do good there is for them the gardens of Paradise for their entertainment, See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا khālidīna fīhā lā yabghūna ʿanhā ḥiwalan to remain [forever]in them, from where they will not seek to shift.

item.title: Al-Kahf:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا khālidīna fīhā lā yabghūna ʿanhā ḥiwalan Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer. See 18:107

item.title: Al-Kahf:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا khālidīna fīhā lā yabghūna ʿanhā ḥiwalan Abiding therein, desiring not to be removed therefrom. See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا qul law kāna l-baḥru midādan likalimāti rabbī lanafida l-baḥru qabla an tanfada kalimātu rabbī walaw ji'nā bimith'lihi madadan Say, 'If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be spent before the words of my Lord are spent, though We brought another like it for replenishment.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا qul law kāna l-baḥru midādan likalimāti rabbī lanafida l-baḥru qabla an tanfada kalimātu rabbī walaw ji'nā bimith'lihi madadan Say, "If the sea were ink for (writing) the words1 of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it in (continual) supplement." Say: If the sea were ink for the Words of my Lord, surely, the sea would be exhausted before the Words of my Lord would be finished, even if We brought like it for its aid (18:109). The Words of the Lord Can Never be Finished Allah says: 'Say, O Muhammad, if the water of the sea were ink for a pen to write down the words,…

item.title: Al-Kahf:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا qul law kāna l-baḥru midādan likalimāti rabbī lanafida l-baḥru qabla an tanfada kalimātu rabbī walaw ji'nā bimith'lihi madadan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "Should the sea become ink (to write) the (This includes both the Creative as well as the Legislative Word of God – Refer to note on Surah 1 on the Word of God.) words of My Lord, the sea will certainly be exhausted ere the words of my Lord are exhausted, and though we bring the like of that (the seas) to (To reimburse.) add thereto." See 18:103

item.title: Al-Kahf:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun faman kāna yarjū liqāa rabbihi falyaʿmal ʿamalan ṣāliḥan walā yush'rik biʿibādati rabbihi aḥadan Say, 'I am just a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So whoever expects to encounter his Lord —let him act righteously, and not associate anyone with the worship of his Lord.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun faman kāna yarjū liqāa rabbihi falyaʿmal ʿamalan ṣāliḥan walā yush'rik biʿibādati rabbihi aḥadan Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone." Say: I am only a man like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is One God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord, let him work righteousness and associate none as a partner in the worship of his Lord (18:110). Muhammad…

item.title: Al-Kahf:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun faman kāna yarjū liqāa rabbihi falyaʿmal ʿamalan ṣāliḥan walā yush'rik biʿibādati rabbihi aḥadan (And) say thou: "I am only a man like you, it is revealed unto me that your God is but One God, whosoever therefore desireth to meet his Lord, let him do good deeds, and associate not any one in the worship of His Lord." People who see only the surface and do not care to know what is below it, immediately quote the opening words of this verse to consider the Holy Prophet as one of the ordinary mortals like the common man. They do not like to consider at all…

item.title: Al-Kawthar:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ innā aʿṭaynāka l-kawthara Indeed We have given you abundance.

item.title: Al-Kawthar:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ innā aʿṭaynāka l-kawthara Indeed, We have granted you, (O Muḥammad), al-Kawthar. إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ For he who hates you, he will be cut off. So they thought in their ignorance that if his sons died, his remembrance would be cut off. Allah forbid! To the contrary, Allah preserved his remembrance for all the world to see, and He obligated all the servants to follow his Law. This will continue for all of time until the Day of Gathering and the coming of the Hereafter. May the blessings of Allah and His peace be upon him forever until the Day of Assembling. This is the end of the Tafsir of Surat Al-Kawthar, and all praise and blessings are due to Allah.

item.title: Al-Kawthar:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ innā aʿṭaynāka l-kawthara Verily We have given thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) The 'Kawthar' (Abundance) The Holy Prophet's son Tahir, born of the Lady Khadija, died and there was no male issue of the Holy Prophet. People viz., Omar Ibn Aas and Hakam Ibn Aas, taunted the Holy Prophet calling him 'Abtar' i.e., the animal whose tail is cut off, meaning, the one whose succession in his seed has ceased, i.e., the one who has none to inherit. To console the Holy Prophet, this Surah was revealed with the glad tidings of the greatest amount or the highest degree of the grace of God, bestowed on him. 'Kawthar' is said to be a stream in heaven which is meant exclusively for the Holy Prophet. When this Surah was revealed, the Holy Prophet was asked as to what…

item.title: Al-Kawthar:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ faṣalli lirabbika wa-in'ḥar So pray to your Lord, and sacrifice [the sacrificial camel].1

item.title: Al-Kawthar:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ faṣalli lirabbika wa-in'ḥar So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice (to Him alone). See 108:1

item.title: Al-Kawthar:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ faṣalli lirabbika wa-in'ḥar So pray thou unto thy Lord! and offer sacrifice Though this terse is addressed to the Holy Prophet to mean that in return for the greatest blessings and the greatest amount of the grace of God which has been showered on him, he should pray and offer sacrifices, but it is a command or instruction for everyone, saying that he who aspires for the special blessings from God should get them through prayer and sacrifices. As a matter of fact, it is the common man who needs such guidance, not an Apostle of God who is sent duly conditioned with the spiritual excellence and the necessary knowledge of the means to achieve goodness, to show those ways to mankind. 'Nahr' may mean sacrifice - or may mean the raising of hand in prayer wherever…

item.title: Al-Kawthar:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ inna shāni-aka huwa l-abtaru Indeed it is your enemy who is without posterity.

item.title: Al-Kawthar:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ inna shāni-aka huwa l-abtaru Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.1 See 108:1

item.title: Al-Kawthar:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ inna shāni-aka huwa l-abtaru Verily, thy enemy shall be the one cut off (in his progeny) (Left unproductive.) There is a consolation as well as a prophecy that it is the one who taunted the Holy Prophet as 'Abtar' who would go into oblivion and not the Holy Prophet, for the issues which he will be blessed with through Ali and Fatimah, will be in such abundance that none will be able to enumerate them or know their number correctly. Today the 'Sadaat' or the issues of the Holy Prophet are found in every part of the world, and this wonderful abundance was granted by God through the one single daughter Lady Fatimah who was married to Ali. No king or any other prophet can claim this grace of having his lineage continued for centuries together…

item.title: Al-Lail:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشٰی wa-al-layli idhā yaghshā By the night when it envelops,

item.title: Al-Lail:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشٰی wa-al-layli idhā yaghshā By the night when it covers.1 وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down? Mujahid said, "This means when he dies." Abu Salih and Malik said – narrating from Zayd bin Aslam, "When he goes down into the Fire."

item.title: Al-Lail:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشٰی wa-al-layli idhā yaghshā By the Night when it spreadeth its evil! Three things are brought into evidence viz., the Night, the Day and the Phenomenon of Sex Differences. Each of the things, is opposed in its qualities to the other. The darkness of the night is a contrast to the light of the day and two kinds of sexes are the opposites of one another. This contrast in the qualities of the three things is an illustration to what is said in the fourth verse.

item.title: Al-Lail:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى wal-nahāri idhā tajallā by the day when it brightens,

item.title: Al-Lail:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى wal-nahāri idhā tajallā And (by) the day when it appears. See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى wal-nahāri idhā tajallā By the Day when (the sun's light) shines! See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى wamā khalaqa l-dhakara wal-unthā by Him who created the male and the female:

item.title: Al-Lail:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى wamā khalaqa l-dhakara wal-unthā And (by) He who created the male and female. See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى wamā khalaqa l-dhakara wal-unthā By Him Who created the male and the female! See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّى inna saʿyakum lashattā your endeavours are indeed unlike.

item.title: Al-Lail:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّى inna saʿyakum lashattā Indeed, your efforts are diverse. See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّى inna saʿyakum lashattā Verily your striving is (unto) diverse (ends)! People have different or diverse aims of their life - One might be taking the pleasures of this life while the other may be mindful only of the life hereafter. The one who loves this world, sacrifices his prosperity and the happiness in the hereafter and the other who aims at the hereafter sacrifices the luxuries and the ease of this life and bears the miseries and trials patiently and willingly.

item.title: Al-Lail:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى fa-ammā man aʿṭā wa-ittaqā As for him who gives and is Godwary

item.title: Al-Lail:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى fa-ammā man aʿṭā wa-ittaqā As for he who gives and fears Allah. See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى fa-ammā man aʿṭā wa-ittaqā Then as for him who giveth (alms) and guardeth (Who preaches piety.) (himself against evil) He who practices charity and gives away alms and guards himself against evil.

item.title: Al-Lail:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى waṣaddaqa bil-ḥus'nā and confirms the best promise,

item.title: Al-Lail:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى waṣaddaqa bil-ḥus'nā And believes in the best (reward). See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى waṣaddaqa bil-ḥus'nā And believeth in the Best (of all religions, Islam) He who has faith in God with conviction of his heart, does good to the World. Note - Islam, wherever it has demanded faith in God, has also made it conditional, its being accompanied with good deeds, i.e., goodness to the others. Mere verbal expression or the observance of any rituals do not prove the faith unless the faith manifests in the sincere acts of goodness to the others in the world. He who loves God will naturally love all that God loves and hate all that displeases Him. The love of good and hatred against evil, is the only and the great proof of the genuineness of the claim to the faith.

item.title: Al-Lail:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَى fasanuyassiruhu lil'yus'rā We shall surely ease him into facility.

item.title: Al-Lail:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَى fasanuyassiruhu lil'yus'rā We will ease him toward ease. See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَى fasanuyassiruhu lil'yus'rā We will smoothen (Prepare. (A.P.).) for him then the path unto bliss The first Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abu Talib says that once the Holy Prophet attending the funeral of a man, with a stick in his hand and striking it on the ground, said: 'For everyone there is space in the heaven and also in the Hell. A man asked ''O' Apostle of God, Then, shall we not act?" The Holy Prophet replied ''You go on discharging your duties. Everyone has been created with an allotment of some work". Saying this he recited this verse, i.e., God has provided with the facilities for every kind of work man chooses for himself. If he chooses good deeds he is helped and he creates a place for himself in the heaven and if he chooses any evil,…

item.title: Al-Lail:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا مَنْ بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَى wa-ammā man bakhila wa-is'taghnā But as for him who is stingy and self-complacent,

item.title: Al-Lail:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا مَنْ بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَى wa-ammā man bakhila wa-is'taghnā But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need. See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا مَنْ بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَى wa-ammā man bakhila wa-is'taghnā And as for him who acted niggardly and deemeth himself free from need (Independent of God.) He who practised niggardliness and became carefree of the life hereafter and did not think of providing for himself for that life by being righteous, doing charity in this world.

item.title: Al-Lail:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَى wakadhaba bil-ḥus'nā and denies the best promise,

item.title: Al-Lail:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَى wakadhaba bil-ḥus'nā And denies the best (reward). See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَى wakadhaba bil-ḥus'nā And belieth the Best (The Truth, Islam.) He who disbelieved and did not accept the truth willingly, with a sincere heart.

item.title: Al-Lail:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى fasanuyassiruhu lil'ʿus'rā We shall surely ease him into hardship.

item.title: Al-Lail:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى fasanuyassiruhu lil'ʿus'rā We will ease him toward difficulty. See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى fasanuyassiruhu lil'ʿus'rā We will smoothen (Prepare.) for him then the path unto affliction Those described in the above two verses, will not be entitled to any merciful relief from the evil consequences of his own evil, i.e., the miseries and the tortures he will get in the life hereafter and on the day of the Final Judgment.

item.title: Al-Lail:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّى wamā yugh'nī ʿanhu māluhu idhā taraddā His wealth shall not avail him when he perishes.

item.title: Al-Lail:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّى wamā yugh'nī ʿanhu māluhu idhā taraddā And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?1 See 92:1

item.title: Al-Lail:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّى wamā yugh'nī ʿanhu māluhu idhā taraddā And will avail him not his wealth when he perisheth The occasion for the revelation of this Surah is said to be as follows: In the house of one of the Ansars (one of those Madinites who helped the Holy Prophet on his migration from Mecca to Madina), was a date palm, the branches of the palm hung in the neighbour's house. Whenever the neighbour used to get up on the palm to take the dates and if any dates fell into his neighbour's house and the neighbour's children picked them up, the man used to get down and snatch away even the one or two dates picked up by the young children and even if the children had put the fruit into their mouths, the man used…

item.title: Al-Lail:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَى inna ʿalaynā lalhudā Indeed with Us rests guidance,

item.title: Al-Lail:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَى inna ʿalaynā lalhudā Indeed, (incumbent) upon Us is guidance. Truly, on Us is (to give) guidance (92:12). And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world) (92:13). Therefore I have warned you of a Fire Talazza (92:14). None shall enter it save the most wretched (92:15). Who denies and turns away (92:16). And those with Taqwa will be far removed from it (92:17). He who gives of his wealth for self-purification (92:18). And who has (in mind) no favor from anyone to be paid back (92:19). Except to seek the Face of his Lord, the Most High (92:20). He, surely, will be pleased (92:21). The Matter of Guidance and Other than it is in the Hand of Allah, and Allah's Warning about the Hellfire Qatadah said: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ Truly, on Us is…

item.title: Al-Lail:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَى inna ʿalaynā lalhudā Verily on Us (dependeth) the guidance (Refer to: 76:13.) See 92:11

item.title: Al-Lail:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَى wa-inna lanā lalākhirata wal-ūlā and indeed to Us belong the world and the Hereafter.

item.title: Al-Lail:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَى wa-inna lanā lalākhirata wal-ūlā And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first (life). See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَى wa-inna lanā lalākhirata wal-ūlā And verily Ours is the Hereafter and the Beginning (i.e. the last and the first i.e. the end and the beginning.) See 92:11

item.title: Al-Lail:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّى fa-andhartukum nāran talaẓẓā So I warn you of a blazing fire,

item.title: Al-Lail:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّى fa-andhartukum nāran talaẓẓā So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّى fa-andhartukum nāran talaẓẓā So I warn you of the fire that flameth See 92:11

item.title: Al-Lail:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى lā yaṣlāhā illā l-ashqā which none shall enter except the most wretched

item.title: Al-Lail:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى lā yaṣlāhā illā l-ashqā None will (enter to) burn therein except the most wretched one. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى lā yaṣlāhā illā l-ashqā None shall be cast into it but the most wretched (ones) 'Ashqa' is the superlative degree 'Shaqi', i.e., the unfortunate one, thus the punishment mentioned in verse 14 above, will be for the most unfortunate one, i.e., the one who has not availed of the lifelong respite given to seek the pardon of the All-Merciful Lord and went on persistently and deliberately sinning for his whole life.

item.title: Al-Lail:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى alladhī kadhaba watawallā —he who denies and turns back.

item.title: Al-Lail:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى alladhī kadhaba watawallā Who had denied and turned away. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى alladhī kadhaba watawallā (He) who belieth (the truth (Or the Apostle.) ) and turneth (his) back (unto it) See 92:15

item.title: Al-Lail:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى wasayujannabuhā l-atqā The Godwary shall be spared it

item.title: Al-Lail:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى wasayujannabuhā l-atqā But the righteous one will avoid it. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى wasayujannabuhā l-atqā And far removed shall be from it, he who guardeth (Practices the maximum possible.) (himself) the most (from evil) 'Atqa' the most guarded one against evil. This is the superlative of 'Taqa' in contrast to 'Ashqa' in verse 15 above.

item.title: Al-Lail:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّى alladhī yu'tī mālahu yatazakkā —he who gives his wealth to purify himself

item.title: Al-Lail:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّى alladhī yu'tī mālahu yatazakkā (He) who gives (from) his wealth to purify himself. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّى alladhī yu'tī mālahu yatazakkā (He) who giveth away his wealth, to purify himself 'Yatazakka', i.e., seeking purity, i.e., nothing but the pleasure of God and not for any show or fame. Note the highest degree of the excellence in the motive of charity which Islam demands.

item.title: Al-Lail:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تُجْزَى wamā li-aḥadin ʿindahu min niʿ'matin tuj'zā and does not expect any reward from anyone,

item.title: Al-Lail:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تُجْزَى wamā li-aḥadin ʿindahu min niʿ'matin tuj'zā And not (giving) for anyone who has (done him) a favor to be rewarded1. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تُجْزَى wamā li-aḥadin ʿindahu min niʿ'matin tuj'zā And no one hath (done) unto Him (God.) any favour, that he should be recompensed The one who sincerely gives anything in charity or spends in the way of the Lord, not in return for any good already done to him or even in the expectation of any return for it, from the one whom he does the good.

item.title: Al-Lail:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْاَعْلٰی illā ib'tighāa wajhi rabbihi l-aʿlā but seeks only the pleasure of his Lord, the Most Exalted,

item.title: Al-Lail:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْاَعْلٰی illā ib'tighāa wajhi rabbihi l-aʿlā But only seeking the face (i.e., acceptance) of his Lord, Most High. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْاَعْلٰی illā ib'tighāa wajhi rabbihi l-aʿlā Save the seeking of the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High The act of charity or goodness is done merely to earn the countenance, i.e., the pleasure of the Lord, the Most High.

item.title: Al-Lail:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَى walasawfa yarḍā and, surely, soon he will be well-pleased.

item.title: Al-Lail:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَى walasawfa yarḍā And he is going to be satisfied. See 92:12

item.title: Al-Lail:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَى walasawfa yarḍā And soon shall he be fully content Such a wholehearted devotee of God shall find God's pleasure as he expects. 'Atqa', i.e., the most pious ones are those whose, one and the only aim of their life, is explained in 6:164. And the most honourable with God, are also only those who guard themselves the most, against evil1. With the variance in the degree of piety and righteousness, will also naturally be the degree of the heavenly bliss that will be meted out. Hence the heaven or Paradise of the 'Atqa' or those 'Nafs al- Mutmainna' the perfectly satisfied soul, mentioned in 89:27, will be God's own heaven as He Himself names it in 89:30 which is His absolute pleasure. In Islam, this degree of piety could be found in the Holy Prophet and his Ahl…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ sa-ala sāilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿin An asker asked for a punishment bound to befall

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ sa-ala sāilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿin A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen.1 وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا But We see it (quite) near. Meaning: the believers believe that its occurrence is near, even though its time of occurrence is unknown and no one knows when it will be except Allah. All of what is approaching then it is near and it will definitely happen.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ sa-ala sāilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿin Demanded, a demander, the chastisement inevitable (Refer to Verses 8:32, 44:45.) According to the leading authorities of the Sunni School, Th, RZ, Kawashi, Jawahir al-Aqdain and Madarik, the occasion for the revelation of this Verse is given as follows: When on the 18th Dhu 'l-Hijjah 10 A.H. on his way back to Madina from his last pilgrimage, at Ghadir Khumm, declared Ali Ibn Abu Talib to be the Lord or the Master of all the Muslims, and the news of this reached on all sides of the Muslim World, Harith Ibn Nu'man-e-Qahri got over his camel and in rage reached the Holy Prophet while he was among his companions at Madina, and in an impertinent tone addressing him asked: "O' Muhammad! Thou ordained us to believe in the Unity of God, me…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ lil'kāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿun —which none can avert from the faithless—1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ lil'kāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿun To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer. See 70:1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ lil'kāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿun For the disbelievers against it, there is no repeller (Refer to Verses. 88:23; 88:24; 11:20; 40:33; 39:19; 10:107; 21:40; 6:147.) This Verse clearly indicates that the chastisement, which was sent in response to the demand, volunteered by him, was the one which was like the one in reserve for the disbelievers as they had demanded it 8:32. It would be a logical inference that the one who receives the punishment meant for the disbelief must necessarily have qualified himself with that quality. Hence, he who disbelieves in the position of Ali as the 'Maula' or the Guardian, the Master or the Lord of the Faithful, conferred upon Ali by the command of God, must necessarily be an infidel.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ mina l-lahi dhī l-maʿāriji from Allah, Lord of the lofty stations.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ mina l-lahi dhī l-maʿāriji (It is) from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent. See 70:1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ mina l-lahi dhī l-maʿāriji From (The Master of the ascending stages.) God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent (Refer to Verse 78:38.) 'Zil-Ma'arij' the Lord of the means of ascent, i.e., the means of the angels, the spirits or the human souls attaining exaltation, to rise higher and ever higher, in the excellence of the divine attributes and thus getting nearer and nearer to the All-Divine Lord, of Life, Knowledge and Power.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanatin The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a day whose span is fifty thousand years.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
