item.description: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanatin The angels and the Spirit (i.e., Jibril) will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years. See 70:1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanatin Unto Him ascend the angels and the spirit in a day of the measure of fifty thousand years (Refer to Verse 78:38.) As the nature of the plane beyond this earthly and ephemeral world, is quite different, the calculation of time and space according to our conception in this world, would be thousands of years to equalise it to a day, in that higher plane, or the huge amount of time given about the distance or space, the angels, the spiritual beings or the human soul could also be to indicate the enormity or impossible aspect of measuring the space or the time, it would take.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا fa-iṣ'bir ṣabran jamīlan So be patient, with a patience that is graceful.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا fa-iṣ'bir ṣabran jamīlan So be patient with gracious patience. See 70:1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا fa-iṣ'bir ṣabran jamīlan So be thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad) patient with an excellent patience (Refer to Verse 12:8.) The genetic factor of patience is the conviction in the ultimate triumph and the consequent relief from the torturous situation. This comes out of faith in God. Absolute patience is a godly attribute for the ultimate is in God's hands. Patience genuine should be without ant complaint expressed or suppressed in mind - and such was the patience of the Holy Prophet for against every torture or persecution that was inflicted on him by his adversaries. He only prayed for the proper guidance of his offenders and this unique quality of the Holy Prophet continued in his Ahl Al-Bayt, i.e., the Holy Imams and particularly in Husayn the Third Holy Imam, the King of Martyrs, it had its…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا innahum yarawnahu baʿīdan Indeed they see it to be far off,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا innahum yarawnahu baʿīdan Indeed, they see it (as) distant. See 70:1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا innahum yarawnahu baʿīdan Verily, they regard it to be far distant Those ignorant of the factual position of the time factor in his life, in relation to that in the hereafter, think the day of the final requital to be a far-off possibility.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا wanarāhu qarīban and We see it to be near.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا wanarāhu qarīban But We see it (as) near. See 70:1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا wanarāhu qarīban And we see (very) near The Time as we calculate in this life, has hardly any value in the spiritual world where the sun, the moon and their rotation, having no effect or value at all. The destined event shall come at any time God chooses, but it is bound to come.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ yawma takūnu l-samāu kal-muh'li The day when the sky will be like molten copper,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ yawma takūnu l-samāu kal-muh'li On the Day the sky will be like murky oil.1 The Day that the sky will be like the Al-Muhl (70:8). And the mountains will be like 'Ihn (70:9). And no friend will ask a friend (70:10). Though they shall be made to see one another, the criminal would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children (70:11). And his wife and his brother (70:12). And his Fasilah who sheltered him (70:13). And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him (70:14). By no means! Verily, it will be the fire of Hell (70:15). Naza'ah the Shawa (70:16). Calling (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (70:17). And collect (wealth) and hide it (from spending it in the cause…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ yawma takūnu l-samāu kal-muh'li On the Day the heaven shall be like molten brass For the drink or the food in the hell being the melted brass see 18:29, 44:45. What is referred to here is about the state into which the beautiful sky we see now, will be transformed presenting the dreadful sight.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'ni and the mountains like [tufts of] dyed wool,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'ni And the mountains will be like wool.1 See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'ni And the mountain shall be as (flakes of) wool (Refer to Verses 20:105 - 20:107; 69:14; 73:14; 78:20; 101:4; 101:5.) The mountains which now stand solid with their immeasurable weight, will be made to fly like the flakes of wool flying up as from the carder's hand - See 101:5.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَسْءَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا walā yasalu ḥamīmun ḥamīman and no friend will inquire about [the welfare of his] friend,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَسْءَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا walā yasalu ḥamīmun ḥamīman And no friend will ask (anything of) a friend. See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَسْءَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا walā yasalu ḥamīmun ḥamīman And will enquire not a friend of (his) friend No one will care for the other, however closely related or most intimately connected in this life. With the transformation of the present values of the things and the vanishing of the landmarks on the earth, as in the skies, the relationship between the people also would have disappeared No individual, however, intimately connected or closely related, he or she might have been in this life, instead of feeling for each other, each individual would fain desire to redeem one's own self from the infliction, pledging all his relations, friends and everything he owned in the world, in exchange for the relief.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīhi [though] they will be placed within each other's sight. The guilty one will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīhi They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children. See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīhi (Though) they will be given sight of each other; The guilty one would fain redeem himself from the punishment of that Day at the price of his (own) children See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ waṣāḥibatihi wa-akhīhi his spouse and his brother,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ waṣāḥibatihi wa-akhīhi And his wife and his brother. See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ waṣāḥibatihi wa-akhīhi And his wife and his brother See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُءْوِيهِ wafaṣīlatihi allatī tu'wīhi his kin which had sheltered him

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُءْوِيهِ wafaṣīlatihi allatī tu'wīhi And his nearest kindred who shelter him. See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُءْوِيهِ wafaṣīlatihi allatī tu'wīhi And his kindred who gave him shelter See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيهِ waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīhi and all those who are upon the earth, if that might deliver him.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيهِ waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīhi And whoever is on earth entirely (so) then it could save him. See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيهِ waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīhi And all that are in the earth, (if) then that deliver him See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا لَظَى kallā innahā laẓā Never! Indeed it is a blazing fire,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا لَظَى kallā innahā laẓā No!1 Indeed, it is the Flame (of Hell). See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا لَظَى kallā innahā laẓā By no means! Verily, it is the flaming (Hell) fire See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَزَّاعَةً لِلشَّوَى nazzāʿatan lilshawā which strips away the scalp.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَزَّاعَةً لِلشَّوَى nazzāʿatan lilshawā A remover of exteriors.1 See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَزَّاعَةً لِلشَّوَى nazzāʿatan lilshawā Dragging by the scalp See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَدْعُوْۤا مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّى tadʿū man adbara watawallā It invites him who has turned back [from the truth] and forsaken [it],

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَدْعُوْۤا مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّى tadʿū man adbara watawallā It invites he who turned his back (on truth) and went away (from obedience). See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَدْعُوْۤا مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّى tadʿū man adbara watawallā Claiming him who turned his back and went away (from the Truth) See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَى wajamaʿa fa-awʿā amassing [wealth] and hoarding [it].

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَى wajamaʿa fa-awʿā And collected (wealth) and hoarded. See 70:8

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَى wajamaʿa fa-awʿā And amassed (wealth), and shut it up See 70:10

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا inna l-insāna khuliqa halūʿan Indeed man has been created covetous:

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا inna l-insāna khuliqa halūʿan Indeed, mankind was created anxious. Verily, man was created very impatient (70:19). Apprehensive when evil touches him (70:20). And suppressive when good touches him (70:21). Except those who are devoted to Salah (70:22). Those who with their Salah are Da'imun (70:23). And those in whose wealth there is a recognized right (70:24). For the one who asks, and for the deprived (70:25). And those who believe in the Day of Recompense (70:26). And those who fear the torment of their Lord (70:27). Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure (70:28). And those who guard their private part (chastity) (70:29). Except from their wives or their right hand possessions – for (then) they are not blameworthy (70:30). But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا inna l-insāna khuliqa halūʿan Verily man is created avaricious 'Halu'a' is interpreted as greedy (MS.). To help man to reach the highest level possible for him in the spiritual sphere of his life, man has been created in the best mould 95:4 and given the essential degree of the discretionary freedom but he can also forfeit this endowment and become weak to counter the attractions 4:28. Man has been described as fettered with avarice and greed and suffering its consequences except those whose attention has been raised from the material temptation towards the spiritual attainments, as referred in Verse 22:35. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا idhā massahu l-sharu jazūʿan anxious when an ill befalls him

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا idhā massahu l-sharu jazūʿan When evil touches him, impatient. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا idhā massahu l-sharu jazūʿan When afflicteth him any evil, he is fretful (Refer to Verses 41:49 - 41:51.) See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا wa-idhā massahu l-khayru manūʿan and grudging when good comes his way

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا wa-idhā massahu l-khayru manūʿan And when good touches him, withholding (of it). See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا wa-idhā massahu l-khayru manūʿan When reacheth him any good, he is niggardly These Verses give in details what man does1, when in distress or need and how the same individual acts when receiving a relief and bounty from God. In adversity he is in restless despair and in prosperity he becomes forgetful of his previous helplessness and become? puffed up of his position and gets unmindful of the dues from him to the others.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ illā l-muṣalīna —[all are such] except the prayerful,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ illā l-muṣalīna Except the observers of prayer. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ illā l-muṣalīna Save those who offer (the regular) prayers (Refer to Verse 24:37.) By 'those who pray do not mean the ones who merely perform certain rituals or offer the daily prayers and in their practical life they are the mostly ungodly. Prayer is nothing but self-surrender and the surrender of the Ego. It is leading this present life in the interest of the hereafter, manifesting the divinity of God in word and action. The perfect models of such beings could be found only in the holy Ahl Al-Bayt. It is a well-known historic fact known to the Islamic world that whenever Ali used to engage himself in prayers, he used to get himself so much detached from this physical world that many a time people took him to be dead. Once a spear point stuck into his…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim dāimūna those who are persevering in their prayers

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim dāimūna Those who are constant in their prayer. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim dāimūna Those who are ever constant at their prayers (Refer to Verse 24:37.) The First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abu Talib says that the people referred to in this Verse are those who do not allow anything good which they can do, to be missed, if they fail to do it in the night, they do in the day and if they could not do it in the day, they do it in the night. This refers to the offering of the optional (Nawafil) prayers. (MS.)

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَعْلُومٌ wa-alladhīna fī amwālihim ḥaqqun maʿlūmun and in whose wealth there is a known right

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَعْلُومٌ wa-alladhīna fī amwālihim ḥaqqun maʿlūmun And those within whose wealth is a known right.1 See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَعْلُومٌ wa-alladhīna fī amwālihim ḥaqqun maʿlūmun And those in whose wealth is (realized) the right declared (by Us) (Refer to Verse 2:177.) 'Haqqun Ma'loom', i.e., the prescribed poor-rate and the other charities to the helpless and the needy.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi for the beggar and the deprived,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi For the petitioner and the deprived. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi For him who asketh and him who is prevented (by shame to ask) (Refer to Verses 76:9 - 76:11; 51:19.) For 'Mahroom', see 51:19 - Those needy ones who do not beg and consequently are not given the alms.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-alladhīna yuṣaddiqūna biyawmi l-dīni and who affirm the Day of Retribution,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-alladhīna yuṣaddiqūna biyawmi l-dīni And those who believe in the Day of Recompense. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-alladhīna yuṣaddiqūna biyawmi l-dīni And those who testify the truth about the day of Judgment See 70:25

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūna and those who are apprehensive of the punishment of their Lord

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūna And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūna And those who are afraid of the chastisement of their Lord Obedience, if that be merely the outcome of fear or the dread of the penalty for the otherwise, is no doubt the acknowledgement of the authority of the control, and of course has its own return but if it be not voluntary without any lust for the return or the fear of punishment, cannot be much commendable. The fear of God's wrath here means the sense or the care to avoid displeasing the Lord by going against His will or breaking any of His laws. In other words, always being mindful of earning or seeking God's pleasure the essential prerequisite for such a conduct, is love and love, if pure and sincere, begets love and the love…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ inna ʿadhāba rabbihim ghayru mamūnin (there is indeed no security from the punishment of their Lord)

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ inna ʿadhāba rabbihim ghayru mamūnin Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ inna ʿadhāba rabbihim ghayru mamūnin Verily, the chastisement of their Lord is not to be felt secure of None shall feel himself secure against the wrath of God. People shall never be confident or proud of their being prayerful or charitable. One should always be fearing the chastisement for going against the divine law or violating the prescribed limits. While fearing God, one must not be dejected of His mercy. His mercy must be sought seeking His pardon through repentance which the All-Merciful Himself invites and is ready to accept, provided it is with the due sincerity accompanied by the necessary amendment.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna and those who guard their private parts

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna And those who guard their private parts. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna And those who guard their private parts (Refer to Verse 23:5.) The chaste - those who practice the due control of the sex urge. Chastity is prescribed for both, among men as well as women. See 23:5.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna (except from their spouses and their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy;

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,1 for indeed, they are not to be blamed. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna Save unto their wives or those whom their right hands possess for then verily they are not to be blamed See 70:29

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna but whoever seeks beyond that —it is they who are the transgressors)

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna But whoso seeketh beyond this, these are they who are the transgressors See 70:29

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna and those who keep their trusts and covenants,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna And those who, unto their pledges and covenants, are faithful (Refer to Verse 2:177; 5:1.) See 70:29

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ wa-alladhīna hum bishahādātihim qāimūna and those who are observant of their testimonies,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ wa-alladhīna hum bishahādātihim qāimūna And those who are in their testimonies upright. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ wa-alladhīna hum bishahādātihim qāimūna And those who in their testimonies are firm Strictly impartial and upright in giving evidence, be that against one's own kith and kin or a friend or a foe.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūna and those who are watchful of their prayers.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūna And those who (carefully) maintain their prayer. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūna And those who, at their (regular) prayers careful (Refer to Verse 23:9.) Those who guard their prayers, i.e., those who are always mindful against missing any of the prescribed prayers. The Seventh Holy Imam Musa Ibn Jafar Al-Kazim says "Our 'Shias', i.e., the devotees of the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt, are always regular in offering the fifty-one 'rak'ats', (i.e., units) of prayers (the 17 compulsory (Wajib) and the 34 optional (Sunnat). To see the best and the perfect model of one possessing this quality in the maximum possible degree of it, one should see the Holy Imam Husayn at Karbala who, in the worst circumstances in the valley of death, under the swords and the sabres of the enemy and under the shower of arrows from the devil's forces, offered his…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُكْرَمُونَ ulāika fī jannātin muk'ramūna They will be in gardens, held in honour.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُكْرَمُونَ ulāika fī jannātin muk'ramūna They will be in gardens,1 honored. See 70:19

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُكْرَمُونَ ulāika fī jannātin muk'ramūna Those shall be in the gardens, (duly) honoured (Refer to Verse 23:10; 23:11.) The honourable ones of Paradise are only those who fulfil the above conditions of faith and conduct.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ famāli alladhīna kafarū qibalaka muh'ṭiʿīna What is the matter with the faithless that they scramble toward you

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ famāli alladhīna kafarū qibalaka muh'ṭiʿīna So what is (the matter) with those who disbelieve, hastening (from) before you, (O Muḥammad). So, what is the matter with those disbelievers, before you Muhti'i (70:36). On the right and on the left, 'Izin (70:37). Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight (70:38). But no! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know (70:39). But no! I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that surely We are Abl (70:40). To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun (70:41). So, leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised (70:42). The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly…

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ famāli alladhīna kafarū qibalaka muh'ṭiʿīna But what hath happened unto the disbelievers that they hasten on around you The disbelievers rejecting the belief in the hereafter, ridiculed it and when the blissful life in the hereafter was described to them in details, they mocked at it further and pretended to run a race for it.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli ʿizīna from the left and the right in batches?

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli ʿizīna (To sit) on (your) right and (your) left in separate groups?1 See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli ʿizīna On the right hand and on the left hand, in groups? See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmin Does each man among them hope to enter the garden of bliss?

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmin Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure? See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmin What! Coveteth every man (Everyone.) of them to enter the Garden of Bliss? See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ kallā innā khalaqnāhum mimmā yaʿlamūna Never! Indeed We created them from what they know.1

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ kallā innā khalaqnāhum mimmā yaʿlamūna No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.1 See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ kallā innā khalaqnāhum mimmā yaʿlamūna By no means! for We have created them (Men created of sperm.) of (the base matter) what they know! Created of the dirty drop of the sperm. Man has nothing great in the animal aspect of his existence, for he is one among the base ones of living things. The only means or the way by which he can rise above the other creatures, is the development or the progress in the spiritual vistas. Those who defied the Truth, ridiculed it, opposed the Holy Prophet, persecuted him, or displeased him even in the least, are still the mere evolution of the dirty drop of semen and have never risen above the animal state of their existence1.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūna So I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We are able

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūna So I swear by the Lord of (all) risings and settings1 that indeed We are able. See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūna But nay! I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, (that) We are certainly able (Refer to Verses 55:17; 7:137; 37:5.) God displays the splendour of His Glory which the world witnesses, from the sunrise and the sunset from the 365 different points every solar year1. About calling to witness see also the following Verses: 56:75; 69:38; 75:1; 75:2; 81:15; 82:6; 84:16; 86:11; 90:1; 91:1; 100:1.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ ʿalā an nubaddila khayran min'hum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna to replace them by [others] better than them and We are not to be outmaneuvered.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ ʿalā an nubaddila khayran min'hum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone. See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ ʿalā an nubaddila khayran min'hum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna To substitute (in their stead) better ones than them, and We shall not be overtaken (Defeated.) See 70:40

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna So leave them to gossip and play until they encounter their day, which they are promised:

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised. See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna So thou leave them (to themselves) to remain in discoursing (in falsehood), and in (vanity) sporting, until they come face to face on the Day which has been promised (unto them) Those adamant in their disbelief and determined never to yield to any argument or reasoning and are persistent in their disbelief, must necessarily be left to be engrossed^, in the vain thoughts and deeds, to be brought to realise by the ultimate end which they are sure to meet.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَى نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūna the day when they emerge from the graves, hastening, as if racing toward a target,

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَى نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūna The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.1 See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَى نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūna On that Day they shall come forth from their graves in haste, as if they were hastening unto a signpost See 70:42

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūna with a humbled look [in their eyes], overcast by abasement. That is the day they had been promised.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūna Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised. See 70:36

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūna With their eyes cast down, disgrace covering them; That is the Day which they were promised! See 70:42

item.title: Al-Maaida:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَوْفُوْۤا بِالْعُقُودِ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُمْ بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّي الصَّيْدِ وَأَنْتُمْ حُرُمٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū awfū bil-ʿuqūdi uḥillat lakum bahīmatu l-anʿāmi illā mā yut'lā ʿalaykum ghayra muḥillī l-ṣaydi wa-antum ḥurumun inna l-laha yaḥkumu mā yurīdu O you who have faith! Keep your agreements. You are permitted animals of grazing livestock, disallowing game while you are in pilgrim sanctity.1 Indeed Allah decrees whatever He desires.

item.title: Al-Maaida:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَوْفُوْۤا بِالْعُقُودِ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُمْ بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّي الصَّيْدِ وَأَنْتُمْ حُرُمٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū awfū bil-ʿuqūdi uḥillat lakum bahīmatu l-anʿāmi illā mā yut'lā ʿalaykum ghayra muḥillī l-ṣaydi wa-antum ḥurumun inna l-laha yaḥkumu mā yurīdu O you who have believed, fulfill (all) contracts.1 Lawful for you are the animals of grazing livestock except for that which is recited to you (in this Qur’ān) - hunting not being permitted while you are in the state of iḥrām.2 Indeed, Allah ordains what He intends.

item.title: Al-Maaida:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَوْفُوْۤا بِالْعُقُودِ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُمْ بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّي الصَّيْدِ وَأَنْتُمْ حُرُمٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū awfū bil-ʿuqūdi uḥillat lakum bahīmatu l-anʿāmi illā mā yut'lā ʿalaykum ghayra muḥillī l-ṣaydi wa-antum ḥurumun inna l-laha yaḥkumu mā yurīdu O' ye who believe! Fulfil the contracts (Covenant, Pacts, Agreements, Promises) made (by you); lawful are made for you (the grass eating) quadrupeds except those which are recited unto you, not allowing the game while ye are under (the prescribed) pilgrimage restrictions, Verily, God commandeth whatever He intendeth (Refer to Verses 2:177; 70:32; 3:92.) . 'Uqud' meaning, covenants, contracts, agreements, engagements, promises, leagues, treaties; be that with man or God, or with any of His Apostles, or with each other. This ordinance makes it crystal clear what importance Islam gives to the welfare and…

item.title: Al-Maaida:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُحِلُّوْۤا شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ وَلَا الشَّهْرَ الْحَرَامَ وَلَا الْهَدْيَ وَلَا الْقَلَائِدَ وَلَا ءَامِّينَ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَرِضْوَانًا وَإِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَاصْطَادُوا وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَءَانُ قَوْمٍ أَنْ صَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ أَنْ تَعْتَدُوْۤا وَتَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوْۤا عَلَى الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuḥillū shaʿāira l-lahi walā l-shahra l-ḥarāma walā l-hadya walā l-qalāida walā āmmīna l-bayta l-ḥarāma yabtaghūna faḍlan min rabbihim wariḍ'wānan wa-idhā ḥalaltum fa-iṣ'ṭādū walā yajrimannakum shanaānu qawmin an ṣaddūkum ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi an taʿtadū wataʿāwanū ʿalā l-biri wal-taqwā walā taʿāwanū ʿalā l-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi O you who have faith! Do not violate Allah's sacraments, neither the sacred month,1 nor the offering,2 nor the necklaces, nor those bound3 for the Sacred House who seek their Lord's grace and [His] pleasure. But…

item.title: Al-Maaida:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran

item.title: Al-Maaida:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةُ وَالدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ وَالْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَالْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَالْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَالنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَا أَكَلَ السَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى النُّصُبِ وَأَنْ تَسْتَقْسِمُوا بِالْأَزْلَامِ ذَلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ الْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَاخْشَوْنِ الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الْإِسْلَامَ دِينًا فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ فِي مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِإِثْمٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ ḥurrimat ʿalaykumu l-maytatu wal-damu walaḥmu l-khinzīri wamā uhilla lighayri l-lahi bihi wal-mun'khaniqatu wal-mawqūdhatu wal-mutaradiyatu wal-naṭīḥatu wamā akala l-sabuʿu illā mā dhakkaytum wamā dhubiḥa ʿalā l-nuṣubi wa-an tastaqsimū bil-azlāmi dhālikum fis'qun l-yawma ya-isa alladhīna kafarū min dīnikum falā takhshawhum wa-ikh'shawni l-yawma akmaltu lakum dīnakum wa-atmamtu ʿalaykum niʿ'matī waraḍītu lakumu l-is'lāma dīnan famani uḍ'ṭurra fī makhmaṣatin ghayra mutajānifin li-ith'min fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun You are prohibited carrion, blood, the flesh of swine, and what has been offered to other than Allah,…

item.title: Al-Maaida:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُونَكَ مَاذَا أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ قُلْ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ وَمَا عَلَّمْتُمْ مِنَ الْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِينَ تُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ اللَّهُ فَكُلُوْۤا مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ yasalūnaka mādhā uḥilla lahum qul uḥilla lakumu l-ṭayibātu wamā ʿallamtum mina l-jawāriḥi mukallibīna tuʿallimūnahunna mimmā ʿallamakumu l-lahu fakulū mimmā amsakna ʿalaykum wa-udh'kurū is'ma l-lahi ʿalayhi wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi They ask you as to what is lawful to them. Say, 'All the good things are lawful to you.' As for what you have taught hunting dogs [to catch], teaching them out of what Allah has taught you, eat of what they catch for you and mention Allah's Name over it, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is swift at reckoning.

So eat of what they catch for you, and mention the name of Allah upon it, and fear Allah." Indeed, Allah is swift in account. They ask you what is lawful for them. Say: Lawful unto you are At-Tayyibat…

item.title: Al-Maaida:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran

item.title: Al-Maaida:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ وَطَعَامُ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ حِلٌّ لَكُمْ وَطَعَامُكُمْ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ إِذَا ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِي أَخْدَانٍ وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِالْإِيمَانِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ وَهُوَ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ al-yawma uḥilla lakumu l-ṭayibātu waṭaʿāmu alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba ḥillun lakum waṭaʿāmukum ḥillun lahum wal-muḥ'ṣanātu mina l-mu'mināti wal-muḥ'ṣanātu mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum idhā ātaytumūhunna ujūrahunna muḥ'ṣinīna ghayra musāfiḥīna walā muttakhidhī akhdānin waman yakfur bil-īmāni faqad ḥabiṭa ʿamaluhu wahuwa fī l-ākhirati mina l-khāsirīna This day (all) good foods have been made lawful, and the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you and your food is lawful for them. And (lawful in marriage are) chaste women from among the believers and chaste women from among those who were given the Scripture before you,…

item.title: Al-Maaida:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ وَطَعَامُ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ حِلٌّ لَكُمْ وَطَعَامُكُمْ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ إِذَا ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِي أَخْدَانٍ وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِالْإِيمَانِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ وَهُوَ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ al-yawma uḥilla lakumu l-ṭayibātu waṭaʿāmu alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba ḥillun lakum waṭaʿāmukum ḥillun lahum wal-muḥ'ṣanātu mina l-mu'mināti wal-muḥ'ṣanātu mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum idhā ātaytumūhunna ujūrahunna muḥ'ṣinīna ghayra musāfiḥīna walā muttakhidhī akhdānin waman yakfur bil-īmāni faqad ḥabiṭa ʿamaluhu wahuwa fī l-ākhirati mina l-khāsirīna This day have been made lawful for you (all) good things; and the food (As per the sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad As Sadiq the word 'Ta'aam' is restricted to which is made of grains and not of any meat, for what is slaughtered by them is not allowed in Islam. (AP)) of…

item.title: Al-Maaida:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ وَامْسَحُوا بِرُءُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ جُنُبًا فَاطَّهَّرُوا وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوْۤا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ مِنْهُ مَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيَجْعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ حَرَجٍ وَلَكِنْ يُرِيدُ لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ وَلِيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā qum'tum ilā l-ṣalati fa-igh'silū wujūhakum wa-aydiyakum ilā l-marāfiqi wa-im'saḥū biruūsikum wa-arjulakum ilā l-kaʿbayni wa-in kuntum junuban fa-iṭṭahharū wa-in kuntum marḍā aw ʿalā safarin aw jāa aḥadun minkum mina l-ghāiṭi aw lāmastumu l-nisāa falam tajidū māan fatayammamū ṣaʿīdan ṭayyiban fa-im'saḥū biwujūhikum wa-aydīkum min'hu mā yurīdu l-lahu liyajʿala ʿalaykum min ḥarajin walākin yurīdu liyuṭahhirakum waliyutimma niʿ'matahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tashkurūna O you who have faith! When you stand up for prayer, wash your faces and your hands up…

item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ وَامْسَحُوا بِرُءُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ جُنُبًا فَاطَّهَّرُوا وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوْۤا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ مِنْهُ مَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيَجْعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ حَرَجٍ وَلَكِنْ يُرِيدُ لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ وَلِيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā qum'tum ilā l-ṣalati fa-igh'silū wujūhakum wa-aydiyakum ilā l-marāfiqi wa-im'saḥū biruūsikum wa-arjulakum ilā l-kaʿbayni wa-in kuntum junuban fa-iṭṭahharū wa-in kuntum marḍā aw ʿalā safarin aw jāa aḥadun minkum mina l-ghāiṭi aw lāmastumu l-nisāa falam tajidū māan fatayammamū ṣaʿīdan ṭayyiban fa-im'saḥū biwujūhikum wa-aydīkum min'hu mā yurīdu l-lahu liyajʿala ʿalaykum min ḥarajin walākin yurīdu liyuṭahhirakum waliyutimma niʿ'matahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tashkurūna O' ye who believe! when ye get ready unto prayers, wash ye your faces and your hands (Including…

item.title: Al-Maaida:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَاقَهُ الَّذِي وَاثَقَكُمْ بِهِ إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ wa-udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum wamīthāqahu alladhī wāthaqakum bihi idh qul'tum samiʿ'nā wa-aṭaʿnā wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Remember Allah's blessing upon you and His covenant with which He has bound you when you said, 'We hear and obey.' And be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: Al-Maaida:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَاقَهُ الَّذِي وَاثَقَكُمْ بِهِ إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ wa-udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum wamīthāqahu alladhī wāthaqakum bihi idh qul'tum samiʿ'nā wa-aṭaʿnā wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant with which He bound you when you said, "We hear and we obey"; and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts. And remember Allah's favor to you and His covenant with which He bound you when you said: "We hear and we obey." And have Taqwa of Allah. Verily, Allah is All-Knower of that which is in the breasts (5:7). O you who believe! Stand out firmly for Allah as just witnesses; and let not the enmity and hatred of others make you avoid justice. Be just,…

item.title: Al-Maaida:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَاقَهُ الَّذِي وَاثَقَكُمْ بِهِ إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ wa-udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum wamīthāqahu alladhī wāthaqakum bihi idh qul'tum samiʿ'nā wa-aṭaʿnā wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri And remember ye the bounties of God on you, and His covenant He hath bound you with, when ye said "We have heard (Thy Commandment) and we have obeyed (it sincerely)-," And fear ye God; Verily, God knoweth whatever is (hidden) in your breasts (hearts) (See note to the last clause of Verse 5:3. Refer to Verses 48:10; 48:18.) . The reference to the covenant here is generally interpreted as to the oath of fidelity taken at 'Aqabah' or the swearing of the allegiance at 'Hudaibiyah.' But the event must be more recent than the reference made in Verses 48:10; 48:18. But…

item.title: Al-Maaida:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كُونُوْۤا قَوَّامِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَاءَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَءَانُ قَوْمٍ عَلَى أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْۤا اعْدِلُوْۤا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kūnū qawwāmīna lillahi shuhadāa bil-qis'ṭi walā yajrimannakum shanaānu qawmin ʿalā allā taʿdilū iʿ'dilū huwa aqrabu lilttaqwā wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna O you who have faith! Be maintainers, as witnesses for the sake of Allah, of justice,1 and ill feeling for a people should never lead you to be unfair. Be fair; that is nearer to Godwariness, and be wary of Allah. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: Al-Maaida:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كُونُوْۤا قَوَّامِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَاءَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَءَانُ قَوْمٍ عَلَى أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْۤا اعْدِلُوْۤا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kūnū qawwāmīna lillahi shuhadāa bil-qis'ṭi walā yajrimannakum shanaānu qawmin ʿalā allā taʿdilū iʿ'dilū huwa aqrabu lilttaqwā wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm for Allah, witnesses in justice, and do not let the hatred of a people prevent you from being just. Be just; that is nearer to righteousness. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is (fully) Aware of what you do. See 5:7

item.title: Al-Maaida:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كُونُوْۤا قَوَّامِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَاءَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَءَانُ قَوْمٍ عَلَى أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْۤا اعْدِلُوْۤا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kūnū qawwāmīna lillahi shuhadāa bil-qis'ṭi walā yajrimannakum shanaānu qawmin ʿalā allā taʿdilū iʿ'dilū huwa aqrabu lilttaqwā wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna O' ye who believe! be always upright for God, bearing witness with justice, and let not hatred of a people incite you not to act equitably; Act ye equitably that is nearer to piety (This makes obvious the importance of piety.) , Fear ye God; Verily God is (fully) Aware of what (all) ye do (Refer to Verses 4:135, 2:190, 5:2, 3:17.) . The insistence on being just and impartial without any consideration at all of any love for or enmity against, any group or community is one…

item.title: Al-Maaida:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ waʿada l-lahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun Allah has promised those who have faith and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: Al-Maaida:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ waʿada l-lahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds (that) for them there is forgiveness and great reward. See 5:7

item.title: Al-Maaida:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ waʿada l-lahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun God hath promised those who believe and do good deeds, (that there is) for them pardon and great recompense. See 5:8

item.title: Al-Maaida:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi As for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, they shall be the inmates of hell.

item.title: Al-Maaida:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi But those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those are the companions of Hellfire. See 5:7

item.title: Al-Maaida:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi And (as far) those who disbelieve and belie Our signs (Reference to disbelief in any apostle or any of the Holy Imams of the Ahl Al-Bayt and the miracles wrought by the holy ones - and in the heavenly Scriptures - as the Word of God.) , these are the companions of the Hell-fire. See 5:8

item.title: Al-Maaida:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَنْ يَبْسُطُوْۤا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh hamma qawmun an yabsuṭū ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum ʿankum wa-ittaqū l-laha waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna O you who have faith! Remember Allah's blessing upon you when a people set out to extend their hands against you, but He withheld their hands from you, and be wary of Allah, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: Al-Maaida:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَنْ يَبْسُطُوْۤا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh hamma qawmun an yabsuṭū ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum ʿankum wa-ittaqū l-laha waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when a people determined to extend their hands (in aggression) against you, but He withheld their hands from you; and fear Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely. See 5:7

item.title: Al-Maaida:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَنْ يَبْسُطُوْۤا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh hamma qawmun an yabsuṭū ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum ʿankum wa-ittaqū l-laha waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna O' ye who believe! remember ye God's bounties on you, when a people had determined to stretch forth their hands towards (Against or to hurt.) you, but He withheld their hands from you; So fear God; and upon God let the faithful rely. The attempts of the enemies to kill the Holy Prophet and to wipe the Muslim community out of existence are too many to be recorded here. Commentators generally think that the reference is to the attempt made by 'Bani Nazir' to put an end to the life of the Holy Prophet.…

item.title: Al-Maaida:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَيْتُمُ الزَّكَاةَ وَءَامَنْتُمْ بِرُسُلِي وَعَزَّرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ walaqad akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa banī is'rāīla wabaʿathnā min'humu ith'nay ʿashara naqīban waqāla l-lahu innī maʿakum la-in aqamtumu l-ṣalata waātaytumu l-zakata waāmantum birusulī waʿazzartumūhum wa-aqraḍtumu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan la-ukaffiranna ʿankum sayyiātikum wala-ud'khilannakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru faman kafara baʿda dhālika minkum faqad ḍalla sawāa l-sabīli Certainly Allah took a pledge from the Children of Israel, and We raised among them twelve chiefs. And Allah said, 'I am with you! Surely, if you maintain the prayer and give the zakāt and have faith in My apostles and support them and lend Allah a good loan, I…

item.title: Al-Maaida:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَيْتُمُ الزَّكَاةَ وَءَامَنْتُمْ بِرُسُلِي وَعَزَّرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ walaqad akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa banī is'rāīla wabaʿathnā min'humu ith'nay ʿashara naqīban waqāla l-lahu innī maʿakum la-in aqamtumu l-ṣalata waātaytumu l-zakata waāmantum birusulī waʿazzartumūhum wa-aqraḍtumu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan la-ukaffiranna ʿankum sayyiātikum wala-ud'khilannakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru faman kafara baʿda dhālika minkum faqad ḍalla sawāa l-sabīli And Allah had already taken a covenant from the Children of Israel, and We delegated from among them twelve leaders. And Allah said, "I am with you. If you establish prayer and give zakāh and believe in My messengers and support them and loan Allah a goodly loan,1 I will…

item.title: Al-Maaida:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَيْتُمُ الزَّكَاةَ وَءَامَنْتُمْ بِرُسُلِي وَعَزَّرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ walaqad akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa banī is'rāīla wabaʿathnā min'humu ith'nay ʿashara naqīban waqāla l-lahu innī maʿakum la-in aqamtumu l-ṣalata waātaytumu l-zakata waāmantum birusulī waʿazzartumūhum wa-aqraḍtumu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan la-ukaffiranna ʿankum sayyiātikum wala-ud'khilannakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru faman kafara baʿda dhālika minkum faqad ḍalla sawāa l-sabīli And certainly did take God, a covenant from the children of Israel and We raised up from among them Twelve chieftains (Rot. Deut 26/17-19. Refer to Verses 2:40; 7:57; 2:245; 57:18; 73:20; 64:17.) ; and said God: "Verily, I am with you; if ye keep up prayer and pay the…

item.title: Al-Maaida:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ مِيثَاقَهُمْ لَعَنَّاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا قُلُوبَهُمْ قَاسِيَةً يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَنْ مَوَاضِعِهِ وَنَسُوْۤا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى خَائِنَةٍ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِنْهُمْ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاصْفَحْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ fabimā naqḍihim mīthāqahum laʿannāhum wajaʿalnā qulūbahum qāsiyatan yuḥarrifūna l-kalima ʿan mawāḍiʿihi wanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkirū bihi walā tazālu taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā khāinatin min'hum illā qalīlan min'hum fa-uʿ'fu ʿanhum wa-iṣ'faḥ inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muḥ'sinīna Then, because of their breaking their covenant We cursed them and made their hearts hard: they pervert words from their meanings, and have forgotten a part of what they were reminded. You will not cease to learn of some of their treachery, excepting a few of them. Yet excuse them and forbear. Indeed Allah loves the virtuous.

item.title: Al-Maaida:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ مِيثَاقَهُمْ لَعَنَّاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا قُلُوبَهُمْ قَاسِيَةً يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَنْ مَوَاضِعِهِ وَنَسُوْۤا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى خَائِنَةٍ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِنْهُمْ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاصْفَحْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ fabimā naqḍihim mīthāqahum laʿannāhum wajaʿalnā qulūbahum qāsiyatan yuḥarrifūna l-kalima ʿan mawāḍiʿihi wanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkirū bihi walā tazālu taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā khāinatin min'hum illā qalīlan min'hum fa-uʿ'fu ʿanhum wa-iṣ'faḥ inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muḥ'sinīna So for their breaking of the covenant We cursed them and made their hearts hardened. They distort words from their (proper) places (i.e., usages) and have forgotten a portion of that of which they were reminded.1 And you will still observe deceit among them, except a few of them. But pardon them and overlook (their misdeeds). Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good. See 5:12

item.title: Al-Maaida:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ مِيثَاقَهُمْ لَعَنَّاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا قُلُوبَهُمْ قَاسِيَةً يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَنْ مَوَاضِعِهِ وَنَسُوْۤا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى خَائِنَةٍ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِنْهُمْ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاصْفَحْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ fabimā naqḍihim mīthāqahum laʿannāhum wajaʿalnā qulūbahum qāsiyatan yuḥarrifūna l-kalima ʿan mawāḍiʿihi wanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkirū bihi walā tazālu taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā khāinatin min'hum illā qalīlan min'hum fa-uʿ'fu ʿanhum wa-iṣ'faḥ inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muḥ'sinīna But for their breaking their covenant; We cursed them and made their hearts hard; they (Consequently.) shift the words (of the Scripture) from their places (Their original positions.) , and have forgotten (Neglected – Abandoned.) a part of what they were admonished with, and nor wilt thou cease to be informed of deceit (The forgeries.) from among them, except (from) a few of them, so forgive them and pass over them; Verily, God loveth the beneficent.…

item.title: Al-Maaida:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّا نَصَارٰی أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَهُمْ فَنَسُوْۤا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَسَوْفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَصْنَعُونَ wamina alladhīna qālū innā naṣārā akhadhnā mīthāqahum fanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkirū bihi fa-aghraynā baynahumu l-ʿadāwata wal-baghḍāa ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wasawfa yunabbi-uhumu l-lahu bimā kānū yaṣnaʿūna Also from those who say, 'We are Christians,' We took their pledge; but they forgot a part of what they were reminded. So We stirred up enmity and hatred among them until the Day of Resurrection, and soon Allah will inform them concerning what they had been doing.

item.title: Al-Maaida:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّا نَصَارٰی أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَهُمْ فَنَسُوْۤا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَسَوْفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَصْنَعُونَ wamina alladhīna qālū innā naṣārā akhadhnā mīthāqahum fanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkirū bihi fa-aghraynā baynahumu l-ʿadāwata wal-baghḍāa ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wasawfa yunabbi-uhumu l-lahu bimā kānū yaṣnaʿūna And from those who say, "We are Christians" We took their covenant; but they forgot a portion of that of which they were reminded.1 So We caused among them2 animosity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. And Allah is going to inform them about what they used to do. See 5:12

item.title: Al-Maaida:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّا نَصَارٰی أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَهُمْ فَنَسُوْۤا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهِ فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَسَوْفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَصْنَعُونَ wamina alladhīna qālū innā naṣārā akhadhnā mīthāqahum fanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkirū bihi fa-aghraynā baynahumu l-ʿadāwata wal-baghḍāa ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wasawfa yunabbi-uhumu l-lahu bimā kānū yaṣnaʿūna And of those (also) who say "Verily, We are Nazerenes (Christians - believers in Jesus of Nazareth - Jesus was born in Nazareth (near Jerusalem).) ", We did take their covenant, but they have forgotten (Neglected – Abandoned.) a portion of what they were admonished with, therefore we stirred up among them enmity and hatred (to last) till the day of Resurrection; And soon will God inform them of what they have been doing." The covenant with the Christians is implied in the prophecy made about the advent of the…

item.title: Al-Maaida:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا كُنْتُمْ تُخْفُونَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ نُورٌ وَكِتَابٌ مُبِينٌ yāahla l-kitābi qad jāakum rasūlunā yubayyinu lakum kathīran mimmā kuntum tukh'fūna mina l-kitābi wayaʿfū ʿan kathīrin qad jāakum mina l-lahi nūrun wakitābun mubīnun O People of the Book! Certainly Our Apostle has come to you, clarifying for you much of what you used to hide of the Book, and excusing many [an offense of yours]. Certainly there has come to you a light from Allah, and a manifest Book.

item.title: Al-Maaida:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا كُنْتُمْ تُخْفُونَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ نُورٌ وَكِتَابٌ مُبِينٌ yāahla l-kitābi qad jāakum rasūlunā yubayyinu lakum kathīran mimmā kuntum tukh'fūna mina l-kitābi wayaʿfū ʿan kathīrin qad jāakum mina l-lahi nūrun wakitābun mubīnun O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger making clear to you much of what you used to conceal of the Scripture and overlooking much.1 There has come to you from Allah a light and a clear Book (i.e., the Qur’ān). O People of the Scripture! Now has come to you Our Messenger explaining to you much of that which you used to hide from the Scripture and passing over much. Indeed, there has come to you from Allah a light and a plain Book (5:15). Wherewith Allah guides all…

item.title: Al-Maaida:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا كُنْتُمْ تُخْفُونَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ نُورٌ وَكِتَابٌ مُبِينٌ yāahla l-kitābi qad jāakum rasūlunā yubayyinu lakum kathīran mimmā kuntum tukh'fūna mina l-kitābi wayaʿfū ʿan kathīrin qad jāakum mina l-lahi nūrun wakitābun mubīnun O' People of the Book! Indeed, Our Apostle, (Muhammad) had come unto you, manifesting unto you much of what ye had been concealing of the Book, and passing over much; Indeed hath come unto you from God, Light (Refer to Verse 4:174 Said the Holy Prophet: 'I and Ali are of one and the same light' 'Noor' referable to both of them.) and a Manifesting (Explaining things clearly and in all their details.) Book (Qur'an). 'Ye hide' implies both what is suppressed or concealed and also what is distorted or misrepresented. 'You' stands for…

item.title: Al-Maaida:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَهْدِي بِهِ اللَّهُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَهُ سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَيُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ yahdī bihi l-lahu mani ittabaʿa riḍ'wānahu subula l-salāmi wayukh'rijuhum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'nihi wayahdīhim ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin With it Allah guides those who follow [the course of] His pleasure to the ways of peace, and brings them out from darkness into light by His will, and guides them to a straight path.

item.title: Al-Maaida:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَهْدِي بِهِ اللَّهُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَهُ سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَيُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ yahdī bihi l-lahu mani ittabaʿa riḍ'wānahu subula l-salāmi wayukh'rijuhum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'nihi wayahdīhim ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin By which Allah guides those who pursue His pleasure to the ways of peace1 and brings them out from darknesses into the light, by His permission, and guides them to a straight path. See 5:15

item.title: Al-Maaida:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَهْدِي بِهِ اللَّهُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَهُ سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَيُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ yahdī bihi l-lahu mani ittabaʿa riḍ'wānahu subula l-salāmi wayukh'rijuhum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'nihi wayahdīhim ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Whereby God guideth him who followeth His pleasure, into the ways of peace and taketh (Refer to Verses 2:257; 24:35; 65:11.) them out from darkness towards the Light by His will and guideth (Refer to Verse 1:6.) them to the path (that is) straight. 'Iznihi', i.e., By His will. Not freed or compelled by anything but at His own independent will. (M.S.). Shows that both sides of the right path - 'Ghulo' (exaggeration or overstepping the limits) 'Taqseer' i.e., falling short of the limits - both are abyss of darkness. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Maaida:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قُلْ فَمَنْ يَمْلِكُ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُهْلِكَ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ laqad kafara alladhīna qālū inna l-laha huwa l-masīḥu ub'nu maryama qul faman yamliku mina l-lahi shayan in arāda an yuh'lika l-masīḥa ib'na maryama wa-ummahu waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā yakhluqu mā yashāu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun They are certainly faithless who say, 'Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary.' Say, 'Who can avail anything against Allah should He wish to destroy the Messiah, son of Mary, and his mother, and everyone upon the earth?' To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them. He creates…

item.title: Al-Maaida:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قُلْ فَمَنْ يَمْلِكُ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُهْلِكَ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ laqad kafara alladhīna qālū inna l-laha huwa l-masīḥu ub'nu maryama qul faman yamliku mina l-lahi shayan in arāda an yuh'lika l-masīḥa ib'na maryama wa-ummahu waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā yakhluqu mā yashāu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun They have certainly disbelieved who say that Allah is Christ, the son of Maryam. Say, "Then who could prevent Allah at all if He had intended to destroy Christ, the son of Maryam, or his mother or everyone on the earth?" And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is…

item.title: Al-Maaida:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قُلْ فَمَنْ يَمْلِكُ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُهْلِكَ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ laqad kafara alladhīna qālū inna l-laha huwa l-masīḥu ub'nu maryama qul faman yamliku mina l-lahi shayan in arāda an yuh'lika l-masīḥa ib'na maryama wa-ummahu waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā yakhluqu mā yashāu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Certainly, infidels are they who say; "Verily, God, He is Messiah (Refer note of Verse 4:171.) , son of Mary;" Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Who could hold anything against God, if He intendeth to destroy the Messiah son of Mary and his mother and (all) that is in the earth together? for unto God belongeth…

item.title: Al-Maaida:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى نَحْنُ أَبْنَؤُا اللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّاؤُهُ قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُمْ بِذُنُوبِكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ waqālati l-yahūdu wal-naṣārā naḥnu abnāu l-lahi wa-aḥibbāuhu qul falima yuʿadhibukum bidhunūbikum bal antum basharun mimman khalaqa yaghfiru liman yashāu wayuʿadhibu man yashāu walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru The Jews and the Christians say, 'We are Allah's children and His beloved ones.' Say, 'Then why does He punish you for your sins?' Rather you are humans from among His creatures. He forgives whomever He wishes, and punishes whomever He wishes, and to Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, and toward Him is the return.

item.title: Al-Maaida:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى نَحْنُ أَبْنَؤُا اللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّاؤُهُ قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُمْ بِذُنُوبِكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ waqālati l-yahūdu wal-naṣārā naḥnu abnāu l-lahi wa-aḥibbāuhu qul falima yuʿadhibukum bidhunūbikum bal antum basharun mimman khalaqa yaghfiru liman yashāu wayuʿadhibu man yashāu walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru But the Jews and the Christians say, "We are the children of Allah and His beloved." Say, "Then why does He punish you for your sins?" Rather, you are human beings from among those He has created. He forgives whom He wills, and He punishes whom He wills. And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and to Him is the (final) destination. See 5:17

item.title: Al-Maaida:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى نَحْنُ أَبْنَؤُا اللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّاؤُهُ قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُمْ بِذُنُوبِكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ waqālati l-yahūdu wal-naṣārā naḥnu abnāu l-lahi wa-aḥibbāuhu qul falima yuʿadhibukum bidhunūbikum bal antum basharun mimman khalaqa yaghfiru liman yashāu wayuʿadhibu man yashāu walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru And the Jews and the Christians say: "We are the sons of God and His beloved ones;" Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Why then doth He punish you for your sins? Nay, ye are but men of those He hath created; He pardoneth whom He pleaseth, and He punisheth whom He pleaseth; and unto God belongeth the dominion of the heavens and the earth; and what is between them (too); and unto Him is the ultimate return (of all) (Refer…

item.title: Al-Maaida:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ عَلَى فَتْرَةٍ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ أَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا مَا جَاءَنَا مِنْ بَشِيرٍ وَلَا نَذِيرٍ فَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بَشِيرٌ وَنَذِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ yāahla l-kitābi qad jāakum rasūlunā yubayyinu lakum ʿalā fatratin mina l-rusuli an taqūlū mā jāanā min bashīrin walā nadhīrin faqad jāakum bashīrun wanadhīrun wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun O People of the Book! Certainly Our Apostle has come to you, clarifying [the Divine teachings] for you after a gap in [the appearance of] the apostles, lest you should say, 'There did not come to us any bearer of good news nor any warner.' Certainly there has come to you a bearer of good news and a warner. And Allah has power over all things.

item.title: Al-Maaida:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
