Some commentators say that this Verse and the next, i.e., the 5th mentioning the cleaning of the clothes and shunning the uncleanliness refer to cleaning and shunning the dirt and the filth which the disbelievers used to throw upon him. 'Thiyab' Lit., a cloth which covers the body but here as interpreted by the Ahl Al-Bayt is used in a very wide sense, meaning anything that surrounds human inner self which includes the character surrounding it and the body surrounding…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ wal-ruj'za fa-uh'jur and keep away from all impurity!

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ wal-ruj'za fa-uh'jur And uncleanliness1 avoid. See 74:1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ wal-ruj'za fa-uh'jur And every kind of abomination, Shun it! The injunctions addressed to the Holy Prophet, i.e., the representative of his followers. Orders meant for the people are given to their leader. The commands are meant for the believers to discipline them to qualify themselves for the higher regions of the state of spiritual bliss. The dirt or anything that diverts man from God such as idols, etc., should be avoided. Both these ideas are presented in Qur'an in different ways1. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِرُ walā tamnun tastakthiru Do not grant a favour seeking a greater gain,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِرُ walā tamnun tastakthiru And do not confer favor to acquire more.1 See 74:1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِرُ walā tamnun tastakthiru And bestow not favours (expecting) that thou mayest receive them back increased Do not oblige considering your contribution to be great. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ walirabbika fa-iṣ'bir and be patient for the sake of your Lord.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ walirabbika fa-iṣ'bir But for your Lord be patient. See 74:1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ walirabbika fa-iṣ'bir And for (the sake of) thy Lord (endure every hardship) in patience! See 74:5

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ fa-idhā nuqira fī l-nāqūri When the Trumpet will be sounded,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ fa-idhā nuqira fī l-nāqūri And when the trumpet is blown. See 74:1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ fa-idhā nuqira fī l-nāqūri For when the Trumpet is beaten (Blown Refers to Resurrection.) Reference is to dawn of the Day of Judgment and what man will then experience particularly the evil fate of the disbelievers who reject the faith and ridicule the believers for their belief in the day of requital. It is said that Zararah Ibn Adna recited these Verses thrice and gave out a loud cry and died fearing the Day of Judgment. It indicates the nature of the punishment connected with the unsuccessful, strive to go up and this applies to those who are unduly ambitious in their life. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ fadhālika yawma-idhin yawmun ʿasīrun that day will be a day of hardship,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ fadhālika yawma-idhin yawmun ʿasīrun That Day will be a difficult day. See 74:1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ fadhālika yawma-idhin yawmun ʿasīrun That, that shall be the Day of distress (for those who disbelieve) See 74:8

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ ʿalā l-kāfirīna ghayru yasīrin not at all easy for the faithless.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ ʿalā l-kāfirīna ghayru yasīrin For the disbelievers - not easy. See 74:1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ ʿalā l-kāfirīna ghayru yasīrin Unto the disbelievers (it shall be) anything other than ease! See 74:8

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا dharnī waman khalaqtu waḥīdan Leave Me [to deal] with him whom I created alone,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا dharnī waman khalaqtu waḥīdan Leave Me with the one I created alone.1 Leave Me alone (to deal) with whom I created lonely (74:11). And then granted him resources in abundance (74:12). And children attending (74:13). And made life smooth and comfortable for him (74:14). After all that he desires that I should give more (74:15). Nay! Verily, he has been opposing Our Ayat (74:16). I shall force him to Sa'ud (74:17). Verily, he thought and plotted (74:18). So let him be cursed, how he plotted (74:19). And once more let him be cursed, how he plotted (74:20). Then he thought (74:21). Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way (74:22). Then he turned back, and was proud (74:23). Then he said: "This is nothing but magic from that of old (74:24). "This is…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا dharnī waman khalaqtu waḥīdan Leave Me (to deal with) him whom I created (bare and) alone! When the beginning Verses of the Sura Ha-Meem (H. M.) i.e., chapter 40 were revealed, the Holy Prophet recited them in the Mosque and seeing Waleed Ibn Mughaira seated near the Mosque, he recited the Verses repeatedly. Waleed got up and returned to his people and told them: "I tell you the truth that I have heard from Muhammad (the Holy Prophet) words which could he neither of any man nor of any jinn. It has the melody which the words of none in the world possess. It is glorious and very high, and it triumphs over the words of all the mortals" Having said this, Waleed returned home. The pagans felt sad, thinking that Waleed has been converted to…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَمْدُودًا wajaʿaltu lahu mālan mamdūdan and then furnished him with extensive means,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَمْدُودًا wajaʿaltu lahu mālan mamdūdan And to whom I granted extensive wealth. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَمْدُودًا wajaʿaltu lahu mālan mamdūdan And unto whom I granted wealth in abundance! God had given Waleed abundant wealth and a large number of sons, none of them he possessed before, and he was very proud of his prosperity.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا wabanīna shuhūdan and [gave him] sons to be at his side,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا wabanīna shuhūdan And children present (with him). See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا wabanīna shuhūdan And sons abiding in his presence! See 74:12

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَهَّدْتُ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا wamahhadttu lahu tamhīdan and facilitated [all matters] for him.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَهَّدْتُ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا wamahhadttu lahu tamhīdan And spread (everything) before him, easing (his life). See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَهَّدْتُ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا wamahhadttu lahu tamhīdan And unto whom I made (life) adjustably smooth! See 74:12

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ thumma yaṭmaʿu an azīda Still he is eager that I should give him more.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ thumma yaṭmaʿu an azīda Then he desires that I should add more. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ thumma yaṭmaʿu an azīda And yet desireth he that I should further add! See 74:12

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِءَايَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا kallā innahu kāna liāyātinā ʿanīdan No indeed! He is an obstinate opponent of Our signs.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِءَايَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا kallā innahu kāna liāyātinā ʿanīdan No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِءَايَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا kallā innahu kāna liāyātinā ʿanīdan Never (it shall be)! for unto Our signs he was a foe! See 74:12

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا sa-ur'hiquhu ṣaʿūdan Soon I will overwhelm him with hardship.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا sa-ur'hiquhu ṣaʿūdan I will cover him with arduous torment. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا sa-ur'hiquhu ṣaʿūdan Soon will I make him afflicted of a severe punishment (Refer to Verse 72:17.) 'Sa'ood' also refers to a particularly distressing kind of punishment in the hereafter. And some commentators say that Waleed had the taste of the wrath of God even in this life. Before his death, i.e., three of his sons deserted him and joined the ranks of the Muslims and the rest perished and he was deprived of his wealth and ultimately died in utter misery, disgrace and poverty.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ innahu fakkara waqaddara Indeed he reflected and decided.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ innahu fakkara waqaddara Indeed, he thought and deliberated.1 See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ innahu fakkara waqaddara Verily, he thought and determined This refers as to how Waleed acted in the presence of his people and what he uttered taunting against the Holy Prophet and the Holy Qur'an.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ faqutila kayfa qaddara Perish he, how he decided!

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ faqutila kayfa qaddara So may he be destroyed (for) how he deliberated. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ faqutila kayfa qaddara But may he be ruined how he determined See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ thumma qutila kayfa qaddara Again, perish he, how he decided!

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ thumma qutila kayfa qaddara Then may he be destroyed (for) how he deliberated. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ thumma qutila kayfa qaddara Again may be he ruined how he determined! See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ thumma naẓara Then he looked;

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ thumma naẓara Then he considered (again). See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ thumma naẓara Then looked he around! See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ thumma ʿabasa wabasara then he frowned and scowled.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ thumma ʿabasa wabasara Then he frowned and scowled. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ thumma ʿabasa wabasara Then frowned he and scowled! See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ thumma adbara wa-is'takbara Then he went away disdainfully,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ thumma adbara wa-is'takbara Then he turned back and was arrogant. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ thumma adbara wa-is'takbara Then turned he his back and swelled in pride! See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ faqāla in hādhā illā siḥ'run yu'tharu saying, 'It1 is nothing but magic handed down.2

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ faqāla in hādhā illā siḥ'run yu'tharu And said, "This is not but magic imitated (from others). See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ faqāla in hādhā illā siḥ'run yu'tharu Then said he: "This is naught but sorcery from of old (Fascinating or the people fascinated of.) !" See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ in hādhā illā qawlu l-bashari It is nothing but the speech of a human being.'

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ in hādhā illā qawlu l-bashari This is not but the word of a human being." See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ in hādhā illā qawlu l-bashari This is naught but the word of a human being! See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ sa-uṣ'līhi saqara Soon I shall cast him into Saqar.1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ sa-uṣ'līhi saqara I will drive him into Saqar.1 See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ sa-uṣ'līhi saqara Soon will I cast him into hell! See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ wamā adrāka mā saqaru And what will show you what is Saqar?

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ wamā adrāka mā saqaru And what can make you know what is Saqar? See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ wamā adrāka mā saqaru And what will make him realize what hell is? See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ lā tub'qī walā tadharu It neither spares nor leaves [anything].

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ lā tub'qī walā tadharu It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing (unburned). See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ lā tub'qī walā tadharu It leaveth not nor it spareth (aught) See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِلْبَشَرِ lawwāḥatun lil'bashari It burns the skin.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِلْبَشَرِ lawwāḥatun lil'bashari Altering (i.e., blackening) the skins. See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِلْبَشَرِ lawwāḥatun lil'bashari It shrivelleth (Alter.) a human body! See 74:18

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ ʿalayhā tis'ʿata ʿashara There are nineteen [keepers] over it.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ ʿalayhā tis'ʿata ʿashara Over it are nineteen (angels). See 74:11

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ ʿalayhā tis'ʿata ʿashara Above it (guardians) are nineteen! The number nineteen refers to the nineteen angels active for hell. Some commentators say that they refer to nineteen kinds of faculties endowed in man which if misused will drag the individual to the hell-fire.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِيمَانًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَذَا مَثَلًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٰی لِلْبَشَرِ wamā jaʿalnā aṣḥāba l-nāri illā malāikatan wamā jaʿalnā ʿiddatahum illā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū liyastayqina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wayazdāda alladhīna āmanū īmānan walā yartāba alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wal-mu'minūna waliyaqūla alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-kāfirūna mādhā arāda l-lahu bihādhā mathalan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu wamā yaʿlamu junūda rabbika illā huwa wamā hiya illā dhik'rā lil'bashari We have assigned only angels as keepers of the Fire, and We have made their number merely a stumbling block for the faithless, and that those…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِيمَانًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَذَا مَثَلًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٰی لِلْبَشَرِ wamā jaʿalnā aṣḥāba l-nāri illā malāikatan wamā jaʿalnā ʿiddatahum illā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū liyastayqina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wayazdāda alladhīna āmanū īmānan walā yartāba alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wal-mu'minūna waliyaqūla alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-kāfirūna mādhā arāda l-lahu bihādhā mathalan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu wamā yaʿlamu junūda rabbika illā huwa wamā hiya illā dhik'rā lil'bashari And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِيمَانًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَذَا مَثَلًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٰی لِلْبَشَرِ wamā jaʿalnā aṣḥāba l-nāri illā malāikatan wamā jaʿalnā ʿiddatahum illā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū liyastayqina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wayazdāda alladhīna āmanū īmānan walā yartāba alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wal-mu'minūna waliyaqūla alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-kāfirūna mādhā arāda l-lahu bihādhā mathalan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu wamā yaʿlamu junūda rabbika illā huwa wamā hiya illā dhik'rā lil'bashari We have made not the guardians of the fire other than angels, and We have made not the number save as a trial for those who…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ kallā wal-qamari No indeed! By the Moon!

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ kallā wal-qamari No! By the moon. See 74:31

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ kallā wal-qamari Nay! By the moon! An oath is generally taken by things solemn and great. Next to the sun, the moon is supposed by the general public of mankind as a great luminary. Besides, for the people of the earth, the Moon is one of the great signs of God which gives the world cool and pleasant light and its reflected light with its daily well- regulated diminishing and increase, is a sign of the divine control of the reflection of the Sun's light for the seasonal benefit for the working of the natural phenomenon concerning the vegetable world. To the poets and the mystics, the moon and its light are of special effect. Even to this day, to the pagans, the moon is a mystery, and it is worshipped as a deity. The Hindus (in India)…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ wa-al-layli idh adbara By the night when it recedes!

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ wa-al-layli idh adbara And (by) the night when it departs. See 74:31

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ wa-al-layli idh adbara And by the night when it retreateth! To an actively and correctly thinking mind the regular alternation of day and night, is not a small sign of the supreme authority of the Almighty Author of the Universe. Hence the constant changing in the nature of the day as well as the night are mentioned in solemn declarations.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā asfara By the dawn when it brightens!

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā asfara And (by) the morning when it brightens. See 74:31

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā asfara And by the morn when it brighteneth! The dawn after the darkness of the night is practically the renewal of the life in the world.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ innahā la-iḥ'dā l-kubari Indeed it is one of the greatest [signs]

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ innahā la-iḥ'dā l-kubari Indeed, it (i.e., the Fire) is of the greatest (afflictions). See 74:31

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ innahā la-iḥ'dā l-kubari Verily it (the Hell) is one of the grievous woes (Refer to Verse 74:31.) ! There is no limit to the number of the signs of God and the day of the Final Requital is the greatest of God's signs.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَذِيرًا لِلْبَشَرِ nadhīran lil'bashari —a warner to all humans,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَذِيرًا لِلْبَشَرِ nadhīran lil'bashari As a warning to humanity. See 74:31

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَذِيرًا لِلْبَشَرِ nadhīran lil'bashari A warning (it is) unto mankind! The message of Islam is for the human world as a whole and not for any particular community, clan, tribe, or nation.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ liman shāa minkum an yataqaddama aw yata-akhara [alike] for those of you who like to advance ahead and those who would linger behind.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ liman shāa minkum an yataqaddama aw yata-akhara To whoever wills among you to proceed1 or stay behind. See 74:31

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ liman shāa minkum an yataqaddama aw yata-akhara Unto him among you who desireth to go forward (in goodness) or to remain behind Again, asserts that man is responsible for the re-action - by the choice given. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ kullu nafsin bimā kasabat rahīnatun Every soul is hostage to what it has earned,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ kullu nafsin bimā kasabat rahīnatun Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.1 Every person is a pledge for what he has earned (74:38). Except those on the Right (74:39). In Gardens they will ask one another (74:40). About criminals (and they will say to them) (74:41). "What has caused you to enter Hell? (74:42). They will say: "We were not of those who used to offer the Salah, (74:43). "Nor did we feed the poor; (74:44). "And we used to speak falsehood with vain speakers (74:45). "And we used to deny the Day of Recompense, (74:46). "Until Al-Yaqin came to us (74:47). So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them (74:48). Then what is wrong with them that they turn away from admonition (74:49). As if they were…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ kullu nafsin bimā kasabat rahīnatun Every soul (Again asserts that man is responsible for the reaction by the choice given. (AP). Refer to Verse 52:21.) , for what it earned, is held in pledge! Every soul1 is under a commitment to goodness and is pledged with responsibilities. Man can redeem himself by his own good deeds in this life. There is no shifting of the responsibility2.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ illā aṣḥāba l-yamīni except the People of the Right Hand.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ illā aṣḥāba l-yamīni Except the companions of the right,1. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ illā aṣḥāba l-yamīni Save the people of the Right hand (Refer to Verses 56:8; 56:27; 56:38.) It is expressly said that the people of the Right hand in the life hereafter, are not fettered by their deeds in this life - 'Raheen' means each one reaped the result of his action. Hence the people of the Right hand there are not an exception. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fī jannātin yatasāalūna [They will be] in gardens, questioning

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fī jannātin yatasāalūna (Who will be) in gardens, questioning each other. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fī jannātin yatasāalūna In gardens shall they be, asking each other See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ʿani l-muj'rimīna concerning the guilty:

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ʿani l-muj'rimīna About the criminals. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ʿani l-muj'rimīna About the guilty ones See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ mā salakakum fī saqara 'What drew you into Hell?'

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ mā salakakum fī saqara (And asking them), "What put you into Saqar?" See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ mā salakakum fī saqara What hath brought you into the hell! See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ qālū lam naku mina l-muṣalīna They will answer, 'We were not among those who prayed.1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ qālū lam naku mina l-muṣalīna They will say, "We were not of those who prayed. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ qālū lam naku mina l-muṣalīna They shall say: "We were not of those who offered the regular prayers (to God)" See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ walam naku nuṭ'ʿimu l-mis'kīna Nor did we feed the poor.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ walam naku nuṭ'ʿimu l-mis'kīna Nor did we used to feed the poor. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ walam naku nuṭ'ʿimu l-mis'kīna And we used not to feed the poor! See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ wakunnā nakhūḍu maʿa l-khāiḍīna We used to gossip along with the gossipers,

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ wakunnā nakhūḍu maʿa l-khāiḍīna And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged (in it). See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ wakunnā nakhūḍu maʿa l-khāiḍīna And used we to talk vanities with the vain talkers! See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ wakunnā nukadhibu biyawmi l-dīni and we used to deny the Day of Retribution,1

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ wakunnā nukadhibu biyawmi l-dīni And we used to deny the Day of Recompense. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ wakunnā nukadhibu biyawmi l-dīni And used we to belie the Day of Judgment! See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ ḥattā atānā l-yaqīnu until death came to us.'

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ ḥattā atānā l-yaqīnu Until there came to us the certainty (i.e., death)." See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ ḥattā atānā l-yaqīnu Till came upon us the Certainty (death) (The one thing which is certain & never fails, is death. Refer to Verse 15:99.) See 74:39

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا تَنْفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ famā tanfaʿuhum shafāʿatu l-shāfiʿīna So the intercession of the intercessors will not avail them.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا تَنْفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ famā tanfaʿuhum shafāʿatu l-shāfiʿīna So there will not benefit them the intercession of (any) intercessors. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا تَنْفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ famā tanfaʿuhum shafāʿatu l-shāfiʿīna So, shall avail them not the intercession (Refer to Verses 2:255; 4:85; 10:3; 19:87; 20:109; 21:28; 34:23.) of the intercessors! By 'Shafiyeen', i.e., intercessors, mean only those false deities and the bogus leaders of any faith in whom the people might rest their hopes of intercession on their behalf. But the great ones in the true faith who have endeared themselves to God to the extent of earning the right of intercession for the unintentional sinners among the faithful, are quite different and they are there to help those who err in their practical life owing to the natural weakness in them without any intention of rebelling against the authority of the Lord or without any wilful violation of the prescribed laws1. This Verse indicates and implies that there are intercessors whose…

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ famā lahum ʿani l-tadhkirati muʿ'riḍīna What is the matter with them that they evade the Reminder

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ famā lahum ʿani l-tadhkirati muʿ'riḍīna Then what is (the matter) with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ famā lahum ʿani l-tadhkirati muʿ'riḍīna What hath happened then (unto them) that they turn aside from the warning See 74:48

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُسْتَنْفِرَةٌ ka-annahum ḥumurun mus'tanfiratun as if they were terrified asses

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُسْتَنْفِرَةٌ ka-annahum ḥumurun mus'tanfiratun As if they were alarmed donkeys. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُسْتَنْفِرَةٌ ka-annahum ḥumurun mus'tanfiratun As if they were asses affrighted See 74:48

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَّتْ مِنْ قَسْوَرَةٍ farrat min qaswaratin fleeing from a lion?

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَّتْ مِنْ قَسْوَرَةٍ farrat min qaswaratin Fleeing from a lion? See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَّتْ مِنْ قَسْوَرَةٍ farrat min qaswaratin Fleeing from a lion ('Qaswara' is used to mean also – archers.) See 74:48

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُؤْتٰی صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَةً bal yurīdu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yu'tā ṣuḥufan munasharatan Rather everyone of them desires to be given unrolled scriptures [from Allah].

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُؤْتٰی صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَةً bal yurīdu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yu'tā ṣuḥufan munasharatan Rather, every person among them desires that he1 would be given scriptures spread about.2 See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُؤْتٰی صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَةً bal yurīdu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yu'tā ṣuḥufan munasharatan Nay! But willeth every one of them that he may be given (the heavenly book) in open pages spread out (Refer to Verses 2:118; 17:93.) The pagans wanted that to every one of them God should send through his angels a separate book in open scrolls addressed to the name of the individual, commanding each one separately to obey the Holy Prophet and follow him1.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ لَا يَخَافُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ kallā bal lā yakhāfūna l-ākhirata No indeed! Rather they do not fear the Hereafter.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ لَا يَخَافُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ kallā bal lā yakhāfūna l-ākhirata No! But they do not fear the Hereafter. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ لَا يَخَافُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ kallā bal lā yakhāfūna l-ākhirata Nay! But they fear not the hereafter! See 74:52

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ kallā innahu tadhkiratun No indeed! It is indeed a reminder.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ kallā innahu tadhkiratun No! Indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is a reminder. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ kallā innahu tadhkiratun Nay! Verily it is a Reminder! The Holy Qur'an is a reminder of the truth already revealed through the Apostles of old containing admonition and glad tidings to the devotees of truth and the doers of good deeds.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ faman shāa dhakarahu So let anyone who wishes remember it.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ faman shāa dhakarahu Then whoever wills will remember it. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ faman shāa dhakarahu So whosoever willeth may mind it See 74:54

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ wamā yadhkurūna illā an yashāa l-lahu huwa ahlu l-taqwā wa-ahlu l-maghfirati And they will not remember unless Allah wishes. He is worthy of [your] being wary [of Him] and He is worthy to forgive.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ wamā yadhkurūna illā an yashāa l-lahu huwa ahlu l-taqwā wa-ahlu l-maghfirati And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for (granting) forgiveness. See 74:38

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ wamā yadhkurūna illā an yashāa l-lahu huwa ahlu l-taqwā wa-ahlu l-maghfirati They will mind it not unless God willeth; Worthy is He to be feared. And worthy is He to seek refuge to For 'Taqwa' or for the 'Muttaqeen' see 2:2; 2:177. Note that the truth having been revealed, there is no compulsion in faith. To adopt the right or the wrong course, is left to the individual choice. See 2:256; 76:3. 'Willeth' here points out that man's action is the outcome of his own personal will, but man's will is subordinate to God's will but on the phenomenon of re-action - Refer to note on action and re-action in Sura 1. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ qad samiʿa l-lahu qawla allatī tujādiluka fī zawjihā watashtakī ilā l-lahi wal-lahu yasmaʿu taḥāwurakumā inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun Allah has certainly heard the speech of her who pleads with you about her husband and complains to Allah. Allah hears the conversation between the two of you. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ qad samiʿa l-lahu qawla allatī tujādiluka fī zawjihā watashtakī ilā l-lahi wal-lahu yasmaʿu taḥāwurakumā inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues (i.e., pleads) with you, (O Muḥammad), concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah. And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing. قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا Indeed Allah has heard the statement of her that disputes with you concerning her husband, She added, "Her husband was Aws bin As-Samit."

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ qad samiʿa l-lahu qawla allatī tujādiluka fī zawjihā watashtakī ilā l-lahi wal-lahu yasmaʿu taḥāwurakumā inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun Indeed, hath God heard the statement of her who pleadeth with thee about her husband and petitioneth unto God; and verily God heareth the contention of you two; Verily God is All-Hearing, All-Seeing (Refer to Verse 33:4.) . Khaula Binte Tha'laba, wife of Aus son of Samit, one day when Khaula had just finished her prayers, her husband wanted her for sexual enjoyment which she resented. Aus pronounced 'Zihar', a pre-Islamic social custom that if a husband says to his wife 'Thou art to me as the back of my mother', thereafter the husband was relieved of the conjugal obligation, not bound to support…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ مَا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنْكَرًا مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ alladhīna yuẓāhirūna minkum min nisāihim mā hunna ummahātihim in ummahātuhum illā allāī waladnahum wa-innahum layaqūlūna munkaran mina l-qawli wazūran wa-inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūrun As for those of you who repudiate their wives by ẓihār,1 they are not their mothers; their mothers are only those who bore them, and indeed they utter an outrageous utterance and a lie. Indeed Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ مَا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنْكَرًا مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ alladhīna yuẓāhirūna minkum min nisāihim mā hunna ummahātihim in ummahātuhum illā allāī waladnahum wa-innahum layaqūlūna munkaran mina l-qawli wazūran wa-inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūrun Those who pronounce ẓihār1 among you (to separate) from their wives - they are not (consequently) their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving. Those among you who make their wives unlawful to them by Zihar they cannot be their mothers. None can be their mothers except those who gave them birth. And verily, they utter an ill word and a lie. And verily, Allah is Oft-Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving (58:2). And those…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ مَا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنْكَرًا مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ alladhīna yuẓāhirūna minkum min nisāihim mā hunna ummahātihim in ummahātuhum illā allāī waladnahum wa-innahum layaqūlūna munkaran mina l-qawli wazūran wa-inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūrun Those of you who abandon any of their wives through 'Zihar' (i.e. a husband in anger declaring as a vow that his wife would thereafter be to him as his mother to deprive her of the sexual enjoyment, as a punishment to her (See 'Fiqh').) (by saying "Be thou unto me as my mother's back"); they are not their mothers; their mothers are only those who gave them birth! and certainly they utter a word hateful and false; and verily God is Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving (Refer to Verse 33:4.) . See 58:1

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوْا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا ذَلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wa-alladhīna yuẓāhirūna min nisāihim thumma yaʿūdūna limā qālū fataḥrīru raqabatin min qabli an yatamāssā dhālikum tūʿaẓūna bihi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun Those who repudiate their wives by ẓihār and then retract what they have said, shall set free a slave before they may touch each other. This you are advised [to carry out], and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوْا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا ذَلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wa-alladhīna yuẓāhirūna min nisāihim thumma yaʿūdūna limā qālū fataḥrīru raqabatin min qabli an yatamāssā dhālikum tūʿaẓūna bihi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then (wish to) go back on what they said - then (there must be) the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Aware of what you do. See 58:2

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوْا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا ذَلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wa-alladhīna yuẓāhirūna min nisāihim thumma yaʿūdūna limā qālū fataḥrīru raqabatin min qabli an yatamāssā dhālikum tūʿaẓūna bihi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun And those who abandon any of their wives through 'Zihar' and then would recall what they have uttered, they may free (Note how far Islam prescribes charity to expatiate sins.) a captive ere they touch each other; that ye are admonished (to conform); and Verily God, of whatever ye do, is Well-Aware. See 58:1

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ذٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu shahrayni mutatābiʿayni min qabli an yatamāssā faman lam yastaṭiʿ fa-iṭ'ʿāmu sittīna mis'kīnan dhālika litu'minū bil-lahi warasūlihi watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun alīmun He who can not afford [to free a slave] shall fast for two successive months before they may touch each other. If he cannot [do so], he shall feed sixty needy persons. This, that you may have faith in Allah and His Apostle. These are Allah's bounds, and there is a painful punishment for the faithless.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ذٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu shahrayni mutatābiʿayni min qabli an yatamāssā faman lam yastaṭiʿ fa-iṭ'ʿāmu sittīna mis'kīnan dhālika litu'minū bil-lahi warasūlihi watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun alīmun And he who does not find (a slave) - then a fast for two months consecutively1 before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe (completely) in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits (set by) Allah. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment. See 58:2

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ذٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu shahrayni mutatābiʿayni min qabli an yatamāssā faman lam yastaṭiʿ fa-iṭ'ʿāmu sittīna mis'kīnan dhālika litu'minū bil-lahi warasūlihi watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun alīmun But whosoever findeth not the means (to free a captive), he may fast for two months consecutively ere they touch each other; and whosoever is not able to do (so) shall feed sixty needy ones; that is in order that ye may believe in God and His Apostle; And these are the bounds set of God; And for the disbeliever there shall be a painful chastisement. See 58:1

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ كُبِتُوْۤا كَمَا كُبِتَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu kubitū kamā kubita alladhīna min qablihim waqad anzalnā āyātin bayyinātin walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun muhīnun Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle will be subdued just as were subdued those before them. We have certainly sent down manifest signs, and there is a humiliating punishment for the faithless.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ كُبِتُوْۤا كَمَا كُبِتَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu kubitū kamā kubita alladhīna min qablihim waqad anzalnā āyātin bayyinātin walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun muhīnun Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment. Verily, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be disgraced as those before them were disgraced. And We have sent down clear Ayat. And for the disbelievers is a disgraceful torment (58:5). On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah has kept account of it, while they have forgotten it. And Allah is Witness over all things (58:6). Have…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ كُبِتُوْۤا كَمَا كُبِتَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu kubitū kamā kubita alladhīna min qablihim waqad anzalnā āyātin bayyinātin walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun muhīnun Verily, those who oppose (Compare this to the defiance against the demand for pen and paper, by the Holy Prophet on the eve of his departure.) God and His Apostle, shall be humiliated as were humiliated those before them; and indeed We have sent down signs clear; and for the disbelievers there shall be a humiliating chastisement. The humiliation or the frustration of the enemies of the Holy Prophet referred to here, is that which the enemy suffered at the battle of 'Khandaq' (the Ditch) - (Ahzab) - (M.S.). It refers also to the bigger and the graver penalty in the hereafter and on…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū aḥṣāhu l-lahu wanasūhu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun The day when Allah will raise them all together, He will inform them about what they have done. Allah has kept account of it, while they forgot it, and Allah is witness to all things.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū aḥṣāhu l-lahu wanasūhu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness.1 See 58:5

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū aḥṣāhu l-lahu wanasūhu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun On the day when God will raise them all to life and inform them of what they did; God hath encompassed (everything) in (His) record; while they (might) have forgotten it; and God is over all things a Witness. Everyone will see the true value and the inward aspects of all his deeds which were not manifest ever before1.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ نَجْوَى ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَا أَدْنَى مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوْۤا ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ alam tara anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi mā yakūnu min najwā thalāthatin illā huwa rābiʿuhum walā khamsatin illā huwa sādisuhum walā adnā min dhālika walā akthara illā huwa maʿahum ayna mā kānū thumma yunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun Have you not regarded that Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth? There is no secret talk among three, but He is their fourth [companion], nor among five but He is their sixth, nor less than that, nor…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ نَجْوَى ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَا أَدْنَى مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوْۤا ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ alam tara anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi mā yakūnu min najwā thalāthatin illā huwa rābiʿuhum walā khamsatin illā huwa sādisuhum walā adnā min dhālika walā akthara illā huwa maʿahum ayna mā kānū thumma yunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them,1 nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ نَجْوَى ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَا أَدْنَى مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوْۤا ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ alam tara anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi mā yakūnu min najwā thalāthatin illā huwa rābiʿuhum walā khamsatin illā huwa sādisuhum walā adnā min dhālika walā akthara illā huwa maʿahum ayna mā kānū thumma yunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun Seest thou not that God knoweth whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth? nowhere taketh place any secret counsel between three (persons) but He is fourth of them, nor between five, but He is the sixth, nor (between) less than that, nor…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نُهُوْۤا عَنِ النَّجْوَى ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوْۤا عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَاجَوْنَ بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَاءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ alam tara ilā alladhīna nuhū ʿani l-najwā thumma yaʿūdūna limā nuhū ʿanhu wayatanājawna bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli wa-idhā jāūka ḥayyawka bimā lam yuḥayyika bihi l-lahu wayaqūlūna fī anfusihim lawlā yuʿadhibunā l-lahu bimā naqūlu ḥasbuhum jahannamu yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-maṣīru Have you not regarded those who were forbidden from secret talks1 but again resumed what they had been forbidden from, and hold secret talks [imbued] with sin and transgression and disobedience to the Apostle? And when they2 come to you they greet you with that with which Allah never greeted you, and they say to themselves,3 'Why does not Allah punish us for what…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نُهُوْۤا عَنِ النَّجْوَى ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوْۤا عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَاجَوْنَ بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَاءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ alam tara ilā alladhīna nuhū ʿani l-najwā thumma yaʿūdūna limā nuhū ʿanhu wayatanājawna bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli wa-idhā jāūka ḥayyawka bimā lam yuḥayyika bihi l-lahu wayaqūlūna fī anfusihim lawlā yuʿadhibunā l-lahu bimā naqūlu ḥasbuhum jahannamu yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-maṣīru Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation (i.e., ridicule and conspiracy) and then return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that (word) by which Allah does not greet you1 and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نُهُوْۤا عَنِ النَّجْوَى ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوْۤا عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَاجَوْنَ بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَاءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ alam tara ilā alladhīna nuhū ʿani l-najwā thumma yaʿūdūna limā nuhū ʿanhu wayatanājawna bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli wa-idhā jāūka ḥayyawka bimā lam yuḥayyika bihi l-lahu wayaqūlūna fī anfusihim lawlā yuʿadhibunā l-lahu bimā naqūlu ḥasbuhum jahannamu yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-maṣīru Seest thou not those who have been forbidden secret counsels, yet return they unto what hath been forbidden and hold they secret counsels to sin and revolt and towards disobedience to the Apostle, and when come they unto thee, they greet thee, not as greeteth thee God; and say they in their selves "Why doth God chastise not for what we say?" Enough for…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا تَنَاجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā tanājaytum falā tatanājaw bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli watanājaw bil-biri wal-taqwā wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna O you who have faith! When you talk secretly, do not hold secret talks [imbued] with sin and aggression and disobedience to the Apostle, but talk secretly in [a spirit of] piety and Godfearing, and be wary of Allah toward whom you will be mustered.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا تَنَاجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā tanājaytum falā tatanājaw bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli watanājaw bil-biri wal-taqwā wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered. See 58:8

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا تَنَاجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā tanājaytum falā tatanājaw bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli watanājaw bil-biri wal-taqwā wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna 'O' ye who believe! When ye counsel among yourselves in secret, then counsel ye not to sin and revolt and disobedience to the Apostle, but counsel ye among yourselves for goodness and restrain (of yourselves against evil)', and fear ye (the wrath of) God unto Whom ye shall all be gathered! Note how far Islam controls the personal morals of the believers even in the private lives. Muslims are forbidden against participating in any secret movement with any evil intent and to be constantly counselling each other on goodness and piety.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا النَّجْوَى مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَيْسَ بِضَارِّهِمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ innamā l-najwā mina l-shayṭāni liyaḥzuna alladhīna āmanū walaysa biḍārrihim shayan illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna Indeed [malicious] secret talks are from Satan, that he may upset the faithful, but he cannot harm them in any way except by Allah's leave, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا النَّجْوَى مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَيْسَ بِضَارِّهِمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ innamā l-najwā mina l-shayṭāni liyaḥzuna alladhīna āmanū walaysa biḍārrihim shayan illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed,1 but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely. See 58:8

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا النَّجْوَى مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَيْسَ بِضَارِّهِمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ innamā l-najwā mina l-shayṭāni liyaḥzuna alladhīna āmanū walaysa biḍārrihim shayan illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna Secret counsels are (Simulated) only by satan (i.e. this is a satanic act.) , that he may cause grief unto those who believe, but he shall harm them not in any way but with the permission of God; and upon God alone depend those who believe. Secret counselling on evil has been condemned as the act of the devil. If any one sees any dreadful dream, the recital of this verse is recommended soon after he awakes and says in continuation of it: - "Allahumma Bi Haqqi Muhammadin wa Aali-Muhammad. Allahumma Salli ala Muhammad wa Aali Muhammad waqeni Sharra ma ra'aitu fi manami" i.e., O' God!…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجَالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا يَفْسَحِ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَإِذَا قِيلَ انْشُزُوْۤا فَانْشُزُوا يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā qīla lakum tafassaḥū fī l-majālisi fa-if'saḥū yafsaḥi l-lahu lakum wa-idhā qīla unshuzū fa-unshuzū yarfaʿi l-lahu alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma darajātin wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun O you who have faith! When you are told, 'Make room,' in sittings, then do make room; Allah will make room for you. And when you are told, 'Rise up!' Do rise up. Allah will raise those of you who have faith and those who have been given knowledge in rank, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجَالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا يَفْسَحِ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَإِذَا قِيلَ انْشُزُوْۤا فَانْشُزُوا يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā qīla lakum tafassaḥū fī l-majālisi fa-if'saḥū yafsaḥi l-lahu lakum wa-idhā qīla unshuzū fa-unshuzū yarfaʿi l-lahu alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma darajātin wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allah will make space for you.1 And when you are told, "Arise,"2 then arise; Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allah is Aware of what you do. O you who believe! When you are told to make room in the assemblies, make room. Allah will give you room. And when you are…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجَالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا يَفْسَحِ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَإِذَا قِيلَ انْشُزُوْۤا فَانْشُزُوا يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā qīla lakum tafassaḥū fī l-majālisi fa-if'saḥū yafsaḥi l-lahu lakum wa-idhā qīla unshuzū fa-unshuzū yarfaʿi l-lahu alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma darajātin wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun 'O' ye who believe! when it is said unto you, 'Make ye room in (your) assemblies! then make ye room, God will make room for you; and when it is said unto you, 'Rise (Get up.) ye up! then rise ye up, God will exalt (you in) ranks (Refer to Verses 4:95; 6:165.) (unto Him), those who believe among you, and those who have been granted knowledge; and God is All-Aware of whatsoever ye do (Refer to Verses 3:7; 3:18;…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nājaytumu l-rasūla faqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqatan dhālika khayrun lakum wa-aṭharu fa-in lam tajidū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun O you who have faith! When you talk secretly to the Apostle, offer a charity before your secret talk. That is better for you and purer. But if you cannot afford [to make the offering], then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nājaytumu l-rasūla faqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqatan dhālika khayrun lakum wa-aṭharu fa-in lam tajidū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun O you who have believed, when you (wish to) privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not (the means) - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. O you who believe! When you (want to) consult the Messenger in private, spend something in charity before your private consultation. That will be better and purer for you. But if you find not (the means for it), then verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (58:12). Are you afraid of spending in charity before your…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nājaytumu l-rasūla faqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqatan dhālika khayrun lakum wa-aṭharu fa-in lam tajidū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun 'O' ye who believe! When ye (wish to) consult in private with the Apostle, then offer some alms before your consultation, that is better for you and purer; but ye find not any means (to do so), then verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful (Refer to Verse 47:38. See note - Since only ''Ali acted on this and none else - this Ordinance was abrogated by the next verse.) . The restriction on the consultation with the Holy Prophet might sound unreasonable to an ordinary lay mind but the serious ones among the intellectuals, in…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوْۤا وَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاٰتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ a-ashfaqtum an tuqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqātin fa-idh lam tafʿalū watāba l-lahu ʿalaykum fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna Were you apprehensive of offering charities before your secret talks? So, as you did not do it, and Allah was clement to you, maintain the prayer and pay the zakāt, and obey Allah and His Apostle. And Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوْۤا وَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاٰتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ a-ashfaqtum an tuqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqātin fa-idh lam tafʿalū watāba l-lahu ʿalaykum fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you, then (at least) establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Aware of what you do. See 58:12

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوْۤا وَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاٰتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ a-ashfaqtum an tuqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqātin fa-idh lam tafʿalū watāba l-lahu ʿalaykum fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna What Restrained (This is practically the condemnation of the niggardliness of the people for to avoid the giving of alms they had stopped consulting the Holy Prophet - the order was withdrawn.) ye that ye give alms before your consultation? Then since ye did it not and God turned (merciful) unto you, then keep ye up (the regular) prayer, and pay ye (the prescribed) poor-rate and obey ye God and His Apostle; and God is All-Aware of what (all) ye do. It was evidently a providential plan to issue the ordinance controlling…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا هُمْ مِنْكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ alam tara ilā alladhīna tawallaw qawman ghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim mā hum minkum walā min'hum wayaḥlifūna ʿalā l-kadhibi wahum yaʿlamūna Have you not regarded those who befriend a people1 at whom Allah is wrathful? They neither belong to you, nor to them, and they swear false oaths [that they are with you] and they know.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا هُمْ مِنْكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ alam tara ilā alladhīna tawallaw qawman ghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim mā hum minkum walā min'hum wayaḥlifūna ʿalā l-kadhibi wahum yaʿlamūna Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know (they are lying). Have you not seen those who take as friends a people upon whom is the wrath of Allah? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to a lie while they know (58:14). Allah has prepared for them a severe torment. Evil indeed is that which they used to do (58:15). They have made their oaths a screen. Thus they hinder (others) from…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا هُمْ مِنْكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ alam tara ilā alladhīna tawallaw qawman ghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim mā hum minkum walā min'hum wayaḥlifūna ʿalā l-kadhibi wahum yaʿlamūna Hast thou not seen those who befriend a people on whom hath been the wrath of God? Thy are neither of your party nor are they of theirs, and swear they for falsehood while they know (what they do) (Refer to Verse 60:13.) . The hypocrites had friendship with the Jews and conveyed the secrets of the believers to them. Among the hypocrites was one Abdullah Ibn Naheel who often used to sit before the Holy Prophet and used to convey to the Jews all the talk which took place with the Holy Prophet. Once the Holy Prophet was seated with his…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna Allah has prepared a severe punishment for them. Evil indeed is what they used to do.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing. See 58:14

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna For them hath prepared God a severe chastisement; Verily, evil is what they do. See 58:14

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ ittakhadhū aymānahum junnatan faṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi falahum ʿadhābun muhīnun They make a shield of their oaths and bar [people] from the way of Allah; so there is a humiliating punishment for them.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ ittakhadhū aymānahum junnatan faṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi falahum ʿadhābun muhīnun They took their (false) oaths as a cover, so they averted (people) from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment. See 58:14

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ ittakhadhū aymānahum junnatan faṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi falahum ʿadhābun muhīnun Make they their oaths a shield (A cover, Refer to Verse 63:2. Refer to the conducts of the hypocrites.) , and obstruct they (others) from the way of God, so for them shall be a shameful chastisement. See 58:14

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ lan tugh'niya ʿanhum amwāluhum walā awlāduhum mina l-lahi shayan ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna Their possessions and children will not avail them in any way against Allah. They shall be the inmates of the Fire and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ lan tugh'niya ʿanhum amwāluhum walā awlāduhum mina l-lahi shayan ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally. See 58:14

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ lan tugh'niya ʿanhum amwāluhum walā awlāduhum mina l-lahi shayan ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna Never shall avail them aught against God, their wealth nor their children; they are fellows of the fire; they shall abide therein. The hypocrites boasted saying that their abundant wealth and the large number of their issues would be of avail to them on the Day of Judgment. This verse was revealed against their false notion.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
