item.description: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayaḥlifūna lahu kamā yaḥlifūna lakum wayaḥsabūna annahum ʿalā shayin alā innahum humu l-kādhibūna The day when Allah will raise them all together, they will swear to Him, just like they swear to you [now], supposing that they stand on something. Look! They are indeed liars!

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayaḥlifūna lahu kamā yaḥlifūna lakum wayaḥsabūna annahum ʿalā shayin alā innahum humu l-kādhibūna On the Day Allah will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are (standing) on something.1 Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars. See 58:14

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayaḥlifūna lahu kamā yaḥlifūna lakum wayaḥsabūna annahum ʿalā shayin alā innahum humu l-kādhibūna On the day when God will raise them all, then will swear they unto Him as they swear unto you, and deem they that it will avail them. Nay! verily they, they are the liars! On the Day of Judgment, the hypocrites would swear upon their being the sincere believers as they did to deceive the Holy Prophet and the believers in their life, but it will be in vain1.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ الشَّيْطَانِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ is'taḥwadha ʿalayhimu l-shayṭānu fa-ansāhum dhik'ra l-lahi ulāika ḥiz'bu l-shayṭāni alā inna ḥiz'ba l-shayṭāni humu l-khāsirūna Satan has prevailed upon them, so he has caused them to forget the remembrance of Allah. They are Satan's confederates. Look! Indeed it is Satan's confederates who are the losers!

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ الشَّيْطَانِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ is'taḥwadha ʿalayhimu l-shayṭānu fa-ansāhum dhik'ra l-lahi ulāika ḥiz'bu l-shayṭāni alā inna ḥiz'ba l-shayṭāni humu l-khāsirūna Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers. See 58:14

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ الشَّيْطَانِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ is'taḥwadha ʿalayhimu l-shayṭānu fa-ansāhum dhik'ra l-lahi ulāika ḥiz'bu l-shayṭāni alā inna ḥiz'ba l-shayṭāni humu l-khāsirūna Satan hath gained hold on them, so he maketh them forget (Those who neglect the daily prayers to note - lest they be listed as the Satan's party.) the remembrance of God; They are Satan's Party; Beware! verily, the party of Satan are the losers. See 58:18

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الْأَذَلِّينَ inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu ulāika fī l-adhalīna Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle —they will be among the most abased.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الْأَذَلِّينَ inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu ulāika fī l-adhalīna Indeed, the ones who oppose Allah and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled. Those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, they will be among those most humiliated (58:20). Allah has decreed: "Verily, I and My Messengers shall be the victorious." Verily, Allah is All-Powerful, Almighty (58:21). You will not find any people who believe in Allah and the Last Day, making friendship with those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even though they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. For such He has written faith in their hearts, and strengthened them with Ruh from Himself. And He will admit them to Gardens under which rivers flow, to dwell therein (forever). Allah is well pleased…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الْأَذَلِّينَ inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu ulāika fī l-adhalīna Verily those who are opposed to God, and His Apostle (Refer to Verse 6:34.) , they shall be of the most humiliated. The reference in this verse to those who opposed God and the Holy Prophet, applies equally to those who go against the Islamic laws and opposed the Holy Prophet, until the end of the world. Apply this verse to those who acted blindly to satisfy their selfish desires in depriving 'Ali and Fatimah and the other members of the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt which act was diametrically opposed to what God had conveyed to His comrades1 through the Holy Prophet and what the Holy Prophet himself had repeatedly told the people about his Ahl Al-Bayt. It is a well-known historic fact that Othman…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِي إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ kataba l-lahu la-aghlibanna anā warusulī inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun Allah has ordained: 'I shall surely prevail, I and My apostles.' Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِي إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ kataba l-lahu la-aghlibanna anā warusulī inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun Allah has written (i.e., decreed), "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might. See 58:20

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِي إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ kataba l-lahu la-aghlibanna anā warusulī inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun God hath decreed: "I shall prevail (Dominate.) , I and My apostles!" Verily God is the All-Strong, the Ever-Prevalent. When after their triumph over the surrounding habitations the Muslims said that very soon God would help us to bring Rome under the sway of Truth (Islam) and the hypocrites said, "Perhaps you imagine Rome and the other countries like those of your environment." Here is the prophecy about the triumph of the Muslims over the other great countries.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ يُوَادُّونَ مَنْ حَادَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا ءَابَاءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَانَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَأَيَّدَهُمْ بِرُوحٍ مِنْهُ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوْۤا عَنْهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ اللَّهِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ lā tajidu qawman yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri yuwāddūna man ḥādda l-laha warasūlahu walaw kānū ābāahum aw abnāahum aw ikh'wānahum aw ʿashīratahum ulāika kataba fī qulūbihimu l-īmāna wa-ayyadahum birūḥin min'hu wayud'khiluhum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu ulāika ḥiz'bu l-lahi alā inna ḥiz'ba l-lahi humu l-muf'liḥūna You will not find a people believing in Allah and the Last Day endearing those who oppose Allah and His Apostle even though they were their own parents, or children, or brothers, or kinsfolk. [For] such, He has…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ يُوَادُّونَ مَنْ حَادَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا ءَابَاءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَانَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَأَيَّدَهُمْ بِرُوحٍ مِنْهُ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوْۤا عَنْهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ اللَّهِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ lā tajidu qawman yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri yuwāddūna man ḥādda l-laha warasūlahu walaw kānū ābāahum aw abnāahum aw ikh'wānahum aw ʿashīratahum ulāika kataba fī qulūbihimu l-īmāna wa-ayyadahum birūḥin min'hu wayud'khiluhum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu ulāika ḥiz'bu l-lahi alā inna ḥiz'ba l-lahi humu l-muf'liḥūna You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their…

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ يُوَادُّونَ مَنْ حَادَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا ءَابَاءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَانَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَأَيَّدَهُمْ بِرُوحٍ مِنْهُ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوْۤا عَنْهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ اللَّهِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ lā tajidu qawman yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri yuwāddūna man ḥādda l-laha warasūlahu walaw kānū ābāahum aw abnāahum aw ikh'wānahum aw ʿashīratahum ulāika kataba fī qulūbihimu l-īmāna wa-ayyadahum birūḥin min'hu wayud'khiluhum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu ulāika ḥiz'bu l-lahi alā inna ḥiz'ba l-lahi humu l-muf'liḥūna Thou shalt find not a people who believe in God and the hereafter befriending those who oppose God and His Apostle, be they even their own fathers, or their sons, or their own brothers, or their kinsmen, they…

item.title: Al-Mulk:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Blessed is He in whose hands is all sovereignty, and He has power over all things.

item.title: Al-Mulk:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent. وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ And indeed We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps, This refers to the stars which have been placed in the heavens, some moving and some stationary. In Allah's statement: وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ and We have made them (as) missiles to drive away the Shayatin, The pronoun 'them' in His statement, "and We have made them" is the same type of statement as the stars being referred to as lamps. This does not mean that they are actually missiles, because the stars in the sky are not thrown. Rather, it is the meteors beneath them that are thrown and they are taken…

item.title: Al-Mulk:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Hallowed is He in Whose hand is the kingdom (of the heaven and the earth), and He, over all things is All-Powerful (Qadeer.) The word i.e., 'Hand' stands for authority, power or might and 'Mulk' means the Kingdom or the Dominion, both visible and invisible to us that which is within the limits of the conception of space and even beyond it. The word 'Mulk' is a very wide and a comprehensive expression which covers anything and everything of matter or energy in the conceptive limits of human intellect and beyond it. This truth about the universal authority of the Lord Creator and the Owner of the Universe is given to educate the human minds against the imaginary or the conjectural dogmas…

item.title: Al-Mulk:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūru He, who created death and life that He may test you [to see] which of you is best in conduct. And He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiving.

item.title: Al-Mulk:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūru (He) who created death and life to test you (as to) which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving. See 67:1

item.title: Al-Mulk:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūru Who created death and life that he may try you (to prove) which of you is best in deeds (Refer to Verses 10:14, 11:7, 18:7, 21:35, 29:3, 38:27, 51:56, 2:28, 40:11.) ; He is the Ever-Prevalent, the Oft-Forgiving Note - Death is mentioned before life, and it is said to be created. If death is to mean the cessation of existence, how could it take effect before the existence itself taking its effect. In 2:28, mankind is told: "How disbelieve ye in God when ye mere dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return" (2:28) Thus death would mean not the cessation of…

item.title: Al-Mulk:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا مَا تَرٰی فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَنِ مِنْ تَفَاوُتٍ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرٰی مِنْ فُطُورٍ alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi l-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūrin He created seven heavens in layers. You do not see any discordance in the creation of the All-beneficent. Look again! Do you see any flaw?

item.title: Al-Mulk:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا مَا تَرٰی فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَنِ مِنْ تَفَاوُتٍ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرٰی مِنْ فُطُورٍ alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi l-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūrin (And) who created seven heavens in layers.1 You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return (your) vision (to the sky); do you see any breaks? See 67:1

item.title: Al-Mulk:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا مَا تَرٰی فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَنِ مِنْ تَفَاوُتٍ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرٰی مِنْ فُطُورٍ alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi l-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūrin Who created the seven heavens layer above layer (Refer to Verses 65:12, 71:15.) : thou seest not in the creation of the Beneficent (God) any defect or incongruity. Then look thou again; Seest thou any gap (To prove the unity, Qur'an advises to refer to the experimental method of repeated observations.) ? The heaven has been created into seven regions and the regions are said to have been arranged as layers one above another1. The arrangement of the heavenly regions and everything in each region is in such perfect order and harmony with one another and the motions of each body in the space…

item.title: Al-Mulk:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-an wahuwa ḥasīrun Look again, once more. Your look will return to you humbled and weary.

item.title: Al-Mulk:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-an wahuwa ḥasīrun Then return (your) vision twice again.1 (Your) vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued. See 67:1

item.title: Al-Mulk:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-an wahuwa ḥasīrun Then repeat thou (thy) gaze again and again, thy gaze shall return unto thee dulled, being Wearied (Refers to the impossibility of the sight passing through the heavens.) It is almost a challenge to man to see, scrutinise or examine not once but repeatedly, for the eye in its travel to examine this fact would only exhaust itself to return dejected. Note, that Islam does not impose any dictated faith but invites every individual to study minutely as might be possible to each one individually, again and again. Even the region which could be seen, are so vast and stretching so far beyond our ken that even with the aid of the most powerful of the implements, our eyes would…

item.title: Al-Mulk:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ walaqad zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba l-saʿīri We have certainly adorned the lowest heaven with lamps, and made them missiles against the devils, and We have prepared for them punishment of the Blaze.

item.title: Al-Mulk:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ walaqad zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba l-saʿīri And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps (i.e., stars) and have made (from) them what is thrown at the devils1 and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze. See 67:1

item.title: Al-Mulk:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ walaqad zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba l-saʿīri Indeed, have We adorned the lower heaven nearest to the world with lamps (i.e., the stars), and We have made them (as) missiles to repulse away the Satans, and We have prepared for them the chastisement of the flaming fire The physical world is divided into seven regions called the seven heavens and the heaven in which is situated the earth, is said to be the lowest heaven which is lighted with the stars1. All these stars, the nearest and the farthest of them and this earth, the sun the moon and the galaxies put together are accommodated in the lowest of the heavens or the regions, the knowledge about the vastness, i.e., the extent of…

item.title: Al-Mulk:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīru For those who defy their Lord is the punishment of hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: Al-Mulk:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīru And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination. And for those who disbelieve in their Lord is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination (67:6). When they are cast therein, they will hear its Shahiq while it is simmering (67:7). It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keepers will ask: Did no warner come to you? (67:8). They will say: "Yes, indeed a warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said: 'Allah never sent down anything; you are only in great error.' (67:9). And they will say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we would not have been among the dwellers…

item.title: Al-Mulk:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīru And for those who disbelieve in their Lord is the chastisement of the hell, and evil is the destination See 67:5

item.title: Al-Mulk:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا فِيهَا سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūru When they are thrown in it, they hear it blaring, as it seethes,

item.title: Al-Mulk:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا فِيهَا سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūru When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a (dreadful) inhaling while it boils up. See 67:6

item.title: Al-Mulk:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا فِيهَا سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūru When they shall be flung into it, they shall hear its roaring as it boileth up (Refer to Verse 11:106.) See 67:5

item.title: Al-Mulk:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīrun almost exploding with rage. Whenever a group is thrown in it, its keepers will ask them, 'Did there not come to you any warner?'

item.title: Al-Mulk:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīrun It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?" See 67:6

item.title: Al-Mulk:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīrun As it would burst with rage; Whenever a group is flung into it, its keepers shall ask them; "Came not there unto you a warner (Refer to Verse 39:71.) ?" See 67:5

item.title: Al-Mulk:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīrin They will say, 'Yes, a warner did come to us, but we impugned [him] and said, 'Allah did not send down anything; you are only in great error.'

item.title: Al-Mulk:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīrin They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'" See 67:6

item.title: Al-Mulk:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīrin They shall say: "Yea! Indeed, a warner did come unto us, but we belied (him) and said we: "God hath sent not down aught, ye are in naught but a vast delusion (Refer to Verse 36:30.) !"'" Here the signs of God, mean the apostles as well as their divinely commissioned deputies the Holy Imams who were also not only rejected but also equally persecuted, mocked and martyred1.

item.title: Al-Mulk:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi l-saʿīri And they will say, 'Had we listened or applied reason, we would not have been among inmates of the Blaze.'

item.title: Al-Mulk:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi l-saʿīri And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze." See 67:6

item.title: Al-Mulk:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi l-saʿīri And they shall say: "Had we but hearkened (unto them) or pondered (over what they said), we would not have been amidst the fellows in the flaming fire" This Verse refers to the failure of man in using his conscience and the discretionary powers, which failure draws the individual to the blazing fire.

item.title: Al-Mulk:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qan li-aṣḥābi l-saʿīri Thus they will admit their sin. So away with the inmates of the Blaze!

item.title: Al-Mulk:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qan li-aṣḥābi l-saʿīri And they will admit their sin, so (it is) alienation1 for the companions of the Blaze. See 67:6

item.title: Al-Mulk:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qan li-aṣḥābi l-saʿīri So shall they confess their sins, but far will be (from mercy) the fellows in blazing fire When passing through the punishment, the disbelievers in the apostles of God and the Holy Imams would not help confessing their folly and their wickedness but that would not be of any avail to them at all for repentance must be with the necessary amendment and then the time or respite for the amendment would have been long over and thus the chance will have long been lost.

item.title: Al-Mulk:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun Indeed for those who fear their Lord in secret there will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: Al-Mulk:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward. Verily, those who fear their Lord unseen, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (67:12). And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it, verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (67:13). Should not He Who has created know? And He is the Most Kind and Courteous, All-Aware (67:14). He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you; so walk in the paths thereof and eat of His provision. And to Him will be the resurrection (67:15). The Reward of those Who Fear their Lord Unseen Allah informs of he who fears standing before his Lord, being frightened about matters between…

item.title: Al-Mulk:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun Verily, those who fear their Lord in secret, for them shall be forgiveness and a great recompense (Refers to the last clause of Verses 35:18, 31:16, 36:11, 50:33.) The fear of God means not only dreading His displeasure and the consequent wrath of His, but also loving Him so heartily and so intensely at heart though He is not seen by the physical eyes or perceived through any of the bodily senses1. Indicates that what is valued with God, is the sincerity in faith and the purity of intention whether declared or not. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mulk:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوْۤا بِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Speak secretly, or do so loudly, indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: Al-Mulk:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوْۤا بِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 67:12

item.title: Al-Mulk:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوْۤا بِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri And conceal ye your word or declare it; Verily, He is the Knower of whatsoever is in the breasts (hearts) See 67:12

item.title: Al-Mulk:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīru Would He who has created not know? And He is the All-attentive, the All-aware.

item.title: Al-Mulk:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīru Does He who created not know,1 while He is the Subtle, the Aware? See 67:12

item.title: Al-Mulk:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīru What! Knoweth not He that created? and He is the Subtle (Lateef.), the All-Aware (Refer to Verses 6:18; 6:103; 11:1; 17:30; 22:59; 24:18; 31:16; 33:34; 35:14; 67:14.) 'Man', i.e., who, or whom - here may be in nominative case meaning who - i.e., What! He Who created - and may also be an objective case meaning - What, whom He has created - and the nominative understood - the latter seems to be more appropriate as a proof in the favour of the statement made in Verse 13. 'Lateef' may be used to mean ''kind' - and also as 'Subtle' - Penetrating - the latter is more appropriate here. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mulk:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوْۤا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوْۤا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū min riz'qihi wa-ilayhi l-nushūru It is He who made the earth tractable for you; so walk on its flanks and eat of His provision, and towards Him is the resurrection.

item.title: Al-Mulk:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوْۤا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوْۤا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū min riz'qihi wa-ilayhi l-nushūru It is He who made the earth tame1 for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection. See 67:12

item.title: Al-Mulk:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوْۤا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوْۤا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū min riz'qihi wa-ilayhi l-nushūru He it is Who made for you the earth subservient (Yielding.) , traVerse ye then its broad sides, and eat ye of His provision; and unto Him (alone) is the return (After death.) The earth has been made usable for the intelligence of man to manage his life affairs concerning his stay in it - 'Zulal' meaning manageable and serviceable, has been used relating to the animals subjected to usage by man1.

item.title: Al-Mulk:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ a-amintum man fī l-samāi an yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūru Are you secure that He who is in the sky will not make the earth swallow you while it quakes?

item.title: Al-Mulk:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ a-amintum man fī l-samāi an yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūru Do you feel secure that He who is above1 would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?2 Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven, will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then it should quake (67:16). Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven, will not send against you a Hasib? Then you shall know how has been My warning (67:17). And indeed those before them rejected, then how terrible was My reproach (67:18). Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out their wings and folding them in? None upholds them except the Most Gracious. Verily, He is the All-Seer…

item.title: Al-Mulk:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ a-amintum man fī l-samāi an yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūru What! deem ye yourself secure of He Who (ruleth) in the heaven (as well) (As well as in the earth.) , that He will cause not the earth to swallow you up (Refer to Verses 17:68, 28:76 - 28:82.) ? Then lo! it shall quake Man has been warned against any false feeling of security in the earthly life against the wrath of God - If God wills the earth on which we live, feeling ourselves safe and secure, would swallow up habitation together through typhoons, earthquakes and tornadoes1. - Heaven is not the physical one - but the spiritual sphere dominating the spheres. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mulk:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ am amintum man fī l-samāi an yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīri Are you secure that He who is in the sky will not unleash upon you a rain of stones? Soon you will know how My warning has been!

item.title: Al-Mulk:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ am amintum man fī l-samāi an yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīri Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how (severe) was My warning. See 67:16

item.title: Al-Mulk:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ am amintum man fī l-samāi an yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīri Or deem ye yourself secure of He Who (ruleth) in the heaven (as well), will send not down upon you a stone-charged violent storm; Then shall ye know how (terrible) My warning is (Refer to Verses 17:68, 29:40.) For the fate of the cities which rebelled against the authority of the Lord and the fate of the people of Lot see 17:68, 29:40.

item.title: Al-Mulk:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīri Certainly those who were before them had denied; but then how was My rebuttal!1

item.title: Al-Mulk:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīri And already had those before them denied, and how (terrible) was My reproach. See 67:16

item.title: Al-Mulk:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīri And indeed belied those before them (My signs): how (terrible) then was My wrath (Refer to Verses 22:42 - 22:44.) See 67:17

item.title: Al-Mulk:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَنُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ awalam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīrun Have they not regarded the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? No one sustains them except the All-beneficent. Indeed He sees best all things.

item.title: Al-Mulk:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَنُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ awalam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīrun Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and (sometimes) folded in? None holds them (aloft) except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing. See 67:16

item.title: Al-Mulk:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَنُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ awalam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīrun Behold they not the birds above them, outstretching (their wings), and contracting (them) (Refer to Verse 24:41.) ? upholdeth them not save the Beneficent (God); for verily He well seeth everything Note how Islam invites man to use his intellect in understanding the glorious existence of the Creator of the Universe, His Power, His Might, His Wisdom by reflecting on the marvels of the various units of His creation. If intelligently viewed the beautiful appearances of the birds, their marvellous flights and their wonderful formations during their flight into the sky, is the most beautiful and the most wonderful manifestation of nature. Their structure, their shapes, their colourful beauty, their…

item.title: Al-Mulk:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni l-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūrin Who is it that is your host who may help you, besides the All-beneficent? The faithless only dwell in delusion.

item.title: Al-Mulk:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni l-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūrin Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion. Who is it besides the Most Gracious that can be an army to you to help you? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion (67:20). Who is it that can provide for you if He should withhold His provision? Nay, but they continue to be in pride, and flee (67:21). Is he who walks prone on his face, more rightly guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path (67:22). Say: It is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing…

item.title: Al-Mulk:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni l-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūrin Or who is that who can be a host for you to succour you besides the Beneficent (God)? the disbelievers are but in mere delusion There is no power besides God's and none can ever defy His will - Hence let man be mindful of his helplessness and the supreme authority of the Lord. Here Qur'an has used the demonstrative pronoun - 'Haaza1', i.e., this - for which we have used 'that' to maintain the English language otherwise the use of this is more justified to indicate the nearness similar to the nearness of God required for the helper to help. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mulk:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ بَلْ لَجُّوْۤا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wanufūrin Who is it that may provide for you if He withholds His provision? Rather they persist in defiance and aversion.

item.title: Al-Mulk:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ بَلْ لَجُّوْۤا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wanufūrin Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion. See 67:20

item.title: Al-Mulk:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ بَلْ لَجُّوْۤا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wanufūrin Or who is that who can provide you with sustenance should He withhold His sustenance? Yet persist they in disdain and aversion (against the Truth) (Refer to Verse 16:73) The word 'sustenance' is a comprehensive term which includes even thing that an individual needs for the various phases of existence, physical, mental, and spiritual, etc. If anyone obstinately pursues the rebellious impulses of his corrupted passions, imagining them as the necessities of life, the individual is vainly pursuing a mirage which would ultimately end in his own perdition. The sustenance being from heaven as well as in the earth1. A soul receives its sustenance even after its death, particularly the one who surrenders his self in…

item.title: Al-Mulk:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَى أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ afaman yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Is he who walks prone on his face better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?

item.title: Al-Mulk:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَى أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ afaman yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path? See 67:20

item.title: Al-Mulk:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَى أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ afaman yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin What! is he who goeth along grovelling on his face, better guided or he who walketh upright upon the straight path (Refer to Verses 32:19, 10:35, 5:100, 13:16, 39:7) ? Everyone in this life, except those who have been purified and guided by God Himself1 () needs a guide or a model to follow. This Verse and Verse 10:35 give the clearest guiding formula for a sincere seeker of the right course. The use of the clue given in this Verse, one needs nothing but an unclouded common sense to enquire and find out the beings whose purity is divine and whose conduct and character is flawless and ideal and whose life from the beginning to…

item.title: Al-Mulk:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna Say, 'It is He who created you, and made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts. Little do you thank.'

item.title: Al-Mulk:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts (i.e., intellect); little are you grateful." See 67:20

item.title: Al-Mulk:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "He it is Who brought (Raised.) you (into being) and made for you the ears and the eyes and the hearts (As the centre of cognition.) ; yet how little is it that ye thank (Refer to Verse 6:98.) !" See 67:22

item.title: Al-Mulk:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna Say, 'It is He who created you on the earth, and toward Him you will be mustered.'

item.title: Al-Mulk:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered." See 67:20

item.title: Al-Mulk:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna Say thou: "He it is Who hath spread you in the earth and unto Him (alone) shall ye all be gathered" See 67:22

item.title: Al-Mulk:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna They say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: Al-Mulk:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?" See 67:20

item.title: Al-Mulk:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And say they: "When shall this appointment (Of the threat or promise.) come to pass, if ye be truthful?" See 67:22

item.title: Al-Mulk:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun Say, 'Its knowledge is only with Allah; I am only a manifest warner.'

item.title: Al-Mulk:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner." See 67:20

item.title: Al-Mulk:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun Say thou: "Verily the knowledge (of it) is only with God, and verily I am only an open Warner" See Math. 24/36, Mark. 13/32. "But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but thy Father only" Math. 24/36. "But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father" Mark. 13/32. Jesus also gives the same reply. The Final Judgment is certain to come but the hour is known to none but God. For the counting of the time with God1. "And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lol a Day with Allah…

item.title: Al-Mulk:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَقِيلَ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūna When they see it brought near, the countenances of the faithless will be distorted, and [they will be] told, 'This is what you asked for!'

item.title: Al-Mulk:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَقِيلَ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūna But when they see it1 approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."2 See 67:20

item.title: Al-Mulk:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَقِيلَ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūna But when they shall see it nigh, grieved shall be the faces of those who disbelieve, and it shall be said (unto them): "This is what ye have been calling for" See 67:26

item.title: Al-Mulk:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ مَعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَنْ يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu waman maʿiya aw raḥimanā faman yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīmin Say, 'Tell me, whether Allah destroys me and those with me, or He has mercy on us, who will shelter the faithless from a painful punishment?'

item.title: Al-Mulk:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ مَعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَنْ يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu waman maʿiya aw raḥimanā faman yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīmin Say, (O Muḥammad), "Have you considered:1 whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?" Say: Tell me! If Allah destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His mercy on us - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment? (67:28). Say: "He is the Most Gracious, in Him we believe, and upon Him we rely. So, you will come to know who it is that is in manifest error (67:29). Say: "Tell me! If (all) your water were to sink away, who then can supply you with flowing water? (67:30). The…

item.title: Al-Mulk:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ مَعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَنْ يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu waman maʿiya aw raḥimanā faman yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīmin Say thou: "See ye? If God were to destroy me and those with me or He bestoweth mercy on us, yet who can protect the disbelievers from the painful chastisement?" The tone here is identical with 5:20 pointing out that God is the Absolute Authority over the entire Universe. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mulk:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ qul huwa l-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīnin Say, 'He is the All-beneficent; we have faith in Him, and in Him do we trust. Soon you will know who is in manifest error.'

item.title: Al-Mulk:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ qul huwa l-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīnin Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will (come to) know who it is that is in clear error." See 67:28

item.title: Al-Mulk:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ qul huwa l-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīnin Say thou: "He is the Beneficent (God)! believe we in Him and on Him (alone) do we rely; so ye shall come to know who it is that is in manifest straying" Here points out that God's authority always manifests through His all-pervading grace. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mulk:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِمَاءٍ مَعِينٍ qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran faman yatīkum bimāin maʿīnin Say, 'Tell me, should your water sink down [into the ground], who will bring you running water?'

item.title: Al-Mulk:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِمَاءٍ مَعِينٍ qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran faman yatīkum bimāin maʿīnin Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken (into the earth), then who could bring you flowing water?" See 67:28

item.title: Al-Mulk:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِمَاءٍ مَعِينٍ qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran faman yatīkum bimāin maʿīnin Say thou: "See ye? if your water should go down (If water totally disappears - getting absorbed in the earth.) (into the earth), who then can bring you flowing water?" The Verse may be taken as a proverb expressing that if you lose even one benefit for some reason who is going to substitute it with another one. It implies that nothing advantageous to man's progress disappears without a successive substitution. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Muminoon:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūna Certainly, the faithful have attained salvation

item.title: Al-Muminoon:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūna Certainly will the believers have succeeded. وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ And those who strictly guard their Salawat. means, they persistently offer their prayers at their appointed times, as Ibn Mas'ud said: I asked the Messenger of Allah SAW, 'O Messenger of Allah, which deed is most beloved to Allah?' He said: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا Prayer at the appointed time. I said, 'Then what?' He said: بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ Kindness to one's parents. I said, 'Then what?' He said: الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ Jihad in the way of Allah. It was recorded in the Two Sahihs. Qatadah said: "At the fixed times, with the proper bowing and prostration." Allah begins and ends this list of praiseworthy qualities with Salah, which is indicative of its virtue, as the Prophet SAW said: اسْتَقِيمُوا وَلَنْ تُحْصُوا، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūna Indeed successful are the believers, The faithful ones surely succeed in reaching their destined goal of life.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūna —those who are humble in their prayers,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūna They who are during their prayer humbly intent. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūna Those who in their prayers are humble, This verse gives the description or the identification of the true believers in God - In prayers they are filled with awe for God's Glory - Humility on the part of the individual presented in prayer manifests the individual's estimation and the acknowledgment of his own self, being nothing in the presence of the Almighty power of God's glory and the individual's consciousness of the Absolute Omnipotent Authority of the Lord. Once a man was seen, while in prayer playing with his beard. The Holy Prophet said: "Had the man been conscious of his insignificance in the presence of the Supreme Majesty of the Lord's Authority, he would surely have manifested in his physical existence, and his presenting it before Him." It is…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūna who avoid vain talk,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūna And they who turn away from ill speech. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūna And those who, from what is vain, (Word or action.) keep (themselves) aloof, 'Laghw' i.e., Vain, the First Holy Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib says that all that is void of the remembrance of God is meant by this term - With the Ahl al-Bayt this term includes all useless entertainments wasteful of time including musical enjoyments, and vain games played just to while away the time, are also covered by this term.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوةِ فَاعِلُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lilzzakati fāʿilūna who carry out their [duty of] zakāt,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوةِ فَاعِلُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lilzzakati fāʿilūna And they who are observant of zakāh. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوةِ فَاعِلُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lilzzakati fāʿilūna And those who act (Acting by the payment of the dues from their well-earned wealth and in whatever purifies one's heart.) for purification, The Sixth Holy Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq says that whosoever stops himself or anybody else from giving away even a grain in dispensing 'Zakat', i.e., the prescribed poor-rate, is not a 'Mu'min', i.e., a True Believer. Purification by payment of the dues from their wealth or in what purifies the heart.1 (Refer to 'Fiqh') (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna who guard their private parts1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna And they who guard their private parts. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna And those who guard their private parts, This brief verse of only a very few words comprehends all the aspects of a chaste life both of the male and the female members of the human family. It enjoins guarding the self against the abuse of the sex urge in both the sexes. The refinement of a human personality can be measured and assessed according to the manifest activity as well as hidden, or the latent ideology. It is in the universal acknowledgment of the dangers of this urge in a man as well as woman getting out of bounds and rebellious that even the average or the minimum activity of this urge is strictly restricted to the bonds of wedlock in which the rights or the liberties of both the sexes in…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna (except from their spouses or their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy;

item.title: Al-Muminoon:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,1 for indeed, they will not be blamed. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna Except from their wives or those whom their right hands possess for then verily they are not blameable, The restriction imposed on the sex urge is given in this verse as the exceptions to the law by prescribing the lawful outlets through the use of which it can be healthy and desirable. 'Ma malakat aymanuhum', i.e., what their right hands possess, meaning slave-girls owned either by purchase or as the captives of a 'Jihad', (i.e., fight in the cause of God, under an apostle of God or under a Divinely appointed Imam, i.e., the Guide in the place of the Apostle). It is pitiable that without the proper knowledge of the amount of regard and protection woman gets under this…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna but whoever seeks [anything] beyond that —it is they who are transgressors)

item.title: Al-Muminoon:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna But whosoever seeketh beyond that, then, these are they the transgressors of the bounds, See 23:6

item.title: Al-Muminoon:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna and those who keep their trusts and covenants,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna And those who keep well their trusts and (honour) their promises, (Covenants – contracts – agreements – undertakings.) Note the regard or respect Islam enjoined for trusts and covenants. This one small verse covers the whole field of obligations undertaken by a Muslim. Carrying out of the obligations or the fulfilment of the promises made, has been made an identification of a true believer in God.1 The matter invites consideration by intelligent readers about the covenant or the actual 'Bay'ah' (Allegiance or Homage) that was taken from the Muslims on the 18th of Dhul-Hijjah 10 A.H. under the command of the Lord received through verse 5:672 at the historic place Ghadir Khumm by the Holy Prophet, about the appointment of Ali ibn Abi Talib as the Mawla or the Lord…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūna and who are watchful of their prayers.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūna And they who carefully maintain their prayers. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūna And those who take care of (the regularity in) their prayers, A strict guard on the regular observance of the prescribed prayers has been made a separate and an exclusive point of the quality and the identification of a true believer. A thoughtless or unintelligent recital of the Word of God is quite different from a serious study of it, to earn the guidance it provides, one has to apply its knowledge to the men and the matters in the world. Let us find out who in Islam has all the qualities enumerated in the above verses of this Surah and who has guarded the prayers to serve as models for us. Taking the observance of the prayers as laid down in this verse, the Muslim world as a whole…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُونَ ulāika humu l-wārithūna It is they who will be the inheritors,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُونَ ulāika humu l-wārithūna Those are the inheritors. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُونَ ulāika humu l-wārithūna These, they are the heirs, Such perfection in the above qualities would naturally inherit the abode of the heavenly bliss for ever, and no doubt, the others also, to the extent to which they qualify themselves for it by their acquiring the above excellence for themselves.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ alladhīna yarithūna l-fir'dawsa hum fīhā khālidūna who shall inherit paradise, and will remain in it [forever].1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ alladhīna yarithūna l-fir'dawsa hum fīhā khālidūna Who will inherit al-Firdaus.1 They will abide therein eternally. See 23:1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ alladhīna yarithūna l-fir'dawsa hum fīhā khālidūna (These are) those who inherit the Paradise; they shall abide therein. See 23:10

item.title: Al-Muminoon:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ طِينٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatin min ṭīnin Certainly We created man from an extract of clay.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ طِينٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatin min ṭīnin And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay. And indeed We created man out of an extract of Tin (23:12). Thereafter We made him a Nutfah in a safe lodging (23:13). Then We made the Nutfah into a clot, then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators (23:14). After that, surely you will die (23:15). Then (again), surely you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection (23:16). The Sign of Allah in the Progressive Creation of Man from Clay Then from Nutfah and Thereafter…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ طِينٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatin min ṭīnin And indeed We, (God.) created man, from an extract of clay, In the opening verses of this chapter, is dealt with the moral or the spiritual growth of the human being marching on the Right Path of the guidance from God. In these verses, is recapitulated the physical growth of man as it was referred to in verse 22:5. This is to make man realize his origin from dust and his return to it once again. The various evolutionary stages of the creative artistry of the Almighty Author of the Universe, is to impress upon man, how the Omnipotent One could convert the inorganic matter into a living organism and deposit it into the ovum, convert it into a clot of thickly congealed blood and cause…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭ'fatan fī qarārin makīnin Then We made him a drop of [seminal] fluid [lodged] in a secure abode.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭ'fatan fī qarārin makīnin Then We placed him as a sperm-drop1 in a firm lodging (i.e., the womb). See 23:12

item.title: Al-Muminoon:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭ'fatan fī qarārin makīnin Then We made him sperm, in a firm resting place, Refers to the beginning of the development of the life from the extract of an inanimate matter. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ thumma khalaqnā l-nuṭ'fata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnā l-ʿalaqata muḍ'ghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍ'ghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnā l-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshanāhu khalqan ākhara fatabāraka l-lahu aḥsanu l-khāliqīna Then We created the drop of fluid as a clinging mass. Then We created the clinging mass as a fleshy tissue. Then We created the fleshy tissue as bones. Then We clothed the bones with flesh. Then We produced him as [yet] another creature. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators!

item.title: Al-Muminoon:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ thumma khalaqnā l-nuṭ'fata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnā l-ʿalaqata muḍ'ghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍ'ghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnā l-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshanāhu khalqan ākhara fatabāraka l-lahu aḥsanu l-khāliqīna Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump (of flesh), and We made (from) the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.1 See 23:12

item.title: Al-Muminoon:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ thumma khalaqnā l-nuṭ'fata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnā l-ʿalaqata muḍ'ghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍ'ghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnā l-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshanāhu khalqan ākhara fatabāraka l-lahu aḥsanu l-khāliqīna Then made We the sperm a clot, then made We the clot a lump of flesh, then made We in the lump of flesh bones, then clothed We the bones with flesh; then We did grow it into another (Refers to beginning or the development of the human Psyche in the newly born child.) creation; so Blessed be God, the Best of the creators. Refers to the substitution of the original matter of the primary stages, with the newly-evolved generation. (Another Creation) Refers to the beginning of the human psyche in the newly-born child. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūna Then indeed you die after that.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūna Then indeed, after that you are to die. See 23:12

item.title: Al-Muminoon:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūna Then verily after that ye shall die, Man is caused to suffer the death of his physical body. But death by no means is the end of his life. It is not the extinction of the life but the transfer or the conveyance of the soul from the physical to the spiritual realm, from the sensual consciousness to the spiritual realisation, from the false to the real or from the sleep to the awakening.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'ʿathūna Then you will indeed be raised up on the Day of Resurrection.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'ʿathūna Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected. See 23:12

item.title: Al-Muminoon:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'ʿathūna Then verily on the Day of Judgment ye shall be raised. As light alone is shone out from light, only wisdom issues from the wise. God is the All Wise. Nothing but wisdom could ever manifest from God. Could all these creative faculties in man be only to be made extinct or perish altogether at death without any plan for the future? It is said here that every one is accountable and shall be resurrected for the Final Judgment. May refer to the physical spheres which are above us or to the spiritual spheres above the primary human psychical stage up to the ultimate stage of communion with the Absolute - stages which are termed by the mystics as 'Taba' Instinct, 'Nafs', i.e., Desire, 'Qalb' i.e., the state of inter-relation…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَافِلِينَ walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāiqa wamā kunnā ʿani l-khalqi ghāfilīna Certainly We created above you the seven tiers1 and We have not been oblivious of creation.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَافِلِينَ walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāiqa wamā kunnā ʿani l-khalqi ghāfilīna And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of (Our) creation unaware. And indeed We have created above you seven Tara'iq, and We are never unaware of the creation (23:17). His Sign in the Creation of the Heavens After mentioning the creation of man, Allah then mentions the creation of the seven heavens. Allah often mentions the creation of the heavens and earth alongside the creation of man, as He says elsewhere: لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ The creation of the heavens and the earth is indeed greater than the creation of mankind (40:57) A similar Ayah appears at the beginning of Surat As-Sajdah, which the Messenger of Allah SAW used to…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَافِلِينَ walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāiqa wamā kunnā ʿani l-khalqi ghāfilīna And indeed made We above (Refer to verse 78:13.) you seven paths (heavens); and neither, of the creation, We are heedless 'Tara'iq' is the plural of 'Tariq', i.e. way, road, tract. The seven roads referred to are the seven orbits of the planets. This statement indicates God's ownership of the world of nature, His Absolute authority and His independent management of the affairs of the whole working of the Universe - and His sustained purposeful - interest in it. The proper system and order including the various stages - and it is not any heedless or aimless action.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūna We sent down water from the sky in a measured manner, and We lodged it within the ground, and We are indeed able to take it away.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūna And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away. And We sent down from the sky water in measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are able to take it away (23:18). Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat (23:19). And a tree that springs forth from Tur Sinai, that grows oil, and relish for the eaters (23:20). And verily, in the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūna And send We down water from the heaven according to a measure, and We cause it to settle in the earth; and verily to take it away We are able. The few words of this verse, have volumes of meaning referring to the Divine wisdom with which the earth is given the ceaseless water supply. The rain comes, not for the whole year but in the fixed seasons. The water from the sky is not dropped in big logs collectively; for, had it been so, the creation on earth below would have been destroyed.
