The water rains in small drops and flows away to sea, washing the surface of the earth and the surface…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْشَأْنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ fa-anshanā lakum bihi jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna Then with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines. There are abundant fruits in them for you, and you eat from them.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْشَأْنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ fa-anshanā lakum bihi jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat. See 23:18

item.title: Al-Muminoon:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْشَأْنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ fa-anshanā lakum bihi jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna Then with it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and grapes; for you therein are fruits in plenty and from them ye do eat, See 23:18

item.title: Al-Muminoon:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِلْءَاكِلِينَ washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāa tanbutu bil-duh'ni waṣib'ghin lil'ākilīna And a tree that grows on Mount Sinai which produces oil and a seasoning for those who eat.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِلْءَاكِلِينَ washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāa tanbutu bil-duh'ni waṣib'ghin lil'ākilīna And (We brought forth) a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food (i.e., olives) for those who eat. See 23:18

item.title: Al-Muminoon:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِلْءَاكِلِينَ washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāa tanbutu bil-duh'ni waṣib'ghin lil'ākilīna And a tree that groweth out of Mount Sinai which produceth oil and a condiment for those who eat. It is said that the Olive was first grown on the Mount Sinai through which Moses saw the fire and God spoke to him. There are some mystic meanings of the names; the 'Fig' the 'Olive', 'Mount Sinai' and the Holy City of the 'Ameen', i.e., the trusted one (i.e., Muhammad), i.e., Mecca.1 The Olive is called the Blessed Tree.2

item.title: Al-Muminoon:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna There is indeed a moral for you in the cattle: We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and you have many uses in them, and you eat some of them,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat. See 23:18

item.title: Al-Muminoon:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna And verily for you there is, in the cattle a lesson; We Provide you to drink of what is in their bellies, and for you there are in them benefits in plenty, and of them ye do eat, See 23:20

item.title: Al-Muminoon:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūna and you are carried on them and on ships.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūna And upon them and on ships you are carried. See 23:18

item.title: Al-Muminoon:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūna And on them and on ships are ye borne. See 23:20

item.title: Al-Muminoon:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna Certainly We sent Noah to his people, and he said, 'O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna And We had certainly sent Nuh to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?" And indeed We sent Nuh to his people, and he said: O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other God but Him. Will you not then have Taqwa? (23:23). But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. Never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna And indeed sent We Noah unto his people, and he said: "O' My people! worship ye God (alone) ye have no (Jesus also said the same and not Trinity 'Hear O' Israel; the Lord our God is one Lord' New Testament. Mark 12/29, Corinthians 8/4, Ephesians 4/5-6.) god other than Him; Will ye not then guard (yourselves against evil)?" God after giving the examples of the creative order, refers to His legislative system of guidance1. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي ءَابَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yurīdu an yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāa l-lahu la-anzala malāikatan mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīna But the elite of the faithless from among his people said, 'This is just a human being like you, who seeks to dominate you. Had Allah wished, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of such a thing among our forefathers.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي ءَابَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yurīdu an yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāa l-lahu la-anzala malāikatan mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīna But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed (to send a messenger), He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers. See 23:23

item.title: Al-Muminoon:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي ءَابَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yurīdu an yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāa l-lahu la-anzala malāikatan mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīna But said the chiefs of those who disbelieved, among from his people: "This is a man like unto yourselves who intendeth to exalt himself above you; but had God will (to send any apostle) He would certainly have sent angels. We have heard (People believed that an angel only could be a prophet from God and not a human being -They wondered at a human being claiming to be a prophet.) not of this among our fathers of old;" See 23:23

item.title: Al-Muminoon:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ حَتّٰی حِينٍ in huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīnin He is just a man possessed by madness. So bear with him for a while.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ حَتّٰی حِينٍ in huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīnin He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time." See 23:23

item.title: Al-Muminoon:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ حَتّٰی حِينٍ in huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīnin Verily (This is what the people said.) he is not but a man maniac (One with the touch of madness.) so bear ye with him for some time. Noah was considered by his people to be mad, otherwise, in their opinion no man could ever think himself to be an apostle of God and yet condemn their deities. Hence, they suggested him to be left to himself for by the segregation, the madness might run out or he would perish.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni He said, 'My Lord! Help me, as they impugn me.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni (Nuh) said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me." He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me (23:26). So, We revealed to him: "Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our revelation. Then, when Our command comes, and (water) gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two, and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favor of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned (23:27). "And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: 'All the praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who are wrongdoers (23:28). "And say: 'My Lord! Cause me to…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni He (Noah) said: "O' my Lord! help me against what they belie." See 23:25

item.title: Al-Muminoon:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ fa-awḥaynā ilayhi ani iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru fa-us'luk fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu min'hum walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna So We revealed to him: 'Build the ark before Our eyes and by Our revelation. When Our edict comes and the oven gushes [a stream of water], bring into it a pair of every kind1 [of animal], and your family, except those of them against whom the decree has gone beforehand, and do not plead with Me for those who are wrongdoers: they shall indeed be drowned.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ fa-awḥaynā ilayhi ani iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru fa-us'luk fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu min'hum walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows,1 put into it (i.e., the ship) from each (creature) two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree (of destruction) has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned. See 23:26

item.title: Al-Muminoon:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ fa-awḥaynā ilayhi ani iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru fa-us'luk fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu min'hum walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna So revealed We unto him that: "Make thou (O' Our Apostle Noah!) the Ark before Our eyes and (as per) Our revelation (Direction.) and when cometh (unto thee) Our command, and gusheth forth water from the oven, take into it two of every species a pair and thy people except those among them about whom had already been issued the word; and address (Pray not – wish not.) Me not in respect of those who are…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ fa-idhā is'tawayta anta waman maʿaka ʿalā l-ful'ki faquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna 'When you, and those who are with you, are settled in the ark, say, "All praise belongs to Allah, who has delivered us from the wrongdoing lot."

item.title: Al-Muminoon:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ fa-idhā is'tawayta anta waman maʿaka ʿalā l-ful'ki faquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.' See 23:26

item.title: Al-Muminoon:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ fa-idhā is'tawayta anta waman maʿaka ʿalā l-ful'ki faquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And when thou art settled (in the Ark), thou and those with thee, then say thou: "All praise be unto God Who delivered us from the unjust people!" And when thou and those with thee on the Ark, are settled, then say thou - (The Praise of the Lord) (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ waqul rabbi anzil'nī munzalan mubārakan wa-anta khayru l-munzilīna And say, "My Lord! Land me with a blessed landing, for You are the best of those who bring ashore." '

item.title: Al-Muminoon:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ waqul rabbi anzil'nī munzalan mubārakan wa-anta khayru l-munzilīna And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate (us).'" See 23:26

item.title: Al-Muminoon:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ waqul rabbi anzil'nī munzalan mubārakan wa-anta khayru l-munzilīna And say thou: "O' my Lord! disembark me with a blessed landing, for Thou art the Best of all who cause to land!" See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyātin wa-in kunnā lamub'talīna There are indeed signs in this; and indeed We have been testing.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyātin wa-in kunnā lamub'talīna Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing (Our servants). See 23:26

item.title: Al-Muminoon:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyātin wa-in kunnā lamub'talīna Verily in this are signs (Of the Omnipotent.) and We do only try (the people). See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīna Then after them We brought forth another generation,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīna Then We produced after them a generation of others. Then, after them, We created another generation (23:31). And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): Worship Allah! You have no other God but Him. Will you not then have Taqwa? (23:32). And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of worldly life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink (23:33). "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily, you indeed would be losers (23:34). "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīna Then We raised up after them another generation (Hud). See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlan min'hum ani uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna and We sent them an apostle from among themselves, saying, 'Worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlan min'hum ani uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna And We sent among them a messenger1 from themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?" See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlan min'hum ani uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna Then sent We among them an apostle (Saleh) from among themselves saying "Worship ye God (alone), there is not (This is what Jesus preached and not Trinity. "Hear, O' Israel; the Lord our God is one Lord." Refer to New Testament Mark 12/29, Corin 8/4, Ephes 4/5-6.) for you any god other than Him: What! Will ye not therefore guard (against evil)?" See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ waqāla l-mala-u min qawmihi alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biliqāi l-ākhirati wa-atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yakulu mimmā takulūna min'hu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūna Said the elite of his people, who were faithless and who denied the encounter of the Hereafter and whom We had given affluence in the life of the world: 'This is just a human being like you: he eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ waqāla l-mala-u min qawmihi alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biliqāi l-ākhirati wa-atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yakulu mimmā takulūna min'hu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūna And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink. See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ waqāla l-mala-u min qawmihi alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biliqāi l-ākhirati wa-atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yakulu mimmā takulūna min'hu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūna And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and belied the meeting of the hereafter, and whom We had richly (Given the provision to indulge.) provided in the life of this world said: "This is not but a man like yourselves, eateth he of what ye eat from, and drinketh he of what ye drink," See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ wala-in aṭaʿtum basharan mith'lakum innakum idhan lakhāsirūna If you obey a human being like yourselves, you will indeed be losers.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ wala-in aṭaʿtum basharan mith'lakum innakum idhan lakhāsirūna And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers. See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ wala-in aṭaʿtum basharan mith'lakum innakum idhan lakhāsirūna And if ye follow a man like yourselves, verily then ye be the losers. See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُمْ مُخْرَجُونَ ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turāban waʿiẓāman annakum mukh'rajūna Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones you will indeed be raised [from the dead]?

item.title: Al-Muminoon:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُمْ مُخْرَجُونَ ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turāban waʿiẓāman annakum mukh'rajūna Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth (once more)? See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُمْ مُخْرَجُونَ ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turāban waʿiẓāman annakum mukh'rajūna What! (This is what the disbelievers said to the people obstructing them from believing in the Apostle.) doth he promise you that when ye are dead and become dust and bones that ye shall be brought forth? See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūna Far-fetched, far-fetched is what you are promised!

item.title: Al-Muminoon:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūna How far, how far, is that which you are promised.1 See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūna Far, (This is what the disbelievers said to the people obstructing them from believing in the Apostle.) Far (from sense) is what ye are promised! See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ in hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīna There is nothing but the life of this world: we live and we die, and we shall not be resurrected.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ in hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīna It (i.e., life) is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected. See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ in hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīna There (This is what the disbelievers said to the people obstructing them from believing in the Apostle.) is nothing but our life in this world: We die and we live and we shall not be raised again. See 23:28

item.title: Al-Muminoon:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ in huwa illā rajulun if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahu bimu'minīna He is just a man who has fabricated a lie against Allah, and we will not believe in him.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ in huwa illā rajulun if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahu bimu'minīna He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him." See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ in huwa illā rajulun if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahu bimu'minīna He (This is what the disbelievers said to the people obstructing them from believing in the Apostle.) is nothing but a man who hath forged a lie about God, and we are not going to believe in him. These1 are common statements of the disbelievers. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni He said, 'My Lord! Help me, as they impugn me.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me." See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni He (Saleh) said: "O' my Lord! help me against what they belie!" See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ qāla ʿammā qalīlin layuṣ'biḥunna nādimīna He said, 'In a little while they will become regretful.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ qāla ʿammā qalīlin layuṣ'biḥunna nādimīna (Allah) said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful." See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ qāla ʿammā qalīlin layuṣ'biḥunna nādimīna Said (God): "Yet a while, they will soon turn repentant," See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً فَبُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāan fabuʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna So the Cry seized them justifiably and We turned them into a scum. So away with the wrongdoing lot!

item.title: Al-Muminoon:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً فَبُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāan fabuʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna So the shriek1 seized them in truth,2 and We made them as (plant) stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people. See 23:31

item.title: Al-Muminoon:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً فَبُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāan fabuʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna Then did the (awful) cry, in truth overtook them, and We made them like a rubbish; so away with the unjust people! See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīna Then after them We brought forth other generations.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīna Then We produced after them other generations. Then, after them, We created other generations (23:42). No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it (23:43). Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so, We made them follow one another, and We made them as Ahadith. So, away with a people who believe not (23:44). Mention of Other Nations Allah says: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا آخَرِينَ Then, after them, We created other generations. Meaning: nations and peoples. مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it. means, they are taken at the appropriate time, as decreed by Allah in His Book that is preserved with…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīna Then We raised after them other generations. See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna No nation can advance its time nor can it defer it.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna No nation will precede its time (of termination), nor will they remain (thereafter). See 23:42

item.title: Al-Muminoon:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna No people can hasten their (fixed) term, nor can they delay (it). See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِقَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jāa ummatan rasūluhā kadhabūhu fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍan wajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha fabuʿ'dan liqawmin lā yu'minūna Then We sent Our apostles successively. Whenever there came to a nation its apostle, they impugned him, so We made them follow one another [to extinction] and We turned them into folktales. So away with the faithless lot!

item.title: Al-Muminoon:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِقَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jāa ummatan rasūluhā kadhabūhu fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍan wajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha fabuʿ'dan liqawmin lā yu'minūna Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them narrations.1 So away with a people who do not believe. See 23:42

item.title: Al-Muminoon:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِقَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jāa ummatan rasūluhā kadhabūhu fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍan wajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha fabuʿ'dan liqawmin lā yu'minūna Then sent We Our apostles one after another; whenever came unto a people their apostle, they belied him, so caused We some to follow the others and made (of) some stories (of old), so away with the people who believe not. See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ thumma arsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin Then We sent Moses and Aaron, his brother, with Our signs and a manifest authority,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ thumma arsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin Then We sent Musa and his brother Harun with Our signs and a clear authority.1 Then We sent Musa and his brother Harun, with Our Ayat and manifest authority (23:45). To Fir'awn and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord) (23:46). They said: Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility! (23:47). So, they denied them both and became of those who were destroyed (23:48). And indeed We gave Musa the Scripture, that they may be guided (23:49). The Story of Musa, Peace Be upon Him, And Fir'awn Allah tells us that He sent Musa (AS), and his brother Harun to Fir'awn and his chiefs with decisive…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ thumma arsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin Then sent We Moses and his brother, Aaron, with Our signs and a manifest authority, See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīna to Pharaoh and his elites; but they acted arrogantly and they were a tyrannical lot.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīna To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people. See 23:45

item.title: Al-Muminoon:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīna Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved proudly and they were a haughty (Insolent, arrogant.) people. See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mith'linā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūna They said, 'Shall we believe two humans like ourselves, while their people are our slaves?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mith'linā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūna They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?" See 23:45

item.title: Al-Muminoon:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mith'linā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūna And said they: "What! Shall we believe in two men (Mortals.) like ourselves whose people are unto us servile." See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ fakadhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muh'lakīna So they impugned the two of them, whereat they were among those who were destroyed.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ fakadhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muh'lakīna So they denied them and were of those destroyed. See 23:45

item.title: Al-Muminoon:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ fakadhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muh'lakīna So they did belie them, so became they of those destroyed. See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūna Certainly We gave Moses the Book so that they might be guided,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūna And We certainly gave Musa the Scripture that perhaps they1 would be guided. See 23:45

item.title: Al-Muminoon:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūna And indeed We gave Moses the Book happly they may be guided aright. See 23:38

item.title: Al-Muminoon:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ اٰیَةً وَءَاوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ wajaʿalnā ib'na maryama wa-ummahu āyatan waāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarārin wamaʿīnin and We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and sheltered them in a highland, level and watered by a stream.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ اٰیَةً وَءَاوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ wajaʿalnā ib'na maryama wa-ummahu āyatan waāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarārin wamaʿīnin And We made the son of Maryam and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level (areas) and flowing water. And We made the son of Maryam and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on a Rabwah, Dhat Qarar, and Ma'in (23:50). Isa and Maryam Allah tells us about His servant and Messenger Isa bin Maryam (AS), and that He made them as a sign for mankind, i.e., definitive proof of His ability to do what He wills. For He created Adam without a father or a mother, He created Hawwa' from a male without a female, and He created Isa from a female without a male, but He…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ اٰیَةً وَءَاوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ wajaʿalnā ib'na maryama wa-ummahu āyatan waāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarārin wamaʿīnin And made We the Son of Mary and his Mother a (Of the Ever-fulfilled Omnipotent will.) Sign, and We gave them a refuge for both on a high land, quiet, secure and watered with springs This is a reference to the situation when the Virgin Mary having conceived the Holy Spirit in her womb (Jesus) being afraid of the condemnation of her people about her bearing a child without a husband, did not know what to do and where to go to take shelter. She was directed by God to take refuge in Bethlehem, where there was for her the fruit tree to eat of and also a spring of water to drink from. The place is on…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوْۤا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا اِنِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِیْمٌ yāayyuhā l-rusulu kulū mina l-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun O apostles! Eat of the good things and act righteously. Indeed I know best what you do.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوْۤا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا اِنِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِیْمٌ yāayyuhā l-rusulu kulū mina l-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun (Allah said), "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing. O Messengers! Eat of the Tayyibat and do righteous deeds. Verily, I am Well-Acquainted with what you do (23:51). And verily, this your religion is one religion, and I am your Lord, so have Taqwa (23:52). But they have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in what is with it (23:53). So, leave them in their error for a time (23:54). Do they think that in wealth and children with which We prolong the (23:55). We hasten unto them with good things. Nay, but they perceive not (23:56). The Command to Eat Lawful Food…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوْۤا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا اِنِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِیْمٌ yāayyuhā l-rusulu kulū mina l-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun (And the apostles were commanded by God) "O' (My) apostles! eat ye of the good things and do good; Verily I know what ye do." See 23:50

item.title: Al-Muminoon:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ wa-inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-ittaqūni Indeed this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord, so be wary of Me.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ wa-inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-ittaqūni And indeed this, your religion, is one religion,1 and I am your Lord, so fear Me." See 23:51

item.title: Al-Muminoon:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ wa-inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-ittaqūni And verily this your group is one group, and I am your Lord therefore fear ye (Only Me). This verse declares the natural unity of mankind and the divisions effected in it, into communities, sects, tribes and nations. The message, the source of guidance and the perfect identity of the messengers bring the messages, all being perfectly identical, obviously proves the Unity of God. All the messengers of the apostles naturally constitute one Brotherhood. Hence all men should naturally be united with mutual love as the creatures of one and the same Lord and worship Him and Him alone and none else1.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna But they fragmented their religion among themselves, each party exulting in what it had.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna But they (i.e., the people) divided their religion among them into portions (i.e., sects) - each faction, in what it has,1 rejoicing. See 23:51

item.title: Al-Muminoon:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna But they have (Islam is a sectless - rather anti-sectarian religion. Sects were started in opposition to the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt Islam-Original is only identified as 'Shiaism') rent the unity among themselves into sects; each party rejoiceth in that which is with them. See 23:52

item.title: Al-Muminoon:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīnin So leave them in their stupor for a while.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīnin So leave them in their confusion for a time. See 23:51

item.title: Al-Muminoon:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīnin So leave them in their over whelming ignorance till a certain time. See 23:52

item.title: Al-Muminoon:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi min mālin wabanīna Do they suppose that whatever aid We provide them in regard to wealth and children [is because]

item.title: Al-Muminoon:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi min mālin wabanīna Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children. See 23:51

item.title: Al-Muminoon:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi min mālin wabanīna What! Think they that what We aid them with of wealth and children, See 23:52

item.title: Al-Muminoon:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ بَلْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ nusāriʿu lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yashʿurūna We are eager to bring them good? Rather they are not aware!

item.title: Al-Muminoon:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ بَلْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ nusāriʿu lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yashʿurūna Is (because) We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.1 See 23:51

item.title: Al-Muminoon:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ بَلْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ nusāriʿu lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yashʿurūna We are hastening unto them the good things? Nay! they (only) perceive not. See 23:52

item.title: Al-Muminoon:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ inna alladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mush'fiqūna Indeed those who are apprehensive for the fear of their Lord,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ inna alladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mush'fiqūna Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord. Verily, those who live in awe for fear of their Lord (23:57). And those who believe in the Ayat of their Lord (23:58). And those who join not anyone as partners with their Lord (23:59). And those who give that which they give with their hearts full of fear, because they are sure to return to their Lord (23:60). It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them (23:61). Description of the People of Good Deeds إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ Verily, those who live in awe for fear of their Lord; means, even though they have reached the level of Ihsan and have faith and do righteous…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ inna alladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mush'fiqūna And Verily they who are thrilled for fear of their Lord, The address shifts from the ungrateful disbelievers in the truth to the grateful believers in it and the following verses identify such infallible ones who should be followed in faith and its practice. The verse also enumerates the basic qualities of godliness and goodness which identifies them. The maximum of each and every one of the qualities mentioned in these verses could be found with the maximum possible perfection, only in the Holy Ahl al-Bayt who alone could naturally own them in the degree and the perfection desired by God for they and none else are those purified by God.1 The description in these verses would reflect upon the others in mankind according to the…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-alladhīna hum biāyāti rabbihim yu'minūna and who believe in the signs of their Lord,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-alladhīna hum biāyāti rabbihim yu'minūna And they who believe in the signs of their Lord. See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-alladhīna hum biāyāti rabbihim yu'minūna And those who believe in the signs of their Lord, See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ wa-alladhīna hum birabbihim lā yush'rikūna and who do not ascribe partners to their Lord;

item.title: Al-Muminoon:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ wa-alladhīna hum birabbihim lā yush'rikūna And they who do not associate anything with their Lord. See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ wa-alladhīna hum birabbihim lā yush'rikūna And those who associate not (anything) with their Lord, See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا ءَاتَوْا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ wa-alladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūna and who give whatever they give while their hearts tremble with awe that they are going to return to their Lord

item.title: Al-Muminoon:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا ءَاتَوْا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ wa-alladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūna And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful1 because they will be returning to their Lord. See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا ءَاتَوْا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ wa-alladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūna And those who give what they give (in charity) while their hearts thrilled for fear that unto their Lord they must return, See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ ulāika yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūna —it is they who are zealous in [performing] good works, and take the lead in them.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ ulāika yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūna It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip (others) therein. See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ ulāika yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūna These (are they who) hasten unto good things and they are the foremost to (attain) them, See 23:57

item.title: Al-Muminoon:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna We task no soul except according to its capacity, and with Us is a book that speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And We charge no soul except (with that within) its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged. And We task not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged (23:62). Nay, but their hearts are covered from this, and they have other deeds, besides which they are doing (23:63). Until when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment; behold, they make humble invocation with a loud voice (23:64). Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly you shall not be helped by Us (23:65). Indeed My Ayat used…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And task We not a soul but to the extent of its ability and with Us is a Book, it speaketh the truth, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly. The 'Lauh-e-Mahfuz', i.e., the Secured Tablet which contains the Will of the Lord about every thing in His creation, i.e., the All-Comprehensive knowledge of God.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِنْ دُونِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratin min hādhā walahum aʿmālun min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūna Rather their hearts are in a stupor in regard to this, and there are their other deeds besides which they perpetrate.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِنْ دُونِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratin min hādhā walahum aʿmālun min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūna But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have (evil) deeds besides that (i.e., disbelief) which they are doing. See 23:62

item.title: Al-Muminoon:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِنْ دُونِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratin min hādhā walahum aʿmālun min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūna Nay! their hearts are in overwhelming ignorance about this, and they have other than this, deeds which they do, The facts mentioned in verse 23:56 - and besides this ignorance they are busy in other activities. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْءَرُونَ ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mut'rafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajarūna When We seize their affluent ones with punishment, behold, they make entreaties [to Us].

item.title: Al-Muminoon:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْءَرُونَ ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mut'rafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajarūna Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment,1 at once they are crying (to Allah) for help. See 23:62

item.title: Al-Muminoon:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْءَرُونَ ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mut'rafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajarūna Until seized We the luxurious ones of them with chastisement, Behold! cry they in supplication! See 23:63

item.title: Al-Muminoon:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَجْءَرُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُونَ lā tajarū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūna 'Do not make entreaties today! Indeed you will not receive any help from Us.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَجْءَرُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُونَ lā tajarū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūna Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped. See 23:62

item.title: Al-Muminoon:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تَجْءَرُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُونَ lā tajarū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūna (It will be said unto them) "Cry not this day for succour! Verily from Us ye shall not be helped!" See 23:63

item.title: Al-Muminoon:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُونَ qad kānat āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūna Certainly My signs used to be recited to you, but you used to take to your heels,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُونَ qad kānat āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūna My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels. See 23:62

item.title: Al-Muminoon:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُونَ qad kānat āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūna Indeed My signs were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels, See 23:63

item.title: Al-Muminoon:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ mus'takbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūna being disdainful of it,1 talking nonsense in your nightly sessions.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ mus'takbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūna In arrogance regarding it,1 conversing by night, speaking evil. See 23:62

item.title: Al-Muminoon:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ mus'takbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūna Puffed up with pride about (Against.) it (Qur'an) discoursing (Talking.) foolishly by night. See 23:63

item.title: Al-Muminoon:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَاءَهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jāahum mā lam yati ābāahumu l-awalīna Have they not contemplated the discourse,1 or has anything come to them [in it] that did not come to their forefathers?

item.title: Al-Muminoon:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَاءَهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jāahum mā lam yati ābāahumu l-awalīna Then have they not reflected over the word (i.e., the Qur’ān), or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers? Have they not pondered over the Word, or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old (23:68). Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger so they deny him (23:69). Or they say: There is madness in him Nay, but he brought them the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth (23:70). And if Al-Haqq had followed their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَاءَهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jāahum mā lam yati ābāahumu l-awalīna What! Ponder they not over the Word (Qur'an) or hath that come (i.e. Similar Scriptures had already come to their ancestors.) unto them which came not unto their fathers of old? See 23:63

item.title: Al-Muminoon:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوْۤا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūna Is it that they do not recognize their apostle,1 and so they deny him?2

item.title: Al-Muminoon:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوْۤا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūna Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging? See 23:68

item.title: Al-Muminoon:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوْۤا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūna Or recognize (For his identification they had through their scriptures.) they not their Apostle that (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) they deny him? See 23:63

item.title: Al-Muminoon:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلْ جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jāahum bil-ḥaqi wa-aktharuhum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna Do they say, 'There is madness in him'? Rather he has brought them the truth, and most of them are averse to the truth.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلْ جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jāahum bil-ḥaqi wa-aktharuhum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse. See 23:68

item.title: Al-Muminoon:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلْ جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jāahum bil-ḥaqi wa-aktharuhum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna Or say they that there is mania in him? (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) Nay! he hath brought unto them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth. After giving the possible reasons for their disbelief here is given the actual reason in their being adamant against the truth because it does not agree with their inclinations. (A. P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ walawi ittabaʿa l-ḥaqu ahwāahum lafasadati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhik'rihim fahum ʿan dhik'rihim muʿ'riḍūna Had the Truth followed their desires, the heavens and the earth would have surely fallen apart [along] with those who are in them. Rather We have brought them their reminder, but they are disregardful of their reminder.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ walawi ittabaʿa l-ḥaqu ahwāahum lafasadati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhik'rihim fahum ʿan dhik'rihim muʿ'riḍūna But if the Truth (i.e., Allah) had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message,1 but they, from their message, are turning away. See 23:68

item.title: Al-Muminoon:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ walawi ittabaʿa l-ḥaqu ahwāahum lafasadati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhik'rihim fahum ʿan dhik'rihim muʿ'riḍūna And should the Truth follow their vain inclinations certainly will perish the heavens and the earth and all those who are therein: Nay! he hath brought unto them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they turn aside. See 23:70

item.title: Al-Muminoon:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ am tasaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna Do you ask a recompense from them? Yet your Lord's recompense is better, and He is the best of providers.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ am tasaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna Or do you, (O Muḥammad), ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers. See 23:68

item.title: Al-Muminoon:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ am tasaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna Or is it that thou asketh them for a (As recompense.) tribute? But the recompense (Refer to note on verse 42:23.) of thy Lord is the Best; and He is the Best of the sustainers. See 23:70

item.title: Al-Muminoon:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wa-innaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Indeed you invite them to a straight path,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wa-innaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin And indeed, you invite them to a straight path. See 23:68

item.title: Al-Muminoon:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wa-innaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin And verily thou callest them unto the straight path; See 23:70

item.title: Al-Muminoon:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ wa-inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ʿani l-ṣirāṭi lanākibūna and indeed those who do not believe in the Hereafter surely deviate from the path.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ wa-inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ʿani l-ṣirāṭi lanākibūna But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path. See 23:68

item.title: Al-Muminoon:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ wa-inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ʿani l-ṣirāṭi lanākibūna And verily those who believe not in the hereafter are from the (right) path, the deviators See 23:70

item.title: Al-Muminoon:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ ضُرٍّ لَلَجُّوْۤا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ walaw raḥim'nāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurrin lalajjū fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna Should We have mercy upon them and remove their distress from them, they would surely persist, bewildered in their rebellion.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ ضُرٍّ لَلَجُّوْۤا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ walaw raḥim'nāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurrin lalajjū fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly. See 23:68

item.title: Al-Muminoon:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ ضُرٍّ لَلَجُّوْۤا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ walaw raḥim'nāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurrin lalajjū fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna And should We have mercy on them and (should) We relieve (them) of their distress, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, blindly wandering on. This shows that evolutionary transmigration, i.e., rebirth in this world will not be profitable, for a bad character will only repeat even if it is brought back a thousand times. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famā is'takānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūna Certainly We have seized them with punishment, yet they neither humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they entreat [Him for mercy].

item.title: Al-Muminoon:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famā is'takānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūna And We had gripped them with suffering (as a warning), but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, (and will continue thus). And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke with submission to Him (23:76). Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged in despair (23:77). It is He Who has created for you hearing, eyes, and hearts. Little thanks you give (23:78). And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back (23:79). And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famā is'takānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūna And indeed We seized them with a chastisement but they sub mitted not themselves unto their Lord, nor did they humble themselves (unto Him). See 23:75

item.title: Al-Muminoon:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mub'lisūna When We opened on them the door of a severe punishment, behold, they are despondent in it.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mub'lisūna Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair. See 23:76

item.title: Al-Muminoon:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mub'lisūna Until when We did open upon them a door of severe chastisement, lo! they got into despair at it. See 23:75

item.title: Al-Muminoon:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ wahuwa alladhī ansha-a lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna It is He who made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts. Little do you thank.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ wahuwa alladhī ansha-a lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts (i.e., intellect); little are you grateful. See 23:76

item.title: Al-Muminoon:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ wahuwa alladhī ansha-a lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna He it is Who caused for you the hearing and the sight and hearts; (very) little it is what ye give thanks (unto Him). The correct use of these organs for the purpose for which they are meant, is the thanksgiving. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Muminoon:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ wahuwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna It is He who created you on the earth, and you will be mustered toward Him.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ wahuwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered. See 23:76

item.title: Al-Muminoon:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ wahuwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna He it is Who multiplied you in the earth, and unto Him (only) ye shall be gathered. See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu walahu ikh'tilāfu al-layli wal-nahāri afalā taʿqilūna And it is He who gives life and brings death and due to Him is the alternation of day and night. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: Al-Muminoon:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu walahu ikh'tilāfu al-layli wal-nahāri afalā taʿqilūna And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason? See 23:76

item.title: Al-Muminoon:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu walahu ikh'tilāfu al-layli wal-nahāri afalā taʿqilūna And He it is Who giveth life and (causeth) death, and (in) His (control) is the alternation of the night and the day; What! do ye not then understand? See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قَالُوْا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ bal qālū mith'la mā qāla l-awalūna Rather they say just like what the ancients said.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قَالُوْا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ bal qālū mith'la mā qāla l-awalūna Rather,1 they say like what the former peoples said. See 23:76

item.title: Al-Muminoon:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قَالُوْا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ bal qālū mith'la mā qāla l-awalūna Nay! say they the like of what said the ancients. See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ qālū a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna They said, 'What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ qālū a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected? See 23:76

item.title: Al-Muminoon:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ qālū a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna They say: "What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we (even) then be raised?" See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا هَذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ laqad wuʿid'nā naḥnu waābāunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna Certainly we and our fathers were promised this before. [But] these are nothing but myths of the ancients.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا هَذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ laqad wuʿid'nā naḥnu waābāunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples." See 23:76

item.title: Al-Muminoon:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا هَذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ laqad wuʿid'nā naḥnu waābāunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna Certainly this have we been promised, we and (also) our fathers aforetime, but this is not but fables of the ancients. See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūna Say, 'To whom does the earth belong and whoever it contains, if you know?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
