Say: "Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know! (23:84). They will say: "It is Allah's!" Say: "Will you not then remember? (23:85). Say: "Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne? (23:86). They will say: "Allah." Say: "Will you not then have Taqwa? (23:87). Say: "In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything? And He protects, while against Whom there is no protector, if you know? (23:88). They will say: "(All that belongs) to Allah." Say: "How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth? (23:89). Nay, but We have brought them the truth,…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūna Say (Ask.) thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Whose is the earth; whoever is in it, if ye know?" See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tadhakkarūna They will say, 'To Allah.' Say, 'Will you not then take admonition?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tadhakkarūna They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?" See 23:84

item.title: Al-Muminoon:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tadhakkarūna They will say: "God's," Say "Will thou (then): "Will ye not reflect?" See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ qul man rabbu l-samāwāti l-sabʿi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi Say, 'Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Great Throne?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ qul man rabbu l-samāwāti l-sabʿi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?" See 23:84

item.title: Al-Muminoon:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ qul man rabbu l-samāwāti l-sabʿi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi Say (Ask.) thou: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Glorious Throne?" See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tattaqūna They will say, '[They belong] to Allah.' Say, 'Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tattaqūna They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?" See 23:84

item.title: Al-Muminoon:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tattaqūna They will say: (that they are) "God's"; (then) Say thou: "Will ye not then guard (yourselves against evil)?" See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūna Say, 'In whose hand is the dominion of all things, and who shelters and no shelter can be provided from Him, if you know?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūna Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?" See 23:84

item.title: Al-Muminoon:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūna Say thou: "Who is it in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things and Who protecteth and is never protected? if ye do but know?" See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّى تُسْحَرُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul fa-annā tus'ḥarūna They will say, '[They all belong] to Allah.' Say, 'Then how are you being deluded?'1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّى تُسْحَرُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul fa-annā tus'ḥarūna They will say, "(All belongs) to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?" See 23:84

item.title: Al-Muminoon:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّى تُسْحَرُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul fa-annā tus'ḥarūna They will say: "In God's" (hand) (then) Say thou: "From whence (then) are ye beguiled?" See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqi wa-innahum lakādhibūna Rather We have brought them the truth, and they are indeed liars.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqi wa-innahum lakādhibūna Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars. See 23:84

item.title: Al-Muminoon:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqi wa-innahum lakādhibūna Nay! We have brought unto them the Truth, and verily they are liars. See 23:78

item.title: Al-Muminoon:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ mā ittakhadha l-lahu min waladin wamā kāna maʿahu min ilāhin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna Allah has not taken any offspring, neither is there any god besides Him, for then each god would take away what he created, and some of them would surely rise up against others. Clear is Allah of what they allege!

item.title: Al-Muminoon:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ mā ittakhadha l-lahu min waladin wamā kāna maʿahu min ilāhin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. (If there had been), then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have (sought to) overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe (concerning Him). No son (or offspring) did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him. (If there had been many gods), then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allah above all…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ mā ittakhadha l-lahu min waladin wamā kāna maʿahu min ilāhin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna Never did God take unto Him a son and never was there with Him any god - else would each god have certainly taken away what he had created, and some of them would certainly have overpowered others; Far from the glory of God, be what they attribute (unto Him), The conception of other deities has no logical justification unless it is postulated that each is totally differentiated from the other without any aspect common between them. On this postulation the result would be as said here. Hence from the unity and…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna The Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, He is above having any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: Al-Muminoon:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna (He is) Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate (with Him). See 23:91

item.title: Al-Muminoon:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna (He is) the Knower (alike) of the seen and the unseen, so exalted is He, far above what they join (with Him). See 23:91

item.title: Al-Muminoon:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ رَبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūna Say, 'My Lord! If You should show me what they are promised,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ رَبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised. Say: "My Lord! If You would show me that with which they are threatened, (23:93). "My Lord! Then, put me not amongst the people who are the wrongdoers (23:94). And indeed We are able to show you that with which We have threatened them (23:95). Repel evil with that which is better. We are best-acquainted with the things they utter (23:96). And say: "My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings of the Shayatin (23:97). "And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they should come near me (23:98). The Command to Call on Allah When Calamity Strikes, to Repel Evil with That Which Is Better, and to Seek Refuge…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ رَبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūna Say thou: "O' my Lord! If thou wilt make me see what (chastisement) they are promised," See 23:91

item.title: Al-Muminoon:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ rabbi falā tajʿalnī fī l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna then do not put me, my Lord, among the wrongdoing lot.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ rabbi falā tajʿalnī fī l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people." See 23:93

item.title: Al-Muminoon:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ rabbi falā tajʿalnī fī l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna O' my Lord! then place me not amidst the unjust people! See 23:91

item.title: Al-Muminoon:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا عَلَى أَنْ نُرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ wa-innā ʿalā an nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūna We are indeed able to show you what We promise them.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا عَلَى أَنْ نُرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ wa-innā ʿalā an nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūna And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them. See 23:93

item.title: Al-Muminoon:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا عَلَى أَنْ نُرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ wa-innā ʿalā an nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūna Verily, We are well able to make thee see (the chastisement) what We have promised them. See 23:91

item.title: Al-Muminoon:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu l-sayi-ata naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūna Repel ill [conduct] with that which is the best. We know best whatever they allege.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu l-sayi-ata naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūna Repel, by (means of) what is best, (their) evil. We are most knowing of what they describe. See 23:93

item.title: Al-Muminoon:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu l-sayi-ata naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūna Repel evil by what is best; We know best what they attribute (against thee). The highest point of Islamic ethics has been given in this verse. To speak of the doctrine of an unconditional and a total surrender against any unprovoked aggression is very easy. What is in the Bible 'Turn the other cheek also if the one is smitten and to give away thy shirt also if the cloak is taken by force' is very easy to be praised and to pride over but the impracticability of the ideal has already been proved by the inability of the Christian authorities themselves to act upon the doctrine. The world can never forget the Edict of Milan against the Jews and the war…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ waqul rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti l-shayāṭīni And say, 'My Lord! I seek Your protection from the promptings of devils;

item.title: Al-Muminoon:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ waqul rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti l-shayāṭīni And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils. See 23:93

item.title: Al-Muminoon:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ waqul rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti l-shayāṭīni And say thou: "O' my Lord! I seek refuge unto Thee from the (evil) (Suggestion.) promptings of the satans!" The evil suggestions of the Devil are such common experiences of every one of us that the matter needs no elaborate dealing. The maximum amount of faith in man is to seek refuge in the Lord Himself which suggests the conviction of the individual about, God alone being worthy of granting the refuge and the inner-most aspiration of the soul to return to All-goodness, (i.e., God) against the attack from the evil one.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūni and I seek Your protection, my Lord, from their presence near me.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūni And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me." See 23:93

item.title: Al-Muminoon:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūni I seek refuge unto Thee O' my Lord! from their (Their presence with me.) access to me With the announcement of the end of the world and the dawn of the Day of Judgment, all family relationship between the members of the human family will be dissolved and every soul will be a separate individual standing upon the merits and the demerits it has earned in its life on earth.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi ir'jiʿūni When death comes to one of them, he says, 'My Lord! Take me back,

item.title: Al-Muminoon:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi ir'jiʿūni (For such is the state of the disbelievers) until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back. Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: My Lord! Send me back, (23:99). "So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!" No! (Kalla) It is but a word that he speaks; and in front of them is Barzakh until the Day when they will be resurrected (23:100). The Disbelievers' Hope When Death Approaches Allah tells us about what happens when death approaches one of the disbelievers or one of those who have been negligent with the commands of Allah.He tells us what he says and how he asks to come back to this…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi ir'jiʿūni Until, when cometh death unto one of them, sayeth he: "My Lord! send me back again (into the world)", See 23:98

item.title: Al-Muminoon:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّا إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qāiluhā wamin warāihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna that I may act righteously in what I have left behind.' 'By no means! These are mere words that he says.' And ahead of them is a barrier until the day they will be resurrected

item.title: Al-Muminoon:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّا إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qāiluhā wamin warāihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."1 No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected. See 23:99

item.title: Al-Muminoon:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّا إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qāiluhā wamin warāihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna That I may do (the) good which I have left undone." By no means! it is but a word he sayeth; and after them shall be a barrier (Any distance in between.) until the day they shall be raised (Resurrected for the final judgment.) (again). 'Barzakh' here means the interval between the death of the individual and the state of total or collective resurrection. Regarding the condition and the state of that interval or the intermediary state the passage is silent - all that is said about this state is derived from authentic sayings of the holy Prophet and the Imams of his House, supported by sound reasoning.…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَلَا أَنْسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma-idhin walā yatasāalūna And when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no ties between them on that day, nor will they ask [about] each other.1

item.title: Al-Muminoon:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَلَا أَنْسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma-idhin walā yatasāalūna So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another. Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another (23:101). Then, those whose Scales (of good deeds) are heavy, these! they are the successful (23:102). And those whose Scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who lose themselves, in Hell will they abide (23:103). The Fire will burn their faces, and therein they will grin, with displaced lips (disfigured) (23:104). The Sounding of the Trumpet and the Weighing of Deeds in the Scales Allah says that when the Trumpet is blown for the…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَلَا أَنْسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma-idhin walā yatasāalūna And when the trumpet is blown, there shall be no ties of kindred between them on that day, nor shall they ask of one another. The word 'Sur' here and elsewhere may be the plural 'Surat', (i.e., Form) - and it may may the time or the also mean the Trumpet. However, the time or the state of the Blow, is when the whole universe along with all its components, animate and inanimate, beings angelic and human, assume the final form and shape to which they are destined. Before reaching that state the relations of the parts and the components to each other and to the whole is subject to change - for instance a seed contains parts and the…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Then those whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales —it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna And those whose scales are heavy (with good deeds) - it is they who are the successful. See 23:101

item.title: Al-Muminoon:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Then (those) whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy, they shall be the successful ones; (In getting salvation.) 'Mawazin' here and elsewhere indicate that every aspect or act of human life will be weighed and for each aspect there will be a different scale. But the Scale of scales is the Imam. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūna As for those whose deeds weigh light in the scales, —they will be the ones who have ruined their souls, [and] they will remain in hell [forever].

item.title: Al-Muminoon:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūna But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, (being) in Hell, abiding eternally. See 23:101

item.title: Al-Muminoon:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūna And those whose scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who shall lose their souls, abiding in Hell. See 23:102

item.title: Al-Muminoon:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ talfaḥu wujūhahumu l-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūna The Fire will scorch their faces, and they will be morose in it.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ talfaḥu wujūhahumu l-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūna The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.1 See 23:101

item.title: Al-Muminoon:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ talfaḥu wujūhahumu l-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūna The fire shall scorch their faces and they therein shall be grinning (of the affliction). See 23:102

item.title: Al-Muminoon:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ alam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūna 'Was it not that My signs were recited to you but you would deny them?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ alam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūna (It will be said), "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?" Were not My Ayat recited to you, and then you used to deny them? (23:105). They will say: "Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were (an) erring people (23:106). "Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If ever we return (to evil), then indeed we shall be wrongdoers (23:107). Rebuking the People of Hell, Their Admission of Their Wretchedness and Their Request to Be Brought out of Hell This is a rebuke from Allah to the people of Hell for the disbelief, sins, unlawful deeds and evil actions that they committed, because of which they were doomed. Allah says: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ alam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūna (Then will God ask them) "Were not My signs rehearsed unto you? then ye used to belie them" See 23:102

item.title: Al-Muminoon:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiq'watunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīna They will say, 'Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were an astray lot.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiq'watunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīna They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray. See 23:105

item.title: Al-Muminoon:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiq'watunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīna They shall say: "O' Our Lord! overcame us our ill-luck and we were people gone astray" See 23:102

item.title: Al-Muminoon:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ rabbanā akhrij'nā min'hā fa-in ʿud'nā fa-innā ẓālimūna Our Lord! Bring us out of this! Then, if we revert, we will indeed be wrongdoers.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ rabbanā akhrij'nā min'hā fa-in ʿud'nā fa-innā ẓālimūna Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return (to evil), we would indeed be wrongdoers." See 23:105

item.title: Al-Muminoon:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ rabbanā akhrij'nā min'hā fa-in ʿud'nā fa-innā ẓālimūna O' our Lord! Take us out of it; if we return (to evil) then verily we shall be unjust, See 23:102

item.title: Al-Muminoon:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اخْسَئُوْۤا فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ qāla ikh'saū fīhā walā tukallimūni He will say, 'Begone in it, and do not speak to Me!

item.title: Al-Muminoon:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اخْسَئُوْۤا فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ qāla ikh'saū fīhā walā tukallimūni He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me. He (Allah) will say: "Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me! (23:108). Verily, there was a party of My servants who used to say: "Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy! (23:109). But you took them for a laughing stock, so much so that they made you forget My remembrance while you used to laugh at them (23:110). Verily, I have rewarded them this Day for their patience; they are indeed the ones that are successful (23:111). Allah's Response and Rejection of the Disbelievers This is the response of Allah to the disbelievers when they ask Him to…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اخْسَئُوْۤا فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ qāla ikh'saū fīhā walā tukallimūni (God will) say: "Be ye driven down into it, and speak ye not unto Me!" See 23:102

item.title: Al-Muminoon:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ innahu kāna farīqun min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna Indeed there was a part of My servants who would say, "Our Lord! We have believed. So forgive us, and have mercy on us, and You are the best of the merciful."

item.title: Al-Muminoon:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ innahu kāna farīqun min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.' See 23:108

item.title: Al-Muminoon:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ innahu kāna farīqun min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna Verily, there was a party of My servants who said: "O' our Lord! we believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, and Thou art the Best of the Merciful ones!" See 23:102

item.title: Al-Muminoon:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتّٰی أَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي وَكُنْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ fa-ittakhadhtumūhum sikh'riyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhik'rī wakuntum min'hum taḍḥakūna But then you took them by ridicule until they made you forget My remembrance,1 and you used to laugh at them.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتّٰی أَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي وَكُنْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ fa-ittakhadhtumūhum sikh'riyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhik'rī wakuntum min'hum taḍḥakūna But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them. See 23:108

item.title: Al-Muminoon:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتّٰی أَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي وَكُنْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ fa-ittakhadhtumūhum sikh'riyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhik'rī wakuntum min'hum taḍḥakūna But ye took them with ridicule that (until they) made you to neglect My remembrance, while ye did laugh at them. Actually, their mockery was the cause of their negligence and not the believers but they were at the bottom of the mischief. The act attributed to them. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ innī jazaytuhumu l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humu l-fāizūna Indeed I have rewarded them today for their patience. They are indeed the triumphant.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ innī jazaytuhumu l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humu l-fāizūna Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers (of success)." See 23:108

item.title: Al-Muminoon:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ innī jazaytuhumu l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humu l-fāizūna Verily, I have recompensed them this day for they were patient; (that), they are the achievers. See 23:110

item.title: Al-Muminoon:112 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ qāla kam labith'tum fī l-arḍi ʿadada sinīna He will say, 'How many years did you remain on earth?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:112 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ qāla kam labith'tum fī l-arḍi ʿadada sinīna (Allah) will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?" He will say: "What number of years did you stay on earth? (23:112). They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account (23:113). He will say: "You stayed not but a little, if you had only known! (23:114). "Did you think that We had created you in play, and that you would not be brought back to Us? (23:115). So Exalted be Allah, the True King: None has the right to be worshipped but He, the Lord of Al-'Arsh Al-Karim (23:116). Allah tells them how much they wasted in their short lives in this world by failing to obey Allah and worship Him…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:112 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ qāla kam labith'tum fī l-arḍi ʿadada sinīna He will say: "How many years did ye tarry in the earth?" See 23:110

item.title: Al-Muminoon:113 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْءَلِ الْعَادِّينَ qālū labith'nā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasali l-ʿādīna They will say, 'We remained for a day, or part of a day; yet ask those who keep the count.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:113 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْءَلِ الْعَادِّينَ qālū labith'nā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasali l-ʿādīna They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate." See 23:112

item.title: Al-Muminoon:113 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْءَلِ الْعَادِّينَ qālū labith'nā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasali l-ʿādīna They will say: "Tarried we a day or part of a day, ask thou those who keep account" However long may be the stay on the earth, it is nothing in comparison to Eternity but however one should realise that this short stay here is not vain and purposeless.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:114 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qāla in labith'tum illā qalīlan law annakum kuntum taʿlamūna He will say, 'You only remained a little; if only you had known.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:114 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qāla in labith'tum illā qalīlan law annakum kuntum taʿlamūna He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known. See 23:112

item.title: Al-Muminoon:114 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ qāla in labith'tum illā qalīlan law annakum kuntum taʿlamūna (God will) say: "You did tarry but a little if ye only knew (it)" See 23:113

item.title: Al-Muminoon:115 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ afaḥasib'tum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ilaynā lā tur'jaʿūna Did you suppose that We created you aimlessly, and that you will not be brought back to Us?'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:115 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ afaḥasib'tum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ilaynā lā tur'jaʿūna Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?" See 23:112

item.title: Al-Muminoon:115 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ afaḥasib'tum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ilaynā lā tur'jaʿūna What! think ye then that We created you in vain and that unto Us ye shall not be returned? Man is informed that the whole working of the Universe is not a vain or an aimless game but a predetermined plan of the All-Wise Author of Creation. Man being one of the constituent beings of the organism of the universe, has also his own individual responsibility - for which one day he would have to account for.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:116 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīmi So exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign, there is no god except Him, the Lord of the Noble Throne.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:116 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīmi So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign,1 the Truth;2 there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne. See 23:112

item.title: Al-Muminoon:116 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīmi Then (behold) the most exalted is God, the True King; No god is there but He, the Lord (Lord Cherisher.) of 'Arsh' (Which comprehends the whole universe.) (the Throne) of Grace. See 23:115

item.title: Al-Muminoon:117 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ waman yadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā bur'hāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūna Whoever invokes besides Allah another god of which he has no proof, his reckoning will indeed rest with his Lord. Indeed the faithless will not be felicitous.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:117 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ waman yadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā bur'hāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūna And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed. And whoever invokes besides Allah, any other god, of whom he has no proof; then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely, disbelievers will not be successful (23:117). And say : My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy! (23:118). Shirk Is the Worst Form of Wrong, Its Practitioner Shall Never Succeed Allah threatens those who associate anything else with Him and worship anything with Him.He informs…

item.title: Al-Muminoon:117 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ waman yadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā bur'hāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūna And whoever invoketh with God another god - he hath no proof therefore - his reckoning is only with his Lord; Verily, the disbelievers shall not be successful. Though there are many proofs for the Unity of God but there is not a single piece of evidence of anyone being besides Him. (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:118 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ waqul rabbi igh'fir wa-ir'ḥam wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna Say, 'My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:118 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ waqul rabbi igh'fir wa-ir'ḥam wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna And, (O Muḥammad), say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful." See 23:117

item.title: Al-Muminoon:118 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ waqul rabbi igh'fir wa-ir'ḥam wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna And say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "O' my Lord! For give and have mercy, and Thou art the Best of the merciful ones!" See 23:117

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِمَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا فِي سَبِيلِي وَابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِي تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُمْ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْهُ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū ʿaduwwī waʿaduwwakum awliyāa tul'qūna ilayhim bil-mawadati waqad kafarū bimā jāakum mina l-ḥaqi yukh'rijūna l-rasūla wa-iyyākum an tu'minū bil-lahi rabbikum in kuntum kharajtum jihādan fī sabīlī wa-ib'tighāa marḍātī tusirrūna ilayhim bil-mawadati wa-anā aʿlamu bimā akhfaytum wamā aʿlantum waman yafʿalhu minkum faqad ḍalla sawāa l-sabīli O you who have faith! Do not take My enemy and your enemy for friends, [secretly] offering them affection (for they have certainly defied whatever has come to you of the truth, expelling the Apostle and you, because you have faith in Allah, your…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِمَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا فِي سَبِيلِي وَابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِي تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُمْ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْهُ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū ʿaduwwī waʿaduwwakum awliyāa tul'qūna ilayhim bil-mawadati waqad kafarū bimā jāakum mina l-ḥaqi yukh'rijūna l-rasūla wa-iyyākum an tu'minū bil-lahi rabbikum in kuntum kharajtum jihādan fī sabīlī wa-ib'tighāa marḍātī tusirrūna ilayhim bil-mawadati wa-anā aʿlamu bimā akhfaytum wamā aʿlantum waman yafʿalhu minkum faqad ḍalla sawāa l-sabīli O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies,1 extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves (only) because you believe in Allah,…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِمَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا فِي سَبِيلِي وَابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِي تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُمْ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْهُ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū ʿaduwwī waʿaduwwakum awliyāa tul'qūna ilayhim bil-mawadati waqad kafarū bimā jāakum mina l-ḥaqi yukh'rijūna l-rasūla wa-iyyākum an tu'minū bil-lahi rabbikum in kuntum kharajtum jihādan fī sabīlī wa-ib'tighāa marḍātī tusirrūna ilayhim bil-mawadati wa-anā aʿlamu bimā akhfaytum wamā aʿlantum waman yafʿalhu minkum faqad ḍalla sawāa l-sabīli 'O' ye who believe! Take ye not My foe and your foe for friends: offering unto them (your) love while denied they what hath come unto you of the Truth (Islam.) ; driving out the Apostle and yourselves for ye believe in God, your…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوْۤا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالسُّوءِ وَوَدُّوْۤا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ in yathqafūkum yakūnū lakum aʿdāan wayabsuṭū ilaykum aydiyahum wa-alsinatahum bil-sūi wawaddū law takfurūna If they were to confront you they would be your enemies, and would stretch out against you their hands and their tongues with evil [intentions], and they are eager that you should be faithless.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوْۤا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالسُّوءِ وَوَدُّوْۤا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ in yathqafūkum yakūnū lakum aʿdāan wayabsuṭū ilaykum aydiyahum wa-alsinatahum bil-sūi wawaddū law takfurūna If they gain dominance over you, they would be (i.e., behave) to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve. See 60:1

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوْۤا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالسُّوءِ وَوَدُّوْۤا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ in yathqafūkum yakūnū lakum aʿdāan wayabsuṭū ilaykum aydiyahum wa-alsinatahum bil-sūi wawaddū law takfurūna If they find any opportunity against you, they will be foes unto you, and will stretch forth unto you their hands and their tongues with evil (intent), and anxiously desire they that ye (too) should disbelieve (Refers to the infidels who had resorted to violence and to the hypocrites who desert in the Holy- Prophet in the battles.) . See 60:1

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَنْ تَنْفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ lan tanfaʿakum arḥāmukum walā awlādukum yawma l-qiyāmati yafṣilu baynakum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Your relatives and your children will not avail you on the Day of Resurrection: He will separate you [from one another], and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَنْ تَنْفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ lan tanfaʿakum arḥāmukum walā awlādukum yawma l-qiyāmati yafṣilu baynakum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing. See 60:1

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَنْ تَنْفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ lan tanfaʿakum arḥāmukum walā awlādukum yawma l-qiyāmati yafṣilu baynakum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Never shall profit you your relations, nor your children, on the Day of Reckoning; He (alone) will decide between you, and God Seeth All whatsoever ye do (Refer to Verses 2:48; 6:164; 17:15; 35:18; 39:7; 53:38.) . Faith and faithfulness should never be allowed to be corrupted by prejudice for the sake of even the nearest relatives - for none, no member of the family, would be of any avail to anyone on the Day of Judgment - as none would bear the burden of the other1. Any infidel resorting to violence, however close a relative he might be, should be disassociated, similar to what has been done by Abraham. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ إِذْ قَالُوْا لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَاؤُا مِنْكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ أَبَدًا حَتّٰی تُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ إِلَّا قَوْلَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَا أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ qad kānat lakum us'watun ḥasanatun fī ib'rāhīma wa-alladhīna maʿahu idh qālū liqawmihim innā buraāu minkum wamimmā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi kafarnā bikum wabadā baynanā wabaynakumu l-ʿadāwatu wal-baghḍāu abadan ḥattā tu'minū bil-lahi waḥdahu illā qawla ib'rāhīma li-abīhi la-astaghfiranna laka wamā amliku laka mina l-lahi min shayin rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa-ilayka anabnā wa-ilayka l-maṣīru There is certainly a good exemplar for you in Abraham and those who were with him, when they said to their own people, 'Indeed we repudiate you and whatever you worship besides Allah. We disavow you,…

item.description: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ إِذْ قَالُوْا لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَاؤُا مِنْكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ أَبَدًا حَتّٰی تُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ إِلَّا قَوْلَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَا أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ qad kānat lakum us'watun ḥasanatun fī ib'rāhīma wa-alladhīna maʿahu idh qālū liqawmihim innā buraāu minkum wamimmā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi kafarnā bikum wabadā baynanā wabaynakumu l-ʿadāwatu wal-baghḍāu abadan ḥattā tu'minū bil-lahi waḥdahu illā qawla ib'rāhīma li-abīhi la-astaghfiranna laka wamā amliku laka mina l-lahi min shayin rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa-ilayka anabnā wa-ilayka l-maṣīru There has already been for you an excellent pattern1 in Ibrahim and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ إِذْ قَالُوْا لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَاؤُا مِنْكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ أَبَدًا حَتّٰی تُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ إِلَّا قَوْلَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَا أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ qad kānat lakum us'watun ḥasanatun fī ib'rāhīma wa-alladhīna maʿahu idh qālū liqawmihim innā buraāu minkum wamimmā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi kafarnā bikum wabadā baynanā wabaynakumu l-ʿadāwatu wal-baghḍāu abadan ḥattā tu'minū bil-lahi waḥdahu illā qawla ib'rāhīma li-abīhi la-astaghfiranna laka wamā amliku laka mina l-lahi min shayin rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa-ilayka anabnā wa-ilayka l-maṣīru Indeed, there is for you a good pattern (of life) in Abraham and those with him; when said they unto their people: "Verily We disassociate (ourselves) from you and from what ye worship other than God;…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū wa-igh'fir lanā rabbanā innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Our Lord! Do not make us a trial for the faithless, and forgive us. Our Lord! Indeed You are the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū wa-igh'fir lanā rabbanā innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Our Lord, make us not (objects of) torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise." See 60:4

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū wa-igh'fir lanā rabbanā innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu 'O' Our Lord! make us not a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us O' Our Lord! Verily Thou art the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise. Do not give the disbelievers a triumph over them so that they might be subjected to their cruelties to try them with their patience and on their, (i.e., believers) failures, they are punished by the chastisement from the Lord. The Sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq said: "In the days gone by a believer was always a poor man and a disbeliever was always rich - until Abraham came into the world as an Apostle of God who offered this prayer after which poverty and riches were left…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ laqad kāna lakum fīhim us'watun ḥasanatun liman kāna yarjū l-laha wal-yawma l-ākhira waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu There is certainly a good exemplar for you in them —for those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day— and anyone who refuses to comply [should know that] indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ laqad kāna lakum fīhim us'watun ḥasanatun liman kāna yarjū l-laha wal-yawma l-ākhira waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy. See 60:4

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْءَاخِرَ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ laqad kāna lakum fīhim us'watun ḥasanatun liman kāna yarjū l-laha wal-yawma l-ākhira waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu Indeed there is for you in them a good pattern (Example.) (of life), for him who hopeth in God and the Last Day; and whosoever turneth away, then verily God is He Who is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised. i.e. In this attachment to the Truth disassociation from falsehood and evil and their attitude to life in this world.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَسٰۤی اللَّهُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ ʿasā l-lahu an yajʿala baynakum wabayna alladhīna ʿādaytum min'hum mawaddatan wal-lahu qadīrun wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun It may be that Allah will bring about between you and those with whom you are at enmity affection, and Allah is all-powerful, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَسٰۤی اللَّهُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ ʿasā l-lahu an yajʿala baynakum wabayna alladhīna ʿādaytum min'hum mawaddatan wal-lahu qadīrun wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun Perhaps Allah will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allah is competent,1 and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. Perhaps Allah will make friendship between you and those whom you hold as enemies. And Allah has power (over all things), and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (60:7). Allah does not forbid you to deal justly and kindly with those who fought not against you on account of religion nor drove you out of your homes. Verily, Allah loves those who deal with equity (60:8). It is only as regards those who fought against you on account of religion, and have driven you…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَسٰۤی اللَّهُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ ʿasā l-lahu an yajʿala baynakum wabayna alladhīna ʿādaytum min'hum mawaddatan wal-lahu qadīrun wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun Maybe that God will cause friendship between you and those whom ye take to be your enemies (The enmity being not personal they may change their view.) among them, and God is All- Powerful; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. After the capture of Mecca, the nearest relations of the believers who before the Hijrat and until the capture of Mecca, were inimical to the Muslims, embraced Islam and became friends. One of the greatest and the leading chiefs of the enemy was Abu-Sofyan who embraced Islam. The enmity being non-personal. they may change their views. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ أَنْ تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ lā yanhākumu l-lahu ʿani alladhīna lam yuqātilūkum fī l-dīni walam yukh'rijūkum min diyārikum an tabarrūhum watuq'siṭū ilayhim inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīna Allah does not forbid you in regard to those who did not make war against you on account of religion and did not expel you from your homes, that you deal with them with kindness and justice. Indeed Allah loves the just.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ أَنْ تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ lā yanhākumu l-lahu ʿani alladhīna lam yuqātilūkum fī l-dīni walam yukh'rijūkum min diyārikum an tabarrūhum watuq'siṭū ilayhim inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīna Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly. See 60:7

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ أَنْ تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ lā yanhākumu l-lahu ʿani alladhīna lam yuqātilūkum fī l-dīni walam yukh'rijūkum min diyārikum an tabarrūhum watuq'siṭū ilayhim inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīna Forbiddeth not God unto you regarding those who have not made war upon you in the matter of (your) religion, and drove you not out of your homes, that ye show them kindness and be just unto them; Verily God loveth the just ones (Islam is not against Muslims extending their generosity and kindness to non-Muslims who are not violent. AP. See Verse 2:221.) . These two verses lay stress on the 'clear and unmistakable language the rule about the kindness and equity, Muslims have been ordained by Islam, towards the non-Muslims, excluding the rampantly aggressive and actively…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ وَظَاهَرُوْۤا عَلَى إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَنْ تَوَلَّوْهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ innamā yanhākumu l-lahu ʿani alladhīna qātalūkum fī l-dīni wa-akhrajūkum min diyārikum waẓāharū ʿalā ikh'rājikum an tawallawhum waman yatawallahum fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna Allah forbids you only in regard to those who made war against you on account of religion and expelled you from your homes and supported [others] in your expulsion, that you make friends with them, and whoever makes friends with them —it is they who are the wrongdoers.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ وَظَاهَرُوْۤا عَلَى إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَنْ تَوَلَّوْهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ innamā yanhākumu l-lahu ʿani alladhīna qātalūkum fī l-dīni wa-akhrajūkum min diyārikum waẓāharū ʿalā ikh'rājikum an tawallawhum waman yatawallahum fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - (forbids) that you make allies1 of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers. See 60:7

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ وَظَاهَرُوْۤا عَلَى إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَنْ تَوَلَّوْهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ innamā yanhākumu l-lahu ʿani alladhīna qātalūkum fī l-dīni wa-akhrajūkum min diyārikum waẓāharū ʿalā ikh'rājikum an tawallawhum waman yatawallahum fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna Only doth God forbid you regarding those who made war upon you in the matter of (your) religion, and drove you out of your homes and aided in your expulsion, that ye make friends of them; and whosoever maketh friends of them, these are the unjust ones (The befriender of the unjust are also the unjust ones. Thus those who are the friends of the enemies of the Ahlul-Bait are themselves the enemies of the holy ones. Refer to Verses 3:118; 2:191.) . See 60:8

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِهِنَّ فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ وَءَاتُوهُمْ مَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَا ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوْۤا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ وَسْءَلُوْۤا مَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْءَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا ذَلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā jāakumu l-mu'minātu muhājirātin fa-im'taḥinūhunna l-lahu aʿlamu biīmānihinna fa-in ʿalim'tumūhunna mu'minātin falā tarjiʿūhunna ilā l-kufāri lā hunna ḥillun lahum walā hum yaḥillūna lahunna waātūhum mā anfaqū walā junāḥa ʿalaykum an tankiḥūhunna idhā ātaytumūhunna ujūrahunna walā tum'sikū biʿiṣami l-kawāfiri wasalū mā anfaqtum walyasalū mā anfaqū dhālikum ḥuk'mu l-lahi yaḥkumu baynakum wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun O you who have faith! When faithful women come to you as immigrants,1 test them. Allah knows best [the state of] their faith. Then, if you ascertain them to be…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِهِنَّ فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ وَءَاتُوهُمْ مَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَا ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوْۤا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ وَسْءَلُوْۤا مَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْءَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا ذَلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā jāakumu l-mu'minātu muhājirātin fa-im'taḥinūhunna l-lahu aʿlamu biīmānihinna fa-in ʿalim'tumūhunna mu'minātin falā tarjiʿūhunna ilā l-kufāri lā hunna ḥillun lahum walā hum yaḥillūna lahunna waātūhum mā anfaqū walā junāḥa ʿalaykum an tankiḥūhunna idhā ātaytumūhunna ujūrahunna walā tum'sikū biʿiṣami l-kawāfiri wasalū mā anfaqtum walyasalū mā anfaqū dhālikum ḥuk'mu l-lahi yaḥkumu baynakum wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine (i.e., test) them. Allah is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know…

When come unto you believing women (Refer to Verse 2:221, Thus Islam recognise change of faith as one of the means of separation - for details…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ فَاتَكُمْ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَءَاتُوْۤا الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَاجُهُمْ مِثْلَ مَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي أَنْتُمْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ wa-in fātakum shayon min azwājikum ilā l-kufāri faʿāqabtum faātū alladhīna dhahabat azwājuhum mith'la mā anfaqū wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī antum bihi mu'minūna If anything pertaining to your wives is not reclaimed from the faithless1 and then you have your turn, then give to those whose wives have left the like of what they have spent, and be wary of Allah in whom you have faith.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ فَاتَكُمْ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَءَاتُوْۤا الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَاجُهُمْ مِثْلَ مَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي أَنْتُمْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ wa-in fātakum shayon min azwājikum ilā l-kufāri faʿāqabtum faātū alladhīna dhahabat azwājuhum mith'la mā anfaqū wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī antum bihi mu'minūna And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain (something),1 then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allah, in whom you are believers. See 60:10

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ فَاتَكُمْ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَءَاتُوْۤا الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَاجُهُمْ مِثْلَ مَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي أَنْتُمْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ wa-in fātakum shayon min azwājikum ilā l-kufāri faʿāqabtum faātū alladhīna dhahabat azwājuhum mith'la mā anfaqū wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī antum bihi mu'minūna And if any of your wives passeth away from you unto the disbelievers and thereafter ye have your turn (of triumph over the disbelievers) then give unto those whose wives have gone away the like of what they have spent; and fear ye (the wrath of) God in Whom ye believe (Note: the strict justice maintained favouring the legal right of even the disbelievers.) . Note the equity maintained in regard to the compensation to the disbeliever husbands of the believer women in spite of the men being the sworn enemies of Islam and the Muslims.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَى أَنْ لَا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَانٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu idhā jāaka l-mu'minātu yubāyiʿ'naka ʿalā an lā yush'rik'na bil-lahi shayan walā yasriq'na walā yaznīna walā yaqtul'na awlādahunna walā yatīna bibuh'tānin yaftarīnahu bayna aydīhinna wa-arjulihinna walā yaʿṣīnaka fī maʿrūfin fabāyiʿ'hunna wa-is'taghfir lahunna l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun O Prophet! If faithful women come to you, to take the oath of allegiance to you, [pledging] that they shall not ascribe any partners to Allah, that they shall not steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor utter any slander that they may have intentionally fabricated, nor disobey you in what is right, then accept their allegiance, and plead for them to…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَى أَنْ لَا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَانٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu idhā jāaka l-mu'minātu yubāyiʿ'naka ʿalā an lā yush'rik'na bil-lahi shayan walā yasriq'na walā yaznīna walā yaqtul'na awlādahunna walā yatīna bibuh'tānin yaftarīnahu bayna aydīhinna wa-arjulihinna walā yaʿṣīnaka fī maʿrūfin fabāyiʿ'hunna wa-is'taghfir lahunna l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allah, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs,1 nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَى أَنْ لَا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَانٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu idhā jāaka l-mu'minātu yubāyiʿ'naka ʿalā an lā yush'rik'na bil-lahi shayan walā yasriq'na walā yaznīna walā yaqtul'na awlādahunna walā yatīna bibuh'tānin yaftarīnahu bayna aydīhinna wa-arjulihinna walā yaʿṣīnaka fī maʿrūfin fabāyiʿ'hunna wa-is'taghfir lahunna l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun 'O' (Our) Prophet (Muhammad!) when come unto thee believer women pledging that they will associate not aught with God, and they will steal not, and they will commit not adultery and kill (Killing the issues by intentional abortion or by any other means AP.) not their children, and they will utter not slander, nor utter any falsehood which they had forged themselves between their…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوْۤا مِنَ الْاٰخِرَةُ كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tatawallaw qawman ghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim qad ya-isū mina l-ākhirati kamā ya-isa l-kufāru min aṣḥābi l-qubūri O you who have faith! Do not befriend a people at whom Allah is wrathful: they have despaired of the Hereafter, just as the faithless have despaired of the occupants of the graves.

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوْۤا مِنَ الْاٰخِرَةُ كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tatawallaw qawman ghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim qad ya-isū mina l-ākhirati kamā ya-isa l-kufāru min aṣḥābi l-qubūri O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry. They have despaired of (reward in) the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of (meeting) the companions (i.e., inhabitants) of the graves. O you who believe! Take not as friends the people who incurred the wrath of Allah. Surely, they have despaired of the Hereafter, just as the disbelievers have despaired of those (buried) in graves (60:13). Just like in the beginning of the Surah, Allah the Exalted forbids taking the disbelievers as protecting friends at the end of the Surah, saying: يَا…

item.title: Al-Mumtahana:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوْۤا مِنَ الْاٰخِرَةُ كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tatawallaw qawman ghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim qad ya-isū mina l-ākhirati kamā ya-isa l-kufāru min aṣḥābi l-qubūri 'O' ye those who believe! Make ye not friends with a people with whom God is wrath; indeed despair they of their hereafter, as the disbelievers despair of those in the graves (This the principle of the doctrine of Tabarra. Refer to Verses 64:7; 58:14.) . A sect of the Jews and the pagan Arabs disbelieved in the Resurrection. Those who do not believe in having any sign of the graves at all or opposed to honouring the graves of holy men by reciting the Word of God to invoke the mercy of God on the dead, may note this. Visiting the…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوْا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَكَاذِبُونَ idhā jāaka l-munāfiqūna qālū nashhadu innaka larasūlu l-lahi wal-lahu yaʿlamu innaka larasūluhu wal-lahu yashhadu inna l-munāfiqīna lakādhibūna When the hypocrites come to you they say, 'We bear witness that you are indeed the apostle of Allah.' Allah knows that you are indeed His Apostle, and Allah bears witness that the hypocrites are indeed liars.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوْا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَكَاذِبُونَ idhā jāaka l-munāfiqūna qālū nashhadu innaka larasūlu l-lahi wal-lahu yaʿlamu innaka larasūluhu wal-lahu yashhadu inna l-munāfiqīna lakādhibūna When the hypocrites come to you, (O Muḥammad), they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." And Allah knows that you are His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars. وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ يَقُولُوا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ And when you look at them, their bodies please you; and when they speak, you listen to their words. Meaning: hypocrites have a graceful outer appearance and are eloquent. When one hears them speak, he will listen to their eloquent words, even though hypocrites are truly weak and feeble, full of fear, fright and cowardice. Allah's statement: يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوْا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَكَاذِبُونَ idhā jāaka l-munāfiqūna qālū nashhadu innaka larasūlu l-lahi wal-lahu yaʿlamu innaka larasūluhu wal-lahu yashhadu inna l-munāfiqīna lakādhibūna When came unto thee the hypocrites, said they: "We bear witness that verily thou art the Apostle of God;" and verily God knoweth that thou (O' Muhammad!) art certainly His Apostle; and verily God beareth witness that the hypocrites (There is no mention of the hypocrites since the departure of the Holy Prophet from this world. The question is - what happened to them? See note to the Verse.) are certainly the liars (Refer to Verse 3:167; 9:73; 29:11; 33:48; 59:11.) . The hidden rancour of hypocrisy is more dangerous and more harmful than any open hostility for in whichever society it might exist, it effects…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ittakhadhū aymānahum junnatan faṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna They make a shield of their oaths, and bar from the way of Allah. Evil indeed is what they used to do.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ittakhadhū aymānahum junnatan faṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted (people) from the way of Allah. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing. See 63:1

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ittakhadhū aymānahum junnatan faṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna They make their oaths a shield, thus they obstruct (others) from the way of God; verily evil is what they are wont to do (Refer to Verse 58:16) . The professing the faith and their oaths are all blank, without any sincerity in it, there being no agreement between their mouths and their hearts1.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ اٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوْۤا فَطُبِعَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ dhālika bi-annahum āmanū thumma kafarū faṭubiʿa ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yafqahūna That is because they believed and then disbelieved, so their hearts were sealed. Hence they do not understand.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ اٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوْۤا فَطُبِعَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ dhālika bi-annahum āmanū thumma kafarū faṭubiʿa ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yafqahūna That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand. See 63:1

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ اٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوْۤا فَطُبِعَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ dhālika bi-annahum āmanū thumma kafarū faṭubiʿa ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yafqahūna That is because they believe, then (again) disbelieve they, so a seal hath been set upon their hearts, so they understand not (Refer to Verses 2:7; 7:101; 10:74; 16:108; 17:46; 45:23.) . The setting of the seal is only the natural consequence of the persistence in disbelief and the adamance against the guidance1. A mere withdrawal of the guidance, which the disbelievers were determined not to avail of it, is the virtual sealing of the hearts effected by the disbelievers themselves.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ وَإِنْ يَقُولُوْۤا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُسَنَّدَةٌ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ هُمُ الْعَدُوُّ فَاحْذَرْهُمْ قَاتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wa-idhā ra-aytahum tuʿ'jibuka ajsāmuhum wa-in yaqūlū tasmaʿ liqawlihim ka-annahum khushubun musannadatun yaḥsabūna kulla ṣayḥatin ʿalayhim humu l-ʿaduwu fa-iḥ'dharhum qātalahumu l-lahu annā yu'fakūna When you see them, their bodies impress you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. Yet they are like dry logs set reclining [against a wall]. They suppose every cry is directed against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah assail them, where do they stray?!

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
