item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ وَإِنْ يَقُولُوْۤا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُسَنَّدَةٌ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ هُمُ الْعَدُوُّ فَاحْذَرْهُمْ قَاتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wa-idhā ra-aytahum tuʿ'jibuka ajsāmuhum wa-in yaqūlū tasmaʿ liqawlihim ka-annahum khushubun musannadatun yaḥsabūna kulla ṣayḥatin ʿalayhim humu l-ʿaduwu fa-iḥ'dharhum qātalahumu l-lahu annā yu'fakūna And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. (They are) as if they were pieces of wood propped up1 - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded? See 63:1

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ وَإِنْ يَقُولُوْۤا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُسَنَّدَةٌ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ هُمُ الْعَدُوُّ فَاحْذَرْهُمْ قَاتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wa-idhā ra-aytahum tuʿ'jibuka ajsāmuhum wa-in yaqūlū tasmaʿ liqawlihim ka-annahum khushubun musannadatun yaḥsabūna kulla ṣayḥatin ʿalayhim humu l-ʿaduwu fa-iḥ'dharhum qātalahumu l-lahu annā yu'fakūna When thou seest them, marvel thee (Personalities.) their bodies; and if they speak (The Prophet addressed for the people.) , thou listeneth unto their speech; (they are) as if they were blocks of wood propped up in garments, deem they that every cry is against them, They are the enemy (of yours), so beware thou of them! may God annihilate them, whence do they deviate! Note how aptly the hypocrites are compared to how bits of timber propped up against other things, i.e., they are useless to serve as a reliable support, i.e., they are without…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ لَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُمْ مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālaw yastaghfir lakum rasūlu l-lahi lawwaw ruūsahum wara-aytahum yaṣuddūna wahum mus'takbirūna When they are told, 'Come, that Allah's Apostle may plead for forgiveness for you,' they twist their heads, and you see them turn away while they are disdainful.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ لَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُمْ مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālaw yastaghfir lakum rasūlu l-lahi lawwaw ruūsahum wara-aytahum yaṣuddūna wahum mus'takbirūna And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant. And when it is said to them: "Come, so that the Messenger of Allah may ask forgiveness from Allah for you," they twist their heads, and you would see them turning away their faces in pride (63:5). It is equal to them whether you ask forgiveness or ask not forgiveness for them, Allah will never forgive them. Verily, Allah guides not the people who are the rebellious (63:6). They are the ones who say: "Spend not on those who are with…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ لَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُمْ مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālaw yastaghfir lakum rasūlu l-lahi lawwaw ruūsahum wara-aytahum yaṣuddūna wahum mus'takbirūna And when it is said unto them: "Come ye! the Apostle of God will seek forgiveness for you," they turn back their heads, and thou seest them turning away while they are the arrogant ones. The adamance of the rejectors of the truth has deprived them of God's mercy for the intercession of the Apostle of God, would be available for the unintentional sinners among the believers who owing to their personal weakness and not for those who have adamantly rebelled against God and His Apostle. It does not mean that God refrains, or the Holy Prophet's intervention is of no use, it means that the blessing of God through the intervention…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ sawāon ʿalayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira l-lahu lahum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīna It is the same for them whether you plead for forgiveness for them, or do not plead for forgiveness for them: Allah will never forgive them. Indeed Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ sawāon ʿalayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira l-lahu lahum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīna It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them. Indeed, Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people. See 63:5

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ sawāon ʿalayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira l-lahu lahum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīna Alike it is for them whether thou seekest forgiveness for them or seekest not forgiveness for them; Never will God forgive them; Verily God guideth not transgressing people (Refer to Verse 9:80.) . See 63:5

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنْفِقُوْۤا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتّٰی يَنْفَضُّوْۤا وَلِلَّهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ humu alladhīna yaqūlūna lā tunfiqū ʿalā man ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ḥattā yanfaḍḍū walillahi khazāinu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walākinna l-munāfiqīna lā yafqahūna They are the ones who say, 'Do not spend on those who are with the Apostle of Allah until they scatter off.' Yet to Allah belong the treasuries of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنْفِقُوْۤا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتّٰی يَنْفَضُّوْۤا وَلِلَّهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ humu alladhīna yaqūlūna lā tunfiqū ʿalā man ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ḥattā yanfaḍḍū walillahi khazāinu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walākinna l-munāfiqīna lā yafqahūna They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband." And to Allah belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand. See 63:5

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنْفِقُوْۤا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتّٰی يَنْفَضُّوْۤا وَلِلَّهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ humu alladhīna yaqūlūna lā tunfiqū ʿalā man ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ḥattā yanfaḍḍū walillahi khazāinu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walākinna l-munāfiqīna lā yafqahūna They are the ones who say (unto those who help the believer refugees')'. "Spend ye not aught upon those who are with the Apostle of God until they break up; And God's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites understand (it) not." The hypocrites did not relish the Madinites helping the believer refugees from Mecca, and went to the extent of dissuading them from doing any good to them. Note how the truth has been presented that God does not leave His devotees to the mercy of the charity of the disbelievers or the hypocrites.…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُونَ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْأَذَلَّ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ yaqūlūna la-in rajaʿnā ilā l-madīnati layukh'rijanna l-aʿazu min'hā l-adhala walillahi l-ʿizatu walirasūlihi walil'mu'minīna walākinna l-munāfiqīna lā yaʿlamūna They say, 'When we return to the city, the mighty will surely expel the abased from it.'1 Yet all might belongs to Allah and His Apostle, and the faithful, but the hypocrites do not know.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُونَ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْأَذَلَّ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ yaqūlūna la-in rajaʿnā ilā l-madīnati layukh'rijanna l-aʿazu min'hā l-adhala walillahi l-ʿizatu walirasūlihi walil'mu'minīna walākinna l-munāfiqīna lā yaʿlamūna They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored (for power) will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allah belongs (all) honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know. See 63:5

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُونَ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْأَذَلَّ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ yaqūlūna la-in rajaʿnā ilā l-madīnati layukh'rijanna l-aʿazu min'hā l-adhala walillahi l-ʿizatu walirasūlihi walil'mu'minīna walākinna l-munāfiqīna lā yaʿlamūna Say they: "If we return to Madina, the honourable ones will certainly drive out the meaner ones; "but for God is all honour and for His Apostle and for the believers, but the hypocrites know (it) not." This is what the Arch-Hypocrite Abdullah Ibn Obai had said - which was reported by Zaid Ibn Arqam1. This is an encouragement for the advocates of the right cause to be sure that they are honoured by God with blessing in spite of the hypocrites and the infidels looking down on them. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tul'hikum amwālukum walā awlādukum ʿan dhik'ri l-lahi waman yafʿal dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūna O you who have faith! Do not let your possessions and children distract you from the remembrance of Allah, and whoever does that —it is they who are the losers.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tul'hikum amwālukum walā awlādukum ʿan dhik'ri l-lahi waman yafʿal dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūna O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers. O you who believe! Let not your properties or your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. And whosoever does that, then they are the losers (63:9). And spend of that with which We have provided you before death comes to one of you, and he says: My Lord! If only You would give me respite for a little while, then I should give Sadaqah from my wealth, and be among the righteous (63:10). And Allah…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tul'hikum amwālukum walā awlādukum ʿan dhik'ri l-lahi waman yafʿal dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūna O' ye who believe! let not your wealth, nor your children divert you from the remembrance of God; and who-soever doeth that, these are then the losers Any amount of wealth and any number of the issues a man might have, all these sources of the enjoyment of this life are only fleeting fortunes combined with miseries and toils. Nothing of these should be allowed to lead men astray from remembering God actively, i.e., from doing as much good as possible. This verse exposes the truth that it is mostly the wealth and the prosperity of a man that makes man forget God and one's duties…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْفِقُوا مِنْ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَا أَخَّرْتَنِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُنْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-anfiqū min mā razaqnākum min qabli an yatiya aḥadakumu l-mawtu fayaqūla rabbi lawlā akhartanī ilā ajalin qarībin fa-aṣṣaddaqa wa-akun mina l-ṣāliḥīna Spend from what We have provided you before death comes to any of you, whereat he will say, 'My Lord, why did You not respite me for a short time so that I might have given charity and become one of the righteous!'

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْفِقُوا مِنْ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَا أَخَّرْتَنِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُنْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-anfiqū min mā razaqnākum min qabli an yatiya aḥadakumu l-mawtu fayaqūla rabbi lawlā akhartanī ilā ajalin qarībin fa-aṣṣaddaqa wa-akun mina l-ṣāliḥīna And spend (in the way of Allah) from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous." See 63:9

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْفِقُوا مِنْ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَا أَخَّرْتَنِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُنْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wa-anfiqū min mā razaqnākum min qabli an yatiya aḥadakumu l-mawtu fayaqūla rabbi lawlā akhartanī ilā ajalin qarībin fa-aṣṣaddaqa wa-akun mina l-ṣāliḥīna And spend (This is a very good caution to those who want to do any good in their life. Refer to Verse 63:11.) ye of what We have provided (Physical & spiritual beauties.) you with, (in the way of God) ere that cometh unto one of you death, then (lest) sayeth he: "O' my Lord! why not thou respite me unto a near term, so that I may give alms, and be of the doers of good." This verse applies to everyone who believes in God and doing good in his life before he is overtaken by death,…

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهَا وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ walan yu-akhira l-lahu nafsan idhā jāa ajaluhā wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna But Allah shall never respite a soul when its time has come, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهَا وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ walan yu-akhira l-lahu nafsan idhā jāa ajaluhā wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Aware of what you do. See 63:9

item.title: Al-Munaafiqoon:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهَا وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ walan yu-akhira l-lahu nafsan idhā jāa ajaluhā wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna And never doth God respite a soul, when hath come unto it its fixed time; and God is All-Aware of whatever ye do. (Refer to Verses 3:144; 7:34; 10:49; 15:5; 16:61; 23:43; 62:8.) See 63:10

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا wal-mur'salāti ʿur'fan By the successive emissaries,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا wal-mur'salāti ʿur'fan By those (winds) sent forth in gusts. لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ the Day of Sorting Out. Then Allah says, in magnifying its matter: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out? Woe that Day to the deniers. Meaning: woe unto them from Allah's torment that is coming in the future.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا wal-mur'salāti ʿur'fan By those sent forth with goodness, one after another 'The Sent Forth', i.e., the winds which blow to the profit of everyone in the world. The letter 'Waw' stands to mean swearing. The benefits which the winds give in their flow are so many that they cannot be enumerated here. Everyone knows that they are the powerful factors which serve in innumerable ways. Air is the cause of life on earth. It is the winds that scatter the clouds and distribute the rainfall. It is the wind that gives life to the vegetable world by its cooling effect1. It scatters seeds, it separates the chaff from grains. It cleanses the air of the poisonous and contagious matter in it. It carries the sound from one place to the other. It helps boats and ships to sail…

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا fal-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfan by the raging hurricanes,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا fal-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfan And the winds that blow violently. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا fal-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfan Which then rage (Exciting, excitement.) in violent rage The 'Fa' indicates that exciting as a result of the communicative function. (A.P.) Exciting - excitement. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا wal-nāshirāti nashran by the sweeping spreaders,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا wal-nāshirāti nashran And (by) the winds that spread (clouds). See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا wal-nāshirāti nashran And by those which spread (goodness) far and wide See 77:2

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا fal-fāriqāti farqan by the decisive separators,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا fal-fāriqāti farqan And those (angels) who bring criterion.1 See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا fal-fāriqāti farqan Then by those that separate (As the result of the Spreading.) them from one another See 77:2

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا fal-mul'qiyāti dhik'ran by the inspirers of remembrance,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا fal-mul'qiyāti dhik'ran And those (angels) who deliver a message. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا fal-mul'qiyāti dhik'ran Then by those that give forth the Reminder See 77:2

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا ʿudh'ran aw nudh'ran to excuse or to warn:

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا ʿudh'ran aw nudh'ran As justification or warning. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا ʿudh'ran aw nudh'ran Either justify (the punishment), or to warn See 77:2

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ innamā tūʿadūna lawāqiʿun indeed what you are promised will surely befall.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ innamā tūʿadūna lawāqiʿun Indeed, what you are promised is to occur. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ innamā tūʿadūna lawāqiʿun Verily, what hath been promised (The Day of Judgement.) unto you shall come to pass (Refer to Verses 51:1 - 51:6.) See 77:2

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ fa-idhā l-nujūmu ṭumisat So when the stars are blotted out,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ fa-idhā l-nujūmu ṭumisat So when the stars are obliterated. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ fa-idhā l-nujūmu ṭumisat So, when the stars shall be caused to cease radiating (As the consequence of the cessation of the radiation. Refer to Verses 81:2, 82:2.) See 77:2

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ wa-idhā l-samāu furijat and when the sky is split,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ wa-idhā l-samāu furijat And when the heaven is opened. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ wa-idhā l-samāu furijat And when the heaven shall be rent asunder (Refer to Verses 82:1, 73:18.) As the consequence of the radiation, causing gaps in the space. (A.P.) As a consequence of the cessation of the radiation. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ wa-idhā l-jibālu nusifat and when the mountains are scattered1 [like dust],

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ wa-idhā l-jibālu nusifat And when the mountains are blown away. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ wa-idhā l-jibālu nusifat And when the mountains shall be carried away like the dust (Refer to Verses 69:14, 81:3.) See 77:9

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ wa-idhā l-rusulu uqqitat and when the time is set for the apostles [to witness]

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ wa-idhā l-rusulu uqqitat And when the messengers' time has come...1 See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ wa-idhā l-rusulu uqqitat And when the messengers are made to reach their appointed time (Signs of the dawn of the Day of Final Judgment.) When the apostles of God will be summoned to bear witness to the response, they met from their respective people with regard to the message they conveyed to them and the admonition they sounded1.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ li-ayyi yawmin ujjilat —for what day has [all] that been set [to occur]?

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ li-ayyi yawmin ujjilat For what Day was it postponed?1 See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ li-ayyi yawmin ujjilat To what day is the appointment (fixed)? See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ liyawmi l-faṣli For the Day of Judgement!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ liyawmi l-faṣli For the Day of Judgement. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ liyawmi l-faṣli To the day of decision (When the truth and the falsehood will be sorted out. Refer to Verses 37:21, 44:40.) ! See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-faṣli And what will show you what is the Day of Judgement!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-faṣli And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement? See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-faṣli And what will make thee know what the Day of Decision is? See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe,1 that Day, to the deniers. See 77:1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ alam nuh'liki l-awalīna Did We not destroy the ancients,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ alam nuh'liki l-awalīna Did We not destroy the former peoples? Did We not destroy the ancients (77:16). So shall We make later generations to follow them (77:17). Thus do We deal with the criminals (77:18). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:19). Did We not create you from a despised water (77:20). Then We placed it in a place of safety (77:21). For a known period (77:22). So We did measure; and We are the best to measure (77:23). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:24). Have We not made the earth Kifat (a receptacle (25)For the living and the dead (26)And have placed therein fixed towers, and have given you Furat water (27)Woe that Day to the deniers (28) The Call to Contemplate the Various Manifestations of Allah's Power Allah says: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ Did We…

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ alam nuh'liki l-awalīna What! Destroyed We not the former people? See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْءَاخِرِينَ thumma nut'biʿuhumu l-ākhirīna [and] then made the latter ones follow them?

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْءَاخِرِينَ thumma nut'biʿuhumu l-ākhirīna Then We will follow them with the later ones. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْءَاخِرِينَ thumma nut'biʿuhumu l-ākhirīna Then did We make the later people follow them See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna That is how We deal with the guilty.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna Thus do We deal with the criminals. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna Thus, We deal with the guilty ones See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُمْ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ alam nakhluqkkum min māin mahīnin Have We not created you from a base fluid,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُمْ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ alam nakhluqkkum min māin mahīnin Did We not create you from a liquid disdained? See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُمْ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ alam nakhluqkkum min māin mahīnin Did We not create you from a fluid despicable (Refer to Verses 32:8, 23:13.) ? See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ fajaʿalnāhu fī qarārin makīnin [and] then lodged it in a secure abode

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ fajaʿalnāhu fī qarārin makīnin And We placed it in a firm lodging (i.e., the womb). See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ fajaʿalnāhu fī qarārin makīnin Then We placed it in a safe place (Mother's womb. Refer to Verse 23:13 .) See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى قَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ ilā qadarin maʿlūmin until a known span [of time]?

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى قَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ ilā qadarin maʿlūmin For a known extent. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى قَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ ilā qadarin maʿlūmin Till the term appointed (For birth.) See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ faqadarnā faniʿ'ma l-qādirūna Then We designed; so how excellent designers We are!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ faqadarnā faniʿ'ma l-qādirūna And We determined (it), and excellent (are We) to determine. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ faqadarnā faniʿ'ma l-qādirūna So We planned then how Excellent are (We) the planners See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers! See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا alam najʿali l-arḍa kifātan Have We not made the earth a receptacle

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا alam najʿali l-arḍa kifātan Have We not made the earth a container. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا alam najʿali l-arḍa kifātan Have We not made the earth a receptacle? See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا aḥyāan wa-amwātan for the living and the dead,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا aḥyāan wa-amwātan Of the living and the dead? See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا aḥyāan wa-amwātan For the living and (also for) the dead ones See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمْ مَاءً فُرَاتًا wajaʿalnā fīhā rawāsiya shāmikhātin wa-asqaynākum māan furātan and set in it lofty [and] firm mountains, and given you agreeable water to drink?

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمْ مَاءً فُرَاتًا wajaʿalnā fīhā rawāsiya shāmikhātin wa-asqaynākum māan furātan And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمْ مَاءً فُرَاتًا wajaʿalnā fīhā rawāsiya shāmikhātin wa-asqaynākum māan furātan And made We therein mountains high (Refer to Verses 16:15, 13:3.) , and given you to drink water sweet? See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:16

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna 'Woe on the Day unto the beliers! See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ inṭaliqū ilā mā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna [They will be told]: 'Get off toward what you used to deny!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ inṭaliqū ilā mā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna (They will be told), "Proceed to that which you used to deny. (It will be said to the disbelievers): Depart you to that which you used to deny! (77:29). "Depart you to a shadow in three columns, (77:30). "Neither shady nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire (77:31). Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr (77:32). As if they were Sufr camels (77:33). Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection) (77:34). That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it) (77:35). And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse (77:36). Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection) (77:37). That will be a Day of Decision! We…

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ inṭaliqū ilā mā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna Begone ye unto that which ye belied (Hell, which the disbelievers belied.) ! See 77:11

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ inṭaliqū ilā ẓillin dhī thalāthi shuʿabin Get off toward the triple-forked shadow,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ inṭaliqū ilā ẓillin dhī thalāthi shuʿabin Proceed to a shadow (of smoke) having three columns. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ inṭaliqū ilā ẓillin dhī thalāthi shuʿabin Begone ye unto the shadow having three columns (Hell with smoke rising in columns) It is said that the smoke from hell will be rising in three columns or branches. The three columns correspond to the Psychical energy - attraction, repulsion, and devilish scheming. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ lā ẓalīlin walā yugh'nī mina l-lahabi which is neither shady nor is of any avail against the flame.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ lā ẓalīlin walā yugh'nī mina l-lahabi (But having) no cool shade and availing not against the flame." See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ lā ẓalīlin walā yugh'nī mina l-lahabi (Which yieldeth) no shade (for coolness) nor availing against the flames See 77:30

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ innahā tarmī bishararin kal-qaṣri Indeed it throws up sparks [huge] like palaces,1

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ innahā tarmī bishararin kal-qaṣri Indeed, it throws sparks (as huge) as a fortress. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ innahā tarmī bishararin kal-qaṣri Verily, it sendeth up sparks like a palace See 77:30

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ ka-annahu jimālatun ṣuf'run [bright] as if they were yellow camels.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ ka-annahu jimālatun ṣuf'run As if they were yellowish (black) camels. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ ka-annahu jimālatun ṣuf'run As if they are tawny camels See 77:30

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers! See 77:30

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ hādhā yawmu lā yanṭiqūna This is a day wherein they will not speak,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ hādhā yawmu lā yanṭiqūna This is a Day they will not speak. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ hādhā yawmu lā yanṭiqūna This is the day when they shall speak not None shall be able to plead or to put forward any excuse for the facts will be laid so bare and the parts of their own body will themselves bear witness against them1.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ walā yu'dhanu lahum fayaʿtadhirūna nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ walā yu'dhanu lahum fayaʿtadhirūna Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ walā yu'dhanu lahum fayaʿtadhirūna And it shall not be permitted unto them so that they may offer excuses (Refers to a particular stage of the day of requital.) Refers to a particular stage of the Day of Requital. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ hādhā yawmu l-faṣli jamaʿnākum wal-awalīna 'This is the Day of Judgement. We have brought together you and the ancients.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ hādhā yawmu l-faṣli jamaʿnākum wal-awalīna This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ hādhā yawmu l-faṣli jamaʿnākum wal-awalīna This is the Day of decision; We will gather you and (all) those of yore See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ fa-in kāna lakum kaydun fakīdūni If you have any stratagems [left], try out your stratagems against Me!'

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ fa-in kāna lakum kaydun fakīdūni So if you have a plan, then plan against Me. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ fa-in kāna lakum kaydun fakīdūni If ye have any device, try ye that device (now)! See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:29

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers! See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī ẓilālin waʿuyūnin Indeed the Godwary will be amid shades and springs,

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī ẓilālin waʿuyūnin Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs. Verily, those who had Taqwa, shall be amidst shades and springs (77:41). And fruits, such as they desire (77:42). Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do (77:43). Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinin (77:44). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:45). Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while. Verily, you are criminals (77:46). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:47). And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself!" They bow not down (77:48). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:49). Then in what statement after this will they believe (77:50). The Final Abode for Those Who have Taqwa Allah informs that His servants who have Taqwa and worship Him by performing the obligations and…

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī ẓilālin waʿuyūnin Verily the pious ones (Those who guard against evil. Refer to Verses 56:89; 56:10 - 56:38.) shall be amid shades and springs See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ wafawākiha mimmā yashtahūna and fruits, such as they desire.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ wafawākiha mimmā yashtahūna And fruits from whatever they desire. See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ wafawākiha mimmā yashtahūna And fruits (Refer to Verse 43:73.) whatsoever they may desire See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna [They will be told:] 'Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.'

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna (Being told), "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do." See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna (Unto them will be said)'. "Eat ye and drink ye in health and delight, as meed for what ye used to do" See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Verily, thus We recompense the doers of good See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers See 77:36

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُجْرِمُونَ kulū watamattaʿū qalīlan innakum muj'rimūna 'Eat and enjoy a little! You are indeed guilty.'

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُجْرِمُونَ kulū watamattaʿū qalīlan innakum muj'rimūna (O disbelievers), eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals. See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُجْرِمُونَ kulū watamattaʿū qalīlan innakum muj'rimūna Eat ye and enjoy yourselves a little, for verily ye are the guilty ones The address is to the people lost in the enjoyment of this world for what they will be doing, will be only a trial for themselves.

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on the Day unto the beliers! See 77:46

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوْۤا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ir'kaʿū lā yarkaʿūna When they are told, 'Bow down,' they do not bow down!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوْۤا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ir'kaʿū lā yarkaʿūna And when it is said to them, "Bow (in prayer)," they do not bow. See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوْۤا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ir'kaʿū lā yarkaʿūna And when it is said unto them "Bow ye down!" they bow not down See 77:46

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on that Day unto the beliers! See 77:46

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūna So what discourse will they believe after this?

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūna Then in what statement after it (i.e., the Qur’ān) will they believe? See 77:41

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūna In what other word after this will they believe? When such a clear message, the people reject, which is the other message they would accept to believe in? (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ waylun lil'muṭaffifīna Woe to the defrauders who use short measures,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ waylun lil'muṭaffifīna Woe to those who give less (than due).1 يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of all that exists? Meaning: they will stand barefooted, naked and uncircumcised at a station that will be difficult, hard, and distressful for the criminals. They will be covered by the command from Allah, and it will be that, which the strength and the senses will not be able to bare. Imam Malik reported from Nafi' who reported from Ibn Umar that the Prophet SAW said: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، حَتّٰى يَغِيبَ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رَشْحِهِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ This will be the Day that mankind will stand before the Lord of all that exists, until one of them will sink up to the middle of his ears in sweat. Al-Bukhari recorded this…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ waylun lil'muṭaffifīna Woe unto the defrauders in measuring! Note the perfect justice & fair play Islam stresses in matters of dealing with men. What is meant here by 'Mutaffifeen' are those who exact their dues in full but when they pay their dues to the others, they commit fraud and disburse less. One must give in full what is due from him even if the other side returns the same in full or not. Commentators have given the root of the word and its meaning in details, but Qur'an itself defines what it means by this term. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوْۤا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā l-nāsi yastawfūna who, when they measure [a commodity bought] from the people, take the full measure,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوْۤا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā l-nāsi yastawfūna Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full. See 83:1

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوْۤا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā l-nāsi yastawfūna Who, when take they by measure from the people, demand (Considering what has been given to them as less. i.e. holding other's measure as less.) it full (Refer to: 74:6.) Considering what has been given to them is less, i.e., holding others' measure as less. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ wa-idhā kālūhum aw wazanūhum yukh'sirūna but diminish when they measure or weigh for them.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ wa-idhā kālūhum aw wazanūhum yukh'sirūna But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss. See 83:1

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ wa-idhā kālūhum aw wazanūhum yukh'sirūna But when they measure unto them, or (when) they weigh unto them, minish (Diminish - reduce - give less.) they (i.e. deceive) When this Surah was revealed, the Holy Prophet went to the open market and amidst the merchants there, read it out and said that the following five evils in the conduct of men, invite the calamities mentioned against each of them: Breaking a promise or any solemn undertaking - Invites the triumph of the enemy. Enjoining on people that which God has not enjoined - Brings poverty and need. Immorality - Brings abundant death. Fraud in measure and weight - Famine, drought and restraint on the produce of foodgrains. Failure to pay the poor-rate and uncharitability - Brings deprivation of the grace and the mercy of God. The…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ alā yaẓunnu ulāika annahum mabʿūthūna Do they not know that they will be resurrected

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ alā yaẓunnu ulāika annahum mabʿūthūna Do they not think that they will be resurrected. See 83:1

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ alā yaẓunnu ulāika annahum mabʿūthūna What! Think they not that they shall (Bound to be raised.) be raised Men are admonished to know and remember that there is the All-Knowing One above all, who knows everything even though people may know it or not - and there is a Day of Judgment when each one has to account for one's own thoughts, words and deeds. Those who think or speak or act wrongly will be disgraced openly on that day and suffer the grievous punishment even for the least evil done by him.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ liyawmin ʿaẓīmin on a tremendous day,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ liyawmin ʿaẓīmin For a tremendous Day. See 83:1

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ liyawmin ʿaẓīmin For a Mighty Day (The Day of the Final Judgment.) See 83:4

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ yawma yaqūmu l-nāsu lirabbi l-ʿālamīna a day when mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds?

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ yawma yaqūmu l-nāsu lirabbi l-ʿālamīna The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds? See 83:1

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ yawma yaqūmu l-nāsu lirabbi l-ʿālamīna On the day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds? It is said that men will be made to stand in the sun brought over their heads perspiring profusely according to the degree of their individual position in their sins. The heat will be so scorching and strong that it will be melting the elements in the body of the wicked.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِیْ سِجِّينٍ kallā inna kitāba l-fujāri lafī sijjīnin No indeed! The record of the vicious is indeed in Sijjīn.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِیْ سِجِّينٍ kallā inna kitāba l-fujāri lafī sijjīnin No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen. Nay! Truly, the Record of the wicked is in Sijjin (83:7). And what will make you know what Sijjin is (83:8). A Register inscribed (83:9). Woe, that Day, to those who deny (83:10). Those who deny the Day of Recompense (83:11). And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, the sinner (83:12). When Our Ayat are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the ancients! (83:13). Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering) which they used to earn (83:14). Nay! Surely, they will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day (83:15). Then verily, they will indeed enter the burning flame of Hell (83:16). Then, it will be said to them: "This is what…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِیْ سِجِّينٍ kallā inna kitāba l-fujāri lafī sijjīnin Nay! the record of the wicked (Destiny.) hast been preserved in the 'Sajjin' 'Kalla', i.e., No! Never. Will they, the people be able to deny any of the evils they had committed? Hence, they should not commit any fraud in the measure or in the weight.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ wamā adrāka mā sijjīnun And what will show you what is Sijjīn?

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ wamā adrāka mā sijjīnun And what can make you know what is sijjeen? See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ wamā adrāka mā sijjīnun And what will make thee know what 'Sajjin' is? 'Sijjin' is from Sijn, i.e., a prison. It is a place in heaven where the reports or the records of the deeds of men are stored.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ kitābun marqūmun It is a written record.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ kitābun marqūmun It is [their destination1 recorded in] a register inscribed. See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ kitābun marqūmun It is a Book Written It is a written record. It should not be imagined to be a record written by any pen and ink on any paper of the kind we have in our use. It means it is perfect in every detail with regard to the motive, words, needs, attitudes and everything connected with the good and evil of each and every individual sinner and his sins without any exception whatsoever. For example, the tap al-recording of speeches may be taken. Everything spoken is recorded in all its details with regard to words as well as the sound, but nothing is written in the tape. If we mortals could affect such a wonderful implement, what is the thing that the Almighty and All-Wise Lord could not do?

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe to the deniers on that day,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe on that day unto the beliers See 83:9

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ alladhīna yukadhibūna biyawmi l-dīni who deny the Day of Retribution;

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ alladhīna yukadhibūna biyawmi l-dīni Who deny the Day of Recompense. See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ alladhīna yukadhibūna biyawmi l-dīni Those who belie the Day of Judgment See 83:9

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ wamā yukadhibu bihi illā kullu muʿ'tadin athīmin and none denies it except every sinful transgressor.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ wamā yukadhibu bihi illā kullu muʿ'tadin athīmin And none deny it except every sinful transgressor. See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ wamā yukadhibu bihi illā kullu muʿ'tadin athīmin And belieth it not (any one) save every transgressor, a sinner Those who were lost in sinning would only deny such an inevitable event.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīna When Our signs are recited to him, he says, 'Myths of the ancients!'

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīna When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples." See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīna When, are recited unto him Our signs (Refer to: 6:25, 68:15.) , sayeth he: (These are only) the stories of yore! They ridicule the Word of God, the Holy Qur'an - and attribute it to the narration of tales of the ancients borrowed from the folklore1.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūna No indeed! Rather their hearts have been sullied1 by what they have been earning.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūna No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.1 See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūna Nay! rather, has rusted their hearts, what they used to do The Holy Prophet said that when a man commits any sin a black dot is created on the heart of the individual and if the man does not repent and continues to sin, the dot covers the whole heart and the whole heart is blackened. The Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn-Ali Al-Baqir said: ''On the heart of every believer there is a white dot and when he commits any sin, a black dot is created and when the individual repents the black dot disappears and if the individual does not repent and continues to sin, the black dot spreads and gradually covers the whole heart and the white dot disappears and then the…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ kallā innahum ʿan rabbihim yawma-idhin lamaḥjūbūna No indeed! They will be alienated from their Lord on that day.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ kallā innahum ʿan rabbihim yawma-idhin lamaḥjūbūna No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.1 See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ kallā innahum ʿan rabbihim yawma-idhin lamaḥjūbūna Nay! verily that day they shall be shut (As a result of their deeds.) out away from the mercy of their Lord It never means that God will hide Himself behind any veil, for such a conception would mean God being confined to a place. He is the Omnipresent. He is the Universally Manifest One. None can hide Him or His glory save the stain of one's own disbelief and evil deeds which sully the heart and destroys its reflectivity so that the heart fails to receive the light and it is the stain on the heart of the individual that disables it to realise the existence of God and enjoy the view of His glory.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوْۤا الْجَحِيمِ thumma innahum laṣālū l-jaḥīmi Then they will indeed enter hell,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوْۤا الْجَحِيمِ thumma innahum laṣālū l-jaḥīmi Then indeed, they will (enter and) burn in Hellfire. See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوْۤا الْجَحِيمِ thumma innahum laṣālū l-jaḥīmi Verily, they shall be committed to the flaming fire See 83:15

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ thumma yuqālu hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna then told, 'This is what you used to deny!'

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ thumma yuqālu hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna Then it will be said (to them), "This is what you used to deny." See 83:7

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ thumma yuqālu hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna Then shall it be said (unto them): ''This is that which ye belied (Refer to: 36:63.) !" See 83:15

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِیْ عِلِّيِّينَ kallā inna kitāba l-abrāri lafī ʿilliyyīna No indeed! The record of the pious is indeed in Illīyūn.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِیْ عِلِّيِّينَ kallā inna kitāba l-abrāri lafī ʿilliyyīna No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn. Nay! Verily, the Record of Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) is (preserved) in 'Illiyyin (83:18). And what will make you know what 'Illiyyin is (83:19). A Register inscribed (83:20). To which bear witness those nearest (83:21). Verily, Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) will be in Delight (83:22). On thrones, looking (83:23). You will recognize in their faces the brightness of delight (83:24). They will be given to drink of pure sealed Rahiq (83:25). Sealed with musk, and for this let those strive who want to strive (83:26). It will be mixed with Tasnim (83:27). A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allah (83:28). The Record Book of the Righteous and Their Reward Allah says that truly: إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ Verily,…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِیْ عِلِّيِّينَ kallā inna kitāba l-abrāri lafī ʿilliyyīna Nay! The record of the righteous shall be in the 'Illiyun (Refer to: 56:10.) ' i.e., The highest places and most exalted in grades, the nearest approach to divinity. It is in contrast to 'Sijjiyeen' in verse 7 above. It is the place where the records of the righteous ones are preserved. The high stage or state or the right side of the Universe towards the Absolute as appeared to the left side tending towards the material realm and whatever is recorded there is witnessed by conscious entities termed as 'Moqarraboon', here the Near Ones and as 'Aaleen' in 38:75 and as Qur'an expressively asserts the prophets and their Vicegerents - who attain the same purification are also included in the witnesses of 'Illiyeen' and this witnessing is…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ wamā adrāka mā ʿilliyyūna And what will show you what is Illīyūn?

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ wamā adrāka mā ʿilliyyūna And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn? See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ wamā adrāka mā ʿilliyyūna And what will make thee know what the 'Illiyun' is (Refer to: 85:21 - 85:22.) ? i.e., None can even imagine correctly what those high places of greatest exaltation could be. They are inconceivable for the intellect of any mortal.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ kitābun marqūmun It is a written record,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ kitābun marqūmun It is [their destination1 recorded in] a register inscribed. See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ kitābun marqūmun (It is) a book written As in the case of the recording of the evils of the disbelievers and the sinners, mentioned in verse 9 above. The record of the deeds of the ones righteous are perfect in every detail of every motive, words and the deeds of every individual one of the doers of good1.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ yashhaduhu l-muqarabūna witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ yashhaduhu l-muqarabūna Which is witnessed by those brought near (to Allah). See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ yashhaduhu l-muqarabūna See it those who are the near ones unto God The Nearest Ones to God witness these records of the righteous ones. Witnessing the records can be interpreted into being present at the recording itself. The nearest to God is said to be the angels highest in purity and excellence but it does preclude to mean the highest spiritual dignitaries who can encourage and help goodness intended to be done by the righteous ones. Who could be nearer to God than the Holy Prophet, the most loved one of God in His whole creation, the Holy Imams whom the Holy Prophet had said to be of the Divine Light of which he himself is. This verse testifies to the truth in the statement that on the Day of Judgment a witness will be called for each…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِیْ نَعِيمٍ inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmin Indeed the pious shall be amid bliss,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِیْ نَعِيمٍ inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmin Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure. See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِیْ نَعِيمٍ inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmin Verily the righteous ones shall be in bounteous bliss See 83:21

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ ʿalā l-arāiki yanẓurūna observing, [as they recline] on couches.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ ʿalā l-arāiki yanẓurūna On adorned couches, observing. See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ ʿalā l-arāiki yanẓurūna On exalted couches will they view (Refer to: 36:56.) (the delightful sights) See 83:21

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ taʿrifu fī wujūhihim naḍrata l-naʿīmi You will perceive in their faces the freshness of bliss

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ taʿrifu fī wujūhihim naḍrata l-naʿīmi You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure. See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ taʿrifu fī wujūhihim naḍrata l-naʿīmi Thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!') wilt recognise in their faces, the (delightful) radiance of the bliss (Refer to: 75:22, 76:11.) ! See 83:21

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسْقَوْنَ مِنْ رَحِيقٍ مَخْتُومٍ yus'qawna min raḥīqin makhtūmin as they are served with a sealed wine,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسْقَوْنَ مِنْ رَحِيقٍ مَخْتُومٍ yus'qawna min raḥīqin makhtūmin They will be given to drink (pure) wine1 (which was) sealed. See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسْقَوْنَ مِنْ رَحِيقٍ مَخْتُومٍ yus'qawna min raḥīqin makhtūmin They shall be provided to quaff of pure drink (which shall be) sealed (Exclusively reserved for them, not allowed to the others, or with sealed purity.) (to others) Could be interpreted as of the maximum purity, and the most delicious in taste.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ khitāmuhu mis'kun wafī dhālika falyatanāfasi l-mutanāfisūna whose seal is musk —for such let the viers vie—

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ khitāmuhu mis'kun wafī dhālika falyatanāfasi l-mutanāfisūna The last of it1 is musk. So for this let the competitors compete. See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ khitāmuhu mis'kun wafī dhālika falyatanāfasi l-mutanāfisūna The seal (being) of musk; For that may aspire (all) those who (wish to) aspire (for bliss) Refers to the extraordinary and special aspect of the value and the flavour.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِنْ تَسْنِيمٍ wamizājuhu min tasnīmin and whose seasoning is from Tasnīm,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِنْ تَسْنِيمٍ wamizājuhu min tasnīmin And its mixture is of Tasneem.1 See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِنْ تَسْنِيمٍ wamizājuhu min tasnīmin Mixed therewith shall be the water of 'Tasnim' 'Tasneem' - The name of a spring in heaven whose drink is of super excellence in purity, flavour and taste, purer than the purest of the drinks in this world.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ʿaynan yashrabu bihā l-muqarabūna a spring where those brought near [to Allah] drink.

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ʿaynan yashrabu bihā l-muqarabūna A spring from which those near (to Allah) drink. See 83:18

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ʿaynan yashrabu bihā l-muqarabūna (Which is) a spring from which drink the Near Ones (Refer to: 56:11,88, 3:45, 96:19, 19:52.) This verse speaks of the water of the spring being used for the drink of the Nearest Ones to God. It indicates that among the nearest ones are also the human souls like those of the Holy Prophet and the Holy Imams, otherwise, the conception of the need for food and drink for the angels nearest to God does not agree with the nature of the angels who are spirits and energies who need no food or water, and nowhere in the Holy Qur'an is there any statement about the angels eating and drinking. It must be remembered that when the angels appeared to Abraham on the way to Sodom to punish the people of Lot,…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوْۤا كَانُوْۤا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَضْحَكُونَ inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūna Indeed the guilty used to laugh at the faithful,

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوْۤا كَانُوْۤا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَضْحَكُونَ inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūna Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed. Verily, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed (83:29). And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (83:30). And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting (83:31). And when they saw them, they said: Verily, these have indeed gone astray! (83:32). But they were not sent as watchers over them (83:33). But this Day those who believe will laugh at the disbeliever (83:34). On thrones, looking (83:35). Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do (83:36). The Wicked Behavior of the Criminals and Their mocking of the Believers Allah informs that the criminals used to laugh at…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوْۤا كَانُوْۤا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَضْحَكُونَ inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūna And verily they who are the guilty ones, used to laugh (During their life in the world.) at those who believe According to the well-known commentator Kashshaf, once the First Holy Imam Ali-Ibn Abu Talib along with a group of some poor men of the believers, while going to the Holy Prophet passed a party of the hypocrites who seeing Ali and those with him winked to each other mocking at them. Those hypocrites said: ''We saw today the bald-headed one (Ali was bald in the front portion of his head)''' and mocked at him. Ali had not even reached the Holy Prophet; the Messenger Angel Gabriel revealed these verses condemning the conduct of the hypocrites and praising Ali. (M.S.) According to Ibn-Abbas -…

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَرُّوْۤا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ wa-idhā marrū bihim yataghāmazūna and when they passed them by they would wink at each other,
