item.description: أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ afanajʿalu l-mus'limīna kal-muj'rimīna Shall We, then, treat those who submit [to Us] as [We treat] the guilty?

item.title: Al-Qalam:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ afanajʿalu l-mus'limīna kal-muj'rimīna Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ afanajʿalu l-mus'limīna kal-muj'rimīna What! shall We then make the 'Muslims' (Those who submit themselves to God.) like unto the guilty ones (Refer to Verses 6:50, 45:21.) ? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna What is the matter with you? How do you judge!

item.title: Al-Qalam:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna What is (the matter) with you? How do you judge? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna What is the matter with you? How judge ye (An appeal to Commonsense, Refer to Verses 52:32 - 52:34.) See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِیْهِ تَدْرُسُونَ am lakum kitābun fīhi tadrusūna Do you possess a scripture in which you read

item.title: Al-Qalam:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِیْهِ تَدْرُسُونَ am lakum kitābun fīhi tadrusūna Or do you have a scripture in which you learn. See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِیْهِ تَدْرُسُونَ am lakum kitābun fīhi tadrusūna Or have ye a scripture wherein ye read? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِیْهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ inna lakum fīhi lamā takhayyarūna that you shall indeed have in it1 whatever you would like?

item.title: Al-Qalam:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِیْهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ inna lakum fīhi lamā takhayyarūna That indeed for you is whatever you choose? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِیْهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ inna lakum fīhi lamā takhayyarūna Verily, therein is for you what ye choose? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūna Do you have a pledge binding on Us until the Day of Resurrection, that you shall indeed have whatever you decide?

item.title: Al-Qalam:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūna Or do you have oaths (binding) upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūna Or have ye a sworn covenant from Us tending to the Day of Judgment that ye shall surely have whatever ye judge? See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ salhum ayyuhum bidhālika zaʿīmun Ask them, which of them will aver [any of] that!

item.title: Al-Qalam:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ salhum ayyuhum bidhālika zaʿīmun Ask them which of them, for that (claim), is responsible. See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ salhum ayyuhum bidhālika zaʿīmun Ask them (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) which of them will guarantee that! See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīna Do they have any partners [they ascribe to Allah]? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful.

item.title: Al-Qalam:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīna Or do they have partners?1 Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful. See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīna Or have they any 'Partners' (to Us)? Then let them bring their partners (associate gods) if they be truthful! See 68:34

item.title: Al-Qalam:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqin wayud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūna The day when the catastrophe occurs,1 and they are summoned to prostrate themselves, they will not be able [to do it].

item.title: Al-Qalam:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqin wayud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūna The Day the shin will be uncovered1 and they are invited to prostration but they (i.e., the disbelievers) will not be able. The Day when the Shin shall be laid bare and they shall be called to prostrate themselves, but they shall not be able to do so (68:42). Their eyes will be cast down and ignominy will cover them; they used to be called to prostrate themselves, while they were (68:43). Then leave Me alone with whoever denies this narration. We shall punish them gradually from directions they perceive not (68:44). And I will grant them a respite. Verily, My plan is strong (68:45). Or is it that you ask them a wage, so that they are heavily burdened with debt…

item.title: Al-Qalam:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqin wayud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūna On the Day that the shin (When befalleth the affliction.) shall be laid bare, (i.e. befalleth an affliction), and they shall be called upon to prostrate in obeisance, but they shall not be able (to do it) When the anklets shall he disclosed stands for the vanishing of all pretences and mysteries and the reality about each individuals faith and conduct being laid bare, i.e., fully manifested. Some commentators interpret it as 'the day when the affair shall become hard and formidable and say that the origin of the expression is in the fright and the flight and the tucking up of the garments to facilitate fleeing from any dreadful situation. When all the secrets of every individual will be laid bare…

item.title: Al-Qalam:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوْۤا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi wahum sālimūna With a humbled look [in their eyes], they will be overcast by abasement. Certainly they were summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet sound.

item.title: Al-Qalam:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوْۤا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi wahum sālimūna Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.1 See 68:42

item.title: Al-Qalam:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوْۤا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi wahum sālimūna Casting down their looks, shall cover them abasement, and indeed they had been called upon to prostrate in obeisance, while yet they were whole (Healthy Ones.) (healthy) 'Saalimoon' whole - with the sense of judgment and the strength of executing their will in tact - not constrained and yet they did not act as commanded by God - Their mind and body in a wholesome state and yet they abstained from adoring the Lord in their mind, on earth.

item.title: Al-Qalam:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْنِي وَمَنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fadharnī waman yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna So leave Me with those who deny this discourse. We will draw them imperceptibly [into ruin], whence they do not know.

item.title: Al-Qalam:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْنِي وَمَنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fadharnī waman yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna So leave Me, (O Muḥammad), with (the matter of) whoever denies this statement (i.e., the Qur’ān). We will progressively lead them (to punishment) from where they do not know.1 See 68:42

item.title: Al-Qalam:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْنِي وَمَنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fadharnī waman yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna So leave Me and him who belieth this announcement, We will lead them on (to ruin) by steps (Taking them by degrees. Refer to Verse 7:182.) from whence they know not Since the conduct of the people worried the Holy Prophet much, to console him, God told him to leave the matter of those who reject His Word to Himself to deal with them. When anyone in spite of wickedness seems to us to flourish it may be, that the punishment is evolutionary and gradual. The ways of the Lord are mysterious and His plans none can ever know or understand beforehand1.

item.title: Al-Qalam:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnun I will grant them respite, for My devising is indeed sure.

item.title: Al-Qalam:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnun And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm. See 68:42

item.title: Al-Qalam:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnun And yet respite (Refer to Verses 3:178, 7:183.) them; for verily My device (Scheme – plan.) is firm Respite is given to the sinners and the disbelievers but if it is not availed of, then, the punishment is enforced.

item.title: Al-Qalam:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are weighed down with debt?

item.title: Al-Qalam:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down? See 68:42

item.title: Al-Qalam:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna Or askest (Neither dost thou ask any recompense for them to feel burdened of the demand.) thou from them a recompense that they are burdened with a load of debt (Refer to Verse 52:40.) ? See 68:45

item.title: Al-Qalam:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna Do they possess [access to] the Unseen so that they write it down?

item.title: Al-Qalam:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna Or have they (knowledge of) the unseen, so they write (it) down? See 68:42

item.title: Al-Qalam:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna Or with them is the knowledge of the unseen, that they write (it) down (Refer to Verse 52:41.) ? See 68:45

item.title: Al-Qalam:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنْ كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَى وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmun So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, and do not be like the Man of the Fish1 who called out as he choked with grief.

item.title: Al-Qalam:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنْ كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَى وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmun Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, (O Muḥammad), and be not like the companion of the fish (i.e., Yunus) when he called out while he was distressed. So, wait with patience for the decision of your Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish when he cried out (to Us) while he was Makzum (68:48). Had not a grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been (left in the stomach of the fish, but We forgave him), so he was cast off on the naked shore, while he was to be blamed (68:49). Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous (68:50). And verily, those who disbelieve…

item.title: Al-Qalam:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنْ كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَى وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmun So wait thou patiently for the judgment of thy Lord! Be not thou like unto the Companion (Zun-Noon – Jonah. Refer to Verses 3:134, 12:84, 40:18, 6:87, 10:98, 21:87, 37:139.) of the fish! when cried he when he was confined (Despair - imprisoned – isolated.) 'Companion of the fish', i.e., 'Zun-Noon' or Jonah1 - There is a mention of Jonah and his people in 6:87 and 10:98. Who thought that he would not be put into hardship by God. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qalam:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْلَا أَنْ تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmun Had it not been for a blessing that came to his rescue from his Lord, he would surely have been cast on a bare shore while he were blameworthy.

item.title: Al-Qalam:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْلَا أَنْ تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmun If not that a favor (i.e., mercy) from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.1 See 68:48

item.title: Al-Qalam:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْلَا أَنْ تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmun Had not a bounty from his Lord reached him, he would certainly have been cast forth on the naked shore while in disgrace The use of 'Lau la' had not - acquits the apostle Yunus of all possible blame and makes him worthy of being chosen. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qalam:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ fa-ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fajaʿalahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna So his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous.

item.title: Al-Qalam:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ fa-ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fajaʿalahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous. See 68:48

item.title: Al-Qalam:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ fa-ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fajaʿalahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna Then chose him his Lord and made him of the righteous ones (Refer to Verse 21:87.) See 68:49

item.title: Al-Qalam:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnun Indeed the faithless almost devour you with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say, 'He is indeed crazy.'

item.title: Al-Qalam:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnun And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes (i.e., looks) when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad." See 68:48

item.title: Al-Qalam:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnun And those who disbelieve would almost smite thee with their eyes (Angry looks.) when they hear the Reminder, and say they: "Verily he is mad" 'Smiting with eye', i.e., the disbelievers having become helpless against the irresistible truth in the message of the Holy Qur'an, now gaze at the Holy Prophet as if they would smite him, if not with any other weapon, at least with their sight, their evil eye, which was in vain. The Verse apparently depicts the attitude of the angry looks of the disbelievers whenever they heard the recitation of Qur'an and their remarks against the Holy Prophet, but most of the commentators have given a different account for the revelation of…

item.title: Al-Qalam:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna Yet it is just a reminder for all the nations.

item.title: Al-Qalam:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna But it is not except a reminder to the worlds. See 68:48

item.title: Al-Qalam:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna And it is naught but a Reminder unto the worlds (the whole Mankind) See 68:51

item.title: Al-Qamar:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamaru The Hour has drawn near and the moon is split.

item.title: Al-Qamar:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamaru The Hour has come near, and the moon has split (in two).1 وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْبَاءِ And indeed there has come to them news ; in this Qur'an, there has come to them the news of the earlier nations that disbelieved in their Messengers and the torment, punishment and affliction that befell them: مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ wherein there is Muzdajar Which is wherein there are warnings and lessons to stop them from idolatry and persisting in denial: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ ۖ Perfect wisdom, in that Allah guides whomever He wills and misguides whomever He wills: فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ but warners benefit them not. but the preaching of warnings does not benefit those upon whom Allah has written misery and sealed their hearts. Who can guide such people after Allah? This Ayah is similar…

item.title: Al-Qamar:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamaru Nigh hath come the Hour (of Reckoning) and hath been rent asunder the Moon (The Sign demanded has been given and there is no excuse for disbelief.) The miraculous event of moon getting rent asunder as mentioned in this verse has been vouched by many reliable authorities from among the companions of the Holy Prophet viz., Ibn Mas'ood, Anas Ibn Malik, Huzaifa al-Yamani, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Jabir Ibn Mat'am. The evidence vouching the incident is strong and so abundant that even the Ahmadi commentator (M.A.) who habitually interprets every miracle into a metaphorical expression has accepted the incident to have taken place (M.A.). Besides the large number of the witnesses to the incident, there are the holy Ahl Al-Bayt whose evidence is always unquestionable. Since commentators say that the prophetic past…

item.title: Al-Qamar:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا اٰیَةً يُعْرِضُوْۤا وَيَقُولُوْۤا سِحْرٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirrun If they see a sign, they turn away, and say, 'An incessant1 magic!'

item.title: Al-Qamar:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا اٰیَةً يُعْرِضُوْۤا وَيَقُولُوْۤا سِحْرٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirrun And if they see a sign (i.e., miracle), they turn away and say, "Passing magic."1 See 54:1

item.title: Al-Qamar:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا اٰیَةً يُعْرِضُوْۤا وَيَقُولُوْۤا سِحْرٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirrun And if they see a sign, turn they away and say (that it is) sorcery continued (Constant.) In spite of the people witnessing the great incident they turned away and did not embrace the truth. Ibn Abbas solemnly affirms that he saw the Mount Hira interposing between the two parts of the split Moon. The second verse clearly asserts that the Splitting of the Moon, had taken place as a Sign which the disbelievers interpreted as continued sorcery. For the denial of this and the apostleship they will be punished as said in Verses 9-15. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qamar:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirrun They denied, and followed their own desires, and every matter has a setting [appropriate to it].

item.title: Al-Qamar:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirrun And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a (time of) settlement. See 54:1

item.title: Al-Qamar:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirrun And they belie (it), and follow they their vain inclinations (Lust, desires.) and every affair is unalterably fixed (Refer to Verse 33:62.) Everything has an end, similarly the rule of evil, and the persecution of the truthful shall also one day end, and the matter against the evil shall be settled for ever,

item.title: Al-Qamar:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْبَاءِ مَا فِیْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajarun There have already come to them reports containing admonishment,

item.title: Al-Qamar:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْبَاءِ مَا فِیْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajarun And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence. See 54:1

item.title: Al-Qamar:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْبَاءِ مَا فِیْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajarun And indeed, hath come unto them some of the tidings wherein is restraint (from evil) The warning given in the past through the preceding apostles of God is hinted. The recounting of the sins of past generations, having been punished with exemplary punishments, when they belied the messengers sent to them with the message of Allah, should open the eyes of the disbelievers and check them in their obstinate belying and sinning. For a time, godlessness seems to triumph, but this triumph is short-lived.

item.title: Al-Qamar:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ ḥik'matun bālighatun famā tugh'ni l-nudhuru [and representing] far-reaching wisdom; but warnings are of no avail!

item.title: Al-Qamar:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ ḥik'matun bālighatun famā tugh'ni l-nudhuru Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail (them). See 54:1

item.title: Al-Qamar:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ ḥik'matun bālighatun famā tugh'ni l-nudhuru Consummate wisdom, but (they) availed not (of) the warnings (Or of the warners.) See 54:4

item.title: Al-Qamar:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَى شَيْءٍ نُكُرٍ fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu l-dāʿi ilā shayin nukurin So turn away from them! The day when the Caller calls to a dire thing,

item.title: Al-Qamar:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَى شَيْءٍ نُكُرٍ fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu l-dāʿi ilā shayin nukurin So leave them, (O Muḥammad). The Day the Caller1 calls to something forbidding. So withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing (54:6). They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad (54:7). Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: This is a hard Day (54:8). The terrible End the Disbelievers will meet on the Day of Resurrection Allah the Exalted says, 'O Muhammad, turn away from these people who, when they witness a miracle, they deny it and say that this is continuous magic.' Turn away from them and wait until: يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيْءٍ نُكُرٍ The Day that the caller will call (them) to a…

item.title: Al-Qamar:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَى شَيْءٍ نُكُرٍ fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu l-dāʿi ilā shayin nukurin So withdraw from them thyself (O Our Apostle Muhammad!) On the day when the Caller shall call them unto the hard task (of Reckoning) (Refer to Verse 20:108.) The call for the great Day of Reckoning which will be a terrible affair for the disbelievers and the evil doers. For the caller to the Day of Judgment1. for the callers who will summon all created beings on the day of reckoning and direct them to the presence of the Lord of the worlds. It will be terrible day for the disbelievers. Five of the stories of the sins of past generations are referred to in the verses 9 to 42 of this surah.

item.title: Al-Qamar:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُنْتَشِرٌ khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādun muntashirun with a humbled look [in their eyes], they will emerge from the graves as if they were scattered locusts,

item.title: Al-Qamar:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُنْتَشِرٌ khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādun muntashirun Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading. See 54:6

item.title: Al-Qamar:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُنْتَشِرٌ khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādun muntashirun With their eyes cast down, they shall go forth from their graves as if they were locusts scattered (Refer to Verses 6:73; 36:51; 36:52; 39:68; 50:20.) It is the most appropriate illustration of the people stunned, rising up in swarms from their graves and getting scattered saying 'Woe unto us'.

item.title: Al-Qamar:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ muh'ṭiʿīna ilā l-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasirun scrambling toward the summoner. The faithless will say, 'This is a hard day!'

item.title: Al-Qamar:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ muh'ṭiʿīna ilā l-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasirun Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day." See 54:6

item.title: Al-Qamar:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ muh'ṭiʿīna ilā l-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasirun Hastening unto the Caller; Shall say the disbelievers: 'This is a hard day!' See 54:7

item.title: Al-Qamar:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوْۤا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnun wa-uz'dujira The people of Noah impugned before them. So they impugned Our servant and said, 'A crazy man,' and he was reviled.1

item.title: Al-Qamar:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوْۤا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnun wa-uz'dujira The people of Nuh denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled. The people of Nuh denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our servant and said: A madman!" Wazdujir (54:9). Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)! (54:10). So, We opened the gates of the heaven with water Munhamir (54:11). And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So, the waters met for a matter predestined (54:12). And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails (Dusur (13)Floating under Our Eyes, a reward for him who had been rejected (14)And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any…

item.title: Al-Qamar:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوْۤا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnun wa-uz'dujira Belied before them the people of Noah (their apostles), so they belied Our servant and said they (he was) "Mad (Called him mad.) " and he was driven out (Refer to Verses 11:25 - 11:48.)" Who has raised us, why have we been resurrected1. They shall hasten on to the Lord. See also Verses 6:74, 78:18, 39:68, 50:20. For the people of Nuh refer to Verses 7:59 to 7:64; 11:25 to 11:48; 23:23 to 23:25 to 23:48; 26:105 to 26:122.

item.title: Al-Qamar:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ fadaʿā rabbahu annī maghlūbun fa-intaṣir Thereat he invoked his Lord, [saying,] 'I have been overcome, so help [me].'

item.title: Al-Qamar:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ fadaʿā rabbahu annī maghlūbun fa-intaṣir So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help." See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ fadaʿā rabbahu annī maghlūbun fa-intaṣir So he called upon his Lord (saying): 'Verily, I am overcome (by these people), so give help' See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ fafataḥnā abwāba l-samāi bimāin mun'hamirin Then We opened the gates of the sky with pouring waters,

item.title: Al-Qamar:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ fafataḥnā abwāba l-samāi bimāin mun'hamirin Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down. See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ fafataḥnā abwāba l-samāi bimāin mun'hamirin So opened We the gates of heaven with water pouring down See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudira and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and the waters met for a preordained purpose.

item.title: Al-Qamar:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudira And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined. See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudira And We caused the earth to break forth like springs and water from the heavens and the earth met together for the purpose verily destined See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥin wadusurin We bore him on a vessel made of planks and nails,

item.title: Al-Qamar:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥin wadusurin And We carried him on a (construction of) planks and nails. See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥin wadusurin And We bore him on a thing (The Ark of Noah.) made of planks and nails See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ tajrī bi-aʿyuninā jazāan liman kāna kufira which sailed [over the flood waters] in Our sight, as a retribution for him who was repudiated.

item.title: Al-Qamar:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ tajrī bi-aʿyuninā jazāan liman kāna kufira Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied. See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ tajrī bi-aʿyuninā jazāan liman kāna kufira It floated on, before Our eyes, a recompense for those who had been rejected (The Apostles.) (by the infidels) See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَاهَا اٰیَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad taraknāhā āyatan fahal min muddakirin Certainly We have left it as a sign; so is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: Al-Qamar:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَاهَا اٰیَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad taraknāhā āyatan fahal min muddakirin And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember? See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَاهَا اٰیَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad taraknāhā āyatan fahal min muddakirin And indeed, We have left it (the Ark) as a sign, but is there one to remember (it) (The Warning. For the different Signs left for mankind refer to the following Verses: 15:77; 25:37; 26:121, 29:35; 51:37; 54:15.) ? See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri So how were My punishment and My warnings?

item.title: Al-Qamar:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri And how (severe) were My punishment and warning.1 See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri How (great) was then My chastisement and My warning! See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: Al-Qamar:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember? See 54:9

item.title: Al-Qamar:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And indeed, have We made Qur'an easy (for remembrance (For men to be mindful and get admonished.) ), but is there one to remember (it)? Unlike any other sacred scripture, the Holy Qur'an is not only abundant with the highest philosophy governing the life secular as well as spiritual, but also full of illustration of the fate of the disbelievers and those who rebelled against the laws prescribed by the Lord. It contains warnings against disbelief, and the evil ways of life and is a perfect code of the laws essential, to discipline the human life in this world. With all these beautiful and wonderful qualities, it is simple, plain and easy to understand. Thus, there remains no excuse for any one with the com non…

item.title: Al-Qamar:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri [The people of] 'Ād impugned [their apostle]. So how were My punishment and My warnings?

item.title: Al-Qamar:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri ʿAad denied; and how (severe) were My punishment and warning. 'Ad denied; then how was My torment and My warnings (54:18). Verily, We sent against them a violently cold (Sarsar) wind on a day of calamity, continuous (54:19). Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date palms (54:20). Then, how was My torment and My warnings (54:21). And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (54:22). The Story of 'Ad Allah states that 'Ad, the People of Hud, denied their Messenger, just as the people of Nuh did. So, Allah sent on them: عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا against them a violently cold (Sarsar) wind Which is means, a bitterly cold and furious wind: فِي يَوْمِ…

item.title: Al-Qamar:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri Belied (the truth) (the people of) 'Ad, then how (great) was My chastisement and My warning! (Refer to Verse 69:7.) The reference is to the violent stormy wind which lasted for seven nights and eight days1. For the people of Ad see Verses 7:65 to 7:72; 11:50 to 11:60; 44:15 and 44:16.

item.title: Al-Qamar:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُسْتَمِرٍّ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsin mus'tamirrin Indeed We unleashed upon them an icy gale on an incessantly ill-fated day,

item.title: Al-Qamar:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُسْتَمِرٍّ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsin mus'tamirrin Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune. See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُسْتَمِرٍّ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsin mus'tamirrin (Lo!) Verily sent We on them a violent wind, on a Day of constant ill-luck (Constant calamity.) See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ tanziʿu l-nāsa ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin munqaʿirin knocking down people as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.

item.title: Al-Qamar:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ tanziʿu l-nāsa ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin munqaʿirin Extracting the people1 as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted. See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ tanziʿu l-nāsa ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin munqaʿirin Flinging the people away, as if they were palm-trunks uprooted See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri So how were My punishment and My warnings?!

item.title: Al-Qamar:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri And how (severe) were My punishment and warning. See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri How (great) was then My chastisement and My warning! (Refer to Verses 54:30; 54:32; 54:39.) See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: Al-Qamar:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember? See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And indeed, have We made Qur'an easy (to remember), but is there one to remember (To receive the warning.) (it)? (Refer to the note on 'Tahrif' in the introduction.) See 54:18

item.title: Al-Qamar:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ kadhabat thamūdu bil-nudhuri [The people of] Thamūd denied the warnings,

item.title: Al-Qamar:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ kadhabat thamūdu bil-nudhuri Thamūd denied the warning. Thamud denied the warnings (54:23). And they said: "A man, alone among us – shall we follow him? Truly, then we should be in error and distress! (54:24). "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him alone from among us? Nay, he is an insolent liar! (54:25). Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one (54:26). Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them, and be patient (54:27). And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one's right to drink being established (by turns) (54:28). But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her) (54:29). Then, how was My torment and My warnings (54:30). Verily, We sent…

item.title: Al-Qamar:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ kadhabat thamūdu bil-nudhuri (The people of) Thamood belied the warners (Every warning. Refer to Verse 41:17.) For the people of Thamud see 7:73 to 7:79; 11:61 to 11:68; 44:17 and 44:18.

item.title: Al-Qamar:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا أَبَشَرًا مِنَّا وَاحِدًا نَتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ faqālū abasharan minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhu innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wasuʿurin and they said, 'Are we to follow a lone human from ourselves?! Indeed then we would be in error and madness.'

item.title: Al-Qamar:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا أَبَشَرًا مِنَّا وَاحِدًا نَتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ faqālū abasharan minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhu innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wasuʿurin And said, "Is it one human being1 among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness. See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا أَبَشَرًا مِنَّا وَاحِدًا نَتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ faqālū abasharan minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhu innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wasuʿurin And said they: 'What! A single man, from among us! and we to follow him? Verily then (In that case.) we shall be astray and in distress (People believed that a warner or an apostle from God cannot be a man. Either God Himself should come or He should send at least some angel. Besides, they thought a single lonely man could not be a warner & could not be followed.) ' This is the mental altitude against God's Vicegerency of a single, and a representative character of a single man as an Absolute authority to be followed, common to all the opponents of the absolute theocracy. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qamar:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ a-ul'qiya l-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashirun 'Has the Reminder been cast upon him from among us? Rather he is a self-conceited1 liar.'

item.title: Al-Qamar:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ a-ul'qiya l-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashirun Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar." See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ a-ul'qiya l-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashirun 'Is it that (the duty of) reminding hath been bestowed on him (alone), of all the (people) among us? Nay! He is a great liar, an insolent one!' See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ sayaʿlamūna ghadan mani l-kadhābu l-ashiru 'Tomorrow they will know who is a self-conceited liar.

item.title: Al-Qamar:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ sayaʿlamūna ghadan mani l-kadhābu l-ashiru They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar. See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ sayaʿlamūna ghadan mani l-kadhābu l-ashiru Soon they shall know on the morrow, (as to) who is the liar, the Insolent One! (Refer to Verses 26:141 - 26:158.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوْۤا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ innā mur'silū l-nāqati fit'natan lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir We are sending the She-camel as a trial for them; so watch them and be steadfast.

item.title: Al-Qamar:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوْۤا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ innā mur'silū l-nāqati fit'natan lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.1 See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوْۤا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ innā mur'silū l-nāqati fit'natan lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir (O' Our Apostle Saleh!) verily We are going to send the she- camel as a trial for them; so watch them and be patient See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُحْتَضَرٌ wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bin muḥ'taḍarun Inform them that the water is to be dispensed between them; every drinking will be attended.'

item.title: Al-Qamar:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُحْتَضَرٌ wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bin muḥ'taḍarun And inform them that the water is shared between them,1 each (day of) drink attended (by turn). See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُحْتَضَرٌ wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bin muḥ'taḍarun And (thou O' Saleh!) make them aware (beforehand) that the water is (to be) divided (Shared.) between them (The She Camel and the people.) ; and every drinking share shall be witnessed (Be present there.) (on it) (Refer to Verses 26:155; 26:156.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَى فَعَقَرَ fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqara But they called their companion, and he took [a knife] and hamstrung [her].

item.title: Al-Qamar:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَى فَعَقَرَ fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqara But they called their companion,1 and he dared2 and hamstrung (her). See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَى فَعَقَرَ fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqara But they called their companion, then he pursued (her) and hamstrung (her) (The She Camel.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri So how were My punishment and My warnings?!

item.title: Al-Qamar:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri And how (severe) were My punishment and warning. See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri How (great) was My chastisement and My warning? See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْۤا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓiri We sent against them a single Cry, and they became like the dry sticks of a corral builder.

item.title: Al-Qamar:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْۤا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓiri Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek (i.e., blast from the sky), and they became like the dry twig fragments of an (animal) pen. See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْۤا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓiri Verily sent We upon them a single (violent) blast, and they were (all) like the dry stubble used by a fencer in a fence (Refer to Verses 7:78; 36:53.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: Al-Qamar:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember? See 54:23

item.title: Al-Qamar:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And indeed, have We made Qur'an easy (to remember) but is there any rememberer? See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhuri And the people of Lot denied the warnings.

item.title: Al-Qamar:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhuri The people of Lut denied the warning. The people of Lut denied the warnings (54:33). Verily, We sent against them Hasib (a violent storm of stones), except the family of Lut, them We saved in the last hour of the night (54:34). As a favor from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks (54:35). And he indeed had warned them of Our punishment, but they doubted the warnings (54:36). And they indeed sought to shame his guests. So, We blinded their eyes (saying), Then taste you My torment and My warnings (54:37). And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning (54:38). Then taste you My torment and My warnings (54:39). And indeed, We have made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that…

item.title: Al-Qamar:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhuri The people of Lot belied the warners (Refer to Verses 11:74 - 11:83.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ نَجَّيْنَاهُمْ بِسَحَرٍ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥarin We unleashed a rain of stones upon them, excepting the family of Lot, whom We delivered at dawn,

item.title: Al-Qamar:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ نَجَّيْنَاهُمْ بِسَحَرٍ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥarin Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lut - We saved them before dawn. See 54:33

item.title: Al-Qamar:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ نَجَّيْنَاهُمْ بِسَحَرٍ innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥarin Verily sent We upon them a stone-storm, (which destroyed them all) save the followers of Lot; We saved them by early dawn (Refer to Verses 11:82; 17:68; 29:40; 67:17.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نِعْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ شَكَرَ niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakara as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

item.title: Al-Qamar:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نِعْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ شَكَرَ niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakara As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful. See 54:33

item.title: Al-Qamar:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نِعْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ شَكَرَ niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakara (As) a bounty from unto Us; Thus do We recompense him who giveth thanks See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhuri He had certainly warned them of Our punishment, but they disputed the warnings.

item.title: Al-Qamar:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhuri And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning. See 54:33

item.title: Al-Qamar:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhuri And indeed, he did warn them of Our severe seizure, but they did dispute about the warner (Refer to Verses 11:78; 11:79.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri Certainly they even solicited of him his guests, whereat We blotted out their eyes, [saying,] 'Taste My punishment and My warnings!'

item.title: Al-Qamar:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, (saying), "Taste My punishment and warning." See 54:33

item.title: Al-Qamar:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri And indeed, they did demand him (Lot.) of his guests (for their evil desert), so did We blind their eyes (saying)'. 'Taste ye then My chastisement and My warning!' See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُسْتَقِرٌّ walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirrun Certainly early at dawn there visited them an abiding punishment:

item.title: Al-Qamar:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُسْتَقِرٌّ walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirrun And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment. See 54:33

item.title: Al-Qamar:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُسْتَقِرٌّ walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirrun And indeed, dawned on them in the morn a lasting chastisement See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri 'Taste My punishment and My warnings!'

item.title: Al-Qamar:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri So taste My punishment and warning. See 54:33

item.title: Al-Qamar:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri Now taste ye My chastisement and My warning! (Refer to Verse 36:63.) See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: Al-Qamar:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember? See 54:33

item.title: Al-Qamar:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin And indeed, have We made Qur'an easy (to he remembered) (For men to be mindful and get admonished.) but is there any one to remember (it) (To receive the warning.) ? See 54:24

item.title: Al-Qamar:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhuru Certainly the warnings came to Pharaoh's clan

item.title: Al-Qamar:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhuru And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning. And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir'awn (54:41). (They) denied all Our signs, so We seized them with a punishment of the Almighty, All-Capable (54:42). Are your disbelievers better than these? Or have you immunity in the Divine Scriptures (54:43). Or say they: We are a great multitude, victorious? (54:44). Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs (54:45). Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter (54:46). The Story of Fir'awn and His People Allah the Exalted narrates to us the story of Fir'awn and his people. A Messenger came to them from Allah, Musa supported by his brother Harun. Their Messengers…

item.title: Al-Qamar:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhuru And indeed, came unto the people of Pharaoh the warners (Or the warnings, Moses and Aaron.) For Musa and Firawn refer to Surah Ta Ha, 20:9 to 20:98.

item.title: Al-Qamar:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadirin who denied all of Our signs. So We seized them with the seizing of One [who is] all-mighty, Omnipotent.

item.title: Al-Qamar:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadirin They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability. See 54:41

item.title: Al-Qamar:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadirin They belied all Our signs so did We seize them after the manner of the one the Ever Prevalent (Aziz in Arabic.) , the All-Mighty One See 54:41

item.title: Al-Qamar:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أُولَئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zuburi Are your faithless better than those, or have you [been granted] some immunity in the scriptures?

item.title: Al-Qamar:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أُولَئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zuburi Are your disbelievers better than those (former ones), or have you immunity in the scriptures? See 54:41

item.title: Al-Qamar:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أُولَئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zuburi What! Are your disbelievers (O' ye Meccans!) better people than these? Or is there an exemption (Immunity.) for you in the sacred Scriptures? A reference to the fate of the disbelievers at the Battle of Badr. It was the triumph of the truth against falsehood. These verses refer to the battle of Badr. Refer to Surah 'Ali Imran, 3:10 to 3:13; Anfal, 8:5 to 8:19 and 8:42 to 8:48.

item.title: Al-Qamar:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُنْتَصِرٌ am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣirun Do they say, 'We are a confederate league'?

item.title: Al-Qamar:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُنْتَصِرٌ am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣirun Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting (each other)"? See 54:41

item.title: Al-Qamar:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُنْتَصِرٌ am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣirun Or say they: "We are a host joined together to help each other? (Refer to Verse 8:7. This is a prophecy made before the Muslims coming into power and the fate of the disbelievers (A.P.).)" See 54:43

item.title: Al-Qamar:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubura The league will be routed and turn its back [to flee].

item.title: Al-Qamar:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubura (Their) assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs (in retreat).1 See 54:41

item.title: Al-Qamar:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubura Soon shall the host be routed, and they shall turn their backs This is a prophecy long before the Muslims coming into power. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qamar:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarru Rather the Hour is their tryst; and the Hour will be most calamitous and bitter.

item.title: Al-Qamar:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarru But the Hour is their appointment (for due punishment), and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter. See 54:41

item.title: Al-Qamar:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarru Nay! The Hour (of Reckoning) is their promised time, and the Hour shall be most grievous and bitter The Day of Judgment will be the most grievous and most bitter experience for the disbelievers. The unjust men are puffed up with pride on account of their numbers and their resources, but more often they are punished in this world, and certainly in the hereafter. Their punishment is for ever. The unjust think that the godly are straying, and mad, particularly when they are in power and in the enjoyment of all the good things of this life. Refer to Sura Ya Sin 36:63 to 36:67.

item.title: Al-Qamar:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿurin Indeed the guilty are in error and madness.

item.title: Al-Qamar:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿurin Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.1. Verily, the criminals are in error and will burn (54:47). The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): Taste you the touch of Hell! (54:48). Verily, We have created all things with Qadar (54:49). And Our commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye (54:50). And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember (54:51). And everything they have done is noted in Az-Zubur (54:52). And everything, small and large, is written down (54:53). Verily, those who have Taqwa, will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers (54:54). In a seat of truth, near the Muqtadir King (54:55). The Destination of the Criminals Allah…

item.title: Al-Qamar:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿurin Verily the guilty ones are straying and mad (in distress) (Refer to Verse 54:24.) The disbelievers would then, i.e., on the Day of Judgment, realise that it was they, who had gone astray1.

item.title: Al-Qamar:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوْۤا مَسَّ سَقَرَ yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqara The day when they are dragged into the Fire on their faces, [it will be said to them,] 'Taste the touch of hell!'

item.title: Al-Qamar:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوْۤا مَسَّ سَقَرَ yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqara The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces (it will be said), "Taste the touch of Saqar."1 See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوْۤا مَسَّ سَقَرَ yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqara On that Day they shall be dragged upon their faces into the fire (and it will be said unto them)'. 'Taste ye (now) the touch of Hell! (Refer to Verse 36:63.) ' See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadarin Indeed We have created everything in a measure,

item.title: Al-Qamar:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadarin Indeed, all things We created with predestination. See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadarin Verily every thing have We created to a determined measure Everything and every event happen strictly according to God's plan.

item.title: Al-Qamar:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣari and Our command is but a single [word], like the twinkling of an eye.

item.title: Al-Qamar:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣari And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye. See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣari And Our command is but one (word 'Be'! And it becometh) like the twinkling of an eye (Refer to Verses 2:117; 16:40; 19:35; 36:82; 40:68.) Refer to Verses 2:117; 16:40; 19:35; 36:82; 40:68.

item.title: Al-Qamar:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakirin Certainly We have destroyed your likes. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: Al-Qamar:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakirin And We have already destroyed your kinds,1 so is there any who will remember? See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakirin And indeed, have We destroyed the like unto you, but is there any one to receive the warning? (To get admonished, or warned) Refer to the references mentioned in the commentary of verses 54:9 to 54:16; 54:18 to 54:21; 54:23 to 54:32; 54:33 to 54:39; 54:41 and 54:42 of this surah for the destruction of the disbelievers.

item.title: Al-Qamar:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zuburi Everything they have done is in the books,

item.title: Al-Qamar:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zuburi And everything they did is in written records. See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zuburi And everything they have done is in the books (of deeds) (Refer to Verse 36:12.) See 54:51

item.title: Al-Qamar:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُسْتَطَرٌ wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭarun and everything big and small, is committed to writing.

item.title: Al-Qamar:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُسْتَطَرٌ wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭarun And every small and great (thing) is inscribed. See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُسْتَطَرٌ wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭarun Every matter small and big, is (correctly) recorded in writing (Refer to Verse 25:29.) See 54:51

item.title: Al-Qamar:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaharin Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and streams,

item.title: Al-Qamar:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaharin Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers. See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaharin Verily, the pious ones shall be in gardens and rivers (Blissful life.) See 54:51

item.title: Al-Qamar:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadirin in the abode of truthfulness1 with an omnipotent King.

item.title: Al-Qamar:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadirin In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.1 See 54:47

item.title: Al-Qamar:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadirin In the seat of Truth, with the Sovereign Omnipotent One (In direct communion. Refer to Verse 3:167.) See 54:51

item.title: Al-Qasas:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: طسم tta-seen-meem Ṭā, Sīn, Mīm.

item.title: Al-Qasas:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: طسم tta-seen-meem Ṭā, Seen, Meem.1 وَنُرِيدُ أَنْ نَمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ And We wished to do a favor to those who were weak in the land, until His saying; يَحْذَرُونَ which they feared. And Allah did indeed do this to them, as He says: وَأَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ And We made the people who were considered weak until His saying; يَعْرِشُونَ they erected (7:137) And Allah said: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ Thus and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them (26:59) Fir'awn hoped that by his strength and power he would be saved from Musa, but that did not help him in the slightest. Despite his great power as a king he could not oppose the decree of Allah, which can never be overcome. On the contrary, Allah's ruling was carried out, for it had…

item.title: Al-Qasas:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: طسم tta-seen-meem Ta Seen Meem (T. S. M.) See 28:5

item.title: Al-Qasas:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni These are the signs of the Manifest Book.

item.title: Al-Qasas:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni These are verses of the clear Book. See 28:1

item.title: Al-Qasas:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni These are the verses of the Book which is manifest. (Manifesting.) See 28:5

item.title: Al-Qasas:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَبَإِ مُوسٰی وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ natlū ʿalayka min naba-i mūsā wafir'ʿawna bil-ḥaqi liqawmin yu'minūna We relate to you truly some of the account of Moses and Pharaoh for a people who have faith.

item.title: Al-Qasas:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَبَإِ مُوسٰی وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ natlū ʿalayka min naba-i mūsā wafir'ʿawna bil-ḥaqi liqawmin yu'minūna We recite to you from the news of Musa and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe. See 28:1

item.title: Al-Qasas:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَبَإِ مُوسٰی وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ natlū ʿalayka min naba-i mūsā wafir'ʿawna bil-ḥaqi liqawmin yu'minūna We recite unto thee from the accounts of Moses and Pharaoh, with truth, for a people who believe. See 28:5

item.title: Al-Qasas:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَائِفَةً مِنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ inna fir'ʿawna ʿalā fī l-arḍi wajaʿala ahlahā shiyaʿan yastaḍʿifu ṭāifatan min'hum yudhabbiḥu abnāahum wayastaḥyī nisāahum innahu kāna mina l-muf'sidīna Indeed Pharaoh tyrannized over the land, reducing its people to factions, abasing one group of them, slaughtering their sons and sparing their women. Indeed He was one of the agents of corruption.

item.title: Al-Qasas:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَائِفَةً مِنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ inna fir'ʿawna ʿalā fī l-arḍi wajaʿala ahlahā shiyaʿan yastaḍʿifu ṭāifatan min'hum yudhabbiḥu abnāahum wayastaḥyī nisāahum innahu kāna mina l-muf'sidīna Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their (newborn) sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters. See 28:1

item.title: Al-Qasas:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَائِفَةً مِنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ inna fir'ʿawna ʿalā fī l-arḍi wajaʿala ahlahā shiyaʿan yastaḍʿifu ṭāifatan min'hum yudhabbiḥu abnāahum wayastaḥyī nisāahum innahu kāna mina l-muf'sidīna Verily, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and divided its people into parties, weakening a group among them, he slaughtered their sons and spared alive their women; Verily he was of the mischief-makers. See 28:5

item.title: Al-Qasas:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
