To check this tendency towards evil the grace of the All-Merciful God provided man with the self-accusing self-called 'Nafs al-Lawwama' which makes the individual feel conscious of the wrong way he treads and to resist it and to seek forgiveness of the Lord. The third sense is called the 'Nafs al-Mutmainnah', i.e., the attainment of perfect satisfaction for the soul to rest in…

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَلَّنْ نَجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ ayaḥsabu l-insānu allan najmaʿa ʿiẓāmahu Does man suppose that We shall not put together his bones?

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَلَّنْ نَجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ ayaḥsabu l-insānu allan najmaʿa ʿiẓāmahu Does man think that We will not assemble his bones? See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَلَّنْ نَجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ ayaḥsabu l-insānu allan najmaʿa ʿiẓāmahu What! thinketh man that never will We assemble his bones (Refer to Verses 36:78, 13:5, 32:10, 19:66, 17:49, 34:7, 23:35, 23:82.) ? See 75:2

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى قَادِرِينَ عَلَى أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ balā qādirīna ʿalā an nusawwiya banānahu Yes indeed, We are able to proportion [even] his fingertips!

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى قَادِرِينَ عَلَى أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ balā qādirīna ʿalā an nusawwiya banānahu Yes. (We are) Able (even) to proportion his fingertips. See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى قَادِرِينَ عَلَى أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ balā qādirīna ʿalā an nusawwiya banānahu Yea! We can put in complete order even his very finger tips (Exactly as they were - with the least precision.) (with the prints thereon)! God is potent enough to restore man his body in all its perfection in all its minute details.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنْسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ bal yurīdu l-insānu liyafjura amāmahu Rather man desires to go on living viciously.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنْسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ bal yurīdu l-insānu liyafjura amāmahu But man desires to continue in sin.1 See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنْسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ bal yurīdu l-insānu liyafjura amāmahu Nay! but willeth man (always) to do evil (even) before him 'What is before', i.e., man neglects his own evils and always postpones repentance. It also means that man forgets or neglects or ignores the Day of Judgment which is sure to befall. This Verse points out that man really does not deny the hereafter and the resurrection, but he wants to be licentious. Thus, his sensual desires influence his reasoning. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ yasalu ayyāna yawmu l-qiyāmati He asks, 'When is this day of resurrection?!'

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ yasalu ayyāna yawmu l-qiyāmati He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?" See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْءَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ yasalu ayyāna yawmu l-qiyāmati Asketh he: "When is the Day of Resurrection (to come) (Refer to Verses 79:42 - 79:46.) ?" See 75:5

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ fa-idhā bariqa l-baṣaru But when the eyes are dazzled,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ fa-idhā bariqa l-baṣaru So when vision is dazzled. See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ fa-idhā bariqa l-baṣaru So when confounded shall be the eye When the sight would become confused and the individual confounded.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ wakhasafa l-qamaru and the moon is eclipsed,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ wakhasafa l-qamaru And the moon darkens. See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ wakhasafa l-qamaru And when darkened shall be the moon Even the great luminaries will lose their light. The moon will lose its reflectivity and will cease to shine. Ali lights will be extinct or will be reduced to nothing before the glory of God.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ wajumiʿa l-shamsu wal-qamaru and the sun and the moon are brought together,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ wajumiʿa l-shamsu wal-qamaru And the sun and the moon are joined. See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ wajumiʿa l-shamsu wal-qamaru And shall be brought together the sun and the moon In the manner they were once united - as scientists say it - or in any other way. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ yaqūlu l-insānu yawma-idhin ayna l-mafaru that day man will say, 'Where is the escape?'

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ yaqūlu l-insānu yawma-idhin ayna l-mafaru Man will say on that Day, "Where is the (place of) escape?" See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ yaqūlu l-insānu yawma-idhin ayna l-mafaru Man shall cry that day: "Where is place to flee to?" See 75:9

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ kallā lā wazara No indeed! There is no refuge!

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ kallā lā wazara No! There is no refuge. See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ kallā lā wazara By no means! No place shall there be of any refuge! See 75:9

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-mus'taqaru That day the abode will be toward your Lord.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-mus'taqaru To your Lord, that Day, is the (place of) permanence. See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-mus'taqaru Unto thy Lord (alone) shall be the place of rest! See 75:9

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَبَّؤُا الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ yunabba-u l-insānu yawma-idhin bimā qaddama wa-akhara That day man will be informed about what he has sent ahead and left behind.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَبَّؤُا الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ yunabba-u l-insānu yawma-idhin bimā qaddama wa-akhara Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead1 and kept back.2 See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَبَّؤُا الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ yunabba-u l-insānu yawma-idhin bimā qaddama wa-akhara Man shall be informed on that day of whatsoever he put before and whatsoever he put behind (Whatever good or bad he has already done and whatever he has left behind to continue. Refer to Verses 74:37, 24:24, 36:65.) ! See 75:9

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ bali l-insānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīratun Rather man is a witness to himself,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ bali l-insānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīratun Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness.1 See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ bali l-insānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīratun Nay! (there is no need as) man against his own self shall be a witness (Well aware of his doings Refer to Verse 17:14 and also 36:65.) ! Well-aware of his doings1. (A.P.) Applicable to man's life here and in the hereafter - meaning there is no use of forwarding excuses when he himself knows. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَلْقَى مَعَاذِيرَهُ walaw alqā maʿādhīrahu though he should offer his excuses.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَلْقَى مَعَاذِيرَهُ walaw alqā maʿādhīrahu Even if he presents his excuses. See 75:1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَلْقَى مَعَاذِيرَهُ walaw alqā maʿādhīrahu And even if he put forth his excuses! See 75:14

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ lā tuḥarrik bihi lisānaka litaʿjala bihi Do not move your tongue with it to hasten it.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ lā tuḥarrik bihi lisānaka litaʿjala bihi Move not your tongue with it, (O Muḥammad), to hasten with it (i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān). Move not your tongue concerning to make haste therewith (75:16). It is for Us to collect it and that it be recited (75:17). And when We have recited it to you, then follow its recitation (75:18). Then it is for Us to make it clear (75:19). But no! Rather you love the present life of this world (75:20). And neglect the Hereafter (75:21). Some faces that Day shall be Nadirah (75:22). Looking at their Lord (75:23). And some faces that Day will be Basirah (75:24). Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them (75:25). How the Prophet SAW Received the Revelation This is Allah teaching His Messenger SAW how…

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ lā tuḥarrik bihi lisānaka litaʿjala bihi (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) Move not thy tongue with it (the Qur'an) in haste (Refer to Verse 20:114.) ! An intelligent study of this Verse and also Verse 20:114 indicates a very great factor along the personality of the Holy Prophet. It indicates that the whole matter of the Holy Qur'an was there already in the heart of the Holy Prophet, and he was commissioned to release only the portion or the part of it which was conveyed to him through the Messenger Angel Gabriel and nothing more. The revelation of the Verses through Gabriel was not repeatedly recited to the Holy Prophet. It was revealed only once and unless the matter had already been there in the heart of the Holy Prophet it could not have been…

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْءَانَهُ inna ʿalaynā jamʿahu waqur'ānahu Indeed it is up to Us to put it together and to recite it.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْءَانَهُ inna ʿalaynā jamʿahu waqur'ānahu Indeed, upon Us is its collection (in your heart) and (to make possible) its recitation. See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْءَانَهُ inna ʿalaynā jamʿahu waqur'ānahu Verily, on Us is the collection of it (The Qur'an. This is a clear indicative that the Qur'an was duly compiled in a divinely willed arrangement before the Holy Prophet left this world - This is the under-taking of God by Himself. Refer to Verse 15:9. See note on 'Tahrif' in the introduction.) and the recital of it! This Verse clearly indicates that under the Divine undertaking about the security of the Holy Qur'an, in its originality and completeness1; the Holy Qur'an as it was revealed, was collected duly under the guidance of the Holy Prophet and there was a complete version of it during his life-time for this Verse clearly indicates the compilation of the Holy Book and to have been done under the Divine guidance and the collection implies the…

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُ fa-idhā qaranāhu fa-ittabiʿ qur'ānahu And when We have recited it, follow its recitation.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُ fa-idhā qaranāhu fa-ittabiʿ qur'ānahu So when We have recited it (through Jibril), then follow its recitation. See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُ fa-idhā qaranāhu fa-ittabiʿ qur'ānahu So, when We have recited it, then follow thou the recital! See 75:17

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ thumma inna ʿalaynā bayānahu Then, its exposition indeed [also] lies with Us.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ thumma inna ʿalaynā bayānahu Then upon Us is its clarification (to you). See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ thumma inna ʿalaynā bayānahu Again, it is on Us the explaining of it! This is another undertaking from God about the correct explanation of the Word of God. This promise was fulfilled in the institution of the Imamate to continue until the end of the world.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ kallā bal tuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata No Indeed! Rather you love this transitory life

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ kallā bal tuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata No! But you (i.e., mankind) love the immediate. See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ kallā bal tuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata Nay! But ye love the fleeing (Refer to Verses 26:128; 21:37.) life! Man by nature is hasty1. Thus, man is after immediate enjoyment of the present life which is temporary and does not care for the hereafter which is permanent. The Verse 'Tohibboona' in plural indicates that the actual addressee in the Verse 16 was not the Holy Prophet but the people - pointing out to man's nature in general that in every matter, the immediate gain is always preferred to the remote one and this tendency manifests itself in every walk of life unless man is controlled by strong intellectual faculties or submits himself to the divine guidance2. (A.P.)

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَذَرُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ watadharūna l-ākhirata and forsake the Hereafter.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَذَرُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ watadharūna l-ākhirata And leave (i.e., neglect) the Hereafter. See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَذَرُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ watadharūna l-ākhirata And neglect ye the hereafter! To avail of the enjoyment at hand in this life, which are only a passing show, man forfeits the hereafter which is an enduring reality.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ wujūhun yawma-idhin nāḍiratun Some faces will be fresh on that day,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ wujūhun yawma-idhin nāḍiratun (Some) faces, that Day, will be radiant. See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ wujūhun yawma-idhin nāḍiratun (Some?) faces (Refer to Verses 76:11; 83:24.) on that day shall be resplendent! This never means that God will appear to anyone in any physical form. The seeing here means realisation of the glory of God.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ ilā rabbihā nāẓiratun looking at their Lord,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ ilā rabbihā nāẓiratun Looking at their Lord.1 See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ ilā rabbihā nāẓiratun Unto their Lord (they will be) attentive (Enjoying God's blessings being in total communion with Him, thus lasting.) ! 'Nazirah' also means waiting for. Every eye will eagerly wait to witness the Divine glory.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ wawujūhun yawma-idhin bāsiratun and some faces will be scowling on that day,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ wawujūhun yawma-idhin bāsiratun And (some) faces, that Day, will be contorted. See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ wawujūhun yawma-idhin bāsiratun And (other) faces on that day shall be despondent See 75:23

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَظُنُّ أَنْ يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ taẓunnu an yuf'ʿala bihā fāqiratun knowing that they will be dealt out a punishment breaking the spine.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَظُنُّ أَنْ يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ taẓunnu an yuf'ʿala bihā fāqiratun Expecting that there will be done to them (something) backbreaking. See 75:16

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَظُنُّ أَنْ يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ taẓunnu an yuf'ʿala bihā fāqiratun Thinking that would befall them some great calamity See 75:23

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ kallā idhā balaghati l-tarāqiya No indeed! When the soul reaches up to the collar bones,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ kallā idhā balaghati l-tarāqiya No! When it (i.e., the soul) has reached the collar bones.1 Nay, when it reaches to the collarbones (75:26). And it will be said: Who can cure him? (75:27). And he will think that it was the parting (75:28). And one shank will be joined with another shank (75:29). The drive will be on that Day to your Lord (75:30). So, he neither believed nor prayed (75:31). But on the contrary, he denied and turned away (75:32). Then he walked in conceit to his family admiring himself (75:33). Woe to you! And then woe to you (75:34). Again, woe to you! And then woe to you (75:35). Does man think that he will be left neglected (75:36). Was he not a Nutfah of semen emitted (75:37). Then he became an 'Alaqah; then…

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ kallā idhā balaghati l-tarāqiya Nay! When it (life) shall reach the throat (Refers to the state of the agony of death) See 75:23

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ waqīla man rāqin and it is said, 'Who will take him up?'1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ waqīla man rāqin And it is said, "Who will cure (him)?" See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ waqīla man rāqin And it will be said: "Who is the charmer (They will remember the charmers and the sooth sayers in who they believed - See note) "? In vain one will think of any one of the charmers or the soothsayers in whom he had believed in, for none could help the dying individual, in the least.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ waẓanna annahu l-firāqu and he knows that it is the [time of] parting,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ waẓanna annahu l-firāqu And he (i.e., the dying one) is certain that it is the (time of) separation. See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ waẓanna annahu l-firāqu And realiseth man that it is the (hour of) parting! See 75:27

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ wal-tafati l-sāqu bil-sāqi and each shank clasps the other shank,1

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ wal-tafati l-sāqu bil-sāqi And the leg is wound about the leg.1 See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ wal-tafati l-sāqu bil-sāqi And when one leg (will twist) with the other leg, (When the agony is heaped on agony) Calamity over calamity shall befall or the state of placing together the legs of the dead body immediately as the souls depart.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-masāqu that day he shall be driven toward your Lord.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-masāqu To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.1 See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-masāqu Unto thy Lord on that day shall be the drive! See 75:29

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّى falā ṣaddaqa walā ṣallā He neither confirmed [the truth], nor prayed,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّى falā ṣaddaqa walā ṣallā And he (i.e., the disbeliever) had not believed, nor had he prayed. See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّى falā ṣaddaqa walā ṣallā For he believed not in the Truth, nor did he offer the regular prayers What the man did in this life He neglected charity and the prayers. This is reference to Abu Jehal's character and conduct.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى walākin kadhaba watawallā but denied [it] and turned away,

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى walākin kadhaba watawallā But (instead), he denied and turned away. See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى walākin kadhaba watawallā But belied the Truth and turned he away The man had rejected the faith and turned away from the right path. Abu Jehal rejected the faith and did not leave the wrong path.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّى thumma dhahaba ilā ahlihi yatamaṭṭā and went swaggering to his family.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّى thumma dhahaba ilā ahlihi yatamaṭṭā And then he went to his people, swaggering (in pride). See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّى thumma dhahaba ilā ahlihi yatamaṭṭā Then went he unto his people in haughtiness The Eighth Holy Imam Ali Ibn Musa Ar-Ridha' says that when these Verses were revealed the Holy Prophet held Abu Jehal by his garments and dragging him recited Verses 34 and 35. "O' Muhammad! Neither thou nor thy God can ever do any harm to me! I am the chief of Mecca!" On the day of the Battle of Badr, seeing the Muslims in a small number against his huge army, Abu Jehal got sure of his success and taunted the Holy Prophet saying that God had brought humiliation to Islam and the Muslims. At last Abu Jehal fell in that battle and was killed by Abdullah Ibn Mas'ood.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى awlā laka fa-awlā So woe to you! Woe to you!

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى awlā laka fa-awlā Woe to you, and woe! See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى awlā laka fa-awlā Nearer unto thee (O' man!) is destruction and nearer still! See 75:33

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى thumma awlā laka fa-awlā Again, woe to you! Woe to you!

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى thumma awlā laka fa-awlā Then woe to you, and woe! See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى thumma awlā laka fa-awlā Again, nearer unto thee (O' man!) the destruction and nearer still! See 75:33

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدًى ayaḥsabu l-insānu an yut'raka sudan Does man suppose that he would be abandoned to futility?

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدًى ayaḥsabu l-insānu an yut'raka sudan Does man think that he will be left neglected?1 See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدًى ayaḥsabu l-insānu an yut'raka sudan What! Thinkest man that he will be left uncontrolled? See 75:33

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِنْ مَنِيٍّ يُمْنَى alam yaku nuṭ'fatan min maniyyin yum'nā Was he not a drop of emitted semen?

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِنْ مَنِيٍّ يُمْنَى alam yaku nuṭ'fatan min maniyyin yum'nā Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted? See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِنْ مَنِيٍّ يُمْنَى alam yaku nuṭ'fatan min maniyyin yum'nā Was he not a (mere) drop of sperm emitted? See 75:33

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّى thumma kāna ʿalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwā Then he became a clinging mass; then He created [him] and proportioned [him],

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّى thumma kāna ʿalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwā Then he was a clinging clot, and (Allah) created (his form) and proportioned (him). See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّى thumma kāna ʿalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwā Then was he a clot of blood, then He created (him), and (He) made (him) proportioned See 75:33

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى fajaʿala min'hu l-zawjayni l-dhakara wal-unthā and made of him the two sexes, the male and the female.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى fajaʿala min'hu l-zawjayni l-dhakara wal-unthā And made of him two mates, the male and the female. See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى fajaʿala min'hu l-zawjayni l-dhakara wal-unthā Then made He of him of two kinds, the male and the female See 75:33

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی alaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā Is not such a one able to revive the dead?

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی alaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā Is not that (Creator) Able to give life to the dead? See 75:26

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی alaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā What! Is not He potent enough to give life (again) unto the dead (Refer to Verses 36:81 - 36:83.) ? See 75:33

item.title: Al-Waaqia:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ idhā waqaʿati l-wāqiʿatu When the Imminent1 [Hour] befalls

item.title: Al-Waaqia:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ idhā waqaʿati l-wāqiʿatu When the Occurrence occurs. وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ And those foremost will be foremost. is about the Prophets (AS), while As-Suddi said that they are the residents of the utmost highs (Ahl Al-'Illiyyin, in Paradise). The meaning of foremost is that they were foremost in performing the acts of righteousness just as Allah commanded them: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ And march forth in the way to forgiveness from your Lord, and for Paradise as wide as the heavens and the earth. (3:133) and: سَابِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ Race with one another in hastening towards forgiveness from your Lord, and Paradise the width whereof is as the width of the heaven and the earth. (57:21) Therefore, those who rush to obey Allah in this life and…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ idhā waqaʿati l-wāqiʿatu When happeneth the Event (The Resurrection for the Final Judgment. Refer to Verses 50:1 - 50:11; 51:1 - 51:6; 52:1 - 52:10; 53:44 - 53:46, 53:57; 54:1 - 54:55; 55:26; 55:27;55:37; 55:39.) The inevitable event is the resurrection for the final Judgement.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ laysa liwaqʿatihā kādhibatun —there is no denying that it will befall—

item.title: Al-Waaqia:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ laysa liwaqʿatihā kādhibatun There is, at its occurrence, no denial. See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ laysa liwaqʿatihā kādhibatun There is not for its happening, any belying People may doubt about its taking place and when it comes, it will be a sudden occurring and will be such a reality that all the false notions against its happening, would vanish away1. It will show the attitude of Qur'an towards the faith in the sure happening of the resurrection, asserting the fact that the whole process of creation bears the testimony to the designed end and this verse re-asserts that there is nothing in the process of creation to belie this (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَافِضَةٌ رَافِعَةٌ khāfiḍatun rāfiʿatun [it will be] lowering, exalting.1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَافِضَةٌ رَافِعَةٌ khāfiḍatun rāfiʿatun It will bring down (some) and raise up (others).1 See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَافِضَةٌ رَافِعَةٌ khāfiḍatun rāfiʿatun (It shall be) Abasing (some and) Exalting (the others) There will be a sorting out of good and evil. The disbelievers, even if they were high and mighty in this world, will be brought low; and the believers, irrespective of whether they occupied low or high position in this world, will be exalted to various ranks and degrees.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا idhā rujjati l-arḍu rajjan When the earth is shaken violently,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا idhā rujjati l-arḍu rajjan When the earth is shaken with convulsion. See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا idhā rujjati l-arḍu rajjan When the earth shall be shaken with a (tremendous) shaking (Refer to Verse 69:14.) The whole physical universe, the existing physical dimension will meet the destruction by its Creator, and a new creation in its place will come into existence1.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا wabussati l-jibālu bassan and the mountains are shattered into bits

item.title: Al-Waaqia:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا wabussati l-jibālu bassan And the mountains are broken down, crumbling. See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا wabussati l-jibālu bassan And the mountains shall be crumbled a terrible crumbling See 56:4

item.title: Al-Waaqia:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَانَتْ هَبَاءً مُنْبَثًّا fakānat habāan munbathan and become scattered dust,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَانَتْ هَبَاءً مُنْبَثًّا fakānat habāan munbathan And become dust dispersing. See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَانَتْ هَبَاءً مُنْبَثًّا fakānat habāan munbathan And they shall become scattered dust (Refer to Verse 51:1.) See 56:4

item.title: Al-Waaqia:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنْتُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ثَلَاثَةً wakuntum azwājan thalāthatan you will be three groups:

item.title: Al-Waaqia:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنْتُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ثَلَاثَةً wakuntum azwājan thalāthatan And you become (of) three kinds. See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنْتُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ثَلَاثَةً wakuntum azwājan thalāthatan And ye shall be (sorted into) three kinds (People will be sorted into three main groups.) See 56:4

item.title: Al-Waaqia:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ fa-aṣḥābu l-maymanati mā aṣḥābu l-maymanati The People of the Right Hand —and what are the People of the Right Hand?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ fa-aṣḥābu l-maymanati mā aṣḥābu l-maymanati Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?1 See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ fa-aṣḥābu l-maymanati mā aṣḥābu l-maymanati Then (will be) the people of the Right hand; Oh! What (a happy state shall) the people of the Right hand (be in)! (Refer to Verses 74:38; 74:39.) The Companions or the Fellows of the Right side - i.e., those who in the beginning of their lives were sinful but subsequently repented and got themselves amended and ended their lives in righteousness. The Sides - 'Right,' (in verse 8) 'Left' in verse 9: and 'Foremost' in verse 10 - are relative terms which are used in Qur'an to indicate the sides inclined towards the Absolute One, the side inclined towards the material are, Many and the Foremost in the order of the beings in submission to the Absolute respectively1 (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْمَشْءَمَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْءَمَةِ wa-aṣḥābu l-mashamati mā aṣḥābu l-mashamati And the People of the Left Hand —and what are the People of the Left Hand?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْمَشْءَمَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْءَمَةِ wa-aṣḥābu l-mashamati mā aṣḥābu l-mashamati And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?1 See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْمَشْءَمَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْءَمَةِ wa-aṣḥābu l-mashamati mā aṣḥābu l-mashamati And the people of the Left hand; Ah! What (a wretched state shall) the people of the Left hand be (in it) The companions or the fellows of the Left-side, i.e., those who from the beginning to the end of their lives were indulged in sinning and ended their lives in sins.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ wal-sābiqūna l-sābiqūna And the Foremost Ones are the foremost ones:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ wal-sābiqūna l-sābiqūna And the forerunners, the forerunners1. See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ wal-sābiqūna l-sābiqūna And the Foremost ones (in faith and virtue) shall be the Foremost ones (in receiving their reward) (Refer to Verses 83:18 - 83:21; 21:106; 21:107;) The Foremost - those who were foremost in faith, and its practice - were always in the forefront, whenever it was necessary for any service to God and goodness. Some say, that the reference is to those who were the foremost to belief in the Truth, viz. all the apostles of God and those who accepted the Truth, the Unity of God, when it was first declared by the Holy Prophet, those who were the foremost to offer the prayers along with the Holy Prophet like 'Ali and Lady Khadija were with the Holy Prophet, in offering the prayers to God, those who were foremost in all the fights for God,…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ulāika l-muqarabūna they are the ones brought near [to Allah],

item.title: Al-Waaqia:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ulāika l-muqarabūna Those are the ones brought near (to Allah). See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ulāika l-muqarabūna These are they who shall be brought nigh (unto God) (Refer to Verses 9:100; 37:40.) Naturally the Foremost praised in the verse above would be the foremost towards the approach to God, i.e., the nearest to Him and naturally be in the Eternal Bliss.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ fī jannāti l-naʿīmi [who will reside] in the gardens of bliss.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ fī jannāti l-naʿīmi In the Gardens of Pleasure. See 56:1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ fī jannāti l-naʿīmi In the gardens of bliss See 56:11

item.title: Al-Waaqia:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ thullatun mina l-awalīna A multitude from the former [generations]1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ thullatun mina l-awalīna A (large) company of the former peoples. A multitude of those will be from the first ones (56:13). And a few of those will be from the later ones (56:14). (They will be) on thrones, Mawdunah (56:15). Reclining thereon, face to face (56:16). Immortal boys will go around them (serving) (56:17). With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine (56:18). Wherefrom neither Yusadda'un nor Yunzifun (56:19). And with fruit that they may choose (56:20). And with the flesh of fowls that they desire (56:21). And (there will be) Hur with wide lovely eyes (56:22). Like preserved pearls (56:23). A reward for what they used to do (56:24). No Laghw (evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (56:25). But only the saying of: Salaman! Salaman! (56:26). The Reward of…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ thullatun mina l-awalīna (A group of the) numerous from among the first ones (The followers of the previous prophets preceding the Holy Prophet.) The number of the Foremost ones, from Adam to the Holy Prophet, is great, i.e., those who believed in God and suffered the most for God and godliness. The reason from the first (verse 13) group being many and from the later (verse 14) - is obvious as in term 'Sabiqoon' and 'Muqurraboon' all the prophets and their divinely commissioned successors (Ausiya) are included - and it is clear that the number of the prophets preceding the Hoy Prophet is greater than the number of 'Sabiqoon' and the 'Muqarraboon' the divinely 'Ausiya' or the successors who are limited to only Twelve as the Holy Prophet has declared 'Al-Ainimato Ba'di Ithna-Ashar' - The leaders or…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَلِيلٌ مِنَ الْءَاخِرِينَ waqalīlun mina l-ākhirīna and a few from the latter ones.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَلِيلٌ مِنَ الْءَاخِرِينَ waqalīlun mina l-ākhirīna And a few of the later peoples. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَلِيلٌ مِنَ الْءَاخِرِينَ waqalīlun mina l-ākhirīna A (group) few from among the later ones (Following the Holy Prophet.) Among the later generations the foremost ones will be few for among- the ancient ones there is the huge number of apostles of God and larger still is the number of their deputies and besides this huge number, are those of the believers who sacrificed themselves for the truth. Though, every sincere follower of the Holy Prophet, i.e., a True Muslim, is surely among those who would enter Paradise but the number of the 'Sadiqoon in Islam could he of the holy Ahl Al-Bayt and the very few of their faithful devotees, who will be rarely found with the degree of the faith and wholehearted devotion to it. This is the reason re: the people of right below the rank of the…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَوْضُونَةٍ ʿalā sururin mawḍūnatin On brocaded couches

item.title: Al-Waaqia:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَوْضُونَةٍ ʿalā sururin mawḍūnatin On thrones woven (with ornament). See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَوْضُونَةٍ ʿalā sururin mawḍūnatin On couches inwrought See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ muttakiīna ʿalayhā mutaqābilīna reclining on them, face to face.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ muttakiīna ʿalayhā mutaqābilīna Reclining on them, facing each other. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ muttakiīna ʿalayhā mutaqābilīna Reclining on them face to face See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ yaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna They will be waited upon by immortal youths,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ yaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ yaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna Around shall go about (serving) them youths of unchanging bloom (Refer to Verse 52:24.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ bi-akwābin wa-abārīqa wakasin min maʿīnin with goblets and ewers and a cup of a clear wine,1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ bi-akwābin wa-abārīqa wakasin min maʿīnin With vessels, pitchers and a cup (of wine) from a flowing spring. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ bi-akwābin wa-abārīqa wakasin min maʿīnin With goblets and ewers and a cup of pure drink See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنْزِفُونَ lā yuṣaddaʿūna ʿanhā walā yunzifūna which neither causes them headache nor stupefaction,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنْزِفُونَ lā yuṣaddaʿūna ʿanhā walā yunzifūna No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنْزِفُونَ lā yuṣaddaʿūna ʿanhā walā yunzifūna Their brows ache not from it, nor faileth the sense (Refer to Verses 76:19; 34:47.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ wafākihatin mimmā yatakhayyarūna and such fruits as they prefer

item.title: Al-Waaqia:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ wafākihatin mimmā yatakhayyarūna And fruit of what they select. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ wafākihatin mimmā yatakhayyarūna And fruits, any that they choose (Refer to Verse 52:22.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ walaḥmi ṭayrin mimmā yashtahūna and such flesh of fowls as they desire,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ walaḥmi ṭayrin mimmā yashtahūna And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ walaḥmi ṭayrin mimmā yashtahūna And the flesh of fowls, any that they like (Refer to Verse 52:23.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ waḥūrun ʿīnun and big-eyed houris

item.title: Al-Waaqia:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ waḥūrun ʿīnun And (for them are) fair women with large, (beautiful) eyes. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ waḥūrun ʿīnun And the Huries (maidens pure), with large (lovely) eyes (Refer to Verses 44:54; 52:20; 55:66; 55:70; 55:72.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ ka-amthāli l-lu'lu-i l-maknūni like guarded pearls,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ ka-amthāli l-lu'lu-i l-maknūni The likenesses of pearls well-protected. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ ka-amthāli l-lu'lu-i l-maknūni Like unto pearls hidden (in their shells) (Refer to Verse 52:24.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna a reward for what they used to do.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna As reward for what they used to do. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna A recompense for what they used to do See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā tathīman They will not hear therein any vain talk or sinful speech,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā tathīman They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā tathīman They shall hear not therein any frivolity, nor any taint of sin (Refer to Verse 52:23.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا illā qīlan salāman salāman but only the watchword, 'Peace!' 'Peace!'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا illā qīlan salāman salāman Only a saying (of) peace, peace. See 56:13

item.title: Al-Waaqia:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا illā qīlan salāman salāman Save (Naught) 'Peace' (and ever) 'Peace!' talked of (Refer to Verses 10:10; 14:23; 19:62.) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ wa-aṣḥābu l-yamīni mā aṣḥābu l-yamīni And the People of the Right Hand —what are the People of the Right Hand?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ wa-aṣḥābu l-yamīni mā aṣḥābu l-yamīni The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right? And those on the right – how (fortunate) will be those on the right (56:27). (They will be) among Sidri Makhdud (56:28). And among Talh Mandud (56:29). And in shade Mamdud (56:30). And by water flowing constantly (56:31). And fruit in plenty (56:32). Whose supply is not cut off nor are they out of reach (56:33). And on couches, raised high (56:34). Verily, We have created them a special creation (56:35). And made them virgins (56:36). 'Urub, Atrab (56:37). For those on the right (56:38). A multitude of those will be from the first generation (56:39). And a multitude of those will be from the later generations (56:40). The Reward of Those on the Right After Allah…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ wa-aṣḥābu l-yamīni mā aṣḥābu l-yamīni And the people of Right hand! Oh! What (a happy state shall) the people of the Right hand (be in)! (Refer to Verses 74:39; 34:16;) See 56:14

item.title: Al-Waaqia:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي سِدْرٍ مَخْضُودٍ fī sid'rin makhḍūdin Amid thornless lote trees

item.title: Al-Waaqia:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي سِدْرٍ مَخْضُودٍ fī sid'rin makhḍūdin (They will be) among lote trees with thorns removed. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي سِدْرٍ مَخْضُودٍ fī sid'rin makhḍūdin Amid thornless lote-trees Regarding the figurative description of the heavenly bliss given in verses 28-38 see our previous notes on it (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَطَلْحٍ مَنْضُودٍ waṭalḥin manḍūdin and clustered spathes1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَطَلْحٍ مَنْضُودٍ waṭalḥin manḍūdin And (banana) trees layered (with fruit). See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَطَلْحٍ مَنْضُودٍ waṭalḥin manḍūdin And banana-trees (with fruits) piled one above another See 56:28

item.title: Al-Waaqia:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ waẓillin mamdūdin and extended shade,1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ waẓillin mamdūdin And shade extended. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ waẓillin mamdūdin And shade spread out See 56:28

item.title: Al-Waaqia:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَاءٍ مَسْكُوبٍ wamāin maskūbin and ever-flowing water

item.title: Al-Waaqia:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَاءٍ مَسْكُوبٍ wamāin maskūbin And water poured out. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَاءٍ مَسْكُوبٍ wamāin maskūbin And water flowing See 56:28

item.title: Al-Waaqia:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ wafākihatin kathīratin and abundant fruits,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ wafākihatin kathīratin And fruit, abundant (and varied). See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ wafākihatin kathīratin And fruit abundant See 56:28

item.title: Al-Waaqia:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ lā maqṭūʿatin walā mamnūʿatin neither inaccessible, nor forbidden,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ lā maqṭūʿatin walā mamnūʿatin Neither limited (to season) nor forbidden. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ lā maqṭūʿatin walā mamnūʿatin Neither failing (by season) nor (their free use) forbidden (by any) See 56:28

item.title: Al-Waaqia:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ wafurushin marfūʿatin and noble spouses.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ wafurushin marfūʿatin And (upon) beds raised high. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ wafurushin marfūʿatin And on thrones exalted (Noble mates.) 'Furash' lit. means - Carpet or anything spread on ground. It has been applied to the earth itself1 , figuratively has been used for wives as the Holy Prophet has used 'al-waladu li 'l-Firaash' - The child belongs to the bed (i.e., wife) and the wife belongs to husband. According to some commentators 'Forush' here means wives and the context of the next immediate verse also supports this. In which case it will mean exalted mates (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً innā anshanāhunna inshāan We have created them with a special creation,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً innā anshanāhunna inshāan Indeed, We have produced them (i.e., the women of Paradise) in a (new) creation. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً innā anshanāhunna inshāan Verily have We created them (The fair beautiful mates) as a (special) creation See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا fajaʿalnāhunna abkāran and made them virgins,

item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا fajaʿalnāhunna abkāran And made them virgins. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا fajaʿalnāhunna abkāran And We have made them virgins pure See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا ʿuruban atrāban loving, of a like age,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا ʿuruban atrāban Devoted (to their husbands) and of equal age. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا ʿuruban atrāban Lovable (by nature), equal in age See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ li-aṣḥābi l-yamīni for the People of the Right Hand.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ li-aṣḥābi l-yamīni For the companions of the right (who are). See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ li-aṣḥābi l-yamīni For the people of the Right hand See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ thullatun mina l-awalīna A multitude from the former [generations]

item.title: Al-Waaqia:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ thullatun mina l-awalīna A company of the former peoples. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ thullatun mina l-awalīna Numerous from among the first ones (Refer to Verse 56:14.) See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْءَاخِرِينَ wathullatun mina l-ākhirīna and a multitude from the latter [ones].

item.title: Al-Waaqia:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْءَاخِرِينَ wathullatun mina l-ākhirīna And a company of the later peoples. See 56:27

item.title: Al-Waaqia:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْءَاخِرِينَ wathullatun mina l-ākhirīna And numerous from among the later ones See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ wa-aṣḥābu l-shimāli mā aṣḥābu l-shimāli And the People of the Left Hand —what are the People of the Left Hand?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ wa-aṣḥābu l-shimāli mā aṣḥābu l-shimāli And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left? And those on the left? How will be those on the left (56:41). In Samum, and Hamim (56:42). And a shadow from Yahmum (56:43). Neither Barid nor Karim (56:44). Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury (56:45). And were persisting in great sin (56:46). And they used to say: When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected? (56:47). "And also our forefathers? (56:48). Say: "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times (56:49). "All will surely be gathered together for appointed meeting of a known Day (56:50). "Then verily, – you the erring – ones, the deniers! (56:51). "You verily, will eat of the trees of Zaqqum (56:52).…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ wa-aṣḥābu l-shimāli mā aṣḥābu l-shimāli And the people of the Left hand, Ah! What (a wretched state shall) the people of the Left hand (be in)! See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ fī samūmin waḥamīmin Amid infernal miasma and boiling water

item.title: Al-Waaqia:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ fī samūmin waḥamīmin (They will be) in scorching fire and scalding water. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ fī samūmin waḥamīmin In scorching (Hot.) wind and scalding (Boiling.) water See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظِلٍّ مِنْ يَحْمُومٍ waẓillin min yaḥmūmin and the shadow of a dense black smoke,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظِلٍّ مِنْ يَحْمُومٍ waẓillin min yaḥmūmin And a shade of black smoke. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَظِلٍّ مِنْ يَحْمُومٍ waẓillin min yaḥmūmin And in the shadow of a black smoke See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ lā bāridin walā karīmin neither cool nor beneficial.1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ lā bāridin walā karīmin Neither cool nor beneficial. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ lā bāridin walā karīmin Neither cool nor graceful See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ innahum kānū qabla dhālika mut'rafīna Indeed they had been affluent before this,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ innahum kānū qabla dhālika mut'rafīna Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ innahum kānū qabla dhālika mut'rafīna Verily they were ere that, of the extravagants (in ease and luxury) (Refer to Verses 34:34; 43:23.) See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنْثِ الْعَظِيمِ wakānū yuṣirrūna ʿalā l-ḥinthi l-ʿaẓīmi and they used to persist in the great sin.1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنْثِ الْعَظِيمِ wakānū yuṣirrūna ʿalā l-ḥinthi l-ʿaẓīmi And they used to persist in the great violation.1 See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنْثِ الْعَظِيمِ wakānū yuṣirrūna ʿalā l-ḥinthi l-ʿaẓīmi And they used to persist in heinous sin (The vindication of the great covenant taken at Ghadir Khumm.) See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يَقُولُونَ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ wakānū yaqūlūna a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna And they used to say, 'What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يَقُولُونَ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ wakānū yaqūlūna a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected? See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانُوْۤا يَقُولُونَ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ wakānū yaqūlūna a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna And they used to say: 'What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we even then indeed be again raised up? (Refer to Verses 37:16 - 37:18; 50:3) ' See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ awaābāunā l-awalūna And our forefathers too?'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ awaābāunā l-awalūna And our forefathers (as well)?" See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ awaābāunā l-awalūna Or our fathers of yore? See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْءَاخِرِينَ qul inna l-awalīna wal-ākhirīna Say, 'Indeed the former and latter generations

item.title: Al-Waaqia:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْءَاخِرِينَ qul inna l-awalīna wal-ākhirīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Indeed, the former and later peoples. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْءَاخِرِينَ qul inna l-awalīna wal-ākhirīna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): 'Verily the ancients and the later ones' See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَى مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ lamajmūʿūna ilā mīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin will all be gathered for the tryst of a known day.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَى مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ lamajmūʿūna ilā mīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day." See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَى مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ lamajmūʿūna ilā mīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin Certainly, shall be gathered together unto the tryst of the known Day (Refer to Verse 36:38.) See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ thumma innakum ayyuhā l-ḍālūna l-mukadhibūna Then indeed, you, astray deniers,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ thumma innakum ayyuhā l-ḍālūna l-mukadhibūna Then indeed you, O those astray (who are) deniers. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ thumma innakum ayyuhā l-ḍālūna l-mukadhibūna Then verily ye, O' ye who are astray and belie it See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْ شَجَرٍ مِنْ زَقُّومٍ laākilūna min shajarin min zaqqūmin will surely eat from the Zaqqūm tree

item.title: Al-Waaqia:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْ شَجَرٍ مِنْ زَقُّومٍ laākilūna min shajarin min zaqqūmin Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْ شَجَرٍ مِنْ زَقُّومٍ laākilūna min shajarin min zaqqūmin Certainly, shall ye eat of a tree of 'Zaqqoom (Refer to Verses 37:64; 44:43 - 44:46.) ' See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna and stuff your bellies with it,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna And filling with it your bellies. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna And fill with it (your) bellies See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ fashāribūna ʿalayhi mina l-ḥamīmi and drink boiling water on top of it,

item.title: Al-Waaqia:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ fashāribūna ʿalayhi mina l-ḥamīmi And drinking on top of it from scalding water. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ fashāribūna ʿalayhi mina l-ḥamīmi And drink over it of boiling water See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ fashāribūna shur'ba l-hīmi drinking like thirsty camels.'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ fashāribūna shur'ba l-hīmi And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ fashāribūna shur'ba l-hīmi Then shall drink ye as drinketh the thirsty camel See 56:34

item.title: Al-Waaqia:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ hādhā nuzuluhum yawma l-dīni Such will be the hospitality they receive on the Day of Retribution.1

item.title: Al-Waaqia:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ hādhā nuzuluhum yawma l-dīni That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense. See 56:41

item.title: Al-Waaqia:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ hādhā nuzuluhum yawma l-dīni This shall be their repast on the Day of Reckoning (Day of the Final Judgement.) The presentation of the reward and the punishment in the life hereafter and the terms of enjoyments and the tortures of a physical life, as it has already been pointed out in the previous notes on the topics, are figurative expressions and in the sense of presenting the unknown in the terms of the known but taking the non-material and metaphysical world as real and the material and the physical one as a mere phenomenon and the manifestation of the real one, it should be said that the enjoyments and the tortures of this life, are figurative expression of the real one1 (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ naḥnu khalaqnākum falawlā tuṣaddiqūna We created you. Then why do you not acknowledge it?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ naḥnu khalaqnākum falawlā tuṣaddiqūna We have created you, so why do you not believe? We created you, then why do you believe not (56:57). Do you not see the semen you emit (56:58). Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator (56:59). We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped (56:60). To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not (56:61). And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation, why then do you not remember (56:62). Proof that Resurrection will Occur Allah asserts that Resurrection will occur and refutes the misguided atheists who deny it, those who said: أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected? (56:47) They said this…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ naḥnu khalaqnākum falawlā tuṣaddiqūna It is We Who created you, why then do ye not admit the Truth? To prove the evolutionary process of the development of life from physical to the transcendental one Qur'an forwards the process of creation which is known to everyone, i.e., the development of a most complicated and perfect living being out of the most insignificant frivolous emitted life germ and the various forms it assumes in the embryo and after its birth till its death, the power which administered these processes, shall not fail to take this continuous change of germs into a further realm of creation unknown to us (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تُمْنُونَ afara-aytum mā tum'nūna Have you considered the sperm that you emit?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تُمْنُونَ afara-aytum mā tum'nūna Have you seen that which you emit?1 See 56:57

item.title: Al-Waaqia:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تُمْنُونَ afara-aytum mā tum'nūna Have ye seen what ye emit (the life germ)? See 56:57

item.title: Al-Waaqia:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَنْتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَالِقُونَ a-antum takhluqūnahu am naḥnu l-khāliqūna Is it you who create it, or are We the creator?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَنْتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَالِقُونَ a-antum takhluqūnahu am naḥnu l-khāliqūna Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator? See 56:57

item.title: Al-Waaqia:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَنْتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَالِقُونَ a-antum takhluqūnahu am naḥnu l-khāliqūna Is it ye that create it or are We the Creators? See 56:57

item.title: Al-Waaqia:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ naḥnu qaddarnā baynakumu l-mawta wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna We have ordained death among you, and We are not to be outmaneuvered

item.title: Al-Waaqia:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ naḥnu qaddarnā baynakumu l-mawta wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone. See 56:57

item.title: Al-Waaqia:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ naḥnu qaddarnā baynakumu l-mawta wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna It is We Who have decreed death among you, and We are not to be frustrated (Prevented.) The decreed respite, given to man in this world until his death which none can ever change or avoid.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنْشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ʿalā an nubaddila amthālakum wanunshi-akum fī mā lā taʿlamūna from replacing you with your likes and recreating you in [a realm] you do not know.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنْشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ʿalā an nubaddila amthālakum wanunshi-akum fī mā lā taʿlamūna In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that (form) which you do not know.1 See 56:57

item.title: Al-Waaqia:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنْشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ʿalā an nubaddila amthālakum wanunshi-akum fī mā lā taʿlamūna To Our changing (Or substituting others like unto you in your place.) your forms and raising you in that ye know not (In a form or a state not known to you now.) If God wills, He can replace any people with any other. Or our soul and put into new forms not known to us - But this is not the transmigration in this world itself.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَى فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ walaqad ʿalim'tumu l-nashata l-ūlā falawlā tadhakkarūna Certainly you have known the first genesis, then why do you not take admonition?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَى فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ walaqad ʿalim'tumu l-nashata l-ūlā falawlā tadhakkarūna And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember? See 56:57

item.title: Al-Waaqia:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَى فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ walaqad ʿalim'tumu l-nashata l-ūlā falawlā tadhakkarūna And indeed, know ye the first growth, why then ye reflect not? It is asserted that the process in the unknown realm is comparable to the process known. Moreover, this verse proves that the life of man is capable of being remembered in the first development known to man. There is no such a thing as a previous development and previous birth, in other words this birth known to man, is the first birth1 (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَحْرُثُونَ afara-aytum mā taḥruthūna Have you considered what you sow?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَحْرُثُونَ afara-aytum mā taḥruthūna And have you seen that (seed) which you sow? Do you not see what you sow (56:63). Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower (56:64). Were it Our will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be Tafakkahun (56:65). (Saying:) "We are indeed Mughramun! (56:66). "Nay, but we are deprived! (56:67). Do you not see the water that you drink (56:68). Is it you who cause it to come down from Al-Muzn, or are We the Cause of it coming down (56:69). If We willed, We verily could make it salty; why then do you not give thanks (56:70). Do you not see the fire which you kindle (56:71). Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower (56:72). We…

item.title: Al-Waaqia:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَحْرُثُونَ afara-aytum mā taḥruthūna Have ye seen what ye sow Note the arguments from verse 58 above to verse 73 below, proving the supreme and the exclusive authority of God over the universe, enumerating a few of the innumerable obvious bounties of nature which also are great marvels if studied intelligently - viz, the growing of the seed, the rain-water, coming down from heaven, the combustion or the quality of the fire etc., There are the other examples of growth, development and changes. In each case, it is to bring home to man that in both cases, though the action is attributed to man but the effect is always due to God's administration (A.P.).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَنْتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ a-antum tazraʿūnahu am naḥnu l-zāriʿūna Is it you who make it grow, or are We the grower?

item.title: Al-Waaqia:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَنْتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ a-antum tazraʿūnahu am naḥnu l-zāriʿūna Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower? See 56:63

item.title: Al-Waaqia:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَأَنْتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ a-antum tazraʿūnahu am naḥnu l-zāriʿūna What! Is it ye (Causers of the growth.) that grow it or are We the growers (Cause it to grow.) ? We only sow the seed. Who is it that makes it grow and yield in manifold quantities. Is it not a wonder, and none else but God does it.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَامًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ law nashāu lajaʿalnāhu ḥuṭāman faẓaltum tafakkahūna If We wish, We surely turn it into chaff, whereat you are left stunned1 [saying to yourselves,]

item.title: Al-Waaqia:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَامًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ law nashāu lajaʿalnāhu ḥuṭāman faẓaltum tafakkahūna If We willed, We could make it (dry) debris, and you would remain in wonder.1 See 56:63

item.title: Al-Waaqia:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
