And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage (78:20). Truly, Hell is a place of ambus (78:21). A dwelling place for the Taghun (78:22). They will abide therein Ahqab (78:23). Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink (78:24). Except Hamim, and Ghassa (78:25). An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes) (78:26). For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning (78:27). But they denied Our Ayat…

item.title: An-Naba:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا inna yawma l-faṣli kāna mīqātan ''Verily the Day of Decision is a time appointed That day, the True and the False, the Good and the Bad, will be separated - Everything will be laid bare in its reality1.

item.title: An-Naba:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fatatūna afwājan the day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will come in groups,

item.title: An-Naba:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fatatūna afwājan The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fatatūna afwājan ''The Day when the Trumpet shall be blown (Refer to: 6:73; 18:99; 20:102; 23:101; 27:87, 36:51; 39:68; 50:20; 69:13: 74:8.) , and ye shall come forth in (huge) groups The angel will be the one who will blow the Trumpet which will give effect to all the violent changes in the present state of existence, heralding the dawn of the day or the hour of the Final Judgment1. People will rise from their graves and run to report to the seat of judgment in hosts, under their respective religious leaders2. Once when the Holy Prophet was in the house of Abu-Ayub Ansari, Ma'aaz Ibn Jabal asked him about the 'Naba' al-Adheem' the Holy Prophet said, ''Certainly it is a very great thing" Then with tears in his eyes…

item.title: An-Naba:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا wafutiḥati l-samāu fakānat abwāban and the sky will be opened and become gates,

item.title: An-Naba:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا wafutiḥati l-samāu fakānat abwāban And the heaven is opened and will become gateways. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا wafutiḥati l-samāu fakānat abwāban ''And (they will find) the heaven opened, full of portals See 78:18

item.title: An-Naba:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا wasuyyirati l-jibālu fakānat sarāban and the mountains will be set moving and become a mirage.

item.title: An-Naba:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا wasuyyirati l-jibālu fakānat sarāban And the mountains are removed and will be (but) a mirage. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا wasuyyirati l-jibālu fakānat sarāban ''And (they will find) the mountains set in motion (Refer to: 81:3.) , as if they are a mere vapour (Mirage.) Mountain means something firm and stable. But when its moving and the transitory condition is realised, it appears that the idea of a mountain was only a mirage. (A.P.)

item.title: An-Naba:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا inna jahannama kānat mir'ṣādan Indeed hell is an ambush,

item.title: An-Naba:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا inna jahannama kānat mir'ṣādan Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا inna jahannama kānat mir'ṣādan ''Verily (they will find) the hell in waiting See 78:20

item.title: An-Naba:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلطَّاغِينَ مَءَابًا lilṭṭāghīna maāban a resort for the rebels,

item.title: An-Naba:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلطَّاغِينَ مَءَابًا lilṭṭāghīna maāban For the transgressors, a place of return. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلطَّاغِينَ مَءَابًا lilṭṭāghīna maāban ''(Being) for the transgressors the destination See 78:20

item.title: An-Naba:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا lābithīna fīhā aḥqāban to reside therein for ages,

item.title: An-Naba:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا lābithīna fīhā aḥqāban In which they will remain for ages (unending). See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا lābithīna fīhā aḥqāban ''To abide therein for ages ('Ahqab' See note.) 'Ahqab' is the plural of 'Huqub', and the Holy Prophet said that a 'Huqub' is the duration of Eighty and more years and each year of an especially long duration of thousands of years in the terms of our present calculations. The First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abu Talib was asked by Bilal as to the length of a ''Huqub' which is ordinarily taken and he replied, ''that a Huqub is of Eighty years and each year of twelve months and each month of thirty days and each day of thousand years!" Then Ali said that 'Huqub' which will continue one after the other before those committed to hell are taken out of it. About the duration of the stay in hell and heaven see 11:107…

item.title: An-Naba:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا lā yadhūqūna fīhā bardan walā sharāban tasting in it neither any coolness nor drink,

item.title: An-Naba:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا lā yadhūqūna fīhā bardan walā sharāban They will not taste therein (any) coolness or drink. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا lā yadhūqūna fīhā bardan walā sharāban ''They shall taste not therein any coolness nor any drink See 78:23

item.title: An-Naba:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا illā ḥamīman waghassāqan except boiling water and pus

item.title: An-Naba:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا illā ḥamīman waghassāqan Except scalding water and (foul) purulence. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا illā ḥamīman waghassāqan ''Save boiling water and running pus 'Ghussaq1' is a liquid with intolerable foul smell.

item.title: An-Naba:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا jazāan wifāqan —a fitting requital.

item.title: An-Naba:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا jazāan wifāqan An appropriate recompense.1 See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا jazāan wifāqan ''A recompense fitting (Refer to: 10:4, 38:57.) (their evils)! See 78:25

item.title: An-Naba:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا innahum kānū lā yarjūna ḥisāban Indeed they did not expect any reckoning,

item.title: An-Naba:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا innahum kānū lā yarjūna ḥisāban Indeed, they were not expecting an account. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا innahum kānū lā yarjūna ḥisāban ''Verily they looked not forward to their reckoning They did not believe in the Day of Judgment and hence they hoped not to be called to account for their faith and their deeds.

item.title: An-Naba:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كِذَّابًا wakadhabū biāyātinā kidhāban and they denied Our signs mendaciously,

item.title: An-Naba:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كِذَّابًا wakadhabū biāyātinā kidhāban And denied Our verses with (emphatic) denial. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كِذَّابًا wakadhabū biāyātinā kidhāban ''And belied Our Signs with a (persistent) falsification They impudently ridiculed and belied the signs of God, called the truth as falsehood. They treated the admonition of the apostles and the holy ones with disdain and ridiculed and persecuted and martyred the apostles of God and their divinely commissioned deputies, i.e., the Holy Imams.

item.title: An-Naba:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu kitāban and We have figured everything in a Book.

item.title: An-Naba:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu kitāban But all things We have enumerated in writing. See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu kitāban ''And everything have We recorded in a book (Refer to: 36:12, 6:59, 34:3.) Every deed has been preserved in its exact originality which will itself speak out. This Book and the Imam al-Mubeen in 36:12 and the Imam in 17:71 - are one and the same entity or two separable entities as already pointed out - thus they are well connected with the Great News here. (A.P.)

item.title: An-Naba:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا فَلَنْ نَزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا fadhūqū falan nazīdakum illā ʿadhāban So [now] taste! We shall increase you in nothing but punishment!

item.title: An-Naba:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا فَلَنْ نَزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا fadhūqū falan nazīdakum illā ʿadhāban "So taste (the penalty), and never will We increase you except in torment."1 See 78:17

item.title: An-Naba:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا فَلَنْ نَزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا fadhūqū falan nazīdakum illā ʿadhāban ''Taste ye then! And never will We increase for you aught but chastisement! See 78:29

item.title: An-Naba:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا inna lil'muttaqīna mafāzan Indeed a triumph awaits the Godwary:

item.title: An-Naba:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا inna lil'muttaqīna mafāzan Indeed, for the righteous is attainment1. Verily, for those who have Taqwa, there will be a success (78:31). Hada'iq and vineyards (78:32). And Kawa'ib Atrab (78:33). And a cup Dihaq (78:34). No Laghw shall they hear therein, nor lying (78:35). Rewarded from your Lord with a sufficient gift (78:36). The Great Success will be for Those Who have Taqwa Allah informs about the happy people and what He has prepared for them of esteem, and eternal pleasure. Allah says: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا Verily, for those who have Taqwa, there will be a success; Ibn 'Abbas and Ad-Dahhak both said, "A place of enjoyable recreation." Mujahid and Qatadah both said, "They are successful and thus, they are saved from the Hellfire." The most obvious meaning here is the statement of Ibn 'Abbas, because Allah says…

item.title: An-Naba:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا inna lil'muttaqīna mafāzan ''Verily for the pious ones is a great realization. (Refer to: 44:57, 45:30, 25:75.) '' For the 'Fawz ul-Adheem', i.e., the Great Achievement1. Read the verse with 'Waja'lan lil muttaqeena Imaman' it will mean that the Muttaqeen or the pious ones shall have their salvation through their Imams. (A.P.)

item.title: An-Naba:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا ḥadāiqa wa-aʿnāban gardens and vineyards,

item.title: An-Naba:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا ḥadāiqa wa-aʿnāban Gardens and grapevines. See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا ḥadāiqa wa-aʿnāban ''Gardens enclosed and vineyards See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا wakawāʿiba atrāban and buxom maidens of a like age,

item.title: An-Naba:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا wakawāʿiba atrāban And young women (companions) of equal age. See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا wakawāʿiba atrāban ''And mates, maidens beautiful See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا wakasan dihāqan and brimming cups.

item.title: An-Naba:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا wakasan dihāqan And a full cup.1 See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا wakasan dihāqan ''And a cup full See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā kidhāban Therein they shall hear neither vain talk nor lies

item.title: An-Naba:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā kidhāban No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood. See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā kidhāban ''They shall hear not therein vain words nor any falsehood See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا jazāan min rabbika ʿaṭāan ḥisāban —a reward from your Lord, a bounty sufficing,1

item.title: An-Naba:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا jazāan min rabbika ʿaṭāan ḥisāban (As) reward from your Lord, (a generous) gift (made due by) account.1 See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا jazāan min rabbika ʿaṭāan ḥisāban ''A recompense from thy Lord, an award according to the reckoning (Refer to: 11:105, 70:4, 97:4.) '' The recompense from the Lord will not be in the degree equal to the goodness, but more, as the gift and the grace from God in addition to it.

item.title: An-Naba:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna min'hu khiṭāban the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the All-beneficent, whom they will not be able to address

item.title: An-Naba:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna min'hu khiṭāban (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him (authority for) speech.1 See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna min'hu khiṭāban ''The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them two, the Beneficent God, they shall possess not the right of addressing (To Plead or addressing God, refer to: 7:46 – 49 as explained in the next verse.) None will have any power or right to question the decision of the Lord1. 'Addressing Him' as a pleader or addressing the others (7:46 - 7:49) or as explained in the next verse. (A.P.)

item.title: An-Naba:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا yawma yaqūmu l-rūḥu wal-malāikatu ṣaffan lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāban on the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in an array. None shall speak except whom the All-beneficent permits and who says what is right.

item.title: An-Naba:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا yawma yaqūmu l-rūḥu wal-malāikatu ṣaffan lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāban The Day that the Spirit (i.e., Jibril) and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct. See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا yawma yaqūmu l-rūḥu wal-malāikatu ṣaffan lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāban ''On the day whereon shall stand the spirit and the angels arrayed, they shall speak not save he whom the Beneficent God giveth leave (He whom the permission will be given, will be the one who spoke nothing but Truth - the Holy Prophet. Refer to: 53:3, 53:4. Refer to: 4:85, 19:87, 20:101, 21:28, 34:23, 39:44, 74:48, 10:3, 43:86.) , who spoke (only) the truth 'Rooh', i.e., spirit - reference to the Messenger Angel Gabriel, being superior to all the angels and the nearest one to God and the one who conveyed messages from God to His Apostles and who after the conclusion of the apostleship with the Holy Prophet Muhammad stayed…

item.title: An-Naba:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ مَءَابًا dhālika l-yawmu l-ḥaqu faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi maāban That is the day of truth. So let anyone who wishes take resort with his Lord.

item.title: An-Naba:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ مَءَابًا dhālika l-yawmu l-ḥaqu faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi maāban That is the True (i.e., certain) Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a (way of) return.1 See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ مَءَابًا dhālika l-yawmu l-ḥaqu faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi maāban ''That is the day certain, whoso then desireth, may take refuge unto his Lord. (Refer to: 25:57.) Read this Verse with 25:57 - the only way to Salvation is the 'Mowaddat' or love of those attached in body and mind to the Last Apostle of God. (A.P.)

item.title: An-Naba:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَالَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāban Indeed We have warned you of a punishment near at hand —the day when a person will observe1 what his hands have sent ahead and the faithless one will say, 'I wish I were dust!'

item.title: An-Naba:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَالَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāban Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth1 and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!" See 78:31

item.title: An-Naba:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَالَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāban ''Verily have We warned you of a chastisement nigh at hand, the day when man shall see what have sent before his two hands, and when the disbeliever shall say, ''Oh! would that I were dust! When a disbeliever and the sinner will see the wrath of God and the punishment they had to meet and the blissful life, the reward for the believers and the righteous, this is what the souls of the wicked ones would desire.

item.title: An-Nahl:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتٰی أَمْرُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ atā amru l-lahi falā tastaʿjilūhu sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna Allah's edict is coming! So do not seek to hasten it. Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: An-Nahl:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتٰی أَمْرُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ atā amru l-lahi falā tastaʿjilūhu sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna The command of Allah is coming,1 so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

item.title: An-Nahl:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتٰی أَمْرُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ atā amru l-lahi falā tastaʿjilūhu sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna The Decree of God hath come, therefore ye hasten it not: Glory be to Him and Exalted is He above what they associate with Him. 'Amrullah', i.e., God's Command - Here meaning the punishment from God with which the people were threatened. 'Amrullah - The commentators have given various interpretations of 'Ata-Amrullah'. Whether it means in future, though the verb is in the form of past or it means perfect, 'Amr' undoubtedly is the decree of punishment. If this verse is read with verse 10:47 it gets clear that with the advent of the Holy Prophet the faith of the people, the believers and the disbelievers, had been decided. All that remains is, its execution to which the people are warned here,…

item.title: An-Nahl:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرُوْۤا أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاتَّقُونِ yunazzilu l-malāikata bil-rūḥi min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi an andhirū annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-ittaqūni He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command1 to whomever He wishes of His servants: 'Warn [the people] that there is no god except Me; so be wary of Me.'

item.title: An-Nahl:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرُوْۤا أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاتَّقُونِ yunazzilu l-malāikata bil-rūḥi min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi an andhirū annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-ittaqūni He sends down the angels, with the inspiration (i.e., revelation) of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, (telling them), "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me." He sends down the angels with the Ruh (revelation) of His command to those servants of His whom He wills (saying): Warn mankind that none has the right to be worshipped but I, so have Taqwa of Me (16:2). Allah Sends Whomever He Wills with the Message of Tawhid يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ He sends down the angels with the Ruh refers to the revelation. This is like the Ayat: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا…

item.title: An-Nahl:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرُوْۤا أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاتَّقُونِ yunazzilu l-malāikata bil-rūḥi min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi an andhirū annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-ittaqūni He sendeth down the angels with the spirit (revelation) by His own decree on whomsoever He willeth of His servants saying: "Warn ye (the mankind) that there (Refers to the source and the course of the receipt of the revelations by the apostles of God, and the object of the revelations.) is no god but I therefore fear (Obey - Be dutiful.) Me." The 'Ruh', i.e., Spirit or Soul - Here 'Ruh' stands for the Holy Qur'an, i.e., guidance which enlivens the dead souls, quickening the ignorant ones with knowledge. 'Ruh' is stated to stand for 'Gabriel', i.e., the Angels always accompany _Gabrie_l1. 'By…

item.title: An-Nahl:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ تَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi taʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He is above having any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: An-Nahl:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ تَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi taʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him. He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. High is He, Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him (16:3). He has created man from a Nutfah, then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent (16:4). Allah is the One Who has Created the Heavens, the Earth, and Man Allah tells us about His creation of the upper realm, which is the heavens, and the lower realm, which is the earth, and everything in them. They have been created for a true purpose, not in vain, so that: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى He may requite those who do evil…

item.title: An-Nahl:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ تَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi taʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna Created He (God.) the heavens and the earth with the truth; Exalted is He above what they associate (with Him). See 16:2

item.title: An-Nahl:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ khalaqa l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun He created man from a drop of [seminal] fluid,1 and, behold, he is an open contender!2

item.title: An-Nahl:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ khalaqa l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once1 he is a clear adversary. See 16:3

item.title: An-Nahl:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ khalaqa l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun He created man from life sperm or germ (Sperm.) and behold! (that same drop now a man) he is an open disputer. (Refer to verses 36:77 - 36:79.) 'Nutfah' which literally means also a small quantity of liquid - Here stands for the small drops containing the life-germs or the spermatozoon in the seminal fluid. Ibne Ubai brought a few bits of some rotten bones and asked the Holy Prophet with ridicule saying: "Who could raise these bits to life again?" This verse was revealed.

item.title: An-Nahl:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ wal-anʿāma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'on wamanāfiʿu wamin'hā takulūna He created the cattle, in which there is warmth1 for you and [other] uses and some of them you eat.

item.title: An-Nahl:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ wal-anʿāma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'on wamanāfiʿu wamin'hā takulūna And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth1 and (numerous) benefits, and from them you eat. And the cattle, He has created them for you; in them there is warmth (warm clothing), and numerous benefits, and you eat from them (16:5). And there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home in the evening, and as you lead them forth to pasture (in the morning) (16:6). And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach yourselves except with great trouble. Truly, your Lord is full of kindness, Most Merciful (16:7). The Cattle are Part of the Creation of Allah and a Blessing from Him Allah reminds His servants of the blessing in…

item.title: An-Nahl:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ wal-anʿāma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'on wamanāfiʿu wamin'hā takulūna And the cattle (He) created them for you, therein is warmth (In their hide and wool.) and many (Advantages.) gains, and of them ye eat. See 16:4

item.title: An-Nahl:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ walakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna waḥīna tasraḥūna There is in them a beauty for you when you bring them home for rest and when you drive them forth to pasture.

item.title: An-Nahl:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ walakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna waḥīna tasraḥūna And for you in them is (the enjoyment of) beauty when you bring them in (for the evening) and when you send them out (to pasture). See 16:5

item.title: An-Nahl:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ walakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna waḥīna tasraḥūna And for you they beseem well when ye drive them (home) and when ye drive them forth (to pasture.) See 16:4

item.title: An-Nahl:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَى بَلَدٍ لَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا بَالِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْأَنْفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ wataḥmilu athqālakum ilā baladin lam takūnū bālighīhi illā bishiqqi l-anfusi inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun And they bear your burdens to towns which you could not reach except by straining yourselves. Indeed your Lord is most kind and merciful.

item.title: An-Nahl:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَى بَلَدٍ لَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا بَالِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْأَنْفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ wataḥmilu athqālakum ilā baladin lam takūnū bālighīhi illā bishiqqi l-anfusi inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful. See 16:5

item.title: An-Nahl:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَى بَلَدٍ لَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا بَالِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْأَنْفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ wataḥmilu athqālakum ilā baladin lam takūnū bālighīhi illā bishiqqi l-anfusi inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun And bear they your burdens to lands which ye could not else reach but with distress unto (your) self; Verily thy Lord is Pitiful, All-Merciful, See 16:4

item.title: An-Nahl:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wal-khayla wal-bighāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wazīnatan wayakhluqu mā lā taʿlamūna And horses, mules and asses, for you to ride them, and for adornment, and He creates what you do not know.

item.title: An-Nahl:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wal-khayla wal-bighāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wazīnatan wayakhluqu mā lā taʿlamūna And (He created) the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and (as) adornment. And He creates that which you do not know. And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride, and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge (16:8). This refers to another category of animals that Allah has created as a blessing for His servants, horses, mules and donkeys, all of which He made for riding and adornment. This is the main purpose for which these animals were created. It was reported in the Two Sahihs that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said: "The Messenger of Allah SAW forbade us to eat the meat of domestic donkeys, but he allowed…

item.title: An-Nahl:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wal-khayla wal-bighāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wazīnatan wayakhluqu mā lā taʿlamūna And (He made) horses and mules and asses that ye might ride upon them and as adornment; and createth He what ye know not. See 16:4

item.title: An-Nahl:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَائِرٌ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ waʿalā l-lahi qaṣdu l-sabīli wamin'hā jāirun walaw shāa lahadākum ajmaʿīna With Allah rests guidance to the straight path,1 and some of them2 are devious, and had He wished He would have guided you all.

item.title: An-Nahl:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَائِرٌ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ waʿalā l-lahi qaṣdu l-sabīli wamin'hā jāirun walaw shāa lahadākum ajmaʿīna And upon Allah1 is the direction of the (right) way, and among them (i.e., the various paths) are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all. And it is up to Allah to show the right way. But there are ways that stray. And had He willed, He would have guided you all (16:9). Explanation of the Different Religious Paths When Allah mentioned the animals which may be used for the purpose of physical journeys, He also referred to the moral, religious routes that people may follow. Often in the Qur'an there is a shift from physical or tangible things to beneficial spiritual and religious matters, as when Allah says: وَتَزَوَّدُوا فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الزَّادِ التَّقْوَىٰ And…

item.title: An-Nahl:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَائِرٌ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ waʿalā l-lahi qaṣdu l-sabīli wamin'hā jāirun walaw shāa lahadākum ajmaʿīna And upon God rests the guidance unto the right way, and of them (the ways) are the deviating ones; and if He willeth He would certainly guide you all aright. Referring to the means of communication, it is asserted that God will add something besides what is already known, (i.e., what is unknown) and the purpose of it is to straighten or shorten the way and facilitate the conveyance towards reaching its destination. Asserting that providing this facility is His duty, it indicates that along with the straight ways there are crooked ways also, and God does not force anything on any one. By these examples of the means of communication in the physical life, man is reminded of the…

item.title: An-Nahl:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لَكُمْ مِنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِیْهِ تُسِيمُونَ huwa alladhī anzala mina l-samāi māan lakum min'hu sharābun wamin'hu shajarun fīhi tusīmūna It is He who sends down water from the sky: from it you get your drink and from it are [sustained] the plants wherein you pasture your herds.

item.title: An-Nahl:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لَكُمْ مِنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِیْهِ تُسِيمُونَ huwa alladhī anzala mina l-samāi māan lakum min'hu sharābun wamin'hu shajarun fīhi tusīmūna It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture (animals). He it is Who sends water down from the sky; from it you drink and from it (grows) the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture (16:10). With it He causes crops to grow for you, the olives, the date palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily, in this there is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for people who give thought (16:11). The Blessings of Rain, and Explaining How it is One of the Signs When Allah mentions the blessings of cattle and…

item.title: An-Nahl:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لَكُمْ مِنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِیْهِ تُسِيمُونَ huwa alladhī anzala mina l-samāi māan lakum min'hu sharābun wamin'hu shajarun fīhi tusīmūna He it is Who sendeth down water from the heavens for you; from it ye drink, and by it (groweth) trees on which ye pasture your cattle. See 16:9

item.title: An-Nahl:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنْبِتُ لَكُمْ بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالنَّخِيلَ وَالْأَعْنَابَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ yunbitu lakum bihi l-zarʿa wal-zaytūna wal-nakhīla wal-aʿnāba wamin kulli l-thamarāti inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna With it He makes the crops grow for you and olives, date palms, vines, and fruits of all kinds. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: An-Nahl:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنْبِتُ لَكُمْ بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالنَّخِيلَ وَالْأَعْنَابَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ yunbitu lakum bihi l-zarʿa wal-zaytūna wal-nakhīla wal-aʿnāba wamin kulli l-thamarāti inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and of all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought. See 16:10

item.title: An-Nahl:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُنْبِتُ لَكُمْ بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالنَّخِيلَ وَالْأَعْنَابَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ yunbitu lakum bihi l-zarʿa wal-zaytūna wal-nakhīla wal-aʿnāba wamin kulli l-thamarāti inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna He groweth for you thereby corn, and the olives, and the palm-trees, and the grapes, and of all the fruits; Verily in this is a sign for a people who reflect. See 16:9

item.title: An-Nahl:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wasakhara lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūmu musakharātun bi-amrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna He disposed the night and the day for you, and the sun, the moon and the stars are disposed by His command. There are indeed signs in that for a people who apply reason.

item.title: An-Nahl:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wasakhara lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūmu musakharātun bi-amrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason. And He has subjected the night and the day for you, and the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His command. Surely, in this are proofs for people who understand (16:12). And all He has created of varying colors on the earth for you. Verily, in this is a sign for people who reflect (16:13). Signs in the Subjection of Night and Day, the Sun and the Moon, and in that which Grows…

item.title: An-Nahl:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wasakhara lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūmu musakharātun bi-amrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna And (He hath) made sub servient for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon; and the stars have been made subservient by His decree; Verily in this are signs for a people who understand, The stars being controlled in their movement by God's order in such a way that they do not deviate from the path decreed by Him, are compared to the Holy Prophet and in his absolute obedience to His Command in verses 53:1 - 53:4. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Nahl:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ wamā dhara-a lakum fī l-arḍi mukh'talifan alwānuhu inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yadhakkarūna And whatever He has created for you in the earth of diverse hues —there is indeed a sign in that for a people who take admonition.

item.title: An-Nahl:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ wamā dhara-a lakum fī l-arḍi mukh'talifan alwānuhu inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yadhakkarūna And (He has subjected) whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember. See 16:12

item.title: An-Nahl:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ wamā dhara-a lakum fī l-arḍi mukh'talifan alwānuhu inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yadhakkarūna And what He hath produced in the earth of varied hues (and qualities) Verily there is in this a sign for a people who are mindful (with gratitude). See 16:12

item.title: An-Nahl:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرٰی الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِیْهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wahuwa alladhī sakhara l-baḥra litakulū min'hu laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijū min'hu ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka mawākhira fīhi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna It is He who disposed the sea [for your benefit] that you may eat from it fresh meat, and obtain from it ornaments, which you wear —and you see the ships plowing through it— and that you may seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.

item.title: An-Nahl:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرٰی الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِیْهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wahuwa alladhī sakhara l-baḥra litakulū min'hu laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijū min'hu ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka mawākhira fīhi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and (He subjected it) that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful. And He it is Who subjected the sea (to you), that you may eat from the fresh tender meat, and that you bring forth out of it ornaments to wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, that you may seek from His bounty and that you…

item.title: An-Nahl:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرٰی الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِیْهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wahuwa alladhī sakhara l-baḥra litakulū min'hu laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijū min'hu ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka mawākhira fīhi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And He it is Who made subservient the sea that ye might eat from it fresh meat and take out from it ornaments which ye wear, and thou seest the ships cleaving through it, and that ye might seek of His grace, and that ye might give thanks. See 16:12

item.title: An-Nahl:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلْقَى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَارًا وَسُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa-anhāran wasubulan laʿallakum tahtadūna He cast in the earth firm mountains lest it should shake with you, and [made] streams and ways, so that you may be guided

item.title: An-Nahl:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلْقَى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَارًا وَسُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa-anhāran wasubulan laʿallakum tahtadūna And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and (made) rivers and roads, that you may be guided. See 16:14

item.title: An-Nahl:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلْقَى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَارًا وَسُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa-anhāran wasubulan laʿallakum tahtadūna And He hath cast great mountains (standing firm) in the earth lest it may shake with you, and rivers and the roads that ye be guided aright, This expression which has been repeated in the Qur'an may refer to the geological fact that the surface of the earth is subject to shaking due to the internal heat of the earth, which had not been covered with a rocky layer. Referring to this Ali says: 'He bolted with rocks due to the shaking of the surface of the earth'. And in another place he says, 'He has balanced the movement of the earth with the bolting granites or rocks' (A.P.).

item.title: An-Nahl:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَامَاتٍ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ waʿalāmātin wabil-najmi hum yahtadūna —and the landmarks [as well], and by the stars they are guided.

item.title: An-Nahl:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَامَاتٍ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ waʿalāmātin wabil-najmi hum yahtadūna And landmarks. And by the stars they are (also) guided.1 See 16:14

item.title: An-Nahl:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَامَاتٍ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ waʿalāmātin wabil-najmi hum yahtadūna And landmarks (too), and by the star they are guided (to the right way) The First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib said that by 'Najm' meaning, Star, i.e., the Pole-Star which is stationary and by which the travellers in the wilderness and on the sea determine their routes. The inner meaning of this statement is that by 'Alaamaat', i.e., the signs, are meant the holy Ahl al-Bayt and by 'Najm' i.e., the Star, means the Holy Prophet Muhammad.

item.title: An-Nahl:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَخْلُقُ كَمَنْ لَا يَخْلُقُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afaman yakhluqu kaman lā yakhluqu afalā tadhakkarūna Is He who creates like one who does not create? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: An-Nahl:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَخْلُقُ كَمَنْ لَا يَخْلُقُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afaman yakhluqu kaman lā yakhluqu afalā tadhakkarūna Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded? See 16:14

item.title: An-Nahl:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَخْلُقُ كَمَنْ لَا يَخْلُقُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afaman yakhluqu kaman lā yakhluqu afalā tadhakkarūna What! Is He then who createth like unto him who createth not? Will ye not then consider? See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَعُدُّوْۤا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-in taʿuddū niʿ'mata l-lahi lā tuḥ'ṣūhā inna l-laha laghafūrun raḥīmun If you enumerate Allah's blessings, you will not be able to count them. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: An-Nahl:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَعُدُّوْۤا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-in taʿuddū niʿ'mata l-lahi lā tuḥ'ṣūhā inna l-laha laghafūrun raḥīmun And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. See 16:14

item.title: An-Nahl:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ تَعُدُّوْۤا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ wa-in taʿuddū niʿ'mata l-lahi lā tuḥ'ṣūhā inna l-laha laghafūrun raḥīmun If ye would count God's bounties, ye can not compute (Count.) them; Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful (Refer to verse 14:34.) . See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna Allah knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose.

item.title: An-Nahl:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal (16:19). Those whom they invoke besides Allah have not created anything, but are themselves created (16:20). (They are) dead, not alive; and they do not know when they will be resurrected (16:21). Allah tells us that He knows what is hidden in people's hearts as well as what is apparent. He will reward or punish everyone for their deeds on the Day of Resurrection. If their deeds are good then they will be rewarded, and if their deeds are evil, then they will be punished. The Gods of the Idolators are Created, they do Not Create Then Allah tells us that the idols which people call on instead…

item.title: An-Nahl:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna And God knoweth what ye hide and what ye manifest (Show – publish.) See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lā yakhluqūna shayan wahum yukh'laqūna Those whom they invoke besides Allah do not create anything and are themselves created.

item.title: An-Nahl:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lā yakhluqūna shayan wahum yukh'laqūna And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they (themselves) are created. See 16:19

item.title: An-Nahl:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lā yakhluqūna shayan wahum yukh'laqūna And those whom they call on besides God create not aught while they are themselves created. See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَاءٍ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ amwātun ghayru aḥyāin wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna They are dead, not living, and are not aware when they will be resurrected.

item.title: An-Nahl:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَاءٍ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ amwātun ghayru aḥyāin wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna They are (in fact) dead,1 not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected. See 16:19

item.title: An-Nahl:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَاءٍ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ amwātun ghayru aḥyāin wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna Dead (they are), not living, and they perceive not when they will be raised. See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مُنْكِرَةٌ وَهُمْ مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati qulūbuhum munkiratun wahum mus'takbirūna Your God is the One God. Those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are amiss,1 and they are arrogant.

item.title: An-Nahl:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مُنْكِرَةٌ وَهُمْ مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati qulūbuhum munkiratun wahum mus'takbirūna Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant. Your god is one God. But for those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts are in denial, and they are proud (16:22). Certainly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Truly, He does not like the proud (16:23). None is to be Worshipped Except Allah Allah tells us that there is none to be worshipped besides Him, the One, the Unique, the Lone, the Self-Sufficient. He tells us that the hearts of the disbelievers deny that and are astonished by that: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ "Has…

item.title: An-Nahl:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مُنْكِرَةٌ وَهُمْ مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati qulūbuhum munkiratun wahum mus'takbirūna Your God is One God; and those who believe not in the hereafter, their hearts are repulsive (against the truth (Perverse.) ), and they are men of pride. (Arrogant.) See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ lā jarama anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'takbirīna Undoubtedly, Allah knows whatever they hide and whatever they disclose. Indeed He does not like the arrogant.

item.title: An-Nahl:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ lā jarama anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'takbirīna Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant. See 16:22

item.title: An-Nahl:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ lā jarama anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'takbirīna Certainly it is that God knoweth what they hide and what they express; Verily He loveth not the proud ones. See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوْا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-idhā qīla lahum mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū asāṭīru l-awalīna When they are told, 'What is it that your Lord has sent down?' They say, 'Myths of the ancients,'

item.title: An-Nahl:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوْا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-idhā qīla lahum mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū asāṭīru l-awalīna And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" they say, "Legends of the former peoples." And when it is said to them: What is it that your Lord has revealed?" They say: "Tales of the men of old! (16:24). They will bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection, and also the burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge. Evil indeed is that which they shall bear (16:25). The Destruction of the Disbelievers and Intensification of their Punishment for Rejecting the Revelation Allah informs us that when it is said to those liars: مَّاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوا "What is it that your Lord has revealed?" They say, not wanting to answer: أَسَاطِيرُ…

item.title: An-Nahl:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوْا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-idhā qīla lahum mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū asāṭīru l-awalīna And when it is said unto them: "What is it that your Lord hath sent down?" Say they (Nothing but the) legends of the ancients, See 16:16

item.title: An-Nahl:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَحْمِلُوا أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ الَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ liyaḥmilū awzārahum kāmilatan yawma l-qiyāmati wamin awzāri alladhīna yuḍillūnahum bighayri ʿil'min alā sāa mā yazirūna that they may bear their entire burdens on the Day of Resurrection, along with some of the burdens of those whom they lead astray without any knowledge. Look! Evil is what they bear!

item.title: An-Nahl:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَحْمِلُوا أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ الَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ liyaḥmilū awzārahum kāmilatan yawma l-qiyāmati wamin awzāri alladhīna yuḍillūnahum bighayri ʿil'min alā sāa mā yazirūna That they may bear their own burdens (i.e., sins) in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without (i.e., by lack of) knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear. See 16:24

item.title: An-Nahl:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَحْمِلُوا أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ الَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ liyaḥmilū awzārahum kāmilatan yawma l-qiyāmati wamin awzāri alladhīna yuḍillūnahum bighayri ʿil'min alā sāa mā yazirūna That they may bear their burden entirely on the Day of Judgment and also of the burdens of those whom they led astray without knowledge; Behold! Evil is it what they bear! Those who mislead others shall bear not only the burden of their own sins but also the sins of all those misled by them without diminishing anything from the punishment of the followers. Similarly, those who guide others aright shall have the reward not only for their own goodness but also for the goodness spread by them among those who follow them, without prejudice or any detriment to the rights of the followers for their own rewards. The…

item.title: An-Nahl:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتٰی اللَّهُ بُنْيَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ qad makara alladhīna min qablihim fa-atā l-lahu bun'yānahum mina l-qawāʿidi fakharra ʿalayhimu l-saqfu min fawqihim wa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Those who were before them [had also] schemed. Then Allah razed their edifice from the foundations and the roof collapsed upon them from above and the punishment overtook them whence they were not aware.

item.title: An-Nahl:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتٰی اللَّهُ بُنْيَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ qad makara alladhīna min qablihim fa-atā l-lahu bun'yānahum mina l-qawāʿidi fakharra ʿalayhimu l-saqfu min fawqihim wa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at (i.e., uprooted) their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them,1 and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive. Those before them indeed plotted, but Allah struck at the foundation of their building, the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the torment overtook them from directions they did not perceive (16:26). Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My (so-called) partners, those over which you caused so much…

item.title: An-Nahl:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتٰی اللَّهُ بُنْيَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ qad makara alladhīna min qablihim fa-atā l-lahu bun'yānahum mina l-qawāʿidi fakharra ʿalayhimu l-saqfu min fawqihim wa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Indeed did plot those before them, and then (the wrath of) God came (attacked or commanded.) (and destroyed) their structure (from) the foundations, and fell on them the roof from above them, and came on them the torment whence they perceived not. God gives the rope of the length of the respite to the disbelievers and the wicked to hang themselves, by frustrating their plans at the end. The disbelievers are allowed to complete their plans and then when they have exerted themselves to the maximum limits possible for them and exhaust all their resources, then all that…

item.title: An-Nahl:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَاءِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوءَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yukh'zīhim wayaqūlu ayna shurakāiya alladhīna kuntum tushāqqūna fīhim qāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma inna l-khiz'ya l-yawma wal-sūa ʿalā l-kāfirīna Then He will disgrace them on the Day of Resurrection, and say, 'Where are My partners for whose sake you used to defy [Allah]?' Those who were given knowledge will say, 'Indeed today disgrace and distress pursue the faithless.'

item.title: An-Nahl:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَاءِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوءَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yukh'zīhim wayaqūlu ayna shurakāiya alladhīna kuntum tushāqqūna fīhim qāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma inna l-khiz'ya l-yawma wal-sūa ʿalā l-kāfirīna Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose (the believers)?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers". See 16:26

item.title: An-Nahl:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَاءِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوءَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yukh'zīhim wayaqūlu ayna shurakāiya alladhīna kuntum tushāqqūna fīhim qāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma inna l-khiz'ya l-yawma wal-sūa ʿalā l-kāfirīna Then on the Day of Resurrection He will bring them to disgrace and say: "Where are My partners (which ye ascribed unto Me), about whom ye have been disputing; (Opposed or turned hostile.) Those who have been given the knowledge will say: "Verily the disgrace this day and evil is upon the infidels," 'Utu al-'Ilm', i.e., those gifted with knowledge. This clearly indicates that there are some, whom God has Himself gifted them with knowledge and they could not be other than the Apostles of God, and the Holy Imams who are Divinely commissioned to preserve and maintain…

item.title: An-Nahl:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَأَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِنْ سُوءٍ بَلَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ẓālimī anfusihim fa-alqawū l-salama mā kunnā naʿmalu min sūin balā inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā kuntum taʿmalūna —Those whom the angels take away while they are wronging themselves. Thereat they submit: 'We were not doing any evil!' 'Yes, indeed Allah knows best what you used to do!

item.title: An-Nahl:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَأَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِنْ سُوءٍ بَلَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ẓālimī anfusihim fa-alqawū l-salama mā kunnā naʿmalu min sūin balā inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā kuntum taʿmalūna The ones whom the angels take in death (while) wronging themselves,1 and (who) then offer submission, (saying), "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do. Those whose lives the angels take while they are doing wrong to themselves. Then, they will (falsely) submit (saying): "We did not do any evil." (The angels will reply): "Yes! Truly, Allah is Most Knowing of what you did (16:28). "So enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein, and indeed, what an evil abode there is for the arrogant (16:29). The Condition of the Disbeliever during…

item.title: An-Nahl:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَأَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِنْ سُوءٍ بَلَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ẓālimī anfusihim fa-alqawū l-salama mā kunnā naʿmalu min sūin balā inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā kuntum taʿmalūna Those whom the angels terminate their life while they are unjust (Sinners.) unto themselves, then they would offer submission (saying): "We used not to do any evil," (the angels will reply): "Aye! Verily knoweth God well what ye were doing." See 16:27

item.title: An-Nahl:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ fa-ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā falabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna Enter the gates of hell to remain in it [forever]. Evil is the [final] abode of the arrogant.'

item.title: An-Nahl:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ fa-ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā falabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant. See 16:28

item.title: An-Nahl:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ fa-ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā falabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna Therefore enter ye the gates of Hell, to abide in it; Woeful indeed will be the abode of the haughty (Arrogant ones.) ones! See 16:27

item.title: An-Nahl:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوْا خَيْرًا لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ waqīla lilladhīna ittaqaw mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū khayran lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun walaniʿ'ma dāru l-mutaqīna But to those who were Godwary it will be said, 'What is it that your Lord has sent down?' They will say, 'Good.' For those who do good in this world there will be a good [reward], and the abode of the Hereafter is better, and the abode of the Godwary is surely excellent:

item.title: An-Nahl:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوْا خَيْرًا لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ waqīla lilladhīna ittaqaw mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū khayran lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun walaniʿ'ma dāru l-mutaqīna And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "(That which is) good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous. And (when) it is said to those who had Taqwa (piety and righteousness), What is it that your Lord has revealed?" They say: "That which is good." For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed…

item.title: An-Nahl:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوْا خَيْرًا لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ waqīla lilladhīna ittaqaw mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū khayran lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun walaniʿ'ma dāru l-mutaqīna And it is said unto those who guard themselves against evil: "What is that hath sent down your Lord?" Say they: "Good; For those who do good in this world is good; and indeed the abode of the hereafter is better; and excellent indeed is the abode of the pious ones," See 16:27

item.title: An-Nahl:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ كَذٰلِكَ يَجْزِي اللَّهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru lahum fīhā mā yashāūna kadhālika yajzī l-lahu l-mutaqīna the Gardens of Eden, which they will enter, with streams running in them. There they will have whatever they wish, and thus does Allah reward the Godwary

item.title: An-Nahl:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ كَذٰلِكَ يَجْزِي اللَّهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru lahum fīhā mā yashāūna kadhālika yajzī l-lahu l-mutaqīna Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous. See 16:30

item.title: An-Nahl:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ كَذٰلِكَ يَجْزِي اللَّهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru lahum fīhā mā yashāūna kadhālika yajzī l-lahu l-mutaqīna Gardens of eternity, they shall enter therein, beneath them flow rivers; they shall have in them whatever they desire for; Thus doth God reward the pious ones, See 16:27

item.title: An-Nahl:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ادْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ṭayyibīna yaqūlūna salāmun ʿalaykumu ud'khulū l-janata bimā kuntum taʿmalūna —those whom the angels take away while they are pure. They say [to them], 'Peace be to you! Enter paradise because of what you used to do.'

item.title: An-Nahl:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ادْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ṭayyibīna yaqūlūna salāmun ʿalaykumu ud'khulū l-janata bimā kuntum taʿmalūna The ones whom the angels take in death, (being) good and pure; (the angels) will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do." See 16:30

item.title: An-Nahl:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ادْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ṭayyibīna yaqūlūna salāmun ʿalaykumu ud'khulū l-janata bimā kuntum taʿmalūna Those whom the angels take away in a good state, (the angels) while receiving them will say: "Peace be on you; Enter ye the Garden, for what ye were doing." See 16:27

item.title: An-Nahl:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā an tatiyahumu l-malāikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim wamā ẓalamahumu l-lahu walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna Do they await anything but that the angels should come to them, or your Lord's edict should come? Those who were before them had acted likewise; Allah did not wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.

item.title: An-Nahl:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā an tatiyahumu l-malāikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim wamā ẓalamahumu l-lahu walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna Do they (i.e., the disbelievers) await except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves. Are they but waiting for the angels to come to them, or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those before them. And Allah did not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves (16:33). Then, they were afflicted by their evil deeds, and they were surrounded by that which they used to mock (16:34). The…

item.title: An-Nahl:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā an tatiyahumu l-malāikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim wamā ẓalamahumu l-lahu walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna What! Await they aught save that come (The coming of the angels to execute the decree of the punishment to them.) unto them the angels or cometh (to pass) the decree of thy Lord? Thus did those before them; And God was not unjust unto them, but they were unto their own selves unjust. See 16:27

item.title: An-Nahl:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna So the evils of what they had earned visited them, and they were besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: An-Nahl:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule. See 16:33

item.title: An-Nahl:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna So afflicted them the evils what they did; and encompassed them that which they were scoffing at. See 16:27

item.title: An-Nahl:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ نَحْنُ وَلَا ءَابَاؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَهَلْ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ waqāla alladhīna ashrakū law shāa l-lahu mā ʿabadnā min dūnihi min shayin naḥnu walā ābāunā walā ḥarramnā min dūnihi min shayin kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim fahal ʿalā l-rusuli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu The polytheists say, 'Had Allah wished, we would not have worshiped anything besides Him —neither we, nor our fathers— nor would we have held anything holy besides Him.'1 Those who were before them had acted likewise. Is the apostles' duty anything but to communicate in clear terms?

item.title: An-Nahl:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ نَحْنُ وَلَا ءَابَاؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَهَلْ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ waqāla alladhīna ashrakū law shāa l-lahu mā ʿabadnā min dūnihi min shayin naḥnu walā ābāunā walā ḥarramnā min dūnihi min shayin kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim fahal ʿalā l-rusuli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except (the duty of) clear notification? And those who worshipped others with Allah said: "If Allah had so willed, neither we nor our fathers would have worshipped any…

item.title: An-Nahl:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ نَحْنُ وَلَا ءَابَاؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَهَلْ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ waqāla alladhīna ashrakū law shāa l-lahu mā ʿabadnā min dūnihi min shayin naḥnu walā ābāunā walā ḥarramnā min dūnihi min shayin kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim fahal ʿalā l-rusuli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu And say they who associated (other gods with God) "If God had willed, we had worshipped not aught besides Him, (neither) we nor our fathers (Fathers and fore-fathers.) ; nor had we (forbidden) aught without a (decree from) Him;" Even so did (say) those before them; Is then (aught) incumbent upon (Our) apostles save a clear delivery (plain preaching of the message)? This is a common plea of all evil doers to throw the responsibility of…

item.title: An-Nahl:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هَدَى اللَّهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلَالَةُ فَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ walaqad baʿathnā fī kulli ummatin rasūlan ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ij'tanibū l-ṭāghūta famin'hum man hadā l-lahu wamin'hum man ḥaqqat ʿalayhi l-ḍalālatu fasīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna Certainly We raised an apostle in every nation [to preach:] 'Worship Allah, and keep away from the Rebels.' Then among them were some whom Allah guided, and among them were some who deserved to be in error. So travel over the land and then observe how was the fate of the deniers.

item.title: An-Nahl:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
