item.description: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هَدَى اللَّهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلَالَةُ فَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ walaqad baʿathnā fī kulli ummatin rasūlan ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ij'tanibū l-ṭāghūta famin'hum man hadā l-lahu wamin'hum man ḥaqqat ʿalayhi l-ḍalālatu fasīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, (saying), "Worship Allah and avoid ṭāghūt."1 And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was (deservedly) decreed. So proceed (i.e., travel) through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers. See 16:35

item.title: An-Nahl:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هَدَى اللَّهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلَالَةُ فَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ walaqad baʿathnā fī kulli ummatin rasūlan ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ij'tanibū l-ṭāghūta famin'hum man hadā l-lahu wamin'hum man ḥaqqat ʿalayhi l-ḍalālatu fasīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna And indeed raised We in every nation an apostle (of Ours) (preaching) that "Worship ye God (only), and (Avoid.) shun ye (the worship of every kind of) idol," so of them were some whom God guided, and of them were others on whom error was confirmed; Therefore travel ye in the earth, then see what hath been the end of the beliers. See 16:35

item.title: An-Nahl:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَحْرِصْ عَلَى هُدَاهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ يُضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ in taḥriṣ ʿalā hudāhum fa-inna l-laha lā yahdī man yuḍillu wamā lahum min nāṣirīna If you are eager for them to be guided, indeed Allah does not guide those who mislead [others], and they will have no helpers.

item.title: An-Nahl:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَحْرِصْ عَلَى هُدَاهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ يُضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ in taḥriṣ ʿalā hudāhum fa-inna l-laha lā yahdī man yuḍillu wamā lahum min nāṣirīna (Even) if you should strive for their guidance, (O Muḥammad), indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray,1 and they will have no helpers. See 16:35

item.title: An-Nahl:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَحْرِصْ عَلَى هُدَاهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ يُضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ in taḥriṣ ʿalā hudāhum fa-inna l-laha lā yahdī man yuḍillu wamā lahum min nāṣirīna If covetest (Strives – Tries – Endeavours.) thou (The Prophet addressed for the people - O' man!) for their guidance, yet verily God guideth not those whom He leaveth to stray, and neither for them shall be any of the helpers. See 16:35

item.title: An-Nahl:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَا يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَمُوتُ بَلَى وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim lā yabʿathu l-lahu man yamūtu balā waʿdan ʿalayhi ḥaqqan walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna They swear by Allah with solemn oaths that Allah will not resurrect those who die. Yes indeed, it is a promise binding upon Him, but most people do not know.

item.title: An-Nahl:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَا يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَمُوتُ بَلَى وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim lā yabʿathu l-lahu man yamūtu balā waʿdan ʿalayhi ḥaqqan walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths (that) Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - (it is) a true promise (binding) upon Him, but most of the people do not know. And they swear by Allah with their strongest oaths, that Allah will not raise up one who dies. Yes, (He will raise them up), a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not (16:38). In order that He may make clear to them what they differed over, and so that those who disbelieved may know that they were liars (16:39). Verily, Our Word to a…

item.title: An-Nahl:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَا يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَمُوتُ بَلَى وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim lā yabʿathu l-lahu man yamūtu balā waʿdan ʿalayhi ḥaqqan walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna And swear they by God, with the strongest of their oaths that God will raise not one who dieth; Nay, but it is a promise binding on Him in truth, but most people know it not, A disbeliever owed a debt to a Muslim. While demanding the repayment of the loan the Muslim took an oath saying, 'I swear in the name of God who would raise one after death,' at which the disbeliever asked the Muslim: 'Art thou sure that thou wouldst be raised from death?' in a tone asserting that there is no return to life after death. The Muslim replied saying,…

item.title: An-Nahl:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِیْهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا كَاذِبِينَ liyubayyina lahumu alladhī yakhtalifūna fīhi waliyaʿlama alladhīna kafarū annahum kānū kādhibīna That He may clarify for them what they differ about, and that the faithless may know that they were liars.

item.title: An-Nahl:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِیْهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا كَاذِبِينَ liyubayyina lahumu alladhī yakhtalifūna fīhi waliyaʿlama alladhīna kafarū annahum kānū kādhibīna (It is) so He will make clear to them (the truth of) that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars. See 16:38

item.title: An-Nahl:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِیْهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا كَاذِبِينَ liyubayyina lahumu alladhī yakhtalifūna fīhi waliyaʿlama alladhīna kafarū annahum kānū kādhibīna (They will be raised up) so that He might manifest unto them that which they differed about, and (that) those who disbelieved might know that they were liars. See 16:38

item.title: An-Nahl:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَيْءٍ إِذَا أَرَدْنَاهُ أَنْ نَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ innamā qawlunā lishayin idhā aradnāhu an naqūla lahu kun fayakūnu All that We say to a thing, when We will it, is to say to it 'Be!' and it is.

item.title: An-Nahl:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَيْءٍ إِذَا أَرَدْنَاهُ أَنْ نَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ innamā qawlunā lishayin idhā aradnāhu an naqūla lahu kun fayakūnu Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is. See 16:38

item.title: An-Nahl:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَيْءٍ إِذَا أَرَدْنَاهُ أَنْ نَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ innamā qawlunā lishayin idhā aradnāhu an naqūla lahu kun fayakūnu Verily only Our word for a thing when We will it is that We say unto it, 'Be' and it exists. See 16:38

item.title: An-Nahl:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْۤا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَلَأَجْرُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-alladhīna hājarū fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā ẓulimū lanubawwi-annahum fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wala-ajru l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna Those who migrate for the sake of Allah after they have been wronged, We will surely settle them in a good place in the world, and the reward of the Hereafter is surely greater, had they known.

item.title: An-Nahl:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْۤا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَلَأَجْرُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-alladhīna hājarū fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā ẓulimū lanubawwi-annahum fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wala-ajru l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna And those who emigrated for (the cause of) Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know. And as for those who emigrated for the cause of Allah, after they had been wronged, We will certainly give them good residence in this world, but indeed the reward of the Hereafter will be greater; if they but knew (16:41). (They are) those who remained patient, and put their trust in their Lord (16:42). The Reward of the Muhajirin Allah tells us about…

item.title: An-Nahl:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْۤا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَلَأَجْرُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-alladhīna hājarū fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā ẓulimū lanubawwi-annahum fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wala-ajru l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna And those who migrate in (the cause of) God (A wider implication means the travel towards God.) after they are oppressed, certainly We will give them good (recompense) in this world; and certainly the reward in the hereafter is much greater, if they only know (this), Those who, for the sake of the faith suffered the worst persecution at the hands of the pagans of Mecca and at last fled their home in utter helplessness, first to Abyssinia and later to Madina.

item.title: An-Nahl:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna —Those who are patient and put their trust in their Lord.

item.title: An-Nahl:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna (They are) those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied. See 16:41

item.title: An-Nahl:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Those who endured patiently (Persecution.) and on their Lord (only) do they rely. See 16:41

item.title: An-Nahl:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْءَلُوْۤا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūna We did not send [any apostles] before you except as men to whom We revealed —ask the People of the Reminder if you do not know—

item.title: An-Nahl:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْءَلُوْۤا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūna And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed (Our message). So ask the people of the message (i.e., former scriptures) if you do not know. And We sent not (as Our Messengers) before you (O Muhammad) any but men, whom We sent revelation. So ask Ahl Adh-Dhikr, if you know not (16:43). With clear signs and Books (We sent the Messengers). And We have also revealed the Dhikr to you so that you may clearly explain to men what was revealed to them, and that perhaps they may reflect (16:44). Only Human Messengers have been Sent Ad-Dahhak said, reporting from Ibn 'Abbas: When Allah sent Muhammad…

item.title: An-Nahl:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْءَلُوْۤا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūna And We sent not before thee but men (as Our apostles), We revealed unto them; So ask ye the people of 'Dhikr' (The Ahl al-Bayt with whom the Holy Prophet left the Qur'an i.e. Dhikr, refer to verses 21:7, 16:44, 43:43 - 15:44.) (the Qur'an) if ye know not, The general interpretation of this is, if you do not know ask your own scholars and priests, who know the history of the ancient people, whether the Apostles of God who visited this earth in the past, were men only, and they were not angels, and they were only men and none of them was a woman. 'Dhikr' is one of…

item.title: An-Nahl:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wa-anzalnā ilayka l-dhik'ra litubayyina lilnnāsi mā nuzzila ilayhim walaʿallahum yatafakkarūna [and sent them] with manifest proofs and scriptures. We have sent down the reminder to you so that you may clarify for the people that which has been sent down to them, so that they may reflect.

item.title: An-Nahl:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wa-anzalnā ilayka l-dhik'ra litubayyina lilnnāsi mā nuzzila ilayhim walaʿallahum yatafakkarūna (We sent them) with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message (i.e., the Qur’ān) that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought. See 16:43

item.title: An-Nahl:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wa-anzalnā ilayka l-dhik'ra litubayyina lilnnāsi mā nuzzila ilayhim walaʿallahum yatafakkarūna With (Every apostle was sent with clear proofs. Signs to prove his bonafide to the people.) clear proofs (miracles) and scriptures; and We sent down unto thee the 'Dhikr' (Qur'an.) (The Reminder i.e., Qur'an) that thou mayest make clear unto mankind what hath been sent down unto them, that they may reflect (The development of intellect & thought in man is one of the objects of the revelation of the Holy Qur'an.) See 16:43

item.title: An-Nahl:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنَ الَّذِينَ مَكَرُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ afa-amina alladhīna makarū l-sayiāti an yakhsifa l-lahu bihimu l-arḍa aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Do those who make evil schemes feel secure that Allah will not make the earth swallow them, or the punishment will not overtake them whence they are not aware?

item.title: An-Nahl:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنَ الَّذِينَ مَكَرُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ afa-amina alladhīna makarū l-sayiāti an yakhsifa l-lahu bihimu l-arḍa aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive? Do then those who devise evil plots feel secure that Allah will not cause them to sink into the earth, or that torment will not seize them from where they do not perceive it (16:45). Or that He may punish them in the midst of their going to and fro (in their livelihood), so that there be no escape for them (from Allah's punishment) (16:46). Or that He may punish them where they…

item.title: An-Nahl:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنَ الَّذِينَ مَكَرُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ afa-amina alladhīna makarū l-sayiāti an yakhsifa l-lahu bihimu l-arḍa aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna What! then feel they secure, who plan evil devices, (against) God causing them swallowed up by the earth, or cometh unto them the wrath from whence they perceive not? See 16:43

item.title: An-Nahl:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ aw yakhudhahum fī taqallubihim famā hum bimuʿ'jizīna Or that He will not seize them in the midst of their bustle, whereupon they will not be able to thwart [Him]?

item.title: An-Nahl:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ aw yakhudhahum fī taqallubihim famā hum bimuʿ'jizīna Or that He would not seize them during their (usual) activity, and they could not cause failure (i.e., escape from Him)? See 16:45

item.title: An-Nahl:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ aw yakhudhahum fī taqallubihim famā hum bimuʿ'jizīna Or that He seizeth them during their movement, they shall not frustrate (Escape.) (God's decree), See 16:43

item.title: An-Nahl:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَى تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ aw yakhudhahum ʿalā takhawwufin fa-inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun Or that He will not visit them with attrition?1 Indeed your Lord is most kind and merciful.

item.title: An-Nahl:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَى تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ aw yakhudhahum ʿalā takhawwufin fa-inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun Or that He would not seize them gradually (in a state of dread)?1 But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.2 See 16:45

item.title: An-Nahl:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَى تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ aw yakhudhahum ʿalā takhawwufin fa-inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun Or He seizeth them by a gradual (In their fear) loss, for verily your Lord is Pitiful and All-Merciful. See 16:43

item.title: An-Nahl:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا ظِلَالُهُ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَالشَّمَائِلِ سُجَّدًا لِلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَاخِرُونَ awalam yaraw ilā mā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin yatafayya-u ẓilāluhu ʿani l-yamīni wal-shamāili sujjadan lillahi wahum dākhirūna Have they not regarded that whatever thing Allah has created casts its shadow to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah in utter humility?

item.title: An-Nahl:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا ظِلَالُهُ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَالشَّمَائِلِ سُجَّدًا لِلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَاخِرُونَ awalam yaraw ilā mā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin yatafayya-u ẓilāluhu ʿani l-yamīni wal-shamāili sujjadan lillahi wahum dākhirūna Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they (i.e., those creations) are humble. Have they not observed things that Allah has created: (how) their shadows shift from right to left, prostrating to Allah while they are humble (16:48). And to Allah prostrate all that are in the heavens and all that are in the earth, the moving creatures and the angels, and they are not proud [i.e. they worship their Lord (Allah) with humility (49)They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded (50) Everything Prostrates…

item.title: An-Nahl:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا ظِلَالُهُ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَالشَّمَائِلِ سُجَّدًا لِلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَاخِرُونَ awalam yaraw ilā mā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin yatafayya-u ẓilāluhu ʿani l-yamīni wal-shamāili sujjadan lillahi wahum dākhirūna Or see they not towards what God hath created that everything turneth its shadow to the right and to the left, prostrating in obeisance unto God, while they lie abased. Obeisance is of two kinds - the one with one's own will and the other by nature. The one done at one's own will is that which the believers offer, freely acknowledging the authority of the Lord and the other is that which everything in the universe is subjected to yield to the function of their native peculiarities like the cold and the flow in the water, the heat and the glow in the fire, the…

item.title: An-Nahl:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ walillahi yasjudu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi min dābbatin wal-malāikatu wahum lā yastakbirūna To Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, including animals and angels, and they are not arrogant.

item.title: An-Nahl:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ walillahi yasjudu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi min dābbatin wal-malāikatu wahum lā yastakbirūna And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels (as well), and they are not arrogant. See 16:48

item.title: An-Nahl:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ walillahi yasjudu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi min dābbatin wal-malāikatu wahum lā yastakbirūna And prostrateth in obeisance unto God (only) whatever (Nothing in the Universe dare exercise pride against the authority of the Lord.) is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, (and) of the (moving) creatures, and the angels (too), and they pride (Neither arrogant nor proud.) not. See 16:48

item.title: An-Nahl:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ yakhāfūna rabbahum min fawqihim wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna They fear their Lord above them, and do what they are commanded.

item.title: An-Nahl:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ yakhāfūna rabbahum min fawqihim wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded. See 16:48

item.title: An-Nahl:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ yakhāfūna rabbahum min fawqihim wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna They fear (Actually they are afraid or conscious or mindful of their own short coming in their obedience due to God.) their Lord (Supreme) above them and do what they are commanded. (Every thing in the Universe acts implicitly as destined by God, to do.) See 16:48

item.title: An-Nahl:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ اللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ waqāla l-lahu lā tattakhidhū ilāhayni ith'nayni innamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun fa-iyyāya fa-ir'habūni And Allah has said, 'Do not worship two gods. Indeed He is the One God, so be in awe of Me [alone].'

item.title: An-Nahl:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ اللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ waqāla l-lahu lā tattakhidhū ilāhayni ith'nayni innamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun fa-iyyāya fa-ir'habūni And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two1 deities. He (i.e., Allah) is but one God, so fear only Me." And Allah said Do not worship two gods. Indeed, He (Allah) is only One God. Then fear Me Alone (16:51). To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth and the religion. Will you then fear any other than Allah (16:52). And whatever of blessings and good things you have, it is from Allah. Then, when harm touches you, unto Him you cry aloud for help (16:53). Then, when He has removed the harm from you, behold! some of you associate others in worship with their Lord (Allah) (16:54). So they…

item.title: An-Nahl:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ اللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ waqāla l-lahu lā tattakhidhū ilāhayni ith'nayni innamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun fa-iyyāya fa-ir'habūni God hath said: "Take ye not two (Reference may be to the 'Dualism' the doctrine of 'Yazdan'. The goodness and 'Ahriman' the source of evil - the source of both is one - Man's hopes should be in God and he should fear only Him.) gods, Verily, Verily, He is only One God; So of Me (alone) should ye be afraid." See 16:48

item.title: An-Nahl:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّينُ وَاصِبًا أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ walahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walahu l-dīnu wāṣiban afaghayra l-lahi tattaqūna To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him belongs the enduring religion. Will you, then, be wary of other than Allah?

item.title: An-Nahl:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّينُ وَاصِبًا أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ walahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walahu l-dīnu wāṣiban afaghayra l-lahi tattaqūna And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is (due) worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear? See 16:51

item.title: An-Nahl:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّينُ وَاصِبًا أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ walahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walahu l-dīnu wāṣiban afaghayra l-lahi tattaqūna And His it is whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and unto Him (only) should obedience constantly (Without any break.) be; Do ye then fear (any one else) other than God? See 16:48

item.title: An-Nahl:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْءَرُونَ wamā bikum min niʿ'matin famina l-lahi thumma idhā massakumu l-ḍuru fa-ilayhi tajarūna Whatever blessing you have is from Allah, then when a distress befalls you, you make entreaties to Him.

item.title: An-Nahl:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْءَرُونَ wamā bikum min niʿ'matin famina l-lahi thumma idhā massakumu l-ḍuru fa-ilayhi tajarūna And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help. See 16:51

item.title: An-Nahl:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْءَرُونَ wamā bikum min niʿ'matin famina l-lahi thumma idhā massakumu l-ḍuru fa-ilayhi tajarūna Whatever of the bounty is with you, it is from God, then when any distress toucheth you, unto Him do ye cry for help. When afflicted by any misfortune then the nature in the individual urges him to helplessly turn to the Lord for help.

item.title: An-Nahl:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنْكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْكُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ thumma idhā kashafa l-ḍura ʿankum idhā farīqun minkum birabbihim yush'rikūna Then when He removes the distress from you, behold, a part of them ascribe partners to their Lord,

item.title: An-Nahl:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنْكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْكُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ thumma idhā kashafa l-ḍura ʿankum idhā farīqun minkum birabbihim yush'rikūna Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord. See 16:51

item.title: An-Nahl:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنْكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْكُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ thumma idhā kashafa l-ḍura ʿankum idhā farīqun minkum birabbihim yush'rikūna Yet when removeth He the distress from you, lo! some of you associate others with their Lord, When fortune favours man he forgets the Lord from Whom he received the grace and the blessings.

item.title: An-Nahl:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūna being unthankful for what We have given them. So let them enjoy. Soon they shall know!

item.title: An-Nahl:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūna So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know. See 16:51

item.title: An-Nahl:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūna That they may deny what We have given them; (Say O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "then enjoy your selves (for a time); for soon will ye know." See 16:54

item.title: An-Nahl:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ تَاللَّهِ لَتُسْءَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ wayajʿalūna limā lā yaʿlamūna naṣīban mimmā razaqnāhum tal-lahi latus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taftarūna To what they do not know, they attribute a share of what We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned concerning what you used to fabricate.

item.title: An-Nahl:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ تَاللَّهِ لَتُسْءَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ wayajʿalūna limā lā yaʿlamūna naṣīban mimmā razaqnāhum tal-lahi latus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taftarūna And they assign to what they do not know1 (i.e., false deities) a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent. And they assign a portion of that which We have provided them with, to what they have no knowledge of (false deities). By Allah, you shall certainly be questioned about (all) that you used to fabricate (16:56). And they assign daughters to Allah! Glorified (and Exalted) is He (above all that they associate with Him!). And for themselves (they assign) what they desire (16:57). And when the news of (the birth of) a female (child) is brought to any of them, his…

item.title: An-Nahl:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ تَاللَّهِ لَتُسْءَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ wayajʿalūna limā lā yaʿlamūna naṣīban mimmā razaqnāhum tal-lahi latus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taftarūna And they assign for what they know not, a portion of what We have provided them with; By God! Certainly ye shall be questioned about what ye have been forging. See 16:54

item.title: An-Nahl:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ الْبَنَاتِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَلَهُمْ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ wayajʿalūna lillahi l-banāti sub'ḥānahu walahum mā yashtahūna And they attribute daughters to Allah —immaculate is He— while they will have what they desire!

item.title: An-Nahl:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ الْبَنَاتِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَلَهُمْ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ wayajʿalūna lillahi l-banāti sub'ḥānahu walahum mā yashtahūna And they attribute to Allah daughters1 - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire (i.e., sons). See 16:56

item.title: An-Nahl:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ الْبَنَاتِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَلَهُمْ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ wayajʿalūna lillahi l-banāti sub'ḥānahu walahum mā yashtahūna And they ascribe daughters (People worshipped the angels as the daughters of God.) to God Glory be to Him; And for themselves (they ascribe sons) what they desire! (As they would like to have for themselves.) See 16:54

item.title: An-Nahl:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِالْأُنْثَى ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bil-unthā ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun When one of them is brought the news of a female [newborn], his face becomes darkened and he chokes with suppressed agony.

item.title: An-Nahl:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِالْأُنْثَى ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bil-unthā ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun And when one of them is informed of (the birth of) a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief. See 16:56

item.title: An-Nahl:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِالْأُنْثَى ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bil-unthā ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun And when is announced unto (any) one of them a daughter, black becometh his face and he is filled with wrath. (People hated to get a female issue and if they got it, they used to bury it alive.) See 16:54

item.title: An-Nahl:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَتَوَارٰی مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنْ سُوءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِ أَيُمْسِكُهُ عَلَى هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِي التُّرَابِ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ yatawārā mina l-qawmi min sūi mā bushira bihi ayum'sikuhu ʿalā hūnin am yadussuhu fī l-turābi alā sāa mā yaḥkumūna He hides from the people out of distress at the news he has been brought: shall he retain it in humiliation, or bury it in the ground!1 Look! Evil is the judgement that they make.

item.title: An-Nahl:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَتَوَارٰی مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنْ سُوءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِ أَيُمْسِكُهُ عَلَى هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِي التُّرَابِ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ yatawārā mina l-qawmi min sūi mā bushira bihi ayum'sikuhu ʿalā hūnin am yadussuhu fī l-turābi alā sāa mā yaḥkumūna He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide. See 16:56

item.title: An-Nahl:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَتَوَارٰی مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنْ سُوءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِ أَيُمْسِكُهُ عَلَى هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِي التُّرَابِ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ yatawārā mina l-qawmi min sūi mā bushira bihi ayum'sikuhu ʿalā hūnin am yadussuhu fī l-turābi alā sāa mā yaḥkumūna He hideth himself from the people, of the evil for the tidings given to him, (he pondereth whether) he shall keep her with disgrace or bury her (alive) in the dust? Behold, (how) evil it is what they decide. See 16:54

item.title: An-Nahl:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰی وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ lilladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati mathalu l-sawi walillahi l-mathalu l-aʿlā wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu For those who do not believe in the Hereafter there is an evil description, and the loftiest description belongs to Allah, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: An-Nahl:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰی وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ lilladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati mathalu l-sawi walillahi l-mathalu l-aʿlā wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description (i.e., an attribute) of evil;1 and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 16:56

item.title: An-Nahl:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰی وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ lilladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati mathalu l-sawi walillahi l-mathalu l-aʿlā wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu For those who believe not in the hereafter is an evil similitude, and God's is the highest similitude; for He is the Mighty, the All-Wise. This verse read with verses 53:27 - 53:31 refers to the common belief of the pagans about the angels that they were step-daughters of God or goddesses. It is true of those who cannot see any reality beyond the material realm. Therefore, to them should be in the similitude, of the material beings - thus they are either male or female and the same was applied to the angels - considering God as a male (father) termed the angels as female (i.e., goddesses). (A.P.).

item.title: An-Nahl:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِمْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa biẓul'mihim mā taraka ʿalayhā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna Were Allah to take mankind to task for their wrongdoing, He would not leave any living being upon it.1 But He respites them until a specified time; so when their time comes they shall not defer it by a single hour nor shall they advance it.

item.title: An-Nahl:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِمْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa biẓul'mihim mā taraka ʿalayhā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon it (i.e., the earth) any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede (it). And if Allah were to punish (all) mankind for their wrongdoing, He would not leave on it (the earth) a single moving creature, but He defers them to an appointed term; and when their term comes, they can neither delay nor advance it…

item.title: An-Nahl:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِمْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa biẓul'mihim mā taraka ʿalayhā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna If God had to take to task the people for their inequity, He would not leave on it (the earth) a single moving being but He respiteth them until an appointed term; so when cometh their doom, they shall delay it not (even) an hour, nor shall they bring it on before (its appointed time). See 16:60

item.title: An-Nahl:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنَى لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَأَنَّهُمْ مُفْرَطُونَ wayajʿalūna lillahi mā yakrahūna wataṣifu alsinatuhumu l-kadhiba anna lahumu l-ḥus'nā lā jarama anna lahumu l-nāra wa-annahum muf'raṭūna They attribute to Allah what they dislike [for themselves], and their tongues assert the lie that the best reward will be theirs. Undoubtedly, the Fire shall be their lot and they will be foremost [in entering it].1

item.title: An-Nahl:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنَى لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَأَنَّهُمْ مُفْرَطُونَ wayajʿalūna lillahi mā yakrahūna wataṣifu alsinatuhumu l-kadhiba anna lahumu l-ḥus'nā lā jarama anna lahumu l-nāra wa-annahum muf'raṭūna And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike (i.e., daughters), and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best (from Him). Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be (therein) neglected.1 See 16:61

item.title: An-Nahl:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنَى لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَأَنَّهُمْ مُفْرَطُونَ wayajʿalūna lillahi mā yakrahūna wataṣifu alsinatuhumu l-kadhiba anna lahumu l-ḥus'nā lā jarama anna lahumu l-nāra wa-annahum muf'raṭūna And they assign unto God what they (themselves) (Worshipping angels as the daughters of God.) hate (Daughters.) and attribute their tongues falsely that for them are (all) (Sons – or – good rewards.) good things; Inevitably there shall be for them the (Hell) fire and they shall be the foremost to it. (Hell fire.) See 16:60

item.title: An-Nahl:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ tal-lahi laqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu l-yawma walahum ʿadhābun alīmun By Allah, We have certainly sent [apostles] to nations before you. But Satan made their deeds seem decorous to them. So he is their master1 today and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: An-Nahl:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ tal-lahi laqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu l-yawma walahum ʿadhābun alīmun By Allah, We did certainly send (messengers) to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is their (i.e., the disbelievers) ally today (as well), and they will have a painful punishment. By Allah, We indeed sent (Messengers) to the nations before you, but Shaytan made their deeds seeming fair to them. So today he is their helper, and theirs will be a painful torment (16:63). And We have not revealed the Book to you, except that you may clearly explain to them those things in which they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe…

item.title: An-Nahl:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ tal-lahi laqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu l-yawma walahum ʿadhābun alīmun By God! indeed sent We (Our) Apostles unto people before thee, but Satan made unto them their deeds fair-seeming, so he is their guardian today, and for them shall be a grievous chastisement. See 16:60

item.title: An-Nahl:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِیْهِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ wamā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba illā litubayyina lahumu alladhī ikh'talafū fīhi wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna We did not send down the Book to you except [for the purpose] that you may clarify for them what they differ about, and as a guidance and mercy for a people who have faith.

item.title: An-Nahl:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِیْهِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ wamā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba illā litubayyina lahumu alladhī ikh'talafū fīhi wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna And We have not revealed to you the Book, (O Muḥammad), except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe. See 16:63

item.title: An-Nahl:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِیْهِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ wamā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba illā litubayyina lahumu alladhī ikh'talafū fīhi wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna And We sent not down unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muham mad!) the Book (the Qur'an) but that thou mayest explain unto them that which they differ (Such a polytheism, Dualism, Trinity, crucification of Jesus - his resurrection - heresy of Aaron and Solomon, about what is permissible & what is forbidden etc.) about, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for the people who believe. See 16:60

item.title: An-Nahl:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ wal-lahu anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yasmaʿūna Allah sends down water from the sky with which He revives the earth after its death. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who listen.

item.title: An-Nahl:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ wal-lahu anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yasmaʿūna And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen. See 16:63

item.title: An-Nahl:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ wal-lahu anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yasmaʿūna And God hath sent down from the heavens water, then enliveneth He with it the earth after its death; Verily, in this is a sign for people who listen. Some commentators interpret the mention of the life-giving water being raised from heaven and quickening the dead earth as the revelation of the Holy Qur'an and the world getting enlightened by the knowledge of the truth revealed through Islam.

item.title: An-Nahl:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَبَنًا خَالِصًا سَائِغًا لِلشَّارِبِينَ wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khāliṣan sāighan lilshāribīna There is indeed a moral for you in the cattle: We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies from between [intestinal] waste and blood, as pure milk, pleasant to those who drink.

item.title: An-Nahl:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَبَنًا خَالِصًا سَائِغًا لِلشَّارِبِينَ wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khāliṣan sāighan lilshāribīna And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers. And there is indeed a lesson for you in the An'am (cattle). We have made a drink for you out of what is in its belly, from between excretions and blood, pure milk; palatable to the drinkers (16:66). And from the fruits of date palms and grapes, you derive strong drink and a goodly provision. There is indeed a sign in this for those of reason (16:67). Lessons and Blessings in Cattle and the Fruit…

item.title: An-Nahl:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَبَنًا خَالِصًا سَائِغًا لِلشَّارِبِينَ wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khāliṣan sāighan lilshāribīna And verily for you there in the cattle is a lesson; We give you to drink what is in their bellies, from betwixt the (Sediment - excrement of the beasts.) faeces and the blood, milk pure, easy and palatable for those who drink (it). It is a Divine Law working in nature that milk is sorted out of the food after the creation of blood and before the actual excretion of the bowels. The 'Betwixt' refers to the middle of the functioning of the process and does not refer to the quality concerned. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Nahl:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wamin thamarāti l-nakhīli wal-aʿnābi tattakhidhūna min'hu sakaran wariz'qan ḥasanan inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿqilūna And of the fruits of date palms and vines, from which you draw wine and goodly provision. There are indeed signs in that for a people who apply reason.

item.title: An-Nahl:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wamin thamarāti l-nakhīli wal-aʿnābi tattakhidhūna min'hu sakaran wariz'qan ḥasanan inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿqilūna And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision.1 Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason. See 16:66

item.title: An-Nahl:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wamin thamarāti l-nakhīli wal-aʿnābi tattakhidhūna min'hu sakaran wariz'qan ḥasanan inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿqilūna And of the fruits of the date-palms, and the grapes - obtain ye from them (drinks of) intoxication and goodly sustenance; Verily in this is a sign for people who understand. Some commentators thought that this passage was revealed before the prohibition of intoxicating liquor but the passage has nothing to do with the permissibility or the prohibition of liquor. It states the various usages of the product of the fruits. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Nahl:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَى رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ wa-awḥā rabbuka ilā l-naḥli ani ittakhidhī mina l-jibāli buyūtan wamina l-shajari wamimmā yaʿrishūna And your Lord inspired the bee [saying]: 'Make your home in the mountains, and on the trees and the trellises that they erect.

item.title: An-Nahl:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَى رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ wa-awḥā rabbuka ilā l-naḥli ani ittakhidhī mina l-jibāli buyūtan wamina l-shajari wamimmā yaʿrishūna And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses (i.e., hives), and among the trees and (in) that which they construct. And your Lord inspired the bee, saying: Take you habitations in the mountains and in the trees and in what they (humans) erect (16:68). "Then, eat of all fruits, and follow the routes that your Lord made easy (for you)." There comes forth from their bellies, a drink of varying colors, in which there is a cure for men. There is indeed a sign in that for people who reflect (16:69). In the Bee and its Honey There is Blessing and a Lesson What is meant by inspiration…

item.title: An-Nahl:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَى رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ wa-awḥā rabbuka ilā l-naḥli ani ittakhidhī mina l-jibāli buyūtan wamina l-shajari wamimmā yaʿrishūna And (Inspired through instincts.) revealed thy Lord unto the bee saying: "Make thou hives in the mountains and in the trees and in what they (men) (Buildings.) build," 'Wahi' mentioned here is not through the same source as it was effected for the revelation of the Holy Qur'an or conveying any matter from God to the Holy Prophet or any other apostles Here the 'Wahi' stands for the instinct endowed in the Bee. Instincts and inspirations are also a kind of 'Wahi' or a Divine Guidance. Even the inanimate objects are inspired with the Will of the Lord.1 The disciples of Jesus were inspired to believe in Jesus.2 The mother of Moses was also…

item.title: An-Nahl:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِیْهِ شِفَاءٌ لِلنَّاسِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ thumma kulī min kulli l-thamarāti fa-us'lukī subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mukh'talifun alwānuhu fīhi shifāon lilnnāsi inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna Then eat from every [kind of] fruit and follow meekly the ways of your Lord.' There issues from its belly a juice of diverse hues in which there is a cure for the people. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: An-Nahl:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِیْهِ شِفَاءٌ لِلنَّاسِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ thumma kulī min kulli l-thamarāti fa-us'lukī subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mukh'talifun alwānuhu fīhi shifāon lilnnāsi inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna Then eat from all the fruits1 and follow the ways of your Lord laid down (for you)." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought. See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِیْهِ شِفَاءٌ لِلنَّاسِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ thumma kulī min kulli l-thamarāti fa-us'lukī subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mukh'talifun alwānuhu fīhi shifāon lilnnāsi inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna Then eat thou of all the fruits and walk thou in the ways of thy Lord submissively." There cometh out from within it a drink of divers colours, in it is healing for men; Verily in this is a sign for the people who reflect. See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِيرٌ wal-lahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffākum waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likay lā yaʿlama baʿda ʿil'min shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun qadīrun Allah has created you, then He takes you away, and there are some among you who are relegated to the nethermost age so that he knows nothing after [having possessed] some knowledge. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-powerful.

item.title: An-Nahl:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِيرٌ wal-lahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffākum waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likay lā yaʿlama baʿda ʿil'min shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun qadīrun And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit (old) age so that he will not know, after (having had) knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent. And Allah created you and then He will cause you to die; and among you there are some who are sent back to senility, so that they know nothing after having known (much). Truly, Allah is Knowing, capable of all things (16:70). In Man There is a Lesson Allah tells us that He is controlling the affairs…

item.title: An-Nahl:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِيرٌ wal-lahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffākum waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likay lā yaʿlama baʿda ʿil'min shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun qadīrun And God hath created you, then He taketh you away, and of you is he who is reverted to the lowest state of the age, so that he knoweth not aught after (once) having knowledge: Verily God is All-Knowing, All-Powerful. See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الرِّزْقِ فَمَا الَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوْۤا بِرَادِّي رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَى مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِیْهِ سَوَاءٌ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ wal-lahu faḍḍala baʿḍakum ʿalā baʿḍin fī l-riz'qi famā alladhīna fuḍḍilū birāddī riz'qihim ʿalā mā malakat aymānuhum fahum fīhi sawāon afabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yajḥadūna Allah has granted some of you an advantage over others in [respect of] provision. Those who have been granted an advantage do not give over their provision to their slaves so that they become equal in its respect. What, will they dispute the blessing of Allah?

item.title: An-Nahl:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الرِّزْقِ فَمَا الَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوْۤا بِرَادِّي رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَى مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِیْهِ سَوَاءٌ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ wal-lahu faḍḍala baʿḍakum ʿalā baʿḍin fī l-riz'qi famā alladhīna fuḍḍilū birāddī riz'qihim ʿalā mā malakat aymānuhum fahum fīhi sawāon afabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yajḥadūna And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored (i.e., given more) would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess (i.e., slaves) so they would be equal to them therein.1 Then is it the favor of Allah they reject? And Allah honored some of you over others with wealth and properties. Then, those who are so honored will by no means hand over their wealth and properties to those (captives of war) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with…

item.title: An-Nahl:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الرِّزْقِ فَمَا الَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوْۤا بِرَادِّي رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَى مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِیْهِ سَوَاءٌ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ wal-lahu faḍḍala baʿḍakum ʿalā baʿḍin fī l-riz'qi famā alladhīna fuḍḍilū birāddī riz'qihim ʿalā mā malakat aymānuhum fahum fīhi sawāon afabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yajḥadūna And God hath favoured some of you above the others in the provision of sustenance, now those who have been more favoured give not their sustenance to those whom their right hands possess, (the slaves) so that they may be equal therein; What! Is it then the bounty of God they deny? See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wajaʿala lakum min azwājikum banīna waḥafadatan warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi hum yakfurūna Allah made for you mates from your own selves and appointed for you, from your mates, children and grandchildren, and We provided you with all the good things. What, will they believe in falsehood while they deny the blessing of Allah?

item.title: An-Nahl:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wajaʿala lakum min azwājikum banīna waḥafadatan warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi hum yakfurūna And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve? And Allah has made for you mates of your own kind, and has made for you, from your mates, sons and grandsons, and has granted you good provisions. Do they then believe in false deities and deny favor of Allah (16:72). Among His Blessings and Signs are Mates, Children and Grandchildren Allah mentions the blessing…

item.title: An-Nahl:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wajaʿala lakum min azwājikum banīna waḥafadatan warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi hum yakfurūna And God hath given you wives of your own selves, and hath given you from your wives sons and grandchildren, (To continue posterity.) and sustained you of good things; What! Is it then in the falsehood they believe, and (While.) (a) in the bounty of God (that) they disbelieve? See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yamliku lahum riz'qan mina l-samāwāti wal-arḍi shayan walā yastaṭīʿūna They worship besides Allah what has no power to provide them with anything from the heavens and the earth, nor are they capable [of doing that].

item.title: An-Nahl:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yamliku lahum riz'qan mina l-samāwāti wal-arḍi shayan walā yastaṭīʿūna And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them (the power of) provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and (in fact), they are unable. And they worship others besides Allah such as do not have power to grant them any provision from the heavens or the earth nor the ability to do so (16:73). So do not give examples on behalf of Allah. Truly, Allah knows and you know not (16:74). Denouncing the Worship of Anything Besides Allah Allah tells us about the Mushrikin who worship others besides Him, even though He alone is the bountiful Provider, the Creator and Sustainer, without partners or…

item.title: An-Nahl:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yamliku lahum riz'qan mina l-samāwāti wal-arḍi shayan walā yastaṭīʿūna And they worship other than God that which owneth not for them any sustenance (aught) from the heavens and the earth, nor have they (whom they worship) any power? See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الْأَمْثَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ falā taḍribū lillahi l-amthāla inna l-laha yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna So do not draw comparisons for Allah: indeed Allah knows and you do not know.

item.title: An-Nahl:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الْأَمْثَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ falā taḍribū lillahi l-amthāla inna l-laha yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna So do not assert similarities to Allah.1 Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know. See 16:73

item.title: An-Nahl:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الْأَمْثَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ falā taḍribū lillahi l-amthāla inna l-laha yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna So coin ye not any similitudes to God; Verily God knoweth (everything) and ye know not. See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَمْلُوكًا لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ وَمَنْ رَزَقْنَاهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا هَلْ يَسْتَوُونَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan ʿabdan mamlūkan lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin waman razaqnāhu minnā riz'qan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu min'hu sirran wajahran hal yastawūna l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Allah draws a parable: a chattel who has no power over anything, and one whom We have provided a goodly provision and who spends out of it secretly and openly. Are they equal? All praise belongs to Allah. But most of them do not know.

item.title: An-Nahl:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَمْلُوكًا لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ وَمَنْ رَزَقْنَاهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا هَلْ يَسْتَوُونَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan ʿabdan mamlūkan lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin waman razaqnāhu minnā riz'qan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu min'hu sirran wajahran hal yastawūna l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Allah presents an example: a slave (who is) owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know. Allah gives the example of a servant under the possession of another, he has no power of any sort, and a man on whom We have bestowed good provisions from Us, and he spends from that secretly and…

item.title: An-Nahl:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَمْلُوكًا لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ وَمَنْ رَزَقْنَاهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا هَلْ يَسْتَوُونَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan ʿabdan mamlūkan lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin waman razaqnāhu minnā riz'qan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu min'hu sirran wajahran hal yastawūna l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Setteth forth God the similitude (of two men: one) a slave, a property of another, who hath no power over aught, and (the one) whom We sustained from unto Ourselves a goodly sustenance, and he spendeth from it secretly and openly; Are the two equal? All praise is God's! But most of them know it not. See 16:68

item.title: An-Nahl:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَى مَوْلَاهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّهْهُ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي هُوَ وَمَنْ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَهُوَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulayni aḥaduhumā abkamu lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin wahuwa kallun ʿalā mawlāhu aynamā yuwajjihhu lā yati bikhayrin hal yastawī huwa waman yamuru bil-ʿadli wahuwa ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Allah draws [another] parable: Two men, one of whom is dumb, having no power over anything and who is a liability to his master: wherever he directs him he does not bring any good. Is he equal to someone who enjoins justice and is [steady] on a straight path?

item.title: An-Nahl:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَى مَوْلَاهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّهْهُ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي هُوَ وَمَنْ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَهُوَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulayni aḥaduhumā abkamu lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin wahuwa kallun ʿalā mawlāhu aynamā yuwajjihhu lā yati bikhayrin hal yastawī huwa waman yamuru bil-ʿadli wahuwa ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path? And Allah gives an example of two men, one of them dumb, who has no power over anything, and he is a burden on his master; whichever way he directs him, he brings…

item.title: An-Nahl:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَى مَوْلَاهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّهْهُ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي هُوَ وَمَنْ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَهُوَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulayni aḥaduhumā abkamu lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin wahuwa kallun ʿalā mawlāhu aynamā yuwajjihhu lā yati bikhayrin hal yastawī huwa waman yamuru bil-ʿadli wahuwa ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Setteth forth God the similitude of two men; one of them is dumb, unable to do anything, he is a burden to his master; wherever he (the master) sendeth him, he bringeth no good; can he be equal to him who enjoineth justice and he (himself) is on the straight (Right.) path? Compare the purity of character, conduct and the inimitable personal excellence of the First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib and his identity with the Holy Prophet, and what yeoman…

item.title: An-Nahl:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā amru l-sāʿati illā kalamḥi l-baṣari aw huwa aqrabu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun To Allah belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. The matter of the Hour1 is just like the twinkling of an eye, or [even] swifter. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: An-Nahl:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā amru l-sāʿati illā kalamḥi l-baṣari aw huwa aqrabu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And to Allah belongs the unseen (aspects) of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent. And to Allah belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And the matter of the Hour is not but as a twinkling of the eye, or even nearer. Truly, Allah is able to do all things (16:77). And Allah has brought you out from the wombs of your mothers while you knew nothing. And He gave you hearing, sight, and hearts, that…

item.title: An-Nahl:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā amru l-sāʿati illā kalamḥi l-baṣari aw huwa aqrabu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And God's is the unseen (worlds) of the heavens and the earth; and the matter of the Hour (of Judgment) is but like a twinkling (Refer to verse 54:50.) of the eye, or nigher still; Verily God over all things hath power. See 16:76

item.title: An-Nahl:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wal-lahu akhrajakum min buṭūni ummahātikum lā taʿlamūna shayan wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata laʿallakum tashkurūna Allah has brought you forth from the bellies of your mothers while you did not know anything. He made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts so that you may give thanks.

item.title: An-Nahl:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wal-lahu akhrajakum min buṭūni ummahātikum lā taʿlamūna shayan wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata laʿallakum tashkurūna And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts (i.e., intellect) that perhaps you would be grateful. See 16:77

item.title: An-Nahl:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wal-lahu akhrajakum min buṭūni ummahātikum lā taʿlamūna shayan wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata laʿallakum tashkurūna And God hath brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers - ye knew not anything, and He gave you hearing and the sight and the hearts, that ye may give thanks. See 16:76

item.title: An-Nahl:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ alam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri musakharātin fī jawwi l-samāi mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-lahu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Have they not regarded the birds disposed in the air of the sky: no one sustains them except Allah. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: An-Nahl:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ alam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri musakharātin fī jawwi l-samāi mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-lahu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe. See 16:77

item.title: An-Nahl:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ alam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri musakharātin fī jawwi l-samāi mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-lahu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna What! See they not towards the birds held poised in the air in the sky? Nothing holdeth them but God; (By giving them the balancing faculty.) Verily in this are signs for a people who believe See 16:76

item.title: An-Nahl:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ جُلُودِ الْأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَا أَثَاثًا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَى حِينٍ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min buyūtikum sakanan wajaʿala lakum min julūdi l-anʿāmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yawma ẓaʿnikum wayawma iqāmatikum wamin aṣwāfihā wa-awbārihā wa-ashʿārihā athāthan wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin It is Allah who has made for you your homes as a place of rest and He made for you homes out of the skins of the cattle which you find portable on the day of your shifting and on the day of your halt, and out of their wool, their fur and hair furniture and wares [enduring] for a while.

item.title: An-Nahl:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ جُلُودِ الْأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَا أَثَاثًا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَى حِينٍ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min buyūtikum sakanan wajaʿala lakum min julūdi l-anʿāmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yawma ẓaʿnikum wayawma iqāmatikum wamin aṣwāfihā wa-awbārihā wa-ashʿārihā athāthan wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment (i.e., provision) for a time. And Allah had made your homes a place of rest for you, and made dwellings for you out of the hides of the cattle which you find so light when you travel and when you camp;…

item.title: An-Nahl:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ جُلُودِ الْأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَا أَثَاثًا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَى حِينٍ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min buyūtikum sakanan wajaʿala lakum min julūdi l-anʿāmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yawma ẓaʿnikum wayawma iqāmatikum wamin aṣwāfihā wa-awbārihā wa-ashʿārihā athāthan wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin And God hath made for you of your houses, a place of rest (and the quiet) and hath made for you of the skins of the cattle houses (Tents.) which ye find so light to carry on the day of your march and on the day of your camping, and of their wool and their fur and their hair (he hath provided for you) (useful) goods of convenience and a provision for a time. See 16:76

item.title: An-Nahl:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَالًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ أَكْنَانًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمْ بَأْسَكُمْ كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum mimmā khalaqa ẓilālan wajaʿala lakum mina l-jibāli aknānan wajaʿala lakum sarābīla taqīkumu l-ḥara wasarābīla taqīkum basakum kadhālika yutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tus'limūna It is Allah who has made for you shade from what He created, and made for you retreats in the mountains, and made for you garments that protect you from heat and garments that protect you from your [mutual] violence. That is how He completes His blessing upon you so that you may submit [to Him].

item.title: An-Nahl:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَالًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ أَكْنَانًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمْ بَأْسَكُمْ كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum mimmā khalaqa ẓilālan wajaʿala lakum mina l-jibāli aknānan wajaʿala lakum sarābīla taqīkumu l-ḥara wasarābīla taqīkum basakum kadhālika yutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tus'limūna And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows (i.e., shade) and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments (i.e., coats of mail) which protect you from your (enemy in) battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit (to Him). See 16:80

item.title: An-Nahl:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
