item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَالًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ أَكْنَانًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمْ بَأْسَكُمْ كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ wal-lahu jaʿala lakum mimmā khalaqa ẓilālan wajaʿala lakum mina l-jibāli aknānan wajaʿala lakum sarābīla taqīkumu l-ḥara wasarābīla taqīkum basakum kadhālika yutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tus'limūna And God hath made for you, of what He hath created shelters, and hath made for you (some) of the mountains (as) places of refuge, and He hath made for you garments to guard you against the heat (and cold), and the garments (Armour.) to protect you in your fighting; Thus completed! He, His bounties on you so that ye may submit (unto Him thankfully). See 16:76

item.title: An-Nahl:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ fa-in tawallaw fa-innamā ʿalayka l-balāghu l-mubīnu But if they turn their backs [on you], your duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: An-Nahl:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ fa-in tawallaw fa-innamā ʿalayka l-balāghu l-mubīnu But if they turn away, (O Muḥammad) - then only upon you is (responsibility for) clear notification. See 16:80

item.title: An-Nahl:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ fa-in tawallaw fa-innamā ʿalayka l-balāghu l-mubīnu But if turn they away, then on thee is incumbent only the clear delivery (of Our message). See 16:76

item.title: An-Nahl:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنْكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ yaʿrifūna niʿ'mata l-lahi thumma yunkirūnahā wa-aktharuhumu l-kāfirūna They recognize the blessing of Allah and then deny it, and most of them are faithless.

item.title: An-Nahl:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنْكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ yaʿrifūna niʿ'mata l-lahi thumma yunkirūnahā wa-aktharuhumu l-kāfirūna They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers. See 16:80

item.title: An-Nahl:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنْكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ yaʿrifūna niʿ'mata l-lahi thumma yunkirūnahā wa-aktharuhumu l-kāfirūna They recognise the bounties of God, and yet they deny them, and most of them are infidels (Ungrateful ones – Deniers.) By 'Na'mah', i.e., the bounty or the favour, is meant the Holy Prophet. The Sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq said: 'the grace or the bounties of God were perfected with the appointment of Ali Ibn Abi Talib as the Maula or the Master in the place of the Holy Prophet on the day of Ghadir Khumm.'1 The huge gathering of the thousands of the people like the pilgrims witnessed it and Omar Ibn Khattab was the first to felicitate by his homage or 'Bay'ah' to Ali on his appointment as the 'Maula' or the Master of every believer-man and believer-woman and yet the…

item.title: An-Nahl:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ wayawma nabʿathu min kulli ummatin shahīdan thumma lā yu'dhanu lilladhīna kafarū walā hum yus'taʿtabūna The day We shall raise a witness from every nation, then the faithless will not be permitted [to speak],1 nor will they be asked to propitiate [Allah].

item.title: An-Nahl:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ wayawma nabʿathu min kulli ummatin shahīdan thumma lā yu'dhanu lilladhīna kafarū walā hum yus'taʿtabūna And (mention) the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness (i.e., their prophet). Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers (to apologize or make excuses), nor will they be asked to appease (Allah). And on the Day when We resurrect a witness from each nation, then those who disbelieve will not be given leave, nor will they be allowed (to return to the world) to repent and ask for Allah's forgiveness.) 85. And once those who did wrong see the torment, it will not decrease for them, nor will they be given respite (16:84). And when those who associated partners with Allah see their partners, they will…

item.title: An-Nahl:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ wayawma nabʿathu min kulli ummatin shahīdan thumma lā yu'dhanu lilladhīna kafarū walā hum yus'taʿtabūna And on the day We will raise up from among every people a witness, then shall be no permission for those who disbelieve (to make any excuses) nor shall they be allowed (Since after that no further amendment could be expected in the life hereafter.) to solicit any amends. See 16:83

item.title: An-Nahl:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ wa-idhā raā alladhīna ẓalamū l-ʿadhāba falā yukhaffafu ʿanhum walā hum yunẓarūna And when the wrongdoers sight the punishment, it shall not be lightened for them, nor will they be granted any respite.

item.title: An-Nahl:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ wa-idhā raā alladhīna ẓalamū l-ʿadhāba falā yukhaffafu ʿanhum walā hum yunẓarūna And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved. See 16:84

item.title: An-Nahl:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ wa-idhā raā alladhīna ẓalamū l-ʿadhāba falā yukhaffafu ʿanhum walā hum yunẓarūna And when those who act unjustly shall see the torment, it shall not be lightened for them, nor shall they be respited. See 16:83

item.title: An-Nahl:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا شُرَكَاءَهُمْ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا هَؤُلَاءِ شُرَكَاؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِكَ فَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ wa-idhā raā alladhīna ashrakū shurakāahum qālū rabbanā hāulāi shurakāunā alladhīna kunnā nadʿū min dūnika fa-alqaw ilayhimu l-qawla innakum lakādhibūna When the polytheists sight their partners, they will say, 'Our Lord! These are our partners whom we used to invoke besides You.' But they will retort to them, 'You are indeed liars!'

item.title: An-Nahl:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا شُرَكَاءَهُمْ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا هَؤُلَاءِ شُرَكَاؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِكَ فَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ wa-idhā raā alladhīna ashrakū shurakāahum qālū rabbanā hāulāi shurakāunā alladhīna kunnā nadʿū min dūnika fa-alqaw ilayhimu l-qawla innakum lakādhibūna And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say, "Our Lord, these are our partners (to You) whom we used to invoke (in worship) besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars." See 16:84

item.title: An-Nahl:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا شُرَكَاءَهُمْ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا هَؤُلَاءِ شُرَكَاؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِكَ فَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ wa-idhā raā alladhīna ashrakū shurakāahum qālū rabbanā hāulāi shurakāunā alladhīna kunnā nadʿū min dūnika fa-alqaw ilayhimu l-qawla innakum lakādhibūna And when those who associate (others with God) will see their associates, (The false gods i.e., the deities associated with God.) they shall say: "O' Our Lord! These are our associates whom we called besides Thee!" But they will throw (back) unto them (their) word, (and say) "Verily ye are liars!" See 16:83

item.title: An-Nahl:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ wa-alqaw ilā l-lahi yawma-idhin l-salama waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna They will submit to Allah on that day, and what they used to fabricate will forsake them.

item.title: An-Nahl:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ wa-alqaw ilā l-lahi yawma-idhin l-salama waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna And they will impart to Allah that Day (their) submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent. See 16:84

item.title: An-Nahl:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ wa-alqaw ilā l-lahi yawma-idhin l-salama waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna And they shall tender submission unto God on that day; And shall depart from them (leaving them in lurch) what they were forging. See 16:83

item.title: An-Nahl:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ زِدْنَاهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يُفْسِدُونَ alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi zid'nāhum ʿadhāban fawqa l-ʿadhābi bimā kānū yuf'sidūna Those who are faithless and bar from the way of Allah —We shall add punishment to their punishment because of the corruption they used to cause.

item.title: An-Nahl:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ زِدْنَاهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يُفْسِدُونَ alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi zid'nāhum ʿadhāban fawqa l-ʿadhābi bimā kānū yuf'sidūna Those who disbelieved and averted (others) from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over (their) punishment for what corruption they were causing. See 16:84

item.title: An-Nahl:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ زِدْنَاهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يُفْسِدُونَ alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi zid'nāhum ʿadhāban fawqa l-ʿadhābi bimā kānū yuf'sidūna (For) those who disbelieved and hinder people from the way of God: And We unto them will increase torment over torment for they were making mischief. See 16:83

item.title: An-Nahl:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ تِبْيَانًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ wayawma nabʿathu fī kulli ummatin shahīdan ʿalayhim min anfusihim waji'nā bika shahīdan ʿalā hāulāi wanazzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba tib'yānan likulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīna The day We raise in every nation a witness against them from among themselves, We shall bring you as a witness against these. We have sent down the Book to you as a clarification of all things and as a guidance and mercy and good news for the muslims.

item.title: An-Nahl:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ تِبْيَانًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ wayawma nabʿathu fī kulli ummatin shahīdan ʿalayhim min anfusihim waji'nā bika shahīdan ʿalā hāulāi wanazzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba tib'yānan likulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīna And (mention) the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves (i.e., their prophet). And We will bring you, (O Muḥammad), as a witness over these (i.e., your nation). And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.1 And on the Day when We resurrect a witness from each nation from among themselves, and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these. And We have revealed the Book…

item.title: An-Nahl:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ تِبْيَانًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ wayawma nabʿathu fī kulli ummatin shahīdan ʿalayhim min anfusihim waji'nā bika shahīdan ʿalā hāulāi wanazzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba tib'yānan likulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīna And on the day when We will raise up in every people from among themselves, a witness (upon them) and bring thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) as a witness upon (all) these; and We have sent down upon thee the Book (The Qur'an) explaining everything, and a guidance, and mercy, and glad tidings unto those who submit themselves (To God). As in verse 16:84. This verse makes obvious the unique spiritual existence of the Holy Prophet from the very beginning of the world to its end. Evidence could be acceptably taken only…

item.title: An-Nahl:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَائِ ذِي الْقُرْبٰی وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ inna l-laha yamuru bil-ʿadli wal-iḥ'sāni waītāi dhī l-qur'bā wayanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari wal-baghyi yaʿiẓukum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna Indeed Allah enjoins justice and kindness and generosity towards relatives, and He forbids indecency, wrong, and aggression. He advises you, so that you may take admonition.

item.title: An-Nahl:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَائِ ذِي الْقُرْبٰی وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ inna l-laha yamuru bil-ʿadli wal-iḥ'sāni waītāi dhī l-qur'bā wayanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari wal-baghyi yaʿiẓukum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving (help) to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded. Verily, Allah orders justice and kindness, and giving (help) to the relatives, and He forbids immoral sins, and evil and tyranny. He admonishes you, so that perhaps you may take heed (16:90). The Command to be Fair and Kind Allah tells us that He commands His servant to be just, i.e., fair and moderate, and that He encourages kindness and good treatment. As He says: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّابِرِينَ And…

item.title: An-Nahl:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَائِ ذِي الْقُرْبٰی وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ inna l-laha yamuru bil-ʿadli wal-iḥ'sāni waītāi dhī l-qur'bā wayanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari wal-baghyi yaʿiẓukum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna Verily, God enjoineth justice and benevolence (to others) and giving (Benevolently.) unto the kindred, and forbiddeth lewdness, and evil, and rebellion; He exhorteth you that ye may take heed. The Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn Ali al-Baqir said that 'Giving to the relatives' stands for the relatives of the Holy Prophet, i.e., Ahl al-Bayt, as in the case of verses 8:41; 17:26; 30:38; 59:7. It is left for every student of the Holy Qur'an to consider that God's command is to deliver to the relatives their due. How could the Holy Prophet himself go against such an explicit ordinance of the Lord and deny his only issue Fatema…

item.title: An-Nahl:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْفُوْۤا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدْتُمْ وَلَا تَنْقُضُوْۤا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ wa-awfū biʿahdi l-lahi idhā ʿāhadttum walā tanquḍū l-aymāna baʿda tawkīdihā waqad jaʿaltumu l-laha ʿalaykum kafīlan inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna Fulfill Allah's covenant when you pledge, and do not break [your] oaths after pledging them solemnly and having made Allah a witness over yourselves. Indeed Allah knows what you do.

item.title: An-Nahl:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْفُوْۤا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدْتُمْ وَلَا تَنْقُضُوْۤا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ wa-awfū biʿahdi l-lahi idhā ʿāhadttum walā tanquḍū l-aymāna baʿda tawkīdihā waqad jaʿaltumu l-laha ʿalaykum kafīlan inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, (O believers), and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a security (i.e., witness). Indeed, Allah knows what you do. And fulfill the covenants (taken in the Name of) Allah when you have taken them, and do not break the oaths after you have confirmed them - and indeed you have appointed Allah as your guarantor. Verily, Allah knows what you do (16:91). And do not be like the one who undoes the thread which she has spun, after it has become…

item.title: An-Nahl:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْفُوْۤا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدْتُمْ وَلَا تَنْقُضُوْۤا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ wa-awfū biʿahdi l-lahi idhā ʿāhadttum walā tanquḍū l-aymāna baʿda tawkīdihā waqad jaʿaltumu l-laha ʿalaykum kafīlan inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna And fulfil ye the covenant of God when ye have covenanted, and break ye not the oaths after ratification (Solemnizing them.) thereof while indeed ye have appointed God over you a surety (for it); Verily God knoweth (everything) what ye do. Was not the 'Bay'ah' taken by the Holy Prophet from the Muslim for Ali Ibn Abi Talib at Ghadir Khumm on 18-12-10 A.H. with a covenant and should it not be honoured and do not those who break that covenant violate this ordinance. The Verse emphatically enjoins the fulfilment of any promise, undertaking, pact or covenant provided it is…

item.title: An-Nahl:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنْكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَنْ تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبٰی مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ walā takūnū ka-allatī naqaḍat ghazlahā min baʿdi quwwatin ankāthan tattakhidhūna aymānakum dakhalan baynakum an takūna ummatun hiya arbā min ummatin innamā yablūkumu l-lahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma l-qiyāmati mā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna Do not be like her who would undo her yarn, breaking it up after [spinning it to] strength, by making your oaths a means of [mutual] deceit among yourselves, so that one community may become more affluent than another community.1 Allah only tests you thereby, and He will surely clarify for you on the Day of Resurrection what you used to differ about.

item.title: An-Nahl:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنْكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَنْ تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبٰی مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ walā takūnū ka-allatī naqaḍat ghazlahā min baʿdi quwwatin ankāthan tattakhidhūna aymānakum dakhalan baynakum an takūna ummatun hiya arbā min ummatin innamā yablūkumu l-lahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma l-qiyāmati mā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong (by) taking your oaths as (means of) deceit between you because one community is more plentiful (in number or wealth) than another community.1 Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ. See 16:91

item.title: An-Nahl:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنْكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَنْ تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبٰی مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ walā takūnū ka-allatī naqaḍat ghazlahā min baʿdi quwwatin ankāthan tattakhidhūna aymānakum dakhalan baynakum an takūna ummatun hiya arbā min ummatin innamā yablūkumu l-lahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma l-qiyāmati mā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna And be not like unto her who unraveleth her yarn, dis joining it into thin filaments, after she hath made it spun strong, ye take your oaths as means of deceit between you for one nation is more flourishing than (other) nation. Verily God only trieth you by this; And most assuredly He will make it clear unto you on the Day of Judgment about what ye were differing. To appreciate the exact significance of this…

item.title: An-Nahl:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِنْ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَلَتُسْءَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalakum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu walatus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taʿmalūna Had Allah wished, He would have made you one community, but He leads astray whomever He wishes and guides whomever He wishes, and you will surely be questioned concerning what you used to do.

item.title: An-Nahl:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِنْ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَلَتُسْءَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalakum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu walatus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taʿmalūna And if Allah had willed, He could have made you (of) one religion, but He sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills.1 And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do. And had Allah willed, He would have made you (all) one nation, but He allows whom He wills to stray and He guides whom He wills. But you shall certainly be called to account for what you used to do (16:93). And do not make your oaths a means of deception among yourselves, resulting in the slip of a foot after it was firmly planted, and you taste the…

item.title: An-Nahl:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِنْ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَلَتُسْءَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalakum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu walatus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taʿmalūna And if God willeth He would surely make you all a single nation, but He leaveth to err whomsoever He willeth (This does not mean compulsion.) and guideth whomsoever He willeth; And certainly will ye be question ed of what ye were doing. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا السُّوءَ بِمَا صَدَدْتُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ walā tattakhidhū aymānakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baʿda thubūtihā watadhūqū l-sūa bimā ṣadadttum ʿan sabīli l-lahi walakum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Do not make your oaths a means of [mutual] deceit among yourselves lest feet should stumble after being steady and [lest] you suffer ill for barring from the way of Allah and there be a great punishment for you.

item.title: An-Nahl:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا السُّوءَ بِمَا صَدَدْتُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ walā tattakhidhū aymānakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baʿda thubūtihā watadhūqū l-sūa bimā ṣadadttum ʿan sabīli l-lahi walakum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun And do not take your oaths as (means of) deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was (once) firm, and you would taste evil (in this world) for what (people) you diverted from the way of Allah,1 and you would have (in the Hereafter) a great punishment. See 16:93

item.title: An-Nahl:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا السُّوءَ بِمَا صَدَدْتُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ walā tattakhidhū aymānakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baʿda thubūtihā watadhūqū l-sūa bimā ṣadadttum ʿan sabīli l-lahi walakum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun And take ye not your oaths a means of deceit between you, lest slippeth a foot after it hath been firmly fixed, and ye taste the evil for ye hindered (others) from God's way; and for you be a great torment. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوْۤا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا إِنَّمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ walā tashtarū biʿahdi l-lahi thamanan qalīlan innamā ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna Do not sell Allah's covenant for a paltry gain. Indeed what is with Allah is better for you, should you know.

item.title: An-Nahl:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوْۤا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا إِنَّمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ walā tashtarū biʿahdi l-lahi thamanan qalīlan innamā ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know. See 16:93

item.title: An-Nahl:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوْۤا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا إِنَّمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ walā tashtarū biʿahdi l-lahi thamanan qalīlan innamā ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna Sell ye not the covenant of God for a mean (Worldly gain.) price; for verily with God is that which is better for you, if ye only knew. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا عِنْدَكُمْ يَنْفَدُ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ mā ʿindakum yanfadu wamā ʿinda l-lahi bāqin walanajziyanna alladhīna ṣabarū ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna That which is with you will be spent but what is with Allah shall last, and We will surely pay the patient their reward by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: An-Nahl:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا عِنْدَكُمْ يَنْفَدُ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ mā ʿindakum yanfadu wamā ʿinda l-lahi bāqin walanajziyanna alladhīna ṣabarū ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do. See 16:93

item.title: An-Nahl:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا عِنْدَكُمْ يَنْفَدُ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ mā ʿindakum yanfadu wamā ʿinda l-lahi bāqin walanajziyanna alladhīna ṣabarū ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna What (ever) is with you passeth away and what is with God is everlasting; and certainly We will give those who exercise patience, their return, with (For Punishment or reward in this life is given for the sake of the act but in the hereafter the same evil or goodness done here, the worst or the best of it will be returned.) the best of what they were doing. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَوةً طَيِّبَةً وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun falanuḥ'yiyannahu ḥayatan ṭayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna Whoever acts righteously, [whether] male or female, should he be faithful, —We shall revive him with a good life and pay them their reward by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: An-Nahl:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَوةً طَيِّبَةً وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun falanuḥ'yiyannahu ḥayatan ṭayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward (in the Hereafter) according to the best of what they used to do. Whoever does righteous deeds - whether male or female - while he (or she) is a believer; then We will certainly give them a good life, and We will certainly grant them their rewards in proportion to the best of what they used to do (16:97). Righteous Deeds and their Reward This is a promise from Allah to those Children…

item.title: An-Nahl:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَوةً طَيِّبَةً وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun falanuḥ'yiyannahu ḥayatan ṭayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna Whosoever did good, whether male or female, and he be a believer, then We will certainly make him live a life good and pure, and certainly We will give them their return with (Refer to note on verse 16:96.) the best of what they were doing. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ fa-idhā qarata l-qur'āna fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi mina l-shayṭāni l-rajīmi When you recite the Qur'ān, seek the protection of Allah against the outcast Satan.

item.title: An-Nahl:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ fa-idhā qarata l-qur'āna fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi mina l-shayṭāni l-rajīmi So when you recite the Qur’ān, (first) seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled (from His mercy). So when you recite the Qur'an, seek refuge with Allah from Shaytan, the outcast (16:98). Verily, he has no power over those who believe and put their trust only in their Lord (16:99). His power is only over those who obey and follow him (Shaytan), and those who join partners with Him (Allah) (16:100). The Command to Seek Refuge with Allah before Reciting the Qur'an This is a command from Allah to His servants upon the tongue of His Prophet SAW, telling them that when they want to read Qur'an, they should seek refuge with Allah from the cursed Shaytan. The Hadiths mentioned about seeking refuge…

item.title: An-Nahl:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ fa-idhā qarata l-qur'āna fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi mina l-shayṭāni l-rajīmi And when recitest thou the Qur'an seek thou refuge with God from Satan the accursed. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ innahu laysa lahu sul'ṭānun ʿalā alladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Indeed he does not have any authority over those who have faith and put their trust in their Lord.

item.title: An-Nahl:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ innahu laysa lahu sul'ṭānun ʿalā alladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord. See 16:98

item.title: An-Nahl:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ innahu laysa lahu sul'ṭānun ʿalā alladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Verily there is no authority for him over those who believe and rely on their Lord. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَانُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُ وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِهِ مُشْرِكُونَ innamā sul'ṭānuhu ʿalā alladhīna yatawallawnahu wa-alladhīna hum bihi mush'rikūna His authority is only over those who befriend him and those who make him a partner [of Allah].

item.title: An-Nahl:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَانُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُ وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِهِ مُشْرِكُونَ innamā sul'ṭānuhu ʿalā alladhīna yatawallawnahu wa-alladhīna hum bihi mush'rikūna His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah. See 16:98

item.title: An-Nahl:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَانُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُ وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِهِ مُشْرِكُونَ innamā sul'ṭānuhu ʿalā alladhīna yatawallawnahu wa-alladhīna hum bihi mush'rikūna Verily, his authority is only over those who befriend him and those who associate others with (God.) Him. See 16:92

item.title: An-Nahl:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَا اٰیَةً مَكَانَ اٰیَةٍ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُفْتَرٍ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-idhā baddalnā āyatan makāna āyatin wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yunazzilu qālū innamā anta muf'tarin bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna When We change a sign with another in its place —and Allah knows best what He sends down— they say, 'You are just a fabricator.' Rather most of them do not know.

item.title: An-Nahl:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَا اٰیَةً مَكَانَ اٰیَةٍ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُفْتَرٍ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-idhā baddalnā āyatan makāna āyatin wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yunazzilu qālū innamā anta muf'tarin bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allah is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, (O Muḥammad), are but an inventor (of lies)." But most of them do not know. And when We change a verse in place of another - and Allah knows best what He reveals - they (the disbelievers) say: "You (O Muhammad) are but a forger." Rather, most of them know not (16:101). Say (O Muhammad); "Ruh-ul-Qudus has brought it (the Qur'an) down from your Lord with truth." for the conviction of those who believe, and as a guide and good…

item.title: An-Nahl:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَا اٰیَةً مَكَانَ اٰیَةٍ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُفْتَرٍ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-idhā baddalnā āyatan makāna āyatin wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yunazzilu qālū innamā anta muf'tarin bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna And when change We one sign for another sign, and God knoweth best what He sendeth down, say they; "Thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) art only a forger." Nay! most of them know not. Regarding the exact significance of this Verse, different views have been given by the commentators that it refers to the abrogation of the contents of a Verse by another Verse. Total removal of a Verse and the replacement by another. Abrogation of the teachings of the previous scriptures by Qur'an. The question of abrogation of one Verse of Qur'an by the other if at all it has taken place is with regard…

item.title: An-Nahl:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ مِنْ رَبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَى لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ qul nazzalahu rūḥu l-qudusi min rabbika bil-ḥaqi liyuthabbita alladhīna āmanū wahudan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīna Say, the Holy Spirit has brought it down duly from your Lord to fortify those who have faith and as a guidance and good news for the muslims.

item.title: An-Nahl:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ مِنْ رَبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَى لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ qul nazzalahu rūḥu l-qudusi min rabbika bil-ḥaqi liyuthabbita alladhīna āmanū wahudan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "The Pure Spirit (i.e., Jibril) has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims." See 16:101

item.title: An-Nahl:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ مِنْ رَبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَى لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ qul nazzalahu rūḥu l-qudusi min rabbika bil-ḥaqi liyuthabbita alladhīna āmanū wahudan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīna Say thou (unto the disbelievers O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "The Holy Spirit (Angel Gabriel) hath brought it down (unto thee) from thy Lord with the truth, that it may establish those who believe and as a guidance and glad tidings unto those who submit (themselves to God)." See 16:101

item.title: An-Nahl:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌ لِسَانُ الَّذِي يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِيٌّ وَهَذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُبِينٌ walaqad naʿlamu annahum yaqūlūna innamā yuʿallimuhu basharun lisānu alladhī yul'ḥidūna ilayhi aʿjamiyyun wahādhā lisānun ʿarabiyyun mubīnun We certainly know that they say, 'It is only a human that instructs him.' The language of him to whom they refer is non-Arabic, while this is a clear Arabic language.

item.title: An-Nahl:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌ لِسَانُ الَّذِي يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِيٌّ وَهَذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُبِينٌ walaqad naʿlamu annahum yaqūlūna innamā yuʿallimuhu basharun lisānu alladhī yul'ḥidūna ilayhi aʿjamiyyun wahādhā lisānun ʿarabiyyun mubīnun And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches him (i.e., the Prophet SAW)." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign,1 and this (recitation, i.e., Qur’ān) is (in) a clear Arabic language. And indeed We know that they (polytheists and pagans) say: "It is only a human being who teaches him." The tongue of the man they refer to is foreign, while this (the Qur'an) is (in) a clear Arabic tongue (16:103). The Idolators' Claim that the Qur'an was Taught by a Human, and the Refutation of their Claim Allah tells us about the idolators' lies, allegations, and slander…

item.title: An-Nahl:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌ لِسَانُ الَّذِي يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِيٌّ وَهَذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُبِينٌ walaqad naʿlamu annahum yaqūlūna innamā yuʿallimuhu basharun lisānu alladhī yul'ḥidūna ilayhi aʿjamiyyun wahādhā lisānun ʿarabiyyun mubīnun And indeed know We that they say: "It is only a man (that) teacheth him." The tongue of him whom they (falsely) hint at is outlandish (Not eloquent - Slang.) while this language is Arabic (pure and) plain. See 16:101

item.title: An-Nahl:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ اللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi lā yahdīhimu l-lahu walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Indeed those who do not believe in the signs of Allah —Allah shall not guide them and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: An-Nahl:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ اللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi lā yahdīhimu l-lahu walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah - Allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment. Verily, those who do not believe in Allah's Ayat (signs, or revelation), Allah will not guide them, and theirs will be a painful punishment (16:104). It is only those who do not believe in Allah's Ayat who fabricate the falsehood, and it is they who are liars (16:105). Allah tells us that He does not guide those who turn away from remembering Him and who are heedless of that which He revealed to His Messenger SAW, those who have no intention of believing in that which he has brought from Allah. This…

item.title: An-Nahl:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ اللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi lā yahdīhimu l-lahu walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Verily those who believe not in the signs of God, God guideth them not, and for them shall be a painful torment. See 16:101

item.title: An-Nahl:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِي الْكَذِبَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ innamā yaftarī l-kadhiba alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-kādhibūna Only those fabricate lies who do not believe in the signs of Allah, and it is they who are the liars.

item.title: An-Nahl:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِي الْكَذِبَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ innamā yaftarī l-kadhiba alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-kādhibūna They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allah, and it is those who are the liars. See 16:104

item.title: An-Nahl:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِي الْكَذِبَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ innamā yaftarī l-kadhiba alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-kādhibūna Verily forge the lie only they who believe not in the signs of God, and these, they are the liars. See 16:101

item.title: An-Nahl:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَكِنْ مَنْ شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ man kafara bil-lahi min baʿdi īmānihi illā man uk'riha waqalbuhu muṭ'ma-innun bil-īmāni walākin man sharaḥa bil-kuf'ri ṣadran faʿalayhim ghaḍabun mina l-lahi walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Whoever renounces faith in Allah after [affirming] his faith —barring someone who is compelled while his heart is at rest in faith— but those who open up their breasts to unfaith, upon such shall be Allah's wrath, and there is a great punishment for them.

item.title: An-Nahl:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَكِنْ مَنْ شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ man kafara bil-lahi min baʿdi īmānihi illā man uk'riha waqalbuhu muṭ'ma-innun bil-īmāni walākin man sharaḥa bil-kuf'ri ṣadran faʿalayhim ghaḍabun mina l-lahi walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun Whoever disbelieves in (i.e., denies) Allah after his belief...1 except for one who is forced (to renounce his religion) while his heart is secure in faith. But those who (willingly) open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment. Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief - except one who was forced while his heart is at peace with the faith - but whoever opens their breasts to disbelief, on them is wrath from Allah, and theirs will be a terrible torment (16:106).…

item.title: An-Nahl:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَكِنْ مَنْ شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ man kafara bil-lahi min baʿdi īmānihi illā man uk'riha waqalbuhu muṭ'ma-innun bil-īmāni walākin man sharaḥa bil-kuf'ri ṣadran faʿalayhim ghaḍabun mina l-lahi walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun He who disbelieveth in God after his belief in Him, save he who is compelled while his heart remaineth steadfast with the faith, but he who openeth (his) breast for infidelity (Note the clearest wording of this Verse - on 'Taqiyyah' which is wrongly interpreted as hypocrisy - which is hiding infidelity at heart with a deceptive show of faith.) , on these is the wrath of God; for them shall be a great torment. This is a clear sanction to hide the true faith to escape any big calamity by uttering…

item.title: An-Nahl:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكَافِرِينَ dhālika bi-annahumu is'taḥabbū l-ḥayata l-dun'yā ʿalā l-ākhirati wa-anna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīna That, because they preferred the life of the world to the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the faithless lot.

item.title: An-Nahl:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكَافِرِينَ dhālika bi-annahumu is'taḥabbū l-ḥayata l-dun'yā ʿalā l-ākhirati wa-anna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīna That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكَافِرِينَ dhālika bi-annahumu is'taḥabbū l-ḥayata l-dun'yā ʿalā l-ākhirati wa-anna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīna This because they love the life of this world preferring it over the hereafter, and that God guideth not the infidel people. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wasamʿihim wa-abṣārihim wa-ulāika humu l-ghāfilūna They are the ones on whose hearts Allah has set a seal, and on their hearing and their sight [as well], and it is they who are the heedless.

item.title: An-Nahl:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wasamʿihim wa-abṣārihim wa-ulāika humu l-ghāfilūna Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wasamʿihim wa-abṣārihim wa-ulāika humu l-ghāfilūna These are those who, God hath set a seal on their hearts, and (on) their hearing (ears) and (on) their sights (eyes), and these, they are the heedless (ones) See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-khāsirūna Undoubtedly, they are the ones who will be the losers in the Hereafter.

item.title: An-Nahl:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-khāsirūna Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-khāsirūna Doubtless (it is) that they in the hereafter, they will be the losers. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوْۤا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوْۤا وَصَبَرُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna hājarū min baʿdi mā futinū thumma jāhadū waṣabarū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun Then indeed your Lord, to those who migrated, after they were persecuted, and waged jihād and were patient —indeed, after that, your Lord will surely be all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: An-Nahl:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوْۤا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوْۤا وَصَبَرُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna hājarū min baʿdi mā futinū thumma jāhadū waṣabarū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled (to say words of disbelief) and thereafter fought (for the cause of Allah) and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful. Then, verily, your Lord for those who emigrated after they were put to trials and then performed Jihad, and were patient, - after this, your Lord is indeed Forgiving, Most Merciful (16:110). (Remember) the Day when every person will come pleading for himself, and every one will be paid in full for what he did, and they will not be dealt with unjustly (16:111). The…

item.title: An-Nahl:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوْۤا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوْۤا وَصَبَرُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna hājarū min baʿdi mā futinū thumma jāhadū waṣabarū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun Then verily thy Lord unto those who migrate after they are persecuted, then they struggle hard (fight) (for God's cause) and exercised patience; verily, thy Lord, after that is Oft- Forgiving, the Most Merciful. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَأْتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ yawma tatī kullu nafsin tujādilu ʿan nafsihā watuwaffā kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna The day when every soul will come pleading for itself and every soul will be recompensed fully for what it has done, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: An-Nahl:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَأْتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ yawma tatī kullu nafsin tujādilu ʿan nafsihā watuwaffā kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna On the Day when every soul will come disputing (i.e., pleading) for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged (i.e., treated unjustly). See 16:110

item.title: An-Nahl:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَأْتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ yawma tatī kullu nafsin tujādilu ʿan nafsihā watuwaffā kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna (Remember) the day when every soul shall come, pleading for itself, and every soul shall be recompensed fully for what (all) it hath done, and they will not be dealt with unjustly. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:112 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ اللَّهِ فَأَذَاقَهَا اللَّهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَصْنَعُونَ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan qaryatan kānat āminatan muṭ'ma-innatan yatīhā riz'quhā raghadan min kulli makānin fakafarat bi-anʿumi l-lahi fa-adhāqahā l-lahu libāsa l-jūʿi wal-khawfi bimā kānū yaṣnaʿūna Allah draws a parable: A town secure and peaceful. Its provision came abundantly from every place. But it was ungrateful toward Allah's blessings. So Allah made it taste hunger and fear because of what they used to do.

item.title: An-Nahl:112 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ اللَّهِ فَأَذَاقَهَا اللَّهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَصْنَعُونَ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan qaryatan kānat āminatan muṭ'ma-innatan yatīhā riz'quhā raghadan min kulli makānin fakafarat bi-anʿumi l-lahi fa-adhāqahā l-lahu libāsa l-jūʿi wal-khawfi bimā kānū yaṣnaʿūna And Allah presents an example: a city (i.e., Makkah) which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allah. So Allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing. And Allah gives the example of a township (Makkah), it was secure and peaceful: its provision coming to it in abundance from every place, but it (its people) denied the favors of Allah. So Allah made it taste extreme hunger (famine) and fear, because…

item.title: An-Nahl:112 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ اللَّهِ فَأَذَاقَهَا اللَّهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَصْنَعُونَ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan qaryatan kānat āminatan muṭ'ma-innatan yatīhā riz'quhā raghadan min kulli makānin fakafarat bi-anʿumi l-lahi fa-adhāqahā l-lahu libāsa l-jūʿi wal-khawfi bimā kānū yaṣnaʿūna And setteth forth God a similitude: "(Like) a town safe and secure, cometh unto it its sustenance in abundance from every side, then it turned ungrateful to the bounties of God, therefore God made it taste of (getting enveloped into) the extreme (Covered with - or totally overwhelming.) of hunger and dread for what they were doing." See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:113 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ walaqad jāahum rasūlun min'hum fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu wahum ẓālimūna There had certainly come to them an apostle from among themselves, but they impugned him, so the punishment seized them while they were wrongdoers.

item.title: An-Nahl:113 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ walaqad jāahum rasūlun min'hum fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu wahum ẓālimūna And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers. See 16:112

item.title: An-Nahl:113 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ walaqad jāahum rasūlun min'hum fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu wahum ẓālimūna And indeed did come unto them (Our) Apostle from among themselves, but they belied him, so seized them a torment while they were unjust. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:114 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلُوْۤا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاشْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ fakulū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ush'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna So eat out of what Allah has provided you as lawful and good, and give thanks for Allah's blessing, if it is Him that you worship.

item.title: An-Nahl:114 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلُوْۤا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاشْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ fakulū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ush'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna Then eat of what Allah has provided for you (which is) lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allah, if it is (indeed) Him that you worship. So eat of the lawful and good food which Allah has provided for you. And be grateful for Allah's favor, if it is He Whom you worship (16:114). He has only forbidden dead flesh, blood, the flesh of swine, and any animal which is slaughtered as a sacrifice for other than Allah. But if one is forced by necessity, without willful disobedience, nor transgressing, then, Allah is Pardoning, Most Merciful (16:115). And do not describe what your tongues have lied about, saying: "This is…

item.title: An-Nahl:114 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلُوْۤا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاشْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ fakulū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ush'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna So eat ye of what God hath provided you lawful and good (things), and give ye thanks for God's bounty if unto Him ye worship. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:115 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ innamā ḥarrama ʿalaykumu l-maytata wal-dama walaḥma l-khinzīri wamā uhilla lighayri l-lahi bihi famani uḍ'ṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun He has forbidden you only carrion, blood, the flesh of the swine, and that which has been offered to other than Allah. But should someone be compelled, without being rebellious or aggressive, indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.1

item.title: An-Nahl:115 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ innamā ḥarrama ʿalaykumu l-maytata wal-dama walaḥma l-khinzīri wamā uhilla lighayri l-lahi bihi famani uḍ'ṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun He has only forbidden to you dead animals,1 blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced (by necessity), neither desiring (it) nor transgressing (its limit) - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. See 16:114

item.title: An-Nahl:115 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ innamā ḥarrama ʿalaykumu l-maytata wal-dama walaḥma l-khinzīri wamā uhilla lighayri l-lahi bihi famani uḍ'ṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun Verily He hath forbidden unto you what dieth of itself and blood and the flesh of swine and that over which hath been invoked any name other than God's; but whosoever be forced to the necessity, nor desiring nor (wilfully) transgressing the limit, then verily God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:116 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَقُولُوْۤا لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ هَذَا حَلَالٌ وَهَذَا حَرَامٌ لِتَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ walā taqūlū limā taṣifu alsinatukumu l-kadhiba hādhā ḥalālun wahādhā ḥarāmun litaftarū ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūna Do not say, asserting falsely with your tongues, 'This is lawful, and this is unlawful,' to fabricate lies against Allah. Indeed those who fabricate lies against Allah will not be felicitous.

item.title: An-Nahl:116 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَقُولُوْۤا لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ هَذَا حَلَالٌ وَهَذَا حَرَامٌ لِتَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ walā taqūlū limā taṣifu alsinatukumu l-kadhiba hādhā ḥalālun wahādhā ḥarāmun litaftarū ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūna And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allah. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed. See 16:114

item.title: An-Nahl:116 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَقُولُوْۤا لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ هَذَا حَلَالٌ وَهَذَا حَرَامٌ لِتَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ walā taqūlū limā taṣifu alsinatukumu l-kadhiba hādhā ḥalālun wahādhā ḥarāmun litaftarū ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūna And utter ye not whatever lie describe your tongues (saying): "This is lawful and this is for bidden," to forge a lie against God; Verily, those who forge a lie against God succeed not. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:117 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ matāʿun qalīlun walahum ʿadhābun alīmun A trifling enjoyment, and there will be a painful punishment for them.

item.title: An-Nahl:117 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ matāʿun qalīlun walahum ʿadhābun alīmun (It is but) a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment. See 16:114

item.title: An-Nahl:117 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ matāʿun qalīlun walahum ʿadhābun alīmun It is a very little means of enjoyment and for them is a painful torment. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:118 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُوْۤا حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ waʿalā alladhīna hādū ḥarramnā mā qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka min qablu wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna We forbade to the Jews what We have recounted to you earlier, and We did not wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.

item.title: An-Nahl:118 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُوْۤا حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ waʿalā alladhīna hādū ḥarramnā mā qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka min qablu wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before.1 And We did not wrong them (thereby), but they were wronging themselves. And for those who are Jews, We have forbidden such things as We have mentioned to you before. And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves (16:118). Then, your Lord for those who did evil out of ignorance and afterward repent and do righteous deeds - verily, after that, your Lord is Pardoning, Most Merciful (16:119). Some Good Things were Forbidden for the Jews After mentioning that He has forbidden us to eat dead meat, blood, the flesh of swine,…

item.title: An-Nahl:118 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُوْۤا حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ waʿalā alladhīna hādū ḥarramnā mā qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka min qablu wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna And unto those who were Jews We had forbidden what We have (already) related unto thee from before; And We did them not any injustice, but they were unto their own selves unjust. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:119 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوْۤا السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna ʿamilū l-sūa bijahālatin thumma tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun Then indeed your Lord, to those who commit evil out of ignorance and then repent after that, and reform —indeed, after that, your Lord will surely be all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: An-Nahl:119 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوْۤا السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna ʿamilū l-sūa bijahālatin thumma tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful. See 16:118

item.title: An-Nahl:119 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوْۤا السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna ʿamilū l-sūa bijahālatin thumma tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmun Yet verily thy Lord, unto those who do an evil (deed) in ignorance, and turn (repent) after that and make amends, Verily thy Lord is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. See 16:106

item.title: An-Nahl:120 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ inna ib'rāhīma kāna ummatan qānitan lillahi ḥanīfan walam yaku mina l-mush'rikīna Indeed Abraham was a nation obedient to Allah, a ḥanīf, and he was not one of the polytheists.

item.title: An-Nahl:120 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ inna ib'rāhīma kāna ummatan qānitan lillahi ḥanīfan walam yaku mina l-mush'rikīna Indeed, Ibrahim was a (comprehensive) leader,1 devoutly obedient to Allah, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allah. Verily, Ibrahim was (himself) an Ummah, obedient to Allah, a Hanif (monotheist), and he was not one of the idolators (16:120). (He was) thankful for His favors. He (Allah) chose him and guided him to a straight path (16:121). And We gave him good in this world, and in the Hereafter he shall be of the righteous (16:122). Then, We have sent the revelation to you: Follow the religion of Ibrahim (he was a) Hanif, and he was not one of the idolators (16:123). The Khalil (Close Friend) of Allah Allah praises His servant,…

item.title: An-Nahl:120 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ inna ib'rāhīma kāna ummatan qānitan lillahi ḥanīfan walam yaku mina l-mush'rikīna Verily Abraham was an Imam (The Leader of the faith or the religion.) (leader in religion) (for the) people, devoutly obedient to God, upright, and he was not of the polytheists, Here Abraham is asserted to be an 'Ummat' which cannot mean but 'Imam', (i.e., a distinctive leading personality), because the word 'Ummat' is used in Qur'an to mean any distinctly distinguished group, person, point of time, point of space, to which attention is drawn. This is the justification of the interpretation of the word 'Ummat' as 'Imam' here and in the other verses of Qur'an which asserts the leading duties for 'Ummat' (A.P.).

item.title: An-Nahl:121 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: شَاكِرًا لِأَنْعُمِهِ اجْتَبَاهُ وَهَدَاهُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ shākiran li-anʿumihi ij'tabāhu wahadāhu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Grateful [as he was] for His blessings, He chose him and guided him to a straight path.

item.title: An-Nahl:121 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: شَاكِرًا لِأَنْعُمِهِ اجْتَبَاهُ وَهَدَاهُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ shākiran li-anʿumihi ij'tabāhu wahadāhu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin (He was) grateful for His favors. He (i.e., Allah) chose him and guided him to a straight path. See 16:120

item.title: An-Nahl:121 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: شَاكِرًا لِأَنْعُمِهِ اجْتَبَاهُ وَهَدَاهُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ shākiran li-anʿumihi ij'tabāhu wahadāhu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Grateful for His bounties; He (God) chose him and He guided him on the right path. See 16:120

item.title: An-Nahl:122 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ waātaynāhu fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīna We gave him good in this world, and in the Hereafter he will indeed be among the Righteous.

item.title: An-Nahl:122 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ waātaynāhu fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīna And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous. See 16:120

item.title: An-Nahl:122 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ waātaynāhu fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīna And We gave him good in this world, and verily he in the hereafter will surely be of the righteous ones. See 16:120

item.title: An-Nahl:123 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ أَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ thumma awḥaynā ilayka ani ittabiʿ millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīna Then We revealed to you [saying], 'Follow the creed of Abraham, a ḥanīf, and he was not one of the polytheists.'

item.title: An-Nahl:123 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ أَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ thumma awḥaynā ilayka ani ittabiʿ millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīna Then We revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), to follow the religion of Ibrahim, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allah. See 16:120

item.title: An-Nahl:123 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ أَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ thumma awḥaynā ilayka ani ittabiʿ millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīna So We revealed unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) that thou followeth (Refer to verse 6:91.) the religion of Abraham, the upright one; and he was not of the polytheists. See 16:120

item.title: An-Nahl:124 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبْتُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِیْهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ innamā juʿila l-sabtu ʿalā alladhīna ikh'talafū fīhi wa-inna rabbaka layaḥkumu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna The Sabbath was only prescribed for those who differed about it. Your Lord will indeed judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: An-Nahl:124 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبْتُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِیْهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ innamā juʿila l-sabtu ʿalā alladhīna ikh'talafū fīhi wa-inna rabbaka layaḥkumu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ. The Sabbath was only prescribed for those who differed concerning it, and verily, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection about what they differed over (16:124). The Prescription of the Sabbath for the Jews There is no doubt that for every nation, Allah prescribed one day of the week for people to gather to worship Him. For this Ummah He prescribed Friday, because it is the sixth day, on which…

item.title: An-Nahl:124 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبْتُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِیْهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ innamā juʿila l-sabtu ʿalā alladhīna ikh'talafū fīhi wa-inna rabbaka layaḥkumu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Verily the sabbath (Refer to verses 2:65, 4:154 & 7:163.) was ordain ed only for those who differed about it; and verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment in what they used to differ about. See 16:120

item.title: An-Nahl:125 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْعُ إِلَى سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلْهُمْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ ud'ʿu ilā sabīli rabbika bil-ḥik'mati wal-mawʿiẓati l-ḥasanati wajādil'hum bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīna Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good advice and dispute with them in a manner that is best. Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are guided.

item.title: An-Nahl:125 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْعُ إِلَى سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلْهُمْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ ud'ʿu ilā sabīli rabbika bil-ḥik'mati wal-mawʿiẓati l-ḥasanati wajādil'hum bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīna Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is (rightly) guided. Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and fair preaching, and argue with them with that which is best. Truly, your Lord best knows who has strayed from His path, and He best knows those who are guided (16:125). The Command to Invite People to Allah with Wisdom and…

item.title: An-Nahl:125 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْعُ إِلَى سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلْهُمْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ ud'ʿu ilā sabīli rabbika bil-ḥik'mati wal-mawʿiẓati l-ḥasanati wajādil'hum bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīna And call thou unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom (Refer to verses 2:231 - 2:269, 3:48, 3:81, 3:164, 4:54, 4:113, 5:113, 33:34, 31:12, 38:20, 42:63 & 62:2.) and kindly exhortation and dispute (Argue.) with them in the manner which is the best; Verily thy Lord knoweth better of him who hath gone astray from His path; and He knoweth best of those guided aright. Note the most polite way in which Islam wants a Muslim to spread the truth against such clear and the most civilized and human method of the propagation of the…

item.title: An-Nahl:126 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَئِنْ صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِلصَّابِرِينَ wa-in ʿāqabtum faʿāqibū bimith'li mā ʿūqib'tum bihi wala-in ṣabartum lahuwa khayrun lilṣṣābirīna And if you retaliate, retaliate with the like of what you have been made to suffer, but if you are patient that is surely better for the patient.

item.title: An-Nahl:126 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَئِنْ صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِلصَّابِرِينَ wa-in ʿāqabtum faʿāqibū bimith'li mā ʿūqib'tum bihi wala-in ṣabartum lahuwa khayrun lilṣṣābirīna And if you punish (an enemy, O believers), punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed.1 But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient. And if you punish them, then punish them with the like of that with which you were afflicted. But if you have patience with them, then it is better for those who are patient (16:126). And be patient, and your patience will not be, but by the help of Allah. And do not grieve over them, and do not be distressed by their plots (16:127). Truly, Allah is with those who have Taqwa, and the doers of good (16:128). The Command for Equality…

item.title: An-Nahl:126 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَئِنْ صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِلصَّابِرِينَ wa-in ʿāqabtum faʿāqibū bimith'li mā ʿūqib'tum bihi wala-in ṣabartum lahuwa khayrun lilṣṣābirīna And if ye punish then punish ye as ye were afflicted; But if ye be patient, certainly it will be best for the patient (Note the patience enjoined by Islam even against unprovided aggression.) ones. This verse gives one the right of retaliation or punishment to one who has done him wrong but Qur'an recommends patience as the best course, and further emphasises on the same in the next verse, 16:127, and explains that this tolerance should be for the sake of God, and in God's way. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Nahl:127 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ wa-iṣ'bir wamā ṣabruka illā bil-lahi walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā taku fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūna So be patient, and you cannot be patient except with Allah['s help]. And do not grieve for them, nor be upset by their guile.

item.title: An-Nahl:127 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ wa-iṣ'bir wamā ṣabruka illā bil-lahi walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā taku fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūna And be patient, (O Muḥammad), and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire. See 16:126

item.title: An-Nahl:127 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ wa-iṣ'bir wamā ṣabruka illā bil-lahi walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā taku fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūna And be thou patient (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) and thy patience is not but by (the help of) God, and grieve not for them; and distress not thyself at what they devise. See 16:126

item.title: An-Nahl:128 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
