item.title: An-Naml:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ falammā jāathum āyātunā mub'ṣiratan qālū hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun So when came unto them Our clear signs, said they: "this is plain sorcery." See 27:10

item.title: An-Naml:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَحَدُوْۤا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنْفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ wajaḥadū bihā wa-is'tayqanathā anfusuhum ẓul'man waʿuluwwan fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna They impugned them —though they were convinced in their hearts— wrongfully and defiantly. So observe how was the fate of the agents of corruption!

item.title: An-Naml:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَحَدُوْۤا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنْفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ wajaḥadū bihā wa-is'tayqanathā anfusuhum ẓul'man waʿuluwwan fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna And they rejected them, while their (inner) selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters. See 27:7

item.title: An-Naml:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَحَدُوْۤا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنْفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ wajaḥadū bihā wa-is'tayqanathā anfusuhum ẓul'man waʿuluwwan fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna They denied them in iniquity and arrogance while their hearts (Lit. Selves – souls.) were convinced; See then how was the end of the mischief makers. See 27:10

item.title: An-Naml:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا دَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walaqad ātaynā dāwūda wasulaymāna ʿil'man waqālā l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrin min ʿibādihi l-mu'minīna Certainly We gave David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who granted us an advantage over many of His faithful servants.'

item.title: An-Naml:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا دَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walaqad ātaynā dāwūda wasulaymāna ʿil'man waqālā l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrin min ʿibādihi l-mu'minīna And We had certainly given to Dawud and Sulayman knowledge, and they said, "Praise (is due) to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants." And indeed We gave knowledge to Dawud and Sulayman, and they both said: "All praise be to Allah, Who has preferred us above many of His believing servants! (27:15). And Sulayman inherited from Dawud. He said: "O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from everything. This, verily, is an evident grace (27:16). And there were gathered before Sulayman his hosts of Jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order…

item.title: An-Naml:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا دَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walaqad ātaynā dāwūda wasulaymāna ʿil'man waqālā l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrin min ʿibādihi l-mu'minīna And indeed gave We knowledge to David and Solomon, and (both the apostles) said: "All praise is God's, Who hath made us to excel many of the believing servants," This verse proves that knowledge to the apostles of God is gifted by God Himself and not acquired by them from anyone in the world. The same was true with the Twelve Holy Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt who learnt nothing from any one on earth and yet were the fountainheads of wonderful knowledge and wisdom.1

item.title: An-Naml:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُدَ وَقَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ wawaritha sulaymānu dāwūda waqāla yāayyuhā l-nāsu ʿullim'nā manṭiqa l-ṭayri waūtīnā min kulli shayin inna hādhā lahuwa l-faḍlu l-mubīnu Solomon inherited from David, and he said, 'O people! We have been taught the speech of the birds, and we have been given out of everything. Indeed this is a manifest advantage.'

item.title: An-Naml:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُدَ وَقَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ wawaritha sulaymānu dāwūda waqāla yāayyuhā l-nāsu ʿullim'nā manṭiqa l-ṭayri waūtīnā min kulli shayin inna hādhā lahuwa l-faḍlu l-mubīnu And Sulayman inherited Dawud. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty." See 27:15

item.title: An-Naml:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُدَ وَقَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ wawaritha sulaymānu dāwūda waqāla yāayyuhā l-nāsu ʿullim'nā manṭiqa l-ṭayri waūtīnā min kulli shayin inna hādhā lahuwa l-faḍlu l-mubīnu And Solomon (Compare with this the false tradition "We the apostles neither inherit nor leave any thing to be inherited" which was advanced just to deprive Fatima of her right.) inherited David, and he said "O' people! We have been taught the language of the birds, and We have been granted (plenty) of every thing; Verily this is a manifest grace." It is said that David had 19 sons and each contested to inherit his father's (David) throne. God informed David of a few questions with their answers and commanded David to put the questions to each of his sons and whosoever answers correctly,…

item.title: An-Naml:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ waḥushira lisulaymāna junūduhu mina l-jini wal-insi wal-ṭayri fahum yūzaʿūna [Once] Solomon's hosts were marched out for him, comprising jinn, humans, and birds, and they were held in check.

item.title: An-Naml:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ waḥushira lisulaymāna junūduhu mina l-jini wal-insi wal-ṭayri fahum yūzaʿūna And gathered for Sulayman were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were (marching) in rows. See 27:15

item.title: An-Naml:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ waḥushira lisulaymāna junūduhu mina l-jini wal-insi wal-ṭayri fahum yūzaʿūna And gathered together unto Solomon his hosts of jinn and men and birds, then they were arrayed in ranks. The hosts at the disposal of Solomon consisted of all varieties of God's creation viz., birds, animals, beasts, men, the spiritual beings like jinn etc. It is said that the hosts occupied a very extensive space on earth.

item.title: An-Naml:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَى وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوْۤا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ḥattā idhā ataw ʿalā wādi l-namli qālat namlatun yāayyuhā l-namlu ud'khulū masākinakum lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaymānu wajunūduhu wahum lā yashʿurūna When they came to the Valley of Ants, an ant said, 'O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Solomon and his hosts should trample on you while they are unaware.'

item.title: An-Naml:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَى وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوْۤا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ḥattā idhā ataw ʿalā wādi l-namli qālat namlatun yāayyuhā l-namlu ud'khulū masākinakum lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaymānu wajunūduhu wahum lā yashʿurūna Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Sulayman and his soldiers while they perceive not." See 27:15

item.title: An-Naml:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَى وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوْۤا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ḥattā idhā ataw ʿalā wādi l-namli qālat namlatun yāayyuhā l-namlu ud'khulū masākinakum lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaymānu wajunūduhu wahum lā yashʿurūna Until they came to the valley of the Ants, said an Ant (addressing the other ants of the valley): "O' ye ants! enter ye into your dwellings, so that Solomon and his hosts may not crush ye (all) while they know (Unintentionally - without knowledge.) it not." As usual with him, a commentator has put up his own construction upon the word 'Naml' and draws his own interpretation using the obscure meaning of the word 'Naml'. The motive behind such interpretation is to deny the extraordinary significance of Solomon being recognised even by the small beings in God's creation on earth viz.…

item.title: An-Naml:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ fatabassama ḍāḥikan min qawlihā waqāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-adkhil'nī biraḥmatika fī ʿibādika l-ṣāliḥīna Whereat he smiled, amused at its words, and he said, 'My Lord! Inspire me to give thanks for Your blessing with which You have blessed me and my parents, and that I may do righteous deeds which may please You, and admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.'

item.title: An-Naml:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ fatabassama ḍāḥikan min qawlihā waqāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-adkhil'nī biraḥmatika fī ʿibādika l-ṣāliḥīna So (Sulayman) smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me1 to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into (the ranks of) Your righteous servants."2 See 27:15

item.title: An-Naml:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ fatabassama ḍāḥikan min qawlihā waqāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-adkhil'nī biraḥmatika fī ʿibādika l-ṣāliḥīna Then smiled (Solomon) laughing at her word, and said: "O' My Lord! (Make me to.) arouse me to be thankful for thy bounty which thou hast bestowed on me and my parents, and that I do good such as Thou wouldst be pleased with, and admit me by Thy mercy, among Thy righteous servants." Solomon smiled at the caution taken by the ants and ordered his hosts to await the ants getting into their holes and to be careful against causing any hurt to the ants in their passing over the land.…

item.title: An-Naml:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرٰی الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ watafaqqada l-ṭayra faqāla mā liya lā arā l-hud'huda am kāna mina l-ghāibīna [One day] he reviewed the birds, and said, 'Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he absent?'

item.title: An-Naml:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرٰی الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ watafaqqada l-ṭayra faqāla mā liya lā arā l-hud'huda am kāna mina l-ghāibīna And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent? He inspected the birds, and said: "What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees? (27:20). "I will surely punish him with a severe torment or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason (27:21). The Absence of the Hoopoe Mujahid, Sa'id bin Jubayr and others narrated from Ibn 'Abbas and others that the hoopoe was an expert who used to show Sulayman where water was if he was out in open land and needed water. The hoopoe would look for water for him in…

item.title: An-Naml:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرٰی الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ watafaqqada l-ṭayra faqāla mā liya lā arā l-hud'huda am kāna mina l-ghāibīna And reviewed the birds, then said: "How is it, I see not Hud-hud (Hoopoe) or is that he is among the absentees?" 'Hudhud', i.e., Hoopoe - It is reported that whenever Solomon went on a journey and fell in want of water for ablution for prayers, this bird used to show the place of water, for it is an instinct in the bird that it could see water underground as one sees a liquid through a bottle. This could not be doubted in the days when by passing the rays of light through opaque bodies things beyond them are pictured (the Xray implement). If man can do it through his own device, there is no room…

item.title: An-Naml:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَذْبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ la-uʿadhibannahu ʿadhāban shadīdan aw laādh'baḥannahu aw layatiyannī bisul'ṭānin mubīnin 'I will surely punish him with a severe punishment, or I will surely behead him, unless he brings a clear-cut excuse.'

item.title: An-Naml:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَذْبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ la-uʿadhibannahu ʿadhāban shadīdan aw laādh'baḥannahu aw layatiyannī bisul'ṭānin mubīnin I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."1 See 27:20

item.title: An-Naml:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَذْبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ la-uʿadhibannahu ʿadhāban shadīdan aw laādh'baḥannahu aw layatiyannī bisul'ṭānin mubīnin Certainly will I chastise him with a severe chastisement, or will I certainly slaughter him, or he shall bring unto me a (Excuse.) warrant clear, See 27:20

item.title: An-Naml:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ famakatha ghayra baʿīdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihi waji'tuka min saba-in binaba-in yaqīnin He did not stay for long [before he turned up] and said, 'I have alighted on something which you have not alighted on, and I have brought you from Sheba a definite report.

item.title: An-Naml:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ famakatha ghayra baʿīdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihi waji'tuka min saba-in binaba-in yaqīnin But he (i.e., the hoopoe) stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed (in knowledge) that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news. But (the hoopoe) stayed not long, he said: I have grasped which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba' with true news (27:22). "I found a woman ruling over them, she has been given all things, and she has a great throne (27:23). "I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah, and Shaytan has made their deeds fair seeming to them to prevent them from the way, so they have no…

item.title: An-Naml:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ famakatha ghayra baʿīdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihi waji'tuka min saba-in binaba-in yaqīnin And he tarried not long, then (he came up in the air and) said: "I comprehend what thou comprehendeth not, and I have brought unto thee from Sheba tidings sure." When 'Hudhud' was flying to report himself to Solomon, he met another of its kind and asked him to which place he belonged. 'Hudhud' replied 'To Solomon's kingdom', and gave the details of Solomon's glory and asked the other bird about his native place and he gave the details of the vast realm of 'Saba' (Sheba) which was ruled by Bilqis the Queen. Hudhud flew along with him to the land of Bilqis and having witnessed the greatness and the glory of…

item.title: An-Naml:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ وَجَدْتُ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ innī wajadttu im'ra-atan tamlikuhum waūtiyat min kulli shayin walahā ʿarshun ʿaẓīmun I found a woman ruling over them, and she has been given everything, and she has a great throne.

item.title: An-Naml:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ وَجَدْتُ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ innī wajadttu im'ra-atan tamlikuhum waūtiyat min kulli shayin walahā ʿarshun ʿaẓīmun Indeed, I found (there) a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne. See 27:22

item.title: An-Naml:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ وَجَدْتُ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ innī wajadttu im'ra-atan tamlikuhum waūtiyat min kulli shayin walahā ʿarshun ʿaẓīmun Verily found I a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given plenty of every thing, and she hath a throne magnificent. Hudhud related all that he saw in Sheba about the Queen and the people who worshipped the sun. It is commended that the reciter of this verse offers 'Sajdah' or prostration.

item.title: An-Naml:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَدْتُهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ wajadttuhā waqawmahā yasjudūna lilshamsi min dūni l-lahi wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūna I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds seem decorous to them —thus he has barred them from the way [of Allah], so they are not guided—

item.title: An-Naml:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَدْتُهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ wajadttuhā waqawmahā yasjudūna lilshamsi min dūni l-lahi wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūna I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from (His) way, so they are not guided. See 27:22

item.title: An-Naml:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَدْتُهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ wajadttuhā waqawmahā yasjudūna lilshamsi min dūni l-lahi wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūna And I found her and her people prostrating (in obeisance) unto the sun, besides God, and unto them Satan hath made their deeds fair-seeming, and thus hath turned them from the (right) way, so they are not guided aright. See 27:23

item.title: An-Naml:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ allā yasjudū lillahi alladhī yukh'riju l-khaba-a fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tukh'fūna wamā tuʿ'linūna so that they do not prostrate themselves to Allah, who brings out the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and He knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose.

item.title: An-Naml:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ allā yasjudū lillahi alladhī yukh'riju l-khaba-a fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tukh'fūna wamā tuʿ'linūna (And) so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. See 27:22

item.title: An-Naml:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ allā yasjudū lillahi alladhī yukh'riju l-khaba-a fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tukh'fūna wamā tuʿ'linūna That (why) they make not obeisance unto God. Who bringeth forth to light what is hid den in the heavens and the earth and what ye hide and what ye manifest, See 27:23

item.title: An-Naml:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi Allah—there is no god except Him— is the Lord of the Great Throne.'

item.title: An-Naml:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne." See 27:22

item.title: An-Naml:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi God! There is no God but He! He is the Lord of 'Arsh', the Mighty (Throne of Supreme Authority) See 27:23

item.title: An-Naml:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَنَنْظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla sananẓuru aṣadaqta am kunta mina l-kādhibīna He said, 'We shall see whether you are truthful, or if you are one of the liars.'

item.title: An-Naml:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَنَنْظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla sananẓuru aṣadaqta am kunta mina l-kādhibīna (Sulayman) said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (Sulayman) said: "We shall see whether you speak the truth or you are (one) of the liars (27:27). "Go you with this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then draw back from them and see what they return (27:28). She said: "O chiefs! Verily, here is delivered to me a noble letter, (27:29). "Verily, it is from Sulayman, and it (reads): 'In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful; (27:30). 'Be you not exalted against me, but come to me submitting (as Muslims).' (27:31). Sulayman's Letter to Bilqis Allah tells us what Sulayman said to the hoopoe when he told him about the people of Saba' and…

item.title: An-Naml:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَنَنْظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla sananẓuru aṣadaqta am kunta mina l-kādhibīna Said (Solomon): "We will see if thou hast uttered the truth or thou art of the liars" To test the statement of Hudhud, Solomon wrote an epistle to the Queen of Sheba.

item.title: An-Naml:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِذْهَبْ بِكِتَابِي هَذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ idh'hab bikitābī hādhā fa-alqih ilayhim thumma tawalla ʿanhum fa-unẓur mādhā yarjiʿūna Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then draw away from them and observe what [response] they return.'

item.title: An-Naml:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِذْهَبْ بِكِتَابِي هَذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ idh'hab bikitābī hādhā fa-alqih ilayhim thumma tawalla ʿanhum fa-unẓur mādhā yarjiʿūna Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what (answer) they will return." See 27:27

item.title: An-Naml:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِذْهَبْ بِكِتَابِي هَذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ idh'hab bikitābī hādhā fa-alqih ilayhim thumma tawalla ʿanhum fa-unẓur mādhā yarjiʿūna Go thou with this letter of mine and convey it unto them, and turn away from them and see what (answer) they return Hudhud is given the epistle to the Queen of Sheba and to get a reply to it.

item.title: An-Naml:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ اِنِّیْ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u innī ul'qiya ilayya kitābun karīmun She said, 'O [members of the] elite! Indeed a noble letter has been delivered to me.

item.title: An-Naml:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ اِنِّیْ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u innī ul'qiya ilayya kitābun karīmun She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter. See 27:27

item.title: An-Naml:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ اِنِّیْ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u innī ul'qiya ilayya kitābun karīmun Said (On receipt of the epistle from Solomon.) (the Queen of Sheba) "O' ye Chiefs! Verily, has been delivered unto me a letter honourable!" The Queen receiving the epistle consulted her courtiers about the graceful communication she had received from Solomon.

item.title: An-Naml:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ innahu min sulaymāna wa-innahu bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi It is from Solomon, and it begins in the name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

item.title: An-Naml:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ innahu min sulaymāna wa-innahu bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi Indeed, it is from Sulayman, and indeed, it is (i.e., reads): 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. See 27:27

item.title: An-Naml:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ innahu min sulaymāna wa-innahu bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi Verily, it is from Solomon; And it is: "In (The text of the epistle.) the name of God the Beneficent, the Most Merciful" The matter of these two verses was the contents of the communication from Solomon. Solomon had invited the Queen and her people to Islam, i.e., submission to God, against their submitting themselves to anything else.

item.title: An-Naml:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا تَعْلُوْۤا عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ allā taʿlū ʿalayya watūnī mus'limīna [It states,] "Do not defy me, and come to me in submission." '

item.title: An-Naml:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا تَعْلُوْۤا عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ allā taʿlū ʿalayya watūnī mus'limīna Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission (as Muslims).'" See 27:27

item.title: An-Naml:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا تَعْلُوْۤا عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ allā taʿlū ʿalayya watūnī mus'limīna That "exalt not yourselves against me, and come ye unto me submitting (yourselves to God)" See 27:30

item.title: An-Naml:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتّٰی تَشْهَدُونِ qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u aftūnī fī amrī mā kuntu qāṭiʿatan amran ḥattā tashhadūni She said, 'O [members of the] elite! Give me your opinion concerning my matter. I do not decide any matter until you are present.'

item.title: An-Naml:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتّٰی تَشْهَدُونِ qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u aftūnī fī amrī mā kuntu qāṭiʿatan amran ḥattā tashhadūni She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness (for) me."1 She said: "O chiefs! Advise me in case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me (27:32). They said: "We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command; so think over what you will command (27:33). She said: "Verily, kings, when they enter a town, they destroy it and make the most honorable among its people the lowest. And thus they do (27:34). "But verily, I am going to send him a present, and see with what (answer) the messengers return (27:35). Bilqis Consults…

item.title: An-Naml:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتّٰی تَشْهَدُونِ qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u aftūnī fī amrī mā kuntu qāṭiʿatan amran ḥattā tashhadūni Said she: "O' ye chiefs! advise me in (this) my affair; (To reply to Solomon's epistle.) (ye know) that I decide not any affair but in your view" (In consultation.) See 27:30

item.title: An-Naml:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا نَحْنُ أُولُوْۤا قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُوْۤا بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَانْظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatin wa-ulū basin shadīdin wal-amru ilayki fa-unẓurī mādhā tamurīna They said, 'We are powerful and possess a great might. But it is up to you to command. So see what you will command.'

item.title: An-Naml:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا نَحْنُ أُولُوْۤا قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُوْۤا بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَانْظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatin wa-ulū basin shadīdin wal-amru ilayki fa-unẓurī mādhā tamurīna They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command." See 27:32

item.title: An-Naml:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا نَحْنُ أُولُوْۤا قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُوْۤا بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَانْظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatin wa-ulū basin shadīdin wal-amru ilayki fa-unẓurī mādhā tamurīna They said: "We are endued with strength and possess mighty prowess, and (But.) to command is thine: so think (well before) what thou wilt command" See 27:30

item.title: An-Naml:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ إِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوْۤا قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوْۤا أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَا أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ qālat inna l-mulūka idhā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wajaʿalū aʿizzata ahlihā adhillatan wakadhālika yafʿalūna She said, 'Indeed when kings enter a town, they devastate it, and reduce the mightiest of its people to the most abased. That is how they act.

item.title: An-Naml:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ إِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوْۤا قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوْۤا أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَا أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ qālat inna l-mulūka idhā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wajaʿalū aʿizzata ahlihā adhillatan wakadhālika yafʿalūna She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do. See 27:32

item.title: An-Naml:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ إِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوْۤا قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوْۤا أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَا أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ qālat inna l-mulūka idhā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wajaʿalū aʿizzata ahlihā adhillatan wakadhālika yafʿalūna Said (the Queen): "Verily kings, when they enter a town (victorious), ruin it and make the noblest of its people the meanest; and thus will they (also) do." See 27:30

item.title: An-Naml:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ wa-innī mur'silatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanāẓiratun bima yarjiʿu l-mur'salūna I will send them a gift, and I shall see what the envoys bring back.'

item.title: An-Naml:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ wa-innī mur'silatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanāẓiratun bima yarjiʿu l-mur'salūna But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what (reply) the messengers will return." See 27:32

item.title: An-Naml:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ wa-innī mur'silatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanāẓiratun bima yarjiʿu l-mur'salūna And verily I will send unto him a present, and (wait to) see with what (answer) return the messengers The Queen decided to send some valuable presents to Solomon and something to test his wisdom. If Solomon was only a king, he would accept the presents and would not know the solution of the things of test and if he be an apostle of God, he would reject the gifts and declare the matter hidden in the problematic things. She sent many invaluable gifts and along with them some slaves in the guise of women and some female attendants of her in garb of men. When the messenger from the Queen arrived in the Land of Solomon and found the greatness and glory of…

item.title: An-Naml:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَا ءَاتَانِ اللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا ءَاتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ falammā jāa sulaymāna qāla atumiddūnani bimālin famā ātāniya l-lahu khayrun mimmā ātākum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūna So when he1 came to Solomon, he said, 'Are you aiding me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather you are exultant over your gift!

item.title: An-Naml:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَا ءَاتَانِ اللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا ءَاتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ falammā jāa sulaymāna qāla atumiddūnani bimālin famā ātāniya l-lahu khayrun mimmā ātākum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūna So when they came to Sulayman, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift. So, when (the messengers with the gift) came to Sulayman, he said: "Will you help me in wealth? What Allah has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay, you rejoice in your gift! (27:36). "Go back to them. We verily, shall come to them with armies that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be abased (27:37).…

item.title: An-Naml:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَا ءَاتَانِ اللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا ءَاتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ falammā jāa sulaymāna qāla atumiddūnani bimālin famā ātāniya l-lahu khayrun mimmā ātākum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūna And when came (the messenger of the Queen) unto Solomon, said (Solomon): "Aid ye me with riches? But what God hath given unto me is better than what He hath given unto you, Aye! it is ye, of your present, exultant." It indicates that Solomon was proud of the divine blessings and the power bestowed in him and not of the temporal power and worldly possessions. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بِجُنُودٍ لَا قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُمْ مِنْهَا أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ ir'jiʿ ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunūdin lā qibala lahum bihā walanukh'rijannahum min'hā adhillatan wahum ṣāghirūna Go back to them, for we will come at them with hosts which they cannot face, and we will expel them from it, abased, and they shall be degraded.'

item.title: An-Naml:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بِجُنُودٍ لَا قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُمْ مِنْهَا أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ ir'jiʿ ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunūdin lā qibala lahum bihā walanukh'rijannahum min'hā adhillatan wahum ṣāghirūna Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased." See 27:36

item.title: An-Naml:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بِجُنُودٍ لَا قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُمْ مِنْهَا أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ ir'jiʿ ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunūdin lā qibala lahum bihā walanukh'rijannahum min'hā adhillatan wahum ṣāghirūna Return thou unto them: for we will surely come unto them with (such) hosts which they shall not be able to meet, and certainly will we expel them out therefrom abased, while they shall be contemptible. Solomon ordered the Messenger to return to his Queen and informed him of his decision to march to Sheba with his unconquerable hosts.

item.title: An-Naml:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ qāla yāayyuhā l-mala-u ayyukum yatīnī biʿarshihā qabla an yatūnī mus'limīna He said, 'O [members of the] elite! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?'

item.title: An-Naml:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ qāla yāayyuhā l-mala-u ayyukum yatīnī biʿarshihā qabla an yatūnī mus'limīna (Sulayman) said, "O assembly (of jinn), which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?" He said: O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves in obedience (as Muslims)? (27:38). An 'Ifrit from the Jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place. And verily, I am indeed strong and trustworthy for such work (27:39). One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture, said: "I will bring it to you within the twinkling of an eye!" Then when he saw it placed before him, he said: "This is by the grace of my Lord – to test me whether I…

item.title: An-Naml:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ qāla yāayyuhā l-mala-u ayyukum yatīnī biʿarshihā qabla an yatūnī mus'limīna Said (Solomon): "O' ye chiefs! which of you can bring unto me her throne, ere they come unto me submitting?" (Bold.) See 27:37

item.title: An-Naml:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مِنْ مَقَامِكَ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ qāla ʿif'rītun mina l-jini anā ātīka bihi qabla an taqūma min maqāmika wa-innī ʿalayhi laqawiyyun amīnun An afreet1 from among the jinn said, 'I will bring it to you before you rise from your place. Indeed I have the power for it and am trustworthy.'

item.title: An-Naml:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مِنْ مَقَامِكَ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ qāla ʿif'rītun mina l-jini anā ātīka bihi qabla an taqūma min maqāmika wa-innī ʿalayhi laqawiyyun amīnun A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this (task) strong and trustworthy." See 27:38

item.title: An-Naml:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مِنْ مَقَامِكَ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ qāla ʿif'rītun mina l-jini anā ātīka bihi qabla an taqūma min maqāmika wa-innī ʿalayhi laqawiyyun amīnun Said an audacious one among the jinn; "I will bring it unto thee ere thou risest up from thy place; for verily I am strong (enough to do it) and I am (also thy) trusted one" The task which Solomon wanted to achieve was something which ordinarily seemed to be impossible, i.e., the bringing of the Queen single-handed arresting her and presenting her with her throne itself. The offer to do it was from a jinn who said he would do it before Solomon rises from his seat, i.e., Solomon disperses his court and gets up but even with that, Solomon was not satisfied. The Ahmadi Commentator just…

item.title: An-Naml:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِي عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِنْدَهُ قَالَ هَذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَنْ شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ qāla alladhī ʿindahu ʿil'mun mina l-kitābi anā ātīka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka ṭarfuka falammā raāhu mus'taqirran ʿindahu qāla hādhā min faḍli rabbī liyabluwanī a-ashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna rabbī ghaniyyun karīmun The one who had knowledge of the Book1 said, 'I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.' So when he saw it set near him, he said, 'This is by the grace of my Lord, to test me if I will give thanks or be ungrateful. And whoever gives thanks, gives thanks only for his own sake. And whoever is…

item.title: An-Naml:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِي عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِنْدَهُ قَالَ هَذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَنْ شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ qāla alladhī ʿindahu ʿil'mun mina l-kitābi anā ātīka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka ṭarfuka falammā raāhu mus'taqirran ʿindahu qāla hādhā min faḍli rabbī liyabluwanī a-ashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna rabbī ghaniyyun karīmun Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when (Sulayman) saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for (the benefit of) himself. And whoever…

item.title: An-Naml:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ الَّذِي عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِنْدَهُ قَالَ هَذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَنْ شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ qāla alladhī ʿindahu ʿil'mun mina l-kitābi anā ātīka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka ṭarfuka falammā raāhu mus'taqirran ʿindahu qāla hādhā min faḍli rabbī liyabluwanī a-ashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna rabbī ghaniyyun karīmun Said he with whom was some knowledge (of a part) of the Book: "I will bring it unto thee ere thy eye (When the one with the Knowledge of a part of the Book could do this, imagine what the one (Ali) with the Knowledge of the whole of the Book could do, about whom the Holy Prophet said: 'I am the City of…

item.title: An-Naml:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَكِّرُوْۤا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنْظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِي أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ qāla nakkirū lahā ʿarshahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu mina alladhīna lā yahtadūna He said, 'Disguise her throne for her, so that we may see whether she is discerning or if she is one of the undiscerning ones.'

item.title: An-Naml:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَكِّرُوْۤا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنْظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِي أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ qāla nakkirū lahā ʿarshahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu mina alladhīna lā yahtadūna He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided (to truth) or will be of those who is not guided." He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will be guided, or she will be one of those not guided (27:41). So when she came, it was said, "Is your throne like this" She said: "As though it were the very same." And he said, "Knowledge was bestowed on us before her, and we had submitted to Allah (as Muslims) (27:42). And Saddaha that which she used to worship besides Allah has prevented her (from Islam), for she was of a disbelieving people (27:43). It…

item.title: An-Naml:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَكِّرُوْۤا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنْظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِي أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ qāla nakkirū lahā ʿarshahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu mina alladhīna lā yahtadūna Said (Solomon): "Transform (Alter it to look otherwise.) her throne for her; we will see if she followeth the way aright, or (she is) of those who go not aright?" See 27:40

item.title: An-Naml:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ falammā jāat qīla ahākadhā ʿarshuki qālat ka-annahu huwa waūtīnā l-ʿil'ma min qablihā wakunnā mus'limīna So when she came, it was said [to her], 'Is your throne like this one?' She said, 'It seems to be the same, and we were informed before it,1 and we had submitted.'

item.title: An-Naml:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ falammā jāat qīla ahākadhā ʿarshuki qālat ka-annahu huwa waūtīnā l-ʿil'ma min qablihā wakunnā mus'limīna So when she arrived, it was said (to her), "Is your throne like this?" She said, "(It is) as though it was it." (Sulayman said), "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims (in submission to Allah). See 27:41

item.title: An-Naml:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ falammā jāat qīla ahākadhā ʿarshuki qālat ka-annahu huwa waūtīnā l-ʿil'ma min qablihā wakunnā mus'limīna So when came (the queen), it was said (unto her): "Is thy throne (also) like this?" Said she: "as it were the same, and we were (already) given the knowledge (of thy apostleship) before it, and we were submitting." See 27:40

item.title: An-Naml:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ waṣaddahā mā kānat taʿbudu min dūni l-lahi innahā kānat min qawmin kāfirīna She had been barred [from the way of Allah] by what she used to worship besides Allah, for she belonged to a faithless people.

item.title: An-Naml:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ waṣaddahā mā kānat taʿbudu min dūni l-lahi innahā kānat min qawmin kāfirīna And that which she was worshipping other than Allah had averted her (from submission to Him). Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people." See 27:41

item.title: An-Naml:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ waṣaddahā mā kānat taʿbudu min dūni l-lahi innahā kānat min qawmin kāfirīna But prevented her what she worshipped besides God, verily she was of the disbelieving people. See 27:40

item.title: An-Naml:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُمَرَّدٌ مِنْ قَوَارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qīla lahā ud'khulī l-ṣarḥa falammā ra-athu ḥasibathu lujjatan wakashafat ʿan sāqayhā qāla innahu ṣarḥun mumarradun min qawārīra qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī wa-aslamtu maʿa sulaymāna lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna It was said to her, 'Enter the palace.' So when she saw it, she supposed it to be a pool of water, and she bared her shanks. He said, 'It is a palace paved with crystal.' She said, 'My Lord! Indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: An-Naml:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُمَرَّدٌ مِنْ قَوَارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qīla lahā ud'khulī l-ṣarḥa falammā ra-athu ḥasibathu lujjatan wakashafat ʿan sāqayhā qāla innahu ṣarḥun mumarradun min qawārīra qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī wa-aslamtu maʿa sulaymāna lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water1 and uncovered her shins (to wade through). He said, "Indeed, it is a palace (whose floor is) made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Sulayman to Allah, Lord of the worlds." See 27:41

item.title: An-Naml:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُمَرَّدٌ مِنْ قَوَارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qīla lahā ud'khulī l-ṣarḥa falammā ra-athu ḥasibathu lujjatan wakashafat ʿan sāqayhā qāla innahu ṣarḥun mumarradun min qawārīra qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī wa-aslamtu maʿa sulaymāna lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna It was said unto her: "Enter thou the palace", but when she saw it she deemed it to be a pool of water and bared her legs; (Solomon) said: "Verily this is but a place smoothed with (slabs of) glass;" said (the Queen): "My Lord! verily I have been unjust to myself, and I submit (along) with Solomon unto God, the Lord of the worlds." While receiving the Queen, Solomon had made arrangements to disillusion her mind by an unbreakable argument and undeniable fact.…

item.title: An-Naml:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ walaqad arsalnā ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan ani uʿ'budū l-laha fa-idhā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūna Certainly We sent to Thamūd Ṣāliḥ, their brother, [with the summons:] 'Worship Allah!' But thereat they became two groups contending with each other.

item.title: An-Naml:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ walaqad arsalnā ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan ani uʿ'budū l-laha fa-idhā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūna And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, (saying), "Worship Allah," and at once they were two parties conflicting. And indeed We sent to Thamud their brother Salih, (saying): "Worship Allah." Then look! They became two parties quarreling with each other (27:45). He said: "O my people! Why do you seek to hasten the evil before the good Why seek you not the forgiveness of Allah, that you may receive mercy? (27:46). They said: "We augur an omen from you and those with you." He said: "Your omen is of Allah; nay, but you are a people that are being tested (27:47). Salih and Thamud Allah tells us about Thamud and how…

item.title: An-Naml:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ walaqad arsalnā ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan ani uʿ'budū l-laha fa-idhā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūna And indeed sent We unto (the tribe of) Thamud their brother Salih, saying: "Worship ye God (alone)!" but lo! they became two parties, wrangling (with each other). See 27:44

item.title: An-Naml:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ qāla yāqawmi lima tastaʿjilūna bil-sayi-ati qabla l-ḥasanati lawlā tastaghfirūna l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna He said, 'O My people! Why do you press for evil sooner than for good? Why do you not plead to Allah for forgiveness so that you may receive His mercy?'

item.title: An-Naml:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ qāla yāqawmi lima tastaʿjilūna bil-sayi-ati qabla l-ḥasanati lawlā tastaghfirūna l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before (i.e., instead of) good?1 Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allah that you may receive mercy?" See 27:45

item.title: An-Naml:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ qāla yāqawmi lima tastaʿjilūna bil-sayi-ati qabla l-ḥasanati lawlā tastaghfirūna l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna Said (Salih): O' my people! Why seek ye to hasten on the evil ere the good? Why seek ye not pardon of God? that ye may be shewn mercy. Since the people always waited for the fulfilment of the threat against the wrath of God, it is said, why do they hasten it, and not seek God's pardon and his protection against the chastisement.

item.title: An-Naml:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنْ مَعَكَ قَالَ طَائِرُكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ qālū iṭṭayyarnā bika wabiman maʿaka qāla ṭāirukum ʿinda l-lahi bal antum qawmun tuf'tanūna They said, 'We take for a bad omen you and those who are with you.' He said, 'Your bad omens are with Allah. Rather you are a people being tested.'

item.title: An-Naml:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنْ مَعَكَ قَالَ طَائِرُكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ qālū iṭṭayyarnā bika wabiman maʿaka qāla ṭāirukum ʿinda l-lahi bal antum qawmun tuf'tanūna They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen (i.e., fate) is with Allah. Rather, you are a people being tested."1 See 27:45

item.title: An-Naml:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنْ مَعَكَ قَالَ طَائِرُكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ qālū iṭṭayyarnā bika wabiman maʿaka qāla ṭāirukum ʿinda l-lahi bal antum qawmun tuf'tanūna Said they: "We augur ill from thee and those with thee." Said (Salih): "Your ill augury (Omen.) is with God; Nay! ye are a people who are being (Put to trial.) tried." See 27:46

item.title: An-Naml:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ wakāna fī l-madīnati tis'ʿatu rahṭin yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna There were nine persons1 in the city who caused corruption in the land, and did not bring about any reform.

item.title: An-Naml:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ wakāna fī l-madīnati tis'ʿatu rahṭin yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending (its affairs). And there were in the city nine Rahtin, who made mischief in the land, and would not reform (27:48). They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his household, and thereafter we will surely say to his near relatives: 'We witnessed not the destruction of his household, and verily, we are telling the truth.' (27:49). So, they plotted a plot, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not (27:50). Then see how was the end of their plot! Verily, We destroyed them and their nation all together (27:51). These…

item.title: An-Naml:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ wakāna fī l-madīnati tis'ʿatu rahṭin yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna And there were in the town nine men who made mischief in the land and they would not amend (Reform – rectify.) (themselves) There were nine ringleaders of the mischief-mongers in the town of Salih who were always behind every mischief. The Holy Prophet said the most cursed one of the people would be the assassin of Ali Ibn Abi Talib.

item.title: An-Naml:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ qālū taqāsamū bil-lahi lanubayyitannahu wa-ahlahu thumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihi mā shahid'nā mahlika ahlihi wa-innā laṣādiqūna They said, '[Let us] swear together by Allah that we will attack him and his family by night. Then we will surely tell his heir that we were not present at the murder of his family and we indeed speak the truth.'

item.title: An-Naml:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ qālū taqāsamū bil-lahi lanubayyitannahu wa-ahlahu thumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihi mā shahid'nā mahlika ahlihi wa-innā laṣādiqūna They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allah that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor,1 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'" See 27:48

item.title: An-Naml:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ qālū taqāsamū bil-lahi lanubayyitannahu wa-ahlahu thumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihi mā shahid'nā mahlika ahlihi wa-innā laṣādiqūna They said: "Swear ye to one another by God that surely we will suddenly attack by night, him and his family, and then surely we would say unto his heir we witnessed not the murder of his family, and verily we are truthful." Conspiracy was made against the Holy Prophet by the tribes of the Quraysh after the demise of Abu Talib, and this became the cause of the 'Hijrah', i.e., migration of the Holy Prophet from Mecca to Medina. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ wamakarū makran wamakarnā makran wahum lā yashʿurūna They devised a plot, and We [too] devised a plan, but they were not aware.

item.title: An-Naml:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ wamakarū makran wamakarnā makran wahum lā yashʿurūna And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not. See 27:48

item.title: An-Naml:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ wamakarū makran wamakarnā makran wahum lā yashʿurūna And plotted they and We (too) plotted a plot, and they perceived not. Similar plotting was done against the Holy Prophet also - Ali's taking the place of the Holy Prophet in his couch at the night of his Migration to Medina which led to their destruction later on in the battles of Badr, Uhud and till the conquest of Mecca. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَاهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum waqawmahum ajmaʿīna So observe how was the outcome of their plotting, as We destroyed them and all their people.

item.title: An-Naml:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَاهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum waqawmahum ajmaʿīna Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all. See 27:48

item.title: An-Naml:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَاهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum waqawmahum ajmaʿīna See then what was the end of their plot, that We, destroyed them and their people as a whole. See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ fatil'ka buyūtuhum khāwiyatan bimā ẓalamū inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿlamūna So there lay their houses, fallen in ruin, because of their wrongdoing. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: An-Naml:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ fatil'ka buyūtuhum khāwiyatan bimā ẓalamū inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿlamūna So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know. See 27:48

item.title: An-Naml:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ fatil'ka buyūtuhum khāwiyatan bimā ẓalamū inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿlamūna So those are their houses in empty ruins for they were unjust; Verily there is in this a sign for people who understand. See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ wa-anjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna And We delivered those who had faith and were Godwary.

item.title: An-Naml:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ wa-anjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah. See 27:48

item.title: An-Naml:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ wa-anjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna And delivered We those who believed and guarded (themselves) against evil. See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata wa-antum tub'ṣirūna And Lot, when he said to his people, 'What! Do you commit this indecency while you see [with your own eyes]?

item.title: An-Naml:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata wa-antum tub'ṣirūna And (mention) Lut, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality1 while you are seeing?2 And (remember) Lut! When he said to his people: Do you commit immoral sins while you see? (27:54). "Do you practice your lusts on men instead of women? Nay, but you are a people who behave senselessly (27:55). There was no other answer given by his people except that they said: "Drive out the family of Lut from your city. Verily, these are men who want to be clean and pure! (27:56). So, We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to be of those who remained behind (27:57). And We rained down on them a rain. So, evil was the rain of…

item.title: An-Naml:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata wa-antum tub'ṣirūna And (sent We) Lut, when said he unto his people "What! Commit ye filthiness while ye see." See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun tajhalūna Do you approach men with [sexual] desire instead of women?! Rather you are a senseless lot!'

item.title: An-Naml:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun tajhalūna Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly." See 27:54

item.title: An-Naml:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun tajhalūna What! come ye unto men with lust rather than (unto) women? Verily ye are ignorant people? See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَخْرِجُوْۤا اٰلَ لُوطٍ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭin min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūna But the only answer of his people was that they said, 'Expel Lot's family from your town! They are indeed a puritanical lot.'

item.title: An-Naml:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَخْرِجُوْۤا اٰلَ لُوطٍ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭin min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūna But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lut from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure." See 27:54

item.title: An-Naml:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَخْرِجُوْۤا اٰلَ لُوطٍ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭin min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūna But the answer of his people was naught save that said they: "Turn ye the people of Lut out of your town; Verily they are people (who seek to be) Pure." See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَاهَا مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnāhā mina l-ghābirīna So We delivered him and his family, except his wife. We ordained her to be among those who remained behind.

item.title: An-Naml:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَاهَا مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnāhā mina l-ghābirīna So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind. See 27:54

item.title: An-Naml:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَاهَا مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnāhā mina l-ghābirīna So We delivered him and his followers, except his wife (Note: a wife of an apostle is wicked to be chastised by God. This is a clear proof that a woman because of her being the wife of a prophet can not also be his Ahl al-Bayt.) ; We had decreed her to be of those who remained behind. See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna Then We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. So evil was the rain of those who were warned!

item.title: An-Naml:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna And We rained upon them a rain (of stones), and evil was the rain of those who were warned. See 27:54

item.title: An-Naml:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna And showered We on them a shower, and evil was the shower of those who had been warned. See 27:50

item.title: An-Naml:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَى ءَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ quli l-ḥamdu lillahi wasalāmun ʿalā ʿibādihi alladhīna iṣ'ṭafā āllahu khayrun ammā yush'rikūna Say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, and Peace be to His servants whom He has chosen.' Is Allah better, or the partners they ascribe [to Him]?

item.title: An-Naml:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَى ءَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ quli l-ḥamdu lillahi wasalāmun ʿalā ʿibādihi alladhīna iṣ'ṭafā āllahu khayrun ammā yush'rikūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Praise be to Allah, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allah better or what they associate with Him?" Say : Praise and thanks be to Allah, and peace be on His servants whom He has chosen! Is Allah better, or what they ascribe as partners? (27:59). Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water from the sky, whereby We cause to grow wonderful gardens full of beauty and delight? It is not in your ability to cause the growth of their trees. Is there any god with Allah? Nay, but they are a people who ascribe equals (27:60). The Command to…

item.title: An-Naml:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَى ءَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ quli l-ḥamdu lillahi wasalāmun ʿalā ʿibādihi alladhīna iṣ'ṭafā āllahu khayrun ammā yush'rikūna Say: "All praise be (only) to God, and peace be on His servants whom He hath chosen: What! Is God better, or what they join (within?)" According to the interpretation of the Holy Ahl al-Bayt, the servants of God referred to herein this verse are the Holy Prophet and the Holy Imams. (M.S., U.B.)1

item.title: An-Naml:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَائِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُنْبِتُوْۤا شَجَرَهَا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ amman khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa-anzala lakum mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā bihi ḥadāiqa dhāta bahjatin mā kāna lakum an tunbitū shajarahā a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal hum qawmun yaʿdilūna Is He who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water from the sky, whereby We grow delightful gardens, whose trees you could never cause to grow…?1 What! Is there a god besides Allah? Rather they are a lot who equate [others with Allah].

item.title: An-Naml:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَائِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُنْبِتُوْۤا شَجَرَهَا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ amman khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa-anzala lakum mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā bihi ḥadāiqa dhāta bahjatin mā kāna lakum an tunbitū shajarahā a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal hum qawmun yaʿdilūna (More precisely), is He (not best) who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not (otherwise) have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allah?1 (No), but they are a people who ascribe equals (to Him). See 27:59

item.title: An-Naml:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَائِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُنْبِتُوْۤا شَجَرَهَا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ amman khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa-anzala lakum mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā bihi ḥadāiqa dhāta bahjatin mā kāna lakum an tunbitū shajarahā a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal hum qawmun yaʿdilūna Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, and sent down for you water from heaven; then caused We to grow by it gardens beautiful; it was not in your power that ye grow the trees thereof; What! Is there any god with God? Nay! they are a people who (yet) find equals (unto Him)? See 27:59

item.title: An-Naml:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ amman jaʿala l-arḍa qarāran wajaʿala khilālahā anhāran wajaʿala lahā rawāsiya wajaʿala bayna l-baḥrayni ḥājizan a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Is He who made the earth an abode [for you], and made rivers [flowing] through it, and set firm mountains for it, and set a barrier between the two seas…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Rather most of them do not know.

item.title: An-Naml:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ amman jaʿala l-arḍa qarāran wajaʿala khilālahā anhāran wajaʿala lahā rawāsiya wajaʿala bayna l-baḥrayni ḥājizan a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Is He (not best) who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allah? (No), but most of them do not know. Is not He Who has made the earth as a fixed abode, and has placed rivers in its midst, and has placed firm mountains therein, and has set a barrier between the two seas (of salt and sweet water)? Is there any ilah (god) with Allah? Nay, but most of them know not…

item.title: An-Naml:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ amman jaʿala l-arḍa qarāran wajaʿala khilālahā anhāran wajaʿala lahā rawāsiya wajaʿala bayna l-baḥrayni ḥājizan a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Is not He Who made the earth a resting place, and made in it rivers, and made on it mountains, and caused between two seas a barrier; Is there any god with God? Nay! most of them know not. See 27:59

item.title: An-Naml:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ الْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ amman yujību l-muḍ'ṭara idhā daʿāhu wayakshifu l-sūa wayajʿalukum khulafāa l-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna Is He who answers the call of the distressed [person] when he invokes Him and removes his distress, and makes you the earth's successors…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Little is the admonition that you take.

item.title: An-Naml:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ الْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ amman yujību l-muḍ'ṭara idhā daʿāhu wayakshifu l-sūa wayajʿalukum khulafāa l-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna Is He (not best) who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth?1 Is there a deity with Allah? Little do you remember. Is not He Who responds to the distressed one, when he calls on Him, and Who removes the evil, and makes you inheritors of the earth, generations after generations? Is there any god with Allah? Little is that you remember (27:62). Allah points out that He is the One upon Whom people call in times of difficulty, and He is the One to Whom they turn when calamity strikes, as He says elsewhere:…

item.title: An-Naml:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ الْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ amman yujību l-muḍ'ṭara idhā daʿāhu wayakshifu l-sūa wayajʿalukum khulafāa l-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna Is (Note: The recital of the first clause from: "Amman yujibu al-mudhtarra idha da'ahu wa yakshifu us-su'u" is an often found surely effective prayer for relief from any unavoidable difficulty 12,000 times at a stretch - but with the constancy of the 'Wajib' or compulsory daily prayers. Beginning and ending with 'Salawaat'.) not He Who answereth the distressed one when he calleth Him, and removeth the distress and maketh you the successors in the earth; Is there any god with God? (Nay!) Little it is what ye reflect. This verse forms an unfailing prayer, if recited 12,000 times at the time of any insurmountable difficulty or need. It…

item.title: An-Naml:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ amman yahdīkum fī ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri waman yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi taʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūna Is He who guides you in the darkness of land and sea and who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Exalted is Allah above [having] any partners they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: An-Naml:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ amman yahdīkum fī ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri waman yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi taʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūna Is He (not best) who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allah? High is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. Is not He Who guides you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy? Is there any god with Allah? Exalted be Allah above all that they associate as partners!) Allah say (27:63). أَمَّنْ يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ Is not He Who guides…

item.title: An-Naml:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
