item.description: أَمَّنْ يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ amman yahdīkum fī ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri waman yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi taʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūna Is not He Who guideth you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sendeth the winds as the bearers of the good news of His Mercy? Is there any god with God? Exalted High is God above what they associate (with Him). See 27:62

item.title: An-Naml:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَمَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قُلْ هَاتُوْۤا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ amman yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu waman yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qul hātū bur'hānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Is He who originates the creation, then He will bring it back, and who provides for you from the sky and the earth…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Say, 'Produce your evidence, should you be truthful.'

item.title: An-Naml:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَمَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قُلْ هَاتُوْۤا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ amman yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu waman yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qul hātū bur'hānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Is He (not best) who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful." Is not He Who originates creation, and shall thereafter repeat it, and Who provides for you from heaven and earth? Is there any god with Allah? Say: Bring forth your proofs, if you are truthful (27:64). He is the One Who, by His might and power, originates creation and then repeats it. This is like the Ayat: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ - إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ…

item.title: An-Naml:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَمَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قُلْ هَاتُوْۤا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ amman yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu waman yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qul hātū bur'hānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Is not He Who originateth the creation, then reproduceth it, and Who provideth for you sustenance from the heaven and the earth? Is there any god with God? Say: "Bring ye your proof, if ye be truthful." See 27:62

item.title: An-Naml:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ qul lā yaʿlamu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi l-ghayba illā l-lahu wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna Say, 'No one in the heavens or the earth knows the Unseen except Allah, and they are not aware when they will be resurrected.'

item.title: An-Naml:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ qul lā yaʿlamu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi l-ghayba illā l-lahu wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allah, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected." Say: None in the heavens and the earth knows the Unseen except Allah, nor can they perceive when they shall be resurrected (27:65). Nay, their knowledge will perceive that in the Hereafter. Nay, they are in doubt about it. Nay, they are in complete blindness about it (27:66). The One Who Knows the Unseen is Allah Allah commands His Messenger SAW to inform all of creation that no one among the dwellers of heaven and earth knows the Unseen, except Allah. إِلَّا اللَّهُ except Allah This is an absolute exception,…

item.title: An-Naml:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ qul lā yaʿlamu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi l-ghayba illā l-lahu wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna Say: "None (either) in the heavens or in the earth knoweth the unseen save God; And they perceive not when they shall be raised" See 27:62

item.title: An-Naml:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ ادَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْهَا بَلْ هُمْ مِنْهَا عَمُونَ bali iddāraka ʿil'muhum fī l-ākhirati bal hum fī shakkin min'hā bal hum min'hā ʿamūna Do they comprehend the knowledge of the Hereafter? No, they are in doubt about it. Rather they are blind to it.

item.title: An-Naml:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ ادَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْهَا بَلْ هُمْ مِنْهَا عَمُونَ bali iddāraka ʿil'muhum fī l-ākhirati bal hum fī shakkin min'hā bal hum min'hā ʿamūna Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind. See 27:65

item.title: An-Naml:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ ادَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْهَا بَلْ هُمْ مِنْهَا عَمُونَ bali iddāraka ʿil'muhum fī l-ākhirati bal hum fī shakkin min'hā bal hum min'hā ʿamūna Nay! hath reached them the knowledge about the hereafter; Nay! they are in doubt about it; Nay! they are blind unto it. See 27:62

item.title: An-Naml:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَءَابَاؤُنَا أَءِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū a-idhā kunnā turāban waābāunā a-innā lamukh'rajūna The faithless say, 'What! When we and our fathers have become dust shall we indeed be raised [from the dead]?

item.title: An-Naml:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَءَابَاؤُنَا أَءِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū a-idhā kunnā turāban waābāunā a-innā lamukh'rajūna And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out (of the graves)? And those who disbelieve say: When we have become dust – we and our fathers – shall we really be brought forth? (27:67). "Indeed we were promised this – we and our forefathers before, verily, these are nothing but tales of ancients (27:68). Say to them: "Travel in the land and see how has been the end of the criminals (27:69). And grieve you not over them, nor be straitened (in distress) because of what they plot (27:70). Scepticism about the Resurrection and Its Refutation Allah tells us about the idolators who deny the Resurrection, considering it extremely…

item.title: An-Naml:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَءَابَاؤُنَا أَءِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū a-idhā kunnā turāban waābāunā a-innā lamukh'rajūna And say those who disbelieve: "What! when we have become dust, and our fathers (too), shall we certainly be brought forth (again)?" See 27:62

item.title: An-Naml:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ laqad wuʿid'nā hādhā naḥnu waābāunā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna Certainly we and our fathers were promised this before. [But] these are just myths of the ancients.'

item.title: An-Naml:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ laqad wuʿid'nā hādhā naḥnu waābāunā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples." See 27:67

item.title: An-Naml:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ laqad wuʿid'nā hādhā naḥnu waābāunā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna Indeed we had been promised this, we and our fathers before (too); (But) these are naught but stories of yore 'Travel' here does not actually mean travelling throughout the earth, it means a proper study of the life of the nations which proves beyond doubt that their actions were not without the consequences and is evidence that the movement of the whole system of creation is not without consequences. This is in answer to the doubts which the short-sighted materialist expressed. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīna Say, 'Travel over the land and then observe how was the fate of the guilty.'

item.title: An-Naml:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Proceed (i.e., travel) through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals." See 27:67

item.title: An-Naml:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīna Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Travel ye in the earth and see how was the end of the guilty (ones)" See 27:68

item.title: An-Naml:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُنْ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā takun fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūna Do not grieve for them, and do not be upset by their guile.

item.title: An-Naml:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُنْ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā takun fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūna And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire. See 27:67

item.title: An-Naml:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُنْ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā takun fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūna And grieve thou not for them and be not distressed of what they devise. See 27:68

item.title: An-Naml:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna They say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: An-Naml:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And they say, "When is (the fulfillment of) this promise, if you should be truthful?" And they say: "When this promise, if you are truthful? (27:71). Say: "Perhaps that which you wish to hasten on, may be close behind you (27:72). Verily, your Lord is full of grace for mankind, yet most of them do not give thanks (27:73). And verily, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they reveal (27:74). And there is nothing hidden in the heaven and the earth but it is in a Clear Book (27:75). Allah tells us about how the idolators asked about the Day of Resurrection, but thought it unlikely that it would ever come to pass. وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ And they say:…

item.title: An-Naml:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And say they: "When shall this promise (of chastisement) come to pass, if ye be truthful?" See 27:68

item.title: An-Naml:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ qul ʿasā an yakūna radifa lakum baʿḍu alladhī tastaʿjilūna Say, 'Perhaps right behind you there is some of what you seek to hasten.'

item.title: An-Naml:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ qul ʿasā an yakūna radifa lakum baʿḍu alladhī tastaʿjilūna Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you (i.e., very near) - some of that for which you are impatient. See 27:71

item.title: An-Naml:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ qul ʿasā an yakūna radifa lakum baʿḍu alladhī tastaʿjilūna Say thou: "Maybe that it is after you, a part of what ye seek to hasten." See 27:68

item.title: An-Naml:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ wa-inna rabbaka ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna Indeed your Lord is gracious to mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.

item.title: An-Naml:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ wa-inna rabbaka ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful." See 27:71

item.title: An-Naml:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ wa-inna rabbaka ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna And verily thy Lord is the Lord of grace unto the people but most of them thank not. The grace of God referred to here, will be clear if this verse is read with the verse 27:10. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ wa-inna rabbaka layaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿ'linūna Your Lord indeed knows whatever their breasts conceal, and whatever they disclose.

item.title: An-Naml:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ wa-inna rabbaka layaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿ'linūna And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare. See 27:71

item.title: An-Naml:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ wa-inna rabbaka layaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿ'linūna And verily thy Lord well-knoweth what do enshroud their breasts and what they declare. See 27:73

item.title: An-Naml:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ غَائِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā min ghāibatin fī l-samāi wal-arḍi illā fī kitābin mubīnin There is no invisible thing in the heaven and the earth but it is in a manifest Book.1

item.title: An-Naml:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ غَائِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā min ghāibatin fī l-samāi wal-arḍi illā fī kitābin mubīnin And there is nothing concealed1 within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.2 See 27:71

item.title: An-Naml:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ غَائِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā min ghāibatin fī l-samāi wal-arḍi illā fī kitābin mubīnin Nothing is there hidden in the heavens and the earth but it is in the manifest Book. The Book manifest is the 'Lauh al-Mahfuz', i.e., the secured Tablet - it is called 'Mahfuz', i.e., secured because none else other than God has any hold on it. There is one point worth consideration, i.e., in the following verse God says that, 'Everything We have accommodated in the Imam' (36:12) (i.e., Guide) 'Manifest' in which case it could be said the Imam or the divinely commissioned guide is also endowed by God with the knowledge as a whole. This fact is proved by the Holy Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt, though not having any education under any mortal in this world and…

item.title: An-Naml:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَقُصُّ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ الَّذِي هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ inna hādhā l-qur'āna yaquṣṣu ʿalā banī is'rāīla akthara alladhī hum fīhi yakhtalifūna Indeed this Qur'ān recounts to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about,

item.title: An-Naml:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَقُصُّ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ الَّذِي هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ inna hādhā l-qur'āna yaquṣṣu ʿalā banī is'rāīla akthara alladhī hum fīhi yakhtalifūna Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree. Verily, this Qur'an narrates to the Children of Israel most of that in which they differ (27:76). And truly, it is a guide and a mercy for the believers (27:77). Verily, your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing (27:78). So, put your trust in Allah; surely, you are on manifest truth (27:79). Verily, you cannot make the dead to hear nor can you make the deaf to hear the call, when they flee, turning their backs (27:80). Nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can only make…

item.title: An-Naml:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَقُصُّ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ الَّذِي هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ inna hādhā l-qur'āna yaquṣṣu ʿalā banī is'rāīla akthara alladhī hum fīhi yakhtalifūna Verily this Qur'an relateth unto the children of Israel most of what they therein disagree. See 27:75

item.title: An-Naml:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-innahu lahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna and it is indeed a guidance and mercy for the faithful.

item.title: An-Naml:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-innahu lahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers. See 27:76

item.title: An-Naml:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-innahu lahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna And verily it is a (sure) guidance and mercy unto the believers. See 27:75

item.title: An-Naml:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ بِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum biḥuk'mihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement, and He is the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

item.title: An-Naml:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ بِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum biḥuk'mihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His (wise) judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing. See 27:76

item.title: An-Naml:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ بِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum biḥuk'mihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu Verily, thy Lord will judge between them by His (Own) decree, and He is the All- Mighty, All-Knowing. See 27:75

item.title: An-Naml:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innaka ʿalā l-ḥaqi l-mubīni So put your trust in Allah, for you indeed stand on the manifest truth.

item.title: An-Naml:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innaka ʿalā l-ḥaqi l-mubīni So rely upon Allah; indeed, you are upon the clear truth. See 27:76

item.title: An-Naml:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innaka ʿalā l-ḥaqi l-mubīni Then rely thou on God; verily thou art on the manifest truth. See 27:75

item.title: An-Naml:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰی وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīna Indeed you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs [upon you],

item.title: An-Naml:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰی وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīna Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating. See 27:76

item.title: An-Naml:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰی وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīna Verily thou canst not make the dead to listen nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they turn away backward. The dead, the deaf and the blind mentioned here are the disbelievers who never wanted to see the right way or to know the truth for they are so deeply sunk in falsehood. Refer to verse 35:22. God can make whomsoever He pleases to hear - but the Holy Prophet limits it just to make the living and the man of understanding to hear as stated here. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِي الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ wamā anta bihādī l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūna nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can make only those hear who believe in Our signs and who have submitted.

item.title: An-Naml:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِي الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ wamā anta bihādī l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūna And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims (i.e., submitting to Allah). See 27:76

item.title: An-Naml:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِي الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ wamā anta bihādī l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūna And nor canst thou be a guide unto the Blind against their straying; thou canst make none hear save those who believe in Our signs, so they have submitted themselves. See 27:80

item.title: An-Naml:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَابَّةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ لَا يُوقِنُونَ wa-idhā waqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim akhrajnā lahum dābbatan mina l-arḍi tukallimuhum anna l-nāsa kānū biāyātinā lā yūqinūna And when the word [of judgement] falls upon them, We shall bring out for them an Animal1 from the earth who shall speak to them that the people had no faith in Our signs.

item.title: An-Naml:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَابَّةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ لَا يُوقِنُونَ wa-idhā waqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim akhrajnā lahum dābbatan mina l-arḍi tukallimuhum anna l-nāsa kānū biāyātinā lā yūqinūna And when the word (i.e., decree) befalls them,1 We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, (saying) that the people were, of Our verses, not certain (in faith). And when the Word is fulfilled against them, We shall bring out from the earth a beast for them, to speak to them because mankind believed not with certainty in Our Ayat (27:82). The Emergence Of the Beast Of the Earth This is the beast which will emerge at the end of time, when mankind has become corrupt and neglected the commands of Allah and changed the true religion. Then Allah will cause a…

item.title: An-Naml:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَابَّةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ لَا يُوقِنُونَ wa-idhā waqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim akhrajnā lahum dābbatan mina l-arḍi tukallimuhum anna l-nāsa kānū biāyātinā lā yūqinūna And when the word shall come to pass on them, We shall bring forth unto them, a walking one from the earth who shall speak unto them, that the people believed not (with certainty') in Our signs. This verse should be read in the light of verse 3:109: to guide people and make them do good and prevent them from doing mischief - God brought forth the best living being - at the end when the final judgment is going to pass against them. The living being which will be brought out from the earth to speak to people must be of the same category, i.e., he should…

item.title: An-Naml:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِمَّنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ wayawma naḥshuru min kulli ummatin fawjan mimman yukadhibu biāyātinā fahum yūzaʿūna The day We shall resurrect1 from every nation a group of those who denied Our signs, and they shall be held in check.

item.title: An-Naml:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِمَّنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ wayawma naḥshuru min kulli ummatin fawjan mimman yukadhibu biāyātinā fahum yūzaʿūna And (warn of) the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be (driven) in rows. And (remember) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a Fawj of those who denied Our Ayat, and they shall be driven (27:83). Till, when they come, He will say: Did you deny My Ayat whereas you comprehended them not by knowledge, or what was it that you used to do? (27:84). And the Word will be fulfilled against them, because they have done wrong, and they will be unable to speak (27:85). See they not that We have made the night for them to rest therein, and…

item.title: An-Naml:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِمَّنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ wayawma naḥshuru min kulli ummatin fawjan mimman yukadhibu biāyātinā fahum yūzaʿūna And on the day when We will collect from every people a party from those who belied our signs, then will they be formed into groups. This verse indicates the 'Raj'ah' that when the Last Holy Imam Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Mehdi would appear s some of the staunch believers in God and those faithfully attached to the truth and those worst among the wicked ones would be resurrected to see their return for their own goodness and vices in this world itself before they meet the chastisement that awaits them after the Final Judgment.

item.title: An-Naml:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِءَايَاتِي وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوْۤا بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ḥattā idhā jāū qāla akadhabtum biāyātī walam tuḥīṭū bihā ʿil'man ammādhā kuntum taʿmalūna When they come, He will say, 'Did you deny My signs without comprehending them in knowledge? What was it that you used to do?'

item.title: An-Naml:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِءَايَاتِي وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوْۤا بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ḥattā idhā jāū qāla akadhabtum biāyātī walam tuḥīṭū bihā ʿil'man ammādhā kuntum taʿmalūna Until, when they arrive (at the place of Judgement), He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what (was it that) you were doing?" See 27:83

item.title: An-Naml:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِءَايَاتِي وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوْۤا بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ḥattā idhā jāū qāla akadhabtum biāyātī walam tuḥīṭū bihā ʿil'man ammādhā kuntum taʿmalūna Till they come before God (who will) say "Belied ye My signs while ye comprehended them not in your knowledge? or what is it ye were doing?" See 27:83

item.title: An-Naml:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا فَهُمْ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ wawaqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim bimā ẓalamū fahum lā yanṭiqūna And the word [of judgement] shall fall upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak.

item.title: An-Naml:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا فَهُمْ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ wawaqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim bimā ẓalamū fahum lā yanṭiqūna And the decree will befall them1 for the wrong they did, and they will not (be able to) speak. See 27:83

item.title: An-Naml:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا فَهُمْ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ wawaqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim bimā ẓalamū fahum lā yanṭiqūna And the word shall come to pass on them for they were unjust, and they shall speak not. See 27:83

item.title: An-Naml:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ alam yaraw annā jaʿalnā al-layla liyaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: An-Naml:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ alam yaraw annā jaʿalnā al-layla liyaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe. See 27:83

item.title: An-Naml:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ alam yaraw annā jaʿalnā al-layla liyaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna What! See they not that We have made the night that they may rest therein, and the day with light (to see); Verily, in this are signs for the people who believe? The change of the day and the night and the purpose they serve, bear clear testimony to the purposefulness of the plan of the Creator. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَاخِرِينَ wayawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fafaziʿa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu wakullun atawhu dākhirīna The day when the trumpet will be blown, whoever is in the heavens will be terrified and whoever is on the earth, except whomever Allah may wish, and all will come to Him in utter humility.

item.title: An-Naml:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَاخِرِينَ wayawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fafaziʿa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu wakullun atawhu dākhirīna And (warn of) the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled. And (remember) the Day on which the Trumpet (Şūr) will be blown – and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth, will be terrified except him whom Allah wills. And all shall come to Him, humbled (27:87). And you will see the mountains and think them solid, but they shall pass away as the passing away of the clouds. The work of…

item.title: An-Naml:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَاخِرِينَ wayawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fafaziʿa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu wakullun atawhu dākhirīna And the day when there shall be blown the Trumpet, and those in the heavens and those in the earth shall be terrorized, save him whom God willeth, and all shall come unto Him abased. Refers to the day of the Total Resurrection as it is clear from the verse. (A.P.).

item.title: An-Naml:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ watarā l-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidatan wahiya tamurru marra l-saḥābi ṣun'ʿa l-lahi alladhī atqana kulla shayin innahu khabīrun bimā tafʿalūna And you see the mountains, which you suppose to be stationary, while they drift like passing clouds —the handiwork of Allah who has made everything faultless. He is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: An-Naml:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ watarā l-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidatan wahiya tamurru marra l-saḥābi ṣun'ʿa l-lahi alladhī atqana kulla shayin innahu khabīrun bimā tafʿalūna And you see the mountains, thinking them motionless,1 while they will pass as the passing of clouds. (It is) the work of Allah, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Aware of that which you do. See 27:87

item.title: An-Naml:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ watarā l-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidatan wahiya tamurru marra l-saḥābi ṣun'ʿa l-lahi alladhī atqana kulla shayin innahu khabīrun bimā tafʿalūna And thou wilt see the mountains which thinkest thou firm, solid, pass away the pas sing of the (As pass the clouds in air.) clouds. It is the work of God Who hath made everything firm; Verily He is All-Aware of what (all) ye do. At the dawn of the Day of Judgment people would see the mountains blasted up into the skies and moving in the air as a cloud of dust. Refers to the continuous change in the material substance or substantial change in the matter which is the basis of evolution and the evidence of the purposefulness of the creation in…

item.title: An-Naml:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا وَهُمْ مِنْ فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ man jāa bil-ḥasanati falahu khayrun min'hā wahum min fazaʿin yawma-idhin āminūna Whoever brings virtue shall receive [a reward] better than it; and they shall be secure from terror on that day.

item.title: An-Naml:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا وَهُمْ مِنْ فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ man jāa bil-ḥasanati falahu khayrun min'hā wahum min fazaʿin yawma-idhin āminūna Whoever comes (at Judgement) with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe. See 27:87

item.title: An-Naml:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا وَهُمْ مِنْ فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ man jāa bil-ḥasanati falahu khayrun min'hā wahum min fazaʿin yawma-idhin āminūna Whosoever bringeth good, for him shall be better than it and they, of the terror of the day, be secure. See 27:88

item.title: An-Naml:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ waman jāa bil-sayi-ati fakubbat wujūhuhum fī l-nāri hal tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna And whoever brings vice —they shall be cast on their faces into the Fire [and told:] 'Shall you be requited except with what you used to do?'

item.title: An-Naml:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ waman jāa bil-sayi-ati fakubbat wujūhuhum fī l-nāri hal tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna And whoever comes with an evil deed1 - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, (and it will be said), "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?" See 27:87

item.title: An-Naml:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ waman jāa bil-sayi-ati fakubbat wujūhuhum fī l-nāri hal tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna And whosoever bringeth evil, these shall be cast down on their faces, in the (Hell) fire; Ye shall be recompensed for aught save what ye were doing. See 27:88

item.title: An-Naml:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ innamā umir'tu an aʿbuda rabba hādhihi l-baldati alladhī ḥarramahā walahu kullu shayin wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna 'Indeed I have been commanded to worship the Lord of this city1 who has made it inviolable2 and to whom all things belong, and I have been commanded to be among those who submit [to Allah],

item.title: An-Naml:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ innamā umir'tu an aʿbuda rabba hādhihi l-baldati alladhī ḥarramahā walahu kullu shayin wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna (Say, O Muḥammad), "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city,1 who made it sacred and to whom (belongs) all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims (i.e., those who submit to Allah). I have been commanded only to worship the Lord of this city, Who has sanctified it and to Whom belongs everything. And I am commanded to be from among the Muslims (27:91). And that I should recite the Qur'an, then whosoever receives guidance, receives it for the good of himself; and whosoever goes astray, say (to him): "I am only one of the warners (27:92). And…

item.title: An-Naml:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ innamā umir'tu an aʿbuda rabba hādhihi l-baldati alladhī ḥarramahā walahu kullu shayin wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna (Say thou unto them O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "I commanded only that I should serve the Lord of this city, Who am hath made it sacred, and His are all things, and commanded I am that I should be of the Muslims (those who have submitted themselves to God)," See 27:88

item.title: An-Naml:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَ الْقُرْآنَ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ wa-an atluwā l-qur'āna famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla faqul innamā anā mina l-mundhirīna and to recite the Qur'ān.' So whoever is guided is guided only for his own sake, and as for him who goes astray, say, 'I am just one of the warners.'

item.title: An-Naml:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَ الْقُرْآنَ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ wa-an atluwā l-qur'āna famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla faqul innamā anā mina l-mundhirīna And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for (the benefit of) himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only (one) of the warners." See 27:91

item.title: An-Naml:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَ الْقُرْآنَ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ wa-an atluwā l-qur'āna famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla faqul innamā anā mina l-mundhirīna And that I should recite the Qur'an: so whosoever is guided aright, he is guided aright for his (own self), and whosoever goeth astray, then say thou: "I am only of the warners." See 27:88

item.title: An-Naml:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ waquli l-ḥamdu lillahi sayurīkum āyātihi fataʿrifūnahā wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna And say, 'All praise belongs to Allah. Soon He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them.' And your Lord is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: An-Naml:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ waquli l-ḥamdu lillahi sayurīkum āyātihi fataʿrifūnahā wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna And say, "(All) praise is (due) to Allah. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do." See 27:91

item.title: An-Naml:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ waquli l-ḥamdu lillahi sayurīkum āyātihi fataʿrifūnahā wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna And say thou, "All praise is God's. Soon will He show you His signs that ye shall recognise them;" and thy Lord is not heed less of what all ye do. See 27:88

item.title: An-Nasr:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ idhā jāa naṣru l-lahi wal-fatḥu When Allah's help comes with victory,

item.title: An-Nasr:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ idhā jāa naṣru l-lahi wal-fatḥu When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest.1 إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ When there comes the help of Allah and the Conquest. was revealed, the Messenger of Allah SAW said: نُعِيَتْ إِلَيَّ نَفْسِي My death has been announced to me. And indeed he died during that year." Ahmad was alone in recording this Hadith. Al-Bukhari recorded that Aisha said, "The Messenger of Allah SAW used to say often in his bowing and prostrating: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي Glory to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me. He did this as his interpretation of the Qur'an (i.e., showing its implementation)." The rest of the group has also recorded this Hadith except for At-Tirmidhi. Imam Ahmad recorded from Masruq…

item.title: An-Nasr:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ idhā jāa naṣru l-lahi wal-fatḥu When cometh the help of God and the Victory The great prophecy was wonderfully fulfilled in the bloodless conquest of Mecca, and the other Arab tribes sent their deputations to the Holy Prophet and entered the folds of the faith, Islam, one after another. The world knows that the one, the Holy Prophet who was persecuted and hunted out of his birth-place Mecca, and who took refuge in Madina, could not be defeated or stopped from having his godly way, even by the most formidable forces of the Meccans and their confederates. His mission gradually made its way and all the wickedness and the treachery of the enemy, recoiled on the enemies themselves. Now this prophecy and the promise came from the Lord with which all the outlying parts of…

item.title: An-Nasr:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا wara-ayta l-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni l-lahi afwājan and you see the people entering Allah's religion in throngs,

item.title: An-Nasr:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا wara-ayta l-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni l-lahi afwājan And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes. See 110:1

item.title: An-Nasr:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا wara-ayta l-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni l-lahi afwājan And thou seest people entering the religion of God in multitudes See 110:1

item.title: An-Nasr:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa-is'taghfir'hu innahu kāna tawwāban then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and plead to Him for forgiveness. Indeed He is all-clement.

item.title: An-Nasr:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa-is'taghfir'hu innahu kāna tawwāban Then exalt (Him) with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.1 See 110:1

item.title: An-Nasr:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa-is'taghfir'hu innahu kāna tawwāban Celebrate then the praise of thy Lord and seek thou His protection (Refer to: 48:2 - Refer to note on 'Istighfar'.) , (for) verily He is Oft-Turning (merciful)! It is indirectly an ordinance for mankind to celebrate God's grace and glory, at each event of success in life and seek His grace through prayer and earn the protection through God's forgiveness of the shortcomings. 'Istighfar' in the case of a sinful being, means seeking the pardon of God and the same 'Istighfar' on the part of a sinless infallible one like the Holy Prophet and His Ahl Al-Bayt who have already been purified by the Lord Himself (33:33) will mean seeking further grace and the greater blessings or the further protection of the Lord against the…

item.title: An-Nisaa:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakumu alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wakhalaqa min'hā zawjahā wabatha min'humā rijālan kathīran wanisāan wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī tasāalūna bihi wal-arḥāma inna l-laha kāna ʿalaykum raqīban O mankind! Be wary of your Lord who created you from a single soul, and created its mate from it, and from the two of them, scattered numerous men and women. Be wary of Allah, in whose Name you adjure one another, and the wombs.1 Indeed Allah is watchful over you.

item.title: An-Nisaa:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakumu alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wakhalaqa min'hā zawjahā wabatha min'humā rijālan kathīran wanisāan wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī tasāalūna bihi wal-arḥāma inna l-laha kāna ʿalaykum raqīban O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul and created from it its mate and dispersed from both of them many men and women. And fear Allah, through whom1 you ask one another,2 and the wombs.3 Indeed Allah is ever,4 over you, an Observer.5

item.title: An-Nisaa:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakumu alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wakhalaqa min'hā zawjahā wabatha min'humā rijālan kathīran wanisāan wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī tasāalūna bihi wal-arḥāma inna l-laha kāna ʿalaykum raqīban O' men! take shelter in your Lord Who hath created you from a single self (Ar. 'Nafs' – Soul.) and created from it, its pair, and spread from these two, men manifold (Innumerable.) and women, and fear God, in Whose name ye importune one another, and (be mindful') of kinship; Verily God is vigilant over you. When it has to be addressed to the people (mankind) in general, the address has been as 'Ya ayyuha an-nas', i.e., 'O' people! And when the Jews or…

item.title: An-Nisaa:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰتُوْۤا الْيَتَامَى أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْخَبِيثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوْۤا أَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلَى أَمْوَالِكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حُوبًا كَبِيرًا waātū l-yatāmā amwālahum walā tatabaddalū l-khabītha bil-ṭayibi walā takulū amwālahum ilā amwālikum innahu kāna ḥūban kabīran Give the orphans their property, and do not replace the good with the bad, and do not eat up their property [by mingling it] with your own property, for that is indeed a great sin.1

item.title: An-Nisaa:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰتُوْۤا الْيَتَامَى أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْخَبِيثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوْۤا أَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلَى أَمْوَالِكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حُوبًا كَبِيرًا waātū l-yatāmā amwālahum walā tatabaddalū l-khabītha bil-ṭayibi walā takulū amwālahum ilā amwālikum innahu kāna ḥūban kabīran And give to the orphans their properties and do not substitute the defective (of your own) for the good (of theirs). And do not consume their properties into your own. Indeed, that is ever a great sin. And give unto orphans their property and do not exchange (your) bad things for (their) good ones; and devour not their substance (by adding it) to your substance. Surely, this is a great sin (4:2). And if you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls, then marry (other) women of your choice, two or three, or four; but if you fear that you shall…

item.title: An-Nisaa:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰتُوْۤا الْيَتَامَى أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْخَبِيثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوْۤا أَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلَى أَمْوَالِكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حُوبًا كَبِيرًا waātū l-yatāmā amwālahum walā tatabaddalū l-khabītha bil-ṭayibi walā takulū amwālahum ilā amwālikum innahu kāna ḥūban kabīran And give unto orphans (Refer to Verse 4:127.) their property, and substitute not (your) worthless things for (their) good ones, and devour not ye their property, along with your own; for verily it is a great crime. The Holy Prophet had been very seriously concerned with the welfare of the poor and particularly of the orphans. The anxiety with which the Holy Prophet has identified himself with the interest of the poor and the orphans, and the stress with which the attention of the believers regarding their duty towards service above self to the needy and the orphans, has been repeatedly invited, has no parallel in the history…

item.title: An-Nisaa:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوْۤا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوْۤا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْۤا فَوَاحِدَةً أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَلَّا تَعُولُوْۤا wa-in khif'tum allā tuq'siṭū fī l-yatāmā fa-inkiḥū mā ṭāba lakum mina l-nisāi mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa fa-in khif'tum allā taʿdilū fawāḥidatan aw mā malakat aymānukum dhālika adnā allā taʿūlū If you fear that you may not deal justly with the orphans,1 then marry [other] women that you like, two, three, or four. But if you fear that you may not treat them fairly, then [marry only] one, or [marry from among] your slave-women. That makes it likelier that you will not be unfair.

item.title: An-Nisaa:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوْۤا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوْۤا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْۤا فَوَاحِدَةً أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَلَّا تَعُولُوْۤا wa-in khif'tum allā tuq'siṭū fī l-yatāmā fa-inkiḥū mā ṭāba lakum mina l-nisāi mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa fa-in khif'tum allā taʿdilū fawāḥidatan aw mā malakat aymānukum dhālika adnā allā taʿūlū And if you fear that you will not deal justly with the orphan girls, then marry those that please you of (other) women, two or three or four. But if you fear that you will not be just, then (marry only) one or those your right hands possess (i.e., slaves). That is more suitable that you may not incline (to injustice). See 4:2

item.title: An-Nisaa:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوْۤا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوْۤا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْۤا فَوَاحِدَةً أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ذٰلِكَ أَدْنَى أَلَّا تَعُولُوْۤا wa-in khif'tum allā tuq'siṭū fī l-yatāmā fa-inkiḥū mā ṭāba lakum mina l-nisāi mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa fa-in khif'tum allā taʿdilū fawāḥidatan aw mā malakat aymānukum dhālika adnā allā taʿūlū And if ye fear that ye cannot act justly among the orphans (Female orphan.) then marry those who seem good to you, two, or three or four, and if ye fear that ye shall not deal justly (with so many) then (marry) one only, or (the slave women) whom your right hands have acquired; that is nigh keeping you from transgressing. Varied explanations to this Verse have been given by various commentators. The common or the popular interpretation is that if you are afraid…

item.title: An-Nisaa:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰتُوْۤا النِّسَاءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً فَإِنْ طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا waātū l-nisāa ṣaduqātihinna niḥ'latan fa-in ṭib'na lakum ʿan shayin min'hu nafsan fakulūhu hanīan marīan Give women their dowries as an obligation; but if they remit anything of it of their own accord, then consume it as [something] lawful and wholesome.

item.title: An-Nisaa:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰتُوْۤا النِّسَاءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً فَإِنْ طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا waātū l-nisāa ṣaduqātihinna niḥ'latan fa-in ṭib'na lakum ʿan shayin min'hu nafsan fakulūhu hanīan marīan And give the women (upon marriage) their (bridal) gifts1 graciously. But if they give up willingly to you anything of it, then take it in satisfaction and ease.2 See 4:2

item.title: An-Nisaa:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰتُوْۤا النِّسَاءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً فَإِنْ طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا waātū l-nisāa ṣaduqātihinna niḥ'latan fa-in ṭib'na lakum ʿan shayin min'hu nafsan fakulūhu hanīan marīan Give (Give without any restriction or even reluctance) away women their dowry freely (without any restraint)', but if, they of themselves (Voluntarily with pleasure of their own accord) (voluntarily with pleasure) remit unto you anything thereof, then (ye may) consume it with pleasure (and it shall be) wholesome (In fairness) (to you) (The position of honour, dignity and the right given to woman in Islam Is unique. No other religion in the world has ever given her Refer to Verses 4:19; 4:20.) . Dowry to a woman in marriage has been made by right and it has to be paid with pleasure to her. The system of compulsory payment of 'Mahr, i.e.,…

item.title: An-Nisaa:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُؤْتُوْۤا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَامًا وَارْزُقُوهُمْ فِيهَا وَاكْسُوهُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا walā tu'tū l-sufahāa amwālakumu allatī jaʿala l-lahu lakum qiyāman wa-ur'zuqūhum fīhā wa-ik'sūhum waqūlū lahum qawlan maʿrūfan Do not give the feeble-minded your property which Allah has assigned you to manage: provide for them out of it, and clothe them, and speak to them honourable words.

item.title: An-Nisaa:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُؤْتُوْۤا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَامًا وَارْزُقُوهُمْ فِيهَا وَاكْسُوهُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا walā tu'tū l-sufahāa amwālakumu allatī jaʿala l-lahu lakum qiyāman wa-ur'zuqūhum fīhā wa-ik'sūhum waqūlū lahum qawlan maʿrūfan And do not give the weak-minded your property,1 which Allah has made a means of sustenance for you, but provide for them with it and clothe them and speak to them words of appropriate kindness. And give not unto the unwise your wealth which Allah has made a means of support for you, but feed and clothe them therewith, and speak to them words of kindness and justice (4:5). And test orphans until they reach the age of marriage; if then you find sound judgment in them, release their property to them, but consume it not wastefully and hastily, fearing that they should grow up. And whoever among…

item.title: An-Nisaa:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُؤْتُوْۤا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَامًا وَارْزُقُوهُمْ فِيهَا وَاكْسُوهُمْ وَقُولُوْۤا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا walā tu'tū l-sufahāa amwālakumu allatī jaʿala l-lahu lakum qiyāman wa-ur'zuqūhum fīhā wa-ik'sūhum waqūlū lahum qawlan maʿrūfan And give not away to the weak in mind, your property which God hath made for you (a means of) your sustenance but maintain them therewith, and clothe them, and speak to them with kind words (for their good) (Note the care of and the treatment to the orphans enjoined by Islam.) ". The property mentioned here, is the property of the orphan entrusted. Before handing over the property to an orphan after he or she becomes a major, it must be made sure if the orphan can maintain it. It creates the necessity of a guardian in case of the weak in mind, whether minors or major.…

item.title: An-Nisaa:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَى حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغُوْۤا النِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ ءَانَسْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَا إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَنْ يَكْبَرُوْۤا وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا wa-ib'talū l-yatāmā ḥattā idhā balaghū l-nikāḥa fa-in ānastum min'hum rush'dan fa-id'faʿū ilayhim amwālahum walā takulūhā is'rāfan wabidāran an yakbarū waman kāna ghaniyyan falyastaʿfif waman kāna faqīran falyakul bil-maʿrūfi fa-idhā dafaʿtum ilayhim amwālahum fa-ashhidū ʿalayhim wakafā bil-lahi ḥasīban Test the orphans when they reach the age of marriage. Then if you discern in them maturity, deliver to them their property. And do not consume it lavishly and hastily lest they should grow up. As for him who is well-off, let him be abstemious, and as for him who is poor, let him eat in an honourable manner. And when you deliver to them their…

item.title: An-Nisaa:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَى حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغُوْۤا النِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ ءَانَسْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَا إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَنْ يَكْبَرُوْۤا وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا wa-ib'talū l-yatāmā ḥattā idhā balaghū l-nikāḥa fa-in ānastum min'hum rush'dan fa-id'faʿū ilayhim amwālahum walā takulūhā is'rāfan wabidāran an yakbarū waman kāna ghaniyyan falyastaʿfif waman kāna faqīran falyakul bil-maʿrūfi fa-idhā dafaʿtum ilayhim amwālahum fa-ashhidū ʿalayhim wakafā bil-lahi ḥasīban And test the orphans (in their abilities) until they reach marriageable age. Then if you perceive in them sound judgement, release their property to them. And do not consume it excessively and quickly, (anticipating) that they will grow up. And whoever, (when acting as guardian), is self-sufficient should refrain (from taking a fee); and whoever is poor - let him take according to what is acceptable.…

item.title: An-Nisaa:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَى حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغُوْۤا النِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ ءَانَسْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَا إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَنْ يَكْبَرُوْۤا وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا wa-ib'talū l-yatāmā ḥattā idhā balaghū l-nikāḥa fa-in ānastum min'hum rush'dan fa-id'faʿū ilayhim amwālahum walā takulūhā is'rāfan wabidāran an yakbarū waman kāna ghaniyyan falyastaʿfif waman kāna faqīran falyakul bil-maʿrūfi fa-idhā dafaʿtum ilayhim amwālahum fa-ashhidū ʿalayhim wakafā bil-lahi ḥasīban And test the orphans until they reach (age marriageable) if ye find in them maturity, then make over to them their property, and consume it not wastefully and hastily lest (Fearing that) they grow to full age; and he (the guardian) who is rich, let him abstain (altogether) and he who is poor let him consume (eat) (for) (himself) reasonably; And when ye make over to…

item.title: An-Nisaa:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ وَلِلنِّسَاءِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ مِمَّا قَلَّ مِنْهُ أَوْ كَثُرَ نَصِيبًا مَفْرُوضًا lilrrijāli naṣībun mimmā taraka l-wālidāni wal-aqrabūna walilnnisāi naṣībun mimmā taraka l-wālidāni wal-aqrabūna mimmā qalla min'hu aw kathura naṣīban mafrūḍan Men have a share in the heritage left by parents and near relatives, and women have a share in the heritage left by parents and near relatives, whether it be little or much, a share ordained [by Allah].

item.title: An-Nisaa:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ وَلِلنِّسَاءِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ مِمَّا قَلَّ مِنْهُ أَوْ كَثُرَ نَصِيبًا مَفْرُوضًا lilrrijāli naṣībun mimmā taraka l-wālidāni wal-aqrabūna walilnnisāi naṣībun mimmā taraka l-wālidāni wal-aqrabūna mimmā qalla min'hu aw kathura naṣīban mafrūḍan For men is a share of what the parents and close relatives leave, and for women is a share of what the parents and close relatives leave, be it little or much - an obligatory share. There is a share for men and a share for women from what is left by parents and those nearest in relation, whether the property be small or large – a legal share (4:7). And when the relatives, and the orphans, and the poor are present at the time of division, give them from the property, and speak to them words of kindness and justice (4:8).…

item.title: An-Nisaa:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ وَلِلنِّسَاءِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ مِمَّا قَلَّ مِنْهُ أَوْ كَثُرَ نَصِيبًا مَفْرُوضًا lilrrijāli naṣībun mimmā taraka l-wālidāni wal-aqrabūna walilnnisāi naṣībun mimmā taraka l-wālidāni wal-aqrabūna mimmā qalla min'hu aw kathura naṣīban mafrūḍan For men shall be a share in what their parents and kindred leave and for women (Note that men and women both are given the right of inheritance) shall be a share in what their parents and kindred leave, be it little or much; (It is) a decreed (allotment of) share (Refer to Verse 2:180.) . It is quite clear from the law of inheritance of Islam how far at its very beginning strikes a death blow to wealth being accumulated with any one person and its remaining stagnant there, starving the other members of the family, of the benefit at least…

item.title: An-Nisaa:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُوْۤا الْقُرْبٰی وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهُ وَقُولُوْۤا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا wa-idhā ḥaḍara l-qis'mata ulū l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīnu fa-ur'zuqūhum min'hu waqūlū lahum qawlan maʿrūfan And when the division is attended by relatives, the orphans and the needy, provide for them out of it, and speak to them honourable words.

item.title: An-Nisaa:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُوْۤا الْقُرْبٰی وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهُ وَقُولُوْۤا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا wa-idhā ḥaḍara l-qis'mata ulū l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīnu fa-ur'zuqūhum min'hu waqūlū lahum qawlan maʿrūfan And when (other) relatives and orphans and the needy are present at the (time of) division, then provide for them (something) out of it (i.e., the estate) and speak to them words of appropriate kindness. See 4:7

item.title: An-Nisaa:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُوْۤا الْقُرْبٰی وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهُ وَقُولُوْۤا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا wa-idhā ḥaḍara l-qis'mata ulū l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīnu fa-ur'zuqūhum min'hu waqūlū lahum qawlan maʿrūfan And when at the division are present those of kin (Note The extent of the fellow feeling Islam ordains to the extent of having a share in one's fortune) , and orphans and the needy, provide them also with (something) from it, And speak to them kind words. The relatives and the orphans mentioned in this Verse are those who may not be entitled to inherit by any right. The consideration shown here even to the distant relatives and the orphans and the needy is not to be found in any other religious order in the world.

item.title: An-Nisaa:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوْۤا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا خَافُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلْيَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْيَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا walyakhsha alladhīna law tarakū min khalfihim dhurriyyatan ḍiʿāfan khāfū ʿalayhim falyattaqū l-laha walyaqūlū qawlan sadīdan Let those fear [the result of mistreating orphans] who, were they to leave behind weak offspring, would be concerned on their account. So let them be wary of Allah, and let them speak upright words.

item.title: An-Nisaa:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوْۤا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا خَافُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلْيَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْيَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا walyakhsha alladhīna law tarakū min khalfihim dhurriyyatan ḍiʿāfan khāfū ʿalayhim falyattaqū l-laha walyaqūlū qawlan sadīdan And let those (executors and guardians) fear (injustice) as if they (themselves) had left weak offspring behind and feared for them. So let them fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice. See 4:7

item.title: An-Nisaa:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوْۤا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا خَافُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلْيَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْيَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا walyakhsha alladhīna law tarakū min khalfihim dhurriyyatan ḍiʿāfan khāfū ʿalayhim falyattaqū l-laha walyaqūlū qawlan sadīdan And let those fear (against hurting the Orphans) who, should they leave behind them weakly offspring, would fear on their account, so let them fear (Fear of God the main caution Islam give to every individual.) God and let them speak the right words. The argument in this Verse appealing to every individual man or woman on earth with reference to their feelings about their own issue, if be left in the situation is another proof positive that nothing does Islam prescribe for its adherents which does not appeal to reasoning in every man or woman. Islam wants everyone to treat the issues of their brethren in the like manner…

item.title: An-Nisaa:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَالَ الْيَتَامَى ظُلْمًا إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ نَارًا وَسَيَصْلَوْنَ سَعِيرًا inna alladhīna yakulūna amwāla l-yatāmā ẓul'man innamā yakulūna fī buṭūnihim nāran wasayaṣlawna saʿīran Indeed those who consume the property of orphans wrongfully, only ingest fire into their bellies, and soon they will enter the Blaze.

item.title: An-Nisaa:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَالَ الْيَتَامَى ظُلْمًا إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ نَارًا وَسَيَصْلَوْنَ سَعِيرًا inna alladhīna yakulūna amwāla l-yatāmā ẓul'man innamā yakulūna fī buṭūnihim nāran wasayaṣlawna saʿīran Indeed, those who devour the property of orphans unjustly are only consuming into their bellies fire. And they will be burned in a Blaze (i.e., Hellfire). See 4:7

item.title: An-Nisaa:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَالَ الْيَتَامَى ظُلْمًا إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ نَارًا وَسَيَصْلَوْنَ سَعِيرًا inna alladhīna yakulūna amwāla l-yatāmā ẓul'man innamā yakulūna fī buṭūnihim nāran wasayaṣlawna saʿīran Verily, those who eat away the properties of the orphans unjustly, they swallow (only) fire into their bellies; and anon shall they (Meet – embrace.) enter the blazing Hell-fire. The example given here indicates the grave nature of the crime. It is related by the Holy Prophet that on the Day of Resurrection some people will rise with fire blazing out from their mouths. The crowd witnessing them will ask who are they. The reply to the query will be: 'These are the people who devoured the properties of the orphans' (M.S.)

item.title: An-Nisaa:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلَادِكُمْ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ فَإِنْ كُنَّ نِسَاءً فَوْقَ اثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَهُنَّ ثُلُثَا مَا تَرَكَ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ وَاحِدَةً فَلَهَا النِّصْفُ وَلِأَبَوَيْهِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ مِمَّا تَرَكَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَوَرِثَهُ أَبَوَاهُ فَلِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ إِخْوَةٌ فَلِأُمِّهِ السُّدُسُ مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصِي بِهَا أَوْ دَيْنٍ ءَابَاؤُكُمْ وَأَبْنَاؤُكُمْ لَا تَدْرُونَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ لَكُمْ نَفْعًا فَرِيضَةً مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا yūṣīkumu l-lahu fī awlādikum lildhakari mith'lu ḥaẓẓi l-unthayayni fa-in kunna nisāan fawqa ith'natayni falahunna thuluthā mā taraka wa-in kānat wāḥidatan falahā l-niṣ'fu wali-abawayhi likulli wāḥidin min'humā l-sudusu mimmā taraka in kāna lahu waladun fa-in lam yakun lahu waladun wawarithahu abawāhu fali-ummihi l-thuluthu fa-in kāna lahu ikh'watun fali-ummihi l-sudusu min baʿdi waṣiyyatin yūṣī bihā aw daynin ābāukum wa-abnāukum lā tadrūna ayyuhum aqrabu lakum nafʿan farīḍatan mina l-lahi inna l-laha kāna…

item.description: يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلَادِكُمْ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ فَإِنْ كُنَّ نِسَاءً فَوْقَ اثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَهُنَّ ثُلُثَا مَا تَرَكَ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ وَاحِدَةً فَلَهَا النِّصْفُ وَلِأَبَوَيْهِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ مِمَّا تَرَكَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَوَرِثَهُ أَبَوَاهُ فَلِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ إِخْوَةٌ فَلِأُمِّهِ السُّدُسُ مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصِي بِهَا أَوْ دَيْنٍ ءَابَاؤُكُمْ وَأَبْنَاؤُكُمْ لَا تَدْرُونَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ لَكُمْ نَفْعًا فَرِيضَةً مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا yūṣīkumu l-lahu fī awlādikum lildhakari mith'lu ḥaẓẓi l-unthayayni fa-in kunna nisāan fawqa ith'natayni falahunna thuluthā mā taraka wa-in kānat wāḥidatan falahā l-niṣ'fu wali-abawayhi likulli wāḥidin min'humā l-sudusu mimmā taraka in kāna lahu waladun fa-in lam yakun lahu waladun wawarithahu abawāhu fali-ummihi l-thuluthu fa-in kāna lahu ikh'watun fali-ummihi l-sudusu min baʿdi waṣiyyatin yūṣī bihā aw daynin ābāukum wa-abnāukum lā tadrūna ayyuhum aqrabu lakum nafʿan farīḍatan mina l-lahi inna l-laha kāna…

item.title: An-Nisaa:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَكُمْ نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ أَزْوَاجُكُمْ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ فَلَكُمُ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْنَ مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصِينَ بِهَا أَوْ دَيْنٍ وَلَهُنَّ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكُمْ وَلَدٌ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ وَلَدٌ فَلَهُنَّ الثُّمُنُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ تُوصُونَ بِهَا أَوْ دَيْنٍ وَإِنْ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُورَثُ كَلَالَةً أَوِ امْرَأَةٌ وَلَهُ أَخٌ أَوْ أُخْتٌ فَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ فَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ فَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فِي الثُّلُثِ مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصَى بِهَا أَوْ دَيْنٍ غَيْرَ مُضَارٍّ وَصِيَّةً مِنَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَلِيمٌ walakum niṣ'fu mā taraka azwājukum in lam yakun lahunna waladun fa-in kāna lahunna waladun falakumu l-rubuʿu mimmā tarakna min baʿdi waṣiyyatin yūṣīna bihā aw daynin walahunna l-rubuʿu mimmā taraktum in lam yakun lakum waladun fa-in kāna lakum waladun falahunna l-thumunu mimmā taraktum min baʿdi waṣiyyatin tūṣūna bihā aw daynin wa-in kāna rajulun…
