item.description: يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi wayuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wakadhālika tukh'rajūna He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.1 See 30:17

item.title: Ar-Room:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi wayuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wakadhālika tukh'rajūna He bringeth forth the living from the dead and bringeth forth dead from the living, and giveth life to the earth after its death, and thus shall ye (too) be brought forth (after ye are dead). Nothing in this world has been a perpetual existence. The process of extinction and revival is a mysterious purposeful working of nature. The creative process is in its constant course and the cycle of appearance and the disappearance of the things in this world is continuously at its work. The Seventh Holy Imam Musa ibn Jafer al-Kadhim said that by a 'being' given life after its death, means God sending His chosen men to enliven the…

item.title: Ar-Room:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُونَ wamin āyātihi an khalaqakum min turābin thumma idhā antum basharun tantashirūna Of His signs is that He created you from dust, then, behold, you are humans scattering [all over]!

item.title: Ar-Room:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُونَ wamin āyātihi an khalaqakum min turābin thumma idhā antum basharun tantashirūna And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing (throughout the earth). And among His signs is this that He created you from dust, and then – behold you are human beings scattered (30:20). And among His signs is this that He created for you wives from among yourselves, that you may find repose in them, and He has put between you affection and mercy. Verily, in that are indeed signs for a people who reflect (30:21). Among the Signs of Allah Allah says: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ And among His signs – which speak of His might and power, is the fact that He created your father Adam out of…

item.title: Ar-Room:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُونَ wamin āyātihi an khalaqakum min turābin thumma idhā antum basharun tantashirūna And of His signs is that He created you from dust, then lo I ye are human beings scattering (in the world). See 30:19

item.title: Ar-Room:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ wamin āyātihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājan litaskunū ilayhā wajaʿala baynakum mawaddatan waraḥmatan inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna And of His signs is that He created for you mates from your own selves that you may take comfort in them, and He ordained affection and mercy between you. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: Ar-Room:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ wamin āyātihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājan litaskunū ilayhā wajaʿala baynakum mawaddatan waraḥmatan inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought. See 30:20

item.title: Ar-Room:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ wamin āyātihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājan litaskunū ilayhā wajaʿala baynakum mawaddatan waraḥmatan inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves, mates that ye may dwell (inclined) unto them, and caused between you love and compassion: Verily in this are signs for a people who reflect. The wonderful love between (man and woman), i.e., (husband and wife) is the grace of God.1 This is the fundamental object of the alliance between the couples - of the same origin, and love and compassion is the only means to achieve that aim. (A.P.).

item.title: Ar-Room:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَانِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْعَالِمِينَ wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfu alsinatikum wa-alwānikum inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'ʿālimīna Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. There are indeed signs in that for those who know.

item.title: Ar-Room:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَانِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْعَالِمِينَ wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfu alsinatikum wa-alwānikum inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'ʿālimīna And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge. And among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colors. Verily, in that are indeed signs for men of sound knowledge (30:22). And among His signs is your sleep by night and by day, and your seeking His bounty. Verily, in that are indeed signs for a people who listen.) Allah sai (30:23). وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ And among His signs indicating His magnificent power. خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ is the creation of the heavens…

item.title: Ar-Room:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَانِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْعَالِمِينَ wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfu alsinatikum wa-alwānikum inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'ʿālimīna And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the variety of your languages and your complexions; verily in this are signs for the learned (who can ponder on matters serious.) (ones). Refers to the development of the various languages and clauses which are of the most complicated subjects of the human strides. (A.P.).

item.title: Ar-Room:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَاؤُكُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ wamin āyātihi manāmukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wa-ib'tighāukum min faḍlihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūna And of His signs is your sleep by night and day, and your pursuit of His grace. There are indeed signs in that for a people who listen.

item.title: Ar-Room:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَاؤُكُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ wamin āyātihi manāmukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wa-ib'tighāukum min faḍlihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūna And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen. See 30:22

item.title: Ar-Room:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَاؤُكُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ wamin āyātihi manāmukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wa-ib'tighāukum min faḍlihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūna And of His signs is your sleeping by night and day and your seeking of His grace; verily in this are signs for a people who would (who interestedly listen.) hear. See 30:22

item.title: Ar-Room:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَيُحْيِي بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wamin āyātihi yurīkumu l-barqa khawfan waṭamaʿan wayunazzilu mina l-samāi māan fayuḥ'yī bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna And of His signs is that He shows you the lightning, arousing fear and hope, and He sends down water from the sky, and with it revives the earth after its death. There are indeed signs in that for a people who apply reason.

item.title: Ar-Room:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَيُحْيِي بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wamin āyātihi yurīkumu l-barqa khawfan waṭamaʿan wayunazzilu mina l-samāi māan fayuḥ'yī bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna And of His signs is (that) He shows you the lightning (causing) fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason. And among His signs is that He shows you the lightning, for fear and for hope, and He sends down water from the sky, and therewith revives the earth after its death. Verily, in that are indeed signs for a people who understand (30:24). And among His signs is that the heaven and…

item.title: Ar-Room:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَيُحْيِي بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ wamin āyātihi yurīkumu l-barqa khawfan waṭamaʿan wayunazzilu mina l-samāi māan fayuḥ'yī bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna And of His signs is that He sheweth you the lightning causing awe and hope, and sendeth down from the heavens water and giveth life with it to the earth after its death; verily in this are signs for a people who (who have the intelligence with the insight to understand things beyond the apparent or the immediate.) understand. See 30:22

item.title: Ar-Room:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ تَقُومَ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ wamin āyātihi an taqūma l-samāu wal-arḍu bi-amrihi thumma idhā daʿākum daʿwatan mina l-arḍi idhā antum takhrujūna And of His signs is that the sky and the earth stand by His command, and then, when He calls you forth from the earth, behold, you will come forth.

item.title: Ar-Room:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ تَقُومَ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ wamin āyātihi an taqūma l-samāu wal-arḍu bi-amrihi thumma idhā daʿākum daʿwatan mina l-arḍi idhā antum takhrujūna And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand (i.e., remain) by His command. Then when He calls you with a (single) call from the earth, immediately you will come forth. See 30:24

item.title: Ar-Room:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ تَقُومَ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ wamin āyātihi an taqūma l-samāu wal-arḍu bi-amrihi thumma idhā daʿākum daʿwatan mina l-arḍi idhā antum takhrujūna And of His signs is that the heavens and the earth stand firm by His command; then (after your death) when He summoneth you with a (single) summons from out of the earth, lo! ye come (Resurrected.) forth It refers to the fact that the cohesive force holding the dimensional realms cannot be but the non-material one, which cannot be explained in any term but as His will. (A.P.)

item.title: Ar-Room:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَهُ قَانِتُونَ walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kullun lahu qānitūna To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient to Him.

item.title: Ar-Room:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَهُ قَانِتُونَ walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kullun lahu qānitūna And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient to Him (30:26). And He it is Who originates the creation, then He will repeat it; and this is easier for Him. His is the highest description in the heavens and in the earth. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.) Allah say (30:27). وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. means, He owns it and it is enslaved to Him. كُلٌّ لَهُ قَانِتُونَ All are obedient to Him. they are humble before Him and submit to Him, whether willingly or unwillingly. Repeating…

item.title: Ar-Room:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَهُ قَانِتُونَ walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kullun lahu qānitūna And His is whosoever is in the heavens and the earth: all are subservient unto Him. See 30:25

item.title: Ar-Room:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰی فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ wahuwa alladhī yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu wahuwa ahwanu ʿalayhi walahu l-mathalu l-aʿlā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu It is He who originates the creation, and then He will bring it back —and that is more simple for Him. His is the loftiest description in the heavens and the earth. And He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Ar-Room:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰی فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ wahuwa alladhī yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu wahuwa ahwanu ʿalayhi walahu l-mathalu l-aʿlā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is (even) easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description (i.e., attribute) in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 30:26

item.title: Ar-Room:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰی فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ wahuwa alladhī yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu wahuwa ahwanu ʿalayhi walahu l-mathalu l-aʿlā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu And He it is Who originateth the creation, then causeth it to return again, and to Him it is most easy; His are the most exalted similitudes (The attributes beyond our imagination.) in the heavens and the earth; and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. See 30:25

item.title: Ar-Room:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ لَكُمْ مَثَلًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ هَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ مِنْ شُرَكَاءَ فِي مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ فَأَنْتُمْ فِیْهِ سَوَاءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ḍaraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum min mā malakat aymānukum min shurakāa fī mā razaqnākum fa-antum fīhi sawāon takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum anfusakum kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿqilūna He draws for you an example from yourselves: Do you have among your slaves any partners [who may share] in what We have provided you, so that you are equal in its respect, and you revere them as you revere one another?1 Thus do We elaborate2 the signs for a people who apply reason.

item.title: Ar-Room:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ لَكُمْ مَثَلًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ هَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ مِنْ شُرَكَاءَ فِي مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ فَأَنْتُمْ فِیْهِ سَوَاءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ḍaraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum min mā malakat aymānukum min shurakāa fī mā razaqnākum fa-antum fīhi sawāon takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum anfusakum kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿqilūna He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess (i.e., slaves) any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein (and) would fear them as your fear of one another (within a partnership)?1 Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason. He sets forth for you a parable from yourselves: Do you have partners among those whom your right hands possess to share as equals in the…

item.title: Ar-Room:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ لَكُمْ مَثَلًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ هَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ مِنْ شُرَكَاءَ فِي مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ فَأَنْتُمْ فِیْهِ سَوَاءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ḍaraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum min mā malakat aymānukum min shurakāa fī mā razaqnākum fa-antum fīhi sawāon takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum anfusakum kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿqilūna He setteth forth unto you a parable of yourselves. Have ye of those whom your right hands possess partners in what We have provided you for sustenance, so that in regard to it, ye are alike, Fear ye them as ye fear each other? Thus We make clear Our signs for a people who understand. It compares all the physical and spiritual forces dominating and working in the system of the Universe as the activities of a slave, i.e., one whose power and actions are subservient…

item.title: Ar-Room:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَمَنْ يَهْدِي مَنْ أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ bali ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū ahwāahum bighayri ʿil'min faman yahdī man aḍalla l-lahu wamā lahum min nāṣirīna Rather the wrongdoers follow their own desires without any knowledge. So who will guide those whom Allah has led astray? They will have no helpers.

item.title: Ar-Room:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَمَنْ يَهْدِي مَنْ أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ bali ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū ahwāahum bighayri ʿil'min faman yahdī man aḍalla l-lahu wamā lahum min nāṣirīna But those who wrong follow their (own) desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allah has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers. See 30:28

item.title: Ar-Room:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَمَنْ يَهْدِي مَنْ أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ bali ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū ahwāahum bighayri ʿil'min faman yahdī man aḍalla l-lahu wamā lahum min nāṣirīna Nay! those who are unjust follow their vain desires without any knowledge: Who can guide him whom God hath allowed to err? There shall not be for them any of the helpers. See 30:28

item.title: Ar-Room:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا فِطْرَتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan fiṭ'rata l-lahi allatī faṭara l-nāsa ʿalayhā lā tabdīla likhalqi l-lahi dhālika l-dīnu l-qayimu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna So set your heart on the religion as a people of pure faith, the origination of Allah according to which He originated mankind (There is no altering Allah's creation; that is the upright religion, but most people do not know.)

item.title: Ar-Room:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا فِطْرَتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan fiṭ'rata l-lahi allatī faṭara l-nāsa ʿalayhā lā tabdīla likhalqi l-lahi dhālika l-dīnu l-qayimu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna So direct your face (i.e., self) toward the religion, inclining to truth. (Adhere to) the fiṭrah1 of Allah upon which He has created (all) people. No change should there be in the creation of Allah.2 That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know. So, set you your face towards the religion as a Hanif. Allah's Fitrah with which He has created mankind. No change let there be in Allah's Khalq, that is the straight religion, but most men know not (30:30). (And remain always) turning in repentance to Him and have…

item.title: Ar-Room:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا فِطْرَتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan fiṭ'rata l-lahi allatī faṭara l-nāsa ʿalayhā lā tabdīla likhalqi l-lahi dhālika l-dīnu l-qayimu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna Then set thou thy face uprightly (The nature on which God made man.) for (the right) religion, in natural devotion to the truth (following) the nature caused by God in which He hath made the people; No change can there be (by any one else) in the creation of God; This (uprightness) is the established (See verse 9:36.) religion; but most people know not, Religion here stands for Islam, i.e., to be steadfast on Islam is to be ever submitting to God's will by living according to His law 'Shariah.' It is a death blow to…

item.title: Ar-Room:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ munībīna ilayhi wa-ittaqūhu wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata walā takūnū mina l-mush'rikīna —turning to Him in penitence, and be wary of Him, and maintain the prayer, and do not be among the polytheists

item.title: Ar-Room:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ munībīna ilayhi wa-ittaqūhu wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata walā takūnū mina l-mush'rikīna (Adhere to it), turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah. See 30:30

item.title: Ar-Room:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ munībīna ilayhi wa-ittaqūhu wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata walā takūnū mina l-mush'rikīna Turning unto Him and fear His wrath and establish prayer and be not of the polytheists, See 30:30

item.title: Ar-Room:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوْۤا دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوْۤا شِيَعًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ mina alladhīna farraqū dīnahum wakānū shiyaʿan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna —of those who split up their religion and became sects: each faction exulting in what it possessed.

item.title: Ar-Room:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوْۤا دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوْۤا شِيَعًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ mina alladhīna farraqū dīnahum wakānū shiyaʿan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna (Or) of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.1 See 30:30

item.title: Ar-Room:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوْۤا دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوْۤا شِيَعًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ mina alladhīna farraqū dīnahum wakānū shiyaʿan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna Of those who split up their religion, and have become sects, every party rejoiceth in what is with them. The groups who rejoice here in this life, will be cursing each other at the end.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Ar-Room:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُمْ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَذَاقَهُمْ مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ wa-idhā massa l-nāsa ḍurrun daʿaw rabbahum munībīna ilayhi thumma idhā adhāqahum min'hu raḥmatan idhā farīqun min'hum birabbihim yush'rikūna When distress befalls people, they supplicate their Lord, turning to Him in penitence. Then, when He lets them taste His mercy, behold, a part of them ascribe partners to their Lord,

item.title: Ar-Room:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُمْ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَذَاقَهُمْ مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ wa-idhā massa l-nāsa ḍurrun daʿaw rabbahum munībīna ilayhi thumma idhā adhāqahum min'hu raḥmatan idhā farīqun min'hum birabbihim yush'rikūna And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord. And when harm touches men, they cry sincerely only to their Lord, turning to Him in repentance; but when He gives them a taste of His mercy, behold, a party of them associates partners in worship with their Lord (30:33). So as to be ungrateful for the graces which We have bestowed on them. Then enjoy; but you will come to know (30:34). Or have We revealed to…

item.title: Ar-Room:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُمْ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَذَاقَهُمْ مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ wa-idhā massa l-nāsa ḍurrun daʿaw rabbahum munībīna ilayhi thumma idhā adhāqahum min'hu raḥmatan idhā farīqun min'hum birabbihim yush'rikūna And when afflicteth the people any harm call they upon their Lord turning unto Him, then when He causeth them taste of mercy from unto Him, lo! some of them associate partners with their Lord, See 30:32

item.title: Ar-Room:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūna being ungrateful toward what We have given them. So let them enjoy. Soon they will know!

item.title: Ar-Room:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūna So that they will deny what We have granted them.1 Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know. See 30:33

item.title: Ar-Room:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūna Let them be ungrateful for what We have given them; But enjoy ye (only for a while) for soon shall ye (the consequence or the end.) know. See 30:32

item.title: Ar-Room:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يُشْرِكُونَ am anzalnā ʿalayhim sul'ṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānū bihi yush'rikūna Have We sent down to them any authority which might speak of what they associate with Him?

item.title: Ar-Room:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يُشْرِكُونَ am anzalnā ʿalayhim sul'ṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānū bihi yush'rikūna Or have We sent down to them an authority (i.e., a proof or scripture), and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him? See 30:33

item.title: Ar-Room:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يُشْرِكُونَ am anzalnā ʿalayhim sul'ṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānū bihi yush'rikūna Or, have We sent down upon them any authority that it speaketh of what they associate with Him? See 30:32

item.title: Ar-Room:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوْۤا بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan fariḥū bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim idhā hum yaqnaṭūna And when We let people taste [Our] mercy, they exult in it; but should an ill visit them because of what their hands have sent ahead, behold, they become despondent!

item.title: Ar-Room:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوْۤا بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan fariḥū bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim idhā hum yaqnaṭūna And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair. See 30:33

item.title: Ar-Room:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوْۤا بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan fariḥū bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim idhā hum yaqnaṭūna And when We make people taste of mercy they rejoice in it, and if befalleth them an evil for what have already wrought their (own) hands, lo! they are in despair. See 30:32

item.title: Ar-Room:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yaraw anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Do they not see that Allah expands the provision for whomever He wishes, and tightens it? There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: Ar-Room:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yaraw anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Do they not see that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts (it)? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe. See 30:33

item.title: Ar-Room:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yaraw anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna What! See they not that God amplifieth the provision for whomsoever He willeth and straiteneth? (For whomsoever He willeth.) Verily in this are signs for a people who believe. See 30:32

item.title: Ar-Room:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَاتِ ذَا الْقُرْبٰی حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ faāti dhā l-qur'bā ḥaqqahu wal-mis'kīna wa-ib'na l-sabīli dhālika khayrun lilladhīna yurīdūna wajha l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Give the relative his right, and the needy and the traveller [as well]. That is better for those who seek Allah's pleasure, and it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: Ar-Room:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَاتِ ذَا الْقُرْبٰی حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ faāti dhā l-qur'bā ḥaqqahu wal-mis'kīna wa-ib'na l-sabīli dhālika khayrun lilladhīna yurīdūna wajha l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face (i.e., approval) of Allah, and it is they who will be the successful. So, give to the kindred his due, and to Al-Miskin and to the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek Allah's Face; and it is they who will be successful (30:38). And that which you give in Riba in order that it may increase from other people's property, has no increase with Allah; but that which you give in Zakah seeking Allah's Face, then those they shall have manifold increase (30:39).…

item.title: Ar-Room:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَاتِ ذَا الْقُرْبٰی حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ faāti dhā l-qur'bā ḥaqqahu wal-mis'kīna wa-ib'na l-sabīli dhālika khayrun lilladhīna yurīdūna wajha l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Then give thou to the near of kin his due, and to the needy, and the wayfarer; this is best for those who desire the pleasure of God, and these it is who are the successful ones. It is noteworthy that how could the Holy Prophet have ever ignored this definite ordinance about his own duty in this regard, to his issues and relatives. When this verse was revealed, the Holy Prophet called his daughter Lady Fatima and conveyed to her the right over the possession of the garden of Fadak which was confiscated immediately as the Holy Prophet departed from this world. (See the note on this)1.…

item.title: Ar-Room:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ءَاتَيْتُمْ مِنْ رِبًا لِيَرْبُوَا فِي أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوْۤا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَمَا ءَاتَيْتُمْ مِنْ زَكَوةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُونَ wamā ātaytum min riban liyarbuwā fī amwāli l-nāsi falā yarbū ʿinda l-lahi wamā ātaytum min zakatin turīdūna wajha l-lahi fa-ulāika humu l-muḍ'ʿifūna That which you give in usury in order that it may increase people's wealth does not increase with Allah. But what you pay as zakāt seeking Allah's pleasure —it is they who will be given a manifold increase.

item.title: Ar-Room:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ءَاتَيْتُمْ مِنْ رِبًا لِيَرْبُوَا فِي أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوْۤا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَمَا ءَاتَيْتُمْ مِنْ زَكَوةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُونَ wamā ātaytum min riban liyarbuwā fī amwāli l-nāsi falā yarbū ʿinda l-lahi wamā ātaytum min zakatin turīdūna wajha l-lahi fa-ulāika humu l-muḍ'ʿifūna And whatever you give for interest (i.e., advantage) to increase within the wealth of people1 will not increase with Allah. But what you give in zakāh,2 desiring the face (i.e., approval) of Allah - those are the multipliers.3 See 30:38

item.title: Ar-Room:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ءَاتَيْتُمْ مِنْ رِبًا لِيَرْبُوَا فِي أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوْۤا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَمَا ءَاتَيْتُمْ مِنْ زَكَوةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُونَ wamā ātaytum min riban liyarbuwā fī amwāli l-nāsi falā yarbū ʿinda l-lahi wamā ātaytum min zakatin turīdūna wajha l-lahi fa-ulāika humu l-muḍ'ʿifūna And what ye give out at interest, (Your money.) so that it (Simple or Compound.) may increase in the wealth of the people, but it increaseth (In the view of God.) not with God, and whatever ye give in charity desiring the pleasure of God, it is these that shall get (Grow.) manifold. 'Riba' is usury - Lending money on a condition to be repaid with an increase in the amount lent and collecting such an increase is forbidden. One has to show his active love and practical sympathy to his fellow being, by lending the…

item.title: Ar-Room:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَفْعَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥ'yīkum hal min shurakāikum man yafʿalu min dhālikum min shayin sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna It is Allah who created you and then He provided for you, then He makes you die, then He will bring you to life. Is there anyone among your partners who does anything of that kind? Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: Ar-Room:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَفْعَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥ'yīkum hal min shurakāikum man yafʿalu min dhālikum min shayin sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna Allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him. See 30:38

item.title: Ar-Room:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَفْعَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥ'yīkum hal min shurakāikum man yafʿalu min dhālikum min shayin sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna God is He who created you then provided you with sustenance, then He causeth you to die, then bringeth you to life; Is there any of your associate gods who doeth aught of these things? Glory be to Him, and Exalted High is He far above what they associate (with Him). See 30:39

item.title: Ar-Room:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوْۤا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ẓahara l-fasādu fī l-bari wal-baḥri bimā kasabat aydī l-nāsi liyudhīqahum baʿḍa alladhī ʿamilū laʿallahum yarjiʿūna Corruption has appeared in land and sea because of the doings of the people's hands, that He may make them taste something of what they have done, so that they may come back.

item.title: Ar-Room:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوْۤا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ẓahara l-fasādu fī l-bari wal-baḥri bimā kasabat aydī l-nāsi liyudhīqahum baʿḍa alladhī ʿamilū laʿallahum yarjiʿūna Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by (reason of) what the hands of people have earned so He (i.e., Allah) may let them taste part of (the consequence of) what they have done that perhaps they will return (to righteousness). Evil has appeared in Al-Barr and Al-Bahr because of what the hands of men have earned, that He may make them taste a part of that which they have done, in order that they may return (30:41). Say: "Travel in the land and see what was the end of those before (you)! Most of them were idolators (30:42). The Effects of Sin in this World Ibn 'Abbas, 'Ikrimah,…

item.title: Ar-Room:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوْۤا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ẓahara l-fasādu fī l-bari wal-baḥri bimā kasabat aydī l-nāsi liyudhīqahum baʿḍa alladhī ʿamilū laʿallahum yarjiʿūna Mischief hath appeared in the land and the sea on account of what the hands of men have wrought, that He may make them taste a part of what they have done, so that they may turn (away from evil). The corruption which ruled the various parts of the earth prior to the advent of Islam, is a matter of history, Hinduism, Budhism, Judaism, Christianity and Zoroastrianism had lost their hold upon their votaries. Vices of all kinds were freely practised in the name of religious orders of the ages. Since Jesus, six centuries had passed away without any heavenly guidance. Christianity, though the most modern and the youngest of…

item.title: Ar-Room:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُشْرِكِينَ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablu kāna aktharuhum mush'rikīna Say, 'Travel over the land and then observe how was the fate of those who were before [you], most of whom were polytheists.'

item.title: Ar-Room:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُشْرِكِينَ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablu kāna aktharuhum mush'rikīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators (of others with Allah). See 30:41

item.title: Ar-Room:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُشْرِكِينَ qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablu kāna aktharuhum mush'rikīna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Travel ye in the earth, then see ye how was the end of those who were before (you); most of them were polytheists." The world had become polytheist. How even Christianity had lost the doctrine of the Divine Unity preached by Jesus and was lost in the belief in the fanciful trinity, is a fact too obvious and well-known to be repeated here.

item.title: Ar-Room:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni l-qayimi min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi yawma-idhin yaṣṣaddaʿūna So set your heart on the upright religion, before there comes a day irrevocable from Allah. On that day they shall be split [into various groups].1

item.title: Ar-Room:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni l-qayimi min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi yawma-idhin yaṣṣaddaʿūna So direct your face (i.e., self) toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.1 So, set you your face to the straight and right religion, before there comes from Allah a Day which none can avert. On that Day men shall be divided (30:43). Whosoever disbelieves will suffer from his disbelief, and whosoever does righteous good deeds, then such will prepare a good place for themselves (30:44). That He may reward those who believe and do righteous good deeds, out of His bounty. Verily, He likes not the disbelievers (30:45). The Command to Follow…

item.title: Ar-Room:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni l-qayimi min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi yawma-idhin yaṣṣaddaʿūna Then set thy face upright unto the established religion ere cometh from God the day, (Death or Resurrection for the Final Judgment.) there is no averting for it, on that day they shall be separated. See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِأَنْفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ man kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan fali-anfusihim yamhadūna Whoever is faithless shall face the consequences of his faithlessness, and those who act righteously only prepare for their own souls,

item.title: Ar-Room:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِأَنْفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ man kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan fali-anfusihim yamhadūna Whoever disbelieves - upon him is (the consequence of) his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing. See 30:43

item.title: Ar-Room:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِأَنْفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ man kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan fali-anfusihim yamhadūna Whoever disbelieveth. on Him shall be (the charge of) the disbelief, and whoever doeth good deeds, for their own self they are preparing, See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكَافِرِينَ liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlihi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-kāfirīna that He may reward those who have faith and do righteous deeds out of His grace. Indeed He does not like the faithless.

item.title: Ar-Room:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكَافِرِينَ liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlihi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-kāfirīna That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers. See 30:43

item.title: Ar-Room:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكَافِرِينَ liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlihi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-kāfirīna So that He may recompense those who believe and do good out of His Grace; Verily He loveth not the disbelievers. See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wamin āyātihi an yur'sila l-riyāḥa mubashirātin waliyudhīqakum min raḥmatihi walitajriya l-ful'ku bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bearers of good news and to let you taste of His mercy, and that the ships may sail by His command, and that you may seek of His grace, and so that you may give [Him] thanks.

item.title: Ar-Room:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wamin āyātihi an yur'sila l-riyāḥa mubashirātin waliyudhīqakum min raḥmatihi walitajriya l-ful'ku bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy (i.e., rain) and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful. And among His signs is this that He sends the winds as glad tidings, giving you a taste of His mercy, and that the ships may sail at His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, in order that you may be thankful (30:46). And indeed We did send Messengers before you to their own peoples. They…

item.title: Ar-Room:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wamin āyātihi an yur'sila l-riyāḥa mubashirātin waliyudhīqakum min raḥmatihi walitajriya l-ful'ku bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And of His signs is that He sendeth forth the winds bearing good tidings, and that He may make you taste of His mercy, and that ships may sail by His Command, and that ye should seek of His grace, and that ye be grateful. See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوْۤا وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walaqad arsalnā min qablika rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti fa-intaqamnā mina alladhīna ajramū wakāna ḥaqqan ʿalaynā naṣru l-mu'minīna Certainly We sent apostles to their people before you, and they brought them manifest proofs. Then We took vengeance upon those who were guilty, and it was a must for Us to help the faithful.

item.title: Ar-Room:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوْۤا وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walaqad arsalnā min qablika rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti fa-intaqamnā mina alladhīna ajramū wakāna ḥaqqan ʿalaynā naṣru l-mu'minīna And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support1 of the believers. See 30:46

item.title: Ar-Room:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوْۤا وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ walaqad arsalnā min qablika rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti fa-intaqamnā mina alladhīna ajramū wakāna ḥaqqan ʿalaynā naṣru l-mu'minīna And indeed sent We before thee apostles unto their people, and came they unto them with clear proofs, then took We vengeance upon those who were guilty; and was incumbent on Us the succour of the believers. See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُ كِسَفًا فَتَرٰی الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ فَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ al-lahu alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhu fī l-samāi kayfa yashāu wayajʿaluhu kisafan fatarā l-wadqa yakhruju min khilālihi fa-idhā aṣāba bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi idhā hum yastabshirūna It is Allah who sends the winds. Then they raise a cloud, then He spreads it as He wishes in the sky, and forms it into fragments, whereat you see the rain issuing from its midst. Then, when He strikes with it whomever of His servants that He wishes, behold, they rejoice;

item.title: Ar-Room:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُ كِسَفًا فَتَرٰی الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ فَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ al-lahu alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhu fī l-samāi kayfa yashāu wayajʿaluhu kisafan fatarā l-wadqa yakhruju min khilālihi fa-idhā aṣāba bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi idhā hum yastabshirūna It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice. Allah is He Who sends the winds, so that they raise clouds and spread them along the sky as He wills, and then break them into fragments until you see rain drops…

item.title: Ar-Room:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُ كِسَفًا فَتَرٰی الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ فَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ al-lahu alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhu fī l-samāi kayfa yashāu wayajʿaluhu kisafan fatarā l-wadqa yakhruju min khilālihi fa-idhā aṣāba bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi idhā hum yastabshirūna God it is Who sendeth forth the winds, so raise they the clouds, then He spreadeth it forth in the skies as He willeth, and causeth it to break up so that ye see the rays coming forth from inside it; and when He causeth it to fall upon whomsoever He pleaseth of His servants, lo! they rejoice. See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ wa-in kānū min qabli an yunazzala ʿalayhim min qablihi lamub'lisīna and indeed they had, before it was sent down upon them, been despondent earlier.

item.title: Ar-Room:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ wa-in kānū min qabli an yunazzala ʿalayhim min qablihi lamub'lisīna Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair. See 30:48

item.title: Ar-Room:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ wa-in kānū min qabli an yunazzala ʿalayhim min qablihi lamub'lisīna Even they who, before it was sent down upon them, were in mute despair. See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ إِلَى ءَاثَارِ رَحْمَتِ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ fa-unẓur ilā āthāri raḥmati l-lahi kayfa yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna dhālika lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun So observe the effects of Allah's mercy: how He revives the earth after its death! Indeed He is the reviver of the dead, and He has power over all things.

item.title: Ar-Room:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ إِلَى ءَاثَارِ رَحْمَتِ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ fa-unẓur ilā āthāri raḥmati l-lahi kayfa yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna dhālika lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that (same one) will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent. See 30:48

item.title: Ar-Room:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ إِلَى ءَاثَارِ رَحْمَتِ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ fa-unẓur ilā āthāri raḥmati l-lahi kayfa yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna dhālika lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Look then at the traces (The phenomenon of the Divine mercy.) of God's mercy, how He giveth life to the earth after its death; verily He (This same God.) is the giver of life to the dead; and He hath power over all things. See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَظَلُّوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ يَكْفُرُونَ wala-in arsalnā rīḥan fara-awhu muṣ'farran laẓallū min baʿdihi yakfurūna And if We send a wind and they see it1 turn yellow, they will surely become ungrateful after that.2

item.title: Ar-Room:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَظَلُّوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ يَكْفُرُونَ wala-in arsalnā rīḥan fara-awhu muṣ'farran laẓallū min baʿdihi yakfurūna But if We should send a (bad) wind and they saw (their crops) turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.1 See 30:48

item.title: Ar-Room:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَظَلُّوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ يَكْفُرُونَ wala-in arsalnā rīḥan fara-awhu muṣ'farran laẓallū min baʿdihi yakfurūna And if We send a wind (from which) they see (their tilth turned) yellow, they become, thereafter, disbelievers (ungrateful). See 30:42

item.title: Ar-Room:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰی وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ fa-innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīna Indeed you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs [upon you],

item.title: Ar-Room:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰی وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ fa-innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīna So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating. So verily, you cannot make the dead to hear, nor can you make the deaf to hear the call, when they show their backs and turn away (30:52). And you cannot guide the blind from their straying; you can make to hear only those who believe in Our Ayat, and have submitted (to Allah in Islam) (30:53). The Disbelievers are like the Dead, Deaf and Blind Allah says, 'just as you are not able to make the dead hear in their graves, or to make your words reach the deaf who cannot hear and…

item.title: Ar-Room:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰی وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ fa-innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīna For verily thou canst not make the dead (at heart - adamant in their disbelief.) to hear and thou canst not make the deaf (at heart - adamant in their disbelief.) to hear the call, when they withdraw turning their backs. The statement made in these two verses means that the preachings and the guidance of the apostles will only avail those whose minds and hearts are inclined towards the truth, and for those who are adamant, it shall be of no use. (A.P.).

item.title: Ar-Room:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِ الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ wamā anta bihādi l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūna nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can make hear only those who have faith in Our signs, and thus have submitted.

item.title: Ar-Room:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِ الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ wamā anta bihādi l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūna And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims (in submission to Allah). See 30:52

item.title: Ar-Room:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِ الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ wamā anta bihādi l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūna Nor canst thou lead the blind out of their straying; Thou canst not make hear any but those who believe in Our signs for they are resigned (to Our will i.e. Muslims). See 30:52

item.title: Ar-Room:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَدِيرُ al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum min ḍaʿfin thumma jaʿala min baʿdi ḍaʿfin quwwatan thumma jaʿala min baʿdi quwwatin ḍaʿfan washaybatan yakhluqu mā yashāu wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-qadīru It is Allah who created you from [a state of] weakness, then He gave you power after weakness. Then, after power, He ordained weakness and old age: He creates whatever He wishes, and He is the All-knowing, the All-powerful.

item.title: Ar-Room:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَدِيرُ al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum min ḍaʿfin thumma jaʿala min baʿdi ḍaʿfin quwwatan thumma jaʿala min baʿdi quwwatin ḍaʿfan washaybatan yakhluqu mā yashāu wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-qadīru Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent. Allah is He Who created you in weakness, then gave you strength after weakness, then after strength gave (you) weakness and grey hair. He creates what He wills. And He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful (30:54). The Different Stages of Man Here Allah points out how man passes through different stages of creation, one phase after another. He…

item.title: Ar-Room:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَدِيرُ al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum min ḍaʿfin thumma jaʿala min baʿdi ḍaʿfin quwwatan thumma jaʿala min baʿdi quwwatin ḍaʿfan washaybatan yakhluqu mā yashāu wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-qadīru God (it is) Who created you out of weakness and then caused strength after weakness, then caused weakness after strength and grey hairs; Createth He what soever He willeth, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful. See 30:52

item.title: Ar-Room:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوْۤا غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوْۤا يُؤْفَكُونَ wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yuq'simu l-muj'rimūna mā labithū ghayra sāʿatin kadhālika kānū yu'fakūna And on the day when the Hour sets in the guilty will swear that they had remained only for an hour. That is how they were used to lying [in the world].

item.title: Ar-Room:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوْۤا غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوْۤا يُؤْفَكُونَ wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yuq'simu l-muj'rimūna mā labithū ghayra sāʿatin kadhālika kānū yu'fakūna And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded. And on the Day that the Hour will be established, the criminals will swear that they stayed not but an hour – thus were they ever deluded (30:55). And those who have been bestowed with knowledge and Faith will say: Indeed you have stayed according to the decree of Allah, until the Day of Resurrection; so this is the Day of Resurrection, but you knew not (30:56). So, on that Day no excuse of theirs will avail those who did wrong, nor will they be allowed to return to seek (Allah's) pleasure (30:57). The Ignorance of…

item.title: Ar-Room:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوْۤا غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوْۤا يُؤْفَكُونَ wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yuq'simu l-muj'rimūna mā labithū ghayra sāʿatin kadhālika kānū yu'fakūna And the day whereon the Hour (of Judgment) arriveth, the guilty will swear that they tarried not but an hour; Even so they used to utter lies (on earth) See 30:52

item.title: Ar-Room:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ فَهَذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلَكِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ waqāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wal-īmāna laqad labith'tum fī kitābi l-lahi ilā yawmi l-baʿthi fahādhā yawmu l-baʿthi walākinnakum kuntum lā taʿlamūna But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, 'Certainly you remained in Allah's Book1 until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not know.'

item.title: Ar-Room:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ فَهَذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلَكِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ waqāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wal-īmāna laqad labith'tum fī kitābi l-lahi ilā yawmi l-baʿthi fahādhā yawmu l-baʿthi walākinnakum kuntum lā taʿlamūna But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allah's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."1 See 30:55

item.title: Ar-Room:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ فَهَذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلَكِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ waqāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wal-īmāna laqad labith'tum fī kitābi l-lahi ilā yawmi l-baʿthi fahādhā yawmu l-baʿthi walākinnakum kuntum lā taʿlamūna And those who have been given knowledge and faith will say: "Indeed tarried ye according to the decree of God till the Day of Resurrection, so this is the Day of Resurrection but ye were wont not to know." The tarrying refers to the intermediary stage as indicated in the following verses. (A.P.)

item.title: Ar-Room:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ fayawma-idhin lā yanfaʿu alladhīna ẓalamū maʿdhiratuhum walā hum yus'taʿtabūna On that day the excuses of the wrongdoers will not benefit them, nor will they be asked to propitiate [Allah].

item.title: Ar-Room:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ fayawma-idhin lā yanfaʿu alladhīna ẓalamū maʿdhiratuhum walā hum yus'taʿtabūna So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease (Allah). See 30:55

item.title: Ar-Room:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ fayawma-idhin lā yanfaʿu alladhīna ẓalamū maʿdhiratuhum walā hum yus'taʿtabūna But on that day their plea shall not profit those who were unjust, nor will they be allowed to (By any repentance.) please (God). See 30:56

item.title: Ar-Room:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَلَئِنْ جِئْتَهُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin wala-in ji'tahum biāyatin layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in antum illā mub'ṭilūna Certainly we have drawn for mankind in this Qur'ān every [kind of] parable. Indeed if you bring them a sign,1 the faithless will surely say, 'You are nothing but fabricators!'

item.title: Ar-Room:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَلَئِنْ جِئْتَهُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin wala-in ji'tahum biāyatin layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in antum illā mub'ṭilūna And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every (kind of) example. But, (O Muḥammad), if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You (believers) are but falsifiers." And indeed We have set forth for mankind, in this Qur'an every kind of parable. But if you bring to them any sign or proof, the disbelievers are sure to say (to the believers): You follow nothing but falsehood and magic (30:58). Thus does Allah seal up the hearts of those who know not (30:59). So be patient. Verily, the promise of Allah is true; and…

item.title: Ar-Room:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَلَئِنْ جِئْتَهُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin wala-in ji'tahum biāyatin layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in antum illā mub'ṭilūna And indeed have We set forth for the people, in this Qur'an every kind of similitude; And if thou bringest unto them a sign, certainly will say those who disbelieve: "Ye are naught but a false (Who mislead others.) claimant." See 30:56

item.title: Ar-Room:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know.

item.title: Ar-Room:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know.1 See 30:58

item.title: Ar-Room:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Thus doth God set a seal on the hearts of those who know not. See 30:56

item.title: Ar-Room:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walā yastakhiffannaka alladhīna lā yūqinūna So be patient! Allah's promise is indeed true. And do not let yourself be upset by those who have no conviction.

item.title: Ar-Room:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walā yastakhiffannaka alladhīna lā yūqinūna So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain (in faith). See 30:58

item.title: Ar-Room:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walā yastakhiffannaka alladhīna lā yūqinūna Therefore be thou patient (for) Verily the promise of God is True, and let not those who have no certainty hold thee in light estimation. See 30:56

item.title: As-Saaffaat:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا wal-ṣāfāti ṣaffan By the [angels] ranged in ranks,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا wal-ṣāfāti ṣaffan By those (angels) lined up in rows. فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا By those who bring the Dhikr. As-Suddi said, "The angels bring the Scriptures and the Qur'an from Allah to mankind." The One True God is Allah إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ - رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ Verily, your God is indeed One, Lord of the heavens and the earth, This is the One by Whom the oath is sworn, stating that there is no God worthy of worship but He, Lord of the heavens and the earth: وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا and all that is between them, means, of created beings. وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ and Lord of every point of the sun's risings. means, He is the Sovereign Who is controlling His creation by subjugating it and all that is in it of stars, planets and heavenly bodies which appear from the east…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا wal-ṣāfāti ṣaffan By those who range themselves in ranks, 'Wa' as a prefix, ordinarily meaning conjunction 'And' has been used in the Holy Qur'an for several obvious purposes: (1) When any fact has to be presented not as a mere allegation or statement but to assert with special emphasis, i.e., to assert some truth against any expected or apprehended rejection of it. Sometimes it is used to prophecy an event. A very reasonable question could arise, whether the persons mentioned in the three different consecutive verses are one and the same or different ones, and who they are. Commentators say that the persons meant are the angels and the men of God, as both of these two kinds of beings, possess the qualities mentioned and function as described in the verses. The angels and the men of God,…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا fal-zājirāti zajran by the ones who drive vigorously,1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا fal-zājirāti zajran And those who drive (the clouds). See 37:1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا fal-zājirāti zajran And (by) those, who drive away the evil with reproof, See 37:1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا fal-tāliyāti dhik'ran by the ones who recite the reminder:1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا fal-tāliyāti dhik'ran And those who recite the message.1 See 37:1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا fal-tāliyāti dhik'ran And by the reciters of Qur'an, See 37:1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ إِلَهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ inna ilāhakum lawāḥidun indeed your God is certainly One,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ إِلَهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ inna ilāhakum lawāḥidun Indeed, your God is One. See 37:1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ إِلَهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ inna ilāhakum lawāḥidun Verily your God is (only) One. The Unity of God is the important message or the Greatest Truth, to convey which, so much emphasis has been used through such a solemn and emphatic assertion, for the correct faith in the Unity of the Creator of the Universe, is directly and most vitally connected with the life and the destiny of the human race. Man has to necessarily know that he has not been created by a mere accident or as a sport of any vain creative power or by any contending forces or by any purposeless mechanical process. Man should essentially know as to who actually is his creator and master and what are his qualities and powers and his rights over his creation. Man must know the correct source or authority from whom…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu l-mashāriqi the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and the Lord of the easts.1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu l-mashāriqi Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.1 See 37:1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu l-mashāriqi The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and the Lord of the places of the rising (Literally, Easts. Refer to verse 7:137.) of (the sun and the moon). 'Mashariq' (the plural of 'Mashriq,' i.e., East). There is not the only one East in the whole universe. The sun rises not only for this earth of our habitation but its rise is for the other globes swimming in the immeasurable space called the heavens and the rotation of each such globe around the sun manifests the rising of the sun and its setting and wherever manifests its rising and setting, is a Mashriq East and a Maghrib West.1 The astronomical discoveries have declared that there is not one solar system but…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ innā zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bizīnatin l-kawākibi Indeed We have adorned the lowest heaven1 with the finery of the stars,2

item.title: As-Saaffaat:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ innā zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bizīnatin l-kawākibi Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars. Verily, We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (37:6). And to guard against every rebellious Shaytan (37:7). They cannot listen to the higher group for they are pelted from every side (37:8). Outcast, and theirs is a constant torment (37:9). Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness (37:10). The Adornment and Protection of the Heaven Comes from Allah Allah tells us that He has adorned the lowest heaven with the heavenly bodies for those among the people of the earth who look at it. The stars and planets in the sky give light to the people of earth, as Allah says: وَلَقَدْ…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ innā zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bizīnatin l-kawākibi Verily We have adorned the heaven nearest to this world (earth) with an adornment, the stars, 'Sama'ad Dunya', i.e., the Lower heavens.1 The nearest heaven to the earth is the Lower heaven, lower than the heavens, which could be called to be the seat of the Exalted Assembly of the Angels. The heavens surrounding the earth are said to be the lowest or the nearest to the earth. The beauty of the starry skies is proverbial. Here is implied the marvellous beauty and the well-planned grouping and the perfectly harmonious working of everything in the heavens manifesting the Unity, the Power and the Wisdom of the One All-Perfect Designer, Creator and the Supreme Master of the Universe.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحِفْظًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَارِدٍ waḥif'ẓan min kulli shayṭānin māridin and to guard from any froward devil.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحِفْظًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَارِدٍ waḥif'ẓan min kulli shayṭānin māridin And as protection against every rebellious devil. See 37:6

item.title: As-Saaffaat:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
