item.description: وَحِفْظًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَارِدٍ waḥif'ẓan min kulli shayṭānin māridin And (which is also) a guard against every rebellious Satan; The perfect, the harmonious, the undisturbed and the continuous movement of everything in the heavens, is itself obvious and sufficiently eloquent in its declaration that the Kingdom of God is perfectly planned and entirely guarded against any rebellious elements, material or spiritual, venturing to disturb it. The functioning of the heavens manifest not only the inimitable divine beauty but also the glory of the power and the authority of the Omnipotent Creator. Goodness is always protected by the All-Good, against evil. Similarly, the men of God who are the goodness personified or the reflection or the manifestation of the goodness of the Lord, are also duly protected, hence they are called 'Masooms', i.e., 'the Divinely Protected ones.' The protection of…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰی وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ lā yassammaʿūna ilā l-mala-i l-aʿlā wayuq'dhafūna min kulli jānibin They do not eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite but are shot at from every side,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰی وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ lā yassammaʿūna ilā l-mala-i l-aʿlā wayuq'dhafūna min kulli jānibin (So) they may not listen to the exalted assembly (of angels) and are pelted from every side.1 See 37:6

item.title: As-Saaffaat:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰی وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ lā yassammaʿūna ilā l-mala-i l-aʿlā wayuq'dhafūna min kulli jānibin (So that) They may hear not (what passeth in) the assembly on high, and they are darted from every side. It is said that the evil spirits, perhaps as a respite, could approach the lower heavens and while they did so, they used to get some information from that region about the future and used to adulterate the knowledge with some falsehood on behalf of their own selves and inspire the matter to their devotees on earth but since the advent of the Last Apostle of God and the revelation of the Final Code of Guidance, the Holy Qur'an, even this approach to the first or the lowest regions above, has been stopped, and since then no evil one could have any…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: دُحُورًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ duḥūran walahum ʿadhābun wāṣibun to drive them away, and for them there is a constant mortification,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: دُحُورًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ duḥūran walahum ʿadhābun wāṣibun Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment. See 37:6

item.title: As-Saaffaat:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: دُحُورًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ duḥūran walahum ʿadhābun wāṣibun (To be) Driven off, and for them being a perpetual chastisement, It is said that after the advent of the Holy Prophet, the doors of even the lower heavens got closed to the devils or the evil spirits. No soothsayer could cheat the people with false prophecies about the future of persons etc.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ illā man khaṭifa l-khaṭfata fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibun except him who snatches a snatch,1 whereat there pursues him a piercing flame.2

item.title: As-Saaffaat:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ illā man khaṭifa l-khaṭfata fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibun Except one who snatches (some words) by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing (in brightness). See 37:6

item.title: As-Saaffaat:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ illā man khaṭifa l-khaṭfata fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibun Except, he who stealeth (a word) by stealth then pursueth him a glistening (Piercing.) flame. Even if any devilish spirit dared to rise to approach the region of the assembly of the angels, it is repulsed and pursued by flames by means of the shooting stars.1 This passage indicates also that the devilish beings fascinated with the phenomena of the lower sphere are unable to come in communion with the angelical beings of the higher sphere but some may attempt to get stealthily the news of the higher sphere but will be driven back. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمْ مَنْ خَلَقْنَا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ لَازِبٍ fa-is'taftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnā innā khalaqnāhum min ṭīnin lāzibin Ask them, is their creation more prodigious1 or [that of other creatures] that We have created? Indeed We created them from a viscous clay.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمْ مَنْ خَلَقْنَا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ لَازِبٍ fa-is'taftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnā innā khalaqnāhum min ṭīnin lāzibin Then inquire of them, (O Muḥammad), "Are they a stronger (or more difficult) creation or those (others) We have created?" Indeed, We created them (i.e., men) from sticky clay. Then ask them: "Are they harder to create, or those whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay (37:11). Nay, you wondered while they mock (37:12). And when they are reminded, they pay no attention (37:13). And when they see an Ayah (a sign) from Allah, they mock at it (37:14). And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic! (37:15). "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we verily be resurrected? (37:16). "And also our fathers of old?…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمْ مَنْ خَلَقْنَا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ لَازِبٍ fa-is'taftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnā innā khalaqnāhum min ṭīnin lāzibin Ask them then (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Are they stronger in creation or (the others) whom We have made?" Verily We created them of a sticky clay. The Holy Prophet was commanded by God to ask the disbelievers whether they were stronger than the former generation who were created with a firm clay, i.e., of strong power of resistance who in spite of their being stronger in build, were destroyed, when they disbelieved and defied the Divine Laws.1 The beings of the higher, i.e., the angelical sphere. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ bal ʿajib'ta wayaskharūna Indeed you wonder, while they engage in ridicule,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ bal ʿajib'ta wayaskharūna But you wonder, while they mock. See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ bal ʿajib'ta wayaskharūna Nay! Wonderest thou (at their disbelief) while they mock (at thee) See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ wa-idhā dhukkirū lā yadhkurūna and [even] when admonished do not take admonition,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ wa-idhā dhukkirū lā yadhkurūna And when they are reminded, they remember not. See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ wa-idhā dhukkirū lā yadhkurūna And when they are warned, (Reminded.) they mind not, See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا اٰیَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ wa-idhā ra-aw āyatan yastaskhirūna and when they see a sign they make it an object of ridicule,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا اٰیَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ wa-idhā ra-aw āyatan yastaskhirūna And when they see a sign, they ridicule. See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا اٰیَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ wa-idhā ra-aw āyatan yastaskhirūna And when they see a sign they incite mocking (at it) See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ waqālū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun and say, 'This is nothing but plain magic!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ waqālū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun And say, "This is not but obvious magic. See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ waqālū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun And say they: "this is but an open sorcery" See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna 'What! When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected? See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna What! when we are dead and are dust and bones, shall we (even then) indeed be raised? See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ awaābāunā l-awalūna And our forefathers too?!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ awaābāunā l-awalūna And our forefathers (as well)?" See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ awaābāunā l-awalūna And (also) our fathers (The ancestors.) of yore? See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنْتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ qul naʿam wa-antum dākhirūna Say, 'Yes! And you will be utterly humble.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنْتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ qul naʿam wa-antum dākhirūna Say, "Yes, and you will be (rendered) contemptible." See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنْتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ qul naʿam wa-antum dākhirūna Say thou: "Yea! ye shall be disgraced" See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūna It will be only a single shout and, behold, they will look on,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūna It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing. See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūna Then it will only be a single (Refer to verse 36:49.) roar, when lo! they shall gaze (around), See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا هَذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ waqālū yāwaylanā hādhā yawmu l-dīni and say, 'Woe to us! This is the Day of Retribution!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا هَذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ waqālū yāwaylanā hādhā yawmu l-dīni They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense." They will say: Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense! (37:20). (It will be said:) "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny (37:21). (It will be said to the angels:) Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions and what they used to worship (37:22). Instead of Allah, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell) (37:23). But stop them, verily, they are to be questioned (37:24). "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another? (37:25). Nay, but that Day they shall surrender (37:26). The Day of Recompense Allah tells us what the disbeliever will say on the Day of Resurrection, how…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا هَذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ waqālū yāwaylanā hādhā yawmu l-dīni And they shall say: "Oh! Woe unto us! This is the Day of Reckoning;" See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ hādhā yawmu l-faṣli alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna 'This is the Day of Judgement that you used to deny!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ hādhā yawmu l-faṣli alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna (They will be told), "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny." See 37:20

item.title: As-Saaffaat:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ hādhā yawmu l-faṣli alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna This is the Day of Judgment which ye used to belie See 37:11

item.title: As-Saaffaat:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُحْشُرُوا۟ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْبُدُونَ uḥ'shurū alladhīna ẓalamū wa-azwājahum wamā kānū yaʿbudūna 'Muster the wrongdoers and their mates1 and what they used to worship

item.title: As-Saaffaat:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُحْشُرُوا۟ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْبُدُونَ uḥ'shurū alladhīna ẓalamū wa-azwājahum wamā kānū yaʿbudūna (The angels will be ordered), "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,1 and what they used to worship. See 37:20

item.title: As-Saaffaat:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُحْشُرُوا۟ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْبُدُونَ uḥ'shurū alladhīna ẓalamū wa-azwājahum wamā kānū yaʿbudūna (And the angels will be commanded): "Gather ye together those who were unjust and their mates, and what they used to worship," It is not necessary the inmates of the Resurrection Day be the same inmates of the life here.1 (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ min dūni l-lahi fa-ih'dūhum ilā ṣirāṭi l-jaḥīmi besides Allah, and show them the way to hell!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ min dūni l-lahi fa-ih'dūhum ilā ṣirāṭi l-jaḥīmi Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire. See 37:20

item.title: As-Saaffaat:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ min dūni l-lahi fa-ih'dūhum ilā ṣirāṭi l-jaḥīmi Besides God, and lead them all unto Hell. See 37:22

item.title: As-Saaffaat:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْءُولُونَ waqifūhum innahum masūlūna [But first] stop them! For they must be questioned.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْءُولُونَ waqifūhum innahum masūlūna And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned." See 37:20

item.title: As-Saaffaat:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْءُولُونَ waqifūhum innahum masūlūna And stop them, for verily they have to be questioned: See 37:22

item.title: As-Saaffaat:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ mā lakum lā tanāṣarūna 'Why is it that you do not support1 one another [today]?'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ mā lakum lā tanāṣarūna (They will be asked), "What is (wrong) with you? Why do you not help each other?" See 37:20

item.title: As-Saaffaat:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ mā lakum lā tanāṣarūna (Saying) "How now, that ye (The disbelievers.) help not one another?" See 37:22

item.title: As-Saaffaat:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ bal humu l-yawma mus'taslimūna Rather today they are [meek and] submissive!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ bal humu l-yawma mus'taslimūna But they, that Day, are in surrender. See 37:20

item.title: As-Saaffaat:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ bal humu l-yawma mus'taslimūna Nay! on that day they shall be submitting themselves. The arrogance they used in the life before death would have totally disappeared and they would become very submissive.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna And they will approach one another asking (i.e., blaming) each other. And they will turn to one another and question one another (37:27). They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side (37:28). They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers (37:29). "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were a transgressing people (37:30). "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly taste (the torment) (37:31). "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray (37:32). Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment (37:33). Certainly, that is how We deal with the criminals (37:34). Truly, when it was said to them: "La ilaha illallah," they puffed…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna And some of them shall advance unto the others questioning each other. See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ qālū innakum kuntum tatūnanā ʿani l-yamīni They will say, 'Indeed you used to accost us peremptorily.'1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ qālū innakum kuntum tatūnanā ʿani l-yamīni They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."1 See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ qālū innakum kuntum tatūnanā ʿani l-yamīni They shall say: "Verily ye did come unto us beguiling from the right side." See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ لَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ qālū bal lam takūnū mu'minīna They will answer, 'Rather you [yourselves] had no faith.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ لَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ qālū bal lam takūnū mu'minīna They (i.e., the oppressors) will say, "Rather, you (yourselves) were not believers. See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ لَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ qālū bal lam takūnū mu'minīna They shall say: "Nay! ye (yourselves) (Mutual accusation.) were not the believers:" See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīna We had no authority over you. Rather you [yourselves] were a rebellious lot.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīna And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people. See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīna And there was not for us over you any authority. Nay! ye were a people rebellious! See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā innā ladhāiqūna So our Lord's word became due against us that we shall indeed taste [the punishment].

item.title: As-Saaffaat:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā innā ladhāiqūna So the word (i.e., decree) of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste (punishment). See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā innā ladhāiqūna So now hath been proved true against us the sentence of Our Lord that verily we shall (have to) taste (the doom) See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ fa-aghwaynākum innā kunnā ghāwīna So we perverted you, for we were perverse [ourselves].'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ fa-aghwaynākum innā kunnā ghāwīna And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators." See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ fa-aghwaynākum innā kunnā ghāwīna And we led you astray, for verily we ourselves were astray. See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ fa-innahum yawma-idhin fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna So that day they will share in the punishment.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ fa-innahum yawma-idhin fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment. See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ fa-innahum yawma-idhin fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna Verily they on that day shall be the sharers in the punishment. See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ innā kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna Indeed that is how We deal with the guilty.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ innā kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals. See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ innā kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna Verily, thus do We deal with the guilty ones. See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ innahum kānū idhā qīla lahum lā ilāha illā l-lahu yastakbirūna Indeed it was they who, when they were told, 'There is no god except Allah,' used to be disdainful,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ innahum kānū idhā qīla lahum lā ilāha illā l-lahu yastakbirūna Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant. See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ innahum kānū idhā qīla lahum lā ilāha illā l-lahu yastakbirūna Verily they, when it was said unto them that there is no god but God, used to behave (Turn away.) proudly, See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَتَارِكُوا آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَجْنُونٍ wayaqūlūna a-innā latārikū ālihatinā lishāʿirin majnūnin and [they would] say, 'Shall we abandon our gods for a crazy poet?'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَتَارِكُوا آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَجْنُونٍ wayaqūlūna a-innā latārikū ālihatinā lishāʿirin majnūnin And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?" See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَتَارِكُوا آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَجْنُونٍ wayaqūlūna a-innā latārikū ālihatinā lishāʿirin majnūnin And (used) to say "What! Are we to indeed give up our gods for a poet (who is) crazed?" See 37:26

item.title: As-Saaffaat:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ bal jāa bil-ḥaqi waṣaddaqa l-mur'salīna Rather he has brought [them] the truth, and confirmed the [earlier] apostles.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ bal jāa bil-ḥaqi waṣaddaqa l-mur'salīna Rather, he (i.e., the Prophet SAW) has come with the truth and confirmed the (previous) messengers. See 37:27

item.title: As-Saaffaat:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ bal jāa bil-ḥaqi waṣaddaqa l-mur'salīna Nay! he hath come with the truth and did testify (Also - are testified the preceding apostles by him.) the (preceding) apostles. His advent also was testified by the apostles of old. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُوا الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ innakum ladhāiqū l-ʿadhābi l-alīmi Indeed you will taste the painful punishment,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُوا الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ innakum ladhāiqū l-ʿadhābi l-alīmi Indeed, you (disbelievers) will be tasters of the painful punishment. Verily, you are going to taste the painful torment (37:38). And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (37:39). Save the chosen servants of Allah (37:40). For them there will be a known provision (37:41). Fruits; and they shall be honored (37:42). In the Gardens of Delight (37:43). Facing one another on thrones (37:44). Round them will be passed a cup of pure win (37:45). White, delicious to the drinkers (37:46). Neither will they have Ghawl from that nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom (37:47). And beside them will be Qasirat-At-Tarf with (wide and beautiful) eyes (37:48). as if they were Bayd Maknun (37:49). The Punishment of the Idolators and the Reward of the Sincere Believers Allah…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُوا الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ innakum ladhāiqū l-ʿadhābi l-alīmi Verily, ye will taste the painful chastisement. See 37:37

item.title: As-Saaffaat:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wamā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna and you will be requited only for what you used to do

item.title: As-Saaffaat:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wamā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wamā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna And ye shall be recompensed not but what ye were doing, If this and the next verse are read together it indicates that the evil doers will only suffer for their own misdeeds but the purified servants of the Lord will enjoy the grace and blessings more and ever more. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna But not the chosen servants of Allah. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna Save the servants of God, the freed ones (Refer to note on verses 37:39, 15:39 - 15:42, 14:22 & 17:65.) (from evil inclinations). See 37:39

item.title: As-Saaffaat:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَعْلُومٌ ulāika lahum riz'qun maʿlūmun For such there is a known1 provision

item.title: As-Saaffaat:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَعْلُومٌ ulāika lahum riz'qun maʿlūmun Those will have a provision determined. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَعْلُومٌ ulāika lahum riz'qun maʿlūmun They, for them is a sustenance known, See 37:39

item.title: As-Saaffaat:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَاكِهُ وَهُمْ مُكْرَمُونَ fawākihu wahum muk'ramūna —fruits—and they will be held in honour,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَاكِهُ وَهُمْ مُكْرَمُونَ fawākihu wahum muk'ramūna Fruits;1 and they will be honored. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَاكِهُ وَهُمْ مُكْرَمُونَ fawākihu wahum muk'ramūna Fruits, and they shall be highly honoured, See 37:39

item.title: As-Saaffaat:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ fī jannāti l-naʿīmi in the gardens of bliss,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ fī jannāti l-naʿīmi In gardens of pleasure. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ fī jannāti l-naʿīmi In the gardens bountiful, (Of delight and bliss.) See 37:39

item.title: As-Saaffaat:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna [reclining] on couches, facing one another,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna On thrones facing one another. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna Upon couches facing each other See 37:39

item.title: As-Saaffaat:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ yuṭāfu ʿalayhim bikasin min maʿīnin served around with a cup from a clear fountain,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ yuṭāfu ʿalayhim bikasin min maʿīnin There will be circulated among them a cup (of wine) from a flowing spring. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ yuṭāfu ʿalayhim bikasin min maʿīnin Round will go unto them a cup from a clear spring, See 37:39

item.title: As-Saaffaat:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ bayḍāa ladhatin lilshāribīna snow-white, delicious to the drinkers,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ bayḍāa ladhatin lilshāribīna White and delicious to the drinkers. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ bayḍāa ladhatin lilshāribīna Limpid white, delicious unto those who, drink. See 37:39

item.title: As-Saaffaat:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنْزَفُونَ lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūna wherein there will be neither headache nor will it cause them stupefaction,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنْزَفُونَ lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūna No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنْزَفُونَ lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūna Nothing therein to oppress (Affect, spoil.) the sense, nor shall they be exhausted therewith The spiritual world is one abstract unit and the bliss of it is universal and enduring but the physical world is a composite organisation with opposites of contrasting demerits. Trouble or fatigue is the state of exertion of the physical body. The life in Paradise being free from all physical dependence and needs, there naturally can be no trouble or exhaustion in any aspect of the blissful life which would naturally be of continued or sustained state of realisation. Such a unique state of existence would be the award from the identical attributes of God who owns it, in its absolute or infinite degree.1 Neither slumber nor sleep could ever approach Him,…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi ʿīnun and with them will be maidens of restrained glances with big [beautiful] eyes,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi ʿīnun And with them will be women limiting (their) glances,1 with large, (beautiful) eyes. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi ʿīnun And with them shall be chaste women with modest gaze, with big (beautiful) eyes, The qualities of chaste, modest and pure womanhood have been presented in this verse. The description of the women in Paradise, no doubt refers to the kind of the mates, the righteous ones would have, in heaven, but the qualities figuratively imply as a model or ideal, worthy to be adopted by every believer woman in her life on earth. It is given here that the most valuable quality in a woman, worthy of belonging to Paradise, is the quality of chastity which is said to possess eyes free from lust.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَكْنُونٌ ka-annahunna bayḍun maknūnun as if they were hidden1 ostrich eggs.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَكْنُونٌ ka-annahunna bayḍun maknūnun As if they were (delicate) eggs, well-protected. See 37:38

item.title: As-Saaffaat:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَكْنُونٌ ka-annahunna bayḍun maknūnun As if they were eggs (secured) hidden The eyes are described as eggs which are always kept safe, closely guarded against the least effect detrimental to its external and the internal security, i.e., from breakage as well as from getting rotten. It is said the Ostrich secures its eggs by keeping them concealed in its feathers against the dust and the sun. The comparison to eggs, is the most apt and in another place women are compared to rubies and pearls which another place women are always found treasured deep in the earth in the mines or in the strong safes in the secured places of the owners.1 Every verse of the Holy Qur'an has an outer and several inner meanings applicable to individuals and people in various states and different walks of life.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other. Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning (37:50). A speaker of them will say: Verily, I had a companion (in the world), (37:51). "Who used to say: 'Are you among those who believe (37:52). (That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be indebted (Madinun)?' (37:53). (The speaker) said: "Will you look down? (37:54). So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire (37:55). He said: "By Allah! You have nearly ruined me (37:56). "Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell) (37:57). "Are we then not to die (any more)? (37:58). "Except our first death, and…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna And shall advance some of them unto the others questioning each other. See verse 27 above. The righteous ones in the heavens discussing with each other.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّیْ كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ qāla qāilun min'hum innī kāna lī qarīnun One of them will say, 'Indeed I had a companion

item.title: As-Saaffaat:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّیْ كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ qāla qāilun min'hum innī kāna lī qarīnun A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion (on earth). See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّیْ كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ qāla qāilun min'hum innī kāna lī qarīnun Shall say a speaker (among them) who shall speak: "Verily, there was of mine an intimate one," One in the heaven would say that he had an intimate one in his earthly life.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ yaqūlu a-innaka lamina l-muṣadiqīna who used to say, "Are you really among those who affirm

item.title: As-Saaffaat:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ yaqūlu a-innaka lamina l-muṣadiqīna Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe. See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ yaqūlu a-innaka lamina l-muṣadiqīna He used to say: "What! art thou (too, indeed) of the testifying (a believer.) ones (of the Resurrection)?" He wondered at the believer in truth.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamadīnūna [that] when we are dead and have become dust and bones, we shall indeed be brought to retribution?" '

item.title: As-Saaffaat:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamadīnūna That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'" See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamadīnūna What! when we are dead and are dust and bones, shall we (even) then in fact be brought to account (Requital – judgment.) ? And doubted about the resurrection after death.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُطَّلِعُونَ qāla hal antum muṭṭaliʿūna He1 will say, 'Will you have a look?'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُطَّلِعُونَ qāla hal antum muṭṭaliʿūna He will say,1 "Would you (care to) look?" See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُطَّلِعُونَ qāla hal antum muṭṭaliʿūna He shall say (unto those around him): "Will ye look?" He shall tell them to see the fate of the disbelievers in Hell.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ fa-iṭṭalaʿa faraāhu fī sawāi l-jaḥīmi Then he will take a look and sight him in the middle of hell.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ fa-iṭṭalaʿa faraāhu fī sawāi l-jaḥīmi And he will look and see him1 in the midst of the Hellfire. See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ fa-iṭṭalaʿa faraāhu fī sawāi l-jaḥīmi Then he looked down and saw him in the midst of Hell. See 37:54

item.title: As-Saaffaat:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ تَاللَّهِ إِنْ كِدْتَ لَتُرْدِينِ qāla tal-lahi in kidtta latur'dīni He will say, 'By Allah, you had almost ruined me!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ تَاللَّهِ إِنْ كِدْتَ لَتُرْدِينِ qāla tal-lahi in kidtta latur'dīni He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me. See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ تَاللَّهِ إِنْ كِدْتَ لَتُرْدِينِ qāla tal-lahi in kidtta latur'dīni He shall say: "By God! thou hast almost caused me to (an exclamation or expression of surprise.) perish!" See 37:54

item.title: As-Saaffaat:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ walawlā niʿ'matu rabbī lakuntu mina l-muḥ'ḍarīna And had it not been for my Lord's blessing, I too would have been among the arraigned!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ walawlā niʿ'matu rabbī lakuntu mina l-muḥ'ḍarīna If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in (to Hell). See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ walawlā niʿ'matu rabbī lakuntu mina l-muḥ'ḍarīna And had it not been the bounty of my Lord, certainly would I (too) have been (with thee) brought into (the Hell) See 37:54

item.title: As-Saaffaat:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ afamā naḥnu bimayyitīna 'Is it [true] that we shall not die [anymore],

item.title: As-Saaffaat:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ afamā naḥnu bimayyitīna Then, are we not to die. See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ afamā naḥnu bimayyitīna Is it then we die not (hereafter)? Having seen the fate of the disbeliever and feeling the joy for being safe, the individual gets conscious of the danger of once again being returned to the earthly life and asks if there is in future any other life of temptation and. the risk of suffering any consequent perdition. Death stands for the turning point from the one state of life to another.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ illā mawtatanā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna aside from our first death, and that we shall not be punished?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ illā mawtatanā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?" See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ illā mawtatanā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna Save our first death; And we shall not be ('Which we have already had before we are granted this bliss.') chastised? See 37:58

item.title: As-Saaffaat:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu This is indeed the great success!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu Indeed, this is the great attainment. See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu Verily this is a great (feeling of realisation.) achievement. See 37:58

item.title: As-Saaffaat:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمِثْلِ هَذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ limith'li hādhā falyaʿmali l-ʿāmilūna Let all the workers work for the like of this!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمِثْلِ هَذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ limith'li hādhā falyaʿmali l-ʿāmilūna For the like of this let the workers (on earth) work. See 37:50

item.title: As-Saaffaat:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمِثْلِ هَذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ limith'li hādhā falyaʿmali l-ʿāmilūna For the like of this should act every active one! See 37:58

item.title: As-Saaffaat:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ adhālika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu l-zaqūmi Is this a better hospitality, or the Zaqqūm tree?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ adhālika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu l-zaqūmi Is that (i.e., Paradise) a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm? Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqum (37:62). Truly, We have made it (as) a trial for the wrongdoers (37:63). Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire (37:64). The shoots of its fruit stalks are like the heads of Shayatin (37:65). Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith (37:66). Then on the top of that they will be given boiling Hamim (37:67). Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell (37:68). Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path (37:69). So they (too) hastened in their footsteps (37:70). The Tree of Zaqqum and its Companions Here Allah asks: 'Is…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ adhālika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu l-zaqūmi Is this the better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqum? The tree of 'Zaqqum' according to some, is a tree having small leaves, stinging and bitter. 'Zaqqum' is a dust-coloured tree, having small round thorny leaves. It has a pungent odour with a bitter taste, and has knots in its stem - the heads of its leaves are very foul.1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِلظَّالِمِينَ innā jaʿalnāhā fit'natan lilẓẓālimīna Indeed We have made it a punishment for the wrongdoers.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِلظَّالِمِينَ innā jaʿalnāhā fit'natan lilẓẓālimīna Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِلظَّالِمِينَ innā jaʿalnāhā fit'natan lilẓẓālimīna Verily, We have made it a trial for the unjust. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ innahā shajaratun takhruju fī aṣli l-jaḥīmi Indeed it is a tree that emerges from the depths of hell.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ innahā shajaratun takhruju fī aṣli l-jaḥīmi Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ innahā shajaratun takhruju fī aṣli l-jaḥīmi Verily, it is a tree that groweth in the bottom of the hell, See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ ṭalʿuhā ka-annahu ruūsu l-shayāṭīni Its spathes are as if they were devils' heads.1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ ṭalʿuhā ka-annahu ruūsu l-shayāṭīni Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ ṭalʿuhā ka-annahu ruūsu l-shayāṭīni Its produce is (ugly) as the heads of the satans. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ fa-innahum laākilūna min'hā famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna Indeed they will eat from it and gorge with it their bellies.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ fa-innahum laākilūna min'hā famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ fa-innahum laākilūna min'hā famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna And verily they shall eat from it and fill (their) bellies with it. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِنْ حَمِيمٍ thumma inna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban min ḥamīmin Indeed, on top of that they will take a solution of scalding water.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِنْ حَمِيمٍ thumma inna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban min ḥamīmin Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِنْ حَمِيمٍ thumma inna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban min ḥamīmin Then verily for them shall be to drink over it, a mixture in boiling water. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ thumma inna marjiʿahum la-ilā l-jaḥīmi Then indeed their retreat will be toward hell.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ thumma inna marjiʿahum la-ilā l-jaḥīmi Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ thumma inna marjiʿahum la-ilā l-jaḥīmi Then verily their return shall be unto the hell See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا ءَابَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ innahum alfaw ābāahum ḍāllīna Indeed they had found their fathers astray,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا ءَابَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ innahum alfaw ābāahum ḍāllīna Indeed they found their fathers astray. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا ءَابَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ innahum alfaw ābāahum ḍāllīna Verily they found their fathers (Also ancestors.) going astray, See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهُمْ عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ fahum ʿalā āthārihim yuh'raʿūna yet they press on in their footsteps.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهُمْ عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ fahum ʿalā āthārihim yuh'raʿūna So they hastened (to follow) in their footsteps. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهُمْ عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ fahum ʿalā āthārihim yuh'raʿūna So they in their footsteps did hasten (running after.) on. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ walaqad ḍalla qablahum aktharu l-awalīna Certainly most of the ancients went astray before them,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ walaqad ḍalla qablahum aktharu l-awalīna And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples. And indeed most of the earlier ones went astray before them (37:71). And indeed We sent among them warners (37:72). Then see what was the end of those who were warned (37:73). Except the chosen servants of Allah (37:74). Allah tells us that most of the previous nations went astray, worshipping other gods alongside Allah. He states that He sent among them warners to alert them to the anger, wrath and vengeance of Allah towards those who disbelieve in Him and worship others besides Him. He tells us that they persisted in their opposition to their Messengers and their disbelief in them, so He destroyed those who disbelieved in Him and saved the believers and caused them to…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ walaqad ḍalla qablahum aktharu l-awalīna And indeed went astray most of the ancients before them, See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ walaqad arsalnā fīhim mundhirīna and certainly We had sent warners among them.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ walaqad arsalnā fīhim mundhirīna And We had already sent among them warners. See 37:71

item.title: As-Saaffaat:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ walaqad arsalnā fīhim mundhirīna And indeed We did send among them warners. See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna So observe how was the fate of those who were warned

item.title: As-Saaffaat:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna Then look how was the end of those who were warned. See 37:71

item.title: As-Saaffaat:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna See then how had been the end of those (already) warned, See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna But not the chosen servants of Allah. See 37:71

item.title: As-Saaffaat:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna Save the servants of God, the freed (See verses 15:39 - 15:42, 14:22 & 17:65.) ones (from sinning). See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ walaqad nādānā nūḥun falaniʿ'ma l-mujībūna Certainly Noah called out to Us, and how well We responded!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ walaqad nādānā nūḥun falaniʿ'ma l-mujībūna And Nuh had certainly called Us, and (We are) the best of responders. And indeed Nuh invoked Us, and We are the best of those who answer (37:75). And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (37:76). And, his progeny, them We made the survivors (37:77). And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generation (37:78). Salam (peace!) be upon Nuh among the all creatures! (37:79). Verily, thus We reward the gooddoers (37:80). Verily, he (Nuh) was one of Our believing servants (37:81). Then We drowned the others (37:82). Nuh and His People When Allah tells us about how most of the early people went astray from the path of salvation, He starts the detailed explanation of that with the story of Nuh and the…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ walaqad nādānā nūḥun falaniʿ'ma l-mujībūna And indeed did call on Us Noah, and (We are) the Most Excellent answerers (of prayer) See 37:62

item.title: As-Saaffaat:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ wanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi We delivered him and his family from the great agony,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ wanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi And We saved him and his family from the great affliction. See 37:75

item.title: As-Saaffaat:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ wanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi And We, delivered him and his followers from the great distress. Noah and his posterity saved through the Ark and the rest made to perish.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ wajaʿalnā dhurriyyatahu humu l-bāqīna and made his descendants the survivors,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ wajaʿalnā dhurriyyatahu humu l-bāqīna And We made his descendants those remaining (on the earth). See 37:75

item.title: As-Saaffaat:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ wajaʿalnā dhurriyyatahu humu l-bāqīna And We made his progeny the survivors. Noah's offsprings have been presented here as the sole survivors after the Deluge though from verses 10:73, 11:36 and 11:40, it is clear that there were others also, though very few - who followed Noah and survived the Deluge. The passage here should be interpreted as of his survivors who carried the torch of guidance to the present day. In other words the spiritual leadership continued unabated and from Abraham through the branches of the Ishmaelites and of Isaac.1 (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna and left for him a good name among posterity:

item.title: As-Saaffaat:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna And left for him (favorable mention) among later generations. See 37:75

item.title: As-Saaffaat:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna And We did perpetuate for him (his praise) in the later generations. See 37:77

item.title: As-Saaffaat:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ عَلَى نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ salāmun ʿalā nūḥin fī l-ʿālamīna 'Peace to Noah, throughout the nations!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ عَلَى نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ salāmun ʿalā nūḥin fī l-ʿālamīna "Peace upon Nuh among the worlds." See 37:75

item.title: As-Saaffaat:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ عَلَى نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ salāmun ʿalā nūḥin fī l-ʿālamīna Peace be on Noah in all the worlds! See 37:77

item.title: As-Saaffaat:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. See 37:75

item.title: As-Saaffaat:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Verily thus do We recompense the doers of good. See 37:77

item.title: As-Saaffaat:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna Indeed, he was of Our believing servants. See 37:75

item.title: As-Saaffaat:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna Verily he was (one) of Our faithful servants. See 37:77

item.title: As-Saaffaat:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna Then We drowned the others.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna Then We drowned the others (i.e., disbelievers). See 37:75

item.title: As-Saaffaat:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna Then We drowned the others. See 37:77

item.title: As-Saaffaat:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ لَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ wa-inna min shīʿatihi la-ib'rāhīma Indeed Abraham was among his followers,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ لَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ wa-inna min shīʿatihi la-ib'rāhīma And indeed, among his kind was Ibrahim. And verily, among those who followed his way was Ibrahim (37:83). When he came to his Lord with a Salim heart (37:84). When he said to his father and to his people: What is it that which you worship? (37:85). "Is it a falsehood – gods other than Allah – that you desire? (37:86). "Then what think you about the Lord of the all that exists? (37:87). The Story of Ibrahim and His People Ali bin Abi Talhah reported that Ibn 'Abbas (RA): وَإِنَّ مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ لَإِبْرَاهِيمَ And verily, among those who followed his ways was Ibrahim. means, he was one of the followers of his religion. Mujahid said, "He was following his path and his way." إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ When he came…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ لَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ wa-inna min shīʿatihi la-ib'rāhīma And verily of his persuasion (i.e., Party – group.) was Abraham. (Compare with verse 3:67.) Persons of the same ideology are called 'Shias'.1 This has become a distinguishing term for those who followed Ali, as the Holy Prophet said: 'O' Ali thou and thy Shias, on the Day of Resurrection will be on the pulpits of light and be successful.' (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ idh jāa rabbahu biqalbin salīmin when he came to his Lord with a sound heart,1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ idh jāa rabbahu biqalbin salīmin When he came to his Lord with a sound heart. See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ idh jāa rabbahu biqalbin salīmin When came he unto his Lord with a submissive heart, See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūna when he said to his father and his people, 'What is it that you are worshiping?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūna (And) when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship? See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūna When said he unto his father (Godfather who adopted. Refer to note on verse 14:41.) and his people: "What is it that ye worship?" See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ a-if'kan ālihatan dūna l-lahi turīdūna Is it a lie, gods other than Allah, that you desire?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ a-if'kan ālihatan dūna l-lahi turīdūna Is it falsehood (as) gods other than Allah you desire? See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ a-if'kan ālihatan dūna l-lahi turīdūna Is it a falsehood - gods other than (the One True) God, desire ye? See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا ظَنُّكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ famā ẓannukum birabbi l-ʿālamīna Then what is your idea about the Lord of all the worlds?'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا ظَنُّكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ famā ẓannukum birabbi l-ʿālamīna Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?" See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا ظَنُّكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ famā ẓannukum birabbi l-ʿālamīna What then think ye about the Lord of the worlds? See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ fanaẓara naẓratan fī l-nujūmi Then he made an observation of the stars1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ fanaẓara naẓratan fī l-nujūmi And he cast a look at the stars. Then he cast a glance at the stars (37:88). And he said: "Verily, I am sick (37:89). So they turned away from him and departed (37:90). Then he turned to their gods and said: "Will you not eat? (37:91). "What is the matter with you that you speak not? (37:92). Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand (37:93). Then they came hastily towards him (37:94). He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve? (37:95). "While Allah has created you and what you make! (37:96). They said: "Build for him a building and throw him into the blazing fire! (37:97). So, they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest (37:98). Ibrahim (AS), said this to his…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ fanaẓara naẓratan fī l-nujūmi Then glanced (Looked up.) he, casting glance at the stars, See 37:83

item.title: As-Saaffaat:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ سَقِيمٌ faqāla innī saqīmun and said, 'Indeed I am sick!'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ سَقِيمٌ faqāla innī saqīmun And said, "Indeed, I am (about to be) ill." See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ سَقِيمٌ faqāla innī saqīmun Then said he: "Verily, sick I am (of your worshipping these)" i.e., I am sick of your worshipping false gods, (i.e., idols). As if he was pained by the people's idolatrous belief in the influence of the stars for which they had made their temples with the idols of the stars. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ fatawallaw ʿanhu mud'birīna So they went away leaving him behind.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ fatawallaw ʿanhu mud'birīna So they turned away from him, departing. See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ fatawallaw ʿanhu mud'birīna So they turned away turning (As the result of the disgust.) their backs. See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ إِلَى آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ farāgha ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā takulūna Then he stole away to their gods and said, 'Will you not eat?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ إِلَى آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ farāgha ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā takulūna Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?1 See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ إِلَى آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ farāgha ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā takulūna Then he (Abraham) turned unto their gods secretly and said: "What! eat ye not?" See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنْطِقُونَ mā lakum lā tanṭiqūna Why do you not speak?'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنْطِقُونَ mā lakum lā tanṭiqūna What is (wrong) with you that you do not speak?" See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنْطِقُونَ mā lakum lā tanṭiqūna What aileth you that ye speak not? See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ farāgha ʿalayhim ḍarban bil-yamīni Then he attacked them, striking forcefully.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ farāgha ʿalayhim ḍarban bil-yamīni And he turned upon them a blow with (his) right hand. See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ farāgha ʿalayhim ḍarban bil-yamīni Then he attacked them in secret, striking with his right hand See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ fa-aqbalū ilayhi yaziffūna They came running towards him.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ fa-aqbalū ilayhi yaziffūna Then they (i.e., the people) came toward him, hastening. See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ fa-aqbalū ilayhi yaziffūna Then came they (the worshippers) hastening unto him. See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ qāla ataʿbudūna mā tanḥitūna He said, 'Do you worship what you have yourselves carved,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ qāla ataʿbudūna mā tanḥitūna He said, "Do you worship that which you (yourselves) carve. See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ qāla ataʿbudūna mā tanḥitūna Said he: (Abraham.) "What! worship ye what ye (yourselves) hew out?" See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ wal-lahu khalaqakum wamā taʿmalūna when Allah has created you and whatever you make?'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ wal-lahu khalaqakum wamā taʿmalūna While Allah created you and that which you do?" See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ wal-lahu khalaqakum wamā taʿmalūna And God hath created you and (also) what ye make (the idols) See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا ابْنُوْۤا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ qālū ib'nū lahu bun'yānan fa-alqūhu fī l-jaḥīmi They said, 'Build a structure for him and cast him into a huge fire.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا ابْنُوْۤا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ qālū ib'nū lahu bun'yānan fa-alqūhu fī l-jaḥīmi They said, "Construct for him a structure (i.e., furnace) and throw him into the burning fire." See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا ابْنُوْۤا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ qālū ib'nū lahu bun'yānan fa-alqūhu fī l-jaḥīmi Said they: "Erect for him (Abraham.) a building (Manjaniq) (furnace) and fling him in the flaming fire!" See 37:89

item.title: As-Saaffaat:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ fa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-asfalīna So they sought to outwit him, but We made them the lowermost.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ fa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-asfalīna And they intended for him a plan (i.e., harm), but We made them the most debased. See 37:88

item.title: As-Saaffaat:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ fa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-asfalīna So they desired a plot against him, but We brought them low. They plotted against Abraham but Abraham was helped to escape from their clutches and to prosper and, it was his enemies that were defeated in their plans and were themselves humiliated.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ waqāla innī dhāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīni He said, 'Indeed I am going toward my Lord, who will guide me.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ waqāla innī dhāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīni And (then) he said, "Indeed, I will go to (where I am ordered by) my Lord; He will guide me. And he said: Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me (37:99). "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous (37:100). So, We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy (37:101). And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you. So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, if Allah wills, you shall find me of the patient (37:102). Then, when they had both submitted themselves, and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (37:103).…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ waqāla innī dhāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīni And said he: (Abraham.) "Verily, I am going unto my Lord, He will guide me;" When Abraham found the people to be immune to every kind of admonition and guidance, and were getting further astray and ever more persecutive, he decided to leave the place and that was Abraham's Hijrat from his native place, the place of his ancestors which was naturally dear to him but dearer still was truth to him, for which he chose to fly away from the people, being sick of their incorrigible and unyielding nature and their adhering only to falsehood and living a rebellious life, Abraham trusted himself to God and left the place. It may be noted that this same thing was repeated by the Holy Prophet Muhammad, in his migrating…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ rabbi hab lī mina l-ṣāliḥīna 'My Lord! Give me [an heir], one of the righteous.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ rabbi hab lī mina l-ṣāliḥīna My Lord, grant me (a child) from among the righteous." See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ rabbi hab lī mina l-ṣāliḥīna O' my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)! Abraham receiving Hajira as a gift from his good-hearted wife Sara who could not till then bear any issue for him, prayed to God for an issue at least from the newly acquired wife (Hajira). To have a companion from his own lineage to assist him in his movement towards God. The same was the prayer of Moses, Zachariah and the Holy Prophet. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ fabasharnāhu bighulāmin ḥalīmin So We gave him the good news of a forbearing son.1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ fabasharnāhu bighulāmin ḥalīmin So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy. See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ fabasharnāhu bighulāmin ḥalīmin So We gave him the glad tidings of a son (Ishmael.) extremely forbearing (Also gentle.) 'Halim' Forbearing - Extremely Patient - Never being hasty in any serious action.
