This quality of 'Hilm' has been mentioned particularly of Abraham and his son Ishmael, the ancestor of the Holy Prophet, who had inherited this quality specially commended by God.1 It was asked of the Sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq as to what was the interval between the two glad tidings given to Abraham of Ishmael and Isaac. He said 'Five years', the first about the birth of Ishmael and that of the subsequent one of Isaac. Though Sara had herself presented Hajira to her husband Abraham, but after Hajira bearing an issue (Ishmael) to Abraham, which she had not by then been blessed to…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا تَرٰی قَالَ يَاأَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ falammā balagha maʿahu l-saʿya qāla yābunayya innī arā fī l-manāmi annī adhbaḥuka fa-unẓur mādhā tarā qāla yāabati if'ʿal mā tu'maru satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣābirīna When he was old enough to assist in his endeavour, he said, 'My son! I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you. See what you think.' He said, 'Father! Do whatever you have been commanded. If Allah wishes, you will find me to be patient.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا تَرٰی قَالَ يَاأَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ falammā balagha maʿahu l-saʿya qāla yābunayya innī arā fī l-manāmi annī adhbaḥuka fa-unẓur mādhā tarā qāla yāabati if'ʿal mā tu'maru satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣābirīna And when he reached with him (the age of) exertion,1 he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I (must) sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast." See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا تَرٰی قَالَ يَاأَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ falammā balagha maʿahu l-saʿya qāla yābunayya innī arā fī l-manāmi annī adhbaḥuka fa-unẓur mādhā tarā qāla yāabati if'ʿal mā tu'maru satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣābirīna And when (the son) reached (the age of) working with him, said he: (Abraham.) "O' my son! verily I saw in a dream that I sacrifice thee: now what is thy view?" Said (the son)! "O' father! Do thou what thou art bidden; (Commanded.) If God willeth, thou wilt find me of the steadfast ones" When Abraham visited Hajira, Ishmael his son had reached the age of thirteen. Once Abraham dreamt to be sacrificing his son Ishmael. It was on the 8th of the lunar month of Dhu…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ falammā aslamā watallahu lil'jabīni So when they had both submitted [to Allah's will], and he had laid him down on his forehead,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ falammā aslamā watallahu lil'jabīni And when they had both submitted1 and he put him down upon his forehead. See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ falammā aslamā watallahu lil'jabīni And when they both had surrendered (themselves) to the will of God and he (Abraham) threw him (the son) upon his forehead, Before laying his son on the ground to fulfil what he had been commanded in the vision to do, Ishmael asked his father to tie his hands and legs tight, and blindfold himself by a bandage on his eyes and to girdle his cloak. Abraham asked Ishmael the reason for the suggestion and if he was afraid and unwilling. Ishmael said that when his throat would be cut, though wholly resigned Ishmael said that when his throat would be cut, though wholly resigned to the will of the Lord, he might naturally feel the pains and get restless and struggle, which sight might naturally disturb Abraham while acting to fulfil…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَنْ يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ wanādaynāhu an yāib'rāhīmu We called out to him, 'O Abraham!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَنْ يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ wanādaynāhu an yāib'rāhīmu We called to him, "O Ibrahim. See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَنْ يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ wanādaynāhu an yāib'rāhīmu And We called out unto him: "O' Abraham!" Any other father would have only rejoiced at the escape of his son from death but Abraham stood disappointed and dismayed apprehending if his sacrifice had been rejected by God. A voice from above cried out to Abraham saying, "O' Abraham! Worry thyself not (37:104), for indeed thou hast been true to Our command given to thee in the vision and thus it is, We recompense those who do good (37:105)".

item.title: As-Saaffaat:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّءْيَا إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ qad ṣaddaqta l-ru'yā innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna You have indeed fulfilled the vision!1 Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّءْيَا إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ qad ṣaddaqta l-ru'yā innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّءْيَا إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ qad ṣaddaqta l-ru'yā innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Indeed hast thou proved true the dream; Verily thus (In this way.) do We recompense the doers of good! See 37:104

item.title: As-Saaffaat:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَؤُا الْمُبِينُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-balāu l-mubīnu This was indeed a manifest test.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَؤُا الْمُبِينُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-balāu l-mubīnu Indeed, this was the clear trial. See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَؤُا الْمُبِينُ inna hādhā lahuwa l-balāu l-mubīnu Verily, this is an open trial. The command was only an open trial to prove the pure calibre of Abraham and Ishmael, the true servants of God, were made of, and the high degree of faith in God they possessed and to what an extreme extent they actually submitted themselves to the will of their Lord.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ wafadaynāhu bidhib'ḥin ʿaẓīmin Then We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ wafadaynāhu bidhib'ḥin ʿaẓīmin And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice.1 See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ wafadaynāhu bidhib'ḥin ʿaẓīmin And We ransomed him with a Great Sacrifice. 'Fadayna' means, ransoming - which demands a similar thing in the place of the one spared. The quality of the sacrifice with which the sacrifice of Ishmael was spared, is termed by God Himself as 'Azeem', i.e., Great. What God the Greatest Being Himself terms as Great must naturally be something Great in an absolute or in an extraordinary degree. In the first place an ordinary sheep can by no means and in no sense whatsoever be sensibly termed to be Great. Secondly, to term a sheep as great, in comparison to the godly son of the great apostle of God, who was also God's apostle, would be nothing but illogical but also degrading Ishmael. A ransom should essentially be of a preferably greater value, otherwise…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna and left for him a good name in posterity:

item.title: As-Saaffaat:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna And We left for him (favorable mention) among later generations. See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna And We shifted (this blessing) on him (who is from) among the generations (to come) in later times; Five years after he had received the glad tidings about the birth of Ishmael, Abraham was given the glad tidings about the birth of Isaac when he was about 100 years of age.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:112 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wabasharnāhu bi-is'ḥāqa nabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We gave him the good news of [the birth of] Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:112 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wabasharnāhu bi-is'ḥāqa nabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We gave him good tidings of Ishaq, a prophet from among the righteous.1 See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:112 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ wabasharnāhu bi-is'ḥāqa nabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīna And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous ones. The keynote is that the tidings of the birth of Isaac is mentioned here after giving the detailed story of Abraham starting his movements, his young son Ishmael and the story of his sacrifice - indicate clearly that the whole story belongs to Ishmael and the history of Isaac being the subject of sacrifice is unfounded according to Qur'an. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:113 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى إِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā is'ḥāqa wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥ'sinun waẓālimun linafsihi mubīnun And We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants [some] are virtuous, and [some] who manifestly wrong themselves.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:113 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى إِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā is'ḥāqa wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥ'sinun waẓālimun linafsihi mubīnun And We blessed him and Ishaq. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself (i.e., sinner). See 37:99

item.title: As-Saaffaat:113 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى إِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā is'ḥāqa wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥ'sinun waẓālimun linafsihi mubīnun And bestowed We Our blessings on him and on Isaac: and on their progeny are the doers of good, and those (too) who are openly unjust (Of the Children of Israel (Jacob) son of Isaac, there were good and also bad ones.) to their own selves. The other name of Isaac was Israel, hence the children of Isaac are referred to as the children of Israel who enjoyed the promised blessings of God as long as they deserved it and when they got corrupted in faith and in their practical life, they themselves earned the fall from God's grace and harmed none but themselves. When the offerings of Abraham are referred to it need not necessarily or exclusively be the…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:114 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَى مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ walaqad manannā ʿalā mūsā wahārūna Certainly We favoured Moses and Aaron,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:114 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَى مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ walaqad manannā ʿalā mūsā wahārūna And We did certainly confer favor upon Musa and Harun. And, indeed We gave Our grace to Musa and Harun (37:114). And We saved them and their people from the great distress (37:115). And helped them, so that they became the victors (37:116). And We gave them the clear Scripture (37:117). And guided them to the right path (37:118). And We left for them among the later generations (37:119). Salam (peace!) be upon Musa and Harun! (37:120). Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good (37:121). Verily, they were two of Our believing servants (37:122). Musa and Harun Allah tells us how He blessed Musa and Harun with prophethood and how He saved them, along with those who believed, from the oppression of Fir'awn and his people, who had…

item.description: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَى مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ walaqad manannā ʿalā mūsā wahārūna And indeed conferred We Our favour on Moses and Aaron. The events relating to the life-history of Moses are very frequent and many in the Holy Qur'an. But for the events specially concerned with reference to this verse.1

item.description: سَلَامٌ عَلَى مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ salāmun ʿalā mūsā wahārūna Peace be on Moses and Aaron. Whenever Moses and Aaron are mentioned jointly as the blessed and the chosen ones of God, the saying of the Holy Prophet should be remembered - Ana wa Ali min Noorin Waahid. I and Ali are of one and the same Light - 'O' Ali thou art to me as Aaron was to Moses.' (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:123 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna il'yāsa lamina l-mur'salīna And indeed Ilyās was one of the apostles,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:123 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna il'yāsa lamina l-mur'salīna And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers. And verily, Ilyas was one of the Messengers (37:123). When he said to his people: "Will you not have Taqwa? (37:124). "Will you call upon 'Ba'l and forsake the Best of creators (37:125). Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers? (37:126). But they denied him, so they will certainly be brought forth (37:127). Save the chosen servants of Allah (37:128). And We left for him among the later generations (37:129). "Salam (peace!) be upon Ilyasin! (37:130). Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good (37:131). Verily, he was one of Our believing servants (37:132). Ilyas Qatadah and Muhammad bin Ishaq said, "Ilyas is another name for Idris." Ibn Abi Hatim recorded that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA), said, "Ilyas is Idris." This…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:123 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna il'yāsa lamina l-mur'salīna And verily, Elias was (one) of the apostles. See verse 6:85. Yaseen was the name of Ilyas' father, and that of the Holy Prophet Muhammad, hence in the Qur'anic address the name of the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt are also known as Aali Yaseen.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:124 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla liqawmihi alā tattaqūna when he said to his people, 'Will you not be Godwary?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:124 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla liqawmihi alā tattaqūna When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah? See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:124 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla liqawmihi alā tattaqūna When said he unto his people; "What! Guard ye (Why do ye not practice piety.) not yourselves (against evil)?" Refers to Ilyas admonishing the people who had turned idolaters after the death of Moses. The people worshipped a huge idol called Ba'l and the place was called after the name of the idol Ba'l Bak – Bak - i.e., the city Ba'l-Bak i.e., Baal's city.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:125 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran

item.title: As-Saaffaat:125 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ atadʿūna baʿlan watadharūna aḥsana l-khāliqīna Do you call upon Baʿl1 and leave the best of creators. See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:125 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ atadʿūna baʿlan watadharūna aḥsana l-khāliqīna What! Call ye upon Ba'l (The idol whom the people worshipped as God.) and forsake the Best of the creators? See 37:124

item.title: As-Saaffaat:126 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ al-laha rabbakum warabba ābāikumu l-awalīna Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:126 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ al-laha rabbakum warabba ābāikumu l-awalīna Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?" See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:126 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ al-laha rabbakum warabba ābāikumu l-awalīna God, is your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of (Ancestors.) yore? See 37:124

item.title: As-Saaffaat:127 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ fakadhabūhu fa-innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna But they impugned him. So they will indeed be arraigned [before Him]

item.title: As-Saaffaat:127 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ fakadhabūhu fa-innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought (for punishment). See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:127 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ fakadhabūhu fa-innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna But they belied him, so they shall certainly be brought (to account), See 37:124

item.title: As-Saaffaat:128 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:128 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna Except the chosen servants of Allah. See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:128 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna Save the servants of God, the freed ones (from sinning) See 37:124

item.title: As-Saaffaat:129 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna We left for him a good name in posterity.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:129 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna And We left for him (favorable mention) among later generations. See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:129 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna And We perpetuated his praise in the later generations, The clause 'We perpetuated' has been mentioned with Noah, Abraham, Moses, Aaron and Elias and stopped. Which means that in the later generation they were persons who represented these personalities - Refer 'Ziarat' (Salutation) of Warith. All these apostles were represented in the Ahl Al-Bayt. Since Lot and Jonah are not reported to have had any offsprings and do not come in the lineage of Noah and Abraham, Elias being alive still, is represented by Ali. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:130 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ عَلَى إِلْ يَاسِينَ salāmun ʿalā il-yāsīna 'Peace be to Ilyās!'1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:130 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ عَلَى إِلْ يَاسِينَ salāmun ʿalā il-yāsīna "Peace upon Elias."1 See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:130 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ عَلَى إِلْ يَاسِينَ salāmun ʿalā il-yāsīna Peace be on 'Ilyasin' (Elias). Whether the recitation of 'Ilyaseen' or 'Aale-Yaseen' the evidence of the context leaves no doubt that it means the same 'Ilyas' mentioned in verse 37:123 - who is identified in the Bible as 'Elia' or 'Elyah'. There is a narration from Ibn Abbas which asserts that the word here is 'Aale-Yaseen' refers to 'Aale-Muhammad' because 'Yaseen' is the title of the Holy Prophet. If the tradition is authentic, most possibly Ibn Abbas mentioned 'Aale-Yaseen' not as the word of the title of the Holy Prophet but on the ground of the association of the ideas he might have mentioned, 'Aale-Yaseen' also to be the subject of the 'Peace from God' similar to 'Ilyaseen' and there are many biblical evidences which show the reappearance of Elijah as identified with…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:131 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:131 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:131 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Verily, thus (in this way.) do We recompense the doers of good. See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:132 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:132 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna Indeed, he was of Our believing servants. See 37:123

item.title: As-Saaffaat:132 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna Verily, he was (one) of Our faithful servants. See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:133 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna lūṭan lamina l-mur'salīna And indeed Lot was one of the apostles,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:133 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna lūṭan lamina l-mur'salīna And indeed, Lut was among the messengers. And verily, Lut was one of the Messengers (37:133). When We saved him and his family, all (37:134). Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind (37:135). Then We destroyed the rest (37:136). Verily, you pass by them in the morning (37:137). And at night; will you not then reflect (37:138). The Destruction of the People of Lut Allah tells us that He sent His servant and Messenger Lut (AS), to his people, and they denied him, so Allah saved him from among them, him and his family with the exception of his wife, who was destroyed along with her people. Allah destroyed them with different kinds of punishments, and made their vicinity a foul, stinking lake which is on…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:133 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna lūṭan lamina l-mur'salīna And verily Lot, was (one) of the apostles. See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:134 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ idh najjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna when We delivered him and all his family,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:134 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ idh najjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna (So mention) when We saved him and his family, all. See 37:133

item.title: As-Saaffaat:134 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ idh najjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna When We delivered him and his followers all. See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:135 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna except an old woman among those who remained behind.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:135 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna Except an old woman (i.e., his wife) among those who remained (with the evildoers). See 37:133

item.title: As-Saaffaat:135 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna Save an aged woman (Wife of Lot. Note the fate of a wife of a Prophet – with regard to the inclusion of her in the Ahl Al-Bayt.) among those who tarried. See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:136 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna Then We destroyed [all] the others.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:136 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna Then We destroyed the others. See 37:133

item.title: As-Saaffaat:136 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna Then We destroyed the others. See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:137 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مُصْبِحِينَ wa-innakum latamurrūna ʿalayhim muṣ'biḥīna And indeed you pass by them at dawn

item.title: As-Saaffaat:137 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مُصْبِحِينَ wa-innakum latamurrūna ʿalayhim muṣ'biḥīna And indeed, you pass by them in the morning. See 37:133

item.title: As-Saaffaat:137 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مُصْبِحِينَ wa-innakum latamurrūna ʿalayhim muṣ'biḥīna And verily, ye pass by (their ruined dwellings) at morn, See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:138 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِاللَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wabi-al-layli afalā taʿqilūna and at night. So do you not apply reason?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:138 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِاللَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wabi-al-layli afalā taʿqilūna And at night. Then will you not use reason? See 37:133

item.title: As-Saaffaat:138 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبِاللَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wabi-al-layli afalā taʿqilūna And at night; What! (even) then understand ye not? See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:139 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna yūnusa lamina l-mur'salīna And indeed Jonah was one of the apostles,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:139 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna yūnusa lamina l-mur'salīna And indeed, Yunus was among the messengers. And verily, Yunus was one of the Messengers (37:139). When he ran to the laden ship (37:140). Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers (37:141). Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame (37:142). Had he not been of them who glorify Allah (37:143). He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection (37:144). But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick (37:45). And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him (37:146). And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more (37:147). And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while (37:148). The Story…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:139 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wa-inna yūnusa lamina l-mur'salīna And verily Jonah was (one) of the apostles. See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:140 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ idh abaqa ilā l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni when he absconded toward the laden ship.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:140 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ idh abaqa ilā l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni (Mention) when he ran away to the laden ship. See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:140 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ idh abaqa ilā l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni When he fled unto a ship fully laden, See 37:130

item.title: As-Saaffaat:141 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ fasāhama fakāna mina l-mud'ḥaḍīna Then he drew lots with them and he was the one to be refuted.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:141 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ fasāhama fakāna mina l-mud'ḥaḍīna And he drew lots1 and was among the losers. See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:141 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ fasāhama fakāna mina l-mud'ḥaḍīna And they drew lots, and he was of those who were cast off. When the lot was cast as to who in the boat should be cast off into the sea, it is said that forty times consecutively the lot fell to the name of Jonah and ultimately, he was cast out from the boat into the sea.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:142 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ fal-taqamahu l-ḥūtu wahuwa mulīmun Then the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:142 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ fal-taqamahu l-ḥūtu wahuwa mulīmun Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.1 See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:142 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ fal-taqamahu l-ḥūtu wahuwa mulīmun And the fish swallowed him while he was blamed. Jonah was swallowed by a fish – and it is said that Jonah felt miserable in the belly of the fish and was caused to remain there for three days and when he prayed to God reciting: "La ilaha illa Anta, Subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin"(21:87), i.e., There is no God save Thee, Thou art the Pure and verily I am of the unjust ones. Jonah was caused to be cast out from the belly of the fish and was restored to ordinary life on earth. Hence the times every day after any recital of this sentence for 121 times every day after any one of the daily prayers regularly for 40 days is very effective to get relief from any calamity or sorrow…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:143 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ falawlā annahu kāna mina l-musabiḥīna And had he not been one of those who celebrate Allah's glory,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:143 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ falawlā annahu kāna mina l-musabiḥīna And had he not been of those who exalt Allah. See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:143 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ falawlā annahu kāna mina l-musabiḥīna So if it were not that he was of those who glorify Us, See 37:142

item.title: As-Saaffaat:144 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna he would have surely remained in its belly till the day they will be resurrected.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:144 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.1 See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:144 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He would certainly have been detained in its belly to the Day (of Resurrection) when they shall be raised; See 37:142

item.title: As-Saaffaat:145 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ fanabadhnāhu bil-ʿarāi wahuwa saqīmun Then We cast him on a bare shore, and he was sick.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:145 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ fanabadhnāhu bil-ʿarāi wahuwa saqīmun But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill. See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:145 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ fanabadhnāhu bil-ʿarāi wahuwa saqīmun And We cast him forth on the naked shore and he was sick. The fish was commanded by God to cast out Jonah from its stomach - upon a barren plain.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:146 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِنْ يَقْطِينٍ wa-anbatnā ʿalayhi shajaratan min yaqṭīnin So We made a gourd plant grow above him.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:146 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِنْ يَقْطِينٍ wa-anbatnā ʿalayhi shajaratan min yaqṭīnin And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.1 See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:146 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِنْ يَقْطِينٍ wa-anbatnā ʿalayhi shajaratan min yaqṭīnin And caused We to grow (to give shade) over him, a plant of gourd. When Jonah was cast out of the fish's belly, he was very ill - with his skin worn out. God caused gourd plant to grow which provided Jonah with its wide leaves with which he protected his body against the sun and prevented flies troubling his wounded body. A wild goat at the command of God, used to come and feed Jonah. When he got better and could move about and had been out somewhere and returned to his place, he found the gourd plant dried away. Jonah felt for losing the useful plant.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:147 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūna We sent him to a [community of] hundred thousand or more,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:147 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūna And We sent him1 to (his people of) a hundred thousand or more. See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:147 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūna And We sent him unto a hundred thousand (people) or (even) more were they. God addressing Jonah said: "O' Jonah! thou didst not feel for a hundred and several thousands of thy fellow men having been made to perish for rebellion against thee and now thou feelest for merely losing a gourd tree which thou needest no more. Now go thou to thy people for a hundred thousand and even more of them have turned faithful and eagerly await to meet thee."

item.title: As-Saaffaat:148 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ faāmanū famattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin and they believed [in him]. So We provided for them for a while.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:148 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ faāmanū famattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment (of life) for a time. See 37:139

item.title: As-Saaffaat:148 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ faāmanū famattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin And believed they, so We gave them provision till a time. When Jonah reached the outskirts of the town of Nainavah, he met a shepherd who did not believe him to be Jonah, for the people knew him to be drowned. Jonah prayed to God and a sheep cried out in clear words bearing testimony to Jonah's identification. The shepherd went to his people and announced to them about Jonah's return but the people first disbelieved, but when they heard the sheep bearing testimony to his claim they believed in him.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:149 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ fa-is'taftihim alirabbika l-banātu walahumu l-banūna Ask them, are daughters to be for your Lord while sons are to be for them?1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:149 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ fa-is'taftihim alirabbika l-banātu walahumu l-banūna So inquire of them, (O Muḥammad), "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?1 Now ask them: Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them? (37:149). Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses (37:150). Verily, it is of their falsehood that they say (37:151). "Allah has begotten." And, verily, they are liars (37:152). Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons (37:153). What is the matter with you? How do you decide (37:154). Will you not then remember (37:155). Or is there for you a plain authority (37:156). Then bring your Book if you are truthful (37:157). And they have invented a kinship between Him and the Jinn, but the Jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (37:158).…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:149 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ fa-is'taftihim alirabbika l-banātu walahumu l-banūna Then ask them (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) Is it that thy Lord hath daughters, (The angels worshipped by the heathens as the daughters of God.) and they have sons? After giving a brief account of the prophets who preached against idolatry in general and the Star-worship in particular, Qur'an turns back addressing the pagans of the time of the Holy Prophet attacking the paganic idea of the time. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:150 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūna Did We create the angels females while they were present?1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:150 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūna Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?" See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:150 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūna Or have We created the angels, females? and did they witness it? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:151 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ alā innahum min if'kihim layaqūlūna Look! It is indeed out of their mendacity that they say,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:151 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ alā innahum min if'kihim layaqūlūna Unquestionably, it is out of their (invented) falsehood that they say. See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:151 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ alā innahum min if'kihim layaqūlūna Beware! Verily it is of their own falsehood that they say: See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:152 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَدَ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ walada l-lahu wa-innahum lakādhibūna 'Allah has begotten,' and they indeed speak a falsehood.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:152 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَدَ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ walada l-lahu wa-innahum lakādhibūna "Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars. See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:152 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَدَ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ walada l-lahu wa-innahum lakādhibūna (that) God hath begotten: (Jesus worshipped as the begotten Son of God.) And verily they utter a lie. See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:153 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ aṣṭafā l-banāti ʿalā l-banīna Has he preferred daughters to sons?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:153 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ aṣṭafā l-banāti ʿalā l-banīna Has He chosen daughters over sons? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:153 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ aṣṭafā l-banāti ʿalā l-banīna Hath he preferred daughters to sons? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:154 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:154 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna What is (wrong) with you? How do you make judgement? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:154 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna What hath happened to you? How judge ye? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:155 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afalā tadhakkarūna Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:155 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afalā tadhakkarūna Then will you not be reminded? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:155 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ afalā tadhakkarūna What! will ye not then reflect? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:156 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُبِينٌ am lakum sul'ṭānun mubīnun Do you have a manifest authority?1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:156 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُبِينٌ am lakum sul'ṭānun mubīnun Or do you have a clear authority?1 See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:156 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُبِينٌ am lakum sul'ṭānun mubīnun Or have ye any clear authority? See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:157 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتُوْۤا بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ fatū bikitābikum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Then produce your scripture, should you be truthful.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:157 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتُوْۤا بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ fatū bikitābikum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful. See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:157 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتُوْۤا بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ fatū bikitābikum in kuntum ṣādiqīna Then bring ye your book if ye be truthful. Most probably the reference is to the star-worshippers who claimed to have their own scripture from one of the ancient prophets. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:158 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna And they have set up a kinship between Him and the jinn, while the jinn certainly know that they will indeed be presented [before Him].

item.title: As-Saaffaat:158 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna And they have made (i.e., claimed) between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they (who made such claims) will be brought (to punishment). See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:158 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna And assign they between Him and the jinn a kinship, and indeed the jinn to know that they shall surely be brought up (to account on the Day of Judgment) Some of the infidels believed that the angels are the issues of God, through His alliance with the selected women of the Jinns. And the fire-worshippers thought that God and Satan are two brothers, one works goodness and creates light and the other works evils and causes darkness.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:159 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna Clear is Allah of whatever they allege [about Him],

item.title: As-Saaffaat:159 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna Exalted is Allah above what they describe. See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:159 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna Hallowed is God far above from what they (people in general.) ascribe (unto Him), See 37:158

item.title: As-Saaffaat:160 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:160 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna Except the chosen servants of Allah (who do not share in that sin). See 37:149

item.title: As-Saaffaat:160 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna But (not so are) the servants, freed (from sinning) The conception about God, forwarded by the others, to the purified servants of God, has no value. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:161 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ fa-innakum wamā taʿbudūna Indeed you and what you worship

item.title: As-Saaffaat:161 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ fa-innakum wamā taʿbudūna So indeed, you (disbelievers) and whatever you worship. So, verily you and those whom you worshi (37:161). Cannot lead astray (37:162). Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell (37:163). And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (37:164). And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (37:165). And verily, we (angels) indeed are those who glorify (37:166). And indeed they used to say (37:167). "If we had a reminder as had the men of old, (37:168). "We would have indeed been the chosen servants of Allah! (37:169). But (now) they disbelieve therein, so they will come to know (37:170). No One Believes what the Idolators Say Except Those Who are Even More Misguided than They Allah says, addressing the idolators: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ - مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:161 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ fa-innakum wamā taʿbudūna So verily ye and what ye worship, See 37:160

item.title: As-Saaffaat:162 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ mā antum ʿalayhi bifātinīna —you cannot mislead [anyone] about Him,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:162 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ mā antum ʿalayhi bifātinīna You cannot tempt (anyone) away from Him. See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:162 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ mā antum ʿalayhi bifātinīna Ye can excite not (any one) against Him, See 37:160

item.title: As-Saaffaat:163 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ illā man huwa ṣāli l-jaḥīmi except someone who is bound for hell.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:163 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ illā man huwa ṣāli l-jaḥīmi Except he who is to (enter and) burn in the Hellfire.1 See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:163 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ illā man huwa ṣāli l-jaḥīmi Except him who goes to Hell. See 37:160

item.title: As-Saaffaat:164 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَعْلُومٌ wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmun 'There is none among us but has a known place.1

item.title: As-Saaffaat:164 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَعْلُومٌ wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmun (The angels say),1 "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.2 See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:164 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَعْلُومٌ wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmun And there is not (any one) of us, but for him is an assigned place, Ref. to what the angels state about their own position, against the wrong description of them the pagans - from verse 149. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:165 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu l-ṣāfūna Indeed it is we who are the ranged ones.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:165 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu l-ṣāfūna And indeed, we are those who line up (for prayer). See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:165 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu l-ṣāfūna And verily we are they who range ourselves in order. (Explanation to the beginning Verses of the Chapter.) See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:166 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu l-musabiḥūna Indeed it is we who are those who celebrate Allah's glory.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:166 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu l-musabiḥūna And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah." See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:166 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ wa-innā lanaḥnu l-musabiḥūna And verily we are they who celebrate His praise. See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:167 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا لَيَقُولُونَ wa-in kānū layaqūlūna Indeed they1 used to say,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:167 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا لَيَقُولُونَ wa-in kānū layaqūlūna And indeed, they (i.e., the disbelievers) used to say.1 See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:167 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا لَيَقُولُونَ wa-in kānū layaqūlūna And certainly they (the disbelievers.) used to say, See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:168 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīna 'Had we possessed a reminder from the ancients,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:168 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīna "If we had a message from (those of) the former peoples. See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:168 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīna Had we a reminder from those of yore, See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:169 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ lakunnā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna we would surely have been Allah's exclusive servants.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:169 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ lakunnā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna We would have been the chosen servants of Allah." See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:169 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ lakunnā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna Certainly had we been the servants of God, sincerely devoted See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:170 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ fakafarū bihi fasawfa yaʿlamūna But they disbelieved it [when it came to them]. Soon they will know.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:170 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ fakafarū bihi fasawfa yaʿlamūna But they disbelieved in it,1 so they are going to know. See 37:161

item.title: As-Saaffaat:170 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ fakafarū bihi fasawfa yaʿlamūna Then disbelieved they with it, so, soon will they know. See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:171 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad sabaqat kalimatunā liʿibādinā l-mur'salīna Certainly Our decree has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants, the apostles,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:171 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad sabaqat kalimatunā liʿibādinā l-mur'salīna And Our word (i.e., decree) has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers. And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our servants, the Messengers (37:171). That they verily would be made triumphant (37:172). And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors (37:173). So, turn away from them for a while (37:174). And watch them and they shall see (37:175). Do they seek to hasten on Our torment (37:176). Then, when it descends in their courtyard, evil will be the morning for those who had warned (37:177). So, turn away from them for a while (37:178). And watch and they shall see (37:179). The Promise of Victory and the Command to Turn Away from Idolators Allah says: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ And, verily, Our Word…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:171 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ walaqad sabaqat kalimatunā liʿibādinā l-mur'salīna And indeed Our word hath already gone forth about (in favour of.) Our servants, the apostles: See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:172 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنْصُورُونَ innahum lahumu l-manṣūrūna that they will indeed receive [Allah's] help,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:172 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنْصُورُونَ innahum lahumu l-manṣūrūna (That) indeed, they would be those given victory. See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:172 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنْصُورُونَ innahum lahumu l-manṣūrūna Verily they shall be the succoured ones. See 37:164

item.title: As-Saaffaat:173 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ جُنْدَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ wa-inna jundanā lahumu l-ghālibūna and indeed Our hosts will be the victors.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:173 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ جُنْدَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ wa-inna jundanā lahumu l-ghālibūna And (that) indeed, Our soldiers (i.e., the believers) will be those who overcome.1 See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:173 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ جُنْدَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ wa-inna jundanā lahumu l-ghālibūna And verily Our hosts, (only) they shall be the victorious. This implies that there should be a state before the Resurrection Day of complete triumph of the mission of the divine guidance on earth which would mean, the triumph of everyone who played his part in the promotion of the divine mission. This is what the reappearance of the last Imam of the Ahl Al-Bayt, The Mahdi, implies - and this refers to the doctrine of 'Raj'at'. In the sense that man by spiritual accomplishment succeeds, to establish communication with all those who took part with all the personalities of the past who played prominent parts in this final triumph of the Truth. This is not the final resurrection day - in support of this refer to verses 39:67 - 39:75. This…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:174 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ fatawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin So leave them alone for a while,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:174 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ fatawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin So, (O Muḥammad), leave them for a time. See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:174 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ fatawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin So turn thou away from them for a time, (Until the Final Triumph.) See 37:173

item.title: As-Saaffaat:175 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ wa-abṣir'hum fasawfa yub'ṣirūna and watch them; soon they will see [the truth of the matter].

item.title: As-Saaffaat:175 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ wa-abṣir'hum fasawfa yub'ṣirūna And see (what will befall) them, for they are going to see. See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:175 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ wa-abṣir'hum fasawfa yub'ṣirūna And (then) behold thou: for they too shall soon behold (their doom). See 37:173

item.title: As-Saaffaat:176 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?

item.title: As-Saaffaat:176 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna Then for Our punishment are they impatient? See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:176 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna What! would they then hasten on Our chastisement? See 37:173

item.title: As-Saaffaat:177 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīna But when it descends in their courtyard it will be a dismal dawn for those who had been warned.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:177 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīna But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned. See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:177 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīna But when it shall descend in their court, (face to face just before them.) evil shall then be the morning of the warned ones. Refer 175 This is what the tradition of the Ahl Al-Bayt asserts, that during the final trial not only those who played a prominent part in favour of the triumph will enjoy, but the chief opponents also wherever they be, will realise the triumph and will suffer. All this shall take place before the Total Resurrection. (A.P.). It is wrong to confine the application of this verse only to those Meccans who were defeated by the Muslims until the conquest of Mecca, as it would mean limitation of the jurisdiction of the Holy Prophet against what is declared at the beginning.1 (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:178 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ watawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin So leave them alone for a while,

item.title: As-Saaffaat:178 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ watawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin And leave them for a time. See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:178 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ watawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin And turn thou away from them for a time, Indicates that before the final triumph, there will be setbacks as the past of the Muslims and the believers should not become loose-hearted or get dejected. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:179 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ wa-abṣir fasawfa yub'ṣirūna and watch; soon they will see.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:179 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ wa-abṣir fasawfa yub'ṣirūna And see, for they are going to see. See 37:171

item.title: As-Saaffaat:179 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ wa-abṣir fasawfa yub'ṣirūna And (then) behold thou, for they too shall soon see (their doom). See 37:178

item.title: As-Saaffaat:180 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūna Clear is your Lord, the Lord of Might, of whatever they allege [concerning Him].

item.title: As-Saaffaat:180 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūna Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Al-'Izzah! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him (37:180). And Salam (peace!) be on the Messengers (37:181). And all the praises and thanks be to Allah, Lord of all that exists (37:182). Allah glorified Himself and states that He is far above what the lying wrongdoers say about Him; glorified and sanctified and exalted be He far above what they say. Allah says: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Al-'Izzah! Meaning: the Owner of might and power Whom none can resist. عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him! means, from what these lying fabricators say. وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ…

item.title: As-Saaffaat:180 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūna Hallowed is thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, far above from that which they ascribe (unto Him) See 37:178

item.title: As-Saaffaat:181 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wasalāmun ʿalā l-mur'salīna Peace be to the apostles!

item.title: As-Saaffaat:181 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wasalāmun ʿalā l-mur'salīna And peace upon the messengers. See 37:180

item.title: As-Saaffaat:181 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ wasalāmun ʿalā l-mur'salīna And peace be upon the apostles. This will actually be realised by all, during the final triumph. Blessed and happy are those who have already realised as the Holy Prophet has done. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:182 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:182 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds. See 37:180

item.title: As-Saaffaat:182 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna And all praise is God's, the Lord of the worlds. See 37:181

item.title: As-Saff:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and whatever there is in the earth, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: As-Saff:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah,1 and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا Verily, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in rows (ranks) "Before Allah's Messenger SAW began the battle against the enemy, he liked to line up his forces in rows; in this Surah, Allah teaches the believers to do the same." He also said that Allah's statement: كَأَنَّهُمْ بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ as if they were a solid structure. means, its parts are firmly connected to each other; in rows for battle. Muqatil bin Hayyan said, "Firmly connected to each other." Ibn 'Abbas commented on the meaning of the…

item.title: As-Saff:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Halloweth (Refer to Verses 17:44; 62:1; 64:1.) God whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and He is the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise. This verse is similar to 59:1 and 62:1. The glorification of God by everything of His creations means the implicit obedience with which the beings known as animate and the inanimate in our classification, both in the heavens and in the earth, working out God' plan without the least diversion from the course given to them by their Lord.

item.title: As-Saff:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lima taqūlūna mā lā tafʿalūna O you who have faith! Why do you say what you do not do?

item.title: As-Saff:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lima taqūlūna mā lā tafʿalūna O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do? See 61:1

item.title: As-Saff:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lima taqūlūna mā lā tafʿalūna 'O' ye who believe! Why say ye what (That which.) ye (yourselves) do (it) not? This refers to the tall talks of most of the companions of the Holy Prophet. People had talked a lot about their devotion to God and His Holy Prophet, about the great sacrifices they were ready to offer, and about their verbal determination to do or to die in the fight for the Truth but when the occasions arose against the enemy, they miserably failed to maintain their verbal resolution with any firmness in action. At Uhud most of the weak in faith and the fickle-minded ones among the converts to Islam took to flight and according to Tabari, Tarikh al-Khamis, Tafsir al-Kabir, Minhaj an-Nubuwwah etc. many of the…

item.title: As-Saff:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi an taqūlū mā lā tafʿalūna It is greatly outrageous to Allah that you should say what you do not do.

item.title: As-Saff:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi an taqūlū mā lā tafʿalūna Greatly hateful in the sight of Allah is that you say what you do not do. See 61:1

item.title: As-Saff:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَنْ تَقُولُوْۤا مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi an taqūlū mā lā tafʿalūna Most hateful is it unto God that ye say what ye (yourselves) do (it) not (Reformer reform thyself first.) . The Sixth Holy Imam Ja'far Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq said: "The promise of a faithful to his brother in faith is a solemn pledge, the failure to fulfil it or acting against it, earns the displeasure and invites the wrath of God. This includes the scholars, the priests and the Preachers of Islam who preach a goodness and godliness to the people but they themselves never act in accordance to what they preach to the others to do." There is a reference to such a character in 2:44. Those who do not themselves act on goodness, are not entitled to preach it. (A.P.)

item.title: As-Saff:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُمْ بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ inna l-laha yuḥibbu alladhīna yuqātilūna fī sabīlihi ṣaffan ka-annahum bun'yānun marṣūṣun Indeed Allah loves those who fight in His way in ranks, as if they were a compact structure.

item.title: As-Saff:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُمْ بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ inna l-laha yuḥibbu alladhīna yuqātilūna fī sabīlihi ṣaffan ka-annahum bun'yānun marṣūṣun Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a (single) structure joined firmly. See 61:1

item.title: As-Saff:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُمْ بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ inna l-laha yuḥibbu alladhīna yuqātilūna fī sabīlihi ṣaffan ka-annahum bun'yānun marṣūṣun Verily God loveth (He hates those who run away from the battlefield.) those who fight in His way in ranks as if they were an unbreakable metalled wall (Refer to Verse 37:1. Believers to be well organised and disciplined acting in coordination with each other.) . Note the degree of Firmness, Steadfastness, Courage and Fortitude which God wants in a true believer in Him, at the time when He tries him against the disbelievers. A believer on such occasions of trials, has to stand by the truth like a compact wall immovable by any attack from falsehood. This is quality which those who ran away from the battle-field miserably lacked, which was exposed at Uhud, Khaybar and Honain1.…

item.title: As-Saff:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِقَوْمِهِ يَاقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَدْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوْۤا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi yāqawmi lima tu'dhūnanī waqad taʿlamūna annī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum falammā zāghū azāgha l-lahu qulūbahum wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīna When Moses said to his people, 'O my people! Why do you torment me, when you certainly know that I am Allah's apostle to you?' So when they swerved [from the right path] Allah made their hearts swerve, and Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

item.title: As-Saff:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِقَوْمِهِ يَاقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَدْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوْۤا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi yāqawmi lima tu'dhūnanī waqad taʿlamūna annī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum falammā zāghū azāgha l-lahu qulūbahum wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīna And (mention, O Muḥammad), when Musa said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you?" And when they deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people. And when Musa said to his people: "O my people! Why do you annoy me while you know certainly that I am the Messenger of Allah to you? So, when they turned away (from the path of Allah), Allah turned their hearts away (from…

item.title: As-Saff:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِقَوْمِهِ يَاقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَدْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوْۤا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi yāqawmi lima tu'dhūnanī waqad taʿlamūna annī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum falammā zāghū azāgha l-lahu qulūbahum wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīna And when said Moses unto his people: "O' ye my people! Why do ye pain me? while indeed ye know that verily I am an apostle of God unto you;" but when (yet) went they astray, God (too) allowed their hearts (to astray)', and God guideth not the people who transgress (Refer to Verse 33:69.) . The people of Moses were characteristically rebellious, they used to vex him with all sorts of ridiculous desires, and insulted him with irritating criticisms. They called him a sorcerer, a madman, and sometimes they wanted him to fix…

item.title: As-Saff:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَابَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wa-idh qāla ʿīsā ub'nu maryama yābanī is'rāīla innī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayya mina l-tawrāti wamubashiran birasūlin yatī min baʿdī us'muhu aḥmadu falammā jāahum bil-bayināti qālū hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun And when Jesus son of Mary said, 'O Children of Israel! Indeed I am the apostle of Allah to you, to confirm what is before me of the Torah, and to give the good news of an apostle who will come after me, whose name is Aḥmad.' Yet when he brought them manifest proofs, they said, 'This is plain magic.'

item.title: As-Saff:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَابَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wa-idh qāla ʿīsā ub'nu maryama yābanī is'rāīla innī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayya mina l-tawrāti wamubashiran birasūlin yatī min baʿdī us'muhu aḥmadu falammā jāahum bil-bayināti qālū hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun And (mention) when Isa, the son of Maryam, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad."1 But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic."2 See 61:5

item.title: As-Saff:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَابَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wa-idh qāla ʿīsā ub'nu maryama yābanī is'rāīla innī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayya mina l-tawrāti wamubashiran birasūlin yatī min baʿdī us'muhu aḥmadu falammā jāahum bil-bayināti qālū hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun And when said Jesus, son of Mary: "O' ye the children of Israel! Verily I am an apostle of God unto you, confirming what is before you of the Torah and bearing (unto you) the glad tidings of an Apostle who shall come after me, his name being Ahmed (The Title of The Holy Prophet Muhammad - i.e. 'Ahmad al- Mujtaba' i.e. the Parcele to John. Which has been anglicised as the Comforter - the Spirit of Truth.…

item.title: As-Saff:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَى إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahuwa yud'ʿā ilā l-is'lāmi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna And who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates falsehoods against Allah, while he is being summoned to Islam? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: As-Saff:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَى إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahuwa yud'ʿā ilā l-is'lāmi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people. And who does more wrong than the one who invents a lie against Allah, while he is being invited to Islam? And Allah guides not the people who are wrongdoers (61:7). They intend to put out the Light of Allah with their mouths. But Allah will bring His Light to perfection even though the disbelievers hate (it) (61:8). He it is Who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to make it victorious over all religions even…

item.title: As-Saff:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَى إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahuwa yud'ʿā ilā l-is'lāmi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna And who is more unjust than he who forgeth a lie against God while he is invited unto Islam? and God guideth not the unjust people (Refer to Verses 3:94; 3:192.) . Nasr Ibn Harith said that on the Day of Judgment his idol gods Lat and Uzza would intercede on his behalf and God would accept the intercession - This verse was revealed - meaning of the idol. Like the light of the sun, which is shone upon all, irrespective of anyone being faithful to God or unfaithful to Him and on those who do not want to avail of it, the sun docs not cease to…

item.title: As-Saff:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِءُوا نُورَ اللَّهِ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ yurīdūna liyuṭ'fiū nūra l-lahi bi-afwāhihim wal-lahu mutimmu nūrihi walaw kariha l-kāfirūna They desire to put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah shall perfect His light though the faithless should be averse.

item.title: As-Saff:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِءُوا نُورَ اللَّهِ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ yurīdūna liyuṭ'fiū nūra l-lahi bi-afwāhihim wal-lahu mutimmu nūrihi walaw kariha l-kāfirūna They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it. See 61:7

item.title: As-Saff:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِءُوا نُورَ اللَّهِ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ yurīdūna liyuṭ'fiū nūra l-lahi bi-afwāhihim wal-lahu mutimmu nūrihi walaw kariha l-kāfirūna Intend they to put out the Light (Refer to Verses 9:32; 24:35 - 24:37; 64:8.) of God with their mouths! but God will perfect His Light, though averse may be the dis-believers. The foolish ones think that they can extinguish (defeat) the truth by false arguments. But God has decided to fulfil it1. Once a Jew, Ka'b Ibn Ashroff saw the Holy Prophet in the state of the trance while he was receiving a revelation from God, and said: "Rejoice ye O' Israelites for God hath extinguished the Light of Muhammad and thank God his mission has been left incomplete."
