This verse was revealed. Regarding the light of God the method and the place of its manifestation2 This…

item.title: As-Saff:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ huwa alladhī arsala rasūlahu bil-hudā wadīni l-ḥaqi liyuẓ'hirahu ʿalā l-dīni kullihi walaw kariha l-mush'rikūna It is He who has sent His Apostle with the guidance and the religion of truth that He may make it prevail over all religions though the polytheists should be averse.

item.title: As-Saff:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ huwa alladhī arsala rasūlahu bil-hudā wadīni l-ḥaqi liyuẓ'hirahu ʿalā l-dīni kullihi walaw kariha l-mush'rikūna It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allah dislike it. See 61:7

item.title: As-Saff:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ huwa alladhī arsala rasūlahu bil-hudā wadīni l-ḥaqi liyuẓ'hirahu ʿalā l-dīni kullihi walaw kariha l-mush'rikūna He it is who hath sent His Apostle (Muhammad) with the Guidance (Qur'an) and the Religion of Truth (Islam), that He may make it triumph over all the (other) religions, though averse may be the polytheists (Refer to Verses 48:28; 9:33.) . The verse prophesies that Islam would be the most dominant religion of the world – which prophecy is yet to be fulfilled. Commentators say that the predominance would be established in time. It would take effect when the Last of the Apostolic successors, the Twelfth Holy Imam. Muhammad Ibnul Hasan Al-Mahdi would re-appear. Though the complete dominance of Islam over all the other religions of the world is destined to…

item.title: As-Saff:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى تِجَارَةٍ تُنْجِيكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū hal adullukum ʿalā tijāratin tunjīkum min ʿadhābin alīmin O you who have faith! Shall I show you a deal that will deliver you from a painful punishment?

item.title: As-Saff:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى تِجَارَةٍ تُنْجِيكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū hal adullukum ʿalā tijāratin tunjīkum min ʿadhābin alīmin O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment? O you who believe! Shall I guide you to a trade that will save you from a painful torment (61:10). That you believe in Allah and His Messenger, and that you strive hard and fight in the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives, that will be better for you, if you but know (61:11). (If you do so) He will forgive you your sins, and admit you into Gardens under which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in 'Adn (Eternal) Paradise; that is indeed the great success (61:12). And also (He will give you) another (blessing)…

item.title: As-Saff:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى تِجَارَةٍ تُنْجِيكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū hal adullukum ʿalā tijāratin tunjīkum min ʿadhābin alīmin O' ye who believe! shall I show you a merchandise which will deliver you from a painful chastisement? Truly it is a very profitable business towards which God guides mankind, for the very little investment, there is an ever-recurring or an everlasting gain, with an eternal bliss1.

item.title: As-Saff:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ tu'minūna bil-lahi warasūlihi watujāhidūna fī sabīli l-lahi bi-amwālikum wa-anfusikum dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna Have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and wage jihād in the way of Allah with your possessions and your persons. That is better for you, should you know.

item.title: As-Saff:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ tu'minūna bil-lahi warasūlihi watujāhidūna fī sabīli l-lahi bi-amwālikum wa-anfusikum dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna (It is that) you believe in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you only knew. See 61:10

item.title: As-Saff:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ tu'minūna bil-lahi warasūlihi watujāhidūna fī sabīli l-lahi bi-amwālikum wa-anfusikum dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna (That) ye should believe in God and His Apostle, and strive in the way of God with your possessions and your selves; that is better for you, if ye but knew! See 61:10

item.title: As-Saff:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَسَاكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِي جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yaghfir lakum dhunūbakum wayud'khil'kum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wamasākina ṭayyibatan fī jannāti ʿadnin dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu He shall forgive you your sins and admit you into gardens with streams running in them, and into good dwellings in the Gardens of Eden. That is the great success.

item.title: As-Saff:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَسَاكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِي جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yaghfir lakum dhunūbakum wayud'khil'kum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wamasākina ṭayyibatan fī jannāti ʿadnin dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment. See 61:10

item.title: As-Saff:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَسَاكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِي جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yaghfir lakum dhunūbakum wayud'khil'kum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wamasākina ṭayyibatan fī jannāti ʿadnin dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu He will forgive you your sins and admit you into gardens, neath which flow rivers and excellent abodes in the gardens (Paradise.) of eternity; that is the supreme achievement. See 61:10

item.title: As-Saff:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُخْرٰی تُحِبُّونَهَا نَصْرٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ukh'rā tuḥibbūnahā naṣrun mina l-lahi wafatḥun qarībun wabashiri l-mu'minīna And other [blessings] you love: help from Allah and a victory near at hand. And give good news to the faithful.

item.title: As-Saff:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُخْرٰی تُحِبُّونَهَا نَصْرٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ukh'rā tuḥibbūnahā naṣrun mina l-lahi wafatḥun qarībun wabashiri l-mu'minīna And (you will obtain) another (favor) that you love - victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers. See 61:10

item.title: As-Saff:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُخْرٰی تُحِبُّونَهَا نَصْرٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ukh'rā tuḥibbūnahā naṣrun mina l-lahi wafatḥun qarībun wabashiri l-mu'minīna And another (blessing will He bestow) which ye love, (that is) the help from God, and a victory at hand; So give thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) the glad tidings unto the believers. May refer to the conquest of Mecca as well as to the ultimate triumph of Islam at the re-appearance of Imam. There the use of 'Qareeb', Near - will be in the same sense as used for the Resurrection Day1. (A.P.)

item.title: As-Saff:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كُونُوْۤا أَنْصَارَ اللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّينَ مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنْصَارُ اللَّهِ فَاٰمَنَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَكَفَرَتْ طَائِفَةٌ فَأَيَّدْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا عَلَى عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا ظَاهِرِينَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kūnū anṣāra l-lahi kamā qāla ʿīsā ub'nu maryama lil'ḥawāriyyīna man anṣārī ilā l-lahi qāla l-ḥawāriyūna naḥnu anṣāru l-lahi faāmanat ṭāifatun min banī is'rāīla wakafarat ṭāifatun fa-ayyadnā alladhīna āmanū ʿalā ʿaduwwihim fa-aṣbaḥū ẓāhirīna O you who have faith! Be Allah's helpers, just as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples, 'Who will be my helpers for Allah's sake?' The Disciples said, 'We will be Allah's helpers!' So a group of the Children of Israel believed, and a group disbelieved. Then We strengthened the faithful against their enemies, and they became the dominant ones.

item.title: As-Saff:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كُونُوْۤا أَنْصَارَ اللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّينَ مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنْصَارُ اللَّهِ فَاٰمَنَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَكَفَرَتْ طَائِفَةٌ فَأَيَّدْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا عَلَى عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا ظَاهِرِينَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kūnū anṣāra l-lahi kamā qāla ʿīsā ub'nu maryama lil'ḥawāriyyīna man anṣārī ilā l-lahi qāla l-ḥawāriyūna naḥnu anṣāru l-lahi faāmanat ṭāifatun min banī is'rāīla wakafarat ṭāifatun fa-ayyadnā alladhīna āmanū ʿalā ʿaduwwihim fa-aṣbaḥū ẓāhirīna O you who have believed, be supporters of Allah, as when Isa, the son of Maryam, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allah." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. O you who believe! Be you helpers (in the cause)…

item.title: As-Saff:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كُونُوْۤا أَنْصَارَ اللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّينَ مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنْصَارُ اللَّهِ فَاٰمَنَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَكَفَرَتْ طَائِفَةٌ فَأَيَّدْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا عَلَى عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا ظَاهِرِينَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kūnū anṣāra l-lahi kamā qāla ʿīsā ub'nu maryama lil'ḥawāriyyīna man anṣārī ilā l-lahi qāla l-ḥawāriyūna naḥnu anṣāru l-lahi faāmanat ṭāifatun min banī is'rāīla wakafarat ṭāifatun fa-ayyadnā alladhīna āmanū ʿalā ʿaduwwihim fa-aṣbaḥū ẓāhirīna O' ye who believe! Be ye the helpers (in the cause) of God as said Jesus, son of Mary unto (his) disciples: "Who (among you) wall be my helpers unto (the work of) God?" Said the disciples (of Jesus) "We are the helpers (in the cause) of God! "Then believed a party of the children of Israel and disbelieved a party (among them), Then We aided those who believed against…

item.title: As-Sajda:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lām, Mīm.

item.title: As-Sajda:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lām, Meem.1 تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ The revelation of the Book in which there is no doubt, means, there is no doubt whatsoever that it has been revealed: مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ from the Lord of all that exists. Then Allah tells us about the idolators: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۚ Or say they: "He has fabricated it?" : they say, he has fabricated it, i.e., he has made it up by himself. بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أَتَاهُمْ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ Nay, it is the truth from your Lord, so that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you, in order that they may be guided. means, in order that they may follow the truth.

item.title: As-Sajda:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lam, Meem. (A. L. M.) See 32:3

item.title: As-Sajda:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ tanzīlu l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīna The [gradual] sending down of the Book, there is no doubt in it, is from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: As-Sajda:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ tanzīlu l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīna (This is) the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds. See 32:1

item.title: As-Sajda:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ tanzīlu l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīna The revelation of the Book (the Qur'an) there is no doubt in it, (it is) from the Lord of the worlds. See 32:3

item.title: As-Sajda:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أَتَاهُمْ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu bal huwa l-ḥaqu min rabbika litundhira qawman mā atāhum min nadhīrin min qablika laʿallahum yahtadūna Do they say, 'He has fabricated it'? Rather it is the truth from your Lord, that you may warn a people to whom there did not come any warner before you, so that they may be guided [to the right path].

item.title: As-Sajda:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أَتَاهُمْ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu bal huwa l-ḥaqu min rabbika litundhira qawman mā atāhum min nadhīrin min qablika laʿallahum yahtadūna Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, (O Muḥammad), that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you (so) perhaps they will be guided. See 32:1

item.title: As-Sajda:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أَتَاهُمْ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu bal huwa l-ḥaqu min rabbika litundhira qawman mā atāhum min nadhīrin min qablika laʿallahum yahtadūna Or say they "He (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) hath forged (Qur'an.) it?" Nay! it is the truth from thy Lord, that thou mayest warn a people unto whom came not any warner before (Since the immediately preceding apostle Jesus.) thee, that happly they may be guided aright. Since the departure of Jesus until the advent of the Holy Prophet Muhammad, there had not come to the people any Warner, i.e., an apostle from God, to prevent their going astray from the right path which was already shown to them through Jesus and the apostles preceding him.

item.title: As-Sajda:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ al-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi mā lakum min dūnihi min waliyyin walā shafīʿin afalā tatadhakkarūna It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days,1 then He settled on the Throne. You do not have besides Him any guardian or intercessor. Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: As-Sajda:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ al-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi mā lakum min dūnihi min waliyyin walā shafīʿin afalā tatadhakkarūna It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne.1 You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded? Allah it is He Who has created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them in six Days. Then He Istawa over the Throne. You have none, besides Him, as a protector or an intercessor. Will you not then remember (32:4). He directs the command from the heavens…

item.title: As-Sajda:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ al-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi mā lakum min dūnihi min waliyyin walā shafīʿin afalā tatadhakkarūna God (it is) Who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days (stages) and got firm on His Throne (of authority), for you there is none besides Him of a guardian, nor any intercessor; What! will ye not then reflect? See verses 7:54, 10:3, 11:7, 25:59, 41:12, 70:4. About the conception of time beyond this life, i.e., on the Day of Judgment - see verse 70:4 and the next verse.

item.title: As-Sajda:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ yudabbiru l-amra mina l-samāi ilā l-arḍi thumma yaʿruju ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu alfa sanatin mimmā taʿuddūna He directs the command1 from the heaven to the earth; then it ascends toward Him in a day2 whose span is a thousand years by your reckoning.

item.title: As-Sajda:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ yudabbiru l-amra mina l-samāi ilā l-arḍi thumma yaʿruju ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu alfa sanatin mimmā taʿuddūna He arranges (each) matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count. See 32:4

item.title: As-Sajda:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ yudabbiru l-amra mina l-samāi ilā l-arḍi thumma yaʿruju ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu alfa sanatin mimmā taʿuddūna Regulateth He (all) the affairs from the heaven to the earth, then shall it ascend unto Him in a day the measure of which is a thousand years of what ye reckon. In view of the extent of the time which to us, now is unimaginable, the restoration of all values on the Day of Judgment will be in so short a time that it will be the twinkling of an eye and yet to our calculation it will be thousands of years.1 This clearly indicates the circular process of the divine administration - descending from the highest to the lowest and ascending from the lowest…

item.title: As-Sajda:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ dhālika ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu That is the Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, the All-mighty, the All-merciful,

item.title: As-Sajda:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ dhālika ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 32:4

item.title: As-Sajda:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ dhālika ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu This (Such.) is the Knower of the hidden and the manifest, the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful, This 'al-Ghayb' and 'al-Shahadah' in correspondence with the 'al-Sama' and the 'al-Ard' mentioned in the previous verse 5 in the sense that by 'al-Sama' means the unseen world and 'al-Ard' the seen world which appeals to the external senses. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Sajda:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِينٍ alladhī aḥsana kulla shayin khalaqahu wabada-a khalqa l-insāni min ṭīnin who perfected everything that He created, and commenced man's creation from clay.

item.title: As-Sajda:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِينٍ alladhī aḥsana kulla shayin khalaqahu wabada-a khalqa l-insāni min ṭīnin Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay. Who made everything He has created good and He began the creation of man from clay (32:7). Then He made his offspring from semen of despised water (32:8). Then He fashioned him in due proportion, and breathed into him the soul; and He gave you hearing, sight and the sense of deduction. Little is the thanks you give (32:9). The Creation of Man in Stages Allah tells us that He has created everything well and formed everything in a goodly fashion. Malik said, narrating from Zayd bin Aslam: الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ ۖ Who made everything He has created good means, "He created everything well…

item.title: As-Sajda:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِينٍ alladhī aḥsana kulla shayin khalaqahu wabada-a khalqa l-insāni min ṭīnin He Who made best every thing which He hath created and began the creation of man from clay. Refer to verse 23:12 - 23:16. His planning of everything is the Best. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Sajda:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ thumma jaʿala naslahu min sulālatin min māin mahīnin Then He made his progeny from an extract of a base fluid.

item.title: As-Sajda:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ thumma jaʿala naslahu min sulālatin min māin mahīnin Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained. See 32:7

item.title: As-Sajda:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ thumma jaʿala naslahu min sulālatin min māin mahīnin Then He made his progeny of an extract of despised water (Sperm. Refer to note on verses 36:77, 16:4 & 86:6.) (liquid) See 32:7

item.title: As-Sajda:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ thumma sawwāhu wanafakha fīhi min rūḥihi wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna Then He proportioned him and breathed into him of His Spirit, and made for you the hearing, the sight, and the hearts. Little do you thank.

item.title: As-Sajda:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ thumma sawwāhu wanafakha fīhi min rūḥihi wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His (created) soul1 and made for you hearing and vision and hearts (i.e., intellect); little are you grateful. See 32:7

item.title: As-Sajda:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ thumma sawwāhu wanafakha fīhi min rūḥihi wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna Then (Refer to verse 15:29.) shaped him and breathed into him of His spirit (Into a harmonious whole.) and made for you the ears, and the eyes and the hearts; (yet how) Little is it that ye give thanks. See 32:7

item.title: As-Sajda:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِیْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ waqālū a-idhā ḍalalnā fī l-arḍi a-innā lafī khalqin jadīdin bal hum biliqāi rabbihim kāfirūna They say, 'When we have been lost in the dust,1 shall we be indeed created anew?' Rather they disbelieve in the encounter with their Lord.

item.title: As-Sajda:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِیْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ waqālū a-idhā ḍalalnā fī l-arḍi a-innā lafī khalqin jadīdin bal hum biliqāi rabbihim kāfirūna And they say, "When we are lost (i.e., disintegrated) within the earth, will we indeed be (recreated) in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers. And they say: When we are lost in the earth, shall we indeed be created anew?" Nay, but they deny the meeting with their Lord (32:10). Say: "The angel of death, who is set over you, will take your souls. Then you shall be brought to your Lord (32:11). Refutation of Those Who think the Resurrection is unlikely to happen Allah tells us how the idolators thought it unlikely that the resurrection would ever come to pass, and how they said:…

item.title: As-Sajda:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِیْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ waqālū a-idhā ḍalalnā fī l-arḍi a-innā lafī khalqin jadīdin bal hum biliqāi rabbihim kāfirūna And said they: "What! when we become lost in the earth, shall (Is it - Are we going to be in a new creation?) we even then be (returned) into a new creation?" Nay! in the meeting of their Lord they are disbelievers. See verses 13:5, 17:49, 19:66, 36:78. This is said referring to what the Holy Prophet used to assert that man is created to last for ever and not to be destroyed after a while. The only thing is that man is shifted from one abode to another one which may be happy or miserable as per his own doings 'khuliqa al-nasu li-l-baqa' la li-l-fana'' - Man has been created…

item.title: As-Sajda:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ qul yatawaffākum malaku l-mawti alladhī wukkila bikum thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna Say, 'You will be taken away by the angel of death, who has been charged with you. Then you will be brought back to your Lord.'

item.title: As-Sajda:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ qul yatawaffākum malaku l-mawti alladhī wukkila bikum thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned." See 32:10

item.title: As-Sajda:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ qul yatawaffākum malaku l-mawti alladhī wukkila bikum thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna Say thou: "Shall cause you to die the angel of death who is put in charge of you, then unto your Lord ye shall be brought back." Here asserts that it is the angel of death who causes death. In verse 6:61 - it attributes death to the angels and in verse 39:42 attributes to God Himself - just to indicate that whatever is done, God is the real cause of it. The others are only the agencies subservient to His will. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Sajda:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوْۤا رُءُوسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ walaw tarā idhi l-muj'rimūna nākisū ruūsihim ʿinda rabbihim rabbanā abṣarnā wasamiʿ'nā fa-ir'jiʿ'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūna Were you to see when the guilty hang their heads before their Lord [confessing], 'Our Lord! We have seen and heard. Send us back so that we may act righteously. Indeed we are [now] convinced.'

item.title: As-Sajda:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوْۤا رُءُوسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ walaw tarā idhi l-muj'rimūna nākisū ruūsihim ʿinda rabbihim rabbanā abṣarnā wasamiʿ'nā fa-ir'jiʿ'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūna If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, (saying), "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us (to the world); we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are (now) certain." And if you only could see when the criminals shall hang their heads before their Lord (saying): Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back that we will do righteous good deeds. Verily, we now believe with certainty (32:12). And if We had willed, surely We would have given every person his guidance, but the Word from Me took effect, that I will fill Hell with…

item.title: As-Sajda:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوْۤا رُءُوسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ walaw tarā idhi l-muj'rimūna nākisū ruūsihim ʿinda rabbihim rabbanā abṣarnā wasamiʿ'nā fa-ir'jiʿ'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūna And couldst thou but see when the guilty ones shall droop their heads before their Lord (saying): "O' our Lord! we have seen and we have heard, now then send us back, we will do good; verily (now) we are certain" See 32:11

item.title: As-Sajda:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَءَاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَاهَا وَلَكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّي لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ walaw shi'nā laātaynā kulla nafsin hudāhā walākin ḥaqqa l-qawlu minnī la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīna Had We wished We would have given every soul its guidance, but My word became due [against the defiant]: 'Surely I will fill hell with all the [guilty] jinn and humans.'1

item.title: As-Sajda:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَءَاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَاهَا وَلَكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّي لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ walaw shi'nā laātaynā kulla nafsin hudāhā walākin ḥaqqa l-qawlu minnī la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīna And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word1 from Me will come into effect (that) "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together. See 32:12

item.title: As-Sajda:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَءَاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَاهَا وَلَكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّي لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ walaw shi'nā laātaynā kulla nafsin hudāhā walākin ḥaqqa l-qawlu minnī la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīna Had We pleased certainly We would have given every soul its guidance, but true (Just.) is the word which hath gone forth from Me, certainly will I fill hell with jinn and men together. As an explanation to this verse refer to the portion of Ali's prayer 'Dua Kumayl'.

item.title: As-Sajda:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا إِنَّا نَسِينَاكُمْ وَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ fadhūqū bimā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā innā nasīnākum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di bimā kuntum taʿmalūna So taste [the punishment] for your having forgotten the encounter of this day of yours. We [too] have forgotten you. Taste the everlasting punishment because of what you used to do.

item.title: As-Sajda:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا إِنَّا نَسِينَاكُمْ وَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ fadhūqū bimā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā innā nasīnākum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di bimā kuntum taʿmalūna So taste (punishment) because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have (accordingly) forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do." See 32:12

item.title: As-Sajda:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذُوقُوْۤا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا إِنَّا نَسِينَاكُمْ وَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ fadhūqū bimā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā innā nasīnākum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di bimā kuntum taʿmalūna So (they will be told) "Taste ye (the recompense) for what ye had forsaken (Neglected.) the meeting of this your day Verily We too forsake you: and taste ye the abiding chastisement for what ye were doing." See 32:13

item.title: As-Sajda:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهَا خَرُّوْۤا سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ innamā yu'minu biāyātinā alladhīna idhā dhukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadan wasabbaḥū biḥamdi rabbihim wahum lā yastakbirūna Only those believe in Our signs who, when they are reminded of them, fall down in prostration and celebrate the praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

item.title: As-Sajda:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهَا خَرُّوْۤا سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ innamā yu'minu biāyātinā alladhīna idhā dhukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadan wasabbaḥū biḥamdi rabbihim wahum lā yastakbirūna Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt (Allah) with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant. Only those believe in Our Ayat, who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate, and glorify the praises of their Lord, and they are not proud (32:15). Their sides forsake their beds, to invoke their Lord in fear and hope, and they spend out of what We have bestowed on them (32:16). No person knows what is kept hidden for them of delights of eyes as a reward for what they used to do (32:17). The State of…

item.title: As-Sajda:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِهَا خَرُّوْۤا سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ innamā yu'minu biāyātinā alladhīna idhā dhukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadan wasabbaḥū biḥamdi rabbihim wahum lā yastakbirūna Verily believed in Our signs only those who when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrating in obeisance and celebrate (Expose His glorification by praising Him.) the praise of their Lord, and they exalt not (with pride). See verses 7:206, 13:15, 22:77. Those who recite this verse and also those who hear it recited, must offer a prostration to the Lord. The prostration here is Wajib, i.e., Compulsory. Exposes His glorification by praising Him.

item.title: As-Sajda:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَتَجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿani l-maḍājiʿi yadʿūna rabbahum khawfan waṭamaʿan wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna Their sides vacate their beds1 to supplicate their Lord in fear and hope, and they spend out of what We have provided them.

item.title: As-Sajda:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَتَجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿani l-maḍājiʿi yadʿūna rabbahum khawfan waṭamaʿan wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna Their sides part (i.e., they arise) from (their) beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.1 See 32:15

item.title: As-Sajda:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَتَجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿani l-maḍājiʿi yadʿūna rabbahum khawfan waṭamaʿan wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna Their sides (For 'Tahajjud' prayers.) forsake their beds (getting way from their beds overnight), praying unto their Lord in fear and (in) hope, and (of what We provide them with) spend they (benevolently in the Way of their Lord) This verse was revealed about the Holy Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib and those of his followers (his Shias) who following his example, sleep only the first two-thirds of the night and in the last one-third they are awake with the eagerness and sincerity to pray to God. The Holy Prophet said: "Shall I inform you of the entrance of righteousness - Remember ye that fasting is a shield against the fire of Hell - Giving of alms wipes…

item.title: As-Sajda:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falā taʿlamu nafsun mā ukh'fiya lahum min qurrati aʿyunin jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna No one knows what has been kept hidden for them of comfort as a reward for what they used to do.

item.title: As-Sajda:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falā taʿlamu nafsun mā ukh'fiya lahum min qurrati aʿyunin jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes (i.e., satisfaction) as reward for what they used to do. See 32:15

item.title: As-Sajda:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falā taʿlamu nafsun mā ukh'fiya lahum min qurrati aʿyunin jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna And knoweth not any soul what is hidden for them (the righteous ones) of the joy of the eyes, in recompense for what (good) they were doing. What God has in store to reward his faithful servants with, no eye has seen, nor any ear has heard it and no heart of any man can ever conceive it. This verse proves that all the description of the sensual pleasures of the life hereafter is a mere figurative expression as otherwise the pleasure is hidden far beyond the human grasp. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Sajda:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا يَسْتَوُونَ afaman kāna mu'minan kaman kāna fāsiqan lā yastawūna Is someone who is faithful like someone who is a transgressor? They are not equal.

item.title: As-Sajda:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا يَسْتَوُونَ afaman kāna mu'minan kaman kāna fāsiqan lā yastawūna Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal. Is then he who is a believer like him who is rebellious? Not equal are they (32:18). As for those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them are Gardens of Abode as an entertainment for what they used to do (32:19). And as for those who rebel, their abode will be the Fire, every time they wish to get away therefrom, they will be put back thereto, and it will be said to them: Taste you the torment of the Fire which you used to deny (32:20). And verily, We will make them taste of the near lighter torment prior to the greater torment, in…

item.title: As-Sajda:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا يَسْتَوُونَ afaman kāna mu'minan kaman kāna fāsiqan lā yastawūna Is he then who is a believer like the one who is a transgressor? (What about breaking the Covenant of Ghadir Khumm?) They shall not be held (Not equal.) alike. It is recorded alike by both the Sunni and the Shia commentators that al-Walid ibn 'Utbah ibn Abi Mu'ayt who was a step-brother of Uthman, once by way of priding over Ali said "O Ali, thou art only a boy and the strength of my youth is superior to thine, I am more than thee in the sharpness of the tongue, my lance is sharper than thine and in the army I am more steadfast than thee." Ali in reply to the infidel said "Be quiet O' rebellious one! Though art no comparison to…

item.title: As-Sajda:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوَى نُزُلًا بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātu l-mawā nuzulan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, for them are gardens of the Abode —a hospitality for what they used to do.

item.title: As-Sajda:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوَى نُزُلًا بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātu l-mawā nuzulan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do. See 32:18

item.title: As-Sajda:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوَى نُزُلًا بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātu l-mawā nuzulan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna As for those who believe and do good, for them, the gardens (of bliss) shall be the (heavenly) abode; as an entertainment for what (good) they were doing. See 32:18

item.title: As-Sajda:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوْۤا فَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوْۤا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوْۤا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوْۤا فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ wa-ammā alladhīna fasaqū famawāhumu l-nāru kullamā arādū an yakhrujū min'hā uʿīdū fīhā waqīla lahum dhūqū ʿadhāba l-nāri alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna As for those who have transgressed, their refuge is the Fire. Whenever they seek to leave it, they will be turned back into it, and they will be told: 'Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.'

item.title: As-Sajda:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوْۤا فَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوْۤا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوْۤا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوْۤا فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ wa-ammā alladhīna fasaqū famawāhumu l-nāru kullamā arādū an yakhrujū min'hā uʿīdū fīhā waqīla lahum dhūqū ʿadhāba l-nāri alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny." See 32:18

item.title: As-Sajda:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوْۤا فَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوْۤا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوْۤا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوْۤا فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ wa-ammā alladhīna fasaqū famawāhumu l-nāru kullamā arādū an yakhrujū min'hā uʿīdū fīhā waqīla lahum dhūqū ʿadhāba l-nāri alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna But as for those who transgress, their abode shall be the (hell) fire; so oft as they shall desire to get out of it they shall be brought back into it, and it shall be said unto them: "Taste ye the chastisement of the fire which ye used to belie." See 32:18

item.title: As-Sajda:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَى دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ walanudhīqannahum mina l-ʿadhābi l-adnā dūna l-ʿadhābi l-akbari laʿallahum yarjiʿūna We shall surely make them taste the nearer punishment before the greater punishment,1 so that they may come back.2

item.title: As-Sajda:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَى دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ walanudhīqannahum mina l-ʿadhābi l-adnā dūna l-ʿadhābi l-akbari laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment1 short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return (i.e., repent). See 32:18

item.title: As-Sajda:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَى دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ walanudhīqannahum mina l-ʿadhābi l-adnā dūna l-ʿadhābi l-akbari laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And (here) certainly will We make them taste of a minimum chastisement instead of the maximum chastisement, that happly they may turn (unto Us, repentant). This could be a reference to the drought of seven years which took place during the lifetime of the Holy Prophet or to the battle of Badr when most of the leading chiefs of the disbelievers were killed.

item.title: As-Sajda:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا إِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنْتَقِمُونَ waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biāyāti rabbihi thumma aʿraḍa ʿanhā innā mina l-muj'rimīna muntaqimūna Who is a greater wrongdoer than him who is reminded of his Lord's signs, whereat he disregards them? Indeed We shall take vengeance upon the guilty.

item.title: As-Sajda:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا إِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنْتَقِمُونَ waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biāyāti rabbihi thumma aʿraḍa ʿanhā innā mina l-muj'rimīna muntaqimūna And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution. See 32:18

item.title: As-Sajda:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا إِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنْتَقِمُونَ waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biāyāti rabbihi thumma aʿraḍa ʿanhā innā mina l-muj'rimīna muntaqimūna And who is more unjust than he who is reminded of the signs of his Lord, then he turneth away from them? Verily We, from the guilty ones, shall exact (the due) retribution. See 32:21

item.title: As-Sajda:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَائِهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba falā takun fī mir'yatin min liqāihi wajaʿalnāhu hudan libanī is'rāīla Certainly We gave Moses the Book, [declaring], 'Do not be in doubt about the encounter with Him,' and We made it a [source of] guidance for the Children of Israel.

item.title: As-Sajda:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَائِهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba falā takun fī mir'yatin min liqāihi wajaʿalnāhu hudan libanī is'rāīla And We certainly gave Musa the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting.1 And We made it (i.e., the Torah) guidance for the Children of Israel. And indeed We gave Musa the Scripture. So, be not you in doubt of meeting him. And We made it a guide to the Children of Israel (32:23). And We made from among them, leaders, giving guidance under Our command, when they were patient and used to believe with certainty in Our Ayat (32:24). Verily, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection, concerning that wherein they used to differ (32:25). The Book of Musa and the Leadership of the…

item.title: As-Sajda:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَائِهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba falā takun fī mir'yatin min liqāihi wajaʿalnāhu hudan libanī is'rāīla And indeed gave We unto Moses the Book, so be thou (The Prophet addressed for the people.) not in doubt of receiving this from Him (God), and it (Torah) made We a guidance unto the children of Israel, The life-history of Moses is identical with that of the Holy Prophet: Moses was given the Torah and the Holy Prophet, the Holy Qur'an. Moses was under the command to fight his enemies, the Holy Prophet was also ordered to do the same. Moses had prayed to God to assist him with Aaron as his Deputy, the Holy Prophet was given Ali as his Deputy. Moses was victorious against Pharaoh's forces and the Holy…

item.title: As-Sajda:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْۤا وَكَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يُوقِنُونَ wajaʿalnā min'hum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā lammā ṣabarū wakānū biāyātinā yūqinūna And amongst them We appointed _imam_s to guide [the people] by Our command, when they had been patient and had conviction in Our signs.

item.title: As-Sajda:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْۤا وَكَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يُوقِنُونَ wajaʿalnā min'hum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā lammā ṣabarū wakānū biāyātinā yūqinūna And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and (when) they were certain of Our signs. See 32:23

item.title: As-Sajda:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْۤا وَكَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يُوقِنُونَ wajaʿalnā min'hum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā lammā ṣabarū wakānū biāyātinā yūqinūna And of them made We Leaders (Imams) (Note: Like the apostles and prophets, Imams or leaders also are made or appointed by God and not by man through election or nomination.) to guide (the people) by (In accordance to.) Our command as they were steadfast (in the calamities); and they of Our signs were quite certain. This is a reference to the twelve holy Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt, the divinely commissioned guides to mankind on the path of Islam and the custodians of the Final Word of God (the Holy Imams) - with whom the Holy Prophet left the Holy Book to secure it intact, against any corruption or Tahrif and to give to mankind its correct interpretations as…

item.title: As-Sajda:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Indeed your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: As-Sajda:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ. See 32:23

item.title: As-Sajda:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Verily thy Lord Himself will decide between them on the Day of Judgment concerning what they therein were disputing. See 32:24

item.title: As-Sajda:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātin afalā yasmaʿūna Does it not dawn upon them how many generations We have destroyed before them, amid [the ruins of] whose dwellings they walk? There are indeed signs in that. Will they not then listen?

item.title: As-Sajda:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātin afalā yasmaʿūna Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, (as) they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear? Is it not a guidance for them: how many generations We have destroyed before them in whose dwellings they do walk about? Verily, therein indeed are signs. Would they not then listen (32:26). Have they not seen how We drive water to the dry land that has no vegetation, and therewith bring forth crops providing food for their cattle and themselves? Will they not then see (32:27). Learning the Lessons of the Past Allah…

item.title: As-Sajda:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātin afalā yasmaʿūna What! Doth it not guide them aright (to see) how many of the generations We did destroy before them, they walk (They pass through or pass by.) (today) in (the ruins of) their abodes; verily in this are signs; Will they not then hear? The very fact of the vicissitude of fortune or the natural changes which are daily taking place here are the proof that, in this life, all are in transitory state which undoubtedly has an end and that whatever one should do to secure a good end it should be done here. Otherwise at the end nothing can be done. (A.P.).

item.title: As-Sajda:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْمَاءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَامُهُمْ وَأَنْفُسُهُمْ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ awalam yaraw annā nasūqu l-māa ilā l-arḍi l-juruzi fanukh'riju bihi zarʿan takulu min'hu anʿāmuhum wa-anfusuhum afalā yub'ṣirūna Do they not see that We carry water to the parched earth and with it We bring forth crops of which they eat, themselves and their cattle? Will they not then see?

item.title: As-Sajda:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْمَاءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَامُهُمْ وَأَنْفُسُهُمْ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ awalam yaraw annā nasūqu l-māa ilā l-arḍi l-juruzi fanukh'riju bihi zarʿan takulu min'hu anʿāmuhum wa-anfusuhum afalā yub'ṣirūna Have they not seen that We drive water (in clouds) to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and (they) themselves? Then do they not see? See 32:26

item.title: As-Sajda:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْمَاءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَامُهُمْ وَأَنْفُسُهُمْ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ awalam yaraw annā nasūqu l-māa ilā l-arḍi l-juruzi fanukh'riju bihi zarʿan takulu min'hu anʿāmuhum wa-anfusuhum afalā yub'ṣirūna What! See they not that We drive the water unto the parched earth and We bring forth with it crops of which eat the cattle and they themselves? Will they not then see? See 32:26

item.title: As-Sajda:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْفَتْحُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And they say, 'When will this judgement be, should you be truthful?'

item.title: As-Sajda:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْفَتْحُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And they say, "When will be this conquest,1 if you should be truthful?" They say: "When will this Fath be, if you are telling the truth? (32:28). Say: "On the Day of Al-Fath, no profit will it be to those who disbelieve if they (then) believe! Nor will they be granted a respite (32:29). So turn aside from them and await, verily, they (too) are awaiting (32:30). How the Disbelievers Sought to Hasten on the Punishment, and what Happened to Them Allah tells us how the disbelievers sought to hasten on the punishment, and to bring the wrath and vengeance of Allah upon themselves, because they thought this punishment would never happen, and because of their disbelief and stubbornness. وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْفَتْحُ They say: "When…

item.title: As-Sajda:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْفَتْحُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And say they: "When will this judgment take place? (tell us) if ye be truthful," See 32:26

item.title: As-Sajda:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِيمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ qul yawma l-fatḥi lā yanfaʿu alladhīna kafarū īmānuhum walā hum yunẓarūna Say, 'On the day of judgement their [newly found] faith shall not avail the faithless, nor will they be granted any respite.'

item.title: As-Sajda:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِيمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ qul yawma l-fatḥi lā yanfaʿu alladhīna kafarū īmānuhum walā hum yunẓarūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved." See 32:28

item.title: As-Sajda:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِيمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ qul yawma l-fatḥi lā yanfaʿu alladhīna kafarū īmānuhum walā hum yunẓarūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "On the Day of Judgment, will not profit those who disbelieve, their faith, nor will they be respited." See 32:26

item.title: As-Sajda:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ إِنَّهُمْ مُنْتَظِرُونَ fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum wa-intaẓir innahum muntaẓirūna So turn away from them, and wait. They too are waiting.

item.title: As-Sajda:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ إِنَّهُمْ مُنْتَظِرُونَ fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum wa-intaẓir innahum muntaẓirūna So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting. See 32:28

item.title: As-Sajda:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ إِنَّهُمْ مُنْتَظِرُونَ fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum wa-intaẓir innahum muntaẓirūna So turn thou away from them and wait, verily they too do wait. See 32:26

item.title: Ash-Shams:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا wal-shamsi waḍuḥāhā By the sun and her forenoon splendour,

item.title: Ash-Shams:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا wal-shamsi waḍuḥāhā By the sun and its brightness. وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّاهَا And indeed he fails who Dassaha. Meaning: to conceal it. This means that he makes it dull, and he disregards it by neglecting to allow it to receive guidance. He treats it in this manner until he performs acts of disobedience and he abandons obedience of Allah. It also could mean that he is indeed successful whose soul Allah purifies, and he has failed whose soul Allah corrupts. This is like what was reported by Al-'Awfi and Ali bin Abi Talhah from Ibn 'Abbas. At-Tabarani recorded that Ibn 'Abbas said, The Messenger of Allah SAW used to stop whenever he recited this Ayah: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا - فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا By Nafs, and Ma Sawwaha (Who apportioned it). Then He showed it its Fujur and its…

item.title: Ash-Shams:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا wal-shamsi waḍuḥāhā By the sun and his radiation! In the verses 1-7 the solemn appeal is made to the reflective faculty mankind has been endowed with. Each one of the objects in whose name the swearing is done, if studied intelligently is one of the manifestations of God's might and wisdom which none else besides Him could ever be imagined to effect. The sun even to this day with the boasting of the human intellect about the progress it has made, is a mystery. None could ever even presume definitely what the matter is that burns so continuously for all the unknown millions of years of its age. The sun with its natural properties and the influence it has over the other heavenly bodies and the blessing it is, to the earth, is nothing but a mystery which…

item.title: Ash-Shams:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا wal-qamari idhā talāhā by the moon when he follows her,

item.title: Ash-Shams:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا wal-qamari idhā talāhā And (by) the moon when it follows it. See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا wal-qamari idhā talāhā By the moon when she followeth after it! The moon following the sun, and its native reflective property, its acting as the substitute of the sun in illuminating the world as the sun's vicegerent - the contrast in its effect of the coolness, in its light quite different from the heat producing light of the sun, though the light reflected by the moon is nothing else other than the light of the sun, and what makes the same light of the sun to become the opposite in effect and nature, to its original properties it possesses before the reflection, is another mystery left till now for the scientist to only speculate and imagine and to go on revising their own theories, one after another. 'Tala' meaning - following of a thing as a consequence…

item.title: Ash-Shams:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا wal-nahāri idhā jallāhā by the day when it reveals her,

item.title: Ash-Shams:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا wal-nahāri idhā jallāhā And (by) the day when it displays it.1 See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا wal-nahāri idhā jallāhā By the Day when it unfoldeth its (Sun's.) light! The day - its duration with fully regulated working of the phenomenon of the dawn and the dusk - the revealing aspect of the sun's glory and effect on earth and all the earthly beings and their activities in it - its end and its fully regulated repetition of the renewals and its closure, is a mystery to any intelligently active mind. It is a proof positive to tell man that as the day is renewed and the sleeping world is once again resurrected, the Lord will one day effect the Final Death and the Final Resurrection for the Final Judgment.

item.title: Ash-Shams:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا wa-al-layli idhā yaghshāhā by the night when it covers her,

item.title: Ash-Shams:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا wa-al-layli idhā yaghshāhā And (by) the night when it covers (i.e., conceals) it. See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا wa-al-layli idhā yaghshāhā By the Night when it enshroudeth it! The disappearance of the sun concealing the light, making man and animal to rest, restore once again the quietude to make man thoughtful that as the day has disappeared and the world ceases to be active, there is one day for the world to sleep in its getting extinct at the will of its Almighty Author. The inimitable beauty that the skies manifest in their glorious exhibition of the heavenly bodies, each one of whom is a wonder by itself. The changing phases, the appearance of the starry show in the skies and the gradual increase of the darkness and the cool atmosphere and the return to the dawn - all in a fully regulated cycle, almighty system, even to this day is nothing but a wonder…

item.title: Ash-Shams:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا wal-samāi wamā banāhā by the sky and Him who built it,

item.title: Ash-Shams:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا wal-samāi wamā banāhā And (by) the sky and He who constructed it. See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا wal-samāi wamā banāhā By the heaven as it is built! The firmament above the skies with the rain-giving clouds - and the wonderful harmony with which the heavenly bodies work, in a wonderfully organised teamwork with the mighty control of the Omnipotent Will, the raising of the water to be stored in the clouds - the distribution of the rain to the various parts of the earth according to mysteriously planned allotment of the fixed annual quota and thousands of the other marvels, are too great and unapproachable for the human intellect to assess the correct value or worth of even a single one of them. The three passages - verses 5-7, the reference is to the mechanism of heavenly bodies and their functioning harmoniously and the earth: its expansion in a harmonious way and to the…

item.title: Ash-Shams:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا wal-arḍi wamā ṭaḥāhā by the earth and Him who spread it,

item.title: Ash-Shams:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا wal-arḍi wamā ṭaḥāhā And (by) the earth and He who spread it. See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا wal-arḍi wamā ṭaḥāhā By the earth as it is expanded forth! The earth, with the invaluable stores of minerals, metals, liquids and gasses treasured in it and its usefulness to life on it, its rivers and springs, the wide, deep and mighty oceans, its fixed and immovable mountains, the various kinds of climate in the different parts of it, with the variety of its soil in its appearance and its properties, it being in global form and yet serving as a plain to the habitations and the innumerable other wonderful properties and its unlimited usefulness, all these are the great marvels which only an intelligent study can disclose.

item.title: Ash-Shams:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا wanafsin wamā sawwāhā by the soul and Him who fashioned it,

item.title: Ash-Shams:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا wanafsin wamā sawwāhā And (by) the soul and He who proportioned it.1 See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا wanafsin wamā sawwāhā By the soul as it is perfected (Well-harmonised (A.P.). Refer to: 32:9.) ! The soul, particularly the human, is one of the greatest mysteries of the universe. The different faculties endowed in it, its gradual development or progress in consciousness, the zenith of the same soul which at its birth could not utter even a single syllable and which could not help its body to take a turn of its own accord, becomes the best gymnast, best scholar and the best sage, every soul by itself is a separate wonder.

item.title: Ash-Shams:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا fa-alhamahā fujūrahā wataqwāhā and inspired it with [discernment between] its virtues and vices:

item.title: Ash-Shams:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا fa-alhamahā fujūrahā wataqwāhā And inspired it (with discernment of) its wickedness and its righteousness. See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا fa-alhamahā fujūrahā wataqwāhā And inspired unto it (against) its vices and (about) its piety (Refer to: 76:3, 90:10.) ! The soul was inspired by God, its Almighty and All-wise Author - the consciousness and the faculty of discretion to distinguish impiety and piety, the right conduct and the wrong ways of life. This is the most invaluable gift granted exclusively to man. Make it known to it what is Vice and what is Virtue. Vices are termed as 'Fujoor' meaning bursts, and Virtue as 'Taqwa' guarding, to indicate that Vices are the outcome of loose conduct and Virtue is the outcome of self-control and will power. The example is given in verse 12. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shams:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا qad aflaḥa man zakkāhā one who purifies it is felicitous,

item.title: Ash-Shams:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا qad aflaḥa man zakkāhā He has succeeded who purifies it. See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا qad aflaḥa man zakkāhā Indeed, succeedeth he who purifieth (Through abstinence from the forbidden and adopting only the course prescribed by the Lord) it! The success of every human individual male and female, as achieved the right goal of this life, the salvation, depends upon preserving the soul in its original purity against its getting soiled, polluted and clouded by the carnal desires, by submitting it to the will and the pleasure of the Lord1.

item.title: Ash-Shams:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا waqad khāba man dassāhā and one who betrays it fails.

item.title: Ash-Shams:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا waqad khāba man dassāhā And he has failed who instills it (with corruption). See 91:1

item.title: Ash-Shams:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا waqad khāba man dassāhā And indeed, faileth he who polluted it! Corruption in the faith in the True God, the Lord, and the failure of the control over the self against its rebellious passions towards the realisation of the carnal desires, leads the soul in the march of life, to perdition.

item.title: Ash-Shams:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا kadhabat thamūdu biṭaghwāhā The [people of] Thamūd denied [Allah's signs] out of their rebellion,

item.title: Ash-Shams:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا kadhabat thamūdu biṭaghwāhā Thamūd denied (their prophet) by reason of their transgression. Thamud denied through their transgression (91:11). When their most wicked went forth (91:12). But the Messenger of Allah said to them: Be cautious! That is the she-camel of Allah! (Do not harm it) and (bar it not from having) its drink! (91:13). Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, Fasawwaha (91:14). And He feared not the consequences thereof (91:15). The Rejection of Thamud and Allah's Destruction of Them Allah informs that Thamud rejected their Messenger because of the injustice and transgression they practiced. This was said by Mujahid, Qatadah and others. Therefore, this resulted in a rejection in their hearts for the guidance and conviction their Messenger came to them with. إِذِ انبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا (When…

item.title: Ash-Shams:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا kadhabat thamūdu biṭaghwāhā Belied (the truth the Tribe), Thamood, due to their rebellious impiety! The Prophet was Saleh. The above verses invite the attention of man, to the fate of the people1 who acted rebellious to the instructions of apostle Saleh and hamstrung the She camel, which was sent as a trial, which conduct of the people brought perdition to them.

item.title: Ash-Shams:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا idhi inbaʿatha ashqāhā when the most wretched of them rose up.

item.title: Ash-Shams:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا idhi inbaʿatha ashqāhā When the most wretched of them was sent forth.1 See 91:11

item.title: Ash-Shams:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا idhi inbaʿatha ashqāhā When rose up the worst wretch among them (with mischief) (Refer to: 7:73 - 7:79, 11:61.) ! See 91:11

item.title: Ash-Shams:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا faqāla lahum rasūlu l-lahi nāqata l-lahi wasuq'yāhā But then the apostle of Allah said to them, 'Let Allah's she-camel drink!'

item.title: Ash-Shams:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا faqāla lahum rasūlu l-lahi nāqata l-lahi wasuq'yāhā And the messenger of Allah (i.e., Ṣāliḥ) said to them, "(Do not harm) the she-camel of Allah or (prevent her from) her drink." See 91:11

item.title: Ash-Shams:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا faqāla lahum rasūlu l-lahi nāqata l-lahi wasuq'yāhā Then said unto them (Saleh) the Apostle of God: ''It is the She Camel of God, (leave her) and its drink! See 91:11

item.title: Ash-Shams:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا fakadhabūhu faʿaqarūhā fadamdama ʿalayhim rabbuhum bidhanbihim fasawwāhā But they impugned him and then hamstrung her, so their Lord took them unawares by night1 because of their sin, and levelled it.2

item.title: Ash-Shams:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا fakadhabūhu faʿaqarūhā fadamdama ʿalayhim rabbuhum bidhanbihim fasawwāhā But they denied him and hamstrung1 her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal (upon all of them). See 91:11

item.title: Ash-Shams:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا fakadhabūhu faʿaqarūhā fadamdama ʿalayhim rabbuhum bidhanbihim fasawwāhā But they belied him (Saleh.) and hamstrung her, so crushed them their Lord for their sins, and levelled them (all with the ground) Hamstrung with no reason, save the rebellious nature which made them commit the heinous act. The Holy Prophet of Islam said: ''The wicked person among the ancients, is the murderer of the harmless She Camel of Saleh which was endowed to the service of God and the most wicked person of the latter age is the murderer of Ali Ibn Ahi Talib as there is no justification for the heinous crimes but the rebellious spirit against a person who has devoted his life from his birth to death to the service of God" This Tradition has been narrated by Usman son of Suhail…

item.title: Ash-Shams:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا walā yakhāfu ʿuq'bāhā And He does not fear its outcome.

item.title: Ash-Shams:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا walā yakhāfu ʿuq'bāhā And He does not fear the consequence thereof.1 See 91:11

item.title: Ash-Shams:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا walā yakhāfu ʿuq'bāhā And He feareth not (any one against) the consequences (they met) When the decree of the Lord comes, it cares not for the consequence which the people might meet.

item.title: Ash-Sharh:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ alam nashraḥ laka ṣadraka Did We not open your breast for you

item.title: Ash-Sharh:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ alam nashraḥ laka ṣadraka Did We not expand for you, (O Muḥammad), your breast?1 وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ And have We not raised high your fame? Mujahid said, "I (Allah) am not remembered except that you are remembered with Me: I bear witness that there is no God worthy of worship except Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." Qatadah said, "Allah raised his fame in this life and in the Hereafter. There is no one who gives a sermon, declares the Testimony of Faith (Shahadah), or prays a prayer (Salah) except that he proclaims it: I bear witness that there is no God worthy of worship except Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." Ease after Difficulty Concerning Allah's saying: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا - إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا Verily along with…

item.title: Ash-Sharh:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ alam nashraḥ laka ṣadraka (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) What! Have We not expanded for thee thy breast (Refer to: 20:25.) ? In spite of the simple and clear words, this Surah, as a whole, has been most erroneously misinterpreted by some commentators. The misinterpretations mislead the common people who blindly follow their pet religious leaders without any scrutiny or verification, readily accepting whatever is told to them. 'Sharh al-sadr' means expansion of the breast, i.e., heart. It is an acknowledged term, to mean the broadening or the extending of the faculty of conscience, reasoning and understanding for the accommodation of wider, greater or higher knowledge. The verse means an assertion from God that He has given the heart of the Holy Prophet, the greatest expanse for knowledge. When Moses was commanded by God to proceed to…

item.title: Ash-Sharh:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنْكَ وِزْرَكَ wawaḍaʿnā ʿanka wiz'raka and relieve you of your burden

item.title: Ash-Sharh:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنْكَ وِزْرَكَ wawaḍaʿnā ʿanka wiz'raka And We removed from you your burden.1 See 94:1

item.title: Ash-Sharh:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنْكَ وِزْرَكَ wawaḍaʿnā ʿanka wiz'raka And We took off from thee thy burden (Ar. 'Vizr, the burden of apostleship - The ministry.) ? The 'Vizr' means the burden of the apostleship, i.e., ministry1. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Sharh:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ alladhī anqaḍa ẓahraka which [almost] broke your back?

item.title: Ash-Sharh:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ alladhī anqaḍa ẓahraka Which had weighed upon your back. See 94:1

item.title: Ash-Sharh:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ alladhī anqaḍa ẓahraka Which weighed down thy back (Refer to: 73:5.) ? See 94:2

item.title: Ash-Sharh:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ warafaʿnā laka dhik'raka Did We not exalt your name?

item.title: Ash-Sharh:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ warafaʿnā laka dhik'raka And raised high for you your repute. See 94:1
