item.title: Ash-Sharh:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ warafaʿnā laka dhik'raka And exalted we for thee, thy fame (Eminence Remembrance.) ? This is a prophetic announcement of the mention, or the eminence of the Holy Prophet being raised to glorious heights both in this world and in the hereafter, high above the mention of any one in the world. Bringing into account the 'Salawat' or the salutation, every Muslim is obliged to recite it at least in each of the five times daily prayer. There is none in the world to be compared to the Holy Prophet in this regard for the name of no other apostle of God, is mentioned in such abundance. This prophecy was made when the Prophet was a solitary figure, not much recognised even by the people of his own place and when most of the people in his environment…

item.title: Ash-Sharh:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا fa-inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran Indeed ease accompanies hardship.

item.title: Ash-Sharh:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا fa-inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran For indeed, with hardship (will be) ease (i.e., relief). See 94:1

item.title: Ash-Sharh:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا fa-inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran Verily with (every) difficulty (there) is ease The whole life of the Holy Prophet was of persecution, difficulties and toil, dangers and worries. The repeated statement here is to give emphasis to the promise and its assurance of the ultimate triumph of the cause even though in the earlier stages the situation was utterly hopeless and the survival of the Holy Prophet, the Muslims and the very name of the faith, Islam, seemed to be an impossibility. By making his name to be mentioned in the 'Azan' the Call for prayer - in the 'Tashah'hud' in the prayer itself and in the form of 'Salawat', i.e., the Salutation - on him and his Ahl Al-Bayt wherever his name is mentioned1. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Sharh:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran Indeed ease accompanies hardship.

item.title: Ash-Sharh:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran Indeed, with hardship (will be) ease. See 94:1

item.title: Ash-Sharh:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran Verily with (every) difficulty (there) is ease (Refer to: 5:3, 5:67.) This is in conformity with the first and second verses of the previous chapter. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Sharh:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ fa-idhā faraghta fa-inṣab So when you are done, appoint,1

item.title: Ash-Sharh:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ fa-idhā faraghta fa-inṣab So when you have finished (your duties), then stand up (for worship). See 94:1

item.title: Ash-Sharh:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ fa-idhā faraghta fa-inṣab And when thou hast finished (While concluding the task of the apostleship establish or perpetuate.) (the duties of thy ministry), then thou establish it (Refer to: 28:51.) ! This refers to the instruction to the Holy Prophet, to fix up the one already notified by him at the 'Dawat al-Asheera', (i.e., Ali Ibn Abu Talib). See note on verse 2 above and 5:67, in his place. By the time and wording of the verse 5:67 it gets evident that it was the instruction through this verse, i.e., about appointing Ali as his successor that the Holy Prophet was waiting to execute. The verse 5:67 clearly states ''Convey that which has already been sent down to thee", i.e., appointment of Ali the instructions for which had already been received. The concluding words and the tone…

item.title: Ash-Sharh:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ wa-ilā rabbika fa-ir'ghab and turn eagerly to your Lord.

item.title: Ash-Sharh:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ wa-ilā rabbika fa-ir'ghab And to your Lord direct (your) longing. See 94:1

item.title: Ash-Sharh:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ wa-ilā rabbika fa-ir'ghab And unto thy Lord, return with fervour (The guidance to mankind by appointing the successor 'Imam' (guide) and the Maula (guardian) of the people in thy place - which the Holy Prophet did at Ghadir Khumm. Refer to: 5:3, 5:67.) 'Farghab', i.e., get inclined - This was the instruction to the Holy Prophet - When he had finished his work as God's apostle, i.e., completed the duties of his ministry, to fix up Ali in his place and then get ready to return. Note the sublime words in which God expresses His will that the Holy Prophet should retire from this world. There is no mention of death. The instructions are to incline himself, i.e., to return to Him at his own choice and pleasure for it is quite evident from this, that death…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: طسم tta-seen-meem Tā, Sīn, Mīm.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: طسم tta-seen-meem Ṭā, Seen, Meem.1 وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, means, the One Who has power over all things, to subdue and control them: الرَّحِيمُ the Most Merciful. means, towards His creation, for He does not hasten to punish the one who sins, but He gives him time to repent, and if he does not, then He seizes him with a mighty punishment. Abu Al-'Aliyah, Qatadah, Ar-Rabi' bin Anas and Ibn Ishaq said: "He is Almighty in His punishment of those who went against His commands and worshipped others besides Him." Sa'id bin Jubayr said: "He is Most Merciful towards those who repent to Him and turn to Him."

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: طسم tta-seen-meem Ta Seen Meem (T. S. M.) Ta, Seen, Meem, (T. S. M.). Regarding the correct interpretations of these symbol letters refer to note on verse 2:1. Various meanings are said to have been given on various occasions which would be only to suit the individual capacity of the enquirers. Let us be content with what Qummi the famous commentator says that the letters stand for the 'Ism-e-A'zam', i.e., the Greatest Name of God which has been kept a close secret.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni These are the signs of the Manifest Book.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni These are the verses of the clear Book. See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni These are the verses of the (Qur'an.) Book Manifest See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ laʿallaka bākhiʿun nafsaka allā yakūnū mu'minīna You are liable to imperil your life [out of distress] that they will not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ laʿallaka bākhiʿun nafsaka allā yakūnū mu'minīna Perhaps, (O Muḥammad), you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers. See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ laʿallaka bākhiʿun nafsaka allā yakūnū mu'minīna Happly thou wilt kill thyself with grief that they become not believers The Holy Prophet felt very much for the heathens to whom he preached the truth for their not getting themselves guided aright. Unlike his predecessor apostles the Holy Prophet instead of inviting heaven's curse upon the rebellious generation of the disbelievers, in spite of their adamant and persistent attitude towards their wrong belief and evil ways, and their mercilessly persecuting him and his faithful followers the Holy Prophet was grieved at the lot of the people that it is said that his merciful anxiety for the salvation of the people and his grief for their lot was so much that was actually choking him to the point of death. Compare this with what Noah prayed 71:26…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ اٰیَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ in nasha nunazzil ʿalayhim mina l-samāi āyatan faẓallat aʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīna If We wish We will send down to them a sign from the sky before which their heads will remain bowed in humility.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ اٰیَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ in nasha nunazzil ʿalayhim mina l-samāi āyatan faẓallat aʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīna If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.1 See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ اٰیَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ in nasha nunazzil ʿalayhim mina l-samāi āyatan faẓallat aʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīna If We will, We can send down upon them from the heaven a sign that their necks get bent unto it. The Eighth Holy Imam Ali Ibn Musa ar-Ridha says that when the Last Imam Muhammad Ibn al-Hassan al-Mahdi will appear, a voice from heaven would announce "Be it known! the Last Argument or the Sign of the Lord has appeared" and everyone in the world would hear this voice.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ wamā yatīhim min dhik'rin mina l-raḥmāni muḥ'dathin illā kānū ʿanhu muʿ'riḍīna There would not come to them any new reminder from the All-beneficent but that they used to disregard it.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ wamā yatīhim min dhik'rin mina l-raḥmāni muḥ'dathin illā kānū ʿanhu muʿ'riḍīna And no mention (i.e., revelation) comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it. See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ wamā yatīhim min dhik'rin mina l-raḥmāni muḥ'dathin illā kānū ʿanhu muʿ'riḍīna And there cometh not unto them of a reminder from the Beneficent (God) afresh, save they, from it, turn aside. Every heavenly book which was a reminder, the people rejected. The Holy Qur'an which in spite of its being a manifest miracle, the people disbelieved in its being the Word of God and ridiculed the Holy Prophet.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْۤا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَؤُا مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ faqad kadhabū fasayatīhim anbāu mā kānū bihi yastahziūna They have certainly denied [the truth], but soon there will come to them the news of what they have been deriding.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْۤا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَؤُا مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ faqad kadhabū fasayatīhim anbāu mā kānū bihi yastahziūna For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule. See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْۤا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَؤُا مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ faqad kadhabū fasayatīhim anbāu mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And indeed they belied it: but soon shall come unto them the tidings of what they mock (at). See 26:5

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ awalam yaraw ilā l-arḍi kam anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin Have they not regarded the earth, how many We have caused to grow in it of every splendid kind [of vegetation]?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ awalam yaraw ilā l-arḍi kam anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind? See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ awalam yaraw ilā l-arḍi kam anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin What! (Observe not the nearest thing at hand.) See they not unto the (Observe not the nearest thing at hand.) earth, how many of every noble kind (Of creation.) We have caused to grow in it? Why do not people look around and see the wonders worked by nature in such abundance - growing things of beauty and use, from the dust and dirt, executing the divine plan without any aid from any one. Verse 26:7 points that those who are adamant to the Divine Signs will never accept any sign. They see the divine signs in the realm of creation and yet most of them believe not. The same would be their attitude towards the signs from…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Verily in that there is a sign; but most of them believe not. See 26:7

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Verily thy Lord, certainly is He the Al-Mighty, the All- Merciful. See 26:7

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ نَادَى رَبُّكَ مُوسٰی أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idh nādā rabbuka mūsā ani i'ti l-qawma l-ẓālimīna When your Lord called out to Moses: [saying,] 'Go to the wrongdoing people,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ نَادَى رَبُّكَ مُوسٰی أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idh nādā rabbuka mūsā ani i'ti l-qawma l-ẓālimīna And (mention) when your Lord called Musa, (saying), "Go to the wrongdoing people. And (remember) when your Lord called Musa (saying): "Go to the people who are wrongdoers (26:10). "The people of Fira'wn. Will they not have Taqwa? (26:11). He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will deny me, (26:12). "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Harun (26:13). "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me (26:14). (Allah) said: "Nay! Go you both with Our signs. Verily, We shall be with you, listening (26:15). "And go both of you to Fira'wn, and say: 'We are the Messengers of the Lord of Al-'Alamin, (26:16). 'So allow the Children…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ نَادَى رَبُّكَ مُوسٰی أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ wa-idh nādā rabbuka mūsā ani i'ti l-qawma l-ẓālimīna And when called out thy Lord unto Moses saying: "Go thou unto the unjust people (to guide them)?" See 26:7

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ qawma fir'ʿawna alā yattaqūna the people of Pharaoh. Will they not be wary [of Allah]?'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ qawma fir'ʿawna alā yattaqūna The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?" See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ qawma fir'ʿawna alā yattaqūna The people of Pharaoh; Will they not ward off evil? See 26:7

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ qāla rabbi innī akhāfu an yukadhibūni He said, 'My Lord! I fear they will impugn me,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ qāla rabbi innī akhāfu an yukadhibūni He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me. See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ qāla rabbi innī akhāfu an yukadhibūni Said (Moses): "O' my Lord! Verily fear I that they will belie me!" See 26:7

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَى هَارُونَ wayaḍīqu ṣadrī walā yanṭaliqu lisānī fa-arsil ilā hārūna and I will become upset, and my tongue will fail me. So send [Your messenger] to Aaron.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَى هَارُونَ wayaḍīqu ṣadrī walā yanṭaliqu lisānī fa-arsil ilā hārūna And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Harun. See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَى هَارُونَ wayaḍīqu ṣadrī walā yanṭaliqu lisānī fa-arsil ilā hārūna And straitened is my breast, and eloquent is not my tongue, so send Thou unto Aaron (to my aid) Moses had not the fluency of tongue which he apprehended to fail him in his mission of preaching the truth to Pharaoh.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ walahum ʿalayya dhanbun fa-akhāfu an yaqtulūni Also they have a charge against me, and I fear they will kill me.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ walahum ʿalayya dhanbun fa-akhāfu an yaqtulūni And they have upon me a (claim due to) sin, so I fear that they will kill me." See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ walahum ʿalayya dhanbun fa-akhāfu an yaqtulūni And they have (a charge) against me (of) a crime, and fear I that they may slay me. Moses was brought up in the very palace of Pharaoh.1 Once when Moses saw an Egyptian beating an Israelite, he rendered a blow by his fist to the Egyptian who succumbed to it. Moses escaped into the Midianite country but the charge of slaying the Egyptian was there against him. Moses remembered the charge and feared the vengeance against him. The statement of Moses about the difficulties in his way to proceed against Pharaoh, was not to avoid the commission but only a prayer seeking the aid by Aaron. Note that the Holy Prophet had also to wait for forty years until (an Aaron to him) was given in Ali…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَلَّا فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُسْتَمِعُونَ qāla kallā fa-idh'habā biāyātinā innā maʿakum mus'tamiʿūna He said, 'Certainly not! Let the two of you go with Our signs: We will indeed be with you, hearing [everything].

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَلَّا فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُسْتَمِعُونَ qāla kallā fa-idh'habā biāyātinā innā maʿakum mus'tamiʿūna (Allah) said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening. See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَلَّا فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُسْتَمِعُونَ qāla kallā fa-idh'habā biāyātinā innā maʿakum mus'tamiʿūna Said (God): "By no means! (What Moses apprehended shall not happen.) so go ye both with Our signs, Verily, with you are We, (and will be) hearing!" See 26:14

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ fatiyā fir'ʿawna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna So approach Pharaoh and say, "We are indeed envoys of the Lord of the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ fatiyā fir'ʿawna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers1 of the Lord of the worlds. See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ fatiyā fir'ʿawna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna So go unto Pharaoh and say ye both (unto him): "Verily we two are the apostles of the Lord of the worlds!" It is said that for about 400 years the Israelites were subjected to the tyrannies of the Egyptians - Moses and Aaron came to Egypt and stayed there for a year. People taking them to be mad men did not make any mention of them to Pharaoh. Once a jester told Pharaoh that there were two men more foolish than him for they claimed to be the apostles of God. Pharaoh ordered the two men (Moses and Aaron) to be presented to him to ridicule them. Pharaoh recognised Moses.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ an arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla that you let the Children of Israel go with us." '

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ an arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla (Commanded to say), "Send with us the Children of Israel."'" See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ an arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla Send thou with us the children of Israel! See 26:16

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdan walabith'ta fīnā min ʿumurika sinīna He said, 'Did we not rear you as a child among us, and did you not stay with us for years of your life?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdan walabith'ta fīnā min ʿumurika sinīna (Pharaoh) said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life? See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdan walabith'ta fīnā min ʿumurika sinīna Said (Pharaoh): "Did we not cherish thee amidst us as a child? And thou didst dwell amidst us for (many) years of thy life," When Moses mentioned the name of God, Pharaoh by way of claiming godhead for himself, asked Moses whether he himself (Pharaoh) was not the Cherisher Lord of Moses as it was he who had brought him up.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ wafaʿalta faʿlataka allatī faʿalta wa-anta mina l-kāfirīna Then you committed that deed of yours, and you are an ingrate.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ wafaʿalta faʿlataka allatī faʿalta wa-anta mina l-kāfirīna And (then) you did your deed which you did,1 and you were of the ungrateful." See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ wafaʿalta faʿlataka allatī faʿalta wa-anta mina l-kāfirīna And thou (O' Moses!) didst a deed which thou didst and thou art one of the ungrateful (ones). The reference is to Moses' slaying the Egyptian who happened to be the cook of Pharaoh.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ qāla faʿaltuhā idhan wa-anā mina l-ḍālīna He said, 'I did that when I was astray.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ qāla faʿaltuhā idhan wa-anā mina l-ḍālīna (Musa) said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray (i.e., ignorant). See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ qāla faʿaltuhā idhan wa-anā mina l-ḍālīna Said (Moses): "I did it while I was one not yet directed" (as what to do) The word 'Zallin' means here, the one lost in the grip of Pharaoh, i.e., Moses was helpless. It does not mean that Moses was in any way ignorant of the truth for an Apostle is born with the wisdom, duly enlightened with the knowledge of the truth.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ fafarartu minkum lammā khif'tukum fawahaba lī rabbī ḥuk'man wajaʿalanī mina l-mur'salīna So I fled from you, as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me judgement and made me one of the apostles.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ fafarartu minkum lammā khif'tukum fawahaba lī rabbī ḥuk'man wajaʿalanī mina l-mur'salīna So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement (i.e., wisdom and prophethood) and appointed me (as one) of the messengers. See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ fafarartu minkum lammā khif'tukum fawahaba lī rabbī ḥuk'man wajaʿalanī mina l-mur'salīna So I fled from you when I feared you, then granted unto me my Lord, command, and made me (one) of (His) apostles. 'Hakm' i.e., Wisdom or authority stands for the apostleship and the commission of it. (a) 'You' indicates that Moses did not consider the act against the will of God but against the will of the unjust ruler. (b) God gifted Moses with command and power of judgment, in return for the golden deed of helping the oppressed against the aggressor the man of Pharaoh otherwise all the apostles have the status of prophethood, i.e., being under Divine Guidance from their very birth. (A.P.)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدْتَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ watil'ka niʿ'matun tamunnuhā ʿalayya an ʿabbadtta banī is'rāīla As for that favour, you remind me of it reproachfully because you have enslaved the Children of Israel.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدْتَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ watil'ka niʿ'matun tamunnuhā ʿalayya an ʿabbadtta banī is'rāīla And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?" See 26:10

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدْتَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ watil'ka niʿ'matun tamunnuhā ʿalayya an ʿabbadtta banī is'rāīla And is it a favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the children of Israel? See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla fir'ʿawnu wamā rabbu l-ʿālamīna He said, 'And what is "the Lord of all the worlds?" '

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla fir'ʿawnu wamā rabbu l-ʿālamīna Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?" Fir'awn said: "And what is the Lord of Al-'Alamin (26:23). (Musa) said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, if you seek to be convinced with certainty (26:24). (Fir'awn) said to those around: "Do you not hear (what he says)? (26:25). (Musa) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers! (26:26). (Fir'awn) said: "Verily, your Messenger who has been sent to you is a madman! (26:27). (Musa) said: "Lord of the east and the west, and all that is between them, if you did but understand! (26:28). Allah Tells us about the Disbelief, Rebellion, Oppression and Denial of Fir'awn, As He Says: وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ (Fir'awn said:) "And what is the…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ qāla fir'ʿawnu wamā rabbu l-ʿālamīna Said Pharaoh: "What is the Lord of the worlds?" See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ qāla rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīna He said, 'The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, —should you have conviction.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ qāla rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīna (Musa) said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced." See 26:23

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ qāla rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīna Said (Moses): "(He is) The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between the two, if only ye be (Those who verify.) sure." See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ qāla liman ḥawlahu alā tastamiʿūna He said to those who were around him, 'Don't you hear?!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ qāla liman ḥawlahu alā tastamiʿūna (Pharaoh) said to those around him, "Do you not hear?" See 26:23

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ qāla liman ḥawlahu alā tastamiʿūna Said (Pharaoh) unto those around him: "Do ye hear (What Moses says.) not?" See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ qāla rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīna He said, 'Your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ qāla rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīna (Musa) said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers." See 26:23

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ qāla rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīna Said (Moses): "(God is) your Lord and the Lord of our fathers of old!" See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ qāla inna rasūlakumu alladhī ur'sila ilaykum lamajnūnun He said, 'Indeed your messenger, who has been sent to you, is surely crazy!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ qāla inna rasūlakumu alladhī ur'sila ilaykum lamajnūnun (Pharaoh) said,1 "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad." See 26:23

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ qāla inna rasūlakumu alladhī ur'sila ilaykum lamajnūnun Said (Pharaoh.) (he): "Verily your apostle who is sent unto you is certainly mad." See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ qāla rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamā baynahumā in kuntum taʿqilūna He said, 'The Lord of the east and the west and whatever is between them —should you apply reason.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ qāla rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamā baynahumā in kuntum taʿqilūna (Musa) said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason." See 26:23

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ qāla rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamā baynahumā in kuntum taʿqilūna Said (Moses): "(God is) the Lord of the east and the west and what is between the two, if ye (only) understand" See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ qāla la-ini ittakhadhta ilāhan ghayrī la-ajʿalannaka mina l-masjūnīna He said, 'If you take up any god other than me, I will surely make you a prisoner!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ qāla la-ini ittakhadhta ilāhan ghayrī la-ajʿalannaka mina l-masjūnīna (Pharaoh) said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned." He said: If you choose a god other than me, I will certainly put you among the prisoners (26:29). He said: "Even if I bring you something manifest? (26:30). He said: "Bring it forth then, if you are of the truthful! (26:31). So he threw his stick, and behold, it was a serpent, manifest (26:32). And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders (26:33). He said to the chiefs around him: "Verily, this is indeed a well-versed sorcerer (26:34). "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery: what is it then that you command? (26:35). They…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ qāla la-ini ittakhadhta ilāhan ghayrī la-ajʿalannaka mina l-masjūnīna Said (Pharaoh): "Should thou take a god other than me, I will certainly make thee one of the imprisoned ones." See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُبِينٍ qāla awalaw ji'tuka bishayin mubīnin He said, 'What if I bring you something manifest?'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُبِينٍ qāla awalaw ji'tuka bishayin mubīnin (Musa) said, "Even if I brought you something (i.e., proof) manifest?" See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُبِينٍ qāla awalaw ji'tuka bishayin mubīnin Said (Moses): "What! even if I bring unto thee something manifest?" (A miracle.) See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qāla fati bihi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna He said, 'Then bring it, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qāla fati bihi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna (Pharaoh) said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful." See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qāla fati bihi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Said (Pharaoh): "Bring it then, if thou be of the truthful ones." See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnun Thereat he threw down his staff, and behold, it was a manifest python.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnun So (Musa) threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.1 See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnun So he (Moses) threw down his staff, and lo! and it was a manifest serpent, See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīna Then he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to the onlookers.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīna And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers. See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīna And he drew out his hand, and lo! it was radiant white unto the beholders. See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌ qāla lil'mala-i ḥawlahu inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun He said to the elite [who stood] around him, 'This is indeed an expert magician

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌ qāla lil'mala-i ḥawlahu inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun (Pharaoh) said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician. See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌ qāla lil'mala-i ḥawlahu inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun Said (Pharaoh) unto the chiefs around him: "Verily this is a skilled sorcerer", See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihi famādhā tamurūna who seeks to expel you from your land with his magic. So what do you advise?'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihi famādhā tamurūna He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?" See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihi famādhā tamurūna Intendeth he to drive you out of your land with his sorcery, what then is it ye (Advise.) counsel? See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-ib'ʿath fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna They said, 'Put him and his brother off for a while, and send heralds to the cities

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-ib'ʿath fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna They said, "Postpone (the matter of) him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers. See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-ib'ʿath fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna Said they: "Give him (Put him off.) respite and to his Brother (Aaron), and send (To collect.) heralds into the cities," See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ yatūka bikulli saḥḥārin ʿalīmin to bring you every expert magician.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ yatūka bikulli saḥḥārin ʿalīmin Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician." See 26:29

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ yatūka bikulli saḥḥārin ʿalīmin (That) they bring unto thee all the sorcerers well-versed See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ fajumiʿa l-saḥaratu limīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin So the magicians were gathered for the tryst of a known day,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ fajumiʿa l-saḥaratu limīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.1 So, the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed (26:38). And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble? (26:39). "That we may follow the sorcerers if they are the winners (26:40). So, when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Fir'awn: "Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners? (26:41). He said: "Yes, and you shall then verily be of those brought near (to myself) (26:42). Musa said to them: "Throw what you are going to throw! (26:43). So, they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said: "By the might of Fir'awn, it is we who will certainly win! (26:44). Then Musa threw his…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ fajumiʿa l-saḥaratu limīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin So were gathered together the sorcerers at the appointed time on a day (which was) announced, See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُجْتَمِعُونَ waqīla lilnnāsi hal antum muj'tamiʿūna and the people were told: 'Will you gather?!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُجْتَمِعُونَ waqīla lilnnāsi hal antum muj'tamiʿūna And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate. See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُجْتَمِعُونَ waqīla lilnnāsi hal antum muj'tamiʿūna And it was said unto the people: "Will ye all assemble?" See 26:21

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ laʿallanā nattabiʿu l-saḥarata in kānū humu l-ghālibīna 'Maybe we will follow the magicians, should they be the victors!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ laʿallanā nattabiʿu l-saḥarata in kānū humu l-ghālibīna That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?" See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ laʿallanā nattabiʿu l-saḥarata in kānū humu l-ghālibīna Happly we may follow the sorcerers, if they be triumphant Pharaoh desired his people to witness the show of his selected sorcerers so that they might get more convinced of his godhead and be more obedient to him.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qālū lifir'ʿawna a-inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīna So when the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, 'Shall we indeed have a reward if we were to be the victors?'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qālū lifir'ʿawna a-inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīna And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?" See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qālū lifir'ʿawna a-inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīna When came the sorcerers, said they unto Pharaoh: "Is there for us a reward if we be triumphant?" See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ qāla naʿam wa-innakum idhan lamina l-muqarabīna He said, ' Of course; and indeed you shall be among those near [to me].'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ qāla naʿam wa-innakum idhan lamina l-muqarabīna He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near (to me)." See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ qāla naʿam wa-innakum idhan lamina l-muqarabīna Said (Pharaoh): "Yea! verily ye in that case be of those (exalted to be) nearest (to me)" See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna Moses said to them, 'Throw down what you have to throw!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna Musa said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw." See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna Said unto them Moses: "Cast ye what ye have to cast!" See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْۤا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ fa-alqaw ḥibālahum waʿiṣiyyahum waqālū biʿizzati fir'ʿawna innā lanaḥnu l-ghālibūna So they threw down their sticks and ropes, and said, 'By the might of Pharaoh, we shall surely be the victors!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْۤا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ fa-alqaw ḥibālahum waʿiṣiyyahum waqālū biʿizzati fir'ʿawna innā lanaḥnu l-ghālibūna So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant." See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْۤا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ fa-alqaw ḥibālahum waʿiṣiyyahum waqālū biʿizzati fir'ʿawna innā lanaḥnu l-ghālibūna Then they cast down their (Taking the oath in Pharaoh's name - as they worshipped him.) cords and their rods and said: "By Pharaoh's dignity we shall certainly be triumphant" See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى مُوسٰی عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ fa-alqā mūsā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūna Thereat Moses threw down his staff, and behold, it was swallowing what they had faked.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى مُوسٰی عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ fa-alqā mūsā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūna Then Musa threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified. See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَلْقَى مُوسٰی عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ fa-alqā mūsā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūna Then cast down Moses his staff, and lo! it swallowed that which they falsely displayed. See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīna Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīna So the magicians fell down in prostration (to Allah). See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīna Then flung themselves the sorcerers prostrating. See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīna They said, 'We believe in the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīna They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds. See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīna Said (the sorcerers): "Believe we in the Lord of the worlds!" See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ rabbi mūsā wahārūna the Lord of Moses and Aaron.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ rabbi mūsā wahārūna The Lord of Musa and Harun." See 26:38

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ rabbi mūsā wahārūna The Lord of Moses and Aaron! See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ءَامَنْتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra falasawfa taʿlamūna la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna He said, 'Do you profess faith in Him before I permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Soon you will surely know! Surely I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ءَامَنْتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra falasawfa taʿlamūna la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna (Pharaoh) said, "You believed him (i.e., Musa) before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all." He said: You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all (26:49).…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ ءَامَنْتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra falasawfa taʿlamūna la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna Said (Pharaoh): "What! Believe ye unto him ere I give you leave; Verily, he is the chief of you who taught you the sorcery; so soon shall ye know; then certainly, will I cut off your hands and your feet on opposite side, and certainly will I crucify you all" See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَ إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ qālū lā ḍayra innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna They said, '[There is] no harm [in that]! Indeed we shall return to our Lord.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَ إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ qālū lā ḍayra innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return. See 26:49

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَ إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ qālū lā ḍayra innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna Said they: "No harm; Verily we unto our Lord shall return.''" See 26:40

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَنْ كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innā naṭmaʿu an yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwala l-mu'minīna Indeed we hope our Lord will forgive us our iniquities for being the first to believe.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَنْ كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innā naṭmaʿu an yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwala l-mu'minīna Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers." See 26:49

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَنْ كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ innā naṭmaʿu an yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwala l-mu'minīna Verily we hope that our Lord will pardon us our wrongs for we are the first of the believers. This statement of the 'First believers' refers to their past sins - not to the sins they committed after embracing the faith - So the tradition which indicates licensing of the believers to do whatever they like after the participation in the Battle of Badr, is certainly spurious. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī innakum muttabaʿūna Then We revealed to Moses, [saying], 'Take My servants on a journey by night, for you will be pursued.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī innakum muttabaʿūna And We inspired to Musa, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued." And We revealed to Musa, saying: "Depart by night with My servants, verily, you will be pursued (26:52). Then Fir'awn sent callers to (all) the cities (26:53). (Saying): "Verily, these indeed are but a small band (26:54). "And verily, they have done what has enraged us (26:55). "But we are a host all assembled, amply forewarned (26:56). So, We expelled them from gardens and springs (26:57). Treasures, and every kind of honorable place (26:58). Thus and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them (26:59). The Exodus of the Children of Israel From Egypt After Musa stayed in Egypt for a long time, and the proof of…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī innakum muttabaʿūna And revealed We unto Moses (saying): "Go thou forth with My servants by night, for verily ye will be pursued." See 26:51

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ fa-arsala fir'ʿawnu fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ fa-arsala fir'ʿawnu fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers.1 See 26:52

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ fa-arsala fir'ʿawnu fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna Then sent Pharaoh in the cities, (his) (Collectors to collect skilled sorcerers to defeat Moses.) heralds. See 26:51

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ inna hāulāi lashir'dhimatun qalīlūna [announcing:] 'These1 are indeed a small gang.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ inna hāulāi lashir'dhimatun qalīlūna (And said), "Indeed, those are but a small band. See 26:52

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ inna hāulāi lashir'dhimatun qalīlūna (And said he) "Verily these (Israelites) are only a small group", See 26:51

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ wa-innahum lanā laghāiẓūna They have surely aroused our wrath,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ wa-innahum lanā laghāiẓūna And indeed, they are enraging us. See 26:52

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ wa-innahum lanā laghāiẓūna Verily they unto us have enraged very much", See 26:51

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ wa-innā lajamīʿun ḥādhirūna and indeed we are all on our guard.'1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ wa-innā lajamīʿun ḥādhirūna And indeed, we are a cautious society..." See 26:52

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ wa-innā lajamīʿun ḥādhirūna And verily We are a multitude forewarned (and well Provided) See 26:51

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fa-akhrajnāhum min jannātin waʿuyūnin So We expelled them from gardens and springs,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fa-akhrajnāhum min jannātin waʿuyūnin So We removed them from gardens and springs. See 26:52

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fa-akhrajnāhum min jannātin waʿuyūnin So We turned them out of the gardens and the springs, See 26:51

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ wakunūzin wamaqāmin karīmin and [from] treasures and splendid places.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ wakunūzin wamaqāmin karīmin And treasures and honorable station1. See 26:52

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ wakunūzin wamaqāmin karīmin And treasures and goodly dwelling, See 26:51

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā banī is'rāīla So it was; and We bequeathed them to the Children of Israel.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā banī is'rāīla Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel. See 26:52

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā banī is'rāīla Thus (did We punish them) and We made the children of Israel the inheritors to them. After Pharaoh was drowned the Israelites returned to Egypt and owned all the wealth and possessions which were in the hands of Pharaoh.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتْبَعُوهُمْ مُشْرِقِينَ fa-atbaʿūhum mush'riqīna Then they pursued them at sunrise.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتْبَعُوهُمْ مُشْرِقِينَ fa-atbaʿūhum mush'riqīna So they pursued them at sunrise. So, they pursued them at sunrise (26:60). And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Musa said: "We are sure to be overtaken (26:61). (Musa) said: "Nay, verily with me is my Lord. He will guide me (26:62). Then We revealed to Musa (saying): "Strike the sea with your stick." And it parted, and each separate part became like huge mountain (26:63). Then We brought near the others to that place (26:64). And We saved Musa and all those with him (26:65). Then We drowned the others (26:66). Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers (26:67). And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful (26:68). Fir'awn's Pursuit and Expulsion of the Children of Israel, and How…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتْبَعُوهُمْ مُشْرِقِينَ fa-atbaʿūhum mush'riqīna Then they (Pharaoh with his host) pursued them at sunrise. See 26:59

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَا الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسٰی إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ falammā tarāā l-jamʿāni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamud'rakūna When the two hosts sighted each other, the companions of Moses said, 'Indeed we have been caught up.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَا الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسٰی إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ falammā tarāā l-jamʿāni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamud'rakūna And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Musa said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!" See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَا الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسٰی إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ falammā tarāā l-jamʿāni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamud'rakūna When the two parties saw each other, said those with Moses: "Indeed we are caught!" See 26:59

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَلَّا إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ qāla kallā inna maʿiya rabbī sayahdīni He said, 'Certainly not! Indeed my Lord is with me. He will guide me.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَلَّا إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ qāla kallā inna maʿiya rabbī sayahdīni (Musa) said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me." See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَلَّا إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ qāla kallā inna maʿiya rabbī sayahdīni (Moses) said: "By no means! verily my Lord is with me, soon will He guide me (to safety)." The fear of the people of Moses and their doubt of safety against the approaching enemy and Moses' consolation is quite similar to the story of the Holy Prophet and his companion in the Cave1 during the 'Hijrah' or immigration to Medina. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ fa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-baḥra fa-infalaqa fakāna kullu fir'qin kal-ṭawdi l-ʿaẓīmi Thereupon We revealed to Moses: 'Strike the sea with your staff!' Whereupon it parted, and each part was as if it were a great mountain.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ fa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-baḥra fa-infalaqa fakāna kullu fir'qin kal-ṭawdi l-ʿaẓīmi Then We inspired to Musa, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain. See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ fa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-baḥra fa-infalaqa fakāna kullu fir'qin kal-ṭawdi l-ʿaẓīmi Then revealed We unto Moses saying: "Strike thou the sea with thy staff"; then it clave asunder and each part (of the water stood) like a huge mountain. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْءَاخَرِينَ wa-azlafnā thamma l-ākharīna There, We brought the others near.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْءَاخَرِينَ wa-azlafnā thamma l-ākharīna And We advanced thereto the others (i.e., the pursuers). See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْءَاخَرِينَ wa-azlafnā thamma l-ākharīna Then We drew near the (Pharaoh and his hosts.) others See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْجَيْنَا مُوسٰی وَمَنْ مَعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ wa-anjaynā mūsā waman maʿahu ajmaʿīna And We delivered Moses and all those who were with him.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْجَيْنَا مُوسٰی وَمَنْ مَعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ wa-anjaynā mūsā waman maʿahu ajmaʿīna And We saved Musa and those with him, all together. See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْجَيْنَا مُوسٰی وَمَنْ مَعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ wa-anjaynā mūsā waman maʿahu ajmaʿīna And saved We Moses and those with him all of them. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna Then We drowned the others.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna Then We drowned the others. See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna Then We drowned the (Pharaoh and his hosts.) others. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna There is indeed a sign in that, but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Verily in this is a sure sign; but most of them believe not. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:60

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a ib'rāhīma Relate to them the account of Abraham

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a ib'rāhīma And recite to them the news of Ibrahim. And recite to them the story of Ibrahim (26:69). When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship? (26:70). They said: "We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted (26:71). He said: "Do they hear you when you call? (26:72). "Or do they benefit you or do they cause harm? (26:73). They said: "(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so (26:74). He said: "Do you observe that which you have been worshipping – (26:75). "You and your ancient fathers? (26:76). "Verily, they are enemies to me, save the Lord of Al-'Alamin, (26:77). How the Close Friend of Allah, Ibrahim Spoke out Against Shirk Here Allah tells us about His servant, Messenger and Close Friend, Ibrahim, upon him…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a ib'rāhīma And recite unto them the story of Abraham. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā taʿbudūna when he said to his father and his people, 'What is it that you are worshiping?!'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā taʿbudūna When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?" See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā taʿbudūna When said he unto his father and his people: "What do ye worship?" See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ qālū naʿbudu aṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīna They said, 'We worship idols, and we will go on clinging to them.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ qālū naʿbudu aṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīna They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted." See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ qālū naʿbudu aṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīna Said they: "Worship we the idols, and we shall ever be unto them the devotees." See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ qāla hal yasmaʿūnakum idh tadʿūna He said, 'Do they hear you when you call them?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ qāla hal yasmaʿūnakum idh tadʿūna He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate? See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ qāla hal yasmaʿūnakum idh tadʿūna Said (Asked.) (Abraham): "Do they hear you when ye call (them)?" See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَنْفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ aw yanfaʿūnakum aw yaḍurrūna Or do they bring you any benefit, or cause you any harm?'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَنْفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ aw yanfaʿūnakum aw yaḍurrūna Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?" See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يَنْفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ aw yanfaʿūnakum aw yaḍurrūna Or do they profit you (in any way) or cause you (any) harm? See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ qālū bal wajadnā ābāanā kadhālika yafʿalūna They said, 'Rather we found our fathers acting likewise.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ qālū bal wajadnā ābāanā kadhālika yafʿalūna They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus." See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ qālū bal wajadnā ābāanā kadhālika yafʿalūna Said they: "Nay! found we our fathers likewise acting." See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ qāla afara-aytum mā kuntum taʿbudūna He said, 'Have you regarded what you have been worshipping,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ qāla afara-aytum mā kuntum taʿbudūna He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping. See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ qāla afara-aytum mā kuntum taʿbudūna Have ye then seen what ye have been worshipping? See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ antum waābāukumu l-aqdamūna you and your ancestors?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ antum waābāukumu l-aqdamūna You and your ancient forefathers? See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ antum waābāukumu l-aqdamūna Ye and your (Ancestors.) fathers ancient? See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ fa-innahum ʿaduwwun lī illā rabba l-ʿālamīna They are indeed hateful to me, but the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ fa-innahum ʿaduwwun lī illā rabba l-ʿālamīna Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds.1 See 26:69

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ fa-innahum ʿaduwwun lī illā rabba l-ʿālamīna Verily they are (As a deity.) enemies unto me, save the Lord of the worlds, See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ alladhī khalaqanī fahuwa yahdīni who created me, it is He who guides me,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ alladhī khalaqanī fahuwa yahdīni Who created me, and He (it is who) guides me. Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me (26:78). And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink (26:79). And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me (26:80). And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (26:81). And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense (26:82). Ibrahim Mentions Allah's Kindness Towards Him Ibrahim said, I will not worship any but the One Who does these things: الَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me. He is the Creator Who has decreed certain things to which He guides His creation, so each person follows the…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ alladhī khalaqanī fahuwa yahdīni Who created me, and He it is who guideth me, See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ wa-alladhī huwa yuṭ'ʿimunī wayasqīni and provides me with food and drink,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ wa-alladhī huwa yuṭ'ʿimunī wayasqīni And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink. See 26:78

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ wa-alladhī huwa yuṭ'ʿimunī wayasqīni And who feedeth me provideth me to drink. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ wa-idhā mariḍ'tu fahuwa yashfīni and when I get sick, it is He who cures me;

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ wa-idhā mariḍ'tu fahuwa yashfīni And when I am ill, it is He who cures me. See 26:78

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ wa-idhā mariḍ'tu fahuwa yashfīni And when I get ill then He healeth me, See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ wa-alladhī yumītunī thumma yuḥ'yīni who will make me die, then He will bring me to life,
