item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ wa-alladhī yumītunī thumma yuḥ'yīni And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life. See 26:78

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ wa-alladhī yumītunī thumma yuḥ'yīni And who causeth me to die and then giveth me life (again), See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيءَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ wa-alladhī aṭmaʿu an yaghfira lī khaṭīatī yawma l-dīni and who, I hope, will forgive me my iniquities on the Day of Retribution.'1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيءَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ wa-alladhī aṭmaʿu an yaghfira lī khaṭīatī yawma l-dīni And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense." See 26:78

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيءَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ wa-alladhī aṭmaʿu an yaghfira lī khaṭīatī yawma l-dīni And Who, hope I, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Judgment. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ rabbi hab lī ḥuk'man wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna 'My Lord! Grant me [unerring] judgement, and unite me with the Righteous.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ rabbi hab lī ḥuk'man wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna (And he said), "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous. My Lord! Bestow Hukm on me, and join me with the righteous (26:83). And grant me an honorable mention in later generations (26:84). And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight (26:85). And forgive my father, verily, he is of the erring (26:86). And disgrace me not on the Day when they will be resurrected (26:87). The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail (26:88). Except him who brings to Allah a clean heart (26:89). The Prayer of Ibrahim for Himself and for His Father Here Ibrahim, upon him be peace, asks his Lord to give him Hukm. Ibn 'Abbas said, "This is knowledge." وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ and join me…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ rabbi hab lī ḥuk'man wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna O' My Lord! Grant thou unto me (Wisdom.) authority and unite me with the righteous! See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wa-ij'ʿal lī lisāna ṣid'qin fī l-ākhirīna Confer on me a worthy repute among the posterity,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wa-ij'ʿal lī lisāna ṣid'qin fī l-ākhirīna And grant me a mention (i.e., reputation) of honor among later generations. See 26:83

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ wa-ij'ʿal lī lisāna ṣid'qin fī l-ākhirīna And cause (Raise – make.) for me a Truthful tongue (goodly mention) among the posterity. See 26:62

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ wa-ij'ʿalnī min warathati jannati l-naʿīmi and make me one of the heirs to the paradise of bliss.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ wa-ij'ʿalnī min warathati jannati l-naʿīmi And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure. See 26:83

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ wa-ij'ʿalnī min warathati jannati l-naʿīmi And make me of the heirs of the garden of Bliss, Abraham's prayer was that one in his seed, be born who should be the Torch-Bearer of truth until the end of the world. There is no greater truth than the Unity of God. The prayer was for one to establish the Unity of God for ever. This was done by the Holy Prophet Muhammad and continued by Ali and the Eleven Holy Imams in his seed. The Holy Prophet and Ali are the only two who never yielded to falsehood, i.e., polytheism. All the others had been idolaters who subsequently embraced the truth. The Holy Prophet Muhammad has been called the 'Spirit of Truth' by Jesus1 who will guide the world unto All Truth - about Ali the Holy…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ wa-igh'fir li-abī innahu kāna mina l-ḍālīna Forgive my father, for he is one of those who are astray.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ wa-igh'fir li-abī innahu kāna mina l-ḍālīna And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray. See 26:83

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ wa-igh'fir li-abī innahu kāna mina l-ḍālīna And forgive my (God father.) father, verily, he was of those who have gone astray, This prayer for his adopted father was before he had given up the hope of his conversion1 (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ walā tukh'zinī yawma yub'ʿathūna Do not disgrace me on the day that they will be resurrected,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ walā tukh'zinī yawma yub'ʿathūna And do not disgrace me on the Day they are (all) resurrected. See 26:83

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ walā tukh'zinī yawma yub'ʿathūna And disgrace me not on the day when they are raised (On the Resurrection Day.) (again), See 26:86

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun walā banūna the day when neither wealth nor children will avail,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun walā banūna The Day when there will not benefit (anyone) wealth or children. See 26:83

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun walā banūna The day when will avail not wealth or sons, See 26:86

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتٰی اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ illā man atā l-laha biqalbin salīmin except him who comes to Allah with a sound heart,'1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتٰی اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ illā man atā l-laha biqalbin salīmin But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart." See 26:83

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتٰی اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ illā man atā l-laha biqalbin salīmin Save him who cometh unto God with a heart submissive. See 26:86

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna and paradise will be brought near for the Godwary,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna And Paradise will be brought near (that Day) to the righteous. And Paradise will be brought near to those who had Taqwa (26:90). And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the astray (26:91). And it will be said to them: "Where are those that you used to worship (26:92). "Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves? (26:93). Then they will be thrown on their faces into it (the Fire), they and the astray (26:94). And all of the hosts of Iblis together (26:95). They will say while contending therein (26:96). "By Allah, we were truly in a manifest error (26:97). "When we held you as equals with the Lord of all that exists; (26:98). "And none has brought us into error except the criminals (26:99). "Now we…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna And shall be (Prepared - made ready.) brought near, the garden for the pious (Those who guard themselves against evil.) ones. See 26:86

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ waburrizati l-jaḥīmu lil'ghāwīna and hell will be brought into view for the perverse,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ waburrizati l-jaḥīmu lil'ghāwīna And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ waqīla lahum ayna mā kuntum taʿbudūna and they shall be told: 'Where is that which you used to worship

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَنْصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ min dūni l-lahi hal yanṣurūnakum aw yantaṣirūna Besides God; can they help you or help themselves? See 26:86

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ fakub'kibū fīhā hum wal-ghāwūna Then they will be cast into it on their faces —they and the perverse,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ fakub'kibū fīhā hum wal-ghāwūna So they shall be thrown down into it, (The Hell fire.) they and those gone astray, See 26:86

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ wajunūdu ib'līsa ajmaʿūna and the hosts of Iblis all together.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ wajunūdu ib'līsa ajmaʿūna And the soldiers of Iblees, all together. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ wajunūdu ib'līsa ajmaʿūna And the hosts of the Iblis (Satan), all together. See 26:86

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ qālū wahum fīhā yakhtaṣimūna They will say, as they wrangle in it [together],

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ qālū wahum fīhā yakhtaṣimūna They will say while they dispute therein. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ qālū wahum fīhā yakhtaṣimūna They shall say, while they wrangle therein among them selves, There is no contradiction between this verse and verse 50:28. It has already been pointed out that these are references to the various stages of the Day of Resurrection. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنَّا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ tal-lahi in kunnā lafī ḍalālin mubīnin By God! we were in plain error, See 26:96

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ idh nusawwīkum birabbi l-ʿālamīna when we equated you with the Lord of all the worlds!

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ idh nusawwīkum birabbi l-ʿālamīna When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ idh nusawwīkum birabbi l-ʿālamīna When we equalled you with the Lord of the worlds, See 26:96

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَضَلَّنَا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ wamā aḍallanā illā l-muj'rimūna And no one led us astray except the guilty.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَضَلَّنَا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ wamā aḍallanā illā l-muj'rimūna And no one misguided us except the criminals. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَضَلَّنَا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ wamā aḍallanā illā l-muj'rimūna And none beguiled us but the guilty ones, See 26:96

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَنَا مِنْ شَافِعِينَ famā lanā min shāfiʿīna Now we have no intercessors,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَنَا مِنْ شَافِعِينَ famā lanā min shāfiʿīna So now we have no intercessors. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَنَا مِنْ شَافِعِينَ famā lanā min shāfiʿīna Now we have no intercessors, See 26:96

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ walā ṣadīqin ḥamīmin nor do we have any sympathetic friend.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ walā ṣadīqin ḥamīmin And not a devoted friend. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ walā ṣadīqin ḥamīmin Nor any loving friend, See 26:96

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ falaw anna lanā karratan fanakūna mina l-mu'minīna Had there been another turn for us, we would be among the faithful.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ falaw anna lanā karratan fanakūna mina l-mu'minīna Then if we only had a return (to the world) and could be of the believers..."1 See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ falaw anna lanā karratan fanakūna mina l-mu'minīna And if there be for us a return, we would be of the believers. See 26:96

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Verily in this (The story of Abraham which is followed by another story of Noah as a next sign see verse 26:105.) is a sign; And most of them believe not. The story of Abraham which followed by another story of Noah, as a next sign1 (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:90

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And verily thy Lord, He is certainly the All-Mighty, All- Merciful. See 26:103

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat qawmu nūḥin l-mur'salīna The people of Noah impugned the apostles

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat qawmu nūḥin l-mur'salīna The people of Nuh denied the messengers.1 The people of Nuh denied the Messengers (26:105). When their brother Nuh said to them: Will you not have Taqwa? (26:106). "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you (26:107). "So have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me (26:108). "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of all that exists (26:109). "So have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me (26:110). Nuh's Preaching to His People, and Their Response Here Allah tells us about His servant and Messenger Nuh (AS), who was the first Messenger sent by Allah to the people of earth after they started to worship idols. Allah sent him to forbid that and to warn people of the consequences of idol worship. But his people…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat qawmu nūḥin l-mur'salīna The people of Noah belied the apostles (of God), See 26:103

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūna when Noah, their brother, said to them, 'Will you not be wary [of Allah]?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūna When their brother Nuh said to them, "Will you not fear Allah? See 26:105

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūna When said unto them their brother Noah: "Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil?" See 26:103

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. See 26:105

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Verily I am unto you a trusted apostle, See 26:103

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me. See 26:105

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni Guard ye therefore against (the wrath of) God, and obey me; See 26:103

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds. See 26:105

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna And I ask not from you any recompense for it, for my recompense is only with the Lord of the worlds. See 26:103

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me." See 26:105

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So guard ye (yourselves) against (the wrath of) God, and obey me See 26:103

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ qālū anu'minu laka wa-ittabaʿaka l-ardhalūna They said, 'Shall we believe in you, when it is the riffraff who follow you?'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ qālū anu'minu laka wa-ittabaʿaka l-ardhalūna They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest (class of people)?" They said: Shall we believe in you, when the inferior follow you? (26:111). He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do? (26:112). "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know (26:113). "And I am not going to drive away the believers (26:114). "I am only a plain warner (26:115). The Demand of the People of Nuh and His Response They said: "We do not believe in you, and we will not follow you and become equal to the meanest of the people, who follow you and believe in you, and they are the lowest among us." قَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ - قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ qālū anu'minu laka wa-ittabaʿaka l-ardhalūna Said they: "What! Shall we believe in thee, while follow thee the meanest (ones)?" This is the common argument of the aristocratic class against the prophets that their followers are commoners. The common answer to their argument is that it is only the deeds of man which make him great or low and not the worldly possession, the account of which is with none but God. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:112 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ qāla wamā ʿil'mī bimā kānū yaʿmalūna He said, 'What do I know as to what they used to do?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:112 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ qāla wamā ʿil'mī bimā kānū yaʿmalūna He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do? See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:112 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ qāla wamā ʿil'mī bimā kānū yaʿmalūna Said (Noah); "No knowledge have I of what they were doing;" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:113 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّي لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ in ḥisābuhum illā ʿalā rabbī law tashʿurūna Their reckoning is only with my Lord, should you be aware.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:113 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّي لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ in ḥisābuhum illā ʿalā rabbī law tashʿurūna Their account is only upon my Lord, if you (could) perceive. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:113 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّي لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ in ḥisābuhum illā ʿalā rabbī law tashʿurūna Their reckoning is only on my Lord, if ye only knew See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:114 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā anā biṭāridi l-mu'minīna I will not drive away the faithful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:114 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā anā biṭāridi l-mu'minīna And I am not one to drive away the believers. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:114 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā anā biṭāridi l-mu'minīna I am not here to drive away the believers. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:115 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ in anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun I am just a manifest warner.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:115 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ in anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun I am only a clear warner." See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:115 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ in anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun I am not but an open warner See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:116 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَانُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ qālū la-in lam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna mina l-marjūmīna They said, 'Noah, if you do not relinquish, you will certainly be stoned [to death].'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:116 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَانُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ qālū la-in lam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna mina l-marjūmīna They said, "If you do not desist, O Nuh, you will surely be of those who are stoned." They said: If you cease not, O Nuh you will surely be among those stoned (26:116). He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have denied me (26:117). "Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me (26:118). And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship (26:119). Then We drowned the rest thereafter (26:120). Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers (26:121). And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful (26:122). His People's Threat, Nuh's Prayer Against Them, and Their Destruction Nuh…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:116 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَانُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ qālū la-in lam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna mina l-marjūmīna Said (they): "Now, if thou desist not, O' Noah! thou shalt surely be one of those stoned to death." See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:117 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi inna qawmī kadhabūni He said, 'My Lord! Indeed my people have impugned me.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:117 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi inna qawmī kadhabūni He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me. See 26:116

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:117 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ qāla rabbi inna qawmī kadhabūni Said (Noah): "My Lord! verily my people have belied me" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:118 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَنْ مَعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-if'taḥ baynī wabaynahum fatḥan wanajjinī waman maʿiya mina l-mu'minīna So judge conclusively between me and them, and deliver me and the faithful who are with me.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:118 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَنْ مَعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-if'taḥ baynī wabaynahum fatḥan wanajjinī waman maʿiya mina l-mu'minīna Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers." See 26:116

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:118 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَنْ مَعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ fa-if'taḥ baynī wabaynahum fatḥan wanajjinī waman maʿiya mina l-mu'minīna Therefore decide thou a decision between me and them, and deliver me and those of the believers with me, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:119 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ fa-anjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni Thereupon We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:119 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ fa-anjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship. See 26:116

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:119 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ fa-anjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni So We delivered him and those with him in the laden Ark See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:120 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ thumma aghraqnā baʿdu l-bāqīna Then We drowned the rest.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:120 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ thumma aghraqnā baʿdu l-bāqīna Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones. See 26:116

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:120 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ thumma aghraqnā baʿdu l-bāqīna Then drowned We the rest afterwards. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:121 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:121 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:116

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:121 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Verily in this is a sign; but most of them believe not. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:122 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:122 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:116

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:122 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:123 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat ʿādun l-mur'salīna [The people of] 'Ād impugned the apostles,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:123 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat ʿādun l-mur'salīna ʿAad denied the messengers. 'Ad denied the Messengers (26:123). When their brother Hud said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa? (26:124). "Verily, I am a trustworthy Messenger to you (26:125). "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me (26:126). "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of all that exists (26:127). "Do you build on every Ri' an Ayah for your amusement? (26:128). "And do you get for yourselves Masani' as if you will live therein forever? (26:129). "And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants (26:130). "So have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me (26:131). "And have Taqwa of Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know (26:132). "He has aided you with cattle and…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:123 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat ʿādun l-mur'salīna The (people) 'Ad belied the apostles (of God), See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:124 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūna when Hūd, their brother, said to them, 'Will you not be wary [of Allah]?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:124 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūna When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allah? See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:124 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūna When said unto them their brother Hud: "Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil?" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:125 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:125 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:125 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Verily I, unto you, am a trusted apostle, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:126 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:126 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:126 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni Therefore guard ye (yourselves) against (the wrath of) God, and obey me See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:127 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:127 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:127 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I seek not from you any recompense for it, for my recompense is only with the Lord of the worlds See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:128 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ اٰیَةً تَعْبَثُونَ atabnūna bikulli rīʿin āyatan taʿbathūna Do you futilely build a sign on every prominence?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:128 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ اٰیَةً تَعْبَثُونَ atabnūna bikulli rīʿin āyatan taʿbathūna Do you construct on every elevation a sign,1 amusing yourselves. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:128 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ اٰیَةً تَعْبَثُونَ atabnūna bikulli rīʿin āyatan taʿbathūna Build ye on every height a monument? (but) vain it is, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:129 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ watattakhidhūna maṣāniʿa laʿallakum takhludūna You set up structures as if you will be immortal,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:129 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ watattakhidhūna maṣāniʿa laʿallakum takhludūna And take for yourselves constructions (i.e., palaces and fortresses) that you might abide eternally? See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:129 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ watattakhidhūna maṣāniʿa laʿallakum takhludūna And raise ye strong mansions as if ye will abide (therein) for ever. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:130 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ wa-idhā baṭashtum baṭashtum jabbārīna and when you seize [someone for punishment], you seize [him] like tyrants.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:130 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ wa-idhā baṭashtum baṭashtum jabbārīna And when you strike, you strike as tyrants. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:130 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ wa-idhā baṭashtum baṭashtum jabbārīna And when ye seize (any one) by force, ye seize as tyrants See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:131 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:131 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:131 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So guard ye (yourselves) against (the wrath of) God, and obey me, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:132 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي أَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ wa-ittaqū alladhī amaddakum bimā taʿlamūna And be wary of Him who has provided you with what you know,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:132 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي أَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ wa-ittaqū alladhī amaddakum bimā taʿlamūna And fear He who provided you with that which you know. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:132 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي أَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ wa-ittaqū alladhī amaddakum bimā taʿlamūna And fear ye Him who hath bestowed plenty on you, what ye know See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:133 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ amaddakum bi-anʿāmin wabanīna and aided you with sons and with cattle,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:133 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ amaddakum bi-anʿāmin wabanīna Provided you with grazing livestock and children. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:133 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ amaddakum bi-anʿāmin wabanīna He hath provided you with plenty of cattle and children, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:134 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ wajannātin waʿuyūnin gardens and springs.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:134 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ wajannātin waʿuyūnin And gardens and springs. See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:134 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ wajannātin waʿuyūnin And gardens and springs, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:135 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:135 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day." See 26:123

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:135 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Verily I fear for you against the chastisement of a grievous day. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:136 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ qālū sawāon ʿalaynā awaʿaẓta am lam takun mina l-wāʿiẓīna They said, 'It is the same to us whether you advise us or not.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:136 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ qālū sawāon ʿalaynā awaʿaẓta am lam takun mina l-wāʿiẓīna They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors. They said: It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach (26:136). "This is no other than Khuluq of the ancients, (26:137). "And we are not going to be punished (26:138). So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers (26:139). And verily your Lord, He is indeed the Almighty, the Most Merciful (26:140). The Response of the People of Hud, and Their Punishment Allah tells us how the people of Hud responded to him after he had warned them, encouraged them, and clearly…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:136 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ qālū sawāon ʿalaynā awaʿaẓta am lam takun mina l-wāʿiẓīna Said (they): "It is same to us if thou admonish us, or be not of the admonishers (unto us)," See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:137 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ in hādhā illā khuluqu l-awalīna These are nothing but the traditions of the ancients,1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:137 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ in hādhā illā khuluqu l-awalīna This is not but the custom of the former peoples. See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:137 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ in hādhā illā khuluqu l-awalīna This (threatening) is naught but the custom of the ancients, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:138 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna and we will not be punished.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:138 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna And we are not to be punished." See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:138 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna And We are not those who would be punished See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:139 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-ahlaknāhum inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna So they impugned him, whereupon We destroyed them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:139 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-ahlaknāhum inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:139 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ fakadhabūhu fa-ahlaknāhum inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna So they belied him, then We destroyed them; Verily in this is a sign; but most of them believe not. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:140 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:140 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:140 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:141 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat thamūdu l-mur'salīna [The people of] Thamūd impugned the apostles

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:141 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat thamūdu l-mur'salīna Thamūd denied the messengers. See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:141 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat thamūdu l-mur'salīna Belied (the tribe of) Thamud, the apostles (of God), See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:142 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūna when Ṣāliḥ, their brother, said to them, 'Will you not be wary [of Allah]?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:142 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūna When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allah? See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:142 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūna When said unto them their brother Salih: "Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil?" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:143 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:143 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:143 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Verily I, unto you, am a trusted apostle, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:144 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:144 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me. See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:144 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni Fear ye (the wrath of) God, and obey me, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:145 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:145 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds. See 26:136

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:145 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna And I seek not of you any recompense for it, (For the apostolic service.) for my recompense is only with the Lord of the worlds; See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:146 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَا ءَامِنِينَ atut'rakūna fī mā hāhunā āminīna Will you be left secure in that which is here

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:146 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَا ءَامِنِينَ atut'rakūna fī mā hāhunā āminīna Will you be left in what is here, secure (from death). "Will you be left secure in that which you have here? (26:146). "In gardens and springs (26:147). "And crops and date palms with soft clusters (26:148). "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill (26:149). "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me (26:150). "And follow not the command of the extravagant, (26:151). Who make mischief in the land, and reform not (26:152). A Reminder to Them of Their Circumstances and the Blessings They Enjoyed Salih preached to them, warning them that the punishment of Allah could overtake them and reminding them of the blessings that Allah had bestowed upon them, by giving them ample provision and making them safe from all kinds of dangers, giving…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:146 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَا ءَامِنِينَ atut'rakūna fī mā hāhunā āminīna What! Will ye be left in what is here, secure (for ever)? See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:147 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fī jannātin waʿuyūnin —amid gardens and springs,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:147 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fī jannātin waʿuyūnin Within gardens and springs. See 26:146

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:147 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ fī jannātin waʿuyūnin In the gardens and springs, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:148 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ wazurūʿin wanakhlin ṭalʿuhā haḍīmun farms and date palms with dainty spathes?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:148 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ wazurūʿin wanakhlin ṭalʿuhā haḍīmun And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit? See 26:146

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:148 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ wazurūʿin wanakhlin ṭalʿuhā haḍīmun And cornfields and palm-trees with fine species! See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:149 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ watanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan fārihīna And you hew houses out of the mountains skillfully.1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:149 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ watanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan fārihīna And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill. See 26:146

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:149 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ watanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan fārihīna And ye hew out of the mountains for dwellings (for you), exaltingly See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:150 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:150 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me. See 26:146

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:150 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni Therefore, fear ye (the wrath of) God, and obey me, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:151 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُطِيعُوْۤا أَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ walā tuṭīʿū amra l-mus'rifīna and do not obey the dictates of the profligate,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:151 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُطِيعُوْۤا أَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ walā tuṭīʿū amra l-mus'rifīna And do not obey the order of the transgressors. See 26:146

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:151 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُطِيعُوْۤا أَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ walā tuṭīʿū amra l-mus'rifīna And obey not the bidding of the extravagants, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:152 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ alladhīna yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna who cause corruption in the land and do not bring about reform.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:152 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ alladhīna yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend." See 26:146

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:152 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ alladhīna yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna Those who make mischief in the earth, and amend not. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:153 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna They said, 'Indeed you are one of the bewitched.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:153 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna They said, "You are only of those affected by magic. They said: "You are only of those bewitched! (26:153). "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful (26:154). He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known (26:155). "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you (26:156). But they killed her, and then they became regretful (26:157). So, the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers (26:158). And verily, your Lord He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful (26:159). The Response of Thamud,…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:153 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna Said they: "verily thou art only of the bewitched ones," See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:154 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِاٰیَةٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ mā anta illā basharun mith'lunā fati biāyatin in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna You are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:154 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِاٰیَةٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ mā anta illā basharun mith'lunā fati biāyatin in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful." See 26:153

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:154 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِاٰیَةٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ mā anta illā basharun mith'lunā fati biāyatin in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Thou art naught but a man like unto us, so bring thou a sign if thou art one of the truthful (ones) See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:155 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ qāla hādhihi nāqatun lahā shir'bun walakum shir'bu yawmin maʿlūmin He said, 'This is a she-camel; she shall drink and you shall drink on known days.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:155 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ qāla hādhihi nāqatun lahā shir'bun walakum shir'bu yawmin maʿlūmin He said, "This is a she-camel.1 For her is a (time of) drink, and for you is a (time of) drink, (each) on a known day. See 26:153

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:155 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ qāla hādhihi nāqatun lahā shir'bun walakum shir'bu yawmin maʿlūmin Said (Salih) "Behold ye! This is a She-Camel for it shall be its drink and for you shall be your drink, (each) on an appointed day." See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:156 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīmin Do not cause her any harm, for then you shall be seized by the punishment of a terrible day.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:156 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīmin And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day." See 26:153

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:156 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīmin Touch her not with evil, lest will seize you the torment of the grievous day. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:157 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا نَادِمِينَ faʿaqarūhā fa-aṣbaḥū nādimīna But they hamstrung her, whereupon they became regretful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:157 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا نَادِمِينَ faʿaqarūhā fa-aṣbaḥū nādimīna But they hamstrung her and so became regretful. See 26:153

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:157 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا نَادِمِينَ faʿaqarūhā fa-aṣbaḥū nādimīna Then they hamstrung her, and turned (themselves) regretful, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:158 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna So the punishment seized them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:158 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:153

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:158 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna So seized them the chastisement; verily in this there is a sign; but most of them believe not. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:159 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:159 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:153

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:159 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And verily thy Lord, He is certainly the All-Mighty, The All-Merciful. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:160 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat qawmu lūṭin l-mur'salīna The people of Lot impugned the apostles

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:160 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat qawmu lūṭin l-mur'salīna The people of Lut denied the messengers. The people of Lut denied the Messengers (26:160). When their brother Lut said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa? (26:161). "Verily, I am a trustworthy Messenger to you (26:162). "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me (26:163). "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of all that exits (26:164). Lut and His Call Here Allah tells us about His servant and Messenger Lut (AS). He was Lut bin Haran bin Azar, the nephew of Ibrahim Al-Khalil, upon him be peace. Allah sent him to a mighty nation during the lifetime of Ibrahim (AS). They lived in Sadum (Sodom) and its environs, where Allah destroyed them and turned the area into a putrid, stinking lake,…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:160 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhabat qawmu lūṭin l-mur'salīna Belied the people of Lut, the apostles (of God) See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:161 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūna when Lot, their brother, said to them, 'Will you not be wary [of Allah]?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:161 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūna When their brother Lut said to them, "Will you not fear Allah? See 26:160

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:161 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūna When said unto them their brother Lut: "Will ye not guard {yourselves) against evil?" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:162 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:162 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. See 26:160

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:162 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Verily I, unto you, am a trusted apostle, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:163 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:163 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me. See 26:160

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:163 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni Therefore fear ye (the wrath of) God, and obey me, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:164 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:164 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds. See 26:160

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:164 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I seek not from you for it any recompense, for my recompense is only on the Lord of the worlds. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:165 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَأْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ atatūna l-dhuk'rāna mina l-ʿālamīna What! Of all people do you come to males,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:165 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَأْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ atatūna l-dhuk'rāna mina l-ʿālamīna Do you approach males among the worlds.1 Go you in unto the males of Al-'Alamin (people), (26:165). "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your wives? Nay, you are a trespassing people! (26:166). They said: "If you cease not, O Lut, verily, you will be one of those who are driven out! (26:167). He said: "I am indeed of those who disapprove with severe anger and fury your behavior (26:168). "My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do (26:169). So, We saved him and his family, all (26:170). Except an old woman among those who remained behind (26:171). Then afterward We destroyed the others (26:172). And We rained on them a rain, and how evil was the rain of those who had been warned (26:173).…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:165 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَأْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ atatūna l-dhuk'rāna mina l-ʿālamīna What! come ye (only) to males, of all the creatures! See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:166 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum bal antum qawmun ʿādūna abandoning your wives your Lord has created for you? Rather you are a transgressing lot.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:166 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum bal antum qawmun ʿādūna And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing." See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:166 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum bal antum qawmun ʿādūna And leave ye what hath created for you your Lord, of your wives? Nay! ye are people transgressing (the limits) See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:167 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَالُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ qālū la-in lam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna mina l-mukh'rajīna They said, 'Lot, if you do not relinquish, you will surely be banished.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:167 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَالُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ qālū la-in lam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna mina l-mukh'rajīna They said, "If you do not desist, O Lut, you will surely be of those evicted." See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:167 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَالُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ qālū la-in lam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna mina l-mukh'rajīna Said they: "If thou desist not O' Lut! thou shalt surely be of those who are expelled." See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:168 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ لِعَمَلِكُمْ مِنَ الْقَالِينَ qāla innī liʿamalikum mina l-qālīna He said, 'Indeed I detest your conduct.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:168 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ لِعَمَلِكُمْ مِنَ الْقَالِينَ qāla innī liʿamalikum mina l-qālīna He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest (it). See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:168 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ لِعَمَلِكُمْ مِنَ الْقَالِينَ qāla innī liʿamalikum mina l-qālīna Said (Lut): "Verily, I am of those who abhor your doings" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:169 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ rabbi najjinī wa-ahlī mimmā yaʿmalūna 'My Lord! Deliver me and my family from what they do.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:169 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ rabbi najjinī wa-ahlī mimmā yaʿmalūna My Lord, save me and my family from (the consequence of) what they do." See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:169 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ rabbi najjinī wa-ahlī mimmā yaʿmalūna My Lord! "deliver me and my family from what they do!" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:170 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna So We delivered him and all his family,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:170 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna So We saved him and his family, all. See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:170 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna So, We did deliver him and his people, (Those who were faithful to him.) all, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:171 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna except an old woman who remained behind.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:171 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna Except an old woman1 among those who remained behind. See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:171 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna Save an old woman (Lut's wife who was a wicked woman - Similar was Noah's wife - see verse 66:10. Both these women were cursed by God. Wives of prophets need not necessarily be righteous - Hence can never be counted as the permanent members of families of the prophets. Refer to note on verse 33:33.) among those who tarried behind. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:172 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna Then We destroyed [all] the others,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:172 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna Then We destroyed the others. See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:172 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna Then We destroyed the others. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:173 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna and rained down upon them a rain [of stones]. Evil was the rain of those who were warned!

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:173 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna And We rained upon them a rain (of stones), and evil was the rain of those who were warned. See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:173 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna And we showered down, upon them, and evil was the rain on those (who were) warned (but heeded not). See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:174 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:174 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:174 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Verily in this is a sign, but most of them believe not. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:175 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:175 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:165

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:175 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, the All-Merciful. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:176 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhaba aṣḥābu al'aykati l-mur'salīna The inhabitants of Aykah impugned the apostles,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:176 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhaba aṣḥābu al'aykati l-mur'salīna The companions of the thicket (i.e., the people of Madyan) denied the messengers. The companions of Al-Aykah denied the Messengers (26:176). When Shu'ayb said to them: "Will you not have Taqwa? (26:177). "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you (26:178). "So, have Taqwa of Allah, and obey me (26:179). "No reward do I ask of you for it; my reward is only from the Lord of Al-'Alamin (26:180). Shu'ayb and His Preaching to the Dwellers of Al-Aykah The companions of Al-Aykah were the people of Madyan, according to the most correct view. The Prophet of Allah Shu'ayb was one of them, but it does not say here, their brother Shu'ayb, because they called themselves by a name denoting their deification of Al-Aykah, which was a tree which they used to worship; it…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:176 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ kadhaba aṣḥābu al'aykati l-mur'salīna Belied the dwellers of the forest, the apostles (of God) See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:177 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūna when Shu'ayb said to them, 'Will you not be wary [of Allah]?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:177 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūna When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah? See 26:176

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:177 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūna When said unto them Shu'ayb: Not to cheat people of their things "Will ye not guard (yourselves) against evil." See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:178 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:178 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. See 26:176

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:178 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ innī lakum rasūlun amīnun Verily I unto you am a trusted apostle, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:179 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:179 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear Allah and obey me. See 26:176

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:179 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni So fear ye (the wrath of) God and obey me See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:180 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:180 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds. See 26:176

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:180 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna I seek not from you, for it any compensation, for my compensation is only on the Lord of the worlds. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:181 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْفُوْۤا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ awfū l-kayla walā takūnū mina l-mukh'sirīna Observe fully the measure, and do not be of those who give short measure.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:181 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْفُوْۤا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ awfū l-kayla walā takūnū mina l-mukh'sirīna Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss. "Give full measure, and cause no loss (to others) (26:181). "And weigh with the true and straight balance (26:182). "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land (26:183). "And have Taqwa of Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old (26:184). The Command to Give Full Measure Allah commanded them to give full measure, and forbade them to give short measure. He said: أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ Give full measure, and cause no loss. Meaning: 'when you give to people, give them full measure, and do not cause loss to them by giving them short measure, while taking full measure…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:181 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْفُوْۤا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ awfū l-kayla walā takūnū mina l-mukh'sirīna Give ye just measure and be not of those who lessen (to deceive) See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:182 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
