item.description: وَزِنُوْۤا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ wazinū bil-qis'ṭāsi l-mus'taqīmi Weigh with an even balance,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:182 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزِنُوْۤا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ wazinū bil-qis'ṭāsi l-mus'taqīmi And weigh with an even (i.e., honest) balance. See 26:181

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:182 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزِنُوْۤا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ wazinū bil-qis'ṭāsi l-mus'taqīmi And weigh with balances correct, upright See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:183 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna and do not cheat the people of their goods. Do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:183 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption. See 26:181

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:183 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna Defraud not people in their (due) goods, (Not to cheat people of their things.) and work not evil in the earth making mischief See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:184 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-ittaqū alladhī khalaqakum wal-jibilata l-awalīna Be wary of Him who created you and the earlier generations.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:184 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-ittaqū alladhī khalaqakum wal-jibilata l-awalīna And fear He who created you and the former creation."1 See 26:181

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:184 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-ittaqū alladhī khalaqakum wal-jibilata l-awalīna Fear Him who created you and the races of old See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:185 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna They said, 'Indeed you are one of the bewitched.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:185 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna They said, "You are only of those affected by magic. They said: "You are only one of those bewitched! (26:185). "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars! (26:186). "So, cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful! (26:187). He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do (26:188). But they denied him, so the torment of the Day of Shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day (26:189). Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers (26:190). And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful (26:191). The Response of Shu'ayb's…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:185 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna Said they: "Verily thou art only of those bewitched," See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:186 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا وَإِنْ نَظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ wamā anta illā basharun mith'lunā wa-in naẓunnuka lamina l-kādhibīna You are just a human being like us, and we indeed consider you to be a liar.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:186 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا وَإِنْ نَظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ wamā anta illā basharun mith'lunā wa-in naẓunnuka lamina l-kādhibīna You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars. See 26:185

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:186 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا وَإِنْ نَظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ wamā anta illā basharun mith'lunā wa-in naẓunnuka lamina l-kādhibīna Thou art but a man like us, and we deem thee certainly of the liars; See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:187 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafan mina l-samāi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Then make a fragment fall upon us from the sky, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:187 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafan mina l-samāi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful." See 26:185

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:187 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafan mina l-samāi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Cause (thou) then a part of the heaven to fall down upon us, if thou art one of the truthful (ones) See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:188 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ qāla rabbī aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna He said, 'My Lord knows best what you are doing.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:188 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ qāla rabbī aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do." See 26:185

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:188 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ qāla rabbī aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna Said (Shu'ayb): "My Lord knoweth best what (all) ye do" See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:189 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi l-ẓulati innahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin So they impugned him, and then they were overtaken by the punishment of the day of the overshadowing cloud. It was indeed the punishment of a tremendous day.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:189 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi l-ẓulati innahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day. See 26:185

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:189 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi l-ẓulati innahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin But they belied him, so seized them the chastisement of the day of cloud; Verily it was a chastisement of a Mighty (Grievous.) day. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:190 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:190 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. See 26:185

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:190 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna Verily in this is a sign, but most of them believe not, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:191 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:191 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:185

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:191 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu And verily thy Lord, certainly He is the All-Mighty, All-Merciful. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:192 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنْزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wa-innahu latanzīlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna This is indeed [a Book] sent down by the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:192 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنْزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wa-innahu latanzīlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna And indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds. And truly, this is a revelation from the Lord of all that exists (26:192). Which the trustworthy Ruh (Jibril) has brought down (26:193). Upon your heart that you may be (one) of the warners (26:194). In the plain Arabic language (26:195). The Qur'an Was Revealed by Allah Here Allah tells us about the Book which He revealed to His servant and Messenger Muhammad SAW. وَإِنَّهُ And truly, this refers to the Qur'an, which at the beginning of the Surah was described as: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ and never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Gracious... (26:5) لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ is a revelation from the Lord of Al-'Alamin.…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:192 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنْزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wa-innahu latanzīlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna And verily it (This Qur'an.) hath come down from the Lord of the worlds. See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:193 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ nazala bihi l-rūḥu l-amīnu brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:193 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ nazala bihi l-rūḥu l-amīnu The Trustworthy Spirit (i.e., Jibril) has brought it down. See 26:192

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:193 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ nazala bihi l-rūḥu l-amīnu Came down with it the Spirit (The Messenger Angel Gabriel.) trusted, See 26:111

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:194 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ ʿalā qalbika litakūna mina l-mundhirīna upon your heart (so that you may be one of the warners),

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:194 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ ʿalā qalbika litakūna mina l-mundhirīna Upon your heart, (O Muḥammad) - that you may be of the warners. See 26:192

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:194 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلَى قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ ʿalā qalbika litakūna mina l-mundhirīna Upon thy heart (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) that thou mayest be the Warner, While explaining this verse and the previous one a commentator has unnecessarily indulged into a very misleading statement about the authority of A'ishah, one of the wives of the Holy Prophet saying: "The pithy but most intelligent statement of that intelligent Lady 'A'ishah' than whom none was more familiar with the recipient of the Qur'anic revelation." In view of the fact it was at the age of about nine years when the Holy Prophet was made to accept Lady A'ishah who was yet a young girl, in his household, in Medina, when she was one of the nine wives, the Holy Prophet would have spent a few hours in the night only once in nine days even…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:195 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُبِينٍ bilisānin ʿarabiyyin mubīnin in a clear Arabic language.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:195 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُبِينٍ bilisānin ʿarabiyyin mubīnin In a clear Arabic language. See 26:192

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:195 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُبِينٍ bilisānin ʿarabiyyin mubīnin In the language, (Chaste and Eloquent.) plain Arabic. The Holy Qur'an was revealed in the most eloquent language of the Arabic tongue so that those who embraced it immediately might understand it easily and fully and spread it all over the world. The matchless eloquence of the Qur'anic language is a challenging sublimity of the Arabic tongue.1

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:196 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِیْ زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-innahu lafī zuburi l-awalīna It is indeed [foretold] in the scriptures of the ancients.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:196 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِیْ زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-innahu lafī zuburi l-awalīna And indeed, it is (mentioned) in the scriptures of former peoples. And verily, it is in the Zubur of the former people (26:196). Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars of the Children of Israel knew it (26:197). And if We had revealed it unto any of the non-Arabs (26:198). And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it (26:199). The Qur'an Was Mentioned in the Previous Scriptures Allah says: this Qur'an was mentioned and referred to in the previous Scriptures that were left behind by their Prophets who foretold it in ancient times and more recently. Allah took a covenant from them that they would follow it, and the last of them stood and addressed his people with the good news of…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:196 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِیْ زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ wa-innahu lafī zuburi l-awalīna And verily it is foretold in the scriptures (Deut 18/18-19, John 14/16, 16/7-8 & 16/12-13.) of (The ancients.) yore, The revelation of the Qur'an was mentioned in the previous scriptures and this was and still is known to the Israelite scholars. John 16/14 is the best evidence of this. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:197 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ اٰیَةً أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَؤُا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ awalam yakun lahum āyatan an yaʿlamahu ʿulamāu banī is'rāīla Is it not a sign for them that the learned of the Children of Israel recognize it?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:197 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ اٰیَةً أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَؤُا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ awalam yakun lahum āyatan an yaʿlamahu ʿulamāu banī is'rāīla And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel? See 26:196

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:197 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ اٰیَةً أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَؤُا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ awalam yakun lahum āyatan an yaʿlamahu ʿulamāu banī is'rāīla Is it not a sign unto them that recognize it the learned ones of the children of Israel? See 26:196

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:198 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الْأَعْجَمِينَ walaw nazzalnāhu ʿalā baʿḍi l-aʿjamīna Had We sent it down upon some non-Arab

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:198 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الْأَعْجَمِينَ walaw nazzalnāhu ʿalā baʿḍi l-aʿjamīna And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners.1 See 26:196

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:198 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الْأَعْجَمِينَ walaw nazzalnāhu ʿalā baʿḍi l-aʿjamīna And if We had sent it down unto any of the outlanders, See 26:196

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:199 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ faqara-ahu ʿalayhim mā kānū bihi mu'minīna and had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:199 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ faqara-ahu ʿalayhim mā kānū bihi mu'minīna And he had recited it to them (perfectly),1 they would (still) not have been believers in it. See 26:196

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:199 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ faqara-ahu ʿalayhim mā kānū bihi mu'minīna (And) then had he recited it unto them, they would have believed not in it. See 26:196

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:200 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika salaknāhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna This is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty:

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:200 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika salaknāhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna Thus have We inserted it (i.e., disbelief) into the hearts of the criminals. Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the criminals (26:200). They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment (26:201). It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not (26:202). Then they will say: Can we be respited? (26:203). Would they then wish for Our torment to be hastened on (26:204). Think, if We do let them enjoy for years (26:205). And afterwards comes to them that which they had been promised (26:206). All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them (26:207). And never did We destroy a township but it had its warner (26:208). By way of reminder, and We have never…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:200 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ kadhālika salaknāhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna Thus We caused it passing into the hearts of the guilty (ones) This refers to the mental procedure in the heart of the guilty not to be believed until they face the punishment.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:201 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ lā yu'minūna bihi ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma they do not believe in it until they sight the painful punishment.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:201 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ lā yu'minūna bihi ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment. See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:201 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ lā yu'minūna bihi ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma They will believe not in it till they see the grievous chastisement, See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:202 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna It will overtake them suddenly while they are unaware.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:202 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive (it) not. See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:202 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna And it shall come upon them of a sudden, while they perceive not, See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:203 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنْظَرُونَ fayaqūlū hal naḥnu munẓarūna Thereupon they will say, 'Shall we be granted any respite?'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:203 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنْظَرُونَ fayaqūlū hal naḥnu munẓarūna And they will say, "May we be reprieved?" See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:203 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنْظَرُونَ fayaqūlū hal naḥnu munẓarūna Then will they say: "Shall we be respited?" See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:204 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna So do they seek to hasten on Our punishment?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:204 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna So for Our punishment are they impatient? See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:204 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna What! Seek they to hasten Our chastisement? See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:205 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِنْ مَتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ afara-ayta in mattaʿnāhum sinīna Do you see, should We let them enjoy for some years,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:205 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِنْ مَتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ afara-ayta in mattaʿnāhum sinīna Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years. See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:205 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِنْ مَتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ afara-ayta in mattaʿnāhum sinīna Hast thou then seen that We provided them to enjoy themselves for years, See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:206 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَاءَهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ thumma jāahum mā kānū yūʿadūna then there comes to them what they have been promised,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:206 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَاءَهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ thumma jāahum mā kānū yūʿadūna And then there came to them that which they were promised? See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:206 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَاءَهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ thumma jāahum mā kānū yūʿadūna Then came unto them that which they were promised, See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:207 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُمَتَّعُونَ mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūna of what avail to them will be that which they were given to enjoy?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:207 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُمَتَّعُونَ mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūna They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided. See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:207 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُمَتَّعُونَ mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūna Availed them not that which they were provided to enjoy. When they will face the chastisement, they will wish for a respite but Qur'an says no amount of respite will be of any avail to them - they will pursue the same course. (A.P.)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:208 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُونَ wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūna We have not destroyed any town without its having warners,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:208 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُونَ wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūna And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners. See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:208 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُونَ wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūna We destroyed not any town but it had its warners, See 26:207

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:209 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِكْرٰی وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ dhik'rā wamā kunnā ẓālimīna for the sake of admonition, and We were not unjust.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:209 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِكْرٰی وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ dhik'rā wamā kunnā ẓālimīna As a reminder; and never have We been unjust. See 26:200

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:209 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِكْرٰی وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ dhik'rā wamā kunnā ẓālimīna To Remind (them); and never are We unjust. See 26:207

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:210 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ wamā tanazzalat bihi l-shayāṭīnu It1 has not been brought down by the devils.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:210 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ wamā tanazzalat bihi l-shayāṭīnu And the devils have not brought it (i.e., the revelation) down.1 And it is not the Shayatin (devils) who have brought it down (26:210). Neither would it suit them nor are they able (26:211). Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it (26:212). The Qur'an Was Brought Down by Jibril, Not Shaytan Allah tells us about His Book, which falsehood cannot approach from before or behind it, sent down by the All-Wise, Worthy of all praise. He states that it has been brought down by the trustworthy Ruh (i.e., Jibril) who is helped by Allah: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ And it is not the Shayatin who have brought it down. Then He tells us that it could not be the case for three reasons that the Shayatin brought it down. One…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:210 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ wamā tanazzalat bihi l-shayāṭīnu And came not with (The devils.) it, the devils. The limitations of the Devil is far below the standard of the contents of the Qur'an, as asserted in verse 26:212. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:211 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ wamā yanbaghī lahum wamā yastaṭīʿūna Neither does it behoove them, nor are they capable [of doing that].

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:211 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ wamā yanbaghī lahum wamā yastaṭīʿūna It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able. See 26:210

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:211 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ wamā yanbaghī lahum wamā yastaṭīʿūna It behoveth them not, they can (Nor have the power to do it.) do it. See 26:210

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:212 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ innahum ʿani l-samʿi lamaʿzūlūna Indeed they are kept at bay [even] from hearing it.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:212 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ innahum ʿani l-samʿi lamaʿzūlūna Indeed they, from (its) hearing, are removed.1 See 26:210

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:212 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ innahum ʿani l-samʿi lamaʿzūlūna Verily they, (even) from hearing it, are far removed. See 26:210

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:213 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ falā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina l-muʿadhabīna So do not invoke any god besides Allah, lest you should be among the punished.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:213 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ falā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina l-muʿadhabīna So do not invoke1 with Allah another deity and (thus) be among the punished. So, invoke not with Allah another god lest you should be among those who receive punishment (231)And warn your tribe of near kindred (26:214). And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you (26:215). Then if they disobey you, say: I am innocent of what you do (26:216). And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful (26:217). Who sees you when you stand up (26:218). And your movements among those who fall prostrate (26:219). Verily, He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower (26:220). The Command to Warn His Tribe of Near Kindred Here Allah commands (His Prophet SAW) to worship Him alone, with…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:213 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ falā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina l-muʿadhabīna So call thou (The Prophet addressed for the people.) not with God another god, lest thou be of the chastised ones. See 26:210

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:214 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ wa-andhir ʿashīrataka l-aqrabīna Warn the nearest of your kinsfolk,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:214 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ wa-andhir ʿashīrataka l-aqrabīna And warn, (O Muḥammad), your closest kindred. See 26:213

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:214 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ wa-andhir ʿashīrataka l-aqrabīna And warn thou thy relatives of nearest kin. The command to warn the nearest kinsmen was with the idea that when the admonition is given to the very nearest relations of the Holy Prophet, the others in mankind automatically come under the warning. On receipt of this command from God what the Holy Prophet did is recorded in all the basic books of Sunni commentary on the Holy Qur'an and books on the biography of the Holy Prophet and Islam viz. Ma'alim al-Tanzil, Tafsir al-Durr al-Manthur, Musnad Ahmad Ibn Hanbal and Riyaḍ al-Naḍra etc. When this verse was revealed, the Holy Prophet called Ali and ordered making a few loaves, with some meat on them and a cup of milk and to invite the sons of Abdul Muttalib. Ali acted as he was commanded…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:215 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka limani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna and lower your wing to the faithful who follow you.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:215 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka limani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna And lower your wing (i.e., show kindness) to those who follow you of the believers. See 26:213

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:215 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka limani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna And be kind unto him who followeth thee, of the believers. See 26:214

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:216 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīon mimmā taʿmalūna But if they disobey you, say, 'I am absolved of what you do.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:216 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīon mimmā taʿmalūna And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing." See 26:213

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:216 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīon mimmā taʿmalūna But if they disobey thee, then say: "verily I disassociate (myself) of what ye do!" Ref. to what Moses said when his people showed their disobedience1 and to what is narrated authentically from the Holy Prophet that when his people disobeyed to provide him with pen and paper, he said 'Get ye away from me, it behoveth ye not, to dispute in my presence.' (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:217 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ watawakkal ʿalā l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīmi And put your trust in the All-mighty, the All-merciful,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:217 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ watawakkal ʿalā l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīmi And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 26:213

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:217 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ watawakkal ʿalā l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīmi And rely thou on Mighty, All-Merciful, See 26:216

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:218 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ alladhī yarāka ḥīna taqūmu who sees you when you stand [for prayer],

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:218 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ alladhī yarāka ḥīna taqūmu Who sees you when you arise.1 See 26:213

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:218 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ alladhī yarāka ḥīna taqūmu He who seeth thee when thou dost stand up, The matter of these two verses has a meaning deeper and wider than a mere literal interpretation. God's seeing anyone standing or prostrating was no secret for the Holy Prophet to be informed of it. It is a disclosure of the hidden truth for the enlightenment of the people about the divine personal excellence of the soul of the Holy Prophet as well as the purity of his physical body that in its journey from the seed of Adam, the soul of the Holy Prophet passed on only through the channels of the purified loins of godly souls who spent their lives in obedience and devotion to the Lord and never the partnership in his ancestral parentage was polluted by the impurity of…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:219 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ wataqallubaka fī l-sājidīna and your going about among those who prostrate.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:219 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ wataqallubaka fī l-sājidīna And your movement among those who prostrate.1 See 26:213

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:219 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ wataqallubaka fī l-sājidīna And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves (in obeisance unto God) See 26:218

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:220 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:220 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing. See 26:213

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:220 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Verily He is the All-Hearing, The All-Knowing, See 26:218

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:221 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَى مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ hal unabbi-ukum ʿalā man tanazzalu l-shayāṭīnu Should I inform you on whom the devils descend?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:221 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَى مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ hal unabbi-ukum ʿalā man tanazzalu l-shayāṭīnu Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend? Shall I inform you upon whom the Shayatin descend (26:221). They descend on every lying, sinful person (Athim) (26:222). Who gives ear, and most of them are liars (26:223). As for the poets, the astray follow them (234)See you not that they speak about every subject in their poetry (26:225). And that they say what they do not do (26:226). Except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and remember Allah much and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned (26:227). Refutation of the Fabrications of the Idolators Here Allah addresses those idolators who claimed that what was brought by the Messenger SAW…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:221 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَى مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ hal unabbi-ukum ʿalā man tanazzalu l-shayāṭīnu Shall I inform you (of him) upon whom descend the satans? From this verse onwards give the limitation and the nature of the devilish revelations. (A.P.).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:222 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ tanazzalu ʿalā kulli affākin athīmin They descend on every sinful liar.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:222 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ tanazzalu ʿalā kulli affākin athīmin They descend upon every sinful liar. See 26:221

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:222 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ tanazzalu ʿalā kulli affākin athīmin Descend they (The satans.) on every lying sinful one, See 26:221

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:223 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ yul'qūna l-samʿa wa-aktharuhum kādhibūna They eavesdrop, and most of them are liars.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:223 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ yul'qūna l-samʿa wa-aktharuhum kādhibūna They pass on what is heard,1 and most of them are liars. See 26:221

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:223 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ yul'qūna l-samʿa wa-aktharuhum kādhibūna Lend they their ears (eagerly), and most of them are liars. The disbelievers had their own conjectures about the Holy Qur'an. Sometimes they said that it was mere stories of old, sometimes they called it the work of the Devil and sometimes they called it the work of a poet having the enchanting appeal of a poetic melody without much seriousness of the meaning or any reality of the thoughts contained in it. The reference here is to some particular class of poets who indulge in vain and exaggerative expressions misleading and rousing unhealthy passions and not against the art of poetry. The particular persons or the kind of the poets referred to here were - Abdullah Ibn al-Ziba'ra, Abu Sufyan bin al-Harith, Zuhayr Ibn Abi Sulma al-Muzani, and Samir Ibn 'Abd…

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:224 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ wal-shuʿarāu yattabiʿuhumu l-ghāwūna As for the poets, [only] the perverse follow them.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:224 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ wal-shuʿarāu yattabiʿuhumu l-ghāwūna And the poets - (only) the deviators follow them. See 26:221

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:224 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ wal-shuʿarāu yattabiʿuhumu l-ghāwūna And the poets, follow them the erring ones, See 26:223

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:225 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ alam tara annahum fī kulli wādin yahīmūna Have you not regarded that they rove in every valley,

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:225 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ alam tara annahum fī kulli wādin yahīmūna Do you not see that in every valley they roam.1 See 26:221

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:225 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ alam tara annahum fī kulli wādin yahīmūna See thou not that they, in every valley (Topic – subject.) they wander bewildered? See 26:223

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:226 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ wa-annahum yaqūlūna mā lā yafʿalūna and that they say what they do not do?

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:226 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ wa-annahum yaqūlūna mā lā yafʿalūna And that they say what they do not do?. See 26:221

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:226 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ wa-annahum yaqūlūna mā lā yafʿalūna And that they say what they (themselves) do not do. See 26:223

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:227 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْۤا وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُونَ illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarū l-laha kathīran wa-intaṣarū min baʿdi mā ẓulimū wasayaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabin yanqalibūna Barring those who have faith and do righteous deeds and remember Allah greatly, and aid each other after they have been wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know at what goal they will end up.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:227 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْۤا وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُونَ illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarū l-laha kathīran wa-intaṣarū min baʿdi mā ẓulimū wasayaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabin yanqalibūna Except those (poets) who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend (the Muslims)1 after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what (kind of) return they will be returned. See 26:221

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:227 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْۤا وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُونَ illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarū l-laha kathīran wa-intaṣarū min baʿdi mā ẓulimū wasayaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabin yanqalibūna Save those who believe and do good, and remember God much, and defend themselves after they are oppressed; And soon shall know those who deal unjustly, what an (evil) turning they shall be turned unto! This is an exception to the condemned art of poetry, in any poetic composition produced by the good believers who remember God in favour of the oppressed ones against the aggressors particularly those who were persecuted for their adherence to the truth. Therefore, the poetic work in the praise of the Holy Prophet or the Ahl al-Bayt or their devotees or condemning the aggressors and their unjust…

item.title: Ash-Shura:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Mīm,

item.title: Ash-Shura:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Meem. وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ And as for those who take as protecting friends others besides Him This refers to the idolators: اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ Allah is Hafiz over them. Meaning: He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full. وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ and you are not a trustee over them. Meaning: 'you are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.'

item.title: Ash-Shura:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ha. Mim. (H. M.) See 42:2

item.title: Ash-Shura:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عسق ain-seen-qaf 'Ayn, Sīn, Qāf.

item.title: Ash-Shura:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عسق ain-seen-qaf ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.1 See 42:1

item.title: Ash-Shura:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عسق ain-seen-qaf Ain. Seen. Qaf. (Y. S. Q.) Ha, Meem (H.M.) Ain, Seen, Qaf (A. S. Q.) These three letters are also a divine mystery known to none but the Holy Prophet and the custodians of his knowledge the holy Imams. What all the others have said about these letters are personal conjectures. The conjectures are the unwarranted interpretations of the mysteries treasured in the Holy Qur'an the knowledge of which has been secured only with the chosen ones, the purified ones of the Lord.1

item.title: Ash-Shura:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ kadhālika yūḥī ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Thus does He reveal to you and to those who were before you, Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise:

item.title: Ash-Shura:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ kadhālika yūḥī ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Thus has He revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 42:1

item.title: Ash-Shura:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ kadhālika yūḥī ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Thus doth reveal unto thee as (did He) unto those before thee, God, the Almighty, The All Wise. See 42:2

item.title: Ash-Shura:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-ʿaẓīmu to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the All-exalted, the All-supreme.

item.title: Ash-Shura:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-ʿaẓīmu To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.1 See 42:1

item.title: Ash-Shura:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-ʿaẓīmu His is whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Highest, the Greatest. See 42:2

item.title: Ash-Shura:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wal-malāikatu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fī l-arḍi alā inna l-laha huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu The heavens are about to be rent apart from above them, while the angels celebrate the praise of their Lord and plead for forgiveness for those on the earth. Look! Allah is indeed the All-forgiving, the All-merciful!

item.title: Ash-Shura:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wal-malāikatu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fī l-arḍi alā inna l-laha huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu The heavens almost break from above them,1 and the angels exalt (Allah) with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful. See 42:1

item.title: Ash-Shura:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wal-malāikatu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fī l-arḍi alā inna l-laha huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Nigh it is (that) the heavens cleave asunder from above (Refers to the relative pronoun 'Whatever' in the previous verse 42:4.) (for the very awe of His glory), while the angels are (there) celebrating (Refer to verse 40:7.) the praise of their Lord and seeking forgiveness for those in the earth; Be it known that verily, God, He (alone) is the Oft- Forgiving, the Most Merciful. The rending asunder of the heavens, signifies God's displeasure and wrath at man's associating any one with Him. The noblest and the purest spiritual beings, which we men can conceive outside the human ranks of God's…

item.title: Ash-Shura:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa l-lahu ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin As for those who have taken guardians besides Him, Allah is watchful over them, and it is not your duty to watch over them.

item.title: Ash-Shura:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa l-lahu ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is (yet) Guardian over them; and you, (O Muḥammad), are not over them a manager. See 42:1

item.title: Ash-Shura:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa l-lahu ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin And those who take aught besides God as their guardians, God watcheth over them, and thou art not over them a guardian. (A watcher.) See 42:5

item.title: Ash-Shura:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرٰی وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ فَرِيقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan litundhira umma l-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawma l-jamʿi lā rayba fīhi farīqun fī l-janati wafarīqun fī l-saʿīri Thus have We revealed to you an Arabic Qur'ān that you may warn [the people of] the Mother of the Towns1 and those around it, and warn [them] of the Day of Gathering,2 in which there is no doubt, [whereupon] a part [of mankind] will be in paradise and a part will be in the Blaze.

item.title: Ash-Shura:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرٰی وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ فَرِيقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan litundhira umma l-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawma l-jamʿi lā rayba fīhi farīqun fī l-janati wafarīqun fī l-saʿīri And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities (i.e., Makkah) and those around it1 and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze. And thus We have revealed to you a Qur'an in Arabic that you may warn the Mother of the Towns and all around it, and warn (them) of the Day of Assembling of which there is no doubt, a party will be in Paradise and a party…

item.title: Ash-Shura:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرٰی وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ فَرِيقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan litundhira umma l-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawma l-jamʿi lā rayba fīhi farīqun fī l-janati wafarīqun fī l-saʿīri And thus have We revealed unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) an Arabic Qur'an, that thou mayest warn the Mother City (Mecca) and those around (To begin with those around - not to be confined to the particular people or restricted to the area, but the whole around with Mecca as the Centre.) it, and (that) thou warn of the Day of Gathering (The Total Resurrection.) together (the Resurrection), wherein (there) is no doubt; (when) a party shall be in the garden (of Paradise) and a party (shall be) in the burning (Hell) fire. 'Ummul-Qura', i.e.,…

item.title: Ash-Shura:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِنْ يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَالظَّالِمُونَ مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalahum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimūna mā lahum min waliyyin walā naṣīrin Had Allah wished, He would have surely made them one community; but He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy, and the wrongdoers do not have any guardian or helper.

item.title: Ash-Shura:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِنْ يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَالظَّالِمُونَ مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalahum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimūna mā lahum min waliyyin walā naṣīrin And if Allah willed, He could have made them (of) one religion, but He admits whom He wills1 into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper. See 42:7

item.title: Ash-Shura:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِنْ يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَالظَّالِمُونَ مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalahum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimūna mā lahum min waliyyin walā naṣīrin And had God (so) pleased certainly would He have made them a single people, but admitteth He whosoever He willeth into His mercy; and the unjust, for them shall not be any guardian or a helper. See 42:7

item.title: Ash-Shura:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ فَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa fal-lahu huwa l-waliyu wahuwa yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Have they taken guardians besides Him? [Say,] 'It is Allah who is the Guardian, and He revives the dead, and He has power over all things.

item.title: Ash-Shura:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ فَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa fal-lahu huwa l-waliyu wahuwa yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Or have they taken protectors (or allies) besides Him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent. Or have they taken protecting friends besides Him? But Allah – He Alone is the protector. And He Who gives life to the dead, and He is Able to do all things (42:9). And in whatsoever you differ, the decision thereof is with Allah. Such is Allah, my Lord in Whom I put my trust, and to Him I turn in repentance (42:10). The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you mates from…

item.title: Ash-Shura:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ فَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa fal-lahu huwa l-waliyu wahuwa yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Or have they taken besides Him, guardians? But God, He is the Guardian, and He giveth life unto the dead, and He is, over all things powerful. See 42:7

item.title: Ash-Shura:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِیْهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ wamā ikh'talaftum fīhi min shayin faḥuk'muhu ilā l-lahi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbī ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību Whatever thing you may differ about, its judgement is with Allah. That is Allah, my Lord. In Him I have put my trust, and to Him I turn penitently.

item.title: Ash-Shura:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِیْهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ wamā ikh'talaftum fīhi min shayin faḥuk'muhu ilā l-lahi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbī ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is (to be referred) to Allah. (Say), "That is Allah, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."1 See 42:9

item.title: Ash-Shura:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِیْهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ wamā ikh'talaftum fīhi min shayin faḥuk'muhu ilā l-lahi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbī ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību And in whatever thing ye differ, (See verses 3:153, 4:65, 4:159 & 33:36.) its decision is unto God; (for) that is your God my Lord, on Him rely I, and unto Him (alone) do I (always) turn. From this verse to verse 21 the idea is to prove that God Who is the Absolute Authority with no rival or match to Him in the realm of creation, is the Absolute Authority in the realm of legislation and sovereignty of the entire universe represented on the earth by a chain of accomplished apostles and their successors; who were ordered to preach one and the same faith, the unity of the religion…

item.title: Ash-Shura:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاطِرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ أَزْوَاجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِیْهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ fāṭiru l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wamina l-anʿāmi azwājan yadhra-ukum fīhi laysa kamith'lihi shayon wahuwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru The originator of the heavens and the earth, He made for you mates from your own selves, and mates of the cattle, by which means He multiplies you. Nothing is like Him,1 and He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing.

item.title: Ash-Shura:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاطِرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ أَزْوَاجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِیْهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ fāṭiru l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wamina l-anʿāmi azwājan yadhra-ukum fīhi laysa kamith'lihi shayon wahuwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru (He is) Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him,1 and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.2 See 42:9

item.title: Ash-Shura:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاطِرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ أَزْوَاجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِیْهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ fāṭiru l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wamina l-anʿāmi azwājan yadhra-ukum fīhi laysa kamith'lihi shayon wahuwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru The Originator of the heavens and the earth; He made for you from among your (own) selves pairs, and of the cattle (too) pairs, thereby He multiplieth you; Nothing whatsoever (is there) like the like (Incomparable.) of Him; and He (alone) is the All-Hearing and the All-Seeing. See 42:10

item.title: Ash-Shura:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth: He expands the provision for whomever He wishes, and tightens it [for whomever He wishes]. Indeed He has knowledge of all things.'

item.title: Ash-Shura:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts (it). Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing. See 42:9

item.title: Ash-Shura:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun His are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; amplifieth He the sustenance unto whomsoever He willeth and straiteneth; (It unto whomsoever He willeth.) Verily He knoweth all things. See 42:10

item.title: Ash-Shura:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّى بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی وَعِيسٰی أَنْ أَقِيمُوْۤا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِیْهِ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُنِيبُ sharaʿa lakum mina l-dīni mā waṣṣā bihi nūḥan wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihi ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā an aqīmū l-dīna walā tatafarraqū fīhi kabura ʿalā l-mush'rikīna mā tadʿūhum ilayhi l-lahu yajtabī ilayhi man yashāu wayahdī ilayhi man yunību He has prescribed for you the religion which He had enjoined upon Noah and which We have [also] revealed to you, and which We had enjoined upon Abraham, Moses and Jesus, declaring, 'Maintain the religion, and do not be divided in it.' Hard on the polytheists is that to which you summon them. Allah chooses for it1 whomever He wishes and He guides to…

item.title: Ash-Shura:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّى بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی وَعِيسٰی أَنْ أَقِيمُوْۤا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِیْهِ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُنِيبُ sharaʿa lakum mina l-dīni mā waṣṣā bihi nūḥan wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihi ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā an aqīmū l-dīna walā tatafarraqū fīhi kabura ʿalā l-mush'rikīna mā tadʿūhum ilayhi l-lahu yajtabī ilayhi man yashāu wayahdī ilayhi man yunību He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Nuh and that which We have revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), and what We enjoined upon Ibrahim and Musa and Isa - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills…

item.title: Ash-Shura:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّى بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی وَعِيسٰی أَنْ أَقِيمُوْۤا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِیْهِ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُنِيبُ sharaʿa lakum mina l-dīni mā waṣṣā bihi nūḥan wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihi ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā an aqīmū l-dīna walā tatafarraqū fīhi kabura ʿalā l-mush'rikīna mā tadʿūhum ilayhi l-lahu yajtabī ilayhi man yashāu wayahdī ilayhi man yunību He hath prescribed for you the religion (Refer to verse 5:3.) what He ordained unto Noah and that which revealed We unto thee and what ordained We unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, that: "Establish (Refer to note on verse 5:3.) ye the religion and be ye not divided therein;" Hard is it to the disbelievers what thou callest them unto; God chooseth unto…

item.title: Ash-Shura:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُورِثُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ wamā tafarraqū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ilā ajalin musamman laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna alladhīna ūrithū l-kitāba min baʿdihim lafī shakkin min'hu murībin They did not divide [into sects] except after the knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves; and were it not for a prior decree of your Lord [granting them reprieve] until a specified time, decision would have been made between them. Indeed those who were made heirs to the Book after them are surely in grave doubt concerning it.

item.title: Ash-Shura:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُورِثُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ wamā tafarraqū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ilā ajalin musamman laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna alladhīna ūrithū l-kitāba min baʿdihim lafī shakkin min'hu murībin And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word1 that preceded from your Lord (postponing the penalty) until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt. See 42:13

item.title: Ash-Shura:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُورِثُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ wamā tafarraqū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ilā ajalin musamman laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna alladhīna ūrithū l-kitāba min baʿdihim lafī shakkin min'hu murībin Nor were they divided until after had come unto them the knowledge, out of rivalry between themselves; and had not the word gone forth from thy Lord (respiting them) to a fixed time, certainly, the affair had been decided between them; and verily, those who were made the heirs (Refer to verse 42:13. The posterity of the prophets.) to the Book after them are certainly in disquieting (The Jews and the Christians who are in doubt about the unity of…

item.title: Ash-Shura:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادْعُ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَقُلْ ءَامَنْتُ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ falidhālika fa-ud'ʿu wa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta walā tattabiʿ ahwāahum waqul āmantu bimā anzala l-lahu min kitābin wa-umir'tu li-aʿdila baynakumu l-lahu rabbunā warabbukum lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum lā ḥujjata baynanā wabaynakumu l-lahu yajmaʿu baynanā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru So summon to this [unity of religion], and be steadfast, just as you have been commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say, 'I believe in whatever Book Allah has sent down. I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. Our deeds belong to us and your deeds belong to you. There is no argument between us and you. Allah will bring us…

item.title: Ash-Shura:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادْعُ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَقُلْ ءَامَنْتُ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ falidhālika fa-ud'ʿu wa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta walā tattabiʿ ahwāahum waqul āmantu bimā anzala l-lahu min kitābin wa-umir'tu li-aʿdila baynakumu l-lahu rabbunā warabbukum lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum lā ḥujjata baynanā wabaynakumu l-lahu yajmaʿu baynanā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru So to that (religion of Allah) invite, (O Muḥammad),1 and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allah has revealed of scripture (i.e., the Qur’ān), and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds.2 There is no (need for)…

item.title: Ash-Shura:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادْعُ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَقُلْ ءَامَنْتُ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ falidhālika fa-ud'ʿu wa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta walā tattabiʿ ahwāahum waqul āmantu bimā anzala l-lahu min kitābin wa-umir'tu li-aʿdila baynakumu l-lahu rabbunā warabbukum lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum lā ḥujjata baynanā wabaynakumu l-lahu yajmaʿu baynanā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru For this then invite on thou (unto the truth) and be thou steadfast (To stand firmly.) (on the right way) as thou art commanded; and follow thou not their vain desires, and say thou (The address for information of the people.) (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "Believe I in what God hath sent down of the Book; and I have been commanded to do justice between you; God is our Lord and your…

item.title: Ash-Shura:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ wa-alladhīna yuḥājjūna fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā us'tujība lahu ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabun walahum ʿadhābun shadīdun Those who argue concerning Allah, after His call has been answered, their argument stands refuted with their Lord, and upon them shall be [His] wrath, and there is a severe punishment for them.

item.title: Ash-Shura:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ wa-alladhīna yuḥājjūna fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā us'tujība lahu ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabun walahum ʿadhābun shadīdun And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to1 - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is (His) wrath, and for them is a severe punishment. And those who dispute concerning Allah, after it has been accepted, of no use is their dispute before their Lord and on them is wrath, and for them will be a severe torment (42:16). It is Allah Who has sent down the Book in truth, and the Balance. And what can make you know that perhaps the Hour is close at hand (42:17). Those who believe not therein seek to hasten…

item.title: Ash-Shura:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ wa-alladhīna yuḥājjūna fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā us'tujība lahu ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabun walahum ʿadhābun shadīdun And those who dispute about God after (Compare to disputing or violating - after entering into the Covenant of Ghadir Khumm.) response made unto Him, their argument is vain unto their Lord, and upon them is the wrath, and for them is a severe chastisement. The people who were given scriptures before, used to wait for the advent of the promised Prophet of God and used also to keep their public informed of the awaited one but when he actually arrived, out of their arrogance and their lust for their sinful life and for their own leadership, disbelieved in him.

item.title: Ash-Shura:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ al-lahu alladhī anzala l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi wal-mīzāna wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata qarībun It is Allah who has sent down the Book with the truth and [He has sent down] the Balance. What do you know —maybe the Hour is near!

item.title: Ash-Shura:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ al-lahu alladhī anzala l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi wal-mīzāna wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata qarībun It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and (also) the balance (i.e., justice). And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near. See 42:16

item.title: Ash-Shura:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ al-lahu alladhī anzala l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi wal-mīzāna wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata qarībun God is He Who sent down the Book with truth and the Balance, and what dost thou know? happly the Hour (of Reckoning) be nigh The Book (the Holy Qur'an) sent down to mankind from God does not contain mere philosophy or mere ideals of life but strictly regulated laws for men to practice and for the regulation of justice on earth. A Balance is the means through which the values are enquired and determined. It is said that here the Balance is the divine personality of the Holy Prophet which manifested the various attributes of God and which presented the best model or the standard of faith and its practice and after him his kith and kin…

item.title: Ash-Shura:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ أَلَا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ yastaʿjilu bihā alladhīna lā yu'minūna bihā wa-alladhīna āmanū mush'fiqūna min'hā wayaʿlamūna annahā l-ḥaqu alā inna alladhīna yumārūna fī l-sāʿati lafī ḍalālin baʿīdin Those who do not believe in it ask [you] to hasten it, but those who have faith are apprehensive of it, and know that it is true. Look! Indeed those who are in doubt about the Hour1 are surely in extreme error!

item.title: Ash-Shura:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ أَلَا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ yastaʿjilu bihā alladhīna lā yu'minūna bihā wa-alladhīna āmanū mush'fiqūna min'hā wayaʿlamūna annahā l-ḥaqu alā inna alladhīna yumārūna fī l-sāʿati lafī ḍalālin baʿīdin Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it,1 but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error. See 42:16

item.title: Ash-Shura:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ أَلَا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ yastaʿjilu bihā alladhīna lā yu'minūna bihā wa-alladhīna āmanū mush'fiqūna min'hā wayaʿlamūna annahā l-ḥaqu alā inna alladhīna yumārūna fī l-sāʿati lafī ḍalālin baʿīdin Hasten it on (in challenge) they who believe not in it, and those who believe are afraid of it, and know they that it is the truth; Beware! Verily those who dispute about the Hour (of Reckoning) are far astray. Refer to verse 13:6. Not believing in the Day of Judgment, the disbelievers in their arrogance openly say: "If it has to come let it come" whereas those who believe know that it is a truth and hold it in awe. The disbelievers shall one day come to know how far they had strayed from the…

item.title: Ash-Shura:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ al-lahu laṭīfun biʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashāu wahuwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu Allah is all-attentive to His servants. He provides for whomever He wishes, and He is the All-strong, the All-mighty.

item.title: Ash-Shura:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ al-lahu laṭīfun biʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashāu wahuwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu Allah is Subtle1 with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might. Allah is very Gracious and Kind to His servants. He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the Almighty (42:19). Whosoever desires the reward of the Hereafter, We give him increase in his reward, and whosoever desires the reward of this world, We give him thereof, and he has no portion in the Hereafter (42:20). Or have they partners with Allah who have instituted for them a religion which Allah has not ordained? And had it not been for a decisive Word, the matter would have been judged between them. And verily, for the wrongdoers there…

item.title: Ash-Shura:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ al-lahu laṭīfun biʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashāu wahuwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu God is Benign unto His servants; Provideth He sustenance to whomsoever He willeth; and He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty. See 42:18

item.title: Ash-Shura:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْاٰخِرَةُ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِي حَرْثِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ مِنْ نَصِيبٍ man kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-ākhirati nazid lahu fī ḥarthihi waman kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-dun'yā nu'tihi min'hā wamā lahu fī l-ākhirati min naṣībin Whoever desires the tillage of the Hereafter, We will enhance for him his tillage, and whoever desires the tillage of the world, We will give it to him, but he will have no share in the Hereafter.

item.title: Ash-Shura:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْاٰخِرَةُ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِي حَرْثِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ مِنْ نَصِيبٍ man kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-ākhirati nazid lahu fī ḥarthihi waman kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-dun'yā nu'tihi min'hā wamā lahu fī l-ākhirati min naṣībin Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest (i.e., reward). And whoever desires the harvest (i.e., benefits) of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share. See 42:19

item.title: Ash-Shura:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
