item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْاٰخِرَةُ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِي حَرْثِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ مِنْ نَصِيبٍ man kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-ākhirati nazid lahu fī ḥarthihi waman kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-dun'yā nu'tihi min'hā wamā lahu fī l-ākhirati min naṣībin Whosoever intendeth the tilth (The life in the hereafter is compared to tilth – As one would sow here so will he reap there. This life as a whole is a sowing season given to every man & woman.) of the hereafter, We increase for him in his tilth; whosoever intended the tilth of this world, We give him of (A little.) it, and for him in the hereafter shall not be any share. It is said that those who had joined the battles to earn the reward in the life hereafter, shall have the material…

item.title: Ash-Shura:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنْ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ am lahum shurakāu sharaʿū lahum mina l-dīni mā lam yadhan bihi l-lahu walawlā kalimatu l-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīmun Do they have partners [besides Allah] who have ordained for them a religion which has not been permitted by Allah? Had it not been for the conclusive word,1 decision would have been made between them. For the wrongdoers there is indeed a painful punishment.

item.title: Ash-Shura:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنْ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ am lahum shurakāu sharaʿū lahum mina l-dīni mā lam yadhan bihi l-lahu walawlā kalimatu l-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīmun Or have they partners (i.e., other deities) who have ordained for them a religion to which Allah has not consented? But if not for the decisive word,1 it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment. See 42:19

item.title: Ash-Shura:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنْ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ am lahum shurakāu sharaʿū lahum mina l-dīni mā lam yadhan bihi l-lahu walawlā kalimatu l-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīmun Or for them are any partners (of God) who have prescribed for them any religion which God doth not sanction? And had it not been for the word of decision (to wait until the Day of Reckoning), the decision would certainly have been made between them; and verily the unjust, for them shall be a painful chastisement. If the decree of the Lord had not been passed for a respite to the disbelievers, they would have a painful chastisement.

item.title: Ash-Shura:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْۤا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ tarā l-ẓālimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā kasabū wahuwa wāqiʿun bihim wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī rawḍāti l-janāti lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru You will see the wrongdoers apprehensive because of what they have earned, while it is about to befall them; but those who have faith and do righteous deeds will be in the gardens of paradise: they will have whatever they wish near their Lord. That is the greatest grace.

item.title: Ash-Shura:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْۤا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ tarā l-ẓālimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā kasabū wahuwa wāqiʿun bihim wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī rawḍāti l-janāti lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will (certainly) befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens (in Paradise) having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty. See 42:19

item.title: Ash-Shura:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْۤا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ tarā l-ẓālimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā kasabū wahuwa wāqiʿun bihim wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī rawḍāti l-janāti lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru (On that Day) thou wilt see the unjust alarmed for what they have earned, and (the chastisement for) it shall befall them; And those who believe and do good deeds shall be in the meadows of the Garden (of Paradise); For them shall be whatever they please with their Lord; that is the greatest grace. See 42:21

item.title: Ash-Shura:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ الَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ قُلْ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبٰی وَمَنْ يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَزِدْ لَهُ فِيهَا حُسْنًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ dhālika alladhī yubashiru l-lahu ʿibādahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti qul lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran illā l-mawadata fī l-qur'bā waman yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahu fīhā ḥus'nan inna l-laha ghafūrun shakūrun That is the good news Allah gives to His servants who have faith and do righteous deeds! Say, 'I do not ask you any reward for it except love of [my] relatives.' Whoever performs a good deed, We shall enhance for him its goodness. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-appreciative.

item.title: Ash-Shura:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ الَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ قُلْ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبٰی وَمَنْ يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَزِدْ لَهُ فِيهَا حُسْنًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ dhālika alladhī yubashiru l-lahu ʿibādahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti qul lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran illā l-mawadata fī l-qur'bā waman yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahu fīhā ḥus'nan inna l-laha ghafūrun shakūrun It is that of which Allah gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, (O Muḥammad), "I do not ask you for it (i.e., this message) any payment (but) only good will through (i.e., due to) kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative.1 That is whereof Allah gives glad tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous good deeds. Say: "No reward…

item.title: Ash-Shura:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ الَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ قُلْ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبٰی وَمَنْ يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَزِدْ لَهُ فِيهَا حُسْنًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ dhālika alladhī yubashiru l-lahu ʿibādahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti qul lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran illā l-mawadata fī l-qur'bā waman yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahu fīhā ḥus'nan inna l-laha ghafūrun shakūrun That is of which giveth God the glad tidings unto His servants who believe and do good deeds; Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "I demand not of you (the only believers - Refer to note on verse 25:57.) any recompense for it (the toils of the apostleship) save the love of (my) relatives; (The holy Ahl Al-Bayt, if one loves the holy ones, he will follow them for by following the divines only, man will get himself divined and reach the…

item.title: Ash-Shura:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَإِنْ يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَى قَلْبِكَ وَيَمْحُ اللَّهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ am yaqūlūna if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fa-in yasha-i l-lahu yakhtim ʿalā qalbika wayamḥu l-lahu l-bāṭila wayuḥiqqu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Do they say, 'He has fabricated a lie against Allah'? If so, should Allah wish He would set a seal on your heart, and Allah will efface the falsehood and confirm the truth with His words. Indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: Ash-Shura:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَإِنْ يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَى قَلْبِكَ وَيَمْحُ اللَّهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ am yaqūlūna if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fa-in yasha-i l-lahu yakhtim ʿalā qalbika wayamḥu l-lahu l-bāṭila wayuḥiqqu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Or do they say, "He has invented about Allah a lie"? But if Allah willed, He could seal over your heart.1 And Allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 42:23

item.title: Ash-Shura:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَإِنْ يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَى قَلْبِكَ وَيَمْحُ اللَّهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ am yaqūlūna if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fa-in yasha-i l-lahu yakhtim ʿalā qalbika wayamḥu l-lahu l-bāṭila wayuḥiqqu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Or do they say: "He hath forged a lie against God?" But if God hath willed, He would have sealed thy heart (and quiet thee) and (yet) He would blot out the falsehood and prove (Confirm.) the truth with His words; Verily He knoweth best whatever is in the breasts (hearts) If God only wills it, He could cause the Holy Prophet to be quiet and He could Himself wipe out the falsehood.

item.title: Ash-Shura:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yaqbalu l-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wayaʿfū ʿani l-sayiāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna It is He who accepts the repentance of His servants, and excuses their misdeeds and knows what you do.

item.title: Ash-Shura:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yaqbalu l-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wayaʿfū ʿani l-sayiāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do. And He it is Who accepts repentance from His servants, and forgives sins, and He knows what you do (42:25). And He answers those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and gives them increase of His bounty. And as for the disbelievers, theirs will be a severe torment (42:26). And if Allah were to extend the provision for His servants, they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sends down by measure as He wills. Verily, He is, in respect of His servants, the Well-Aware, the All-Seer (42:27). And He it is Who sends down…

item.title: Ash-Shura:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ wahuwa alladhī yaqbalu l-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wayaʿfū ʿani l-sayiāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna He it is Who accepteth repentance from His servants, and forgiveth the sins, and knoweth He whatever ye do, Note the encouragement the sinners in Islam are offered not towards unconditional redemption saying just believe in any one as the son of God who has paid the price of the sins of the world and you are saved, but assuring of the repentance from sinning, being accepted and pardon granted so that a sinner need not be dejected and get hopeless of his being pardoned and thus go on sinning and not amending his conduct. This verse is another assurance that God is He Who is not interested in only punishing His offenders but more than…

item.title: Ash-Shura:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَالْكَافِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ wayastajību alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum min faḍlihi wal-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun And He answers those who have faith and do righteous deeds and enhances them out of His grace. But as for the faithless, there is a severe punishment for them.

item.title: Ash-Shura:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَالْكَافِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ wayastajību alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum min faḍlihi wal-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun And He answers (the supplication of) those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases (for) them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment. See 42:25

item.title: Ash-Shura:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَالْكَافِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ wayastajību alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum min faḍlihi wal-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun And He respondeth to those who believe and do good deeds, and increaseth unto them of His grace; And the disbelievers, for them shall be a severe chastisement. To those who amend their character and conduct and do good deeds, and never go near evil, there is the encouragement through the promise of not only the reward of an equal value but more than that, through the infinite mercy and the grace of the All-Merciful Lord.

item.title: Ash-Shura:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ walaw basaṭa l-lahu l-riz'qa liʿibādihi labaghaw fī l-arḍi walākin yunazzilu biqadarin mā yashāu innahu biʿibādihi khabīrun baṣīrun Were Allah to expand the provision for His servants, they would surely create havoc on the earth. But He sends down in a [precise] measure whatever He wishes. Indeed He is all-aware, all-seeing about His servants.

item.title: Ash-Shura:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ walaw basaṭa l-lahu l-riz'qa liʿibādihi labaghaw fī l-arḍi walākin yunazzilu biqadarin mā yashāu innahu biʿibādihi khabīrun baṣīrun And if Allah had extended (excessively) provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends (it) down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing. See 42:25

item.title: Ash-Shura:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ walaw basaṭa l-lahu l-riz'qa liʿibādihi labaghaw fī l-arḍi walākin yunazzilu biqadarin mā yashāu innahu biʿibādihi khabīrun baṣīrun And should God amplify the sustenance unto His servants, they would certainly rebel in the earth, but He sendeth it down by measure as He willeth; Verily of His servants, He is All-Aware, All-Seeing. It is the every day experience of the world since the advent of mankind in it, that it is only the rich and the wealthy ones and those endowed with power and authority that revolted against God. Hence it is more a warning to those entrusted with wealth and power to be careful against getting astray, 'As He pleases' meaning, as one pleases Him by one's goodness and entitles one's self to…

item.title: Ash-Shura:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْۤا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ wahuwa alladhī yunazzilu l-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭū wayanshuru raḥmatahu wahuwa l-waliyu l-ḥamīdu It is He who sends down the rain after they have been despondent, and unfolds His mercy, and He is the Guardian, the All-laudable.

item.title: Ash-Shura:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْۤا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ wahuwa alladhī yunazzilu l-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭū wayanshuru raḥmatahu wahuwa l-waliyu l-ḥamīdu And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy. See 42:25

item.title: Ash-Shura:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْۤا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ wahuwa alladhī yunazzilu l-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭū wayanshuru raḥmatahu wahuwa l-waliyu l-ḥamīdu He it is Who sendeth down the rain after what they have despaired, and spreadeth His Mercy; And He is the (Greatest) Guardian, the (Most) Praised One. God's mercy, grace and bounties come to His creation beyond all calculations of human intellect.

item.title: Ash-Shura:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā batha fīhimā min dābbatin wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim idhā yashāu qadīrun Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and whatever creatures He has scattered in them, and He is able to gather them whenever He wishes.

item.title: Ash-Shura:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā batha fīhimā min dābbatin wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim idhā yashāu qadīrun And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent. And among His Ayat is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and whatever moving creatures He has dispersed in them both. And He is Able to assemble them whenever He wills (42:29). And whatever of misfortune befalls you, it is because of what your hands have earned. And He pardons much (42:30). And you cannot escape from Allah in the earth, and besides Allah you have neither any protector nor any helper (42:31). Among the…

item.title: Ash-Shura:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā batha fīhimā min dābbatin wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim idhā yashāu qadīrun And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and (the creation of) what He hath spread out in both of them of the animate beings and for their gathering together when He willeth, He is All-Powerful. See 42:28

item.title: Ash-Shura:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ wamā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aydīkum wayaʿfū ʿan kathīrin Whatever affliction that may visit you is because of what your hands have earned, and He excuses many [an offense].

item.title: Ash-Shura:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ wamā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aydīkum wayaʿfū ʿan kathīrin And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much. See 42:29

item.title: Ash-Shura:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ wamā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aydīkum wayaʿfū ʿan kathīrin And whatever befalleth you of a misfortune, it is what your (own) hands have wrought, and (yet) He pardoneth the most of your sins. This refers only to what befalls the sinners as the natural consequence of their own doings. This does not refer to the calamities and the miseries which the apostles and the Imams and the other holy ones meet at the hands of the people while discharging their sacred duties in the world.

item.title: Ash-Shura:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīrin You cannot thwart [Allah] on the earth, and you do not have besides Allah any guardian or helper.

item.title: Ash-Shura:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīrin And you will not cause failure (to Allah)1 upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper. See 42:29

item.title: Ash-Shura:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīrin Ye can not frustrate (God's) will in the earth, and for you (there) is none other than God, Guardian or a Helper. Pardon or punishment to man or to any being, can come only from God and from none else and when it comes, it comes in any measure or without any restriction and none can defeat God in executing His will. This sura is Makki but these four verses are Madani, i.e., revealed at Madina when Hasan and Husayn were born. This fact is proved by the great number of 'Riwayat' detailed narratives from the most reliable authorities on the Islamic history. Even if these verses also are imagined to be…

item.title: Ash-Shura:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ wamin āyātihi l-jawāri fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlāmi Among His signs are the ships [that run] on the sea [appearing] like landmarks.

item.title: Ash-Shura:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ wamin āyātihi l-jawāri fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlāmi And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains. And among His signs are the ships in the sea like mountains (42:32). If He wills, He causes the wind to cease, then they would become motionless on the surface (of the sea). Verily, in this are signs for everyone patient and grateful (42:33). Or He may destroy them because of that which their (people) have earned. And He pardons much (42:34). And those who dispute as regards Our Ayat may know that there is no place of refuge for them (42:35). Ships are Also among the Signs of Allah Allah tells us that another sign of His great power and dominion is the fact that He has subjugated the sea so that ships may sail…

item.title: Ash-Shura:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ wamin āyātihi l-jawāri fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlāmi And among His signs are the ships in the sea like mountains. Those who can reflect upon the working of the forces of nature in the world, and how much man depends upon God's mercy, can easily appreciate the example given in these verses, for it is one of the most can easily appreciate the example given in these verses, for it is one of the obvious instances of man's helplessness that one experiences in deep waters and in the midst of the high seas when a ship sails safe amidst the mountainlike waves and through the stormy gales and how helplessly it depends upon the favourable winds and tides.

item.title: Ash-Shura:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ in yasha yus'kini l-rīḥa fayaẓlalna rawākida ʿalā ẓahrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin If He wishes He stills the wind, whereat they remain standstill on its surface. There are indeed signs in that for every patient and grateful [servant].

item.title: Ash-Shura:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ in yasha yus'kini l-rīḥa fayaẓlalna rawākida ʿalā ẓahrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful. See 42:32

item.title: Ash-Shura:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ in yasha yus'kini l-rīḥa fayaẓlalna rawākida ʿalā ẓahrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin If He willeth, He lulleth the wind that they (the ships) lie motionless on the back of it (the sea); Verily in this are signs for every steadfast grateful one, See 42:32

item.title: Ash-Shura:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَيَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ aw yūbiq'hunna bimā kasabū wayaʿfu ʿan kathīrin Or He wrecks them because of what they have earned, and He excuses many [an offense].

item.title: Ash-Shura:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَيَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ aw yūbiq'hunna bimā kasabū wayaʿfu ʿan kathīrin Or He could destroy them1 for what they earned; but He pardons much. See 42:32

item.title: Ash-Shura:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَيَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ aw yūbiq'hunna bimā kasabū wayaʿfu ʿan kathīrin Or He may cause them to perish (To sink.) for what they have wrought, and (yet) He pardoneth the most, See 42:32

item.title: Ash-Shura:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ wayaʿlama alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātinā mā lahum min maḥīṣin Let those who dispute Our signs know that there is no escape for them.

item.title: Ash-Shura:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ wayaʿlama alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātinā mā lahum min maḥīṣin And (that is so) those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape. See 42:32

item.title: Ash-Shura:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ wayaʿlama alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātinā mā lahum min maḥīṣin And (that) may know those who dispute about Our signs; For them (there) is no refuge. See 42:32

item.title: Ash-Shura:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ famā ūtītum min shayin famatāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamā ʿinda l-lahi khayrun wa-abqā lilladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna Whatever you have been given are the wares of the life of this world, but what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have faith and who put their trust in their Lord.

item.title: Ash-Shura:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ famā ūtītum min shayin famatāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamā ʿinda l-lahi khayrun wa-abqā lilladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna So whatever thing you have been given - it is but (for) enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely. So whatever you have been given is but (a passing) enjoyment for this worldly life, but that which is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord (42:36). And those who shun the greater sins, and Al-Fawahish, and when they are angry, they forgive (42:37). And those who answer the Call of their Lord, and perform the Salah, and…

item.title: Ash-Shura:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ famā ūtītum min shayin famatāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamā ʿinda l-lahi khayrun wa-abqā lilladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna And whatever ye are given (here) is but a provision for the life of this world, and what is with God is better and more lasting for those who believe and on their Lord they rely; See 42:32

item.title: Ash-Shura:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْۤا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ wa-alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha wa-idhā mā ghaḍibū hum yaghfirūna —Those who avoid major sins and indecencies, and forgive when angered;

item.title: Ash-Shura:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْۤا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ wa-alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha wa-idhā mā ghaḍibū hum yaghfirūna And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive. See 42:36

item.title: Ash-Shura:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْۤا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ wa-alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha wa-idhā mā ghaḍibū hum yaghfirūna And those who shun the great sins and filthiness, and when they are angry, they forgive; 'Kaba'ir' - Greater or Graver sins viz. Polytheism, Adultery, Drunkenness, Theft etc. The Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn Ali Al-Baqir says that one who, with the power, authority and means to retaliate, still suppresses his own anger against any one - on the Day of Judgment God would fill his heart with peace and security and he will be safe from the Hell-fire.

item.title: Ash-Shura:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورٰی بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ wa-alladhīna is'tajābū lirabbihim wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-amruhum shūrā baynahum wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna those who answer their Lord, maintain the prayer, and their affairs are by counsel among themselves, and they spend out of what We have provided them with;

item.title: Ash-Shura:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورٰی بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ wa-alladhīna is'tajābū lirabbihim wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-amruhum shūrā baynahum wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is (determined by) consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend. See 42:36

item.title: Ash-Shura:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورٰی بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ wa-alladhīna is'tajābū lirabbihim wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-amruhum shūrā baynahum wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna And those who respond to their Lord, and establish prayer, and (conduct) their (Note mutual consultation commended only in the people's own private affairs and not in the affairs of the public and not of the nation as a whole.) affairs with counsel among themselves, what We have provided them with their sustenance they spend, This verse refers to the good-hearted Muslims who while under persecution from the heartless pagans of Mecca, prior to the 'Hijrat', i.e., the emigration to Madina, used to act after consulting each other. The people had assembled in the house of Abu Ayub Ansari and had discussed about their receiving the Holy Prophet on his 'Hijrat', (i.e., emigration from Mecca) - God praises…

item.title: Ash-Shura:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ wa-alladhīna idhā aṣābahumu l-baghyu hum yantaṣirūna those who, when visited by aggression, come to each other's aid.

item.title: Ash-Shura:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ wa-alladhīna idhā aṣābahumu l-baghyu hum yantaṣirūna And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate (in a just manner).1 See 42:36

item.title: Ash-Shura:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ wa-alladhīna idhā aṣābahumu l-baghyu hum yantaṣirūna And (those) who when afflicteth them any great wrong, they get helped by themselves. There are two kinds of people among the believers: Those who overlook and forgive the excesses and aggression against them and the others who take the revenge for the wrongs done to them. The command is that the revenge should never exceed the limits of the wrong done and under no circumstances the retaliation should cross the extent of the offence, and, if any wrong is forgiven and pardoned, it has its own reward with God - for the compensation for it, God has taken it on Himself, which means the reward would be extraordinarily great. The critics of Islam may note the control that Islam imposes even on those who suffer wrongs, i.e.,…

item.title: Ash-Shura:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَزَؤُا سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِثْلُهَا فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ wajazāu sayyi-atin sayyi-atun mith'luhā faman ʿafā wa-aṣlaḥa fa-ajruhu ʿalā l-lahi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīna The requital of evil is an evil like it. So whoever excuses and conciliates, his reward lies with Allah. Indeed He does not like the wrongdoers.

item.title: Ash-Shura:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَزَؤُا سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِثْلُهَا فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ wajazāu sayyi-atin sayyi-atun mith'luhā faman ʿafā wa-aṣlaḥa fa-ajruhu ʿalā l-lahi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīna And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is (due) from Allah. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers. The recompense for an evil is an evil like thereof; but whoever forgives and makes reconciliation, his reward is with Allah. Verily, He likes not the wrongdoers (42:40). And indeed whosoever takes revenge after he has suffered wrong, for such there is no way (of blame) against them (42:41). The way is only against those who oppress men and rebel in the earth without justification; for such there will be a painful torment (42:42). And verily, whosoever shows patience and…

item.title: Ash-Shura:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَزَؤُا سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِثْلُهَا فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ wajazāu sayyi-atin sayyi-atun mith'luhā faman ʿafā wa-aṣlaḥa fa-ajruhu ʿalā l-lahi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīna And the recompense for an evil shall be an ill-return like unto it, but (if) one pardoneth and amendeth, his reward is incumbent on God; Verily He loveth not the unjust. See 42:39

item.title: Ash-Shura:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَنِ انْتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ walamani intaṣara baʿda ẓul'mihi fa-ulāika mā ʿalayhim min sabīlin As for those who retaliate after being wronged, there is no blame upon them.

item.title: Ash-Shura:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَنِ انْتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ walamani intaṣara baʿda ẓul'mihi fa-ulāika mā ʿalayhim min sabīlin And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause (for blame). See 42:40

item.title: Ash-Shura:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَنِ انْتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ walamani intaṣara baʿda ẓul'mihi fa-ulāika mā ʿalayhim min sabīlin And whosoever defendeth himself (in avenging) after being oppressed, then against these there is no way (to blame) See 42:39

item.title: Ash-Shura:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ innamā l-sabīlu ʿalā alladhīna yaẓlimūna l-nāsa wayabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun The blame lies only upon those who wrong the people and commit aggression in the land unduly. For such there is a painful punishment.

item.title: Ash-Shura:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ innamā l-sabīlu ʿalā alladhīna yaẓlimūna l-nāsa wayabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment. See 42:40

item.title: Ash-Shura:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ innamā l-sabīlu ʿalā alladhīna yaẓlimūna l-nāsa wayabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun The way (to blame) is against those who do injustice unto the people and transgress (Cross the limits.) in the earth unjustly; these, for them shall be a painful chastisement. Note - Islam's attitude towards unprovoked aggression. None can ever prove that the Holy Prophet, ever in his life-term, conducted or permitted any unprovoked aggression even upon any of his enemy tribes. Every battle fought, was in defence of the faith and the faithful or to frustrate the enemy's plans and plots which were to take the Muslims unawares. This is in case the transgressor being overpowered but by no means the transgressor should be encouraged – as the verse…

item.title: Ash-Shura:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَنْ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ walaman ṣabara waghafara inna dhālika lamin ʿazmi l-umūri As for him who endures patiently and forgives —that is indeed the steadiest of courses.

item.title: Ash-Shura:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَنْ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ walaman ṣabara waghafara inna dhālika lamin ʿazmi l-umūri And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters (worthy) of resolve.1 See 42:40

item.title: Ash-Shura:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَنْ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ walaman ṣabara waghafara inna dhālika lamin ʿazmi l-umūri And indeed whosoever remaineth patient and forgiveth, verily this is an act of great resolution. See 42:42

item.title: Ash-Shura:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَتَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَى مَرَدٍّ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min waliyyin min baʿdihi watarā l-ẓālimīna lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddin min sabīlin Whomever Allah leads astray has no guardian apart from Him. You will see the wrongdoers, when they sight the punishment, saying, 'Is there any way for a retreat?'

item.title: Ash-Shura:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَتَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَى مَرَدٍّ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min waliyyin min baʿdihi watarā l-ẓālimīna lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddin min sabīlin And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return (to the former world) any way?" And whomsoever Allah sends astray, for him there is no protector after Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they behold the torment, they will say: Is there any way of return? (42:44). And you will see them brought forward to it (Hell) made humble by disgrace, (and) looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say: "Verily, the losers are…

item.title: Ash-Shura:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَتَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَى مَرَدٍّ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min waliyyin min baʿdihi watarā l-ẓālimīna lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddin min sabīlin And whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him (there) shall not be any guardian after it; and thou shalt behold the unjust when they see the chastisement, saying: "Is there any way (to help us) to return" See 42:42

item.title: Ash-Shura:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَاهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَاشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنْظُرُونَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُقِيمٍ watarāhum yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna mina l-dhuli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyyin waqāla alladhīna āmanū inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā inna l-ẓālimīna fī ʿadhābin muqīmin You will see them being exposed to it, humbled by abasement, looking askance secretly. And the faithful will say, 'Indeed the losers are those who have ruined themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Look! The wrongdoers are indeed in lasting punishment.

item.title: Ash-Shura:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَاهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَاشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنْظُرُونَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُقِيمٍ watarāhum yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna mina l-dhuli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyyin waqāla alladhīna āmanū inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā inna l-ẓālimīna fī ʿadhābin muqīmin And you will see them being exposed to it (i.e., the Fire), humbled from humiliation, looking from (behind) a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the (true) losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment." See 42:44

item.title: Ash-Shura:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرَاهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَاشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنْظُرُونَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُقِيمٍ watarāhum yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna mina l-dhuli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyyin waqāla alladhīna āmanū inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā inna l-ẓālimīna fī ʿadhābin muqīmin And thou shalt see them brought unto it humbled of disgrace, looking with a stealthy glance; And shall say those who believe: "Verily the losers are those who lost their selves and their people on the Day of Reckoning." Beware! verily the unjust shall be in a lasting chastisement. See 42:42

item.title: Ash-Shura:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يَنْصُرُونَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ wamā kāna lahum min awliyāa yanṣurūnahum min dūni l-lahi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min sabīlin They have no guardians to help them besides Allah. Whomever Allah leads astray has no way out.'

item.title: Ash-Shura:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يَنْصُرُونَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ wamā kāna lahum min awliyāa yanṣurūnahum min dūni l-lahi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min sabīlin And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah. And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way. See 42:44

item.title: Ash-Shura:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يَنْصُرُونَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ wamā kāna lahum min awliyāa yanṣurūnahum min dūni l-lahi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min sabīlin And there shall not be for them any of the guardians to help them besides God; and whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him shall not be any (other) way (way out.) (of being guided aright) See 42:42

item.title: Ash-Shura:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتَجِيبُوا لِرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ مَلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَكِيرٍ is'tajībū lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi mā lakum min malja-in yawma-idhin wamā lakum min nakīrin Answer your Lord before there comes a day for which there is no revoking from Allah. On that day you will have no refuge, neither will you have [any chance for] denial.

item.title: Ash-Shura:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتَجِيبُوا لِرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ مَلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَكِيرٍ is'tajībū lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi mā lakum min malja-in yawma-idhin wamā lakum min nakīrin Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.1 Answer the Call of your Lord before there comes from Allah a Day which cannot be averted. You will have no refuge on that Day nor there will be for you any denying (42:47). But if they turn away, We have not sent you as a Hafiz over them. Your duty is to convey. And verily, when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us, he…

item.title: Ash-Shura:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتَجِيبُوا لِرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ مَلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَكِيرٍ is'tajībū lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi mā lakum min malja-in yawma-idhin wamā lakum min nakīrin Respond ye unto your Lord ere cometh the Day from God for which there is no averting; for you shall not be any refuge on the Day, and nor for you will it be to make any denial. See 42:42

item.title: Ash-Shura:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ وَإِنَّا إِذَا أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ كَفُورٌ fa-in aʿraḍū famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan in ʿalayka illā l-balāghu wa-innā idhā adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim fa-inna l-insāna kafūrun But if they disregard [your warnings], We have not sent you as a keeper over them. Your duty is only to communicate. Indeed when We let man taste Our mercy, he exults in it; but should an ill visit them because of what their hands have sent ahead, then man is indeed very ungrateful.

item.title: Ash-Shura:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ وَإِنَّا إِذَا أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ كَفُورٌ fa-in aʿraḍū famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan in ʿalayka illā l-balāghu wa-innā idhā adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim fa-inna l-insāna kafūrun But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, (O Muḥammad), over them as a guardian; upon you is only (the duty of) notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful. See 42:47

item.title: Ash-Shura:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ وَإِنَّا إِذَا أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ كَفُورٌ fa-in aʿraḍū famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan in ʿalayka illā l-balāghu wa-innā idhā adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim fa-inna l-insāna kafūrun And if they turn away, then We have not sent thee over them as a watcher; On thee is naught but only to convey ('Balaagh' i.e. To deliver – It may be to deliver the message which is only the apostolic duty and it means also taking one to the end, which is the function of 'Vilayat' Refer to verse 3:67 & 33:6 (A.P.).) (Our Word unto mankind); And verily when We make man taste mercy from Us, rejoiceth he thereby, and if afflicteth them any…

item.title: Ash-Shura:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ lillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yakhluqu mā yashāu yahabu liman yashāu ināthan wayahabu liman yashāu l-dhukūra To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wishes; He gives females to whomever He wishes, and gives males to whomever He wishes,

item.title: Ash-Shura:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ lillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yakhluqu mā yashāu yahabu liman yashāu ināthan wayahabu liman yashāu l-dhukūra To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female (children), and He gives to whom He wills males. To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills. He bestows female upon whom He wills, and bestows male upon whom He wills (42:49). Or He bestows both males and females, and He renders barren whom He wills. Verily, He is the All-Knower and is Able (to do all things) (42:50). Allah tells us that He is the Creator, Sovereign and Controller of the heavens and the earth. Whatever he wills…

item.title: Ash-Shura:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ lillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yakhluqu mā yashāu yahabu liman yashāu ināthan wayahabu liman yashāu l-dhukūra God's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; Createth He whatever He willeth; Granteth He unto whomsoever He willeth females (Only daughters.) and granteth He whomsoever He willeth males, (Only sons.) See 42:48

item.title: Ash-Shura:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِيرٌ aw yuzawwijuhum dhuk'rānan wa-ināthan wayajʿalu man yashāu ʿaqīman innahu ʿalīmun qadīrun or He combines them males and females, and makes sterile whomever He wishes. Indeed He is all-knowing, all-powerful.

item.title: Ash-Shura:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِيرٌ aw yuzawwijuhum dhuk'rānan wa-ināthan wayajʿalu man yashāu ʿaqīman innahu ʿalīmun qadīrun Or He makes them (both) males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent. See 42:49

item.title: Ash-Shura:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِيرٌ aw yuzawwijuhum dhuk'rānan wa-ināthan wayajʿalu man yashāu ʿaqīman innahu ʿalīmun qadīrun Or mingleth (grants both sons and also daughters.) them of both males (i.e., sons) and females (i.e., daughters), and maketh whomsoever He willeth barren; Verily He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful. This may hint to the outstanding examples of Abraham being given only males – Ishmael and Isaac and Zaccharias also having only a son, i.e., Yahya.1Imran having only a daughter – Virgin Mary.2 The Holy Prophet having both sons and a daughter, Lady Fatimah - and Ayesha and the other wives of the prophet's being made barren – and Ali and Fatimah getting both sons and daughters. (A.P.)

item.title: Ash-Shura:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wamā kāna libasharin an yukallimahu l-lahu illā waḥyan aw min warāi ḥijābin aw yur'sila rasūlan fayūḥiya bi-idh'nihi mā yashāu innahu ʿaliyyun ḥakīmun It is not [possible] for any human that Allah should speak to him1 except through revelation or from behind a curtain,2 or send a messenger3 who reveals by His permission whatever He wishes. Indeed He is all-exalted, all-wise.

item.title: Ash-Shura:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wamā kāna libasharin an yukallimahu l-lahu illā waḥyan aw min warāi ḥijābin aw yur'sila rasūlan fayūḥiya bi-idh'nihi mā yashāu innahu ʿaliyyun ḥakīmun And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger (i.e., angel) to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise. It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation, or from behind a veil, or (that) He sends a Messenger to reveal what He wills by His leave. Verily, He is Most High, Most Wise (42:51). And thus We have sent…

item.title: Ash-Shura:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wamā kāna libasharin an yukallimahu l-lahu illā waḥyan aw min warāi ḥijābin aw yur'sila rasūlan fayūḥiya bi-idh'nihi mā yashāu innahu ʿaliyyun ḥakīmun And it is not for any man that God should speak unto him save by revelation or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger and to reveal by His permission what He willeth; Verily He is the Most High, the All-Wise. This verse explains the verse 42:4, meaning that even the discourse with Moses was through a medium and not in person, i.e., in the manner mentioned here. (A.P.)

item.title: Ash-Shura:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْاِیْمَانُ وَلَكِنْ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ نَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka rūḥan min amrinā mā kunta tadrī mā l-kitābu walā l-īmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nahdī bihi man nashāu min ʿibādinā wa-innaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Thus have We revealed to you the Spirit of Our dispensation. You did not know what the Book is, nor what is faith; but We made it a light that We may guide by its means whomever We wish of Our servants. And indeed you guide to a straight path,

item.title: Ash-Shura:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْاِیْمَانُ وَلَكِنْ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ نَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka rūḥan min amrinā mā kunta tadrī mā l-kitābu walā l-īmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nahdī bihi man nashāu min ʿibādinā wa-innaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command (i.e., the Qur’ān). You did not know what is the Book or (what is) faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, (O Muḥammad), you guide to a straight path. See 42:51

item.title: Ash-Shura:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْاِیْمَانُ وَلَكِنْ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ نَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka rūḥan min amrinā mā kunta tadrī mā l-kitābu walā l-īmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nahdī bihi man nashāu min ʿibādinā wa-innaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Thus did We reveal (Thus, in the same manner.) unto thee Our guidance by Our command; Thou didst know (Whatever the Holy Prophet possessed was not his own but that which was only gifted by God. Refer to verse 34:50.) not what the Book (Qur'an) was, nor the faith, but We made it a light, guide We thereby whomsoever We will of Our servants; and verily guideth thou unto the Right Path; 'Rooh', i.e., spirit i.e., the Holy Qur'an which is the Spirit of Truth or…

item.title: Ash-Shura:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: صِرَاطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ ṣirāṭi l-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi alā ilā l-lahi taṣīru l-umūru the path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Look! To Allah do all matters return!

item.title: Ash-Shura:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: صِرَاطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ ṣirāṭi l-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi alā ilā l-lahi taṣīru l-umūru The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do (all) matters evolve (i.e., return). See 42:51

item.title: Ash-Shura:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: صِرَاطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ ṣirāṭi l-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi alā ilā l-lahi taṣīru l-umūru The path of God, Whose is whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; Be it known! Unto God (alone) shall be referred all affairs. See 42:52

item.title: At-Taariq:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ wal-samāi wal-ṭāriqi By the sky, by the nightly visitor,

item.title: At-Taariq:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ wal-samāi wal-ṭāriqi By the sky and the knocker. يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ The Day when all the secrets will be examined. Meaning: on the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested. This means that they will be exposed and made manifest. Thus, the secret will be made open and that which is concealed will be well known. It is confirmed in the Two Sahihs on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah SAW said: يُرْفَعُ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ عِنْدَ اسْتِهِ يُقَالُ: هٰذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ Every betrayer will have a flag raised for him behind his back, and it will be said, 'This is the betrayal of so-and-so, the son of so-and-so.' Concerning Allah's statement: فَمَا لَهُ Then he will have no Meaning: man on the Day of Judgement. مِن قُوَّةٍ any power Meaning:…

item.title: At-Taariq:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ wal-samāi wal-ṭāriqi By the heaven and the Nightly Visitant The mention of the Night-visitant is a mystic expression. There are various interpretations of the word 'Tariq'. Some take it to be a particular star, some say it is the Morning Star, some say Sirius, and some take it to be the star in general for the stars shine in the nights, all through the year. 'Tariq' lit. Hammering - figuratively has been used for a visitor at night who knocks at the door by a hammer hanging at it. Furthermore, it has been used for a constant traveller who hammers or tramples the ground at the time. Here as expressed in Verse 3, is used to mean a piercing or shining star. According to a tradition from the Ahl Al-Bayt it refers to a star which traverses all…

item.title: At-Taariq:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ wamā adrāka mā l-ṭāriqu (and what will show you what is the nightly visitor?

item.title: At-Taariq:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ wamā adrāka mā l-ṭāriqu And what can make you know what is the knocker? See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ wamā adrāka mā l-ṭāriqu What will let thee know what the Nightly Visitant is? The query itself suggests the mystic nature of the reference and meaning of it having been kept a secret, and all interpretations being mere conjectures.

item.title: At-Taariq:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ al-najmu l-thāqibu It is the brilliant star):

item.title: At-Taariq:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ al-najmu l-thāqibu It is the piercing star1. See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلنَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ al-najmu l-thāqibu (It is) the Star of piercing radiance See 86:2

item.title: At-Taariq:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ in kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓun there is a guard1 over every soul.

item.title: At-Taariq:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ in kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓun There is no soul but that it has over it a protector. See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ in kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓun There is not a soul is set a Watcher (Refer to: 2:143, 22:78, 16:89, 33:45.) It is only said that it is the star of piercing brightness. It is not said which star - for it is a figurative reference to the great personality. Some commentators take the reference to the First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abu Talib, for he used to get in communion with the Lord in getting himself absorbed in the All-Divine, in his prayers that Salman and the others had more than once taken him even to be dead. Besides, Ali used to get out in the night enquiring about the needs of the poor and the helpless and help them. It is said that even soul has been preserved or guarded or protected…

item.title: At-Taariq:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ falyanẓuri l-insānu mimma khuliqa So let man consider from what he was created.

item.title: At-Taariq:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ falyanẓuri l-insānu mimma khuliqa So let man observe from what he was created. See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ falyanẓuri l-insānu mimma khuliqa Let man then reflect, of what he is created See 86:4

item.title: At-Taariq:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خُلِقَ مِنْ مَاءٍ دَافِقٍ khuliqa min māin dāfiqin He was created from an effusing fluid

item.title: At-Taariq:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خُلِقَ مِنْ مَاءٍ دَافِقٍ khuliqa min māin dāfiqin He was created from a fluid, ejected. See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خُلِقَ مِنْ مَاءٍ دَافِقٍ khuliqa min māin dāfiqin He is created a water (drop) ejected The sperm issued from between the back and the ribs1.

item.title: At-Taariq:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ yakhruju min bayni l-ṣul'bi wal-tarāibi which issues from between the loins and the breast-bones.

item.title: At-Taariq:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ yakhruju min bayni l-ṣul'bi wal-tarāibi Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs. See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ yakhruju min bayni l-ṣul'bi wal-tarāibi Coming forth from between the backbone and the ribs (Refer to: 36:77, 76:2, 80:19.) The stimulant for the discharge of the matter is generated in the brain and is conveyed through the spinal cord, continued with the Medulla Oblongata. The kidneys thus pissing from the back from between the ribs and the hip bones. The ejected water referred to here, with a mention of backbone (the Spinal Cord) and ribs evidently refers to the part which the breast and the spinal cord play a joint role in the process of the meeting of the sperm and the ovum which result in the formation of the embryo. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Taariq:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ عَلَى رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ innahu ʿalā rajʿihi laqādirun Indeed He is able to bring him back [after death],

item.title: At-Taariq:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ عَلَى رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ innahu ʿalā rajʿihi laqādirun Indeed, He (i.e., Allah), to return him (to life), is Able. See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ عَلَى رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ innahu ʿalā rajʿihi laqādirun Verily, He is Well-Able to resurrect him (Man. Refer to: 85:13.) See 85:12, 36:77 - 36:82, particularly 36:81 wherein is given the greatest argument ''What! Is not He who created the heavens and earth, able to create the like of them? Yes, He, is the Creator (of all) the Knower.' He who created the physical body with all its Psychic forces with the wonderful harmony in the working of the various kinds of forces, can bring back the same at His will. God who caused the union of the sperm and the ovum out of which the most complicated form of an organic being comes into evidence, is naturally able to make a higher complicated soul to proceed towards its Maker by undergoing trial after trial to unfold the possibilities endowed in…

item.title: At-Taariq:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ yawma tub'lā l-sarāiru on the day when the secrets are examined,

item.title: At-Taariq:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ yawma tub'lā l-sarāiru The Day when secrets will be put on trial.1 See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ yawma tub'lā l-sarāiru On the day when all things hidden shall be tried When asked what are the secrets that will be disclosed, the Holy Prophet said ''All your deeds good and bad, open and hidden" (MS.)

item.title: At-Taariq:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ famā lahu min quwwatin walā nāṣirin and he shall have neither power nor helper.

item.title: At-Taariq:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ famā lahu min quwwatin walā nāṣirin Then he (i.e., man) will have no power or any helper. See 86:1

item.title: At-Taariq:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ famā lahu min quwwatin walā nāṣirin Then for him shall not be any power, and nor any helper On the Day of Judgment, which will be the day of reality and truth, none shall have any help from anyone else. Everybody for himself. None shall bear the burden of the other1.

item.title: At-Taariq:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ wal-samāi dhāti l-rajʿi By the resurgent sky,1

item.title: At-Taariq:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ wal-samāi dhāti l-rajʿi By the sky which sends back.1 By the sky which gives rain, again and again (86:11). And the earth which splits (86:12). Verily, this is the Word that separates (86:13). And it is not a thing for amusement (86:14). Verily, they are but plotting a plot (86:15). And I am planning a plan (86:16). So, give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while (86:17). Swearing to the Truthfulness of the Qur'an and the Failure of Those Who Oppose it Ibn 'Abbas said, "Ar-raj' means rain." It has also been narrated from him that he said, "It means the clouds that contain rain." He also said: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again. "This means that it rains and then it rains…

item.title: At-Taariq:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ wal-samāi dhāti l-rajʿi By the heaven endued with rotation 'Raj', i.e., return. Here the return of the same action or function again and again in a prescribed order or cycle - the return of the monsoonic functions and their relevant changes in the working of the heavenly bodies and the consequent effects on the earth. Though the Firmament above, is always the same yet the change in its function takes place quietly, secretly, smoothly and regularly without any voice of anyone else in the matter save the will of the Almighty Author of the Universe. The revolving and the change in the activities of the heavenly bodies, goes on constantly and it is ever true to its Centre. It indicates the rotational and revolutionary nature of the heavenly bodies. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Taariq:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ wal-arḍi dhāti l-ṣadʿi by the furrowed earth:

item.title: At-Taariq:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ wal-arḍi dhāti l-ṣadʿi And (by) the earth which splits.1 See 86:11

item.title: At-Taariq:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ wal-arḍi dhāti l-ṣadʿi And by the earth endued splitting (With power or the capacity of recipiency and productivity.) The earth is made amenable to opening itself or yielding to the gushing out of the springs and the sprouting of the vegetation, necessary for every kind of life on earth. Refers to the recipiency and the productivity of the earth. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Taariq:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ innahu laqawlun faṣlun it is indeed a decisive word,

item.title: At-Taariq:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ innahu laqawlun faṣlun Indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is a decisive statement. See 86:11

item.title: At-Taariq:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ innahu laqawlun faṣlun Verily, it (the Qur'an) is a decisive word The Holy Qur'an is the Final Word of God, complete and perfect to be current for all times until the end of the world for the human race as a whole.

item.title: At-Taariq:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ wamā huwa bil-hazli and it is not a jest.

item.title: At-Taariq:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ wamā huwa bil-hazli And it is not amusement. See 86:11

item.title: At-Taariq:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ wamā huwa bil-hazli And it is not a jest It is not a collection of mere tales of the ancient people as imagined by the disbelievers1.

item.title: At-Taariq:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا innahum yakīdūna kaydan Indeed they are devising a stratagem,

item.title: At-Taariq:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا innahum yakīdūna kaydan Indeed, they are planning a plan. See 86:11

item.title: At-Taariq:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا innahum yakīdūna kaydan Verily scheme they (against the truth), a scheme It is a reference to the scheming activities among the disbelievers and the hypocrites. The immediate reference is said to be to what the pagans of Mecca did, in their preparation for the battle of Badr. But the reference has the common application also that the disbelievers will always exert to the utmost, plotting to thwart the spread of the truth or to make it totally extinct. God undertakes to Himself to fight the disbelievers and hypocrites, i.e., the enemies of the truth. This indicates the continuous effort against Islam and the perpetual help from God, to save and spread it1.

item.title: At-Taariq:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا wa-akīdu kaydan and I [too] am devising a plan.

item.title: At-Taariq:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا wa-akīdu kaydan But I am planning a plan. See 86:11

item.title: At-Taariq:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا wa-akīdu kaydan And I too do scheme (against them), a scheme See 86:15

item.title: At-Taariq:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا famahhili l-kāfirīna amhil'hum ruwaydan So respite the faithless; give them a gentle respite.

item.title: At-Taariq:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا famahhili l-kāfirīna amhil'hum ruwaydan So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.1 See 86:11

item.title: At-Taariq:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا famahhili l-kāfirīna amhil'hum ruwaydan So respite thou the disbelievers; let them alone a while Thus, the disbelievers and the wicked ones, are granted a respite. It is the mercy of the Lord that has given a chance for those who reject the truth to reconsider their decision and amend it. At the end, their doom shall overtake them and bring everyone to account individually for each, of the good and the evil, even the motives as well as the deeds.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ yusabbiḥu lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi lahu l-mul'ku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and whatever there is in the earth. To Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ yusabbiḥu lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi lahu l-mul'ku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah.1 To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs (all) praise, and He is over all things competent. يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ He knows what is in the heavens and on earth, and He knows what you conceal and what you reveal. And Allah is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ yusabbiḥu lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi lahu l-mul'ku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Halloweth the Glory of God whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; His (exclusively) is the Kingdom and unto Him (only) is due (all) praise, and He (alone) is over all things All-Powerful (Refer to Verse 17:44, 61:1, 62:1.) . All praise and gratitude are due only to God and to none else-for it is He and He alone Who has power over all things. This is to inform man that there is none besides God who has any power over the destiny of any one in the universe. Hence every praise or adoration or gratitude should be only to Him and…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنْكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنْكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ huwa alladhī khalaqakum faminkum kāfirun waminkum mu'minun wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun It is He who created you. Then some of you are faithless and some of you are faithful, and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنْكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنْكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ huwa alladhī khalaqakum faminkum kāfirun waminkum mu'minun wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing. See 64:1

item.title: At-Taghaabun:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنْكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنْكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ huwa alladhī khalaqakum faminkum kāfirun waminkum mu'minun wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun He it is Who created you, then some of you are disbelievers and (some) of you are believers; and God seest all whatsoever ye do (Refer to Verses 67:3; 76:2 - 76:3. Concerning Iblis, refer to Verses 7:11; 38:73 - 38:76.) . God created man with the purity of soul and the soundness of the matter but the limited discretionary freedom granted to him, was misused and consequently evil was earned and those who maintained the original purity remained unadulterated or uncorrupted.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
