item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru He created the heavens and the earth with reason, and He formed you and perfected your forms, and toward Him is the destination.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the (final) destination. See 64:1

item.title: At-Taghaabun:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru Created He the heavens and the earth with Truth and fashioned you and made good your forms and unto Him (only) is the ultimate resort (Refer to Verses 40:64; 11:123; 5:18; 36:83.) . See 64:2

item.title: At-Taghaabun:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna wal-lahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri He knows whatever there is in the heavens and the earth, and He knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose, and Allah knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna wal-lahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 64:1

item.title: At-Taghaabun:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna wal-lahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Knoweth He whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth and knoweth He whatsoever ye conceal and whatsoever ye declare; and God knoweth all of whatsoever is in the breasts (hearts). Not only concrete things but abstract things also are bound by His knowledge, viz., complexes.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوْۤا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ alam yatikum naba-u alladhīna kafarū min qablu fadhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Has there not come to you the account of those who were faithless before? They tasted the evil consequences of their conduct, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوْۤا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ alam yatikum naba-u alladhīna kafarū min qablu fadhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment. Has not the news reached you of those who disbelieved aforetime? And so they tasted the evil result of their disbelief, and theirs will be a painful torment (64:5). That was because there came to them their Messengers with Bayyinat, but they said: "Shall mere men guide us?" So they disbelieved and turned away. But Allah was not in need. And Allah is not in need, Worthy of all praise (64:6). A Warning Delivered through Mentioning the End of the Disbelieving Nations Informing about the…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوْۤا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ alam yatikum naba-u alladhīna kafarū min qablu fadhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīmun Hath not come unto you the story of those who disbelieved before, then tasted they the evil consequences of their (own) doings; and for them shall be a painful chastisement (Refer to Verses 59:15, 65:9.) . Evil has always its natural evil consequences. This verse refers to the sufferings of the infidels before the advent of Islam. While the verse 59:15 refers to the sufferings of infidels after the advent of Islam as the word 'Qareeban', there asserts. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Taghaabun:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوْۤا أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوْۤا وَتَوَلَّوْا وَاسْتَغْنَى اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ dhālika bi-annahu kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti faqālū abasharun yahdūnanā fakafarū watawallaw wa-is'taghnā l-lahu wal-lahu ghaniyyun ḥamīdun That was because their apostles used to bring them manifest proofs, but they said, 'Shall humans be our guides?!' So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was in no need [of their faith] and Allah is all-sufficient, all-laudable.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوْۤا أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوْۤا وَتَوَلَّوْا وَاسْتَغْنَى اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ dhālika bi-annahu kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti faqālū abasharun yahdūnanā fakafarū watawallaw wa-is'taghnā l-lahu wal-lahu ghaniyyun ḥamīdun That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed (with them); and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy. See 64:5

item.title: At-Taghaabun:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوْۤا أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوْۤا وَتَوَلَّوْا وَاسْتَغْنَى اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ dhālika bi-annahu kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti faqālū abasharun yahdūnanā fakafarū watawallaw wa-is'taghnā l-lahu wal-lahu ghaniyyun ḥamīdun That because there had come their apostles with clear proofs, but said they: "What! shall men (mortals like unto us) guide us?" So disbelieved they and they turned away, and God needeth not (anything), and God is Self Sufficient, The Most Praised. About the people's imagination that man would never be an apostle of God to guide mankind1.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنْ لَنْ يُبْعَثُوْۤا قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ وَذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ zaʿama alladhīna kafarū an lan yub'ʿathū qul balā warabbī latub'ʿathunna thumma latunabba-unna bimā ʿamil'tum wadhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun The faithless claim that they will not be resurrected. Say, 'Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did, and that is easy for Allah.'

item.title: At-Taghaabun:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنْ لَنْ يُبْعَثُوْۤا قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ وَذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ zaʿama alladhīna kafarū an lan yub'ʿathū qul balā warabbī latub'ʿathunna thumma latunabba-unna bimā ʿamil'tum wadhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy." The disbelievers pretend that they will never be resurrected. Say: Yes! By my Lord, you will certainly be resurrected, then you will be informed of what you did; and that is easy for Allah (64:7). Therefore, believe in Allah and His Messenger and in the Light which We have sent down. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do (64:8). The Day when He will gather you…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنْ لَنْ يُبْعَثُوْۤا قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ وَذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ zaʿama alladhīna kafarū an lan yub'ʿathū qul balā warabbī latub'ʿathunna thumma latunabba-unna bimā ʿamil'tum wadhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun Think those who disbelieve that never shall they be raised. Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!')'. "Aye! By my Lord! certainly shall ye be raised, then certainly shall ye be informed of what ye did; and that, for God, is easy (Refer to Verses 45:28; 60:13.) ." See 64:6

item.title: At-Taghaabun:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْنَا وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wal-nūri alladhī anzalnā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun So have faith in Allah and His Apostle and the light which We have sent down, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْنَا وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wal-nūri alladhī anzalnā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the light (i.e., the Qur’ān) which We have sent down. And Allah is Aware of what you do. See 64:7

item.title: At-Taghaabun:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَءَامِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْنَا وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wal-nūri alladhī anzalnā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun So believe ye in God and His Apostle and the Light (Either Qur'an or the Holy entities who are with it for ever, vide the Hadith ath-Thaqalain. Refer to note on Verse 61:8.) We have sent down; and God is Well-Aware of whatsoever ye do. 'And the Light' - i.e., the Holy Qur'an which shows the right ways against the wrong ones, and the lawful things against the forbidden ones. According to the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt, the Light here stands for the divinely commissioned Imam - i.e., to believe in God as directed by the Holy Prophet and to believe in the Holy Prophet as directed by the Holy Imam. As a matter of fact, along with the inauguration of…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yawma yajmaʿukum liyawmi l-jamʿi dhālika yawmu l-taghābuni waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu The day when He will gather you for the Day of Gathering, that will be a day of dispossession.1 And whoever has faith in Allah and acts righteously, He shall absolve him of his misdeeds and admit him into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. That is the great success.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yawma yajmaʿukum liyawmi l-jamʿi dhālika yawmu l-taghābuni waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.1 And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment. See 64:7

item.title: At-Taghaabun:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ yawma yajmaʿukum liyawmi l-jamʿi dhālika yawmu l-taghābuni waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu The day that He will gather you for the day of gathering, that is the day of mutual loss; and whosoever believeth in God and doeth good, He will wipe out from him his sins and admit him into gardens 'neath which flow rivers, to abide therein for ever; that is a great achievement. The Day of Judgment will be the day of the determination of the actual value of each one's faith and deeds. Those who thought that by accumulating wealth in this world, would…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri khālidīna fīhā wabi'sa l-maṣīru But as for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, —they shall be the inmates of the Fire, to remain in it [forever], and it is an evil destination.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri khālidīna fīhā wabi'sa l-maṣīru But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination. See 64:7

item.title: At-Taghaabun:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri khālidīna fīhā wabi'sa l-maṣīru And those who disbelieved and belied Our signs, they are the fellows of the fire, to abide therein; and wretched is the destination. See 64:9

item.title: At-Taghaabun:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ mā aṣāba min muṣībatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waman yu'min bil-lahi yahdi qalbahu wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun No affliction visits [anyone] except by Allah's leave. Whoever has faith in Allah, He guides his heart, and Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ mā aṣāba min muṣībatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waman yu'min bil-lahi yahdi qalbahu wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things. No calamity occurs, but by the permission of Allah, and whosoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart. And Allah is the All-Knower of everything (64:11). Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away, then the duty of Our Messenger is only to convey clearly (64:12). Allah! La ilaha illa Huwa. And in Allah therefore let the believers put their trust (64:13). All that Occurs to Mankind is by Allah's Permission Allah informs us as He did in Surat…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ mā aṣāba min muṣībatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waman yu'min bil-lahi yahdi qalbahu wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun Afflicteth not any affliction (One who has faith in God is guided by Him as to what to do when facing hardships.) save by the leave of God; and whosoever believeth in God, He guideth aright his heart; and verily God well-knoweth all things. One who has faith in God, is guided as what to do when facing hardships. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Taghaabun:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَى رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ wa-aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla fa-in tawallaytum fa-innamā ʿalā rasūlinā l-balāghu l-mubīnu Obey Allah and obey the Apostle; but if you turn away, then Our Apostle's duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَى رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ wa-aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla fa-in tawallaytum fa-innamā ʿalā rasūlinā l-balāghu l-mubīnu And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only (the duty of) clear notification. See 64:11

item.title: At-Taghaabun:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَى رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ wa-aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla fa-in tawallaytum fa-innamā ʿalā rasūlinā l-balāghu l-mubīnu And obey ye God, and obey ye the Apostle! And if ye turn away, then upon Our Apostle is only the clear delivery (of Our Message) (And the warnings.) . See 64:11

item.title: At-Taghaabun:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna Allah—there is no god except Him— in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely. See 64:11

item.title: At-Taghaabun:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna God, there is no god but He; and upon God (alone) should rely the believers. See 64:11

item.title: At-Taghaabun:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ وَإِنْ تَعْفُوْۤا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū inna min azwājikum wa-awlādikum ʿaduwwan lakum fa-iḥ'dharūhum wa-in taʿfū wataṣfaḥū wataghfirū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun O you who have faith! Indeed among your spouses and children you have enemies; so beware of them. And if you excuse, forbear and forgive, then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ وَإِنْ تَعْفُوْۤا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū inna min azwājikum wa-awlādikum ʿaduwwan lakum fa-iḥ'dharūhum wa-in taʿfū wataṣfaḥū wataghfirū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. O you who believe! Verily, among your wives and your children there are enemies for you; therefore beware of them! But if you pardon (them) and overlook, and forgive, then verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (64:14). Your wealth and your children are only a Fitnah, whereas Allah! With Him is a great reward (64:15). So have Taqwa of Allah as much as you can; listen and obey,…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ وَإِنْ تَعْفُوْۤا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū inna min azwājikum wa-awlādikum ʿaduwwan lakum fa-iḥ'dharūhum wa-in taʿfū wataṣfaḥū wataghfirū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun O' ye who believe! Verily of your wives and your children (some are) enemy unto you; wherefore beware (Lest they may deviate you from the right path. Meanwhile you may not adopt a harsh course against them.) of them, and if ye forgive, overlook and cover up (their ills) then verily God is Oft-Forgiving, The Most Merciful. Lest they may deviate you from the right path - Meanwhile you may not adopt a harsh course with them. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Taghaabun:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ innamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wal-lahu ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmun Rather your possessions and children are a trial, and Allah—with Him is a great reward!

item.title: At-Taghaabun:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ innamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wal-lahu ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmun Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward. See 64:14

item.title: At-Taghaabun:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ innamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wal-lahu ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmun Verily (ye should know that.) your possessions and your children are only a trial (not the end.) and verily God it is (He) with Whom is a great recompense (Refer to Verse 8:28.) . See 64:14

item.title: At-Taghaabun:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنْفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ fa-ittaqū l-laha mā is'taṭaʿtum wa-is'maʿū wa-aṭīʿū wa-anfiqū khayran li-anfusikum waman yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihi fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna So be wary of Allah, as far as you can, and listen and obey, and spend [in the way of Allah]; that is better for yourselves. Those who are saved from their own greed —it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنْفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ fa-ittaqū l-laha mā is'taṭaʿtum wa-is'maʿū wa-aṭīʿū wa-anfiqū khayran li-anfusikum waman yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihi fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend (in the way of Allah); it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful. See 64:14

item.title: At-Taghaabun:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنْفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ fa-ittaqū l-laha mā is'taṭaʿtum wa-is'maʿū wa-aṭīʿū wa-anfiqū khayran li-anfusikum waman yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihi fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna So fear ye (the wrath of) God as much as ye can, and listen ye (unto His word), obey ye (only Him), and spend ye (in His way), it is better for yourselves; and whosoever is saved from the greed of his (own) self, these it is who are the successful ones (Refer to Verse 59:9.) . Some early commentators thought that this passage abrogates the contents of 3:102. While a proper study of both shows that one supports the other. That passage means to be careful of the duty to God as it ought to be and here it says - as much as you can -…

item.title: At-Taghaabun:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تُقْرِضُوْۤا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ in tuq'riḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿif'hu lakum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu shakūrun ḥalīmun If you lend Allah a good loan, He shall multiply it for you and forgive you, and Allah is all-appreciative, all-forbearing,

item.title: At-Taghaabun:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تُقْرِضُوْۤا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ in tuq'riḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿif'hu lakum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu shakūrun ḥalīmun If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is (most) Appreciative1 and Forbearing.2 See 64:14

item.title: At-Taghaabun:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تُقْرِضُوْۤا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ in tuq'riḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿif'hu lakum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu shakūrun ḥalīmun If ye lend God a goodly loan, He will double it unto you and will forgive you; And God is Most Appreciating, the Most Forbearing (Refer to Verses 2:245; 5:12; 57:18; 73:20; 35:30.) . Re 'Shakoor' thankfulness, but on the part of God it means His appreciating the indebtedness on the part of the receivers of His bounties1.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: At-Taghaabun:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 64:14

item.title: At-Taghaabun:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu The Knower of (all things) the unseen and the seen, the Ever-Prevalent, the All-Wise. See 64:17

item.title: At-Tahrim:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu lima tuḥarrimu mā aḥalla l-lahu laka tabtaghī marḍāta azwājika wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O Prophet! Why do you prohibit [yourself] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking to please your wives? And Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: At-Tahrim:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu lima tuḥarrimu mā aḥalla l-lahu laka tabtaghī marḍāta azwājika wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O Prophet, why do you prohibit (yourself from) what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ If you two turn in repentance to Allah your hearts are indeed so inclined ‘Umar said, ‘I am astonished at your question, O Ibn ‘Abbas.''' - Az-Zuhri (a subnarrator) said that ‘Umar did not like the question, but he still answered it, saying that they were ‘Aisha and Hafsah. Then ‘Umar went on relating the story and said, ‘We, the people of Quraysh, used to have authority over our women. But when we came to live with…

item.title: At-Tahrim:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu lima tuḥarrimu mā aḥalla l-lahu laka tabtaghī marḍāta azwājika wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun O' (Our) Prophet! Why dost thou forbid (unto thyself) what God hath made lawful unto thee? Thou seekest to please thy wives; and God is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful (Refer note of Verses 33:28, 5:88) . It is a historical fact that until Lady Khadija was alive the Holy Prophet did not take any other wife. A'ysha was not the choice of the Holy Prophet, but it was the acceptance of the offer from Abu-Bakr, who aspired for the honour of being the father-in-law of the Holy Prophet. History gives the details as to how A'ysha was offered by her father. And as none could accept the hand of Hafsa, the daughter…

item.title: At-Tahrim:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ qad faraḍa l-lahu lakum taḥillata aymānikum wal-lahu mawlākum wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu Allah has certainly made lawful for you the dissolution of your oaths,1 and Allah is your master and He is the All-knowing, the All-wise.

item.title: At-Tahrim:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ qad faraḍa l-lahu lakum taḥillata aymānikum wal-lahu mawlākum wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu Allah has already ordained for you (Muslims) the dissolution of your oaths.1 And Allah is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise. See 66:1

item.title: At-Tahrim:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ qad faraḍa l-lahu lakum taḥillata aymānikum wal-lahu mawlākum wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu Indeed hath God made lawful for you the dissolution of your oaths (in such cases), and God (alone) is your Lord (Arabic Maula, Master, Protector, Guardian.) , and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise (Refer note of Verses 2:225, 5:89) . If any vow taken stands in the way of any good or the discharge of any duties, it should be expiated - just for the sake of the vow, none should refrain from doing good deeds or from availing of the legitimate provisions. The incident was providentially improvised to illustrate this ordinance. The Christian Scholars even at the point of betraying their ignorance of the elements of the Arabic knowledge, have not spared misrepresenting Islam to the…

item.title: At-Tahrim:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنْ بَعْضٍ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنْبَأَكَ هَذَا قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ wa-idh asarra l-nabiyu ilā baʿḍi azwājihi ḥadīthan falammā nabba-at bihi wa-aẓharahu l-lahu ʿalayhi ʿarrafa baʿḍahu wa-aʿraḍa ʿan baʿḍin falammā nabba-ahā bihi qālat man anba-aka hādhā qāla nabba-aniya l-ʿalīmu l-khabīru When the Prophet confided to one of his wives a matter, but when she divulged it, and Allah apprised him about it, he announced [to her] part of it and disregarded part of it. So when he told her about it, she said, 'Who informed you about it?' He said, 'The All-knowing and the All-aware informed me.'

item.title: At-Tahrim:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنْ بَعْضٍ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنْبَأَكَ هَذَا قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ wa-idh asarra l-nabiyu ilā baʿḍi azwājihi ḥadīthan falammā nabba-at bihi wa-aẓharahu l-lahu ʿalayhi ʿarrafa baʿḍahu wa-aʿraḍa ʿan baʿḍin falammā nabba-ahā bihi qālat man anba-aka hādhā qāla nabba-aniya l-ʿalīmu l-khabīru And (remember) when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed (another) of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware." See 66:1

item.title: At-Tahrim:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنْ بَعْضٍ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنْبَأَكَ هَذَا قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ wa-idh asarra l-nabiyu ilā baʿḍi azwājihi ḥadīthan falammā nabba-at bihi wa-aẓharahu l-lahu ʿalayhi ʿarrafa baʿḍahu wa-aʿraḍa ʿan baʿḍin falammā nabba-ahā bihi qālat man anba-aka hādhā qāla nabba-aniya l-ʿalīmu l-khabīru When the Prophet confided unto one of his wives a matter, but when she divulged it (unto others) and God apprised him thereof, he made known a part of it and avoided a part; so when he informed her of it, said she: "Who informed thee of this?" He said: "Informed, me, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware (This one Verse is quite sufficient to know now happy or miserable was the domestic life of the Holy Prophet, how good or bad were some…

item.title: At-Tahrim:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا وَإِنْ تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَاهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ in tatūbā ilā l-lahi faqad ṣaghat qulūbukumā wa-in taẓāharā ʿalayhi fa-inna l-laha huwa mawlāhu wajib'rīlu waṣāliḥu l-mu'minīna wal-malāikatu baʿda dhālika ẓahīrun If the two of you1 repent to Allah …2 for your hearts have certainly swerved, and if you back each other against him, then [know that] Allah is indeed his guardian, and Gabriel, the righteous among the faithful, and, thereafter, the angels are his supporters.

item.title: At-Tahrim:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا وَإِنْ تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَاهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ in tatūbā ilā l-lahi faqad ṣaghat qulūbukumā wa-in taẓāharā ʿalayhi fa-inna l-laha huwa mawlāhu wajib'rīlu waṣāliḥu l-mu'minīna wal-malāikatu baʿda dhālika ẓahīrun If you two (wives) repent to Allah, (it is best), for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allah is his protector, and Jibril and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are (his) assistants. See 66:1

item.title: At-Tahrim:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا وَإِنْ تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَاهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ in tatūbā ilā l-lahi faqad ṣaghat qulūbukumā wa-in taẓāharā ʿalayhi fa-inna l-laha huwa mawlāhu wajib'rīlu waṣāliḥu l-mu'minīna wal-malāikatu baʿda dhālika ẓahīrun If ye two (Refer to the two wives of the Holy Prophet A'ysha and Hafsa. See note on Verse.) turn (in repentance) unto Him, then indeed your hearts are inclined (to this) but if ye two back up each other against him (The Holy Prophet.) , then verily God it is Who is his Protector, and Gabriel, and the (most) Virtuous ('Ali Ibn Abi Talib.) one among the believers, and the angels thereafter will back (him)- up. The reference is to A'ysha and Hafsa, the two offenders who had teased the Holy Prophet who were involved in the…

item.title: At-Tahrim:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَسٰۤی رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا ʿasā rabbuhu in ṭallaqakunna an yub'dilahu azwājan khayran minkunna mus'limātin mu'minātin qānitātin tāibātin ʿābidātin sāiḥātin thayyibātin wa-abkāran It may be that if he divorces you his Lord will give him, in [your] stead, wives better than you: [such as are] muslim, faithful, obedient, penitent, devout and given to fasting, virgins and non-virgins.

item.title: At-Tahrim:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَسٰۤی رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا ʿasā rabbuhu in ṭallaqakunna an yub'dilahu azwājan khayran minkunna mus'limātin mu'minātin qānitātin tāibātin ʿābidātin sāiḥātin thayyibātin wa-abkāran Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you (all), would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting (to Allah), believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling1 - (ones) previously married and virgins. See 66:1

item.title: At-Tahrim:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَسٰۤی رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا ʿasā rabbuhu in ṭallaqakunna an yub'dilahu azwājan khayran minkunna mus'limātin mu'minātin qānitātin tāibātin ʿābidātin sāiḥātin thayyibātin wa-abkāran Happly his Lord if he divorceth you, will give him in your place wives better (This clearly indicates that the wives who were there at the revelation of this Verse and those involved in the charge in verse 3 and warned in verse 4 were not the best women, women better than them were there in the place. See note on Verse.) than you, submissive, faithful, obedient, repentant, prayerful, observers of fast, widows and virgins (See Verses 33:30 - 33:34, 4:34.) . The Holy Prophet offered to divorce all his wives, but none would like to forego the unique honour of being the consorts of the…

item.title: At-Tahrim:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا قُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَائِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū qū anfusakum wa-ahlīkum nāran waqūduhā l-nāsu wal-ḥijāratu ʿalayhā malāikatun ghilāẓun shidādun lā yaʿṣūna l-laha mā amarahum wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna O you who have faith! Save yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [assigned] angels, severe and mighty, who do not disobey whatever Allah has commanded them, and carry out what they are commanded.

item.title: At-Tahrim:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا قُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَائِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū qū anfusakum wa-ahlīkum nāran waqūduhā l-nāsu wal-ḥijāratu ʿalayhā malāikatun ghilāẓun shidādun lā yaʿṣūna l-laha mā amarahum wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are (appointed) angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded. O you who believe! Protect yourselves and your families against a Fire (Hell) whose fuel is men and stones, over which are (appointed) angels stern (and) severe, who disobey not the commands they receive from Allah, but do that which they are commanded (66:6). (It will be said in the Hereafter) O you…

item.title: At-Tahrim:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا قُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَائِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū qū anfusakum wa-ahlīkum nāran waqūduhā l-nāsu wal-ḥijāratu ʿalayhā malāikatun ghilāẓun shidādun lā yaʿṣūna l-laha mā amarahum wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna O' ye who believe! Save yourselves and your families from the fire whose fuel shall be men and stones (Refer to Verse 2:24.) ; over which shall be angels stern and strong, they disobey not God in what He commandeth them, and act (only) as they are bidden. The seriousness of the evil conduct on the part of the two' consorts of the Holy Prophet viz., A'ysha and Hafsa could be very easily estimated from the trend of the admonition starting from the two directly involved in the issue, to all the wives of the Holy…

item.title: At-Tahrim:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna kafarū lā taʿtadhirū l-yawma innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna [They will call out to the faithless:] 'O faithless ones! Do not make any excuses today. You are only being requited for what you used to do.'

item.title: At-Tahrim:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna kafarū lā taʿtadhirū l-yawma innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do. See 66:6

item.title: At-Tahrim:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ yāayyuhā alladhīna kafarū lā taʿtadhirū l-yawma innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna (Will say the Angels) "O' ye who disbelieve! Make ye not excuses this day; ye shall be recompensed as ye used to do!" The punishment which the disbelievers or the offenders of the Divine Laws would receive on the day of Judgment would be no hardship or injustice to them but that which they themselves had earned. It will be the exact reflection of their own life, the consequences of their own disbelief and evil deeds during their life on earth.

item.title: At-Tahrim:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا تُوبُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا عَسٰۤی رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū tūbū ilā l-lahi tawbatan naṣūḥan ʿasā rabbukum an yukaffira ʿankum sayyiātikum wayud'khilakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yawma lā yukh'zī l-lahu l-nabiya wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu nūruhum yasʿā bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-igh'fir lanā innaka ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun O you who have faith! Repent to Allah with sincere repentance! Maybe your Lord will absolve you of your misdeeds and admit you into gardens with streams running in them, on the day when Allah will not let the Prophet down and the faithful who are with him. Their light…

item.title: At-Tahrim:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا تُوبُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا عَسٰۤی رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū tūbū ilā l-lahi tawbatan naṣūḥan ʿasā rabbukum an yukaffira ʿankum sayyiātikum wayud'khilakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yawma lā yukh'zī l-lahu l-nabiya wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu nūruhum yasʿā bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-igh'fir lanā innaka ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps1 your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow (on) the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before…

item.title: At-Tahrim:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا تُوبُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا عَسٰۤی رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū tūbū ilā l-lahi tawbatan naṣūḥan ʿasā rabbukum an yukaffira ʿankum sayyiātikum wayud'khilakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yawma lā yukh'zī l-lahu l-nabiya wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu nūruhum yasʿā bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-igh'fir lanā innaka ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun O' ye who believe! Turn ye (in repentance) unto God with a turning of sincere penitence; happily your Lord will wipe out from you your sins and admit you into gardens 'neath which flow rivers, on the day, God will abase not the Prophet and those who believe with him;…

item.title: At-Tahrim:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu jāhidi l-kufāra wal-munāfiqīna wa-ugh'luẓ ʿalayhim wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru O Prophet! Wage jihād against the faithless and the hypocrites, and be severe with them. Their refuge shall be hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: At-Tahrim:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu jāhidi l-kufāra wal-munāfiqīna wa-ugh'luẓ ʿalayhim wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination. O Prophet! Strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be severe against them; their abode will be Hell, and worst indeed is that destination (66:9). Allah sets forth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Nuh and the wife of Lut. They were under two of our righteous servants, but they both betrayed them. So, they availed them not against Allah and it was said: Enter the Fire along with those who enter! (66:10). The Command for Jihad against the Disbelievers and the Hypocrites Allah the Exalted orders His Messenger…

item.title: At-Tahrim:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ yāayyuhā l-nabiyu jāhidi l-kufāra wal-munāfiqīna wa-ugh'luẓ ʿalayhim wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru O' (Our) Prophet! strive thou against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be thou hard against them; And their abode is hell; And evil is (their) destination (Refer to Verse 9:73) . The Holy Prophet was commanded to wage war upon the disbelievers and the hypocrites. War with the infidels, the Holy Prophet fought whenever he was forced by the infidels themselves, to do it, but the war with the hypocrites, he had to leave it to his vicegerent 'Ali since the hypocrites called themselves all Muslims though they were tied to the heathenic wickedness, for all practical purposes they had to be treated as Muslims and with them the war was with the strict enforcement of the…

item.title: At-Tahrim:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna kafarū im'ra-ata nūḥin wa-im'ra-ata lūṭin kānatā taḥta ʿabdayni min ʿibādinā ṣāliḥayni fakhānatāhumā falam yugh'niyā ʿanhumā mina l-lahi shayan waqīla ud'khulā l-nāra maʿa l-dākhilīna Allah draws an example for the faithless: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of our righteous servants, yet they betrayed them. So they1 did not avail them2 in any way against Allah, and it was said [to them], 'Enter the Fire, along with those who enter [it].'

item.title: At-Tahrim:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna kafarū im'ra-ata nūḥin wa-im'ra-ata lūṭin kānatā taḥta ʿabdayni min ʿibādinā ṣāliḥayni fakhānatāhumā falam yugh'niyā ʿanhumā mina l-lahi shayan waqīla ud'khulā l-nāra maʿa l-dākhilīna Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Nuh and the wife of Lut. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them,1 so they (i.e., those prophets) did not avail them from Allah at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." See 66:9

item.title: At-Tahrim:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna kafarū im'ra-ata nūḥin wa-im'ra-ata lūṭin kānatā taḥta ʿabdayni min ʿibādinā ṣāliḥayni fakhānatāhumā falam yugh'niyā ʿanhumā mina l-lahi shayan waqīla ud'khulā l-nāra maʿa l-dākhilīna Setteth forth God the similitude unto those who disbelieve the wife (Note the position of the wives of the apostles Noah and Lot.) of Noah, and the wife of Lot; they both were under two of Our righteous servants, but they two were unfaithful (unto their husbands) and they (their husbands) availed them naught against God, and it was said (unto them)', "Enter ye both the fire (along) with those who enter (it)?'" The reference here is to the wives of Noah and Lot. It is…

item.title: At-Tahrim:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna āmanū im'ra-ata fir'ʿawna idh qālat rabbi ib'ni lī ʿindaka baytan fī l-janati wanajjinī min fir'ʿawna waʿamalihi wanajjinī mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna Allah draws an[other] example for those who have faith: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, 'My Lord! Build me a home near You in paradise, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his conduct, and deliver me from the wrongdoing lot.'

item.title: At-Tahrim:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna āmanū im'ra-ata fir'ʿawna idh qālat rabbi ib'ni lī ʿindaka baytan fī l-janati wanajjinī min fir'ʿawna waʿamalihi wanajjinī mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." And Allah has set forth an example for those who believe: the wife of Fir'awn, when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with You in Paradise, and save me from Fir'awn and his work, and save me from the people who are wrongdoers (66:11). And Maryam, the…

item.title: At-Tahrim:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna āmanū im'ra-ata fir'ʿawna idh qālat rabbi ib'ni lī ʿindaka baytan fī l-janati wanajjinī min fir'ʿawna waʿamalihi wanajjinī mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna Setteth forth God the similitude unto those who believe the wife of Pharaoh, when said she: "O' My Lord! Build thou for me a house in the Garden (Paradise.) and deliver me from Pharaoh and his doing, and deliver me from the unjust people!" The wife of Pharaoh is traditionally called 'Asiya'. She is one of the four godly women - the other three are: Mary the virgin mother of Jesus. Khadija, the First, and the faithful wife of the Holy Prophet. Fatimah-Zahra - the godly daughter of the Holy Prophet, the…

item.title: At-Tahrim:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ wamaryama ib'nata ʿim'rāna allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhi min rūḥinā waṣaddaqat bikalimāti rabbihā wakutubihi wakānat mina l-qānitīna And Mary, daughter of Imran, who guarded the chastity of her womb, so We breathed into it of Our spirit. She confirmed the words of her Lord and His Books, and she was one of the obedient.

item.title: At-Tahrim:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ wamaryama ib'nata ʿim'rāna allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhi min rūḥinā waṣaddaqat bikalimāti rabbihā wakutubihi wakānat mina l-qānitīna And (the example of) Maryam, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into (her garment) through Our angel (i.e., Jibril), and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient. See 66:11

item.title: At-Tahrim:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ wamaryama ib'nata ʿim'rāna allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhi min rūḥinā waṣaddaqat bikalimāti rabbihā wakutubihi wakānat mina l-qānitīna And Mary the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity; and breathed We into it (her body) of Our Spirit, and she testified the truth of the words of her Lord, and His Scriptures, and she was of the obedient ones (Refer to Verses 3:44 - 3:46, 19:16 - 19:34.) . 'Imran' was the name of the father of Mary the mother of Jesus1. For the birth of Jesus from his virgin mother, Mary, and the Jews falsely accusing her of unchastity, refer to Verses 3:44 - 3:46, 19:16 - 19:34. The miraculous birth of Jesus was only the manifestation of the Might, Authority or Power…

item.title: At-Takaathur:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ alhākumu l-takāthuru Rivalry [and vainglory] distracted you

item.title: At-Takaathur:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ alhākumu l-takāthuru Competition in (worldly) increase diverts you. ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ Then on that Day you shall be asked about the delights! Meaning: 'on that Day you all will be questioned concerning your gratitude towards the favors that Allah blessed you with, such as health, safety, sustenance and other things. You will be asked did you return His favors by being thankful to Him and worshipping Him.' Ibn Jarir recorded that Al-Husayn bin Ali As-Suda'i narrated to him from Al-Walid bin Al-Qasim, who reported from Yazid bin Kaysan, who reported from Abi Hazim, who reported from Abu Hurayrah that he said, "Once while Abu Bakr and Umar were sitting, the Prophet SAW came to them and said, مَا أَجْلَسَكُمَا هٰهُنَا؟ (What has caused you two to sit here?) They replied, "By He Who has sent you…

item.title: At-Takaathur:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ alhākumu l-takāthuru Engageth (Diverts.) you (your) vying in exuberance The occasion for the revelation of this Surah has been reported to be that the people of Bani Abd al-Manaf, Bani Qusai and Ibn-Sahm Ibn Omar, got busy in a mutual contest of priding over each other, the strength, their number and the matter went to the extent of counting even the dead among them, to the sides and once when one of the parties fell short of one to win over the others, a grave was opened and the dead lying therein was counted. This Surah was revealed. Refers to the total indulgence into the material acquisitions in this world which, not only d al-generates the moral and the spiritual aspect of the individual but also takes away all the time more and more, it is leaving no…

item.title: At-Takaathur:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ ḥattā zur'tumu l-maqābira until you visited [even] the graves.

item.title: At-Takaathur:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ ḥattā zur'tumu l-maqābira Until you visit the graveyards.1 See 102:1

item.title: At-Takaathur:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ ḥattā zur'tumu l-maqābira Until ye come to the graves To the extent of the people counting the dead in the graves or that man gets involved in vying with each other, and the people are lost in it and for the best of acquisition engage themselves in piling wealth over wealth until they meet death, being fit for nothing but to be laid in the grave.

item.title: At-Takaathur:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ kallā sawfa taʿlamūna No indeed! Soon you will know!

item.title: At-Takaathur:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ kallā sawfa taʿlamūna No! You are going to know. See 102:1

item.title: At-Takaathur:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ kallā sawfa taʿlamūna Nay! Soon shall ye know (your folly) The repetition in the same statement, is to lay stress and to give to force it, that surely without fail will men know the real value of the wealth with which they vie with each other and spend their whole life in acquiring it, for it will be of no value or avail to them when they meet death and in the life hereafter - For the fate of those who pile wealth in this life1.

item.title: At-Takaathur:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūna Again, no indeed! Soon you will know!

item.title: At-Takaathur:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūna Then, no! You are going to know. See 102:1

item.title: At-Takaathur:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūna Nay! Nay! Soon shall ye know (your folly) See 102:3

item.title: At-Takaathur:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ kallā law taʿlamūna ʿil'ma l-yaqīni No indeed! Were you to know with certain knowledge,

item.title: At-Takaathur:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ kallā law taʿlamūna ʿil'ma l-yaqīni No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...1 See 102:1

item.title: At-Takaathur:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ kallā law taʿlamūna ʿil'ma l-yaqīni Nay! Would that ye knew it with the knowledge ('Ilm al-Yaqeen'.) , of certitude nature Men will know the real value of their motives and deeds as certainty of their knowledge, when they pass from this life to the hereafter and on the Day of Final Judgment. Certainty of knowledge has been described to have stages: - What one only hears about - 'Ilm al-Yaqeen', i.e., the mere information about what is said to a certainty. What one sees with one's eyes - the visual knowledge of that which exists 'Ain al-Yaqeen' as said in verse 7 below in this Surah - seeing the Hell with the eyes. The realisation or the knowledge proper is the personal experience with the thing, is 'Haqq al-Yaqeen', i.e., the realisation of the Truth…

item.title: At-Takaathur:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ latarawunna l-jaḥīma you would surely see hell.

item.title: At-Takaathur:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ latarawunna l-jaḥīma You will surely see the Hellfire. See 102:1

item.title: At-Takaathur:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ latarawunna l-jaḥīma (That) Ye shall certainly see the hell The deniers of the Day of Requital, shall themselves see Hell.

item.title: At-Takaathur:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ thumma latarawunnahā ʿayna l-yaqīni Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

item.title: At-Takaathur:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ thumma latarawunnahā ʿayna l-yaqīni Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.1 See 102:1

item.title: At-Takaathur:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ thumma latarawunnahā ʿayna l-yaqīni Then, ye shall certainly see it with the vision (Ainul Yaqeen.) of certitude They will see it with their own eyes, and they will know about it as certainty and when they will be thrown in it, they will then know what it actually is, i.e., the realisation of the Truth about Hell.

item.title: At-Takaathur:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَتُسْءَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ thumma latus'alunna yawma-idhin ʿani l-naʿīmi Then, that day, you will surely be questioned concerning the blessing.

item.title: At-Takaathur:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَتُسْءَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ thumma latus'alunna yawma-idhin ʿani l-naʿīmi Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.1 See 102:1

item.title: At-Takaathur:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَتُسْءَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ thumma latus'alunna yawma-idhin ʿani l-naʿīmi Then shall ye be questioned on that day, about the bounties (ye enjoined) Man will be questioned about the bounties of God which had been granted to him. Some commentators say that man will have to account for everything which he was given in this world. It is reported to have been told by the Holy Prophet that man will not be asked about: The garments he used to cover his shame. The food he took in hunger. What he spent in the way of the Lord. The Eighth Holy Imam Ali Ibn Musa Ar-Ridha' told a man that ''a man does not like burdening anyone with any obligation about what is gifted to him, how could God ask for everything. He has Himself granted out of His grace. But…

item.title: At-Takwir:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ idhā l-shamsu kuwwirat When the sun is wound up,1

item.title: At-Takwir:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ idhā l-shamsu kuwwirat When the sun is wrapped up (in darkness). عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا أَحْضَرَتْ Every person will know what he has brought. This is the conclusive response of the previous statements, meaning at the time these matters occur, every soul will know what it has done, and that will be brought forth for it, as Allah says: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُ أَمَدًا بَعِيدًا On the Day when every person will be confronted with all the good he has done, and all the evil he has done, he will wish that there were a great distance between him and his evil. (3:30) Allah also says: يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward,…

item.title: At-Takwir:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ idhā l-shamsu kuwwirat When the sun is folded. (Ceaseth to radiate.) Verses 1-13 mention the signs which will herald the dawn of the Day of Judgment. It is a well-known fact that the sun is the centre, controlling the solar system and it is the sun that gives all the light, heat and energy. With the sun losing its essential property, will naturally cease to maintain the present order in the heavenly bodies and every heavenly body will consequently lose its native property and will necessarily be decomposed and lose its form, its use and the usual functioning.

item.title: At-Takwir:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ wa-idhā l-nujūmu inkadarat when the stars scatter,1

item.title: At-Takwir:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ wa-idhā l-nujūmu inkadarat And when the stars fall, dispersing. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ wa-idhā l-nujūmu inkadarat And when the stars darken (Refer to: 82:2.) With the fate of the sun mentioned in the preceding verse, the stars will naturally lose their lustre.

item.title: At-Takwir:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-jibālu suyyirat when the mountains are set moving,

item.title: At-Takwir:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-jibālu suyyirat And when the mountains are removed. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-jibālu suyyirat And when the mountains are removed (as scattered dust) (Refer to: 56:5, 56:6, 78:20.) With the sun ceasing to be what it is and consequently losing its hold on the solar system as a whole, the fate of the earth itself can be easily imagined and with the earth, the mountains will naturally suffer the fate mentioned in this verse1.

item.title: At-Takwir:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ wa-idhā l-ʿishāru ʿuṭṭilat when the pregnant camels are neglected,

item.title: At-Takwir:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ wa-idhā l-ʿishāru ʿuṭṭilat And when full-term she-camels1 are neglected. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ wa-idhā l-ʿishāru ʿuṭṭilat And when the 'Ishaar' (she camel) shall be abandoned As the she camel when it is about to deliver a young one is, a very precious asset to the Arabs, even that will be unattended. So terrible will be the mental agony at the dawn of the Day of Judgment. It means to say that man will not care for anything of any value or worth to him. 'Ishaar' has been used for the she camel which had delivered its young one after ten months of pregnancy. She is the symbol of wealth and communication among the Arabs - any suspense of ''Ishaar' to an Arab is similar to the usage of the market coming to a standstill, meaning stoppage of social progress and transaction. It may also mean when the social life is…

item.title: At-Takwir:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ wa-idhā l-wuḥūshu ḥushirat when the wild beasts are mustered,

item.title: At-Takwir:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ wa-idhā l-wuḥūshu ḥushirat And when the wild beasts are gathered. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ wa-idhā l-wuḥūshu ḥushirat And when the wild beasts are herded together It is said that even the animals will be collected together to give an account of their sufferings and to receive justice for their sufferings.

item.title: At-Takwir:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-biḥāru sujjirat when the seas are set afire,

item.title: At-Takwir:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-biḥāru sujjirat And when the seas are filled with flame.1 See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-biḥāru sujjirat And when the oceans are caused to boil and burn (Refer to: 82:3, 52:6.) The whole equilibrium of the natural control at the flow of the water and its level will be lost and oceans will have no bounds and consequently surge and boil1. The presentation of the oceans in 82:3 - as to be made to burst is the result of its being made to boil. It is not that both verses convey the same meaning. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Takwir:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ wa-idhā l-nufūsu zuwwijat when the souls are assorted,1

item.title: At-Takwir:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ wa-idhā l-nufūsu zuwwijat And when the souls are paired.1 See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ wa-idhā l-nufūsu zuwwijat And when souls shall be reunited (Refer to: 56:7, or assorted.) (with their bodies) The souls will be sorted, separated and r al-classified or paired with the others of corresponding, equal or the identical value. The three general or main classifications of the people on the Day of Judgment1. The translators and commentators have given different views of 'Zowarijat' - reunion of the Soul with the body. Association of each human individual with its spiritual match or it means the souls are assorted into groups as indicated in Surah 56:7. The last one is more comprehensive and in conformity with the well-known sayings of the Holy Prophet. Souls are made into various hosts. Those familiar with others will be allied together and those who are unfamiliar with each other will differ from each other.…

item.title: At-Takwir:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ wa-idhā l-mawūdatu su-ilat when the girl buried-alive will be asked

item.title: At-Takwir:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ wa-idhā l-mawūdatu su-ilat And when the girl (who was) buried alive is asked. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ wa-idhā l-mawūdatu su-ilat And when the femal al-baby buried (alive) shall be asked (about) The Arabs used to bury alive their female children out of the feeling of the false degradation or shame of allowing their daughters to be enjoyed by the others as their spouses. Such female children which were buried alive will be questioned about the cause for their being killed, i.e., to say that the heinous crime of burying female babies also will have to be accounted for. In some recitation instead of 'Ma'oodah' meaning buried, 'Mawaddat' meaning love has been recited, in which case the meaning remains the same, but the expression will be more rhetoric, because the one who buries his child, destroys affection entirely. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Takwir:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ bi-ayyi dhanbin qutilat for what sin she was killed.

item.title: At-Takwir:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ bi-ayyi dhanbin qutilat For what sin she was killed. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ bi-ayyi dhanbin qutilat For what sin (of hers) was she put to death See 81:8

item.title: At-Takwir:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ wa-idhā l-ṣuḥufu nushirat When the records [of deeds] are unfolded,

item.title: At-Takwir:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ wa-idhā l-ṣuḥufu nushirat And when the pages1 are spread (i.e., made public). See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ wa-idhā l-ṣuḥufu nushirat And when the Books (of the deeds of mankind) shall be unfolded. (Laid open.) The recourse of the deeds of each individual will be laid open to man and woman. Every secret will be laid bare, and everything will be seen in its original or the true value. 50:17 - 50:18, 82:11 - 82:12.

item.title: At-Takwir:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ wa-idhā l-samāu kushiṭat when the sky is stripped off,

item.title: At-Takwir:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ wa-idhā l-samāu kushiṭat And when the sky is stripped away. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ wa-idhā l-samāu kushiṭat And when the heaven shall be removed (Refer to: 21:104.) After the solar system had disappeared, there will naturally be an open space in the place of the present skies.

item.title: At-Takwir:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-jaḥīmu suʿʿirat when hell is set ablaze,

item.title: At-Takwir:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-jaḥīmu suʿʿirat And when Hellfire is set ablaze. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ wa-idhā l-jaḥīmu suʿʿirat And when the Hell shall be made to blaze See 81:11

item.title: At-Takwir:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ wa-idhā l-janatu uz'lifat when paradise is brought near,

item.title: At-Takwir:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ wa-idhā l-janatu uz'lifat And when Paradise is brought near. See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ wa-idhā l-janatu uz'lifat And when the Garden (Paradise) is brought nigh See 81:11

item.title: At-Takwir:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا أَحْضَرَتْ ʿalimat nafsun mā aḥḍarat then a soul shall know what it has readied [for itself].

item.title: At-Takwir:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا أَحْضَرَتْ ʿalimat nafsun mā aḥḍarat A soul will (then) know what it has brought (with it).1 See 81:1

item.title: At-Takwir:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا أَحْضَرَتْ ʿalimat nafsun mā aḥḍarat Every soul shall (then) know (Refer to: 82:5, or prepared - or send in advance.) what it hath presented See 81:11

item.title: At-Takwir:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ falā uq'simu bil-khunasi So I swear by the stars that return,

item.title: At-Takwir:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ falā uq'simu bil-khunasi So I swear by the retreating stars. But nay! I swear by Al-Khunnas (81:15). Al-Jawar Al-Kunnas (81:16). And by the night when it 'As'as (81:17). And by the day when it Tanaffas (81:18). Verily, this is the Word a most honorable messenger (81:19). Dhi Quwwah, with the Lord of the Throne – Makin (81:20). Obeyed there, trustworthy (81:21). And your companion is not a madman (81:22). And indeed he saw him in the clear horizon (81:23). And he withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen (81:24). And it is not the word of the outcast Shaytan (81:25). Then where are you going (81:26). Verily, this is no less than a Reminder for the creatures (81:27). To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight (81:28). And you cannot will unless that Allah wills –…

item.title: At-Takwir:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ falā uq'simu bil-khunasi And I swear by the (turning) planets It is to impress the statement with strength and stress that the powerful bodies of mysterious existence are used in the swearing1.

item.title: At-Takwir:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ al-jawāri l-kunasi the planets that hide,

item.title: At-Takwir:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ al-jawāri l-kunasi Those that run (their courses) and disappear (i.e., set). See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ al-jawāri l-kunasi The running and the gliding ones These are the five planets: Zohal Mushtari Zohra Otarad Mirreekh. They are termed as wandering stars. They appear in their course to return back and become stationary for some time and again start their course - And for Mushtari in its yearly revolution eleven backward movements and for Zohal there are 29 backward movements, have been recorded. The Astronomers have given causes for it and of the Muslim scholars Ali is the first to give this interpretation. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Takwir:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ wa-al-layli idhā ʿasʿasa by the night as it approaches,

item.title: At-Takwir:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ wa-al-layli idhā ʿasʿasa And by the night as it closes in.1 See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ wa-al-layli idhā ʿasʿasa And (by) the night when it endeth See 81:16

item.title: At-Takwir:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā tanaffasa by the dawn as it breathes,

item.title: At-Takwir:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā tanaffasa And by the dawn when it breathes (i.e., stirs). See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā tanaffasa And (by) the dawn when it brighteneth See 81:16

item.title: At-Takwir:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmin it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle,1

item.title: At-Takwir:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmin (That) indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is a word (conveyed by) a noble messenger (i.e., Jibril). See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmin Verily it (the Qur'an) is the word of an Apostle the most Honoured i.e., The Angel Gabriel - who occupies the highest place of honour among the angels, who receives the messages from God and conveys them to God's apostles on earth.
