These attributes are true of both the Holy Prophet as well as the Angel Gabriel and verse 23 asserts that both were in communion in the Clear Horizon - the Clear Horizon here is different from the highest horizon is 53:7, which is lower than the Highest Horizon mentioned. Hence whatever is asserted for one is true of the other. The Holy Prophet has a further stage of attainment beyond the reach of Gabriel. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Takwir:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ dhī quwwatin ʿinda dhī l-ʿarshi makīnin powerful and eminent with the Lord of the Throne,

item.title: At-Takwir:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ dhī quwwatin ʿinda dhī l-ʿarshi makīnin (Who is) possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure (in position). See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ dhī quwwatin ʿinda dhī l-ʿarshi makīnin Gifted with Mighty Power (Refer to: 53:5.) , Honoured in the presence of the Lord of the 'ARSH' (Universe) Mankind is once again informed that the Holy Prophet Muhammad is the true apostle of God and not a mad man as some of his enemies thought about him.

item.title: At-Takwir:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ muṭāʿin thamma amīnin one who is heard and trustworthy as well.

item.title: At-Takwir:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ muṭāʿin thamma amīnin Obeyed there (in the heavens) and trustworthy. See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ muṭāʿin thamma amīnin The Obeyed One (by all creation) and above all the Trustworthy See 81:20

item.title: At-Takwir:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ wamā ṣāḥibukum bimajnūnin Your companion is not crazy:

item.title: At-Takwir:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ wamā ṣāḥibukum bimajnūnin And your companion (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW ) is not (at all) mad.1 See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ wamā ṣāḥibukum bimajnūnin And (O' ye people!) your Companion (Muhammad, is Our Apostle; he) is not gone mad See 81:20

item.title: At-Takwir:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ رَاٰهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ walaqad raāhu bil-ufuqi l-mubīni certainly he saw him on the manifest horizon,

item.title: At-Takwir:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ رَاٰهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ walaqad raāhu bil-ufuqi l-mubīni And he has already seen him (i.e., Jibril) in the clear horizon.1 See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ رَاٰهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ walaqad raāhu bil-ufuqi l-mubīni And indeed, he saw him (Gabriel (Refer to: 53:7.) the Messenger Angel) on the clear horizon It is said that the Holy Prophet saw the Angel Gabriel in the different places in the horizon manifesting his strength and power.

item.title: At-Takwir:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ wamā huwa ʿalā l-ghaybi biḍanīnin and he is not miserly concerning the Unseen.

item.title: At-Takwir:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ wamā huwa ʿalā l-ghaybi biḍanīnin And he (i.e., Muḥammad SAW) is not a withholder of (knowledge of) the unseen.1 See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ wamā huwa ʿalā l-ghaybi biḍanīnin And he is not avid about the unseen What the Holy Prophet preaches is nothing but that which has been revealed. He would not grudge revealing to you what he receives from the unseen.

item.title: At-Takwir:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ wamā huwa biqawli shayṭānin rajīmin And it is not the speech of an outcast Satan.

item.title: At-Takwir:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ wamā huwa biqawli shayṭānin rajīmin And it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is not the word of a devil, expelled (from the heavens). See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ wamā huwa biqawli shayṭānin rajīmin And nor is it the word of the Cursed Satan (the Outcast of the heavens) The pronoun 'Howa' repeated in the verse 25, 27 - may refer to one and the same object, 'Qur'an', and may here refer to Gabriel or the Holy Prophet in the 25th and 27th undoubtedly refers to Qur'an. The significance in any case remains the same - as these three entities are identified in complete communion in the higher stages. (A.P.)

item.title: At-Takwir:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ fa-ayna tadhhabūna So where are you going?

item.title: At-Takwir:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ fa-ayna tadhhabūna So where are you going?1 See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ fa-ayna tadhhabūna Whither then go ye? Why then the people leave the right path, do not repent and accept the truth.

item.title: At-Takwir:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna It is just a reminder for all the nations,

item.title: At-Takwir:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna It is not except a reminder to the worlds. See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna It (the Qur'an) is naught but a Reminder unto (all) the worlds See 81:26

item.title: At-Takwir:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ liman shāa minkum an yastaqīma for those of you who wish to be steadfast;1

item.title: At-Takwir:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ liman shāa minkum an yastaqīma For whoever wills among you to take a right course. See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ liman shāa minkum an yastaqīma Unto him of you who willeth, to go straight See 81:26

item.title: At-Takwir:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna but you do not wish unless it is wished by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: At-Takwir:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds. See 81:15

item.title: At-Takwir:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna And ye willeth not save that willeth God (Refer to: 74:54 - 74:56, 76:30.) , the Lord of the worlds See 81:26

item.title: At-Talaaq:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوْۤا الْعِدَّةَ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ لَا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَمْرًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu idhā ṭallaqtumu l-nisāa faṭalliqūhunna liʿiddatihinna wa-aḥṣū l-ʿidata wa-ittaqū l-laha rabbakum lā tukh'rijūhunna min buyūtihinna walā yakhruj'na illā an yatīna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi waman yataʿadda ḥudūda l-lahi faqad ẓalama nafsahu lā tadrī laʿalla l-laha yuḥ'dithu baʿda dhālika amran O Prophet! When you1 divorce women, divorce them at [the conclusion of] their term2 and calculate the term, and be wary of Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out from their houses, nor shall they go out, unless they commit a gross3 indecency.4 These are Allah's bounds, and whoever transgresses the bounds of Allah certainly wrongs himself.…

item.title: At-Talaaq:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوْۤا الْعِدَّةَ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ لَا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَمْرًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu idhā ṭallaqtumu l-nisāa faṭalliqūhunna liʿiddatihinna wa-aḥṣū l-ʿidata wa-ittaqū l-laha rabbakum lā tukh'rijūhunna min buyūtihinna walā yakhruj'na illā an yatīna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi waman yataʿadda ḥudūda l-lahi faqad ẓalama nafsahu lā tadrī laʿalla l-laha yuḥ'dithu baʿda dhālika amran O Prophet, when you (Muslims) divorce women, divorce them for (the commencement of) their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period,1 and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their (husbands') houses, nor should they (themselves) leave (during that period) unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits (set…

item.title: At-Talaaq:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوْۤا الْعِدَّةَ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ لَا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَمْرًا yāayyuhā l-nabiyu idhā ṭallaqtumu l-nisāa faṭalliqūhunna liʿiddatihinna wa-aḥṣū l-ʿidata wa-ittaqū l-laha rabbakum lā tukh'rijūhunna min buyūtihinna walā yakhruj'na illā an yatīna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi waman yataʿadda ḥudūda l-lahi faqad ẓalama nafsahu lā tadrī laʿalla l-laha yuḥ'dithu baʿda dhālika amran O' (Our) Prophet! (say thou unto the believers that) "When divorce ye (your) women (Wives.) , divorce ye at their prescribed period, and reckon ye the 'Iddah' (prescribed periods (Immediately after the divorce. See 'Fiqh'.) ) (exactly); and fear ye (the wrath of) God your Lord; and turn them not out of their houses, nor shall they (themselves)…

item.title: At-Talaaq:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوْۤا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ذَلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا fa-idhā balaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikūhunna bimaʿrūfin aw fāriqūhunna bimaʿrūfin wa-ashhidū dhaway ʿadlin minkum wa-aqīmū l-shahādata lillahi dhālikum yūʿaẓu bihi man kāna yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu makhrajan Then, when they have completed their term, either retain them honourably or separate from them honourably, and take the witness of two fair men from among yourselves, and bear witness for the sake of Allah. To [comply with] this is advised whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever is wary of Allah, He shall make a way out for him,

item.title: At-Talaaq:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوْۤا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ذَلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا fa-idhā balaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikūhunna bimaʿrūfin aw fāriqūhunna bimaʿrūfin wa-ashhidū dhaway ʿadlin minkum wa-aqīmū l-shahādata lillahi dhālikum yūʿaẓu bihi man kāna yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu makhrajan And when they have (nearly) fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for (the acceptance of) Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.1 Then when they are about to attain their term appointed, either take…

item.title: At-Talaaq:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوْۤا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ذَلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا fa-idhā balaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikūhunna bimaʿrūfin aw fāriqūhunna bimaʿrūfin wa-ashhidū dhaway ʿadlin minkum wa-aqīmū l-shahādata lillahi dhālikum yūʿaẓu bihi man kāna yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu makhrajan And when they reached their 'Iddah' (the term prescribed), then either retain (Withdrawing the 'Talaq". See 'Fiqh'.) them with fairness or part (By allowing the term to expire) with them with kindness, and call to witness two men (endued) with justice (Pious - at the time of pronouncing the divorce.) , and establish (Addressed to the witnesses.) the witness (as) before God; That is with which is admonished he who believeth in God and the Last Day; and whosoever (Reciting…

item.title: At-Talaaq:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا wayarzuq'hu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasibu waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fahuwa ḥasbuhu inna l-laha bālighu amrihi qad jaʿala l-lahu likulli shayin qadran and provide for him from whence he does not reckon. And whoever puts his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Indeed Allah carries through His command. Certainly Allah has set a measure for everything.

item.title: At-Talaaq:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا wayarzuq'hu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasibu waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fahuwa ḥasbuhu inna l-laha bālighu amrihi qad jaʿala l-lahu likulli shayin qadran And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a (decreed) extent. See 65:2

item.title: At-Talaaq:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا wayarzuq'hu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasibu waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fahuwa ḥasbuhu inna l-laha bālighu amrihi qad jaʿala l-lahu likulli shayin qadran And provide him with sustenance from whence he reckon- eth not; and whosoever relieth on God, then sufficient is He for him; Verily God accomplished! His purpose; Indeed hath prescribed God for everything the due measure. It is said that when this verse was revealed some men stopped going out to earn their livelihood, confined themselves in their houses and engaged themselves in prayer - expecting their sustenance from God to reach them without any effort on their part. When the Holy Prophet came to know of this, he sent word that every possible and the desirable effect…

item.title: At-Talaaq:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا wa-allāī ya-is'na mina l-maḥīḍi min nisāikum ini ir'tabtum faʿiddatuhunna thalāthatu ashhurin wa-allāī lam yaḥiḍ'na wa-ulātu l-aḥmāli ajaluhunna an yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu min amrihi yus'ran As for those of your wives who do not hope to have menses, should you have any doubts, their term shall be three months, and for those [as well] who have not yet had menses. As for those who are pregnant, their term shall be until they deliver. And whoever is wary of Allah, He shall grant him ease in his affairs.

item.title: At-Talaaq:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا wa-allāī ya-is'na mina l-maḥīḍi min nisāikum ini ir'tabtum faʿiddatuhunna thalāthatu ashhurin wa-allāī lam yaḥiḍ'na wa-ulātu l-aḥmāli ajaluhunna an yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu min amrihi yus'ran And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and (also for) those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.1 And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease. Those in menopause among your women, for them the 'Iddah, if you have doubt, is three months; and for those who have no courses. And for those who are…

item.title: At-Talaaq:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا wa-allāī ya-is'na mina l-maḥīḍi min nisāikum ini ir'tabtum faʿiddatuhunna thalāthatu ashhurin wa-allāī lam yaḥiḍ'na wa-ulātu l-aḥmāli ajaluhunna an yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu min amrihi yus'ran And (such of) those of your women as despair of menstruation, if doubt ye, then their prescribed term shall be three months, and (the same is the case) of those who have not yet had the course (if there be any doubt)', and (as for) those pregnant women their prescribed 'Iddah' (term) shall be until they deliver their burden (Child.) ; and whosoever feareth (Guards himself against the evil.) (the wrath of) God, He will make for him his affair an ease. For fuller…

item.title: At-Talaaq:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ أَنْزَلَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْرًا dhālika amru l-lahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi l-laha yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayuʿ'ẓim lahu ajran That is the ordinance of Allah which He has sent down to you, and whoever is wary of Allah, He shall absolve him of his misdeeds and give him a great reward.

item.title: At-Talaaq:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ أَنْزَلَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْرًا dhālika amru l-lahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi l-laha yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayuʿ'ẓim lahu ajran That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward. See 65:4

item.title: At-Talaaq:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ أَنْزَلَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْرًا dhālika amru l-lahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi l-laha yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayuʿ'ẓim lahu ajran This is the command of God which He hath sent down unto you, and whosoever feareth (the wrath of) God, He will wipe out from him his sins and will increase (Enhance.) for him the recompense. Note how man is repeatedly admonished to be within the bounds of the prescribed laws and be guarded against getting astray, promising in return for the controlled and the disciplined life, greater reward - and even by wiping away the past sins.

item.title: At-Talaaq:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنْتُمْ مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ وَإِنْ كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنْفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتّٰی يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَءَاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُمْ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَإِنْ تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرٰی askinūhunna min ḥaythu sakantum min wuj'dikum walā tuḍārrūhunna lituḍayyiqū ʿalayhinna wa-in kunna ulāti ḥamlin fa-anfiqū ʿalayhinna ḥattā yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna fa-in arḍaʿna lakum faātūhunna ujūrahunna watamirū baynakum bimaʿrūfin wa-in taʿāsartum fasatur'ḍiʿu lahu ukh'rā House them where you live,1 in accordance with your means, and do not harass them to put them in straits, and should they be pregnant, maintain them until they deliver. Then, if they suckle [the baby] for you, give them their wages and consult together honourably; but if you make things difficult for each other, then another woman will suckle [the baby] for him.2

item.title: At-Talaaq:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنْتُمْ مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ وَإِنْ كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنْفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتّٰی يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَءَاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُمْ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَإِنْ تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرٰی askinūhunna min ḥaythu sakantum min wuj'dikum walā tuḍārrūhunna lituḍayyiqū ʿalayhinna wa-in kunna ulāti ḥamlin fa-anfiqū ʿalayhinna ḥattā yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna fa-in arḍaʿna lakum faātūhunna ujūrahunna watamirū baynakum bimaʿrūfin wa-in taʿāsartum fasatur'ḍiʿu lahu ukh'rā Lodge them1 (in a section) of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them.2 And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him (i.e., the father) another woman.3 Lodge them where…

item.title: At-Talaaq:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنْتُمْ مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ وَإِنْ كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنْفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتّٰی يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَءَاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُمْ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَإِنْ تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرٰی askinūhunna min ḥaythu sakantum min wuj'dikum walā tuḍārrūhunna lituḍayyiqū ʿalayhinna wa-in kunna ulāti ḥamlin fa-anfiqū ʿalayhinna ḥattā yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna fa-in arḍaʿna lakum faātūhunna ujūrahunna watamirū baynakum bimaʿrūfin wa-in taʿāsartum fasatur'ḍiʿu lahu ukh'rā Lodge them wherever ye lodge according to your means, and ye harm them not to straiten (life for) them, and if they be pregnant, spend ye on them until they lay (Deliver.) down their burden (Child.) ; and if they suckle (to your issues) for you, ye give them their recompense; and deal ye unto one another in fairness; And if ye find between you difficulties, then shall suckle some other woman for him (Refer note…

item.title: At-Talaaq:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُنْفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِهِ وَمَنْ قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنْفِقْ مِمَّا ءَاتَاهُ اللَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا ءَاتَاهَا سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا liyunfiq dhū saʿatin min saʿatihi waman qudira ʿalayhi riz'quhu falyunfiq mimmā ātāhu l-lahu lā yukallifu l-lahu nafsan illā mā ātāhā sayajʿalu l-lahu baʿda ʿus'rin yus'ran Let the affluent man spend out of his affluence, and let he whose provision has been tightened spend out of what Allah has given him. Allah does not task any soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about ease after hardship.

item.title: At-Talaaq:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُنْفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِهِ وَمَنْ قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنْفِقْ مِمَّا ءَاتَاهُ اللَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا ءَاتَاهَا سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا liyunfiq dhū saʿatin min saʿatihi waman qudira ʿalayhi riz'quhu falyunfiq mimmā ātāhu l-lahu lā yukallifu l-lahu nafsan illā mā ātāhā sayajʿalu l-lahu baʿda ʿus'rin yus'ran Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except (according to) what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease (i.e., relief). See 65:6

item.title: At-Talaaq:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُنْفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِهِ وَمَنْ قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنْفِقْ مِمَّا ءَاتَاهُ اللَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا ءَاتَاهَا سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا liyunfiq dhū saʿatin min saʿatihi waman qudira ʿalayhi riz'quhu falyunfiq mimmā ātāhu l-lahu lā yukallifu l-lahu nafsan illā mā ātāhā sayajʿalu l-lahu baʿda ʿus'rin yus'ran Let him with abundance spend of his abundance and he on whom is straitened his subsistence, let him spend of what (Note the wide range - which includes everything given by God, including even the intellect, physical strength, knowledge and experience.) God hath given him; (for) God layeth not on any soul a burden save to the extent to which He hath given it; God will soon bring about ease after difficulty. Man is admonished not to avoid his responsibilities fearing any difficulties for if he behaves justly and remains…

item.title: At-Talaaq:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُكْرًا waka-ayyin min qaryatin ʿatat ʿan amri rabbihā warusulihi faḥāsabnāhā ḥisāban shadīdan waʿadhabnāhā ʿadhāban nuk'ran How many a town defied the command of its Lord and His apostles, then We called it to a severe account and punished it with a dire punishment.

item.title: At-Talaaq:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُكْرًا waka-ayyin min qaryatin ʿatat ʿan amri rabbihā warusulihi faḥāsabnāhā ḥisāban shadīdan waʿadhabnāhā ʿadhāban nuk'ran And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment. And many a town revolted against the command of its Lord and His Messengers; and We called it to a severe account, and We shall punish it with a horrible torment (65:8). So it tasted the evil result of its affair, and the consequence of its affair was loss (65:9). Allah has prepared for them a severe torment. So have Taqwa of Allah, O men of understanding, those who believe! Allah has indeed sent down to you a Reminder (65:10). A Messenger,…

item.title: At-Talaaq:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُكْرًا waka-ayyin min qaryatin ʿatat ʿan amri rabbihā warusulihi faḥāsabnāhā ḥisāban shadīdan waʿadhabnāhā ʿadhāban nuk'ran And how many a town rebelled against the command of their Lord, and His apostles, so We did call it to account unto a severe accounting and We chastised it with a stern chastisement. The fate of those who rebelled against God in the past, is reminded to warn man against transgressing the limits prescribed by the Law, to make man know that insolent impiety would never go unpunished. Thus never to forget the moral decency in the dealings with the weaker sex in particular.

item.title: At-Talaaq:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَاقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا fadhāqat wabāla amrihā wakāna ʿāqibatu amrihā khus'ran So it tasted the evil consequences of its conduct, and the outcome of its conduct was ruin.

item.title: At-Talaaq:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَاقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا fadhāqat wabāla amrihā wakāna ʿāqibatu amrihā khus'ran And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair (i.e., rebellion), and the outcome of its affair was loss. See 65:8

item.title: At-Talaaq:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَاقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا fadhāqat wabāla amrihā wakāna ʿāqibatu amrihā khus'ran So it did taste the evil consequences of its doings, and the end of its conduct was perdition. See 65:8

item.title: At-Talaaq:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَاأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan fa-ittaqū l-laha yāulī l-albābi alladhīna āmanū qad anzala l-lahu ilaykum dhik'ran Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. So be wary of Allah, O you who possess intellect and have faith! Allah has already sent down to you a reminder,

item.title: At-Talaaq:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَاأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan fa-ittaqū l-laha yāulī l-albābi alladhīna āmanū qad anzala l-lahu ilaykum dhik'ran Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you a message (i.e., the Qur’ān).1 See 65:8

item.title: At-Talaaq:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَاأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan fa-ittaqū l-laha yāulī l-albābi alladhīna āmanū qad anzala l-lahu ilaykum dhik'ran God hath prepared for them severe chastisement, so fear ye (the wrath of) God! O' ye with understanding who believe! Indeed hath God sent down unto you a Reminder (The Qur'an.) . 'Rasoolan' is appositional case qualifying 'Zikr' i.e., the 'Zikr' and 'Rasool' here are one. Then the question is what it means - whether Qur'an or the Prophet or the Angel Gabriel. The function discards the possibility Gabriel be meant, for Gabriel does not recite the Sign to the people. On the contrary it is the Holy Prophet who recites to the people but the use of the verb 'Anzala' i.e., revealed, is mostly used for Qur'an…

item.title: At-Talaaq:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَسُولًا يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا rasūlan yatlū ʿalaykum āyāti l-lahi mubayyinātin liyukh'rija alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan qad aḥsana l-lahu lahu riz'qan an apostle reciting to you the manifest signs of Allah that He may bring out those who have faith and do righteous deeds from darkness into light. And whoever has faith in Allah and does righteous deeds, He shall admit him into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. Allah has certainly granted him an excellent provision.

item.title: At-Talaaq:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَسُولًا يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا rasūlan yatlū ʿalaykum āyāti l-lahi mubayyinātin liyukh'rija alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan qad aḥsana l-lahu lahu riz'qan (He sent) a Messenger (i.e., Muḥammad SAW) reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allah will have perfected for him a provision. See 65:8

item.title: At-Talaaq:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَسُولًا يَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا rasūlan yatlū ʿalaykum āyāti l-lahi mubayyinātin liyukh'rija alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan qad aḥsana l-lahu lahu riz'qan An Apostle (The Holy Prophet.) who reciteth unto you the clear signs of God that he may bring out those who believe and do good deeds from the darkness unto light (See notes of Verses 2:257, 24:35, 5:15, 2:40.) ; and whosoever believeth in God and doeth good deeds, He will admit him into gardens beneath which flow rivers, to abide therein for ever; God hath bestowed on him a goodly sustenance.…

item.title: At-Talaaq:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا al-lahu alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin wamina l-arḍi mith'lahunna yatanazzalu l-amru baynahunna litaʿlamū anna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun wa-anna l-laha qad aḥāṭa bikulli shayin ʿil'man It is Allah who has created seven heavens, and of the earth [a number] similar to them. The command gradually descends through them, that you may know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah comprehends all things in knowledge.

item.title: At-Talaaq:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا al-lahu alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin wamina l-arḍi mith'lahunna yatanazzalu l-amru baynahunna litaʿlamū anna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun wa-anna l-laha qad aḥāṭa bikulli shayin ʿil'man It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them.1 (His) command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge. It is Allah Who has created seven heavens and of the earth the like thereof. His command descends between them, that you may know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah surrounds all things with (His) knowledge (65:12). Allah's Perfect Power Allah the Exalted asserts His…

item.title: At-Talaaq:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا al-lahu alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin wamina l-arḍi mith'lahunna yatanazzalu l-amru baynahunna litaʿlamū anna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun wa-anna l-laha qad aḥāṭa bikulli shayin ʿil'man God is He Who created the seven heavens and of the earth, the like unto them, and are sent down amidst them, that ye may know that God, over all things is All-Powerful, and that God encompasseth all things in (His) knowledge (Refer to Verses 67:3, 78:13, 71:15.) . The seven heavens, i.e., the seven firmaments. The number seven is a mystical distribution of the various grades or stages or the states of the creation in the universe - including the spiritual and the heavenly. The Eighth Imam 'Ali Ibn…

item.title: At-Tawba:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ barāatun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīna [This is] a [declaration of] repudiation by Allah and His Apostle [addressed] to the polytheists with whom you had made a treaty:

item.title: At-Tawba:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ barāatun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīna (This is a declaration of) disassociation, from Allah and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists.1 بَرَاءَةٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ Freedom from obligations from Allah and His Messenger SAW Which is is a declaration of freedom from all obligations from Allah and His Messenger SAW: إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدتُّم مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ - فَسِيحُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ to those of the Mushrikin, with whom you made a treaty. So travel freely (Mushrikin) for four months (as you will) throughout the land (9:1-2) This Ayah refers to idolators who had indefinite treaties and those, whose treaties with Muslims ended in less than four months. The terms of these treaties were restricted to four months only. As for…

item.title: At-Tawba:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ barāatun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīna (This a declaration of) Immunity from God and His Apostle (Muhammad) towards those of the idolaters with whom ye have (mutually) covenanted. Since this Sura contains curses against infidelity it has not been started with 'Bismillah' as 'Bismillah' contains the blessings and the mercy of God. According to some traditions of the Holy Prophet, since this Sura has been revealed without 'Bismillah,' 'Bismillah' should not be recited at its recital. It is also held that the preceding chapter, 'Anfal' and this chapter, i.e., 'Tawbah' put together is one continuous chapter. As regards the revelation of the Qur'an to the Holy Prophet and its compilation in the form of a complete book, it is historic fact that the Holy Qur'an was revealed to…

item.title: At-Tawba:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسِيحُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْزِي الْكَافِرِينَ fasīḥū fī l-arḍi arbaʿata ashhurin wa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wa-anna l-laha mukh'zī l-kāfirīna Travel [unmolested] in the land for four months, but know that you cannot thwart Allah, and that Allah shall disgrace the faithless.

item.title: At-Tawba:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسِيحُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْزِي الْكَافِرِينَ fasīḥū fī l-arḍi arbaʿata ashhurin wa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wa-anna l-laha mukh'zī l-kāfirīna So travel freely, (O disbelievers), throughout the land (during) four months but know that you cannot cause failure to Allah and that Allah will disgrace the disbelievers. See 9:1

item.title: At-Tawba:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسِيحُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْزِي الْكَافِرِينَ fasīḥū fī l-arḍi arbaʿata ashhurin wa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wa-anna l-laha mukh'zī l-kāfirīna So go ye about in the earth for four months, and know ye that ye are not weakening God, and that God bringeth shame unto the infidels. See 9:1

item.title: At-Tawba:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَذَانٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ فَإِنْ تُبْتُمْ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-adhānun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā l-nāsi yawma l-ḥaji l-akbari anna l-laha barīon mina l-mush'rikīna warasūluhu fa-in tub'tum fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in tawallaytum fa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wabashiri alladhīna kafarū biʿadhābin alīmin [This is] an announcement from Allah and His Apostle to all the people on the day of the greater ḥajj:1 that Allah and His Apostle repudiate the polytheists: If you repent2 that is better for you; but if you turn your backs [on Allah], know that you cannot thwart Allah, and inform the faithless of a painful punishment

item.title: At-Tawba:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَذَانٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ فَإِنْ تُبْتُمْ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-adhānun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā l-nāsi yawma l-ḥaji l-akbari anna l-laha barīon mina l-mush'rikīna warasūluhu fa-in tub'tum fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in tawallaytum fa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wabashiri alladhīna kafarū biʿadhābin alīmin And (it is) an announcement from Allah and His Messenger to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage1 that Allah is disassociated from the disbelievers, and (so is) His Messenger. So if you repent, that is best for you; but if you turn away - then know that you will not cause failure to Allah.2 And give tidings to those who disbelieve of a painful punishment. And a declaration from Allah and His Messenger…

item.title: At-Tawba:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَذَانٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ فَإِنْ تُبْتُمْ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-adhānun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā l-nāsi yawma l-ḥaji l-akbari anna l-laha barīon mina l-mush'rikīna warasūluhu fa-in tub'tum fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in tawallaytum fa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wabashiri alladhīna kafarū biʿadhābin alīmin And an Announcement from God and His Apostle unto the people on the day of the great pilgrimage, that God is immune (Arabic 'Bara'at', Severance of Connection - immune.) (from any obligation to) the idolaters, and (so is) His Apostle; therefore if ye repent, better will it be for you, and if ye turn back, then know ye that ye are not weakening God; and announce thou (O' Our Apostle!) unto those who dis-believe, a painful…

item.title: At-Tawba:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْقُصُوكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَمْ يُظَاهِرُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا فَأَتِمُّوْۤا إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَى مُدَّتِهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīna thumma lam yanquṣūkum shayan walam yuẓāhirū ʿalaykum aḥadan fa-atimmū ilayhim ʿahdahum ilā muddatihim inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna (barring the polytheists with whom you have made a treaty, and who did not violate any [of its terms] with you, nor backed anyone against you. So fulfill the treaty with them until [the end of] its term. Indeed Allah loves the Godwary).

item.title: At-Tawba:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْقُصُوكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَمْ يُظَاهِرُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا فَأَتِمُّوْۤا إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَى مُدَّتِهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīna thumma lam yanquṣūkum shayan walam yuẓāhirū ʿalaykum aḥadan fa-atimmū ilayhim ʿahdahum ilā muddatihim inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna Excepted are those with whom you made a treaty among the polytheists and then they have not been deficient toward you in anything or supported anyone against you; so complete for them their treaty until their term (has ended). Indeed, Allah loves the righteous (who fear Him). Except those of the Mushrikin with whom you have a treaty, and who have not subsequently failed you in aught, nor have supported anyone against you. So fulfill their treaty for them until the end of their term. Surely, Allah loves those who have Taqwa (9:4). Existing Peace Treaties…

item.title: At-Tawba:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْقُصُوكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَمْ يُظَاهِرُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا فَأَتِمُّوْۤا إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَى مُدَّتِهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīna thumma lam yanquṣūkum shayan walam yuẓāhirū ʿalaykum aḥadan fa-atimmū ilayhim ʿahdahum ilā muddatihim inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna Except those (with whom) ye have entered into a pact, from the Idolaters who thereafter failed not you in aught and have backed not any one against you, then fulfil their pact unto the end of their term; Verily God loveth those who guard themselves (against evil). Note the regard for the treaties entered into even with the deadliest of the enemies and the consideration paid to the fulfilment of the terms by the opposite side. It is clear that the Muslims were commanded to fight only those of the enemy who violated the terms of…

item.title: At-Tawba:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا انْسَلَخَ الْأَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ فَإِنْ تَابُوْۤا وَأَقَامُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَخَلُّوْۤا سَبِيلَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ fa-idhā insalakha l-ashhuru l-ḥurumu fa-uq'tulū l-mush'rikīna ḥaythu wajadttumūhum wakhudhūhum wa-uḥ'ṣurūhum wa-uq'ʿudū lahum kulla marṣadin fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fakhallū sabīlahum inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun Then, when the sacred months have passed, kill the polytheists wherever you find them, capture them and besiege them, and lie in wait for them at every ambush. But if they repent, and maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, then let them alone. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: At-Tawba:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا انْسَلَخَ الْأَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ فَإِنْ تَابُوْۤا وَأَقَامُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَخَلُّوْۤا سَبِيلَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ fa-idhā insalakha l-ashhuru l-ḥurumu fa-uq'tulū l-mush'rikīna ḥaythu wajadttumūhum wakhudhūhum wa-uḥ'ṣurūhum wa-uq'ʿudū lahum kulla marṣadin fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fakhallū sabīlahum inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun And when the inviolable months1 have passed, then kill the polytheists wherever you find them and capture them and besiege them and sit in wait for them at every place of ambush. But if they should repent, establish prayer, and give zakāh, let them (go) on their way. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. So when the Sacred Months have passed, then fight the Mushrikin wherever you find them, and capture them and besiege them, and lie in wait for them in each and every ambush. But if…

item.title: At-Tawba:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا انْسَلَخَ الْأَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ فَإِنْ تَابُوْۤا وَأَقَامُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَخَلُّوْۤا سَبِيلَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ fa-idhā insalakha l-ashhuru l-ḥurumu fa-uq'tulū l-mush'rikīna ḥaythu wajadttumūhum wakhudhūhum wa-uḥ'ṣurūhum wa-uq'ʿudū lahum kulla marṣadin fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fakhallū sabīlahum inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun So when the sacred months are past then slay the idolaters wherever ye find them, and seize them and besiege them and lie in wait for them in every ambush, then if they repent and establish prayer, and give the poor-rate, then leave their way free to them; Verily God is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. The fight enjoined here is only against the repeated violation of the treaties by the infidels and the condition to grant amnesty is their repentance for their past conduct and their sincere…

item.title: At-Tawba:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتّٰی يَسْمَعَ كَلَامَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُ ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-in aḥadun mina l-mush'rikīna is'tajāraka fa-ajir'hu ḥattā yasmaʿa kalāma l-lahi thumma abligh'hu mamanahu dhālika bi-annahum qawmun lā yaʿlamūna If any of the polytheists seeks asylum from you, grant him asylum until he hears the Word of Allah. Then convey him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know.

item.title: At-Tawba:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتّٰی يَسْمَعَ كَلَامَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُ ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-in aḥadun mina l-mush'rikīna is'tajāraka fa-ajir'hu ḥattā yasmaʿa kalāma l-lahi thumma abligh'hu mamanahu dhālika bi-annahum qawmun lā yaʿlamūna And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, then grant him protection so that he may hear the words of Allah (i.e., the Qur’ān). Then deliver him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know. And if anyone of the Mushrikin seeks your protection then grant him protection so that he may hear the Word of Allah (the Qur'an) and then escort him to where he can be secure, that is because they are men who know not (9:6). Idolators are Granted Safe Passage If They Seek It Allah said to His Prophet (AS):…

item.title: At-Tawba:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتّٰی يَسْمَعَ كَلَامَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُ ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-in aḥadun mina l-mush'rikīna is'tajāraka fa-ajir'hu ḥattā yasmaʿa kalāma l-lahi thumma abligh'hu mamanahu dhālika bi-annahum qawmun lā yaʿlamūna And if anyone from the idolaters seeketh protection from thee, grant thou protection to him till he hears the Word of God (This indicates, how particular Islam is about making people hear the Word of God and giving respite to them to ponder over and understand it. The pagans had to be given security to have approach to it, in utter contrast to the other Scriptures. (A.P.).) , then convey him to his place of safety; This because they are a people who know not. Note the toleration exercised by Islam. It is said that at the proclamation of the verses by 'Ali Ibn…

item.title: At-Tawba:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ رَسُولِهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَمَا اسْتَقَامُوا لَكُمْ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ kayfa yakūnu lil'mush'rikīna ʿahdun ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda rasūlihi illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum ʿinda l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi famā is'taqāmū lakum fa-is'taqīmū lahum inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna How shall the polytheists have any [valid] treaty with Allah and His Apostle?! (Barring those with whom you made a treaty at the Holy Mosque; so long as they are steadfast with you, be steadfast with them. Indeed Allah loves the Godwary.)

item.title: At-Tawba:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ رَسُولِهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَمَا اسْتَقَامُوا لَكُمْ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ kayfa yakūnu lil'mush'rikīna ʿahdun ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda rasūlihi illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum ʿinda l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi famā is'taqāmū lakum fa-is'taqīmū lahum inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna How can there be for the polytheists a treaty in the sight of Allah and with His Messenger, except for those with whom you made a treaty at al-Masjid al-Ḥarām? So as long as they are upright toward you,1 be upright toward them. Indeed, Allah loves the righteous (who fear Him). How can there be a covenant with Allah and with His Messenger for the Mushrikin except those with whom you made a covenant near Al-Masjid Al-Haram (at Makkah)? So long as they are true to you, stand you true to them. Verily, Allah…

item.title: At-Tawba:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ رَسُولِهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَمَا اسْتَقَامُوا لَكُمْ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ kayfa yakūnu lil'mush'rikīna ʿahdun ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda rasūlihi illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum ʿinda l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi famā is'taqāmū lakum fa-is'taqīmū lahum inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīna How can there be a covenant for the idolaters with God and with His Apostle except (for) those with whom ye made a covenant at the Sacred Mosque? So long as they stand faithful to you, then be ye too faithful to them; Verily God loveth those who guard themselves (against evil). Note the regard Islam gives to promises and the covenants, be they with the polytheists – and the stress laid on piety.

item.title: At-Tawba:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَيْفَ وَإِنْ يَظْهَرُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوْۤا فِيكُمْ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً يُرْضُونَكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتَأْبٰی قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ kayfa wa-in yaẓharū ʿalaykum lā yarqubū fīkum illan walā dhimmatan yur'ḍūnakum bi-afwāhihim watabā qulūbuhum wa-aktharuhum fāsiqūna How? For if they get the better of you, they will observe toward you neither kinship nor covenant. They please you with their mouths while their hearts spurn you; and most of them are transgressors.

item.title: At-Tawba:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَيْفَ وَإِنْ يَظْهَرُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوْۤا فِيكُمْ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً يُرْضُونَكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتَأْبٰی قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ kayfa wa-in yaẓharū ʿalaykum lā yarqubū fīkum illan walā dhimmatan yur'ḍūnakum bi-afwāhihim watabā qulūbuhum wa-aktharuhum fāsiqūna How (can there be a treaty) while, if they gain dominance over you, they do not observe concerning you any pact of kinship or covenant of protection? They satisfy you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse (compliance), and most of them are defiantly disobedient. How? When if you are overpowered by them, they regard not the ties, either of kinship, ('Ill') or of covenant (Dhimmah)? With their mouths they please you, but their hearts are averse to you, and most of them are rebellious (9:8). Allah encourages the believers to show enmity to the idolators and to dissociate from them, affirming that they do not deserve to…

item.title: At-Tawba:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَيْفَ وَإِنْ يَظْهَرُوْۤا عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوْۤا فِيكُمْ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً يُرْضُونَكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتَأْبٰی قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ kayfa wa-in yaẓharū ʿalaykum lā yarqubū fīkum illan walā dhimmatan yur'ḍūnakum bi-afwāhihim watabā qulūbuhum wa-aktharuhum fāsiqūna How (can there be any alliance!) while they overcome you they regard not in you any tie nor of any covenant; They allure you with (the sweet words of) their mouths while their hearts are averse (from you), and most of them are transgressors. See 9:7

item.title: At-Tawba:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِشْتَرَوْا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ish'taraw biāyāti l-lahi thamanan qalīlan faṣaddū ʿan sabīlihi innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna They have sold the signs of Allah for a paltry gain, and have barred [the people] from His way. Evil indeed is what they have been doing.

item.title: At-Tawba:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِشْتَرَوْا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ish'taraw biāyāti l-lahi thamanan qalīlan faṣaddū ʿan sabīlihi innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna They have exchanged the signs of Allah for a small price and averted (people) from His way. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing. They have purchased with the Ayat of Allah a little gain, and they hindered men from His way; evil indeed is that which they used to do (9:9). With regard to a believer, they respect not the ties, either of kinship or of covenant! It is they who are the transgressors (9:10). But if they repent, perform the Salah and give the Zakah, then they are your brethren in religion. (In this way) We explain the Ayat in detail for a people who know (9:11). Allah admonishes the idolators…

item.title: At-Tawba:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِشْتَرَوْا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ish'taraw biāyāti l-lahi thamanan qalīlan faṣaddū ʿan sabīlihi innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna They have bartered the signs of God for a small price, so they turn others away from His way; Verily evil is what they do. See 9:7

item.title: At-Tawba:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَرْقُبُونَ فِي مُؤْمِنٍ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ lā yarqubūna fī mu'minin illan walā dhimmatan wa-ulāika humu l-muʿ'tadūna They observe toward a believer neither kinship nor covenant, and it is they who are the transgressors.

item.title: At-Tawba:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَرْقُبُونَ فِي مُؤْمِنٍ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ lā yarqubūna fī mu'minin illan walā dhimmatan wa-ulāika humu l-muʿ'tadūna They do not observe toward a believer any pact of kinship or covenant of protection. And it is they who are the transgressors. See 9:9

item.title: At-Tawba:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَرْقُبُونَ فِي مُؤْمِنٍ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ lā yarqubūna fī mu'minin illan walā dhimmatan wa-ulāika humu l-muʿ'tadūna They pay not regard in the case of a believer, to any tie nor to any covenant; and these are they who transgress the limits. See 9:7

item.title: At-Tawba:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَابُوْۤا وَأَقَامُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wanufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna Yet if they repent and maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, then they are your brethren in faith. We elaborate the signs for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: At-Tawba:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَابُوْۤا وَأَقَامُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wanufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna But if they repent, establish prayer, and give zakāh, then they are your brothers in religion; and We detail the verses for a people who know. See 9:9

item.title: At-Tawba:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَابُوْۤا وَأَقَامُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wanufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna But if repent they and establish regular prayer and give away the regular charity, then they are your brethren in faith (Note: mere verbal declaration without the faithful practice of it holds no good.) ; and We explain the signs for the people who know. See 9:7

item.title: At-Tawba:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ نَكَثُوْۤا أَيْمَانَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوْۤا فِي دِينِكُمْ فَقَاتِلُوْۤا أَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَا أَيْمَانَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنْتَهُونَ wa-in nakathū aymānahum min baʿdi ʿahdihim waṭaʿanū fī dīnikum faqātilū a-immata l-kuf'ri innahum lā aymāna lahum laʿallahum yantahūna But if they break their pledges after their having made a treaty and revile your religion, then fight the leaders of unfaith —indeed they have no [commitment to] pledges— maybe they will relinquish.

item.title: At-Tawba:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ نَكَثُوْۤا أَيْمَانَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوْۤا فِي دِينِكُمْ فَقَاتِلُوْۤا أَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَا أَيْمَانَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنْتَهُونَ wa-in nakathū aymānahum min baʿdi ʿahdihim waṭaʿanū fī dīnikum faqātilū a-immata l-kuf'ri innahum lā aymāna lahum laʿallahum yantahūna And if they break their oaths after their treaty and defame your religion, then combat the leaders of disbelief, for indeed, there are no oaths (sacred) to them; (fight them that) they might cease. But if they violate their oaths after their covenant, and attack your religion with disapproval and criticism, then fight (you) against the leaders of disbelief – for surely, their oaths are nothing to them – so that they may stop (evil actions) (9:12). The Oaths of the Leaders of Disbelief Mean Nothing to Them Allah says, if the idolators with whom you conducted peace treaties for an appointed term break:…

item.title: At-Tawba:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ نَكَثُوْۤا أَيْمَانَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوْۤا فِي دِينِكُمْ فَقَاتِلُوْۤا أَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَا أَيْمَانَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنْتَهُونَ wa-in nakathū aymānahum min baʿdi ʿahdihim waṭaʿanū fī dīnikum faqātilū a-immata l-kuf'ri innahum lā aymāna lahum laʿallahum yantahūna And if they violate their oaths after their covenant and revile your religion, then fight the leaders of infidelity, Verily there is no oath (Any solemn promise.) for them, so that they may desist. It is reported from Huzaifa that by the word 'A'immat al-Kufr', i.e., the Imams or the guides of infidelity are meant the people who would appear to fight one of the divinely commissioned Imams or guides. 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib recited this verse on the occasion of the Battle of 'Jamal' (the Camel) and said: "The Holy Prophet had prophesied to me saying, O' 'Ali Thou art of those who…

item.title: At-Tawba:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَكَثُوْۤا أَيْمَانَهُمْ وَهَمُّوْۤا بِإِخْرَاجِ الرَّسُولِ وَهُمْ بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَوْهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ alā tuqātilūna qawman nakathū aymānahum wahammū bi-ikh'rāji l-rasūli wahum badaūkum awwala marratin atakhshawnahum fal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mu'minīna Will you not make war on a people who broke their pledges and resolved to expel the Apostle, and opened [hostilities] against you initially? Do you fear them? But Allah is worthier of being feared by you, should you be faithful.

item.title: At-Tawba:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَكَثُوْۤا أَيْمَانَهُمْ وَهَمُّوْۤا بِإِخْرَاجِ الرَّسُولِ وَهُمْ بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَوْهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ alā tuqātilūna qawman nakathū aymānahum wahammū bi-ikh'rāji l-rasūli wahum badaūkum awwala marratin atakhshawnahum fal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mu'minīna Would you not fight against a people who broke their oaths and determined to expel the Messenger, and they had begun (the attack upon) you the first time? Do you fear them? But Allah has more right that you should fear Him, if you are (truly) believers. Will you not fight a people who have violated their oaths and intended to expel the Messenger while they did attack you first? Do you fear them? Allah has more right that you should fear Him if you are believers (9:13). Fight against them so that Allah will punish them by your hands,…

item.title: At-Tawba:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَكَثُوْۤا أَيْمَانَهُمْ وَهَمُّوْۤا بِإِخْرَاجِ الرَّسُولِ وَهُمْ بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَوْهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ alā tuqātilūna qawman nakathū aymānahum wahammū bi-ikh'rāji l-rasūli wahum badaūkum awwala marratin atakhshawnahum fal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mu'minīna What! will ye not fight the people who violated their oaths and aimed at the expulsion of the Apostle, and they attacked you first; What! do ye fear them? whereas God is the most deserving that ye should fear Him, if ye are believers. See 9:12

item.title: At-Tawba:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَاتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ qātilūhum yuʿadhib'humu l-lahu bi-aydīkum wayukh'zihim wayanṣur'kum ʿalayhim wayashfi ṣudūra qawmin mu'minīna Make war on them so that Allah may punish them by your hands and humiliate them, and help you against them, and heal the hearts of a faithful folk,

item.title: At-Tawba:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَاتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ qātilūhum yuʿadhib'humu l-lahu bi-aydīkum wayukh'zihim wayanṣur'kum ʿalayhim wayashfi ṣudūra qawmin mu'minīna Fight them; Allah will punish them by your hands and will disgrace them and give you victory over them and satisfy the breasts (i.e., desires) of a believing people. See 9:13

item.title: At-Tawba:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَاتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ qātilūhum yuʿadhib'humu l-lahu bi-aydīkum wayukh'zihim wayanṣur'kum ʿalayhim wayashfi ṣudūra qawmin mu'minīna Fight them, that God may chastise (Literally torment, punish.) them by your hands and put them to shame, and help you (to victory) over them and heal (Please.) the (injured) breast (Heart.) of a believer people. See 9:12

item.title: At-Tawba:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wayudh'hib ghayẓa qulūbihim wayatūbu l-lahu ʿalā man yashāu wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun and remove rage from their hearts, and Allah turns clemently to whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

item.title: At-Tawba:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wayudh'hib ghayẓa qulūbihim wayatūbu l-lahu ʿalā man yashāu wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun And remove the fury in their (i.e., the believers') hearts. And Allah turns in forgiveness to whom He wills; and Allah is Knowing and Wise. See 9:13

item.title: At-Tawba:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wayudh'hib ghayẓa qulūbihim wayatūbu l-lahu ʿalā man yashāu wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun And removeth He the rage of the hearts; And God turneth (merciful) unto whomsoever He pleaseth; and Verily God is All-Knowing, All-Wise. See 9:12

item.title: At-Tawba:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تُتْرَكُوْۤا وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوْۤا مِنْكُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِ وَلَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةً وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ am ḥasib'tum an tut'rakū walammā yaʿlami l-lahu alladhīna jāhadū minkum walam yattakhidhū min dūni l-lahi walā rasūlihi walā l-mu'minīna walījatan wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna Do you suppose that you will be let off while Allah has not yet ascertained those of you who wage jihād and those who do not take, besides Allah and His Apostle and the faithful, anyone as [their] confidant? Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: At-Tawba:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تُتْرَكُوْۤا وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوْۤا مِنْكُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِ وَلَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةً وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ am ḥasib'tum an tut'rakū walammā yaʿlami l-lahu alladhīna jāhadū minkum walam yattakhidhū min dūni l-lahi walā rasūlihi walā l-mu'minīna walījatan wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna Do you think that you will be left (as you are) while Allah has not yet made evident those among you who strive (for His cause) and do not take other than Allah, His Messenger and the believers as intimates? And Allah is (fully) Aware of what you do. Do you think that you shall be left alone while Allah has not yet tested those among you who have striven hard and fought, and have not taken Walijah besides Allah and His Messenger, and the believers. Allah is well-acquainted with what you…

item.title: At-Tawba:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تُتْرَكُوْۤا وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوْۤا مِنْكُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِ وَلَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةً وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ am ḥasib'tum an tut'rakū walammā yaʿlami l-lahu alladhīna jāhadū minkum walam yattakhidhū min dūni l-lahi walā rasūlihi walā l-mu'minīna walījatan wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna Or think ye (O' believers!) that ye will be left away while God yet knoweth (Prove or show or make manifest.) not those of you who strove and did not take any one as an intervener besides God, and His Apostle and the believers, And verily God is fully aware of what all ye do. See 9:12

item.title: At-Tawba:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَنْ يَعْمُرُوْۤا مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ شَاهِدِينَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِالْكُفْرِ اُولٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ وَفِي النَّارِ هُمْ خَالِدُونَ mā kāna lil'mush'rikīna an yaʿmurū masājida l-lahi shāhidīna ʿalā anfusihim bil-kuf'ri ulāika ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum wafī l-nāri hum khālidūna The polytheists may not maintain Allah's mosques while they are witness to their own unfaith. Their works have failed, and they shall remain in the Fire [forever].

item.title: At-Tawba:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَنْ يَعْمُرُوْۤا مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ شَاهِدِينَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِالْكُفْرِ اُولٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ وَفِي النَّارِ هُمْ خَالِدُونَ mā kāna lil'mush'rikīna an yaʿmurū masājida l-lahi shāhidīna ʿalā anfusihim bil-kuf'ri ulāika ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum wafī l-nāri hum khālidūna It is not for the polytheists to maintain the mosques of Allah (while) witnessing against themselves with disbelief. (For) those, their deeds have become worthless, and in the Fire they will abide eternally. It is not for the Mushrikin, to maintain the Masjids of Allah, while they witness against themselves of disbelief. The works of such are in vain and in Fire shall they abide (9:17). The Masjids of Allah shall be maintained only by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day; perform the Salah, and give Zakah and fear none but Allah. It is they who are on true guidance (9:18).…

item.title: At-Tawba:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَنْ يَعْمُرُوْۤا مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ شَاهِدِينَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِالْكُفْرِ اُولٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ وَفِي النَّارِ هُمْ خَالِدُونَ mā kāna lil'mush'rikīna an yaʿmurū masājida l-lahi shāhidīna ʿalā anfusihim bil-kuf'ri ulāika ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum wafī l-nāri hum khālidūna It is not for the idolaters to maintain (Arabic 'Amara', literally to renew the old - or to keep up a thing fresh. Regarding mosques it means both upkeep and building as well as its functioning. Therefore, it is restricted neither only to building nor to visiting.) the Mosques of God, themselves bearing witness upon their (own) selves against (their) infidelity; These it is (whose) deeds are made in vain, and in the fire (of Hell) shall they abide. At the end of the Battle of Badr, Abbas, the uncle of the Holy Prophet, and others, were taken captives. The other Muslims admonished the…

item.title: At-Tawba:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَأَقَامَ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتٰی الزَّكَاةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ فَعَسٰی اُولٰٓئِكَ أَنْ يَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ innamā yaʿmuru masājida l-lahi man āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wa-aqāma l-ṣalata waātā l-zakata walam yakhsha illā l-laha faʿasā ulāika an yakūnū mina l-muh'tadīna Only those shall maintain Allah's mosques who believe in Allah and the Last Day, and maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, and fear no one except Allah. They, hopefully, will be among the guided.

item.title: At-Tawba:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَأَقَامَ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتٰی الزَّكَاةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ فَعَسٰی اُولٰٓئِكَ أَنْ يَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ innamā yaʿmuru masājida l-lahi man āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wa-aqāma l-ṣalata waātā l-zakata walam yakhsha illā l-laha faʿasā ulāika an yakūnū mina l-muh'tadīna The mosques of Allah are only to be maintained by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and establish prayer and give zakāh and do not fear except Allah, for it is expected that those will be of the (rightly) guided. See 9:17

item.title: At-Tawba:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَأَقَامَ الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتٰی الزَّكَاةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ فَعَسٰی اُولٰٓئِكَ أَنْ يَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ innamā yaʿmuru masājida l-lahi man āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wa-aqāma l-ṣalata waātā l-zakata walam yakhsha illā l-laha faʿasā ulāika an yakūnū mina l-muh'tadīna Only he shall maintain (Refer to note to verse 9:17. When even the maintenance of a mosque with-out the necessary piety is not accept of what worth can any territorial expansion be, which were done with the political ambitions and the lust for power & glory? with the treachery to the very House of the Holy Prophet inflicting miseries and torturing and killing the holy members of the Ahl Al-Bayt and their devotees.) the Mosques of God who believeth in God and the Last Day, (of requital) and established prayer and giveth away the…

item.title: At-Tawba:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَاجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَجَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَا يَسْتَوُونَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ ajaʿaltum siqāyata l-ḥāji waʿimārata l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi kaman āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wajāhada fī sabīli l-lahi lā yastawūna ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna Do you regard the providing of water to ḥajj pilgrims and the maintenance of the Holy Mosque as similar [in worth] to someone who has faith in Allah and [believes in] the Last Day and wages jihād in the way of Allah? They are not equal with Allah, and Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: At-Tawba:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَاجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَجَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَا يَسْتَوُونَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ ajaʿaltum siqāyata l-ḥāji waʿimārata l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi kaman āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wajāhada fī sabīli l-lahi lā yastawūna ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna Have you made the providing of water for the pilgrim and the maintenance of al-Masjid al-Ḥarām equal to (the deeds of) one who believes in Allah and the Last Day and strives in the cause of Allah? They are not equal in the sight of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people. Do you consider the providing of drinking water to the pilgrims and the maintenance of Al-Masjid Al-Haram as equal to the worth of those who believe in Allah and the Last Day, and strive hard and fight in…

item.title: At-Tawba:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَاجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَجَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَا يَسْتَوُونَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ ajaʿaltum siqāyata l-ḥāji waʿimārata l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi kaman āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wajāhada fī sabīli l-lahi lā yastawūna ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna What! make ye the giving of drink to the pilgrims and maintenance of the Sacred Mosque, equal to the one who believeth in God and the Last Day, (of requital) and striveth in God's way? They are not equal in God's view; and verily God guideth not the unjust people. It is reported by Vahidi and D.M. and the other commentators that once Talha Ibn Shaiba prided over Abbas saying that he is superior to Abbas, for he held the keys of the Ka'ba, meaning, that he was the owner of the…

item.title: At-Tawba:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīli l-lahi bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim aʿẓamu darajatan ʿinda l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-fāizūna Those who have believed and migrated, and waged jihād in the way of Allah with their possessions and persons have a greater rank near Allah, and it is they who are the triumphant.

item.title: At-Tawba:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهَاجَرُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīli l-lahi bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim aʿẓamu darajatan ʿinda l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-fāizūna The ones who have believed, emigrated and striven in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives are greater in rank in the sight of Allah. And it is those who are the attainers (of success). See 9:19

item.title: At-Tawba:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
