item.description: أَوَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ يُفْتَنُونَ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لَا يَتُوبُونَ وَلَا هُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ awalā yarawna annahum yuf'tanūna fī kulli ʿāmin marratan aw marratayni thumma lā yatūbūna walā hum yadhakkarūna See they not that they arc tried once or twice in every year and yet turn they not (unto God) and, and nor do they remember (mind or get warned.) . See 9:123

item.title: At-Tawba:127 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ نَظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ هَلْ يَرَاكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا صَرَفَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ wa-idhā mā unzilat sūratun naẓara baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin hal yarākum min aḥadin thumma inṣarafū ṣarafa l-lahu qulūbahum bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūna And whenever a sūrah is sent down, they look at one another: 'Is anybody observing you?' Then they slip away. Allah has turned aside their hearts, for they are a people who do not understand.

item.title: At-Tawba:127 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ نَظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ هَلْ يَرَاكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا صَرَفَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ wa-idhā mā unzilat sūratun naẓara baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin hal yarākum min aḥadin thumma inṣarafū ṣarafa l-lahu qulūbahum bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūna And whenever a sūrah is revealed, they look at each other, (as if saying), "Does anyone see you?" and then they dismiss themselves. Allah has dismissed their hearts because they are a people who do not understand. See 9:126

item.title: At-Tawba:127 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ نَظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ هَلْ يَرَاكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا صَرَفَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ wa-idhā mā unzilat sūratun naẓara baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin hal yarākum min aḥadin thumma inṣarafū ṣarafa l-lahu qulūbahum bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūna And whenever a 'Sura' is sent down, they cast glances at one another; (saying) "Doth he (the believer) (When a believer (Muslim) sees the hypocrites - they would ask one another if the Muslim had seen any one of them there for, they did not like any Muslim to know their secret meetings and their discourses.) seeth of you anyone?" Then they turn away; God hath turned away their hearts because they are a people who understand not. See 9:123

item.title: At-Tawba:128 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ laqad jāakum rasūlun min anfusikum ʿazīzun ʿalayhi mā ʿanittum ḥarīṣun ʿalaykum bil-mu'minīna raūfun raḥīmun There has certainly come to you an apostle from among yourselves. Grievous to him is your distress; he has deep concern for you, and is most kind and merciful to the faithful.

item.title: At-Tawba:128 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ laqad jāakum rasūlun min anfusikum ʿazīzun ʿalayhi mā ʿanittum ḥarīṣun ʿalaykum bil-mu'minīna raūfun raḥīmun There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; (he is) concerned over you (i.e., your guidance) and to the believers is kind and merciful. Verily, there has come unto you a Messenger from among yourselves. It grieves him that you should receive any injury or difficulty. He is eager for you; for the believers (he is) full of pity, kind, and merciful (9:128). But if they turn away, say: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no God but He, in Him I put my trust and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne (9:129). The Advent of the Prophet SAW…

item.title: At-Tawba:128 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ laqad jāakum rasūlun min anfusikum ʿazīzun ʿalayhi mā ʿanittum ḥarīṣun ʿalaykum bil-mu'minīna raūfun raḥīmun Indeed hath come unto you an Apostle from among your selves; grievous to him is your falling into distress, (he is) solicitous regarding your welfare, towards the faithful (he is) compassionate, (and) merciful. Some of the early reciters of the Holy Qur'an used to stop with the word 'Aziz', which stop means the Prophet Victorious and Triumphant upon all his enemies. "It grieves him your falling into distress" indicates that the sins of the Muslims hurt him, hence the Muslims should see that none of their deeds grieve him in the least.

item.title: At-Tawba:129 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ fa-in tawallaw faqul ḥasbiya l-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi But if they turn their backs [on you], say, 'Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god except Him. In Him I have put my trust and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.'

item.title: At-Tawba:129 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ fa-in tawallaw faqul ḥasbiya l-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi But if they turn away, (O Muḥammad), say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne." See 9:128

item.title: At-Tawba:129 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ fa-in tawallaw faqul ḥasbiya l-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi But (Note: This is a very effective verse - The readers to note - that if in any exigency or difficulty this verse is recited 64 times after any one of the daily prayers for forty days - with purity & concentration - the relief desired is unfailingly achieved - To start the recital & conclude it with 15 times Salawat (Salutation) of the Holy Prophet and His Ahl Al-Bayt (Aal).) if they turn away, Say thou: "Sufficeth me God; There is no god but He; On Him do I rely, and He is the Lord of the great 'Arsh' (i.e. the Glorious Throne of Mighty Power)." A profound study…

item.title: At-Tin:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ wal-tīni wal-zaytūni By the fig and the olive,

item.title: At-Tin:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ wal-tīni wal-zaytūni By the fig and the olive.1 أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ Is not the Allah the best of judges? Meaning: 'is He not the best of judges, Who does not oppress or do any injustice to anyone?' And from His justice is that He will establish the Judgement, and He will give retribution to the person who was wronged in this life against whoever wronged him.

item.title: At-Tin:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ wal-tīni wal-zaytūni By the Fig and the Olive! The names of the things and the events which have been used in the solemn statements in the Holy Qur'an, are mostly symbols of some latent objects, the knowledge of which God has willed to keep it away from the common minds. 'Teen', i.e., Fig, but commentators have given many alternate interpretations which are only conjectures. Ibn-Abbas says i.e., the Fig stands for the Mosque of Noah, and 'Zaitoon', i.e., the Olive, for Jerusalem. 'Balad al-Ameen', i.e., the City of Security, City of the Trusted One the Holy Prophet i.e., Mecca. Fig is known to be the finest, the most wholesome and also the most nutritious fruit used not only as food but a remedy for several bodily complaints. It is taken as a symbol for man's destiny. In its…

item.title: At-Tin:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ waṭūri sīnīna by Mount Sinai,

item.title: At-Tin:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ waṭūri sīnīna And (by) Mount Sinai. See 95:1

item.title: At-Tin:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ waṭūri sīnīna By the Mount Sinai (Refer to: 52:1.) ! 'Seneen', i.e., Sinai - where the Law was given to Moses - See 19:52 and on the Mount Sinai God manifested His glory to Moses and the men who came there asking for the manifestation of God's glory.

item.title: At-Tin:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهَذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ wahādhā l-baladi l-amīni by this secure town:1

item.title: At-Tin:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهَذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ wahādhā l-baladi l-amīni And (by) this secure city (i.e., Makkah). See 95:1

item.title: At-Tin:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهَذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ wahādhā l-baladi l-amīni And by this City (declared) Inviolate (Refer to: 14:35, 3:97.) ! 'Balad al-Ameen' - The city of security - Mecca, where the Final Word of God, the Holy Qur'an, had the start of its revelation. But some say 'Ameen' stands for the Holy Prophet - then it will mean the city (Mecca) where the Holy Prophet, the Last Apostle of God, was born. The people themselves called the Holy Prophet as 'Ameen'.

item.title: At-Tin:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīmin We certainly created man in the best of forms;

item.title: At-Tin:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīmin We have certainly created man in the best of stature.1 See 95:1

item.title: At-Tin:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīmin Indeed, We created man in the best structure 'Ahsan', i.e., the best. 'Taqweem', i.e., the make, the constitution, structure, form, pattern. One who knows the wonderful wisdom with which every part of the human body, with its form, its structure, its faculties and its constitution, which manages the function of each part in perfect harmony with every other and the marvellous faculties, the brain is endowed with, will know the significance of man being referred to in invoking the recognition of the existence of the One with the supreme Wisdom, Power and the Authority who has affected such marvels in the Universe. The make of everything in God's creation is so perfect that there is no room for any change or alternative in it1. Man has been made…

item.title: At-Tin:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ thumma radadnāhu asfala sāfilīna then We relegated him to the lowest of the low,

item.title: At-Tin:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ thumma radadnāhu asfala sāfilīna Then We return him to the lowest of the low.1 See 95:1

item.title: At-Tin:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ thumma radadnāhu asfala sāfilīna Then We reverted (Rendered.) him to the lowest of the low (Refer to: 25:44, 7:179.) When man, the same wonderful and the great work of the Almighty and All-Wise Providence, loses the equilibrium of his conscience and gets lost into the wrong tracks of low passions seeking the satisfaction of the carnal desires, is thrown in the abyss of degradation and ignominy, and fits himself only for the flames of the hell-fire. The same Almighty and All-Wise Author of the laws of nature, Who creates man with such marvellous and excellent gifts of the wonderful strength of mind and body, again manifests the function of His will on the reverse side of the existence that as man advances in age, after reaching the zenith of the development of the endowed faculties, he…

item.title: At-Tin:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. There will be an everlasting reward for them.

item.title: At-Tin:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted. See 95:1

item.title: At-Tin:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin Save those who believe and do good deeds, for them shall be a recompense incessant It is far from real charity to give a thing and take it back. When we give anything to the needy, we do not take it back from them. Would God, having given life to man, take it away from him? No! Man has been created for eternity. He has to work in this world, for the life eternal of his, in the hereafter, to be either in bliss and enjoyment or in misery and suffering. The life in this world is only the chance given to every individual man and woman to prepare or build his or her own heaven or hell. He who believes in…

item.title: At-Tin:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ famā yukadhibuka baʿdu bil-dīni So what makes you deny the Retribution?

item.title: At-Tin:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ famā yukadhibuka baʿdu bil-dīni So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?1 See 95:1

item.title: At-Tin:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ famā yukadhibuka baʿdu bil-dīni (O' Man!) What then can make thee belie after this the Final Judgment? In spite of so much clear evidence given and the doubtless proofs presented, none can ever contradict what the Holy Prophet preached about the Day of Judgment.

item.title: At-Tin:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ alaysa l-lahu bi-aḥkami l-ḥākimīna Is not Allah the fairest of all judges?

item.title: At-Tin:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ alaysa l-lahu bi-aḥkami l-ḥākimīna Is not Allah the most just of judges? See 95:1

item.title: At-Tin:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ alaysa l-lahu bi-aḥkami l-ḥākimīna What! Is not God the Judge of the judges (Refer to: 10:109; 6:57; 2:284; 4:40; 18:49; 21:47.) ? God is the Best of judges to know the truth about each individual being, be that open or concealed. Justice will be meted out to each one according to the individual's merits and demerits. None can ever escape the law of requital which will be strictly followed both in this life as well as in the hereafter.

item.title: At-Tur:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالطُّورِ wal-ṭūri By the Mount [Sinai],

item.title: At-Tur:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالطُّورِ wal-ṭūri By the mount. أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ - اصْلَوْهَا Is this magic or do you not see? Enter therein Meaning: enter the Fire, 'which will encircle you from every direction,' فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. 'whether you endure its torment and afflictions or not, you will never avert it or be saved from it,' إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ You are only being requited for what you used to do. and surely, Allah is never unjust with anyone. Most certainly, Allah recompenses each according to their deeds.

item.title: At-Tur:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالطُّورِ wal-ṭūri By (I swear.) the Mountain 'Tur' (Refer to Verse 95:2.) The adjuration is by five things to assert the certainty of future events in the most emphatic terms in verse 7 to 28 - the coming of judgement and the passing away of this phenomenal world; the future ill consequences of ill deeds; and the future attainment of bliss and complete realisation of Allah's grace and mercy as recompense for good deeds. Tur, i.e., The Mount, The Mount Sinai, which stands for all that happened in the ministry of Moses. There is a mention of it in 95:2.

item.title: At-Tur:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ wakitābin masṭūrin by the Book inscribed

item.title: At-Tur:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ wakitābin masṭūrin And (by) a Book inscribed.1 See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ wakitābin masṭūrin And the Book written The Book inscribed 'The Secured Tablet' called the Lawh al-Mahfooz., Some commentators mean the Holy Qur'an and some others mean Torah which was given to Moses on the Mount Sinai, inscribed on Tablets of Stone. With the exception Tur which clearly refers to Mount Sinai- The rest of the references are to things not terrestrial. The written Book in the lustrous sheet, refers neither to Torah nor to Qur'an nor either to other Scripture in its revealed form. Therefore, the Book will refer to whatever is inscribed on 'Lawh al-Mahfooz', on the Secured Tablet (A.P.).

item.title: At-Tur:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ fī raqqin manshūrin on an unrolled parchment;

item.title: At-Tur:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ fī raqqin manshūrin In parchment spread open. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ fī raqqin manshūrin On a lustrous Parchment outstretched The Scroll unfolded is The Holy Qur'an, which is unfolded by a revelation for the benefit of mankind as a whole and for all times.

item.title: At-Tur:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ wal-bayti l-maʿmūri by the House greatly frequented;1

item.title: At-Tur:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ wal-bayti l-maʿmūri And (by) the frequented House.1 See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ wal-bayti l-maʿmūri And by the House (The Ka'bah.) populated (Visited by frequent worshippers.) Bayt al-Ma'mur (the much-frequented house), the Holy Ka'ba, which is always full of the visitors, the pilgrims, on all days of the year, the Ka'ba which was cleared of the idols in it by the Holy Prophet (S) and Imam ''Ali ('a) and re-dedicated to the worship of the One True God. Some commentators say that by the word 'Bayt', i.e., house, it means the 'Bayt al-Ma'mur' a place of adoration for the heavenly bodies. So, 'Bayt al-Ma'mur' does not refer to any terrestrial sacred place of worship none of which is ever filled with worshippers all the days of the year; but it refers to the heavenly place of worship as narrated by ''Ali Ibn Abi Talib ('a): "The heavenly place of worship which…

item.title: At-Tur:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ wal-saqfi l-marfūʿi by the vault raised high,

item.title: At-Tur:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ wal-saqfi l-marfūʿi And (by) the ceiling (i.e., heaven) raised high. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ wal-saqfi l-marfūʿi And by the Roof (Refer to Verses 16:26; 21:32.) elevated (Something beyond the physical expanse.) "The roof elevated" is the canopy of heaven, to whose height or sublimity no limit can be assigned by the mind of man. The nebular ocean refers to the beyond physical expanse. Except Tur, all above-noted signs or things are celestial.

item.title: At-Tur:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ wal-baḥri l-masjūri by the surging sea:1

item.title: At-Tur:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ wal-baḥri l-masjūri And (by) the sea set on fire.1 See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ wal-baḥri l-masjūri And by the Sea (Refer to Verses 40:72; 81:6.) boiling The Nebular Oceans within the heart of the earth, within the suns - and the other heavenly bodies (A.P.).

item.title: At-Tur:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿun indeed your Lord's punishment will surely befall.

item.title: At-Tur:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿun Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿun Verily the chastisement of thy Lord shall indeed come to pass Verses 7 to 10 illustrate with the solemnity the reference to the above great things of wonder which are facts, the coming Doom from God also, is assured as a reality which shall come to pass.

item.title: At-Tur:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَهُ مِنْ دَافِعٍ mā lahu min dāfiʿin There is none who can avert it.

item.title: At-Tur:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَهُ مِنْ دَافِعٍ mā lahu min dāfiʿin Of it there is no preventer. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَهُ مِنْ دَافِعٍ mā lahu min dāfiʿin There is none to repel (Refer to Verse 70:2.) it See 52:7

item.title: At-Tur:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا yawma tamūru l-samāu mawran On the day when the sky whirls violently,

item.title: At-Tur:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا yawma tamūru l-samāu mawran On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا yawma tamūru l-samāu mawran On the Day (The happenings on the eve of the Resurrection for the Final Judgment.) when the heaven shall reel a (Terrible) reeling (Refer to Verses 82:1; 84:1.) See 52:7

item.title: At-Tur:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا watasīru l-jibālu sayran and the mountains move with an awful motion:

item.title: At-Tur:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا watasīru l-jibālu sayran And the mountains will pass on, departing1. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا watasīru l-jibālu sayran And the mountains shall fly an (awful) flight (Refer to Verses 81:3; 77:10; 78:20.) See 52:7

item.title: At-Tur:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ fawaylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna woe to the deniers on that day

item.title: At-Tur:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ fawaylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Then woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ fawaylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna Woe then that day unto those who belie the Truth (Refer to Verses 70:6 - 70:10; 83:10.) The day of reckoning will be a day of woe to the unjust who belied the signs of Allah, just as it will be a day of joy and bliss to the righteous believers. Every evil thought or deed has its own retributive and punishable chain of consequences. Whatever is done in this life is a preparation for the hereafter, which the disbelievers will find a reality after the day of judgement, not a farce. They did not take notice of the signs of Allah nor paid attention to the warnings the messengers of Allah gave them, so there will be no time for repentance. They will roast in hell, whether they endure it or not.

item.title: At-Tur:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ alladhīna hum fī khawḍin yalʿabūna —those who play around in vain talk,

item.title: At-Tur:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ alladhīna hum fī khawḍin yalʿabūna Who are in (empty) discourse amusing themselves. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ alladhīna hum fī khawḍin yalʿabūna Those who, in vain sport (In discourse.) do play The reference is to those who ridicule the warnings about the day of requital, and spend their time in sport and vain amusements, the time which everyone has to avail of, to prepare for himself for the life hereafter specially to give the account of his life, to the Lord.

item.title: At-Tur:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿan the day when they will be shoved toward the fire of hell forcibly,

item.title: At-Tur:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿan The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a (violent) thrust, (its angels will say). See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿan The Day on which they shall be driven unto the hell-fire with a violent drive See 52:12

item.title: At-Tur:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ hādhihi l-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūna [and told:] 'This is the Fire which you used to deny!'

item.title: At-Tur:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ hādhihi l-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūna "This is the Fire which you used to deny. See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ hādhihi l-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūna [And it shall be said unto them]: 'This is the Fire (Refer to Verse 36:63.) which ye used to belie' See 52:12

item.title: At-Tur:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūna Is this then magic, or is it you who do not perceive?

item.title: At-Tur:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūna Then is this magic, or do you not see? See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūna What! Is it sorcery then? Or ye see it not? The disbelievers would then be asked, if they now realise that the warnings that the apostles of God, gave them about the Day of Judgment, were not fake or false but truth which they see with their own eyes.

item.title: At-Tur:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْۤا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna 'Enter it, and whether you are patient or impatient it will be the same for you. You are only being requited for what you used to do.'

item.title: At-Tur:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْۤا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna (Enter to) burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed (for) what you used to do." See 52:1

item.title: At-Tur:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْۤا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna Enter ye into it then be ye patient, or be ye not patient, alike shall it be unto you; certainly, shall ye be recompensed what ye used to do In the worldly punishment one is punished for an act but in the natural punishment one receives, which one does here, i.e., the final shape of what the actions assume (A.P.). The righteous believers will be in the land of eternal bliss. By their own effort and striving they won Allah's grace and mercy.

item.title: At-Tur:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaʿīmin Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and bliss,

item.title: At-Tur:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaʿīmin Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure. Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in Gardens and Delight (52:17). Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire (52:18). Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do (52:19). They will recline on thrones Masfufah. And We shall marry them to Hur (fair females) with wide lovely eyes (52:20). Description of the Destination of the Happy Allah the Exalted described the destination of the happy ones: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in Gardens and Delight. in contrast to the torment and punishment of the miserable; فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ Enjoying in that…

item.title: At-Tur:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaʿīmin Verily the pious ones shall be in the gardens (Of Paradise.) amidst the bounties (therein) Everyone, as an individual, will have full satisfaction (in whatever he or she does) dignity and joy of companionship. Every one will be purified but will not be merged into one sameness. There will be a general social satisfaction shared with all whom they loved in this earthly life, all near and dear ones, provided they had believed and done good deeds, because each individual is responsible for his conduct and none shall bear another's burden, as stressed in 2:48, 2:123, 2:254; 6:164; 17:15; 35:18; 39:7 and 53:38. Relationship of this life has no value in the hereafter unless it is sanctioned by the ties of true faith.

item.title: At-Tur:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi rejoicing because of what their Lord has given them, and that their Lord has saved them from the punishment of hell.

item.title: At-Tur:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire. See 52:17

item.title: At-Tur:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi Rejoicing in what gave them their Lord, and saved them their Lord from the chastisement of the Hell See 52:17

item.title: At-Tur:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna [They will be told:] 'Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.'

item.title: At-Tur:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna (They will be told), "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do." See 52:17

item.title: At-Tur:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna (It will be said unto them)'. "Eat ye and drink ye in health and delight for what ye used to do'" See 52:17

item.title: At-Tur:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ muttakiīna ʿalā sururin maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin They will be reclining on arrayed couches, and We will wed them to big-eyed houris.

item.title: At-Tur:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ muttakiīna ʿalā sururin maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, (beautiful) eyes. See 52:17

item.title: At-Tur:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ muttakiīna ʿalā sururin maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin Reclining on thrones ranged; And We will unite (Make their offsprings follow them in their goodness thus multiply or add the reward of one with that of the other, for both of them.) them with Huries (maidens pure) with large (lovely) eyes (Refer to Verses 37:48 - 37:49; 44:54; 55:56; 55:72 56:22; 56:35 - 56:37.) Though the Hoor or the Ghilman, would not be the beings, same as the imperfect, impure and the mortal human beings of this life, they are beings, purity and beauty embodied who could not be aptly explained with comparison to anything in this world which could not be compared to that of the hereafter. Make their offspring follow them in their goodness1.

item.title: At-Tur:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnun The faithful and their descendants who followed them in faith —We will make their descendants join them, and We will not stint anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Every man is a hostage to what he has earned.

item.title: At-Tur:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnun And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.1 Every person, for what he earned, is retained.2 And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in faith, – to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned (52:21). And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire (52:22). There they shall pass from hand to…

item.title: At-Tur:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnun And those who believe and follow them their offspring in faith, We will unite (Make their offsprings follow them in their goodness thus multiply or add the reward of one with that of the other, for both of them.) with them their offspring and We will lessen not unto them aught of their (good) deeds; Every man shall for what he hath wrought, be responsible (Refer to Verses 53:39; 74:38.) Note the doctrine of the personal responsibility of every individual man or woman – None shall bear the burden of the other - This aspect of the individual responsibility, the realization of…

item.title: At-Tur:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatin walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūna We will provide them with fruits and meat, such as they desire.

item.title: At-Tur:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatin walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūna And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire. See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatin walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūna And We will provide with fruits and flesh of what they desire (What they would be pleased to have. Refer to Verses 56:20; 56:21.) See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasan lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmun There they will pass from hand to hand a cup wherein there will be neither any vain talk nor sinful speech.

item.title: At-Tur:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasan lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmun They will exchange with one another a cup (of wine) wherein (results) no ill speech or commission of sin. See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasan lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmun They shall pass therein to one another a cup (Of drink which would not corrupt the mind or affect the health) wherein shall not be any vanity nor a sin (Refer to Verse 56:25.) See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَكْنُونٌ wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānun lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-on maknūnun They will be waited upon by youths, their own, as if they were guarded pearls.

item.title: At-Tur:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَكْنُونٌ wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānun lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-on maknūnun There will circulate among them (servant) boys (especially) for them, as if they were pearls well-protected. See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَكْنُونٌ wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānun lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-on maknūnun And there shall go around them (serving them) youths (handsome) as if they are imbedded pearls (Refer to Verses 56:17; 76:19.) See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna They will turn to one another, questioning each other.

item.title: At-Tur:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other. See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna And some shall accost the others making mutual enquiries See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīna They will say, 'Indeed, aforetime, we used to be apprehensive about our families.

item.title: At-Tur:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīna They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful (of displeasing Allah). See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīna They will say: 'Verily we feared ere (this) in regard to our families' See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba l-samūmi But Allah showed us favour and He saved us from the punishment of the [infernal] miasma;

item.title: At-Tur:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba l-samūmi So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire. See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba l-samūmi But God hath bestowed His grace on us, and He hath saved us from the chastisement of the scorching wind See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru l-raḥīmu indeed we used to supplicate Him aforetime. Indeed He is the All-benign, the All-merciful.'

item.title: At-Tur:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru l-raḥīmu Indeed, we used to supplicate1 Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful." See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru l-raḥīmu Verily, we used ere this to call upon Him; Verily, He is the Benign, the Most Merciful See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūnin So admonish. By your Lord's blessing, you are not a soothsayer, nor mad.

item.title: At-Tur:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūnin So remind, (O Muḥammad), for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman. Therefore, remind. By the grace of Allah, you are neither a Kahin nor a madman (52:29). Or do they say: "A poet! We await for him some calamity by time! (52:30). Say: "Wait! I am with you among those who wait! (52:31). Or do their minds command them this or are they people transgressing all bounds (52:32). Or do they say: "He has forged it?" Nay! They believe not (52:33). Let them then produce a recitation like unto it if they are truthful (52:34). Absolving the Prophet SAW of the False Accusations the Idolators Made against Him Allah the Exalted commands His Messenger SAW to…

item.title: At-Tur:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūnin So thou remind on (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) for thou, by the grace (Bounty.) of thy Lord (on thee), art neither a soothsayer, nor a mad man See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūni Do they say, '[He is] a poet, for whom we await a fatal accident'?

item.title: At-Tur:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūni Or do they say (of you), "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?1 See 52:29

item.title: At-Tur:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūni Or say they (about thee O' Our Apostle!) 'A poet (is he)! Let us wait (What the people said.) for him (The Holy Prophet.) some fatal adversity (Death.) (drawn) by time!' See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīna Say, 'Wait! I too am waiting along with you.'

item.title: At-Tur:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīna Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters." See 52:29

item.title: At-Tur:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!). "Wait ye, and verily I too with you am of those who wait' (Refer to Verses 9:15 and 9:52.)" See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهَذَا أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūna Is it their intellect which prompts them to [say] this, or are they a rebellious lot?

item.title: At-Tur:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهَذَا أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūna Or do their minds1 command them to (say) this, or are they a transgressing people? See 52:29

item.title: At-Tur:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهَذَا أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūna Or is it that bid them their deliberations, to do this, or are they an inordinate (Rebels.) people? See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَلْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūna Do they say, 'He has improvised it [himself]?' Rather they have no faith!

item.title: At-Tur:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَلْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūna Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe. See 52:29

item.title: At-Tur:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَلْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūna Or say they (that): 'He (The Holy Prophet.) hath forged it (the Qur'an)? Nay! they believe not (Refer to Verses 69:41 - 69:47.) ' See 52:21

item.title: At-Tur:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِثْلِهِ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ falyatū biḥadīthin mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīna Let them bring a discourse like it, if they are truthful.

item.title: At-Tur:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِثْلِهِ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ falyatū biḥadīthin mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīna Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful. See 52:29

item.title: At-Tur:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِثْلِهِ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ falyatū biḥadīthin mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīna Let them then bring a dis-course like unto it, if they be truthful (Refer to Verses 2:23; 10:38; 11:13.) Of all the religious scriptures of the world which claim to be heavenly or sacred in any other way, the Holy Qur'an is the only Scripture which has repeatedly challenged its disbelievers to bring a part of its kind and about 1400 years have elapsed and yet none could reply to it. This is one of the living miracles of the Holy Qur'an that its text is inimitable, even from the literary aspect of its beauty and superiority and none could corrupt it nor effect any change in its arrangement1.

item.title: At-Tur:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خُلِقُوْۤا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūna Were they created from nothing? Or are they [their own] creators?

item.title: At-Tur:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خُلِقُوْۤا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūna Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators (of themselves)? Or were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators (52:35). Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm belief (52:36). Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like (52:37). Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof (52:38). Or has He only daughters and you have sons (52:39). Or is it that you ask a wage from them so that they are burdened with a load of debt (52:40). Or that the Unseen is…

item.title: At-Tur:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خُلِقُوْۤا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūna Or were they created by nothing? Or are they themselves the creators? (See note on the Existence of God in the introduction.) The disbelievers are asked that if they believed, that they had been created without a Creator or without any purpose. This lays the fundamental axiom which is one of the and scientific propositions are based - that an effect of a phenomenon or by itself (A.P.).

item.title: At-Tur:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خَلَقُوْۤا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بَلْ لَا يُوقِنُونَ am khalaqū l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūna Did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather they have no certainty!

item.title: At-Tur:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خَلَقُوْۤا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بَلْ لَا يُوقِنُونَ am khalaqū l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūna Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain. See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ خَلَقُوْۤا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بَلْ لَا يُوقِنُونَ am khalaqū l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūna Or created they the heavens and the earth? Nay! they have no certainty (Firmness of belief.) See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūna Do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of their dispensation]?

item.title: At-Tur:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūna Or have they the depositories (containing the provision) of your Lord? Or are they the controllers (of them)? See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūna Or with them are the treasures of thy Lord, Or hold they the absolute authority? See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِیْهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ am lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānin mubīnin Do they have a ladder [leading up to heaven] whereby they eavesdrop?1 If so let their eavesdropper produce a manifest authority.

item.title: At-Tur:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِیْهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ am lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānin mubīnin Or have they a stairway (into the heaven) upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority (i.e., proof). See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِیْهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ am lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānin mubīnin Or for them is a ladder by which they can (climb up into the heaven and) listen (to the angels)? Then let the listener of theirs bring a proof manifest Or is it that they have any ladder to get into basic foundations on which all philosophic cannot come into being out of nothing heaven to know the secrets1. This applies to those who claim that besides the logical method of the approach to the moral, social and theological problems, they have special ways of direct communion or direct touch with the divine sources. Claims of such nature have no value unless it is supported by clear and irrefutable evidence, such as miracles (A.P.).

item.title: At-Tur:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūna Does He have daughters while you have sons?1

item.title: At-Tur:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūna Or has He daughters while you have sons? See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūna Or for Him are daughters and for ye sons? (Refer to Verses 16:57; 43:16.) See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are weighed down with debt?

item.title: At-Tur:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna Or do you, (O Muḥammad), ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down? See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna Or thou asketh of them any recompense, that they are burdened with the weight of debt? (Refer to Verse 68:46.) See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna Do they have [access to] the Unseen, which they write down?

item.title: At-Tur:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna Or have they (knowledge of) the unseen, so they write (it) down? See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna Or with them is the unseen that they write it down? (Refer to Verse 68:47.) See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūna Do they seek to outmaneuver [Allah]? But it is the faithless who are the outmaneuvered ones!

item.title: At-Tur:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūna Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan. See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūna Or intend they to lay (Scheming.) snares for thee? But those who disbelieve are themselves the snared ones See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna Do they have any god other than Allah? Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: At-Tur:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. See 52:35

item.title: At-Tur:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna Or for them is a god other than God? Hallowed is God from what they associate (Creating equals to Him - False Gods - Worshipping angels as the daughters and Jesus as the Son of God.) (with Him) See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوْۤا سَحَابٌ مَرْكُومٌ wa-in yaraw kis'fan mina l-samāi sāqiṭan yaqūlū saḥābun markūmun Were they to see a fragment falling from the sky, they would say, 'A cumulous cloud.'

item.title: At-Tur:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوْۤا سَحَابٌ مَرْكُومٌ wa-in yaraw kis'fan mina l-samāi sāqiṭan yaqūlū saḥābun markūmun And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,1 they would say, "(It is merely) clouds heaped up." And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: Clouds gathered in heaps! (52:44). So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror) (52:45). The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all, nor will they be helped (52:46). And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment before this; but most of them know not (52:47). So wait patiently for the decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes; and glorify the praises of your Lord…

item.title: At-Tur:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوْۤا سَحَابٌ مَرْكُومٌ wa-in yaraw kis'fan mina l-samāi sāqiṭan yaqūlū saḥābun markūmun And if they see a portion of the heaven coming down, they would say: '(they are) clouds piled up (Refer to Verse 26:187.) ' See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يُصْعَقُونَ fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūna So leave them until they encounter their day on which they will be thunderstruck;

item.title: At-Tur:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يُصْعَقُونَ fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūna So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible. See 52:44

item.title: At-Tur:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يُصْعَقُونَ fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūna Leave them then until they encounter the Day of theirs where-in they shall be smitten (With Thunderbolt.) (with terror) to swoon (Refer to Verse 39:68.) See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayan walā hum yunṣarūna the day when their guile will not avail them in any way, nor will they be helped.

item.title: At-Tur:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayan walā hum yunṣarūna The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped. See 52:44

item.title: At-Tur:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayan walā hum yunṣarūna A day wherein their devices shall avail them not aught, nor shall they be helped See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna Indeed for those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that, but most of them do not know.

item.title: At-Tur:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment1 before that, but most of them do not know. See 52:44

item.title: At-Tur:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna And verily for those who did injustice there shall be a chastisement besides that, but most of them know it not See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūmu So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, for indeed you fare before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise [at dawn],

item.title: At-Tur:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūmu And be patient, (O Muḥammad), for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes (i.e., sight). And exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord when you arise. See 52:44

item.title: At-Tur:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūmu And wait thou patiently for the command of thy Lord, for verily thou art before Our (Purview.) eyes, and celebrate thou the praise of thy Lord when thou risest (Thus, every act of the Holy Prophet will be the view of the Lord. Refer to Verses 50:39 - 50:40.) See 52:38

item.title: At-Tur:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūmi and also glorify Him during the night and at the receding of the stars.

item.title: At-Tur:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūmi And in a part of the night exalt Him and after (the setting of) the stars. See 52:44

item.title: At-Tur:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūmi And in the night too, celebrate thou His Glory and at the setting of the stars About spending a part of the night in prayer, see Verses 17:78 - 17:79. And at the setting of the stars, see Verse 113:1.

item.title: Az-Zalzala:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا idhā zul'zilati l-arḍu zil'zālahā When the earth is rocked with a terrible quake

item.title: Az-Zalzala:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا idhā zul'zilati l-arḍu zil'zālahā When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake. يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups (Ashtat) Meaning: they will return from the station of the Judgement in separate groups. This means that they will be divided into types and categories: between those who are miserable and those who are happy, and those who are commanded to go to Paradise and those who are commanded to go to the Hellfire. As-Suddi said, "Ashtat means sects." Allah said: لِّيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ that they may be shown their deeds. Meaning: so that they may act and be rewarded for what they did in this life of good and evil. The Recompense for Every Minute Deed Therefore, Allah goes on to say: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ - وَمَن يَعْمَلْ…

item.title: Az-Zalzala:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا idhā zul'zilati l-arḍu zil'zālahā When the earth shall quake with her (terrible) quaking (See 70:7 - 70:9.) These verses 1-4 refer to the violent effects of destruction and disaster the earth will suffer on the Day of Judgment. See Chapter 88. The whole earth will be quaked and getting reduced to nothing bursting and throwing out all its contents, even the heaviest of them.

item.title: Az-Zalzala:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا wa-akhrajati l-arḍu athqālahā and the earth discharges her burdens,

item.title: Az-Zalzala:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا wa-akhrajati l-arḍu athqālahā And the earth discharges its burdens.1 See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا wa-akhrajati l-arḍu athqālahā And the earth bringeth forth her burdens See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا لَهَا waqāla l-insānu mā lahā and man says, 'What is the matter with her?'

item.title: Az-Zalzala:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا لَهَا waqāla l-insānu mā lahā And man says,1 "What is (wrong) with it?". See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا لَهَا waqāla l-insānu mā lahā And man shall say: ''What hath happened to her (Earth.) ? Since the disaster will overtake the world all of a sudden, the sudden upheaval and the uprooting of the mountains and the strongest structures on earth and the convulsion of the earth as a whole will only confound man who will be plunged into a terrific surprise.

item.title: Az-Zalzala:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا yawma-idhin tuḥaddithu akhbārahā On that day she will relate her chronicles

item.title: Az-Zalzala:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا yawma-idhin tuḥaddithu akhbārahā That Day, it will report its news. See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا yawma-idhin tuḥaddithu akhbārahā On that day she shall relate her news (about all that happened on her) The earth will declare aloud what all had happened on it. Tamim Ibn Hatim says ''Once we went to Basra and while we were about to camp, a quake of earth was felt. We were all panicky, but Ali got down from his camel and placing his hand on the ground addressing the earth, said, 'What hast happened to thee.' The quaking stopped. Lady Fatimah reports that once in Madina an earthquake was felt and the people got panicky and rushed to Abu-Bakr and Omar who took the whole multitude to the door of Ali and Ali came out with perfect peace of mind and took the people outside Madina and sitting on a mound, addressed the huge crowd and…

item.title: Az-Zalzala:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَى لَهَا bi-anna rabbaka awḥā lahā for her Lord will have inspired her.

item.title: Az-Zalzala:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَى لَهَا bi-anna rabbaka awḥā lahā Because your Lord has inspired (i.e., commanded) it. See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَى لَهَا bi-anna rabbaka awḥā lahā That thy Lord hath revealed unto her (Earth – See note.) The word of command from the Almighty Lord would have brought the dissolutive and disastrous effect and the deeds done openly or secretly will be laid bare in the full light of the day. 'Wahi' or the revelation or instruction or command need not always be through an angel1. This verse indicates the extent of the divine revelation and that even the earth shall have some sort of receiving the revelation. (A.P.).

item.title: Az-Zalzala:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ yawma-idhin yaṣduru l-nāsu ashtātan liyuraw aʿmālahum On that day, mankind will issue forth in various groups1 to be shown their deeds.

item.title: Az-Zalzala:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ yawma-idhin yaṣduru l-nāsu ashtātan liyuraw aʿmālahum That Day, the people will depart1 separated (into categories) to be shown (the result of) their deeds. See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ yawma-idhin yaṣduru l-nāsu ashtātan liyuraw aʿmālahum On that day shall come out people (from their graves) in (scattered) groups, to be shown their own deeds (Refer to: 82:4 - This is the first stage of the total resurrection.) Since the day of the Final Judgment will be the day of sorting out the good and the evil stuff in humanity - the dead will be divided into groups of good and bad according to the various levels of their merits and demerits, and rising from their graves, rush to see to know what is there for them by way of their own earning in this world, in the records of their own deeds1. This is the first stage of the Total Resurrection. (A.P.).

item.title: Az-Zalzala:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ faman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin khayran yarahu So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

item.title: Az-Zalzala:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ faman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin khayran yarahu So whoever does an atom's weight1 of good will see it. See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ faman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin khayran yarahu Then he who hath done an atom-weight of good shall See it (Note: - What a great encouragement. Refer to: 55:60.) Note: how man is warned of the strictness with which he will he dealt with in the accounting for his deeds. Even the smallest deed, good or evil, will not escape the accounting and will be duly recompensed, and no one will be able to bear the burden of the other1. In this state every individual will realise his own deeds - good or bad - and the last stage of the resurrection is the judging of the actions, as a whole, i.e., the last stage of 'Shafa'at al-Kubra'. These verses have been taken as to signify that our action here, assumes concrete forms on the resurrection…

item.title: Az-Zalzala:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ waman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin sharran yarahu and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

item.title: Az-Zalzala:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ waman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin sharran yarahu And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it. See 99:1

item.title: Az-Zalzala:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ waman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin sharran yarahu And he who hath done an atom-weight of evil shall see it (Note: - What a great Warning - Refer to: 55:60.) See 99:7

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Mīm.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Meem.1 فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا Then We destroyed men stronger than these means, 'We destroyed those who disbelieved in the Messengers, and they were stronger in power than these who disbelieve in you, O Muhammad.' This is like the Ayah: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً Have they not traveled through the earth and seen what was the end of those before them? They were more in number than them and mightier in strength (40:82) And there are many similar Ayat. وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ and the example of the ancients has passed away. Mujahid said, "The way of their life." Qatadah said, "Their punishment." Others said, "Their lesson," i.e., 'We made them a lesson for those disbelievers who came after them, that they would suffer the…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ha. Mim. (H. M.) See 43:2

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ wal-kitābi l-mubīni By the Manifest Book:

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ wal-kitābi l-mubīni By the clear Book. See 43:1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ wal-kitābi l-mubīni By the Book Manifesting, By the Book (the Holy Qur'an) which makes manifest and plain the truth and the laws of the human discipline on earth. This verse and the similar other verses clearly indicate what was revealed or given to the Holy Prophet was a Book in its fullness, not mere verses for the people to put it into a book form.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna We have made it an Arabic Qur'ān so that you may apply reason,

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand. See 43:1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna Verily, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that ye may understand. The Holy Qur'an was revealed in the Arabic language so that the people to whom it was first conveyed might understand the truth fully and then convey the same to mankind in the other parts of the world.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-innahu fī ummi l-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīmun and indeed it is with Us in the Mother Book [and it is] surely sublime and wise.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-innahu fī ummi l-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīmun And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book1 with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.2 See 43:1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wa-innahu fī ummi l-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīmun And verily it is in the Mother-Book (which is) with Us, Most Exalted (The same attribute. Refer to verse 42:51.) (it is), full of Wisdom. 'Ummul Kitab' the Mother Book, i.e., the Secured Tablet from which gets out all knowledge.1 The Opening Chapter is also called the 'Ummul Kitab' for it contains in essence, the whole matter of the Holy Qur'an in a nutshell, i.e., the Original Source of the Holy Qur'an. It also means that the original of this Holy Book is secured and none can ever make it extinct.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُسْرِفِينَ afanaḍribu ʿankumu l-dhik'ra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawman mus'rifīna Shall We withhold the Reminder from you unconcernedly, because you are a profligate lot?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُسْرِفِينَ afanaḍribu ʿankumu l-dhik'ra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawman mus'rifīna Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people? See 43:1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُسْرِفِينَ afanaḍribu ʿankumu l-dhik'ra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawman mus'rifīna What! Shall We then turn away from you the Reminder wholly for ye are a people extravagant? 'Reminder', i.e., the Holy Qur'an. Since the people ridicule the apostles and reject their messages, should God also be unmerciful and refrain from revealing His word which, if a few of the people did not like it, others would surely be benefited, and if one generation does not avail of it duly, the other one might do it.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ wakam arsalnā min nabiyyin fī l-awalīna How many a prophet We have sent to the ancients!

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ wakam arsalnā min nabiyyin fī l-awalīna And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples. See 43:1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ wakam arsalnā min nabiyyin fī l-awalīna And how many did We send of Our prophets among those gone before. (The ancients.) See 43:5

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
