item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wamā yatīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna There did not come to them any prophet but that they used to deride him.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wamā yatīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. See 43:1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wamā yatīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna And there came not unto them a prophet but at him they used to mock. See 43:5

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا وَمَضَى مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ fa-ahlaknā ashadda min'hum baṭshan wamaḍā mathalu l-awalīna So We destroyed those who were stronger than these,1 and the example of the ancients has passed.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا وَمَضَى مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ fa-ahlaknā ashadda min'hum baṭshan wamaḍā mathalu l-awalīna And We destroyed greater than them1 in (striking) power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded. See 43:1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا وَمَضَى مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ fa-ahlaknā ashadda min'hum baṭshan wamaḍā mathalu l-awalīna Then We did destroy those mightier than these in strength, and hath gone (such) examples among those gone before. See 43:5

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu If you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will surely say, 'The All-mighty, the All-knowing created them.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing." And indeed if you ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" They will surely say: "The All-Mighty, the All-Knower created them (43:9). Who has made for you the earth like a bed, and has made for you roads therein, in order that you may find your way (43:10). And Who sends down water from the sky in due measure, then We revive a dead land therewith, and even so you will be brought forth (43:11). And Who has created all the pairs and has appointed for you ships and…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu And if thou shouldst ask them: "Who created the heavens and the earth?" certainly would they say: "Created them the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing," It is a challenging fact that even if it be asked of the disbelievers as to who created the heaven and the earth, they could not help declaring it with perfect conviction at their heart saying it is God Who has created them, i.e., the exclusive propriety of God as the Creator of the Universe is such an undeniable fact that every one in the world knows it, be he a believer in Him or a disbeliever even.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulan laʿallakum tahtadūna He, who made the earth a cradle for you and made in it ways for you, so that you may be guided [to your destinations],

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulan laʿallakum tahtadūna (The one) who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided. See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulan laʿallakum tahtadūna He Who made for you the earth (as) a cradle (Or a couch.) and hath made therein ways for you that ye might be guided aright. See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنْشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ wa-alladhī nazzala mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika tukh'rajūna and who sent down water from the sky in a measured manner, and We revived with it a dead country. (Likewise you [too] shall be raised [from the dead].)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنْشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ wa-alladhī nazzala mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika tukh'rajūna And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth. See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنْشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ wa-alladhī nazzala mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika tukh'rajūna And He Who sendeth down water from the heavens in a measure; then raise We with it a country which is dead (dried), even so shall ye be brought forth (from your graves on the Day of Resurrection) See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ wa-alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mina l-ful'ki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūna And who created all the kinds1 and made for you the ships and the cattle such as you ride,

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ wa-alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mina l-ful'ki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūna And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount. See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ wa-alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mina l-ful'ki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūna And He who created pairs in all things and made for you of the ships and the cattle that ye may ride on, See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَى ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurū niʿ'mata rabbikum idhā is'tawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū sub'ḥāna alladhī sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muq'rinīna that you may sit on their backs, then remember the blessing of your Lord when you are settled on them, and say, 'Immaculate is He who has disposed this for us, and we [by ourselves] were no match for it.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَى ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurū niʿ'mata rabbikum idhā is'tawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū sub'ḥāna alladhī sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muq'rinīna That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have (otherwise) subdued it.1 See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَى ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurū niʿ'mata rabbikum idhā is'tawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū sub'ḥāna alladhī sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muq'rinīna That ye may mount (Settle – Take position.) on their backs, then remember ye the bounty of your Lord, and when ye mount (Settle – Take position.) on it and say ye: Hallowed is He Who subjected this unto us, and we (by ourselves) were not able to attain (Capable of Subjugating or Subduing them or making them yield to us.) this, Settle - take position - 'Istawa' means to dominate - to mount - to take an equidistant position, i.e., Central - In no place has been used in the sense of mere sitting. This is the actual sense…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ wa-innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna Indeed we shall return to our Lord.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ wa-innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna And indeed we, to our Lord, will (surely) return." See 43:9

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ wa-innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna And verily We, unto our Lord, shall return, (Are returning.) See 43:13

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوْۤا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُبِينٌ wajaʿalū lahu min ʿibādihi juz'an inna l-insāna lakafūrun mubīnun They ascribe to Him offspring1 from among His servants! Man is indeed a manifest ingrate.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوْۤا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُبِينٌ wajaʿalū lahu min ʿibādihi juz'an inna l-insāna lakafūrun mubīnun But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.1 Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful. Yet, they assign to some of His servants a share with Him. Verily, man is indeed a manifest ingrate (43:15). Or has He taken daughters out of what He has created, and He has selected for you sons (43:16). And if one of them is informed of the news of that which he sets forth as a parable to the Most Gracious, his face becomes dark, and he is filled with grief (43:17). A creature who is brought up in adornments, and who in dispute cannot make itself clear (43:18). And they make females the angels who themselves are servants of the Most Gracious. Did they…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوْۤا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُبِينٌ wajaʿalū lahu min ʿibādihi juz'an inna l-insāna lakafūrun mubīnun And (yet) they assign (Man generally ascribes some human aspects to the Absolute.) unto (some) of His servants a partnership with Him; Verily man is an open ingrate! Generally, asserts that some human aspects for the absolute. So it is anthropomorphism in some way or other, in crude or a refined way, it is very difficult for man to escape from that tendency - this is the reason that Qur'an insists that nothing should be attributed to God but that which has been revealed. (A.P.).

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُمْ بِالْبَنِينَ ami ittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātin wa-aṣfākum bil-banīna Did He adopt daughters from what He creates while He preferred you with sons?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُمْ بِالْبَنِينَ ami ittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātin wa-aṣfākum bil-banīna Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for (having) sons? See 43:15

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُمْ بِالْبَنِينَ ami ittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātin wa-aṣfākum bil-banīna What! Hath He taken daughters (Refers to the heathens regarding the angels as the daughters of God and worshipping them.) (unto Himself) of what He hath (Himself) created, and chosen you to have the sons? Since the people held the female sex in contempt, they ascribed daughters to God saying that the angels were the daughters of God. To assign daughters or to imagine God having wives or any issues, is most abominable with God and a blasphemy most abhorred by Him.1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun When one of them is brought the news of what he ascribes to the All-beneficent, his face becomes darkened1 and he chokes with suppressed agony, [and says]

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison (i.e., a daughter), his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief. See 43:15

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun And when the news (Of the birth of a daughter to themselves - they hated to have daughters - used to bury them alive.) is given unto anyone of them of what he setteth up a similitude unto the Beneficent (God) his face becometh darkened (With sorrow.) and he is choked with rage. The disbelievers used to assign daughters to God but when they were informed of a daughter born to them, their complexion used to get turned black in their sorrow and disappointment and they were filled with rage.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ awaman yunasha-u fī l-ḥil'yati wahuwa fī l-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīnin 'What! One who is brought up amid ornaments and is inconspicuous in contests?'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ awaman yunasha-u fī l-ḥil'yati wahuwa fī l-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīnin So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident1 (attributed to Allah)? See 43:15

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ awaman yunasha-u fī l-ḥil'yati wahuwa fī l-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīnin What! the one (Refers to the idols bedecked with ornaments – unable to speak.) which was brought up amidst ornaments and in disputes can make not itself plain (to be associated with God)? The reference to idols which when bedecked with ornaments and fixed for worship, could not answer any criticism against them - and yet they were adored as gods and goddesses.1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوْۤا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَاثًا أَشَهِدُوْۤا خَلْقَهُمْ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْءَلُونَ wajaʿalū l-malāikata alladhīna hum ʿibādu l-raḥmāni ināthan ashahidū khalqahum satuk'tabu shahādatuhum wayus'alūna And they have made the angels —who are servants of the All-beneficent— females. Were they witness to their creation? Their testimony will be written down and they shall be questioned.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوْۤا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَاثًا أَشَهِدُوْۤا خَلْقَهُمْ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْءَلُونَ wajaʿalū l-malāikata alladhīna hum ʿibādu l-raḥmāni ināthan ashahidū khalqahum satuk'tabu shahādatuhum wayus'alūna And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned. See 43:15

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلُوْۤا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَاثًا أَشَهِدُوْۤا خَلْقَهُمْ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْءَلُونَ wajaʿalū l-malāikata alladhīna hum ʿibādu l-raḥmāni ināthan ashahidū khalqahum satuk'tabu shahādatuhum wayus'alūna And make they the angels who are the servants of the Beneficent (God) - females (deities); What! did they witness their creation? Their witness shall be written down and they shall be they questioned. See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُمْ مَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ waqālū law shāa l-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum mā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yakhruṣūna They say, 'Had the All-beneficent wished, we would not have worshipped them.'1 They do not have any knowledge of that, and they do nothing but surmise.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُمْ مَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ waqālū law shāa l-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum mā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yakhruṣūna And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging. See 43:15

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُمْ مَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ waqālū law shāa l-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum mā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yakhruṣūna And say they: "If had willed the Beneficent (God) we should not have worshipped them." They have no knowledge of this; they do but guess. See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ فَهُمْ بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ am ātaynāhum kitāban min qablihi fahum bihi mus'tamsikūna Did We give them a Book before this, so that they are holding fast to it?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ فَهُمْ بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ am ātaynāhum kitāban min qablihi fahum bihi mus'tamsikūna Or have We given them a book before it (i.e., the Qur’ān) to which they are adhering? Or have We given them any Book before this (the Qur'an) to which they are holding fast (43:21). Nay! They say: We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we guide ourselves by their footsteps (43:22). And similarly, We sent not a warner before you to any town (people) but the luxurious ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we will indeed follow their footsteps (43:23). He said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following?" They said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ فَهُمْ بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ am ātaynāhum kitāban min qablihi fahum bihi mus'tamsikūna Or have We given them a Book ere it that they hold fast (hold fast the Book in their arguments.) unto it? See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُهْتَدُونَ bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muh'tadūna Rather they say, 'We found our fathers following a creed, and we are indeed guided in their footsteps.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُهْتَدُونَ bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muh'tadūna Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps (rightly) guided." See 43:21

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُهْتَدُونَ bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muh'tadūna Nay! say they: "Verily we found our fathers on a creed (a way distinguished.) and verily by their footprints are we guided" See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُقْتَدُونَ wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muq'tadūna And so it has been that We did not send any warner to a town before you, without its affluent ones saying, 'We found our fathers following a creed and we are indeed following in their footsteps.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُقْتَدُونَ wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muq'tadūna And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following." See 43:21

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُقْتَدُونَ wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muq'tadūna And thus, We sent not ere thee in any town a warner, but the luxurious (Those who indulge in luxury and ease.) of it said: "Verily, we found our fathers on a creed, and verily, of their footprints we are the followers" See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِأَهْدَى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَكُمْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ qāla awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāakum qālū innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna He would say, 'What! Even if I bring you a better guidance than what you found your fathers following?!' They would say, 'We indeed disbelieve in what you are sent with.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِأَهْدَى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَكُمْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ qāla awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāakum qālū innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna (Each warner) said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that (religion) upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers." See 43:21

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِأَهْدَى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَكُمْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ qāla awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāakum qālū innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna Said (that warner): "What! even if I bring you a guidance better than that on which found ye your fathers (will ye not believe)?" Said they: "Verily we are disbelievers in whatever ye (The apostles.) are sent with". See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna Thereupon We took vengeance on them; so observe how was the fate of the deniers.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers. See 43:21

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna So We did retribute them, and behold thou how was the end of those who belied (Our apostles). See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi waqawmihi innanī barāon mimmā taʿbudūna When Abraham said to his father and his people, 'I repudiate what you worship,

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi waqawmihi innanī barāon mimmā taʿbudūna And (mention, O Muḥammad), when Ibrahim said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship. And (remember) when Ibrahim said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship, (43:26). "Except Him Who created me; and verily, He will guide me (43:27). And he made it a word lasting among his offspring, that they may turn back (43:28). Nay, but I gave to these and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth, and a Messenger making things clear (43:29). And when the truth came to them, they said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein (43:30). And they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi waqawmihi innanī barāon mimmā taʿbudūna And (remember thou) when said Abraham unto his father and his people: "Verily I am free (Arabic 'Bara'un'. This is 'Tabarra'.) of what ye worship," See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ illā alladhī faṭaranī fa-innahu sayahdīni excepting Him who originated me; indeed He will guide me.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ illā alladhī faṭaranī fa-innahu sayahdīni Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me." See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ illā alladhī faṭaranī fa-innahu sayahdīni (I worship) but (only) Him Who created me, for verily He will guide me. See 43:18

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wajaʿalahā kalimatan bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And He made it1 a lasting word among his posterity so that they may come back [to the right path].

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wajaʿalahā kalimatan bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And he made it1 a word remaining among his descendants that they might return (to it). See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wajaʿalahā kalimatan bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And he (Abraham.) made it a word (doctrine) (The unity of God - in the sense of rejecting all deities and submitting only to God.) to continue (Lasting .) in his progeny that they may return (unto God). The 'Word', i.e., the knowledge about the Unity of God which he left behind him hoping his progeny to preserve the faith in it. (a) Indicates that the doctrine of the Unity of God shall remain in the seed of Abraham for ever. In the lineage of the Holy Prophet, all were monotheists. (b) Of the Unity of God - in the sense of rejecting all deities and submitting only to Him. (A.P.)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَؤُلَاءِ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ bal mattaʿtu hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā jāahumu l-ḥaqu warasūlun mubīnun Rather I provided for these1 and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a manifest apostle.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَؤُلَاءِ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ bal mattaʿtu hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā jāahumu l-ḥaqu warasūlun mubīnun However, I gave enjoyment to these (people of Makkah) and their fathers1 until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.2 See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَؤُلَاءِ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ bal mattaʿtu hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā jāahumu l-ḥaqu warasūlun mubīnun Nay! I did provide these and their fathers to enjoy until there came unto them the truth (the Qur'an) and the Apostle (Muhammad) manifesting (the truth). See 43:28

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ walammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu qālū hādhā siḥ'run wa-innā bihi kāfirūna But when the truth came to them, they said, 'This is magic, and we indeed disbelieve in it.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ walammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu qālū hādhā siḥ'run wa-innā bihi kāfirūna But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers." See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ walammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu qālū hādhā siḥ'run wa-innā bihi kāfirūna And when came unto them the truth (the Qur'an) said they: "This is a sorcery, we are disbelievers in it" See 43:28

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhā l-qur'ānu ʿalā rajulin mina l-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmin And they said, 'Why was not this Qur'ān sent down to some great man from the two cities?'1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhā l-qur'ānu ʿalā rajulin mina l-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmin And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from (one of) the two cities?"1 See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhā l-qur'ānu ʿalā rajulin mina l-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmin And say they: "Why was not this Qur'an sent down unto a man in the two cities, (Mecca and Taif the two important cities of the land.) (who is) great ?" (Some prominent i.e. man of political or tribal position or importance. See verses 2:247 & 4:54.) This is what the people said that if the Holy Qur'an was in fact the Word of God, it ought to have been given to any one of the leading persons in wealth in Mecca or Taif and not to a poor man like the Holy Prophet who did not own any wealth and comforts. So degenerated had become the tastes of the people that moral greatness and spiritual excellence had no value…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukh'riyyan waraḥmatu rabbika khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna Is it they who dispense the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have dispensed among them their livelihood in the present life, and raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service, and your Lord's mercy is better than what they amass.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukh'riyyan waraḥmatu rabbika khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees (of rank) that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate. See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukh'riyyan waraḥmatu rabbika khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna What! do they distribute the mercy of thy Lord? (It is) We Who did distribute among them (even) their livelihood in the life of this world, and We did raise some of them above the others in rank, so that some of them may take the others in subjection; (For the purpose of serving each other, to maintain discipline in the practical life.) and the mercy of thy Lord is better than whatever they hoard. (Wealth.) God does not commission any one with His apostleship on the merit of owning…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا أَنْ يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ walawlā an yakūna l-nāsu ummatan wāḥidatan lajaʿalnā liman yakfuru bil-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufan min fiḍḍatin wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūna Were it not [for the danger] that mankind would be one community,1 We would have surely made for those who defy the All-beneficent, silver roofs for their houses and [silver] stairways by which they ascend;

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا أَنْ يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ walawlā an yakūna l-nāsu ummatan wāḥidatan lajaʿalnā liman yakfuru bil-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufan min fiḍḍatin wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūna And if it were not that the people would become one community (of disbelievers),1 We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount. See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْلَا أَنْ يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ walawlā an yakūna l-nāsu ummatan wāḥidatan lajaʿalnā liman yakfuru bil-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufan min fiḍḍatin wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūna And were it not that all people had been (Become.) of one (evil) way of life, We would certainly have provided those who disbelieve in the Beneficent God, (to make) for their houses, roofs of silver and the stairs on which they ascend, Had it not been misleading to the people, God would have granted so much of gold and silver to the disbelievers that they could have made their abodes with their roofs, of gold but then people would have thought the bestowal of the wealth, to be the reward for the wrong ways of the disbelievers and all of them would have joined the…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ walibuyūtihim abwāban wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiūna and [silver] doors for their houses and [silver] couches on which they recline;

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ walibuyūtihim abwāban wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiūna And for their houses - doors and couches (of silver) upon which to recline. See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ walibuyūtihim abwāban wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiūna And the doors of their houses, and the couches on which they recline, See 43:33

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُخْرُفًا وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ wazukh'rufan wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil'muttaqīna and ornaments of gold;1 yet all that would be nothing but the wares of the life of this world, and the Hereafter near your Lord is for the Godwary.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُخْرُفًا وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ wazukh'rufan wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil'muttaqīna And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous. See 43:26

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَزُخْرُفًا وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ wazukh'rufan wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil'muttaqīna And ornaments of gold; But all these are only the provision of the life of this world; And the hereafter (Spiritual position - Status – gain – bliss.) unto thy Lord is for the pious ones. And what is with God, as the reward for the pious and righteous, is more than what human imagination could conceive.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ waman yaʿshu ʿan dhik'ri l-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnun Whoever turns a blind eye to1 the remembrance of the All-beneficent, We assign him a devil who remains his companion.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ waman yaʿshu ʿan dhik'ri l-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnun And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion. And whosoever Ya'shu (turns away blindly) from the remembrance of the Most Gracious, We appoint for him Shaytan to be a Qarin (a companion) to him (43:36). And verily, they hinder them from the path, but they think that they are guided aright (43:37). Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says, "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west) a worst companion (indeed)! (43:38). It will profit you not this Day as you did wrong, (and) that you will be sharers…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ waman yaʿshu ʿan dhik'ri l-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnun And whosoever is blinded against the remembrance of the Beneficent (God), for him We appoint a satan and he shall be his close companion. (Associate. Refer to verse 41:25.) He who avoids remembering God, is naturally going on adding to his evils. The First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib says 'He who goes on sinning gets blind at heart.' When one leaves the society of God Satan naturally gets free access to the individual. It is to keep man necessarily in communion with the Lord the minimum course prescribed for man is the regular offering of the five times daily prayers.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani l-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna Indeed they1 bar them from the way while they suppose that they are [rightly] guided.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani l-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna And indeed, they (i.e., the devils) avert them from the way (of guidance) while they think that they are (rightly) guided. See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani l-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna And verily (the satans) turn them away from the (right) path, and deem they that they are guided aright. The worst is that man maddened by evil, thinks that he is on the right path and there is no harm in whatever evil he commits, whereas every step of his, takes him farther away from the right course, and nearer to perdition.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَالَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ ḥattā idhā jāanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿ'da l-mashriqayni fabi'sa l-qarīnu When he comes to Us, he will say, 'I wish there had been between me and you the distance between east and west! What an evil companion [are you]!'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَالَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ ḥattā idhā jāanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿ'da l-mashriqayni fabi'sa l-qarīnu Until, when he comes to Us (at Judgement), he says (to his companion), "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion." See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَالَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ ḥattā idhā jāanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿ'da l-mashriqayni fabi'sa l-qarīnu Until when cometh he unto Us, he would say: "(O' Satan!) would that between me and thee there were the distance of two Easts!" (The relative value of the term - East and West.) (what) an evil companion is (Satan)! This is what on the Day of Judgment, the victims of Satan would say. The use of Two Easts – for east and west implies the relative value of the term east and west (A.P.)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ walan yanfaʿakumu l-yawma idh ẓalamtum annakum fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna 'Today that1 will be of no avail to you. As you did wrong, so will you share in the punishment.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ walan yanfaʿakumu l-yawma idh ẓalamtum annakum fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are (all) sharing in the punishment. See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ walan yanfaʿakumu l-yawma idh ẓalamtum annakum fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna And never shall it profit you on this day, since ye did injustice, that ye be partners in the chastisement. See 43:38

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma aw tahdī l-ʿum'ya waman kāna fī ḍalālin mubīnin Can you, then, make the deaf hear or guide the blind and someone who is in manifest error?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma aw tahdī l-ʿum'ya waman kāna fī ḍalālin mubīnin Then will you make the deaf hear, (O Muḥammad), or guide the blind or he who is in clear error? See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma aw tahdī l-ʿum'ya waman kāna fī ḍalālin mubīnin What! Canst thou then make the deaf hear or guide the blind (The arrogant ones who would neither listen to nor see the facts - thus deaf and blind at heart.) and him who is manifestly astray? Guidance is God's grace and mercy and it comes only from God and not at the will of even the apostles.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُمْ مُنْتَقِمُونَ fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā min'hum muntaqimūna Either We shall take you away —for We will indeed take vengeance on them—

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُمْ مُنْتَقِمُونَ fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā min'hum muntaqimūna And whether (or not) We take you away (in death), indeed, We will take retribution upon them. See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُمْ مُنْتَقِمُونَ fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā min'hum muntaqimūna Even if We take thee away, then verily shall We extract retribution from them Ibn Mardwaih reports from Jabir Ibn Abdullah Ansari that the Holy Prophet said that this verse is about Ali who after the Holy Prophet would fight and punish the treacherous ones who violate the covenant of faith they had entered into.1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ مُقْتَدِرُونَ aw nuriyannaka alladhī waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim muq'tadirūna or We shall show you what We have promised them, for indeed We hold them in Our power.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ مُقْتَدِرُونَ aw nuriyannaka alladhī waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim muq'tadirūna Or whether (or not) We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability. See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ مُقْتَدِرُونَ aw nuriyannaka alladhī waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim muq'tadirūna Or We shall show thee that which We have promised them for verily We are over them (fully) Powerful. See 43:41

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ fa-is'tamsik bi-alladhī ūḥiya ilayka innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. Indeed you are on a straight path.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ fa-is'tamsik bi-alladhī ūḥiya ilayka innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path. See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ fa-is'tamsik bi-alladhī ūḥiya ilayka innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Therefore, hold thou fast what hath been revealed unto thee, Verily, thou art on the Right Path. Jabir Ibn Abdullah Ansari reports that after returning from the 'Hajjat ul-wida' (i.e., the Last Haj) the Holy Prophet used very frequently to admonish and warn the people about holding fast to the command of Ali as set up at Ghadir Khumm where the Holy Prophet under the command from God had declared 'Of whomsoever I am the Lord, this Ali is his Lord'1 on the declaration of which, depended the completion of the mission of the apostleship of the Holy Prophet and the perfection of the faith as a duly regulated religion for mankind.2 The concluding words of the verse indicate that to acknowledge Ali in…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ وَسَوْفَ تُسْءَلُونَ wa-innahu ladhik'run laka waliqawmika wasawfa tus'alūna Indeed it is a reminder for you and for your people, and soon you will be questioned.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ وَسَوْفَ تُسْءَلُونَ wa-innahu ladhik'run laka waliqawmika wasawfa tus'alūna And indeed, it is a remembrance1 for you and your people, and you (all) are going to be questioned. See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ وَسَوْفَ تُسْءَلُونَ wa-innahu ladhik'run laka waliqawmika wasawfa tus'alūna And verily, it is a reminder (Imminence.) for thee and for thy people, and ye shall soon be questioned (about it). The question would be as to how much the Holy Qur'an was honoured in practice, in the daily life. The Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn Ali Al-Baqir and also (the Sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq said, "Zikr is the Holy Qur'an and we are those who would be questioned about." (MS.) According to 'Tha'alabi' one of the renowned Sunni Commentators, the Holy Prophet said that 'On the night of Mi'raj (Ascension) when I was in the heavens among the souls of the apostles of God, and angels, at the command of God desired me to ask the apostles with what basic object they had been…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رُسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ wasal man arsalnā min qablika min rusulinā ajaʿalnā min dūni l-raḥmāni ālihatan yuʿ'badūna Ask those of Our apostles We have sent before you:1 Did We set up any gods besides the All-beneficent to be worshipped?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رُسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ wasal man arsalnā min qablika min rusulinā ajaʿalnā min dūni l-raḥmāni ālihatan yuʿ'badūna And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped? See 43:36

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رُسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ wasal man arsalnā min qablika min rusulinā ajaʿalnā min dūni l-raḥmāni ālihatan yuʿ'badūna And ask thou those of Our apostles We sent before thee: Did We appoint besides the Beneficent God any gods to be worshipped? See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faqāla innī rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his elite. He said, 'I am indeed an apostle of the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faqāla innī rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna And certainly did We send Musa with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds." And indeed We did send Musa with Our Ayat to Fir'awn and his chiefs. He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of all that exists (43:46). But when he came to them with Our Ayat, behold, they laughed at them (43:47). And not an Ayah We showed them but it was greater than its fellow preceding it, and We seized them with torment, in order that they might turn (43:48). And they said (to Musa): "O you sorcerer! Invoke your Lord for us according to…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faqāla innī rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna And indeed sent We Moses with Our signs, unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and said he: "Verily I am the apostle of the Lord of the worlds" (Refer to verses 7:104, 7:130 - 7:136.) See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ falammā jāahum biāyātinā idhā hum min'hā yaḍḥakūna But when he brought them Our signs, behold, they laughed at them.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ falammā jāahum biāyātinā idhā hum min'hā yaḍḥakūna But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them. See 43:46

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ falammā jāahum biāyātinā idhā hum min'hā yaḍḥakūna And when came he unto them with Our signs, lo! they laughed at them, See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا وَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukh'tihā wa-akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And We did not show them a sign but it was greater than the other, and We seized them with punishment so that they might come back.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا وَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukh'tihā wa-akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return (to faith). See 43:46

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُرِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا وَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukh'tihā wa-akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And We showed them not a sign but it was greater than the other, and seized them with chastisement, that they may return. See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ waqālū yāayyuha l-sāḥiru ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka innanā lamuh'tadūna They would say, 'O magician! Invoke your Lord for us by the covenant He has made with you. We will indeed be guided.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ waqālū yāayyuha l-sāḥiru ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka innanā lamuh'tadūna And they said (to Musa), "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided." See 43:46

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ waqālū yāayyuha l-sāḥiru ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka innanā lamuh'tadūna And said they: "O' sorcerer! Call on for us thy Lord, (to do) as he hath covenanted (to remove the destructive signs. Refer to verses 7:132 - 7:135.) with thee; verily we will be guided aright." See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūna But when We lifted the punishment from them, behold, they would break their pledge.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūna But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word. See 43:46

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūna But when We relieved them from the chastisement, lo! they broke the pledge. See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِي أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ wanādā fir'ʿawnu fī qawmihi qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mul'ku miṣ'ra wahādhihi l-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī afalā tub'ṣirūna And Pharaoh proclaimed amongst his people. He said, 'O my people! Does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me and these rivers that run at my feet? Do you not perceive?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِي أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ wanādā fir'ʿawnu fī qawmihi qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mul'ku miṣ'ra wahādhihi l-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī afalā tub'ṣirūna And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see? And Fir'awn proclaimed among his people (saying): "O my people! Is not mine the dominion of Egypt, and these rivers flowing underneath me. See you not then? (43:51). "Am I not better than this one (Musa) who is despicable and can scarcely express himself clearly? (43:52). Why then are not golden bracelets bestowed on him, or angels sent along with him? (43:53). Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. Verily, they were…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِي أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ wanādā fir'ʿawnu fī qawmihi qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mul'ku miṣ'ra wahādhihi l-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī afalā tub'ṣirūna And proclaimed Pharaoh unto his people: "O' my people! is not the kingdom of Egypt mine? And these rivers flow below me; What! behold ye not?" See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ am anā khayrun min hādhā alladhī huwa mahīnun walā yakādu yubīnu Am I not better than this humble1 one who cannot even speak clearly?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ am anā khayrun min hādhā alladhī huwa mahīnun walā yakādu yubīnu Or am I (not) better than this one (i.e., Musa) who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?1 See 43:51

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ am anā khayrun min hādhā alladhī huwa mahīnun walā yakādu yubīnu Nay! I am better than this (fellow) who is contemptible, and who scarce can speak distinctly? (Make plain. Not that there was any defect in his vocal system. (A.P.).) See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ falawlā ul'qiya ʿalayhi aswiratun min dhahabin aw jāa maʿahu l-malāikatu muq'tarinīna Why have no bracelets of gold been cast upon him, nor have the angels come with him as escorts?'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ falawlā ul'qiya ʿalayhi aswiratun min dhahabin aw jāa maʿahu l-malāikatu muq'tarinīna Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?" See 43:51

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ falawlā ul'qiya ʿalayhi aswiratun min dhahabin aw jāa maʿahu l-malāikatu muq'tarinīna And why have not then bracelets of gold been put upon him? Or (why have not) come with him angels as (his) companions? See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ fa-is'takhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna So he misled his people and they obeyed him. Indeed they were a transgressing lot.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ fa-is'takhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were (themselves) a people defiantly disobedient (of Allah). See 43:51

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ fa-is'takhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna Thus, did he persuade his people to levity and they obeyed him; verily they were a transgressing people See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ءَاسَفُونَا انْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ falammā āsafūnā intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna So when they roused Our wrath, We took vengeance on them and drowned them all.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ءَاسَفُونَا انْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ falammā āsafūnā intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all. See 43:51

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ءَاسَفُونَا انْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ falammā āsafūnā intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna And when they had angered Us, We did retribute them, so did We drown them all together, See 43:44

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِلْءَاخِرِينَ fajaʿalnāhum salafan wamathalan lil'ākhirīna Thus We made them the vanguard1 and an example for posterity.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِلْءَاخِرِينَ fajaʿalnāhum salafan wamathalan lil'ākhirīna And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples. See 43:51

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِلْءَاخِرِينَ fajaʿalnāhum salafan wamathalan lil'ākhirīna And We made them a precedent and an example for the later generations. This is just to compare the similarity between the people of Pharaoh and the people of Mecca - attaching importance to temporal power and possession and ignoring the spiritual side of the life and the life hereafter.1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ walammā ḍuriba ub'nu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka min'hu yaṣiddūna When the Son of Mary was cited as an example, behold, your people raise an outcry.1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ walammā ḍuriba ub'nu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka min'hu yaṣiddūna And when the son of Maryam was presented as an example,1 immediately your people laughed aloud. And when the son of Maryam is quoted as an example, behold, your people cry aloud thereat (43:57). And say: "Are our gods better or is he?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people (43:58). He was not more than a servant. We granted Our favor to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel (43:59). And if it were Our will, We would have made angels to replace you on the earth (43:60). And he shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour. Therefore have no doubt concerning it.…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ walammā ḍuriba ub'nu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka min'hu yaṣiddūna And when was set forth (Jesus) son of Mary as an instance (of Our power), lo! thy people laughed out (in ridicule). Power and righteousness - Pharaoh was the instance of wickedness - resulting in invoking wrath of God - Jesus an example of the divine blessings manifested in his ideal righteousness. (A.P.)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا ءَأَالِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ waqālū aālihatunā khayrun am huwa mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalan bal hum qawmun khaṣimūna They say, 'Are our gods better or he?' They only cite him to you for the sake of contention. Rather they are a contentious lot.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا ءَأَالِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ waqālū aālihatunā khayrun am huwa mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalan bal hum qawmun khaṣimūna And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?"1 They did not present it (i.e., the comparison) except for (mere) argument. But, (in fact), they are a people prone to dispute. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا ءَأَالِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ waqālū aālihatunā khayrun am huwa mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalan bal hum qawmun khaṣimūna And say they: "Are our gods better or is He?" (God.) They do not set it forth unto thee but by way of disputation; nay! they are a contentious people. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ in huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalan libanī is'rāīla He was just a servant whom We had blessed and made an exemplar for the Children of Israel.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ in huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalan libanī is'rāīla He (i.e., Isa) was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ in huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalan libanī is'rāīla None was he but a servant (of Ours), bestowed We on him (Our) favour (In the same manner as in verse 4:69.) (giving him the miracles); and We made him an example (of Our power) unto the children of Israel. With the unusual mode of his birth and his miraculous disappearing, as in the case of the last saint in the seed of Ishmael, the Last Imam, Muhammad Ibn Hasan al-Mahdi shares his grace as they would resemble each other in their miraculous reappearances - the former following the lead of the latter.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ مَلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ walaw nashāu lajaʿalnā minkum malāikatan fī l-arḍi yakhlufūna Had We wished We would have set in your stead angels to be [your] successors on the earth.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ مَلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ walaw nashāu lajaʿalnā minkum malāikatan fī l-arḍi yakhlufūna And if We willed, We could have made (instead) of you angels succeeding (one another)1 on the earth. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ مَلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ walaw nashāu lajaʿalnā minkum malāikatan fī l-arḍi yakhlufūna And had We pleased, certainly We could have made from among you angels to be in the earth (your) successors. (To succeed their lands.) See 43:59

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-innahu laʿil'mun lilssāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wa-ittabiʿūni hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Indeed he1 is a portent of the Hour; so do not doubt it and follow Me. This is a straight path.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-innahu laʿil'mun lilssāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wa-ittabiʿūni hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun And indeed, he (i.e., Isa) will be (a sign for) knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me.1 This is a straight path. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-innahu laʿil'mun lilssāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wa-ittabiʿūni hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun And verily he shall be the sign of (approach of) the Hour (of Reckoning), doubt not then about it and follow Me: This is the Right Path. 'The Hour', i.e., the Day of the Final Judgment, Jesus shall be the sign for the dawn of the Day of Judgment. Just before the Day of the Final Judgment, Jesus shall descend from heaven and destroy the idols in the churches which people have established in his name and break the cross and abolish once for all the false doctrine of trinity and prepare the way for the universal acceptance of the doctrine of the Unity of God as founded by the Holy Qur'an. There are the other details about all that…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ walā yaṣuddannakumu l-shayṭānu innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun Do not let Satan bar you [from the way of Allah]. Indeed he is your manifest enemy.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ walā yaṣuddannakumu l-shayṭānu innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ walā yaṣuddannakumu l-shayṭānu innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun And let not satan prevent you, (The people.) verily he is your open (Refer to note on verse 36:60.) enemy. See 43:61

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسٰی بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِیْهِ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ walammā jāa ʿīsā bil-bayināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥik'mati wali-ubayyina lakum baʿḍa alladhī takhtalifūna fīhi fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni When Jesus brought the manifest proofs, he said, 'I have certainly brought you wisdom, and [I have come] to make clear to you some of the things that you differ about. So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسٰی بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِیْهِ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ walammā jāa ʿīsā bil-bayināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥik'mati wali-ubayyina lakum baʿḍa alladhī takhtalifūna fīhi fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni And when Isa brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom (i.e., prophethood) and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسٰی بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِیْهِ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ walammā jāa ʿīsā bil-bayināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥik'mati wali-ubayyina lakum baʿḍa alladhī takhtalifūna fīhi fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni And when came Jesus with clear proofs (miracles), said he: "Indeed have I come unto you with wisdom, and that I may make clear for you some of those things of which ye differ in; so guard ye (yourselves against evil) and obey me." See 43:61

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ inna l-laha huwa rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ inna l-laha huwa rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path." See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ inna l-laha huwa rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Verily God (alone) is my Lord and your Lord, so serve ye (only) Him; This is the right path. "Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and Him only shalt thou serve."1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīmin But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the wrongdoers for the punishment of a painful day.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīmin But the denominations from among them differed (and separated), so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day. See 43:57

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīmin But differed parties from among them, so woe unto those who were unjust, from the chastisement of a painful day. See 43:64

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Do they await anything but that the Hour should overtake them suddenly, while they are unaware?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not? Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly while they perceive not (43:66). Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except those who have Taqwa (43:67). My servants! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve (43:68). (You) who believed in Our Ayat and were Muslims (43:69). Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness (43:70). Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that their souls desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever (43:71). This is…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
