item.description: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ hal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Wait they for aught but the Hour (of Reckoning) to come on them suddenly while they perceive not? See 43:64

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ al-akhilāu yawma-idhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illā l-mutaqīna On that day, friends will be one another's enemies, except for the Godwary.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ al-akhilāu yawma-idhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illā l-mutaqīna Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous. See 43:66

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ al-akhilāu yawma-idhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illā l-mutaqīna The friends that day shall be enemies to one another, save the pious ones. The partners in the evil ways in this world who think themselves to be the friends of each other in this life, would on the Day of Judgement condemn each other whereas the pious would naturally feel increased in joy when they meet each other in the rejoicing. The Sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad As-Sadiq gathered his devotees the Shias and reciting this verse commanded them to seek the friendship of the pious even if they be found in the darkest part of the earth. But to know as to who the perfect ones of the 'Muttaqin' the pious ones are1 and for the position of the pious with God.2 Refer…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu l-yawma walā antum taḥzanūna [They will be told,] 'O My servants! Today you will have no fear, nor will you grieve.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu l-yawma walā antum taḥzanūna (To whom Allah will say), "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve. See 43:66

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu l-yawma walā antum taḥzanūna O' My servants! No fear shall be on you this day, nor shall ye grieve. See 43:67

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ alladhīna āmanū biāyātinā wakānū mus'limīna Those who believed in Our signs and had been muslims.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ alladhīna āmanū biāyātinā wakānū mus'limīna (You) who believed in Our verses and were Muslims. See 43:66

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ alladhīna āmanū biāyātinā wakānū mus'limīna Those who believed in Our signs and were Muslims (those submitting themselves unto God). See 43:67

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ أَنْتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ ud'khulū l-janata antum wa-azwājukum tuḥ'barūna Enter paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ أَنْتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ ud'khulū l-janata antum wa-azwājukum tuḥ'barūna Enter Paradise, you and your kinds,1 delighted." See 43:66

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ أَنْتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ ud'khulū l-janata antum wa-azwājukum tuḥ'barūna Enter ye the Garden, ye and your mates; ye shall be made to be delighted. (Rejoicing.) See 43:67

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ وَأَنْتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfin min dhahabin wa-akwābin wafīhā mā tashtahīhi l-anfusu wataladhu l-aʿyunu wa-antum fīhā khālidūna (they will be served around with golden dishes and goblets, and therein1 will be whatever the souls desire and eyes delight in) 'and you will remain in it [forever].

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ وَأَنْتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfin min dhahabin wa-akwābin wafīhā mā tashtahīhi l-anfusu wataladhu l-aʿyunu wa-antum fīhā khālidūna Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and (what) delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally. See 43:66

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ وَأَنْتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfin min dhahabin wa-akwābin wafīhā mā tashtahīhi l-anfusu wataladhu l-aʿyunu wa-antum fīhā khālidūna Shall be passed round unto them dishes of gold and cups (of drinks); and therein shall be whatever desire their souls, and (wherein) could delight the eyes; and ye shall abide therein. The purpose of Qur'an enumerating the details of the sensual pleasure, is to bring home and assert the fact that in the life hereafter, none of the senses of any individual, are lost but are developed and sharpened - so each will have the object desired by it the most, as the verse says and the weakest1 will suffer for being deprived of the realisation of the objects of their senses. (A.P.)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ watil'ka l-janatu allatī ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna That is the paradise you have been given to inherit for what you used to do.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ watil'ka l-janatu allatī ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do. See 43:66

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ watil'ka l-janatu allatī ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna This is the Garden (Paradise) ye are made to receive as a heritage (in recompense) for what ye have been doing. See 43:71

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratun min'hā takulūna Therein are abundant fruits for you from which you will eat.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratun min'hā takulūna For you therein is much fruit1 from which you will eat. See 43:66

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratun min'hā takulūna For you therein are fruits in abundance of which ye shall eat. See 43:71

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ inna l-muj'rimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūna Indeed the guilty will remain [forever] in the punishment of hell.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ inna l-muj'rimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūna Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally. Verily, the criminals will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever (43:74). (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein (43:75). We wronged them not, but they were the wrongdoers (43:76). And they will cry: O Malik (keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us." He will say: "Verily, you shall abide forever (43:77). Indeed We have brought the truth to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth (43:78). Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning (43:79). Or do they think that We hear not their secrets…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ inna l-muj'rimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūna Verily the guilty ones, in the torment of Hell, they shall abide. See 43:71

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mub'lisūna It will not be lightened for them and they will be despondent in it.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mub'lisūna It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair. See 43:74

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mub'lisūna It shall not be abated from them, and they therein shall be despairing. See 43:71

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū humu l-ẓālimīna We did not wrong them, but they themselves were wrongdoers.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū humu l-ẓālimīna And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers. See 43:74

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū humu l-ẓālimīna And We were not unjust unto them, but (it was) they (who) were unto themselves unjust. See 43:71

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَوْا يَامَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ مَاكِثُونَ wanādaw yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuka qāla innakum mākithūna They will call out, 'O Mālik!1 Let your Lord finish us off!' He will say, 'Indeed you will stay on.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَوْا يَامَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ مَاكِثُونَ wanādaw yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuka qāla innakum mākithūna And they will call, "O Mālik,1 let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." See 43:74

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَوْا يَامَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ مَاكِثُونَ wanādaw yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuka qāla innakum mākithūna And they shall cry out: "O' Malik! would that thy Lord maketh an end of us!" He shall say: "Verily ye shall remain (here)." It is said that when the fellows of the Hell-fire would feel the torment therein as unbearable they would cry out to 'Malik' the angel in charge of Hell to pray to God to kill them once for all. But he would reply 'Ye have been convicted to remain thus in Hell.'1

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ laqad ji'nākum bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharakum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna 'We certainly brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ laqad ji'nākum bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharakum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse. See 43:74

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ laqad ji'nākum bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharakum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna Indeed have We brought unto you with the truth but most of you unto the truth, were hateful. See 43:77

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوْۤا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ am abramū amran fa-innā mub'rimūna Have they settled on some [devious] plan? Indeed We too are settling [on Our plans].

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوْۤا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ am abramū amran fa-innā mub'rimūna Or have they devised (some) affair?1 But indeed, We are devising (a plan). See 43:74

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوْۤا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ am abramū amran fa-innā mub'rimūna Or (Either ye hated or did devise plots.) have they settled any device (among themselves)? then verily We too shall be the settlers (of Ours). See 43:77

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُمْ بَلَى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūna Do they suppose that We do not hear their secret thoughts and their secret talks? Yes indeed! And with them are Our messengers, writing down.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُمْ بَلَى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūna Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, (We do), and Our messengers (i.e., angels) are with them recording. See 43:74

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُمْ بَلَى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūna Or think (Or used to think Refer to verse 45:29.) they that We hear not their secret and their concealed discourses? Aye! (We do hear everything) and Our messengers (The angels.) unto them do write down (everything). See 43:77

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ qul in kāna lilrraḥmāni waladun fa-anā awwalu l-ʿābidīna Say, 'If the All-beneficent had a son, I would have been the first to worship [him].'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ qul in kāna lilrraḥmāni waladun fa-anā awwalu l-ʿābidīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of (his) worshippers."1 Say: "If the Most Gracious had a son, then I am the first of the worshippers (43:81). Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him) (43:82). So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised (43:83). It is He Who is the only God in the heaven and the only God on the earth. And He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower (43:84). And Blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ qul in kāna lilrraḥmāni waladun fa-anā awwalu l-ʿābidīna Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "If there be for the Beneficent God any son, I am (to be that (If God had to adopt any one as His son, it would have been the Holy Prophet Muhammad for he is the First and the foremost of God's creation and the first to worship Him. Refer to note to verse 43:81.) for I am) the first of the worshippers (to Him)" If there had been any son of God, the Holy Prophet being the greatest servant and the chosen one of God even among His apostles, would have been the first to serve that son. But far, far away is God's having any son for Him. As the verse 39:4 clearly says that if God…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna Clear is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, of whatever they allege [concerning Him]!

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ sub'ḥāna rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna Hallowed is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of 'Arsh', (The throne of Supreme authority.) far from what they attribute. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna So leave them to gossip and play until they encounter their day which they are promised.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna So leave them to plunge on, and sport (into vanities of falsehood) until meet they their day which they have been promised (warned with). See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَهٌ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ wahuwa alladhī fī l-samāi ilāhun wafī l-arḍi ilāhun wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu It is He who is God in the sky, and God on the earth; and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَهٌ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ wahuwa alladhī fī l-samāi ilāhun wafī l-arḍi ilāhun wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu And it is He (i.e., Allah) who is (the only) deity in the heaven, and on the earth (the only) deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَهٌ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ wahuwa alladhī fī l-samāi ilāhun wafī l-arḍi ilāhun wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu And He it is Who is God in the heavens and God in the earth; and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ watabāraka alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā waʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna Blessed is He to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be brought back.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ watabāraka alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā waʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ watabāraka alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā waʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna Holiest is He Whose is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them two, and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour (of Reckoning), and unto Him shall ye all be returned. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ walā yamliku alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi l-shafāʿata illā man shahida bil-ḥaqi wahum yaʿlamūna Those whom they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, except those who are witness to the truth and who know [for whom to intercede].

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ walā yamliku alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi l-shafāʿata illā man shahida bil-ḥaqi wahum yaʿlamūna And those they invoke1 besides Him do not possess (power of) intercession; but only those who testify to the truth (can benefit), and they know.2 See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ walā yamliku alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi l-shafāʿata illā man shahida bil-ḥaqi wahum yaʿlamūna And those whom they call besides Him, own not any power of intercession, save he who beareth witness of the truth and they know (the truth). Those who deny the doctrine of intercession for the repentant sinners may note the condition laid down in this verse. He who Bears Witness by surrendering his own soul to the Lord, i.e., a martyr in His way shall own the right to intercede. And who else could be greater than Husayn the King of Martyrs, the Greatest Bearer of witness to the truth, whose severed head bore witness glorifying the Lord even from the point of the lance. This verse lays down the criteria for the right…

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna If you ask them, 'Who created them?' they will surely say, 'Allah.' Then where do they stray?

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna And if you asked them1 who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded? See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna And if thou ask them who created them, they would certainly say: "God". Whence are they then deluded away (from the truth)? See 43:86

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلِهِ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ waqīlihi yārabbi inna hāulāi qawmun lā yu'minūna And his1 plaint: 'My Lord! Indeed these are a people who will not have faith!'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلِهِ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ waqīlihi yārabbi inna hāulāi qawmun lā yu'minūna And (Allah acknowledges) his saying,1 "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe." See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلِهِ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ waqīlihi yārabbi inna hāulāi qawmun lā yu'minūna And (God hath the knowledge of) his cry (i.e. of the Prophet): "O' my Lord! verily these are people who will believe not!" See 43:86

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ fa-iṣ'faḥ ʿanhum waqul salāmun fasawfa yaʿlamūna So disregard them, and say, 'Peace!' Soon they will know.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ fa-iṣ'faḥ ʿanhum waqul salāmun fasawfa yaʿlamūna So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."1 But they are going to know. See 43:81

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ fa-iṣ'faḥ ʿanhum waqul salāmun fasawfa yaʿlamūna So turn thou (Address to the Holy Prophet.) away from them and say: "Peace (be unto you)"; for they shall soon know (the result). See 43:86

item.title: Az-Zumar:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Az-Zumar:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The revelation of the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَاصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ Had Allah willed to take a son (or offspring), He could have chosen whom He willed out of those whom He created. Meaning: the matter would not have been as they claim. This is a conditional sentence which does not imply that this happened or that it is permitted; indeed, it is impossible. The aim is only to point out the ignorance of their claims. It is like the Ayat: لَوْ أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَاتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا إِنْ كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ Had We intended to take a pastime, We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were…

item.title: Az-Zumar:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi The descent of the Book (Qur'an) is from God, the Al-Mighty, The All-Wise. This indicates the Qur'an as a Book, was revealed as a whole to the Holy Prophet. Refer to verse 44:3. (A.P.). It is asserted that: (1) The Holy Qur'an is the Book from God. (2) God Who is exalted in Power, i.e., He could cause His will to be revealed to any one He chooses. (3) The Book being from the All-Wise One, contains guidance to the wisdom essential for mankind.

item.title: Az-Zumar:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi fa-uʿ'budi l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna Indeed We have sent down the Book to you with the truth; so worship Allah, putting exclusive faith1 in Him.

item.title: Az-Zumar:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi fa-uʿ'budi l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, (O Muḥammad), in truth. So worship Allah, (being) sincere to Him in religion. See 39:1

item.title: Az-Zumar:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi fa-uʿ'budi l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna Verily, We have sent down unto thee the Book (Qur'an) with the truth; so worship thou God (alone), being sincere unto Him in religion Adoration, Gratitude and Service is due to none but God. Man should seek protection and succour from none but God and God alone can give protection or succour to every being in the Universe. Nearness or approach to God could be had through none but the men of God, i.e., man should seek the correct or the right medium or means to approach Him. The correct medium is that of the Holy Prophet and the Holy Imams, by following their ideals and the practical examples set by these holy souls in their life on earth. Islam…

item.title: Az-Zumar:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ alā lillahi l-dīnu l-khāliṣu wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa mā naʿbuduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilā l-lahi zul'fā inna l-laha yaḥkumu baynahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa kādhibun kaffārun Look! [Only] exclusive faith is worthy of Allah, and those who take guardians besides Him [claiming,] 'We only worship them so that they may bring us near to Allah,' Allah will indeed judge between them concerning that about which they differ. Indeed Allah does not guide someone who is a liar and an ingrate.

item.title: Az-Zumar:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ alā lillahi l-dīnu l-khāliṣu wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa mā naʿbuduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilā l-lahi zul'fā inna l-laha yaḥkumu baynahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa kādhibun kaffārun Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion.1 And those who take protectors besides Him (say), "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and (confirmed) disbeliever. See 39:1

item.title: Az-Zumar:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ alā lillahi l-dīnu l-khāliṣu wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa mā naʿbuduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilā l-lahi zul'fā inna l-laha yaḥkumu baynahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa kādhibun kaffārun Beware! Unto God alone is due all (Religion exclusive.) obedience; and those who take guardians besides Him, (say) "we worship them not (The excuse the idolators give.) save (in order) that they may make us near unto God," verily God will judge between them about what they differ; Verily, God guideth him not who is a liar, an ingrate (ungrateful.) Worshipping anything or any power in the place of God, in any form whatsoever…

item.title: Az-Zumar:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَاصْطَفَى مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ law arāda l-lahu an yattakhidha waladan la-iṣ'ṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāu sub'ḥānahu huwa l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru Had Allah intended to take a son, He could have chosen from those He has created whatever He wished. Immaculate is He! He is Allah, the One, the All-paramount.

item.title: Az-Zumar:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَاصْطَفَى مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ law arāda l-lahu an yattakhidha waladan la-iṣ'ṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāu sub'ḥānahu huwa l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.1 See 39:1

item.title: Az-Zumar:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَاصْطَفَى مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ law arāda l-lahu an yattakhidha waladan la-iṣ'ṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāu sub'ḥānahu huwa l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru Had God intended to take a son unto Himself, certainly would He select those He willeth of what He hath created, Hallowed is He! He (alone) is God, the Almighty. See verse 112:4. Neither God begets nor is He begotten. Begetting needs two interdependent partners to be the joint-causative factors, - none of them alone do anything of its own accord, without the co-operative partnership of the other. Dependence is a shortcoming, an imperfection and a weakness and God is Omnipotent, All-Perfect and All-Powerful and independent. The act of begetting needs a husband and a wife and the functioning of animals passion in both, thus the act is…

item.title: Az-Zumar:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi yukawwiru al-layla ʿalā l-nahāri wayukawwiru l-nahāra ʿalā al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman alā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He winds the night over the day, and winds the day over the night, and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term.1 Look! He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiver!

item.title: Az-Zumar:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi yukawwiru al-layla ʿalā l-nahāri wayukawwiru l-nahāra ʿalā al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman alā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running (its course) for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.1 He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. He makes the night to go in the day and makes the day to go in the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon. Each running for an appointed term. Verily, He is…

item.title: Az-Zumar:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi yukawwiru al-layla ʿalā l-nahāri wayukawwiru l-nahāra ʿalā al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman alā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru He hath created the heavens and the earth with the truth; causeth He the night to enter the day and the day to enter the night, and subjected the sun and the moon; each one speedeth on to an assigned term; Beware! He is the All-Mighty, the Oft- Forgiving. See verse 6:73. 'Mighty and the Most Forgiving' God is the Mightiest and at the same time the Most Pardonful for those who turn repentant of their sins and amend thereafter.

item.title: Az-Zumar:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِنْ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin thumma jaʿala min'hā zawjahā wa-anzala lakum mina l-anʿāmi thamāniyata azwājin yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqan min baʿdi khalqin fī ẓulumātin thalāthin dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna He created you from a single soul, then made from it its mate, and He has sent down for you eight mates of the cattle.1 He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold darkness. That is Allah, your Lord! To Him belongs all sovereignty. There is no god except Him. Then where are you being led away?

item.title: Az-Zumar:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِنْ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin thumma jaʿala min'hā zawjahā wa-anzala lakum mina l-anʿāmi thamāniyata azwājin yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqan min baʿdi khalqin fī ẓulumātin thalāthin dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates.1 He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses.2 That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted? See 39:5

item.title: Az-Zumar:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِنْ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin thumma jaʿala min'hā zawjahā wa-anzala lakum mina l-anʿāmi thamāniyata azwājin yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqan min baʿdi khalqin fī ẓulumātin thalāthin dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna He created you from a single (Refer to verses 16:72 & 22:5.) being, then made He from it its mate, and sent down for you eight (Refer to verse 6:143.) in pairs, of the cattle, He createth you in the wombs of your mothers a creation after a creation, in triple darkness; that is God your Lord, His is the kingdom; there is no god but He; How…

item.title: Az-Zumar:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَكْفُرُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكُمْ وَلَا يَرْضَى لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ وَإِنْ تَشْكُرُوْۤا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ in takfurū fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ʿankum walā yarḍā liʿibādihi l-kuf'ra wa-in tashkurū yarḍahu lakum walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri If you are ungrateful,1 indeed Allah has no need of you, though He does not approve ingratitude for His servants; and if you give thanks He approves that for you. No bearer shall bear another's burden; then to your Lord will be your return, whereat He will inform you concerning what you used to do. Indeed He knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: Az-Zumar:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَكْفُرُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكُمْ وَلَا يَرْضَى لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ وَإِنْ تَشْكُرُوْۤا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ in takfurū fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ʿankum walā yarḍā liʿibādihi l-kuf'ra wa-in tashkurū yarḍahu lakum walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves (i.e., likes) it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. If you disbelieve, then verily, Allah is…

item.title: Az-Zumar:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَكْفُرُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكُمْ وَلَا يَرْضَى لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ وَإِنْ تَشْكُرُوْۤا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ in takfurū fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ʿankum walā yarḍā liʿibādihi l-kuf'ra wa-in tashkurū yarḍahu lakum walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri If ungrateful ye be, then verily God is (Self-Sufficient) independent (above all needs. Refer to verse 3:96.) of you; and He liketh not ingratitude in His servants; and if ye be grateful; He liketh it in you; and no bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another; then unto your Lord is your return, then will He inform you of what ye were doing; verily, He knoweth all what is in the breasts (hearts). On the…

item.title: Az-Zumar:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً مِنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ wa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ilayhi thumma idhā khawwalahu niʿ'matan min'hu nasiya mā kāna yadʿū ilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillahi andādan liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿ bikuf'rika qalīlan innaka min aṣḥābi l-nāri When distress befalls man, he supplicates his Lord, turning to Him penitently. Then, when He grants him a blessing from Himself, he forgets that for which he had supplicated Him before,1 and sets up equals to Allah that he may lead [people] astray from His way. Say, 'Revel in your ingratitude2 for a while. Indeed you are among the inmates of the Fire.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً مِنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ wa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ilayhi thumma idhā khawwalahu niʿ'matan min'hu nasiya mā kāna yadʿū ilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillahi andādan liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿ bikuf'rika qalīlan innaka min aṣḥābi l-nāri And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him (alone); then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before,1 and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead (people) from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire." See 39:7

item.title: Az-Zumar:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً مِنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ wa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ilayhi thumma idhā khawwalahu niʿ'matan min'hu nasiya mā kāna yadʿū ilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillahi andādan liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿ bikuf'rika qalīlan innaka min aṣḥābi l-nāri And when toucheth (Afflicteth.) man a distress he crieth unto his Lord, oft-turning unto Him; and when He bestowed upon him a favour from Him, forgetteth he that for which he did cry unto Him before, and (he) setteth up rivals unto God, that he may beguile (men) to stray away from His path; say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad! unto such a man) "Enjoy thyself in thy ingratitude a little; verily,…

item.title: Az-Zumar:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ ءَانَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا يَحْذَرُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوْۤا رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ amman huwa qānitun ānāa al-layli sājidan waqāiman yaḥdharu l-ākhirata wayarjū raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawī alladhīna yaʿlamūna wa-alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna innamā yatadhakkaru ulū l-albābi Is he who supplicates1 in the watches of the night, prostrating and standing, apprehensive of the Hereafter and expecting the mercy of his Lord …?2 Say, 'Are those who know equal to those who do not know?' Only those who possess intellect take admonition.

item.title: Az-Zumar:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ ءَانَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا يَحْذَرُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوْۤا رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ amman huwa qānitun ānāa al-layli sājidan waqāiman yaḥdharu l-ākhirata wayarjū raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawī alladhīna yaʿlamūna wa-alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna innamā yatadhakkaru ulū l-albābi Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing (in prayer), fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (like one who does not)? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember (who are) people of understanding. Is one who is obedient to Allah, Ana'a Al-Layl prostrating and standing fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord? Say: "Are those who know equal to those who know not?" It is only men of…

item.title: Az-Zumar:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ ءَانَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا يَحْذَرُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوْۤا رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ amman huwa qānitun ānāa al-layli sājidan waqāiman yaḥdharu l-ākhirata wayarjū raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawī alladhīna yaʿlamūna wa-alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna innamā yatadhakkaru ulū l-albābi What! (this or) he who is prayerful during the hours of the night, prostrating in obeisance and standing, and he taketh heed of the hereafter and hopeth he for the mercy of his Lord! Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "What! Can those who know be equal to those who know not? Verily only the men of understanding take the warning" This is one of the verses of the Holy Qur'an which gives clear and definite guidance to the right course following only certain men of God who are endowed with distinguished…

item.title: Az-Zumar:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاعِبَادِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَأَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَاسِعَةٌ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ qul yāʿibādi alladhīna āmanū ittaqū rabbakum lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun wa-arḍu l-lahi wāsiʿatun innamā yuwaffā l-ṣābirūna ajrahum bighayri ḥisābin Say, '[Allah declares:] "O My servants who have faith! Be wary of your Lord. For those who do good in this world there will be a good [reward], and Allah's earth is vast. Indeed the patient will be paid in full their reward without any reckoning." '

item.title: Az-Zumar:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاعِبَادِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَأَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَاسِعَةٌ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ qul yāʿibādi alladhīna āmanū ittaqū rabbakum lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun wa-arḍu l-lahi wāsiʿatun innamā yuwaffā l-ṣābirūna ajrahum bighayri ḥisābin Say,1 "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account (i.e., limit)." Say: O My servants who believe, have Taqwa of your Lord. Good is for those who do good in this world, and Allah's earth is spacious! Only those who are patient shall receive their reward in full, without reckoning (39:10). Say: "Verily, I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion sincerely for Him (39:11). "And I am commanded (this)…

item.title: Az-Zumar:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاعِبَادِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَأَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَاسِعَةٌ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ qul yāʿibādi alladhīna āmanū ittaqū rabbakum lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun wa-arḍu l-lahi wāsiʿatun innamā yuwaffā l-ṣābirūna ajrahum bighayri ḥisābin Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "O' my servants who believe! Fear ye (the wrath of) your Lord, for those who do good in this world (there) is good, and God's earth is extensive; Verily, only the patient (Are there any in the Islamic World as a whole who were tortured, persecuted more than the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt, particularly the martyrs of Karbala, and those taken captives thereafter? What could be the recompense of Lord? How great & unaccountable would be their recompense.) ones will be paid their recompense without any account." Regarding the value of piety in…

item.title: Az-Zumar:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ qul innī umir'tu an aʿbuda l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna Say, 'Indeed I have been commanded to worship Allah with exclusive faith in Him,

item.title: Az-Zumar:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ qul innī umir'tu an aʿbuda l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, (being) sincere to Him in religion. See 39:10

item.title: Az-Zumar:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ qul innī umir'tu an aʿbuda l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna Say thou: "I have been bidden that I should worship God (alone) being sincere unto Him in religion," The pagans asked the Holy Prophet as to why he preached a new faith opposed to the idolatry already current, and put his followers and devotees to untold miseries and heartless persecution - This verse was revealed. Not in the order of the conversion of Meccans, but in the order of creation as a whole, mentioned in verse 3:183. (A.P.).

item.title: Az-Zumar:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wa-umir'tu li-an akūna awwala l-mus'limīna and I have been commanded to be the first of those who submit [to Him].'

item.title: Az-Zumar:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wa-umir'tu li-an akūna awwala l-mus'limīna And I have been commanded to be the first (among you) of the Muslims." See 39:10

item.title: Az-Zumar:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wa-umir'tu li-an akūna awwala l-mus'limīna And Commanded I am, that I shall be the first (Of those who submit themselves to God.) Muslim See 39:11

item.title: Az-Zumar:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Say, 'Indeed, should I disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day." Say: "Verily, if I disobey my Lord, I am afraid of the torment of a great Day (39:13). Say: "Allah Alone I worship by doing religious deeds sincerely for His sake only (39:14). "So, worship what you like besides Him." Say: "The losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Verily, that will be a manifest loss! (39:15). They shall have coverings of Fire, above them and covering (of Fire) beneath them. With this Allah frightens His servants: "O My servants, therefore have Taqwa of Me! (39:16). Creating Fear of the Punishment of Allah Allah says, say O Muhammad,…

item.title: Az-Zumar:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin Say: "Verily, fear I, if I disobey my Lord, the chastisement of a great day." See 39:11

item.title: Az-Zumar:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ دِينِي quli l-laha aʿbudu mukh'liṣan lahu dīnī Say, '[Only] Allah do I worship, putting my exclusive faith in Him.

item.title: Az-Zumar:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ دِينِي quli l-laha aʿbudu mukh'liṣan lahu dīnī Say, "Allah (alone) do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion. See 39:13

item.title: Az-Zumar:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ دِينِي quli l-laha aʿbudu mukh'liṣan lahu dīnī Say: "God (It is Whom) worship I, being sincere unto Him in my religion," See 39:11

item.title: Az-Zumar:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ fa-uʿ'budū mā shi'tum min dūnihi qul inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu You worship whatever you wish besides Him.' Say, 'Indeed the losers are those who ruin themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection.' Look! That is a manifest loss!

item.title: Az-Zumar:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ fa-uʿ'budū mā shi'tum min dūnihi qul inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss." See 39:13

item.title: Az-Zumar:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ fa-uʿ'budū mā shi'tum min dūnihi qul inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu Worship ye then whatsoever ye like other than Him." Say thou: "Verily, the losers are those who have lost their own selves and their families on the Day of Judgment; Beware! that is the clear loss This is not even a permission but a note of reproach meaning, if in spite of all the given admonitions and the clear guidance, any one chooses only to go astray, let him act as he pleases and entitle himself to the return for it. But later this verse is said to have been abrogated by the command for the fight for the cause of truth.1

item.title: Az-Zumar:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ يَاعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ lahum min fawqihim ẓulalun mina l-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun dhālika yukhawwifu l-lahu bihi ʿibādahu yāʿibādi fa-ittaqūni There will be canopies of fire above them, and [similar] canopies beneath them. With that Allah deters His servants. So, My servants, be wary of Me!

item.title: Az-Zumar:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ يَاعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ lahum min fawqihim ẓulalun mina l-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun dhālika yukhawwifu l-lahu bihi ʿibādahu yāʿibādi fa-ittaqūni They will have canopies (i.e., layers) of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens (i.e., warns) His servants. O My servants, then fear Me. See 39:13

item.title: Az-Zumar:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ يَاعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ lahum min fawqihim ẓulalun mina l-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun dhālika yukhawwifu l-lahu bihi ʿibādahu yāʿibādi fa-ittaqūni For them shall be from above them coverings of fire and from beneath them coverings; with that maketh God His servants to fear; (so) fear Me ye O' My servants. See 39:15

item.title: Az-Zumar:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ wa-alladhīna ij'tanabū l-ṭāghūta an yaʿbudūhā wa-anābū ilā l-lahi lahumu l-bush'rā fabashir ʿibādi As for those who stay clear of the worship of the Rebel and turn penitently to Allah, there is good news for them. So give good news to My servants

item.title: Az-Zumar:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ wa-alladhīna ij'tanabū l-ṭāghūta an yaʿbudūhā wa-anābū ilā l-lahi lahumu l-bush'rā fabashir ʿibādi But those who have avoided ṭāghūt,1 lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants. Those who avoid At-Taghut by not worshipping them and turn to Allah, for them are glad tidings; so announce the good news to My servants (39:17). Those who listen to the Word and follow the best thereof, those are (the ones) whom Allah has guided and those are men of understanding (39:18). Good News for the Righteous Abdur-Rahman bin Zayd bin Aslam said, narrating from his father: وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهَا Those who avoid At-Taghut by not worshipping them was revealed concerning Zayd bin 'Amr bin Nufayl…

item.title: Az-Zumar:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ wa-alladhīna ij'tanabū l-ṭāghūta an yaʿbudūhā wa-anābū ilā l-lahi lahumu l-bush'rā fabashir ʿibādi And those who shun the worship of the idols and turn they unto God, for them is the glad tidings, so bear thou the glad tidings unto My servants. See 39:15

item.title: Az-Zumar:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمْ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ alladhīna yastamiʿūna l-qawla fayattabiʿūna aḥsanahu ulāika alladhīna hadāhumu l-lahu wa-ulāika hum ulū l-albābi who listen to the word [of Allah] and follow the best [sense] of it. They are the ones whom Allah has guided, and it is they who possess intellect.

item.title: Az-Zumar:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمْ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ alladhīna yastamiʿūna l-qawla fayattabiʿūna aḥsanahu ulāika alladhīna hadāhumu l-lahu wa-ulāika hum ulū l-albābi Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding. See 39:17

item.title: Az-Zumar:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمْ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ alladhīna yastamiʿūna l-qawla fayattabiʿūna aḥsanahu ulāika alladhīna hadāhumu l-lahu wa-ulāika hum ulū l-albābi Those who hearken unto the word (All words – all talks.) and follow the best of it; those are they whom God hath guided; and those it is who are the men of understanding. See 39:15

item.title: Az-Zumar:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنْتَ تُنْقِذُ مَنْ فِي النَّارِ afaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimatu l-ʿadhābi afa-anta tunqidhu man fī l-nāri Can he against whom the word of punishment has become due?1 Can you rescue someone who is in the Fire?

item.title: Az-Zumar:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنْتَ تُنْقِذُ مَنْ فِي النَّارِ afaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimatu l-ʿadhābi afa-anta tunqidhu man fī l-nāri Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment (to be guided)? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire? Is, then one against whom the Word of punishment is justified (equal to the one who avoids evil)? Will you rescue him who is in the Fire (39:19). But those who have Taqwa of their Lord, for them are built lofty rooms, one above another under which rivers flow. (This is) the promise of Allah, and Allah does not fail in (His) promise (39:20). Allah says, 'if He has decreed that someone is to be doomed, can you save him from his misguidance and doom?' Which means, no one can guide him apart from Allah, because whomever…

item.title: Az-Zumar:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنْتَ تُنْقِذُ مَنْ فِي النَّارِ afaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimatu l-ʿadhābi afa-anta tunqidhu man fī l-nāri What! Is he on whom the sentence of chastisement hath been justly passed (equal to one who deserveth a reward)? Canst thou rescue him who is in the fire? See 39:15

item.title: Az-Zumar:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihā ghurafun mabniyyatun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waʿda l-lahi lā yukh'lifu l-lahu l-mīʿāda But as for those who are wary of their Lord, for them there will be lofty abodes with [other] lofty abodes built above them, with streams running beneath them —a promise of Allah. Allah does not break His promise.

item.title: Az-Zumar:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihā ghurafun mabniyyatun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waʿda l-lahi lā yukh'lifu l-lahu l-mīʿāda But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers,1 above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. (This is) the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in (His) promise. See 39:19

item.title: Az-Zumar:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihā ghurafun mabniyyatun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waʿda l-lahi lā yukh'lifu l-lahu l-mīʿāda But (for) those who fear (The pious ones.) the (wrath of) their Lord are lofty pavilions, above them (ever) lofty pavilions, built (for them), 'neath which flow rivers: (this is) the promise of God: Faileth not God (His) promise. Reference may be to the enjoyments awaiting the Pious in the life hereafter. (A.P.).

item.title: Az-Zumar:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fī l-arḍi thumma yukh'riju bihi zarʿan mukh'talifan alwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi Have you not seen that Allah sends down water from the sky, then He conducts it through the ground as springs. Then with it He brings forth crops of diverse hues. Then they wither and you see them turn yellow. Then He turns them into chaff. There is indeed an admonition in that for those who possess intellect.

item.title: Az-Zumar:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fī l-arḍi thumma yukh'riju bihi zarʿan mukh'talifan alwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs (and rivers) in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them (scattered) debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding. See you not that Allah sends down water from the sky, and causes it to penetrate the earth, as water springs, and…

item.title: Az-Zumar:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fī l-arḍi thumma yukh'riju bihi zarʿan mukh'talifan alwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi Seest thou not that God sendeth down water from heaven, then causeth it go into the earth in the springs, then bringeth forth with it herbage of various colours (Kinds.) then it withereth that thou seest it yellow, then He maketh it chaff (Crumbleth it down.) ? Verily in this is a reminder for men of understanding. See 39:20

item.title: Az-Zumar:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَى نُورٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَوَيْلٌ لِلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ afaman sharaḥa l-lahu ṣadrahu lil'is'lāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin min rabbihi fawaylun lil'qāsiyati qulūbuhum min dhik'ri l-lahi ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin Is someone whose breast Allah has opened to Islam so that he follows a light from His Lord?1 So woe to those whose hearts have been hardened to the remembrance of Allah. They are in manifest error.

item.title: Az-Zumar:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَى نُورٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَوَيْلٌ لِلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ afaman sharaḥa l-lahu ṣadrahu lil'is'lāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin min rabbihi fawaylun lil'qāsiyati qulūbuhum min dhik'ri l-lahi ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to (accept) Islām and he is upon (i.e., guided by) a light from his Lord (like one whose heart rejects it)? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error. See 39:21

item.title: Az-Zumar:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَى نُورٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَوَيْلٌ لِلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ afaman sharaḥa l-lahu ṣadrahu lil'is'lāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin min rabbihi fawaylun lil'qāsiyati qulūbuhum min dhik'ri l-lahi ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin What! is he whose breast (heart) God hath opened for Islam then he followeth the Light from God (like unto the hardhearted one)? Nay! Woe unto those whose hearts are hard against the remembrance of God; those are in a clear error. It is said that this verse was revealed referring to the First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib who was endued with the light of Islam and whose personal purity and spiritual excellence and that of the Holy Prophet was one and the same. Besides the Holy Prophet, Ali was the only one who never in his life…

item.title: Az-Zumar:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُتَشَابِهًا مَثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ al-lahu nazzala aḥsana l-ḥadīthi kitāban mutashābihan mathāniya taqshaʿirru min'hu julūdu alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ilā dhik'ri l-lahi dhālika hudā l-lahi yahdī bihi man yashāu waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Allah has sent down the best of discourses, a scripture [composed] of similar1 motifs, whereat quiver the skins of those who fear their Lord, then their skins and hearts soften to Allah's remembrance. That is Allah's guidance, by which He guides whomever He wishes; and whomever Allah leads astray, has no guide.

item.title: Az-Zumar:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُتَشَابِهًا مَثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ al-lahu nazzala aḥsana l-ḥadīthi kitāban mutashābihan mathāniya taqshaʿirru min'hu julūdu alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ilā dhik'ri l-lahi dhālika hudā l-lahi yahdī bihi man yashāu waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance (i.e., mention) of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no guide. Allah has sent down the Best Statement, a Book,…

item.title: Az-Zumar:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُتَشَابِهًا مَثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ al-lahu nazzala aḥsana l-ḥadīthi kitāban mutashābihan mathāniya taqshaʿirru min'hu julūdu alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ilā dhik'ri l-lahi dhālika hudā l-lahi yahdī bihi man yashāu waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin God hath sent down the best recital, a Book Consistent (Consistent similarity in its parts.) (in its parts) with iteration, at which do shudder the skins of those who fear (The pious ones.) their Lord, then get softened their skins and their hearts unto the remembrance of God; This is God's guidance, guideth He with it whomsoever He willeth; and whomsoever alloweth God to stray, for him there is no guide. The…

item.title: Az-Zumar:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ ذُوقُوْۤا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ afaman yattaqī biwajhihi sūa l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqū mā kuntum taksibūna What! Is someone who fends off with his face the terrible punishment [meted out to him] on the Day of Resurrection?1 And the wrongdoers will be told, 'Taste what you used to earn.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ ذُوقُوْۤا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ afaman yattaqī biwajhihi sūa l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqū mā kuntum taksibūna Then is he who will shield with his face1 the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection (like one secure from it)? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn." Is he then, who will confront with his face the awful torment on the Day of Resurrection? And it will be said to the wrongdoers: Taste what you used to earn! (39:24). Those before them denied, and so the torment came on them from directions they perceived not (39:25). So, Allah made them to taste the disgrace in the present life, but greater is the torment of the Hereafter if they only knew (39:26). The Final…

item.title: Az-Zumar:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ ذُوقُوْۤا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ afaman yattaqī biwajhihi sūa l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqū mā kuntum taksibūna What! is he then who hath to guard himself with his own face against the torment of the chastisement on the Day of Judgment (like unto him who is secure from it)? And it will be said unto the unjust: "Taste ye what ye were earning!" See 39:23

item.title: Az-Zumar:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Those who were before them impugned [the apostles], whereat the punishment overtook them whence they were not aware.

item.title: Az-Zumar:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive. See 39:24

item.title: Az-Zumar:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna Those before them did belie (the apostles) so came there unto them the chastisement from whence they perceived (Expect.) not. Regarding the chastisement coming to the disbelievers and the evil doers from which they would not perceive.1

item.title: Az-Zumar:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-adhāqahumu l-lahu l-khiz'ya fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna So Allah made them taste disgrace in the life of the world, and the punishment of the Hereafter will surely be greater, had they known.

item.title: Az-Zumar:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-adhāqahumu l-lahu l-khiz'ya fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. See 39:24

item.title: Az-Zumar:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-adhāqahumu l-lahu l-khiz'ya fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna Then did God make them taste the disgrace in the life of this world and certainly the chastisement of the hereafter is greater: did they but know. See 39:25

item.title: Az-Zumar:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna Certainly we have drawn for mankind in this Qur'ān every [kind of] example, so that they may take admonition

item.title: Az-Zumar:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every (kind of) example - that they might remember. And indeed We have put forth for men, in this Qur'an every kind of parable in order that they may remember (39:27). An Arabic Qur'an, without any crookedness (therein) in order that they may have Taqwa of Him (39:28). Allah puts forth a parable: a man belonging to many partners disputing with one another, and a man belonging entirely to one master. Are those two equal in comparison? All the praises and thanks be to Allah! But most of them know not (39:29). Verily, you will die, and verily, they (too) will die (39:30). Then, on the…

item.title: Az-Zumar:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna And indeed have We set forth for the people in this Qur'an examples of every sort that happly they may reflect. Matters spiritual, things abstract in nature and the factors of higher wisdom, would be conceived or understood easily by means of parables, metaphors and similitudes which are aptly used in the Holy Qur'an.
