Figurative language is used not only to teach matters of wisdom and higher knowledge, but also to treasure greater or higher secrets for the minds qualified to own them, with the necessary search for them at any time until the day of judgment.

item.title: Az-Zumar:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhī ʿiwajin laʿallahum yattaqūna —an Arabic Qur'ān, without any deviousness, so that they may be Godwary.

item.title: Az-Zumar:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhī ʿiwajin laʿallahum yattaqūna (It is) an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance1 that they might become righteous.2 See 39:27

item.title: Az-Zumar:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhī ʿiwajin laʿallahum yattaqūna An Arabic Qur'an without any crookedness, that happly they may guard (they may become pious.) themselves (against evil). See 39:27

item.title: Az-Zumar:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلًا فِیْهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulan fīhi shurakāu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Allah draws an example: a man jointly owned by several contending masters, and a man belonging entirely to one man: are the two equal in comparison?1 All praise belongs to Allah! But most of them do not know.

item.title: Az-Zumar:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلًا فِیْهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulan fīhi shurakāu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Allah presents an example: a man (i.e., slave) owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know. See 39:27

item.title: Az-Zumar:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلًا فِیْهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulan fīhi shurakāu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Setteth forth God the examples of the man in (the service of) associates quarrelling with each other, and of a man (devoted) wholly to a (single) man (Master). Can the two (such) ones be alike in condition? (No!) All Praise is God's; Nay! most of them know not. The impracticability of serving two masters opposed to each other, (i.e., the falsehood of Polytheism) and the harmony, the love and the happiness naturally found in the service of one single master, (i.e., Monotheism), is depicted here.

item.title: Az-Zumar:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ مَيِّتُونَ innaka mayyitun wa-innahum mayyitūna You will indeed die, and they [too] will die indeed.

item.title: Az-Zumar:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ مَيِّتُونَ innaka mayyitun wa-innahum mayyitūna Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die. See 39:27

item.title: Az-Zumar:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ مَيِّتُونَ innaka mayyitun wa-innahum mayyitūna Verily thou shall (one day) die, and they (too) shall (one day) die. All men good or bad, even the apostles of God, must die. None is exempt from the bodily death. There is life after death and it is then, and there, that every one good or bad would have to render account of his faith and deeds.

item.title: Az-Zumar:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūna Then on the Day of Resurrection you will indeed contend before your Lord.

item.title: Az-Zumar:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūna Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute. See 39:27

item.title: Az-Zumar:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūna Then verily ye on the Day of Judgment before your Lord will wrangle one with another. On the Day of Judgment, the disputers about the truth would realise their folly and meet the consequence of it.

item.title: Az-Zumar:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ faman aẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā l-lahi wakadhaba bil-ṣid'qi idh jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīna So who is a greater wrongdoer than him who attributes a falsehood to Allah, and denies the truth when it reaches him? Is not the [final] abode of the faithless in hell?

item.title: Az-Zumar:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ faman aẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā l-lahi wakadhaba bil-ṣid'qi idh jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīna So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers? Then, who does more wrong than one who utters a lie against Allah, and denies the truth when it comes to him! Is there not in Hell an abode for the disbelievers (39:32). And he who has brought the truth and (those who) believed therein, they are those who have Taqwa (39:33). They shall have all that they will desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good (39:34). So that Allah may expiate from…

item.title: Az-Zumar:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ faman aẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā l-lahi wakadhaba bil-ṣid'qi idh jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīna Who is then more unjust than he who lieth about God and belieth the truth when it cometh unto him; Is there not in the Hell an abode for the disbelievers? If man in spite of the continuous efforts for his guidance from the High above and in spite of the manifest signs drawing his attention towards the Truth, denies his own Creator, Sustainer and Protector, it would be an act of unpardonable ingratitude1. The Holy Prophet Jesus warns against blasphemy against the Holy Ghost: "Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not…

item.title: Az-Zumar:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ wa-alladhī jāa bil-ṣid'qi waṣaddaqa bihi ulāika humu l-mutaqūna He who brings the truth and he who confirms it —it is they who are the Godwary.

item.title: Az-Zumar:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ wa-alladhī jāa bil-ṣid'qi waṣaddaqa bihi ulāika humu l-mutaqūna And the one who has brought the truth (i.e., the Prophet SAW) and (they who) believed in it - those are the righteous. See 39:32

item.title: Az-Zumar:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ wa-alladhī jāa bil-ṣid'qi waṣaddaqa bihi ulāika humu l-mutaqūna And he who bringeth the truth and he who testifieth it - These are they that are the pious ones. By 'He who brought the truth' is meant the Holy Prophet Muhammad and it is the most undeniable fact of Islamic history that the first to believe among the males was Ali Ibn Abi Talib the first cousin and the Vicegerent of the Holy Prophet. Ibn Abbas says, when on the of 'Mi'raj' (Ascension) the Holy Prophet visited the Kingdom of God in the heavens, God told the Holy Prophet "Go and inform thy people on the earth what thou hast seen in the Heavens," to which the Holy Prophet submitted "Who would vouch my statement O' Lord?" The reply came "Ali would do…

item.title: Az-Zumar:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika jazāu l-muḥ'sinīna They will have whatever they wish near their Lord. That is the reward of the virtuous,

item.title: Az-Zumar:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika jazāu l-muḥ'sinīna They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good. See 39:32

item.title: Az-Zumar:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika jazāu l-muḥ'sinīna For them is whatever they please with their Lord; that is the recompense of the doers of good; See 39:33

item.title: Az-Zumar:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوْۤا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ liyukaffira l-lahu ʿanhum aswa-a alladhī ʿamilū wayajziyahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna so that Allah may absolve them of the worst of what they did, and pay them their reward by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: Az-Zumar:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوْۤا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ liyukaffira l-lahu ʿanhum aswa-a alladhī ʿamilū wayajziyahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do. See 39:32

item.title: Az-Zumar:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوْۤا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ liyukaffira l-lahu ʿanhum aswa-a alladhī ʿamilū wayajziyahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna That God may take away from them the worst of what they did, and recompense them with their reward for the best of what they used to do. See 39:33

item.title: Az-Zumar:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ alaysa l-lahu bikāfin ʿabdahu wayukhawwifūnaka bi-alladhīna min dūnihi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Does not Allah suffice [to defend] His servant? They1 would frighten you of others than Him. Yet whomever Allah leads astray, has no guide,

item.title: Az-Zumar:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ alaysa l-lahu bikāfin ʿabdahu wayukhawwifūnaka bi-alladhīna min dūnihi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW)? And (yet), they threaten you with those (they worship) other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide. Is not Allah Sufficient for His servant? Yet they try to frighten you with those besides Him! And whom Allah sends astray, for him there will be no guide (39:36). And whomsoever Allah guides, for him there will be no misleader. Is not Allah Almighty, Possessor of Retribution (39:37). And verily, if you ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth?" Surely, they will say: "Allah." Say: "Tell me then, the things that you…

item.title: Az-Zumar:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ alaysa l-lahu bikāfin ʿabdahu wayukhawwifūnaka bi-alladhīna min dūnihi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Is not God sufficient for His servant? And they frighten thee with those besides Him, and whomsoever God alloweth to stray, for him there shall not be any guide. (No amount of guidance will be effective.) See 39:33

item.title: Az-Zumar:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُضِلٍّ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِي انْتِقَامٍ waman yahdi l-lahu famā lahu min muḍillin alaysa l-lahu biʿazīzin dhī intiqāmin and whomever Allah guides, there is no one who can lead him astray. Is not Allah an all-mighty avenger?

item.title: Az-Zumar:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُضِلٍّ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِي انْتِقَامٍ waman yahdi l-lahu famā lahu min muḍillin alaysa l-lahu biʿazīzin dhī intiqāmin And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution? See 39:36

item.title: Az-Zumar:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُضِلٍّ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِي انْتِقَامٍ waman yahdi l-lahu famā lahu min muḍillin alaysa l-lahu biʿazīzin dhī intiqāmin And whomsoever God guideth, then him none shall beguile; Is not God the Almighty Lord of Retribution? (Not against any wrong done to God but, the wrong done to each other - He is Self-Subsistent, Self- Sufficient. None can harm 'Him'.) See 39:33

item.title: Az-Zumar:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu qul afara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi in arādaniya l-lahu biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi aw arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mum'sikātu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya l-lahu ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakilūna If you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will surely say, 'Allah.' Say, 'Have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? Should Allah desire some distress for me, can they remove the distress visited by Him? Or should He desire some mercy for me, can they withhold His mercy?' Say, 'Allah is sufficient for me. In Him let all the trusting put their trust.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu qul afara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi in arādaniya l-lahu biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi aw arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mum'sikātu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya l-lahu ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakilūna And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered1 what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him (alone) rely the (wise) reliers." See 39:36

item.title: Az-Zumar:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu qul afara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi in arādaniya l-lahu biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi aw arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mum'sikātu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya l-lahu ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakilūna And if thou ask them who created the heavens and the earth? They would certainly say: 'God'; Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "Bethink ye then of what ye call upon besides than God, if willeth God unto me a harm, could they be the removers of His harm, or if willeth (God) unto me His mercy, could they be the withholders of His mercy?" Say thou: "Sufficeth…

item.title: Az-Zumar:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ qul yāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūna Say, 'O my people! Act according to your ability. I too am acting. Soon you will know

item.title: Az-Zumar:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ qul yāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūna Say, "O my people, work according to your position, (for) indeed, I am working; and you are going to know. See 39:36

item.title: Az-Zumar:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ qul yāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "O' my people! Act ye (as ye like) in your place, verily I (too) do act, soon will ye come to know," See 39:38

item.title: Az-Zumar:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun who will be overtaken by a punishment that will disgrace him, and on whom a lasting punishment will descend.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment." See 39:36

item.title: Az-Zumar:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun Who it is unto whom cometh a chastisement which will disgrace him, and whom there falleth the everlasting doom. See 39:38

item.title: Az-Zumar:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ innā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba lilnnāsi bil-ḥaqi famani ih'tadā falinafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin Indeed We have sent down the Book to you for [the deliverance of] mankind with the truth. So whoever is guided is guided for his own sake, and whoever goes astray, goes astray to his own detriment, and it is not your duty to watch over them.

item.title: Az-Zumar:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ innā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba lilnnāsi bil-ḥaqi famani ih'tadā falinafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for (the benefit of) his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager (i.e., authority) over them. Verily, We have sent down to you the Book for mankind in truth. So, whosoever accepts the guidance, it is only for himself; and whosoever goes astray, he goes astray only to his (own) loss. And you are not a trustee over them (39:41). It is Allah Who takes away the souls at the time of their death,…

item.title: Az-Zumar:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ innā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba lilnnāsi bil-ḥaqi famani ih'tadā falinafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin Verily We sent down on thee the Book (Qur'an) for the sake of the people, with the truth; and whosoever is guided aright, it is for his own self, and whosoever goeth astray, strayeth he only to its own hurt, (detriment.) and thou art not over them a custodian. See 39:38

item.title: Az-Zumar:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنْفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرٰی إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ al-lahu yatawaffā l-anfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-allatī lam tamut fī manāmihā fayum'siku allatī qaḍā ʿalayhā l-mawta wayur'silu l-ukh'rā ilā ajalin musamman inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those who have not died in their sleep. Then He retains those for whom He has ordained death and releases the others until a specified time. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: Az-Zumar:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنْفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرٰی إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ al-lahu yatawaffā l-anfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-allatī lam tamut fī manāmihā fayum'siku allatī qaḍā ʿalayhā l-mawta wayur'silu l-ukh'rā ilā ajalin musamman inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die (He takes) during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought. See 39:41

item.title: Az-Zumar:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنْفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرٰی إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ al-lahu yatawaffā l-anfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-allatī lam tamut fī manāmihā fayum'siku allatī qaḍā ʿalayhā l-mawta wayur'silu l-ukh'rā ilā ajalin musamman inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna God taketh the souls at death, and those that die not (He taketh) during their sleep; and He withholdeth those on whom He hath passed the decree of death (from returning unto their bodies); but sendeth He the others (to their bodies) till a time which is fixed; Verily, in this are signs for a people who reflect. Points out the affinity between sleep and death - to some extent1. There is no doubt that in the state of sleep, the cognitive self-disassociates its attention from the external…

item.title: Az-Zumar:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَاءَ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ ami ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi shufaʿāa qul awalaw kānū lā yamlikūna shayan walā yaʿqilūna Have they taken intercessors besides Allah? Say, 'What! Even though they have no control over anything and cannot apply reason?!'

item.title: Az-Zumar:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَاءَ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ ami ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi shufaʿāa qul awalaw kānū lā yamlikūna shayan walā yaʿqilūna Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess (power over) anything, nor do they reason?" Have they taken as intercessors besides Allah? Say: "Even if they have power over nothing whatever and have no intelligence? (39:43). Say: "To Allah belongs all intercession. His is the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you shall be brought back (39:44). And when Allah Alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are filled with disgust and when those besides Him are mentioned, behold, they rejoice (39:45). There is no Intercession except with Allah, and how the Idolators are…

item.title: Az-Zumar:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَاءَ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ ami ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi shufaʿāa qul awalaw kānū lā yamlikūna shayan walā yaʿqilūna Or, have they taken intercessors other than God? Say thou: "What! even though they have no power over anything, nor do they understand." See 39:42

item.title: Az-Zumar:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ qul lillahi l-shafāʿatu jamīʿan lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi thumma ilayhi tur'jaʿūna Say, 'All intercession rests with Allah. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; then you will be brought back to Him.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ qul lillahi l-shafāʿatu jamīʿan lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi thumma ilayhi tur'jaʿūna Say, "To Allah belongs (the right to allow) intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned." See 39:43

item.title: Az-Zumar:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لِلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ qul lillahi l-shafāʿatu jamīʿan lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi thumma ilayhi tur'jaʿūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "God's (alone) is intercession altogether; His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; then unto Him (only) ye shall all be returned." About the doctrine of 'Shafa'at', i.e., (Intercession).1

item.title: Az-Zumar:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ wa-idhā dhukira l-lahu waḥdahu ish'ma-azzat qulūbu alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati wa-idhā dhukira alladhīna min dūnihi idhā hum yastabshirūna When Allah is mentioned alone, [thereat] shrink away the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter, but when others are mentioned besides Him, behold, they rejoice!

item.title: Az-Zumar:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ wa-idhā dhukira l-lahu waḥdahu ish'ma-azzat qulūbu alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati wa-idhā dhukira alladhīna min dūnihi idhā hum yastabshirūna And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those (worshipped) other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice. See 39:43

item.title: Az-Zumar:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ wa-idhā dhukira l-lahu waḥdahu ish'ma-azzat qulūbu alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati wa-idhā dhukira alladhīna min dūnihi idhā hum yastabshirūna When God alone is mentioned, shrink the hearts of those who believe not in the hereafter; and when those besides Him are mentioned, lo! they rejoice. This verse clearly says that a mere verbal declaration of the faith does not necessarily mean that every such declarer is also a genuine believer1. Such was the case with many of those who had merely professed Islam but were not believers in fact.2 Only such hypocrites were those who turned inimical to the House of the Holy Prophet (the holy Ahl Al-Bayt) for, immediately as the Holy Prophet departed from this world all such hypocrites who were…

item.title: Az-Zumar:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ quli l-lahuma fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ʿālima l-ghaybi wal-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fī mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Say, 'O Allah! Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, You will judge between Your servants concerning that about which they used to differ.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ quli l-lahuma fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ʿālima l-ghaybi wal-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fī mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ." Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! You will judge between your servants about that wherein they used to differ (39:46). And those who did wrong, if they had all that is on the earth and therewith as much again, they verily, would offer it to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the evil torment; and there will become apparent to them…

item.title: Az-Zumar:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ quli l-lahuma fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ʿālima l-ghaybi wal-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fī mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "O' God! the Originator of the heavens and the earth, the Knower of the unseen and the manifest! Thou (alone) shalt judge between Thy servants in the matter wherein they were differing." See 39:45

item.title: Az-Zumar:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِنْ سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَبَدَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَحْتَسِبُونَ walaw anna lilladhīna ẓalamū mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan wamith'lahu maʿahu la-if'tadaw bihi min sūi l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati wabadā lahum mina l-lahi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūna Even if the wrongdoers possessed all that is on the earth, and as much of it besides, they would surely offer it to redeem themselves with it from a terrible punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and there will appear to them from Allah what they had never reckoned.

item.title: Az-Zumar:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِنْ سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَبَدَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَحْتَسِبُونَ walaw anna lilladhīna ẓalamū mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan wamith'lahu maʿahu la-if'tadaw bihi min sūi l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati wabadā lahum mina l-lahi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūna And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would (attempt to) ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account.1 See 39:46

item.title: Az-Zumar:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِنْ سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَبَدَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَحْتَسِبُونَ walaw anna lilladhīna ẓalamū mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan wamith'lahu maʿahu la-if'tadaw bihi min sūi l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati wabadā lahum mina l-lahi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūna And had it been for those who did injustice, whatever is in the earth and the like added to it, they verily will seek to ransom themselves with it from the pain of the chastisement on the Day of Judgment; and there shall appear unto them, from God, that which they had not been reckoning. See 39:45

item.title: Az-Zumar:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā kasabū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna The evils of what they had earned will appear to them, and they will be besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: Az-Zumar:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā kasabū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule. See 39:46

item.title: Az-Zumar:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā kasabū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And shall appear unto them the evils of what they wrought, and shall surround them that which they used to mock at. See 39:45

item.title: Az-Zumar:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ نِعْمَةً مِنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma idhā khawwalnāhu niʿ'matan minnā qāla innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿil'min bal hiya fit'natun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna When distress befalls man, he supplicates Us. Then, when We grant him a blessing from Us, he says, 'I was given it by virtue of [my] knowledge.' Rather it is a test, but most of them do not know.

item.title: Az-Zumar:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ نِعْمَةً مِنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma idhā khawwalnāhu niʿ'matan minnā qāla innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿil'min bal hiya fit'natun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of (my) knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know. When harm touches man, he calls to Us (for help); then when We have changed it into a favor from Us, he says: "Only because of knowledge I obtained it." Nay, it is only a trial, but most of them know not (39:49). Verily, those before them said it, yet (all) that they…

item.title: Az-Zumar:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ نِعْمَةً مِنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ fa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma idhā khawwalnāhu niʿ'matan minnā qāla innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿil'min bal hiya fit'natun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna And when toucheth (Afflicteth.) man a harm he crieth unto Us; then when We grant him a favour from Us, sayeth he; "I have been granted it only on account of (my) knowledge." Nay! it is only a trial, but most of them know not. See 39:45

item.title: Az-Zumar:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ qad qālahā alladhīna min qablihim famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna Those who were before them [also] said that, but what they used to earn did not avail them.

item.title: Az-Zumar:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ qad qālahā alladhīna min qablihim famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn. See 39:49

item.title: Az-Zumar:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ qad qālahā alladhīna min qablihim famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna Indeed, the same did say those before them, but availed them not what they had been earning. See 39:45

item.title: Az-Zumar:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā kasabū wa-alladhīna ẓalamū min hāulāi sayuṣībuhum sayyiātu mā kasabū wamā hum bimuʿ'jizīna So the evils of what they had earned visited them, and as for the wrongdoers among these, the evils of what they earn shall be visited on them and they will not thwart [Allah's might].

item.title: Az-Zumar:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā kasabū wa-alladhīna ẓalamū min hāulāi sayuṣībuhum sayyiātu mā kasabū wamā hum bimuʿ'jizīna And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these (people) will be struck (i.e., afflicted) by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.1 See 39:49

item.title: Az-Zumar:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā kasabū wa-alladhīna ẓalamū min hāulāi sayuṣībuhum sayyiātu mā kasabū wamā hum bimuʿ'jizīna So befell unto them the evils what they did earn; and (for) those of these who did injustice, soon shall befall unto them the evils what they did earn, and they shall frustrate Us not (in Our Plans). See 39:45

item.title: Az-Zumar:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yaʿlamū anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Do they not know that Allah expands the provision for whomever He wishes and tightens it [for whomever He wishes]? There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: Az-Zumar:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yaʿlamū anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna Do they not know that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts (it)? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe. See 39:49

item.title: Az-Zumar:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ awalam yaʿlamū anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna What! know they not that (it is) God (alone Who) amplifieth the sustenance unto whomsoever He willeth, and straiteneth (it) (whosoever He willeth); Verily in this are signs for a people who believe. The provision of sustenance to His creation is a matter which is in the hands of God Himself. He provides every thing with its sustenance. Everything needs the sustenance necessary for its life and when sustenance is in the hands of God, the existence of everything would naturally depend upon Him, and everything should necessarily adore Him and none else. There is no need for any creature to fear or implore anyone else save God. Any act…

item.title: Az-Zumar:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوْۤا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْۤا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ qul yāʿibādiya alladhīna asrafū ʿalā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati l-lahi inna l-laha yaghfiru l-dhunūba jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Say [that Allah declares,] 'O My servants who have committed excesses against their own souls, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed Allah will forgive all sins. Indeed He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

item.title: Az-Zumar:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوْۤا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْۤا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ qul yāʿibādiya alladhīna asrafū ʿalā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati l-lahi inna l-laha yaghfiru l-dhunūba jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves (by sinning), do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.1 Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful." Say: "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, verily, Allah forgives all sins. Truly, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (39:53). "And turn in repentance (and in obedience with true faith) to your Lord and submit to Him before the torment comes upon you, (and) then you will not be helped (39:54). "And follow the best of that which…

item.title: Az-Zumar:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوْۤا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْۤا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ qul yāʿibādiya alladhīna asrafū ʿalā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati l-lahi inna l-laha yaghfiru l-dhunūba jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "O' My servants! who have been extravagant unto their own selves, despair ye not of the mercy of God; verily God forgiveth sins all together; verily He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful." The First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib says that there is no greater verse of God's grace and His mercy than this verse in the whole of the Holy Qur'an. It is Islam and no other religion in the world which introduces God to His creation, not as a mere mercilessly just judge whose decisions are based only on law…

item.title: Az-Zumar:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ wa-anībū ilā rabbikum wa-aslimū lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūna Turn penitently to Him and submit to Him before the punishment overtakes you, whereupon you will not be helped.

item.title: Az-Zumar:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ wa-anībū ilā rabbikum wa-aslimū lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūna And return (in repentance) to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped. See 39:53

item.title: Az-Zumar:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ wa-anībū ilā rabbikum wa-aslimū lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūna And return ye unto your Lord, and resign ye yourselves unto Him, ere cometh unto you the chastisement, for then ye shall not be helped. This verse invites the sinners to turn to the Lord before their case comes up to Him for His final decision. Pardon could reasonably be had before being caught by the execution or the application of the law and before being held by justice to deal with the offence, and once the decree is passed there remains no room for any excuse for the one who never repented and went on committing the offence until caught and brought to account. Mercy would naturally be due to one who surrenders…

item.title: Az-Zumar:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ wa-ittabiʿū aḥsana mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu baghtatan wa-antum lā tashʿurūna And follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Lord, before the punishment overtakes you suddenly while you are unaware.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ wa-ittabiʿū aḥsana mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu baghtatan wa-antum lā tashʿurūna And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord (i.e., the Qur’ān) before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive. See 39:53

item.title: Az-Zumar:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ wa-ittabiʿū aḥsana mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu baghtatan wa-antum lā tashʿurūna And follow ye the most excellent thing what hath been sent down unto you from your Lord, ere cometh unto you the chastisement suddenly while ye even perceive it not, The best one sent down to man from God is the Holy Prophet with the Word of God, the Holy Qur'an. Before leaving this world, the Holy Prophet made it known to the people as to who should be their ideal or models in their practical life in this world in his absence from it. There are a great many of his declarations about the position of his Ahl Al-Bayt and the most prominent and directly speaking are…

item.title: Az-Zumar:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَاحَسْرَتَى عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْتُ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ an taqūla nafsun yāḥasratā ʿalā mā farraṭtu fī janbi l-lahi wa-in kuntu lamina l-sākhirīna Lest anyone should say, 'Alas for my negligence in the vicinage of Allah! Indeed I was among those who ridiculed.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَاحَسْرَتَى عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْتُ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ an taqūla nafsun yāḥasratā ʿalā mā farraṭtu fī janbi l-lahi wa-in kuntu lamina l-sākhirīna Lest a soul should say,1 "Oh, (how great is) my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah and that I was among the mockers." See 39:53

item.title: Az-Zumar:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَاحَسْرَتَى عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْتُ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ an taqūla nafsun yāḥasratā ʿalā mā farraṭtu fī janbi l-lahi wa-in kuntu lamina l-sākhirīna Lest a soul should say: "Oh! Alas, Woe unto me! for what I failed (in my duty) unto God, and certainly was I of those who mocked," Thus, a disbeliever or a sinner who mocked at every admonition, would retrieve his position and all kinds of regrets would assail the individual with sighs of no avail.

item.title: Az-Zumar:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ aw taqūla law anna l-laha hadānī lakuntu mina l-mutaqīna Or say, 'Had Allah guided me I would have surely been among the Godwary!'

item.title: Az-Zumar:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ aw taqūla law anna l-laha hadānī lakuntu mina l-mutaqīna Or (lest) it say, "If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the righteous." See 39:53

item.title: Az-Zumar:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ aw taqūla law anna l-laha hadānī lakuntu mina l-mutaqīna Or, it should say: "Had God guided me, I would certainly have been of the pious ones," See 39:56

item.title: Az-Zumar:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرٰی الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ aw taqūla ḥīna tarā l-ʿadhāba law anna lī karratan fa-akūna mina l-muḥ'sinīna Or say, when he sights the punishment, 'If only there had been a second chance for me I would be among the virtuous!'

item.title: Az-Zumar:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرٰی الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ aw taqūla ḥīna tarā l-ʿadhāba law anna lī karratan fa-akūna mina l-muḥ'sinīna Or (lest) it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn1 so I could be among the doers of good." See 39:53

item.title: Az-Zumar:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرٰی الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ aw taqūla ḥīna tarā l-ʿadhāba law anna lī karratan fa-akūna mina l-muḥ'sinīna Or, it should say when it seeth the chastisement: "Had there been only a return for me, I would be of the righteous (ones)" See 39:56

item.title: Az-Zumar:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ ءَايَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ balā qad jāatka āyātī fakadhabta bihā wa-is'takbarta wakunta mina l-kāfirīna 'Yes, My signs certainly came to you, but you denied them and acted arrogantly and you were among the faithless.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ ءَايَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ balā qad jāatka āyātī fakadhabta bihā wa-is'takbarta wakunta mina l-kāfirīna But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers. See 39:53

item.title: Az-Zumar:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ ءَايَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ balā qad jāatka āyātī fakadhabta bihā wa-is'takbarta wakunta mina l-kāfirīna Nay! indeed did come unto thee My signs, then thou didst belie them, thou didst act proudly and thou wert of the disbelievers. See 39:56

item.title: Az-Zumar:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرٰی الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُمْ مُسْوَدَّةٌ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ wayawma l-qiyāmati tarā alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā l-lahi wujūhuhum mus'waddatun alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'mutakabbirīna On the Day of Resurrection you will see those who attributed lies to Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the [final] abode of the arrogant in hell?

item.title: Az-Zumar:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرٰی الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُمْ مُسْوَدَّةٌ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ wayawma l-qiyāmati tarā alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā l-lahi wujūhuhum mus'waddatun alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'mutakabbirīna And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah (with) their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant? And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied against Allah – their faces will be black. Is there not in Hell an abode for the arrogant (39:60). And Allah will deliver those who have Taqwa to their places of success. Evil shall touch them not, nor shall they grieve (39:61). The Consequences for Those Who Tell Lies against Allah and for Those Who have Taqwa Allah tells us that on the Day of Resurrection, some faces will be blackened and…

item.title: Az-Zumar:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرٰی الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُمْ مُسْوَدَّةٌ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ wayawma l-qiyāmati tarā alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā l-lahi wujūhuhum mus'waddatun alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'mutakabbirīna And on the Day of Resurrection thou shalt see those who have uttered lies against God their faces shall be blackened; is there not in Hell an abode for the proud? 'Spotless White' has been taken as a sign of joy and honour1 and 'Darkness or Blackness' as the symbol of sorrow, grief, disgrace.2 With this sign of their given complexion, the blessed and the cursed ones on the day would be identified by the others.

item.title: Az-Zumar:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ wayunajjī l-lahu alladhīna ittaqaw bimafāzatihim lā yamassuhumu l-sūu walā hum yaḥzanūna Allah will deliver those who were Godwary with their salvation. No ill shall touch them, nor will they grieve.

item.title: Az-Zumar:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ wayunajjī l-lahu alladhīna ittaqaw bimafāzatihim lā yamassuhumu l-sūu walā hum yaḥzanūna And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment;1 no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve. See 39:60

item.title: Az-Zumar:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ wayunajjī l-lahu alladhīna ittaqaw bimafāzatihim lā yamassuhumu l-sūu walā hum yaḥzanūna And shall deliver God those who guard (themselves) against evil, with their success: evil shall touch them not, nor shall they grieve. See 39:60

item.title: Az-Zumar:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ al-lahu khāliqu kulli shayin wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun Allah is creator of all things, and He watches over all things.

item.title: Az-Zumar:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ al-lahu khāliqu kulli shayin wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs. Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the Trustee over all things (39:62). To Him belong the Maqalid of the heavens and the earth. And those who disbelieve in the Ayat of Allah, such are they who will be the losers (39:63). Say: "Do you order me to worship other than Allah O you fools! (39:64). And indeed it has been revealed to you, as it was to those before you: "If you join others in worship with Allah, surely your deeds will be in vain, and you will certainly be among the losers (39:65). Nay! But worship Allah, and be among the…

item.title: Az-Zumar:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ al-lahu khāliqu kulli shayin wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun God (alone) is the Creator of everything, and He (alone) is over all things the Guardian. See 39:60

item.title: Az-Zumar:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūna To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth, and those who disbelieve in the signs of Allah —it is they who are the losers.

item.title: Az-Zumar:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūna To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers. See 39:62

item.title: Az-Zumar:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūna His are the keys of the heavens and the earth; and those who disbelieve in the signs of God, these are they who are the losers. See 39:60

item.title: Az-Zumar:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجَاهِلُونَ qul afaghayra l-lahi tamurūnnī aʿbudu ayyuhā l-jāhilūna Say, 'Will you, then, bid me to worship other than Allah, O you senseless ones?!'

item.title: Az-Zumar:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجَاهِلُونَ qul afaghayra l-lahi tamurūnnī aʿbudu ayyuhā l-jāhilūna Say, (O Muḥammad), "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?" See 39:62

item.title: Az-Zumar:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجَاهِلُونَ qul afaghayra l-lahi tamurūnnī aʿbudu ayyuhā l-jāhilūna Say (Ask the people.) thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!)'. "What! Bid ye me to worship others than God? O' ye ignorant ones!" The Gospel of Unity, has been the message from God to mankind since the birth of the very First man. The passage itself indicates that it is a general statement, no particular person is meant. The people are addressed through the Holy Prophet. It indicates that not only associating with God destroys one's deeds but even if the motive of the deeds is not exclusively for God. (A.P.).

item.title: Az-Zumar:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walaqad ūḥiya ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika la-in ashrakta layaḥbaṭanna ʿamaluka walatakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna Certainly it has been revealed to you and to those [who have been] before you: 'If you ascribe a partner to Allah your works shall fail and you shall surely be among the losers.

item.title: Az-Zumar:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walaqad ūḥiya ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika la-in ashrakta layaḥbaṭanna ʿamaluka walatakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate (anything) with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers. See 39:62

item.title: Az-Zumar:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walaqad ūḥiya ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika la-in ashrakta layaḥbaṭanna ʿamaluka walatakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna And indeed hath it been revealed unto thee and unto those before thee: "Verily if thou (Prophet addressed for the people.) associatest (others with God), certainly would come to naught thy work, and certainly wouldst thou be of the losers." See 39:64

item.title: Az-Zumar:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ bali l-laha fa-uʿ'bud wakun mina l-shākirīna Rather, worship Allah, and be among the grateful!'

item.title: Az-Zumar:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ bali l-laha fa-uʿ'bud wakun mina l-shākirīna Rather, worship (only) Allah and be among the grateful. See 39:62

item.title: Az-Zumar:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ bali l-laha fa-uʿ'bud wakun mina l-shākirīna Nay! But God alone, worship thou and be of the thankful ones. See 39:64

item.title: Az-Zumar:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا قَدَرُوْۤا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ wamā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi wal-arḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma l-qiyāmati wal-samāwātu maṭwiyyātun biyamīnihi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna They do not regard Allah with the regard due to Him, yet the entire earth will be in His fist on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens, scrolled, in His right hand. Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: Az-Zumar:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا قَدَرُوْۤا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ wamā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi wal-arḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma l-qiyāmati wal-samāwātu maṭwiyyātun biyamīnihi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal,1 while the earth entirely will be (within) His grip2 on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand.3 Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him. They made not a just estimate of Allah such as is due to Him. And on the Day of Resurrection the whole of the earth will be grasped by His Hand and the heavens will be rolled up in His Right Hand. Glorified be He, and High be He above all that they associate as partners with Him (39:67). The Idolators did not…

item.title: Az-Zumar:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا قَدَرُوْۤا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ wamā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi wal-arḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma l-qiyāmati wal-samāwātu maṭwiyyātun biyamīnihi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna They have esteemed (Refer to verse 22:74.) not God, as it is His rightful due; While the whole earth shall be in His grip on the Day of Judgment and heavens rolled (Refer to verses 14:48, 21:104, 22:74 & 39:69.) up (shall be) in His right (An aspect of God's power.) hand; Hallowed is He, high above what they associate (with Him). If they have duly valued the Power, Might and the Authority of God, people would never have run after false gods and worshipped imaginary beings who have neither any power nor any authority with them, to rule the destiny of anything in the world…

item.title: Az-Zumar:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِیْهِ أُخْرٰی فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنْظُرُونَ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri faṣaʿiqa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu thumma nufikha fīhi ukh'rā fa-idhā hum qiyāmun yanẓurūna And the Trumpet will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens will swoon and whoever is on the earth, except whomever Allah wishes. Then it will be blown a second time, behold, they will rise up, looking on!

item.title: Az-Zumar:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِیْهِ أُخْرٰی فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنْظُرُونَ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri faṣaʿiqa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu thumma nufikha fīhi ukh'rā fa-idhā hum qiyāmun yanẓurūna And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on. And the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth will swoon away, except him whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown another time, and behold they will be standing, looking on (39:68). And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and…

item.title: Az-Zumar:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِیْهِ أُخْرٰی فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنْظُرُونَ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri faṣaʿiqa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu thumma nufikha fīhi ukh'rā fa-idhā hum qiyāmun yanẓurūna And (when) shall be blown the Trumpet, then shall swoon (die) whoever is in the heavens and whoever is in the earth save those whom God hath willed (to keep alive); then (the Trumpet) shall be blown (Refer to the note on Trumpet.) again, then lo! they shall stand up awaiting. With the first Trumpet would all the beings on the earth be caused to die and with the second Trumpet all heavenly beings would cease to live. And there will come into existence a new earth and a new heaven with the people resurrected.1 'Sayiqa'…

item.title: Az-Zumar:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ وَجِاىءَ بِالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wa-ashraqati l-arḍu binūri rabbihā wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu wajīa bil-nabiyīna wal-shuhadāi waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And the earth will glow with the light of her Lord, and the Book1 will be set up, and the prophets and the martyrs2 will be brought, and judgment will be made between them with justice, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: Az-Zumar:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ وَجِاىءَ بِالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wa-ashraqati l-arḍu binūri rabbihā wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu wajīa bil-nabiyīna wal-shuhadāi waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record (of deeds) will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged. See 39:68

item.title: Az-Zumar:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ وَجِاىءَ بِالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wa-ashraqati l-arḍu binūri rabbihā wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu wajīa bil-nabiyīna wal-shuhadāi waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And the earth shall get radiant with the light of its Lord, and the Book (Book of the deeds of the people.) (of deeds) shall be set, and the prophets shall be brought up and the witnesses, (Refer to verses 36:65, 40:51, 41:20 - 41:23.) and (it shall) be judged between them, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly. 'Kitab' means the individual record of the deeds, i.e., deeds of every individual. (A.P.). This includes the witnesses of high order1 but even the very organs of the individual's body.2 (A.P.)

item.title: Az-Zumar:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahuwa aʿlamu bimā yafʿalūna Every soul will be recompensed fully for what it has done, and He is best aware of what they do.

item.title: Az-Zumar:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahuwa aʿlamu bimā yafʿalūna And every soul will be fully compensated (for) what it did; and He is most knowing1 of what they do. See 39:68

item.title: Az-Zumar:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahuwa aʿlamu bimā yafʿalūna And shall be paid in full unto every soul what it hath wrought, and He knoweth best what they do. See 39:69

item.title: Az-Zumar:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنْذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ wasīqa alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā futiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatlūna ʿalaykum āyāti rabbikum wayundhirūnakum liqāa yawmikum hādhā qālū balā walākin ḥaqqat kalimatu l-ʿadhābi ʿalā l-kāfirīna The faithless will be driven to hell in throngs. When they reach it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, 'Did there not come to you [any] apostles from among yourselves, reciting to you the signs of your Lord and warning you of the encounter of this day of yours?' They will say, 'Yes, but the word of punishment became due against the faithless.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنْذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ wasīqa alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā futiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatlūna ʿalaykum āyāti rabbikum wayundhirūnakum liqāa yawmikum hādhā qālū balā walākin ḥaqqat kalimatu l-ʿadhābi ʿalā l-kāfirīna And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word (i.e., decree) of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers." And…

item.title: Az-Zumar:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنْذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ wasīqa alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā futiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatlūna ʿalaykum āyāti rabbikum wayundhirūnakum liqāa yawmikum hādhā qālū balā walākin ḥaqqat kalimatu l-ʿadhābi ʿalā l-kāfirīna And shall be driven those who disbelieved, unto the Hell, in flocks; Until, when come they to it, its doors shall be opened and shall say unto them the keepers (The angels.) of it; (The hell.) "Came not unto you apostles from among you reciting unto you the signs of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this your day?" they shall say; "Yea! but just is the sentence of…

item.title: Az-Zumar:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ ادْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ qīla ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna It will be said, 'Enter the gates of hell to remain in it [forever]. Evil is the [ultimate] abode of the arrogant.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ ادْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ qīla ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna (To them) it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant." See 39:71

item.title: Az-Zumar:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ ادْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ qīla ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna It shall be said (unto them): "Enter ye (Now) the gates of Hell, to abide therein, and wretched the abode of the arrogant." See 39:69

item.title: Az-Zumar:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَالِدِينَ wasīqa alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum ilā l-janati zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā wafutiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ʿalaykum ṭib'tum fa-ud'khulūhā khālidīna Those who are wary of their Lord will be led to paradise in throngs. When they reach it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, 'Peace be to you! You are welcome!1 Enter it to remain [forever].'

item.title: Az-Zumar:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَالِدِينَ wasīqa alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum ilā l-janati zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā wafutiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ʿalaykum ṭib'tum fa-ud'khulūhā khālidīna But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," (they will enter).1 And those who had Taqwa will be led to Paradise in groups till when they reach it, and its gates will be opened and its keepers will say: "Salam 'Alaykum (peace be upon you)! You have done well, so enter here to abide therein forever (39:73). And they will say: "All the praises and…

item.title: Az-Zumar:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَالِدِينَ wasīqa alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum ilā l-janati zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā wafutiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ʿalaykum ṭib'tum fa-ud'khulūhā khālidīna And shall be conveyed those who feared (Take shelter against - or guard against.) (the wrath of) their Lord, in companies unto the garden; until when they come to it, and its doors shall be opened, and the keepers of it shall say unto them: "Peace be on you! ye shall be happy; Enter it then to abide." See 39:69

item.title: Az-Zumar:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī ṣadaqanā waʿdahu wa-awrathanā l-arḍa natabawwa-u mina l-janati ḥaythu nashāu faniʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīna They will say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who has fulfilled His promise to us and made us heirs to the earth, that we may settle in paradise wherever we may wish!' How excellent is the reward of the workers [of righteousness]!

item.title: Az-Zumar:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī ṣadaqanā waʿdahu wa-awrathanā l-arḍa natabawwa-u mina l-janati ḥaythu nashāu faniʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīna And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth (so) we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of (righteous) workers." See 39:73

item.title: Az-Zumar:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī ṣadaqanā waʿdahu wa-awrathanā l-arḍa natabawwa-u mina l-janati ḥaythu nashāu faniʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīna And they shall say: "All praise is God's, Who hath made good to us His promise, and He hath made us to inherit the earth, we may dwell in the gardens wherever we please, and goodly is the recompense of the workers (of good deeds)." The creation begins with 'Alhamdulillah' praising God and ends with the same. Thus, the Holy Imams recommend that man should begin with thanksgiving to God and end it with it.1 Attributing this grace and the blessings of God to the early Muslim conquest of a strip of some fertile lands, is nothing but the profanation of the high ideals of Islam, into a…

item.title: Az-Zumar:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ watarā l-malāikata ḥāffīna min ḥawli l-ʿarshi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi waqīla l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, celebrating the praise of their Lord, and judgment will be made between them with justice, and it will be said, 'All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds!'

item.title: Az-Zumar:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ watarā l-malāikata ḥāffīna min ḥawli l-ʿarshi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi waqīla l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting (Allah) with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "(All) praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds." And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne from all round, glorifying the praises of their Lord. And they will be judged with truth. And it will be said, All the praises and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of all that exits (39:75). Allah tells us how He will pass judgement on the people of Paradise and Hell, and put each of them in the place…

item.title: Az-Zumar:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
