item.description: وَتَرٰی الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ watarā l-malāikata ḥāffīna min ḥawli l-ʿarshi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi waqīla l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna And thou shalt see the angels circling around the 'Arsh' (Refer to verse 40:7.) (The Throne of Absolute Authority), celebrating (Hallowing Him by His praise.) the Praise of their Lord; and it shall be judged between them with justice, and it shall be said, All praise is God's the Lord of the worlds! This is the presentation of the Absolute Divine Sovereignty and the Hold over the entire universe, in the terms of the Royal Majestic form of which the people are acquainted. Otherwise, the throne actually as the Holy Imams of the Ahl Al-Bayt interpret it, is His All-Embracing Knowledge wherein the angelical entities and…

item.title: Faatir:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ al-ḥamdu lillahi fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jāʿili l-malāikati rusulan ulī ajniḥatin mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa yazīdu fī l-khalqi mā yashāu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun All praise belongs to Allah, originator of the heavens and the earth, maker of the angels [His] messengers, possessing wings, two, three or four [of them]. He adds to the creation whatever He wishes. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: Faatir:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ al-ḥamdu lillahi fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jāʿili l-malāikati rusulan ulī ajniḥatin mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa yazīdu fī l-khalqi mā yashāu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun (All) praise is (due) to Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, (who) made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent. الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ 1. All praise is due to Allah, Fatir of the heavens and the earth, Who made the angels messengers with wings, two or three or four. He…

item.title: Faatir:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ al-ḥamdu lillahi fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jāʿili l-malāikati rusulan ulī ajniḥatin mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa yazīdu fī l-khalqi mā yashāu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun (All) praise is God's, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, the Maker of the angels, messengers flying on wings, two, and three, and four: (A figurative expression to the graded flights.) He addeth to His creation whatever He willeth; Verily God, over all things hath power. All praise is God's and gratitude due only to Him.1 To know God the Creator or the Originator of the Primeval cause which started the genetic process of the creation of the Universe and its ever-progressive functioning in the innumerable forms and in infinite…

item.title: Faatir:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ mā yaftaḥi l-lahu lilnnāsi min raḥmatin falā mum'sika lahā wamā yum'sik falā mur'sila lahu min baʿdihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Whatever mercy Allah unfolds for the people, no one can withhold it; and whatever He withholds no one can release it after Him,1 and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Faatir:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ mā yaftaḥi l-lahu lilnnāsi min raḥmatin falā mum'sika lahā wamā yum'sik falā mur'sila lahu min baʿdihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. Whatever of mercy, Allah may grant to mankind, none can withhold it; and whatever He may withhold, none can grant it thereafter. And He is the Almighty, the All-Wise (35:2). None can Withhold the Mercy of Allah Allah tells us that what He wills, happens, and what He does not will, does not happen. None can give what He withholds, and none can withhold what He gives. Imam Ahmad recorded that…

item.title: Faatir:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ mā yaftaḥi l-lahu lilnnāsi min raḥmatin falā mum'sika lahā wamā yum'sik falā mur'sila lahu min baʿdihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Whatever God layeth open of His mercy unto the people, there is none to hold it back, and whatever He holdeth back there is none to send it forth after that, and He is the All- Mighty, the All-Wise. God's will is always done. No power can ever stop or withhold any decrees of His, be that to grant any gift or to chastise any individual or people.

item.title: Faatir:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ yāayyuhā l-nāsu udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum hal min khāliqin ghayru l-lahi yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna O mankind! Remember Allah's blessing upon you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the sky and the earth? There is no god except Him. So where do you stray?

item.title: Faatir:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ yāayyuhā l-nāsu udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum hal min khāliqin ghayru l-lahi yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna O mankind, remember the favor of Allah upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded? O mankind! Remember the grace of Allah upon you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the sky (rain) and the earth? La ilaha illa Huwa. How then are you turning away (from Him) (35:3). The Evidence of Tawhid Allah shows His servants that they should worship Him Alone, for just as He is Independent in His…

item.title: Faatir:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ yāayyuhā l-nāsu udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum hal min khāliqin ghayru l-lahi yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna O' ye people! Remember ye God's bounty on you; Is there any creator other than God who provideth you with your sustenance from the heaven and the earth? There is no god but He; Whence then are ye turned away (from the truth)? The Primal Cause of the whole creation, is none else but God. By the question 'whether man finds any other creator besides the Only God' man is exhorted to turn only to God and not to get involved in the false fancies about imaginary deities. Sustenance is necessary for the soul as for the body…

item.title: Faatir:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru If they impugn you, certainly [other] apostles were impugned before you, and all matters are returned to Allah.

item.title: Faatir:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru And if they deny you, (O Muḥammad) - already were messengers denied before you. And to Allah are returned (all) matters. And if they deny you, so were Messengers denied before you. And to Allah return all matters (35:4). O mankind! Verily, the promise of Allah is true. So, let not this present life deceive you, and let not the chief deceiver deceive you about Allah (35:5). Surely, Shaytan is an enemy to you, so take (treat) him as an enemy. He only invites his followers that they may become the dwellers of the blazing Fire (35:6). Consolation in the Fact that the Previous Messengers were Denied, and a Reminder of the Resurrection Allah says: 'Even if these…

item.title: Faatir:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru And if they belie thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) indeed have been belied apostles before thee; and unto God (alone) are returned all affairs! No apostle of God was ever honoured in this world. Every one of the apostles had suffered rejection, ridicule and persecution at the hands of the people, but none of the apostles was discouraged for they were sure that the ultimate return of every one and all matters, is only to God and to none else.

item.title: Faatir:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūru O mankind! Allah's promise is indeed true. So do not let the life of the world deceive you, nor let the Deceiver deceive you concerning Allah.1

item.title: Faatir:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūru O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver (i.e., Satan). See 35:4

item.title: Faatir:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūru O' ye people! verily the promise of God is true, so let not the life of this world beguile you; and let not the Arch-Beguiler (Satan) beguile you about God! Man is exhorted to remember that from God, he has come, and unto Him alone, is his return to render account of the life he spent in this world. One should remember that life does not end in this world, but there is the future for it, in which God promises man, mercy, i.e., the reward or the punishment he entitles himself to, by his goodness or badness in this life. Both the promises of God are certain to be fulfilled. Let…

item.title: Faatir:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوْۤا حِزْبَهُ لِيَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ inna l-shayṭāna lakum ʿaduwwun fa-ittakhidhūhu ʿaduwwan innamā yadʿū ḥiz'bahu liyakūnū min aṣḥābi l-saʿīri Satan is indeed your enemy, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his confederates so that they may be among the inmates of the Blaze.

item.title: Faatir:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوْۤا حِزْبَهُ لِيَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ inna l-shayṭāna lakum ʿaduwwun fa-ittakhidhūhu ʿaduwwan innamā yadʿū ḥiz'bahu liyakūnū min aṣḥābi l-saʿīri Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze. See 35:4

item.title: Faatir:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوْۤا حِزْبَهُ لِيَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ inna l-shayṭāna lakum ʿaduwwun fa-ittakhidhūhu ʿaduwwan innamā yadʿū ḥiz'bahu liyakūnū min aṣḥābi l-saʿīri Verily Satan is your enemy, so ye (too) take him (as your) enemy; He (Satan.) only inviteth his party that they may be the fellows of the flaming fire. Satan is evil personified, hence every evil should be treated as our enemy. The snare of Satan is very vast and ever spread. He wants man to share his damnation. Hence man should always shun evil.

item.title: Faatir:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ alladhīna kafarū lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun There is a severe punishment for the faithless, but for those who have faith and do righteous deeds there will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: Faatir:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ alladhīna kafarū lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward. Those who disbelieve, theirs will be a severe torment; and those who believe and do righteous good deeds, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (35:7). Is he, then, to whom the evil of his deeds is made fairseeming, so that he considers it as good? Verily, Allah sends astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. So destroy not yourself in sorrow for them. Truly, Allah is the All-Knower of what they do (35:8). The Punishment of the Disbeliever and the Reward of the Believer on the Day of…

item.title: Faatir:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ alladhīna kafarū lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun Those who disbelieve, for them shall be a severe chastisement; And as for those who believe and do good, for them shall be forgiveness and a great recompense. To reject the belief in God is to reject everything good which He has created. Those who are not true or correct in their faith and righteous in their living, shall have the consequent evil return for it and those who are true and correct in their faith and are faithful in its practice, shall have God's grace and a great reward.

item.title: Faatir:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَاتٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ afaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi faraāhu ḥasanan fa-inna l-laha yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu falā tadhhab nafsuka ʿalayhim ḥasarātin inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yaṣnaʿūna Is someone the evil of whose conduct is presented as decorous to him, so he regards it as good….1 Indeed Allah leads astray whomever He wishes, and guides whomever He wishes. So do not fret yourself to death regretting for them. Indeed Allah knows best what they do.

item.title: Faatir:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَاتٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ afaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi faraāhu ḥasanan fa-inna l-laha yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu falā tadhhab nafsuka ʿalayhim ḥasarātin inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yaṣnaʿūna Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good (like one rightly guided)? For indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do. See 35:7

item.title: Faatir:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَاتٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ afaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi faraāhu ḥasanan fa-inna l-laha yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu falā tadhhab nafsuka ʿalayhim ḥasarātin inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yaṣnaʿūna What! Is he then whose evil deed is made alluring that he beholdeth it good (equal to the one guided aright)! (Nay! by no means!), for verily God leaveth to stray whomsoever He willeth and guideth He whomsoever He willeth, so let not thy self go (in vain) in grief (Worry about.) for them; Verily God knoweth all that they do. Man is exhorted to guard against his own rebellious self and should not allow it to get astray from the right path.

item.title: Faatir:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَاهُ إِلَى بَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا كَذٰلِكَ النُّشُورُ wal-lahu alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fasuq'nāhu ilā baladin mayyitin fa-aḥyaynā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā kadhālika l-nushūru It is Allah who sends the winds and they raise a cloud; then We drive it toward a dead land and with it revive the earth after its death. Likewise will be the resurrection [of the dead].

item.title: Faatir:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَاهُ إِلَى بَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا كَذٰلِكَ النُّشُورُ wal-lahu alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fasuq'nāhu ilā baladin mayyitin fa-aḥyaynā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā kadhālika l-nushūru And it is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection. And it is Allah Who sends the winds, so that they raise up the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land, and revive therewith the earth after its death. As such (will be) the Resurrection (35:9). Whosoever desires Al-'Izzah then to Allah belongs Al-'Izzah. To Him ascend the good words, and the righteous deeds exalt it, but those who plot evils, theirs will be a severe torment. And the…

item.title: Faatir:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَاهُ إِلَى بَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا كَذٰلِكَ النُّشُورُ wal-lahu alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fasuq'nāhu ilā baladin mayyitin fa-aḥyaynā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā kadhālika l-nushūru And God is He Who sendeth the winds and they raise the clouds, then We drive them on to a country (which is) dead, and give We life therewith to the earth after its death; Even so is the (rising of the dead in) Resurrection. To prove as to how the dead will be resurrected, the example of the dried, unpromising soil is given which to all intents and purposes, seems to be dead and which is once again quickened by rain and made productive. The same will be the process of the Resurrection. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ وَالَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَكْرُ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ man kāna yurīdu l-ʿizata falillahi l-ʿizatu jamīʿan ilayhi yaṣʿadu l-kalimu l-ṭayibu wal-ʿamalu l-ṣāliḥu yarfaʿuhu wa-alladhīna yamkurūna l-sayiāti lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wamakru ulāika huwa yabūru Whoever seeks honour1 [should know that] honour entirely belongs to Allah. To Him ascends the good word, and He elevates righteous conduct;2 as for those who devise evil schemes, there is a severe punishment for them, and their plotting shall come to naught.

item.title: Faatir:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ وَالَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَكْرُ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ man kāna yurīdu l-ʿizata falillahi l-ʿizatu jamīʿan ilayhi yaṣʿadu l-kalimu l-ṭayibu wal-ʿamalu l-ṣāliḥu yarfaʿuhu wa-alladhīna yamkurūna l-sayiāti lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wamakru ulāika huwa yabūru Whoever desires honor (through power) - then to Allah belongs all honor.1 To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it.2 But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish. See 35:9

item.title: Faatir:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ وَالَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَكْرُ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ man kāna yurīdu l-ʿizata falillahi l-ʿizatu jamīʿan ilayhi yaṣʿadu l-kalimu l-ṭayibu wal-ʿamalu l-ṣāliḥu yarfaʿuhu wa-alladhīna yamkurūna l-sayiāti lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wamakru ulāika huwa yabūru Whosoever desireth honour (let him seek it from God, for) God's (alone) (God alone gives honour to whomsoever He pleases. Refer to verse 58:8.) is all honour; Unto Him (only) ascend all good words; and as for those who plot evil deeds, for them shall be a severe chastisement; and their plot, it shall be vain. Those who wish for honour and reward even in this world as in the next should turn only to God Goodness in any degree, is never lost. Every good word and action, is certainly exalted. Every…

item.title: Faatir:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِنْ مُعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنْقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ wal-lahu khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma jaʿalakum azwājan wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wamā yuʿammaru min muʿammarin walā yunqaṣu min ʿumurihi illā fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun Allah created you from dust, then from a drop of [seminal] fluid, then He made you mates.1 No female conceives or delivers except with His knowledge, and no elderly person advances in years, nor is anything diminished of his life, but it is [recorded] in a Book. That is indeed easy for Allah.

item.title: Faatir:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِنْ مُعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنْقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ wal-lahu khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma jaʿalakum azwājan wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wamā yuʿammaru min muʿammarin walā yunqaṣu min ʿumurihi illā fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun And Allah created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted (additional) life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allah is easy. See 35:9

item.title: Faatir:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِنْ مُعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنْقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ wal-lahu khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma jaʿalakum azwājan wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wamā yuʿammaru min muʿammarin walā yunqaṣu min ʿumurihi illā fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun And God created you of dust, then of the life-germ, then He made you pairs (of male and female); and a female beareth not, nor doth she deliver, save with His knowledge; and ageth not the aged, nor finisheth from any one's life, but it is all in a Book (decree ordained); Verily this, for God, is easy. This refers to the lowly origin of the physical existence of man whose body…

item.title: Faatir:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرَانِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَائِغٌ شَرَابُهُ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَمِنْ كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرٰی الْفُلْكَ فِیْهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wamā yastawī l-baḥrāni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun sāighun sharābuhu wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wamin kullin takulūna laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijūna ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka fīhi mawākhira litabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna Not alike are the two seas:1 this one sweet and agreeable, pleasant to drink, and that one briny and bitter, and from each you eat fresh meat and obtain ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through them, that you may seek of His grace, and so that you may give thanks.

item.title: Faatir:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرَانِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَائِغٌ شَرَابُهُ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَمِنْ كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرٰی الْفُلْكَ فِیْهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wamā yastawī l-baḥrāni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun sāighun sharābuhu wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wamin kullin takulūna laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijūna ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka fīhi mawākhira litabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And not alike are the two seas (i.e., bodies of water). One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through (them) that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful. And the two seas (kinds of water) are not alike: this is palatable, sweet and pleasant to drink, and that is salty and bitter. And…

item.title: Faatir:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرَانِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَائِغٌ شَرَابُهُ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَمِنْ كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرٰی الْفُلْكَ فِیْهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wamā yastawī l-baḥrāni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun sāighun sharābuhu wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wamin kullin takulūna laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijūna ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka fīhi mawākhira litabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And nor are the two seas alike, this one (is) sweet, quencheth thirst its sweetness, (and) pleasant to drink, and the other salt, and bitter; and yet from them both, eat ye flesh fresh (Fish.) and take forth ornaments which wear ye; and seest thou the ships cleave through it, that ye may seek of His grace, and that ye may be grateful. Man has to use his discretionary powers in differentiating good and evil as both can never be of one and the…

item.title: Faatir:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْ قِطْمِيرٍ yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi mā yamlikūna min qiṭ'mīrin He makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night, and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs all sovereignty. As for those whom you invoke besides Him, they do not control so much as the husk of a date stone.

item.title: Faatir:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْ قِطْمِيرٍ yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi mā yamlikūna min qiṭ'mīrin He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running (its course) for a specified term. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess (as much as) the membrane of a date seed. He merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night. And He has subjected the sun…

item.title: Faatir:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْ قِطْمِيرٍ yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi mā yamlikūna min qiṭ'mīrin Causeth He the night to enter into the day, and the day to enter into the night, and hath made He subservient (unto you) the sun and the moon; each travelleth to an appointed time: This is God your Lord! His is the kingdom; and those whom ye call upon other than Him, own not (even) a straw. Compare with verses 13:2, 21:33, 22:61 & 36:38. Indicates that the act of creation is constant and the continuation has a beginning and an end. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْۤا دُعَاءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوْۤا مَا اسْتَجَابُوا لَكُمْ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ in tadʿūhum lā yasmaʿū duʿāakum walaw samiʿū mā is'tajābū lakum wayawma l-qiyāmati yakfurūna bishir'kikum walā yunabbi-uka mith'lu khabīrin If you invoke them they will not hear your invocation, and even if they heard they cannot respond to you, and on the Day of Resurrection they will forswear your polytheism, and none can inform you like the One who is all-aware.

item.title: Faatir:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْۤا دُعَاءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوْۤا مَا اسْتَجَابُوا لَكُمْ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ in tadʿūhum lā yasmaʿū duʿāakum walaw samiʿū mā is'tajābū lakum wayawma l-qiyāmati yakfurūna bishir'kikum walā yunabbi-uka mith'lu khabīrin If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association.1 And none can inform you like (one) Aware (of all matters). See 35:13

item.title: Faatir:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْۤا دُعَاءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوْۤا مَا اسْتَجَابُوا لَكُمْ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ in tadʿūhum lā yasmaʿū duʿāakum walaw samiʿū mā is'tajābū lakum wayawma l-qiyāmati yakfurūna bishir'kikum walā yunabbi-uka mith'lu khabīrin If ye call on them they shall hear not your call; and even if they hear they shall answer you not; and on the Day of Judgment they will deny your associating them (with God), and none can (ever) inform thee as (the One Who is) the All-Aware. See 35:13

item.title: Faatir:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu antumu l-fuqarāu ilā l-lahi wal-lahu huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu O mankind! You are the ones who stand in need of Allah, and Allah—He is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: Faatir:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu antumu l-fuqarāu ilā l-lahi wal-lahu huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy. O mankind! it is you who stand in need of Allah. But Allah is the Rich, Worthy of all praise (35:15). If He willed, He could destroy you and bring about a new creation (35:16). And that is not hard for Allah (35:17). And no bearer of burdens shall bear another's burden; and if one heavily laden calls another to (bear) his load, nothing of it will be lifted even though he be near of kin. You can warn only those who fear their Lord unseen and perform the Salah. And he who purifies himself (from all kinds of sins), then he…

item.title: Faatir:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu antumu l-fuqarāu ilā l-lahi wal-lahu huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu O' ye people! ye are the needy unto God; and God (alone) is He Who is the (Arabic Ghani.) Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised (Arabic Hameed.) One. Every man or woman undoubtedly depends upon God's provision even for his or her own sustenance. This is the permanent tie between the creature and the Creator. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ in yasha yudh'hib'kum wayati bikhalqin jadīdin If He wishes, He will take you away, and bring about a new creation;

item.title: Faatir:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ in yasha yudh'hib'kum wayati bikhalqin jadīdin If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation. See 35:15

item.title: Faatir:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ in yasha yudh'hib'kum wayati bikhalqin jadīdin If He willeth, He will take you off and bring a new creation. See 35:15

item.title: Faatir:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ wamā dhālika ʿalā l-lahi biʿazīzin and that is not a hard thing for Allah.

item.title: Faatir:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ wamā dhālika ʿalā l-lahi biʿazīzin And that is for Allah not difficult. See 35:15

item.title: Faatir:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ wamā dhālika ʿalā l-lahi biʿazīzin And nor this is hard for God. See 35:15

item.title: Faatir:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی وَإِنْ تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَى حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبٰی إِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَمَنْ تَزَكَّى فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّى لِنَفْسِهِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā wa-in tadʿu muth'qalatun ilā ḥim'lihā lā yuḥ'mal min'hu shayon walaw kāna dhā qur'bā innamā tundhiru alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waman tazakkā fa-innamā yatazakkā linafsihi wa-ilā l-lahi l-maṣīru No bearer shall bear another's burden, and should one heavily burdened call [another] to carry it, nothing of it will be carried, even if he were a near relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord in secret and maintain the prayer. Whoever purifies himself, purifies only for his own sake, and to Allah is the return.

item.title: Faatir:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی وَإِنْ تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَى حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبٰی إِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَمَنْ تَزَكَّى فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّى لِنَفْسِهِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā wa-in tadʿu muth'qalatun ilā ḥim'lihā lā yuḥ'mal min'hu shayon walaw kāna dhā qur'bā innamā tundhiru alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waman tazakkā fa-innamā yatazakkā linafsihi wa-ilā l-lahi l-maṣīru And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls (another) to (carry some of) its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for (the benefit of) his soul. And to Allah is the (final)…

item.title: Faatir:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی وَإِنْ تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَى حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبٰی إِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَمَنْ تَزَكَّى فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّى لِنَفْسِهِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā wa-in tadʿu muth'qalatun ilā ḥim'lihā lā yuḥ'mal min'hu shayon walaw kāna dhā qur'bā innamā tundhiru alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waman tazakkā fa-innamā yatazakkā linafsihi wa-ilā l-lahi l-maṣīru And no bearer (Refer to verses 2:48, 2:123, 2:254, 6:165, 17:15, 39:7 & 53:38.) shall bear the burden of another; and if the heavy laden one should cry for (another bearer to carry) its burden, (even) aught (Any thing.) of it shall not be carried, and even if he be near of kin; Thou canst but warn those who (Refer to verses 36:11, 50:33 & 67:12.) fear their Lord unseen and keep…

item.title: Faatir:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru The blind one and the seer are not equal,

item.title: Faatir:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru Not equal are the blind and the seeing. Not alike are the blind and the seeing (35:19). Nor are (depths of) darkness and light (35:20). Nor are the shade and the sun's heat (35:21). Nor are the living and the dead. Verily, Allah makes whom He wills to hear, but you cannot make hear those who are in graves (35:22). You are only a warner (35:23). Verily, We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner. And there never was a nation but a warner had passed among them (35:24). And if they deny you, those before them also denied. Their Messengers came to them with clear signs, and with the Scriptures, and with the Book giving light (35:25). Then I took hold of those who…

item.title: Faatir:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru And alike are not (both) the blind and the seeing, This is the refutation of the doctrine of the subjective value of good and bad which even now a section of the Indian School of Philosophy maintains. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا الظُّلُمَاتُ وَلَا النُّورُ walā l-ẓulumātu walā l-nūru nor darkness and light;

item.title: Faatir:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا الظُّلُمَاتُ وَلَا النُّورُ walā l-ẓulumātu walā l-nūru Nor are the darknesses and the light. See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا الظُّلُمَاتُ وَلَا النُّورُ walā l-ẓulumātu walā l-nūru Nor the darkness and the light See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ walā l-ẓilu walā l-ḥarūru nor shade and torrid heat;

item.title: Faatir:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ walā l-ẓilu walā l-ḥarūru Nor are the shade and the heat.1 See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ walā l-ẓilu walā l-ḥarūru Nor the shade and the heat, See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ wamā yastawī l-aḥyāu walā l-amwātu inna l-laha yus'miʿu man yashāu wamā anta bimus'miʿin man fī l-qubūri nor are the living equal to the dead. Indeed Allah makes whomever He wishes to hear, and you cannot make those who are in the graves hear.

item.title: Faatir:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ wamā yastawī l-aḥyāu walā l-amwātu inna l-laha yus'miʿu man yashāu wamā anta bimus'miʿin man fī l-qubūri And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allah causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.1 See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ wamā yastawī l-aḥyāu walā l-amwātu inna l-laha yus'miʿu man yashāu wamā anta bimus'miʿin man fī l-qubūri And neither are alike (both) the living and the dead; Verily God heareth whom He willeth, and thou canst not make those hear who are in the graves. See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ أَنْتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ in anta illā nadhīrun You are but a warner.

item.title: Faatir:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ أَنْتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ in anta illā nadhīrun You, (O Muḥammad), are not but a warner. See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ أَنْتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ in anta illā nadhīrun None else art thou (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) but a Warner. This indicates that those who are dead, though their connection is severed from this world they are not totally perished. It is a figurative expression to say that those who are alive to the message, are not like those who are totally indifferent to it. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَإِنْ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqi bashīran wanadhīran wa-in min ummatin illā khalā fīhā nadhīrun Indeed We have sent you with the truth as a bearer of good news and as a warner; and there is not a nation but a warner has passed in it.

item.title: Faatir:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَإِنْ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqi bashīran wanadhīran wa-in min ummatin illā khalā fīhā nadhīrun Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner. See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَإِنْ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqi bashīran wanadhīran wa-in min ummatin illā khalā fīhā nadhīrun Verily We sent thee with truth, as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner: and there is not a people (This Verse indicates that the great Sages who visited the other parts of the world like India, China etc. could be the Warners to those respective people.) but a warner hath gone among them. See 35:23

item.title: Faatir:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wabil-zuburi wabil-kitābi l-munīri If they impugn you, those before them have impugned [likewise]: their apostles brought them manifest proofs, [holy] writs, and illuminating scriptures.

item.title: Faatir:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wabil-zuburi wabil-kitābi l-munīri And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture. See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wabil-zuburi wabil-kitābi l-munīri And if they belie thee, so indeed did belie those before them; their apostles had come unto them with clear proofs, and with scriptures, and with the enlightening Book. Refer to verses 3:185, 5:48, 10:47, 16:36. Regarding the previous apostles also having suffered rejection from the people. See verse 35:4 above.

item.title: Faatir:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ thumma akhadhtu alladhīna kafarū fakayfa kāna nakīri Then I seized the faithless. So how was My rebuttal!

item.title: Faatir:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ thumma akhadhtu alladhīna kafarū fakayfa kāna nakīri Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how (terrible) was My reproach. See 35:19

item.title: Faatir:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ thumma akhadhtu alladhīna kafarū fakayfa kāna nakīri Then did I seize those who disbelieved, so how (Severe) was the abhorrence (of Mine)? See 35:25

item.title: Faatir:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi thamarātin mukh'talifan alwānuhā wamina l-jibāli judadun bīḍun waḥum'run mukh'talifun alwānuhā wagharābību sūdun Have you not regarded that Allah sends down water from the sky, with which We produce fruits of diverse hues; and in the mountains are stripes white and red, of diverse hues, and [others] pitch black?

item.title: Faatir:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi thamarātin mukh'talifan alwānuhā wamina l-jibāli judadun bīḍun waḥum'run mukh'talifun alwānuhā wagharābību sūdun Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and (some) extremely black. See you not that Allah sends down water from the sky, and We produce therewith fruits of various colors, and among the mountains are Judad, white and red, of varying colors and (others) Gharabib black (35:27). And likewise, men and moving creature and cattle are of various colors. It is only those among His servants who have knowledge that fear…

item.title: Faatir:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi thamarātin mukh'talifan alwānuhā wamina l-jibāli judadun bīḍun waḥum'run mukh'talifun alwānuhā wagharābību sūdun Seest thou not that God sendeth down water from the heaven; then We bring forth with it fruits of various colours; and in the mountains are streaks white and red, of various colours, and (others) intensely black? Presents the universal grace which produces various effects in various receptacles. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذٰلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَخْشٰی اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَؤُا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ wamina l-nāsi wal-dawābi wal-anʿāmi mukh'talifun alwānuhu kadhālika innamā yakhshā l-laha min ʿibādihi l-ʿulamāu inna l-laha ʿazīzun ghafūrun And of humans and beasts and cattle there are likewise diverse hues. Only those of Allah's servants having knowledge fear Him. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-forgiving.

item.title: Faatir:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذٰلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَخْشٰی اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَؤُا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ wamina l-nāsi wal-dawābi wal-anʿāmi mukh'talifun alwānuhu kadhālika innamā yakhshā l-laha min ʿibādihi l-ʿulamāu inna l-laha ʿazīzun ghafūrun And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allah, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Forgiving. See 35:27

item.title: Faatir:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذٰلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَخْشٰی اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَؤُا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ wamina l-nāsi wal-dawābi wal-anʿāmi mukh'talifun alwānuhu kadhālika innamā yakhshā l-laha min ʿibādihi l-ʿulamāu inna l-laha ʿazīzun ghafūrun And of the people and beasts and cattle are of various colours likewise; verily fear God only those of His servants endued with knowledge: Verily, God is All-Mighty, Oft-Forgiving. See 35:27

item.title: Faatir:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ inna alladhīna yatlūna kitāba l-lahi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūra Indeed those who recite the Book of Allah and maintain the prayer, and spend out of what We have provided them, secretly and openly, expect a commerce that will never go bankrupt,

item.title: Faatir:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ inna alladhīna yatlūna kitāba l-lahi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūra Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allah and establish prayer and spend (in His cause) out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, (can) expect a transaction (i.e., profit) that will never perish. Verily, those who recite the Book of Allah, and perform the Salah, and spend out of what We have provided for them, secretly and openly, they hope for a (sure) trade-gain that will never perish (35:29). That He may pay them their wages in full, and give them (even) more, out of His grace. Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate (35:30). The Muslims will be the Ones Who Gain in…

item.title: Faatir:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ inna alladhīna yatlūna kitāba l-lahi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūra Verily, those who recite the Book (Qur'an.) of God and establish prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with, secretly and openly, hope for a merchandise which will never perish, See 35:27

item.title: Faatir:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wayazīdahum min faḍlihi innahu ghafūrun shakūrun so that He may pay them their reward in full and enhance them out of His grace. Indeed He is all-forgiving, all-appreciative.

item.title: Faatir:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wayazīdahum min faḍlihi innahu ghafūrun shakūrun That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.1 See 35:29

item.title: Faatir:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wayazīdahum min faḍlihi innahu ghafūrun shakūrun That He may give them back their recompense (in full) and increase of His grace unto them; verily, He is Oft-Forgiving, the Greatest Appreciator (of Good) See 35:27

item.title: Faatir:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka mina l-kitābi huwa l-ḥaqu muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi inna l-laha biʿibādihi lakhabīrun baṣīrun That which We have revealed to you of the Book is the truth, confirming what was [revealed] before it. Indeed Allah is all-aware, all-seeing about His servants.

item.title: Faatir:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka mina l-kitābi huwa l-ḥaqu muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi inna l-laha biʿibādihi lakhabīrun baṣīrun And that which We have revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed Allah, of His servants, is Aware and Seeing. And what We have revealed to you of the Book, it is the (very) truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it. Verily, Allah is indeed All-Aware and All-Seer of His servants (35:31). The Qur'an is The True Book of Allah وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ And what We have revealed to you – O Muhammad, of the Book, i.e., the Qur'an: هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ it is the (very) truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it.…

item.title: Faatir:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka mina l-kitābi huwa l-ḥaqu muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi inna l-laha biʿibādihi lakhabīrun baṣīrun And that which We have revealed unto thee of the (Qur'an.) Book, it is the truth testifying that which hath come before it; verily God, about His servants is All-Aware, All- Seeing. See 35:27

item.title: Faatir:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتَابَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ thumma awrathnā l-kitāba alladhīna iṣ'ṭafaynā min ʿibādinā famin'hum ẓālimun linafsihi wamin'hum muq'taṣidun wamin'hum sābiqun bil-khayrāti bi-idh'ni l-lahi dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru Then We made heirs to the Book1 those whom We chose from Our servants. Yet some of them are those who wrong themselves, and some of them are average, and some of them are those who take the lead in all the good works by Allah's will. That is the greatest grace [of Allah]!

item.title: Faatir:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتَابَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ thumma awrathnā l-kitāba alladhīna iṣ'ṭafaynā min ʿibādinā famin'hum ẓālimun linafsihi wamin'hum muq'taṣidun wamin'hum sābiqun bil-khayrāti bi-idh'ni l-lahi dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru Then We caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants;1 and among them is he who wrongs himself (i.e., sins), and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allah. That (inheritance) is what is the great bounty. Then We gave the Book as inheritance to such of Our servants whom We chose. Then of them are some who wrong themselves, and of them are some who follow a middle course, and of them are some who are, by Allah's leave,…

item.title: Faatir:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتَابَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ thumma awrathnā l-kitāba alladhīna iṣ'ṭafaynā min ʿibādinā famin'hum ẓālimun linafsihi wamin'hum muq'taṣidun wamin'hum sābiqun bil-khayrāti bi-idh'ni l-lahi dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru Then made We the inheritors (Before leaving this world, the Holy Prophet entrusted the Book of God, Qur'an, to the Ahl al-Bayt. Refer to the Hadith al-Thaqalayn - "I leave behind among you the Book of God & my Ahl al-Bayt etc., etc.") of the Book (Qur'an) those whom chose We from among Our servants: and of them is he who causeth himself to suffer a loss, and of them is he who followeth the middle course, and of them is he who is the foremost in goodness by God's permission: This is that which is the greatest…

item.title: Faatir:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīrun Gardens of Eden, which they will enter, adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be of silk.

item.title: Faatir:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīrun (For them are) gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk. 'Adn (Gardens) will they enter, therein will they be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be of silk (35:33). And they will say: "All praise and thanks be to Allah, Who has removed from us (all) grief. Verily, our Lord is indeed Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate (35:34). "Who, out of His grace, has lodged us in a home that will last forever, where toil will touch us not nor weariness will touch us (35:35). Allah tells us that…

item.title: Faatir:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīrun Gardens of eternity they shall enter into, they shall be given to wear therein bracelets of gold and pearls, and their raiment therein be silk. (A figurative expression of the sublime bliss.) See 35:32

item.title: Faatir:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī adhhaba ʿannā l-ḥazana inna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūrun They will say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who has removed all grief from us. Indeed Our Lord is all-forgiving, all-appreciative,

item.title: Faatir:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī adhhaba ʿannā l-ḥazana inna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūrun And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has removed from us (all) sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative. See 35:33

item.title: Faatir:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī adhhaba ʿannā l-ḥazana inna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūrun And they shall say: "All praise is God's (alone) Who hath taken away from us (all) (Caused by dirt. Refer to verse 33:33.) grief; Verily our Lord is Oft-Forgiving, the Greatest Appreciator (of goodness)" This is an indication to the state of perfect peace of mind and tranquillity that the people in it would enjoy, i.e., there shall be in Paradise, neither any fear any grief of any kind whatsoever for the inmates.

item.title: Faatir:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ alladhī aḥallanā dāra l-muqāmati min faḍlihi lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabun walā yamassunā fīhā lughūbun who has settled us in the everlasting abode by His grace. In it we are untouched by toil, and untouched therein by fatigue.'

item.title: Faatir:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ alladhī aḥallanā dāra l-muqāmati min faḍlihi lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabun walā yamassunā fīhā lughūbun He who has settled us in the home of duration (i.e., Paradise) out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness (of mind)." See 35:33

item.title: Faatir:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ alladhī aḥallanā dāra l-muqāmati min faḍlihi lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabun walā yamassunā fīhā lughūbun He Who hath alighted (Figurative expression to the heavenly bliss.) us of His grace in an abode to abide (for ever); therein toucheth us not any toil, nor affecteth us therein any fatigue. Neither any toil nor any fatigue - Fatigue could be even of rejoicing. The Bliss in Paradise shall be universal, continuous, and perpetual.

item.title: Faatir:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِهَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٍ wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannama lā yuq'ḍā ʿalayhim fayamūtū walā yukhaffafu ʿanhum min ʿadhābihā kadhālika najzī kulla kafūrin As for the faithless there is for them the fire of hell: they will neither be done away with so that they may die, nor shall its punishment be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every ingrate.

item.title: Faatir:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِهَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٍ wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannama lā yuq'ḍā ʿalayhim fayamūtū walā yukhaffafu ʿanhum min ʿadhābihā kadhālika najzī kulla kafūrin And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. (Death) is not decreed for them1 so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We recompense every ungrateful one. But those who disbelieve, for them will be the fire of Hell. Neither will it have a complete killing effect on them so that they die nor shall its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every disbeliever (35:36). Therein they will cry: Our Lord! Bring us out, we shall do righteous good deeds, not that we used to do." (Allah will reply:) "Did We not…

item.title: Faatir:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِهَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٍ wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannama lā yuq'ḍā ʿalayhim fayamūtū walā yukhaffafu ʿanhum min ʿadhābihā kadhālika najzī kulla kafūrin And those who disbelieve, for them shall be the fire of Hell, it shall not be decreed that they should die, nor shall be lightened unto them aught of its torment; Thus do We retribute every ungrateful one. See 35:35

item.title: Faatir:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُمْ مَا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِیْهِ مَنْ تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ فَذُوقُوْۤا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ نَصِيرٍ wahum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā rabbanā akhrij'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu awalam nuʿammir'kum mā yatadhakkaru fīhi man tadhakkara wajāakumu l-nadhīru fadhūqū famā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīrin They shall cry therein for help: 'Our Lord! Bring us out, so that we may act righteously —different from what we used to do!' 'Did We not give you a life long enough that one who is heedful might take admonition? And [moreover] the warner had [also] come to you. Now taste [the consequence of your deeds], for the wrongdoers have no helper.'

item.title: Faatir:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُمْ مَا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِیْهِ مَنْ تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ فَذُوقُوْۤا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ نَصِيرٍ wahum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā rabbanā akhrij'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu awalam nuʿammir'kum mā yatadhakkaru fīhi man tadhakkara wajāakumu l-nadhīru fadhūqū famā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīrin And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us;1 we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste (the punishment), for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper. See 35:36

item.title: Faatir:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُمْ مَا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِیْهِ مَنْ تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ فَذُوقُوْۤا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ نَصِيرٍ wahum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā rabbanā akhrij'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu awalam nuʿammir'kum mā yatadhakkaru fīhi man tadhakkara wajāakumu l-nadhīru fadhūqū famā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīrin And they shall cry aloud therein for help: "O' our Lord! Take us out (hence), we will do good deeds other than what we used to do (before)." (It shall be said unto them by the Lord): "Did not We keep you alive long enough for him who reflected to reflect therein? and came unto you the Warner (too); So (now) taste ye (the fruits of your deeds), then for the unjust there (shall be) no helper." Respite for repentance in the present life. No repentance could be of any…

item.title: Faatir:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ inna l-laha ʿālimu ghaybi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Indeed Allah is the knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: Faatir:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ inna l-laha ʿālimu ghaybi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Indeed, Allah is Knower of the unseen (aspects) of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. Verily, Allah is the All-Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Verily, He is the All-Knower of that is in the breasts (35:38). He it is Who has made you successors generations after generations in the earth, so whosoever disbelieves, on him will be his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers adds nothing but hatred of their Lord. And the disbelief of the disbelievers adds nothing but loss (35:39). Here Allah tells us that He knows the unseen in the heavens and earth, and that He knows all that is hidden and the secrets…

item.title: Faatir:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ inna l-laha ʿālimu ghaybi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Verily, God (alone) is the Knower of the unseen of the heavens and the earth; Verily He knoweth all that is in the breasts (hearts). The attributes of God are not any addition to His All-Perfect Self. Hence knowledge of any thing or action, hidden or manifest, even feelings, motives, and plans, is not to be acquired by God as in the case of any other being. God's knowledge pervades in and out of everything in the world. Whatever is of the heavens, in the earth and in between the two aspects, one which may appeal to human senses which may be termed as phenomenon and the other which is hidden from the reach of the human senses. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا huwa alladhī jaʿalakum khalāifa fī l-arḍi faman kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum ʿinda rabbihim illā maqtan walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum illā khasāran It is He who made you successors on the earth.1 So whoever is faithless, his unfaith is to his own detriment. And the unfaith of the faithless does not increase them with their Lord [in anything] except disfavour, and their unfaith increases the faithless in nothing except loss.

item.title: Faatir:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا huwa alladhī jaʿalakum khalāifa fī l-arḍi faman kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum ʿinda rabbihim illā maqtan walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum illā khasāran It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be (the consequence of) his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss. See 35:38

item.title: Faatir:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا huwa alladhī jaʿalakum khalāifa fī l-arḍi faman kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum ʿinda rabbihim illā maqtan walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum illā khasāran He is the One Who made you the successors (of those who preceded you) in the earth; so whosoever disbelieveth against him shall be his disbelief; And the disbelief of the infidels shall increase not with their Lord but (His) wrath, and increaseth not the disbelief of the infidels but loss. See 35:38

item.title: Faatir:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَى بَيِّنَتٍ مِنْهُ بَلْ إِنْ يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا qul ara-aytum shurakāakumu alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti am ātaynāhum kitāban fahum ʿalā bayyinatin min'hu bal in yaʿidu l-ẓālimūna baʿḍuhum baʿḍan illā ghurūran Say, 'Tell me about your partners [you ascribe to Allah] whom you invoke besides Allah? Show me what [part] of the earth have they created. Do they have any share in the heavens?' Have We given them a scripture so that they stand on a manifest proof thereof? Rather the wrongdoers do not promise one another [anything] except delusion.

item.title: Faatir:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَى بَيِّنَتٍ مِنْهُ بَلْ إِنْ يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا qul ara-aytum shurakāakumu alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti am ātaynāhum kitāban fahum ʿalā bayyinatin min'hu bal in yaʿidu l-ẓālimūna baʿḍuhum baʿḍan illā ghurūran Say, "Have you considered1 your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership (with Him) in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are (standing) on evidence therefrom? (No), rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."2 Say: Have you considered your partners whom you call upon besides Allah? Show Me, what they have created of the…

item.title: Faatir:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَى بَيِّنَتٍ مِنْهُ بَلْ إِنْ يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا qul ara-aytum shurakāakumu alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti am ātaynāhum kitāban fahum ʿalā bayyinatin min'hu bal in yaʿidu l-ẓālimūna baʿḍuhum baʿḍan illā ghurūran Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "See ye not your partners whom ye call upon other than God? Show me what part of the earth they have created, or have they any share in the heavens; or gave We unto them any scripture so that from (From the Book.) it they (may give) proof (be sure of the authority.) (of their claim) Nay! Promise (hold out a promise.) not the unjust unto one another…

item.title: Faatir:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولَا وَلَئِنْ زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا inna l-laha yum'siku l-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā wala-in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadin min baʿdihi innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūran Indeed Allah sustains the heavens and the earth lest they should fall apart, and if they were to fall apart there is none who can sustain them except Him. Indeed He is all-forbearing, all-forgiving.

item.title: Faatir:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولَا وَلَئِنْ زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا inna l-laha yum'siku l-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā wala-in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadin min baʿdihi innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūran Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them (in place) after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing1 and Forgiving. See 35:40

item.title: Faatir:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولَا وَلَئِنْ زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا inna l-laha yum'siku l-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā wala-in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadin min baʿdihi innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūran Verily, God holdeth (Upholds.) the heavens and the earth lest they come to naught; and if they come to naught none besides Hirn can hold them back; Verily, He is the Most Forbearing, the Oft-Forgiving. This is the clear assertion that the dimensional being whether terrestrial or celestial, is nothing existing in itself as a substance. It is a mere phenomenon, the outcome of a cohesive power, unexplainable in dimensional terms. (A.P.).

item.title: Faatir:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَى مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in jāahum nadhīrun layakūnunna ahdā min iḥ'dā l-umami falammā jāahum nadhīrun mā zādahum illā nufūran And they1 swore by Allah with solemn oaths that if a warner were to come to them they would be better guided than any of the nations. But when a warner came to them it only increased them in aversion,

item.title: Faatir:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَى مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in jāahum nadhīrun layakūnunna ahdā min iḥ'dā l-umami falammā jāahum nadhīrun mā zādahum illā nufūran And they swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than (any) one of the (previous) nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion. And they swore by Allah their most binding oath that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any of the nations; yet when a warner came to them, it increased in them nothing but flight (from the truth) (35:42). (They took to flight because of their) arrogance in the land and their plotting of evil.…

item.title: Faatir:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
