item.description: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَى مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in jāahum nadhīrun layakūnunna ahdā min iḥ'dā l-umami falammā jāahum nadhīrun mā zādahum illā nufūran And swore they by God with the strongest oaths that if came unto them a warner, they would certainly be guided aright better than any other people; but when came unto them a warner it increased not in them but their aversion, See 35:41

item.title: Faatir:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا is'tik'bāran fī l-arḍi wamakra l-sayi-i walā yaḥīqu l-makru l-sayi-u illā bi-ahlihi fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnata l-awalīna falan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi taḥwīlan acting arrogantly in the land and devising evil schemes; and evil schemes beset only their authors. So do they await anything except the precedent of the ancients? Yet you will never find any change in Allah's precedent, and you will never find any revision in Allah's precedent.

item.title: Faatir:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا is'tik'bāran fī l-arḍi wamakra l-sayi-i walā yaḥīqu l-makru l-sayi-u illā bi-ahlihi fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnata l-awalīna falan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi taḥwīlan (Due to) arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way (i.e., fate) of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way (i.e., established method) of Allah any change, and you will never find in the way of Allah1 any alteration.2 See 35:42

item.title: Faatir:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا is'tik'bāran fī l-arḍi wamakra l-sayi-i walā yaḥīqu l-makru l-sayi-u illā bi-ahlihi fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnata l-awalīna falan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi taḥwīlan (In) priding in the earth, and planning evil; and the evil plans {of theirs) shall beset not but the devisers themselves; Then wait they for aught save the course of the people gone before? For never shall thou find any change in the course of God; and never shalt thou find in the course of God any alteration. To all the ancient people who rebelled against the truth and lived beyond the control of faith were dealt with respite - first they were shown mercy and given the…

item.title: Faatir:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوْۤا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim wakānū ashadda min'hum quwwatan wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿ'jizahu min shayin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi innahu kāna ʿalīman qadīran Have they not traveled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? They were more powerful than them, and Allah is not to be thwarted by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed He is all-knowing, all-powerful.

item.title: Faatir:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوْۤا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim wakānū ashadda min'hum quwwatan wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿ'jizahu min shayin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi innahu kāna ʿalīman qadīran Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure (i.e., prevented) by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent. Have they not traveled in the land, and seen what was the end of those before them – though they were superior to them in power? Allah is not…

item.title: Faatir:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوْۤا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim wakānū ashadda min'hum quwwatan wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿ'jizahu min shayin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi innahu kāna ʿalīman qadīran Have they travelled not in the earth and seen how was the end of those before them though they were stronger than them in strength? And God is not such to frustrate Him aught in the heavens or in the earth; Verity He is the All-Knowing, All-Powerful See 35:43

item.title: Faatir:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا مَا تَرَكَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum fa-inna l-laha kāna biʿibādihi baṣīran Were Allah to take mankind to task because of what they have earned, He would not leave any living being on its back.1 But He respites them until a specified time, and when their time comes, Allah indeed sees best His servants.

item.title: Faatir:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا مَا تَرَكَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum fa-inna l-laha kāna biʿibādihi baṣīran And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it (i.e., the earth) any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allah has ever been, of His servants, Seeing. See 35:44

item.title: Faatir:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا مَا تَرَكَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum fa-inna l-laha kāna biʿibādihi baṣīran And were God to seize the people (to punish them) for what they wrought, He would leave not on the back of it (the earth) any moving being, (Any creature.) but He respiteth them till an appointed term; and when cometh their doom, then verily God, about His servants is All-Seeing. It is God's mercy that the sinners in the world are left to themselves with the respite to amend their deserts otherwise everyone on earth would long have perished if God had dealt every one with His strict justice.…

item.title: Fussilat:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Mīm:

item.title: Fussilat:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ḥā, Meem.1 بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا Giving glad tidings and warning, means, sometimes it brings glad tidings to the believers, and sometimes it brings a warning to the disbelievers. فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ but most of them turn away, so they hear not. means, most of the Quraysh did not understand anything of it at all, despite the fact that it was so clear. وَقَالُوا قُلُوبُنَا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ And they say: "Our hearts are under coverings..." Meaning: they are wrapped and screened: مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَفِي آذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ from that to which you invite us; and in our ears is deafness, means, 'we are deaf to the message you bring to us.' وَمِنْ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ and between us and you is a screen, 'so nothing of what you say reaches us.' فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَامِلُونَ so work you (on…

item.title: Fussilat:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حم hha-meem Ha. Mim. (H. M.) This Book is the manifestation of God's Grace and Mercy in the aspects of 'Rahmaniyat' and 'Rahimiyat'.1

item.title: Fussilat:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ tanzīlun mina l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi A [gradually] sent down [revelation] from the All-beneficent, the All-merciful,

item.title: Fussilat:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ tanzīlun mina l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi (This is) a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. See 41:1

item.title: Fussilat:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَنْزِيلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ tanzīlun mina l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi A descent (Revelation) from the Beneficent, the Most Merciful (God); See 41:1

item.title: Fussilat:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan liqawmin yaʿlamūna [this is] a Book whose signs have been elaborated, an Arabic Qur'ān, for a people who have knowledge,

item.title: Fussilat:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan liqawmin yaʿlamūna A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān1 for a people who know. See 41:1

item.title: Fussilat:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan liqawmin yaʿlamūna A Book, fully expounded (Made plain.) are its verses, a Qur'an (A collection, a recital. Refer to verse 24:49.) in Arabic, for people who know, The Holy Qur'an, is a Book not of any ambiguous and mystic sayings but with every verse of it, duly explained. It is in Arabic, the language of the people through whom it has been divinely willed to reach every nation in the various parts of the world, so that the people, the Arabs, to whom it was first introduced, might easily know the truth and spread it to others. Arabic here does not mean the Arabian language but is an adjective meaning the best, the most expressive, the most eloquent language. Opposed to this the Arabs called 'Ajam' meaning the…

item.title: Fussilat:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ bashīran wanadhīran fa-aʿraḍa aktharuhum fahum lā yasmaʿūna a bearer of good news and a warner. But most of them turn away [from it], [and] so they do not listen.

item.title: Fussilat:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ bashīran wanadhīran fa-aʿraḍa aktharuhum fahum lā yasmaʿūna As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear. See 41:1

item.title: Fussilat:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ bashīran wanadhīran fa-aʿraḍa aktharuhum fahum lā yasmaʿūna A Bearer of glad tidings and a Warner, but turn away most of them and hearken not. The qualities 'Bashir' and 'Nazir' mentioned in this verse refer to the believers and the righteous ones and as well as warning to the disbelievers and the evil doers.

item.title: Fussilat:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا قُلُوبُنَا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَفِي ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنْ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَامِلُونَ waqālū qulūbunā fī akinnatin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi wafī ādhāninā waqrun wamin bayninā wabaynika ḥijābun fa-iʿ'mal innanā ʿāmilūna They say, 'Our hearts are in veils [which shut them off] from what you invite us to, and there is a deafness in our ears, and there is a curtain between us and you. So act [as your faith requires]; we too are acting [according to our own].'

item.title: Fussilat:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا قُلُوبُنَا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَفِي ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنْ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَامِلُونَ waqālū qulūbunā fī akinnatin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi wafī ādhāninā waqrun wamin bayninā wabaynika ḥijābun fa-iʿ'mal innanā ʿāmilūna And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings (i.e., screened) from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work;1 indeed, we are working." See 41:1

item.title: Fussilat:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا قُلُوبُنَا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَفِي ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنْ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَامِلُونَ waqālū qulūbunā fī akinnatin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi wafī ādhāninā waqrun wamin bayninā wabaynika ḥijābun fa-iʿ'mal innanā ʿāmilūna And say they: "Our hearts are under coverings from that unto which thou inviteth us, and in our ears is a heaviness, and between us and thee hangeth a veil, so act thou (as thou thinkest right): Verily we too act (as we do)" It was either to the superiority complex under which the people mostly laboured that the people sarcastically said that their hearts were not intelligent enough to understand the high ideals nor were their ears sufficiently acute to hear their exposition, as if the Holy Prophet and the people were quite different from each other and there could never possibly be any conciliation…

item.title: Fussilat:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-is'taqīmū ilayhi wa-is'taghfirūhu wawaylun lil'mush'rikīna Say, 'I am just a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So be steadfast toward Him and plead to Him for forgiveness.' And woe to the polytheists

item.title: Fussilat:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-is'taqīmū ilayhi wa-is'taghfirūhu wawaylun lil'mush'rikīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allah. Say: I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God, therefore take straight path to Him and obedience to Him, and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe to the polytheists (41:6). Those who give not the Zakah and they are disbelievers in the Hereafter (41:7). Truly, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for…

item.title: Fussilat:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-is'taqīmū ilayhi wa-is'taghfirūhu wawaylun lil'mush'rikīna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "I am only a man like you; it is revealed (The distinction of being in communion with God definitely separates him from ordinary men.) unto me that your God is One God, be ye then in attention straight unto Him, and seek ye His forgiveness; and woe unto those who associate others with God," 'I am a man like you.' This statement qualified by 'it has been revealed to me' - gives a unique and distinguishing position to the Holy Prophet among mankind as a whole. Though a man for all purposes of appearance and nature, is an animal but endued with…

item.title: Fussilat:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna lā yu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna —those who do not pay the zakāt and disbelieve in the Hereafter.

item.title: Fussilat:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna lā yu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers. See 41:6

item.title: Fussilat:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna lā yu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna Those who give not the poor-rate, (In Arabic, Zakat. This is a reference to the Muslims who avoid giving Zakat and are not mindful of the life hereafter.) and they in the hereafter too are disbelievers. 'Zakat' here may mean giving for the sake of God - though they may give in the form of charity for motives not godly, otherwise the disbelievers were not expected to pay the 'Zakat' prescribed by the faith of Islam. (A.P.).

item.title: Fussilat:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, there will be an everlasting reward for them.

item.title: Fussilat:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted. See 41:6

item.title: Fussilat:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin Verily, those who believe and do good, for them shall be a recompense ceaseless. See 41:7

item.title: Fussilat:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ أَنْدَادًا ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ qul a-innakum latakfurūna bi-alladhī khalaqa l-arḍa fī yawmayni watajʿalūna lahu andādan dhālika rabbu l-ʿālamīna Say, 'Do you really disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days,1 and ascribe partners to Him? That is the Lord of all the worlds!'

item.title: Fussilat:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ أَنْدَادًا ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ qul a-innakum latakfurūna bi-alladhī khalaqa l-arḍa fī yawmayni watajʿalūna lahu andādan dhālika rabbu l-ʿālamīna Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds." Say: "Do you verily disbelieve in Him Who created the earth in two Days? And you set up rivals with Him? That is the Lord of all that exists (41:9). He placed therein firm mountains from above it, and He blessed it, and measured therein its sustenance in four Days equal for all those who ask (41:10). Then He rose over (Istawa ila) the heaven when it was smoke, and said to it and to the earth: "Come both of you willingly or unwillingly." They both…

item.title: Fussilat:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ أَنْدَادًا ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ qul a-innakum latakfurūna bi-alladhī khalaqa l-arḍa fī yawmayni watajʿalūna lahu andādan dhālika rabbu l-ʿālamīna Say thou: "What! do ye indeed disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days (periods), and set ye up unto Him equals? that is the Lord of (all) the worlds" The term 'days' used in this verse, and the next verses besides the others, in the Holy Qur'an, can never be in the sense or the measure we use it, in the ordinary meaning of the word. A day to us is a measure of the time calculated according to the movement of earth in relation to the sun. When the sun and the earth and nothing else exist, the term day would necessarily mean something other than what we…

item.title: Fussilat:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَبَارَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَا أَقْوَاتَهَا فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya min fawqihā wabāraka fīhā waqaddara fīhā aqwātahā fī arbaʿati ayyāmin sawāan lilssāilīna He set in it firm mountains [rising] above it, and blessed it and ordained therein its [various] means of sustenance in four days, alike for all the seekers [of the means of sustenance].

item.title: Fussilat:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَبَارَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَا أَقْوَاتَهَا فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya min fawqihā wabāraka fīhā waqaddara fīhā aqwātahā fī arbaʿati ayyāmin sawāan lilssāilīna And He placed on it (i.e., the earth) firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its (creatures') sustenance in four days without distinction1 - for (the information of) those who ask. See 41:9

item.title: Fussilat:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَبَارَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَا أَقْوَاتَهَا فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya min fawqihā wabāraka fīhā waqaddara fīhā aqwātahā fī arbaʿati ayyāmin sawāan lilssāilīna And hath made therein mountains high from above its surface; and He blessed therein, and planned therein its foods, in four (Including the first two days in the previous verse.) days (periods): alike for the seekers. (equal opportunity for all.) In verses 7:54, 10:3, 11:7, 25:59 & 32:4 it is said that God created the heavens and the earth in Six days. The above verse (verse 9) mentions the base of the two main groups of the beings, i.e., physical and the spiritual, (i.e., matter and spirit), and in this, the remaining four stages relating to the details of the beings from each base. The term 'days' in this verse…

item.title: Fussilat:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَا أَتَيْنَا طَائِعِينَ thumma is'tawā ilā l-samāi wahiya dukhānun faqāla lahā walil'arḍi i'tiyā ṭawʿan aw karhan qālatā ataynā ṭāiʿīna Then He turned to the heaven, and it was smoke, and He said to it and to the earth, 'Come! Willingly or unwillingly!' They said, 'We come heartily.'

item.title: Fussilat:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَا أَتَيْنَا طَائِعِينَ thumma is'tawā ilā l-samāi wahiya dukhānun faqāla lahā walil'arḍi i'tiyā ṭawʿan aw karhan qālatā ataynā ṭāiʿīna Then He directed Himself1 to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come (into being),2 willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly." See 41:9

item.title: Fussilat:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَا أَتَيْنَا طَائِعِينَ thumma is'tawā ilā l-samāi wahiya dukhānun faqāla lahā walil'arḍi i'tiyā ṭawʿan aw karhan qālatā ataynā ṭāiʿīna Then He applied Himself unto the heaven, which was yet only a smoke, so said He unto it and unto the earth: "Come ye Two, willing or reluctant;" Said the two: "We do come willingly" About the mountains.1 This may refer to the theory of Nebula (Nebular Theory) as the Original form of the heavenly bodies. (A.P.).

item.title: Fussilat:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَى فِي كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ faqaḍāhunna sabʿa samāwātin fī yawmayni wa-awḥā fī kulli samāin amrahā wazayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa waḥif'ẓan dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi Then He set them up as seven heavens in two days, and revealed in each heaven its ordinance.1 We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps, and guarded them.2 That is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

item.title: Fussilat:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَى فِي كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ faqaḍāhunna sabʿa samāwātin fī yawmayni wa-awḥā fī kulli samāin amrahā wazayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa waḥif'ẓan dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired (i.e., made known) in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps (i.e., stars, for beauty) and as protection.1 That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing. See 41:9

item.title: Fussilat:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَى فِي كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ faqaḍāhunna sabʿa samāwātin fī yawmayni wa-awḥā fī kulli samāin amrahā wazayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa waḥif'ẓan dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi And He made them seven heavens in two days (periods), and revealed in every heaven His Will; and adorned We the lower heavens with lights (of the brilliant stars), and made it guarded (with angels); That is the decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing. This and the verses 67:5, 77:8, 15:16 - 15:17 indicate that all illuminating stars are arranged in the lower sky. Then the other six skies may be in the nebular state1. (A.P.).

item.title: Fussilat:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَقُلْ أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صَاعِقَةً مِثْلَ صَاعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ fa-in aʿraḍū faqul andhartukum ṣāʿiqatan mith'la ṣāʿiqati ʿādin wathamūda But if they turn away, say, 'I warn you of a thunderbolt, like the thunderbolt of 'Ād and Thamūd.'

item.title: Fussilat:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَقُلْ أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صَاعِقَةً مِثْلَ صَاعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ fa-in aʿraḍū faqul andhartukum ṣāʿiqatan mith'la ṣāʿiqati ʿādin wathamūda But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt (that struck) ʿAad and Thamūd. But if they turn away, then say: "I have warned you of a Sa'iqah like the Sa'iqah which overtook 'Ad and Thamud (41:13). When the Messengers came to them, from before them and behind them (saying): "Worship none but Allah," they said: "If our Lord had so willed, He would surely have sent down the angels. So, indeed we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent (41:14). As for 'Ad, they were arrogant in the land without right, and they said: "Who is mightier than us in strength?" See they not that Allah Who created them was mightier…

item.title: Fussilat:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَقُلْ أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صَاعِقَةً مِثْلَ صَاعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ fa-in aʿraḍū faqul andhartukum ṣāʿiqatan mith'la ṣāʿiqati ʿādin wathamūda And if they turn away, then say: "I warn you of thunderbolt (Scourge, affliction.) (of a destructive punishment) (which afflicted the people) of 'Ad and Thamud." 'Ṣa'iqah' - as used in the Holy Qur'an - any destructive heavenly phenomenon viz. lightning, thunderbolt, Meteor, etc. (A.P.).

item.title: Fussilat:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ قَالُوْا لَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ idh jāathumu l-rusulu min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim allā taʿbudū illā l-laha qālū law shāa rabbunā la-anzala malāikatan fa-innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna When the apostles came to them, before them and in their own time,1 saying, 'Worship no one except Allah!' They said, 'Had our Lord wished, He would certainly have sent down angels [to us]. We indeed disbelieve in what you have been sent with.'

item.title: Fussilat:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ قَالُوْا لَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ idh jāathumu l-rusulu min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim allā taʿbudū illā l-laha qālū law shāa rabbunā la-anzala malāikatan fa-innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna (That occurred) when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, (saying), "Worship not except Allah." They said, "If our Lord had willed,1 He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers." See 41:13

item.title: Fussilat:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ جَاءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ قَالُوْا لَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ idh jāathumu l-rusulu min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim allā taʿbudū illā l-laha qālū law shāa rabbunā la-anzala malāikatan fa-innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna And when came unto them apostles from before them and from behind them, (Successively.) saying: "Worship ye not aught but God;" said they: "Had our Lord willed, He would certainly have sent down angels; so verily in what ye have been sent with, we disbelieve." See 41:13

item.title: Fussilat:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوْۤا مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَكَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ fa-ammā ʿādun fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi waqālū man ashaddu minnā quwwatan awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqahum huwa ashaddu min'hum quwwatan wakānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna As for [the people of] 'Ād, they acted arrogantly in the earth unduly, and they said, 'Who is more powerful than us?' Did they not see that Allah, who created them, is more powerful than them? They used to impugn Our signs;

item.title: Fussilat:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوْۤا مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَكَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ fa-ammā ʿādun fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi waqālū man ashaddu minnā quwwatan awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqahum huwa ashaddu min'hum quwwatan wakānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. See 41:13

item.title: Fussilat:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوْۤا مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَكَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ fa-ammā ʿādun fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi waqālū man ashaddu minnā quwwatan awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqahum huwa ashaddu min'hum quwwatan wakānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna And as to the people of 'Ad, they prided (Became arrogant.) in the land without right, and said they: "Who is mightier than we in power?" What! Beheld they not that God Who created them is mightier than they in power? And Our signs they used to deny. (To gainsay.) See 41:13

item.title: Fussilat:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي أَيَّامٍ نَحِسَاتٍ لِنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَخْزَى وَهُمْ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī ayyāmin naḥisātin linudhīqahum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akhzā wahum lā yunṣarūna so We unleashed upon them an icy gale during ill-fated days, that We might make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the life of the world. Yet the punishment of the Hereafter is surely more disgraceful, and they will not be helped.

item.title: Fussilat:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي أَيَّامٍ نَحِسَاتٍ لِنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَخْزَى وَهُمْ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī ayyāmin naḥisātin linudhīqahum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akhzā wahum lā yunṣarūna So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped. See 41:13

item.title: Fussilat:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي أَيَّامٍ نَحِسَاتٍ لِنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَخْزَى وَهُمْ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī ayyāmin naḥisātin linudhīqahum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akhzā wahum lā yunṣarūna So sent We on them a violent wind in inauspicious days, that We may make them taste the chastisement of disgrace in the life of this world, and certainly the chastisement of the hereafter is more disgracing, and they shall not be helped. Jabir Ibn Abdullah Ansari says that Abu Jahl gathered the chiefs of the Quraysh and said that what Muhammad (the Holy Prophet) has, is nothing but sorcery, poetry and some black art of the soothsayers. We must send someone who knows these arts to him and get him examined. Utbah bin Rabi'a stood up and said "I know these…

item.title: Fussilat:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَاهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمَى عَلَى الْهُدَى فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَاعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ wa-ammā thamūdu fahadaynāhum fa-is'taḥabbū l-ʿamā ʿalā l-hudā fa-akhadhathum ṣāʿiqatu l-ʿadhābi l-hūni bimā kānū yaksibūna As for [the people of] Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness to guidance. So the bolt of a humiliating punishment seized them because of what they used to earn.

item.title: Fussilat:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَاهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمَى عَلَى الْهُدَى فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَاعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ wa-ammā thamūdu fahadaynāhum fa-is'taḥabbū l-ʿamā ʿalā l-hudā fa-akhadhathum ṣāʿiqatu l-ʿadhābi l-hūni bimā kānū yaksibūna And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn. See 41:13

item.title: Fussilat:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَاهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمَى عَلَى الْهُدَى فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَاعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ wa-ammā thamūdu fahadaynāhum fa-is'taḥabbū l-ʿamā ʿalā l-hudā fa-akhadhathum ṣāʿiqatu l-ʿadhābi l-hūni bimā kānū yaksibūna And as to (the people of) Thamud We did guide them aright, but they loved (Preferred.) error against the right guidance, so there seized them the thunder bolt of a disgracing chastisement for what they used to earn. See 41:16

item.title: Fussilat:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ wanajjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna And We delivered those who had faith and were Godwary.

item.title: Fussilat:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ wanajjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah. See 41:13

item.title: Fussilat:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ wanajjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna And We rescued those who believed and guarded (themselves against evil). Those who believed in God and lived a righteous life were saved.

item.title: Fussilat:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّهِ إِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ wayawma yuḥ'sharu aʿdāu l-lahi ilā l-nāri fahum yūzaʿūna The day when the enemies of Allah are marched out toward the Fire, and they shall be held in check.

item.title: Fussilat:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّهِ إِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ wayawma yuḥ'sharu aʿdāu l-lahi ilā l-nāri fahum yūzaʿūna And (mention, O Muḥammad), the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are (driven), assembled in rows. And (remember) the Day that the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire, then they will be driven (41:19). Till, when they reach it, their hearing (ears) and their eyes and their skins will testify against them as to what they used to do (41:20). And they will say to their skins, Why do you testify against us?" They will say: "Allah has caused us to speak - as He causes all things to speak, and He created you the first time, and to Him you are made to return (41:21). And you have not been hiding yourselves…

item.title: Fussilat:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّهِ إِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ wayawma yuḥ'sharu aʿdāu l-lahi ilā l-nāri fahum yūzaʿūna And on the day when shall be collected together the enemies of God, unto the fire, then they shall be ranked in groups. See 41:18

item.title: Fussilat:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا مَا جَاءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَارُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ḥattā idhā mā jāūhā shahida ʿalayhim samʿuhum wa-abṣāruhum wajulūduhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūna When they come to it, their hearing will bear witness against them and their sight and their skins concerning what they used to do.

item.title: Fussilat:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا مَا جَاءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَارُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ḥattā idhā mā jāūhā shahida ʿalayhim samʿuhum wa-abṣāruhum wajulūduhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūna Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do. See 41:19

item.title: Fussilat:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا مَا جَاءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَارُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ḥattā idhā mā jāūhā shahida ʿalayhim samʿuhum wa-abṣāruhum wajulūduhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūna Until they come unto it (the Hell), shall bear witness against them, their ears and their eyes and their skins as to what they used to do. See 41:18

item.title: Fussilat:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْتُمْ عَلَيْنَا قَالُوْا أَنْطَقَنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْطَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ waqālū lijulūdihim lima shahidttum ʿalaynā qālū anṭaqanā l-lahu alladhī anṭaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna They will say to their skins, 'Why did you bear witness against us?' They will say, 'We were given speech by Allah, who gave speech to all things. He created you the first time, and to Him you are being brought back.

item.title: Fussilat:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْتُمْ عَلَيْنَا قَالُوْا أَنْطَقَنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْطَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ waqālū lijulūdihim lima shahidttum ʿalaynā qālū anṭaqanā l-lahu alladhī anṭaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned. See 41:19

item.title: Fussilat:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْتُمْ عَلَيْنَا قَالُوْا أَنْطَقَنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْطَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ waqālū lijulūdihim lima shahidttum ʿalaynā qālū anṭaqanā l-lahu alladhī anṭaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna And they shall say unto their skins: "Why witness ye against us?" They shall say: "Caused us to speak God who maketh everything speak, and He it is Who created you for the first time, (Indicate this birth of man is the first birth - This refutes the theory of this birth being the re-incarnated one.) and unto Him ye shall (all) be returned." See 41:18

item.title: Fussilat:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ wamā kuntum tastatirūna an yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum walā abṣārukum walā julūdukum walākin ẓanantum anna l-laha lā yaʿlamu kathīran mimmā taʿmalūna You did not use to conceal yourselves lest your hearing should bear witness against you, or [for that matter] your sight, or your skin, but you thought that Allah did not know most of what you did.

item.title: Fussilat:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ wamā kuntum tastatirūna an yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum walā abṣārukum walā julūdukum walākin ẓanantum anna l-laha lā yaʿlamu kathīran mimmā taʿmalūna And you were not covering (i.e., protecting) yourselves,1 lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do. See 41:19

item.title: Fussilat:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ wamā kuntum tastatirūna an yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum walā abṣārukum walā julūdukum walākin ẓanantum anna l-laha lā yaʿlamu kathīran mimmā taʿmalūna And ye covered not yourselves (merely) lest that your ears and your eyes and your skins should bear witness against you, but (it was) that ye thought that God knoweth not most of what ye did. May refer to the doctrine that God's knowledge comprehends particular objects viz. deeds of the individuals. His knowledge is confined to general and universal objects and ideas. (A.P.).

item.title: Fussilat:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِي ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَاكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ wadhālikum ẓannukumu alladhī ẓanantum birabbikum ardākum fa-aṣbaḥtum mina l-khāsirīna That misjudgment that you entertained about your Lord ruined you. So you became losers.'

item.title: Fussilat:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِي ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَاكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ wadhālikum ẓannukumu alladhī ẓanantum birabbikum ardākum fa-aṣbaḥtum mina l-khāsirīna And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers." See 41:19

item.title: Fussilat:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِي ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَاكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ wadhālikum ẓannukumu alladhī ẓanantum birabbikum ardākum fa-aṣbaḥtum mina l-khāsirīna And that your (evil) conjectures which ye did conject about your Lord hath tumbled you into ruin, so ye are become of the losers. The Sixth Holy Imam said that 'A believer should fear God's wrath so much that he must imagine himself being cast into the hell-fire and must be hopeful for God's mercy so much that he must be imagining himself to be of the fellows of Paradise.' And said that 'God is there with the thought of man and if the thought be good, He rewards the individual and if that be evil, the thinker is punished.' The Holy Prophet said that 'There is not one sent in humanity, who bears good thoughts and God is not with him,…

item.title: Fussilat:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ يَصْبِرُوْۤا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ وَإِنْ يَسْتَعْتِبُوا فَمَا هُمْ مِنَ الْمُعْتَبِينَ fa-in yaṣbirū fal-nāru mathwan lahum wa-in yastaʿtibū famā hum mina l-muʿ'tabīna Should they be patient, the Fire is their abode; and should they seek to propitiate, they will not be redeemed.

item.title: Fussilat:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ يَصْبِرُوْۤا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ وَإِنْ يَسْتَعْتِبُوا فَمَا هُمْ مِنَ الْمُعْتَبِينَ fa-in yaṣbirū fal-nāru mathwan lahum wa-in yastaʿtibū famā hum mina l-muʿ'tabīna So (even) if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease (Allah), they will not be of those who are allowed to appease. See 41:19

item.title: Fussilat:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ يَصْبِرُوْۤا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ وَإِنْ يَسْتَعْتِبُوا فَمَا هُمْ مِنَ الْمُعْتَبِينَ fa-in yaṣbirū fal-nāru mathwan lahum wa-in yastaʿtibū famā hum mina l-muʿ'tabīna And if they be patient, yet the fire shall be their abode: or if they seek favour, yet then they shall not be of the favoured (ones). It is a sarcastic announcement. 'If they only wait, then they would surely find the hell-fire their abode and if they seek grace then it will be too late.'

item.title: Fussilat:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَاءَ فَزَيَّنُوا لَهُمْ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ waqayyaḍnā lahum quranāa fazayyanū lahum mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum waḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna We have assigned them companions who make to seem decorous to them whatever is before them1 and whatever is behind them,2 and the word became due against them,3 as it did against the nations that passed away before them of jinn and humans. They were indeed losers.

item.title: Fussilat:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَاءَ فَزَيَّنُوا لَهُمْ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ waqayyaḍnā lahum quranāa fazayyanū lahum mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum waḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna And We appointed for them companions1 who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them (of sin), and the word (i.e., decree) has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they (all) were losers. And We have assigned for them intimate companions (in this world), who have made fair seeming to them, what was before them and what was behind them. And the Word is justified against them as it was justified against those…

item.title: Fussilat:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَاءَ فَزَيَّنُوا لَهُمْ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ waqayyaḍnā lahum quranāa fazayyanū lahum mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum waḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna And We have appointed for them intimate companions so for them have they made fair seeming what is before them and what is behind them, and the sentence (Literally, Word.) proved just against them, as it did among the peoples of the jinn and the human beings that have passed away before them; verily they were the losers. As the happiness increases in a congenial society of the partners in the joy, so also the regret, sorrow and grief is multiplied and deepened and gets more effective when the partners…

item.title: Fussilat:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَسْمَعُوْۤا لِهَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ وَالْغَوْا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tasmaʿū lihādhā l-qur'āni wal-ghaw fīhi laʿallakum taghlibūna The faithless say, 'Do not listen to this Qur'ān and hoot it down so that you may prevail [over the Apostle].'

item.title: Fussilat:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَسْمَعُوْۤا لِهَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ وَالْغَوْا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tasmaʿū lihādhā l-qur'āni wal-ghaw fīhi laʿallakum taghlibūna And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily1 during (the recitation of) it that perhaps you will overcome." See 41:25

item.title: Fussilat:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَسْمَعُوْۤا لِهَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ وَالْغَوْا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tasmaʿū lihādhā l-qur'āni wal-ghaw fīhi laʿallakum taghlibūna And those who disbelieve say: "Hearken ye not unto this Qur'an, make noise in it, happly ye may overcome." Refer to note on verses 22:52 - 22:54 verses on Taḥrif in the introduction. This was and still is the effort to create confusion about Qur'an but it had been in vain. Refer to note on verses 41:41 & 41:42. (A.P.).

item.title: Fussilat:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falanudhīqanna alladhīna kafarū ʿadhāban shadīdan walanajziyannahum aswa-a alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna We will surely make the faithless taste a severe punishment, and We will surely requite them by the worst of what they used to do.

item.title: Fussilat:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falanudhīqanna alladhīna kafarū ʿadhāban shadīdan walanajziyannahum aswa-a alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing. See 41:25

item.title: Fussilat:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ falanudhīqanna alladhīna kafarū ʿadhāban shadīdan walanajziyannahum aswa-a alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna So, We will certainly make those who disbelieve taste a severe chastisement, and certainly will We recompense them for the worst of what they used to do. See 41:26

item.title: Fussilat:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ أَعْدَاءِ اللَّهِ النَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ dhālika jazāu aʿdāi l-lahi l-nāru lahum fīhā dāru l-khul'di jazāan bimā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna That is the requital of the enemies of Allah —the Fire! In it they will have an everlasting abode, as a requital for their impugning Our signs.

item.title: Fussilat:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ أَعْدَاءِ اللَّهِ النَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ dhālika jazāu aʿdāi l-lahi l-nāru lahum fīhā dāru l-khul'di jazāan bimā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting. See 41:25

item.title: Fussilat:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ أَعْدَاءِ اللَّهِ النَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ dhālika jazāu aʿdāi l-lahi l-nāru lahum fīhā dāru l-khul'di jazāan bimā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna That shall be the recompense of the enemies of God, the fire! For them therein shall be the abode to abide; in recompense for what they, with Our signs used to deny. It clearly indicates that their misdeeds themselves will be paying them. (A.P.)

item.title: Fussilat:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّنَا أَرِنَا الَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ الْأَسْفَلِينَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū rabbanā arinā alladhayni aḍallānā mina l-jini wal-insi najʿalhumā taḥta aqdāminā liyakūnā mina l-asfalīna The faithless will say, 'Our Lord! Show us those who led us astray from among jinn and humans so that we may trample them under our feet, so that they may be among the lowermost!'

item.title: Fussilat:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّنَا أَرِنَا الَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ الْأَسْفَلِينَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū rabbanā arinā alladhayni aḍallānā mina l-jini wal-insi najʿalhumā taḥta aqdāminā liyakūnā mina l-asfalīna And those who disbelieved will (then) say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men (so) we may put them under our feet1 that they will be among the lowest." See 41:25

item.title: Fussilat:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّنَا أَرِنَا الَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ الْأَسْفَلِينَ waqāla alladhīna kafarū rabbanā arinā alladhayni aḍallānā mina l-jini wal-insi najʿalhumā taḥta aqdāminā liyakūnā mina l-asfalīna And those who disbelieve will say: "O' our Lord! show us those who led us astray of the jinn and the human beings; both of them will we trample under our feet so that they may be of the lowest (meanest.) ones." As goodness rejoices in helping the others to be good, so also evil tends to drag others into it and longs to see them disgraced and condemned. The forces of evil had been on their work ever since the advent of human life on earth.1 Those meeting the afflictions which their evil had earned for them, would like to see their leaders who misled them to…

item.title: Fussilat:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوْۤا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوْۤا وَأَبْشِرُوا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu l-malāikatu allā takhāfū walā taḥzanū wa-abshirū bil-janati allatī kuntum tūʿadūna Indeed those who say, 'Our Lord is Allah!' and then remain steadfast, the angels descend upon them, [saying,] 'Do not fear, nor be grieved! Receive the good news of the paradise which you have been promised.

item.title: Fussilat:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوْۤا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوْۤا وَأَبْشِرُوا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu l-malāikatu allā takhāfū walā taḥzanū wa-abshirū bil-janati allatī kuntum tūʿadūna Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, (saying), "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised. Verily, those who say: Our Lord is Allah," and then they stand firm, on them the angels will descend (saying): "Fear not, nor grieve! But receive the glad tidings of Paradise which you have been promised! (41:30). "We have been your friends in the life of this world and are (so) in the Hereafter. Therein you shall have (all) that your…

item.title: Fussilat:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوْۤا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوْۤا وَأَبْشِرُوا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu l-malāikatu allā takhāfū walā taḥzanū wa-abshirū bil-janati allatī kuntum tūʿadūna Verily, those who say: Our Lord is God! and persevere aright, descend upon them the angels, (saying): that "Fear ye not, nor be grieved, and receive the glad tidings of the Garden which ye were promised." This clearly indicates that the descension of the angels with glad tidings, is not only for the apostles but to whomsoever believe and persevere aright. But from some traditions of the Ahl Al-Bayt, it seems that it refers to the descension of angels to the true believers at the agony of death. That may be one of the instances of the descension of the angels. It…

item.title: Fussilat:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِي أَنْفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ naḥnu awliyāukum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati walakum fīhā mā tashtahī anfusukum walakum fīhā mā taddaʿūna We are your friends in the life of this world and in the Hereafter, and you will have in it whatever your souls desire, and you will have in it whatever you ask for,

item.title: Fussilat:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِي أَنْفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ naḥnu awliyāukum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati walakum fīhā mā tashtahī anfusukum walakum fīhā mā taddaʿūna We (angels) were your allies in worldly life and (are so) in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request (or wish). See 41:30

item.title: Fussilat:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِي أَنْفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ naḥnu awliyāukum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati walakum fīhā mā tashtahī anfusukum walakum fīhā mā taddaʿūna We are your guardians in the life of this world and in the hereafter, and for you shall be therein whatever desireth your selves and yours shall be therein whatever ye shall ask for. See 41:30

item.title: Fussilat:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نُزُلًا مِنْ غَفُورٍ رَحِيمٍ nuzulan min ghafūrin raḥīmin as a hospitality from One all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: Fussilat:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نُزُلًا مِنْ غَفُورٍ رَحِيمٍ nuzulan min ghafūrin raḥīmin As accommodation from a (Lord who is) Forgiving and Merciful." See 41:30

item.title: Fussilat:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نُزُلًا مِنْ غَفُورٍ رَحِيمٍ nuzulan min ghafūrin raḥīmin A hospitable welcome (Reception or entertainment.) from the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful (God). See 41:30

item.title: Fussilat:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِمَّنْ دَعَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ waman aḥsanu qawlan mimman daʿā ilā l-lahi waʿamila ṣāliḥan waqāla innanī mina l-mus'limīna Who has a better call than him who summons to Allah and acts righteously and says, 'Indeed I am one of the muslims'?

item.title: Fussilat:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِمَّنْ دَعَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ waman aḥsanu qawlan mimman daʿā ilā l-lahi waʿamila ṣāliḥan waqāla innanī mina l-mus'limīna And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims." And who is better in speech than he who invites to Allah, and does righteous deeds, and says: I am one of the Muslims (41:33). The good deed and the evil deed cannot be equal. Repel (the evil) with one which is better, then verily he, between whom and you there was enmity, (will become) as though he was a close friend (41:34). But none is granted it except those who are patient – and none is granted it except the owner of the great portion in this world (41:35). And…

item.title: Fussilat:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِمَّنْ دَعَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ waman aḥsanu qawlan mimman daʿā ilā l-lahi waʿamila ṣāliḥan waqāla innanī mina l-mus'limīna And who is better in speech than he who calleth unto God and doeth good and sayeth "Verily I am of the Muslims (These who have submitted themselves to God.)" See 41:30

item.title: Fussilat:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ walā tastawī l-ḥasanatu walā l-sayi-atu id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu fa-idhā alladhī baynaka wabaynahu ʿadāwatun ka-annahu waliyyun ḥamīmun Good and evil [conduct] are not equal.1 Repel [evil] with what is best. [If you do so,] behold, he between whom and you was enmity, will be as though he were a sympathetic friend.

item.title: Fussilat:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ walā tastawī l-ḥasanatu walā l-sayi-atu id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu fa-idhā alladhī baynaka wabaynahu ʿadāwatun ka-annahu waliyyun ḥamīmun And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel (evil) by that (deed) which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity (will become) as though he was a devoted friend. See 41:33

item.title: Fussilat:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ walā tastawī l-ḥasanatu walā l-sayi-atu id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu fa-idhā alladhī baynaka wabaynahu ʿadāwatun ka-annahu waliyyun ḥamīmun And equals can not be the good (Thus those purified ones by God (see verse 33:33) i.e., the Ahl Al-Bayt and the others cannot be equal.) and the evil. Repel thou (evil) with what is the best, when lo! he between whom and thee was enmity, shall be as though he were a warm friend. Here again a note of guidance is given to help men to have a correct value and appreciation of goodness and not to equalise it with evil. The holy Ahl Al-Bayt were goodness personified. The believers are guided in various ways, through parables and figurative expressions to bring home to the…

item.title: Fussilat:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ wamā yulaqqāhā illā alladhīna ṣabarū wamā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmin But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except the greatly endowed.

item.title: Fussilat:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ wamā yulaqqāhā illā alladhīna ṣabarū wamā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmin But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion (of good). See 41:33

item.title: Fussilat:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ wamā yulaqqāhā illā alladhīna ṣabarū wamā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmin And receive it not but those who are steadfast, and receive it not but those with the greatest good fortune. See 41:34

item.title: Fussilat:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Should a temptation from Satan disturb you, seek the protection of Allah. Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: Fussilat:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing. See 41:33

item.title: Fussilat:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And if an enticement from satan enticeth thee, (The people addressed through the Prophet.) then seek thou refuge in God; Verily, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. In the verse above, the Muslims are admonished to fight evil in the best way possible and here the greatest and the best remedy against an open attack from the Satanic forces is given, i.e., to seek refuge with God and the promise of response from God is there for every one who seeks to have it.

item.title: Fussilat:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ wamin āyātihi al-laylu wal-nahāru wal-shamsu wal-qamaru lā tasjudū lilshamsi walā lil'qamari wa-us'judū lillahi alladhī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna Among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun, nor to the moon, but prostrate to Allah who created them, if it is Him that you worship.

item.title: Fussilat:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ wamin āyātihi al-laylu wal-nahāru wal-shamsu wal-qamaru lā tasjudū lilshamsi walā lil'qamari wa-us'judū lillahi alladhī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allah, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.1 And from among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves to the sun nor to the moon, but prostrate yourselves to Allah Who created them, if you worship Him (41:37). But if they are too proud, then there are those who are with your Lord glorify Him night and day, and never…

item.title: Fussilat:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ wamin āyātihi al-laylu wal-nahāru wal-shamsu wal-qamaru lā tasjudū lilshamsi walā lil'qamari wa-us'judū lillahi alladhī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna And among His signs are the night, and the day, the sun and the moon; Do not prostrate ye in obeisance (Worship.) unto the sun nor unto the moon; and prostrate ye in obeisance (Worship.) unto God (alone) Who created them, if Him it is ye worship. See 41:36

item.title: Fussilat:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فَالَّذِينَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْءَمُونَ fa-ini is'takbarū fa-alladhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahu bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wahum lā yasamūna But if they disdain [the worship of Allah], those who are near your Lord glorify Him night and day, and they are not wearied.

item.title: Fussilat:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فَالَّذِينَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْءَمُونَ fa-ini is'takbarū fa-alladhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahu bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wahum lā yasamūna But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord (i.e., the angels) exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary. See 41:37

item.title: Fussilat:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فَالَّذِينَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْءَمُونَ fa-ini is'takbarū fa-alladhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahu bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wahum lā yasamūna But if they be arrogant (to do this), yet those with (The angels and the Holy ones.) thy Lord glorify Him during the night and the day, and they tire (Refer to note on verse 21:8.) not. From the use of the term ''inda rabbika' - with thy Lord - here and in verses 21:8 and in 3:169, 15:21, 13:39, 16:96 it is obvious that it refers to a particular state of being in the presence of God. The Mother Book is with Him, i.e., the source of everything is with Him. There are entities in His presence who are constantly praising and praying to God. This state is not a physical one - it is…

item.title: Fussilat:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنَّكَ تَرٰی الْأَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ إِنَّ الَّذِي أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ wamin āyātihi annaka tarā l-arḍa khāshiʿatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat inna alladhī aḥyāhā lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Among His signs is that you see the earth desolate; but when We send down water upon it, it stirs and swells. Indeed He who revives it is the reviver of the dead. Indeed He has power over all things.

item.title: Fussilat:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنَّكَ تَرٰی الْأَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ إِنَّ الَّذِي أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ wamin āyātihi annaka tarā l-arḍa khāshiʿatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat inna alladhī aḥyāhā lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent. See 41:37

item.title: Fussilat:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنَّكَ تَرٰی الْأَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ إِنَّ الَّذِي أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ wamin āyātihi annaka tarā l-arḍa khāshiʿatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat inna alladhī aḥyāhā lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun And among His signs is this, that seest thou the earth barren, but when send We down on it water, it is stirred and swelleth; verily He Who giveth it life, will certainly give life unto the dead; (Refers to resurrection.) Verily, He hath power over all things. See 41:38

item.title: Fussilat:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَا أَفَمَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَمْ مَنْ يَأْتِي اٰمِنًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اعْمَلُوْۤا مَا شِئْتُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ inna alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā afaman yul'qā fī l-nāri khayrun am man yatī āminan yawma l-qiyāmati iʿ'malū mā shi'tum innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Indeed those who commit sacrilege in Our signs are not hidden from Us. Is someone who is cast in the Fire better off, or someone who arrives safely on the Day of Resurrection? Act as you wish; indeed He sees best what you do.

item.title: Fussilat:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَا أَفَمَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَمْ مَنْ يَأْتِي اٰمِنًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اعْمَلُوْۤا مَا شِئْتُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ inna alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā afaman yul'qā fī l-nāri khayrun am man yatī āminan yawma l-qiyāmati iʿ'malū mā shi'tum innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses1 are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do. Verily, those who 'Yulḥidūna Fī' Our Ayat are not hidden from Us. Is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do what you will. Verily, He is All-Seer of what you do…

item.title: Fussilat:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَا أَفَمَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَمْ مَنْ يَأْتِي اٰمِنًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اعْمَلُوْۤا مَا شِئْتُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ inna alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā afaman yul'qā fī l-nāri khayrun am man yatī āminan yawma l-qiyāmati iʿ'malū mā shi'tum innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Verily, those who distort (Cause distortion in the Signs.) (a) Our signs are not hidden from Us. What! is he then who is cast in the fire better or he who cometh safe on the Day of Judgment? Do ye what ye like; Verily seeth He what all ye do. See 41:38

item.title: Fussilat:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُ لَكِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ inna alladhīna kafarū bil-dhik'ri lammā jāahum wa-innahu lakitābun ʿazīzun Indeed those who defy the Reminder when it comes to them….1 Indeed it is an august Book:

item.title: Fussilat:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُ لَكِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ inna alladhīna kafarū bil-dhik'ri lammā jāahum wa-innahu lakitābun ʿazīzun Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message (i.e., the Qur’ān)1 after it has come to them...2 And indeed, it is a mighty3 Book. See 41:40

item.title: Fussilat:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُ لَكِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ inna alladhīna kafarū bil-dhik'ri lammā jāahum wa-innahu lakitābun ʿazīzun Verily, those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it cometh unto them, and verily it (Qur'an) is a Book Unassailable. (Mighty, Triumphant.) Qur'an depicted as unassailable in complete conformity with verse 15:9 and it refutes the possibility of being tampered by anyone. Lit. Descension1. (A.P.).

item.title: Fussilat:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَأْتِيهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ lā yatīhi l-bāṭilu min bayni yadayhi walā min khalfihi tanzīlun min ḥakīmin ḥamīdin falsehood cannot approach it, from before it nor from behind it, a [gradually] sent down [revelation] from One all-wise, all-laudable.

item.title: Fussilat:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَأْتِيهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ lā yatīhi l-bāṭilu min bayni yadayhi walā min khalfihi tanzīlun min ḥakīmin ḥamīdin Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; (it is) a revelation from a (Lord who is) Wise and Praiseworthy. See 41:40

item.title: Fussilat:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَأْتِيهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ lā yatīhi l-bāṭilu min bayni yadayhi walā min khalfihi tanzīlun min ḥakīmin ḥamīdin Shall come not nigh it falsehood from before it nor from behind it: a revelation from the All- Wise, the Most Praised One. See 41:41

item.title: Fussilat:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratin wadhū ʿiqābin alīmin Nothing is said to you except what has already been said [earlier] to the apostles before you. Indeed your Lord is forgiving and One who metes out a painful retribution.

item.title: Fussilat:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratin wadhū ʿiqābin alīmin Nothing is said to you, (O Muḥammad), except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty. See 41:40

item.title: Fussilat:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratin wadhū ʿiqābin alīmin Nothing is said unto thee save what indeed was said unto the apostles before thee; Verily, thy Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of grievous retribution. See 41:41

item.title: Fussilat:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
