item.description: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ ءَأَعْجَمِيٌّ وَعَرَبِيٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ walaw jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan aʿjamiyyan laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuhu āʿ'jamiyyun waʿarabiyyun qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudan washifāon wa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna fī ādhānihim waqrun wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿaman ulāika yunādawna min makānin baʿīdin Had We made it a non-Arabic1 Qur'ān, they2 would have surely said, 'Why have not its signs been articulated?' 'What! A non-Arabian [scripture]3 and an Arabian [prophet]!?' Say, 'For those who have faith, it is a guidance and healing; but as for those who are faithless, there is a deafness in their ears and it is lost to their sight.' They are [as if they were] called from a distant place.

item.title: Fussilat:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ ءَأَعْجَمِيٌّ وَعَرَبِيٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ walaw jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan aʿjamiyyan laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuhu āʿ'jamiyyun waʿarabiyyun qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudan washifāon wa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna fī ādhānihim waqrun wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿaman ulāika yunādawna min makānin baʿīdin And if We had made it a foreign (i.e., non-Arabic) Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail (in our language)? Is it a foreign (recitation) and an Arab (messenger)?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.1 And if We had sent this as a…

item.title: Fussilat:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ ءَأَعْجَمِيٌّ وَعَرَبِيٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ walaw jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan aʿjamiyyan laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuhu āʿ'jamiyyun waʿarabiyyun qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudan washifāon wa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna fī ādhānihim waqrun wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿaman ulāika yunādawna min makānin baʿīdin And had We made it a Qur'an (A recital.) in a slang (Inexpressive.) language, certainly had they said: "Why are not its verses been made plain? What! in a slang (tongue)? (This is what the people would have said if the Qur'an had not been in the plain eloquent language as it now is.) while the Prophet is Arabian" Say: "It is unto those who believe a guidance and a cure; but as to those who believe not, there is…

item.title: Fussilat:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin Certainly We gave Moses the Book, but differences arose about it; and were it not for a prior decree of your Lord, judgement would have been made between them, for they are indeed in grave doubt concerning it.

item.title: Fussilat:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin And We had already given Musa the Scripture, but it came under disagreement.1 And if not for a word (i.e., decree)2 that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it (i.e., the Qur’ān), in disquieting doubt. See 41:44

item.title: Fussilat:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin And indeed, gave We Moses the Book, but disputes arose therein: and had not a word already gone forth from thy Lord, there would certainly have been judgment (Sentenced.) between them; and certainly they are about it in a disquieting doubt. See 41:44

item.title: Fussilat:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā wamā rabbuka biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own soul, and whoever does evil, it is to its detriment, and your Lord is not tyrannical to the servants.

item.title: Fussilat:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā wamā rabbuka biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi Whoever does righteousness - it is for his (own) soul; and whoever does evil (does so) against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to (His) servants. Whosoever does righteous good deed, it is for himself; and whosoever does evil, it is against himself. And your Lord is not at all unjust to (His) servants (41:46). To Him is referred the knowledge of the Hour. No fruit comes out of its sheath, nor does a female conceive nor brings forth (young), except by His knowledge. And on the Day when He will call unto them (saying): Where are My (so-called) partners?" They will say: "We inform You that none of us bears witness to it! (41:47). And…

item.title: Fussilat:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā wamā rabbuka biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi Whosoever doeth good, it is for his own self, and whosoever doeth evil, it is against it; and 1 is not unjust unto the thy Lord servants. See 41:44

item.title: Fussilat:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتٍ مِنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَاءِي قَالُوْا ءَاذَنَّاكَ مَا مِنَّا مِنْ شَهِيدٍ ilayhi yuraddu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wamā takhruju min thamarātin min akmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wayawma yunādīhim ayna shurakāī qālū ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīdin On Him devolves the knowledge of the Hour, and no fruit emerges from its covering and no female conceives or delivers except with His knowledge. On the day when He will call out to them, 'Where are My partners?' They will say, 'We have apprised You that there is no witness amongst us.'

item.title: Fussilat:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتٍ مِنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَاءِي قَالُوْا ءَاذَنَّاكَ مَا مِنَّا مِنْ شَهِيدٍ ilayhi yuraddu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wamā takhruju min thamarātin min akmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wayawma yunādīhim ayna shurakāī qālū ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīdin To Him (alone) is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is (no longer) among us any witness (to that)." See 41:46

item.title: Fussilat:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتٍ مِنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَاءِي قَالُوْا ءَاذَنَّاكَ مَا مِنَّا مِنْ شَهِيدٍ ilayhi yuraddu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wamā takhruju min thamarātin min akmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wayawma yunādīhim ayna shurakāī qālū ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīdin Unto Him is referred the knowledge of the Hour (of Reckoning); And cometh not forth any of the fruits from its covering, and beareth not any of the females, and nor doth she delivereth, but with His (God's.) knowledge; and on the day when He shall call unto them (saying). "Where are (those whom ye made) My partners?" They shall say: "We declare unto Thee, there is not from us any witness," Since everything in the universe is only that which God made, nothing…

item.title: Fussilat:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yadʿūna min qablu waẓannū mā lahum min maḥīṣin What they used to invoke before has forsaken them, and they know there is no escape for them.

item.title: Fussilat:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yadʿūna min qablu waẓannū mā lahum min maḥīṣin And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape. See 41:46

item.title: Fussilat:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yadʿūna min qablu waẓannū mā lahum min maḥīṣin And shall pass away from them what they called upon before, and they shall know that for them there is no escape. See 41:47

item.title: Fussilat:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْءَمُ الْإِنْسَانُ مِنْ دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِنْ مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ lā yasamu l-insānu min duʿāi l-khayri wa-in massahu l-sharu fayaūsun qanūṭun Man is never wearied of supplicating for good, and should any ill befall him, he becomes hopeless, despondent.

item.title: Fussilat:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْءَمُ الْإِنْسَانُ مِنْ دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِنْ مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ lā yasamu l-insānu min duʿāi l-khayri wa-in massahu l-sharu fayaūsun qanūṭun Man is not weary of supplication for good (things), but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing. Man does not get tired of asking for good; but if an evil touches him, then he gives up all hope and is lost in despair (41:49). And truly, if We give him a taste of mercy from Us, after some adversity has touched him, he is sure to say: "This is due to my (merit); I think not that the Hour will be established. But if I am brought back to my Lord, surely there will be for me the best with Him. "Then, We verily will show to the disbelievers what they have done, and We shall…

item.title: Fussilat:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْءَمُ الْإِنْسَانُ مِنْ دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِنْ مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ lā yasamu l-insānu min duʿāi l-khayri wa-in massahu l-sharu fayaūsun qanūṭun Tireth not man in praying for good, and if toucheth him any evil, then is he despaired, hopeless. See 41:47

item.title: Fussilat:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَذَا لِي وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِنْ رُجِعْتُ إِلَى رَبِّي إِنَّ لِي عِنْدَهُ لَلْحُسْنَى فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ wala-in adhaqnāhu raḥmatan minnā min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lī wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rujiʿ'tu ilā rabbī inna lī ʿindahu lalḥus'nā falanunabbi-anna alladhīna kafarū bimā ʿamilū walanudhīqannahum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin And if We let him have a taste of Our mercy after distress has befallen him, he will surely say, 'This is my due! I do not think the Hour will ever set in, and in case I am returned to my Lord, I will indeed have the best [reward] with Him.' But We will surely inform the faithless about what they have done, and will surely make them taste a harsh punishment.

item.title: Fussilat:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَذَا لِي وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِنْ رُجِعْتُ إِلَى رَبِّي إِنَّ لِي عِنْدَهُ لَلْحُسْنَى فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ wala-in adhaqnāhu raḥmatan minnā min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lī wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rujiʿ'tu ilā rabbī inna lī ʿindahu lalḥus'nā falanunabbi-anna alladhīna kafarū bimā ʿamilū walanudhīqannahum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is (due) to me,1 and I do not think the Hour will occur; and (even) if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.…

item.title: Fussilat:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَذَا لِي وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِنْ رُجِعْتُ إِلَى رَبِّي إِنَّ لِي عِنْدَهُ لَلْحُسْنَى فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ wala-in adhaqnāhu raḥmatan minnā min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lī wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rujiʿ'tu ilā rabbī inna lī ʿindahu lalḥus'nā falanunabbi-anna alladhīna kafarū bimā ʿamilū walanudhīqannahum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin And if We make him taste mercy from Us, after a distress hath toucheth him, certainly sayeth he: "This is my due; and I deem not the Hour (of Reckoning) would ever be established (Will ever come to happen. Refer to verses 18:35 - 18:36.) : and if I be returned unto my Lord, verily for me (is stored) with Him is (much of the) best;" but certainly will We inform those who disbelieved of what…

item.title: Fussilat:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَءَا بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu fadhū duʿāin ʿarīḍin When We bless man, he is disregardful and turns aside; but when an ill befalls him, he makes protracted supplications.

item.title: Fussilat:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَءَا بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu fadhū duʿāin ʿarīḍin And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication. See 41:49

item.title: Fussilat:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَءَا بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu fadhū duʿāin ʿarīḍin And when bestow We (Our) bounties on man, he turneth away, and withdraweth himself; and when toucheth him any distress, then aboundeth he in long prayers. See 41:47

item.title: Fussilat:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi thumma kafartum bihi man aḍallu mimman huwa fī shiqāqin baʿīdin Say, 'Tell me, if it is from Allah and you disbelieve in it, who will be more astray than someone who is in extreme defiance.'

item.title: Fussilat:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi thumma kafartum bihi man aḍallu mimman huwa fī shiqāqin baʿīdin Say, "Have you considered: if it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is from Allah and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?" Say: Tell me, if it is from Allah, and you disbelieve in it Who is more astray than one who is in opposition far away (41:52). We will show them Our signs in the universes, and within themselves, until it becomes manifest to them that this is the truth. Is it not sufficient in regard to your Lord that He is a Witness over all things (41:53). Lo, Verily, they are in doubt concerning the meeting with…

item.title: Fussilat:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi thumma kafartum bihi man aḍallu mimman huwa fī shiqāqin baʿīdin Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "See ye then? If it (i.e. this Book Qur'an) is from God, and yet disbelieve ye in it, who is farther astray than he who is in (such a great) opposition far away (from truth)?" See 41:47

item.title: Fussilat:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فِي الْءَافَاقِ وَفِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَتّٰی يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ sanurīhim āyātinā fī l-āfāqi wafī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahu l-ḥaqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun Soon We shall show them Our signs in the horizons and in their own souls until it becomes clear to them that He is the Real.1 Is it not sufficient that your Lord is witness to all things?

item.title: Fussilat:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فِي الْءَافَاقِ وَفِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَتّٰی يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ sanurīhim āyātinā fī l-āfāqi wafī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahu l-ḥaqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.1 But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?2 See 41:52

item.title: Fussilat:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فِي الْءَافَاقِ وَفِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَتّٰی يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ sanurīhim āyātinā fī l-āfāqi wafī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahu l-ḥaqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun Soon will We show them Our signs in the horizons (of the world), and in their own selves until it becometh manifest unto them that He is the Truth. Is it not sufficient for thy Lord that He ('O' He, Who proves His existence with His Own Self.') is a witness over all things. Truth needs to be raised by anyone but it rises of its own accord, rises and spreads by itself. It is a heavenly challenge to the opposition from the people that signs of the triumph of Islam would be shown even among the very people in the place…

item.title: Fussilat:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطٌ alā innahum fī mir'yatin min liqāi rabbihim alā innahu bikulli shayin muḥīṭun Look! They are indeed in doubt about the encounter with their Lord! Look! He indeed comprehends all things!

item.title: Fussilat:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطٌ alā innahum fī mir'yatin min liqāi rabbihim alā innahu bikulli shayin muḥīṭun Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing. See 41:52

item.title: Fussilat:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطٌ alā innahum fī mir'yatin min liqāi rabbihim alā innahu bikulli shayin muḥīṭun (Be it known that) verily they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord! (Be it known that) verily He encompasseth (Penetrates.) every thing. See 41:53

item.title: Hud:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الر كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ alif-lam-ra kitābun uḥ'kimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakīmin khabīrin Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book, whose signs have been made definitive1 and the elaborated2 from One [who is] all-wise, all-aware,

item.title: Hud:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الر كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ alif-lam-ra kitābun uḥ'kimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakīmin khabīrin Alif, Lām, Rā.1 (This is) a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from (one who is) Wise and Aware.2 إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ To Allah is your return, This is means your return on the Day of Judgement. وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ and He is able to do all things. This means that He is capable of doing whatever He wishes, whether it be goodness towards His Awliya' (friends and allies), or vengeance upon His enemies. This also includes His ability to repeat the creation of His creatures on the Day of Resurrection. This section encourages fear, just as the previous section encourages hope.

item.title: Hud:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الر كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ alif-lam-ra kitābun uḥ'kimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakīmin khabīrin 'Alif Lam Ra. (A L. R.) (this is) a book whose verses are firmly arranged (together) then separated (in revelation) from the All-Wise, the All-A ware (Refer to verses 17:106, 25:32.) . 'Alif Lam Ra - A. L. R. This verse has been interpreted in several ways. All mean a separate description and quality applicable to Qur'an but the translation and interpretation here is more appropriate and it is in complete accord with the verse 17:106, which shows Qur'an had a pre-existence in a well-arranged and a perfectly collected form of a Complete Book. The separation of the Verses, Chapters took place in the course of the gradual revelation to make it easy for people to understand, remember and digest…

item.title: Hud:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنَّنِي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innanī lakum min'hu nadhīrun wabashīrun declaring: 'Worship no one but Allah. I am indeed a warner from Him to you and a bearer of good news.

item.title: Hud:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنَّنِي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innanī lakum min'hu nadhīrun wabashīrun (Through a messenger, saying), "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings." See 11:1

item.title: Hud:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنَّنِي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innanī lakum min'hu nadhīrun wabashīrun That ye should worship not (any one) but God; Verily I am for you from Him, a Warner and a bearer of good tidings. See 11:1

item.title: Hud:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُمْ مَتَاعًا حَسَنًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ wa-ani is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiʿ'kum matāʿan ḥasanan ilā ajalin musamman wayu'ti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlahu wa-in tawallaw fa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīrin Plead with your Lord for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently. He will provide you with a good provision for a specified term and grant His grace to every meritorious person. But if you turn your backs [on Him], indeed I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day.

item.title: Hud:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُمْ مَتَاعًا حَسَنًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ wa-ani is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiʿ'kum matāʿan ḥasanan ilā ajalin musamman wayu'ti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlahu wa-in tawallaw fa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīrin And (saying), "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, (and) He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor (i.e., reward). But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day. See 11:1

item.title: Hud:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُمْ مَتَاعًا حَسَنًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ wa-ani is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiʿ'kum matāʿan ḥasanan ilā ajalin musamman wayu'ti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlahu wa-in tawallaw fa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīrin And (to preach unto you) that "Seek ye the forgiveness of your Lord, then turn ye unto Him repentant, He will provide you with a goodly provision to an appointed term and bestow (bestows grace on everyone who deserves it.) on every gracious one endowed (Ibne Mardwaih says that 'Zil-Fazl' refers to 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib.) with grace; and if ye turn back, then verily I fear for you the torment of an awful day." See 11:1

item.title: Hud:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ilā l-lahi marjiʿukum wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun To Allah will be your return, and He has power over all things.'

item.title: Hud:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ilā l-lahi marjiʿukum wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent." See 11:1

item.title: Hud:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ilā l-lahi marjiʿukum wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun Unto God is your return; and He over all things hath power. See 11:1

item.title: Hud:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا مِنْهُ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ alā innahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfū min'hu alā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Look! They fold up their breasts1 to hide [their secret feelings] from Him. Look! When they draw their cloaks over their heads,2 He knows whatever they keep secret and whatever they disclose. Indeed He knows best whatever is in the breasts.

item.title: Hud:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا مِنْهُ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ alā innahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfū min'hu alā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Unquestionably, they (i.e., the disbelievers) turn away their breasts to hide themselves from him. Unquestionably, (even) when they cover themselves in their clothing, He (i.e., Allah) knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. No doubt! They did fold up their breasts, that they may hide from Him. Surely, even when they cover themselves with their garments, He knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Verily, He is the All-Knower of the (innermost secrets) of the breasts (11:5). Allah is Aware of All Things Ibn 'Abbas said, "They used to dislike facing…

item.title: Hud:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا مِنْهُ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ alā innahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfū min'hu alā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri Behold! Verily they fold (Hiding the hypocrisy individually or collectively Hearts.) up their breasts that they may conceal (their infidelity) from Him; Behold! when they put their garments as a covering knoweth He what (all) they conceal and what (all) they make known; verily knoweth He (all the inmost secrets) of the breasts (Hearts.) . 'Folding the breast or the bosom' is a term to indicate hiding or concealing of enmity. Ayashi reports on the authority of Jabir Ibn Abdullah that whenever the idolaters saw the Holy Prophet, they used to hang their heads before them and cover their head with some…

item.title: Hud:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi illā ʿalā l-lahi riz'quhā wayaʿlamu mus'taqarrahā wamus'tawdaʿahā kullun fī kitābin mubīnin There is no animal on the earth, but that its sustenance lies with Allah, and He knows its [enduring] abode and its temporary place of lodging. Everything is in a manifest Book.

item.title: Hud:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi illā ʿalā l-lahi riz'quhā wayaʿlamu mus'taqarrahā wamus'tawdaʿahā kullun fī kitābin mubīnin And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage.1 All is in a clear register. And no moving creature is there on earth but its provision is due from Allah. And He knows its dwelling place and its deposit. All is in a Clear Book (11:6). Allah is Responsible for the Provisions of All Creatures Allah, the Exalted, informs that He is responsible for the provisions of all the creatures that dwell in the earth, whether they are small, large, sea-dwelling or land-dwelling. He knows their place of dwelling and their place…

item.title: Hud:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi illā ʿalā l-lahi riz'quhā wayaʿlamu mus'taqarrahā wamus'tawdaʿahā kullun fī kitābin mubīnin There is no moving creature in the earth but on God is its sustenance, And He knoweth its resting-place and its repository; All (things) (Everything.) is in the Manifest Book. See 11:5

item.title: Hud:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَلَئِنْ قُلْتَ إِنَّكُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wahuwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin wakāna ʿarshuhu ʿalā l-māi liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wala-in qul'ta innakum mabʿūthūna min baʿdi l-mawti layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days —and His Throne was [then] upon the waters— that He may test you [to see] which of you is best in conduct. Yet if you say, 'You will indeed be raised up after death,' the faithless will surely say, 'This is nothing but plain magic.'

item.title: Hud:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَلَئِنْ قُلْتَ إِنَّكُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wahuwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin wakāna ʿarshuhu ʿalā l-māi liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wala-in qul'ta innakum mabʿūthūna min baʿdi l-mawti layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic." And He it is Who has created the heavens and the earth in six Days and His Throne was…

item.title: Hud:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَلَئِنْ قُلْتَ إِنَّكُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ wahuwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin wakāna ʿarshuhu ʿalā l-māi liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wala-in qul'ta innakum mabʿūthūna min baʿdi l-mawti layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six (Refer to verses 7:54, 10:14, 18:7, 21:35, 41:9, 67:2.) days - And His Throne was on the water - (He created the Heavens and the earth) that He might try you, which of you is best in conduct; And if thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad) sayest, "Verily ye shall be raised up after death," surely would say those who disbelieve: "This is (not) but open…

item.title: Hud:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِلَى أُمَّةٍ مَعْدُودَةٍ لَيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wala-in akharnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba ilā ummatin maʿdūdatin layaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuhu alā yawma yatīhim laysa maṣrūfan ʿanhum waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And if We defer their punishment until a certain time, they will surely say, 'What holds it back?' Look! On the day it overtakes them it shall not be turned away from them, and they will be besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: Hud:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِلَى أُمَّةٍ مَعْدُودَةٍ لَيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wala-in akharnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba ilā ummatin maʿdūdatin layaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuhu alā yawma yatīhim laysa maṣrūfan ʿanhum waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say,1 "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule. See 11:7

item.title: Hud:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِلَى أُمَّةٍ مَعْدُودَةٍ لَيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ wala-in akharnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba ilā ummatin maʿdūdatin layaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuhu alā yawma yatīhim laysa maṣrūfan ʿanhum waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna And if We hold back from them the torment until a reckoned (Arabic 'Ummat'. Note - 'Ummat' has been used here as a distinguished time. This passage shows that there is a reckoned time of respite - It is not the Resurrection.) time, they will surely say: "What holdeth it back?" Beware! on the day it cometh to them it shall not be turned away from them, and will encircle them that which they used to scoff at (Refer to verse 45:33.) . See 11:7

item.title: Hud:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ wala-in adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan thumma nazaʿnāhā min'hu innahu layaūsun kafūrun If We let man taste a mercy from Us, and then withdraw it from him, he becomes despondent, ungrateful.

item.title: Hud:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ wala-in adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan thumma nazaʿnāhā min'hu innahu layaūsun kafūrun And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful. And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us, and then withdraw it from him, verily, he is despairing, ungrateful (11:9). But if We let him taste good (favor) after evil (poverty and harm) has touched him, he is sure to say: "Ills have departed from me." Surely, he is exultant and boastful (ungrateful to Allah) (11:10). Except those who show patience and do righteous good deeds: those, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (Paradise) (11:11). The Changing of Man's Attitude in Happiness and Hardship Allah, the Exalted, informs about…

item.title: Hud:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ wala-in adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan thumma nazaʿnāhā min'hu innahu layaūsun kafūrun And if We make man taste mercy from Us, (and) then take it off from him; Verily he is despairing, ungrateful. See 11:7

item.title: Hud:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ wala-in adhaqnāhu naʿmāa baʿda ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna dhahaba l-sayiātu ʿannī innahu lafariḥun fakhūrun And if We let him have a taste of Our blessings after adversities have befallen him, he will surely say, 'All ills have left me.' Indeed he becomes an exultant braggart,

item.title: Hud:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ wala-in adhaqnāhu naʿmāa baʿda ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna dhahaba l-sayiātu ʿannī innahu lafariḥun fakhūrun But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful. See 11:9

item.title: Hud:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ wala-in adhaqnāhu naʿmāa baʿda ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna dhahaba l-sayiātu ʿannī innahu lafariḥun fakhūrun And if We make him taste (Our) favours after distress hath afflicted him, he will surely say: "The evils have (all) gone away from me;" Verily he is joyous, boastful See 11:7

item.title: Hud:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ illā alladhīna ṣabarū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun excepting those who are patient and do righteous deeds. For such there will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: Hud:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ illā alladhīna ṣabarū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward. See 11:9

item.title: Hud:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ illā alladhīna ṣabarū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun Except those who forbear and do good; these! for them is forgiveness and a recompense (very) great. See 11:7

item.title: Hud:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَضَائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ مَلَكٌ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ نَذِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ falaʿallaka tārikun baʿḍa mā yūḥā ilayka waḍāiqun bihi ṣadruka an yaqūlū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi kanzun aw jāa maʿahu malakun innamā anta nadhīrun wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun [Look out] lest you should disregard aught of what has been revealed to you, and be upset because they say, 'Why has not a treasure been sent down to him, or [why does] not an angel accompany him?' You are only a warner, and Allah watches over all things.

item.title: Hud:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَضَائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ مَلَكٌ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ نَذِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ falaʿallaka tārikun baʿḍa mā yūḥā ilayka waḍāiqun bihi ṣadruka an yaqūlū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi kanzun aw jāa maʿahu malakun innamā anta nadhīrun wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun Then would you possibly leave (out) some of what is revealed to you,1 or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allah is Disposer of all things. So perchance you may give up a part of what is revealed unto you, and that your breast feels straitened for it because they say, Why has not a treasure been sent down…

item.title: Hud:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَضَائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ مَلَكٌ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ نَذِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ falaʿallaka tārikun baʿḍa mā yūḥā ilayka waḍāiqun bihi ṣadruka an yaqūlū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi kanzun aw jāa maʿahu malakun innamā anta nadhīrun wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun So perchance mayest thou (be inclined) to give up a part of what is revealed unto thee and becometh straitened thy breast by it lest they say: "Why hath not a treasure been sent down unto him or an angel come with him?" (Say thou that) Verily thou art only a warner; and God over all things is the Custodian! Ayashi in his commentary on the authority of Zaid Ibn Arqam, reports that the Messenger Angel Gabriel arrived on the eve of Arafat to convey the…

item.title: Hud:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِثْلِهِ مُفْتَرَيَاتٍ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū biʿashri suwarin mith'lihi muf'tarayātin wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Then bring ten _sūrah_s like it, fabricated, and invoke whomever you can, besides Allah, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Hud:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِثْلِهِ مُفْتَرَيَاتٍ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū biʿashri suwarin mith'lihi muf'tarayātin wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten sūrahs like it that have been invented and call upon (for assistance) whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful." See 11:12

item.title: Hud:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِثْلِهِ مُفْتَرَيَاتٍ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū biʿashri suwarin mith'lihi muf'tarayātin wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna Or do they say: "He (Our apostle) hath forged it." Say thou! "Bring ye then ten suras (Chapters.) like unto it forged, and call ye (to your aid) whomsoever ye can besides God, if ye be truthful. (Refer to verses 2:23,10:38,17:88,52:34.)" For a similar challenge see 2:23, 10:38 and 17:88. It is noteworthy that all the other religious scriptures of the world are held holy and sacred simply because they relate to religious knowledge. There is nothing in any one of them to assert any of them being the Word of God with such a vehement and such a repeated challenge about its position.…

item.title: Hud:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ بِعِلْمِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ fa-illam yastajībū lakum fa-iʿ'lamū annamā unzila biʿil'mi l-lahi wa-an lā ilāha illā huwa fahal antum mus'limūna But if they do not respond to you, know that it has been sent down by Allah's knowledge, and that there is no god except Him. Will you, then, submit [to Allah]?

item.title: Hud:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ بِعِلْمِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ fa-illam yastajībū lakum fa-iʿ'lamū annamā unzila biʿil'mi l-lahi wa-an lā ilāha illā huwa fahal antum mus'limūna And if they do not respond to you - then know that it (i.e., the Qur’ān) was revealed with the knowledge of Allah1 and that there is no deity except Him. Then,2 would you (not) be Muslims? See 11:12

item.title: Hud:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ بِعِلْمِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ fa-illam yastajībū lakum fa-iʿ'lamū annamā unzila biʿil'mi l-lahi wa-an lā ilāha illā huwa fahal antum mus'limūna Then if they answer ye not, then know ye that this (Qur'an) is revealed (only) by God's knowledge, and that there is no god but He! Will ye then submit (and be Muslims now?). See 11:13

item.title: Hud:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ man kāna yurīdu l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ilayhim aʿmālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yub'khasūna As for those who desire the life of this world and its glitter, We will recompense them fully for their works therein, and they shall not be underpaid in it.

item.title: Hud:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ man kāna yurīdu l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ilayhim aʿmālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yub'khasūna Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein,1 and they therein will not be deprived. Whosoever desires the life of the world and its glitter, to them We shall pay in full (the wages of) their deeds therein, and they will have no diminution therein (11:15). They are those for whom there is nothing in the Hereafter but Fire, and vain are the deeds they did therein. And of no effect is that which they used to do (11:16). Whoever Wants the Worldly Life, Then He will have No Share of the Hereafter Al-'Awfi reported that Ibn 'Abbas said concerning this…

item.title: Hud:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ man kāna yurīdu l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ilayhim aʿmālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yub'khasūna Whosoever desireth the life of this world and its pomp, We shall pay them (the recompense for) their deeds therein, they shall suffer not any loss. Even the disbelievers if they do anything good will be duly recompensed then and there in this life as Qur'an repeatedly says that God never lets go any good unrewarded but they will have no share of it in the hereafter. Therefore, their deeds here will be of no value or avail to them in the life hereafter. (A.P.).

item.title: Hud:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِلَّا النَّارُ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوْۤا فِيهَا وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ulāika alladhīna laysa lahum fī l-ākhirati illā l-nāru waḥabiṭa mā ṣanaʿū fīhā wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūna They are the ones for whom there shall be nothing in the Hereafter but Fire: what they had accomplished in the world has failed, and their works have come to naught.

item.title: Hud:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِلَّا النَّارُ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوْۤا فِيهَا وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ulāika alladhīna laysa lahum fī l-ākhirati illā l-nāru waḥabiṭa mā ṣanaʿū fīhā wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūna Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein,1 and worthless is what they used to do. See 11:15

item.title: Hud:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِلَّا النَّارُ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوْۤا فِيهَا وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ ulāika alladhīna laysa lahum fī l-ākhirati illā l-nāru waḥabiṭa mā ṣanaʿū fīhā wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūna These are they for whom there is nothing in the hereafter but (the Hell) fire, and vain shall be (all) that they wrought in it, and vain shall be what they were doing. All that is acquired of the things of the enjoyment of this world will be made of no avail and every such act of seeming goodness done, not to earn the pleasure of God but only to make a show of godliness, will be made null and void on the Day of Judgment. Some commentators say that it is also a prophecy to say that whatever plot that will be devised against the Holy Prophet…

item.title: Hud:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِنْهُ وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِهِ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُ فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatlūhu shāhidun min'hu wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan ulāika yu'minūna bihi waman yakfur bihi mina l-aḥzābi fal-nāru mawʿiduhu falā taku fī mir'yatin min'hu innahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna Is he who stands on a manifest proof from his Lord, and whom a witness of his own [family] follows?1 And before him2 there was the Book of Moses, a guide and mercy. It is they who have faith in it, and whoever defies him from among the factions, the Fire is their tryst. So do not be in doubt about it;…

item.title: Hud:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِنْهُ وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِهِ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُ فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatlūhu shāhidun min'hu wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan ulāika yu'minūna bihi waman yakfur bihi mina l-aḥzābi fal-nāru mawʿiduhu falā taku fī mir'yatin min'hu innahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna So is one who (stands) upon a clear evidence from his Lord (like the aforementioned)? And a witness1 from Him follows it,2 and before it was the Scripture of Musa to lead and as mercy. Those (believers in the former revelations) believe in it (i.e., the Qur’ān). But whoever disbelieves in it from the (various) factions - the Fire is his promised…

item.title: Hud:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِنْهُ وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِهِ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُ فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatlūhu shāhidun min'hu wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan ulāika yu'minūna bihi waman yakfur bihi mina l-aḥzābi fal-nāru mawʿiduhu falā taku fī mir'yatin min'hu innahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna Is he then (like unto him) who hath a clear proof from his Lord and followeth him a witness from Him, and preceded by the Book of Moses, a guide (Lit. 'Imam'.) and a mercy (testifying it)? These believe in it (Qur'an.) ; and whosoever of the parties (of the idolaters) disbelieveth in it, the (Hell) fire is the promised place; so…

item.title: Hud:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا اُولٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ الْأَشْهَادُ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban ulāika yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalā rabbihim wayaqūlu l-ashhādu hāulāi alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā rabbihim alā laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīna And who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah? They shall be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, 'It is these who lied against their Lord.' Look! The curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers

item.title: Hud:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا اُولٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ الْأَشْهَادُ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban ulāika yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalā rabbihim wayaqūlu l-ashhādu hāulāi alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā rabbihim alā laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīna And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers. And who does more wrong than he who invents a lie against Allah. Such will be brought before their Lord, and the witnesses will say,"These are the ones who lied against their Lord!" No doubt! The curse of Allah is on the wrongdoers (11:18). Those who hinder (others) from the path…

item.title: Hud:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا اُولٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ الْأَشْهَادُ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban ulāika yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalā rabbihim wayaqūlu l-ashhādu hāulāi alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā rabbihim alā laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīna And who is more unjust than he who forgeth a lie against God? These shall be presented before their Lord, and shall say the witnesses: "These are those who lied against their Lord; Beware! (Now) verily the curse (Note - that cursing the Tyrants is a godly act - See the other verses also on this.) of God is on the unjust" The 'witnesses' mentioned in this verse refer to: The writer Angels (called Kiraman Katibin) who record the deeds of every individual then and there. The Apostle of God of the age and…

item.title: Hud:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna —those who bar [others] from the way of Allah, and seek to make it crooked, and disbelieve in the Hereafter.

item.title: Hud:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna Who averted (people) from the way of Allah and sought to make it (seem) deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna Those who hinder (others) from the path of God and seek to make it crooked; and they in the hereafter, they are the disbelievers. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ السَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يُبْصِرُونَ ulāika lam yakūnū muʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā kāna lahum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa yuḍāʿafu lahumu l-ʿadhābu mā kānū yastaṭīʿūna l-samʿa wamā kānū yub'ṣirūna They cannot thwart [Allah] on the earth, nor do they have besides Allah any guardian. For them the punishment shall be doubled, for they could neither listen, nor did they use to see.

item.title: Hud:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ السَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يُبْصِرُونَ ulāika lam yakūnū muʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā kāna lahum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa yuḍāʿafu lahumu l-ʿadhābu mā kānū yastaṭīʿūna l-samʿa wamā kānū yub'ṣirūna Those were not causing failure (to Allah) on earth, nor did they have besides Allah any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.1 See 11:18

item.title: Hud:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ السَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يُبْصِرُونَ ulāika lam yakūnū muʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā kāna lahum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa yuḍāʿafu lahumu l-ʿadhābu mā kānū yastaṭīʿūna l-samʿa wamā kānū yub'ṣirūna These shall in no way weaken (God's design) in the earth nor shall there be for them besides God any protecting friends; The torment shall be doubled for them; They could not bear to hear and they used not to see. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna They are the ones who have ruined their souls, and what they used to fabricate has forsaken them.

item.title: Hud:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna These are they who have lost their selves and have left (Failed.) them (in lurch) (the false deities) what they (fancifully) used to forge. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūna Undoubtedly, they are the ones who will be the biggest losers in the Hereafter.

item.title: Hud:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūna Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūna Undoubtedly they are the very ones who in the hereafter will be the greatest losers. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَخْبَتُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wa-akhbatū ilā rabbihim ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds and are humble before their Lord —they shall be the inhabitants of paradise, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: Hud:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَخْبَتُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wa-akhbatū ilā rabbihim ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein. Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and humble themselves before their Lord, they will be the dwellers of Paradise to dwell therein forever (11:23). The likeness of the two parties is as the blind and the deaf and the seer and the hearer. Are they equal when compared? Will you not then take heed (11:24). Rewarding the People of Faith When Allah, the Exalted, mentioned the condition of the wretched, He also commended the people of delight (the believers). They are those…

item.title: Hud:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَخْبَتُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wa-akhbatū ilā rabbihim ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna Verily those who believe and do good and humble themselves unto their Lord, these are the dwellers of the Garden (Paradise), they will abide therein. See 11:18

item.title: Hud:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَالْأَعْمَى وَالْأَصَمِّ وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالسَّمِيعِ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ mathalu l-farīqayni kal-aʿmā wal-aṣami wal-baṣīri wal-samīʿi hal yastawiyāni mathalan afalā tadhakkarūna The parable of the two parties is that of one who is blind and deaf and one who sees and hears. Are they equal in comparison? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: Hud:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَالْأَعْمَى وَالْأَصَمِّ وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالسَّمِيعِ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ mathalu l-farīqayni kal-aʿmā wal-aṣami wal-baṣīri wal-samīʿi hal yastawiyāni mathalan afalā tadhakkarūna The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember? See 11:23

item.title: Hud:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَالْأَعْمَى وَالْأَصَمِّ وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالسَّمِيعِ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ mathalu l-farīqayni kal-aʿmā wal-aṣami wal-baṣīri wal-samīʿi hal yastawiyāni mathalan afalā tadhakkarūna The similitude of the two parties is like the blind and the deaf, and the seeing (ones) and the hearing (ones): What! Can they two be (compared as) equals? Will ye not then mind? If the blind and the deaf are compared to the disbelievers, the other group of the seeing and the hearing are naturally the believers. Among the believers those whose faith in God is perfect and flawless and whose practical life is wholly godly, are the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt, whose purity of soul and personal character and conduct is vouched by the divine declaration 33:33. In view of these facts, this verse is to guide us saying, that the Holy Ahl Al-Bayt can never be…

item.title: Hud:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun Certainly We sent Noah to his people [to declare]: 'Indeed I am a manifest warner to you,

item.title: Hud:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun And We had certainly sent Nuh to his people, (saying), "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner. And indeed We sent Nuh to his people (and he said): I have come to you as a plain warner (11:25). "That you worship none but Allah; surely, I fear for you the torment of a painful Day (11:26). The chiefs who disbelieved among his people said: "We see you but a man like ourselves, nor do we see any follow you but the meanest among us and they (too) followed you without thinking. And we do not see in you any merit above us, in fact we think you are liars (11:27). The Story of Nuh and His Conversation with His People Allah,…

item.title: Hud:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun And indeed sent We Noah unto his people (and he said unto them) "I am unto you a plain warner." See 11:24

item.title: Hud:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ an lā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin alīmin Worship none but Allah. Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a painful day.'

item.title: Hud:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ an lā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin alīmin That you not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day." See 11:25

item.title: Hud:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ an lā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin alīmin That (The purport of the teachings of every apostle of God was the belief in the Unity of God - worship only to Him and to lead a goodly and godly life on earth.) ye shall worship not (any one) but God; verily I fear for you the chastisement of a painful day. See 11:24

item.title: Hud:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَاكَ اتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّأْيِ وَمَا نَرٰی لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَاذِبِينَ faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā narāka illā basharan mith'lanā wamā narāka ittabaʿaka illā alladhīna hum arādhilunā bādiya l-rayi wamā narā lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin bal naẓunnukum kādhibīna But the elite of the faithless from among his people said, 'We do not see you to be anything but a human being like ourselves, and we do not see anyone following you except those who are simpleminded riffraff from our midst. Nor do we see that you have any merit over us. Rather we consider you to be liars.'

item.title: Hud:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَاكَ اتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّأْيِ وَمَا نَرٰی لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَاذِبِينَ faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā narāka illā basharan mith'lanā wamā narāka ittabaʿaka illā alladhīna hum arādhilunā bādiya l-rayi wamā narā lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin bal naẓunnukum kādhibīna So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us (and) at first suggestion.1 And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars." See 11:25

item.title: Hud:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَاكَ اتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّأْيِ وَمَا نَرٰی لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَاذِبِينَ faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā narāka illā basharan mith'lanā wamā narāka ittabaʿaka illā alladhīna hum arādhilunā bādiya l-rayi wamā narā lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin bal naẓunnukum kādhibīna Then (Thus, the true believers were those who had no value for any worldly possessions - who love poverty and do not hate the poor) said the chiefs of those who disbelieved from among his people: "We see not (in) thee but a man like ourselves and we see not any have followed thee but those who are the meanest of us, at first thought (without discretion), nor see we (in) you any excellence over us, nay we deem you liars." See…

item.title: Hud:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنْتُمْ لَهَا كَارِهُونَ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī raḥmatan min ʿindihi faʿummiyat ʿalaykum anul'zimukumūhā wa-antum lahā kārihūna He said, 'O my people! Tell me, should I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord, and He has granted me His own mercy —though it should be invisible to you— shall we force it upon you while you are averse to it?

item.title: Hud:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنْتُمْ لَهَا كَارِهُونَ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī raḥmatan min ʿindihi faʿummiyat ʿalaykum anul'zimukumūhā wa-antum lahā kārihūna He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it? He said: O my people! Tell me, if I have a clear proof from my Lord, and a mercy (prophethood) has come to me from Him, but that (mercy) has been obscured from your sight. Shall we compel you (to accept) it when you have a strong hatred for it (11:28). The Response of Nuh Allah…

item.title: Hud:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنْتُمْ لَهَا كَارِهُونَ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī raḥmatan min ʿindihi faʿummiyat ʿalaykum anul'zimukumūhā wa-antum lahā kārihūna Said he: "O' my people! think ye, if I be upon a clear proof from my Lord, and He hath bestowed on me mercy from unto Himself and it hath been made obscure unto you; shall we compel you to (accept) it while ye be averse from it?" See 11:24

item.title: Hud:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّهُمْ مُلَاقُوْۤا رَبِّهِمْ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ wayāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi mālan in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wamā anā biṭāridi alladhīna āmanū innahum mulāqū rabbihim walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna O my people! I do not ask you any material reward for it. My reward lies only with Allah. But I will not drive away those who have faith. Indeed they will encounter their Lord. But I see that you are an ignorant lot.

item.title: Hud:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّهُمْ مُلَاقُوْۤا رَبِّهِمْ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ wayāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi mālan in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wamā anā biṭāridi alladhīna āmanū innahum mulāqū rabbihim walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allah. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly. And O my people! I ask of you no wealth for it, my reward is from none but Allah. I am not going to drive away those who have believed. Surely, they are going to meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people that are…

item.title: Hud:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّهُمْ مُلَاقُوْۤا رَبِّهِمْ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ wayāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi mālan in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wamā anā biṭāridi alladhīna āmanū innahum mulāqū rabbihim walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna And, O' my people! I ask not of you any wealth in return for it; my reward is (with none) but with God and I will drive not away those who believe; verily they shall meet their Lord, but I see you a people (who act) ignorantly. See 11:24

item.title: Hud:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ مَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ طَرَدْتُهُمْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ wayāqawmi man yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ṭaradttuhum afalā tadhakkarūna O my people! Who would come to my help against Allah were I to drive them away? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: Hud:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ مَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ طَرَدْتُهُمْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ wayāqawmi man yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ṭaradttuhum afalā tadhakkarūna And O my people, who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded? See 11:29

item.title: Hud:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ مَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ طَرَدْتُهُمْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ wayāqawmi man yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ṭaradttuhum afalā tadhakkarūna And, O' my people! Who will help me against God if I drive them away! What! will ye not then mind? See 11:24

item.title: Hud:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَنْ يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ اِنِّیْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu innī malakun walā aqūlu lilladhīna tazdarī aʿyunukum lan yu'tiyahumu l-lahu khayran l-lahu aʿlamu bimā fī anfusihim innī idhan lamina l-ẓālimīna I do not say to you that I possess the treasuries of Allah, neither do I know the Unseen. I do not claim to be an angel, neither do I say of those who are despicable in your eyes that Allah will not grant them any good —Allah knows best what is in their hearts— for then I would indeed be a wrongdoer.'

item.title: Hud:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَنْ يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ اِنِّیْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu innī malakun walā aqūlu lilladhīna tazdarī aʿyunukum lan yu'tiyahumu l-lahu khayran l-lahu aʿlamu bimā fī anfusihim innī idhan lamina l-ẓālimīna And I do not tell you that I have the depositories (containing the provision) of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allah will never grant them any good. Allah is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers (i.e., the unjust)." And I do not say…

item.title: Hud:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَنْ يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ اِنِّیْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu innī malakun walā aqūlu lilladhīna tazdarī aʿyunukum lan yu'tiyahumu l-lahu khayran l-lahu aʿlamu bimā fī anfusihim innī idhan lamina l-ẓālimīna And I say not unto you that with me are the treasures of God; and I know not the unseen, nor say I that I am an angel; and say I not about those whom your eyes hold in contempt (that) God will never bestow on them (any) good; God knoweth best what is in their hearts, (Lit: -Selves.) for verily then (If I say that.) I should be of the unjust ones. See 11:24

item.title: Hud:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَانُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū yānūḥu qad jādaltanā fa-aktharta jidālanā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna They said, 'O Noah, you have disputed with us already, and you have disputed with us exceedingly. Now bring us what you threaten us with should you be truthful.

item.title: Hud:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَانُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū yānūḥu qad jādaltanā fa-aktharta jidālanā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna They said, "O Nuh, you have disputed (i.e., opposed) us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful." They said: O Nuh! You have disputed with us, and much have you prolonged the dispute with us, now bring upon us what you threaten us with, if you are of the truthful (11:32). He said: "Only Allah will bring it (the punishment) on you, if He wills, and then you will escape not (11:33). "And my advice will not profit you, even if I wish to give you good counsel, if Allah's will is to keep you astray. He is your Lord!…

item.title: Hud:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
