item.description: قَالُوْا يَانُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ qālū yānūḥu qad jādaltanā fa-aktharta jidālanā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna Said they: "O' Noah! indeed hast thou disputed with us and thou hast prolonged the dispute with us, now bring thou unto us what thou hast threatened (The wrath of God.) us with, if thou art of the truthful ones." See 11:24

item.title: Hud:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ إِنْ شَاءَ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ qāla innamā yatīkum bihi l-lahu in shāa wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna He said, 'Allah will indeed bring it on you if He wishes, and you cannot thwart [Him].

item.title: Hud:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ إِنْ شَاءَ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ qāla innamā yatīkum bihi l-lahu in shāa wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna He said, "Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause (Him) failure. See 11:32

item.title: Hud:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ إِنْ شَاءَ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ qāla innamā yatīkum bihi l-lahu in shāa wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna Said he: (Noah.) "Verily God will bring it unto you only if He willeth, and ye shall by no means prevail against Him." See 11:24

item.title: Hud:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي إِنْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ إِنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُغْوِيَكُمْ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ walā yanfaʿukum nuṣ'ḥī in aradttu an anṣaḥa lakum in kāna l-lahu yurīdu an yugh'wiyakum huwa rabbukum wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna My exhorting will not benefit you, much as I may seek to exhort you, if Allah desires to consign you to perversity. He is your Lord, and to Him you shall be brought back.'

item.title: Hud:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي إِنْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ إِنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُغْوِيَكُمْ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ walā yanfaʿukum nuṣ'ḥī in aradttu an anṣaḥa lakum in kāna l-lahu yurīdu an yugh'wiyakum huwa rabbukum wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - if Allah should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned." See 11:32

item.title: Hud:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي إِنْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ إِنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُغْوِيَكُمْ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ walā yanfaʿukum nuṣ'ḥī in aradttu an anṣaḥa lakum in kāna l-lahu yurīdu an yugh'wiyakum huwa rabbukum wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna And will profit you not my good advice, if I intend to give you good advice if God willeth that He should leave you astray; He is your Lord! and unto Him (only) shall ye be returned. See 11:24

item.title: Hud:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ إِجْرَامِي وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu faʿalayya ij'rāmī wa-anā barīon mimmā tuj'rimūna Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Should I have fabricated it, then my guilt will be upon me, and I am absolved of your guilty conduct.'

item.title: Hud:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ إِجْرَامِي وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu faʿalayya ij'rāmī wa-anā barīon mimmā tuj'rimūna Or do they say (about Prophet Muḥammad SAW), "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is (the consequence of) my crime; but I am innocent of what (crimes) you commit." Or they (the pagans of Makkah) say: He has fabricated it." Say: "If I have fabricated it, upon me be my crimes, but I am innocent of (all) those crimes which you commit (11:35). An Interruption to Verify the Truthfulness of the Prophet SAW This is presented in the middle of the story to affirm the story itself. It is as if Allah, the Exalted, is saying to Muhammad, "Or do these obstinate disbelievers say that he fabricated this and invented…

item.title: Hud:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ إِجْرَامِي وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu faʿalayya ij'rāmī wa-anā barīon mimmā tuj'rimūna Or say they: "He (Muhammad) hath forged it (Qur'an)? Say thou! (The Holy Prophet.) If I have forged it, on me be my guilt, and I am free of that which ye are guilty." The people had charged Noah of having forged some matter and presenting it as the revelations from God. This is in reply to the charge. Some say that the reference in this verse is to the charge made by the heathens of Mecca against the Holy Prophet, saying, that the story of Noah was only a fabrication, and the reply refers to what the people were told.

item.title: Hud:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُوحِيَ إِلَى نُوحٍ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ مِنْ قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَنْ قَدْ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْعَلُونَ waūḥiya ilā nūḥin annahu lan yu'mina min qawmika illā man qad āmana falā tabta-is bimā kānū yafʿalūna It was revealed to Noah: 'None of your people will believe except those who already have faith; so do not sorrow for what they used to do.

item.title: Hud:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُوحِيَ إِلَى نُوحٍ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ مِنْ قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَنْ قَدْ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْعَلُونَ waūḥiya ilā nūḥin annahu lan yu'mina min qawmika illā man qad āmana falā tabta-is bimā kānū yafʿalūna And it was revealed to Nuh that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing. And it was revealed to Nuh: "None of your people will believe except those who have believed already. So be not sad because of what they used to do (11:36). "And construct the ship under Our Eyes and with Our revelation, and address Me not on behalf of those who did wrong; they are surely to be drowned (11:37). And as he was constructing the ship, whenever the chiefs of his people passed by him,…

item.title: Hud:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُوحِيَ إِلَى نُوحٍ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ مِنْ قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَنْ قَدْ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْعَلُونَ waūḥiya ilā nūḥin annahu lan yu'mina min qawmika illā man qad āmana falā tabta-is bimā kānū yafʿalūna And it was revealed unto Noah: that "never will any of thy people believe except those who have already believed, therefore grieve thou not for what they do" See 11:35

item.title: Hud:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ wa-iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna Build the ark before Our eyes and by Our revelation, and do not plead with Me for those who are wrongdoers: they shall indeed be drowned.'

item.title: Hud:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ wa-iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are (to be) drowned." See 11:36

item.title: Hud:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ wa-iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna And make thou an ark under Our (Under the direct protection and the care of God and His angels.) eyes and Our revelation and thou address (plead) not unto Me about those who are unjust; Verily they shall be drowned. See 11:35

item.title: Hud:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوْۤا مِنْهُ قَالَ إِنْ تَسْخَرُوْۤا مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنْكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ wayaṣnaʿu l-ful'ka wakullamā marra ʿalayhi mala-on min qawmihi sakhirū min'hu qāla in taskharū minnā fa-innā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūna As he was building the ark, whenever the elders of his people passed by him, they would ridicule him. He said, 'If you ridicule us [today], we shall ridicule you [tomorrow] just as you ridicule us [now].

item.title: Hud:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوْۤا مِنْهُ قَالَ إِنْ تَسْخَرُوْۤا مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنْكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ wayaṣnaʿu l-ful'ka wakullamā marra ʿalayhi mala-on min qawmihi sakhirū min'hu qāla in taskharū minnā fa-innā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūna And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule. See 11:36

item.title: Hud:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوْۤا مِنْهُ قَالَ إِنْ تَسْخَرُوْۤا مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنْكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ wayaṣnaʿu l-ful'ka wakullamā marra ʿalayhi mala-on min qawmihi sakhirū min'hu qāla in taskharū minnā fa-innā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūna And he began making the Ark; and whenever the chiefs of his people passed by him, mocked they at him; Said he: "If ye mock at us, verily we too shall mock (The Condition of the mockers shall be as such which would justify any mockery. It does not mean that an apostle of God would retaliate in the mean manner.) at you, even as ye mock (at us)." When Noah began making the Ark, the people laughed at him and ridiculed saying that Noah was making the Ark to sail on the land and he was going to act as a…

item.title: Hud:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ fasawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun Soon you will know whom a disgraceful punishment will overtake and on whom a lasting punishment will descend.'

item.title: Hud:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ fasawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him (on earth) and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment (in the Hereafter)." See 11:36

item.title: Hud:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ fasawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun Soon shall ye know who it is on whom descendeth a torment which will disgrace him, and on whom (ultimately) falleth a lasting torment. See 11:38

item.title: Hud:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَمَا اٰمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ ḥattā idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru qul'nā iḥ'mil fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu waman āmana wamā āmana maʿahu illā qalīlun When Our edict came and the oven gushed [a stream of water], We said, 'Carry in it a pair1 of every kind [of animal], along with your family —except those [of them] against whom the edict has already been given— and those who have faith.' And none believed with him except a few.

item.title: Hud:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَمَا اٰمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ ḥattā idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru qul'nā iḥ'mil fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu waman āmana wamā āmana maʿahu illā qalīlun (So it was), until when Our command came and the oven overflowed,1 We said, "Load upon it (i.e., the ship) of each (creature) two mates and your family, except those about whom the word (i.e., decree) has preceded, and (include) whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few. (So it was) till when Our command came and the oven gushed forth (water like fountains from the earth). We said: Embark therein, of each kind two (male and female), and your family – except him…

item.title: Hud:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَمَا اٰمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ ḥattā idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru qul'nā iḥ'mil fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu waman āmana wamā āmana maʿahu illā qalīlun Until when came Our command and water gushed forth out of the oven, said We: "Carry (thou O' Noah) in it two of each kind, a pair, and thy family, except him on whom the sentence hath already been passed, and those who believe". And there believed not with him but a few (The maximum number mentioned is 80 and the minimum is 7.) . (The Holy Prophet has compared his Ahl Al-Bayt to the Ark of Noah and those attached to the Ahl Al-Bayt are also few…

item.title: Hud:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوْۤا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرِيهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ waqāla ir'kabū fīhā bis'mi l-lahi majrahā wamur'sāhā inna rabbī laghafūrun raḥīmun He said, 'Board it: In the Name of Allah it shall set sail and cast anchor. Indeed my Lord is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: Hud:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوْۤا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرِيهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ waqāla ir'kabū fīhā bis'mi l-lahi majrahā wamur'sāhā inna rabbī laghafūrun raḥīmun And (Nuh) said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allah (are) its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful." And he said: "Embark therein: in the Name of Allah will be its (moving) course and its (resting) anchorage. Surely, my Lord is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (11:41). So it (the ship) sailed with them amidst waves like mountains, and Nuh called out to his son, who had separated himself (apart): "O my son! Embark with us and be not with the disbelievers (11:42). The son replied: "I will betake myself to some mountain, it will save me from the water." Nuh said: "This day there is no savior from the decree of Allah except him…

item.title: Hud:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوْۤا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرِيهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ waqāla ir'kabū fīhā bis'mi l-lahi majrahā wamur'sāhā inna rabbī laghafūrun raḥīmun And said he (Noah): "Embark ye in it, In the name of God be its sailing and its anchorage! Verily my Lord is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful." See 11:40

item.title: Hud:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَى نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ يَابُنَيَّ ارْكَبْ مَعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنْ مَعَ الْكَافِرِينَ wahiya tajrī bihim fī mawjin kal-jibāli wanādā nūḥun ib'nahu wakāna fī maʿzilin yābunayya ir'kab maʿanā walā takun maʿa l-kāfirīna And it sailed along with them amid waves [rising] like mountains. Noah called out to his son, who stood aloof, 'O my son! 'Board with us, and do not be with the faithless!'

item.title: Hud:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَى نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ يَابُنَيَّ ارْكَبْ مَعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنْ مَعَ الْكَافِرِينَ wahiya tajrī bihim fī mawjin kal-jibāli wanādā nūḥun ib'nahu wakāna fī maʿzilin yābunayya ir'kab maʿanā walā takun maʿa l-kāfirīna And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Nuh called to his son who was apart (from them), "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers." See 11:41

item.title: Hud:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَى نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ يَابُنَيَّ ارْكَبْ مَعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنْ مَعَ الْكَافِرِينَ wahiya tajrī bihim fī mawjin kal-jibāli wanādā nūḥun ib'nahu wakāna fī maʿzilin yābunayya ir'kab maʿanā walā takun maʿa l-kāfirīna And it (the Ark) moved on with them amid waves (towering) like mountains; and Noah called out unto his son: and he was aloof, "O' My son! embark (See verse 69:11.) (thou) with us and be not with the disbelievers." See 11:40

item.title: Hud:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَءَاوِي إِلَى جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ qāla saāwī ilā jabalin yaʿṣimunī mina l-māi qāla lā ʿāṣima l-yawma min amri l-lahi illā man raḥima waḥāla baynahumā l-mawju fakāna mina l-mugh'raqīna He said, 'I shall take refuge on a mountain; it will protect me from the flood.' He said, 'There is none today who can protect from Allah's edict, except someone upon whom He has mercy.' Then the waves came between them, and he was among those who were drowned.

item.title: Hud:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَءَاوِي إِلَى جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ qāla saāwī ilā jabalin yaʿṣimunī mina l-māi qāla lā ʿāṣima l-yawma min amri l-lahi illā man raḥima waḥāla baynahumā l-mawju fakāna mina l-mugh'raqīna (But) he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." (Nuh) said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allah, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned. See 11:41

item.title: Hud:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَءَاوِي إِلَى جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ qāla saāwī ilā jabalin yaʿṣimunī mina l-māi qāla lā ʿāṣima l-yawma min amri l-lahi illā man raḥima waḥāla baynahumā l-mawju fakāna mina l-mugh'raqīna Said he (Noah's son.) "I will betake me unto a mountain that shall secure me from the water;" Said he (Noah): "There is no protector today from God's decree but (of whom) He hath mercy;" and a wave passed between them, so he was among the drowned (ones). Taking the description of Noah's Ark and the few who believed and joined Noah when the deluge submerged the land and all who remained behind, whether the members of his family or the others, perished and comparing it with the well-known saying of the Holy Prophet…

item.title: Hud:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ يَاأَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَاسَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ waqīla yāarḍu ib'laʿī māaki wayāsamāu aqliʿī waghīḍa l-māu waquḍiya l-amru wa-is'tawat ʿalā l-jūdiyi waqīla buʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna Then it was said, 'O earth, swallow your water! O sky, leave off!' The waters receded; the edict was carried out, and it1 settled on [Mount] Judi. Then it was said, 'Away with the wrongdoing lot!'

item.title: Hud:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ يَاأَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَاسَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ waqīla yāarḍu ib'laʿī māaki wayāsamāu aqliʿī waghīḍa l-māu waquḍiya l-amru wa-is'tawat ʿalā l-jūdiyi waqīla buʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold (your rain)." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it (i.e., the ship) came to rest on the (mountain of) Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." And it was said: O earth! Swallow up your water, and O sky! Withhold (your rain)." And the water was made to subside and the decree was fulfilled. And it rested on (Mount) Judi, and it was said: "Away with the people who are wrongdoing! (11:44). The End of the Flood Allah, the Exalted, informs that when the people of…

item.title: Hud:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقِيلَ يَاأَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَاسَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ waqīla yāarḍu ib'laʿī māaki wayāsamāu aqliʿī waghīḍa l-māu waquḍiya l-amru wa-is'tawat ʿalā l-jūdiyi waqīla buʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna And it was said: "O' Earth! swallow down thy water, and O' sky! withhold (thy rain)! And the water abated, and the decree was fulfilled, and it (the Ark) rested on the (Mount) Judi; and it was said "Away with the unjust people!" See 11:43

item.title: Hud:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى نُوحٌ رَبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wanādā nūḥun rabbahu faqāla rabbi inna ib'nī min ahlī wa-inna waʿdaka l-ḥaqu wa-anta aḥkamu l-ḥākimīna Noah called out to his Lord, and said, 'My Lord! My son is indeed from my family. Your promise is indeed true, and You are the fairest of all judges.'

item.title: Hud:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى نُوحٌ رَبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wanādā nūḥun rabbahu faqāla rabbi inna ib'nī min ahlī wa-inna waʿdaka l-ḥaqu wa-anta aḥkamu l-ḥākimīna And Nuh called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" And Nuh called upon his Lord and said, O my Lord! Verily, my son is of my family! And certainly, Your promise is true, and You are the Most Just of the judges (11:45). He said: "O Nuh! Surely, he is not of your family; verily, his work is unrighteous, so ask not of Me that of which you have no knowledge! I admonish you, lest you should be one of the ignorant (11:46). Nuh said: "O my Lord!…

item.title: Hud:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَى نُوحٌ رَبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wanādā nūḥun rabbahu faqāla rabbi inna ib'nī min ahlī wa-inna waʿdaka l-ḥaqu wa-anta aḥkamu l-ḥākimīna And Noah cried unto his Lord and said: "My Lord! Verily my son is of my family; and verily Thy promise is true, and Thou art the most just of the judges." The supplication of Noah aims to clear the doubt in the mind of his followers of the subsequent ages that mere birth or any other without the spiritual affinity with the prophets would not justify the application of the term, which besides relationship, implies the merit. Therefore, the term 'Ahl Al-Bayt'1 is restricted only to the deserving members of the House of the Prophets and the same restriction is applicable to the term of 'Relatives' which does not…

item.title: Hud:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَانُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ فَلَا تَسْءَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ اِنِّیْ أَعِظُكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ qāla yānūḥu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu ʿamalun ghayru ṣāliḥin falā tasalni mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun innī aʿiẓuka an takūna mina l-jāhilīna Said He, 'O Noah! Indeed He is not of your family. Indeed he is [personification of] unrighteous conduct. So do not ask Me [something] of which you have no knowledge. I advise you lest you should be among the ignorant.'

item.title: Hud:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَانُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ فَلَا تَسْءَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ اِنِّیْ أَعِظُكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ qāla yānūḥu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu ʿamalun ghayru ṣāliḥin falā tasalni mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun innī aʿiẓuka an takūna mina l-jāhilīna He said, "O Nuh, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is (one whose) work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant." See 11:45

item.title: Hud:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَانُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ فَلَا تَسْءَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ اِنِّیْ أَعِظُكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ qāla yānūḥu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu ʿamalun ghayru ṣāliḥin falā tasalni mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun innī aʿiẓuka an takūna mina l-jāhilīna Said, He (God): "O' Noah! Verily he is not of thy family; Verily he is (of) conduct other (Note that being the son of even a Prophet of God the lack of righteousness gets him disowned from the progeny of the apostolic family.) than righteous; There fore seek thou not of Me that of which thou hast no knowledge; Verily I admonish thee lest thou mayest be of the ignorant ones." Noah's pleading was for his own son, and the reply was that the lad was not worthy of being his son. It is…

item.title: Hud:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْءَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ qāla rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an asalaka mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-illā taghfir lī watarḥamnī akun mina l-khāsirīna He said, 'My Lord! I seek Your protection lest I should ask You something of which I have no knowledge. If You do not forgive me and have mercy upon me I shall be among the losers.'

item.title: Hud:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْءَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ qāla rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an asalaka mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-illā taghfir lī watarḥamnī akun mina l-khāsirīna (Nuh) said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers." See 11:45

item.title: Hud:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْءَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ qāla rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an asalaka mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-illā taghfir lī watarḥamnī akun mina l-khāsirīna Said he: (Noah.) "O' My Lord! Verily I seek refuge in Thee from asking Thee that of which I have no knowledge; And if Thou forgiveth me not and have mercy on me, I should be of the losers." See 11:46

item.title: Hud:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ يَانُوحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلَامٍ مِنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى أُمَمٍ مِمَّنْ مَعَكَ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمْ مِنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ qīla yānūḥu ih'biṭ bisalāmin minnā wabarakātin ʿalayka waʿalā umamin mimman maʿaka wa-umamun sanumattiʿuhum thumma yamassuhum minnā ʿadhābun alīmun It was said, 'O Noah! Disembark in peace from Us and with [Our] blessings upon you and upon nations [to descend] from those who are with you, and nations whom We shall provide for, then a painful punishment from Us shall befall them.'

item.title: Hud:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ يَانُوحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلَامٍ مِنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى أُمَمٍ مِمَّنْ مَعَكَ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمْ مِنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ qīla yānūḥu ih'biṭ bisalāmin minnā wabarakātin ʿalayka waʿalā umamin mimman maʿaka wa-umamun sanumattiʿuhum thumma yamassuhum minnā ʿadhābun alīmun It was said, "O Nuh, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations (descending) from those with you. But other nations (of them) We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment." It was said: O Nuh! Come down (from the ship) with peace from Us and blessings on you and on the people who are with you (and on some of their offspring), but (there will be other) people to whom We shall grant their pleasures (for a time), but in the end a painful torment will reach them from Us (11:48). The Command…

item.title: Hud:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قِيلَ يَانُوحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلَامٍ مِنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى أُمَمٍ مِمَّنْ مَعَكَ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمْ مِنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ qīla yānūḥu ih'biṭ bisalāmin minnā wabarakātin ʿalayka waʿalā umamin mimman maʿaka wa-umamun sanumattiʿuhum thumma yamassuhum minnā ʿadhābun alīmun It was said: "O' Noah! Debark (Get down from the Ark.) thou with peace from Us and blessings on thee and on the people (the springs) of those with thee; and there shall be (other) people (Not included in the blessings from God.) whom We shall afford provisions, then shall afflict them from Us a painful torment." See 11:46

item.title: Hud:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَا إِلَيْكَ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ til'ka min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhā ilayka mā kunta taʿlamuhā anta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā fa-iṣ'bir inna l-ʿāqibata lil'muttaqīna These are accounts of the Unseen which We reveal to you. Neither you nor your people used to know them before this. So be patient. Indeed the outcome will be in favour of the Godwary.

item.title: Hud:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَا إِلَيْكَ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ til'ka min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhā ilayka mā kunta taʿlamuhā anta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā fa-iṣ'bir inna l-ʿāqibata lil'muttaqīna That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, (O Muḥammad). You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the (best) outcome is for the righteous. This is of the news of the Unseen which We reveal unto you; neither you nor your people knew it before this. So be patient. Surely, the (good) end is for those who have Taqwa (11:49). The Explanation of These Stories is a Proof of the Revelation of Allah to His Messenger SAW Allah, the Exalted, says to His Prophet SAW concerning these stories and…

item.title: Hud:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَا إِلَيْكَ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ til'ka min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhā ilayka mā kunta taʿlamuhā anta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā fa-iṣ'bir inna l-ʿāqibata lil'muttaqīna These are of the tidings of the unseen which We reveal unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad); thou didst not know them thou (thyself) nor thy people (knew it) ere this; Therefore be thou patient; Verily the end is (only) for the pious ones. The opening words of this verse clearly indicate that all that is said of the ancient history in the Qur'an is that which was conveyed to the Holy Prophet through revelation and the knowledge which the Holy Prophet possessed, was that which he received from God and not acquired from any other source.

item.title: Hud:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu in antum illā muf'tarūna And to 'Ād [We sent] Hūd, their brother. He said, 'O my people! Worship Allah. You have no other god besides Him: you merely fabricate [the deities that you worship].

item.title: Hud:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu in antum illā muf'tarūna And to ʿAad (We sent) their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors (of falsehood). And to the 'Ad (people We sent) their brother Hud. He said, O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other god but Him. Certainly, you do nothing but invent lies (11:50). "O my people I ask of you no reward for it (the Message). My reward is only from Him Who created me. Will you not then understand? (11:51). "And O my people! Ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him, He will send…

item.title: Hud:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu in antum illā muf'tarūna And unto (the people) 'Ad (We sent) their brother Hud. (Refer to verses 7:65, 53:50 & 89:6.) Said he: "O' my people! Worship ye (the Only) God, ye have no god other than He; ye are but forgers." (Of false creeds.) See 11:49

item.title: Hud:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ yāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran in ajriya illā ʿalā alladhī faṭaranī afalā taʿqilūna 'O my people! I do not ask you any reward for it. My reward lies only with Him who originated me. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: Hud:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ yāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran in ajriya illā ʿalā alladhī faṭaranī afalā taʿqilūna O my people, I do not ask you for it (i.e., my advice) any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason? See 11:50

item.title: Hud:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ yāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran in ajriya illā ʿalā alladhī faṭaranī afalā taʿqilūna O' my people! I ask you not on it any recompense; my recompense is only with Him Who created me; What! then ye understand not? See 11:49

item.title: Hud:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَى قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ wayāqawmi is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran wayazid'kum quwwatan ilā quwwatikum walā tatawallaw muj'rimīna 'O my people! Plead with your Lord for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently: He will send copious rains for you from the sky, and add power to your [present] power. So do not turn your backs [on Him] as guilty ones.'

item.title: Hud:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَى قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ wayāqawmi is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran wayazid'kum quwwatan ilā quwwatikum walā tatawallaw muj'rimīna And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send (rain from) the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength (added) to your strength. And do not turn away, (being) criminals." See 11:50

item.title: Hud:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَى قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ wayāqawmi is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran wayazid'kum quwwatan ilā quwwatikum walā tatawallaw muj'rimīna And O' my people! Ask ye the forgiveness of your Lord and then turn ye repentant unto Him, He sendeth clouds (Lit- Skies) on you pouring down abundant rain and addeth He strength to your strength, and turn ye not back as guilty ones. See 11:49

item.title: Hud:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَنْ قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ qālū yāhūdu mā ji'tanā bibayyinatin wamā naḥnu bitārikī ālihatinā ʿan qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimu'minīna They said, 'O Hūd, you have not brought us any manifest proof. We are not going to abandon our gods for what you say, and we are not going to believe you.

item.title: Hud:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَنْ قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ qālū yāhūdu mā ji'tanā bibayyinatin wamā naḥnu bitārikī ālihatinā ʿan qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimu'minīna They said, "O Hūd, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you. They said: "O Hud! No evidence have you brought us, and we shall not leave our gods for your (mere) saying! And we are not believers in you (11:53). All that we say is that some of our gods (false deities) have seized you with evil (madness). He said: "I call Allah to witness and bear you witness that I am free from that which you ascribe as partners in worship (11:54). Besides Him (Allah). So plot against me, all of…

item.title: Hud:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَنْ قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ qālū yāhūdu mā ji'tanā bibayyinatin wamā naḥnu bitārikī ālihatinā ʿan qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimu'minīna Said they: "O' Hud! thou hast not brought unto us any clear sign (of your truthfulness) and we will desert not our gods on thy word! and nor are we believers in thee!" See 11:49

item.title: Hud:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ نَقُولُ إِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ قَالَ اِنِّیْ أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ in naqūlu illā iʿ'tarāka baʿḍu ālihatinā bisūin qāla innī ush'hidu l-laha wa-ish'hadū annī barīon mimmā tush'rikūna All we say is that some of our gods have visited you with some evil.' He said, 'I call Allah to witness —and you too be [my] witnesses— that I repudiate what you take as [His] partners

item.title: Hud:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ نَقُولُ إِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ قَالَ اِنِّیْ أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ in naqūlu illā iʿ'tarāka baʿḍu ālihatinā bisūin qāla innī ush'hidu l-laha wa-ish'hadū annī barīon mimmā tush'rikūna We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil (i.e., insanity)." He said, "Indeed, I call Allah to witness, and witness (yourselves) that I am free from whatever you associate with Allah. See 11:53

item.title: Hud:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ نَقُولُ إِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ قَالَ اِنِّیْ أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ in naqūlu illā iʿ'tarāka baʿḍu ālihatinā bisūin qāla innī ush'hidu l-laha wa-ish'hadū annī barīon mimmā tush'rikūna We say nothing but that have smitten thee some of our gods with evil;" said he (Hud.) : "Verily I call God to witness, and bear ye also witness that I am clear (detach myself from what you associate.) of what ye associate, See 11:49

item.title: Hud:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِهِ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنْظِرُونِ min dūnihi fakīdūnī jamīʿan thumma lā tunẓirūni besides Him. Now try out your stratagems against me, together, without granting me any respite.

item.title: Hud:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِهِ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنْظِرُونِ min dūnihi fakīdūnī jamīʿan thumma lā tunẓirūni Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite. See 11:53

item.title: Hud:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِنْ دُونِهِ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنْظِرُونِ min dūnihi fakīdūnī jamīʿan thumma lā tunẓirūni Besides Him, and then conspire ye against me all of you and give ye no respite. See 11:49

item.title: Hud:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ innī tawakkaltu ʿalā l-lahi rabbī warabbikum mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Indeed I have put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no living being but He holds it by its forelock. Indeed my Lord is on a straight path.

item.title: Hud:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ innī tawakkaltu ʿalā l-lahi rabbī warabbikum mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds it by its forelock (i.e., controls it). Indeed, my Lord is on a path (that is) straight. See 11:53

item.title: Hud:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِنِّیْ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ innī tawakkaltu ʿalā l-lahi rabbī warabbikum mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Verily I rely on God, my Lord and your Lord; there is no living creature but He holdeth it (in His control) by its forelock; Verily my Lord is on the Right (Never unjust to anyone.) path. See 11:49

item.title: Hud:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ fa-in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbī qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūnahu shayan inna rabbī ʿalā kulli shayin ḥafīẓun But if you turn your backs [on me], then [know that] I have communicated to you whatever I was sent to you with. My Lord will make another people succeed you, and you will not hurt Allah in the least. Indeed my Lord is watchful over all things.'

item.title: Hud:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ fa-in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbī qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūnahu shayan inna rabbī ʿalā kulli shayin ḥafīẓun But if you turn away, then I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."1 So if you turn away, still I have conveyed the Message with which I was sent to you. My Lord will make another people succeed you, and you will not harm Him in the least. Surely, my Lord is Guardian over all things (11:57). And when Our commandment came, We saved Hud and…

item.title: Hud:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ fa-in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbī qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūnahu shayan inna rabbī ʿalā kulli shayin ḥafīẓun But if ye turn back, then indeed have I conveyed unto you that which I have been sent with unto you, and my Lord will make to succeed you, people other than you; and ye can not do harm unto Him in any way (In any thing or in the least.) at all; Verily my Lord is over all things the (ever) Protecting. 'Qummi' relates in his commentary that the 'Ad' were a people of strong build and huge stature. They lived in the forests. They worshipped idols. However much the Apostle Hud exhorted them to give up…

item.title: Hud:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā hūdan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wanajjaynāhum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin And when Our edict came, We delivered Hūd and the faithful who were with him, by a mercy from Us, and We delivered them from a harsh punishment.

item.title: Hud:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā hūdan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wanajjaynāhum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin And when Our command came, We saved Hūd and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment. See 11:57

item.title: Hud:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā hūdan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wanajjaynāhum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin And when Our decree came (to pass), We delivered Hud and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us; and We delivered them from a (very) severe torment. See 11:57

item.title: Hud:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ watil'ka ʿādun jaḥadū biāyāti rabbihim waʿaṣaw rusulahu wa-ittabaʿū amra kulli jabbārin ʿanīdin Such were [the people of] 'Ād: they impugned the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His apostles, and followed the dictates of every obdurate tyrant.

item.title: Hud:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ watil'ka ʿādun jaḥadū biāyāti rabbihim waʿaṣaw rusulahu wa-ittabaʿū amra kulli jabbārin ʿanīdin And that was ʿAad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant. See 11:57

item.title: Hud:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ watil'ka ʿādun jaḥadū biāyāti rabbihim waʿaṣaw rusulahu wa-ittabaʿū amra kulli jabbārin ʿanīdin And this was (the people) 'Ad, they denied the signs of their Lord, and disobeyed His apostles, and followed the bid dings of every insolent tyrant. See 11:57

item.title: Hud:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati alā inna ʿādan kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan liʿādin qawmi hūdin So they were pursued by a curse in this world and on the Day of Resurrection. Look! Indeed 'Ād defied their Lord. Look! Away with 'Ād, the people of Hud!

item.title: Hud:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati alā inna ʿādan kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan liʿādin qawmi hūdin And they were (therefore) followed in this world with a curse and (as well) on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, ʿAad denied their Lord; then away with ʿAad, the people of Hūd. See 11:57

item.title: Hud:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati alā inna ʿādan kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan liʿādin qawmi hūdin And they were followed in this world by a curse and on the Resurrection Day (also); Behold! verily (the people) 'Ad disbelieved in their Lord; Behold! away with 'Ad the people of Hud. See 11:57

item.title: Hud:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ هُوَ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu huwa ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-is'taʿmarakum fīhā fa-is'taghfirūhu thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī qarībun mujībun And to Thamūd [We sent] Ṣāliḥ, their brother. He said, 'O my people! Worship Allah. You have no other god besides Him. He brought you forth from the earth and made it your habitation. So plead with Him for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently. My Lord is indeed nearmost [and] responsive.'

item.title: Hud:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ هُوَ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu huwa ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-is'taʿmarakum fīhā fa-is'taghfirūhu thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī qarībun mujībun And to Thamūd (We sent) their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive." And to Thamud (people We sent) their brother Salih. He said: O my people! Worship Allah: you have no other god but Him. He brought you forth from the earth and settled you therein, then…

item.title: Hud:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ هُوَ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu huwa ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-is'taʿmarakum fīhā fa-is'taghfirūhu thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī qarībun mujībun And unto the (people) Thamud (sent We) their brother Salih. Said he: "O' my people'! Worship ye (none but the only) God; Ye have no god other than He; (Hear, O' Israel! the Lord, our God is one Lord: Deut 6/4 & Ephesians 4/5-6.) He raised you from the earth and hath given (made you flourish.) you to flourish therein; therefore ask ye forgiveness of Him, then turn ye repentant unto Him: Verily my Lord is (ever) Nigh, (ready) Responser." See 11:57

item.title: Hud:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاصَالِحُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَذَا أَتَنْهَانَا أَنْ نَعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ qālū yāṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā atanhānā an naʿbuda mā yaʿbudu ābāunā wa-innanā lafī shakkin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi murībin They said, 'O Ṣāliḥ! You were a source of hope to us before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers have been worshiping? Indeed we have grave doubts concerning that to which you invite us.'

item.title: Hud:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاصَالِحُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَذَا أَتَنْهَانَا أَنْ نَعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ qālū yāṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā atanhānā an naʿbuda mā yaʿbudu ābāunā wa-innanā lafī shakkin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi murībin They said, "O Ṣāliḥ, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt." They said: "O Salih! You have been among us as a figure of good hope until this! Do you (now) forbid us the worship of what our fathers have worshipped? But we are really in grave doubt as to that to which you invite us (11:62). He said: "O my people! Tell me, if I have a clear proof from…

item.title: Hud:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاصَالِحُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَذَا أَتَنْهَانَا أَنْ نَعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ qālū yāṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā atanhānā an naʿbuda mā yaʿbudu ābāunā wa-innanā lafī shakkin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi murībin Said they: "O' Salih! Indeed thou wert amongst us in whom (our) hopes were centred before this; Dost thou (now) forbid us from worshipping what our fathers did worship? And verily we are in a disquieting doubt about that unto which thou callest us." See 11:57

item.title: Hud:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī min'hu raḥmatan faman yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ʿaṣaytuhu famā tazīdūnanī ghayra takhsīrin He said, 'O my people! Tell me, should I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord, and He has granted me His own mercy, who will protect me from Allah should I disobey Him? For then you will increase me in nothing but loss.

item.title: Hud:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī min'hu raḥmatan faman yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ʿaṣaytuhu famā tazīdūnanī ghayra takhsīrin He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allah if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss. See 11:62

item.title: Hud:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī min'hu raḥmatan faman yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ʿaṣaytuhu famā tazīdūnanī ghayra takhsīrin Said he: (Salih.) "O' my people! See ye not? if I am on a clear sign (guidance) from my Lord and He hath granted mercy (His apostleship) from Himself, who will then help me against God if I disobeyed Him? Therefore ye add not to my lot (anything) other than loss." See 11:57

item.title: Hud:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ wayāqawmi hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun qarībun O my people! This she-camel of Allah is a sign for you. Let her graze [freely] in Allah's land, and do not cause her any harm, for then you shall be seized by a prompt punishment.'

item.title: Hud:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ wayāqawmi hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun qarībun And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah - (she is) to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allah's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment." "And O my people! This she-camel of Allah is a sign to you, so leave her to graze in Allah's land, and touch her not with evil, lest a near torment should seize you (11:64). But they slaughtered her. So he said: "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. This is a promise (a threat) that will not be belied (11:65). So when Our commandment…

item.title: Hud:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ wayāqawmi hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun qarībun And O' my people! This is God's she camel for you, a sign (of my truthfulness), there fore leave her to (freely) pasture on God's earth and ye touch her not with (any) evil, for then will overtake you a ready torment. See 11:57

item.title: Hud:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ذٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ faʿaqarūhā faqāla tamattaʿū fī dārikum thalāthata ayyāmin dhālika waʿdun ghayru makdhūbin But they hamstrung her, whereupon he said, 'Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days: that is a promise not to be belied!'

item.title: Hud:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ذٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ faʿaqarūhā faqāla tamattaʿū fī dārikum thalāthata ayyāmin dhālika waʿdun ghayru makdhūbin But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied (i.e., unfailing)." See 11:64

item.title: Hud:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ذٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ faʿaqarūhā faqāla tamattaʿū fī dārikum thalāthata ayyāmin dhālika waʿdun ghayru makdhūbin Yet they did hamstring her, Then said he (Salih.) "Enjoy ye in your abode for three days; That is a promise not to be belied." If the people of Thamud deserved punishment for killing the She-camel assigned to God then a believer in Qur'an should think what would deserve those who killed the men and the children of the House of the Holy Prophet and took their women into captivity, whereas the holy ones were those whom the Holy Prophet had left along with Qur'an behind him recommending his followers to adhere to both. It is said the Holy Imam Husain prayed to the Lord when his baby son Ali was brutally killed in the field of Karbala…

item.title: Hud:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ falammā jāa amrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wamin khiz'yi yawmi-idhin inna rabbaka huwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu So when Our edict came, We delivered Ṣāliḥ and the faithful who were with him by a mercy from Us, and from the [punishment and] disgrace of that day. Your Lord is indeed the All-strong, the All-mighty.

item.title: Hud:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ falammā jāa amrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wamin khiz'yi yawmi-idhin inna rabbaka huwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu So when Our command came, We saved Ṣāliḥ and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and (saved them) from the disgrace of that day.1 Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might. See 11:64

item.title: Hud:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ falammā jāa amrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wamin khiz'yi yawmi-idhin inna rabbaka huwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu When Our decree came (to pass), We delivered Salih and those who believed with him by mercy from Us, and (We delivered them) from ignominy of that day; verily thy Lord, He is the Strong, the Mighty. See 11:65

item.title: Hud:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ wa-akhadha alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna The Cry seized those who were wrongdoers, and they lay lifeless prostrate in their homes,

item.title: Hud:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ wa-akhadha alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna And the shriek1 seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes (corpses) fallen prone. See 11:64

item.title: Hud:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ wa-akhadha alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna And seized those who were unjust the (mighty) blast so they became in their homes motionless corpses, See 11:65

item.title: Hud:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِثَمُودَ ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā inna thamūdā kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan lithamūda as if they had never lived there. Look! Indeed Thamūd defied their Lord. Look! Away with Thamūd!

item.title: Hud:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِثَمُودَ ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā inna thamūdā kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan lithamūda As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamūd denied their Lord; then, away with Thamūd. See 11:64

item.title: Hud:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِثَمُودَ ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā inna thamūdā kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan lithamūda As though they dwelt not in them; Behold! Verily (the people) Thamud disbelieved in their Lord; Behold! verily away with (the people) Thamud. See 11:65

item.title: Hud:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوْا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ walaqad jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū salāman qāla salāmun famā labitha an jāa biʿij'lin ḥanīdhin Certainly Our messengers came to Abraham with the good news, and said, 'Peace!' 'Peace!' He replied. Presently he brought [for them] a roasted calf.

item.title: Hud:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوْا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ walaqad jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū salāman qāla salāmun famā labitha an jāa biʿij'lin ḥanīdhin And certainly did Our messengers (i.e., angels) come to Ibrahim with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing (them) a roasted calf. And verily, there came Our messengers to Ibrahim with the glad tidings. They said: Salaman (greetings or peace!)" He answered, "Salamun (greetings or peace!)," and he hastened to entertain them with a roasted calf (11:69). But when he saw their hands went not towards it (the meal), he mistrusted them, and conceived a fear of them. They said: "Fear not, we have been sent against the people of Lut (11:70). And his wife was standing (there), and she laughed. But We…

item.title: Hud:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوْا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ walaqad jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū salāman qāla salāmun famā labitha an jāa biʿij'lin ḥanīdhin And indeed Our messengers (the angels) came unto Abraham with glad tidings; Said they: "Peace! (Abraham in reply), said (And on you also be) "Peace"! and delayed not to bring a roasted calf." See 11:65

item.title: Hud:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَءَا أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ falammā raā aydiyahum lā taṣilu ilayhi nakirahum wa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmi lūṭin But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he took them amiss and felt a fear of them. They said, 'Do not be afraid. We have been sent to the people of Lot.'

item.title: Hud:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَءَا أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ falammā raā aydiyahum lā taṣilu ilayhi nakirahum wa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmi lūṭin But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension.1 They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lut." See 11:69

item.title: Hud:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَءَا أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ falammā raā aydiyahum lā taṣilu ilayhi nakirahum wa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmi lūṭin But when he saw that their hands extended (Reached. Refer to verses 7:80, 21:71 - 21:74 & 15:59.) not towards it, (The food which Abraham had offered.) (he) mistrusted (deemed strange.) them and conceived fear of them. Said they (the Angels): "Fear (thou) not; Verily we are sent unto Lot's people." See 11:65

item.title: Hud:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَامْرَأَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ وَرَاءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ wa-im'ra-atuhu qāimatun faḍaḥikat fabasharnāhā bi-is'ḥāqa wamin warāi is'ḥāqa yaʿqūba His wife, standing by, laughed as We gave her the good news of [the birth of] Isaac, and of Jacob, after Isaac.

item.title: Hud:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَامْرَأَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ وَرَاءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ wa-im'ra-atuhu qāimatun faḍaḥikat fabasharnāhā bi-is'ḥāqa wamin warāi is'ḥāqa yaʿqūba And his wife was standing, and she smiled.1 Then We gave her good tidings of Ishaq and after Ishaq, Ya'qub. See 11:69

item.title: Hud:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَامْرَأَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ وَرَاءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ wa-im'ra-atuhu qāimatun faḍaḥikat fabasharnāhā bi-is'ḥāqa wamin warāi is'ḥāqa yaʿqūba And his wife was standing (by), and she laughed, (ROT Gen. 18/10-12.) then We gave her the glad tidings of Isaac and after Isaac of (a son's (Grandson.) son) Jacob. See 11:65

item.title: Hud:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاوَيْلَتَى ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهَذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ qālat yāwaylatā a-alidu wa-anā ʿajūzun wahādhā baʿlī shaykhan inna hādhā lashayon ʿajībun She said, 'Oh, my! Shall I, an old woman, bear [children], and [while] this husband of mine is an old man?! That is indeed an odd thing!'

item.title: Hud:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاوَيْلَتَى ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهَذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ qālat yāwaylatā a-alidu wa-anā ʿajūzun wahādhā baʿlī shaykhan inna hādhā lashayon ʿajībun She said, "Woe to me!1 Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!" See 11:69

item.title: Hud:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ يَاوَيْلَتَى ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهَذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ qālat yāwaylatā a-alidu wa-anā ʿajūzun wahādhā baʿlī shaykhan inna hādhā lashayon ʿajībun Said she: "O' Woe unto me! shall I bear a son (now) when I am an (extremely) old (woman) and this my husband an (extremely) old (man)? (The wonder on the part of the Lady clearly indicates that her giving birth to Isaac was a miraculous act enacted by the Will of the Lord.) Verily this is a thing wonderful!" See 11:65

item.title: Hud:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ qālū ataʿjabīna min amri l-lahi raḥmatu l-lahi wabarakātuhu ʿalaykum ahla l-bayti innahu ḥamīdun majīdun They said, 'Are you amazed at Allah's dispensation? [That is] Allah's mercy and His blessings upon you, members of the household. Indeed He is all-laudable, all-glorious.'

item.title: Hud:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ qālū ataʿjabīna min amri l-lahi raḥmatu l-lahi wabarakātuhu ʿalaykum ahla l-bayti innahu ḥamīdun majīdun They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable." See 11:69

item.title: Hud:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ qālū ataʿjabīna min amri l-lahi raḥmatu l-lahi wabarakātuhu ʿalaykum ahla l-bayti innahu ḥamīdun majīdun Said they: (The angels.) "What! wonderest thou at the decree of God? The mercy of God and His blessings be on ye, O' People of the House; (Arabic: Ahl Al-Bayt refer to note on verse 33:33. See note on the use of the address Ahl Al-Bayt on this note & verse 33:33.) Verily He (alone) is Praiseworthy, the All-Glorious!" Since in the mercy and the bounty of God offered in this verse to the people of the house of Abraham and Sarah the wife of Abraham happens to be the probable person included in the address of 'Ahl Al-Bayt' some commentators in their anxiety to find some argument, for their counting the…

item.title: Hud:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَى يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ falammā dhahaba ʿan ib'rāhīma l-rawʿu wajāathu l-bush'rā yujādilunā fī qawmi lūṭin So when the awe had left Abraham and the good news had reached him, he pleaded with Us concerning the people of Lot.

item.title: Hud:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَى يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ falammā dhahaba ʿan ib'rāhīma l-rawʿu wajāathu l-bush'rā yujādilunā fī qawmi lūṭin And when the fright had left Ibrahim and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue (i.e., plead) with Us1 concerning the people of Lut. Then when the fear had gone away from (the mind of) Ibrahim, and the glad tidings had reached him, he began to plead with Us (Our messengers) for the people of Lut (11:74). Verily, Ibrahim was, without doubt, forbearing, used to invoke Allah with humility, and was repentant (11:75). O Ibrahim! Forsake this. Indeed, the commandment of your Lord has gone forth. Verily, there will come a torment for them which cannot be turned back (11:76). The Dispute of Ibrahim over the People of Lut Allah, the Exalted, informs of what…

item.title: Hud:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَى يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ falammā dhahaba ʿan ib'rāhīma l-rawʿu wajāathu l-bush'rā yujādilunā fī qawmi lūṭin And when had gone away from Abraham the awe and the glad tidings came unto him, he began pleading with Us for Lot's people. Owing to his being extremely merciful, Abraham began to continuously argue with the angels about the punishment they had come to inflict upon the people of Sodom but when he received the commandment from God, he kept fully reconciled with the will of the Lord.

item.title: Hud:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ inna ib'rāhīma laḥalīmun awwāhun munībun Abraham was indeed most forbearing, plaintive, [and] penitent.

item.title: Hud:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ inna ib'rāhīma laḥalīmun awwāhun munībun Indeed, Ibrahim was forbearing, grieving1 and (frequently) returning (to Allah). See 11:74

item.title: Hud:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ inna ib'rāhīma laḥalīmun awwāhun munībun Verily Abraham was indeed forbearing, compassionate, oft- returning (to God). See 11:74

item.title: Hud:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ yāib'rāhīmu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā innahu qad jāa amru rabbika wa-innahum ātīhim ʿadhābun ghayru mardūdin 'O Abraham, let this matter alone! Your Lord's edict has certainly come, and an irrevocable punishment shall overtake them.'

item.title: Hud:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ yāib'rāhīmu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā innahu qad jāa amru rabbika wa-innahum ātīhim ʿadhābun ghayru mardūdin (The angels said), "O Ibrahim, give up this (plea). Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled." See 11:74

item.title: Hud:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ yāib'rāhīmu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā innahu qad jāa amru rabbika wa-innahum ātīhim ʿadhābun ghayru mardūdin O' (Said God unto Abraham.) Abraham! Forsake this! Indeed the decree of thy Lord hath come to pass; and verily unto them cometh a torment (which is) irreversible. See 11:74

item.title: Hud:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ walammā jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqāla hādhā yawmun ʿaṣībun When Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed on their account and in a predicament for their sake, and he said, 'This is a terrible day!'

item.title: Hud:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ walammā jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqāla hādhā yawmun ʿaṣībun And when Our messengers, (the angels), came to Lut, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort1 and said, "This is a trying day." And when Our messengers came to Lut, he was grieved on account of them and was concerned for them. He said: This is a distressful day (11:77). And his people came rushing towards him, and since aforetime they used to commit crimes, he said: "O my people! Here are my daughters, they are purer for you. So have Taqwa of Allah and disgrace me not with regard to my guests! Is there not among you a single right-minded man? (11:78). They said: "Surely, you know that we…

item.title: Hud:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ walammā jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqāla hādhā yawmun ʿaṣībun And when Our messengers (the angels) came unto Lot, he was grieved for them and felt his arm straitened (Helpless.) to protect them and said: "This is a distressful day." It is evident from the feeling of helplessness expressed by Lot that even being sinless like that of an apostle of God could not be sufficient to defend the people against any heavenly calamity.

item.title: Hud:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي أَلَيْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَشِيدٌ wajāahu qawmuhu yuh'raʿūna ilayhi wamin qablu kānū yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti qāla yāqawmi hāulāi banātī hunna aṭharu lakum fa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni fī ḍayfī alaysa minkum rajulun rashīdun Then his people came running toward him, and they had been committing vices aforetime. He said, 'O my people, these are my daughters: they are purer for you.1 Be wary of Allah and do not humiliate me with regard to my guests. Is there not a right-minded man among you?'

item.title: Hud:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي أَلَيْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَشِيدٌ wajāahu qawmuhu yuh'raʿūna ilayhi wamin qablu kānū yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti qāla yāqawmi hāulāi banātī hunna aṭharu lakum fa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni fī ḍayfī alaysa minkum rajulun rashīdun And his people came hastening to him, and before (this) they had been doing evil deeds.1 He said, "O my people, these are my daughters;2 they are purer for you. So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?" See 11:77

item.title: Hud:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي أَلَيْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَشِيدٌ wajāahu qawmuhu yuh'raʿūna ilayhi wamin qablu kānū yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti qāla yāqawmi hāulāi banātī hunna aṭharu lakum fa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni fī ḍayfī alaysa minkum rajulun rashīdun And came his people rushing unto him; for aforetime they did evil deeds; Said he (Lot): "O' my people! these my daughters are - they are purer for you, so guard ye against (the punishment of) God, and disgrace me not about my guests; Is there not among you a single man rightminded?" See 11:77

item.title: Hud:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
