item.description: قَالُوْا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ qālū laqad ʿalim'ta mā lanā fī banātika min ḥaqqin wa-innaka lataʿlamu mā nurīdu They said, 'You certainly know that we have no interest in your daughters, and indeed you know what we want.'

item.title: Hud:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ qālū laqad ʿalim'ta mā lanā fī banātika min ḥaqqin wa-innaka lataʿlamu mā nurīdu They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters (i.e., women) any claim (i.e., desire), and indeed, you know what we want." See 11:77

item.title: Hud:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ qālū laqad ʿalim'ta mā lanā fī banātika min ḥaqqin wa-innaka lataʿlamu mā nurīdu Said they: "Indeed knowest thou that we need not thy daughters, and verily well-knoweth thou what we intend." See 11:77

item.title: Hud:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِي إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ qāla law anna lī bikum quwwatan aw āwī ilā ruk'nin shadīdin He said, 'If only I had the power to deter you, or could take refuge in a mighty support!'

item.title: Hud:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِي إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ qāla law anna lī bikum quwwatan aw āwī ilā ruk'nin shadīdin He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support." He said: "Would that I had strength to overpower you, or that I could betake myself to some powerful support (11:80). They (messengers) said: "O Lut! Verily, we are the messengers from your Lord! They shall not reach you! So travel with your family in a part of the night, and let not any of you look back; but your wife (will remain behind), verily, the punishment which will afflict them, will afflict her. Indeed, morning is their appointed time. Is not the morning near? (11:81). Lut's Inability, His Desire for Strength and the Angels' Informing Him of the Reality…

item.title: Hud:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِي إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ qāla law anna lī bikum quwwatan aw āwī ilā ruk'nin shadīdin Said he: (Lot.) "Would that I had strength to resist you or betake myself to a strong supporter." See 11:77

item.title: Hud:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَالُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ يَصِلُوْۤا إِلَيْكَ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ إِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ qālū yālūṭu innā rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilū ilayka fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun illā im'ra-ataka innahu muṣībuhā mā aṣābahum inna mawʿidahumu l-ṣub'ḥu alaysa l-ṣub'ḥu biqarībin They said, 'O Lot, we are messengers of your Lord. They will never get at you. Set out with your family in a watch of the night; and none of you shall turn round, except your wife; indeed she will be struck by what strikes them. Indeed their tryst is the dawn. Is not the dawn [already] near?'

item.title: Hud:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَالُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ يَصِلُوْۤا إِلَيْكَ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ إِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ qālū yālūṭu innā rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilū ilayka fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun illā im'ra-ataka innahu muṣībuhā mā aṣābahum inna mawʿidahumu l-ṣub'ḥu alaysa l-ṣub'ḥu biqarībin They (the angels) said, "O Lut, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; (therefore), they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night1 and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is (for) the morning. Is not the morning near?" See 11:80

item.title: Hud:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَالُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ يَصِلُوْۤا إِلَيْكَ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ إِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ qālū yālūṭu innā rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilū ilayka fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun illā im'ra-ataka innahu muṣībuhā mā aṣābahum inna mawʿidahumu l-ṣub'ḥu alaysa l-ṣub'ḥu biqarībin Said they: (The angels.) "O' Lot! Verily we are messengers from thy Lord! Never shall they reach thee! so depart thou with thy people while a part of the night remaineth, and let none of you turn back - but thy wife; Verily shall befall her what befalleth them; Verily their appointed time is the morning; Is not the morning nigh?" See 11:77

item.title: Hud:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ مَنْضُودٍ falammā jāa amrunā jaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhā ḥijāratan min sijjīlin manḍūdin So when Our edict came, We made its1 topmost part its nethermost, and We rained on it stones of laminar shale,

item.title: Hud:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ مَنْضُودٍ falammā jāa amrunā jaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhā ḥijāratan min sijjīlin manḍūdin So when Our command came, We made the highest part (of the city) its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, (which were). So when Our commandment came, We turned them upside down, and rained on them stones of clay, in an array (11:82). Marked from your Lord; and they are not ever far from the wrongdoers (11:83). The Town of Lut's People is Overturned and Their Destruction Allah, the Exalted, says: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا So when Our commandment came, This happened at sunrise. جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا We (turned it)... The city of Sadum (Sodom) سَافِلَهَا upside down, This is similar to Allah's statement: فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ So there covered them that which did…

item.title: Hud:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ مَنْضُودٍ falammā jāa amrunā jaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhā ḥijāratan min sijjīlin manḍūdin So when Our decree came to pass, We turned their (township) upside down, and rained on them hard stones of baked clay, (spreading) layer on layer. See 11:77

item.title: Hud:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika wamā hiya mina l-ẓālimīna bibaʿīdin marked1 with your Lord [for the profligate],2 never far from the wrongdoers.

item.title: Hud:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika wamā hiya mina l-ẓālimīna bibaʿīdin Marked from your Lord. And it (i.e., Allah's punishment) is not from the wrongdoers (very) far. See 11:82

item.title: Hud:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika wamā hiya mina l-ẓālimīna bibaʿīdin Marked (for punishment) with thy Lord; Nor are they (the ruins of their township) far distant from the unjust ones. See 11:77

item.title: Hud:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ وَلَا تَنْقُصُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ اِنِّیْ أَرَاكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu walā tanquṣū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna innī arākum bikhayrin wa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin muḥīṭin And to Midian [We sent] Shu'ayb, their brother. He said, 'O my people! Worship Allah. You have no other god besides Him. Do not diminish the measure or the balance. Indeed I see that you are faring well, but I fear for you the punishment of an all-embracing day.'

item.title: Hud:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ وَلَا تَنْقُصُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ اِنِّیْ أَرَاكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu walā tanquṣū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna innī arākum bikhayrin wa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin muḥīṭin And to Madyan (We sent) their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day. And to the Madyan people (We sent) their brother Shu'ayb. He said: O my people! Worship Allah, you have no other god but Him, and give not short measure or weight. I see you in prosperity and verily,…

item.title: Hud:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ وَلَا تَنْقُصُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ اِنِّیْ أَرَاكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu walā tanquṣū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna innī arākum bikhayrin wa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin muḥīṭin And unto (the people of) Midian (We sent) their brother Shu'aib. Said he: "O' my people! Worship ye God (alone); Ye have no god other than He; (Refer to note on verses 11:61, 7:73. O.T. Deut. 6/4 N.T. Eph. 4/5-6.) and give not short measure (Scale.) and weight, (Scale.) (Refer to verse 83:1 - 83:3.) Verily I see you in prosperity and verily I fear for you the torment of an all-encompassing day." Besides the great Prophets like Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus and the Holy Prophet who were…

item.title: Hud:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ أَوْفُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوْۤا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wayāqawmi awfū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna bil-qis'ṭi walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna 'O my people! Observe fully the measure and the balance, with justice, and do not cheat the people of their goods,1 and do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption.'

item.title: Hud:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ أَوْفُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوْۤا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wayāqawmi awfū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna bil-qis'ṭi walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption. "And O my people! Give full measure and weight in justice and reduce not the things that are due to the people, and do not commit mischief in the land, causing corruption (11:85). "That which is left by Allah is better for you, if you are believers. And I am not a guardian over you (11:86). First, he (Shu'ayb) prohibited them from cheating in business by decreasing the weights whenever they gave (products) to people. He commanded them to give just measure…

item.title: Hud:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ أَوْفُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوْۤا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wayāqawmi awfū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna bil-qis'ṭi walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And O' my people! give ye full measure and (correct) weight in justice, and defraud ye not people of their things, (Dues.) and act not corruptly in the earth, making mischief. See 11:84

item.title: Hud:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَفِيظٍ baqiyyatu l-lahi khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna wamā anā ʿalaykum biḥafīẓin 'What remains of Allah's provision1 is better for you, should you be faithful, and I am not a keeper over you.'

item.title: Hud:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَفِيظٍ baqiyyatu l-lahi khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna wamā anā ʿalaykum biḥafīẓin What remains (lawful) from Allah is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you." See 11:85

item.title: Hud:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَفِيظٍ baqiyyatu l-lahi khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna wamā anā ʿalaykum biḥafīẓin That which is left by God unto you is good for you if ye be believers, and I am not over you a keeper. 'Sabbaghi', one of the renowned scholars of the Sunni School in his famous book 'Fusul al-Muhimmah' has related at length a tradition on the authority of the sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq - about the signs of the re-appearance of the Twelfth or the Last Holy Imam at the end of the world. The Holy Imam said: "When the Last one of us (the Holy Imams) will appear, there will be around him only (313). Three hundred and thirteen faithful ones of the believers. He would lean on the wall of the…

item.title: Hud:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ نَتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا أَوْ أَنْ نَفْعَلَ فِي أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ إِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ qālū yāshuʿaybu aṣalatuka tamuruka an natruka mā yaʿbudu ābāunā aw an nafʿala fī amwālinā mā nashāu innaka la-anta l-ḥalīmu l-rashīdu They said, 'O Shu'ayb, does your worship require that we abandon what our fathers have been worshiping, or that we should not do with our wealth whatever we wish? You are indeed [a] gentle and sensible [person].'

item.title: Hud:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ نَتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا أَوْ أَنْ نَفْعَلَ فِي أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ إِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ qālū yāshuʿaybu aṣalatuka tamuruka an natruka mā yaʿbudu ābāunā aw an nafʿala fī amwālinā mā nashāu innaka la-anta l-ḥalīmu l-rashīdu They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer (i.e., religion) command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"1 They said: O Shu'ayb! Does your Salah command you that we give up what our fathers used to worship, or that we give up doing what we like with our property? Verily, you are the forbearer, right-minded! (11:87). The Response of Shu'ayb's People They said to Shu'ayb, in mockery: أَصَلَاتُكَ Does your Salah Al-A'mash said, "This means your reading." تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا…

item.title: Hud:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ نَتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا أَوْ أَنْ نَفْعَلَ فِي أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ إِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ qālū yāshuʿaybu aṣalatuka tamuruka an natruka mā yaʿbudu ābāunā aw an nafʿala fī amwālinā mā nashāu innaka la-anta l-ḥalīmu l-rashīdu Said they: "O' Shu'aib! Doth thy religion enjoin thee that we should forsake what our fathers did worship or we (should forsake to) do with our property what we please? Forsooth (May be a mockery and it may be a remark of regard for Shua'ib was regarded by his people as such and they did not expect from him any thing of the warnings he issued against them. This meaning is supported by the next verse, 11:88.) thou art the one forbearing, the rightminded." See 11:86

item.title: Hud:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَى مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī warazaqanī min'hu riz'qan ḥasanan wamā urīdu an ukhālifakum ilā mā anhākum ʿanhu in urīdu illā l-iṣ'lāḥa mā is'taṭaʿtu wamā tawfīqī illā bil-lahi ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību He said, 'O my people! Have you considered, should I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord, who has provided me a good provision from Himself?1 I do not wish to oppose you by what I forbid you. I only desire to put things in order, as far as I can, and my success lies only with Allah: in Him I have put my trust, and to Him I…

item.title: Hud:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَى مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī warazaqanī min'hu riz'qan ḥasanan wamā urīdu an ukhālifakum ilā mā anhākum ʿanhu in urīdu illā l-iṣ'lāḥa mā is'taṭaʿtu wamā tawfīqī illā bil-lahi ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...?1 And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allah. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him…

item.title: Hud:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَى مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī warazaqanī min'hu riz'qan ḥasanan wamā urīdu an ukhālifakum ilā mā anhākum ʿanhu in urīdu illā l-iṣ'lāḥa mā is'taṭaʿtu wamā tawfīqī illā bil-lahi ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību Said he: "O' my people! See ye not if I am on a clear sign (guidance) from my Lord, and (He) hath provided me from Himself, sustenance (pure and) good; and I desire not that in opposition to you I betake my self unto that which I forbid you from it; I desire naught but reform what (As far as I can.) I am able to (do); and my guidance…

item.title: Hud:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِنْكُمْ بِبَعِيدٍ wayāqawmi lā yajrimannakum shiqāqī an yuṣībakum mith'lu mā aṣāba qawma nūḥin aw qawma hūdin aw qawma ṣāliḥin wamā qawmu lūṭin minkum bibaʿīdin O my people, do not let your defiance toward me lead you to be visited by the like of what was visited on the people of Noah, or the people of Hūd, or the people of Ṣāliḥ, and the people of Lot are not distant from you.

item.title: Hud:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِنْكُمْ بِبَعِيدٍ wayāqawmi lā yajrimannakum shiqāqī an yuṣībakum mith'lu mā aṣāba qawma nūḥin aw qawma hūdin aw qawma ṣāliḥin wamā qawmu lūṭin minkum bibaʿīdin And O my people, let not (your) dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Nuh or the people of Hūd or the people of Ṣāliḥ. And the people of Lut are not from you far away. "And O my people! Let not my Shiqaq cause you to suffer the fate similar to that of the people of Nuh or of Hud or of Salih, and the people of Lut are not far off from you! (11:89). "And ask forgiveness of your Lord and turn unto Him…

item.title: Hud:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِنْكُمْ بِبَعِيدٍ wayāqawmi lā yajrimannakum shiqāqī an yuṣībakum mith'lu mā aṣāba qawma nūḥin aw qawma hūdin aw qawma ṣāliḥin wamā qawmu lūṭin minkum bibaʿīdin And, O' my people! Let not (your) opposition to me cause you to sin, lest befalleth unto you the like of what befell the people of Noah, or the people of Hud, or the people of Salih; and nor the people of Lot are far off from you. See 11:86

item.title: Hud:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ wa-is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī raḥīmun wadūdun Plead with your Lord for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently. My Lord is indeed all-merciful, all-affectionate.'

item.title: Hud:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ wa-is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī raḥīmun wadūdun And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate." See 11:89

item.title: Hud:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ wa-is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī raḥīmun wadūdun And ask ye forgiveness of your Lord, and turn ye unto Him (repentant); Verily my Lord is All-Merciful, Loving-Kind. See 11:86

item.title: Hud:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَاكَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ qālū yāshuʿaybu mā nafqahu kathīran mimmā taqūlu wa-innā lanarāka fīnā ḍaʿīfan walawlā rahṭuka larajamnāka wamā anta ʿalaynā biʿazīzin They said, 'O Shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say. Indeed we see you are weak amongst us, and were it not for your tribe, we would have stoned you, and you are not venerable to us.'

item.title: Hud:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَاكَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ qālū yāshuʿaybu mā nafqahu kathīran mimmā taqūlu wa-innā lanarāka fīnā ḍaʿīfan walawlā rahṭuka larajamnāka wamā anta ʿalaynā biʿazīzin They said, "O Shuʿayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you (to death); and you are not to us one respected." They said: "O Shu'ayb! We do not understand much of what you say, and we see you weak among us. Were it not for your family, you would have been stoned, and you are not powerful against us (11:91). He said: "O my people! Is then my family of more weight with you than Allah? And you have cast Him away…

item.title: Hud:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَاكَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ qālū yāshuʿaybu mā nafqahu kathīran mimmā taqūlu wa-innā lanarāka fīnā ḍaʿīfan walawlā rahṭuka larajamnāka wamā anta ʿalaynā biʿazīzin Said they: "O' Shu'aib We understand not much of what thou sayest, and most surely we see thee weak amongst us; and were it not for thy family we would surely stone thee; and thou art not against us powerful." See 11:86

item.title: Hud:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِي أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ qāla yāqawmi arahṭī aʿazzu ʿalaykum mina l-lahi wa-ittakhadhtumūhu warāakum ẓih'riyyan inna rabbī bimā taʿmalūna muḥīṭun He said, 'O my people! Is my tribe more venerable in your sight than Allah, to whom you pay no regard? Indeed my Lord comprehends whatever you do.

item.title: Hud:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِي أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ qāla yāqawmi arahṭī aʿazzu ʿalaykum mina l-lahi wa-ittakhadhtumūhu warāakum ẓih'riyyan inna rabbī bimā taʿmalūna muḥīṭun He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allah? But you put Him behind your backs (in neglect). Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do. See 11:91

item.title: Hud:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِي أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ qāla yāqawmi arahṭī aʿazzu ʿalaykum mina l-lahi wa-ittakhadhtumūhu warāakum ẓih'riyyan inna rabbī bimā taʿmalūna muḥīṭun Said he (Shu'aib.) : "What! Is my family more esteemed by you than God? and caste ye Him behind your back, with neglect? Verily, my Lord encompasseth what (all) ye do." See 11:86

item.title: Hud:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ وَارْتَقِبُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ wayāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun sawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi waman huwa kādhibun wa-ir'taqibū innī maʿakum raqībun O my people! Act according to your ability; I too am acting. Soon you will know who will be overtaken by a punishment that will disgrace him, and who is a liar. So be on the watch; I too will be watching along with you.'

item.title: Hud:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ وَارْتَقِبُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ wayāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun sawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi waman huwa kādhibun wa-ir'taqibū innī maʿakum raqībun And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, (awaiting the outcome)." And O my people! Act according to your ability, and I am acting. You will come to know who it is on whom descends the torment that will cover him with ignominy, and who is a liar! And watch you! Verily, I too am watching with you (11:93). And when Our commandment came, We saved Shu'ayb and…

item.title: Hud:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ وَارْتَقِبُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ wayāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun sawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi waman huwa kādhibun wa-ir'taqibū innī maʿakum raqībun And O' my people! Act ye according to your ability, I too am acting; soon will ye know on whom cometh the torment that will disgrace him, and who it is a liar; and watch ye, verily I too with you am watching. See 11:86

item.title: Hud:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā shuʿayban wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wa-akhadhati alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna And when Our edict came, We delivered Shu'ayb and the faithful who were with him by a mercy from Us. And the Cry seized those who were wrongdoers, whereat they lay lifeless prostrate in their homes,

item.title: Hud:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā shuʿayban wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wa-akhadhati alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes (corpses) fallen prone. See 11:93

item.title: Hud:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā shuʿayban wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wa-akhadhati alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna And when came to pass Our decree We delivered Shu'aib and those who believed with him by mercy from Us; and overtook those who did injustice, the (mighty) blast so they became in their homes motionless corpses, See 11:86

item.title: Hud:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا بُعْدًا لِمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā buʿ'dan limadyana kamā baʿidat thamūdu as if they had never lived there. Look! Away with Midian! —just as Thamūd was done away with!

item.title: Hud:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا بُعْدًا لِمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā buʿ'dan limadyana kamā baʿidat thamūdu As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away. See 11:93

item.title: Hud:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا بُعْدًا لِمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā buʿ'dan limadyana kamā baʿidat thamūdu (It happened) As though they dwelt not in them; Behold! away with (the people of) Midian even as were cast away (the people of) Thamud! See 11:86

item.title: Hud:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs and a manifest authority

item.title: Hud:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin And We did certainly send Musa with Our signs and a clear authority.1 And indeed We sent Musa with Our Ayat and a manifest authority (11:96). To Fir'awn and his chiefs, but they followed the command of Fir'awn, and the command of Fir'awn was no right guide (11:97). He will go ahead of his people on the Day of Resurrection, and will lead them into the Fire, and evil indeed is the place to which they are led (11:98). They were pursued by a curse in this (deceiving life of this world) and (so they will be pursued by a curse) on the Day of Resurrection, evil indeed is the gift granted (11:99). The Story of Musa and Fir'awn In these verses Allah informs of His sending Musa…

item.title: Hud:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin And indeed We sent Moses, with Our signs and an authority (which was) manifest, See 11:86

item.title: Hud:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَا أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-ittabaʿū amra fir'ʿawna wamā amru fir'ʿawna birashīdin to Pharaoh and his elite, but they followed Pharaoh's dictates, and Pharaoh's dictates were not right-minded.

item.title: Hud:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَا أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-ittabaʿū amra fir'ʿawna wamā amru fir'ʿawna birashīdin To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not (at all) discerning. See 11:96

item.title: Hud:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَا أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-ittabaʿū amra fir'ʿawna wamā amru fir'ʿawna birashīdin Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they followed the bidding of Pharaoh; and Pharaoh's bidding was no right directive. (Right-minded – correct.) See 11:86

item.title: Hud:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ yaqdumu qawmahu yawma l-qiyāmati fa-awradahumu l-nāra wabi'sa l-wir'du l-mawrūdu On the Day of Resurrection he will lead his people and conduct them into the Fire: an evil goal for the incoming!1

item.title: Hud:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ yaqdumu qawmahu yawma l-qiyāmati fa-awradahumu l-nāra wabi'sa l-wir'du l-mawrūdu He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led. See 11:96

item.title: Hud:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ yaqdumu qawmahu yawma l-qiyāmati fa-awradahumu l-nāra wabi'sa l-wir'du l-mawrūdu He shall lead his people on the Resurrection Day, and bring them down to the (Hell) fire; but woeful will be the leading and the place led to. See 11:86

item.title: Hud:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati bi'sa l-rif'du l-marfūdu They were pursued by a curse in this [world], as well as on the Day of Resurrection; evil is the award conferred [upon them]!

item.title: Hud:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati bi'sa l-rif'du l-marfūdu And they were followed in this (world) with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift1 which is given. See 11:96

item.title: Hud:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati bi'sa l-rif'du l-marfūdu They are followed by a curse in this (life) and (also) on the Day of Resurrection; And woeful is the gift which shall be given (unto them). See 11:86

item.title: Hud:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْقُرٰی نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهَا قَائِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ dhālika min anbāi l-qurā naquṣṣuhu ʿalayka min'hā qāimun waḥaṣīdun These are from the accounts of the townships which We recount to you. Of them there are some that still stand, and some that have been mown down.

item.title: Hud:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْقُرٰی نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهَا قَائِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ dhālika min anbāi l-qurā naquṣṣuhu ʿalayka min'hā qāimun waḥaṣīdun That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are (still) standing and some are (as) a harvest (mowed down).1 That is some of the news of the (population of) towns which We relate unto you; of them, some are (still) standing, and some have been (already) reaped (11:100). We wronged them not, but they wronged themselves. So their gods whom they call upon besides Allah, profited them naught when there came the command of your Lord, nor did they add aught to them but destruction (11:101). The Lesson Taken from the Destroyed Towns When Allah mentioned the story of the Prophets and what happened with them and their nations – how He destroyed the…

item.title: Hud:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْقُرٰی نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهَا قَائِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ dhālika min anbāi l-qurā naquṣṣuhu ʿalayka min'hā qāimun waḥaṣīdun This is of the account of (the fate of) the townships We relate unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) of them some are standing and some have been mown down (by the passage of time) See 11:86

item.title: Hud:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فَمَا أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin ẓalamū anfusahum famā aghnat ʿanhum ālihatuhumu allatī yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi min shayin lammā jāa amru rabbika wamā zādūhum ghayra tatbībin We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. Of no avail to them were their gods whom they would invoke besides Allah, in any wise, when your Lord's edict came, and they1 did not increase them in anything but ruin.

item.title: Hud:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فَمَا أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin ẓalamū anfusahum famā aghnat ʿanhum ālihatuhumu allatī yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi min shayin lammā jāa amru rabbika wamā zādūhum ghayra tatbībin And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allah when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin. See 11:100

item.title: Hud:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فَمَا أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin ẓalamū anfusahum famā aghnat ʿanhum ālihatuhumu allatī yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi min shayin lammā jāa amru rabbika wamā zādūhum ghayra tatbībin And We did no injustice unto them, but they were unjust unto themselves, so availed them not aught their gods whom they called upon besides God when came to pass the decree of thy Lord; they added not (aught to their lot) but perdition. See 11:86

item.title: Hud:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرٰی وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ اَلِیْمٌ شَدِيدٌ wakadhālika akhdhu rabbika idhā akhadha l-qurā wahiya ẓālimatun inna akhdhahu alīmun shadīdun Such is the seizing of your Lord when He seizes the townships that are wrongdoing. Indeed His seizing is painful, severe.

item.title: Hud:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرٰی وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ اَلِیْمٌ شَدِيدٌ wakadhālika akhdhu rabbika idhā akhadha l-qurā wahiya ẓālimatun inna akhdhahu alīmun shadīdun And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe. Such is the punishment of your Lord when He seizes the (population of) towns while they are doing wrong. Verily, His punishment is painful (and) severe.) It is as though Allah is saying, Just as We have destroyed these wicked generations who rejected their Messengers, We will do the same to any who are like them (11:102). إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ Verily, His punishment is painful (and) severe. In the Two Sahihs, it is recorded that Abu Musa said that the Messenger of Allah SAW said: إِنَّ اللهَ لَيُمْلِي لِلظَّالِمِ حَتَّى…

item.title: Hud:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرٰی وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ اَلِیْمٌ شَدِيدٌ wakadhālika akhdhu rabbika idhā akhadha l-qurā wahiya ẓālimatun inna akhdhahu alīmun shadīdun Such is the grasp (of punishment) of thy Lord when graspeth (Punished.) He the townships while they are unjust; Verily His grasp (punishment) is painful, severe. See 11:86

item.title: Hud:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْاٰخِرَةُ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ inna fī dhālika laāyatan liman khāfa ʿadhāba l-ākhirati dhālika yawmun majmūʿun lahu l-nāsu wadhālika yawmun mashhūdun There is indeed a sign in that for him who fears the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a day on which all mankind will be gathered, and it is a day witnessed [by all creatures].

item.title: Hud:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْاٰخِرَةُ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ inna fī dhālika laāyatan liman khāfa ʿadhāba l-ākhirati dhālika yawmun majmūʿun lahu l-nāsu wadhālika yawmun mashhūdun Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day (which will be) witnessed. Indeed in that (there) is a sure lesson for those who fear the torment of the Hereafter. That is a Day whereon mankind will be gathered together, and that is a Day when all will be present (11:103). And We delay it only for a term (already) fixed (11:104). On the Day when it comes, no person shall speak except by His (Allah's) leave. Some among them will be wretched and (others) blessed…

item.title: Hud:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْاٰخِرَةُ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ inna fī dhālika laāyatan liman khāfa ʿadhāba l-ākhirati dhālika yawmun majmūʿun lahu l-nāsu wadhālika yawmun mashhūdun Verily, in this there is a sign for him who feareth the chastisement of the hereafter; This is a day for which mankind shall be gathered together, And this day shall be witnessed (by all) See 11:86

item.title: Hud:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَعْدُودٍ wamā nu-akhiruhu illā li-ajalin maʿdūdin And We do not defer it but for a determinate term.

item.title: Hud:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَعْدُودٍ wamā nu-akhiruhu illā li-ajalin maʿdūdin And We do not delay it except for a limited term. See 11:103

item.title: Hud:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَعْدُودٍ wamā nu-akhiruhu illā li-ajalin maʿdūdin And We delay it not but to an appointed (Numbered.) term. See 11:86

item.title: Hud:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ yawma yati lā takallamu nafsun illā bi-idh'nihi famin'hum shaqiyyun wasaʿīdun The day it comes, no one shall speak except by His leave. [On that day,] some of them will be wretched and [some] felicitous.

item.title: Hud:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ yawma yati lā takallamu nafsun illā bi-idh'nihi famin'hum shaqiyyun wasaʿīdun The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous. See 11:103

item.title: Hud:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ yawma yati lā takallamu nafsun illā bi-idh'nihi famin'hum shaqiyyun wasaʿīdun The day (when) it arriveth, no soul shall speak but by His leave; then (some) of them shall be wretched and (some) blessed. A) Ref. to the Resurrection Day. Here it is asserted that no soul shall speak without His permission. In 77:35 it is said on that day they will not be permitted to forward their excuses. In 55:39 it is said none neither men nor the jinn will be questioned. In 37:24 it is asserted they will question each other. In 41:21 it is said that they will ask their skins as to why they gave evidence against them. The answer from the skin will be that God made them speak. These and similar passages seem to be…

item.title: Hud:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوْۤا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ fa-ammā alladhīna shaqū fafī l-nāri lahum fīhā zafīrun washahīqun As for the wretched, they shall be in the Fire: their lot therein will be groaning and wailing.

item.title: Hud:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوْۤا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ fa-ammā alladhīna shaqū fafī l-nāri lahum fīhā zafīrun washahīqun As for those who were (destined to be) wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is (violent) exhaling and inhaling.1 As for those who are wretched, they will be in the Fire, in it they will experience Zafir and Shahiq (11:106). They will dwell therein for all the time that the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills. Verily, your Lord is the doer of whatsoever He intends (or wills (107) The Condition of the Wretched People and their Destination Allah, the Exalted, says: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ in it they will experience Zafir and Shahiq. Ibn 'Abbas said, "Az-Zafir is a sound in the throat and Ash-Shahiq is a sound in the chest. This means…

item.title: Hud:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوْۤا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ fa-ammā alladhīna shaqū fafī l-nāri lahum fīhā zafīrun washahīqun Then as for those who shall be wretched, they shall be in the (Hell) fire, for them therein shall be sighing and groaning. The commentators have forwarded several views as to the exact meaning and significance of these Verses. The most appropriate one is to take these verses as referring to the conditions of the two classes of the wretched and blessed not after but before the Resurrection Day. It means people will be classified into two groups on the Resurrection Day prior to it. The groups of the wretched ones are kept in hell and torture as long as the heavens and earth endure subject to God's will which means there is the possibility of their being taken out even before…

item.title: Hud:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka inna rabbaka faʿʿālun limā yurīdu They shall remain in it for as long as the heavens and the earth endure —except what your Lord may wish; indeed your Lord does whatever He desires.

item.title: Hud:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka inna rabbaka faʿʿālun limā yurīdu (They will be) abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends. See 11:106

item.title: Hud:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka inna rabbaka faʿʿālun limā yurīdu They shall abide therein so long as the heavens and the earth endure, except (as) what willeth thy Lord; Verily thy Lord is the (Mighty) Doer of what soever He willeth. See 11:106

item.title: Hud:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوْۤا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ wa-ammā alladhīna suʿidū fafī l-janati khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka ʿaṭāan ghayra majdhūdhin As for the felicitous, they will be in paradise. They will remain in it for as long as the heavens and the earth endure —except what your Lord may wish— an endless bounty.

item.title: Hud:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوْۤا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ wa-ammā alladhīna suʿidū fafī l-janati khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka ʿaṭāan ghayra majdhūdhin And as for those who were (destined to be) prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted. And those who are blessed, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein for all the time that the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills: a gift without an end (11:108). The Condition of the Happy People and their Destination Allah, the Exalted, says: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا And those who are blessed. These are the followers of the Messengers. فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ they will be in…

item.title: Hud:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوْۤا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ wa-ammā alladhīna suʿidū fafī l-janati khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka ʿaṭāan ghayra majdhūdhin And as for those who will be blessed, they shall be in the garden (of Paradise) abiding therein so long as the heavens and the earth endure, except (as) what thy Lord willeth; (it will be) A gift incessant. One of the commentators holds that the punishment after the Final Judgment will not be a permanent one. To establish this contention, he quotes this verse - interpreting 'As long as the heavens and the earth endure'. But this argument does not hold good for it will be a time when the heavens and the earth will also cease to be and it will be…

item.title: Hud:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَؤُلَاءِ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنْقُوصٍ falā taku fī mir'yatin mimmā yaʿbudu hāulāi mā yaʿbudūna illā kamā yaʿbudu ābāuhum min qablu wa-innā lamuwaffūhum naṣībahum ghayra manqūṣin So do not be in doubt about what these1 worship: they worship just as their fathers worshiped before, and We shall surely pay them their full share, undiminished.

item.title: Hud:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَؤُلَاءِ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنْقُوصٍ falā taku fī mir'yatin mimmā yaʿbudu hāulāi mā yaʿbudūna illā kamā yaʿbudu ābāuhum min qablu wa-innā lamuwaffūhum naṣībahum ghayra manqūṣin So do not be in doubt, (O Muḥammad), as to what these (polytheists) are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished. So be not in doubt as to what these people (pagans and polytheists) worship. They worship nothing but what their fathers worshipped before (them). And verily, We shall repay them in full their portion without diminution (11:109). Indeed, We gave the Book to Musa, but differences arose therein, and had it not been for a Word that had gone forth before from your Lord, the case would…

item.title: Hud:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَؤُلَاءِ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنْقُوصٍ falā taku fī mir'yatin mimmā yaʿbudu hāulāi mā yaʿbudūna illā kamā yaʿbudu ābāuhum min qablu wa-innā lamuwaffūhum naṣībahum ghayra manqūṣin Therefore be thou (The Prophet addressed for the people.) not in doubt concerning what worship these (people); they worship not but as their fathers did worship before (them); and verily We will certainly pay them back in full their (due) share without (any) rebate. See 11:108

item.title: Hud:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin Certainly We gave Moses the Book, but differences arose about it, and were it not for a prior decree of your Lord, a decision would have been made between them; indeed they are in grave doubt concerning it.

item.title: Hud:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin And We had certainly given Musa the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word1 that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning it (i.e., the Qur’ān), in disquieting doubt. See 11:109

item.title: Hud:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin And indeed gave We unto Moses the Book, (The Torah.) but variance was created in it; and had not a word (decree of respite) gone forth from thy Lord, the matter would surely have been decided between them; and verily they are in a doubt (about the Qur'an which is) disquieting (them). See 11:108

item.title: Hud:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wa-inna kullan lammā layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka aʿmālahum innahu bimā yaʿmalūna khabīrun Your Lord will indeed recompense everyone fully for their works. Indeed He is well aware of what they do.

item.title: Hud:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wa-inna kullan lammā layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka aʿmālahum innahu bimā yaʿmalūna khabīrun And indeed, each (of the believers and disbelievers) - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Aware of what they do. See 11:109

item.title: Hud:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wa-inna kullan lammā layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka aʿmālahum innahu bimā yaʿmalūna khabīrun And verily unto all will thy Lord pay back in full their recompense for all their deeds; verily He of what (all) they do is fully aware. See 11:108

item.title: Hud:112 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَمَنْ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ fa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta waman tāba maʿaka walā taṭghaw innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun So be steadfast, just as you have been commanded— [you] and whoever has turned [to Allah] with you— and do not overstep the bounds. Indeed He sees best what you do.

item.title: Hud:112 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَمَنْ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ fa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta waman tāba maʿaka walā taṭghaw innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, (you) and those who have turned back with you (to Allah), and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do. So stand (ask Allah to make) you firm and straight as you are commanded and those who turn in repentance with you, and transgress not. Verily, He is All-Seer of what you do (11:112). And incline not toward those who do wrong, lest the Fire should touch you, and you have no protectors other than Allah, nor would you then be helped (11:113). The Command to Stand Firm and Straight Allah, the Exalted, commands His Messenger and His believing servants to be…

item.title: Hud:112 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَمَنْ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ fa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta waman tāba maʿaka walā taṭghaw innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun Then stand thou fast (O' Our Apostle Muhammad) (on the Right Path) as thou art commanded (by thy Lord) and also he who hath turned (unto God) with thee, and (O' men) be ye not inordinate; Verily He (God.) (your Lord), what ever ye do, well-seeth. See 11:108

item.title: Hud:113 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوْۤا إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ walā tarkanū ilā alladhīna ẓalamū fatamassakumu l-nāru wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa thumma lā tunṣarūna And do not incline toward the wrongdoers, lest the Fire should touch you, and you will not have any friend besides Allah, then you will not be helped.

item.title: Hud:113 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوْۤا إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ walā tarkanū ilā alladhīna ẓalamū fatamassakumu l-nāru wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa thumma lā tunṣarūna And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allah any protectors; then you would not be helped. See 11:112

item.title: Hud:113 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوْۤا إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ walā tarkanū ilā alladhīna ẓalamū fatamassakumu l-nāru wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa thumma lā tunṣarūna And (ye believers) incline ye not unto those who act unjustly lest toucheth you the (Hell) fire, for you besides God there is no protector, nor shall ye be helped. It is reported from the Holy Prophet that on the Day of Judgment an announcement will be made aloud. "Where are the iniquitous and the tyrants and those who assisted them, agreed with them, and those who used their pen and ink for them. Bring them all along with the iniquitous and the tyrants."

item.title: Hud:114 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ذٰلِكَ ذِكْرٰی لِلذَّاكِرِينَ wa-aqimi l-ṣalata ṭarafayi l-nahāri wazulafan mina al-layli inna l-ḥasanāti yudh'hib'na l-sayiāti dhālika dhik'rā lildhākirīna Maintain the prayer at the two ends of the day,1 and during the early hours of the night. Indeed good deeds efface misdeeds.2 That is an admonition for the mindful.

item.title: Hud:114 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ذٰلِكَ ذِكْرٰی لِلذَّاكِرِينَ wa-aqimi l-ṣalata ṭarafayi l-nahāri wazulafan mina al-layli inna l-ḥasanāti yudh'hib'na l-sayiāti dhālika dhik'rā lildhākirīna And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember. And perform the Salah, at the two ends of the day and in some hours of the night. Verily, the good deeds remove the evil deeds. That is a reminder for the mindful (11:114). And be patient; verily, Allah wastes not the reward of the doers of good (11:115). The Command to Establish the Prayer Ali bin Abi Talhah reported that Ibn 'Abbas said: وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ And perform the Salah, at the two ends of the day "This…

item.title: Hud:114 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ذٰلِكَ ذِكْرٰی لِلذَّاكِرِينَ wa-aqimi l-ṣalata ṭarafayi l-nahāri wazulafan mina al-layli inna l-ḥasanāti yudh'hib'na l-sayiāti dhālika dhik'rā lildhākirīna And establish thou, prayer in the two ends of the day, and at the approaches of the night, Verily the good (Note the unique way Islam encourages man to good deeds with the promise to remove the evil ones in return.) deeds take away the evil deeds; This is a reminder for the (believers who are) mindful (of their Lord). This verse gives the ordinance about the five times of the prescribed daily prayers. This is another clear evidence against the fallacy in the claim of 'Hasbona kitabullah.' The Verse gives only the timings of the prayers and the details as to how they should be conducted and with what recitals of…

item.title: Hud:115 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-iṣ'bir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna And be patient; indeed Allah does not waste the reward of the virtuous.

item.title: Hud:115 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-iṣ'bir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good. See 11:114

item.title: Hud:115 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ wa-iṣ'bir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna And be thou patient, for verily God suffereth not to be lost the recompense of the righteous (ones). See 11:114

item.title: Hud:116 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُوْۤا بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّنْ أَنْجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا أُتْرِفُوْۤا فِیْهِ وَكَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ falawlā kāna mina l-qurūni min qablikum ulū baqiyyatin yanhawna ʿani l-fasādi fī l-arḍi illā qalīlan mimman anjaynā min'hum wa-ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū mā ut'rifū fīhi wakānū muj'rimīna Why were there not among the generations before you a remnant [of the wise] who might forbid corruption in the earth, except a few of those whom We delivered from among them? Those who were wrongdoers pursued that in which they had been granted affluence, and they were a guilty lot.

item.title: Hud:116 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُوْۤا بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّنْ أَنْجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا أُتْرِفُوْۤا فِیْهِ وَكَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ falawlā kāna mina l-qurūni min qablikum ulū baqiyyatin yanhawna ʿani l-fasādi fī l-arḍi illā qalīlan mimman anjaynā min'hum wa-ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū mā ut'rifū fīhi wakānū muj'rimīna So why were there not1 among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals. If only there had been among the generations before you persons having wisdom, prohibiting (others) from Fasad (corruption) in the earth, except a few of those whom We saved from among them! Those who did wrong pursued the enjoyment of good things of (this…

item.title: Hud:116 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُوْۤا بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّنْ أَنْجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا أُتْرِفُوْۤا فِیْهِ وَكَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ falawlā kāna mina l-qurūni min qablikum ulū baqiyyatin yanhawna ʿani l-fasādi fī l-arḍi illā qalīlan mimman anjaynā min'hum wa-ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū mā ut'rifū fīhi wakānū muj'rimīna But why were not there among the generations before you those endowed with understanding forbidding against mischief in the earth, except a few of those whom We delivered from among them? And pursued those who did injustice, what they were made to enjoy (of the plenty) and they were guilty. See 11:114

item.title: Hud:117 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰی بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ wamā kāna rabbuka liyuh'lika l-qurā biẓul'min wa-ahluhā muṣ'liḥūna Your Lord would never destroy the townships unjustly while their inhabitants were bringing about reform.

item.title: Hud:117 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰی بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ wamā kāna rabbuka liyuh'lika l-qurā biẓul'min wa-ahluhā muṣ'liḥūna And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers. See 11:116

item.title: Hud:117 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰی بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ wamā kāna rabbuka liyuh'lika l-qurā biẓul'min wa-ahluhā muṣ'liḥūna Nor was thy Lord (ever such) to destroy townships unjustly while its people were righteous. See 11:114

item.title: Hud:118 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ walaw shāa rabbuka lajaʿala l-nāsa ummatan wāḥidatan walā yazālūna mukh'talifīna Had your Lord wished, He would have made mankind one community; but they continue to differ,

item.title: Hud:118 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ walaw shāa rabbuka lajaʿala l-nāsa ummatan wāḥidatan walā yazālūna mukh'talifīna And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ. And if your Lord had so willed, He could surely have made mankind one Ummah, but they will not cease to disagree (11:118). Except him on whom your Lord has bestowed His mercy, and for that did He create them. And the Word of your Lord has been fulfilled (His saying): Surely, I shall fill Hell with Jinn and men all together (11:119). Allah has Not Made Faith Universally Accepted Allah, the Exalted, informs that He is able to make all of mankind one nation upon belief, or disbelief. This is just as He said: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَآمَنَ مَن…

item.title: Hud:118 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ walaw shāa rabbuka lajaʿala l-nāsa ummatan wāḥidatan walā yazālūna mukh'talifīna And had thy Lord willed He would certainly have made men a single people, but they will cease not to differ, See 11:114

item.title: Hud:119 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ illā man raḥima rabbuka walidhālika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīna except those on whom your Lord has mercy —and that is why He created them— and the word of your Lord has been fulfilled: 'I will surely fill hell with jinn and humans, all together!'1

item.title: Hud:119 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ illā man raḥima rabbuka walidhālika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīna Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together." See 11:118

item.title: Hud:119 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ illā man raḥima rabbuka walidhālika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīna Except he on whom thy Lord hath mercy; And for this did He create them; and the word (decree) of thy Lord is fulfilled; Certainly will I fill the hell with the jinn and the men, all together. This clearly indicates that God has left man to develop his native endowments at his own choice and did not force any particular way of life on man and asserts that there will always be differences save those who have submitted their limited will to God's universal will and has enjoined His blessings and mercy for which they had been created. That shows that those blessed with the mercy of God do…

item.title: Hud:120 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلًّا نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ wakullan naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāi l-rusuli mā nuthabbitu bihi fuādaka wajāaka fī hādhihi l-ḥaqu wamawʿiẓatun wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīna Whatever We relate to you of the accounts of the apostles are those by which We strengthen your heart, and there has come to you in this [sūrah] the truth and an advice and admonition for the faithful.

item.title: Hud:120 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلًّا نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ wakullan naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāi l-rusuli mā nuthabbitu bihi fuādaka wajāaka fī hādhihi l-ḥaqu wamawʿiẓatun wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīna And each (story) We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers. And all that We relate to you of the news of the Messengers is in order that We may make strong and firm your heart thereby. And in this has come to you the truth, as well as an admonition and a reminder for the believers (11:120). The Conclusion Allah, the Exalted, is saying, 'We relate all of these stories to you (Muhammad) concerning what…

item.title: Hud:120 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلًّا نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ wakullan naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāi l-rusuli mā nuthabbitu bihi fuādaka wajāaka fī hādhihi l-ḥaqu wamawʿiẓatun wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīna And all that We relate unto thee of the accounts of the apostles is to confirm with it thy heart (The conviction of the people.) ; And hath come unto thee in this the truth, and an admonition and a reminder unto the believers. The Holy Qur'an is an admonition and a reminder for the true believers in God. In 2:2 there is a similar statement saying, that the Holy Qur'an is a Guidance for the Pious and in 3:137 is said that the Holy Qur'an is a mere statement for the ordinary people but an exhortation and a guidance for the pious.

item.title: Hud:121 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ waqul lilladhīna lā yu'minūna iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innā ʿāmilūna And say to those who do not have faith, 'Act according to your ability; we too are acting.

item.title: Hud:121 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ waqul lilladhīna lā yu'minūna iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innā ʿāmilūna And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working. And say to those who do not believe: Act according to your ability and way, We are acting (11:121). And you wait! We (too) are waiting (11:122). Allah, the Exalted, commands His Messenger SAW to say to those who disbelieve in what he has come with from his lord, by way of warning. اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ Act according to your ability This means upon your path and your way. إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ We are acting (in our way). This means that we are upon our path and our way (Islam). وَانتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ And you wait! We (too) are waiting. This means: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن تَكُونُ…

item.title: Hud:121 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقُلْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ waqul lilladhīna lā yu'minūna iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innā ʿāmilūna And say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) unto those who believe not; "Act (ye) whatever ye can: and verily we (too) do act." See 11:120

item.title: Hud:122 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَانْتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُونَ wa-intaẓirū innā muntaẓirūna And wait! We too are waiting.'

item.title: Hud:122 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَانْتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُونَ wa-intaẓirū innā muntaẓirūna And wait; indeed, we are waiting." See 11:121

item.title: Hud:122 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَانْتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُونَ wa-intaẓirū innā muntaẓirūna And wait ye! and verily we too do wait. See 11:120

item.title: Hud:123 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilayhi yur'jaʿu l-amru kulluhu fa-uʿ'bud'hu watawakkal ʿalayhi wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna To Allah belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and to Him all matters are returned. So worship Him and trust in Him. Your Lord is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: Hud:123 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilayhi yur'jaʿu l-amru kulluhu fa-uʿ'bud'hu watawakkal ʿalayhi wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna And to Allah belong the unseen (aspects) of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do. And to Allah belongs the Ghayb of the heavens and the earth, and to Him return all affairs (for decision). So worship Him and put your trust in Him. And your Lord is not unaware of what you (people) do (11:123). Allah, the Exalted, informs that He is the All-Knower of the unseen of the heavens and the earth and that unto Him is final return.…

item.title: Hud:123 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilayhi yur'jaʿu l-amru kulluhu fa-uʿ'bud'hu watawakkal ʿalayhi wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna And God's is the unseen (worlds) of the heavens and the earth, and unto Him (only) is returned the whole of the affair, so worship thou (Address to the people through the Prophet.) (only) Him and rely thou (Address to the people through the Prophet.) (only) on Him; and thy Lord is not heedless of whatever ye do. See 11:120

item.title: Ibrahim:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الر كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ alif-lam-ra kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka litukh'rija l-nāsa mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'ni rabbihim ilā ṣirāṭi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book We have sent down to you that you may bring mankind out from darkness into light, by the command of their Lord, to the path of the All-mighty, the All-laudable

item.title: Ibrahim:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الر كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ alif-lam-ra kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka litukh'rija l-nāsa mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'ni rabbihim ilā ṣirāṭi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi Alif, Lām, Rā.1 (This is) a Book which We have revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy. اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth! Which is is similar to: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ Say: "O mankind! Verily, I am sent to you all as the Messenger of Allah - to Whom belongs the dominion…

item.title: Ibrahim:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الر كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ alif-lam-ra kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka litukh'rija l-nāsa mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'ni rabbihim ilā ṣirāṭi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi Alif, Lam, Ra, (A. L. R.) A Book (the Qur'an) (We) sent it down unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad) that thou mayest lead out men from the darkness into the light, by their Lord's permission, unto the way of the Mighty, the (Most) Praised (One), Alif Lam Ra (A. L. R.)1 'Anzalnahu-ilaik', i.e., We have sent it unto thee - indicates that the Holy Qur'an came down from the High in a Complete Book form2 and was not edited or compiled here on earth by anyone. The object of the revelation of the Book is given to be, to take out mankind from the darkness of ignorance…

item.title: Ibrahim:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ al-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wawaylun lil'kāfirīna min ʿadhābin shadīdin —Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe to the faithless for a severe punishment

item.title: Ibrahim:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
