item.description: وَأَنْذِرِ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ الْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا رَبَّنَا أَخِّرْنَا إِلَى أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا أَقْسَمْتُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ زَوَالٍ wa-andhiri l-nāsa yawma yatīhimu l-ʿadhābu fayaqūlu alladhīna ẓalamū rabbanā akhir'nā ilā ajalin qarībin nujib daʿwataka wanattabiʿi l-rusula awalam takūnū aqsamtum min qablu mā lakum min zawālin And warn thou the people, of the day when shall come unto them the chastisement, then will say those who did injustice "O' Our Lord! respite us yet for a short term, (that) we may respond unto Thy call and follow the apostles." What! Were ye not wont to swear aforetime that there will not be for you any decline, (Pass away.) See 14:42

item.title: Ibrahim:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَكَنْتُمْ فِي مَسَاكِنِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْأَمْثَالَ wasakantum fī masākini alladhīna ẓalamū anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faʿalnā bihim waḍarabnā lakumu l-amthāla while you dwelt in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves [before], and it had been made clear to you how We had dealt with them [before you], and We had [also] cited examples for you?'

item.title: Ibrahim:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَكَنْتُمْ فِي مَسَاكِنِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْأَمْثَالَ wasakantum fī masākini alladhīna ẓalamū anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faʿalnā bihim waḍarabnā lakumu l-amthāla And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you (many) examples." See 14:44

item.title: Ibrahim:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَكَنْتُمْ فِي مَسَاكِنِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْأَمْثَالَ wasakantum fī masākini alladhīna ẓalamū anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faʿalnā bihim waḍarabnā lakumu l-amthāla And ye dwelt in the abodes of those who did injustice unto themselves, and it was made clear unto you how We dealt with them and We have set forth examples for you. See 14:42

item.title: Ibrahim:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ waqad makarū makrahum waʿinda l-lahi makruhum wa-in kāna makruhum litazūla min'hu l-jibālu They certainly devised their schemes, but their schemes are known to Allah, and their schemes are not such as to dislodge the mountains.1

item.title: Ibrahim:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ waqad makarū makrahum waʿinda l-lahi makruhum wa-in kāna makruhum litazūla min'hu l-jibālu And they had planned their plan, but with Allah is (recorded) their plan, even if their plan had been (sufficient) to do away with the mountains.1 See 14:44

item.title: Ibrahim:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ waqad makarū makrahum waʿinda l-lahi makruhum wa-in kāna makruhum litazūla min'hu l-jibālu And indeed they did devise their plots, but (all) within the view of God were their plots even though their plot was such (powerful one) as to move thereby mountains. The comparison to the passing away of the mountains indicates the intensive power with which the disbelievers employed their plans. Islam and the 'Shariat', i.e., the Laws of Islam, are compared to mountains. It is prophecy about the permanence or the firm establishment of the faith, Islam, and its laws remaining ever unchanged as the mountains, the complete unshakable triumph and establishment of Islam and the teachings of the Holy Prophet, for they are divinely secured in the Holy Ahl al-Bayt to remain with them for…

item.title: Ibrahim:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ falā taḥsabanna l-laha mukh'lifa waʿdihi rusulahu inna l-laha ʿazīzun dhū intiqāmin So do not suppose that Allah will break His promise to His apostles. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, avenger.

item.title: Ibrahim:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ falā taḥsabanna l-laha mukh'lifa waʿdihi rusulahu inna l-laha ʿazīzun dhū intiqāmin So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.1 So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His Messengers. Certainly, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Able of Retribution (14:47). On the Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will be the heavens, and they (all creatures) will appear before Allah, the One, the Irresistible (14:48). Allah Never Breaks a Promise Allah affirms His promise: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His Messengers. His promise to grant them victory in this life and on the Day…

item.title: Ibrahim:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ falā taḥsabanna l-laha mukh'lifa waʿdihi rusulahu inna l-laha ʿazīzun dhū intiqāmin And (God will never cease helping whom He has Himself sent Commissioned by Him for the guidance of the people - viz the Apostles and the Imams.) think ye not that God will fail His apostles in His promise; Verily God is Mighty, the Lord of Retribution. See 14:46

item.title: Ibrahim:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ وَبَرَزُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ yawma tubaddalu l-arḍu ghayra l-arḍi wal-samāwātu wabarazū lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri The day the earth is transformed into another earth and the heavens [as well], and they are presented before Allah, the One, the All-paramount.

item.title: Ibrahim:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ وَبَرَزُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ yawma tubaddalu l-arḍu ghayra l-arḍi wal-samāwātu wabarazū lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri (It will be) on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens (as well), and they (i.e., all creatures) will come out before Allah, the One, the Prevailing. See 14:47

item.title: Ibrahim:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ وَبَرَزُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ yawma tubaddalu l-arḍu ghayra l-arḍi wal-samāwātu wabarazū lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri On the day when the earth shall be changed into a different (Refer to verses 21:104 & 39:67.) earth, and (so will be) the heavens (too), and (all men) shall be marshalled forth unto God the One, the Dominant. Some commentators say the changing of this earth stands for the great change of the trans formation brought to effect by Islam which swept away all false beliefs and wickedness. But the Holy Imams say that this earth will be utterly changed into a totally new one.1 A thorough study of the verses referred to, supported by several authentic traditions of different tones, leaves no room for any doubt that the present earth and heavens in their evolutionary course of movement,…

item.title: Ibrahim:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ watarā l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi On that day you will see the guilty bound together in chains,

item.title: Ibrahim:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ watarā l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in irons. And you will see the criminals that Day, Muqarranun (bound together) in fetters (14:49). Their garments will be of Qatiran (tar), and fire will cover their faces (14:50). That Allah may requite each person according to what he has earned. Truly, Allah is swift at reckoning (14:51). The Condition of the Criminals on the Day of Resurrection Allah said: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ On the Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will be the heavens 'and the creations will be brought before their Lord, and you, O Muhammad, will witness the criminals who committed the crimes of Kufr and mischief,' مُّقَرَّنِينَ Muqarranin bound together, each with his or…

item.title: Ibrahim:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَرٰی الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ watarā l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi And thou wilt see the guilty (ones) on that day bound together in chains. See 14:48

item.title: Ibrahim:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَرَابِيلُهُمْ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشٰی وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ sarābīluhum min qaṭirānin wataghshā wujūhahumu l-nāru their garments made of pitch,1 and the Fire covering their faces,

item.title: Ibrahim:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَرَابِيلُهُمْ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشٰی وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ sarābīluhum min qaṭirānin wataghshā wujūhahumu l-nāru Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire. See 14:49

item.title: Ibrahim:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَرَابِيلُهُمْ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشٰی وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ sarābīluhum min qaṭirānin wataghshā wujūhahumu l-nāru Their garments (shall be) of pitch and their faces covered with fire, See 14:48

item.title: Ibrahim:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ liyajziya l-lahu kulla nafsin mā kasabat inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi so that Allah may reward every soul for what it has earned.1 Indeed Allah is swift at reckoning.

item.title: Ibrahim:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ liyajziya l-lahu kulla nafsin mā kasabat inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account. See 14:49

item.title: Ibrahim:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ liyajziya l-lahu kulla nafsin mā kasabat inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi That God may recompense each soul (as) what it hath earned; Verily God is swift in reckoning. See 14:48

item.title: Ibrahim:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا بَلَاغٌ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنْذَرُوا بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ hādhā balāghun lilnnāsi waliyundharū bihi waliyaʿlamū annamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun waliyadhakkara ulū l-albābi This is a proclamation for mankind, so that they may be warned thereby and know that He is indeed the One God, and those who possess intellect may take admonition.

item.title: Ibrahim:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا بَلَاغٌ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنْذَرُوا بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ hādhā balāghun lilnnāsi waliyundharū bihi waliyaʿlamū annamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun waliyadhakkara ulū l-albābi This (Qur’ān) is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded. This (Qur'an) is a Message for mankind (and a clear proof against them), in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is the only One God and that men of understanding may take heed (14:52). Allah states that this Qur'an is a Message for mankind. لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِ وَمَن بَلَغَ (So) that I may therewith warn you and whomsoever it may reach. (6:19) This Qur'an is for all mankind and the Jinns, just as Allah said…

item.title: Ibrahim:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا بَلَاغٌ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنْذَرُوا بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ hādhā balāghun lilnnāsi waliyundharū bihi waliyaʿlamū annamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun waliyadhakkara ulū l-albābi This is a clear message for the mankind and that they may be warned by it, that they may know that He is God, (the only) One and that the men of understanding may mind. See 14:48

item.title: Luqman:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lām, Mīm.

item.title: Luqman:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lām, Meem.1

item.title: Luqman:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الم alif-lam-meem Alif, Lam, Meem. (A. L. M.) (Refer to note on verse 2:1.) See 31:2

item.title: Luqman:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīmi These are the signs of the Definitive Book,

item.title: Luqman:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīmi These are verses of the wise1 Book. See 31:1

item.title: Luqman:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīmi These are the verses of the Book (The Wise Book.) of wisdom, The Holy Qur'an is termed as the Book of Wisdom for it contains factors of the highest knowledge which a mortal of any standard of intellect, from the average to the maximum degree, can possibly bear and which is sufficient for man to raise himself from the abyss of material degradation to the sublime heights of heavenly grace and eternal bliss.

item.title: Luqman:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ hudan waraḥmatan lil'muḥ'sinīna a guidance and mercy for the virtuous,

item.title: Luqman:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ hudan waraḥmatan lil'muḥ'sinīna As guidance and mercy for the doers of good. See 31:1

item.title: Luqman:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ hudan waraḥmatan lil'muḥ'sinīna A guidance and a mercy unto the righteous ones, The Holy Qur'an is a guidance from God and God's mercy - for those who are after achieving goodness in their life on earth. Those who wish goodness for themselves and for others, loving the good (Tawallah) and discarding the evil (Tabarra). This quality, in other words, is 'Taqwa', i.e., piety and those who possess it, the 'Muttaqin', the pious ones.1

item.title: Luqman:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūna who maintain the prayer, and pay the zakāt, and are certain of the Hereafter.

item.title: Luqman:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūna Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain (in faith). See 31:1

item.title: Luqman:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūna Those who establish prayer and pay the poor-rate, and they, of the hereafter are certain; See 31:3

item.title: Luqman:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ عَلَى هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ulāika ʿalā hudan min rabbihim wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Those follow their Lord's guidance, and it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: Luqman:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ عَلَى هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ulāika ʿalā hudan min rabbihim wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna Those are on (right) guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful. See 31:1

item.title: Luqman:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ عَلَى هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ulāika ʿalā hudan min rabbihim wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna These are on the guidance from their Lord, and these are they who are successful. See 31:3

item.title: Luqman:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ wamina l-nāsi man yashtarī lahwa l-ḥadīthi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattakhidhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun Among the people is he who buys diversionary talk that he may lead [people] astray from Allah's way without any knowledge, and he takes it in derision. For such there is a humiliating punishment.

item.title: Luqman:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ wamina l-nāsi man yashtarī lahwa l-ḥadīthi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattakhidhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech1 to mislead (others) from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it (i.e., His way) in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment. And of mankind is he who purchases idle talk (Lahw Al-Hadith) to mislead from the path of Allah without knowledge, and takes it by way of mockery. For such there will be a humiliating torment (31:6). And when Our Ayat are recited to such a one, he turns away in pride, as if he heard them not – as if there were deafness in his ear. So…

item.title: Luqman:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ wamina l-nāsi man yashtarī lahwa l-ḥadīthi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattakhidhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun And of the people there is he who buyeth for a vain story, that he may lead (others) astray from the path of God without knowledge; and taketh it (The right path.) (the revelation from God) for a mockery; for these shall be a disgracing chastisement. Nusr ibn Harith had been to Syria for trade and having got from there, some stories of the Persian heroes, recited the legends to the assemblies of the Quraysh in Mecca with attention of the people from listening to the recitation of the Qur'an. This verse was revealed. 'Lahw', i.e., anything which engages one's mind from serious thinking.…

item.title: Luqman:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا وَلَّى مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā wallā mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā ka-anna fī udhunayhi waqran fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin And when Our signs are recited to him he turns away disdainfully as if he had not heard them [at all], as if there were a deafness in his ears. So inform him of a painful punishment.

item.title: Luqman:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا وَلَّى مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā wallā mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā ka-anna fī udhunayhi waqran fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment. See 31:6

item.title: Luqman:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا وَلَّى مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā wallā mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā ka-anna fī udhunayhi waqran fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin And when are recited unto him Our signs, he turneth back proudly as if he had heard them not, as though in his ears were a heaviness; so give thou unto him the tidings of a painful chastisement. See 31:6

item.title: Luqman:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātu l-naʿīmi As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, for them will be gardens of bliss,

item.title: Luqman:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātu l-naʿīmi Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure. Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them are Gardens of Delight (31:8). To abide therein. It is a promise of Allah in truth. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise (31:9). The Good Destiny of the Believers Here Allah mentions the destiny of the righteous in the Hereafter, those who believe in Allah and His Messenger SAW and do righteous deeds in accordance with the Laws of Allah. لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ for them are Gardens of Delight. means, there they will enjoy all kinds of delights and pleasures, food, drink, clothing, dwelling-places, means of transportation, women, a light of beauty and delightful sounds, which…

item.title: Luqman:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātu l-naʿīmi Verily those who believe and do good, for them are the gardens bountiful, (Blissful.) See 31:6

item.title: Luqman:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ khālidīna fīhā waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu to remain in them [forever] —a true promise of Allah, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: Luqman:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ khālidīna fīhā waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Wherein they abide eternally; (it is) the promise of Allah (which is) truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 31:8

item.title: Luqman:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ khālidīna fīhā waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu To dwell therein; It is the promise of God, (a) true (promise); and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. See 31:6

item.title: Luqman:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا وَأَلْقَى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ khalaqa l-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wabatha fīhā min kulli dābbatin wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin He created the heavens without any pillars that you may see, and cast firm mountains in the earth lest it should shake with you, and He has scattered in it every kind of animal. And We sent down water from the sky and caused every splendid kind [of plant] to grow in it.

item.title: Luqman:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا وَأَلْقَى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ khalaqa l-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wabatha fīhā min kulli dābbatin wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein (plants) of every noble kind. He has created the heavens without any pillars that you see, and has set on the earth firm mountains lest it should shake with you. And He has scattered therein moving creatures of all kinds. And We send down…

item.title: Luqman:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا وَأَلْقَى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ khalaqa l-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wabatha fīhā min kulli dābbatin wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin Created He the heavens without pillars as ye can see them, and He did cast mountains upon the earth lest it shaketh with you, and He hath spread in it of every kind of animals; and We sent down water from the heaven, then caused We to grow up therein (vegetables) of every noble (Beautiful.) kind. There is no doubt that the heavenly bodies are standing and they are not independent in this stand of theirs as it has been proved that every dimensional being is…

item.title: Luqman:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ بَلِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ hādhā khalqu l-lahi fa-arūnī mādhā khalaqa alladhīna min dūnihi bali l-ẓālimūna fī ḍalālin mubīnin This is the creation of Allah. Now show Me what others besides Him have created. Rather the wrongdoers are in manifest error!

item.title: Luqman:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ بَلِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ hādhā khalqu l-lahi fa-arūnī mādhā khalaqa alladhīna min dūnihi bali l-ẓālimūna fī ḍalālin mubīnin This is the creation of Allah. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error. See 31:10

item.title: Luqman:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ بَلِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ hādhā khalqu l-lahi fa-arūnī mādhā khalaqa alladhīna min dūnihi bali l-ẓālimūna fī ḍalālin mubīnin This is the creation of God, Show me what those besides Him have created. Nay! The unjust are in a manifest straying. See 31:10

item.title: Luqman:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ وَمَنْ يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ walaqad ātaynā luq'māna l-ḥik'mata ani ush'kur lillahi waman yashkur fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ḥamīdun Certainly We gave Luqman wisdom, saying, 'Give thanks to Allah; and whoever gives thanks, gives thanks only for his own sake. And whoever is ungrateful, [let him know that] Allah is indeed all-sufficient, all-laudable.'

item.title: Luqman:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ وَمَنْ يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ walaqad ātaynā luq'māna l-ḥik'mata ani ush'kur lillahi waman yashkur fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ḥamīdun And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom (and said), "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for (the benefit of) himself. And whoever denies (His favor) - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy. And indeed We bestowed upon Luqman Al-Hikmah saying: "Give thanks to Allah." And whoever gives thanks, he gives thanks for (the good of) himself. And whoever is unthankful, then verily, Allah is All-Rich, Worthy of all praise (31:12). Luqman The Salaf differed over the identity of Luqman; there are two opinions: was he a Prophet or just a righteous servant of Allah without the prophethood?…

item.title: Luqman:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ وَمَنْ يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ walaqad ātaynā luq'māna l-ḥik'mata ani ush'kur lillahi waman yashkur fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ḥamīdun And indeed gave We to Luqman wisdom saying: "Be thou grateful to God; for whoever is grateful, verily he is only grateful for his own self; and whoever is ungrateful, (it is to the discredit of his own self) then verily God is Self-Sufficient, the Most Praised." Luqman is said to have been not an apostle of God, but the one blessed with an extraordinary or a special endowment of wisdom. He was the nephew of Ayyub (Job) and had lived for a thousand years from the time of David (Dawud) to the time of Jonah (Yunus). Once when Luqman was asleep the angels…

item.title: Luqman:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَابُنَيَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ wa-idh qāla luq'mānu li-ib'nihi wahuwa yaʿiẓuhu yābunayya lā tush'rik bil-lahi inna l-shir'ka laẓul'mun ʿaẓīmun When Luqman said to his son, as he advised him: 'O my son! Do not ascribe any partners to Allah. Polytheism is indeed a great injustice.'

item.title: Luqman:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَابُنَيَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ wa-idh qāla luq'mānu li-ib'nihi wahuwa yaʿiẓuhu yābunayya lā tush'rik bil-lahi inna l-shir'ka laẓul'mun ʿaẓīmun And (mention, O Muḥammad), when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate (anything) with Allah. Indeed, association (with Him) is great injustice." And when Luqman said to his son when he was advising him: O my son! Join not in worship others with Allah. Verily, joining others in worship with Allah is a great Zulm (wrong) indeed (31:13). And We have enjoined on man (to be dutiful and good) to his parents. His mother bore him in weakness and hardship upon weakness and hardship, and his weaning is in two years – give thanks to Me and to your parents. Unto Me is…

item.title: Luqman:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَابُنَيَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ wa-idh qāla luq'mānu li-ib'nihi wahuwa yaʿiẓuhu yābunayya lā tush'rik bil-lahi inna l-shir'ka laẓul'mun ʿaẓīmun And when said Luqman unto his son, while he was exhorting unto him: "O' my son! (O' my child!) associate not aught with God for verily (In authority.) associating (aught) with God is the greatest iniquity." It is said that one of his wives and some of his sons were disbelievers and Luqman preached to them the faith in God and ultimately, they embraced Islam. Note that polytheism is called 'Zulman-Azim' - the Greatest Iniquity. It needs to reflect by implying this to the promise of God to Abraham1 wherein God says that 'Imamah', i.e., the office of a Divinely Commissioned Guide (Religious leadership) is a Covenant of God, which shall not…

item.title: Luqman:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَى وَهْنٍ وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥamalathu ummuhu wahnan ʿalā wahnin wafiṣāluhu fī ʿāmayni ani ush'kur lī waliwālidayka ilayya l-maṣīru We have enjoined man concerning his parents: His mother carried him through weakness upon weakness, and his weaning takes two years. Give thanks to Me and to your parents. To Me is the return.

item.title: Luqman:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَى وَهْنٍ وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥamalathu ummuhu wahnan ʿalā wahnin wafiṣāluhu fī ʿāmayni ani ush'kur lī waliwālidayka ilayya l-maṣīru And We have enjoined upon man (care) for his parents. His mother carried him, (increasing her) in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the (final) destination. See 31:13

item.title: Luqman:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَى وَهْنٍ وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥamalathu ummuhu wahnan ʿalā wahnin wafiṣāluhu fī ʿāmayni ani ush'kur lī waliwālidayka ilayya l-maṣīru And We did enjoin upon man concerning his parents; beareth him his mother in weakness upon weakness and his weaning taketh two years (and) saying: "Be thou grateful unto Me and unto thy parents; (and remember thou that) unto Me is the ultimate return (of all)," Obedience to parents is enjoined as the prescribed duty of the issues excepting when it is against God and the issue is enjoined against the correct belief in Him. Subject to this proviso, duty to the parents has been made subordinate or next to one's duty to God. The last clause asserts that thanking God is more important than thanking…

item.title: Luqman:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wa-in jāhadāka ʿalā an tush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā waṣāḥib'humā fī l-dun'yā maʿrūfan wa-ittabiʿ sabīla man anāba ilayya thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna But if they urge you to ascribe to Me as partner that of which you have no knowledge, then do not obey them. Keep their company honourably in this world and follow the way of him who turns to Me penitently. Then to Me will be your return, whereat I will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: Luqman:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wa-in jāhadāka ʿalā an tush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā waṣāḥib'humā fī l-dun'yā maʿrūfan wa-ittabiʿ sabīla man anāba ilayya thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge,1 do not obey them but accompany them in (this) world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me (in repentance). Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do. See 31:13

item.title: Luqman:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ wa-in jāhadāka ʿalā an tush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā waṣāḥib'humā fī l-dun'yā maʿrūfan wa-ittabiʿ sabīla man anāba ilayya thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna And if they contend with thee that thou should associate (In authority.) with Me what thou hast no knowledge of, (then thou) obey them not, and consort kindly, (Reputably.) with them in the world, and follow thou the path of him who turneth (repentant) unto Me; then unto Me is the return of ye (all), and then will I inform you of what ye were doing. This is a clear order not to follow the parents who are not on the right…

item.title: Luqman:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابُنَيَّ إِنَّهَا إِنْ تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُنْ فِي صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَوْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ yābunayya innahā in taku mith'qāla ḥabbatin min khardalin fatakun fī ṣakhratin aw fī l-samāwāti aw fī l-arḍi yati bihā l-lahu inna l-laha laṭīfun khabīrun 'O my son! Even if it should be the weight of a mustard seed, and [even though] it should be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will produce it. Indeed Allah is all-attentive, all-aware.

item.title: Luqman:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابُنَيَّ إِنَّهَا إِنْ تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُنْ فِي صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَوْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ yābunayya innahā in taku mith'qāla ḥabbatin min khardalin fatakun fī ṣakhratin aw fī l-samāwāti aw fī l-arḍi yati bihā l-lahu inna l-laha laṭīfun khabīrun (And Luqmān said), "O my son, indeed if it (i.e., a wrong) should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or (anywhere) in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle1 and Aware. "O my son! If it be (anything) equal to the weight of a grain of mustard seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens or on the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Verily, Allah is Subtle, Well-Aware (31:16). "O my son!…

item.title: Luqman:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابُنَيَّ إِنَّهَا إِنْ تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُنْ فِي صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَوْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ yābunayya innahā in taku mith'qāla ḥabbatin min khardalin fatakun fī ṣakhratin aw fī l-samāwāti aw fī l-arḍi yati bihā l-lahu inna l-laha laṭīfun khabīrun O' my son! Verily if it is even the very weight of the grain of a mustard seed (closed) in (even) a rock, or (be it high above) in the heavens or (buried deep) in the earth, God will bring it (forth) to light; (for) verily God is All-Subtle, (Ar. Latif.) All- Aware. Refers to the Total Resurrection when everything will be resurrected and that nothing will escape the attention of the All-Pervading Omniscient God. (A.P.).

item.title: Luqman:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ yābunayya aqimi l-ṣalata wamur bil-maʿrūfi wa-in'ha ʿani l-munkari wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā aṣābaka inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūri O my son! Maintain the prayer and bid what is right and forbid what is wrong, and be patient through whatever may visit you. That is indeed the steadiest of courses.

item.title: Luqman:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ yābunayya aqimi l-ṣalata wamur bil-maʿrūfi wa-in'ha ʿani l-munkari wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā aṣābaka inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūri O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, (all) that is of the matters (requiring) resolve.1 See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ yābunayya aqimi l-ṣalata wamur bil-maʿrūfi wa-in'ha ʿani l-munkari wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā aṣābaka inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūri O' my son! establish prayer and enjoin the good and forbid the evil, and be patient against what befalleth thee; verily this is the task of steadfastness See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ walā tuṣaʿʿir khaddaka lilnnāsi walā tamshi fī l-arḍi maraḥan inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin Do not turn your cheek disdainfully from the people, and do not walk exultantly on the earth. Indeed Allah does not like any swaggering braggart.

item.title: Luqman:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ walā tuṣaʿʿir khaddaka lilnnāsi walā tamshi fī l-arḍi maraḥan inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin And do not turn your cheek (in contempt) toward people1 and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful. See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ walā tuṣaʿʿir khaddaka lilnnāsi walā tamshi fī l-arḍi maraḥan inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin And turn not thy face at people (in scorn) and walk not in the earth exulting; verily God loveth not any self-conceited boaster See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاقْصِدْ فِي مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ إِنَّ أَنْكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ wa-iq'ṣid fī mashyika wa-ugh'ḍuḍ min ṣawtika inna ankara l-aṣwāti laṣawtu l-ḥamīri Be modest in your bearing, and lower your voice. Indeed the ungainliest of voices is the donkey's voice.'

item.title: Luqman:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاقْصِدْ فِي مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ إِنَّ أَنْكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ wa-iq'ṣid fī mashyika wa-ugh'ḍuḍ min ṣawtika inna ankara l-aṣwāti laṣawtu l-ḥamīri And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys." See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاقْصِدْ فِي مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ إِنَّ أَنْكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ wa-iq'ṣid fī mashyika wa-ugh'ḍuḍ min ṣawtika inna ankara l-aṣwāti laṣawtu l-ḥamīri And be moderate (Modest.) (in thy movement) (Gait.) and lower thy voice: Note the degree of humility Islam enjoins upon its adherents verily the most unpleasant of voices is the braying of the asses. See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ alam taraw anna l-laha sakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-asbagha ʿalaykum niʿamahu ẓāhiratan wabāṭinatan wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīrin Do you not see that Allah has disposed for you whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth and He has showered upon you His blessings, the outward and the inward? Yet among the people are those who dispute concerning Allah without any knowledge or guidance or an illuminating scripture.

item.title: Luqman:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ alam taraw anna l-laha sakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-asbagha ʿalaykum niʿamahu ẓāhiratan wabāṭinatan wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīrin Do you not see that Allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, (both) apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book (from Him). See you not that Allah has subjected for you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth, and has completed and perfected His graces…

item.title: Luqman:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ alam taraw anna l-laha sakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-asbagha ʿalaykum niʿamahu ẓāhiratan wabāṭinatan wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīrin What! See ye not that God hath made subservient unto you what is in the heavens and what is in the earth, and completed (Refer to note on verses 5:3 & 5:67.) on you His bounties (both) apparently (Outwardly.) and (Inwardly.) hidden? yet among the people is he who disputeth concerning God without knowledge and without any guidance and without any book illuminating. See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوْۤا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوْا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَنَا أَوَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittabiʿū mā anzala l-lahu qālū bal nattabiʿu mā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā awalaw kāna l-shayṭānu yadʿūhum ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīri When they are told, 'Follow what Allah has sent down,' they say, 'We will rather follow what we found our fathers following.' What! Even if Satan be calling them to the punishment of the Blaze?

item.title: Luqman:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوْۤا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوْا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَنَا أَوَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittabiʿū mā anzala l-lahu qālū bal nattabiʿu mā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā awalaw kāna l-shayṭānu yadʿūhum ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīri And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze? See 31:20

item.title: Luqman:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوْۤا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوْا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَنَا أَوَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittabiʿū mā anzala l-lahu qālū bal nattabiʿu mā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā awalaw kāna l-shayṭānu yadʿūhum ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīri And when it is said unto them, "Follow ye what God hath sent down," say they, "Nay! follow we that on which found we our fathers"; (Or ancestors.) What! (would they do it) even if it be Satan beckoning them unto the chastisement of the blazing fire! See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى وَإِلَى اللَّهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ waman yus'lim wajhahu ilā l-lahi wahuwa muḥ'sinun faqadi is'tamsaka bil-ʿur'wati l-wuth'qā wa-ilā l-lahi ʿāqibatu l-umūri Whoever surrenders his heart to Allah and is virtuous, has certainly held fast to the firmest handle, and with Allah lies the outcome of all matters.

item.title: Luqman:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى وَإِلَى اللَّهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ waman yus'lim wajhahu ilā l-lahi wahuwa muḥ'sinun faqadi is'tamsaka bil-ʿur'wati l-wuth'qā wa-ilā l-lahi ʿāqibatu l-umūri And whoever submits his face (i.e., self) to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of (all) matters. And whosoever submits his face (himself) to Allah, while he is a Muhsin, then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah return all matters for decision (31:22). And whoever disbelieves, let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We shall inform them what they have done. Verily, Allah is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (31:23). We let them enjoy for a little while, then in…

item.title: Luqman:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى وَإِلَى اللَّهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ waman yus'lim wajhahu ilā l-lahi wahuwa muḥ'sinun faqadi is'tamsaka bil-ʿur'wati l-wuth'qā wa-ilā l-lahi ʿāqibatu l-umūri And whosoever setteth his face (submitting himself) unto God, and he be a doer of good, then indeed hath (he) laid hold on a firmest hand-hold (Handle or a Rope.) (a rope); and unto God is the end of all affairs. See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ كُفْرُهُ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ waman kafara falā yaḥzunka kuf'ruhu ilaynā marjiʿuhum fanunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri As for those who are faithless, let their faithlessness not grieve you. To Us will be their return, and We will inform them about what they have done. Indeed Allah knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: Luqman:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ كُفْرُهُ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ waman kafara falā yaḥzunka kuf'ruhu ilaynā marjiʿuhum fanunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 31:22

item.title: Luqman:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ كُفْرُهُ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ waman kafara falā yaḥzunka kuf'ruhu ilaynā marjiʿuhum fanunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri And whoever disbelieveth, let not his disbelief grieve (Compare this compassion to Noah, Moses and Jesus cursing the disbelievers. Refer to note on verse 71:26.) thee; unto Us is their return, then will We inform them of what they did; verily God well-knoweth what is in their breasts. See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَى عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ numattiʿuhum qalīlan thumma naḍṭarruhum ilā ʿadhābin ghalīẓin We will provide for them for a short time, then We will shove them toward a harsh punishment.

item.title: Luqman:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَى عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ numattiʿuhum qalīlan thumma naḍṭarruhum ilā ʿadhābin ghalīẓin We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment. See 31:22

item.title: Luqman:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَى عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ numattiʿuhum qalīlan thumma naḍṭarruhum ilā ʿadhābin ghalīẓin We provide them to enjoy a little, then will We drive them to a severe chastisement. See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna If you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will surely say, 'Allah.' Say, 'All praise belongs to Allah!' Yet most of them do not know.

item.title: Luqman:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "(All) praise is (due) to Allah"; but most of them do not know. And if you ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth," they will certainly say: "Allah." Say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah!" But most of them know not (31:25). To Allah belongs whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. Verily, Allah, He is Al-Ghani, Worthy of all praise (31:26). The Idolators Admitted that Allah is the Creator Allah tells us that these idolators who associated others with Him admitted that Allah Alone, with no…

item.title: Luqman:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna And if thou askest them "Who created the heavens and the earth?" certainly will they say: "God." Say thou: "(all) praise is God's;" "Nay! most of them know not." See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: Luqman:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy. See 31:25

item.title: Luqman:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu God's is whatever is in the heavens and the earth; verily God is the Self-Sufficient, (Ar. Ghani.) the Most Praised. (Ar. Hameed.) See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَامٌ وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ walaw annamā fī l-arḍi min shajaratin aqlāmun wal-baḥru yamudduhu min baʿdihi sabʿatu abḥurin mā nafidat kalimātu l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun If all the trees on the earth were pens, and the sea replenished with seven more seas [were ink], the words of Allah would not be spent. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: Luqman:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَامٌ وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ walaw annamā fī l-arḍi min shajaratin aqlāmun wal-baḥru yamudduhu min baʿdihi sabʿatu abḥurin mā nafidat kalimātu l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea (was ink), replenished thereafter by seven (more) seas, the words1 of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise. And if all the trees on the earth were pens and the sea, with seven seas behind it to add to it, yet the Words of Allah would not be exhausted. Verily, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise (31:27). The creation of you all and the resurrection of you all are only as a single person. Verily, Allah is All-Hearer, All-Seer (31:28). The Words…

item.title: Luqman:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَامٌ وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ walaw annamā fī l-arḍi min shajaratin aqlāmun wal-baḥru yamudduhu min baʿdihi sabʿatu abḥurin mā nafidat kalimātu l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmun And if it were that all the trees in the earth be pens, and the sea added to seven (more) seas (be ink), (yet) will exhaust not the words (Concerning Creation as well as legislation.) of God; Verily God is All-Mighty, All-Wise. See 31:16

item.title: Luqman:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ mā khalqukum walā baʿthukum illā kanafsin wāḥidatin inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun Your creation and your resurrection are not but as of a single soul. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: Luqman:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ mā khalqukum walā baʿthukum illā kanafsin wāḥidatin inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul.1 Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing. See 31:27

item.title: Luqman:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ mā khalqukum walā baʿthukum illā kanafsin wāḥidatin inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun Neither your creation nor your raising (after your death) is anything but as a single soul: Verily God is All-Hearing, All- Seeing. The passage may mean that the creation and the resurrection of the whole, is as easy as is the creation and the resurrection or the procedure of the creation and the resurrection of the whole, is the same. the procedure of the creation and the resurrection of the whole, is the Qur'an - it may mean that the whole is so well connected with its components that the creation and the resurrection of one part affects also the whole. (A.P.)

item.title: Luqman:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ alam tara anna l-laha yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī ilā ajalin musamman wa-anna l-laha bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun Have you not regarded that Allah makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night; and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term, and that Allah is well aware of what you do?

item.title: Luqman:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ alam tara anna l-laha yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī ilā ajalin musamman wa-anna l-laha bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun Do you not see (i.e., know) that Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running (its course) for a specified term, and that Allah, of whatever you do, is Aware? See you not that Allah merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night, and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running its course for a term appointed; and that Allah is All-Aware of what you…

item.title: Luqman:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ alam tara anna l-laha yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī ilā ajalin musamman wa-anna l-laha bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun Seest thou not that God causeth the night to pass into the day, and causeth the day to pass into the night, and hath made subservient the sun and the moon, each passing an appointed term, and that God, of what ye do, is All-Aware. See 31:28

item.title: Luqman:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi l-bāṭilu wa-anna l-laha huwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīru That is because Allah is the Reality,1 and whatever they invoke besides Him is nullity,2 and because Allah is the All-exalted, the All-great.

item.title: Luqman:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi l-bāṭilu wa-anna l-laha huwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīru That is because Allah is the True Reality, and that what they call upon1 other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand. See 31:29

item.title: Luqman:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi l-bāṭilu wa-anna l-laha huwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīru This, because God is truth, and that which they call upon besides Him is falsehood, and that God, He is the Highest, the Greatest. See 31:28

item.title: Luqman:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ الْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُمْ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ alam tara anna l-ful'ka tajrī fī l-baḥri biniʿ'mati l-lahi liyuriyakum min āyātihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin Have you not regarded that the ships sail at sea by Allah's blessing, that He may show you some of His signs? There are indeed signs in that for every patient and grateful [servant].

item.title: Luqman:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ الْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُمْ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ alam tara anna l-ful'ka tajrī fī l-baḥri biniʿ'mati l-lahi liyuriyakum min āyātihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allah that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful. See you not that the ships sail through the sea by Allah's grace that He may show you of His signs? Verily, in this are signs for every patient, grateful (person) (31:31). And when waves cover them like shades, they invoke Allah, making their invocations for Him only. But when He brings them safe to land, there are among them those that stop in between. And Our Ayat are…

item.title: Luqman:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ الْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُمْ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ alam tara anna l-ful'ka tajrī fī l-baḥri biniʿ'mati l-lahi liyuriyakum min āyātihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin Seest thou (The Prophet addressed for the people.) not that the ships sail on the sea by the favour of God, that He may show you of His signs? Verily in this are signs for every steadfast grateful (one). See 31:28

item.title: Luqman:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُمْ مَوْجٌ كَالظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ wa-idhā ghashiyahum mawjun kal-ẓulali daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari famin'hum muq'taṣidun wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā kullu khattārin kafūrin When waves cover them like awnings, they invoke Allah, putting exclusive faith in Him. But when He delivers them towards land, [only] some of them remain unswerving. And no one will impugn Our signs except an ungrateful traitor.

item.title: Luqman:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُمْ مَوْجٌ كَالظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ wa-idhā ghashiyahum mawjun kal-ẓulali daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari famin'hum muq'taṣidun wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā kullu khattārin kafūrin And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion (i.e., faith). But when He delivers them to the land, there are (some) of them who are moderate (in faith). And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful. See 31:31

item.title: Luqman:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُمْ مَوْجٌ كَالظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ wa-idhā ghashiyahum mawjun kal-ẓulali daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari famin'hum muq'taṣidun wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā kullu khattārin kafūrin And when covereth them a wave like mountains they call upon God in sincere devotion unto Him; but when He bringeth them safe to land, of them are those who halt between (Moderate.) (the right and wrong); and disputeth not about Our signs but every perfidious, ungrateful one. See 31:28

item.title: Luqman:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْا يَوْمًا لَا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَنْ وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَنْ وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum wa-ikh'shaw yawman lā yajzī wālidun ʿan waladihi walā mawlūdun huwa jāzin ʿan wālidihi shayan inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūru O mankind! Be wary of your Lord and fear the day when a father shall not atone for his child, nor the child shall atone for its father in any wise. Indeed Allah's promise is true. So do not let the life of the world deceive you, nor let the Deceiver1 deceive you concerning Allah.

item.title: Luqman:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْا يَوْمًا لَا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَنْ وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَنْ وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum wa-ikh'shaw yawman lā yajzī wālidun ʿan waladihi walā mawlūdun huwa jāzin ʿan wālidihi shayan inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūru O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver (i.e., Satan). O mankind! Have Taqwa of your Lord, and fear a Day when no father can avail aught for his son, nor a son avail aught for his father. Verily,…

item.title: Luqman:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْا يَوْمًا لَا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَنْ وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَنْ وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum wa-ikh'shaw yawman lā yajzī wālidun ʿan waladihi walā mawlūdun huwa jāzin ʿan wālidihi shayan inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūru O' ye people! guard ye (your selves against the wrath of) your Lord and dread ye the day (The day of final judgment.) when a father shall avail not of his son, neither the child shall avail of its father; verily the promise of God is true, so let not the life of the world beguile you; nor let the deceiver deceive you concerning God. The First Holy Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib said - 'There are only three days…

item.title: Luqman:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ خَبِيرٌ inna l-laha ʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wayunazzilu l-ghaytha wayaʿlamu mā fī l-arḥāmi wamā tadrī nafsun mādhā taksibu ghadan wamā tadrī nafsun bi-ayyi arḍin tamūtu inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīrun Indeed the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah. He sends down the rain, and He knows what is in the wombs. No soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-aware.

item.title: Luqman:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ خَبِيرٌ inna l-laha ʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wayunazzilu l-ghaytha wayaʿlamu mā fī l-arḥāmi wamā tadrī nafsun mādhā taksibu ghadan wamā tadrī nafsun bi-ayyi arḍin tamūtu inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīrun Indeed, Allah (alone) has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs.1 And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Aware. Verily, Allah, with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, He sends down the rain, and knows that which is in the wombs. No person knows what he will earn tomorrow, and no person knows in what land he will die.…

item.title: Luqman:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ خَبِيرٌ inna l-laha ʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wayunazzilu l-ghaytha wayaʿlamu mā fī l-arḥāmi wamā tadrī nafsun mādhā taksibu ghadan wamā tadrī nafsun bi-ayyi arḍin tamūtu inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīrun Verily, God is He with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour (Of the ultimate end.) and He sendeth down the rain, and knoweth He what is in the wombs; and knoweth not any soul what he shall earn the morrow; and knoweth not any soul in what lands he shall die; Verily God is All-Knowing, All-Aware. A man, Harith ibn Amr al-Mahrabi, a Bedouin, came to the Holy Prophet and said: Tell me when the Day of Judgment would take place. I have sown, let…

item.title: Maryam:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كهيعص kaf-ha-ya-ain-sad Kāf, Hā, Yā, 'Ayn, Ṣād.

item.title: Maryam:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كهيعص kaf-ha-ya-ain-sad Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.1 يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ who shall inherit me, and inherit (also) the posterity of Ya'qub. "He would be a Prophet like his forefathers were Prophets." Allah's statement: وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا and make him, my Lord, one with whom You are well-pleased! means "Make him pleasing to You (Allah) and your creation. Love him and make him beloved to your creatures, in both his religion and his character."

item.title: Maryam:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كهيعص kaf-ha-ya-ain-sad Kaf. Ha. Ya. Ain. Sad. (K. H. Y. A. S.) Kaf, Ha, Ya, Ain, Saad. It has already been said before that the true meaning or the correct interpretation of these symbol letters is known to God and the Holy Prophet and besides these two authorities the interpretation of these mysterious symbols could be known only to the Holy Ahl al-Bayt, i.e., the Holy Imams with whom the Holy Prophet left the Holy Qur'an. I leave aside all other conjectures about these symbols and state here what the First Holy Imam, Ali ibn Abi Talib said about the letters used in this verse. Each of the five letters stands for a divine attribute of God. Kaf (K) stands for (the Charitable Giver) or Kafi meaning (Self-sufficient). Ha (H) for Hadi (the Guide). Ya (Y) for Yad (Hand -…

item.title: Maryam:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّا dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā [This is] an account1 of your Lord's mercy on His servant, Zechariah,

item.title: Maryam:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّا dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā (This is) a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zakariyya. See 19:1

item.title: Maryam:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّا dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā (This is) a mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah. See 19:1

item.title: Maryam:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyyan when he called out to his Lord with a secret cry.

item.title: Maryam:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyyan When he called to his Lord a private call (i.e., supplication). See 19:1

item.title: Maryam:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyyan When called he unto his Lord (with) prayer in low voice. See 19:1

item.title: Maryam:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا qāla rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-ish'taʿala l-rasu shayban walam akun biduʿāika rabbi shaqiyyan He said, 'My Lord! Indeed my bones have become feeble, and my head has turned white with age, yet never have I, my Lord, been disappointed in supplicating You!

item.title: Maryam:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا qāla rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-ish'taʿala l-rasu shayban walam akun biduʿāika rabbi shaqiyyan He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled1 with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy (i.e., disappointed). See 19:1

item.title: Maryam:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا qāla rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-ish'taʿala l-rasu shayban walam akun biduʿāika rabbi shaqiyyan Said he: "O' my Lord! Verily my bones are weakened and my head doth glisten (Flare.) with grey hoariness: but never am I in my prayer unto Thee, O' my Lord! been unblest! (Unresponded.)" While praying to God, Zachariah submitted saying that whenever he prayed for any thing, his prayer never went unheard. A similar merciful attitude of the Lord, Zachariah prayed for with regard to his desire for an heir.

item.title: Maryam:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَرَاءِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا wa-innī khif'tu l-mawāliya min warāī wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran fahab lī min ladunka waliyyan Indeed I fear my kinsmen, after me, and my wife is barren. So grant me from Yourself an heir

item.title: Maryam:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَرَاءِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا wa-innī khif'tu l-mawāliya min warāī wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran fahab lī min ladunka waliyyan And indeed, I fear the successors1 after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir. See 19:1

item.title: Maryam:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَرَاءِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا wa-innī khif'tu l-mawāliya min warāī wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran fahab lī min ladunka waliyyan And verily I fear my kindred (cousins) after me, and my wife is barren, So grant me from Thyself an heir! The anxiety of Zachariah was not merely to own a son for the sake of being merely the father of an issue but his fear was that after his death his relatives might be led astray and there will be none to guide them and keep the lamp of guidance burnished bright also to inherit him.1 'Vali' originally means 'Qarib' - the near one - and it is used in several senses - the common factor of it is - nearness - be that as a nearest relative, as an heir or a…

item.title: Maryam:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wa-ij'ʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyan who may inherit from me and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]!'

item.title: Maryam:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wa-ij'ʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyan Who will inherit me1 and inherit from the family of Ya'qub. And make him, my Lord, pleasing (to You)." See 19:1

item.title: Maryam:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wa-ij'ʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyan Who shall inherit (This verse clearly proves the fallacy of the saying that the apostles of God leave no legacy - and with this plea the Holy Lady Fatimah was deprived of her right over Fadak which was given away to her by the Holy Prophet.) me and inherit from the family of Jacob; and make him O' my Lord! one with whom Thou art well pleased! The heir prayed for was to inherit Zachariah and his ancestors as he himself inherited his forefathers. This verse gives out the fallacy of the lame excuse given against the Holy Lady Fatima's claim to inherit her father, the Holy Prophet, i.e., her right over the Garden of Fadak, which was bequeathed by the Holy Prophet himself…

item.title: Maryam:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
