item.description: يَازَكَرِيَّا إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَى لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا yāzakariyyā innā nubashiruka bighulāmin us'muhu yaḥyā lam najʿal lahu min qablu samiyyan 'O Zechariah! Indeed We give you the good news of a son, whose name is "John." Never before have We made anyone his namesake.'

item.title: Maryam:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَازَكَرِيَّا إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَى لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا yāzakariyyā innā nubashiruka bighulāmin us'muhu yaḥyā lam najʿal lahu min qablu samiyyan (He was told),1 "O Zakariyya, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be Yahya. We have not assigned to any before (this) name." (Allah said:) O Zakariyya! Verily, We give you the good news of a son, whose name will be Yahya. We have given that name to none before (him) (19:7). The Acceptance of His Supplication This statement implies what is not mentioned, that his supplication was answered. It was said to him: يَا زَكَرِيَّا إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَىٰ (Allah said:) "O Zakariyya! Verily, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be Yahya..." Similarly Allah, the Exalted, said; هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ ۖ قَالَ…

item.title: Maryam:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَازَكَرِيَّا إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَى لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا yāzakariyyā innā nubashiruka bighulāmin us'muhu yaḥyā lam najʿal lahu min qablu samiyyan (The Lord responded to the prayer saying): "O' Zachariah! Verily We give thee the glad tidings of a son, his name shall be Yahya (John), and We gave not to any one before (him) that name!" With the glad tidings of getting a son, Zachariah was informed of what the name of the son was to be. None else had ever been before with the name Yahya - derived from Hayat, i.e., life. It is said that the name Yahya was given to him for he was born of a barren woman who for never being productive and also for her having crossed the age of production of an issue, was virtually dead to womanhood.1 The…

item.title: Maryam:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran waqad balaghtu mina l-kibari ʿitiyyan He said, 'My Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I am already advanced in age?'

item.title: Maryam:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran waqad balaghtu mina l-kibari ʿitiyyan He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?" He said: My Lord! How can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have reached the extreme old age (19:8). He said: "Thus your Lord says: 'It is easy for Me. Certainly I have created you before, when you had been nothing!'") (19:8- (9) His Amazement after the Acceptance of His Supplication Zakariyya was amazed when his supplication was answered and he was given the good news of a son. He became extremely overjoyed and asked how this child would be born to him, and…

item.title: Maryam:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran waqad balaghtu mina l-kibari ʿitiyyan Said he: "O' my Lord! How can there be for me a son while my wife is barren and indeed I have reached of the old age the extreme infirmity?" The cause of surprise and the inability of Zachariah to readily believe the prophecy about his having a son was that the ordinary natural time-limit for an ordinary man and woman to be productive had long passed away and besides his wife had never produced, i.e., she was declared barren.

item.title: Maryam:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan He said, 'So shall it be. Your Lord has said, "It is simple for Me." Certainly I created you before when you were nothing.'

item.title: Maryam:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan (An angel) said, "Thus (it will be); your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'" See 19:8

item.title: Maryam:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan Said He (the Lord): "So shall it be." Thy Lord sayeth: "Easy is it to Me, for indeed have I created thee aforetime, when thou wert nothing!" 'He said', meaning the angel said, i.e., the angel in reply to the surprise and the wonder on the part of Zachariah conveyed what he heard from the Lord saying that it was easy for Him (the Lord) to enact what is impossible under the usual law of nature - for He created even Zachariah himself from nothing.1

item.title: Maryam:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي اٰیَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyan He said, 'My Lord! Appoint a sign for me.' He said, 'Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three complete nights.'

item.title: Maryam:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي اٰیَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyan (Zakariyya) said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, (being) sound."1 He Zakariyya said: My Lord! Appoint for me a sign." He said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak unto mankind for three nights, though having no bodily defect (19:10). Then he came out to his people from the Mihrab and he indicated to them by signs to glorify (Allah) in the morning and in the afternoon (19:11). The Sign of the Pregnancy Allah, the Exalted, informed about Zakariyya that he said: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَل لِّي آيَةً He (Zakariyya) said: "My Lord! Appoint for me a…

item.title: Maryam:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي اٰیَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyan Said he: "O' my Lord! Vouchsafe me a sign!" He said: "Thy sign is that thou speaketh not to the people for three nights, though sound (in health)!" See 19:9

item.title: Maryam:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَرَجَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَى إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ سَبِّحُوْۤا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina l-miḥ'rābi fa-awḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū buk'ratan waʿashiyyan So he emerged before his people from the Temple, and signaled to them that they should glorify [Allah] morning and evening.

item.title: Maryam:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَرَجَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَى إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ سَبِّحُوْۤا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina l-miḥ'rābi fa-awḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū buk'ratan waʿashiyyan So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt (Allah) in the morning and afternoon. See 19:10

item.title: Maryam:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَرَجَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَى إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ سَبِّحُوْۤا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina l-miḥ'rābi fa-awḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū buk'ratan waʿashiyyan Then he went out (of the sanctuary) unto his people and made signs unto them (with his hands) that they should glorify (God) morning and evening. See verse 3:40. The use of 'Awha' gives the justification for the use of the root 'Wahi' and its derivations in any suggestive method for a clear verbal conversation. (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَايَحْيَى خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا yāyaḥyā khudhi l-kitāba biquwwatin waātaynāhu l-ḥuk'ma ṣabiyyan 'O John!' [We said,] 'Hold on with power to the Book!' And We gave him judgement while still a child,

item.title: Maryam:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَايَحْيَى خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا yāyaḥyā khudhi l-kitāba biquwwatin waātaynāhu l-ḥuk'ma ṣabiyyan (Allah said), "O Yahya, take the Scripture (i.e., adhere to it) with determination." And We gave him judgement (while yet) a boy. (It was said to his son): "O Yahya! Hold fast to the Scripture." And We gave him wisdom while yet a child (19:12). And Hananan from Us, and Zakatan, and he was pious (19:13). And dutiful to his parents, and he was not arrogant or disobedient (19:14). And Salam (peace) be on him the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he will be raised up to life (again) (19:15). The Birth of the Boy and His Characteristics This also implies what is not mentioned, that this promised boy was born and he was Yahya. There is also the…

item.title: Maryam:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَايَحْيَى خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا yāyaḥyā khudhi l-kitāba biquwwatin waātaynāhu l-ḥuk'ma ṣabiyyan (The Lord said unto Zachariah's son) "O' Yahya! Hold thou the Book fast!" and We granted him wisdom (apostleship) while yet a child. The Command in this verse is that which was given to Yahya after his birth. Even from his very young age, Yahya clad himself with the simplest covering made of jute and fed himself with simplest food of mere dried leaves. 'Hukm' - meaning the strength or the power of correct judgment, i.e., 'Hikmat' meaning Wisdom which means also apostleship. This Gift of God was, when he was yet very young. Yahya from his earliest age used to be with the priests and scholars of the religion, firmly established in faith. It is a fact that Jesus spoke from the cradle claiming himself…

item.title: Maryam:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَنَانًا مِنْ لَدُنَّا وَزَكَوةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا waḥanānan min ladunnā wazakatan wakāna taqiyyan and a compassion and purity from Us. He was Godwary,

item.title: Maryam:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَنَانًا مِنْ لَدُنَّا وَزَكَوةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا waḥanānan min ladunnā wazakatan wakāna taqiyyan And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah. See 19:12

item.title: Maryam:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَحَنَانًا مِنْ لَدُنَّا وَزَكَوةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا waḥanānan min ladunnā wazakatan wakāna taqiyyan And compassion as from Us and purity, and pious (Devout.) one was he, See 19:12

item.title: Maryam:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا wabarran biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyan and good to his parents, and was not self-willed or disobedient.

item.title: Maryam:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا wabarran biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyan And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant. See 19:12

item.title: Maryam:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا wabarran biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyan And duteous unto his parents, and neither insolent (nor) disobedient. See 19:12

item.title: Maryam:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yub'ʿathu ḥayyan Peace be to him, the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he is raised alive!

item.title: Maryam:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yub'ʿathu ḥayyan And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive. See 19:12

item.title: Maryam:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yub'ʿathu ḥayyan Peace be on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth, and the day he is raised (once again) to life. 'Peace' mentioned here to have been conferred upon Yahya (John) and in the case of Jesus also (verse 19:33 below) refers to the peace of mind granted to these two divines at the stage of the agony of birth, death and resurrection for on these three occasions the soul suffers a terrible agony. Yahya (John) was so tender-hearted and god-fearing that he could not bear even the mention of the various kinds of the chastisements of Hell. Whenever he heard any one mentioning the torments of the Hell-fire, he used to weep and even get out of control…

item.title: Maryam:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi maryama idhi intabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyyan And mention in the Book Mary, when she withdrew from her family to an easterly place.

item.title: Maryam:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi maryama idhi intabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyyan And mention, (O Muḥammad), in the Book (the story of) Maryam, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. And mention in the Book, Maryam, when she withdrew in seclusion from her family to place facing east (19:16). She placed a screen before them; then We sent to her Our Ruh, and he appeared before her in the form of a man in all respects (19:17). She said: "Verily, I seek refuge with the Most Gracious (Allah) from you, if you do fear Allah (19:18). (The angel) said: "I am only a messenger from your Lord, (to announce) to you the gift of a righteous son (19:19). She said: "How can I have a son when…

item.title: Maryam:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi maryama idhi intabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyyan And mention in the Book (Qur'an) about Mary (also) when she withdrew herself from her family (in the house) eastward The subject of Mary and Jesus has been dealt with in verses 3:42 - 3:51. Here it is mentioned with reference to the devotion of the true believers in God. East referred to here and West in verse 28:44, besides its apparent meaning of the two different directions, refer also to a deeper significance connected with the peculiarity of the distinctive aspects of the missions of these two great prophets, before the Last One. Jesus' mission deals more with the spiritual aspect of the human life which is situated in the direction (East) from where the Light of Existence proceeds…

item.title: Maryam:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا fa-ittakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyyan Thus did she seclude herself from them, whereupon We sent to her Our Spirit1 and he became incarnate for her as a well-proportioned human.

item.title: Maryam:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا fa-ittakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyyan And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel (i.e., Jibril), and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man. See 19:16

item.title: Maryam:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا fa-ittakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyyan Then she took a (To have a bath.) veil (cover herself) from them; then sent We unto her Our Spirit, then he (the Spirit) appeared to her a man sound (Perfect, proper.) (in form) It is said Mary used to pray within a veil which she hung for herself in the comer of the synagogue, or she had retired into seclusion from her people for a bath.1 The spirit was the Angel Gabriel. He appeared in perfect human form. The Question arises how could spirit, an abstract being, take any shape. The fact is that the spiritual power of the Angel Gabriel caused Mary to see him in a human form, otherwise the angel as a spirit remained…

item.title: Maryam:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا qālat innī aʿūdhu bil-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyan She said, 'I seek the protection of the All-beneficent from you, should you be Godwary!'

item.title: Maryam:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا qālat innī aʿūdhu bil-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyan She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, (so leave me), if you should be fearing of Allah." See 19:16

item.title: Maryam:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا qālat innī aʿūdhu bil-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyan Said she: "Verily I fly for refuge in The Beneficent (God) from thee, (be gone from me) if thou art (Pious.) God-fearing" Mary asks the person who appeared to her to be away if he be a pious soul.

item.title: Maryam:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا qāla innamā anā rasūlu rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyan He said, 'I am only a messenger of your Lord that I may give you a pure son.'

item.title: Maryam:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا qāla innamā anā rasūlu rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyan He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you (news of) a pure boy (i.e., son)." See 19:16

item.title: Maryam:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا qāla innamā anā rasūlu rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyan Said he: (The Spirit.) "I am only a messenger (Angel) of thy Lord: so that I give to thee a son (Holy.) purified." See 19:18

item.title: Maryam:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun walam yamsasnī basharun walam aku baghiyyan She said, 'How shall I have a child seeing that no human being has ever touched me, nor have I been unchaste?'

item.title: Maryam:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun walam yamsasnī basharun walam aku baghiyyan She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?" See 19:16

item.title: Maryam:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun walam yamsasnī basharun walam aku baghiyyan Said she: "How can there be unto me a son (Boy.) while hath not touched me (any) man and nor was I unchaste!" See 19:18

item.title: Maryam:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ اٰیَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyinun walinajʿalahu āyatan lilnnāsi waraḥmatan minnā wakāna amran maqḍiyyan He said, 'So shall it be. Your Lord says, "It is simple for Me." And so that We may make him a sign for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter [already] decided.'

item.title: Maryam:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ اٰیَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyinun walinajʿalahu āyatan lilnnāsi waraḥmatan minnā wakāna amran maqḍiyyan He said, "Thus (it will be); your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter (already) decreed.'" See 19:16

item.title: Maryam:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ اٰیَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyinun walinajʿalahu āyatan lilnnāsi waraḥmatan minnā wakāna amran maqḍiyyan Said he (The Spirit.) "So shall it (As told.) be; thy Lord sayeth, It is easy for Me, and that We will make him (Jesus.) a Sign (miracle) (of Ours) unto the people and a Mercy from Us; It is a matter (already) decreed." (The fulfilment of the divine will has already started - i.e., the Conception taken place.) The Israelites had lost faith in God and had subjected themselves to certain rituals and the imaginary dogmas initiated by the priests and were drowned in all sorts of evils. Jesus' advent in the wonderful way it took place, i.e., being born without a father, was to bring back to the…

item.title: Maryam:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا faḥamalathu fa-intabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyyan Thus she conceived him, then withdrew with him to a distant place.

item.title: Maryam:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا faḥamalathu fa-intabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyyan So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place. So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place (19:22). And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a date palm. She said: Would that I had died before this, and had been forgotten and out of sight! (19:23). The Conception and the Birth Allah, the Exalted, informs about Maryam that when Jibril had spoken to her about what Allah said, she accepted the decree of Allah. Many scholars of the predecessors (Salaf) have mentioned that at this point the angel (who was Jibril) blew into the opening of the garment that she was wearing. Then the breath descended until it entered into her vagina and she conceived the child…

item.title: Maryam:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا faḥamalathu fa-intabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyyan So she conceived him and retired with him (Baby Jesus in her womb.) (away from her people) to a remote (Not to a mean place like a manger, as the Bible says.) place. See 19:21

item.title: Maryam:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ إِلَى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَالَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا fa-ajāahā l-makhāḍu ilā jidh'ʿi l-nakhlati qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan The birth pangs brought her to the trunk of a date palm. She said, 'I wish I had died before this and become a forgotten thing, beyond recall.'

item.title: Maryam:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ إِلَى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَالَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا fa-ajāahā l-makhāḍu ilā jidh'ʿi l-nakhlati qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten." See 19:22

item.title: Maryam:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ إِلَى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَالَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا fa-ajāahā l-makhāḍu ilā jidh'ʿi l-nakhlati qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan And the throes (of childbirth) forced her to betake herself unto the trunk of a palm-tree. She said: "Oh! Had I died ere this, and had been lost in oblivion totally forgotten!" When Mary felt the pangs of childbirth she came out of the synagogue and sat resting upon an old trunk of a dead date-palm tree; but as she leaned upon the trunk it became green and spread new leaves and branches began to shoot out of it bearing fresh and ripe fruits in them. Quite a similar miracle had been effected when the Holy Prophet while migrating from Mecca to Madina rested upon the trunk of a dead tree, the dead tree's…

item.title: Maryam:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَاهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyan Thereupon he1 called her from below her [saying,] 'Do not grieve! Your Lord has made a spring to flow at your feet.

item.title: Maryam:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَاهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyan But he1 called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. Then he cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not: your Lord has provided a Sariy under you (19:24). "And shake the trunk of date palm towards you, it will let fall fresh ripe dates upon you (19:25). "So eat and drink and rejoice. And if you see any human being, say: 'Verily, I have vowed a fast for the Most Gracious so I shall not speak to any human being today., (19:26). What was Said to Her after the Birth Some reciters read the Ayah as: (مَن تَـحْتَهَآ) Who was below her Meaning the one who was below her called…

item.title: Maryam:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَنَادَاهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyan Then (a voice) called out unto her from beneath her; "Grieve not thou, verily thy Lord hath caused from beneath thee, (to flow) a stream!" See 19:23

item.title: Maryam:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا wahuzzī ilayki bijidh'ʿi l-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyan Shake the trunk of the palm tree, freshly picked dates will drop upon you.

item.title: Maryam:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا wahuzzī ilayki bijidh'ʿi l-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyan And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates. See 19:24

item.title: Maryam:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا wahuzzī ilayki bijidh'ʿi l-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyan And shake towards thee the trunk of the palm-tree, it will drop on thee dates fresh (and) ripe. See 19:23

item.title: Maryam:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي اِنِّیْ نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنْسِيًّا fakulī wa-ish'rabī waqarrī ʿaynan fa-immā tarayinna mina l-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallima l-yawma insiyyan Eat, drink, and be comforted. Then if you see any human, say, "Indeed I have vowed a fast to the All-beneficent, so I will not speak to any human today." '

item.title: Maryam:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي اِنِّیْ نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنْسِيًّا fakulī wa-ish'rabī waqarrī ʿaynan fa-immā tarayinna mina l-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallima l-yawma insiyyan So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to (any) man.'" See 19:24

item.title: Maryam:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي اِنِّیْ نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنْسِيًّا fakulī wa-ish'rabī waqarrī ʿaynan fa-immā tarayinna mina l-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallima l-yawma insiyyan Then eat and drink and refresh the eye. Then if thou seest any man say: "Verily I have vowed unto the Beneficent (God) a fast so never shall I speak today unto any man." Mary was commanded to observe silence and not to speak to any man or woman. This was to put her on guard against her giving her own answers to the expected censure from the people, for the answer was destined to be given by the Holy Baby (Jesus) himself.

item.title: Maryam:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ قَالُوْا يَامَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyyan Then carrying him she brought him to her people. They said, 'O Mary, you have certainly come up with an odd thing!

item.title: Maryam:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ قَالُوْا يَامَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyyan Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Maryam, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented. Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said: O Maryam! Indeed you have brought a thing Fariy (19:27). "O sister of Harun! Your father was not a man who used to commit adultery, nor your mother was an unchaste woman (19:28). Then she pointed to him. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle? (19:29). He said: "Verily, I am a servant of Allah, He has given me the Scripture and made me a Prophet; (19:30). "And He has made me blessed wherever I be, and has enjoined on me…

item.title: Maryam:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ قَالُوْا يَامَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyyan And she came with him (With her baby, Jesus.) unto her people carrying him (with her). Said they: "O' Mary! Indeed thou hath come with an unusual thing!" See 19:26

item.title: Maryam:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأُخْتَ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawin wamā kānat ummuki baghiyyan O sister of Aaron['s lineage]! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother unchaste.'

item.title: Maryam:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأُخْتَ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawin wamā kānat ummuki baghiyyan O sister (i.e., descendant) of Harun, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste." See 19:27

item.title: Maryam:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأُخْتَ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawin wamā kānat ummuki baghiyyan O' sister of Aaron! thy father was not a bad man, nor was thy mother an unchaste woman! It is said that there was a righteous man called Aaron known for his exemplary righteousness, and whoever was righteous as a token of his righteousness, used to be addressed and associated with the name of the man as the brother or the sister of Aaron. Mary for the excellence of her ideal chastity, modesty and sublime life, was addressed as the sister of Aaron. However, it was an utterance expressing the degree of the surprise of the people referring to Mary's high priestly lineage and her being of parents of exceptional good morals and how she, in their imagination,…

item.title: Maryam:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوْا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyyan Thereat she pointed to him. They said, 'How can we speak to one who is yet a baby in the cradle?'

item.title: Maryam:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوْا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyyan So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?" See 19:27

item.title: Maryam:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوْا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyyan But she pointed unto him. They said: "How can we speak unto one who is (yet) a child in the cradle" The Holy Baby (Jesus) came to the rescue of his mother against the calumny from the faith less Israelites. A commentator who does not like to see anything beyond matter, interprets this verse saying that the declaration of Jesus about himself was in his advanced age and not while he was in the cradle. This is a purposeful distortion of facts just to please the materialist deniers of godly powers. Whereas this verse as well as verse 3:45 clearly says that Jesus lying in the cradle spoke out the words in the defence of his Holy Mother. The meaninglessness…

item.title: Maryam:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ءَاتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyyan He said, 'Indeed I am a servant of Allah! He has given me the Book and made me a prophet.

item.title: Maryam:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ءَاتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyyan (Isa) said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet. See 19:27

item.title: Maryam:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ءَاتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyyan He (Jesus miraculously) said: "Verily I am a servant of God; He hath given me a Book (Evangel) and made me a Prophet!" Note here that Jesus, while yet a baby in the cradle, claimed to be an Apostle of God and to have been given the Book (Injil, i.e., Evangel). Compare this to the story of the experience of the Holy Prophet with the Messenger Angel.1 Whereas the Holy Prophet says: "I was an Apostle of God when Adam was yet between the clay and water (i.e., yet in the making)." As Jesus was from the very birth a believer in God and His devotee, the First Holy Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, was born in the Holy Ka'ba and never in his…

item.title: Maryam:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayyan He has made me blessed, wherever I may be, and He has enjoined me to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakāt as long as I live,

item.title: Maryam:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayyan And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive. See 19:27

item.title: Maryam:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayyan And He hath made me blessed wherever I be and He hath enjoined on me prayer and poor-rate so long as I live! This verse contains the continuation of the matter uttered by Jesus, while he was yet a baby in the cradle in defence of his mother against the calumnious suspicion of the people at his birth without a male parent. It has been the persistent tendency of man to deny an excellence to the other great men of God if that quality is not found in his own assumed hero or leader. It is only such disappointed followers of the false prophets that persistently deny the power of showing miracles in the genuine apostles from God…

item.title: Maryam:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyyan and to be good to my mother, and He has not made me self-willed and wretched.

item.title: Maryam:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyyan And (made me) dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant. See 19:27

item.title: Maryam:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyyan And (to be) duteous to my mother, and He hath not made me insolent unblest! See 19:31

item.title: Maryam:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayyan Peace is to me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised alive.'

item.title: Maryam:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayyan And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive." See 19:27

item.title: Maryam:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayyan And peace be on me day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised alive (Resurrected on the Day of Judgment.) "! See 19:31

item.title: Maryam:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūna That is Jesus, son of Mary, a Word of the Real concerning whom they are in doubt.

item.title: Maryam:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūna That is Isa, the son of Maryam - the word of truth about which they are in dispute. Such is Isa, son of Maryam. Qawlal-Haqq (it is a statement of truth) about which they doubt (or dispute) (19:34). It befits not (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glorified be He. When He decrees a thing, He only says to it: Be!" – and it is (19:35). (Isa said): "And verily, Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. That is the straight path (19:36). Then the sects differed, so woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of a great Day (19:37). Isa is the Servant of Allah and Not His Son Allah, the Exalted, says to…

item.title: Maryam:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūna This is Jesus, the son of Mary; (this is) a statement of the truth about which they dispute. The mention of the people doubting about Jesus is a further indication that the doubt against the birth of Jesus without a male-parent was the betrayal of the faith in the omnipotence of the Lord, for He can always act as He wills, as He is the Creator of the laws of nature and not Himself bound by any laws which He Himself regulates for the created world with the limitations to govern and regulate the life in the universe. For instance, the law of nature is that no thing could be created from nothing, but this universal phenomenon of nature does not bind…

item.title: Maryam:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ سُبْحَانَهُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ mā kāna lillahi an yattakhidha min waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu It is not for Allah to take a son. Immaculate is He! When He decides on a matter, He just says to it, 'Be!' and it is.

item.title: Maryam:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ سُبْحَانَهُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ mā kāna lillahi an yattakhidha min waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu It is not (befitting) for Allah to take a son; exalted is He!1 When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is. See 19:34

item.title: Maryam:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ سُبْحَانَهُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ mā kāna lillahi an yattakhidha min waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu It beseemeth not God that He should take unto Himself a son, glory be to Him; when a matter is decreed, He only sayeth unto it 'Be' and it is Those who are beguiled by the virgin birth of Jesus and take Jesus to be the son of God are reminded of the Omnipotent authority of the Creator Lord of the Universe Whose will is never controlled by the laws of nature. Whereas every law of nature is controlled by His will, and whenever He wills He can cause anything to take effect. The very Scripture in their own hands says that God is able even to raise…

item.title: Maryam:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun 'Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a straight path.'

item.title: Maryam:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun (Isa said), "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path." See 19:34

item.title: Maryam:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun And verily God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship (only) Him; this is the right way. See 19:35

item.title: Maryam:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ مَشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmin But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the faithless at the scene of a tremendous day.

item.title: Maryam:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ مَشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmin Then the factions differed (concerning Isa) from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day. See 19:34

item.title: Maryam:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ مَشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmin Then did differ the sects among themselves and woe unto those who disbelieved, because of their presenting themselves on the great day. In several other verses such as the verse 3:19 Qur'an declares that the differences among the various groups of the people of the Book, including the Muslims, are based on the rebellious tendency against the unequivocal declarations of God. (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَكِنِ الظَّالِمُونَ الْيَوْمَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini l-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālin mubīnin How well they will hear and how well they will see on the day when they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are in manifest error.

item.title: Maryam:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَكِنِ الظَّالِمُونَ الْيَوْمَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini l-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālin mubīnin How (clearly) they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error. How clearly will they see and hear, the Day when they will appear before Us! But the wrongdoers today are in plain error (19:38). And warn them of the Day of grief and regrets, when the case has been decided, while (now) they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not (19:39). Verily, We will inherit the earth and whatsoever is thereon. And to Us they all shall be returned (19:40). The Disbeliever's Warning of the Day of Distress Allah, the Exalted, says informing about the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection that they will…

item.title: Maryam:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَكِنِ الظَّالِمُونَ الْيَوْمَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini l-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālin mubīnin How clearly shall they hear and how clearly shall they see on the day when they appear unto Us, but the unjust this day are in manifest straying. See 19:37

item.title: Maryam:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatin wahum lā yu'minūna Warn them of the Day of Regret,1 when the matter will be decided, while they are [yet] heedless and do not have faith.

item.title: Maryam:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatin wahum lā yu'minūna And warn them, (O Muḥammad), of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded;1 and (yet), they are in (a state of) heedlessness, and they do not believe. See 19:38

item.title: Maryam:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatin wahum lā yu'minūna And warn them of the intense regret, when the matter shall have been decreed while they are (now) in negligence and they believe not. See 19:37

item.title: Maryam:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna Indeed We shall inherit the earth and whoever there is on it, and to Us they shall be brought back.

item.title: Maryam:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned. See 19:38

item.title: Maryam:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna Verily We inherit the earth and those who are on it, and unto Us shall they be returned. See 19:37

item.title: Maryam:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan And mention in the Book Abraham. Indeed he was a truthful one, a prophet.

item.title: Maryam:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan And mention in the Book (the story of) Ibrahim. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet. And mention in the Book, Ibrahim. Verily, he was a man of truth, a Prophet (19:41). When he said to his father: "O my father! Why do you worship that which hears not, sees not and cannot avail you in anything? (19:42). "O my father! Verily, there has come to me the knowledge of that which came not unto you. So follow me, I will guide you to the straight path (19:43). "O my father! Worship not Shaytan. Verily, Shaytan has been a rebel against the Most Gracious (19:44). "O my father! Verily, I fear lest a torment from the Most Gracious should overtake you,…

item.title: Maryam:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan And (make) mention in the Book (Qur'an) Abraham; verily he was a man of Truth, an Apostle (of Ours). Abraham is universally accepted by all nations as the Apostle of God, be they the Jews, the Christians or the Muslims. This should be read with the opening verses of Surah Sad, 38:1 - 38:3. It shows that Qur'an is the Book containing the remembrance of the apostles and the righteous devotees of God and encourages people to remember the chosen servants of God, in the ages. (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْكَ شَيْئًا idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shayan When he said to his father, 'Father! Why do you worship that which neither hears nor sees, and is of no avail to you in any way?

item.title: Maryam:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْكَ شَيْئًا idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shayan (Mention) when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all? See 19:41

item.title: Maryam:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْكَ شَيْئًا idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shayan When said he unto his father, "O' My Father! Why worshippeth thou that which heareth not, nor doth it see, nor doth it avail thee in aught?" When Abraham addressed Azar as his father it was customary to address a guardian as such whereas he was his paternal uncle. Azar, an idol-worshipper had adopted Abraham as his son. The real father of Abraham was Terah who was a believer.

item.title: Maryam:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ قَدْ جَاءَنِي مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِي أَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyan Father! Indeed a knowledge has already come to me which has not come to you. So follow me that I may guide you to a right path.

item.title: Maryam:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ قَدْ جَاءَنِي مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِي أَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyan O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path. See 19:41

item.title: Maryam:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ قَدْ جَاءَنِي مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِي أَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyan O' my father! Indeed hath come unto me, of the knowledge which hath not come unto thee, so follow me: I will guide thee on the path (which is) straight. See 19:42

item.title: Maryam:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ عَصِيًّا yāabati lā taʿbudi l-shayṭāna inna l-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyan Father! Do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan is disobedient to the All-beneficent.

item.title: Maryam:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ عَصِيًّا yāabati lā taʿbudi l-shayṭāna inna l-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyan O my father, do not worship (i.e., obey) Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient. See 19:41

item.title: Maryam:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ عَصِيًّا yāabati lā taʿbudi l-shayṭāna inna l-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyan O' my father! Worship not Satan; Verily Satan unto the Beneficent (God), was disobedient". See 19:42

item.title: Maryam:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيًّا yāabati innī akhāfu an yamassaka ʿadhābun mina l-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyan Father! I am indeed afraid that a punishment from the All-beneficent will befall you, and you will become Satan's accomplice.'

item.title: Maryam:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيًّا yāabati innī akhāfu an yamassaka ʿadhābun mina l-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyan O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion (in Hellfire)." See 19:41

item.title: Maryam:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيًّا yāabati innī akhāfu an yamassaka ʿadhābun mina l-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyan O' my father! Verily I fear that toucheth thee chastisement from the Beneficent (God), so that thou be unto Satan a friend. See 19:42

item.title: Maryam:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنْتَ عَنْ آلِهَتِي يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَاهْجُرْنِي مَلِيًّا qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyyan He said, 'Abraham! Are you renouncing my gods? If you do not relinquish, I will stone you. Keep away from me for a long while.'1

item.title: Maryam:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنْتَ عَنْ آلِهَتِي يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَاهْجُرْنِي مَلِيًّا qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyyan (His father) said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Ibrahim? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time." He (the father) said: "Do you revile my gods, O Ibrahim? If you stop not (this), I will La'arjumannak. So get away from me Maliyan (19:46). Ibrahim said: "Peace be on you! I will ask forgiveness of my Lord for you. Verily, He is unto me Hafiyyan (19:47). And I shall turn away from you and from those whom you invoke besides Allah. And I shall call upon my Lord, and I certainly hope that I shall not be unblessed in my invocation to my Lord (19:48). The…

item.title: Maryam:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنْتَ عَنْ آلِهَتِي يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَاهْجُرْنِي مَلِيًّا qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyyan Said he: "Inclineth (Incline against or turn against.) thou against my gods, O' Abraham; If thou didst desist not certainly I will stone thee; Begone from me for a long while." See 19:42

item.title: Maryam:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِي حَفِيًّا qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyyan He said, 'Peace be to you! I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you. Indeed He is gracious to me.

item.title: Maryam:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِي حَفِيًّا qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyyan (Ibrahim) said, "Peace (i.e., safety) will be upon you.1 I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me. See 19:46

item.title: Maryam:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِي حَفِيًّا qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyyan Said he: "Peace be on thee, I will (Refer to verse 9:114.) pray unto my Lord to forgive thee; Verily He unto me is most gracious." See 19:42

item.title: Maryam:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي عَسٰۤی أَلَّا أَكُونَ بِدُعَاءِ رَبِّي شَقِيًّا wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyyan I dissociate myself from you and whatever you invoke besides Allah. I will supplicate my Lord. Hopefully, I will not be disappointed in supplicating my Lord.'

item.title: Maryam:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي عَسٰۤی أَلَّا أَكُونَ بِدُعَاءِ رَبِّي شَقِيًّا wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyyan And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke1 my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy (i.e., disappointed)." See 19:46

item.title: Maryam:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي عَسٰۤی أَلَّا أَكُونَ بِدُعَاءِ رَبِّي شَقِيًّا wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyyan I withdraw from you (all) and what ye call upon other than God, and I call upon (only) my Lord; Happly in my prayer unto my Lord I shall not be unblest. See 19:42

item.title: Maryam:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyan So when he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each We made a prophet.

item.title: Maryam:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyan So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Ishaq and Ya'qub, and each (of them) We made a prophet. So when he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Ishaq and Ya'qub, and each one of them We made a Prophet (19:49). And We gave them of Our mercy, and We granted them Sidqin 'Aliyyan on the tongues (19:50). Allah Gave Ibrahim Ishaq and Ya'qub Allah, the Exalted, says that when the Friend of Allah (Ibrahim) withdrew from his father and his people for the sake of Allah, Allah gave him in exchange those who…

item.title: Maryam:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyan And when he withdrew from them and what they worshipped besides God, We granted unto him Isaac and Jacob; and each one of them made We an apostle. See 19:42

item.title: Maryam:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا wawahabnā lahum min raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyyan And We gave them out of Our mercy, and conferred on them a worthy and lofty repute.

item.title: Maryam:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا wawahabnā lahum min raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyyan And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention (i.e., reputation) of high honor. See 19:49

item.title: Maryam:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا wawahabnā lahum min raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyyan And granted We unto them of Our mercy, and assigned unto them a lofty tongue of truth fulness. 'The Truthful Tongue' stands for the mention of the actual position of his distinguished excellence to be raised in the generations of the human progeny. This was the grant of Abraham's prayer. See the grant of Abraham's prayer.1 Here it means that God decreed that the mention of the height of Abraham's excellence be sustained in the history of followers of the Holy Prophet Muhammad. In verse 26:84 Abraham prays to God to appoint for him a Truthful Tongue in his last generation. The first generation after Abraham which was honoured and prospered with pontified task, was the Israelite branch through Isaac which ended…

item.title: Maryam:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسٰی إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣan wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan And mention in the Book Moses. Indeed he was exclusively dedicated [to Allah], and an apostle and a prophet.

item.title: Maryam:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسٰی إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣan wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan And mention in the Book, Musa. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.1 And mention in the Book, Musa. Verily, he was Mukhlasan and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet (19:51). And We called him from the right side of the Mount (Tur), and made him draw near to Us for a talk with him (19:52). And We granted him his brother Harun, (also) a Prophet, out of Our mercy (19:53). Mentioning Musa and Harun After Allah had mentioned Ibrahim, the Friend of Allah, and commended him, he next mentioned Al-Kalim (the one spoken to by Allah directly). Allah said: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسَىٰ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا And mention in the Book, Musa.…

item.title: Maryam:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسٰی إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣan wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan And mention in the Book (Qur'an) about Moses; Verily he was one (Freed from the fetters of the sensual world.) freed, and he was an Apostle and a Prophet. For the difference of the two terms 'Rasul', i.e., apostle and 'Nabi', i.e., prophet used in the Qur'an, various accounts have been given, the most comprehensive is 'Nabi', i.e., one who is informed by God, and 'Rasool', i.e., a person who was sent to mankind by God with some message. Thus every 'Rasul' is necessarily a 'Nabi' but it is not necessary that every 'Nabi' be also a 'Rasul.' Therefore if 'Nubuwwat' ends, there can never be any room for any 'Risalat'.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا wanādaynāhu min jānibi l-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyan We called him from the right side of the Mount and We drew him near for confidential discourse.

item.title: Maryam:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا wanādaynāhu min jānibi l-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyan And We called him from the side of the mount1 at (his) right and brought him near, confiding (to him). See 19:51

item.title: Maryam:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا wanādaynāhu min jānibi l-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyan And We called unto him from the right side of the Mount Sinai, and made him draw nigh (unto Us) for a (Refer to verses 20:25 - 20:32.) communion. A voice had been sounded to Moses from the right side of Mount Sinai saying, "Verily, I am God, the Lord of the Worlds." (28:30). Aiman and Maisar - 'Maimana' and 'Maisara' - 'Yameen' and 'Shimal' are opposite terms used in Qur'an which may be translated as right and left - blessed and cursed respectively. However it means here and everywhere the term 'Aiman' directing towards godliness, and 'Aisar', the side directing towards the worldliness. (A.P.). This refers to the raising of Moses or his Ascension to the nearest state of communion befitting his devotional status. (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ نَبِيًّا wawahabnā lahu min raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyan And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet.

item.title: Maryam:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ نَبِيًّا wawahabnā lahu min raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyan And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Harun as a prophet. See 19:51

item.title: Maryam:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ نَبِيًّا wawahabnā lahu min raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyan And granted We unto him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron, (also) a Prophet. Moses had prayed to God to help him by allowing Aaron his brother to assist him for he was more eloquent and clearer in his speech.1 Similarly the Holy Prophet under the Command of God had appointed Ali to be his Vazier, his Vicegerent, his heir and Caliph. The Holy Prophet announced it in the open assembly of the Quraysh at the very inauguration of his ministry as the Apostle of God.2 The Holy Prophet had more than once declared 'O' Ali! Thou art to me as Aaron was to Moses.' In the state of the Ascension God declared to Moses that Haroon was also a prophet and all that he…

item.title: Maryam:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan And mention in the Book Ishmael. Indeed he was true to his promise, and an apostle and a prophet.

item.title: Maryam:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan And mention in the Book, Ismail. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet. And mention in the Book, Ismail. Verily, he was true to what he promised, and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet (19:54). And he would enjoin on his family and his people the Salah and the Zakah, and his Lord was pleased with him (19:55). Mentioning Ismail Here Allah has commended Ismail, the son of Ibrahim, the Friend of Allah. He (Ismail) is the father of all of the Arabs of the Hijaz because he was true to what he promised. Ibn Jurayj said, "He did not make any promise to his Lord, except that he…

item.title: Maryam:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan And (make) mention in the Book (Qur'an) Ishmael verily he was (ever) true to his promise, and he was an Apostle, a Prophet. Christianity claims God's grace to be an exclusive right of the heritage of Isaac and his seed but the Bible gives equal position to Ishmael. At Abraham's prayer for Ishmael, God said that He had heard the prayer1 which means apostleship will as well be in the seed of Ishmael.2 "And Abraham said unto God, O' that Ishmael might live before thee! "And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac; and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with…

item.title: Maryam:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ وَكَانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyan He used to bid his family to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakāt, and was pleasing to his Lord.

item.title: Maryam:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ وَكَانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyan And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing (i.e., accepted by Him). See 19:54

item.title: Maryam:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ وَكَانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyan And he was enjoining on his family, prayer and charity and was he unto his Lord well-pleasing. See 19:54

item.title: Maryam:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan And mention in the Book Idrīs. Indeed he was a truthful one, a prophet,

item.title: Maryam:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet. And mention in the Book, Idris. Verily, he was a man of truth, (and) a Prophet (19:56). And We raised him to a high station (19:57). Mentioning Idris Allah complimented Idris for being a truthful Prophet and He mentioned that he raised him to a high station. It has previously been mentioned that in the Sahih it is recorded that the Messenger of Allah SAW passed by Idris on the night of the Isra (Night Journey) and he (Idris) was in the fourth heaven. Sufyan reported from Mansur that Mujahid said: وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا And We raised him to a high station. "This means the fourth heaven." Al-Hasan…

item.title: Maryam:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan And mention in the Book (Qur'an) (about) Idris; verily he was a truthful one, a Prophet. Idris, i.e., Enoch of the Old Testament Gen. 5/24, Hebrew 11/5. Idris was the grandfather of the father of Noah. Idris was the son of the grandson of Sheeth. He was born a hundred years after the death of Adam (M.S)1. Idris was the first to start the art of writing, measuring the weights by a balance and to declare the knowledge about the movements of the heavenly bodies, i.e., the planets. He was the first man to make weapons and start the art of stitching (Tailoring).

item.title: Maryam:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyan and We raised him to a station exalted.

item.title: Maryam:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyan And We raised him to a high station. See 19:56

item.title: Maryam:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyan And We exalted him to a high station. Idris prayed so abundantly that even the angels wondered at his prayerfulness, and once Izrael the Angel of Death desired to visit Idris and God permitted him to do it in a human form. When Izrael in a human form stayed with Idris without taking any food or drink, Idris asked him as to who in fact he was. On being informed that he was Izrael the Angel of Death, Idris requested him to take his soul so that he might taste death. Izrael took his soul out of his body and again returned it into it. Thus, Idris died and was again alive. Then Idris desired to be taken into heaven to see what kind of place Hell and Paradise is. Izrael took Idris into…

item.title: Maryam:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْرَاءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَا إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُ الرَّحْمَنِ خَرُّوْۤا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu l-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadan wabukiyyan They are the ones whom Allah has blessed from among the prophets of Adam's progeny, and from [the progeny of] those We carried with Noah, and from among the progeny of Abraham and Israel, and from among those We guided and chose. When the signs of the All-beneficent were recited to them, they would fall down weeping in prostration.

item.title: Maryam:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْرَاءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَا إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُ الرَّحْمَنِ خَرُّوْۤا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu l-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadan wabukiyyan Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried (in the ship) with Nuh, and of the descendants of Ibrahim and Israel (i.e., Ya'qub), and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping. Those were they unto whom Allah bestowed His grace from among the Prophets, of the offspring of Adam, and…

item.title: Maryam:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْرَاءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَا إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُ الرَّحْمَنِ خَرُّوْۤا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu l-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadan wabukiyyan These are they on whom did God bestow (His) bounties, from among the prophets of the posterity of Adam; and of those whom We did bare with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel, (Jacob.) and of those whom We did guide and We did choose; When the signs of the Beneficent (God) were rehearsed unto them, they fell down prostrating (in obeisance) and weeping. See 19:57

item.title: Maryam:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū l-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū l-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan But they were succeeded by an evil posterity who neglected the prayer, and followed [their base] appetites. So they will soon encounter [the reward of] perversity,

item.title: Maryam:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū l-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū l-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan But there came after them successors (i.e., later generations) who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil1. Then, there has succeeded them a posterity who have lost the Salah and have followed lusts. So they will meet Ghaiy (19:59). Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness. Such will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in aught (19:60). They were Succeeded by Wicked People and Good People After Allah mentioned the party of blessed ones – the Prophets and those who followed them by maintainig the limits set by Allah and His commandments, fulfilling what Allah ordered and avoiding His prohibitions – then He mentions: (خَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ) there…

item.title: Maryam:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
