item.description: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū l-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū l-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan But followed after them a succession who neglected prayers and they followed lust, so they shall soon meet perdition, Not all of their posterity1 - which asserts that of the posterity, there are those selected persons who are foremost in all that is excellent and good - and who are by the permission of God, the Topmost ones - and here also exception is made in the next few verses 19:60 - 19:63. (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shayan barring those who repent, believe, and act righteously. Such will enter paradise, and they will not be wronged in the least.

item.title: Maryam:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shayan Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all. See 19:59

item.title: Maryam:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shayan Except he who repented and believed and did good, then these shall enter the garden {of Paradise), and they shall not be dealt with unjustly in aught, See 19:59

item.title: Maryam:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada l-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyyan Gardens of Eden promised by the All-beneficent to His servants, [while they were still] unseen. Indeed His promise is bound to come to pass.

item.title: Maryam:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada l-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyyan (Therein are) gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.1 (They will enter) 'Adn Gardens which the Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the unseen. Verily, His promise must come to pass (19:61). They shall not hear therein any Laghw, but only Salam. And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and afternoon (19:62). Such is the Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who had Taqwa (19:63). The Description of the Gardens of the Truthful and Those Who Repent Allah, the Exalted, says that the Gardens (of Paradise), which the penitent will enter, will be…

item.title: Maryam:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada l-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyyan The gardens of eternity which the Beneficent (God) hath promised unto His servants, while (While the gardens are not seen now.) unseen; Verily His promise shall come to pass. The word 'Unseen' indicates that the description of the pleasure or pain, i.e., of Paradise and Hell given in Qur'an, is not something familiar to be identified with the sensual pleasure and pain of the world. So whatever is said, is a figurative presentation, the means of pleasures and pains of the Next World for the perception of which all senses have not yet developed - or otherwise there is no morning or evening in Paradise mentioned in verse 19:62.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَامًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāman walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'ratan waʿashiyyan Therein they will not hear vain talk, but only 'Peace!' And therein they will have their provision morning and evening.

item.title: Maryam:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَامًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāman walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'ratan waʿashiyyan They will not hear therein any ill speech - only (greetings of) peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَامًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāman walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'ratan waʿashiyyan They will hear not therein any vain discourse, but only 'Peace' (Only Peace from the angels.) , and they shall have their sustenance therein, morning and evening. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَنْ كَانَ تَقِيًّا til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyan This is the paradise We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who are Godwary.

item.title: Maryam:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَنْ كَانَ تَقِيًّا til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyan That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَنْ كَانَ تَقِيًّا til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyan This is the garden (Paradise) which We shall cause to be inherited by those of Our servants who are pious. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyan 'We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is in between that, and your Lord is not forgetful.

item.title: Maryam:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyan (Jibril said),1 "And we (angels) descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful. And we descend not except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two; and your Lord is never forgetful (19:64). Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, so worship Him and abide patiently in His worship. Do you know of any who is similar to Him (19:65).…

item.title: Maryam:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyan (Say the (The angels hinted. Refer to verse 19:62.) angels, "O' Apostle of God, Muhammad!) "We come not down (from heaven) but by the command of thy Lord; His is whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is between these! And thy Lord is not (Refer to verse 20:126.) forgetful." See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyan The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. So worship Him and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know anyone who could be His namesake?'

item.title: Maryam:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyan Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?" See 19:64

item.title: Maryam:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyan The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what (ever) is between them; so worship Him (alone), and be steadfast in His worship! Knowest thou of any other (worthy of being) named (with) of the same name? (as He)? See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayyan Man says, 'Shall I, when I have died, be brought forth alive?'

item.title: Maryam:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayyan And man (i.e., the disbeliever) says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?" And man says: When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive? (19:66). Does not man remember that We created him before, while he was nothing (19:67). So by your Lord, surely We shall gather them together, and (also) the Shayatin, then We shall bring them round Hell, Jithyya (19:68). Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Gracious (19:69). Then, verily, We know best those who are most worthy of being burnt therein (19:70). Man's Amazement about Life after Death and the Refutation against this Amazement Allah, the Exalted, informs that…

item.title: Maryam:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayyan And sayeth man: "What! When I am dead shall I be brought forth alive?" See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayan Does not man remember that We created him before when he was nothing?

item.title: Maryam:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayan Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing? See 19:66

item.title: Maryam:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayan What! Beareth not man in mind that We created him before when he was naught. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyan By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will surely bring them up around hell [scrambling] on their knees.1

item.title: Maryam:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyan So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.1 See 19:66

item.title: Maryam:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyan So by thy Lord! Most certainly will we gather them together and the Satan, then shall We certainly bring them forth round the Hell on their (Or in groups.) knees. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ عِتِيًّا thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā l-raḥmāni ʿitiyyan Then from every group We shall draw whichever of them was more defiant to the All-beneficent.

item.title: Maryam:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ عِتِيًّا thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā l-raḥmāni ʿitiyyan Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence. See 19:66

item.title: Maryam:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ عِتِيًّا thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā l-raḥmāni ʿitiyyan Then shall We certainly pick out from every group of them those who against the Beneficent (God) were more intensely (The Ring Leaders of the rebels.) rebellious. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَى بِهَا صِلِيًّا thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyan Then surely We will know best those who deserve most to enter it.

item.title: Maryam:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَى بِهَا صِلِيًّا thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyan Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein. See 19:66

item.title: Maryam:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَى بِهَا صِلِيًّا thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyan And certainly, We do know best those (The Ring Leaders of the rebels.) who deserve most to be burnt therein. See 19:61

item.title: Maryam:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا wa-in minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyyan There is none of you but will come to it:1 a [matter that is a] decided certainty with your Lord.

item.title: Maryam:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا wa-in minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyyan And there is none of you except he will come to it.1 This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed. There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell); this is with your Lord, a decree which must be accomplished (19:71). Then We shall save those who had Taqwa. And We shall leave the wrongdoers in it, Jithiyya (19:72). Everyone will be Brought to Hell, Then the Righteous will be Saved Ibn Jarir reported from 'Abdullah that he said concerning Allah's statement: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا There is not one of you but will pass over it. "The bridge over Hell is like the sharp edge of a sword. The first group to cross it will pass like a…

item.title: Maryam:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا wa-in minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyyan And (there is) not one of you but shall go down unto it; This is of thy Lord a decided (unavoidable) decree To this universal proposition, an exception be taken, of those who are the First and the Foremost in receiving the Divine grace and blessings mentioned in verses 21:101 - 21:107 and they are the group.1 There remain two other groups of the right and the left - both will be gathered round the Hell, in groups, and of them, undoubtedly all shall enter Hell, but for the rightists, Hell will be of no effect and they will come out of it and the leftists or the unjust ones will remain in it.2 (A.P.).

item.title: Maryam:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu l-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyan Then We will deliver those who are Godwary, and leave the wrongdoers in it, fallen on their knees.

item.title: Maryam:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu l-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyan Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees. See 19:71

item.title: Maryam:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu l-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyan And then will We deliver those who guarded (themselves) against evil, and We will leave the unjust on their knees. See 19:71

item.title: Maryam:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrun maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyyan When Our manifest signs are recited to them, the faithless say to the faithful, 'Which of the two sides is superior in station1 and better with respect to company?'2

item.title: Maryam:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrun maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyyan And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of (our) two parties is best in position and best in association?"1 And when Our clear Ayat are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: Which of the two groups has the best dwellings and the finest Nadiyyan? (19:73). And how many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were better in wealth, goods and outward appearance (19:74). The Disbelievers Boast over Their Good Fortune in the World Allah, the Exalted, informs that when the clear, evident Ayat of Allah are recited to…

item.title: Maryam:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrun maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyyan And when Our clear signs are rehearsed unto them, say those who disbelieve unto those who believe, which of the two parties is best in position? And which is the most goodly company? See 19:71

item.title: Maryam:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِءْيًا wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthan wari'yan How many a generation We have destroyed before them, who were superior in furnishings and appearance!

item.title: Maryam:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِءْيًا wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthan wari'yan And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and (outward) appearance? See 19:73

item.title: Maryam:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِءْيًا wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthan wari'yan And how many of the generations We did destroy before them, they were (even) better in riches and in (Outward attraction.) splendour. See 19:71

item.title: Maryam:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الضَّلَالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ مَدًّا حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُنْدًا qul man kāna fī l-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu l-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā l-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun makānan wa-aḍʿafu jundan Say, 'Whoever abides in error, the All-beneficent shall prolong his respite until they sight what they have been promised: either punishment, or the Hour.' Then they will know whose position is worse, and whose host is weaker.

item.title: Maryam:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الضَّلَالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ مَدًّا حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُنْدًا qul man kāna fī l-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu l-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā l-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun makānan wa-aḍʿafu jundan Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension (in wealth and time) until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment (in this world) or the Hour (of resurrection) - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers." Say: whoever is in error, the Most Gracious will extend (circumstances) for him, until, when they see that which they were promised, either the torment or the Hour, they will come to know who is worst…

item.title: Maryam:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الضَّلَالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ مَدًّا حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُنْدًا qul man kāna fī l-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu l-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā l-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun makānan wa-aḍʿafu jundan Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "As to those who are in error, the Beneficent (God) will certainly lengthen (Respite. Refer to verse 2:96.) the span (of their) life; until behold they what they were promised, be it the chastisement (in this world) or the Hour (of Doom); Then shall they know who is worse placed and (who is the) weakest in forces!" The wicked are given a respite and not that they have been left for ever to enjoy wickedness. The passage means that for those who are in…

item.title: Maryam:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَرَدًّا wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudan wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun maraddan Allah enhances in guidance those who are [rightly] guided, and lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward, and better at the return [to Allah].

item.title: Maryam:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَرَدًّا wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudan wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun maraddan And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord1 for reward and better for recourse. And Allah increases in guidance those who walk aright. And the righteous good deeds that last are better with your Lord for reward and better for resort (19:76). Increasing Guidance of Those Who are Guided After Allah mentions the extended time and respite that is allowed to those who are in misguidance, increasing them in misguidance, He informs of the increase in guidance of those who are rightly guided. Similarly He says: وَإِذَا مَا أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ أَيُّكُمْ زَادَتْهُ هَٰذِهِ إِيمَانًا And whenever there comes down a…

item.title: Maryam:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَرَدًّا wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudan wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun maraddan And God increaseth in guidance those who are guided aright; and the everlasting good deeds are best with thy Lord, in recompense and best in (the ultimate) return. See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālan wawaladan Have you not regarded him who defies Our signs, and says, 'I will surely be given wealth and children'?

item.title: Maryam:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālan wawaladan Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children (in the next life)"? Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayat and said: I shall certainly be given wealth and children (if I live again) (19:77). Has he known the Unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Gracious (19:78). Nay, We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment (19:79). And We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of, and he shall come to Us alone (19:80). Refuting the Disbelievers Who Claim that They will be Given Wealth and Children in the Hereafter Imam Ahmad reported from Khabbab bin Al-Aratt that he said, I…

item.title: Maryam:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālan wawaladan Have thou then seen him who disbelieveth in Our signs and sayeth: "I shall surely be given wealth and children (sons)" See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan Has he come to know the Unseen, or taken a promise from the All-beneficent?

item.title: Maryam:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise? See 19:77

item.title: Maryam:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan Hath he got into the (secret) knowledge of the unseen? or hath taken from the Beneficent (God) a promise? See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi maddan No indeed! We will write down what he says, and We will prolong his punishment endlessly.

item.title: Maryam:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi maddan No! We will record what he says and extend (i.e., increase) for him from the punishment extensively. See 19:77

item.title: Maryam:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi maddan By no means! We will write down what he sayeth and We will lengthen for him the length of the chastisement. See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā fardan We shall take over from him what he talks about,1 and he will come to Us alone.

item.title: Maryam:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā fardan And We will inherit him (in) what he mentions,1 and he will come to Us alone. See 19:77

item.title: Maryam:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā fardan And We will inherit (Record – Reserve.) what he spake of, and he shall come unto Us all alone. See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan liyakūnū lahum ʿizzan They have taken gods besides Allah that they may be a [source of] might to them:

item.title: Maryam:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan liyakūnū lahum ʿizzan And they have taken besides Allah (false) deities that they would be for them (a source of) honor. And they have taken gods besides Allah, that they might give them honor, power and glory (19:81). Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and will become their adversaries (19:82). See you not that We have sent the Shayatin against the disbelievers to push them to do evil (19:83). So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number (19:84). The Idols of the Polytheists will Deny Their Worship Allah, the Exalted, informs about the disbelievers who associate partners with their Lord, that they have taken gods besides Allah, so that these gods may be a source of honor…

item.title: Maryam:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan liyakūnū lahum ʿizzan They have taken gods besides God that they shall be unto them a source of strength, See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddan No Indeed! Soon they will disown their worship, and they will be their opponents.

item.title: Maryam:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddan No! They (i.e., those "gods") will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents (on the Day of Judgement). See 19:81

item.title: Maryam:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddan By no means! Soon shall they disavow their worship, and they shall unto them be adversaries. See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا alam tara annā arsalnā l-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azzan Have you not regarded that We unleash the devils upon the faithless to urge them impetuously?

item.title: Maryam:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا alam tara annā arsalnā l-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azzan Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them (to evil) with (constant) incitement? See 19:81

item.title: Maryam:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا alam tara annā arsalnā l-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azzan What! Seest (This indicates that the Holy Prophet could visualise the satanic forces misleading the disbelievers.) thou not that We have sent satans against the dis believers to incite them with an incitement (to sin), See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddan So do not make haste against them; indeed We are counting1 for them, a counting [down].

item.title: Maryam:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddan So be not impatient over them. We only count out (i.e., allow) to them a (limited) number.1 See 19:81

item.title: Maryam:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddan So be not thou in haste against them, We only count (Numbering.) unto them a limited number (of days). See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ وَفْدًا yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā l-raḥmāni wafdan The day We shall gather the Godwary toward the All-beneficent, on mounts,1

item.title: Maryam:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ وَفْدًا yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā l-raḥmāni wafdan On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation. The Day We shall gather those with Taqwa unto the Most Gracious (Allah), like a delegation (19:85). And We shall drive the criminals to Hell, in a thirsty state (19:86). None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from the Most Gracious (Allah) (19:87). The Condition of the Righteous and the Criminals on the Day of Resurrection Allah, the Exalted, informs about His righteous friends, who feared Him in the life of this world. They followed His Messengers and believed in what the Messengers told them. They obeyed them in what they commanded them and abstained from that which they prohibited. Allah explains that…

item.title: Maryam:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ وَفْدًا yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā l-raḥmāni wafdan On the day (of resurrection) We will gather the pious ones unto the Beneficent (God) like the guests of honour, See 19:75

item.title: Maryam:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'dan and drive the guilty as a thirsty herd towards hell.

item.title: Maryam:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'dan And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst. See 19:85

item.title: Maryam:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'dan But We will drive the guilty ones, unto Hell like (the thirsty) herd (to the watering place). It is made clear here that redemption or intercession is a fact but reserved to only those who have earned the covenant from the Lord to do it. And who else could deserve or be entitled to the covenant, than those who have surrendered their selves (the martyrs) in the Way of the Lord; and the Islamic World as a whole unanimously acknowledges that the world never witnessed a greater martyrdom than that which was enacted at Karbala and the greatest martyr in the Cause of God was Husayn, whose martyrdom God Himself has termed as 'Azeem' 'Great.'1 It is a historic fact that the Holy Prophet was poisoned by the Jewess of…

item.title: Maryam:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا lā yamlikūna l-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan No one will have the power to intercede [with Allah], except for him who has taken a covenant with the All-beneficent.

item.title: Maryam:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا lā yamlikūna l-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan None will have (power of) intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.1 See 19:85

item.title: Maryam:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا lā yamlikūna l-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan They shall own (The right of - Power of – Possess.) not any intercession, save he who hath taken a promise from the Beneficent (God to do so). See 19:86

item.title: Maryam:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan They say, 'The All-beneficent has taken a son!'

item.title: Maryam:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken (for Himself) a son." And they say: The Most Gracious (Allah) has begotten a son (19:88). Indeed you have brought forth (said) a thing Idda (19:89). Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains Hadda (19:90). That they ascribe a son to the Most Gracious (19:91). But it is not suitable for the Most Gracious that He should beget a son (19:92). There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Gracious as a slave (19:93). Verily, He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting (19:94). And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection (19:95). The Stern Rejection of Attributing a…

item.title: Maryam:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan And say they: "The Beneficent (God) hath taken unto Him a son!" How much the Christian belief in Jesus as the son of God, i.e., assigning a God a son, is abhorred by God, is obvious from these verses. Such a wrong belief is so abominable that it has been repeated and frequently been refuted in the Holy Qur'an.

item.title: Maryam:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا laqad ji'tum shayan iddan You have certainly advanced something hideous!

item.title: Maryam:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا laqad ji'tum shayan iddan You have done an atrocious thing. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا laqad ji'tum shayan iddan Indeed, have ye put forth a thing (most) monstrous! See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu haddan The heavens are about to be rent apart at it, the earth to split open, and the mountains to collapse into bits,

item.title: Maryam:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu haddan The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu haddan Might the heavens be almost rent thereat, and the earth cleaveth asunder, and the mountains fall down in (Pieces.) fragments, See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدًا an daʿaw lilrraḥmāni waladan that they should ascribe a son to the All-beneficent!

item.title: Maryam:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدًا an daʿaw lilrraḥmāni waladan That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدًا an daʿaw lilrraḥmāni waladan That they should ascribe unto the Beneficent (God) a son! See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَنِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni an yattakhidha waladan It does not behoove the All-beneficent to take a son.

item.title: Maryam:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَنِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni an yattakhidha waladan And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَنِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni an yattakhidha waladan And it behoveth not the Beneficent (God) that He should take (unto Him) (any one) a son. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا ءَاتِي الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدًا in kullu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī l-raḥmāni ʿabdan There is none in the heavens and the earth but he comes to the All-beneficent as a servant.

item.title: Maryam:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا ءَاتِي الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدًا in kullu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī l-raḥmāni ʿabdan There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا ءَاتِي الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدًا in kullu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī l-raḥmāni ʿabdan None there is in the heavens and the earth but must come unto the Beneficent (God) as a servant. (As a creature of God, the Holy Prophet is the First in this order – Refer to verse 43:81.) See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَحْصَاهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddan Certainly He has counted them [all] and numbered them precisely,

item.title: Maryam:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَحْصَاهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddan He has enumerated them and counted them a (full) counting. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ أَحْصَاهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddan And indeed He hath an account of (all), and numbered them (with) an exact numbering. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرْدًا wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati fardan and each of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection.

item.title: Maryam:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرْدًا wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati fardan And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone. See 19:88

item.title: Maryam:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرْدًا wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati fardan And each one of them shall come unto him on the Day of Judgment, singly (alone). The love of God and the godly ones is an automatic result of one's belief in God and leading a righteous life of goodness on earth. Love begets love, and one who sincerely loves God will naturally be loved by God. A man asked the Sixth Holy Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq as to how he (the man) could know if God is pleased with him or not. The Holy Imam said that it was very easy for if he is pleased with God naturally God also will be pleased with him.

item.title: Maryam:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ وُدًّا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu l-raḥmānu wuddan Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds —the All-beneficent will endear them [to His creation].

item.title: Maryam:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ وُدًّا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu l-raḥmānu wuddan Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.1 Verily, those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Gracious will bestow love for them (19:96). So, We have made this easy in your own tongue, only that you may give glad tidings to those who have Taqwa, and warn with it the people that are Ludda (19:97). And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them (19:98). Allah Places Love of the Righteous People in the Hearts Allah, the Exalted, informs about His believing servants, who work righteous deeds – deeds that He is pleased…

item.title: Maryam:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ وُدًّا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu l-raḥmānu wuddan Verily those who believe and work good deeds the Beneficent (God) will appoint love for them. (The best example of it in verse 42:23.) See 19:95

item.title: Maryam:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنْذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًا لُدًّا fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawman luddan Indeed We have made it simple in your language so that you may give good news thereby to the Godwary and warn with it a disputatious lot.

item.title: Maryam:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنْذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًا لُدًّا fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawman luddan So, (O Muḥammad), We have only made it (i.e., the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue (i.e., the Arabic language) that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people. See 19:96

item.title: Maryam:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنْذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًا لُدًّا fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawman luddan So have We only made it (Qur'an) easy (Fluent - Refers to the repeated rhythm of Yassarna in Surah 54.) in thine own tongue (Refer to verses 20:25 - 20:29.) that thou mayest give glad tidings thereby unto the pious ones, and warn by it a people (who are) contentious. See 19:95

item.title: Maryam:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'zan How many a generation We have destroyed before them! Can you descry any one of them, or hear from them so much as a murmur?

item.title: Maryam:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'zan And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound? See 19:96

item.title: Maryam:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'zan And how many of the generations We did destroy before them? Dost thou find out any one (anywhere)? or dost thou hear (even) a whisper (of them)? See 19:95

item.title: Muhammad:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi aḍalla aʿmālahum Those who are [themselves] faithless and bar [others] from the way of Allah —He has made their works go awry.

item.title: Muhammad:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi aḍalla aʿmālahum Those who disbelieve and avert (people) from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.1 الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ - وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَآمَنُوا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ - ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ 1. Those who disbelieve and hinder (men) from the path of Allah, He will render their deeds vain. 2. But those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and believe in that which is sent down to Muhammad – for it is the truth from their Lord – He expiates from them their sins and amends their Bal. 3.…

item.title: Muhammad:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi aḍalla aʿmālahum Those who disbelieve and hinder (others) from the Path of God, He shall render in vain (This asserts that mere good deeds without the correct faith will be of no avail. See note to Verse 2.) their deeds Generally, commentators ascribe this verse to the conduct of the disbelievers like Nazr and Utbah and the others who were not only themselves on the wrong path, but also prevented the others from getting aright. There is another very reasonable and very logical interpretation of this verse. The concluding words, 'He (God) shall render their (good) works null and void' suggest the people meant by this verse could also be those believers who did a good thing by embracing Islam and consequently having done many other…

item.title: Muhammad:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَءَامَنُوْۤا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waāmanū bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa l-ḥaqu min rabbihim kaffara ʿanhum sayyiātihim wa-aṣlaḥa bālahum But those who have faith and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down to Muḥammad —and it is the truth from their Lord— He shall absolve them of their misdeeds and set right their affairs.

item.title: Muhammad:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَءَامَنُوْۤا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waāmanū bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa l-ḥaqu min rabbihim kaffara ʿanhum sayyiātihim wa-aṣlaḥa bālahum And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition. See 47:1

item.title: Muhammad:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَءَامَنُوْۤا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waāmanū bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa l-ḥaqu min rabbihim kaffara ʿanhum sayyiātihim wa-aṣlaḥa bālahum And those who believe and do good, and believe in what hath been sent down unto (Our Apostle) Muhammad, and (that) it is the truth from their Lord, He (God) will remove (Shortcomings of the believers will be redressed. A contrast to note to Verse 1.) from them their evils, and (shall) improve their state. Belief in God necessarily includes the belief in His Word, i.e., the Holy Qur'an, and the belief in what was sent down to the Holy Prophet would mean something particularly important and different from the general revelations. A reference to this special revelation is found in verse 5:67 under…

item.title: Muhammad:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-anna alladhīna kafarū ittabaʿū l-bāṭila wa-anna alladhīna āmanū ittabaʿū l-ḥaqa min rabbihim kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu lilnnāsi amthālahum That is because the faithless follow falsehood, and because the faithful follow the truth from their Lord. That is how Allah draws comparisons for mankind.

item.title: Muhammad:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-anna alladhīna kafarū ittabaʿū l-bāṭila wa-anna alladhīna āmanū ittabaʿū l-ḥaqa min rabbihim kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu lilnnāsi amthālahum That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.1 See 47:1

item.title: Muhammad:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-anna alladhīna kafarū ittabaʿū l-bāṭila wa-anna alladhīna āmanū ittabaʿū l-ḥaqa min rabbihim kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu lilnnāsi amthālahum That is because, those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord; Thus doth God set forth unto the people their examples (of the righteous and the wicked) . See 47:2

item.title: Muhammad:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَثْخَنْتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوْۤا الْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَاءً حَتّٰی تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ذٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لِيَبْلُوَا بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ قُتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَنْ يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ fa-idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū faḍarba l-riqābi ḥattā idhā athkhantumūhum fashuddū l-wathāqa fa-immā mannan baʿdu wa-immā fidāan ḥattā taḍaʿa l-ḥarbu awzārahā dhālika walaw yashāu l-lahu la-intaṣara min'hum walākin liyabluwā baʿḍakum bibaʿḍin wa-alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi falan yuḍilla aʿmālahum When you meet the faithless in battle, strike their necks. When you have thoroughly decimated them, bind the captives firmly. Thereafter either oblige them [by setting them free] or take ransom till the war lays down its burdens. That [is Allah's ordinance], and had Allah wished He could have taken vengeance on them,1 but that He may test some of you by means of…

item.title: Muhammad:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَثْخَنْتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوْۤا الْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَاءً حَتّٰی تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ذٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لِيَبْلُوَا بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ قُتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَنْ يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ fa-idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū faḍarba l-riqābi ḥattā idhā athkhantumūhum fashuddū l-wathāqa fa-immā mannan baʿdu wa-immā fidāan ḥattā taḍaʿa l-ḥarbu awzārahā dhālika walaw yashāu l-lahu la-intaṣara min'hum walākin liyabluwā baʿḍakum bibaʿḍin wa-alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi falan yuḍilla aʿmālahum So when you meet those who disbelieve (in battle), strike (their) necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure (their) bonds,1 and either (confer) favor2 afterwards or ransom (them) until the war lays down its burdens.3 That (is the command). And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them (Himself), but (He ordered armed struggle) to test some…

item.title: Muhammad:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَثْخَنْتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوْۤا الْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَاءً حَتّٰی تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ذٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لِيَبْلُوَا بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ قُتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَنْ يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ fa-idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū faḍarba l-riqābi ḥattā idhā athkhantumūhum fashuddū l-wathāqa fa-immā mannan baʿdu wa-immā fidāan ḥattā taḍaʿa l-ḥarbu awzārahā dhālika walaw yashāu l-lahu la-intaṣara min'hum walākin liyabluwā baʿḍakum bibaʿḍin wa-alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi falan yuḍilla aʿmālahum So when ye encounter those who disbelieve (in a battle) then smite the necks (This refers to the infidels who attack the believers with unprovoked aggression and not the others. Refer to note on verse 2:256, 10:41, 109:6. This was a strictly defensive ordinance issued after the unprovoked aggression at Badr.) until when ye have routed wounding them (rendering them helpless) and take them…

item.title: Muhammad:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ sayahdīhim wayuṣ'liḥu bālahum He will guide them and set right their affairs,

item.title: Muhammad:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ sayahdīhim wayuṣ'liḥu bālahum He will guide them and amend their condition. See 47:4

item.title: Muhammad:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ sayahdīhim wayuṣ'liḥu bālahum Soon will He guide them aright and improve their state; See 47:4

item.title: Muhammad:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ wayud'khiluhumu l-janata ʿarrafahā lahum and admit them into paradise with which He has acquainted them.

item.title: Muhammad:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ wayud'khiluhumu l-janata ʿarrafahā lahum And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them. See 47:4

item.title: Muhammad:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ wayud'khiluhumu l-janata ʿarrafahā lahum And admit them to the garden which He hath made known to them. See 47:4

item.title: Muhammad:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ تَنْصُرُوْۤا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tanṣurū l-laha yanṣur'kum wayuthabbit aqdāmakum O you who have faith! If you help Allah, He will help you and make your feet steady.

item.title: Muhammad:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ تَنْصُرُوْۤا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tanṣurū l-laha yanṣur'kum wayuthabbit aqdāmakum O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet. See 47:4

item.title: Muhammad:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ تَنْصُرُوْۤا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tanṣurū l-laha yanṣur'kum wayuthabbit aqdāmakum firm (This verse to be read with 8:12, 14:27.) your feet. God's making firm the feet of the believers, is conditional, i.e., subject to their helping the cause of God. It does not mean that God is helpless and He appeals to man to help Him. It is to prove the worth of the calibre of the people themselves and to manifest their inherent qualities to justify the bestowal of His grace and bounties on them. Thus, those who fled away from the battle-fields deserting Islam and the Holy Prophet are naturally those who are not firm in their feet1. This fact is proved from the rebellious conduct, of the people in their covetous hunt for undue power and position, immediately as…

item.title: Muhammad:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَتَعْسًا لَهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ wa-alladhīna kafarū fataʿsan lahum wa-aḍalla aʿmālahum As for the faithless, their lot will be to fall [into ruin],1 and He will make their works go awry.

item.title: Muhammad:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَتَعْسًا لَهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ wa-alladhīna kafarū fataʿsan lahum wa-aḍalla aʿmālahum But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds. See 47:4

item.title: Muhammad:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَتَعْسًا لَهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ wa-alladhīna kafarū fataʿsan lahum wa-aḍalla aʿmālahum And those who disbelieve, stumbling (with destruction) shall be for them, and He shall render (all) their (good) deeds in vain. See 47:7

item.title: Muhammad:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahum karihū mā anzala l-lahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum That is because they loathed what Allah has sent down, so He made their works fail.

item.title: Muhammad:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahum karihū mā anzala l-lahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds. See 47:4

item.title: Muhammad:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahum karihū mā anzala l-lahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum That is for they hated what God sent down, so shall He render null their deeds. This verse clearly says the fate of those described in the previous one, i.e., all their good deeds are consequently wiped out after their deserting the Holy Prophet and running away from the battle-fields, there did not remain the least credit to them for their goodness. This indicates that disliking any portion of the revelation renders the other deeds null and void - as Tabari tells us about the conversation which took place between Ibn Abbas and Omar the kalif while the latter said 'Quraysh did not like the apostleship and the caliphate both to be in the house of Hasham so they chose their own man'. Ibn…

item.title: Muhammad:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْثَالُهَا afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim dammara l-lahu ʿalayhim walil'kāfirīna amthāluhā Have they not travelled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? Allah destroyed them, and a similar [fate] awaits the faithless.

item.title: Muhammad:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْثَالُهَا afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim dammara l-lahu ʿalayhim walil'kāfirīna amthāluhā Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed (everything) over them,1 and for the disbelievers is something comparable. Have they not traveled through the earth and seen what happened in the end to those before them? Allah destroyed them completely, and a similar (awaits) the disbelievers (47:10). That is because Allah is the Protector of those who believe, whereas the disbelievers have no protector (47:11). Certainly Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous good deeds, into Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise); while those who disbelieve enjoy their life and eat as cattle eat; but…

item.title: Muhammad:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْثَالُهَا afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim dammara l-lahu ʿalayhim walil'kāfirīna amthāluhā What! have they not travelled in the earth and seen how was the end of those before them? God brought destruction on them, and for the disbelievers shall be the like unto it. See 47:9

item.title: Muhammad:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَأَنَّ الْكَافِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَى لَهُمْ dhālika bi-anna l-laha mawlā alladhīna āmanū wa-anna l-kāfirīna lā mawlā lahum That is because Allah is the protector of the faithful, and because the faithless have no protector.

item.title: Muhammad:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَأَنَّ الْكَافِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَى لَهُمْ dhālika bi-anna l-laha mawlā alladhīna āmanū wa-anna l-kāfirīna lā mawlā lahum That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector. See 47:10

item.title: Muhammad:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَأَنَّ الْكَافِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَى لَهُمْ dhālika bi-anna l-laha mawlā alladhīna āmanū wa-anna l-kāfirīna lā mawlā lahum That is for God is the guardian of those who believe, and that the infidels, there shall not be any guardian ('Mawla' here means a guardian & in 45:19 means a 'Friend'.) for them. Note the title 'Mawla' (Master) or the Lord, used for God, the same title is used for the Holy Prophet 5:55 and 33:6. The same word has been used by the Holy Prophet for 'Ali at Ghadir Khumm.1 Thus the position of 'Ali in relation to the Ummate-Muhammadi, i.e., the Muslim people, is that of the Holy Prophet as 'Khalifat Allah', a Deputy of God on earth. Nothing else could have been said for 'Ali. 'Mawla' here means 'Guardian' and in 45:19 it means…

item.title: Muhammad:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْأَنْعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wa-alladhīna kafarū yatamattaʿūna wayakulūna kamā takulu l-anʿāmu wal-nāru mathwan lahum Indeed Allah will admit those who have faith and do righteous deeds into gardens with streams running in them. As for the faithless, they enjoy and eat just like the cattle eat, and the Fire will be their [final] abode.

item.title: Muhammad:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْأَنْعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wa-alladhīna kafarū yatamattaʿūna wayakulūna kamā takulu l-anʿāmu wal-nāru mathwan lahum Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them. See 47:10

item.title: Muhammad:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْأَنْعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wa-alladhīna kafarū yatamattaʿūna wayakulūna kamā takulu l-anʿāmu wal-nāru mathwan lahum Verily, God will admit those who believe and do good, to the gardens 'neath which flow rivers; and those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as the beasts (Refer to verses 8:55 & 25:44.) eat, and the fire shall be their abode. Those who are exclusively covetous of this life and the happiness in this world, are mindful of their physical welfare, always after enjoying various kinds of delicious food and the fulfilment of various kinds of carnal desires and the other vain amusements. They do not have any inkling of the spiritual welfare in the…

item.title: Muhammad:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِنْ قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ waka-ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatī akhrajatka ahlaknāhum falā nāṣira lahum How many a town there has been which was more powerful than your town which expelled you, which We have destroyed, and they had no helper.

item.title: Muhammad:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِنْ قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ waka-ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatī akhrajatka ahlaknāhum falā nāṣira lahum And how many a city was stronger than your city (i.e., Makkah) which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them. See 47:10

item.title: Muhammad:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِنْ قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ waka-ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatī akhrajatka ahlaknāhum falā nāṣira lahum And how many a town which was mightier in power than thy town which hath driven thee out; We destroyed them, and no helper was there for them. The town referred to, is Mecca which the Holy Prophet was forced to leave. He loved the town so very much that while leaving it, he turned round to it and addressing it he said, "O' Mecca! Thou art the one whom I loved the most, had I not been forced by the disbelievers, and commanded by the Lord, I would never have left thee." This verse contains the prophecy of the overthrow of the then authority of the heathens who held sway over…

item.title: Muhammad:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ كَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum Is he who stands on a manifest proof from his Lord like someone to whom the evil of his conduct is made to seem decorous, and who follow their desires?

item.title: Muhammad:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ كَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their (own) desires? Can then he, who stands on clear evidence from his Lord, be like those for whom their evil deeds are beautified for them, while they follow their own lusts (47:14). The description of Paradise which is promised to those who have Taqwa, (is that) in it are rivers of water that are not Asin, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink it, and rivers of refined honey; and therein for them are all kinds…

item.title: Muhammad:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ كَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum What! is he (The Holy Prophet. Refer to verse 11:17.) who is on (the path of the) clear proofs from his Lord like unto him whom the evil of his work is made fairseeming; and follow they their (own) vain desires? Such examples, of the opposites never being equal, have been repeatedly given in the Holy Qur'an, to warn man, against committing such blunders while choosing a leader for him, or fixing an ideal for him to follow in his practical life in this world1. The Divine Mercy is obviously interested in providing as many cautions and as many guiding notes as desirable, to keep man away from falling into the traps of the…

item.title: Muhammad:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ فِيهَا أَنْهَارٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ خَمْرٍ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ عَسَلٍ مُصَفًّى وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوْۤا مَاءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَاءَهُمْ mathalu l-janati allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna fīhā anhārun min māin ghayri āsinin wa-anhārun min labanin lam yataghayyar ṭaʿmuhu wa-anhārun min khamrin ladhatin lilshāribīna wa-anhārun min ʿasalin muṣaffan walahum fīhā min kulli l-thamarāti wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khālidun fī l-nāri wasuqū māan ḥamīman faqaṭṭaʿa amʿāahum A description of the paradise promised to the Godwary: therein are streams of unstaling water, and streams of milk unchanging in flavour, and streams of wine delicious to the drinkers, and streams of purified honey; there will be for them every kind of fruit in it, and forgiveness from their Lord. [Are…

item.title: Muhammad:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ فِيهَا أَنْهَارٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ خَمْرٍ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ عَسَلٍ مُصَفًّى وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوْۤا مَاءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَاءَهُمْ mathalu l-janati allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna fīhā anhārun min māin ghayri āsinin wa-anhārun min labanin lam yataghayyar ṭaʿmuhu wa-anhārun min khamrin ladhatin lilshāribīna wa-anhārun min ʿasalin muṣaffan walahum fīhā min kulli l-thamarāti wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khālidun fī l-nāri wasuqū māan ḥamīman faqaṭṭaʿa amʿāahum Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered,1 rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all (kinds of) fruits and forgiveness from their…

item.title: Muhammad:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ فِيهَا أَنْهَارٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ خَمْرٍ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ عَسَلٍ مُصَفًّى وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوْۤا مَاءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَاءَهُمْ mathalu l-janati allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna fīhā anhārun min māin ghayri āsinin wa-anhārun min labanin lam yataghayyar ṭaʿmuhu wa-anhārun min khamrin ladhatin lilshāribīna wa-anhārun min ʿasalin muṣaffan walahum fīhā min kulli l-thamarāti wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khālidun fī l-nāri wasuqū māan ḥamīman faqaṭṭaʿa amʿāahum A similitude of the garden which has been promised to the pious ones (Those who guard themselves against evils.) . Therein are rivers of water incorruptible, and rivers of milk, changeth not its taste, and rivers of wine – delicious unto those who drink, and rivers of honey pure and clear; And…

item.title: Muhammad:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتّٰی إِذَا خَرَجُوْۤا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ wamin'hum man yastamiʿu ilayka ḥattā idhā kharajū min ʿindika qālū lilladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma mādhā qāla ānifan ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum There are some among them who prick up their ears at you. But when they go out from your presence, they say to those who have been given knowledge, 'What did he say just now?' They are the ones on whose hearts Allah has set a seal, and they follow their own desires.

item.title: Muhammad:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتّٰی إِذَا خَرَجُوْۤا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ wamin'hum man yastamiʿu ilayka ḥattā idhā kharajū min ʿindika qālū lilladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma mādhā qāla ānifan ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum And among them, (O Muḥammad), are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge,1 "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their (own) desires. And among them are some who listen to you till when they go out from you, they say to those who have received knowledge: "What is it that he has said just now? "Such are men whose hearts Allah has sealed because…

item.title: Muhammad:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
