item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتّٰی إِذَا خَرَجُوْۤا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ wamin'hum man yastamiʿu ilayka ḥattā idhā kharajū min ʿindika qālū lilladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma mādhā qāla ānifan ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum And of them are those who seek to listen to thee until when they go forth from thee (Refer to verse 69:12. See note) say they unto those who have been given (Refer to verses 6:25, 29:49. See note.) the knowledge: "What was it that he said just now?" These are they on whose hearts hath God set a seal, and follow they their vain desires. 'Ali, the First Holy Imam, says that it is we, the Ahl Al-Bayt who were first informed of the Word of God which was revealed to…

item.title: Muhammad:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَاهُمْ تَقْوَاهُمْ wa-alladhīna ih'tadaw zādahum hudan waātāhum taqwāhum As for those who are [rightly] guided, He enhances their guidance, and invests them with their Godwariness.

item.title: Muhammad:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَاهُمْ تَقْوَاهُمْ wa-alladhīna ih'tadaw zādahum hudan waātāhum taqwāhum And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.1 See 47:16

item.title: Muhammad:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَاهُمْ تَقْوَاهُمْ wa-alladhīna ih'tadaw zādahum hudan waātāhum taqwāhum And those who avail of the guidance, He addeth to His guidance unto them, and granteth them their guard (Power of resistance against temptations.) (against evils) See 47:16

item.title: Muhammad:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَقَدْ جَاءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا فَأَنَّى لَهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَاهُمْ fahal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jāa ashrāṭuhā fa-annā lahum idhā jāathum dhik'rāhum Do they await anything except that the Hour should overtake them suddenly? Certainly its portents have come. Of what avail to them will their admonition be when it overtakes them?

item.title: Muhammad:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَقَدْ جَاءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا فَأَنَّى لَهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَاهُمْ fahal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jāa ashrāṭuhā fa-annā lahum idhā jāathum dhik'rāhum Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come (some of) its indications. Then how (i.e., what good) to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance? See 47:16

item.title: Muhammad:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَقَدْ جَاءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا فَأَنَّى لَهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَاهُمْ fahal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jāa ashrāṭuhā fa-annā lahum idhā jāathum dhik'rāhum What! wait they then for aught save the Hour (of Reckoning) that it cometh on them all of a sudden (Refer to verses 12:107 & 43:66.) ? Indeed have (already) come the signs of it; and of what avail can be the reminder to them when it (The Hour - with the arrival of the Hour, the respite ends.) hath already come on them? The Holy Prophet has given the following signs heralding the approach of the end of the world and the Day of the Final Judgment1. People mould neglect praying. Carnal desires mould be blindly followed. The sincere believers in God mould be helpless against the rebellious life…

item.title: Muhammad:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَاكُمْ fa-iʿ'lam annahu lā ilāha illā l-lahu wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-lahu yaʿlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwākum Know that there is no god except Allah, and plead [to Allah] for forgiveness of your sin and for the faithful, men and women. Allah knows your itinerary and your [final] abode.

item.title: Muhammad:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَاكُمْ fa-iʿ'lam annahu lā ilāha illā l-lahu wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-lahu yaʿlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwākum So know, (O Muḥammad), that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin1 and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place. See 47:16

item.title: Muhammad:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَاكُمْ fa-iʿ'lam annahu lā ilāha illā l-lahu wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-lahu yaʿlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwākum So know thou that there is no god but God, and seek thou protection (Arabic 'Wa 'staghfir'- i.e., seek protection and not seek forgiveness. Protection is sought for future and not for past. This has to be studied under verse 33:33: all Apostles are sinless. Refer to note on verse 21:27. for Moses seeking protection for himself & his brother Aaron, refer to verse 7:151. For sins committed not by them but by the people, see also notes on verses 47:15 & 47:19.) for thy (Refer to note on verses 40:55 and 48:2. See note.) sins and for (the sins of) the believer men and believer women; and God knoweth well the…

item.title: Muhammad:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَإِذَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا الْقِتَالُ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِيِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَأَوْلَى لَهُمْ wayaqūlu alladhīna āmanū lawlā nuzzilat sūratun fa-idhā unzilat sūratun muḥ'kamatun wadhukira fīhā l-qitālu ra-ayta alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun yanẓurūna ilayka naẓara l-maghshiyi ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-awlā lahum The faithful say, 'If only a sūrah were sent down!' But when a definitive sūrah is sent down and war is mentioned in it, you see those in whose hearts is a sickness1 looking upon you with the look of someone fainting at death. So woe to them!

item.title: Muhammad:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَإِذَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا الْقِتَالُ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِيِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَأَوْلَى لَهُمْ wayaqūlu alladhīna āmanū lawlā nuzzilat sūratun fa-idhā unzilat sūratun muḥ'kamatun wadhukira fīhā l-qitālu ra-ayta alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun yanẓurūna ilayka naẓara l-maghshiyi ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-awlā lahum Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah1 not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease (i.e., hypocrisy) looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them2 (would have been). Those who believe say: "Why is not a Surah sent down (for us)?" But now that a decisive Surah is sent down mentioning fighting, you can see those in whose hearts is disease…

item.title: Muhammad:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَإِذَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا الْقِتَالُ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِيِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَأَوْلَى لَهُمْ wayaqūlu alladhīna āmanū lawlā nuzzilat sūratun fa-idhā unzilat sūratun muḥ'kamatun wadhukira fīhā l-qitālu ra-ayta alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun yanẓurūna ilayka naẓara l-maghshiyi ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-awlā lahum And say those who believe: "Why hath not been sent a chapter (for us), "But when is sent down a decisive chapter (Refer to verse 47:29, 2:216, 4:77) , and mentioned therein is war, seest thou those in whose hearts (Refer to verse 2:10) is a disease look unto thee with a look of one on whom has fallen the shadow of death; (This naturally refers to those who ran away from the battle fields) woe unto them! far better will certainly be for them, (Refer…

item.title: Muhammad:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَعْرُوفٌ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوْۤا اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ ṭāʿatun waqawlun maʿrūfun fa-idhā ʿazama l-amru falaw ṣadaqū l-laha lakāna khayran lahum Obedience and upright speech ….1 So when the matter has been resolved upon, if they remain true to Allah that will surely be better for them.

item.title: Muhammad:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَعْرُوفٌ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوْۤا اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ ṭāʿatun waqawlun maʿrūfun fa-idhā ʿazama l-amru falaw ṣadaqū l-laha lakāna khayran lahum Obedience and good words. And when the matter (of fighting) was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them. See 47:20

item.title: Muhammad:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَعْرُوفٌ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوْۤا اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ ṭāʿatun waqawlun maʿrūfun fa-idhā ʿazama l-amru falaw ṣadaqū l-laha lakāna khayran lahum Obedience and a fair word; but when the affair is determined, then if (the use of this conditional clause indicates that their loyalty was doubtful.) they be true to God, it would certainly be better for them, (And if they be true). The use of this conditional clause shows that their loyalty was doubtful. This may be as a complete sentence meaning, condemnation what some commentators have interpreted as in verse 75:34 & 75:35 and it may be taken as a phrase meaning as rendered here - and this is the interpretation attributed to Ibn Abbas. (A.P.)

item.title: Muhammad:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ fahal ʿasaytum in tawallaytum an tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi watuqaṭṭiʿū arḥāmakum May it not be that if you were to wield authority you would cause corruption in the land and ill-treat your blood relations?

item.title: Muhammad:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ fahal ʿasaytum in tawallaytum an tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi watuqaṭṭiʿū arḥāmakum So would you perhaps, if you turned away,1 cause corruption on earth and sever your (ties of) relationship? See 47:20

item.title: Muhammad:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ fahal ʿasaytum in tawallaytum an tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi watuqaṭṭiʿū arḥāmakum Then be like ye are, if ye hold authority, that ye make mischief in the earth and sever the ties of kinship! This is a continuation of the previous verse and reference is to the same party - not applicable to the 'Ansar' – and Abdullah Ibn 'Ubay cannot be included into it, because he was a notorious figure already known for his inclinations. (A.P.)

item.title: Muhammad:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ ulāika alladhīna laʿanahumu l-lahu fa-aṣammahum wa-aʿmā abṣārahum They are the ones whom Allah has cursed, so He made them deaf, and blinded their sight.

item.title: Muhammad:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ ulāika alladhīna laʿanahumu l-lahu fa-aṣammahum wa-aʿmā abṣārahum Those (who do so) are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision. See 47:20

item.title: Muhammad:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ ulāika alladhīna laʿanahumu l-lahu fa-aṣammahum wa-aʿmā abṣārahum Those are they whom hath cursed (Note cursing the wicked – i.e., 'Tabarra', a godly act.) God, and so hath he made them deaf and blinded their eyes. See 47:22

item.title: Muhammad:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا afalā yatadabbarūna l-qur'āna am ʿalā qulūbin aqfāluhā Do they not contemplate the Qur'ān, or are there locks on the hearts?

item.title: Muhammad:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا afalā yatadabbarūna l-qur'āna am ʿalā qulūbin aqfāluhā Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon (their) hearts? Will they not then reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon their hearts (47:24). Verily, those who have turned back as disbelievers after guidance had become clear to them – Shaytan has enticed them and filled them with false hopes (47:25). That is because they said to those who hate what Allah has sent down: "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows their secrets (47:26). Then how (will it be) when the angels will take their souls at death, striking their faces and their backs (47:27). That is because they followed that which angered Allah and hated what earns His pleasure, so He rendered…

item.title: Muhammad:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا afalā yatadabbarūna l-qur'āna am ʿalā qulūbin aqfāluhā What! Reflect (Asserts the authority of Qur'an and the necessity of its deep study.) they not on the Qur'an? Nay! on (their) hearts are (set) their locks. Note that unlike any other faiths demanding blind following, Islam wants every individual to reflect on the Word of God and know the truth for one's own self.

item.title: Muhammad:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ ارْتَدُّوْۤا عَلَى أَدْبَارِهِمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى الشَّيْطَانُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَى لَهُمْ inna alladhīna ir'taddū ʿalā adbārihim min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā l-shayṭānu sawwala lahum wa-amlā lahum Indeed those who turned their backs after the guidance had become clear to them, it was Satan who had seduced them, and he had given them [far-flung] hopes.1

item.title: Muhammad:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ ارْتَدُّوْۤا عَلَى أَدْبَارِهِمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى الشَّيْطَانُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَى لَهُمْ inna alladhīna ir'taddū ʿalā adbārihim min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā l-shayṭānu sawwala lahum wa-amlā lahum Indeed, those who reverted back (to disbelief) after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them. See 47:24

item.title: Muhammad:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ ارْتَدُّوْۤا عَلَى أَدْبَارِهِمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى الشَّيْطَانُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَى لَهُمْ inna alladhīna ir'taddū ʿalā adbārihim min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā l-shayṭānu sawwala lahum wa-amlā lahum Verily, those who return on the backs (Like the deserters in the battles.) after hath become manifest unto them the guidance, the satan hath beguiled (As in the case of those who raised the false cry at Uhud that the Holy Prophet was dead and invited the people to return to their former creed. This indicates the desire of some for power and they had been secretly plotting.) them, and hath given them a respite. This refers to those of the hypocrites as well as those who turned disbelievers in their madness for power, pomp and position after the departure of the Holy Prophet from this world. They…

item.title: Muhammad:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahum qālū lilladhīna karihū mā nazzala l-lahu sanuṭīʿukum fī baʿḍi l-amri wal-lahu yaʿlamu is'rārahum That is because they said to those who loathed what Allah had sent down: 'We shall obey you in some matters,' and Allah knows their secret dealings.

item.title: Muhammad:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahum qālū lilladhīna karihū mā nazzala l-lahu sanuṭīʿukum fī baʿḍi l-amri wal-lahu yaʿlamu is'rārahum That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down,1 "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal. See 47:24

item.title: Muhammad:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahum qālū lilladhīna karihū mā nazzala l-lahu sanuṭīʿukum fī baʿḍi l-amri wal-lahu yaʿlamu is'rārahum That is for they say unto those who hate what God hath sent down (saying): "We will obey you in a part of (this) matter" But God knoweth well their secret reservations. Compare the historic facts, how after the Holy Prophet the people refused to obey some of his commands about 'Ali and his Ahl Al-Bayt and compare what all the Holy Prophet said about the holy ones of his family, and quite the opposite to it, the people behaved with them.

item.title: Muhammad:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ fakayfa idhā tawaffathumu l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum But how will it be [with them] when the angels take them away, striking their faces and their backs?!

item.title: Muhammad:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ fakayfa idhā tawaffathumu l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum Then how (will it be) when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs? See 47:24

item.title: Muhammad:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ fakayfa idhā tawaffathumu l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum But how? When the angels causing them to die, will smite their faces and their backs. See 47:26

item.title: Muhammad:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوْۤا مَا أَسْخَطَ اللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوْۤا رِضْوَانَهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahumu ittabaʿū mā askhaṭa l-laha wakarihū riḍ'wānahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum That, because they pursued what displeased Allah, and loathed His pleasure. So He has made their works fail.

item.title: Muhammad:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوْۤا مَا أَسْخَطَ اللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوْۤا رِضْوَانَهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahumu ittabaʿū mā askhaṭa l-laha wakarihū riḍ'wānahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked (what earns) His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds. See 47:24

item.title: Muhammad:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوْۤا مَا أَسْخَطَ اللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوْۤا رِضْوَانَهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ dhālika bi-annahumu ittabaʿū mā askhaṭa l-laha wakarihū riḍ'wānahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum That is for they follow what displeaseth God, and hate what is His pleasure, so hath He made null their deeds. Thus, it is clearly laid down here that all the good deeds which these hypocrites might have done, have been wiped out of their records.

item.title: Muhammad:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَنْ لَنْ يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ أَضْغَانَهُمْ am ḥasiba alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun an lan yukh'rija l-lahu aḍghānahum Do those in whose hearts is a sickness suppose that Allah will not expose their spite?

item.title: Muhammad:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَنْ لَنْ يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ أَضْغَانَهُمْ am ḥasiba alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun an lan yukh'rija l-lahu aḍghānahum Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their (feelings of) hatred? Or do those in whose hearts is a disease, think that Allah will not expose their ill–wills (47:29). Had We so willed, We could have shown them clearly to you, so that you would know them by their marks; but you will know them by the tone of their speech! And Allah knows (all) your deeds (47:30). And We will surely, try you until We know those who strive among you and the patient, and We will put to a test all your affairs (47:31). Exposing the Hidden Secret of the Hypocrites Allah says: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ…

item.title: Muhammad:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَنْ لَنْ يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ أَضْغَانَهُمْ am ḥasiba alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun an lan yukh'rija l-lahu aḍghānahum Or deem those in whose hearts is a disease that never will God bring forth their spite? The disease of infidelity was manifest in the open opposition to Islam. The disease in the heart, naturally refers to the hypocrisy of those who professed Islam by their lips but at heart they were opposed to it. The reference here is to the enmity or the ill-will the hypocrites bore particularly to 'Ali because he was the one and the only hero of Islam, the ever-victorious soldier and the Commander of the Muslim army who could never be defeated by any one of the enemies of the faith. With 'Ali on the side of the Holy Prophet and Islam, the…

item.title: Muhammad:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَأَرَيْنَاكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِي لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَالَكُمْ walaw nashāu la-araynākahum falaʿaraftahum bisīmāhum walataʿrifannahum fī laḥni l-qawli wal-lahu yaʿlamu aʿmālakum If We wish, We will show them1 to you so that you recognize them by their mark. Yet you will recognize them by their tone of speech, and Allah knows your deeds.

item.title: Muhammad:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَأَرَيْنَاكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِي لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَالَكُمْ walaw nashāu la-araynākahum falaʿaraftahum bisīmāhum walataʿrifannahum fī laḥni l-qawli wal-lahu yaʿlamu aʿmālakum And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of (their) speech. And Allah knows your deeds. See 47:29

item.title: Muhammad:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَأَرَيْنَاكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِي لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَالَكُمْ walaw nashāu la-araynākahum falaʿaraftahum bisīmāhum walataʿrifannahum fī laḥni l-qawli wal-lahu yaʿlamu aʿmālakum And if We willed We could certainly have shown them unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) and thou wouldst certainly have known them by their features; and (now) certainly thou (can) recognise them by the tone of (their) speech; and God knoweth well (all) your deeds. Abu Sa'id al-Khudri says that 'Lahnil-Qaul' stands for the enmity against 'Ali. And Ubbadah Ibn Samit says that "we tested our issues with their love for 'Ali and if we found anyone with no love for 'Ali we knew that he would never walk aright in his faith". The Holy Prophet said "O' 'Ali! none loveth thee save a believer and none hateth thee save a hypocrite" (MS.) Some commentators…

item.title: Muhammad:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتّٰی نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا أَخْبَارَكُمْ walanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum wal-ṣābirīna wanabluwā akhbārakum We will surely test you until We ascertain those of you who wage jihād and those who are steadfast, and We shall appraise your record.

item.title: Muhammad:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتّٰی نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا أَخْبَارَكُمْ walanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum wal-ṣābirīna wanabluwā akhbārakum And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you (for the cause of Allah) and the patient, and We will test your affairs. See 47:29

item.title: Muhammad:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتّٰی نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا أَخْبَارَكُمْ walanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum wal-ṣābirīna wanabluwā akhbārakum And certainly will We try ('Mujahid' In the battle particularly at Uhud, Khaybar & Hunayn who was a 'Mujahid' and who was a 'Mujahid' and who was a deserter – who was sincere & who was a hypocrite.) you until We have known (Make known – and accordingly the hypocrites were exposed and identified) those who strive (fight) among you and the patient ones, and make your affairs known. Apply this verse to those who deserted the Holy Prophet and left the Muslims in the midst of the enemies and the experiences which history relates about Uhud, Hunayn and Khaybar and those who would not even stir from their places at Ahzab, i.e., Khandaq, against even a single soldier Amar Ibn Abdwud from the…

item.title: Muhammad:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَشَاقُّوْۤا الرَّسُولَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi washāqqū l-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan wasayuḥ'biṭu aʿmālahum Indeed those who are faithless and bar from the way of Allah and defy the Apostle after guidance has become clear to them, will not hurt Allah in the least, and He shall make their works fail.

item.title: Muhammad:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَشَاقُّوْۤا الرَّسُولَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi washāqqū l-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan wasayuḥ'biṭu aʿmālahum Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted (people) from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds. Verily, those who disbelieve, and hinder from the path of Allah, and oppose the Messenger, after the guidance has been clearly shown to them, they will not harm Allah in the least, but He will make their deeds fruitless (47:32). O you who believe! Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger and invalidate not your deeds (47:33). Verily, those who disbelieved…

item.title: Muhammad:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَشَاقُّوْۤا الرَّسُولَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi washāqqū l-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan wasayuḥ'biṭu aʿmālahum Verily, those who disbelieve and hinder (others) from the path of God, and oppose the Apostle after that the guidance hath been made manifest unto them, can never harm God in any way; and He will make null their deeds. It is clearly laid down here that any opposition, i.e., causing displeasure to the Holy Prophet results in the complete forfeiture of the credit for all the good deeds the opponent might have done. Immediately as the Holy Prophet left this world, 'Ali's neck was seen in the rope of a group of men, and the world witnessed…

item.title: Muhammad:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوْۤا أَعْمَالَكُمْ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla walā tub'ṭilū aʿmālakum O you who have faith! Obey Allah and obey the Apostle, and do not render your works void.

item.title: Muhammad:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوْۤا أَعْمَالَكُمْ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla walā tub'ṭilū aʿmālakum O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds. See 47:32

item.title: Muhammad:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوْۤا أَعْمَالَكُمْ yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla walā tub'ṭilū aʿmālakum O' ye who believe! Obey ye God, and obey ye the Apostle, and do not render null your deeds. Merely doing of any amount of good deeds in the life has no guarantee of their being of any avail also, to the individual. He must be a sincere believer in God and he must obey God and His apostle Muhammad. Otherwise, all the good that has been done by the individual would be made null and void. Apply this verse to those who disobeyed the Holy Prophet even before he had left this world. At the verge of his departure, he commanded those surrounding him, to get him pen and paper to record something so that the people may never…

item.title: Muhammad:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوْۤا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi thumma mātū wahum kuffārun falan yaghfira l-lahu lahum Indeed those who are faithless and bar from the way of Allah and then die faithless, Allah will never forgive them.

item.title: Muhammad:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوْۤا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi thumma mātū wahum kuffārun falan yaghfira l-lahu lahum Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted (people) from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them. See 47:32

item.title: Muhammad:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوْۤا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi thumma mātū wahum kuffārun falan yaghfira l-lahu lahum Verily, those who disbelieve and hinder (others) from the way of God, then they die while they are disbelievers, then never will God forgive them. See 47:33

item.title: Muhammad:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَهِنُوْۤا وَتَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى السَّلْمِ وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَنْ يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ falā tahinū watadʿū ilā l-salmi wa-antumu l-aʿlawna wal-lahu maʿakum walan yatirakum aʿmālakum So do not slacken and [do not] call for peace when you have the upper hand and Allah is with you, and He will not stint [the reward of] your works.

item.title: Muhammad:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَهِنُوْۤا وَتَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى السَّلْمِ وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَنْ يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ falā tahinū watadʿū ilā l-salmi wa-antumu l-aʿlawna wal-lahu maʿakum walan yatirakum aʿmālakum So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of (the reward of) your deeds. See 47:32

item.title: Muhammad:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا تَهِنُوْۤا وَتَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى السَّلْمِ وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَنْ يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ falā tahinū watadʿū ilā l-salmi wa-antumu l-aʿlawna wal-lahu maʿakum walan yatirakum aʿmālakum So be not fainthearted and call (falter so as to call.) (the infidels) to peace, while ye have the upper hand, and God is with you, and never will He depreciate (make your deeds in vain – make them naught - or reduce their value or reward.) your deeds. See 47:33

item.title: Muhammad:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْءَلْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ innamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wa-in tu'minū watattaqū yu'tikum ujūrakum walā yasalkum amwālakum The life of the world is just play and diversion, but if you are faithful and Godwary, He will give you your rewards, and will not ask your wealth [in return] from you.

item.title: Muhammad:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْءَلْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ innamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wa-in tu'minū watattaqū yu'tikum ujūrakum walā yasalkum amwālakum (This) worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties. This worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and have Taqwa of Allah, He will grant you your rewards, and will not ask from you (to sacrifice all of) your possessions (47:36). If He would demand of you all of it and urge you, you would withhold. And He will expose your (secret) ill–wills (47:37). Here you are now invited to spend in Allah's cause; but among you are those who withhold (stingily). And whoever acts stingily is but stingy toward himself.…

item.title: Muhammad:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْءَلْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ innamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wa-in tu'minū watattaqū yu'tikum ujūrakum walā yasalkum amwālakum The life of this world is only an idle sport and a play, and if ye believe and guard (yourselves against evil (i.e., practice piety.) ), He will give your recompense, and will ask not of you of your possessions. Refer to the commentary of verses 6:32, 29:64, 57:20. "Will not ask for you possessions" is in no way connected with zakat and khums. It refers to the Holy Prophet regarding his return for his mission. (A.P.)

item.title: Muhammad:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَسْءَلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوْۤا وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَانَكُمْ in yasalkumūhā fayuḥ'fikum tabkhalū wayukh'rij aḍghānakum Should He ask it from you, and press you, you will be stingy, and He will expose your spite.

item.title: Muhammad:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَسْءَلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوْۤا وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَانَكُمْ in yasalkumūhā fayuḥ'fikum tabkhalū wayukh'rij aḍghānakum If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred (i.e., unwillingness). See 47:36

item.title: Muhammad:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يَسْءَلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوْۤا وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَانَكُمْ in yasalkumūhā fayuḥ'fikum tabkhalū wayukh'rij aḍghānakum Should He ask them of you, and if He urgeth you, ye will be niggardly, and He will bring forth your spite. See 47:36

item.title: Muhammad:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَاأَنْتُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنْفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يَبْخَلُ وَمَنْ يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوْۤا أَمْثَالَكُمْ hāantum hāulāi tud'ʿawna litunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fa-innamā yabkhalu ʿan nafsihi wal-lahu l-ghaniyu wa-antumu l-fuqarāu wa-in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma lā yakūnū amthālakum Ah! There you are, being invited to spend in the way of Allah; yet among you there are those who are stingy; and whoever is stingy is stingy only to himself. Allah is the All-sufficient, and you are all-needy, and if you turn away He will replace you with another people, and they will not be like you.

item.title: Muhammad:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَاأَنْتُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنْفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يَبْخَلُ وَمَنْ يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوْۤا أَمْثَالَكُمْ hāantum hāulāi tud'ʿawna litunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fa-innamā yabkhalu ʿan nafsihi wal-lahu l-ghaniyu wa-antumu l-fuqarāu wa-in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma lā yakūnū amthālakum Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold (out of greed). And whoever withholds only withholds (benefit) from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away (i.e., refuse), He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you. See 47:36

item.title: Muhammad:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَاأَنْتُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنْفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يَبْخَلُ وَمَنْ يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوْۤا أَمْثَالَكُمْ hāantum hāulāi tud'ʿawna litunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fa-innamā yabkhalu ʿan nafsihi wal-lahu l-ghaniyu wa-antumu l-fuqarāu wa-in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma lā yakūnū amthālakum Lo! ye are they, who are called upon to spend in the way of God, but of you are those who are niggardly, and whosoever is niggardly, is niggardly only against his own self; and God is Self-Sufficient (Arabic 'Ghani'.) and ye are in need (of Him), and if ye turn back, He will bring in your place a people other than you, then they will not be like unto you. Charity is prescribed for the benefit of the people themselves. And…

item.title: Nooh:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmun Indeed We sent Noah to his people, [saying,] 'Warn your people before a painful punishment overtakes them.'

item.title: Nooh:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmun Indeed, We sent Nuh to his people, (saying), "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment." أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ That you should worship Allah, and have Taqwa of Him, Meaning: 'abandon those things that He has forbidden and avoid that which He has declared to be sinful.' وَأَطِيعُونِ and obey me, 'In that which I command you to do and that which I forbid you from.' يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ He will forgive you of your sins Meaning: 'if you do what I command you to do and you believe in what I have been sent with to you, then Allah will forgive you for your sins.' وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ…

item.title: Nooh:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmun Verily, sent We Noah unto his people, saying: "Warn then thy people? ere cometh there upon them a painful chastisement (Refer to Verses 11:25 - 11:49.)" The people were totally lost in faithlessness and sins. The evil character and the wicked conduct of the people needed a serious and a thorough purge which was affected by the great deluge1.

item.title: Nooh:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun He said, 'O my people! Indeed I am a manifest warner to you.

item.title: Nooh:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner. See 71:1

item.title: Nooh:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun Said he: "O' ye my people! Verily, I am unto you an open warner!" Noah's preachings were, public as well as private. He tried his best to bring the people on the right path even through private talks taking the people into confidence, but no efforts on his part were of any avail.

item.title: Nooh:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūni Worship Allah and be wary of Him, and obey me,

item.title: Nooh:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūni To worship Allah, fear Him and obey me. See 71:1

item.title: Nooh:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūni That worship ye God (alone), Fear Him, and Obey me See 71:2

item.title: Nooh:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūna that He may forgive you some of your sins and respite you until a specified time. Indeed when Allah's [appointed] time comes, it cannot be deferred, should you know.'

item.title: Nooh:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūna He (i.e., Allah) will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time (set by) Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew." See 71:1

item.title: Nooh:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūna He will forgive you of your sins and respite you unto an appointed term; Verily, the term (fixed) of God, when it cometh, shall not be put back, if ye but knew (this)! It is also clearly indicated through this Verse that God gives respite and if the respite is not availed of, and when His decree comes, no power, besides Him can, even delay it.

item.title: Nooh:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylan wanahāran He said, 'My Lord! Indeed I have summoned my people night and day

item.title: Nooh:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylan wanahāran He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people (to truth) night and day. He said: O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (71:5). But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (71:6). And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted, and magnified themselves in pride (71:7). Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud) (71:8). Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private (71:9). I said (to them): Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving (71:10). He will send rain to you Midrar (71:11). And give you…

item.title: Nooh:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylan wanahāran Said he: "O' my Lord! Verily I called my people by night and by day!" See 71:4

item.title: Nooh:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَاءِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firāran but my summons only increases their evasion.

item.title: Nooh:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَاءِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firāran But my invitation increased them not except in flight (i.e., aversion). See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَاءِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firāran But increased not (for) them my call but (their) flight (from the Right Way) While those whose conscience is not yet dead or not totally destroyed or clouded with evil, receive the admonition and get their thoughts and deeds amended, while the others who are totally submerged in evil, take the admonition as reproach and fly further away from the truth and the right path of righteousness1. Those, whose hearts are corrupt and totally polluted, God allows them to go ahead in their straying2. This is one of the examples of the people's reaction to the divine guidance, as given in the note on action and reaction in Sura 1. Here, the disbelievers are responsible for their aversion yet. Noah ascribes the aversion to his action. (A.P.)

item.title: Nooh:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْۤا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bāran Indeed whenever I have summoned them, so that You might forgive them, they would put their fingers into their ears and draw their cloaks over their heads, and they were persistent [in their unfaith], and disdainful in [their] arrogance.

item.title: Nooh:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْۤا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bāran And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,1 persisted, and were arrogant with (great) arrogance. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْۤا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bāran Whenever I called them, that Thou mayest forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and covered (Refer to Verse 11:5.) themselves in their garments, and persist (in their error), and are puffed with pride (Displayed their arrogance.) They not only closed their ears against hearing any words of admonition but also covered themselves with their clothes so that they might not even be seen by the Apostle or they themselves did not like to see him.

item.title: Nooh:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihāran Again I summoned them aloud,

item.title: Nooh:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihāran Then I invited them publicly. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihāran Then verily I called unto them aloud (too) The people had been so adamant and obstinate that for forty or seventy years continuously, God stopped rain and turned their women barren and yet they did not believe in what Noah preached.

item.title: Nooh:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rāran and again appealed to them publicly and confided with them privately,

item.title: Nooh:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rāran Then I announced to them and (also) confided to them secretly. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rāran Then verily spake I openly unto them, and I confided unto them in secret (too) See 71:8

item.title: Nooh:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran telling [them]: "Plead to your Lord for forgiveness. Indeed He is all-forgiver.

item.title: Nooh:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran Then said I: "Seek ye the forgiveness of your Lord! Verily He is the Most-Forgiving" Ibn Abbas says that once a man told the First Holy Imam Ali Ibn Abu Talib that he had sinned a great deal. Ali said, 'Seek God's pardon.' Another one said that need has reduced him to destitution. Ali said, 'Seek God's pardon.' Another said that he had no issues. Ali said, 'Seek God's pardon'. Similarly, several others complained against their own difficulties and needs and to one and all of them, Ali said the same 'Seek God's pardon.' Ibn Abbas asked "O' Amir Al-Mu'minin! horn is it that you gave one and the same reply in advice to every one of those who related to you, different grievances and various needs" Ali…

item.title: Nooh:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran He will send for you abundant rains from the sky,

item.title: Nooh:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran He will send (rain from) the sky upon you in (continuing) showers. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran He will send (down) upon you the cloud raining in torrents The people were promised rain water which they had been denied for years together. 1.

item.title: Nooh:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْهَارًا wayum'did'kum bi-amwālin wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātin wayajʿal lakum anhāran and aid you with wealth and sons, and provide you with gardens and provide you with streams.

item.title: Nooh:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْهَارًا wayum'did'kum bi-amwālin wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātin wayajʿal lakum anhāran And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْهَارًا wayum'did'kum bi-amwālin wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātin wayajʿal lakum anhāran And help you with wealth and sons (children) and make (Cause.) (grow) for you gardens, and make for you rivers They were also promised the blessings of God through their being restored to have issues from their wives

item.title: Nooh:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqāran What is the matter with you that you do not look upon Allah with veneration,

item.title: Nooh:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqāran What is (the matter) with you that you do not attribute to Allah (due) grandeur. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqāran What hath happened unto you that ye consider not for God any greatness? See 71:12

item.title: Nooh:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا waqad khalaqakum aṭwāran though He has created you in [various] stages?

item.title: Nooh:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا waqad khalaqakum aṭwāran While He has created you in stages?1 See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا waqad khalaqakum aṭwāran While indeed He created you through regular stages 'Atwara' i.e., various kinds or modes or conditions. This is an allusion to the various creative stages the foetus passes through; it is transformed into a perfect human child and the child passing through the various stages of growth in this world and getting gradually endowed with different kinds of marvellous mental faculties and moral and social development. The very creation of man from a foetus is such a great marvel that if studied seriously will be quite sufficient to make man believe in the infinite power and wisdom of the Author of this one creature of His, (i.e., a human being)1.

item.title: Nooh:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan Have you not seen how Allah has created seven heavens in layers,

item.title: Nooh:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers.1 See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan See ye not how hath created God the seven heavens (in layers) one above the other (Refer to Verses 67:3, 65:12.) ? See 71:14

item.title: Nooh:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala l-shamsa sirājan and has made therein the moon for a light, and the sun for a lamp?

item.title: Nooh:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala l-shamsa sirājan And made the moon therein a (reflected) light and made the sun a burning lamp? See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala l-shamsa sirājan And made the moon, in it a light, and the sun as a lamp (Refer to Verses 25:61, 33:46.) See 71:14

item.title: Nooh:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَنْبَتَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabātan Allah made you grow from the earth, with a [vegetable] growth.

item.title: Nooh:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَنْبَتَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabātan And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a (progressive) growth. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ أَنْبَتَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabātan And God made you grow of the earth as a growth (of a plant) The evolutionary process of the growth of man is compared to the vegetation from the earth which grows gradually. This confirms the evolutionary course, the development of life on earth, but it does not apply to the mechanical evolution of the Darwinian School. (A.P.)

item.title: Nooh:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rājan Then He makes you return to it, and He will bring you forth [without fail].

item.title: Nooh:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rājan Then He will return you into it and extract you (another) extraction. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rājan Then He returneth you therein, and again will He bringeth you forth a new' bringing (at the Resurrection) See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭan Allah has made the earth a vast expanse for you

item.title: Nooh:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭan And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse. See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭan And verily God hath made for you the earth outstretched See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا litaslukū min'hā subulan fijājan so that you may travel over its spacious ways." '

item.title: Nooh:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا litaslukū min'hā subulan fijājan That you may follow therein roads of passage.'" See 71:5

item.title: Nooh:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا litaslukū min'hā subulan fijājan That ye may walk therein along paths wide (convenient) (Refer to Verse 20:53.) See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَنْ لَمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا qāla nūḥun rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū man lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasāran Noah said, 'My Lord! They have disobeyed me, following someone whose wealth and children only add to his loss,

item.title: Nooh:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَنْ لَمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا qāla nūḥun rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū man lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasāran Nuh said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. Nuh said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss (71:21). "And they have plotted a mighty plot (71:22). "And they have said: 'You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth, and Ya'uq and Nasr.' (71:23). "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allah): 'Grant no increase to the wrongdoers save error.' (71:24). Nuh Complains to His Lord about His People's Response Allah says that Nuh turned to Allah to inform…

item.title: Nooh:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَنْ لَمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا qāla nūḥun rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū man lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasāran Said Noah: "O' my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but follow they him whose riches and children increase not unto him but loss" See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا wamakarū makran kubbāran and they have devised an outrageous plot.

item.title: Nooh:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا wamakarū makran kubbāran And they conspired an immense conspiracy. See 71:21

item.title: Nooh:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا wamakarū makran kubbāran And they have plotted a great plot (Against me and my followers.) See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasran They say, "Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwā, nor Yaghūth, Ya'ūq and Nasr,"1

item.title: Nooh:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasran And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'1 See 71:21

item.title: Nooh:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasran And say they (unto each other) -. "Forsake not ye your gods, and forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa; neither Yaghus, and Ya'uq and Nasr (Names of the idol deities.) !" See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوْۤا كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا waqad aḍallū kathīran walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālan and already they have led many astray. Do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but error.'

item.title: Nooh:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوْۤا كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا waqad aḍallū kathīran walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālan And already they have misled many. And, (my Lord), do not increase the wrongdoers except in error." See 71:21

item.title: Nooh:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوْۤا كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا waqad aḍallū kathīran walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālan And indeed, have they led astray many, and then increase not unto the unjust (aught) but error See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مِمَّا خَطِيءَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوْۤا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنْصَارًا mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣāran They were drowned because of their iniquities, then made to enter a Fire, and they did not find for themselves any helpers besides Allah.

item.title: Nooh:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مِمَّا خَطِيءَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوْۤا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنْصَارًا mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣāran Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah (any) helpers. Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allah (71:25). And Nuh said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth Dayyar! (71:26). "If You leave them, they will mislead Your servants, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers (71:27). "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the wrongdoers grant You no increase but destruction!") Allah say…

item.title: Nooh:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مِمَّا خَطِيءَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوْۤا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنْصَارًا mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣāran Because of their (own) sins they were drowned, and were made to enter the fire, and (then) they found not any helper for them besides God See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا waqāla nūḥun rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāran And Noah said, 'My Lord! 'Do not leave on the earth any inhabitant from among the faithless.

item.title: Nooh:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا waqāla nūḥun rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāran And Nuh said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant. See 71:25

item.title: Nooh:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا waqāla nūḥun rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāran And said Noah! "O' my Lord! leave Thou not on the earth, of the unjust ones, a single dweller (alive)?" See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوْۤا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوْۤا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffāran If You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants and will not beget except vicious ingrates.

item.title: Nooh:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوْۤا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوْۤا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffāran Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except (every) wicked one and (confirmed) disbeliever. See 71:25

item.title: Nooh:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوْۤا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوْۤا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffāran Verily if Thou leaveth them (alive), they will lead astray Thy servants, and will not beget they but immoral ingrates (This confirms that the parents of the Holy Prophet all were believers.) ! See 71:17

item.title: Nooh:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا rabbi igh'fir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minan walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā tabāran My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and the faithful men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers in anything except ruin.'

item.title: Nooh:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا rabbi igh'fir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minan walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā tabāran My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction." See 71:25

item.title: Nooh:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا rabbi igh'fir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minan walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā tabāran O' my Lord! Forgive Thou me and my parents and him who entereth my abode (Ahl Al-Bayt.) believing (in Thee), and the believer- men and the believer-women (The faithful followers of the Ahl Al-Bayt.) , and increase not unto the unjust ones in aught save perdition (Refer to Verse 14:41. Compare this with Verse 31:23.) ! See 71:17

item.title: Qaaf:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ق وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِيدِ qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīdi Qāf. By the glorious Qur'ān.

item.title: Qaaf:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ق وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِيدِ qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīdi Qāf.1 By the honored Qur’ān...2 بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ Nay, but they have denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a Marij state. This is the state of all those who defy the Truth: whatever they say and utter after denying the Truth, is utterly false. Marij means, in disarray, in a confused state and defying the characteristics of the Truth. Allah the Exalted said in another Ayah: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِي قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ - يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ Certainly, you have different ideas. Turned aside therefrom is he who is turned aside. (51:8-9)

item.title: Qaaf:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ق وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِيدِ qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīdi Qaf (Q); By the Glorious Quran According to Syed Murtaza Alamul Huda (AR). The use of the letter-symbols to begin the Suras, seem to indicate that the matter following it is not poetry but prose. This seems to refute the opinion that the Holy Qur'an is only an enchanting poetry. Some commentators conjecture that 'Q' stands for some of the qualifying names of God - viz., Qadir, Qahir, Qadeer, Qadeem, Qayyum etc. while some say, it is one of the names of the Holy Qur'an. But all these are only conjectures, the actual meaning is a secret conveyed to the Holy Prophet, who in his turn has conveyed to his divinely commissioned successors, the Holy Imams. It is universally acknowledged that the Holy Prophet declared "I am the City of Knowledge and 'Ali is…

item.title: Qaaf:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ عَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajībun Rather they consider it odd that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. So the faithless say, 'This is an odd thing.

item.title: Qaaf:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ عَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajībun But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing. See 50:1

item.title: Qaaf:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ عَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajībun Nay! wonder they that hath come unto them a warner from among themselves, so say the disbelievers: "This is a wonderful thing!" See 50:1

item.title: Qaaf:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdun What! When we are dead and have become dust [shall we be raised again]? That is a far-fetched return!'

item.title: Qaaf:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdun When we have died and have become dust, (we will return to life)? That is a distant (i.e., unlikely) return." See 50:1

item.title: Qaaf:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdun What! when we are dead and have become dust (shall we return)? That is a return far (or far from our understanding it.) (from the truth) 'Raj'un', i.e., a return far from possibility. This is what the disbelievers said about the resurrection. It is said the bodies, of all human beings which are turned into dust after their death shall be resurrected but the bodies of the men of God viz. the apostles, the successors (the Imams) and the martyrs are preserved even after death and they will be raised in their original state on the Day of Judgment. History has proved this fact, in the case of the martyrs of Karbala. The severed head of the Holy Imam Husayn even about a month after it…

item.title: Qaaf:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِنْدَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓun We know what the earth diminishes from them,1 and with Us is a preserving Book.

item.title: Qaaf:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِنْدَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓun We know what the earth diminishes (i.e., consumes) of them, and with Us is a retaining record. See 50:1

item.title: Qaaf:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِنْدَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓun Indeed, know We what reduceth the earth of them, with Us is a written record that secureth. The Book which is preserved and preserves everything in its entirety, i.e., 'Lauh al-Mahfooz,' i.e., the 'Preserved or the Secured Tablet.' 1

item.title: Qaaf:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrin marījin Rather they denied the truth when it came to them; so they are now in a perplexed state of affairs.

item.title: Qaaf:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrin marījin But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition. See 50:1

item.title: Qaaf:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrin marījin Nay! they belied (The denial is not based on any scientific proof but an outcome of a mental confusion) the truth when it came unto them, so they are in a confused state. Seeing the truth which the Holy Qur'an, day by day manifested and its getting proved by its acknowledgement by their own leaders, the disbelievers not knowing what to do, were confused for they, owing to their arrogance and obstinacy, would not like to accept it, nor they could hold any longer, against it.

item.title: Qaaf:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْۤا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوجٍ afalam yanẓurū ilā l-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūjin Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have built it and adorned it, and that there are no cracks in it?

item.title: Qaaf:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْۤا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوجٍ afalam yanẓurū ilā l-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūjin Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and (how) it has no rifts? Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no Furuj in it (50:6). And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon Rawasi standing firm, and We planted in it every lovely (Bahij) pair (50:7). An insight and a Reminder for every servant who turns to Allah in repentance (50:8). And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith Jannat and grain that are reaped (50:9). And date palms Basiqat, with arranged clusters (50:10).…

item.title: Qaaf:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْۤا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوجٍ afalam yanẓurū ilā l-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūjin What! See they not up unto the heaven above them how We have made it and adorned it, no gaps are therein. The more and ever more, man uses his brain and his own perfected scientific implements, it only increases his wonder about the heavens and their heavenly wonders. The increase in knowledge, only increases the marvel about the objects, the heavens. In support of the resurrection, Qur'an draws man's attention to the continuity of the creation in space and time and that in spite of all the variations, there is no gap. Thus, life in its various stages, is an evolutionary continuity.1 (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahījin And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and caused every delightful kind to grow in it.

item.title: Qaaf:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahījin And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein (something) of every beautiful kind. See 50:6

item.title: Qaaf:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
