item.description: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahījin And the earth, We have spread it out, and have cast We therein mountains and have caused We therein the growth of all beauteous kinds, See 50:6

item.title: Qaaf:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرٰی لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ tabṣiratan wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdin munībin [In this there is] an insight and admonition for every penitent servant.

item.title: Qaaf:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرٰی لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ tabṣiratan wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdin munībin Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns (to Allah). See 50:6

item.title: Qaaf:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرٰی لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ tabṣiratan wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdin munībin To serve insight and as a reminder unto every servant (of God) who turneth (unto His Lord). This is the best and the most vivid illustration for every one who can reflect intelligently on the creation of the world around him. A beautiful description of the wonders of nature, proving the Omnipotence and wisdom of its Author.

item.title: Qaaf:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُبَارَكًا فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ wanazzalnā mina l-samāi māan mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba l-ḥaṣīdi And We send down from the sky salubrious water, with which We grow gardens and the grain which is harvested,

item.title: Qaaf:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُبَارَكًا فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ wanazzalnā mina l-samāi māan mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba l-ḥaṣīdi And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest. See 50:6

item.title: Qaaf:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُبَارَكًا فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ wanazzalnā mina l-samāi māan mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba l-ḥaṣīdi And sent We down from the heaven water with blessings, and caused We to grow thereby gardens and the grain which is harvested, See 50:8

item.title: Qaaf:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ wal-nakhla bāsiqātin lahā ṭalʿun naḍīdun and tall date palms with regularly set spathes,

item.title: Qaaf:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ wal-nakhla bāsiqātin lahā ṭalʿun naḍīdun And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers. See 50:6

item.title: Qaaf:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ wal-nakhla bāsiqātin lahā ṭalʿun naḍīdun And the tall palm-trees with fruit-stalks, closely set one above another, See 50:8

item.title: Qaaf:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رِزْقًا لِلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ riz'qan lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika l-khurūju as a provision for servants; and with it We revive a dead country. Likewise will be the rising [from the dead].

item.title: Qaaf:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رِزْقًا لِلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ riz'qan lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika l-khurūju As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence (i.e., resurrection). See 50:6

item.title: Qaaf:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رِزْقًا لِلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ riz'qan lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika l-khurūju A sustenance for the servants, and give We life thereby unto a dead town; Thus will be the Resurrection. The resurrection is proved by the example of the dead earth being quickened after it is totally dried and cleared of all its vegetation on it.

item.title: Qaaf:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu l-rasi wathamūdu The people of Noah denied before them, and [so did] the inhabitants of Rass1 and Thamūd,

item.title: Qaaf:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu l-rasi wathamūdu The people of Nuh denied before them,1 and the companions of the well2 and Thamūd. Denied before them the people of Nuh, and the Dwellers of Rass, and Thamud (50:12). And 'Ad, and Fir'awn, and the brethren of Lut (50:13). And the Dwellers of Al-Aykah, and the people of Tubba'. Everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My threat took effect (50:14). Were We then tired with the first creation? Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation (50:15). Reminding the Quraysh of the Destruction of Earlier Disbelieving Nations Allah the Exalted warns the disbelievers of Quraysh and reminds them of the punishment and painful torment that He sent in this life on their likes, who disbelieved before them. For instance, Allah the Exalted…

item.title: Qaaf:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu l-rasi wathamūdu Belied (also) those before them the people of Noah and the dwellers of Ar-Rass and Thamood, See 50:11

item.title: Qaaf:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭin and 'Ād, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,

item.title: Qaaf:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭin And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers (i.e., people) of Lut. See 50:12

item.title: Qaaf:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭin And 'Ad and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot, See 50:11

item.title: Qaaf:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīdi and the inhabitants of Aykah and the people of Tubba'.1 Each [of them] impugned the apostles, and so My threat became due [against them].

item.title: Qaaf:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīdi And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. See 50:12

item.title: Qaaf:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīdi And the dwellers of the Wood and the people of Tubba; all belied the apostles, so was proved true My promise (of the doom). See 50:11

item.title: Qaaf:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsin min khalqin jadīdin Were We exhausted by the first creation? Rather they are in doubt about a new creation.

item.title: Qaaf:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsin min khalqin jadīdin Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation. See 50:12

item.title: Qaaf:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsin min khalqin jadīdin What! were We then wearied (Fatigued.) out with the first creation? Yet are they in doubt about the creation anew. (Refer to verses 50:38, 46:33, 2:255.) See 50:11

item.title: Qaaf:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīdi Certainly We have created man and We know to what his soul tempts him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

item.title: Qaaf:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīdi And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer1 to him than (his) jugular vein. And indeed We have created man, and We know what his self whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein (50:16). (Remember) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being), one sitting on the right and one on the left (50:17). Not a word does he (or she) utter but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it) (50:18). And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding! (50:19). And the Trumpet…

item.title: Qaaf:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīdi And indeed We created man, and know We whatever thoughts whispereth his self unto him, and We are nearer (The nearer here is the nearness of a real cause to its effect.) to him than his (very) life-vein. When it is a fact that everything in the universe has been created by God then the Creator would naturally and essentially know each one of His creatures more than the creatures would themselves know. The knowledge of the creature about itself would necessarily depend upon the gift of consciousness and intellect endowed in it by the Creator Himself. Man has been created by God. God knows everything, even the inner most, i.e., the…

item.title: Qaaf:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli qaʿīdun When the twin recorders record [his deeds], seated on the right hand and on the left:

item.title: Qaaf:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli qaʿīdun When the two receivers (i.e., recording angels) receive,1 seated on the right and on the left. See 50:16

item.title: Qaaf:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli qaʿīdun When receive (and record all doings) the two (guardian angels) appointed to receive, sitting, (one) on the right and (the other) on the left. The two attached, is referred to, the two angels who are posted to remain stationed on the right and on the left of each individual man and woman, recording every word and deed that comes out of the individual.

item.title: Qaaf:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdun he says no word but that there is a ready observer beside him.

item.title: Qaaf:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdun He (i.e., man) utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared (to record). See 50:16

item.title: Qaaf:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdun He (Man.) pronounceth not a word but is unto him a watcher ready (to record) Nothing uttered or acted, is ever missed by these recorders who record every word and deed of the individual then and there. The one angel records all goodness and the other one records everything evil wrought by the individual. It is said that when any one commits a sin, respite of some time is given by the mercy of the Lord for the individual to repent and amend himself and when the sinner does not avail of it, the evil committed is then recorded.

item.title: Qaaf:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīdu Then the agony of death brings the truth:1 'This is what you used to shun!'

item.title: Qaaf:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīdu And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid. See 50:16

item.title: Qaaf:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīdu And shall come the stupor (Agony.) of death in truth; that is (the state) which thou wast wont to shun. (Avoid.) See 50:18

item.title: Qaaf:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīdi Then the Trumpet will be blown: 'This is the promised day.'

item.title: Qaaf:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīdi And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of (carrying out) the threat. See 50:16

item.title: Qaaf:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīdi And shall be blown the Trumpet, it is the Day Promised (warned against). See 50:18

item.title: Qaaf:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ wajāat kullu nafsin maʿahā sāiqun washahīdun Then every soul will come accompanied by a driver and a witness:

item.title: Qaaf:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ wajāat kullu nafsin maʿahā sāiqun washahīdun And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.1 See 50:16

item.title: Qaaf:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ wajāat kullu nafsin maʿahā sāiqun washahīdun And shall come every soul, along with it a driver and a witness. (Refer to verse 50:17.) On the Day of Judgment every soul shall be driven by an angel and the angels with the record of the deeds of the soul will also be there to bear witness to his conduct in this life. Corresponding to man's practical and theoretical faculties. (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ laqad kunta fī ghaflatin min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīdun 'You were certainly oblivious of this. We have removed your veil from you, and so your sight is acute today.'

item.title: Qaaf:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ laqad kunta fī ghaflatin min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīdun (It will be said), "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,1 so your sight, this Day, is sharp." See 50:16

item.title: Qaaf:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ laqad kunta fī ghaflatin min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīdun (It will be said): "Thou wert heedless of this, now have We removed from thee thy veil, so thy sight today is sharp." Every one shall be made to see the actual consequences of his own evils which the individual could not visualise in this life. This proves that in the life hereafter the senses will be sharpened.1 (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīdun Then his companion will say, 'This is what is ready with me [of testimony].'

item.title: Qaaf:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīdun And his companion, (the angel), will say, "This (record) is what is with me, prepared." And his companion (angel) will say: Here is (his record) ready with me! (50:23). (Allah will say to the angels:) "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever (50:24). "Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter, (50:25). "Who set up another god with Allah. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment (50:26). His companion (devil) will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, but he was himself in error far astray (50:27). (Allah) will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat (50:28). "The sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants…

item.title: Qaaf:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīdun And shall say his companion: (The angel.) "This is what is ready with me" See 50:22

item.title: Qaaf:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdin 'The two of you cast every obdurate ingrate into hell,

item.title: Qaaf:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdin (Allah will say), "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever. See 50:23

item.title: Qaaf:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdin (It will be commanded): "Cast ye two (Angels.) into hell, every ingrate rebel," The verb used here is 'daul' - Ibn Abbas says, He, i.e., the Holy Prophet, told me saying 'O' Ibn Abbas! Follow thou 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib, for his words are guidance and following him is salvation. Never go against his orders - Woe unto the one who holds enmity with him or is ill-disposed to him. Beware thou 'O' Ibn Abbas! On the Day of Judgment he would admit the people to hell and heaven." It is said that the two who would be commanded by God to throw the sinners into the hell-fire would be the Holy Prophet and 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib (MS). The criterion of judging the individuals might be the…

item.title: Qaaf:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُرِيبٍ mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin murībin [every] hinderer of all good,1 transgressor, and skeptic,

item.title: Qaaf:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُرِيبٍ mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin murībin Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter. See 50:23

item.title: Qaaf:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُرِيبٍ mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin murībin The forbidder of good, the transgressor, the doubter, See 50:24

item.title: Qaaf:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi l-shadīdi who has set up another god along with Allah! So the two of you cast him into the severe punishment.'

item.title: Qaaf:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi l-shadīdi Who made (as equal) with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment." See 50:23

item.title: Qaaf:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi l-shadīdi Who did set up with God other gods, then cast him ye two into the severe chastisement. Those who did not submit totally to the authority of God. (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīdin His companion1 will say, 'Our Lord! I did not make him a rebel, but he [himself] was in extreme error.'

item.title: Qaaf:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīdin His (devil) companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he (himself) was in extreme error." See 50:23

item.title: Qaaf:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīdin Will say his companion: "O' Our Lord! I led him not to rebel but he had himself gone far astray" 'Companion' here stands for satan whose society man did not shun in spite of being repeatedly warned by God.1

item.title: Qaaf:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيدِ qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīdi He will say, 'Do not wrangle in My presence, for I had already warned you in advance.

item.title: Qaaf:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيدِ qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīdi (Allah) will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat (i.e., warning). See 50:23

item.title: Qaaf:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيدِ qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīdi He shall say: "Wrangle ye not in my presence, Indeed I had sent beforehand unto you the warning:" See 50:27

item.title: Qaaf:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi The word [of judgement] is unalterable with Me, and I am not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: Qaaf:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi The word (i.e., decree) will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants." See 50:23

item.title: Qaaf:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi Changeth not the word with Me, nor am I (in the least) unjust unto (any of) the servants. See 50:27

item.title: Qaaf:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal min mazīdin The day when We shall say to hell, 'Are you full?' It will say, 'Is there any more?'

item.title: Qaaf:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal min mazīdin On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more." On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more? (50:30). And Paradise will be Uzlifat to those who had Taqwa, not far off (50:31). (It will be said): "This is what you were promised – (it is) for those returning in sincere repentance, and Hafiz (50:32). "Who feared Ar-Rahman unseen and brought a heart turned in repentance (50:33). "Enter you therein in peace and security – this is a Day of eternal life! (50:34). There they will have all that they desire – and We have more (50:35). Jahannam and Paradise and…

item.title: Qaaf:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal min mazīdin That day We will say unto hell: "Art thou filled up?" And it will say: "Are there (any) more?" To make man know that the hell is not a place of any limited accommodation for God's punishment to stop for want of any space in the hell for the sinners. Any number of the convicts thrown into it, would never fill it, there would still be space for even more.

item.title: Qaaf:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīdin And paradise will be brought near for the Godwary, not distant [any more]:

item.title: Qaaf:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīdin And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far. See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīdin And the Garden (Paradise) shall be brought near unto the pious ones, not far (from thence). See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓin 'This is what you were promised. [It is] for every penitent and dutiful [servant]

item.title: Qaaf:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓin (It will be said), "This is what you were promised - for every returner (to Allah) and keeper (of His covenant). See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓin This is what ye have been promised; (this is) for every one who turneth (frequently) unto God, (and) guardeth (His limits); See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُنِيبٍ man khashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbin munībin who fears the All-beneficent in secret and comes with a penitent heart.

item.title: Qaaf:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُنِيبٍ man khashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbin munībin Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning (in repentance). See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُنِيبٍ man khashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbin munībin Who feareth the Beneficent God in secret, and cometh (unto Him) with a heart, turned (to Him in devotion) See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūdi Enter it in peace! This is the day of immortality.'

item.title: Qaaf:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūdi Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity." See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūdi Enter it ye in peace, this is the Day of eternal life! See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdun There they will have whatever they wish, and with Us there is yet more.

item.title: Qaaf:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdun They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more. See 50:30

item.title: Qaaf:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdun For them therein shall be whatever they desire and with Us is yet more. The main feature of the heavenly life, is having what is wanted - and free from any need - i.e., satisfaction with blessing after blessing. (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal min maḥīṣin How many generations We have destroyed before them, who were stronger than these, insomuch that they ransacked the towns?! Is there any escape [from Allah's punishment]?

item.title: Qaaf:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal min maḥīṣin And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in (striking) power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape? And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And they went about the land! Could they find any place of refuge (50:36). Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful (50:37). And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us (50:38). So bear with patience all that…

item.title: Qaaf:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal min maḥīṣin And how many a generation We did destroy before them who were mightier than they in power! then they did wander through the lands; (searching) if there was any place of refuge (for them)? See 50:35

item.title: Qaaf:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā l-samʿa wahuwa shahīdun There is indeed an admonition in that for one who has a heart, or gives ear, being attentive.

item.title: Qaaf:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā l-samʿa wahuwa shahīdun Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present (in mind). See 50:36

item.title: Qaaf:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā l-samʿa wahuwa shahīdun Verily in this is a reminder for him who hath a heart or he giveth ear with the presence of his mind. Only those would be benefited by the Holy Qur'an who have hearts to understand, who have ears to hear the truth and who are and an there ready to bear witness to the Truth, i.e., only those who make a sincere and an intelligent study of it. Jesus has also said the same thing. "He that hath ears to hear, let him hear."1 Either with a pure heart to reflect the Truth or listen to the former, with the presence of mind. (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin wamā massanā min lughūbin Certainly We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days, and any fatigue did not touch Us.

item.title: Qaaf:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin wamā massanā min lughūbin And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness. See 50:36

item.title: Qaaf:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin wamā massanā min lughūbin And indeed created We the heavens and the earth and what is between them two, in six periods and touched Us not any fatigue. (Refer to verses 50:15, 35:35, 7:54) Refer to verses 7:54, 41:12, 10:3, 11:7, 25:59, 31:4, 40:9. Regarding fatigue of any kind not touching God, see 35:35. This confirms that the total periods of creation does not exceed six.1 (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūbi So be patient over what they say, and celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the sunset,

item.title: Qaaf:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūbi So be patient, (O Muḥammad), over what they say and exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting. See 50:36

item.title: Qaaf:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūbi So be thou patient on what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere its setting, This verse hints about the five daily canonical prayers. The prayers before sunrise, Fajr. 2 and 3 'Zuhr' the (afternoon prayers and Asr 4 and 5) Sunset and the night prayers, i.e., Maghrib and Isha. Man has always to remember His real Lord but for the individual adoration the best times are enumerated in this verse.

item.title: Qaaf:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra l-sujūdi and glorify Him through part of the night and after the prostrations.

item.title: Qaaf:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra l-sujūdi And (in part) of the night exalt Him and after prostration (i.e., prayer). See 50:36

item.title: Qaaf:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra l-sujūdi And in the night glorify Him and after the prostrations (prayers). By the glorification at night referred to here, is taken as 'Tahajjud' (i.e., after the Midnight prayers) which is among the supernumerary or the extra prayers called the 'Sunnat' or the Nawafil. After the prostration is taken as the Sunnat prayers and the remembering God's glorious attributes (on a rosary) or the extra supplication by concluding the prayers, attitude of the individual in meditation and seeking the divine grace for the individual.

item.title: Qaaf:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi min makānin qarībin And be on the alert for the day when the caller calls from a close quarter,

item.title: Qaaf:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi min makānin qarībin And listen on the Day when the Caller1 will call out from a place that is near. And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place (50:41). The Day when they will hear As-Sayhah in truth, that will be the Day of coming out (50:42). Verily, it is We Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return (50:43). On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us (50:44). We know best what they say. And you are not the one to force them. But warn by the Qur'an; him who fears My threat (50:45). Admonition from Some Scenes…

item.title: Qaaf:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi min makānin qarībin And listen for the day whereon the crier shall cry from near place, See 50:40

item.title: Qaaf:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ yawma yasmaʿūna l-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūji the day when they hear the Cry in all truth. That is the day of rising [from the dead].

item.title: Qaaf:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ yawma yasmaʿūna l-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūji The Day they will hear the blast (of the Horn) in truth. That is the Day of Emergence (from the graves). See 50:41

item.title: Qaaf:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ yawma yasmaʿūna l-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūji The Day when they hear the cry in truth; that is the Day of coming forth (from the graves) The reference may be to the advent of the Last Imam Mahdi and the return of Jesus or the Final Resurrection but the contents are more in favour of the first - for it commands to listen which can refer to the living while the resurrection will only follow the second Trumpet and there will be none living to listen. (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīru Indeed it is We who give life and bring death, and toward Us is the destination.

item.title: Qaaf:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīru Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination. See 50:41

item.title: Qaaf:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīru Verily, We give life and cause death, and unto Us shall all return. See 50:42

item.title: Qaaf:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīrun The day the earth is split open for [disentombing] them, [they will come out] hastening. That mustering1 is easy for Us [to carry out].

item.title: Qaaf:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīrun On the Day the earth breaks away from them (and they emerge) rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us. See 50:41

item.title: Qaaf:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīrun The Day on which the earth shall cleave asunder under them, they will make haste; that is a gathering together easy for Us, This may refer to the Total Resurrection or the partial one1 (A.P.)

item.title: Qaaf:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مَنْ يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni man yakhāfu waʿīdi We know best what they say, and you are not to be a tyrant over them. So admonish by the Qur'ān him who fears My threat.

item.title: Qaaf:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مَنْ يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni man yakhāfu waʿīdi We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.1 But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat. See 50:41

item.title: Qaaf:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مَنْ يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni man yakhāfu waʿīdi We know best what they say, and thou art not one to compel (Refer to note on verse 2:256) them; therefore remind him though the Quran who feareth My threat. See 50:44

item.title: Quraish:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ liīlāfi qurayshin [In gratitude] for solidarity1 among the Quraysh,

item.title: Quraish:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ liīlāfi qurayshin For the accustomed security of the Quraysh1. الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ Who has fed them against hunger, Meaning: He is the Lord of the House and He is the One Who feeds them against hunger. وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ And has made them safe from fear. Meaning: He favors them with safety and gentleness, so they should single Him out for worship alone, without any partner. They should not worship any idol, rival or statue besides Him. Therefore, whoever accepts this command, Allah will give him safety in both this life and the Hereafter. However, whoever disobeys Him, He will remove both of them from him. This is as Allah says: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ آمِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ اللَّهِ فَأَذَاقَهَا اللَّهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ - وَلَقَدْ…

item.title: Quraish:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ liīlāfi qurayshin For the union (Protection – Security.) of the Quraysh 'Quraysh' - The noble tribe constituted by the descendants of Nazr Ibn Kunanah, settled in Mecca. They were the descendants of Abraham through Ishmael. To this tribe belonged the Holy Prophet Muhammad. The Quraysh held the charge of the Holy House which was constructed and dedicated exclusively for the worship of the Only True God, by Abraham and Ishmael. The Quraysh were honoured all over Arabia because of the Holy Ka'ba being in their City Mecca and their being its guardians and custodians. In summer they used to go to Syria and in winter to Yaman for purposes of trade and it was through God's grace that they travelled safe and undisturbed in their journeys, otherwise the routes were not safe, and none could travel without being…

item.title: Quraish:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ īlāfihim riḥ'lata l-shitāi wal-ṣayfi their solidarity during winter and summer journeys,

item.title: Quraish:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ īlāfihim riḥ'lata l-shitāi wal-ṣayfi Their accustomed security (in) the caravan of winter and summer1. See 106:1

item.title: Quraish:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ īlāfihim riḥ'lata l-shitāi wal-ṣayfi Their union during their journey in the winter and the summer The protection, safety and the honour, the Quraysh enjoyed was due to the Holy Ka'ba being in their city and their being its guardians.

item.title: Quraish:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ falyaʿbudū rabba hādhā l-bayti let them worship the Lord of this House,

item.title: Quraish:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ falyaʿbudū rabba hādhā l-bayti Let them worship the Lord of this House.1 See 106:1

item.title: Quraish:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ falyaʿbudū rabba hādhā l-bayti So let them worship the Lord of this House The Quraysh, under the great obligation, in duty bound, should worship or serve the Lord of the Ka'ba who is the True God and not their own made idols and their other fanciful deities in His place, who could neither hurt nor profit anyone.

item.title: Quraish:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin waāmanahum min khawfin who has fed them [and saved them] from hunger, and secured them from fear.

item.title: Quraish:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin waāmanahum min khawfin Who has fed them, (saving them) from hunger and made them safe, (saving them) from fear. See 106:1

item.title: Quraish:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin waāmanahum min khawfin (He) Who fed them against hunger (Refer to: 2:126, 14:37, 28:57, 29:67.) , and secured them against fear When the Quraysh have been granted such great blessings they must gratefully worship the Lord of the Ka'ba, who in spite of their land being only a desert and thus unproductive, provides them with every kind of good food and the other provisions of life through merchandise and the pilgrimage which brings to their very door, their needs through the great multitudes of the visitors who come there also to buy and sell, and God had protected them from the most formidable enemy Abraha, but for God's help they would have been destroyed and their city would have been lost, the Ka'ba, on account of which they are…

item.title: Saad:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ص وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'ri Ṣād. By the Qur'ān bearing the Reminder!1

item.title: Saad:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ص وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'ri Ṣād.1 By the Qur’ān containing reminder...2 كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ How many a generation have We destroyed before them! Meaning: disbelieving nations. فَنَادَوْا And they cried out means, when the punishment came to them, they called for help and cried out to Allah, but that did not save them at all. This is like the Ayat: فَلَمَّا أَحَسُّوا بَأْسَنَا إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ - لَا تَرْكُضُوا وَارْجِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَا أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْأَلُونَ Then, when they perceived (saw) Our torment, behold, they (tried to) flee from it. Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned. (21:12-13) Abu Dawud At-Tayalisi recorded that At-Tamimi said, I asked Ibn 'Abbas (RA), about the Ayah: فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ…

item.title: Saad:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ص وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'ri Sad, (S) By the Qur'an (which) is full of admonition (Reminder.) It must be remembered that we are warned against imaginary interpretation of the letter-symbols used in the Holy Qur'an.1 'Zikr' is one of the names of the Holy Qur'an and the Word means 'Reminder.' Some commentators say that 'Sad' is one of the hidden names of God. But the Qur'an is called Reminder, Admonition and Guidance. The sura as a whole, contains reminders about the chosen righteous servants of God. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqin Yet the faithless dwell in conceit and defiance.

item.title: Saad:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqin But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension. See 38:1

item.title: Saad:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqin Nay! those who disbelieve are (steeped) in self-exaltation and opposition. The disbelievers are involved in false dignity, rebellious pride and self-exaltation, - dissensions among themselves resulting into separation even among their own selves.

item.title: Saad:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣin How many a generation We have destroyed before them! They cried out [for help], but it was no more the time for escape.

item.title: Saad:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣin How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they (then) called out; but it was not a time for escape. See 38:1

item.title: Saad:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣin How many We did destroy of the generations before them, and they cried while (there was no longer) the time to escape. Refers to the people who disbelieved the truth, when it was preached to them and who did not reflect and amend their faith and conduct and when respite was granted to them, i.e., they did avail of the respite to their profit and when the chastisement overtook them, they cried for help which was in vain. There was no way of escape left for them.

item.title: Saad:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābun They consider it odd that there should come to them a warner from among themselves, and the faithless say, 'This is a magician, a mendacious liar.'

item.title: Saad:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābun And they wonder that there has come to them a warner (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW) from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar. And they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This is a sorcerer, a liar (38:4). "Has he made the gods into One God. Verily, this is a curious thing! (38:5). And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your gods! Verily, this is a thing designed! (38:6). "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days. This is nothing but an invention! (38:7). "Has the Reminder been sent down to…

item.title: Saad:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābun And they did wonder that came unto them a warner from among themselves, and said the disbelievers: "This is a sorcerer, a great liar." The people called the Apostle of God as a Threatening Sorcerer.

item.title: Saad:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَهًا وَاحِدًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābun 'Has he reduced the gods to one god? This is indeed an odd thing!'

item.title: Saad:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَهًا وَاحِدًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābun Has he made the gods (only) one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing." See 38:4

item.title: Saad:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَهًا وَاحِدًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābun What! maketh he (The Warner i.e., the Apostle.) the gods to be but one God? Verily this is a thing indeed strange! The disbelievers wondered at the Unity of God against their polytheistic belief in the many gods of their own imagination and fancy. This is the main reason of Quraysh opposition that they did not want to give up the bureaucratic system of life which was the outcome of the idol worship or the idol worship was the outcome of the system. They did not like to give up idolatry and to surrender or submit to one authority. Here in the beginning of Islam they expressed their surprise and later on, when Islam established its theocratic form of Government in the person of…

item.title: Saad:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوْۤا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَى آلِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurādu Their elite go about [urging others]: 'Go and stand by your gods! This is indeed the desirable thing [to do].

item.title: Saad:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوْۤا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَى آلِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurādu And the eminent among them went forth, (saying), "Continue, and be patient over (the defense of) your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.1 See 38:4

item.title: Saad:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوْۤا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَى آلِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurādu And the chiefs from them get away (impatiently, exhorting the others saying): "Walk ye away hence and be steadfast unto your gods: verily this is (but) with something designed against us!" 'Shaiyun Yuraad', i.e., thing designed. Behind this doctrine there is some plan against us. (A.P.)

item.title: Saad:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqun We did not hear of this in the latter-day creed.1 This is nothing but a fabrication.

item.title: Saad:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqun We have not heard of this in the latest religion.1 This is not but a fabrication. See 38:4

item.title: Saad:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqun We heard not of this (Such a unity of One Absolute God.) in the former creed. This is nothing but an imposture: 'Ikhtilaq', i.e., a fabricated tale. People were so deeply sunk in idolatry and were so much intoxicated with pride and self-exaltation, that they called the Truth a made-up or a fabricated tale. The reference here is to the immediately preceding faith, i.e., Christianity, saying that unity being absent among the Christians themselves, is a clear proof of their having departed from the purely monotheistic religion preached by Jesus, having adopted the polytheistic Trinity which the pagans say that they did not find any trace of the Unity of God in it. Such a unity - The Jews believed…

item.title: Saad:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ ذِكْرِي بَلْ لَمَّا يَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِ a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhābi Has the reminder been sent down to him out of [all of] us?' Rather they are in doubt concerning My reminder. Rather they have not yet tasted My punishment.

item.title: Saad:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ ذِكْرِي بَلْ لَمَّا يَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِ a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhābi Has the message been revealed to him out of (all of) us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment. See 38:4

item.title: Saad:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ ذِكْرِي بَلْ لَمَّا يَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِ a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhābi (What!) Hath the reminder been sent down (only) unto him (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) among us?" Nay! they are in doubt about My reminder, Nay! they have yet tasted not My chastisement! The people said that if any message from God had to be conveyed to them, why should it come to the orphan son of Abdullah, for it ought to have come to one of the rich ones, i.e., the chiefs among them. The reply is also contained in the verse saying that the people had no clear or correct idea as to how God executes His Will. Apostleship or the agency or the medium of the divine guidance…

item.title: Saad:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahābi Do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-mighty, the All-munificent?

item.title: Saad:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahābi Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?1 See 38:4

item.title: Saad:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahābi Or is it that with them are the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the All-Mighty, the Greater Bestower? If they have all the means, power and authority to set themselves up against the independent and Omnipotent authority of God about His choosing His own men for His mission, let them mount up into the heavens, and see if they could do it at all.

item.title: Saad:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbābi Do they own the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? [If so,] let them ascend [to the higher spheres] by the means1 [of ascension].

item.title: Saad:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbābi Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through (any) ways of access.1 See 38:4

item.title: Saad:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbābi Or is it that unto them belongeth the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend with means (Ropes or ladders.) See 38:9

item.title: Saad:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جُنْدٌ مَا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzābi [They are but] a routed host out there, from among the factions.1

item.title: Saad:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جُنْدٌ مَا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzābi (They are but) soldiers (who will be) defeated there among the companies (of disbelievers). See 38:4

item.title: Saad:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جُنْدٌ مَا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzābi And what a mighty host of the clans shall here be routed. (This is a prophecy about the clans Ahzab, being utterly defeated by the Muslims which was an impossibility.) This is a prophecy saying that even when they would combine all the forces in the land, they could ally themselves with, they would suffer an absolute discomfiture and a total overthrow, miserably routed and crushed.1 This is a prophecy about the fate of the group of the Allies which were to be defeated very soon.2 (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtādi Before them Noah's people impugned [their apostle] and [so did the people of] 'Ād, and Pharaoh, the Impaler1 [of his victims],

item.title: Saad:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtādi The people of Nuh denied before them, and (the tribe of) ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes.1 Before them denied – the people of Nuh; and 'Ad; and Fir'awn the man of stakes (38:12). And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Dwellers of Al-Aykah; such were the Confederates (38:13). Not one of them but denied the Messengers; therefore My torment was justified (38:14). And these only wait for a single Sayhah there will be no pause or ending thereto (38:15). They say: Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittana before the Day of Reckoning! (38:16). Be patient of what they say.. () A Reminder of Those Who were destroyed among the Previous Nations Allah tells us about those past nations and the…

item.title: Saad:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtādi And did belie before them the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh the lord, of stakes (of established authority), This is a reference to the fate of the previous people who disbelieved and rejected the truth. It is indirectly asked that should not the posterity of those who suffered before take a lesson from their ancestors.1

item.title: Saad:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzābu and Thamūd, and the people of Lot, and the inhabitants of Aykah:1 those were the factions.

item.title: Saad:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzābu And (the tribe of) Thamūd and the people of Lut and the companions of the thicket (i.e., people of Madyan). Those are the companies.1 See 38:12

item.title: Saad:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzābu And Thamood and the people of Lot and the dwellers of the wood; these were the clans. See 38:12

item.title: Saad:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqābi Each of them did not but impugn the apostles; so My retribution became due [against them].

item.title: Saad:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqābi Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified. See 38:12

item.title: Saad:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqābi Not one (of them) but did belie the apostles (from Me) so just was (My) retribution. See 38:12

item.title: Saad:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqin These1 do not await but a single Cry which will not grant any respite.

item.title: Saad:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqin And these (disbelievers) await not but one blast (of the Horn); for it there will be no delay.1 See 38:12

item.title: Saad:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqin And wait not these (infidels) but a single (Trumpet) blast, there shall be no delaying (No recovery – no escape.) it. See 38:12

item.title: Saad:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisābi They say, 'Our Lord! Hasten on for us our share1 before the Day of Reckoning.'

item.title: Saad:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisābi And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share (of the punishment) before the Day of Account." See 38:12

item.title: Saad:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisābi And (yet) they (dare to) say: "O' Our Lord! hasten on unto us our lot before the Day of Reckoning" May refer to what the disbelievers used to say in mockery. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُدَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābun Be patient over what they say, and remember Our servant, David, [the man] of strength. Indeed he was a penitent [soul].

item.title: Saad:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُدَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābun Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, Dawud, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back (to Allah). And remember Our slave Dawud, endued with Al-Ayd. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (38:17). Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our praises with him in the 'Ashi and Ishraq (38:18). And (so did) the birds assembled, all obedient to him (38:19). We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Hikmah and sound judgement in speech and decision (38:20). Dawud (AS)Allah Tells us that His Servant and Messenger Dawud (AS), was Endued with Power. Al-Ayd Means Strength in Knowledge and Action. Ibn 'Abbas (RA), As-Suddi and Ibn…

item.title: Saad:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُدَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābun Bear (thou) with patience what they say, and remember Our servant David, (who was blessed by Us) with the strength of hand, (and yet) verily he (was the one who) Oft-turned (unto Us in patience). See 38:16

item.title: Saad:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāqi Indeed We disposed the mountains to glorify [Allah] with him at evening and dawn,

item.title: Saad:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāqi Indeed, We subjected the mountains (to praise) with him, exalting (Allah) in the (late) afternoon and (after) sunrise. See 38:17

item.title: Saad:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāqi Verily, We did subject the mountains to join with him in the hymns (of their Lord) at the night-fall and at sunrise, See 38:16

item.title: Saad:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَهُ أَوَّابٌ wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābun and the birds [as well], mustered [in flocks], all echoing him [in a chorus].

item.title: Saad:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَهُ أَوَّابٌ wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābun And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating (praises). See 38:17

item.title: Saad:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَهُ أَوَّابٌ wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābun And the birds assembled together (to sing the hymns unto their Lord) and were unto him (David.) obedient. See 38:16

item.title: Saad:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭābi We made his kingdom firm and gave him wisdom and conclusive speech.

item.title: Saad:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭābi And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech. See 38:17

item.title: Saad:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭābi And made We strong his kingdom and bestowed We on him wisdom, and the clear (power of) judgment. Two Israelites came to David disputing about a cow. David demanded witnesses from the plaintiff but the plaintiff could not produce them. David asked the disputants to come to him the next day. At night in a dream David was commanded to slay the defendant, but since the crime was not proved by any evidence, he did not execute the decree and yet delayed the decision. When for three consecutive nights David had the same dream, David ordered the defendant to be executed. The defendant pleaded asking the grounds on which the sentence was passed. David replied that he had been commanded by God through dreams consecutively for three nights.…

item.title: Saad:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهَلْ أَتَىكَ نَبَؤُا الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāba Has there not come to you the account of the contenders, when they scaled the wall into the sanctuary?1

item.title: Saad:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهَلْ أَتَىكَ نَبَؤُا الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāba And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of (his) prayer chamber. And has the news of the litigants reached you? When they climbed over the wall into (his) Mihrab (private chamber of worship) (38:21). When they entered in upon Dawud, he was terrified of them. They said: "Fear not! (We are) two litigants, one of us has wronged the other, therefore judge between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, and guide us to the right way (38:22). Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety-nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: "Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech (38:23). (Dawud) said: "He has wronged you…

item.title: Saad:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَهَلْ أَتَىكَ نَبَؤُا الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāba And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? when they climbed the wall into the prayer room? Oriya the brother of David had asked for the hand of a woman in marriage to him. The match was fixed but at the last moment the guardians of the woman decided not to give her to Oriya and the match was consequently dissolved. David sent his message for the woman, and her guardians influenced by David's position as the king, gave her away to him in marriage. David had already 99 wives, and this woman added, the number was a complete 100. Oriya was hurt. David ought to have chosen the course preferable for him, i.e., to have used his good services and dominant influence to…

item.title: Saad:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى دَاوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَى بَعْضُنَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَى سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭi When they entered into the presence of David, he was alarmed by them. They said, 'Do not be afraid. [We are only] two contenders: one of us has bullied the other. So judge justly between us, and do not exceed [the bounds of justice], and show us the right path.'

item.title: Saad:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى دَاوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَى بَعْضُنَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَى سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭi When they entered upon Dawud and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. (We are) two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed (it) and guide us to the sound path. See 38:21

item.title: Saad:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى دَاوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَى بَعْضُنَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَى سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭi When entered they upon David and he was frightened (Refer to verses 11:70, 20:21, 15:52, 51:53, 51:25 - 51:28.) of them, said they: "Fear (i.e., Surprised. Apostles of God are free from the ordinary fear experienced by the other mortals. Refer to note on verse 10:62.) (thou) not, (we are) two litigants, one of us hath exceeded against the other, so decide thou between us with justice, and act not unjustly, and guide us unto the right way." See 38:21

item.title: Saad:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭābi 'Indeed this brother of mine has ninety-nine ewes, while I have only a single ewe, and [yet] he says, 'Commit it to my care,' and he browbeats me in speech.'

item.title: Saad:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭābi Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech." See 38:21

item.title: Saad:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭābi Verily, this my brother; he hath ninety and nine ewes and for me is but a single ewe;" but said he, "Make me the owner of that (also), and hath prevailed over me in arguing The angels in human forms said that one of them already had ninety-nine sheep and the other had only one, but the one who had 99 wanted to have the only one also which the other one had.

item.title: Saad:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
