item.description: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَى نِعَاجِهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāba He said, 'He has certainly wronged you by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes, and indeed many partners bully one another, except such as have faith and do righteous deeds, and few are they.' Then David knew that We had indeed tested him, whereat he pleaded with his Lord for forgiveness, and fell down prostrate and repented.

item.title: Saad:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَى نِعَاجِهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāba (Dawud) said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe (in addition) to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And Dawud became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord1 and fell down bowing (in prostration) and turned in repentance (to Allah). See 38:21

item.title: Saad:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَى نِعَاجِهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāba Said (David): "Indeed hath he been unjust unto thee in demanding thine ewe to add her to his own ewes: Verily many of the associates act wrongfully unto one another, save those who believe and do good deeds, and few are they!" And David perceived that We (God.) had tried him: so asked he the forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down bowing and oft-turning himself (unto Us). David decreed that the demand was unjust.…

item.title: Saad:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin So We forgave him that and indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination.

item.title: Saad:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return. See 38:21

item.title: Saad:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin So We forgave him that (lapse), and verily for him with Us is a near approach, and an excellent resort. See 38:24

item.title: Saad:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَادَاوُدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisābi 'O David! Indeed We have made you a vicegerent on the earth. So judge between people with justice, and do not follow desire, or it will lead you astray from the way of Allah. Indeed those who stray from the way of Allah —there is a severe punishment for them because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.'

item.title: Saad:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَادَاوُدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisābi (We said), "O Dawud, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow (your own) desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account. O Dawud! Verily, We have placed you as a successor on the earth; so judge you between men in…

item.title: Saad:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَادَاوُدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisābi O' David! Verily We have appointed thee a vicegerent in the earth, so judge thou between the people with justice and follow not vain desires, lest it should take thee astray from the Way of God; for them shall be a severe chastisement for forgot they the Day of Reckoning. See verse 2:30. It is obvious that David as represented in the Biblical story of the wife of Oriya, does not agree to his divine position as the Vicegerent of…

item.title: Saad:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنَ النَّارِ wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nāri We did not create the sky and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. That is a conjecture of the faithless. So woe to the faithless for the Fire!

item.title: Saad:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنَ النَّارِ wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nāri And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire. And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire (38:27). Shall We treat those who believe and do righteous good deeds as those who cause mischief on the earth? Or shall We treat those who have Taqwa as the evildoers (38:28). (This is) a Book which We have sent down to…

item.title: Saad:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنَ النَّارِ wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nāri And We created not the heavens and the earth in vain: that is the imagination of those who disbelieve; then woe unto those who disbelieve - because of the fire. It is made crystal clear that the creation of the Universe has been with a definite plan of its Creator Lord and not an effect of any unintentional act or any purposeless accident. Thinking that the creation is an outcome of a mechanical accident - with no prepared design. (A.P.). Regarding the object of the creation of life and death and the jinns and men, see 67:2 and 51:56; 10:14, 11:7, 18:7, 21:35, 29:3. All these verses clearly…

item.title: Saad:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujāri Shall We treat those who have faith and do righteous deeds like those who cause corruption on the earth? Shall We treat the Godwary like the vicious?

item.title: Saad:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujāri Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked? See 38:27

item.title: Saad:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujāri (Or) shall We treat those who believe and do good deeds like the mischief-makers in the earth? Or shall We treat the pious ones like the wicked (loose conduct.) ones? See 38:27

item.title: Saad:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّرُوا اٰیٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albābi [It is] a blessed Book that We have sent down to you, so that they may contemplate its signs, and that those who possess intellect may take admonition.

item.title: Saad:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّرُوا اٰیٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albābi (This is) a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded. See 38:27

item.title: Saad:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّرُوا اٰیٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albābi (O' Our Apostle Muhammad! this Qur'an is) the Book (Qur'an i.e., A Book complete.) which We have sent down unto thee, abounding in blessings, that they may ponder over its verses, and bear in mind those (who are) endowed (Mindful.) with understanding. See 38:27

item.title: Saad:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun And to David We gave Solomon —what an excellent servant! Indeed he was a penitent [soul].

item.title: Saad:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun And to Dawud We gave Sulayman. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back (to Allah). And to Dawud We gave Sulayman. How excellent a servant! Verily, he was ever turning in repentance (to Us) (38:30). When there were displayed before him, in the afternoon, well trained horses of the highest breed (38:31). He said: "I did love the good instead of remembering my Lord," till the time was over, and (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of night) (38:32). Then he said: "Bring them back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (38:33). Sulayman the Son of Dawud Allah tells us that he gave Sulayman to Dawud as a Prophet, as He says elsewhere:…

item.title: Saad:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun And to David We gave (a son) Solomon; an excellent servant (of Ours was he); Verily he was oft-turning (unto Us). See 38:27

item.title: Saad:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyādu When one evening there were displayed before him prancing steeds,

item.title: Saad:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyādu (Mention) when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised (standing) racehorses. See 38:30

item.title: Saad:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyādu Remember when were shown unto him at eventide lightfooted coursers. (chargers horses.) Once while Solomon was busy seeing some horses which had been purchased for purpose of war against some disbelievers, found the time for the afternoon prayer had passed away and Solomon addressed the angels to get back the set sunlight to enable him to offer his prayers to God. By then the sun had set and the stars had appeared in the sky. By the prayer of Solomon the sun returned and it was again an afternoon and when he finished his afternoon prayers it was night again. This is what some commentators say but see A.P.'s note on verse 32. Twice did such a thing happen in the Islamic history, once after the Battle of…

item.title: Saad:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتّٰی تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijābi he said, 'Indeed I have preferred the love of [worldly] niceties to the remembrance of my Lord until [the sun] disappeared behind the [night's] veil.'

item.title: Saad:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتّٰی تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijābi And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good (things) over the remembrance of my Lord until it (i.e., the sun) disappeared into the curtain (of darkness)." See 38:30

item.title: Saad:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتّٰی تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijābi Then said he: "Verily I have loved the good things besides the remembrance of my Lord, until (Horse or the sun.) got hidden in the veil (of the darkness of the Night):" 'Khair' in the Arabic language has been used for quality horses. The point to be noted here is that 'Zikr' here cannot be taken to mean compulsory prayer, as otherwise he should have expressed his repentance. The disappearance may refer to the sun. Thus he missed the prayer or the horses - in which case it will mean that the prayer was delayed. Some commentators have taken 'Un' as due to - because the horses and their parade were meant for 'jehad'. Thus there is no…

item.title: Saad:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāqi 'Bring it1 back for me!' Then he [and others] began to wipe [their] legs and necks.

item.title: Saad:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāqi (He said), "Return them to me," and set about striking1 (their) legs and necks. See 38:30

item.title: Saad:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāqi (Then said he): "Bring it back unto me!" And he began to rub the legs and necks. The interpretation of this verse, saying that the love of the horses interrupted his devotion to God. Solomon got the horses and slew them is absurd and impossible for an apostle of God to enact the cruelty to the poor animals. Solomon loved horses not for any vanity of possessing them for any worldly pomp and show. He had large armies and abundant wealth, not for himself, but to use it in the way of God. He waged wars not for any lust for blood or for any glory of a mere conquest but to bring men to the right course of faith and righteousness. When he found that in reviewing…

item.title: Saad:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāba Certainly We tried Solomon, and cast a [lifeless] body on his throne. Thereupon he was penitent.

item.title: Saad:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāba And We certainly tried Sulayman and placed on his throne a body;1 then he returned.2 And indeed, We tried Sulayman and We placed on his throne Jasad (a body), and he returned (38:34). He said: "My Lord! Forgive me, and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me. Verily, You are the Bestower (38:35). So, We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently by his order wherever he willed (38:36). And the Shayatin, from every kind of builder and diver (38:37). And also others bound in fetters (38:38). (Allah said to Sulayman): "This is Our gift, so spend you or withhold, no account will be asked of you (38:39). And verily, for him is…

item.title: Saad:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāba And indeed We did try Solomon, and cast on his throne a (mere) body, then turned he (unto God). Once Solomon said that he would have a son from each one of his wives. Since he did not rest the fulfilment of his desire upon the will of God, only one of his wives was caused by God to bear a child and even that was a still-born. The woman brought the dead body of the baby and presented it by placing it on Solomon's throne. When Solomon got aware of the cause of the miserable failure of his intention being his neglect of saying 'Insha-Allah', i.e., if God wills, he turned repentant and engaged himself in prayers. Said the Holy Prophet…

item.title: Saad:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahābu He said, 'My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom that does not befit anyone except me.1 Indeed You are the All-munificent.'

item.title: Saad:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahābu He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower." See 38:34

item.title: Saad:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahābu Said he: "O' my Lord! Forgive me and grant me a dominion such as shall not befit any one after me, verily Thou alone art the Bounteous Bestower!" Solomon prayed to God for a Kingdom or authority which none else shall snatch it away from him after once he receives it. This prayer could imply Solomon's desire to live as a king unconquered by any one else. It could be his glory in the life after death of which he did not like to be deprived of by any shortcoming on his part in this life under any instigation from any satanic forces.

item.title: Saad:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāba So We disposed the wind for him, blowing softly by his command wherever he intended,

item.title: Saad:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāba So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed. See 38:34

item.title: Saad:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāba Then We made subservient unto him the wind: it flew gently at his command whithersoever he desired. Solomon's prayer was granted with so many unique gifts.1

item.title: Saad:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣin and the devils [as well as], every builder and diver,

item.title: Saad:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣin And (also) the devils (of jinn) - every builder and diver. See 38:34

item.title: Saad:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣin And the satans, (The satans also were employed in building & diving into the Sea.) every builder, and diver, See 38:36

item.title: Saad:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi and others [too] bound together in chains.

item.title: Saad:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi And others bound together in irons. See 38:34

item.title: Saad:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi And the others bound in chains; See 38:36

item.title: Saad:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābin 'This is Our bounty: so give away or withhold, without any reckoning.'

item.title: Saad:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābin (We said), "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account." See 38:34

item.title: Saad:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābin This is Our gift, now give thou freely or withhold it, (for thou hast) not to render (any) account. See 38:36

item.title: Saad:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin Indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination.

item.title: Saad:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return. See 38:34

item.title: Saad:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin And verily, for him unto Us is a near approach and an excellent resort. See 38:36

item.title: Saad:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābin And remember Our servant Job [in the Qur'ān]. When he called out to his Lord, 'The devil has visited on me hardship and torment,'

item.title: Saad:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābin And remember Our servant Ayyub, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." And remember Our servant Ayyub, when he invoked his Lord (saying): "Verily, Shaytan has afflicted me with distress and torment! (38:41). (Allah said to him): "Strike the ground with your foot. This is (a spring of) water to wash in, cool and a drink (38:42). And We gave him (back) his family, and along with them the like thereof, as a mercy from Us, and a reminder for those who understand (38:43). "And take in your hand a bundle of thin grass and strike therewith (your wife), and break not your oath." Truly, We found him patient. How…

item.title: Saad:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābin And remember Our servant Job, when he cried unto his Lord; "Verily, Satan hath caused me an affliction and pain." See verses 21:83 & 21:94. There is a mention of Job in Chapter 21, but here some other details about him are given. The Holy Prophet is reminded of Job who was known for his extraordinary patience. He was the son of Ees and the son-in-law of Joseph. His wife was called Rahmat or Rahima. Job who was given abundance of wealth and issues was tested with the loss of everything he possessed. At every kind of loss Job only thanked God and remained patient. Lastly, he was tried with the sickness of his body with ulcers in…

item.title: Saad:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābun [We told him:] 'Stamp your foot on the ground; this [ensuing spring] is a cooling bath and drink.'

item.title: Saad:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābun (So he was told), "Strike (the ground) with your foot; this is a (spring for a) cool bath and drink." See 38:41

item.title: Saad:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābun (Said We unto him); "Stamp thou with thy foot" thou this (spring) is (for thee) to wash with, (it is) cool, and a (refreshing) drink Job was commanded by God to strike at the rock and out of it gushed forth two springs, one of hot water for Job to wash his body of all physical ailments, and the other of cold water for him to drink and refresh his soul. Job was cured and his health was restored in full and he was once again a healthy fresh youth.

item.title: Saad:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi And We gave [back] his family to him along with others like them, as a mercy from Us and an admonition for those who possess intellect.

item.title: Saad:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi And We granted him his family and a like (number) with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. See 38:41

item.title: Saad:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi And gave him his family and the like of them with them, a mercy from Us and a reminder for those with understanding. See 38:42

item.title: Saad:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun [We told him:] 'Take a faggot in your hand and then strike [your wife] with it, but do not break [your] oath.' Indeed We found him to be patient. What an excellent servant! Indeed he was a penitent [soul].

item.title: Saad:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun (We said), "And take in your hand a bunch (of grass) and strike with it and do not break your oath."1 Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back (to Allah). See 38:41

item.title: Saad:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun And (it was said unto him) "Take in thine hand a bunch of (thin) stick (like fibre) and strike thou (thy wife) with it, and break not thine oath. Verily We found him steadfast; an excellent servant (was he): Verily he was oft-turning (unto Us)." Job had taken an oath that he would punish his wife for listening to Satan, with a hundred stripes. To be true to his solemn commitment in God's holy name, Job was commanded by God to strike her with a bundle of hundred sticks just to fulfil the oath.

item.title: Saad:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣāri And remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of strength and insight.

item.title: Saad:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣāri And remember Our servants, Ibrahim, Ishaq and Ya'qub - those of strength and (religious) vision. And remember Our servants, Ibrahim, Ishaq, and Ya'qub, Ulil-Aydi wal-Absar (38:45). Verily, We did choose them by granting them the remembrance of the Abode (38:46). And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best (38:47). And remember Ismail, Alyasa, and Dhul-Kifli, all are among the best (38:48). This is a Reminder.. () The Chosen and the Best among the Prophets Allah tells us about the virtues of His servants the Messengers and His Prophets: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ And remember Our servants, Ibrahim, Ishaq, and Ya'qub, Ulil-Aydi wal-Absar. Meaning: righteous deeds, beneficial knowledge, strength in worship and insight. Ali bin Abi Talhah…

item.title: Saad:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣāri And remember thou Our servants, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, men of strength and insight. See 38:44

item.title: Saad:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرٰی الدَّارِ innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dāri Indeed We purified them with the exclusiveness of the remembrance of the abode [of the Hereafter].

item.title: Saad:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرٰی الدَّارِ innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dāri Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home (of the Hereafter). See 38:45

item.title: Saad:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرٰی الدَّارِ innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dāri Verily We freed them (from sinning) with a distinction of remembrance of the (eternal) abode. Freed from all other objects of life - keeping up a pure quality, i.e., keeping in mind only the ultimate abode. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyāri Indeed with Us they are surely among the elect of the best.

item.title: Saad:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyāri And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding. See 38:45

item.title: Saad:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyāri Verily, they are with Us, of the chosen ones, the good ones. See 38:46

item.title: Saad:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الْأَخْيَارِ wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyāri And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl —each [of whom was] among the elect.

item.title: Saad:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الْأَخْيَارِ wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyāri And remember Ismail, Alyasa and Dhul-Kifli, and all are among the outstanding. See 38:45

item.title: Saad:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الْأَخْيَارِ wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyāri And remember Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl; they all were of the good ones. See 38:46

item.title: Saad:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābin This is a reminder, and indeed the Godwary have a good destination

item.title: Saad:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābin This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return. And verily, for those who have Taqwa is a good final return (38:49). 'Adn Paradise, whose doors will be opened for them (38:50). Therein they will recline; therein they will call for fruits in abundance and drinks (38:51). And beside them will be Qasirat-at-Tarf, (and) of equal ages (38:52). This it is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning (38:53). (It will be said to them)! Verily, this is Our provision which will never finish (38:54). The Final Return of the Blessed Allah tells us that His blessed, believing servants will have a good final return in the Hereafter, which means their ultimate destination. Then He explains it further, as He…

item.title: Saad:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābin This is a reminder; and verily, for the pious ones there is an excellent resort, The whole chapter continues, reminder after reminder about the chosen servants of God. The verse clearly indicates that remembrance and the commemoration of the lives of the chosen servants of God, is commendable in the view of God. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwābu —the Gardens of Eden, whose gates are flung open for them.

item.title: Saad:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwābu Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwābu Gardens of eternal bliss, opened for them are the doors (thereof). See 38:49

item.title: Saad:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratin washarābin Reclining therein [on couches], therein they ask for abundant fruits and drinks,

item.title: Saad:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratin washarābin Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratin washarābin Reclining therein, calling therein for many a fruit and drink. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi atrābun and with them will be maidens of restrained glances of a like age.

item.title: Saad:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi atrābun And with them will be women limiting (their) glances1 and of equal age. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi atrābun And with them shall be of modest gaze, equals in age. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisābi This is what you are promised on the Day of Reckoning.

item.title: Saad:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisābi This is what you, (the righteous), are promised for the Day of Account. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisābi This is what ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِنْ نَفَادٍ inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min nafādin This is indeed Our provision, which will never be exhausted.

item.title: Saad:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِنْ نَفَادٍ inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min nafādin Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ هَذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِنْ نَفَادٍ inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min nafādin Verily, this is Our sustenance; for it there is no end, See 38:49

item.title: Saad:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَءَابٍ hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābin This [is for the righteous], and as for the rebellious there will surely be a bad destination

item.title: Saad:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَءَابٍ hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābin This (is so). But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return. This is so! And for the Taghin will be an evil final return (38:55). Hell! Where they will enter it, and worst (indeed) is that place to rest (38:56). This is so! Then let them taste it - Hamim and Ghassaq (38:57). And other of similar kind - all together (38:58). This is a troop entering with you (in Hell), no welcome for them! Verily, they shall enter in the Fire (38:59). (The followers will say to those who misled): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you who brought this upon us, so evil is this place to stay in! (38:60). They will say: "Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, add to…

item.title: Saad:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَءَابٍ hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābin This (for the righteous); and verily for the wicked ones there a wretched resort, See 38:49

item.title: Saad:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihādu —hell, which they shall enter, an evil resting place.

item.title: Saad:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihādu Hell, which they will (enter to) burn, and wretched is the resting place. See 38:55

item.title: Saad:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihādu Hell, they shall enter it, and so evil is the place, See 38:49

item.title: Saad:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqun This; let them taste it: scalding water and pus,

item.title: Saad:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqun This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and (foul) purulence. See 38:55

item.title: Saad:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqun Even so, Let them then taste it - boiling water and gore, (The dirty wash from rotten wounds in a body.) See 38:49

item.title: Saad:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ waākharu min shaklihi azwājun and other kinds [of torments] resembling it.

item.title: Saad:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ waākharu min shaklihi azwājun And other (punishments) of its type (in various) kinds. See 38:55

item.title: Saad:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَءَاخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ waākharu min shaklihi azwājun And other (torment) similar to it, of various sort! See 38:49

item.title: Saad:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا فَوْجٌ مُقْتَحِمٌ مَعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوْۤا النَّارِ hādhā fawjun muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū l-nāri 'This is a group plunging [into hell] along with you.'1 'May wretchedness be their lot! They will indeed enter the Fire.'2

item.title: Saad:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا فَوْجٌ مُقْتَحِمٌ مَعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوْۤا النَّارِ hādhā fawjun muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū l-nāri (Its inhabitants will say), "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire." See 38:55

item.title: Saad:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذَا فَوْجٌ مُقْتَحِمٌ مَعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوْۤا النَّارِ hādhā fawjun muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū l-nāri (To their leaders it shall be said) "This army (of your followers) shall be thrown headlong with you! No welcome for them! Verily they shall enter the fire!" See 38:49

item.title: Saad:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ أَنْتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ أَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarāru They1 say, 'Rather, may wretchedness be your lot! You prepared this [hell] for us. What an evil abode!'

item.title: Saad:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ أَنْتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ أَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarāru They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, (our leaders), brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement." See 38:55

item.title: Saad:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا بَلْ أَنْتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ أَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarāru They (The followers.) shall say: "Nay! ye (The leaders.) too! there shall be no welcome for you; Indeed ye did prepare this for us; and wretched is the abode!" See 38:49

item.title: Saad:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī l-nāri They say, 'Our Lord! Whoever has prepared this for us, double his punishment in the Fire!'

item.title: Saad:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī l-nāri They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire." See 38:55

item.title: Saad:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī l-nāri They (The followers.) shall say: "O' our Lord! Whoever (The leaders.) hath brought this for us, increase Thou a twofold torment in the fire." See 38:49

item.title: Saad:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰی رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَشْرَارِ waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrāri And they say, 'What is the matter with us that we do not see [here] men whom we used to count among the bad ones?

item.title: Saad:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰی رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَشْرَارِ waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrāri And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?1 See 38:55

item.title: Saad:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالُوْۤا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰی رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَشْرَارِ waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrāri And they shall say: "What (This is what the inmates of the hell will say - among themselves.) hath happened unto us that we see not the men whom we counted among the wicked (Vicious.) ones?" See 38:49

item.title: Saad:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣāru Did we ridicule them [unduly in the world], or do [our] eyes miss them [here]?'

item.title: Saad:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣāru Is it (because) we took them in ridicule, or has (our) vision turned away from them?" See 38:55

item.title: Saad:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣāru What! was it that we (wrongly) took them to scorn, or have our eyes turned from them? See 38:49

item.title: Saad:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli l-nāri That is indeed a truth: the contentions of the inmates of the Fire.

item.title: Saad:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli l-nāri Indeed, that is truth (i.e., reality) - the quarreling of the people of the Fire. See 38:55

item.title: Saad:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli l-nāri Verily, this is truth - the wrangling of one with another of the inmates of the fire. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ qul innamā anā mundhirun wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru Say, 'I am just a warner, and there is no god except Allah, the One, the All-paramount,

item.title: Saad:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ qul innamā anā mundhirun wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru Say, (O Muḥammad), "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.1 Say: "I am only a warner and there is no God (worthy of worship) except Allah the One, the Irresistible, (38:65). "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving (38:66). Say: "That is a great news, (38:67). "From which you turn away! (38:68). "I had no knowledge of the chiefs (angels) on high when they were disputing and discussing (38:69). "Only this has been revealed to me, that I am a plain warner (38:70). The Message of the Messenger SAW is a Great News Allah tells His Messenger…

item.title: Saad:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ qul innamā anā mundhirun wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "I am only a warner and there is no god but God the One, The Almighty!" See 38:49

item.title: Saad:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the All-mighty, the All-forgiver.'

item.title: Saad:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might,1 the Perpetual Forgiver."2 See 38:65

item.title: Saad:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru Lord of the heavens and the earth, and what is between them two, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving. See 38:49

item.title: Saad:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيمٌ qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmun Say, 'It is a great prophesy,

item.title: Saad:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيمٌ qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmun Say, "It is great news. See 38:65

item.title: Saad:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيمٌ qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmun Say thou: "It is a message of (great) importance," According to the Ahl Al-Bayt the great message of importance, is the vicegerency of man on earth - the Imamat over the creatures of God. This interpretation is supported by verse 78:3, which was the disputed one, and this was the subject of dispute among the angels1 - and in verse 68 - wherein the turning away of man is referred to, again - there is the reference to the dispute in the angelical sphere about it.2 It is a fact of history that man always revolted and disputed about the vicegerency in the earth. Of the theological doctrines forwarded in the Holy Qur'an, the great and the important one, in its comprehensive or all-embracing nature, is the doctrine of absolute theocracy over…

item.title: Saad:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūna of which you are disregardful.

item.title: Saad:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūna From which you turn away. See 38:65

item.title: Saad:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūna (And) ye are turning away from it. See 38:67

item.title: Saad:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰۤی إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūna I have no knowledge of the Supernal Elite when they contend.

item.title: Saad:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰۤی إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūna I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly (of angels) when they were disputing (the creation of Adam). See 38:65

item.title: Saad:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰۤی إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūna I had no knowledge of the exalted (The heavenly beings.) chiefs when they disputed! See 38:67

item.title: Saad:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ in yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun All that is revealed to me is that I am just a manifest warner.'

item.title: Saad:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ in yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner." See 38:65

item.title: Saad:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ in yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun It is revealed unto me save that I am an open Warner. See 38:67

item.title: Saad:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṭīnin When your Lord said to the angels, 'Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay.

item.title: Saad:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṭīnin (So mention) when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay. (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: Truly, I am going to create man from clay (38:71). "So, when I have fashioned him and breathed into him (his) soul created by Me, then you fall down prostrate to him (38:72). So, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them (38:73). Except Iblis, he was proud and was one of the disbelievers (38:74). (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands. Are you too proud or are you one of the high exalted? (38:75). (Iblis) said: "I am better than he.…

item.title: Saad:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṭīnin Remember when thy Lord said unto the angels: "Verily I am about to create man from clay," See 38:67

item.title: Saad:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.'

item.title: Saad:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My (created) soul,1 then fall down to him in prostration." See 38:71

item.title: Saad:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna And when I have completed and have breathed into him of My spirit, then fall ye prostrating (Note: the prostration to Adam ordained by God Himself - Every prostration is not polytheism.) in obeisance unto him. 'Taswiya' and its derivations have been used in Qur'an for Adam and for the Holy Prophet and the apostles1- it refers to the state of establishment of the cognitive self in such a zenith of realization which enables to have an equal view of all things and that was the state with which Adam was honoured and the angels view was only one-sided. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together,

item.title: Saad:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely. See 38:71

item.title: Saad:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna And did fall prostrating in obeisance the angels all together, See 38:72

item.title: Saad:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīna but not Iblis; he acted arrogantly and he was one of the faithless.

item.title: Saad:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīna Except Iblees;1 he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers. See 38:71

item.title: Saad:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīna Save Iblis; he was proud and was of the disbelievers. (Note: Refusal to prostrate to the Vicegerent of God is 'Kufr' infidelity.) See 38:72

item.title: Saad:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīna He said, 'O Iblis! What keeps you from prostrating before that which I have created with My [own] two hands? Are you arrogant, or are you [one] of the exalted ones?'

item.title: Saad:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīna (Allah) said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?1 Were you arrogant (then), or were you (already) among the haughty?" See 38:71

item.title: Saad:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīna Said (God): "O' Iblis! what prevented thee that thou shouldst not prostrate in obeisance unto him whom I created with My two hands? (Hands refer to the two aspects Spiritual & physical excellence endowed in Adam. See note.) Art thou proud or art thou of the exalted (Indicates that there are some exalted ones who need not prostrate to Adam. Refer to verse 33:33.) ones?" Refers to the two aspects of the spiritual and the physical realms – one as the manifestation of His name 'Az Zaahir', the Manifest, and the other manifestation of His name 'Al-Baatin' - the Hidden. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin 'I am better than him,' he said. 'You created me from fire and You created him from clay.'

item.title: Saad:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay." See 38:71

item.title: Saad:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin Said he: "I am better than he: (Adam.) Thou hast created me of fire and Thou didst create him from clay." He was proud of the power of the activity of the nature of the fire he was made of, and despised the infinite power of recipiency of the clay of which Adam was made. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun He said, 'Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast,

item.title: Saad:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun (Allah) said, "Then get out of it (i.e., Paradise), for indeed, you are expelled. See 38:71

item.title: Saad:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun Said (God): "Begone thou out of it, (God's grace or Heavenly Bliss.) for verily thou art the outcast one!" See 38:76

item.title: Saad:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi l-dīni and indeed My curse will be on you till the Day of Retribution.'

item.title: Saad:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi l-dīni And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense." See 38:71

item.title: Saad:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi l-dīni And verily on thee shall be My curse to the Day of Judgment. See 38:76

item.title: Saad:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He said, 'My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.'

item.title: Saad:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected." See 38:71

item.title: Saad:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna He said: "O' my Lord! then Respite me to the Day when they (Adam and his posterity) will be raised," See 38:76

item.title: Saad:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna Said He, 'You are indeed among the reprieved

item.title: Saad:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna (Allah) said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved. See 38:71

item.title: Saad:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna Said (God): "Verily then thou art of the respited ones," See 38:76

item.title: Saad:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi until the day of the known time.'

item.title: Saad:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi Until the Day of the time well-known." See 38:71

item.title: Saad:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi Till the day of the time made known! See 38:76

item.title: Saad:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna He said, 'By Your might, I will surely pervert them,

item.title: Saad:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna (Iblees) said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all. See 38:71

item.title: Saad:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna Said he: "Then by Thy Might, I will certainly beguile them all," See 38:76

item.title: Saad:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna except Your exclusive servants among them.'

item.title: Saad:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna Except, among them, Your chosen servants." See 38:71

item.title: Saad:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna Save Thy servants from among them the freed (Refer to note on verse 33:33 freed from sinning.) ones, See 38:76

item.title: Saad:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūlu He said, 'The truth is that —and I speak the truth—

item.title: Saad:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūlu (Allah) said, "The truth (is My oath), and the truth I say. See 38:71

item.title: Saad:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūlu He (God.) said: "Then it is the truth - and the truth do I speak," See 38:76

item.title: Saad:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ la-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīna I will surely fill hell with you and all of those who follow you.'1

item.title: Saad:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ la-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīna (That) I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together." See 38:71

item.title: Saad:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ la-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīna Certainly, will I fill hell with thee and with those who follow thee, all (together) See 38:76

item.title: Saad:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīna Say, 'I do not ask you any reward for it, and I am no impostor.1

item.title: Saad:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "I do not ask you for it (i.e., the Qur’ān) any payment, and I am not of the pretentious. Say: No wage do I ask of you for this, nor am I one of the Mutakallifin (38:86). "It is only a Reminder for all the creatures (38:87). "And you shall certainly know the truth of it after a while (38:88). Allah says: 'Say, O Muhammad, to these idolators: I do not ask you to give me any reward from the goods of this world in return for the Message which I convey to you and the sincere advice I offer.' وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ nor am I one of the Mutakallifin. means, 'and I do not add…

item.title: Saad:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "I ask ye not for any recompense for it; nor am I of the imposters" There is no doubt that the Holy Prophet was commanded to ask for a recompense1 as an exception to other prophets and as pointed out in 24:47 - the reward asked for was in the interest of the people themselves, i.e., the people who wanted to find a way towards their Lord.2 But this roused an objection as in the clause 'Imposter' is implied. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna It is just a reminder for all the nations,

item.title: Saad:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna It is but a reminder to the worlds. See 38:86

item.title: Saad:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna It is naught but a Reminder unto the worlds (i.e., to mankind as a whole.) 'It' refers to the recompense asked for in verse 42:23. (A.P.).

item.title: Saad:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīnin and you will surely learn its tidings in due time.'

item.title: Saad:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīnin And you will surely know (the truth of) its information after a time." See 38:86

item.title: Saad:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīnin And certainly ye will come to know about it after a time. History records the guidance the world has and will have to the end of the world, by the Ahl Al-Bayt. (A.P.).

item.title: Saba:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-ākhirati wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīru All praise belongs to Allah to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. To Him belongs all praise in the Hereafter, and He is the All-wise, the All-aware.

item.title: Saba:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-ākhirati wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīru (All) praise is (due) to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs (all) praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware. يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا He knows that which goes into the earth and that which comes forth from it, Meaning: He knows the number of raindrops that sink into the depths of the earth, and the seeds that have been sown, and the things that are hidden in it, and He knows what comes forth from that, how many they are, how they grow and what…

item.title: Saba:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-ākhirati wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīru All praise is God's, Whose is whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and His is all praise in the hereafter; and He is the All Wise, the All-Aware. This is against the polytheistic view of dividing the universe into different regions and believing in different gods and deities ruling the different regions. Everything in the heavens and the earth and in between belongs to none but the One and only Creator Lord, hence praise of every kind and in any degree is His. The faith in this fact is of so much importance that it has been repeated in the Holy…

item.title: Saba:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُ yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa l-raḥīmu l-ghafūru He knows whatever enters into the earth and whatever emerges from it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it, and He is the All-merciful, the All-forgiving.

item.title: Saba:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُ yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa l-raḥīmu l-ghafūru He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving. See 34:1

item.title: Saba:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُ yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa l-raḥīmu l-ghafūru Knoweth He whatever that passeth (Lit. Thirst.) into the earth and whatever that cometh out of it, and whatever that cometh down from the heaven and whatever that goeth up unto it; and He is the Most Merciful, the Oft-Forgiving. Everything hidden and manifest, is known to God and to God alone - Man in his ignorance thinks anything that is dead and buried is lost. Take for instance, the water absorbed by the earth or the seed sown into the soil, replenishes numerous streams and feeds the numerous forms of life and helps the growth of myriad forms of growth which grow and…

item.title: Saba:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَأْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tatīnā l-sāʿatu qul balā warabbī latatiyannakum ʿālimi l-ghaybi lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mith'qālu dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi walā aṣgharu min dhālika walā akbaru illā fī kitābin mubīnin The faithless say, 'The Hour will not overtake us.' Say, 'Yes indeed, by my Lord, it will surely come to you.' —The Knower of the Unseen, not [even] an atom's weight escapes Him in the heavens or in the earth, nor [is there] anything smaller than that nor bigger, but it is in a manifest Book,

item.title: Saba:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَأْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tatīnā l-sāʿatu qul balā warabbī latatiyannakum ʿālimi l-ghaybi lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mith'qālu dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi walā aṣgharu min dhālika walā akbaru illā fī kitābin mubīnin But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. (Allah is) the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight1 within the heavens or within the earth or (what is) smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register. Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will not come to us." Say: "Yes, by my…

item.title: Saba:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَأْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tatīnā l-sāʿatu qul balā warabbī latatiyannakum ʿālimi l-ghaybi lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mith'qālu dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi walā aṣgharu min dhālika walā akbaru illā fī kitābin mubīnin And say those who disbelieve: "The Hour (of Judgment) shall not come upon us." Say thou: "Yea: By my Lord, the Knower of the unseen, it shall certainly come upon you, from Him is not hidden, the weight of (even) an atom in the heavens and nor in the earth, nor is there aught less than this and nor aught greater, but it is in the manifesting (Which is perspicuous.) Book," See verses 6:59 and 36:12.…

item.title: Saba:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun that He may reward those who have faith and do righteous deeds. For such there will be forgiveness and a noble provision.
