item.description: وَاٰیَةٌ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُمْ مُظْلِمُونَ waāyatun lahumu al-laylu naslakhu min'hu l-nahāra fa-idhā hum muẓ'limūna And a sign unto them, is the night, We draw forth from it the day, and Io! they are in the dark, See 36:36

item.title: Yaseen:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَهَا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ wal-shamsu tajrī limus'taqarrin lahā dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi And the sun runs on to its place of rest:1 That is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

item.title: Yaseen:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَهَا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ wal-shamsu tajrī limus'taqarrin lahā dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi And the sun runs (on course) toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing. See 36:37

item.title: Yaseen:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَهَا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ wal-shamsu tajrī limus'taqarrin lahā dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi And the sun travelleth unto a resting-place (Refer to verses 13:2, 21:33 & 55:5.) fixed for it; That (The moment.) is the decree of the All- Mighty, the All-Knowing. Until the very recent past, the sun was supposed to be stationary and all the other planets revolving round it and since very recently it has been found out that the sun also along with the whole of its solar system, is moving towards some destination. This fact had been declared centuries ago by the Holy Qur'an. This verse clearly declares that the sun is travelling towards a fixed destination or an end, and none knows when it would cease to be or stop to function, and this is the decree of the Omnipotent Lord…

item.title: Yaseen:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰی عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿur'jūni l-qadīmi As for the moon, We have ordained its phases, until it becomes like an old palm leaf.

item.title: Yaseen:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰی عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿur'jūni l-qadīmi And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns (appearing) like the old date stalk. See 36:37

item.title: Yaseen:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰی عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿur'jūni l-qadīmi And (as for) the moon. We have fixed for it stages till it returneth to be bent like an old palm branch. Reference is to the lunar mansions of the Zodiac, 'Urjun' the sickle-like appearance of the new moon.

item.title: Yaseen:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ lā l-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tud'rika l-qamara walā al-laylu sābiqu l-nahāri wakullun fī falakin yasbaḥūna Neither it behooves the sun to overtake the moon, nor may the night outrun the day, and each swims in an orbit.

item.title: Yaseen:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ lā l-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tud'rika l-qamara walā al-laylu sābiqu l-nahāri wakullun fī falakin yasbaḥūna It is not allowable (i.e., possible) for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming. See 36:37

item.title: Yaseen:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ lā l-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tud'rika l-qamara walā al-laylu sābiqu l-nahāri wakullun fī falakin yasbaḥūna It is not (expedient) for the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day; and each (of these luminaries) rotate on in (its peculiar) sphere. Though the sun and moon move in the same Zodiac path, the laws of the movement of each have been so fixed that the one can never clash with the other. Note what a beautiful and realistic technical term has been used to describe the movement of the heavenly bodies in the space as swimming in it.1 This same term is used in our modern days for the planes that fly in the space, using the word navigation. Ali…

item.title: Yaseen:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰیَةٌ لَهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ waāyatun lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni A sign for them is that We carried their progeny in the laden ship,1

item.title: Yaseen:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰیَةٌ لَهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ waāyatun lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers1 in a laden ship. And an Ayah for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship (36:41). And We have created for them of the like thereunto, on which they ride (36:42). And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout for them, nor will they be saved (36:43). Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while (36:44). Among the Signs of Allah is that He Carried Them in the Laden Ship Allah tells us: another sign for them of His might and power is that He has subjugated the sea to carry ships, including – most significantly –…

item.title: Yaseen:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاٰیَةٌ لَهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ waāyatun lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni And a sign unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden Ark, Man's own personal experience in his practical life is appealed to. Man is invited to reflect upon his travelling safely along with his cargo through the high seas fighting the violent winds and the mountain-like waves - as it was done in the case of Noah and the Ark1 - which has become a 'sign for all peoples.'

item.title: Yaseen:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مِثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ wakhalaqnā lahum min mith'lihi mā yarkabūna and We have created for them what is similar to it, which they ride.1

item.title: Yaseen:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مِثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ wakhalaqnā lahum min mith'lihi mā yarkabūna And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride. See 36:41

item.title: Yaseen:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مِثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ wakhalaqnā lahum min mith'lihi mā yarkabūna And that We have created for them (the other conveyances) like it, on which ride they. It is unquestionably God's gifted intelligence with which man has devised the seacraft and the aircraft to manage with the laws of gravity, otherwise it would have been nothing short of an impossibility to pass through the sea or the air. Muhyiddin Ibn Arabi in his mystic interpretation of this verse interprets – 'Like it' as the Ark of Noah and says, that is the Ark belonging to Muhammad, i.e., hinting at the celebrated saying of the Holy Prophet: 'Mathal Ahl-e-Bayti ka-mathal safeenat Nuh; man rakibaha naja, wa man takhallafa anha gharq wa hawa'. i.e., the similitude of my Ahlul-Bait is that of the Ark of Noah; he who got into it…

item.title: Yaseen:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ نَشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْقَذُونَ wa-in nasha nugh'riq'hum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūna And if We like We drown them, whereat they have no one to call for help, nor are they rescued

item.title: Yaseen:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ نَشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْقَذُونَ wa-in nasha nugh'riq'hum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūna And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved. See 36:41

item.title: Yaseen:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ نَشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْقَذُونَ wa-in nasha nugh'riq'hum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūna And if We only will, We can drown them, then there shall not be any one to help them, nor shall they be rescued, See 36:42

item.title: Yaseen:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَى حِينٍ illā raḥmatan minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin ⎯except by a mercy from Us and for an enjoyment until some time.

item.title: Yaseen:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَى حِينٍ illā raḥmatan minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time. See 36:41

item.title: Yaseen:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَى حِينٍ illā raḥmatan minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin Save (by) mercy from Us and as an enjoyment for yet awhile. See 36:42

item.title: Yaseen:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوْۤا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna And when they are told, 'Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you,1 so that you may receive [His] mercy.'2

item.title: Yaseen:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوْۤا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;1 perhaps you will receive mercy..."2 And when it is said to them: "Beware of that which is before you, and that which is behind you, in order that you may receive mercy (36:45). And never came an Ayah from among the Ayat of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it (36:46). And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allah has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allah willed, He would have fed? You are only in a plain error (36:47). The…

item.title: Yaseen:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوْۤا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna And when it is said unto them: "Guard ye (yourselves) against what is before you and what is behind you, that ye be treated with mercy." Man had always been admonished to reflect upon his faulty past, know its consequences, beware of the future and guard himself against his sins recurring for, when one sincerely does this, God also turns merciful to him, He not only forgives the past but also grants strength to amend his life in the future.

item.title: Yaseen:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ wamā tatīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna There did not come to them any sign from among the signs of their Lord but that they used to disregard it.

item.title: Yaseen:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ wamā tatīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away. See 36:45

item.title: Yaseen:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ wamā tatīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna And there cometh not unto them any sign from the signs of their Lord but from it turn they away. See 36:45

item.title: Yaseen:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنْفِقُوْۤا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭ'ʿimu man law yashāu l-lahu aṭʿamahu in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīnin When they are told, 'Spend out of what Allah has provided you,' the faithless say to the faithful, 'Shall we feed [someone] whom Allah would have fed, had He wished? You are only in manifest error.'

item.title: Yaseen:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنْفِقُوْۤا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭ'ʿimu man law yashāu l-lahu aṭʿamahu in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīnin And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error." See 36:45

item.title: Yaseen:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنْفِقُوْۤا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭ'ʿimu man law yashāu l-lahu aṭʿamahu in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīnin And when it is said unto them: "Spend ye of what God hath provided you with the sustenance," say those who disbelieve unto those who believe: "What! shall we feed him whom, if God willeth, He could feed? Ye are not but in a manifest error." When those who have been granted ample provision of wealth, influence or knowledge, are told to spend out of what God has blessed them with, for the benefit of their fellow beings, they laugh to scorn such appeals and indirectly blame God Himself for not having…

item.title: Yaseen:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And they say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: Yaseen:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?" And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful? (36:48). They await only but a single 'Şayḥah' which will seize them while they are disputing (36:49). Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family (36:50). The Disbelievers thought that the Day of Resurrection would never come to pass Allah tells us how the disbelievers thought that the Day of Resurrection would never come to pass, as they said: مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ ("When will this promise be fulfilled...") يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ Those who believe not therein seek to hasten it (42:18) Allah says: مَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ…

item.title: Yaseen:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And say they: "When will this promise (The warning against chastisement.) come to pass, if ye be truthful?" The disbelievers not only reject the belief in the hereafter but also by way of taunting, question as to when the Day of Judgment would come? The answer to them is that it will come but never at your or anybody else's fancy but when the Lord would will it.

item.title: Yaseen:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan takhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūna They do not await but a single Cry that would seize them as they wrangle.

item.title: Yaseen:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan takhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūna They do not await except one blast1 which will seize them while they are disputing. See 36:48

item.title: Yaseen:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan takhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūna They wait not but for a single (terrible) cry which will seize them while they wrangle with one another. See 36:48

item.title: Yaseen:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyatan walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūna Then they will not be able to make any will, nor will they return to their folks.

item.title: Yaseen:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyatan walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūna And they will not be able (to give) any instruction, nor to their people can they return. See 36:48

item.title: Yaseen:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyatan walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūna Then shall they not be able to make a bequest, nor shall they be able to return unto their families. See 36:48

item.title: Yaseen:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُمْ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُونَ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūna And when the Trumpet is blown, behold, there they will be, scrambling from their graves towards their Lord!

item.title: Yaseen:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُمْ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُونَ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūna And the Horn will be blown;1 and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten. And the Trumpet will be blown and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord (36:51). They will say: Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Gracious had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth! (36:52). It will be but a single 'Şayḥah', so behold they will all be brought up before Us (36:53). This Day, none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do (36:54). The Trumpet Blast of the Resurrection…

item.title: Yaseen:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُمْ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُونَ wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūna And is blown the Trumpet, when lo! From the grave unto their Lord they (all) hasten. About the blowing of the Trumpet, see verses 78:18, 39:68, 50:20, 27:87, 23:101 'Ajdath', i.e., the place or state where the former shapes and forms of the living beings with which they were buried or lost whether it is in grave or burnt into ashes or eaten away by animals or thrown into the sea. The verse expressively points out that after rising from their burials in new forms, their movements in chain will be towards their Lord.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاوَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ qālū yāwaylanā man baʿathanā min marqadinā hādhā mā waʿada l-raḥmānu waṣadaqa l-mur'salūna They will say, 'Woe to us! Who raised us from our place of sleep?' 'This is what the All-beneficent had promised, and the apostles had spoken the truth!'

item.title: Yaseen:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاوَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ qālū yāwaylanā man baʿathanā min marqadinā hādhā mā waʿada l-raḥmānu waṣadaqa l-mur'salūna They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" (The reply will be), "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth." See 36:51

item.title: Yaseen:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاوَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ qālū yāwaylanā man baʿathanā min marqadinā hādhā mā waʿada l-raḥmānu waṣadaqa l-mur'salūna They shall say: "Oh! woe unto us! who hath raised us up from our place of repose?" (it will be replied): "This (What the believers would say.) is what the Beneficent (God) did promise and the apostles spake the truth." 'Ruqud' means sleeping - 'Marqad' sleeping place, figuratively refers to any state or stage wherein man is not aware of what is awaiting for him in future. It is true of this life in comparison to the life hereafter and it is also true of the life after death in the intermediary stage before the Total Resurrection. The Holy Prophet has said: 'People are asleep, when they will die they will awake.' (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūna It will be but a single Cry, and, behold, they will all be presented before Us!

item.title: Yaseen:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūna It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us. See 36:51

item.title: Yaseen:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنْ كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūna There will be but a single cry, when lo! they shall all be brought (Summoned.) unto Us. See 36:52

item.title: Yaseen:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ fal-yawma lā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan walā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna 'Today no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be requited except for what you used to do.'

item.title: Yaseen:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ fal-yawma lā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan walā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna So today (i.e., the Day of Judgement) no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do. See 36:51

item.title: Yaseen:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ fal-yawma lā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan walā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna So this day no soul shall be dealt with unjustly in the least, nor shall ye be recompensed but that which ye were doing. The reward or punishment will be the consequence of one's own actions, or in other words, the actions themselves assuming pleasant or unpleasant forms which will make the doer enjoy or suffer. (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ inna aṣḥāba l-janati l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūna Indeed today the inhabitants of paradise rejoice in their engagements

item.title: Yaseen:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ inna aṣḥāba l-janati l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūna Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in (joyful) occupation. Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things (36:55). They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones (36:56). They will have therein fruits and all that they ask for (36:57). (It will be said to them): "Salam (Peace!)" – a Word from the Lord, Most Merciful (36:58). The Life of the People of Paradise Allah tells us that on the Day of Resurrection, when the people of Paradise have reached the arena of judgement, and have settled in the gardens of Paradise, they will be too preoccupied with their own victory and new life of eternal delights to worry about anyone else. Al-Hasan…

item.title: Yaseen:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ inna aṣḥāba l-janati l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūna Verily, the inmates of the Garden shall on that day be busy enjoying. See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ hum wa-azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalā l-arāiki muttakiūna —they and their mates, reclining on couches in the shades.

item.title: Yaseen:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ hum wa-azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalā l-arāiki muttakiūna They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches. See 36:55

item.title: Yaseen:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ hum wa-azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalā l-arāiki muttakiūna They and their mates, shall be in (Pleasant) shades, on raised couches reclining; See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُمْ مَا يَدَّعُونَ lahum fīhā fākihatun walahum mā yaddaʿūna There they have fruits and they have whatever they want.

item.title: Yaseen:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُمْ مَا يَدَّعُونَ lahum fīhā fākihatun walahum mā yaddaʿūna For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request (or wish). See 36:55

item.title: Yaseen:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُمْ مَا يَدَّعُونَ lahum fīhā fākihatun walahum mā yaddaʿūna For them therein shall be fruits, and for them shall be whatever they call for. (desire.) See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِنْ رَبٍّ رَحِيمٍ salāmun qawlan min rabbin raḥīmin 'Peace!'—a watchword from the all-merciful Lord.

item.title: Yaseen:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِنْ رَبٍّ رَحِيمٍ salāmun qawlan min rabbin raḥīmin (And) "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord. See 36:55

item.title: Yaseen:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِنْ رَبٍّ رَحِيمٍ salāmun qawlan min rabbin raḥīmin (They shall receive the greeting): "Peace" a word (of salutation) from the Lord the Most Merciful. See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ wa-im'tāzū l-yawma ayyuhā l-muj'rimūna And 'Get apart today, you guilty ones!'

item.title: Yaseen:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ wa-im'tāzū l-yawma ayyuhā l-muj'rimūna (Then He will say), "But stand apart today, you criminals.1 (It will be said): "And O you the criminals! Get you apart this Day (36:59). "Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaytan? Verily, he is a plain enemy to you (36:60). "And that you should worship Me. That is the straight path (36:61). "And indeed he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not then understand? (36:62). The Isolation of the Disbelievers and Their Rebuke on the Day of Resurrection Allah tells us what the end of the disbelievers will be on the Day of Resurrection, when He commands them to get apart from the believers, i.e., to stand apart from the believers. This is like the Ayat: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا…

item.title: Yaseen:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ wa-im'tāzū l-yawma ayyuhā l-muj'rimūna (And a voice would say): "And get ye aside this day O' ye the guilty ones!" See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama an lā taʿbudū l-shayṭāna innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun 'Did I not exhort you, O children of Adam, saying, "Do not worship Satan. He is indeed your manifest enemy.

item.title: Yaseen:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama an lā taʿbudū l-shayṭāna innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - (for) indeed, he is to you a clear enemy. See 36:59

item.title: Yaseen:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama an lā taʿbudū l-shayṭāna innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun Enjoined (Did I not announce the command?) I not on you O' children of Adam! that ye should worship (also serve not.) not Satan? for he is your open enemy, See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-ani uʿ'budūnī hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun Worship Me. That is a straight path"?

item.title: Yaseen:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-ani uʿ'budūnī hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun And that you worship (only) Me? This is a straight path. See 36:59

item.title: Yaseen:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-ani uʿ'budūnī hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun And ye should worship (only) Me, (and) this is the (only) Right way? See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا تَعْقِلُونَ walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran afalam takūnū taʿqilūna Certainly he has led astray many of your generations. Did you not use to apply reason?

item.title: Yaseen:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا تَعْقِلُونَ walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran afalam takūnū taʿqilūna And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason? See 36:59

item.title: Yaseen:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا تَعْقِلُونَ walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran afalam takūnū taʿqilūna And yet hath he led astray a great multitude of you; Did ye not then understand? See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ hādhihi jahannamu allatī kuntum tūʿadūna This is the hell you had been promised!

item.title: Yaseen:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ hādhihi jahannamu allatī kuntum tūʿadūna This is the Hellfire which you were promised. This is Hell which you were promised (36:63). Burn (enter) therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve (36:64). This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn (36:65). And if it had been Our will, We would surely have wiped out their eyes, so that they would struggle for the path, how then would they see (36:66). And if it had been Our will, We could have transformed them in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back (36:67). On the Day of Resurrection, it will be said to the disbelievers…

item.title: Yaseen:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هَذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ hādhihi jahannamu allatī kuntum tūʿadūna This is the hell which ye were promised, See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ iṣ'lawhā l-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūna Enter it today, because of what you used to defy.

item.title: Yaseen:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ iṣ'lawhā l-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūna (Enter to) burn therein today for what you used to deny."1 See 36:63

item.title: Yaseen:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ iṣ'lawhā l-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūna Enter ye into it, for what ye were disbelieving. See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūna Today We shall seal their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness concerning what they used to earn.'

item.title: Yaseen:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūna That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn. See 36:63

item.title: Yaseen:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūna On that day will We set a seal upon their mouths, and shall speak unto Us their hands and shall bear witness their feet, of what they were earning. See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَى أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّى يُبْصِرُونَ walaw nashāu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-is'tabaqū l-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yub'ṣirūna Had We wished We would have blotted out their eyes:1 then, were they to advance towards the path, how would have they seen?

item.title: Yaseen:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَى أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّى يُبْصِرُونَ walaw nashāu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-is'tabaqū l-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yub'ṣirūna And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to (find) the path, and how could they see?1 See 36:63

item.title: Yaseen:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَى أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّى يُبْصِرُونَ walaw nashāu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-is'tabaqū l-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yub'ṣirūna And if We will, We would certainly put (Make blind.) out their eyes, then they would struggle (groping) to get first to the way, but how could they see? See 36:54

item.title: Yaseen:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ walaw nashāu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā is'taṭāʿū muḍiyyan walā yarjiʿūna And had We wished We would have deformed them in their place;1 then they would have neither been able to go ahead nor to go back.2

item.title: Yaseen:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ walaw nashāu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā is'taṭāʿū muḍiyyan walā yarjiʿūna And if We willed, We could have deformed them, (paralyzing them) in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.1 See 36:63

item.title: Yaseen:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ walaw nashāu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā is'taṭāʿū muḍiyyan walā yarjiʿūna And if We will, We would certainly transform them in their (own) places, then they would not be able to go on, nor will they return. Indicates for those who lose their human form, there will be no progress or retrogressing. (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ نُعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ waman nuʿammir'hu nunakkis'hu fī l-khalqi afalā yaʿqilūna And whomever We give a long life, We cause him to regress in creation. Then will they not apply reason?

item.title: Yaseen:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ نُعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ waman nuʿammir'hu nunakkis'hu fī l-khalqi afalā yaʿqilūna And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;1 so will they not understand? And he whom We grant long life – We reverse him in creation. Will they not then understand (36:68). And We have not taught him poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur'an (36:69). That he or it may give warning to him who is living, and that Word may be justified against the disbelievers (36:70). Allah tells us that the longer the son of Adam lives, the more he becomes weak after being strong, and incapable after being able and active This is like the Ayah: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْ…

item.title: Yaseen:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَنْ نُعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ waman nuʿammir'hu nunakkis'hu fī l-khalqi afalā yaʿqilūna And whomsoever We lengthen in age, We reverse him to an abject state in life, What! Do they understand not? See 36:67

item.title: Yaseen:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُبِينٌ wamā ʿallamnāhu l-shiʿ'ra wamā yanbaghī lahu in huwa illā dhik'run waqur'ānun mubīnun We did not teach him poetry, nor does it behoove him. This is just a reminder and a manifest Qur'ān,

item.title: Yaseen:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُبِينٌ wamā ʿallamnāhu l-shiʿ'ra wamā yanbaghī lahu in huwa illā dhik'run waqur'ānun mubīnun And We did not give him (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW) knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān. See 36:68

item.title: Yaseen:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُبِينٌ wamā ʿallamnāhu l-shiʿ'ra wamā yanbaghī lahu in huwa illā dhik'run waqur'ānun mubīnun We have taught him (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) not poetry, nor would it beseem him; It is naught but a Remin der and manifesting Qur'an, 'Poetry' here means proposition based on imaginary data exciting human emotion. (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ liyundhira man kāna ḥayyan wayaḥiqqa l-qawlu ʿalā l-kāfirīna so that anyone who is alive may be warned, and that the word may come due against the faithless.

item.title: Yaseen:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ liyundhira man kāna ḥayyan wayaḥiqqa l-qawlu ʿalā l-kāfirīna To warn whoever is alive1 and justify the word (i.e., decree) against the disbelievers. See 36:68

item.title: Yaseen:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ liyundhira man kāna ḥayyan wayaḥiqqa l-qawlu ʿalā l-kāfirīna To warn him who is alive, (with awakened heart.) and (that) the word be proved against the disbelievers. See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūna Have they not seen that We have created for them —of what Our hands have worked— cattle, so they have become their masters?

item.title: Yaseen:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūna Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands1 have made, grazing livestock, and (then) they are their owners? Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have fashioned, the cattle, so that they are their owners (36:71). And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat (36:72). And they have (other) benefits from them, and (they get to) drink. Will they not then be grateful (36:73). There is a Sign and a Blessing in Cattle Allah mentions the blessing that He has bestowed upon His creation by subjugating these cattle for their use.…

item.title: Yaseen:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūna What! See they not that We created the cattle for them, of what Our hands (Powers, authorities, agencies, deputies.) have wrought, and of them they (The people.) are the masters? See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ wadhallalnāhā lahum famin'hā rakūbuhum wamin'hā yakulūna And We made them tractable for them, so some of them make their mounts and some of them they eat.

item.title: Yaseen:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ wadhallalnāhā lahum famin'hā rakūbuhum wamin'hā yakulūna And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat. See 36:71

item.title: Yaseen:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ wadhallalnāhā lahum famin'hā rakūbuhum wamin'hā yakulūna And them (the cattle) We did subject unto them (To the people for their use.) and some of them they ride upon, and some of them they eat. See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu afalā yashkurūna There are other benefits for them therein, and drinks.1 Will they not then give thanks?

item.title: Yaseen:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu afalā yashkurūna And for them therein are (other) benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful? See 36:71

item.title: Yaseen:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu afalā yashkurūna And for them (To the people for their use.) in them (The cattle.) are benefits and drinks: What! will they not then be grateful? See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan laʿallahum yunṣarūna They have taken gods besides Allah [hoping] that they might be helped.

item.title: Yaseen:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan laʿallahum yunṣarūna But they have taken besides Allah (false) deities that perhaps they would be helped. And they have taken besides Allah, gods, hoping that they might be helped (36:74). They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop (against those who worshipped them) (36:75). So, let not their speech then grieve you. Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal (36:76). The Gods of the Idolators are Not Able to Help Them Allah denounces the idolators for taking the idols as gods alongside Allah, hoping that those gods will help them and provide for them and bring them closer to Allah. Allah says: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ They cannot help them, Meaning: those gods cannot help their worshippers; they are too weak,…

item.title: Yaseen:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan laʿallahum yunṣarūna And (yet) they have taken gods besides (the only True) God so that they may be helped. See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُحْضَرُونَ lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundun muḥ'ḍarūna [Yet] they cannot help them, while they [themselves] are ready warriors for them.1

item.title: Yaseen:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُحْضَرُونَ lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundun muḥ'ḍarūna They are not able to help them, and they (themselves) are for them soldiers in attendance.1 See 36:74

item.title: Yaseen:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُحْضَرُونَ lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundun muḥ'ḍarūna They shall not be able to help them: and yet they (the disbelievers) are their host (who on the Day of Resurrection) shall be brought forth to account. See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ falā yaḥzunka qawluhum innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna So do not let their remarks grieve you. We indeed know whatever they hide and whatever they disclose.

item.title: Yaseen:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ falā yaḥzunka qawluhum innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare. See 36:74

item.title: Yaseen:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ falā yaḥzunka qawluhum innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna So let not their speech grieve thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!), (for) verily know We what they do hiding, and what they do openly. See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ awalam yara l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun Does not man see that We created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid, and, behold, he is an open contender!?

item.title: Yaseen:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ awalam yara l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun Does man not consider that We created him from a (mere) sperm-drop - then at once1 he is a clear adversary? Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah. Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent (36:77). And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust? (36:78). Say: "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation! (36:79). He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith (36:80). The Denial of Life after…

item.title: Yaseen:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ awalam yara l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun What! Seest not man that We created him from (a drop of) sperm? (and) yet lo! he is an open disputant! (Adversary.) See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ مَنْ يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ waḍaraba lanā mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qāla man yuḥ'yī l-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīmun He draws comparisons for Us, and forgets his own creation. He says, 'Who shall revive the bones when they have decayed?'

item.title: Yaseen:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ مَنْ يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ waḍaraba lanā mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qāla man yuḥ'yī l-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīmun And he presents for Us an example1 and forgets his (own) creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?" See 36:77

item.title: Yaseen:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ مَنْ يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ waḍaraba lanā mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qāla man yuḥ'yī l-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīmun He setteth unto Us an argument, and hath forgotten his (own) creation (origin), Sayeth he: "Who will enliven the bones when they are rotten?" See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنْشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِیْمٌ qul yuḥ'yīhā alladhī ansha-ahā awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmun Say, 'He will revive them who produced them the first time, and He has knowledge of all creation.

item.title: Yaseen:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنْشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِیْمٌ qul yuḥ'yīhā alladhī ansha-ahā awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmun Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing." See 36:77

item.title: Yaseen:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنْشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِیْمٌ qul yuḥ'yīhā alladhī ansha-ahā awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmun Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "He will enliven them Who created them for the first time, and He is, fully cognizant of (all) the creation," See 36:69

item.title: Yaseen:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنْتُمْ مِنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ alladhī jaʿala lakum mina l-shajari l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum min'hu tūqidūna —He, who made for you fire out of the green tree, and, behold, you light fire from it!

item.title: Yaseen:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنْتُمْ مِنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ alladhī jaʿala lakum mina l-shajari l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum min'hu tūqidūna (It is) He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite. See 36:77

item.title: Yaseen:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنْتُمْ مِنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ alladhī jaʿala lakum mina l-shajari l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum min'hu tūqidūna He who made for you the fire from the green tree, and lo! from it ye kindle (fire). Refers to the assumption of being of opposite form, in their evolutionary movements towards the ultimate shape. (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ بَلَى وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ awalaysa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum balā wahuwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Yes indeed! He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

item.title: Yaseen:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ بَلَى وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ awalaysa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum balā wahuwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, (it is so); and He is the Knowing Creator. Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator (36:81). Verily, His command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" – and it is (36:82). So glorified be He and exalted (above all that they associate with Him), and in Whose Hand is the dominion of all things, and to Him you shall be returned (36:83). Allah points out His great might and…

item.title: Yaseen:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ بَلَى وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ awalaysa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum balā wahuwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu What! Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create (again) the like of them? Yea! and He is the Creator (Omnipotent), the All-Knowing. The stress on 'Alim' shows that no unconscious being can have any creative power.1 (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ innamā amruhu idhā arāda shayan an yaqūla lahu kun fayakūnu All His command, when He wills something, is to say to it 'Be,' and it is.

item.title: Yaseen:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ innamā amruhu idhā arāda shayan an yaqūla lahu kun fayakūnu His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is. See 36:81

item.title: Yaseen:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ innamā amruhu idhā arāda shayan an yaqūla lahu kun fayakūnu His command, when intendeth He anything, is only that He sayeth unto it 'Be' then (and there) it is. The process of creation is given in the term of His Will and attention. Thus, every being is God's Word. (A.P.).

item.title: Yaseen:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ fasub'ḥāna alladhī biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna So immaculate is He in whose hand is the dominion of all things and to whom you shall be brought back.

item.title: Yaseen:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ fasub'ḥāna alladhī biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned. See 36:81

item.title: Yaseen:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ fasub'ḥāna alladhī biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna Therefore, Hallowed is He in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things, and unto Him ye shall all be returned. See 36:82

item.title: Yunus:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīmi Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the signs of the Wise1 Book.

item.title: Yunus:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīmi Alif, Lām, Rā.1 These are the verses of the wise2 Book. أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا Is it a wonder for mankind... Allah's statement; أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ that they shall have with their Lord the rewards of their good deeds Scholars have differed over the meaning of the reward for the good deeds in this Ayah: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ and give good news to those who believe that they shall have with their Lord the rewards of their good deeds. Ali bin Abi Talhah reported that Ibn 'Abbas said about this Ayah, "Eternal happiness has been written for them." Al-'Awfi reported that Ibn 'Abbas said: "It is the good reward for what they have done." Mujahid said: "It is their good deeds – their prayers,…

item.title: Yunus:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīmi 'Alif, Lam, Ra. (A. L. R.) These are verses of the Book All-Wise. 'Alif Lam Ra - (A. L. R.), 'Hakim' qualifying the Book (The Holy Qur'an), meaning the Book full of wisdom. It has already been said that the letter symbols used in the Holy Qur'an are divine secrets known only to God, the Holy Prophet and the Holy Imams. All interpretations by the people, are only conjectures.

item.title: Yunus:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ أَنْذِرِ النَّاسَ وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ مُبِينٌ akāna lilnnāsi ʿajaban an awḥaynā ilā rajulin min'hum an andhiri l-nāsa wabashiri alladhīna āmanū anna lahum qadama ṣid'qin ʿinda rabbihim qāla l-kāfirūna inna hādhā lasāḥirun mubīnun Does it seem odd to these people that We have revealed to a man from among themselves, [declaring], 'Warn mankind, and give good news to the faithful that they are in good standing with their Lord'? The faithless say, 'This is indeed a plain magician.'

item.title: Yunus:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ أَنْذِرِ النَّاسَ وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ مُبِينٌ akāna lilnnāsi ʿajaban an awḥaynā ilā rajulin min'hum an andhiri l-nāsa wabashiri alladhīna āmanū anna lahum qadama ṣid'qin ʿinda rabbihim qāla l-kāfirūna inna hādhā lasāḥirun mubīnun Have the people been amazed that We revealed (revelation) to a man from among them, (saying), "Warn mankind and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a (firm) precedence of honor1 with their Lord"? (But) the disbelievers say, "Indeed, this is an obvious magician." See 10:1

item.title: Yunus:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ أَنْذِرِ النَّاسَ وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ مُبِينٌ akāna lilnnāsi ʿajaban an awḥaynā ilā rajulin min'hum an andhiri l-nāsa wabashiri alladhīna āmanū anna lahum qadama ṣid'qin ʿinda rabbihim qāla l-kāfirūna inna hādhā lasāḥirun mubīnun What! Is it for the people a wonder that We revealed unto a man from among themselves, saying "Warn thou! mankind and bear good tidings unto those who believe that there is a footing of firmness with their Lord;" (but) say the infidels "Verily this is an obvious sorcerer." 'Rajul', i.e., man - refers to the Holy Prophet Muhammad. It is quite evident that the people believed that guidance from God, if at all had to come to them, could come from some beings like the angels and…

item.title: Yunus:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مَا مِنْ شَفِيعٍ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ إِذْنِهِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yudabbiru l-amra mā min shafīʿin illā min baʿdi idh'nihi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu afalā tadhakkarūna Indeed your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days, and then settled on the Throne, directing the command.1 There is no intercessor, except by His leave. That is Allah, your Lord! So worship Him. Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: Yunus:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مَا مِنْ شَفِيعٍ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ إِذْنِهِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yudabbiru l-amra mā min shafīʿin illā min baʿdi idh'nihi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu afalā tadhakkarūna Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne,1 arranging the matter (of His creation). There is no intercessor except after His permission. That is Allah, your Lord, so worship Him. Then will you not remember? Surely, your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days and then rose over (Istawa) the Throne, arranging the affair (of all things). No intercessor (can plead with…

item.title: Yunus:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مَا مِنْ شَفِيعٍ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ إِذْنِهِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yudabbiru l-amra mā min shafīʿin illā min baʿdi idh'nihi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu afalā tadhakkarūna Verily, Your Lord is God Who created the heavens and the earth in six days (terms) and is firmly established on 'Arsh (The Throne of Authority. Refer to note to verse 7:54.) ' He regulateth everything; No intercessor can there be save after His leave (Refer to verses 4:85, 19:86, 20:109, 21:28, 34:23, 39:44, 43:86, 74:48. This clearly indicates that there is intercession but by leave from God. See verse 2:255.) ; This is God, your Lord, Therefore Him (alone) worship ye;…

item.title: Yunus:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا إِنَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ بِالْقِسْطِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ ilayhi marjiʿukum jamīʿan waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan innahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti bil-qis'ṭi wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum sharābun min ḥamīmin waʿadhābun alīmun bimā kānū yakfurūna To Him will be the return of you all —[that is] Allah's true promise. Indeed He originates the creation, then He will bring it back that He may reward those who have faith and do righteous deeds with justice. As for the faithless, they shall have boiling water for drink, and a painful punishment because of what they used to defy.

item.title: Yunus:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا إِنَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ بِالْقِسْطِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ ilayhi marjiʿukum jamīʿan waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan innahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti bil-qis'ṭi wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum sharābun min ḥamīmin waʿadhābun alīmun bimā kānū yakfurūna To Him is your return all together. (It is) the promise of Allah (which is) truth. Indeed, He begins the (process of) creation and then repeats it that He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds, in justice. But those who disbelieved will have a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment for what they used to deny. To Him is the return of all of you. The promise of Allah is true. It is He Who begins the creation…

item.title: Yunus:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا إِنَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ بِالْقِسْطِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ ilayhi marjiʿukum jamīʿan waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan innahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti bil-qis'ṭi wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum sharābun min ḥamīmin waʿadhābun alīmun bimā kānū yakfurūna Unto Him shall return ye all; (this is) the promise of God in truth; Verily, (it is only) He (Who) beginneth (Originates.) the creation, then causeth it to return (Unto Him.) that He may with equity recompense those who believe and do good; and those who disbelieve, for them shall be the drink from the boiling fluids (Refer to verse 78:24.) and a chastisement painful for they did disbelieve. See 10:3

item.title: Yunus:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاءً وَالْقَمَرَ نُورًا وَقَدَّرَهُ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسَابَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ ذٰلِكَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ huwa alladhī jaʿala l-shamsa ḍiyāan wal-qamara nūran waqaddarahu manāzila litaʿlamū ʿadada l-sinīna wal-ḥisāba mā khalaqa l-lahu dhālika illā bil-ḥaqi yufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna It is He who made the sun a radiance and the moon a light, and ordained its phases that you might know the number of years and the calculation [of time]. Allah did not create all that except with reason. He elaborates the signs for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: Yunus:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاءً وَالْقَمَرَ نُورًا وَقَدَّرَهُ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسَابَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ ذٰلِكَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ huwa alladhī jaʿala l-shamsa ḍiyāan wal-qamara nūran waqaddarahu manāzila litaʿlamū ʿadada l-sinīna wal-ḥisāba mā khalaqa l-lahu dhālika illā bil-ḥaqi yufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna It is He who made the sun a shining light and the moon a derived light and determined for it phases - that you may know the number of years and account (of time). Allah has not created this except in truth. He details the signs for a people who know. It is He Who made the sun a shining thing and the moon as a light and measured out for it stages that you might know the number of years and the reckoning. Allah did not create this but in truth. He explains…

item.title: Yunus:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاءً وَالْقَمَرَ نُورًا وَقَدَّرَهُ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسَابَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ ذٰلِكَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ huwa alladhī jaʿala l-shamsa ḍiyāan wal-qamara nūran waqaddarahu manāzila litaʿlamū ʿadada l-sinīna wal-ḥisāba mā khalaqa l-lahu dhālika illā bil-ḥaqi yufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna He is (the One) Who made the sun a radiation (Arabic 'Zia'.) and the moon a light and planned (the Zodiac lines of movements.) into stations (Not restricted only to moon, the movement of both the Sun and the moon have been planned into stations. It is quite idiomatic in the Arabic language to use the Singular pronoun in the place of a dual or a plural, if it is evident from the context. (A.P.).) that ye might know the number of years and the reckoning (of time); created not God (all) this but…

item.title: Yunus:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي اخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَّقُونَ inna fī ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā khalaqa l-lahu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin liqawmin yattaqūna Indeed in the alternation of night and day, and whatever Allah has created in the heavens and the earth, there are surely signs for a people who are Godwary.

item.title: Yunus:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي اخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَّقُونَ inna fī ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā khalaqa l-lahu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin liqawmin yattaqūna Indeed, in the alternation of the night and the day and (in) what Allah has created in the heavens and the earth are signs for a people who fear Allah. See 10:5

item.title: Yunus:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ فِي اخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَّقُونَ inna fī ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā khalaqa l-lahu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin liqawmin yattaqūna Verily in the variation of the night and the day, and what (all) hath created God in the heavens and in the earth, surely are there signs for a people who guard (The pious. Refer to verses 2:2 & 2:3.) (themselves) against evil. See 10:5

item.title: Yunus:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا وَرَضُوْۤا بِالْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاطْمَأَنُّوا بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ ءَايَاتِنَا غَافِلُونَ inna alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā waraḍū bil-ḥayati l-dun'yā wa-iṭ'ma-annū bihā wa-alladhīna hum ʿan āyātinā ghāfilūna Indeed those who do not expect to encounter Us and who are pleased with the life of this world and satisfied with it, and those who are oblivious of Our signs

item.title: Yunus:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا وَرَضُوْۤا بِالْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاطْمَأَنُّوا بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ ءَايَاتِنَا غَافِلُونَ inna alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā waraḍū bil-ḥayati l-dun'yā wa-iṭ'ma-annū bihā wa-alladhīna hum ʿan āyātinā ghāfilūna Indeed, those who do not expect the meeting with Us and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure therein and those who are heedless of Our signs. Verily, those who hope not for their meeting with Us, but are pleased and satisfied with the life of the present world, and those who are heedless of Our Ayat (10:7). Those, their abode will be the Fire, because of what they used to earn (10:8). The Abode of Those Who Deny the Hour is Hell-Fire Allah describes the state of the wretched who disbelieved in the meeting with Allah on the Day of Resurrection and did not look…

item.title: Yunus:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا وَرَضُوْۤا بِالْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاطْمَأَنُّوا بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ ءَايَاتِنَا غَافِلُونَ inna alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā waraḍū bil-ḥayati l-dun'yā wa-iṭ'ma-annū bihā wa-alladhīna hum ʿan āyātinā ghāfilūna Verily, those who hope not to meet Us (on the Day of Judgment) and are pleased with the life of this world and are satisfied (pleased with.) with it, and those who are neglectful of Our signs (This is in contrast to the preceding verse.) . 'Liqa'ana', i.e., meeting Us, the ultimate and of everyone is the return to God for the final judgment. This does not mean seeing God with the physical eye in any form. It has been clearly laid 'La thoriduh al-Absar', i.e., The eyes will not see Him (God). See verse 10:11.

item.title: Yunus:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ ulāika mawāhumu l-nāru bimā kānū yaksibūna —it is they whose refuge shall be the Fire because of what they used to earn.

item.title: Yunus:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ ulāika mawāhumu l-nāru bimā kānū yaksibūna For those their refuge will be the Fire because of what they used to earn. See 10:7

item.title: Yunus:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُولٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ ulāika mawāhumu l-nāru bimā kānū yaksibūna These! their abode is the fire for what they did earn. See 10:7

item.title: Yunus:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِإِيمَانِهِمْ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti yahdīhim rabbuhum biīmānihim tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru fī jannāti l-naʿīmi Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds, their Lord guides them by the means of their faith. Streams will run for them in gardens of bliss.

item.title: Yunus:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِإِيمَانِهِمْ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti yahdīhim rabbuhum biīmānihim tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru fī jannāti l-naʿīmi Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their Lord will guide them because of their faith. Beneath them rivers will flow in the Gardens of Pleasure. Verily, those who believe and do deeds of righteousness, their Lord will guide them through their faith; under them will flow rivers in the Gardens of delight (Paradise) (10:9). Their way of request therein will be: Glory to You, O Allah!" and "Salam" (peace, safety from evil) will be their greetings therein! And the close of their request will be: "All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all that exists (10:10). The Good Reward is for the People of…

item.title: Yunus:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِإِيمَانِهِمْ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti yahdīhim rabbuhum biīmānihim tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru fī jannāti l-naʿīmi Verily (for) those who believe and do good, guideth them their Lord by their faith, beneath them will flow rivers in gardens of bliss (Refer to note to verses 14:23 19:62 56:25, 26 36:58.) . See 10:7

item.title: Yunus:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ وَءَاخِرُ دَعْوَاهُمْ أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ daʿwāhum fīhā sub'ḥānaka l-lahuma wataḥiyyatuhum fīhā salāmun waākhiru daʿwāhum ani l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna Their call therein will be, 'O Allah! Immaculate are You!' and their greeting therein will be, 'Peace!' and their concluding call, 'All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: Yunus:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ وَءَاخِرُ دَعْوَاهُمْ أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ daʿwāhum fīhā sub'ḥānaka l-lahuma wataḥiyyatuhum fīhā salāmun waākhiru daʿwāhum ani l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna Their call therein will be, "Exalted are You, O Allah," and their greeting therein will be, "Peace." And the last of their call will be, "Praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds!" See 10:9

item.title: Yunus:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ وَءَاخِرُ دَعْوَاهُمْ أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ daʿwāhum fīhā sub'ḥānaka l-lahuma wataḥiyyatuhum fīhā salāmun waākhiru daʿwāhum ani l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna Their cry therein (will be), "Glory be to Thee O' God!" and their greetings in it (will be) 'Peace' and the last of their cry (will be), that God's is the praise, the Lord of the worlds (The supplication continues to the life here-after even to the final abode but the nature of it will differ as they will be in the state of realisation. They will witness always his glory and absolute Lordship. Thus, they rejoice.) . It is said that the salutation of the people in Paradise will be 'Peace' meaning it will be a life of Bliss-Perfect. This has been mentioned in 56:25& 56:26. These verses explain the meaning…

item.title: Yunus:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ اسْتِعْجَالَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرِ لَقُضِيَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ فَنَذَرُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ walaw yuʿajjilu l-lahu lilnnāsi l-shara is'tiʿ'jālahum bil-khayri laquḍiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanadharu alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna Were Allah to hasten ill1 for mankind with their haste for good, their term would have been over. But We leave those who do not expect to encounter Us bewildered in their rebellion.

item.title: Yunus:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ اسْتِعْجَالَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرِ لَقُضِيَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ فَنَذَرُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ walaw yuʿajjilu l-lahu lilnnāsi l-shara is'tiʿ'jālahum bil-khayri laquḍiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanadharu alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna And if Allah was to hasten for the people the evil (they invoke)1 as He hastens for them the good, their term would have been ended for them.2 But We leave the ones who do not expect the meeting with Us, in their transgression, wandering blindly. And were Allah to hasten for mankind the evil as He hastens for them the good then they would have been ruined. So We leave those who expect not their meeting with Us, in their trespasses, wandering blindly in distraction (10:11). Allah does Not Respond to the Requests for Evil like He does with the Requests for Good…

item.title: Yunus:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
