item.description: وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ اسْتِعْجَالَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرِ لَقُضِيَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ فَنَذَرُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ walaw yuʿajjilu l-lahu lilnnāsi l-shara is'tiʿ'jālahum bil-khayri laquḍiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanadharu alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna And if God were to hasten unto men the evil (they have earned) as they would fain hasten on for (their) good, surely should have been decreed unto them their doom (Refer to note to verse 2:15.) ; But We leave those who hope not to meet Us (on the Day of Judgment) in their contumacy (The end of the term of respite.) blindly wandering (bewildered). The use of 'Laqa' in this verse explains the actual meaning of the word being the ultimate return and not seeing without the eyes. In another verse1 it is said that the object of the life and the…

item.title: Yunus:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ الضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنْبِهِ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَائِمًا فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُ ضُرَّهُ مَرَّ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَدْعُنَا إِلَى ضُرٍّ مَسَّهُ كَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-idhā massa l-insāna l-ḍuru daʿānā lijanbihi aw qāʿidan aw qāiman falammā kashafnā ʿanhu ḍurrahu marra ka-an lam yadʿunā ilā ḍurrin massahu kadhālika zuyyina lil'mus'rifīna mā kānū yaʿmalūna When distress befalls man, he supplicates Us, [lying] on his side, sitting, or standing; but when We remove his distress, he passes on as if he had never supplicated Us concerning the distress that had befallen him. To the profligate is thus presented as decorous what they have been doing.

item.title: Yunus:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ الضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنْبِهِ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَائِمًا فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُ ضُرَّهُ مَرَّ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَدْعُنَا إِلَى ضُرٍّ مَسَّهُ كَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-idhā massa l-insāna l-ḍuru daʿānā lijanbihi aw qāʿidan aw qāiman falammā kashafnā ʿanhu ḍurrahu marra ka-an lam yadʿunā ilā ḍurrin massahu kadhālika zuyyina lil'mus'rifīna mā kānū yaʿmalūna And when affliction touches man, he calls upon Us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when We remove from him his affliction, he continues (in disobedience) as if he had never called upon Us to (remove) an affliction that touched him. Thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing. And when harm touches man, he invokes Us, lying on his side, or sitting or standing. But when We have removed his harm from him, he passes on…

item.title: Yunus:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ الضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنْبِهِ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَائِمًا فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُ ضُرَّهُ مَرَّ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَدْعُنَا إِلَى ضُرٍّ مَسَّهُ كَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ wa-idhā massa l-insāna l-ḍuru daʿānā lijanbihi aw qāʿidan aw qāiman falammā kashafnā ʿanhu ḍurrahu marra ka-an lam yadʿunā ilā ḍurrin massahu kadhālika zuyyina lil'mus'rifīna mā kānū yaʿmalūna And when toucheth a man (an) affliction he crieth unto Us whether lying, or sitting or standing; but when remove We from him his affliction, he passes on as though he had not called unto Us an account of the affliction which did touch him; thus is made fairseeming unto the transgressors what they do (Refer to verses 39:8, 39:48, 30:36, 42:48. Literally, What they were doing.) . See 10:11

item.title: Yunus:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوْۤا وَجَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ walaqad ahlaknā l-qurūna min qablikum lammā ẓalamū wajāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wamā kānū liyu'minū kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīna Certainly We destroyed [several] generations before you when they perpetrated wrongs: their apostles brought them manifest proofs, but they would not have faith. Thus do We requite the guilty lot.

item.title: Yunus:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوْۤا وَجَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ walaqad ahlaknā l-qurūna min qablikum lammā ẓalamū wajāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wamā kānū liyu'minū kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīna And We had already destroyed generations before you when they wronged, and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. And indeed, We destroyed generations before you when they did wrong, while their Messengers came to them with clear proofs, but they were not such as to believe! Thus do We requite the people who are criminals (10:13). Then We made you successors after them, generations after generations in the land, that We might see how you would work (10:14). The Admonition Held in the Destruction of the Previous Generations Allah tells…

item.title: Yunus:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوْۤا وَجَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ walaqad ahlaknā l-qurūna min qablikum lammā ẓalamū wajāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wamā kānū liyu'minū kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīna And indeed We did destroy generations before you when they did wrong, and had come unto them apostles for them with clear signs (Miracles to prove their bonafides.) but they would not believe; Thus do We recompense the guilty people. See 10:11

item.title: Yunus:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لِنَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ thumma jaʿalnākum khalāifa fī l-arḍi min baʿdihim linanẓura kayfa taʿmalūna Then We made you successors on the earth after them that We may observe how you will act.

item.title: Yunus:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لِنَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ thumma jaʿalnākum khalāifa fī l-arḍi min baʿdihim linanẓura kayfa taʿmalūna Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do. See 10:13

item.title: Yunus:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لِنَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ thumma jaʿalnākum khalāifa fī l-arḍi min baʿdihim linanẓura kayfa taʿmalūna Then We made you (their) successors in the land after them, that We might see how ye act. See 10:11

item.title: Yunus:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا ائْتِ بِقُرْءَانٍ غَيْرِ هَذَا أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لِي أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُ مِنْ تِلْقَائِ نَفْسِي إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā i'ti biqur'ānin ghayri hādhā aw baddil'hu qul mā yakūnu lī an ubaddilahu min til'qāi nafsī in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin When Our manifest signs are recited to them, those who do not expect to encounter Us say, 'Bring a Qur'ān other than this, or alter it.' Say, 'I may not alter it of my own accord. I follow only what is revealed to me. Indeed should I disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: Yunus:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا ائْتِ بِقُرْءَانٍ غَيْرِ هَذَا أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لِي أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُ مِنْ تِلْقَائِ نَفْسِي إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā i'ti biqur'ānin ghayri hādhā aw baddil'hu qul mā yakūnu lī an ubaddilahu min til'qāi nafsī in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Bring us a Qur’ān other than this or change it." Say, (O Muḥammad), "It is not for me to change it on my own accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my…

item.title: Yunus:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا ائْتِ بِقُرْءَانٍ غَيْرِ هَذَا أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لِي أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُ مِنْ تِلْقَائِ نَفْسِي إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā i'ti biqur'ānin ghayri hādhā aw baddil'hu qul mā yakūnu lī an ubaddilahu min til'qāi nafsī in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin And when are recited unto them Our clear signs, those who hope not to meet Us (Those who do not believe in spiritual life-life after death & the day of judgment Refer to verses 16:101 - 105.) say, "Bring thou (The Holy Prophet.) a Qur'an other than this or change it;" say thou "it is not for me to change it as…

item.title: Yunus:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَدْرَاكُمْ بِهِ فَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ فِيكُمْ عُمُرًا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ qul law shāa l-lahu mā talawtuhu ʿalaykum walā adrākum bihi faqad labith'tu fīkum ʿumuran min qablihi afalā taʿqilūna Say, 'Had Allah [so] wished, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I have dwelled among you for a lifetime before it. Do you not apply reason?'

item.title: Yunus:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَدْرَاكُمْ بِهِ فَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ فِيكُمْ عُمُرًا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ qul law shāa l-lahu mā talawtuhu ʿalaykum walā adrākum bihi faqad labith'tu fīkum ʿumuran min qablihi afalā taʿqilūna Say, "If Allah had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I had remained among you a lifetime before it.1 Then will you not reason?" See 10:15

item.title: Yunus:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَدْرَاكُمْ بِهِ فَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ فِيكُمْ عُمُرًا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ qul law shāa l-lahu mā talawtuhu ʿalaykum walā adrākum bihi faqad labith'tu fīkum ʿumuran min qablihi afalā taʿqilūna Say thou, "If God hath so willed, I had not recited it unto you, nor would He have taught it to you; Indeed have I lived among you an age (of forty long years - and you have your selves found me truthful & trustworthy and yourselves titled me - Al-Ameen' the Trustworthy.) before it; What! then (yet) ye understand not?" The Truthfulness, Honesty and Reliability of the character and conduct of the Holy Prophet was first made to be stamped on the hearts of the people to be undisputedly acknowledged by all for forty long years, before the declaration of his apostolic mission…

item.title: Yunus:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِءَايَاتِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-muj'rimūna So who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah, or denies His signs? Indeed the guilty will not be felicitous.

item.title: Yunus:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِءَايَاتِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-muj'rimūna So who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah or denies His signs? Indeed, the criminals will not succeed. So who does more wrong than he who forges a lie against Allah or denies His Āyāt? Surely, the criminals will never be successful (10:17). Allah says that no one is more wrong, unjust and arrogant than he who invented a lie against Allah, forged claims about Allah, or claimed that Allah has sent a message to him but his claim was not true. No one is more of a criminal or has committed greater wrong than such a person. Liars cannot be confused with Prophets. Anyone who claims…

item.title: Yunus:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِءَايَاتِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-muj'rimūna Who then doth more wrong than he who forgeth a lie against God or belieth His signs? Verily succeed not the guilty ones. See 10:16

item.title: Yunus:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَؤُلَاءِ شُفَعَاؤُنَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّئُونَ اللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yaḍurruhum walā yanfaʿuhum wayaqūlūna hāulāi shufaʿāunā ʿinda l-lahi qul atunabbiūna l-laha bimā lā yaʿlamu fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna They worship besides Allah that which neither causes them any harm, nor brings them any benefit, and they say, 'These are our intercessors with Allah.' Say, 'Will you inform Allah about something He does not know in the heavens or on the earth?' Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: Yunus:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَؤُلَاءِ شُفَعَاؤُنَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّئُونَ اللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yaḍurruhum walā yanfaʿuhum wayaqūlūna hāulāi shufaʿāunā ʿinda l-lahi qul atunabbiūna l-laha bimā lā yaʿlamu fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna And they worship other than Allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say, "These are our intercessors with Allah." Say, "Do you inform Allah of something He does not know in the heavens or on the earth?" Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him. And they worship besides Allah things that harm them not, nor profit them, and they say: These are our intercessors with Allah." Say: Do you inform Allah of that which…

item.title: Yunus:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَؤُلَاءِ شُفَعَاؤُنَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّئُونَ اللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yaḍurruhum walā yanfaʿuhum wayaqūlūna hāulāi shufaʿāunā ʿinda l-lahi qul atunabbiūna l-laha bimā lā yaʿlamu fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna And worship they besides God, what can neither hurt them nor profit them, and say they: "These are our intercessors with God." Say thou "What! (imagine) ye (to) inform God of what He knoweth not (of what is) in the heavens and in the earth?" Glory be to Him and Exalted is He (far) above what they associate (with Him). This means to argue saying that which they associate with God is not to be found anywhere in the universe, i.e., it…

item.title: Yunus:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ إِلَّا أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَاخْتَلَفُوا وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ فِيمَا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ wamā kāna l-nāsu illā ummatan wāḥidatan fa-ikh'talafū walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum fīmā fīhi yakhtalifūna Mankind were but a single [religious] community; then they differed. And were it not for a prior decree of your Lord, decision would have been made between them concerning that about which they differ.

item.title: Yunus:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ إِلَّا أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَاخْتَلَفُوا وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ فِيمَا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ wamā kāna l-nāsu illā ummatan wāḥidatan fa-ikh'talafū walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum fīmā fīhi yakhtalifūna And mankind was not but one community (united in religion), but (then) they differed. And if not for a word1 that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them (immediately) concerning that over which they differ. See 10:18

item.title: Yunus:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ إِلَّا أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَاخْتَلَفُوا وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ فِيمَا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ wamā kāna l-nāsu illā ummatan wāḥidatan fa-ikh'talafū walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum fīmā fīhi yakhtalifūna And mankind was naught but one community (Refer to verses 2:213; 21:92; 21:93; 23:52; 23:53; 11:118.) but (later) differed (Got divided.) ; and had not a word (of decree of respite) already gone forth from thy Lord, it would have been decided between them in respect of what they differ therein. Note the conception of humanity as a whole being one nation on the conviction about which depends on the conception of the Brotherhood of Man and the belief in the Fatherhood of God, i.e., God being the Creator of one and all. The same phenomenon has been referred to with greater details in verse 2:23.

item.title: Yunus:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا الْغَيْبُ لِلَّهِ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ wayaqūlūna lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi faqul innamā l-ghaybu lillahi fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna They say, 'Why has not some sign1 been sent down to him from his Lord?' Say, '[The knowledge of] the Unseen belongs only to Allah. So wait. I too am waiting along with you.'

item.title: Yunus:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا الْغَيْبُ لِلَّهِ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ wayaqūlūna lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi faqul innamā l-ghaybu lillahi fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna And they say, "Why is a sign not sent down to him from his Lord?" So say, "The unseen is only for Allah (to administer), so wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait." And they say: How is it that not a sign is sent down on him from his Lord?" Say: "The Unseen belongs only to Allah, so wait you, verily, I am with you among those who wait (10:20). The Idolators Requested a Miracle These stubborn, lying disbelievers said, "Why would not a sign be revealed to Muhammad from his Lord." They meant a sign such as given to Salih. Allah sent the…

item.title: Yunus:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا الْغَيْبُ لِلَّهِ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ wayaqūlūna lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi faqul innamā l-ghaybu lillahi fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna And they say, "Why is not a sign (of destruction) sent unto him from His lord?" Say thou "Verily the unseen is only for God, there-fore wait ye; verily I am (also) with you of the waiting ones." See 10:19

item.title: Yunus:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُمْ إِذَا لَهُمْ مَكْرٌ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا قُلِ اللَّهُ أَسْرَعُ مَكْرًا إِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكْتُبُونَ مَا تَمْكُرُونَ wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathum idhā lahum makrun fī āyātinā quli l-lahu asraʿu makran inna rusulanā yaktubūna mā tamkurūna When We let people taste [Our] mercy after a distress that has befallen them, behold, they scheme against Our signs! Say, 'Allah is more swift at devising.' Indeed Our messengers write down what you scheme.

item.title: Yunus:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُمْ إِذَا لَهُمْ مَكْرٌ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا قُلِ اللَّهُ أَسْرَعُ مَكْرًا إِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكْتُبُونَ مَا تَمْكُرُونَ wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathum idhā lahum makrun fī āyātinā quli l-lahu asraʿu makran inna rusulanā yaktubūna mā tamkurūna And when We give the people a taste of mercy after adversity has touched them, at once they conspire against Our verses. Say, "Allah is swifter in strategy." Indeed, Our messengers (i.e., angels) record that which you conspire. And when We let mankind taste mercy after some adversity has afflicted them, behold! They take to plotting against Our Ayat! Say: Allah is more swift in planning!" Certainly, Our messengers (angels) record all of that which you plot (10:21). He it is Who enables you to travel through land and sea, till when you are in the…

item.title: Yunus:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُمْ إِذَا لَهُمْ مَكْرٌ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا قُلِ اللَّهُ أَسْرَعُ مَكْرًا إِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكْتُبُونَ مَا تَمْكُرُونَ wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathum idhā lahum makrun fī āyātinā quli l-lahu asraʿu makran inna rusulanā yaktubūna mā tamkurūna And when We make people taste of (Our) mercy after an affliction hath touched them; lo! they devise plots against Our signs; Say thou (O' Our Apostle!) "God is quicker in devising; Verily Our messengers (Angels.) write down what (all) ye devise." Whenever any of God's bounty reached the people after any straitness, they attributed it as the gift of some imaginary star-god or some false deity, and they started plotting against the apostles of God. Once a very severe famine and drought visited Mecca for seven continuous years and when at last God turned merciful…

item.title: Yunus:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ حَتّٰی إِذَا كُنْتُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَرَيْنَ بِهِمْ بِرِيحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ وَفَرِحُوْۤا بِهَا جَاءَتْهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ وَجَاءَهُمُ الْمَوْجُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ أُحِيطَ بِهِمْ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ لَئِنْ أَنْجَيْتَنَا مِنْ هَذِهِ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ huwa alladhī yusayyirukum fī l-bari wal-baḥri ḥattā idhā kuntum fī l-ful'ki wajarayna bihim birīḥin ṭayyibatin wafariḥū bihā jāathā rīḥun ʿāṣifun wajāahumu l-mawju min kulli makānin waẓannū annahum uḥīṭa bihim daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna la-in anjaytanā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna It is He who carries you across land and sea. When you are in the ships, and they sail with them with a favourable wind, rejoicing in it, there comes upon them a tempestuous wind and waves assail them from every side, and they think that they are besieged, they invoke Allah putting exclusive faith in Him, 'If…

item.title: Yunus:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ حَتّٰی إِذَا كُنْتُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَرَيْنَ بِهِمْ بِرِيحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ وَفَرِحُوْۤا بِهَا جَاءَتْهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ وَجَاءَهُمُ الْمَوْجُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ أُحِيطَ بِهِمْ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ لَئِنْ أَنْجَيْتَنَا مِنْ هَذِهِ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ huwa alladhī yusayyirukum fī l-bari wal-baḥri ḥattā idhā kuntum fī l-ful'ki wajarayna bihim birīḥin ṭayyibatin wafariḥū bihā jāathā rīḥun ʿāṣifun wajāahumu l-mawju min kulli makānin waẓannū annahum uḥīṭa bihim daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna la-in anjaytanā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna It is He who enables you to travel on land and sea until, when you are in ships and they sail with them1 by a good wind and they rejoice therein, there comes a storm wind and the waves come upon them from every place and they expect to be engulfed, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in…

item.title: Yunus:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ حَتّٰی إِذَا كُنْتُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَرَيْنَ بِهِمْ بِرِيحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ وَفَرِحُوْۤا بِهَا جَاءَتْهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ وَجَاءَهُمُ الْمَوْجُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ أُحِيطَ بِهِمْ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ لَئِنْ أَنْجَيْتَنَا مِنْ هَذِهِ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ huwa alladhī yusayyirukum fī l-bari wal-baḥri ḥattā idhā kuntum fī l-ful'ki wajarayna bihim birīḥin ṭayyibatin wafariḥū bihā jāathā rīḥun ʿāṣifun wajāahumu l-mawju min kulli makānin waẓannū annahum uḥīṭa bihim daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna la-in anjaytanā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīna He it is Who enableth you to travel by land and sea; so that ye go on board the ships; and they sail on with them in a favourable (Fair.) breeze, and they rejoice thereat, (and when cometh) unto them a violent gale and the billows surge in on them from all sides and they think (Realise.) that…

item.title: Yunus:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَنْجَاهُمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا بَغْيُكُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ مَتَاعَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ falammā anjāhum idhā hum yabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi yāayyuhā l-nāsu innamā baghyukum ʿalā anfusikum matāʿa l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿukum fanunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna But when He delivers them, behold, they commit violations on the earth unduly! O mankind! Your violations are only to your own detriment. [These are] the wares of the life of this world; then to Us will be your return, whereat We will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: Yunus:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَنْجَاهُمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا بَغْيُكُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ مَتَاعَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ falammā anjāhum idhā hum yabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi yāayyuhā l-nāsu innamā baghyukum ʿalā anfusikum matāʿa l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿukum fanunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna But when He saves them, at once they commit injustice1 upon the earth without right. O mankind, your injustice is only against yourselves, (being merely) the enjoyment of worldly life. Then to Us is your return, and We will inform you of what you used to do. See 10:21

item.title: Yunus:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَنْجَاهُمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا بَغْيُكُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ مَتَاعَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ falammā anjāhum idhā hum yabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi yāayyuhā l-nāsu innamā baghyukum ʿalā anfusikum matāʿa l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿukum fanunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna But when He (God.) delivereth them, behold! they rebel in the earth unjustly; "O' mankind! your rebellion is against your own selves, a provision for (for enjoying.) the life of (only) this world, then unto Us shall be your return, then will. We inform you of what ye were doing." See 10:21

item.title: Yunus:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ وَالْأَنْعَامُ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَخَذَتِ الْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا وَازَّيَّنَتْ وَظَنَّ أَهْلُهَا أَنَّهُمْ قَادِرُونَ عَلَيْهَا أَتَاهَا أَمْرُنَا لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا فَجَعَلْنَاهَا حَصِيدًا كَأَنْ لَمْ تَغْنَ بِالْأَمْسِ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ innamā mathalu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamāin anzalnāhu mina l-samāi fa-ikh'talaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi mimmā yakulu l-nāsu wal-anʿāmu ḥattā idhā akhadhati l-arḍu zukh'rufahā wa-izzayyanat waẓanna ahluhā annahum qādirūna ʿalayhā atāhā amrunā laylan aw nahāran fajaʿalnāhā ḥaṣīdan ka-an lam taghna bil-amsi kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yatafakkarūna The parable of the life of this world is that of water which We send down from the sky. It mingles with the earth's vegetation from which humans and cattle eat. When the earth puts on its luster and is adorned, and its inhabitants think they have power over it, Our edict comes to…

item.title: Yunus:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ وَالْأَنْعَامُ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَخَذَتِ الْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا وَازَّيَّنَتْ وَظَنَّ أَهْلُهَا أَنَّهُمْ قَادِرُونَ عَلَيْهَا أَتَاهَا أَمْرُنَا لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا فَجَعَلْنَاهَا حَصِيدًا كَأَنْ لَمْ تَغْنَ بِالْأَمْسِ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ innamā mathalu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamāin anzalnāhu mina l-samāi fa-ikh'talaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi mimmā yakulu l-nāsu wal-anʿāmu ḥattā idhā akhadhati l-arḍu zukh'rufahā wa-izzayyanat waẓanna ahluhā annahum qādirūna ʿalayhā atāhā amrunā laylan aw nahāran fajaʿalnāhā ḥaṣīdan ka-an lam taghna bil-amsi kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yatafakkarūna The example of (this) worldly life is but like rain which We have sent down from the sky that the plants of the earth absorb - (those) from which men and livestock eat - until, when the earth has taken on its adornment and is beautified and its people suppose that they have capability…

item.title: Yunus:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ وَالْأَنْعَامُ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَخَذَتِ الْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا وَازَّيَّنَتْ وَظَنَّ أَهْلُهَا أَنَّهُمْ قَادِرُونَ عَلَيْهَا أَتَاهَا أَمْرُنَا لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا فَجَعَلْنَاهَا حَصِيدًا كَأَنْ لَمْ تَغْنَ بِالْأَمْسِ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ innamā mathalu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamāin anzalnāhu mina l-samāi fa-ikh'talaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi mimmā yakulu l-nāsu wal-anʿāmu ḥattā idhā akhadhati l-arḍu zukh'rufahā wa-izzayyanat waẓanna ahluhā annahum qādirūna ʿalayhā atāhā amrunā laylan aw nahāran fajaʿalnāhā ḥaṣīdan ka-an lam taghna bil-amsi kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yatafakkarūna The likeness of this world's life is only as water which We send down from the sky; by its mingling grow the produce of the earth of which eat men and cattle; until when the earth puts on its golden raiment and gets garnished, and its people deem that they have power (of disposal)…

item.title: Yunus:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wal-lahu yadʿū ilā dāri l-salāmi wayahdī man yashāu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin Allah invites to the abode of peace, and He guides whomever He wishes to a straight path.

item.title: Yunus:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wal-lahu yadʿū ilā dāri l-salāmi wayahdī man yashāu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin And Allah invites to the Home of Peace (i.e., Paradise) and guides whom He wills to a straight path. See 10:24

item.title: Yunus:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ wal-lahu yadʿū ilā dāri l-salāmi wayahdī man yashāu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin And God calleth (Mankind in general.) (you) to the abode of peace (The life described in verse 10:24 is the transitory life, but God calls to a permanent abode of bliss.) ; and guideth whomsoever He willeth unto the right way (Refer to verses 36:60 & 36:61.) . 'Salam', i.e., Peace and Bliss, refers to the state in the paradise where prevails bliss-perfect. 'Salam' is one of the holy names with which God is addressed. Applying this interpretation, God invites mankind to Him with Whom nothing, but bliss prevails. It is said that the life on this earth starts with crying (a human child immediately as it lands on earth starts its life with crying), passes through miseries…

item.title: Yunus:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا الْحُسْنَى وَزِيَادَةٌ وَلَا يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ lilladhīna aḥsanū l-ḥus'nā waziyādatun walā yarhaqu wujūhahum qatarun walā dhillatun ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna Those who are virtuous shall receive the best reward and an enhancement. Neither dust nor abasement shall overcast their faces. They shall be the inhabitants of paradise, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: Yunus:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا الْحُسْنَى وَزِيَادَةٌ وَلَا يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ lilladhīna aḥsanū l-ḥus'nā waziyādatun walā yarhaqu wujūhahum qatarun walā dhillatun ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna For them who have done good is the best (reward) - and extra.1 No darkness will cover their faces, nor humiliation. Those are companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally. For those who have done good is the best, and even more. Neither darkness nor dust nor any humiliating disgrace shall cover their faces. They are the dwellers of Paradise, they will abide therein forever (10:26). The Reward of the Good-Doers Allah states that those who do good in this world – by having faith and performing righteous deeds – will be rewarded with a good reward in the Hereafter. Allah said: هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ…

item.title: Yunus:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا الْحُسْنَى وَزِيَادَةٌ وَلَا يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ lilladhīna aḥsanū l-ḥus'nā waziyādatun walā yarhaqu wujūhahum qatarun walā dhillatun ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna For those who do good is excellent reward and more (than this); No darkness shall cover their faces nor shall ignominy (befall them); these are the dwellers of the garden; in it shall they abide (Refer to verses 3:105, 39:60.) . See 10:25

item.title: Yunus:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَسَبُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ جَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ بِمِثْلِهَا وَتَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ مَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ كَأَنَّمَا أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna kasabū l-sayiāti jazāu sayyi-atin bimith'lihā watarhaquhum dhillatun mā lahum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin ka-annamā ugh'shiyat wujūhuhum qiṭaʿan mina al-layli muẓ'liman ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna For those who have committed misdeeds, the requital of a misdeed shall be its like, and they shall be overcast by abasement. They shall have no one to protect [them] from Allah. [They will be] as if their faces were covered with dark patches of the night. They shall be the inmates of the Fire, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: Yunus:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَسَبُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ جَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ بِمِثْلِهَا وَتَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ مَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ كَأَنَّمَا أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna kasabū l-sayiāti jazāu sayyi-atin bimith'lihā watarhaquhum dhillatun mā lahum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin ka-annamā ugh'shiyat wujūhuhum qiṭaʿan mina al-layli muẓ'liman ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna But they who have earned (blame for) evil doings - the recompense of an evil deed is its equivalent, and humiliation will cover them. They will have from Allah no protector. It will be as if their faces are covered with pieces of the night - so dark (are they). Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally. And those who have earned evil deeds, the recompense of an evil deed is the like thereof, and humiliating disgrace will cover them (their…

item.title: Yunus:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَالَّذِينَ كَسَبُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ جَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ بِمِثْلِهَا وَتَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ مَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ كَأَنَّمَا أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-alladhīna kasabū l-sayiāti jazāu sayyi-atin bimith'lihā watarhaquhum dhillatun mā lahum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin ka-annamā ugh'shiyat wujūhuhum qiṭaʿan mina al-layli muẓ'liman ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna And those who have earned evil, the recompense for evil is the like of it; and ignominy shall come upon them; from (the wrath of) God they shall have no protector; as if their faces have been covered (So dark - darkened) as a piece of the darkening night; these are the inmates of the (Hell) fire; in it shall they abide (Refer to verse 3:105.) . See 10:25

item.title: Yunus:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا مَكَانَكُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَشُرَكَاؤُكُمْ فَزَيَّلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَقَالَ شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ إِيَّانَا تَعْبُدُونَ wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ashrakū makānakum antum washurakāukum fazayyalnā baynahum waqāla shurakāuhum mā kuntum iyyānā taʿbudūna On the day when We gather them all together, We shall say to those who ascribe partners [to Allah], 'Stay where you are —you and your partners!' Then We shall set them apart from one another, and their partners1 will say, 'It was not us that you worshipped.

item.title: Yunus:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا مَكَانَكُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَشُرَكَاؤُكُمْ فَزَيَّلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَقَالَ شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ إِيَّانَا تَعْبُدُونَ wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ashrakū makānakum antum washurakāukum fazayyalnā baynahum waqāla shurakāuhum mā kuntum iyyānā taʿbudūna And (mention, O Muḥammad), the Day We will gather them all together - then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "(Remain in) your place, you and your 'partners.'"1 Then We will separate them,2 and their "partners" will say, "You did not used to worship us.3 And the Day whereon We shall gather them all together, then We shall say to those who did set partners in worship with Us: "Stop at your place! You and your partners." Then We shall separate them, and their partners shall say: "It was not us that you used to worship (10:28). "So sufficient is…

item.title: Yunus:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا مَكَانَكُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَشُرَكَاؤُكُمْ فَزَيَّلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَقَالَ شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ إِيَّانَا تَعْبُدُونَ wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ashrakū makānakum antum washurakāukum fazayyalnā baynahum waqāla shurakāuhum mā kuntum iyyānā taʿbudūna On the day (of resurrection) when We will gather them all together (This is a definite declaration of the truth about the Common day of the final judgment.) , then will We say unto those who associated others (with Us) "Keep ye where ye are, ye and your associated gods;" then We shall separate them, the one from the other, and shall say (unto them) their associate gods "It was not us that ye worshipped (Served.) ". See 10:25

item.title: Yunus:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنْ كُنَّا عَنْ عِبَادَتِكُمْ لَغَافِلِينَ fakafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynanā wabaynakum in kunnā ʿan ʿibādatikum laghāfilīna Allah suffices as a witness between you and us. We were indeed unaware of your worship.'

item.title: Yunus:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنْ كُنَّا عَنْ عِبَادَتِكُمْ لَغَافِلِينَ fakafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynanā wabaynakum in kunnā ʿan ʿibādatikum laghāfilīna And sufficient is Allah as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware." See 10:28

item.title: Yunus:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنْ كُنَّا عَنْ عِبَادَتِكُمْ لَغَافِلِينَ fakafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynanā wabaynakum in kunnā ʿan ʿibādatikum laghāfilīna Therefore, God is a sufficient witness between us and you (that) we certainly, of your worship (of us), were unaware. See 10:25

item.title: Yunus:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُوْۤا كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا أَسْلَفَتْ وَرُدُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ hunālika tablū kullu nafsin mā aslafat waruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna There every soul will examine what it has sent in advance, and they will be returned to Allah, their real master, and what they used to fabricate will forsake them.

item.title: Yunus:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُوْۤا كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا أَسْلَفَتْ وَرُدُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ hunālika tablū kullu nafsin mā aslafat waruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna There, (on that Day), every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously, and they will be returned to Allah, their master, the Truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent. See 10:28

item.title: Yunus:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُوْۤا كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا أَسْلَفَتْ وَرُدُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ hunālika tablū kullu nafsin mā aslafat waruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna There shall every soul realize what it hath sent (Advanced.) before, and they shall be brought back to God, their true Lord (Master.) , and what they did fabricate (Devised.) (the false deities) will vanish (away) from them. See 10:25

item.title: Yunus:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَمَّنْ يَمْلِكُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَمَنْ يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَمَنْ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ فَسَيَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ فَقُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ qul man yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi amman yamliku l-samʿa wal-abṣāra waman yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi waman yudabbiru l-amra fasayaqūlūna l-lahu faqul afalā tattaqūna Say, 'Who provides for you out of the sky and the earth? Who controls [your] hearing and sight, and who brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living, and who directs the command?' They will say, 'Allah.' Say, 'Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: Yunus:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَمَّنْ يَمْلِكُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَمَنْ يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَمَنْ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ فَسَيَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ فَقُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ qul man yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi amman yamliku l-samʿa wal-abṣāra waman yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi waman yudabbiru l-amra fasayaqūlūna l-lahu faqul afalā tattaqūna Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Or who controls hearing and sight and who brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and who arranges (every) matter?" They will say, "Allah," so say, "Then will you not fear Him?" Say: Who provides for you from the sky and the earth? Or who owns hearing and sight? And who brings out the living from the dead and brings out the dead from the living? And…

item.title: Yunus:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ مَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَمَّنْ يَمْلِكُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَمَنْ يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَمَنْ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ فَسَيَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ فَقُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ qul man yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi amman yamliku l-samʿa wal-abṣāra waman yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi waman yudabbiru l-amra fasayaqūlūna l-lahu faqul afalā tattaqūna Say (Ask them.) (thou O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Who provideth you sustenance from the sky and from the earth? or who controlled! the hearing and the sight? and who bringeth forth the living (Refer to verses 30:19, 5:16, 69:11, 2:57.) from the dead, and bringeth forth the dead from the living? and who administreth (every) affair?" Then they will say "God". Then say (thou unto them) "Will ye not then guard (yourselves against His displeasure)?" Bringing forth the living from the dead figuratively means bringing forth…

item.title: Yunus:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ الْحَقِّ إِلَّا الضَّلَالُ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ fadhālikumu l-lahu rabbukumu l-ḥaqu famādhā baʿda l-ḥaqi illā l-ḍalālu fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna That, then, is Allah, your true Lord. So what is there after the truth except error? Then where are you being led away?

item.title: Yunus:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ الْحَقِّ إِلَّا الضَّلَالُ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ fadhālikumu l-lahu rabbukumu l-ḥaqu famādhā baʿda l-ḥaqi illā l-ḍalālu fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna For that is Allah, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted? See 10:31

item.title: Yunus:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ الْحَقِّ إِلَّا الضَّلَالُ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ fadhālikumu l-lahu rabbukumu l-ḥaqu famādhā baʿda l-ḥaqi illā l-ḍalālu fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna Then this is God, your true Lord; and what is apart from truth but error; whereto then are ye turned away? See 10:31

item.title: Yunus:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ kadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna fasaqū annahum lā yu'minūna Thus the word of your Lord became due against those who transgress that they shall not have faith.

item.title: Yunus:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ kadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna fasaqū annahum lā yu'minūna Thus the word (i.e., decree) of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe. See 10:31

item.title: Yunus:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: كَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ kadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna fasaqū annahum lā yu'minūna Thus is proved true the word of thy Lord against those who transgress that they believe not (Refer to verse 39:71) . See 10:31

item.title: Yunus:34 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ qul hal min shurakāikum man yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu quli l-lahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu fa-annā tu'fakūna Say, 'Is there anyone among your partners who originates the creation and then brings it back?' Say, 'Allah originates the creation, then He will bring it back.' Then where do you stray?

item.title: Yunus:34 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ qul hal min shurakāikum man yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu quli l-lahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu fa-annā tu'fakūna Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who begins creation and then repeats it?" Say, "Allah begins creation and then repeats it, so how are you deluded?" Say: "Is there of your partners one that originates the creation and then repeats it?" Say: "Allah originates the creation and then He repeats it. Then how are you deluded away (from the truth)? (10:34). Say: "Is there of your partners one that guides to the truth?" Say: "It is Allah Who guides to the truth. Is then He Who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed, or he who finds not guidance (himself) unless he is…

item.title: Yunus:34 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ qul hal min shurakāikum man yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu quli l-lahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu fa-annā tu'fakūna Say (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Of your associates (False Gods and Deities.) , is there anyone who can originate the creation (and), then return it?" Say thou! "God alone doth originate the creation and returneth it whereunto are ye then inclined away (From the truth.) ?" See 10:31

item.title: Yunus:35 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَهْدِي لِلْحَقِّ أَفَمَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّنْ لَا يَهِدِّي إِلَّا أَنْ يُهْدَى فَمَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ qul hal min shurakāikum man yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi quli l-lahu yahdī lil'ḥaqqi afaman yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi aḥaqqu an yuttabaʿa amman lā yahiddī illā an yuh'dā famā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna Say, 'Is there anyone among your partners who may guide to the truth?' Say, 'Allah guides to the truth. Is He who guides to the truth worthier to be followed, or he who is not guided unless he is shown the way? What is the matter with you? How do you judge?'

item.title: Yunus:35 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَهْدِي لِلْحَقِّ أَفَمَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّنْ لَا يَهِدِّي إِلَّا أَنْ يُهْدَى فَمَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ qul hal min shurakāikum man yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi quli l-lahu yahdī lil'ḥaqqi afaman yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi aḥaqqu an yuttabaʿa amman lā yahiddī illā an yuh'dā famā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who guides to the truth?" Say, "Allah guides to the truth. So is He who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed or he who guides not unless he is guided? Then what is (wrong) with you - how do you judge?" See 10:34

item.title: Yunus:35 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَهْدِي لِلْحَقِّ أَفَمَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّنْ لَا يَهِدِّي إِلَّا أَنْ يُهْدَى فَمَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ qul hal min shurakāikum man yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi quli l-lahu yahdī lil'ḥaqqi afaman yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi aḥaqqu an yuttabaʿa amman lā yahiddī illā an yuh'dā famā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "Of your associates is there anyone who can guide unto truth?" Say thou! "It is God alone Who guideth unto truth; Is then He Who guideth unto truth more worthy to be followed or he who himself goeth not aright unless he is guided? What then hath be-fallen you? How (ill) ye judge (Refer to verses 46:4, 5:100, 6:50, 13:16, 39:9, 67:22. This is an open refutation of the Validity of the majority's opinion for they…

item.title: Yunus:36 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا إِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ wamā yattabiʿu aktharuhum illā ẓannan inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yafʿalūna Most of them just follow conjecture; indeed conjecture is no substitute for the truth. Indeed Allah knows best what they do.

item.title: Yunus:36 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا إِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ wamā yattabiʿu aktharuhum illā ẓannan inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yafʿalūna And most of them follow not except assumption. Indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do. See 10:34

item.title: Yunus:36 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا إِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ wamā yattabiʿu aktharuhum illā ẓannan inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yafʿalūna And follow not most of them (anything) but (their own) conjecture; verily conjecture cannot avail anything against the truth; verily God knoweth all what they do. This verse clearly exposes the position of those who do not follow the phenomenon or the note of guidance laid down in the last Verse 36 and abide by their own imaginary conceptions which in the words of The Holy Qur'an are nothing but conjectures.

item.title: Yunus:37 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ أَنْ يُفْتَرٰی مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā kāna hādhā l-qur'ānu an yuf'tarā min dūni l-lahi walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīna This Qur'ān could not have been fabricated by anyone besides Allah; rather it is a confirmation of what was [revealed] before it, and an elaboration of the Book, there is no doubt in it, from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: Yunus:37 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ أَنْ يُفْتَرٰی مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā kāna hādhā l-qur'ānu an yuf'tarā min dūni l-lahi walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīna And it was not (possible) for this Qur’ān to be produced by other than Allah, but (it is) a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the (former) Scripture, about which there is no doubt,1 from the Lord of the worlds. And this Qur'an is not such as could ever be produced by other than Allah but it is a confirmation of (the revelation) which was before it, and a full explanation of the Book – wherein there is no doubt – from the Lord of all that exists (10:37). Or do…

item.title: Yunus:37 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ أَنْ يُفْتَرٰی مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ wamā kāna hādhā l-qur'ānu an yuf'tarā min dūni l-lahi walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīna And this Qur'an is not such as to be forged by (any one) besides God, but it is a confirmation of (the scriptures) that went before it and (the clearest) explanation of the Book, there is no doubt in it, (it is) from the Lord of the worlds (It refers to the Book - there is an explanation Book stands for the revealed and the explained form of the Book. Refer to verses 56:77 - 56:80; 85:21, 85:22 and their notes. This verse & the next establish the challenging position of the Qu'ran. See also 2:2…

item.title: Yunus:38 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِسُورَةٍ مِثْلِهِ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū bisūratin mith'lihi wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Then bring a sūrah like it, and invoke whomever you can, besides Allah, should you be truthful.'

item.title: Yunus:38 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِسُورَةٍ مِثْلِهِ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū bisūratin mith'lihi wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna Or do they say (about the Prophet SAW), "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a sūrah like it and call upon (for assistance) whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful." See 10:37

item.title: Yunus:38 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِسُورَةٍ مِثْلِهِ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū bisūratin mith'lihi wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna Or do they say: "He (Apostle Muhammad) hath forged it (This verse asserts that the arrangement of Qur'an in its Suras was regular along with its revelation, otherwise the Challenge here and in verses 2:23, 11:13, 17:88, 52:34 to bring a Sura or ten Suras if there had not been any suras will be meaningless.) ?" Say thou! "Bring ye then a chapter like unto it and call on (to your aid) whomsoever ye can, besides God, if ye be truthful." See 10:36

item.title: Yunus:39 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوْۤا بِعِلْمِهِ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُ كَذٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظَّالِمِينَ bal kadhabū bimā lam yuḥīṭū biʿil'mihi walammā yatihim tawīluhu kadhālika kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-ẓālimīna Rather, they deny that whose knowledge they do not comprehend, and whose explanation has not yet come to them. Those who were before them denied likewise. So observe how was the fate of the wrongdoers!

item.title: Yunus:39 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوْۤا بِعِلْمِهِ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُ كَذٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظَّالِمِينَ bal kadhabū bimā lam yuḥīṭū biʿil'mihi walammā yatihim tawīluhu kadhālika kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-ẓālimīna Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers. See 10:37

item.title: Yunus:39 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوْۤا بِعِلْمِهِ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُ كَذٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظَّالِمِينَ bal kadhabū bimā lam yuḥīṭū biʿil'mihi walammā yatihim tawīluhu kadhālika kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-ẓālimīna Nay, they belied that which they comprehended not with the knowledge of it and the explanation (the ultimate significance) of it came not unto them; even thus did belie those before them, see then what was the end of the unjust ones. The disbelievers were too materialistic to grasp the actual meaning of revelation and the divine wordings and similar were those who were before them and some are those of the present age and will be in future also. (A.P.).

item.title: Yunus:40 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ wamin'hum man yu'minu bihi wamin'hum man lā yu'minu bihi warabbuka aʿlamu bil-muf'sidīna Some of them believe in it, and some of them do not believe in it, and your Lord best knows the agents of corruption.

item.title: Yunus:40 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ wamin'hum man yu'minu bihi wamin'hum man lā yu'minu bihi warabbuka aʿlamu bil-muf'sidīna And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters. See 10:37

item.title: Yunus:40 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ wamin'hum man yu'minu bihi wamin'hum man lā yu'minu bihi warabbuka aʿlamu bil-muf'sidīna And of them is he who believeth in it, and of them is he who believeth not in it; and thy Lord knoweth best the mischief-makers. See 10:39

item.title: Yunus:41 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُلْ لِي عَمَلِي وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ أَنْتُمْ بَرِيءُونَ مِمَّا أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ wa-in kadhabūka faqul lī ʿamalī walakum ʿamalukum antum barīūna mimmā aʿmalu wa-anā barīon mimmā taʿmalūna If they deny you, say, 'My deeds belong to me and your deeds belong to you: you are absolved of what I do and I am absolved of what you do.'

item.title: Yunus:41 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُلْ لِي عَمَلِي وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ أَنْتُمْ بَرِيءُونَ مِمَّا أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ wa-in kadhabūka faqul lī ʿamalī walakum ʿamalukum antum barīūna mimmā aʿmalu wa-anā barīon mimmā taʿmalūna And if they deny you, (O Muḥammad), then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do." And if they belie you, say: For me are my deeds and for you are your deeds! You are innocent of what I do, and I am innocent of what you do! (10:41). And among them are some who listen to you, but can you make the deaf to hear – even though they apprehend not (10:42). And among them are some who look at you, but can you guide the blind – even though…

item.title: Yunus:41 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُلْ لِي عَمَلِي وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ أَنْتُمْ بَرِيءُونَ مِمَّا أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ wa-in kadhabūka faqul lī ʿamalī walakum ʿamalukum antum barīūna mimmā aʿmalu wa-anā barīon mimmā taʿmalūna And if they belie thee, say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) "For me is my work and for you is your work, ye are clear oft' of what I do and I am clear off of what ye do (Refer to verses 104:6; 104:7; 42:43; 7:79.) ." See 10:39

item.title: Yunus:42 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wamin'hum man yastamiʿūna ilayka afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma walaw kānū lā yaʿqilūna There are some of them who prick up their ears at you. But can you make the deaf hear even if they do not apply reason?

item.title: Yunus:42 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wamin'hum man yastamiʿūna ilayka afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma walaw kānū lā yaʿqilūna And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear (i.e., benefit from this hearing), although they will not use reason? See 10:41

item.title: Yunus:42 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wamin'hum man yastamiʿūna ilayka afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma walaw kānū lā yaʿqilūna And of them are those who hearken unto thee; canst thou make the deaf hear? though they understand not (Refer to verse 7:179.) . See 10:39

item.title: Yunus:43 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يُبْصِرُونَ wamin'hum man yanẓuru ilayka afa-anta tahdī l-ʿum'ya walaw kānū lā yub'ṣirūna And there are some of them who observe you. But can you guide the blind even if they do not perceive?

item.title: Yunus:43 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يُبْصِرُونَ wamin'hum man yanẓuru ilayka afa-anta tahdī l-ʿum'ya walaw kānū lā yub'ṣirūna And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not (attempt to) see? See 10:41

item.title: Yunus:43 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يُبْصِرُونَ wamin'hum man yanẓuru ilayka afa-anta tahdī l-ʿum'ya walaw kānū lā yub'ṣirūna And of them are those who look at thee; canst thou guide (Show the way to the blind.) the blind though they see not (Refer to verse 7:179.) . See 10:39

item.title: Yunus:44 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ النَّاسَ شَيْئًا وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ inna l-laha lā yaẓlimu l-nāsa shayan walākinna l-nāsa anfusahum yaẓlimūna Indeed Allah does not wrong people in the least; rather it is people who wrong themselves.

item.title: Yunus:44 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ النَّاسَ شَيْئًا وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ inna l-laha lā yaẓlimu l-nāsa shayan walākinna l-nāsa anfusahum yaẓlimūna Indeed, Allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves. See 10:41

item.title: Yunus:44 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ النَّاسَ شَيْئًا وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ inna l-laha lā yaẓlimu l-nāsa shayan walākinna l-nāsa anfusahum yaẓlimūna Verily, God doeth not any injustice to people, but men (of their own doing.) to their (own) selves do injustice. See 10:39

item.title: Yunus:45 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنَ النَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُهْتَدِينَ wayawma yaḥshuruhum ka-an lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan mina l-nahāri yataʿārafūna baynahum qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi wamā kānū muh'tadīna On the day He will gather them [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] except for an hour of the day getting acquainted with one another. They are certainly losers who deny the encounter with Allah, and they are not guided.

item.title: Yunus:45 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنَ النَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُهْتَدِينَ wayawma yaḥshuruhum ka-an lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan mina l-nahāri yataʿārafūna baynahum qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi wamā kānū muh'tadīna And on the Day when He will gather them, (it will be) as if they had not remained (in the world) but an hour of the day, (and) they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided. And on the Day when He shall gather them together, (it will be) as if they had not stayed (in the life of this world and graves) but an hour of a day. They will recognize each other. Ruined indeed will be those who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided…

item.title: Yunus:45 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنَ النَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُهْتَدِينَ wayawma yaḥshuruhum ka-an lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan mina l-nahāri yataʿārafūna baynahum qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi wamā kānū muh'tadīna And on the day (of resurrection) when He (God.) will gather them as though they had not tarried (Refer to verses 23:112 - 23:114.) in the world or in the grave but an hour of the day, they will recognise each other; Indeed will perish those who belied the meeting with God and were not guided aright (Refer to verse 79:45.) . Literally 'Labth', stay or halt, may refer to present life or to the intermediary state between this life and the final and the total resurrection. These verses, 23:112 - 23:114, if read together assert that man's memory of…

item.title: Yunus:46 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَى مَا يَفْعَلُونَ wa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma l-lahu shahīdun ʿalā mā yafʿalūna Whether We show you a part of what We promise them, or take you away [before that], [in any case] their return will be to Us. Then Allah will be witness to what they do.

item.title: Yunus:46 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَى مَا يَفْعَلُونَ wa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma l-lahu shahīdun ʿalā mā yafʿalūna And whether We show you some of what We promise them, (O Muḥammad), or We take you in death, to Us is their return; then, (either way), Allah is a witness concerning what they are doing. Whether We show you some of what We promise them (the torment), or We cause you to die – still unto Us is their return, and moreover Allah is Witness over what they used to do (10:46). And for every Ummah there is a Messenger; when their Messenger comes, the matter will be judged between them with justice, and they will not be wronged (10:47). The Criminals will Certainly be Avenged – Whether in…

item.title: Yunus:46 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَى مَا يَفْعَلُونَ wa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma l-lahu shahīdun ʿalā mā yafʿalūna And if We let thee behold something of (Our wrath) what We warn them against or (before that) We take thee to Ourselves, (even) then (In any case.) unto Us is their return, then God is a witness to (all) what they do (Refer to verse 40:77.) . See 10:45

item.title: Yunus:47 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walikulli ummatin rasūlun fa-idhā jāa rasūluhum quḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna There is an apostle1 for every nation; so when their apostle comes, judgement is made between them with justice, and they are not wronged.

item.title: Yunus:47 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walikulli ummatin rasūlun fa-idhā jāa rasūluhum quḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes,1 it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged. See 10:46

item.title: Yunus:47 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walikulli ummatin rasūlun fa-idhā jāa rasūluhum quḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And for every people (was sent) an apostle (Refer to notes to verses 16:1, 16:36, 5:48, 35:24. The faith in all the previous prophets and Scriptures is one of the unique distinctions of Islam.) ; and when came their apostle, the matter between them was decided with equity (The fate of every nation is determined and decided by God conditioned with their response to their respective apostles.) and they shall not (in the least) be done (any) injustice. See 10:45

item.title: Yunus:48 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna They say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: Yunus:48 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And they say, "When is (the fulfillment of) this promise, if you should be truthful?" And they say: "When will be this promise (the torment or the Day of Resurrection), if you speak the truth? (10:48). Say: "I have no power over any harm or profit for myself except what Allah may will. For every Ummah, there is a term appointed; when their term comes, neither can they delay it nor can they advance it an hour (or a moment) (10:49). Say: "Tell me, if His torment should come to you by night or by day, which portion thereof would the criminals hasten on? (10:50). Is it then that when it has actually befallen, you will believe in it? What! Now (you believe) And you used…

item.title: Yunus:48 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna And say they "When this promise (May refer to the wrath or the resurrection.) (of Our wrath) will come to pass, if ye be truthful." See 10:45

item.title: Yunus:49 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ qul lā amliku linafsī ḍarran walā nafʿan illā mā shāa l-lahu likulli ummatin ajalun idhā jāa ajaluhum falā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna Say, 'I have no control over any benefit for myself nor [over] any harm except what Allah may wish. There is a time for every nation: when their time comes, they shall not defer it by a single hour nor shall they advance it.'

item.title: Yunus:49 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ qul lā amliku linafsī ḍarran walā nafʿan illā mā shāa l-lahu likulli ummatin ajalun idhā jāa ajaluhum falā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allah should will. For every nation is a (specified) term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede (it)." See 10:48

item.title: Yunus:49 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ qul lā amliku linafsī ḍarran walā nafʿan illā mā shāa l-lahu likulli ummatin ajalun idhā jāa ajaluhum falā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna Say thou (O' Our Apostle!) "I own not for myself any harm nor any benefit save what willeth God; To every people is an appointed term; when cometh their term then shall they neither retard (even) an hour (The least time.) nor go before it (This is a warning as well to mankind, to every nation. Refer to verse 63:11.) ." See 10:45

item.title: Yunus:50 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُهُ بَيَاتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا مَاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ qul ara-aytum in atākum ʿadhābuhu bayātan aw nahāran mādhā yastaʿjilu min'hu l-muj'rimūna Say, 'Tell me, should His punishment overtake you by night or day, [you will not be able to avert it]; so what part of it do the guilty seek to hasten?'

item.title: Yunus:50 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُهُ بَيَاتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا مَاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ qul ara-aytum in atākum ʿadhābuhu bayātan aw nahāran mādhā yastaʿjilu min'hu l-muj'rimūna Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which (aspect) of it would the criminals be impatient?"1 See 10:48

item.title: Yunus:50 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُهُ بَيَاتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا مَاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ qul ara-aytum in atākum ʿadhābuhu bayātan aw nahāran mādhā yastaʿjilu min'hu l-muj'rimūna Say thou (O' Muhammad!) "Do ye see (Tell me.) if His chastisement cometh upon you by night or by day, what then is there of it that the guilty hasten for?" See 10:45

item.title: Yunus:51 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ athumma idhā mā waqaʿa āmantum bihi āl'āna waqad kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna 'What! Do you believe it when it has befallen? Now? While you would seek to hasten it [earlier]?!'

item.title: Yunus:51 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ athumma idhā mā waqaʿa āmantum bihi āl'āna waqad kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna Then is it that when it has (actually) occurred you will believe in it? Now?1 And you were (once) for it impatient.2 See 10:48

item.title: Yunus:51 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ athumma idhā mā waqaʿa āmantum bihi āl'āna waqad kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna Is it when it cometh to pass, ye will believe in it? What! now (believe ye)? when ye have been (challenging in it and) hastening it on? See 10:45

item.title: Yunus:52 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ thumma qīla lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di hal tuj'zawna illā bimā kuntum taksibūna Then it will be said to those who were wrongdoers, 'Taste the everlasting punishment. Shall you be requited except for what you used to earn?'

item.title: Yunus:52 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ thumma qīla lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di hal tuj'zawna illā bimā kuntum taksibūna Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn?" See 10:48

item.title: Yunus:52 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ thumma qīla lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di hal tuj'zawna illā bimā kuntum taksibūna Then shall it be said unto those who had been unjust: "Taste ye abiding punishment! Would ye (then) receive other than what ye have wrought?" See 10:45

item.title: Yunus:53 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
