item.description: وَيَسْتَنْبِئُونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ قُلْ إِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ wayastanbiūnaka aḥaqqun huwa qul ī warabbī innahu laḥaqqun wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna They inquire of you, 'Is it true?' Say, 'Yes! By my Lord, it is true, and you cannot thwart [Him].'

item.title: Yunus:53 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَنْبِئُونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ قُلْ إِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ wayastanbiūnaka aḥaqqun huwa qul ī warabbī innahu laḥaqqun wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna And they ask information of you, (O Muḥammad), "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure (to Allah)." And they ask you to inform them (saying): Is it true" Say: "Yes! By my Lord! It is the very truth! And you cannot escape it! (10:53). And if every person who had wronged, possessed all that is on the earth and sought to ransom himself therewith (it will not be accepted), and they would feel in their hearts regret when they see the torment, and they will be judged with justice, and no wrong will be done unto them (10:54). The Resurrection is Real Allah said that they ask…

item.title: Yunus:53 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيَسْتَنْبِئُونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ قُلْ إِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ wayastanbiūnaka aḥaqqun huwa qul ī warabbī innahu laḥaqqun wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna And they ask thee: "Is that true?" Say thou! "Aye! By my Lord! Verily, Verily, it is the truth; and ye will not escape (Will not be in a position to defy.) (His wrath)." Hai Bin Akhtab, a Madinite Jew, prior to the Emigration of the Holy Prophet from Mecca, used to visit Mecca on the business of (trade). When he heard about the Holy Prophet, he once attended the audience and hearing the recitation of the Holy Qur'an, asked the Holy Prophet, "O' Muhammad, is what thou reciteth the Truth or a mere jest?" This verse was revealed in reply to his question (M.S.). The 'EA' in Arabic goes before a swearing to denote stress upon the…

item.title: Yunus:54 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَافْتَدَتْ بِهِ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walaw anna likulli nafsin ẓalamat mā fī l-arḍi la-if'tadat bihi wa-asarrū l-nadāmata lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba waquḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna Were any soul that has done wrong to possess whatever there is on the earth, it would surely offer it for ransom. They will hide their remorse when they sight the punishment; and judgement will be made between them with justice and they will not be wronged.

item.title: Yunus:54 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَافْتَدَتْ بِهِ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walaw anna likulli nafsin ẓalamat mā fī l-arḍi la-if'tadat bihi wa-asarrū l-nadāmata lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba waquḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged. See 10:53

item.title: Yunus:54 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَافْتَدَتْ بِهِ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walaw anna likulli nafsin ẓalamat mā fī l-arḍi la-if'tadat bihi wa-asarrū l-nadāmata lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba waquḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And if every soul that hath done injustice had all that is in the earth, it would assuredly ransom itself therewith; and they will proclaim their repentance when they behold the doom, and it shall be decided between them with justice and they shall not be done (any) injustice. Meaning even if all that is in the earth be offered by the iniquitous ones, on the Day of Judgment, as a ransom for their acquittal, i.e., to escape the penalty, it shall not be accepted from them. The word 'Asarro' may mean, either declare or reveal and also…

item.title: Yunus:55 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ alā inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alā inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna Look! To Allah indeed belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Look! Allah's promise is indeed true; but most of them do not know.

item.title: Yunus:55 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ alā inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alā inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Unquestionably, the promise of Allah is truth, but most of them do not know. No doubt, surely, all that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. No doubt, surely, Allah's promise is true. But most of them know not (10:55). It is He Who gives life, and causes death, and to Him you (all) shall return.) Allah is the Owner of the heavens and earth. His promise is true and is indeed going to be fulfilled. He is the One Who gives life and causes death. To Him is the return of everyone,…

item.title: Yunus:55 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ alā inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alā inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna Be it known verily God's is what is in the heavens and the earth; Be it (also) known, Verily, God's promise is true, but most of them know not (See also verses 11:120, 39:51.) . See 10:54

item.title: Yunus:56 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna It is He who gives life and brings death, and to Him you shall be brought back.

item.title: Yunus:56 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned. See 10:55

item.title: Yunus:56 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna He giveth life and causeth to die, and unto Him (Alone) shall ye (all) return. See 10:54

item.title: Yunus:57 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāatkum mawʿiẓatun min rabbikum washifāon limā fī l-ṣudūri wahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna O mankind! There has certainly come to you an advice from your Lord, and a cure for what is in the breasts, and a guidance and mercy for the faithful.

item.title: Yunus:57 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāatkum mawʿiẓatun min rabbikum washifāon limā fī l-ṣudūri wahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers. O mankind! There has come to you good advice from your Lord, and a cure for that which is in your breasts, – a guidance and a mercy for the believers (10:57). Say: "In the bounty of Allah, and in His mercy; therein let them rejoice." That is better than what (the wealth) they amass (10:58). The Qur'an is an Admonition, Cure, Mercy and Guidance Allah confers a great favor on His creatures in what He has sent down of the Gracious Qur'an to His Noble…

item.title: Yunus:57 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāatkum mawʿiẓatun min rabbikum washifāon limā fī l-ṣudūri wahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna O' mankind! Indeed hath come unto you an exhortation from your Lord, and a cure for (the diseases) what is in your breasts and a guidance and mercy for the believers. In the place of punishment which the people have earned and which they repeatedly demanded, God has sent the Reminder, thus giving an asked for respite. It is undoubtedly the mercy of the Lord1. The physical heart has been considered as the seat of all feelings and emotions in the sense that what is felt by the cognitive self has an immediate effect on the physical heart, such as the feelings of fear and rage, shyness which effect the movement of…

item.title: Yunus:58 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ qul bifaḍli l-lahi wabiraḥmatihi fabidhālika falyafraḥū huwa khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna Say, 'In Allah's grace and His mercy— let them rejoice in that! It is better than what they amass.'

item.title: Yunus:58 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ qul bifaḍli l-lahi wabiraḥmatihi fabidhālika falyafraḥū huwa khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate." See 10:57

item.title: Yunus:58 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ qul bifaḍli l-lahi wabiraḥmatihi fabidhālika falyafraḥū huwa khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna Say! (The above blessings are the outcome of God's grace and His Mercy) (that) in the grace (The 5th Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn 'Ali al-Baqir says - By 'Fazl' is meant the Holy Prophet & by 'Rahmat' 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib - This same is the version of some Sunni Commentators (UB) (Kalbi).) of God and in His mercy, in that they should rejoice; it is better than (the wealth) that they gather. See 10:57

item.title: Yunus:59 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُمْ مِنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَالًا قُلْ ءَاللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ أَمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ qul ara-aytum mā anzala l-lahu lakum min riz'qin fajaʿaltum min'hu ḥarāman waḥalālan qul āllahu adhina lakum am ʿalā l-lahi taftarūna Say, 'Have you regarded what Allah has sent down for you of [His] provision, whereupon you made some of it unlawful and [some] lawful?' Say, 'Did Allah give you the sanction [to do so], or do you fabricate a lie against Allah?'

item.title: Yunus:59 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُمْ مِنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَالًا قُلْ ءَاللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ أَمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ qul ara-aytum mā anzala l-lahu lakum min riz'qin fajaʿaltum min'hu ḥarāman waḥalālan qul āllahu adhina lakum am ʿalā l-lahi taftarūna Say, "Have you seen what Allah has sent down to you of provision of which you have made (some) lawful and (some) unlawful?" Say, "Has Allah permitted you (to do so), or do you invent (something) about Allah?" Say: Tell me, what provision Allah has sent down to you! And you have made of it lawful and unlawful." Say: "Has Allah permitted you (to do so), or do you invent a lie against Allah (10:59). And what think those who invent a lie against Allah, on the Day of Resurrection Truly, Allah is full of bounty to mankind, but most…

item.title: Yunus:59 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُمْ مِنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَالًا قُلْ ءَاللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ أَمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ qul ara-aytum mā anzala l-lahu lakum min riz'qin fajaʿaltum min'hu ḥarāman waḥalālan qul āllahu adhina lakum am ʿalā l-lahi taftarūna Say thou! "See ye what (things) God hath sent down for you of sustenance, then ye made something of it unlawful (Refer to verse 6:146 and the subsequent verses dealing with similar subject) and (something of it) lawful." Say thou! "Hath God permitted you or ye forge a lie against God (This refers to declaring thing made lawful & unlawful against the authority of God and the Holy Prophet- Compare this to the 'Mut'as' being declared as unlawful and the other things. Refer to verses 7:32 & 7:33.) ?" See 10:57

item.title: Yunus:60 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ wamā ẓannu alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna What is the idea of those who fabricate lies against Allah [concerning their situation] on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed Allah is gracious to mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.

item.title: Yunus:60 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ wamā ẓannu alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna And what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about Allah on the Day of Resurrection?1 Indeed, Allah is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful. See 10:59

item.title: Yunus:60 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ wamā ẓannu alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna And what imagine those who forge lies against God on the Day of Resurrection? Verily, God is the Lord of grace for mankind, but most of them thank not. See 10:57

item.title: Yunus:61 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُوْۤا مِنْهُ مِنْ قُرْءَانٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْ رَبِّكَ مِنْ مِثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَا أَصْغَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā takūnu fī shanin wamā tatlū min'hu min qur'ānin walā taʿmalūna min ʿamalin illā kunnā ʿalaykum shuhūdan idh tufīḍūna fīhi wamā yaʿzubu ʿan rabbika min mith'qāli dharratin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi walā aṣghara min dhālika walā akbara illā fī kitābin mubīnin You do not engage in any work, neither do you recite any part of the Qur'ān, nor do you perform any deed without Our being witness over you when you are engaged therein. Not an atom's weight escapes your Lord in the earth or in the sky, nor [is there] anything smaller than that nor bigger,…

item.title: Yunus:61 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُوْۤا مِنْهُ مِنْ قُرْءَانٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْ رَبِّكَ مِنْ مِثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَا أَصْغَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā takūnu fī shanin wamā tatlū min'hu min qur'ānin walā taʿmalūna min ʿamalin illā kunnā ʿalaykum shuhūdan idh tufīḍūna fīhi wamā yaʿzubu ʿan rabbika min mith'qāli dharratin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi walā aṣghara min dhālika walā akbara illā fī kitābin mubīnin And, (O Muḥammad), you are not (engaged) in any matter and do not recite any of the Qur’ān and you (people) do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any (part) of an atom's weight1 within the earth or…

item.title: Yunus:61 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُوْۤا مِنْهُ مِنْ قُرْءَانٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْ رَبِّكَ مِنْ مِثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَا أَصْغَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā takūnu fī shanin wamā tatlū min'hu min qur'ānin walā taʿmalūna min ʿamalin illā kunnā ʿalaykum shuhūdan idh tufīḍūna fīhi wamā yaʿzubu ʿan rabbika min mith'qāli dharratin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi walā aṣghara min dhālika walā akbara illā fī kitābin mubīnin And thou art not (engaged) in any affair, nor dost thou recite any part of the (Holy) Qur'an and nor any deed ye (mankind) be doing, but We are witness over you when ye are engrossed (Entered into.) therein; And doth not lie concealed from thy Lord (even) the weight of an atom in the earth…

item.title: Yunus:62 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ alā inna awliyāa l-lahi lā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Look! The friends of Allah will indeed have no fear nor will they grieve.

item.title: Yunus:62 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ alā inna awliyāa l-lahi lā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Unquestionably, (for) the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve. Behold! The Awliya' of Allah, no fear shall come upon them nor shall they grieve (10:62). Those who believed, and have Taqwa (10:63). For them is good news, in the life of the present world, and in the Hereafter. No change can there be in the Words of Allah. This is indeed the supreme success (10:64). Identifying the Awliya' of Allah Allah tells us that His Awliya' (friends and allies) are those who believe and have Taqwa of Allah as He defined them. Every pious, God-fearing person is a friend of Allah, therefore: لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ no fear shall come upon them from…

item.title: Yunus:62 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ alā inna awliyāa l-lahi lā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna Be it known, verily, the friends of God, no fear shall (does not overtake them.) be on them, nor do they grieve. It is quite natural that those who have befriended themselves to the Lord will naturally get freed from every kind of fear or worry from any quarter whatsoever other than God. The first Holy Imam 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib said that those to whom this verse applies (i.e., those meant by 'Aulia Allah'') are the Holy Imams and those who faithfully follow them. The Holy Prophet of God said the friends of God are those by seeing whom, one should be automatically reminded of the Divine Attributes of God, and whose prayer fulness and godliness should infuse in…

item.title: Yunus:63 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna —Those who have faith, and are Godwary.

item.title: Yunus:63 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna Those who believed and were fearing Allah. See 10:62

item.title: Yunus:63 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna Those who believe and guarded (themselves) against evil. Regarding the promise in the next verse i.e., for those who believe and guard themselves against evil, the Holy Prophet said that the good news which the friends of God, i.e., the true believers are promised in this life are the good visions they would see in their sleep and the promise in the hereafter is that, when a believer gets into the agony of death before be breathes his last, the Holy Prophet and the Holy Imams appear to him and give him the glad tidings that whomsoever he loved in his life-time are those ready to receive him and whatever he prayed for, is there already provided for him. (M.S. and U.B. and M.F.A.).

item.title: Yunus:64 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ lahumu l-bush'rā fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati lā tabdīla likalimāti l-lahi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu For them is good news in the life of this world and in the Hereafter. (There is no altering the words of Allah.) That is the great success.

item.title: Yunus:64 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ lahumu l-bush'rā fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati lā tabdīla likalimāti l-lahi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words (i.e., decrees) of Allah. That is what is the great attainment. See 10:62

item.title: Yunus:64 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ lahumu l-bush'rā fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati lā tabdīla likalimāti l-lahi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu For them are glad tidings in the life in this world and in the hereafter; there is no changing the words of God; that is the great achievement (Refer to verses 6:34, 18:27.) . See 10:63

item.title: Yunus:65 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ walā yaḥzunka qawluhum inna l-ʿizata lillahi jamīʿan huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu Do not grieve at their remarks; indeed all might belongs to Allah; He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: Yunus:65 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ walā yaḥzunka qawluhum inna l-ʿizata lillahi jamīʿan huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor (due to power) belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing. Do not grieve over their speech, for all power and honor belong to Allah. He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower (10:65). Behold! Verily, to Allah belongs whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth. And those who worship and invoke others besides Allah, in fact they follow not the partners, they follow only a conjecture and they do nothing but lie (10:66). He it is Who has appointed for you the night that you may rest therein, and the day to make things visible (to you). Verily, in this are Ayat for a people who…

item.title: Yunus:65 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ walā yaḥzunka qawluhum inna l-ʿizata lillahi jamīʿan huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu And let not their discourse (Refer to verse 63:8. Discourse of the polytheists.) grieve thee, Verily, glory is wholly God's; He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing (God has bestowed His glory on the Holy Prophet and the believers.) . See 10:63

item.title: Yunus:66 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ alā inna lillahi man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi wamā yattabiʿu alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi shurakāa in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-in hum illā yakhruṣūna Look! To Allah indeed belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And what do they pursue who invoke partners besides Allah? They merely follow conjectures and they just make surmises.

item.title: Yunus:66 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ alā inna lillahi man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi wamā yattabiʿu alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi shurakāa in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-in hum illā yakhruṣūna Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allah do not (actually) follow (His) "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging. See 10:65

item.title: Yunus:66 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ alā inna lillahi man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi wamā yattabiʿu alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi shurakāa in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-in hum illā yakhruṣūna Be it known, Verily, God's is whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth; They (really) follow not any associates (of God), who call on others besides God; they follow not anything but (their own) gesture (baseless conjecture.) , and they only lie. See 10:63

item.title: Yunus:67 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūna It is He who made the night for you, that you may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. There are indeed signs in that for people who listen.

item.title: Yunus:67 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūna It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight.1 Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen. See 10:65

item.title: Yunus:67 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūna He it is who did make for you the night that ye might rest in it, and the sight-giving (Illuminating.) day; Verily there are signs in it for people who hearken. See 10:63

item.title: Yunus:68 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنْ عِنْدَكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بِهَذَا أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qālū ittakhadha l-lahu waladan sub'ḥānahu huwa l-ghaniyu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi in ʿindakum min sul'ṭānin bihādhā ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna They say, 'Allah has taken a son!' Immaculate is He! He is the All-sufficient. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [statement]. Do you attribute to Allah what you do not know?

item.title: Yunus:68 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنْ عِنْدَكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بِهَذَا أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qālū ittakhadha l-lahu waladan sub'ḥānahu huwa l-ghaniyu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi in ʿindakum min sul'ṭānin bihādhā ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna They1 have said, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the (one) Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority2 for this (claim). Do you say about Allah that which you do not know? They say: Allah has begotten a son." Glory is to Him! He is Rich (free of all needs). His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. No warrant have you for this. Do…

item.title: Yunus:68 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنْ عِنْدَكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بِهَذَا أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qālū ittakhadha l-lahu waladan sub'ḥānahu huwa l-ghaniyu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi in ʿindakum min sul'ṭānin bihādhā ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna Say they: God hath taken a son (unto Himself!) Glory be to Him! He is the Self-Sufficient; His (exclusively) is whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth; ye have no authority for this (What they forged.) ; What! say ye against God what ye know not? This refers to the faith of the heathens who believed the angels to be the daughters of God and the Christians believed Jesus to be the Son of God and some others believed their religious leaders to be the sons…

item.title: Yunus:69 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ qul inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūna Say, 'Indeed those who fabricate lies against Allah will not be felicitous.'

item.title: Yunus:69 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ qul inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūna Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed." See 10:68

item.title: Yunus:69 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ qul inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūna Say thou, Verily those who forge a lie against God succeed not. See 10:68

item.title: Yunus:70 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: مَتَاعٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ الْعَذَابَ الشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ matāʿun fī l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma nudhīquhumu l-ʿadhāba l-shadīda bimā kānū yakfurūna An enjoyment in this world; then to Us shall be their return, then We shall make them taste the severe punishment because of what they used to defy.

item.title: Yunus:70 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: مَتَاعٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ الْعَذَابَ الشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ matāʿun fī l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma nudhīquhumu l-ʿadhāba l-shadīda bimā kānū yakfurūna (For them is brief) enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve. See 10:68

item.title: Yunus:70 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: مَتَاعٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ الْعَذَابَ الشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ matāʿun fī l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma nudhīquhumu l-ʿadhāba l-shadīda bimā kānū yakfurūna A provision (The forging – The means of enjoyment.) (it is only) in this world, then unto Us (only) is their return, then shall We make them taste severe chastisement for what they did disbelieve. See 10:68

item.title: Yunus:71 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَقَامِي وَتَذْكِيرِي بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَعَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوا أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَاءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةً ثُمَّ اقْضُوْۤا إِلَيَّ وَلَا تُنْظِرُونِ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a nūḥin idh qāla liqawmihi yāqawmi in kāna kabura ʿalaykum maqāmī watadhkīrī biāyāti l-lahi faʿalā l-lahi tawakkaltu fa-ajmiʿū amrakum washurakāakum thumma lā yakun amrukum ʿalaykum ghummatan thumma iq'ḍū ilayya walā tunẓirūni Relate to them the account of Noah when he said to his people, 'O my people! If my stay [among you] be hard on you and [also] my reminding you of Allah's signs, [for my part] I have put my trust in Allah. So conspire together, along with your partners,1 leaving nothing vague in your plan, then carry it out against me without giving me any respite.

item.title: Yunus:71 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَقَامِي وَتَذْكِيرِي بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَعَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوا أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَاءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةً ثُمَّ اقْضُوْۤا إِلَيَّ وَلَا تُنْظِرُونِ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a nūḥin idh qāla liqawmihi yāqawmi in kāna kabura ʿalaykum maqāmī watadhkīrī biāyāti l-lahi faʿalā l-lahi tawakkaltu fa-ajmiʿū amrakum washurakāakum thumma lā yakun amrukum ʿalaykum ghummatan thumma iq'ḍū ilayya walā tunẓirūni And recite to them the news of Nuh, when he said to his people, "O my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of Allah has become burdensome upon you - then I have relied upon Allah. So resolve upon your plan and (call upon) your associates. Then let not your plan be obscure to you.1 Then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite. And recite to…

item.title: Yunus:71 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَقَامِي وَتَذْكِيرِي بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَعَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوا أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَاءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةً ثُمَّ اقْضُوْۤا إِلَيَّ وَلَا تُنْظِرُونِ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a nūḥin idh qāla liqawmihi yāqawmi in kāna kabura ʿalaykum maqāmī watadhkīrī biāyāti l-lahi faʿalā l-lahi tawakkaltu fa-ajmiʿū amrakum washurakāakum thumma lā yakun amrukum ʿalaykum ghummatan thumma iq'ḍū ilayya walā tunẓirūni And recite unto them the story of Noah (This verse, to verse 10:73 refers to the conduct of the people of Noah.) when said he to his people: "O' my people! if my stay and my reminding (you) of the signs of God be hard on you yet on God do I rely, muster therefore your designs (Intellect.) and (gather) your associates (false gods), then let not your designs be dubious (Puzzling.) , then…

item.title: Yunus:72 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ fa-in tawallaytum famā sa-altukum min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna If you turn your back [on me], I do not ask any reward from you; my reward lies only with Allah and I have been commanded to be of those who submit [to Allah].'

item.title: Yunus:72 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ fa-in tawallaytum famā sa-altukum min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna And if you turn away (from my advice) - then no payment have I asked of you. My reward is only from Allah, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims (i.e., those who submit to Allah)." See 10:71

item.title: Yunus:72 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ fa-in tawallaytum famā sa-altukum min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna But if ye turn back, (remember ye) then asked I not any recompense from you; my recompense is only (expected) from God, and I am commanded to be of those submitted unto God (Muslims) (Refer to verses 24:47, 42:23.) . See 10:68

item.title: Yunus:73 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ خَلَائِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fakadhabūhu fanajjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wajaʿalnāhum khalāifa wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna But they impugned him. So We delivered him and those who were with him in the ark and We made them the successors,1 and We drowned those who denied Our signs. So observe how was the fate of those who were warned!

item.title: Yunus:73 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ خَلَائِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fakadhabūhu fanajjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wajaʿalnāhum khalāifa wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna And they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Then see how was the end of those who were warned. See 10:71

item.title: Yunus:73 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ خَلَائِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fakadhabūhu fanajjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wajaʿalnāhum khalāifa wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna But they belied him so We delivered him and those with him in the Ark, and We made them successors and drowned those who belied Our signs; see then what was the end of the warned (people who were warned.) ones! See 10:68

item.title: Yunus:74 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رُسُلًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْۤا بِهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَذٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihi rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū bihi min qablu kadhālika naṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbi l-muʿ'tadīna Then after him We sent [other] apostles to their people. They brought them manifest proofs, but they would not believe something they had denied before. Thus do We seal the hearts of the transgressors.

item.title: Yunus:74 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رُسُلًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْۤا بِهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَذٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihi rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū bihi min qablu kadhālika naṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbi l-muʿ'tadīna Then We sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. But they were not to believe in that which they had denied before.1 Thus We seal over the hearts of the transgressors. Then after him We sent Messengers to their people. They brought them clear proofs, but they would not believe what they had already rejected beforehand. Thus We seal the hearts of the transgressors (10:74). Meaning, then after Nuh We sent Messengers to their people. They brought them clear proofs. and evidences of the truth that they came…

item.title: Yunus:74 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رُسُلًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْۤا بِهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَذٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihi rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū bihi min qablu kadhālika naṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbi l-muʿ'tadīna Then We did raise up after him apostles unto their people, so they came unto them with clear evidences (Miracles.) but they would not believe in what they had belied before; Thus do We seal up the hearts of the transgressors (Refer to verses 2:7, 7:100, 6:108, 45:23, 63:3. This indicates the similarity of hearts of their posterity with that of their ancestors.) ! It is not that the people enact the evils owing to their hearts having been already sealed but the sealing is the consequence of their continuous persistence in sinning without reflecting upon…

item.title: Yunus:75 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā wahārūna ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi biāyātinā fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīna Then, after them, We sent Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his elite with Our signs, but they acted arrogantly and they were a guilty lot.

item.title: Yunus:75 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā wahārūna ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi biāyātinā fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīna Then We sent after them Musa and Harun to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. Then after them We sent Musa and Harun to Fir'awn and his chiefs with Our Ayat. But they behaved arrogantly and were a people who were criminals (10:75). So when came to them the truth from Us, they said: This is indeed clear magic (10:76). Musa said: "Say you (this) about the truth when it has come to you Is this magic? But the magicians will never be successful (10:77). They said: "Have you come to us to turn us away from that we found our fathers…

item.title: Yunus:75 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā wahārūna ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi biāyātinā fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīna Then We did send after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our signs (miracles) but they showed arrogance and they were a guilty people (Refer to verse 73:15.) . See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:76 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا إِنَّ هَذَا لَسِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ falammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu min ʿindinā qālū inna hādhā lasiḥ'run mubīnun When the truth from Us came to them, they said, 'This is indeed plain magic!'

item.title: Yunus:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا إِنَّ هَذَا لَسِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ falammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu min ʿindinā qālū inna hādhā lasiḥ'run mubīnun So when there came to them the truth from Us, they said, "Indeed, this is obvious magic." See 10:75

item.title: Yunus:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا إِنَّ هَذَا لَسِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ falammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu min ʿindinā qālū inna hādhā lasiḥ'run mubīnun And so when the truth came unto them from Us said they: "Verily, this is clear sorcery." See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مُوسٰی أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَكُمْ أَسِحْرٌ هَذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُونَ qāla mūsā ataqūlūna lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāakum asiḥ'run hādhā walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥirūna Moses said, 'Do you say of the truth when it comes to you [that it is magic]? Is this magic? Magicians do not find salvation.'

item.title: Yunus:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مُوسٰی أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَكُمْ أَسِحْرٌ هَذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُونَ qāla mūsā ataqūlūna lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāakum asiḥ'run hādhā walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥirūna Musa said, "Do you say (thus) about the truth when it has come to you? Is this magic? But magicians will not succeed." See 10:75

item.title: Yunus:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مُوسٰی أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَكُمْ أَسِحْرٌ هَذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُونَ qāla mūsā ataqūlūna lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāakum asiḥ'run hādhā walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥirūna Said Moses: "What! say ye (this) of the truth when it hath come unto you? Is this sorcery? And sorcerers succeed not." See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ qālū aji'tanā litalfitanā ʿammā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā watakūna lakumā l-kib'riyāu fī l-arḍi wamā naḥnu lakumā bimu'minīna They said, 'Have you come to us to turn us away from what we found our fathers following, so that supremacy may be yours in the land? We will not believe in the two of you.'1

item.title: Yunus:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ qālū aji'tanā litalfitanā ʿammā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā watakūna lakumā l-kib'riyāu fī l-arḍi wamā naḥnu lakumā bimu'minīna They said, "Have you come to us to turn us away from that upon which we found our fathers and so that you two may have grandeur in the land? And we are not believers in you." See 10:75

item.title: Yunus:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ qālū aji'tanā litalfitanā ʿammā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā watakūna lakumā l-kib'riyāu fī l-arḍi wamā naḥnu lakumā bimu'minīna Said they: "Hast thou come to us to turn us away from (the faith) what we found our fathers upon, and that for ye two (Moses and Aaron.) (only) may be the greatness in the land? And in ye two we are not believers (Why we are not going to believe in you two.) ." See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ waqāla fir'ʿawnu i'tūnī bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin Pharaoh said, 'Bring me every expert magician.'

item.title: Yunus:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ waqāla fir'ʿawnu i'tūnī bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician." And Fir'awn said: "Bring me every well-versed sorcerer (10:79). And when the sorcerers came, Musa said to them: "Cast down what you want to cast! (10:80). Then when they had cast down, Musa said: "What you have brought is sorcery, Allah will surely make it of no effect. Verily, Allah does not set right the work of the evildoers (10:81). "And Allah will establish and make apparent the truth by His Words, however much the criminals may hate (it) (10:82). Between Musa and the Magicians Allah mentioned the story of the magicians and Musa in Surat Al-A'raf (there is a commentary on it in that Surah), this Surah, Surat Ta Ha, and in Surat Ash-Shu'ara'. Fir'awn, may Allah's curse…

item.title: Yunus:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ waqāla fir'ʿawnu i'tūnī bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin Said Pharaoh: "Bring unto me every sorcerer (thoroughly) skilled." See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, 'Throw down what you have to throw.'

item.title: Yunus:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna So when the magicians came, Musa said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw." See 10:79

item.title: Yunus:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna When came the sorcerers, said unto them Moses: "Cast ye down what ye have to cast." See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسٰی مَا جِئْتُمْ بِهِ السِّحْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ falammā alqaw qāla mūsā mā ji'tum bihi l-siḥ'ru inna l-laha sayub'ṭiluhu inna l-laha lā yuṣ'liḥu ʿamala l-muf'sidīna So when they threw down [their sticks and ropes], Moses said, 'What you have produced is magic. Indeed Allah will bring it to naught presently. Indeed Allah does not foster the efforts of those who cause corruption.

item.title: Yunus:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسٰی مَا جِئْتُمْ بِهِ السِّحْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ falammā alqaw qāla mūsā mā ji'tum bihi l-siḥ'ru inna l-laha sayub'ṭiluhu inna l-laha lā yuṣ'liḥu ʿamala l-muf'sidīna And when they had thrown, Musa said, "What you have brought is (only) magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters. See 10:79

item.title: Yunus:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسٰی مَا جِئْتُمْ بِهِ السِّحْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ falammā alqaw qāla mūsā mā ji'tum bihi l-siḥ'ru inna l-laha sayub'ṭiluhu inna l-laha lā yuṣ'liḥu ʿamala l-muf'sidīna So when they had cast down (their rods and cords) said Moses (unto them) "what ye have brought of sorcery (Here Moses gives the distinction between Sorcery and miracles as the former is momentary and the latter permanent. This also hints to the miraculous status of Qur'an in its ever-current guiding influence. (A.P.).) ; Verily God will presently make it naught; Verily, God causeth not to thrive the work of the mischief- makers." See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ wayuḥiqqu l-lahu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi walaw kariha l-muj'rimūna Allah will confirm the truth with His words, though the guilty should be averse.'

item.title: Yunus:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ wayuḥiqqu l-lahu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi walaw kariha l-muj'rimūna And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it." See 10:79

item.title: Yunus:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ wayuḥiqqu l-lahu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi walaw kariha l-muj'rimūna And God will prove (Establish.) the truth to be the truth by His words, though the guilty ones be averse (to it). See 10:74

item.title: Yunus:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اٰمَنَ لِمُوسٰی إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ عَلَى خَوْفٍ مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِيهِمْ أَنْ يَفْتِنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ famā āmana limūsā illā dhurriyyatun min qawmihi ʿalā khawfin min fir'ʿawna wamala-ihim an yaftinahum wa-inna fir'ʿawna laʿālin fī l-arḍi wa-innahu lamina l-mus'rifīna But none believed in Moses except some youths from among his people, for the fear of Pharaoh and his elite that he would persecute them. For Pharaoh was indeed a tyrant in the land, and indeed he was an unrestrained [despot].

item.title: Yunus:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اٰمَنَ لِمُوسٰی إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ عَلَى خَوْفٍ مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِيهِمْ أَنْ يَفْتِنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ famā āmana limūsā illā dhurriyyatun min qawmihi ʿalā khawfin min fir'ʿawna wamala-ihim an yaftinahum wa-inna fir'ʿawna laʿālin fī l-arḍi wa-innahu lamina l-mus'rifīna But no one believed Musa, except (some) offspring (i.e., youths) among his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. And indeed, Pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors. But none believed in Musa except the offspring of his people, because of the fear of Fir'awn and his chiefs, lest they should persecute them; and verily, Fir'awn was an arrogant tyrant on the earth, he was indeed one of the transgressors (10:83). Only a Few Youth from Fir'awn's People Believed in Musa Allah tells us…

item.title: Yunus:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَمَا اٰمَنَ لِمُوسٰی إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ عَلَى خَوْفٍ مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِيهِمْ أَنْ يَفْتِنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ famā āmana limūsā illā dhurriyyatun min qawmihi ʿalā khawfin min fir'ʿawna wamala-ihim an yaftinahum wa-inna fir'ʿawna laʿālin fī l-arḍi wa-innahu lamina l-mus'rifīna But believed not in Moses except the posterity of his (may refer to Moses or Pharaoh - Some or few.) people (and they were), inspite of (the) fear of Pharaoh and their chiefs, lest he should torment them; and verily, Pharaoh was lofty in the land; and verily, he was of the extravagant. The people of Moses, i.e., the Israelites. Of the Israelites only a few had believed and the others had not. Here it refers to the people, it means that only the young men believed and the old men did not and if it…

item.title: Yunus:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُسْلِمِينَ waqāla mūsā yāqawmi in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi faʿalayhi tawakkalū in kuntum mus'limīna And Moses said, 'O my people! If you have faith in Allah, put your trust in Him, if you have submitted [to Him].'

item.title: Yunus:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُسْلِمِينَ waqāla mūsā yāqawmi in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi faʿalayhi tawakkalū in kuntum mus'limīna And Musa said, "O my people, if you have believed in Allah, then rely upon Him, if you should be Muslims (i.e., submitting to Him)." And Musa said: O my people! If you have believed in Allah, then put your trust in Him if you are Muslims (10:84). They said: "In Allah we put our trust. Our Lord! Make us not a trial for the folk who are wrongdoers (10:85). "And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving folk (10:86). Musa Encouraged His People to Put Their Trust in Allah Allah told us that Musa said to the Children of Israel: يَا قَوْمِ إِن كُنتُمْ آمَنتُم بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِن كُنتُم مُّسْلِمِينَ O my people!…

item.title: Yunus:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُسْلِمِينَ waqāla mūsā yāqawmi in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi faʿalayhi tawakkalū in kuntum mus'limīna And said Moses, "O' my people! If ye (really) believe in God then on Him (alone) rely (ye) if ye be Muslims (Those who Submit themselves to God.) ." See 10:83

item.title: Yunus:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ faqālū ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna Whereat they said, 'In Allah we have put our trust.' 'Our Lord! Do not make us a [means of] test for the wrongdoing lot,

item.title: Yunus:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ faqālū ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna So they said, "Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not (objects of) trial for the wrongdoing people. See 10:84

item.title: Yunus:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَقَالُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ faqālū ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna Then said they: "On God (alone) rely! O' Our Lord! make us not (subject) to a trial ('Fitna' here stands for trial - persecution at the hands of the people of Pharaoh.) from the unjust people." See 10:83

item.title: Yunus:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ wanajjinā biraḥmatika mina l-qawmi l-kāfirīna and deliver us by Your mercy from the faithless lot.'

item.title: Yunus:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ wanajjinā biraḥmatika mina l-qawmi l-kāfirīna And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people." See 10:84

item.title: Yunus:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ wanajjinā biraḥmatika mina l-qawmi l-kāfirīna And deliver us by Thy mercy from the disbelieving people. See 10:83

item.title: Yunus:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی وَأَخِيهِ أَنْ تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَاجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā wa-akhīhi an tabawwaā liqawmikumā bimiṣ'ra buyūtan wa-ij'ʿalū buyūtakum qib'latan wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata wabashiri l-mu'minīna We revealed to Moses and his brother [saying], 'Settle your people in the city,1 and let your houses face each other,2 and maintain the prayer, and give good news to the faithful.'

item.title: Yunus:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی وَأَخِيهِ أَنْ تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَاجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā wa-akhīhi an tabawwaā liqawmikumā bimiṣ'ra buyūtan wa-ij'ʿalū buyūtakum qib'latan wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata wabashiri l-mu'minīna And We inspired to Musa and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses (facing the) qiblah1 and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers." And We revealed to Musa and his brother (saying): Provide dwellings for your people in Egypt, and make your dwellings as places for your worship, and perform the Salah, and give glad tidings to the believers (10:87). They were Commanded to Pray Inside Their Homes Allah tells us why He saved the Children of Israel from Fir'awn and his people. He tells us how he saved them. Allah commanded Musa and his brother Harun to take…

item.title: Yunus:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی وَأَخِيهِ أَنْ تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَاجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā wa-akhīhi an tabawwaā liqawmikumā bimiṣ'ra buyūtan wa-ij'ʿalū buyūtakum qib'latan wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata wabashiri l-mu'minīna And revealed We unto Moses and his brother (saying) "Take for the people of ye two houses to abide in Egypt and make ye your houses places of worship, and establish ye (regular) prayers; and give glad tidings to the believers." The Israelites after becoming the believers had constructed mosques and prayed in them. When Pharaoh heard of this, he got all these mosques demolished. It was then that God ordered the Israelites to start praying in their own houses. (U.B., M.S.) Ibn Asakir reports on the authority of 'Abu Rafe' that once the Holy Prophet explaining this verse said that when God ordered the Israelites to have…

item.title: Yunus:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَالًا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْۤا حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ waqāla mūsā rabbanā innaka ātayta fir'ʿawna wamala-ahu zīnatan wa-amwālan fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā rabbanā liyuḍillū ʿan sabīlika rabbanā iṭ'mis ʿalā amwālihim wa-ush'dud ʿalā qulūbihim falā yu'minū ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma Moses said, 'Our Lord! You have given Pharaoh and his elite glamour and wealth in the life of this world, our Lord, that they may lead [people] astray from Your way! Our Lord! Blot out their wealth and harden their hearts so that they do not believe until they sight the painful punishment.'

item.title: Yunus:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَالًا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْۤا حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ waqāla mūsā rabbanā innaka ātayta fir'ʿawna wamala-ahu zīnatan wa-amwālan fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā rabbanā liyuḍillū ʿan sabīlika rabbanā iṭ'mis ʿalā amwālihim wa-ush'dud ʿalā qulūbihim falā yu'minū ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma And Musa said, "Our Lord, indeed You have given Pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth in the worldly life, our Lord, that they may lead (men) astray from Your way. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment." And Musa said: "Our Lord! You have indeed bestowed on Fir'awn and his chiefs splendor and wealth in the life of this world, our Lord! That they may lead men…

item.title: Yunus:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ مُوسٰی رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَالًا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْۤا حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ waqāla mūsā rabbanā innaka ātayta fir'ʿawna wamala-ahu zīnatan wa-amwālan fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā rabbanā liyuḍillū ʿan sabīlika rabbanā iṭ'mis ʿalā amwālihim wa-ush'dud ʿalā qulūbihim falā yu'minū ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma And said (prayed) Moses: "O' Our Lord! Verily Thou hast given to Pharaoh and his chiefs splendour and riches in the life of this world, (is it) O' Our Lord! so that they lead (people) astray from Thy path? O' Our Lord! destroy (Compare this prayer of More to the worry of the Holy Prophet for the salvation of the people. Refer to verses 11:12, 15:97, 16:127.) thou their riches and harden their hearts so that they will believe not until they…

item.title: Yunus:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُكُمَا فَاسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَانِّ سَبِيلَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ qāla qad ujībat daʿwatukumā fa-is'taqīmā walā tattabiʿānni sabīla alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Said He, 'Your1 supplication has already been granted. So be steadfast, and do not follow the way of those who do not know.'

item.title: Yunus:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُكُمَا فَاسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَانِّ سَبِيلَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ qāla qad ujībat daʿwatukumā fa-is'taqīmā walā tattabiʿānni sabīla alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna (Allah) said, "Your supplication has been answered."1 So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know." See 10:88

item.title: Yunus:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُكُمَا فَاسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَانِّ سَبِيلَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ qāla qad ujībat daʿwatukumā fa-is'taqīmā walā tattabiʿānni sabīla alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna Said He (God.) : "Indeed is accepted the prayer of ye two (O' Moses and Aaron!) Then keep fast ye two to the right path and follow not ye two the path of those who know not (This is a warning that the path of the ignorant should not be followed.) ." See 10:88

item.title: Yunus:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُ بَغْيًا وَعَدْوًا حَتّٰی إِذَا أَدْرَكَهُ الْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الَّذِي اٰمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوْۤا إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu wajunūduhu baghyan waʿadwan ḥattā idhā adrakahu l-gharaqu qāla āmantu annahu lā ilāha illā alladhī āmanat bihi banū is'rāīla wa-anā mina l-mus'limīna We carried the Children of Israel across the sea, whereat Pharaoh and his troops pursued them out of defiance and aggression. When overtaken by drowning, he called out, 'I believe that there is no god except Him in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am one of those who submit [to Him]!'

item.title: Yunus:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُ بَغْيًا وَعَدْوًا حَتّٰی إِذَا أَدْرَكَهُ الْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الَّذِي اٰمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوْۤا إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu wajunūduhu baghyan waʿadwan ḥattā idhā adrakahu l-gharaqu qāla āmantu annahu lā ilāha illā alladhī āmanat bihi banū is'rāīla wa-anā mina l-mus'limīna And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh and his soldiers pursued them in tyranny and enmity until, when drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no deity except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims." And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Fir'awn with his hosts followed them in oppression and enmity, till when drowning overtook him, he (Fira'wn) said: I believe that none has the right…

item.title: Yunus:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُ بَغْيًا وَعَدْوًا حَتّٰی إِذَا أَدْرَكَهُ الْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الَّذِي اٰمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوْۤا إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu wajunūduhu baghyan waʿadwan ḥattā idhā adrakahu l-gharaqu qāla āmantu annahu lā ilāha illā alladhī āmanat bihi banū is'rāīla wa-anā mina l-mus'limīna And caused We the children of Israel to pass (safely) through the sea, then Pharaoh and his hosts chased them in rebellion and hostility; until when drowning overtook him, said (cried) he 'I believe that there is no God but (He) in Whom the children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims' (Those who have Submitted themselves to God.) . When Pharaoh with his huge well-armed army began to chase Moses and Aaron who were leading the Israelites out of the place (Egypt) Moses…

item.title: Yunus:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ āl'āna waqad ʿaṣayta qablu wakunta mina l-muf'sidīna [He was told,] 'What! Now? When you have been disobedient heretofore and were among the agents of corruption?!

item.title: Yunus:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ āl'āna waqad ʿaṣayta qablu wakunta mina l-muf'sidīna Now? And you had disobeyed (Him) before and were of the corrupters? See 10:90

item.title: Yunus:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ āl'āna waqad ʿaṣayta qablu wakunta mina l-muf'sidīna What (This is what God said.) ! Now! (when facing death?) when thou didst disobey before and thou wast of the mischief-makers. See 10:90

item.title: Yunus:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ اٰیَةً وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَاتِنَا لَغَافِلُونَ fal-yawma nunajjīka bibadanika litakūna liman khalfaka āyatan wa-inna kathīran mina l-nāsi ʿan āyātinā laghāfilūna So today We shall deliver your body so that you may be a sign for those who come after you.' Indeed many of the people are oblivious to Our signs.

item.title: Yunus:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ اٰیَةً وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَاتِنَا لَغَافِلُونَ fal-yawma nunajjīka bibadanika litakūna liman khalfaka āyatan wa-inna kathīran mina l-nāsi ʿan āyātinā laghāfilūna So today We will save you in body1 that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. And indeed, many among the people, of Our signs, are heedless. See 10:90

item.title: Yunus:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ اٰیَةً وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَاتِنَا لَغَافِلُونَ fal-yawma nunajjīka bibadanika litakūna liman khalfaka āyatan wa-inna kathīran mina l-nāsi ʿan āyātinā laghāfilūna But this day We shall save thee in thy body that thou mayest be after thee a sign (of Ours) unto those who come! But verily many of the people are heedless of Our signs (Refer to verse 43:56.) . Today after the passage of thousands of years, the body of Rameses II has been discovered and identified to be the body of the Pharaoh of Moses' time (Ency. Br. Art Mummy). The Bible which is supposed by Christendom as the Word of God could not give this information about the fate which Pharaoh and his host met. This discovery of the fact is another proof positive of the Holy Qur'an being…

item.title: Yunus:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ walaqad bawwanā banī is'rāīla mubawwa-a ṣid'qin warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti famā ikh'talafū ḥattā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna Certainly We settled the Children of Israel in a worthy settlement and We provided them with all the good things, and they did not differ until [after] the knowledge had come to them. Your Lord will indeed judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: Yunus:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ walaqad bawwanā banī is'rāīla mubawwa-a ṣid'qin warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti famā ikh'talafū ḥattā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna And We had certainly settled the Children of Israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. And they did not differ until (after) knowledge had come to them. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ. And indeed We settled the Children of Israel in an honorable dwelling place, and provided them with good things, and they differed not until the knowledge came to them. Verily, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection…

item.title: Yunus:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ walaqad bawwanā banī is'rāīla mubawwa-a ṣid'qin warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti famā ikh'talafū ḥattā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna And indeed We did lodge the children of Israel a true lodging and provided them with good things (for their sustenance); but they differed not until had come unto them the knowledge; verily, thy Lord will judge on the Day of Resurrection in that which they disagreed (Refer to verse 10:104.) . See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كُنْتَ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ فَسْءَلِ الَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَقَدْ جَاءَكَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ fa-in kunta fī shakkin mimmā anzalnā ilayka fasali alladhīna yaqraūna l-kitāba min qablika laqad jāaka l-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takūnanna mina l-mum'tarīna So if you are in doubt about what We have sent down to you, ask those who read the Book [revealed] before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord; so do not be among the skeptics.

item.title: Yunus:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كُنْتَ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ فَسْءَلِ الَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَقَدْ جَاءَكَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ fa-in kunta fī shakkin mimmā anzalnā ilayka fasali alladhīna yaqraūna l-kitāba min qablika laqad jāaka l-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takūnanna mina l-mum'tarīna So if you are in doubt, (O Muḥammad), about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters. So if you are in doubt concerning that which We have revealed unto you, then ask those who are reading the Book before you. Verily, the truth has come to you from your Lord. So be not of those who doubt (it) (10:94). And be not one of those who belie the Ayat…

item.title: Yunus:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَإِنْ كُنْتَ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ فَسْءَلِ الَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَقَدْ جَاءَكَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ fa-in kunta fī shakkin mimmā anzalnā ilayka fasali alladhīna yaqraūna l-kitāba min qablika laqad jāaka l-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takūnanna mina l-mum'tarīna But if thou (Address to any one of the pagans who were not acquainted with the nature and the tone of revelation. They are asked to compare with the people of the Book. In support of this Abu Talib in order to make the pagans understand the apostolic nature compares the Holy Prophet to Moses.) art in doubt about what We have sent down unto thee, ask those who read the book (sent) before thee; Indeed the truth hath come unto thee from thy Lord, so be not thou (The Prophet addressed for the people. Address…

item.title: Yunus:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walā takūnanna mina alladhīna kadhabū biāyāti l-lahi fatakūna mina l-khāsirīna And do not be of those who deny the signs of Allah, [for] then you shall be among the losers.

item.title: Yunus:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walā takūnanna mina alladhīna kadhabū biāyāti l-lahi fatakūna mina l-khāsirīna And never be of those who deny the signs of Allah and (thus) be among the losers.1 See 10:94

item.title: Yunus:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ walā takūnanna mina alladhīna kadhabū biāyāti l-lahi fatakūna mina l-khāsirīna Nor be thou of those who belied the signs of God (for) then thou shouldst (also) be of the losers. See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna alladhīna ḥaqqat ʿalayhim kalimatu rabbika lā yu'minūna Indeed those against whom your Lord's judgement has become due will not have faith,

item.title: Yunus:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna alladhīna ḥaqqat ʿalayhim kalimatu rabbika lā yu'minūna Indeed, those upon whom the word (i.e., decree) of your Lord has come into effect will not believe. See 10:94

item.title: Yunus:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ inna alladhīna ḥaqqat ʿalayhim kalimatu rabbika lā yu'minūna Verily, those against whom the word of thy Lord hath proved true will believe not. See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ جَاءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ اٰیَةٍ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ walaw jāathum kullu āyatin ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma even though every sign were to come to them, until they sight the painful punishment.

item.title: Yunus:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ جَاءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ اٰیَةٍ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ walaw jāathum kullu āyatin ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment. See 10:94

item.title: Yunus:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ جَاءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ اٰیَةٍ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ walaw jāathum kullu āyatin ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma Even if come unto them every sign, until they witness the grievous chastisement. See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ اٰمَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَا إِيمَانُهَا إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّا اٰمَنُوْا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ falawlā kānat qaryatun āmanat fanafaʿahā īmānuhā illā qawma yūnusa lammā āmanū kashafnā ʿanhum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin Why has there not been any town that might believe, so that its belief might benefit it, except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in the life of this world, and We provided for them for a while.

item.title: Yunus:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ اٰمَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَا إِيمَانُهَا إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّا اٰمَنُوْا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ falawlā kānat qaryatun āmanat fanafaʿahā īmānuhā illā qawma yūnusa lammā āmanū kashafnā ʿanhum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin Then has there not been a (single) city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Yunus? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment (i.e., provision) for a time. Was there any town (community) that believed (after seeing the punishment), and its faith (at that moment) saved it (from the punishment)?– except the people of Yunus; when they believed, We removed from them the torment of disgrace in the life of the (present) world, and permitted them to enjoy for a while (10:98). Belief…

item.title: Yunus:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
