item.description: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ اٰمَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَا إِيمَانُهَا إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّا اٰمَنُوْا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ falawlā kānat qaryatun āmanat fanafaʿahā īmānuhā illā qawma yūnusa lammā āmanū kashafnā ʿanhum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin And why then was there not a town which believed (There was no Village who believed after witnessing the painful punishment whose faith was of any avail to them save the people of Jonah.) , so its faith should have profited it but the people of Jonah? When they believed We removed from them the torment of ignominy in the life of the world and provided them (with comfort) (to enjoy it) for a fixed while (Refer to verses 6:87, 21:87, 37:139, 68:48.) . See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَءَامَنَ مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا أَفَأَنْتَ تُكْرِهُ النَّاسَ حَتّٰی يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ walaw shāa rabbuka laāmana man fī l-arḍi kulluhum jamīʿan afa-anta tuk'rihu l-nāsa ḥattā yakūnū mu'minīna And had your Lord wished, all those who are on earth would have believed. Would you then force people until they become faithful?

item.title: Yunus:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَءَامَنَ مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا أَفَأَنْتَ تُكْرِهُ النَّاسَ حَتّٰی يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ walaw shāa rabbuka laāmana man fī l-arḍi kulluhum jamīʿan afa-anta tuk'rihu l-nāsa ḥattā yakūnū mu'minīna And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, (O Muḥammad), would you compel the people in order that they become believers? And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed, all of them together. So, will you then compel mankind, until they become believers (10:99). It is not for any person to believe, except by the leave of Allah, and He will put the Rijs on those who do not reason (10:100). It is Not Part of Allah's Decree to Compel Belief Allah said: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ And had your Lord willed meaning 'O Muhammad, if it had been…

item.title: Yunus:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَءَامَنَ مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا أَفَأَنْتَ تُكْرِهُ النَّاسَ حَتّٰی يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ walaw shāa rabbuka laāmana man fī l-arḍi kulluhum jamīʿan afa-anta tuk'rihu l-nāsa ḥattā yakūnū mu'minīna And if hath willed, thy Lord verily all those who are in the earth would have believed, all of them (together); wilt thou then compel people against their will to become believers (Refer to verses 2:256, 18:6.) ? See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَيَجْعَلُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wamā kāna linafsin an tu'mina illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wayajʿalu l-rij'sa ʿalā alladhīna lā yaʿqilūna No soul may have faith except by Allah's leave, and He lays defilement on those who do not apply reason.

item.title: Yunus:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَيَجْعَلُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wamā kāna linafsin an tu'mina illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wayajʿalu l-rij'sa ʿalā alladhīna lā yaʿqilūna And it is not for a soul (i.e., anyone) to believe except by permission of Allah, and He will place defilement1 upon those who will not use reason. See 10:99

item.title: Yunus:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَيَجْعَلُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ wamā kāna linafsin an tu'mina illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wayajʿalu l-rij'sa ʿalā alladhīna lā yaʿqilūna And (While.) (although) it is not for any soul to believe except by God's permission (Allowing the deserving individuals to use their choice of faith.) ; while casteth He uncleanliness (of infidelity) on those who use not (their) sense (Not understand.) . See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ انْظُرُوْۤا مَاذَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُغْنِي الْآيَاتُ وَالنُّذُرُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ quli unẓurū mādhā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā tugh'nī l-āyātu wal-nudhuru ʿan qawmin lā yu'minūna Say, 'Observe what is in the heavens and the earth.' But neither signs nor warnings avail a people who have no faith.

item.title: Yunus:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ انْظُرُوْۤا مَاذَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُغْنِي الْآيَاتُ وَالنُّذُرُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ quli unẓurū mādhā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā tugh'nī l-āyātu wal-nudhuru ʿan qawmin lā yu'minūna Say, "Observe what is in the heavens and the earth." But of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe. Say: Behold all that is in the heavens and the earth." But neither Ayat nor warners benefit those who do not believe (10:101). Then do they wait save for the likes of the days of men who passed away before them Say: "Wait then, I am waiting with you among those who wait (10:102). Then We save Our Messengers and those who believe! Thus it is incumbent upon Us to save the believers (10:103). The Command to Reflect upon the Creation of the Heavens and the…

item.title: Yunus:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلِ انْظُرُوْۤا مَاذَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُغْنِي الْآيَاتُ وَالنُّذُرُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ quli unẓurū mādhā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā tugh'nī l-āyātu wal-nudhuru ʿan qawmin lā yu'minūna Say thou, "Observe (Behold – Consider.) ye What is in the heavens and earth; but avail not signs and warnings people who believe not." See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ قُلْ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ fahal yantaẓirūna illā mith'la ayyāmi alladhīna khalaw min qablihim qul fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna Do they await anything except the like of the days of those who passed away before them? Say, 'Then wait! I too am waiting along with you.'

item.title: Yunus:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ قُلْ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ fahal yantaẓirūna illā mith'la ayyāmi alladhīna khalaw min qablihim qul fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna So do they wait except for like (what occurred in) the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait." See 10:101

item.title: Yunus:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَهَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ قُلْ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ fahal yantaẓirūna illā mith'la ayyāmi alladhīna khalaw min qablihim qul fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna What! wait they then for (any-thing) but the like of the days of those who passed away before them? Say thou "Wait ye then; Verily I too am with you of the waiting ones." See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنْجِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ thumma nunajjī rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū kadhālika ḥaqqan ʿalaynā nunji l-mu'minīna Then We shall deliver Our apostles and those who have faith. Thus it is a must for Us to deliver the faithful.

item.title: Yunus:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنْجِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ thumma nunajjī rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū kadhālika ḥaqqan ʿalaynā nunji l-mu'minīna Then We will save Our messengers and those who have believed. Thus, it is an obligation upon Us that We save the believers.1 See 10:101

item.title: Yunus:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنْجِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ thumma nunajjī rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū kadhālika ḥaqqan ʿalaynā nunji l-mu'minīna Ultimately (when Our wrath fell) We deliver Our apostles and those who believe - even so it is binding on Us (that) We deliver the believers (Indicates the turmoil and the material conflict at last will destroy those who do not appreciate higher values of life save the apostles and the believers who are concerned with nothing but the higher values of life. (A.P.).) . See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ دِينِي فَلَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ أَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī shakkin min dīnī falā aʿbudu alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi walākin aʿbudu l-laha alladhī yatawaffākum wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mu'minīna Say, 'O people! if you are in doubt about my religion, then [know that] I do not worship those whom you worship besides Allah. Rather I worship only Allah, who causes you to die, and I have been commanded to be among the faithful,

item.title: Yunus:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ دِينِي فَلَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ أَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī shakkin min dīnī falā aʿbudu alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi walākin aʿbudu l-laha alladhī yatawaffākum wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mu'minīna Say, (O Muḥammad), "O people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then I do not worship those which you worship besides Allah; but I worship Allah, who causes your death. And I have been commanded to be of the believers. Say: O people! If you are in doubt about my religion - I will never worship those whom you worship besides Allah, rather, I will worship Allah, the One Who cause you to die. And I was commanded to be one of the believers…

item.title: Yunus:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ دِينِي فَلَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ أَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī shakkin min dīnī falā aʿbudu alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi walākin aʿbudu l-laha alladhī yatawaffākum wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mu'minīna Say: "O' people! If ye be in doubt as to my religion, then (know ye that) I worship not those whom ye worship besides God, but worship I (only) God, Who taketh you away (from this world) and commanded I am that I be of the believers." See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ wa-an aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan walā takūnanna mina l-mush'rikīna and that: "Dedicate yourself to the religion, as a ḥanīf, and never be one of the polytheists.

item.title: Yunus:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ wa-an aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan walā takūnanna mina l-mush'rikīna And (commanded), 'Direct your face (i.e., self) toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allah. See 10:104

item.title: Yunus:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ wa-an aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan walā takūnanna mina l-mush'rikīna And (I have also been commanded) saying "Set thy face towards religion uprightly and be thou not of the polytheists." See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَدْعُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ فَإِنْ فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā tadʿu min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuka walā yaḍurruka fa-in faʿalta fa-innaka idhan mina l-ẓālimīna Nor invoke besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor can do you any harm. For if you do so, then you will indeed be among the wrongdoers." '

item.title: Yunus:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَدْعُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ فَإِنْ فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā tadʿu min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuka walā yaḍurruka fa-in faʿalta fa-innaka idhan mina l-ẓālimīna And do not invoke1 besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers.'"2 See 10:104

item.title: Yunus:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَا تَدْعُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ فَإِنْ فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ walā tadʿu min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuka walā yaḍurruka fa-in faʿalta fa-innaka idhan mina l-ẓālimīna And call thou not (any one) besides God, that which neither profiteth thee nor harmeth thee; for if thou dost, then (beware!) verily if thou didst it then in that case thou wilt be of the unjust-ones. See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِنْ يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-in yamsaska l-lahu biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu illā huwa wa-in yurid'ka bikhayrin falā rādda lifaḍlihi yuṣību bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu Should Allah visit you with some distress, there is no one to remove it except Him; and should He desire any good for you, none can stand in the way of His grace: He grants it to whomever He wishes of His servants, and He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

item.title: Yunus:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِنْ يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-in yamsaska l-lahu biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu illā huwa wa-in yurid'ka bikhayrin falā rādda lifaḍlihi yuṣību bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful. See 10:104

item.title: Yunus:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِنْ يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ wa-in yamsaska l-lahu biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu illā huwa wa-in yurid'ka bikhayrin falā rādda lifaḍlihi yuṣību bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu If God should afflict thee with any harm, then none can be the remover of it but He, and if willeth He any good to thee none can be the repeller of His grace; He bringeth it unto whomsoever He willeth of His servants; and He is the Oft-Forgiving the Merciful. See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāakumu l-ḥaqu min rabbikum famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anā ʿalaykum biwakīlin Say, 'O mankind! The truth has already come to you from your Lord. Whoever is guided, is guided only for [the good of] his own soul, and whoever goes astray, goes astray only to its detriment, and it is not my business to watch over you.'

item.title: Yunus:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāakumu l-ḥaqu min rabbikum famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anā ʿalaykum biwakīlin Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for (the benefit of) his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray (in violation) against it. And I am not over you a manager." Say: O people! Now the truth has come to you from your Lord. So whoever receives guidance, he does so for the good of himself. And whoever goes astray, he does so at his own loss. And I am not set over you as a guardian (10:108). And follow what is revealed…

item.title: Yunus:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāakumu l-ḥaqu min rabbikum famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anā ʿalaykum biwakīlin Say thou: "O' ye people! Indeed hath come unto you the truth (Qur'an) from your Lord: therefore whosoever receiveth the guidance, he receiveth the guidance for (the good of) his own self; and whosoever strayeth most surely, he strayeth to the detriment of it; and I am not over you a custodian." See 10:92

item.title: Yunus:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَاصْبِرْ حَتّٰی يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka wa-iṣ'bir ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna And follow that which is revealed to you, and be patient until Allah issues [His] judgement, and He is the best of judges.

item.title: Yunus:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَاصْبِرْ حَتّٰی يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka wa-iṣ'bir ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna And follow what is revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), and be patient until Allah will judge. And He is the best of judges. See 10:108

item.title: Yunus:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَاصْبِرْ حَتّٰی يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka wa-iṣ'bir ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna And (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) follow thou what is revealed unto thee and forbear till God giveth judgment; and He is the Best of (all) judges. See 10:92

item.title: Yusuf:1 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the signs of the Manifest Book.

item.title: Yusuf:1 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni Alif, Lām, Rā.1 These are the verses of the clear Book. نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ We relate unto you the best of stories... There is a Hadith that is relevant upon mentioning this honorable Ayah, which praises the Qur'an and demonstrates that it is sufficient from needing all books besides it. Imam Ahmad recorded a narration from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that Umar bin Al-Khattab came to the Prophet SAW with a book that he took from some of the People of the Book. Umar began reading it to the Prophet SAW who became angry. He said: أَمُتَهَوِّكُونَ فِيهَا يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ؟ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَقَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِهَا بَيْضَاءَ نَقِيَّةً، لَا تَسْأَلُوهُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَيُخْبِرُوكُمْ بِحَقٍّ فَتُكَذِّبُونَهُ، أَوْ بِبَاطِلٍ فَتُصَدِّقُونَهُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَوْ أَنَّ مُوسَى كَانَ حَيًّا مَا وَسِعَهُ…

item.title: Yusuf:1 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni Alif, Lam, Ra. (A. L. R.); These are the verses of the Book (which makes the truth) manifest. Alif Lam Ra - (A. L. R.). 'Kitabun Mubin' - The Book Making the Truth Manifest. The chieftains of Arabia, just to test the Holy Prophet asked the cause of the children of Jacob (Israel) migrating from Syria to Egypt. This Sura was revealed.

item.title: Yusuf:2 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ innā anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna Indeed We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'ān so that you may apply reason.

item.title: Yusuf:2 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ innā anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān1 that you might understand. See 12:1

item.title: Yusuf:2 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ innā anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna Verily We have sent it down, the Arabic Qur'an that ye may understand. The world was lost in the darkness of ignorance particularly about God and the genuine godliness and Arabia was the darkest spot on earth, but the people of Arabia were proud of their language and particularly of the art of poetry which has been so much developed and popular among the people that they could even speak in poetry very easily. The Qur'an was revealed in the Arabic language - not because it was meant only for the people whose mother tongue was Arabic but as an ever-current challenge to the literary pride of the people to produce the like of it, if they could do it.1 The Sixth Holy Imam Jafar Ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq…

item.title: Yusuf:3 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ naḥnu naquṣṣu ʿalayka aḥsana l-qaṣaṣi bimā awḥaynā ilayka hādhā l-qur'āna wa-in kunta min qablihi lamina l-ghāfilīna We will recount to you the best of narratives1 in what We have revealed to you of this Qur'ān, and indeed prior to it you were among those who are unaware [of it].

item.title: Yusuf:3 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ naḥnu naquṣṣu ʿalayka aḥsana l-qaṣaṣi bimā awḥaynā ilayka hādhā l-qur'āna wa-in kunta min qablihi lamina l-ghāfilīna We relate to you, (O Muḥammad), the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware. See 12:1

item.title: Yusuf:3 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ naḥnu naquṣṣu ʿalayka aḥsana l-qaṣaṣi bimā awḥaynā ilayka hādhā l-qur'āna wa-in kunta min qablihi lamina l-ghāfilīna We narrate unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) the most excellent of the narratives (Stories - Explanations.) by (means of) what We have revealed unto thee this Qur'an; though thou wert before this of the unaware ones. The story of Joseph is called here as the best or the most beautiful of stories. Commentators have given a great many reasons for terming this story as 'the most beautiful narration'. The beauty of the narration consists in conveying a great amount of meaning in the shortest possible narration through the use of the most minimum of words with most eloquent hints. The story of Joseph deals with the external…

item.title: Yusuf:4 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ idh qāla yūsufu li-abīhi yāabati innī ra-aytu aḥada ʿashara kawkaban wal-shamsa wal-qamara ra-aytuhum lī sājidīna When Joseph said to his father, 'Father! I saw eleven planets,1 and the sun and the moon: I saw them prostrating themselves before me.'

item.title: Yusuf:4 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ idh qāla yūsufu li-abīhi yāabati innī ra-aytu aḥada ʿashara kawkaban wal-shamsa wal-qamara ra-aytuhum lī sājidīna (Of these stories mention) when Yusuf said to his father,1 "O my father, indeed I have seen (in a dream) eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (Remember) when Yusuf said to his father: O my father! Verily, I saw (in a dream) eleven stars and the sun and the moon - I saw them prostrating themselves to me (12:4). Yusuf's Dream Allah says, 'Mention to your people, O Muhammad, among the stories that you narrate to them, the story of Yusuf.' Prophet Yusuf mentioned his dream to his father, Prophet Ya'qub, son of Prophet Ishaq, son of Prophet Ibrahim (AS). 'Abdullah bin…

item.title: Yusuf:4 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ idh qāla yūsufu li-abīhi yāabati innī ra-aytu aḥada ʿashara kawkaban wal-shamsa wal-qamara ra-aytuhum lī sājidīna When said Joseph unto his father (Jacob): "O' my father! Verily I did see (dreamt) eleven stars and the sun and moon, I saw them (all) prostrating unto me." _Yacoob (_Jacob) had twelve sons and Joseph was the youngest and extremely beautiful. Jacob loved Joseph the most. Joseph's mother Raheel had died and his aunt who was later wedded to Jacob, had brought up Joseph. The eleven brothers of Joseph were envious of him. Joseph when he was yet of twelve years of age dreamt that the gates of heaven had become wide open, a great light had enveloped the whole environment, an ocean with huge waves rising in it…

item.title: Yusuf:5 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَى إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ qāla yābunayya lā taqṣuṣ ru'yāka ʿalā ikh'watika fayakīdū laka kaydan inna l-shayṭāna lil'insāni ʿaduwwun mubīnun He said, 'My son, do not recount your dream to your brothers, lest they should devise schemes against you. Satan is indeed man's manifest enemy.

item.title: Yusuf:5 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَى إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ qāla yābunayya lā taqṣuṣ ru'yāka ʿalā ikh'watika fayakīdū laka kaydan inna l-shayṭāna lil'insāni ʿaduwwun mubīnun He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy. He (the father) said: O my son! Relate not your vision to your brothers, lest they should arrange a plot against you. Verily, Shaytan is to man an open enemy! (12:5). Ya'qub Orders Yusuf to Hide His Vision to Avoid Shaytan's Plots Allah narrates the reply Ya'qub gave his son Yusuf when he narrated to him the vision that he saw, which indicated that his brothers would be under his authority. They would be subjugated to Yusuf's authority to such an…

item.title: Yusuf:5 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَى إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ qāla yābunayya lā taqṣuṣ ru'yāka ʿalā ikh'watika fayakīdū laka kaydan inna l-shayṭāna lil'insāni ʿaduwwun mubīnun Said he (Jacob): "O' my (dear) son! (Beware!) Relate thou not thy dream unto thy brothers, lest they plot against thee a plot; Verily Satan unto man is an open enemy!" Joseph was wonderfully beautiful and the envy of his brothers had gradually developed into definite hostility and they only waited for an opportunity even to do away with Joseph's life. When the Omnipotent Lord wills, He can manifest anything in the Universe, let man wonder at it, believe in it or not. Every apostle of God was granted a distinctive excellence, and the divine gift to Joseph was his wonderful personal beauty. It is related that once at night…

item.title: Yusuf:6 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى آلِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَا أَتَمَّهَا عَلَى أَبَوَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wakadhālika yajtabīka rabbuka wayuʿallimuka min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wayutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalayka waʿalā āli yaʿqūba kamā atammahā ʿalā abawayka min qablu ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa inna rabbaka ʿalīmun ḥakīmun That is how your Lord will choose you, and teach you the interpretation of dreams,1 and complete His blessing upon you and upon the house of Jacob, just as He completed it earlier for your fathers, Abraham and Isaac. Your Lord is indeed all-knowing, all-wise.'

item.title: Yusuf:6 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى آلِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَا أَتَمَّهَا عَلَى أَبَوَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wakadhālika yajtabīka rabbuka wayuʿallimuka min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wayutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalayka waʿalā āli yaʿqūba kamā atammahā ʿalā abawayka min qablu ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa inna rabbaka ʿalīmun ḥakīmun And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives (i.e., events or dreams) and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Ya'qub, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Ibrahim and Ishaq. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise." Thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of dreams (and other things) and perfect His favor on you and on the offspring of Ya'qub, as He perfected it on your fathers, Ibrahim and Ishaq aforetime! Verily, your Lord…

item.title: Yusuf:6 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَذٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى آلِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَا أَتَمَّهَا عَلَى أَبَوَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wakadhālika yajtabīka rabbuka wayuʿallimuka min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wayutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalayka waʿalā āli yaʿqūba kamā atammahā ʿalā abawayka min qablu ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa inna rabbaka ʿalīmun ḥakīmun And thus will thy Lord choose thee and teach thee the interpretation of sayings (dreams), and perfect His grace unto thee and unto the children of Jacob, even as He perfected it to thy (fore) fathers aforetime, Abraham, Isaac; Verily thy Lord is All-Knowing, All-Wise. See 12:5

item.title: Yusuf:7 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ laqad kāna fī yūsufa wa-ikh'watihi āyātun lilssāilīna In Joseph and his brothers there are certainly signs for the seekers.

item.title: Yusuf:7 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ laqad kāna fī yūsufa wa-ikh'watihi āyātun lilssāilīna Certainly were there in Yusuf and his brothers signs for those who ask, (such as). Verily, in Yusuf and his brethren there were Ayat for those who ask (12:7). When they said: Truly, Yusuf and his brother are dearer to our father than we, while we are 'Usbah (a group). Really, our father is in a plain error (12:8). "Kill Yusuf or cast him out to some (other) land, so that the favor of your father may be given to you alone, and after that you will be righteous folk (12:9). One from among them said: "Kill not Yusuf, but if you must do something, throw him down to the bottom of a well; he will be picked up by some caravan of travelers (12:10). There…

item.title: Yusuf:7 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ laqad kāna fī yūsufa wa-ikh'watihi āyātun lilssāilīna Indeed there are in (the accounts of) Joseph and their brothers, signs for the inquirers. See 12:5

item.title: Yusuf:8 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالُوْا لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اَبِیْنَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ idh qālū layūsufu wa-akhūhu aḥabbu ilā abīnā minnā wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun inna abānā lafī ḍalālin mubīnin When they1 said, 'Surely Joseph and his brother2 are dearer to our father than [the rest of] us, though we are a hardy group. Our father is indeed in manifest error.'

item.title: Yusuf:8 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالُوْا لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اَبِیْنَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ idh qālū layūsufu wa-akhūhu aḥabbu ilā abīnā minnā wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun inna abānā lafī ḍalālin mubīnin When they said, "Yusuf and his brother1 are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error. See 12:7

item.title: Yusuf:8 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: إِذْ قَالُوْا لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اَبِیْنَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ idh qālū layūsufu wa-akhūhu aḥabbu ilā abīnā minnā wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun inna abānā lafī ḍalālin mubīnin When said they: (Brothers of Joseph.) "Surely Joseph and his (own) brother (Bin Yamin' i.e. Benjamin - own brother of Joseph.) are dearer to our father than we, though we are (in) a (bigger) group; Verily our father is in manifest error." See 12:5

item.title: Yusuf:9 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اُقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ أَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ قَوْمًا صَالِحِينَ uq'tulū yūsufa awi iṭ'raḥūhu arḍan yakhlu lakum wajhu abīkum watakūnū min baʿdihi qawman ṣāliḥīna 'Kill Joseph or cast him away into some [distant] land, so that your father's love may be exclusively yours, and that you may become a righteous lot after that.'

item.title: Yusuf:9 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اُقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ أَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ قَوْمًا صَالِحِينَ uq'tulū yūsufa awi iṭ'raḥūhu arḍan yakhlu lakum wajhu abīkum watakūnū min baʿdihi qawman ṣāliḥīna Kill Yusuf or cast him out to (another) land; the countenance (i.e., attention) of your father will (then) be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people."1 See 12:7

item.title: Yusuf:9 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اُقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ أَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ قَوْمًا صَالِحِينَ uq'tulū yūsufa awi iṭ'raḥūhu arḍan yakhlu lakum wajhu abīkum watakūnū min baʿdihi qawman ṣāliḥīna (So) Slay ye Joseph! or cast him out to some (other) land, (so that) unto you (exclusively) be the attention of your father, and ye may be after that a righteous people. It is said that the whole story of Joseph was revealed to the Holy Prophet for more than one purpose, one of which was to inform him of what happened even among the brothers, the children of one and the same father. Thus, there could be no wonder if the people behaved or dealt with him as they did. It could be to hint to the Holy Prophet that as the brothers of Joseph conspired and acted, his people would…

item.title: Yusuf:10 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ السَّيَّارَةِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ qāla qāilun min'hum lā taqtulū yūsufa wa-alqūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi yaltaqiṭ'hu baʿḍu l-sayārati in kuntum fāʿilīna One of them said, 'Do not kill Joseph, but throw him into the recess of some well so that some caravan may pick him up, if you are to do [anything].'

item.title: Yusuf:10 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ السَّيَّارَةِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ qāla qāilun min'hum lā taqtulū yūsufa wa-alqūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi yaltaqiṭ'hu baʿḍu l-sayārati in kuntum fāʿilīna Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Yusuf but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do (something)." See 12:7

item.title: Yusuf:10 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ السَّيَّارَةِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ qāla qāilun min'hum lā taqtulū yūsufa wa-alqūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi yaltaqiṭ'hu baʿḍu l-sayārati in kuntum fāʿilīna Said a speaker (The one who suggested not to kill: According to the Old Testament - 'And Reuben said unto them Shed no blood but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him of their hands to deliver him to his father again' Gen. 37/22 According to M.S. 'Lavi' - do - UB. 'Yahooda'.) among them: "Slay ye not Joseph throw him into the bottom of the well: some wayfarers may take him up; If ye must be doing it." It is to be noted that in the mention of the events in the Bible…

item.title: Yusuf:11 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَنَّا عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَنَاصِحُونَ qālū yāabānā mā laka lā tamannā ʿalā yūsufa wa-innā lahu lanāṣiḥūna They said, 'Father! Why is it that you do not trust us with Joseph? We are indeed his well-wishers.

item.title: Yusuf:11 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَنَّا عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَنَاصِحُونَ qālū yāabānā mā laka lā tamannā ʿalā yūsufa wa-innā lahu lanāṣiḥūna They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Yusuf while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors? They said: "O our father! Why do you not trust us with Yusuf though we are indeed his well-wishers? (12:11). "Send him with us tomorrow to enjoy himself and play, and verily, we will take care of him (12:12). Yusuf's Brothers Ask for Their Father's Permission to Take Yusuf with Them When Yusuf's brothers agreed to take him and throw him down the well, taking the advice of their elder brother Rubil, they went to their father Ya'qub (AS). They said to him, Why is it that you: لَا تَأْمَنَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَنَاصِحُونَ do not…

item.title: Yusuf:11 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَنَّا عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَنَاصِحُونَ qālū yāabānā mā laka lā tamannā ʿalā yūsufa wa-innā lahu lanāṣiḥūna Said (The request was with determined plot.) they: (Brothers of Joseph.) "O' Our father! What cause is with thee that thou dost not trust us with regard to Joseph? Verily, we are his well-wishers." See 12:10

item.title: Yusuf:12 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ arsil'hu maʿanā ghadan yartaʿ wayalʿab wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna Let him go with us tomorrow so that he may eat lots of fruits and play, and we will indeed take [good] care of him.'

item.title: Yusuf:12 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ arsil'hu maʿanā ghadan yartaʿ wayalʿab wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians." See 12:11

item.title: Yusuf:12 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ arsil'hu maʿanā ghadan yartaʿ wayalʿab wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna Send him with us tomorrow that he may enjoy (Amuse.) himself and play, and verily we for him shall be the guards. See 12:10

item.title: Yusuf:13 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَنْ تَذْهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَأَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ غَافِلُونَ qāla innī layaḥzununī an tadhhabū bihi wa-akhāfu an yakulahu l-dhi'bu wa-antum ʿanhu ghāfilūna He said, 'It really upsets me that you should take him away, and I fear the wolf may eat him while you are oblivious of him.'

item.title: Yusuf:13 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَنْ تَذْهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَأَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ غَافِلُونَ qāla innī layaḥzununī an tadhhabū bihi wa-akhāfu an yakulahu l-dhi'bu wa-antum ʿanhu ghāfilūna (Ya'qub) said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware." He (Ya'qub) said: "Truly, it saddens me that you should take him away. I fear lest a wolf should devour him, while you are careless of him (12:13). They said: "If a wolf devours him, while we are 'Usbah (a group), then surely, we are the losers (12:14). Ya'qub's Answer to Their Request Allah narrates to us that His Prophet Ya'qub said to his children, in response to their request that he send Yusuf with them to the desert to tend their cattle: إِنِّي لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَن تَذْهَبُوا بِهِ…

item.title: Yusuf:13 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ اِنِّیْ لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَنْ تَذْهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَأَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ غَافِلُونَ qāla innī layaḥzununī an tadhhabū bihi wa-akhāfu an yakulahu l-dhi'bu wa-antum ʿanhu ghāfilūna Said he: (Joseph.) "Verily it saddens me that ye should take him away, and I fear lest the wolf (This is what Jacob had dreamt the night before - he relates it as his apprehension.) devour him while ye are heedless of him." See 12:10

item.title: Yusuf:14 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّا إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ qālū la-in akalahu l-dhi'bu wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun innā idhan lakhāsirūna They said, 'Should the wolf eat him while we are a hardy group, then we will indeed be losers!'

item.title: Yusuf:14 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّا إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ qālū la-in akalahu l-dhi'bu wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun innā idhan lakhāsirūna They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a (strong) clan, indeed, we would then be losers." See 12:13

item.title: Yusuf:14 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّا إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ qālū la-in akalahu l-dhi'bu wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun innā idhan lakhāsirūna Said they: (Brothers of Joseph.) "If the wolf were to devour while we are (so large a group) Verily then (In that case.) we should be losers." When the brothers of Joseph found their father unwilling to permit them to take Joseph along a with them, they went to Joseph and somehow made him go to the father and get the permission for himself. At last Jacob ordered Joseph to be given a bath and to be clad in the best of his clothes. The shirt which Abraham wore when he was thrown by Nimrod into the fire, was tied on his side (as a talisman), and provided him with all sorts of food and a supply of refreshing syrups and fresh…

item.title: Yusuf:15 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَاَجْمَعُوْۤا أَنْ يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ falammā dhahabū bihi wa-ajmaʿū an yajʿalūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi wa-awḥaynā ilayhi latunabbi-annahum bi-amrihim hādhā wahum lā yashʿurūna So when they took him away and conspired to put him into the recess of a well, We revealed to him, '[A day will come when] you will surely inform them about this affair of theirs while they are not aware [of your identity].'

item.title: Yusuf:15 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَاَجْمَعُوْۤا أَنْ يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ falammā dhahabū bihi wa-ajmaʿū an yajʿalūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi wa-awḥaynā ilayhi latunabbi-annahum bi-amrihim hādhā wahum lā yashʿurūna So when they took him (out) and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well...1 But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them (someday) about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive (your identity)." So, when they took him away, they all agreed to throw him down to the bottom of the well, and We revealed to him: Indeed, you shall (one day) inform them of this their affair, when they know (you) not (12:15). Yusuf is Thrown in a Well Allah says that when Yusuf's brothers took him from his father, after they requested him to permit that: وَأَجْمَعُوا…

item.title: Yusuf:15 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَاَجْمَعُوْۤا أَنْ يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ falammā dhahabū bihi wa-ajmaʿū an yajʿalūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi wa-awḥaynā ilayhi latunabbi-annahum bi-amrihim hādhā wahum lā yashʿurūna So when they had gone with him and agreed to put him in the bottom of the well, and We revealed (God, through the Messenger Angel Gabriel gave Joseph the glad tidings that he would one day be raised to a very high position and his brothers would come to him and they would not recognise him. Refer to verse 12:58.) unto him: (Joseph.) "Thou wilt (one day) most surely tell them of this their deed while they recognise (thee) not". See 12:14

item.title: Yusuf:16 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَآءُوْ أَبَاهُمْ عِشَاءً يَبْكُونَ wajāū abāhum ʿishāan yabkūna In the evening, they came weeping to their father.

item.title: Yusuf:16 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَآءُوْ أَبَاهُمْ عِشَاءً يَبْكُونَ wajāū abāhum ʿishāan yabkūna And they came to their father at night, weeping. And they came to their father in the early part of the night weeping (12:16). They said: "O our father! We went racing with one another, and left Yusuf by our belongings and a wolf devoured him; but you will never believe us even when we speak the truth (12:17). And they brought his shirt stained with false blood. He said: "Nay, but your own selves have made up a tale. So (for me) patience is most fitting. And it is Allah (Alone) Whose help can be sought against that (lie) which you describe (12:18). Yusuf's Brothers Try to Deceive Their Father Allah narrates to us the deceit that Yusuf's brothers resorted to, after they threw him to the bottom of the well.…

item.title: Yusuf:16 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَآءُوْ أَبَاهُمْ عِشَاءً يَبْكُونَ wajāū abāhum ʿishāan yabkūna And came they unto their father at nightfall, weeping. See 12:14

item.title: Yusuf:17 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِنْدَ مَتَاعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ لَنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَادِقِينَ qālū yāabānā innā dhahabnā nastabiqu wataraknā yūsufa ʿinda matāʿinā fa-akalahu l-dhi'bu wamā anta bimu'minin lanā walaw kunnā ṣādiqīna They said, 'Father! We had gone racing and left Joseph with our things, whereat the wolf ate him. But you will not believe us even if we spoke truly.'

item.title: Yusuf:17 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِنْدَ مَتَاعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ لَنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَادِقِينَ qālū yāabānā innā dhahabnā nastabiqu wataraknā yūsufa ʿinda matāʿinā fa-akalahu l-dhi'bu wamā anta bimu'minin lanā walaw kunnā ṣādiqīna They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Yusuf with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful." See 12:16

item.title: Yusuf:17 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِنْدَ مَتَاعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ لَنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَادِقِينَ qālū yāabānā innā dhahabnā nastabiqu wataraknā yūsufa ʿinda matāʿinā fa-akalahu l-dhi'bu wamā anta bimu'minin lanā walaw kunnā ṣādiqīna Said they: "O' Our father! Verily went we racing, and left we Joseph by our things; then devoured him the wolf, but thou wilt believe us not, even if we be truthful." See 12:14

item.title: Yusuf:18 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَآءُوْ عَلَى قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ wajāū ʿalā qamīṣihi bidamin kadhibin qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun wal-lahu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna And they produced sham blood on his shirt. He said, 'Rather your souls have made a matter seem decorous to you. Yet patience is graceful, and Allah is my resort against what you allege.'

item.title: Yusuf:18 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَآءُوْ عَلَى قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ wajāū ʿalā qamīṣihi bidamin kadhibin qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun wal-lahu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna And they brought upon his shirt false blood.1 (Ya'qub) said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allah is the one sought for help against that which you describe." See 12:16

item.title: Yusuf:18 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَآءُوْ عَلَى قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ wajāū ʿalā qamīṣihi bidamin kadhibin qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun wal-lahu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna And came they with his shirt with false blood on it. Said he (Jacob.) : "Nay, have beguiled you your (guilty) selves into something; But (my course is) comely (Refer to verse 12:83.) patience; and God is He Whose help is to be sought against what ye describe." They came to their father with the shirt. The Fifth Holy Imam Muhammad Ibn Ali Al-Baqir states that the brothers of Joseph had laid a sheep upon the shirt and slew it. The blood of the animal drenched the shirt which was brought to Jacob, seeing which, Jacob swooned and Dunya began weeping. The Sixth Holy…

item.title: Yusuf:19 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَاَدْلٰی دَلْوَهُ قَالَ يَابُشْرَى هَذَا غُلَامٌ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَاعَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ wajāat sayyāratun fa-arsalū wāridahum fa-adlā dalwahu qāla yābush'rā hādhā ghulāmun wa-asarrūhu biḍāʿatan wal-lahu ʿalīmun bimā yaʿmalūna And there came a caravan, and they sent their water-drawer, who let down his bucket. 'Good news!' he said. 'This is a young boy!' So they hid him as [a piece of] merchandise, and Allah knew best what they were doing.

item.title: Yusuf:19 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَاَدْلٰی دَلْوَهُ قَالَ يَابُشْرَى هَذَا غُلَامٌ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَاعَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ wajāat sayyāratun fa-arsalū wāridahum fa-adlā dalwahu qāla yābush'rā hādhā ghulāmun wa-asarrūhu biḍāʿatan wal-lahu ʿalīmun bimā yaʿmalūna And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, (taking him) as merchandise;1 and Allah was Knowing of what they did. And there came a caravan of travelers and they sent their water-drawer, and he let down his bucket (into the well). He said: "What good news! Here is a boy." So they hid him as merchandise (a slave). And Allah was the All-Knower of what they did (12:19). And they sold him for a Bakhs price, - for a few Dirhams. And they were of…

item.title: Yusuf:19 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَاَدْلٰی دَلْوَهُ قَالَ يَابُشْرَى هَذَا غُلَامٌ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَاعَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ wajāat sayyāratun fa-arsalū wāridahum fa-adlā dalwahu qāla yābush'rā hādhā ghulāmun wa-asarrūhu biḍāʿatan wal-lahu ʿalīmun bimā yaʿmalūna And came there a caravan (ROT. Gen: 37/28 'Then there passed by Midianite merchantmen, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of Silver, and they brought Joseph into Egypt. O.T. Gen. 37/28 See Note.) and they sent their water drawer and he let down (Into the well in which Joseph was thrown.) his bucket; Said (cried) he (The water drawer.) "O' Good news!" "This is a youth!" and they concealed him as an article of merchandise; and verily God was the Knower of what all they were doing. A caravan of merchants from Midian lost…

item.title: Yusuf:20 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ washarawhu bithamanin bakhsin darāhima maʿdūdatin wakānū fīhi mina l-zāhidīna And they sold him for a cheap price, a few dirhams, for they set small store by him.

item.title: Yusuf:20 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ washarawhu bithamanin bakhsin darāhima maʿdūdatin wakānū fīhi mina l-zāhidīna And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little. See 12:19

item.title: Yusuf:20 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ washarawhu bithamanin bakhsin darāhima maʿdūdatin wakānū fīhi mina l-zāhidīna And they (Brothers of Joseph.) sold him for a paltry (The cheap price is reported to be 18 or 20 dirhams, even that of alloyed metal.) price, for a few dirhams (According to the Bible 20 pieces of Silver. Gen. 37/28.) (silver pieces) counted out; and in him they had no interest. See 12:19

item.title: Yusuf:21 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِنْ مِصْرَ لِامْرَاَتِهٖۤ أَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَاللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ waqāla alladhī ish'tarāhu min miṣ'ra li-im'ra-atihi akrimī mathwāhu ʿasā an yanfaʿanā aw nattakhidhahu waladan wakadhālika makkannā liyūsufa fī l-arḍi walinuʿallimahu min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wal-lahu ghālibun ʿalā amrihi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna The man from Egypt who had bought him said to his wife, 'Give him an honourable place [in the household].1 Maybe he will be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.' Thus We established Joseph in the land and that We might teach him the interpretation of dreams. Allah has [full] command of His affairs, but most people do not know.

item.title: Yusuf:21 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِنْ مِصْرَ لِامْرَاَتِهٖۤ أَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَاللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ waqāla alladhī ish'tarāhu min miṣ'ra li-im'ra-atihi akrimī mathwāhu ʿasā an yanfaʿanā aw nattakhidhahu waladan wakadhālika makkannā liyūsufa fī l-arḍi walinuʿallimahu min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wal-lahu ghālibun ʿalā amrihi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna And the one from Egypt1 who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Yusuf in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events (i.e., dreams). And Allah is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. And he (the man) from Egypt who bought him, said to his wife:…

item.title: Yusuf:21 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِنْ مِصْرَ لِامْرَاَتِهٖۤ أَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَاللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ waqāla alladhī ish'tarāhu min miṣ'ra li-im'ra-atihi akrimī mathwāhu ʿasā an yanfaʿanā aw nattakhidhahu waladan wakadhālika makkannā liyūsufa fī l-arḍi walinuʿallimahu min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wal-lahu ghālibun ʿalā amrihi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna And he of Egypt who purchased him said unto his wife (Zulaikha.) "Give him an honourable place, maybe he may profit us, or we will adopt him as a son;" And thus did We establish Joseph in the land (Egypt); and that We may teach him the interpretation of events (dreams); And Verily God is Predominant over His affair, but most of mankind know not. See 12:19

item.title: Yusuf:22 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ walammā balagha ashuddahu ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wakadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna When he came of age, We gave him judgement and [sacred] knowledge, and thus do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: Yusuf:22 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ walammā balagha ashuddahu ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wakadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna And when he (i.e., Yusuf) reached maturity, We gave him judgement and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good. See 12:21

item.title: Yusuf:22 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ walammā balagha ashuddahu ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wakadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna And when he (Joseph) attained his prime (At the age of 33 made the Vizier & at 40 received the commission of apostleship from the Lord. Minhaj as-Sadiqin (Tafsir – Persian) and Umdat al-Byan (commentary by Maulvi Syed Ammar Ali).) (maturity) We gave him authority (apostle ship) and knowledge; And thus do We recompense the doers of good. "And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man, and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian." Gen. 39/2. It is related1 that Joseph was of thirty-three years when he was made the Vizier and at the age of forty he was commissioned with the apostleship of God and he lived for one hundred and twenty years.

item.title: Yusuf:23 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْأَبْوَابَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ warāwadathu allatī huwa fī baytihā ʿan nafsihi waghallaqati l-abwāba waqālat hayta laka qāla maʿādha l-lahi innahu rabbī aḥsana mathwāya innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-ẓālimūna The woman in whose house he was solicited him. She closed the doors and said, 'Come!!' He said, 'God forbid! Indeed He is my Lord; He has given me a good abode.1 Indeed the wrongdoers are not felicitous.'

item.title: Yusuf:23 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْأَبْوَابَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ warāwadathu allatī huwa fī baytihā ʿan nafsihi waghallaqati l-abwāba waqālat hayta laka qāla maʿādha l-lahi innahu rabbī aḥsana mathwāya innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-ẓālimūna And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "(I seek) the refuge of Allah. Indeed, he1 is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed." And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him (to do an evil act), and she closed the doors and said: Come on, O you." He said: "I seek refuge in Allah! Truly, he is my Rabb! He made my living in a great comfort! Verily, the wrongdoers will…

item.title: Yusuf:23 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْأَبْوَابَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ warāwadathu allatī huwa fī baytihā ʿan nafsihi waghallaqati l-abwāba waqālat hayta laka qāla maʿādha l-lahi innahu rabbī aḥsana mathwāya innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-ẓālimūna And she, ('Zulaikha' the wife of the Aziz of Egypt.) in whose house he was, sought to seduce him from his (pure) self; and she fastened the doors and said: "Now come on thou! Said he: (Joseph.) "(I seek) God's refuge!" Verily He is my Lord! He made good my abode; Verily prosper not the unjust (The wrong doers.) ones." Day by day the fire of love for Joseph in the heart of Zulaikha got inflamed, and every time she endeavoured to mislead him towards gaining her object of illegal union with him. Joseph…

item.title: Yusuf:24 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا أَنْ رَءَا بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ كَذٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ walaqad hammat bihi wahamma bihā lawlā an raā bur'hāna rabbihi kadhālika linaṣrifa ʿanhu l-sūa wal-faḥshāa innahu min ʿibādinā l-mukh'laṣīna She certainly made for him; and he would have made for her [too] had he not beheld the proof of his Lord. So it was, that We might turn away from him all evil and indecency. He was indeed one of Our dedicated servants.

item.title: Yusuf:24 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا أَنْ رَءَا بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ كَذٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ walaqad hammat bihi wahamma bihā lawlā an raā bur'hāna rabbihi kadhālika linaṣrifa ʿanhu l-sūa wal-faḥshāa innahu min ʿibādinā l-mukh'laṣīna And she certainly determined (to seduce) him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof (i.e., sign) of his Lord. And thus (it was) that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants. And indeed she did desire him, and he would have inclined to her desire, had he not seen the evidence of his Lord. Thus it was, that We might turn away from him evil and immoval sins. Surely, he was one of Our Mukhlasin servants.) This is about the thoughts that cross the mind, according to Al-Baghawi…

item.title: Yusuf:24 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا أَنْ رَءَا بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ كَذٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ walaqad hammat bihi wahamma bihā lawlā an raā bur'hāna rabbihi kadhālika linaṣrifa ʿanhu l-sūa wal-faḥshāa innahu min ʿibādinā l-mukh'laṣīna And indeed she ('Zulaikha' the wife of the Aziz of Egypt.) longed for him, and he (also) would have longed for her, had he not seen the evidence of his Lord; Thus (By showing Joseph the evidence before hand.) it was that We turn away from him evil and shameful deeds; Verily he was (one) of Our freed (Freed from temporal desires.) servants. It was Zulaikha who made violent overtures and tried the worst to entangle Joseph into the sin of fornication but Joseph who was wholly pure, innocent and infallible, abstained himself.

item.title: Yusuf:25 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِنْ دُبُرٍ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا الْبَابِ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَاءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوءًا إِلَّا أَنْ يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-is'tabaqā l-bāba waqaddat qamīṣahu min duburin wa-alfayā sayyidahā ladā l-bābi qālat mā jazāu man arāda bi-ahlika sūan illā an yus'jana aw ʿadhābun alīmun They raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and they ran into her husband at the door. She said, 'What is to be the requital of him who has evil intentions for your wife except imprisonment or a painful punishment?'

item.title: Yusuf:25 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِنْ دُبُرٍ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا الْبَابِ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَاءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوءًا إِلَّا أَنْ يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-is'tabaqā l-bāba waqaddat qamīṣahu min duburin wa-alfayā sayyidahā ladā l-bābi qālat mā jazāu man arāda bi-ahlika sūan illā an yus'jana aw ʿadhābun alīmun And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. She said, "What is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment?" So they raced with one another to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back. They both found her master (i.e. her husband) at the door. She said: What is the recompense (punishment) for him who intended an evil design against your wife, except that he…

item.title: Yusuf:25 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِنْ دُبُرٍ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا الْبَابِ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَاءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوءًا إِلَّا أَنْ يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ wa-is'tabaqā l-bāba waqaddat qamīṣahu min duburin wa-alfayā sayyidahā ladā l-bābi qālat mā jazāu man arāda bi-ahlika sūan illā an yus'jana aw ʿadhābun alīmun And raced they both to the door, and she rent his shirt from behind and they met her husband at the door. She said (cried); "What is the punishment for him who intendeth evil to thy wife save he be imprisoned or a painful torment?" A witness bearing the witness refers to the miraculous event that when Joseph pleaded that he was not guilty the Aziz asked 'What is the proof?' Joseph was inspired by God to point out to a baby of three- or six-months old belonging to one of the nearest relatives…

item.title: Yusuf:26 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla hiya rāwadatnī ʿan nafsī washahida shāhidun min ahlihā in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min qubulin faṣadaqat wahuwa mina l-kādhibīna He said, 'It was she who solicited me.' A witness of her own household testified: 'If his shirt is torn from the front, she tells the truth and he lies.

item.title: Yusuf:26 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla hiya rāwadatnī ʿan nafsī washahida shāhidun min ahlihā in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min qubulin faṣadaqat wahuwa mina l-kādhibīna (Yusuf) said, "It was she who sought to seduce me." And a witness from her family testified, "If his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars. See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:26 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ qāla hiya rāwadatnī ʿan nafsī washahida shāhidun min ahlihā in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min qubulin faṣadaqat wahuwa mina l-kādhibīna He (Joseph.) said: "She (it was who) sought to seduce me from my (pure) self" and bore witness, (Refer to note on verse 12:25.) a witness of her own household; "If his shirt be rent from the front, she speaketh the truth and he is of the liars." (a suckling babe in a cradle cried out in clear words the matter quoted in this verse and in the next.) See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:27 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ wa-in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min duburin fakadhabat wahuwa mina l-ṣādiqīna But if his shirt is torn from behind, then she lies and he tells the truth.'

item.title: Yusuf:27 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ wa-in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min duburin fakadhabat wahuwa mina l-ṣādiqīna But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful." See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:27 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَإِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ wa-in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min duburin fakadhabat wahuwa mina l-ṣādiqīna And if his shirt be rent from behind, she sayeth a lie and he (Joseph.) is of the truthful Ones. See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:28 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَءَا قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ كَيْدِكُنَّ إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ falammā raā qamīṣahu qudda min duburin qāla innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna ʿaẓīmun So when he saw that his shirt was torn from behind, he said, 'This is [a case] of you women's guile! Your guile is great indeed!

item.title: Yusuf:28 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَءَا قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ كَيْدِكُنَّ إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ falammā raā qamīṣahu qudda min duburin qāla innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna ʿaẓīmun So when he (i.e., her husband) saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "Indeed, it is of your (i.e., women's) plan. Indeed, your plan is great (i.e., vehement). See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:28 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا رَءَا قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ كَيْدِكُنَّ إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ falammā raā qamīṣahu qudda min duburin qāla innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna ʿaẓīmun So when he (Aziz.) (the husband) saw the shirt rent from behind, said he: (Aziz.) "Verily it is a guile of ye women! Verily great is your guile!" See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:29 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنْبِكِ إِنَّكِ كُنْتِ مِنَ الْخٰطِـِٕیْنَ۠ yūsufu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā wa-is'taghfirī lidhanbiki innaki kunti mina l-khāṭiīna Joseph, let this matter alone, and you, woman, plead for forgiveness for your sin, for you have indeed been erring.'

item.title: Yusuf:29 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنْبِكِ إِنَّكِ كُنْتِ مِنَ الْخٰطِـِٕیْنَ۠ yūsufu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā wa-is'taghfirī lidhanbiki innaki kunti mina l-khāṭiīna Yusuf, ignore this.1 And, (my wife), ask forgiveness for your sin. Indeed, you were of the sinful." See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:29 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنْبِكِ إِنَّكِ كُنْتِ مِنَ الْخٰطِـِٕیْنَ۠ yūsufu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā wa-is'taghfirī lidhanbiki innaki kunti mina l-khāṭiīna O' Joseph! Leave (To be silent about it - rather to keep it a secret.) thou this affair, and thou (O' my wife!) ask forgiveness for thy sin; Verily thou art of the guilty (ones). See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:30 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا إِنَّا لَنَرَاهَا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ waqāla nis'watun fī l-madīnati im'ra-atu l-ʿazīzi turāwidu fatāhā ʿan nafsihi qad shaghafahā ḥubban innā lanarāhā fī ḍalālin mubīnin Some of the townswomen said, 'The chieftain's wife has solicited her slave boy! He has captivated her love. Indeed we see her to be in manifest error.'

item.title: Yusuf:30 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا إِنَّا لَنَرَاهَا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ waqāla nis'watun fī l-madīnati im'ra-atu l-ʿazīzi turāwidu fatāhā ʿan nafsihi qad shaghafahā ḥubban innā lanarāhā fī ḍalālin mubīnin And women in the city said, "The wife of al-ʿAzeez is seeking to seduce her slave boy; he has impassioned her with love. Indeed, we see her (to be) in clear error." And women in the city said: "The wife of the 'Aziz is seeking to seduce her (slave) young man, indeed she loves him violently; verily, we see her in plain error (12:30). So when she heard of their accusation, she sent for them and prepared a banquet for them; she gave each one of them a knife, and she said (to Yusuf): "Come out before them." Then, when they saw him, they…

item.title: Yusuf:30 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا إِنَّا لَنَرَاهَا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ waqāla nis'watun fī l-madīnati im'ra-atu l-ʿazīzi turāwidu fatāhā ʿan nafsihi qad shaghafahā ḥubban innā lanarāhā fī ḍalālin mubīnin And said the women (The news somehow escaped out of the palace - and became the talk of the town - The title 'Aziz' was the title of the Chief of the Royal Staff i.e. a Vizier.) in the City: "The wife of the (great) 'Aziz' (Aziz the Official Title of the Chief Officer or the Vizier of the King of Egypt.) (the chief) seeketh to seduce her slave from his (pure) self; Verily hath he affected her deeply with love; Verily we see her in manifest error." See 12:25

item.title: Yusuf:31 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَءًا وَءَاتَتْ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًا وَقَالَتِ اخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْنَهُ أَكْبَرْنَهُ وَقَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّهِ مَا هَذَا بَشَرًا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ falammā samiʿat bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna wa-aʿtadat lahunna muttaka-an waātat kulla wāḥidatin min'hunna sikkīnan waqālati ukh'ruj ʿalayhinna falammā ra-aynahu akbarnahu waqaṭṭaʿna aydiyahunna waqul'na ḥāsha lillahi mā hādhā basharan in hādhā illā malakun karīmun When she heard of their machinations, she sent for them and arranged a repast, and gave each of them a knife, and said [to Joseph], 'Come out before them.' So when they saw him, they marveled at him and cut their hands [absent-mindedly], and they said, 'Good heavens! This is not a human being! This is but a noble angel!'

item.title: Yusuf:31 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَءًا وَءَاتَتْ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًا وَقَالَتِ اخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْنَهُ أَكْبَرْنَهُ وَقَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّهِ مَا هَذَا بَشَرًا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ falammā samiʿat bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna wa-aʿtadat lahunna muttaka-an waātat kulla wāḥidatin min'hunna sikkīnan waqālati ukh'ruj ʿalayhinna falammā ra-aynahu akbarnahu waqaṭṭaʿna aydiyahunna waqul'na ḥāsha lillahi mā hādhā basharan in hādhā illā malakun karīmun So when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said (to Yusuf), "Come out before them." And when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands1 and said, "Perfect is Allah!2 This is not a man; this is none but a noble angel." See 12:30

item.title: Yusuf:31 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَءًا وَءَاتَتْ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًا وَقَالَتِ اخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْنَهُ أَكْبَرْنَهُ وَقَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّهِ مَا هَذَا بَشَرًا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ falammā samiʿat bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna wa-aʿtadat lahunna muttaka-an waātat kulla wāḥidatin min'hunna sikkīnan waqālati ukh'ruj ʿalayhinna falammā ra-aynahu akbarnahu waqaṭṭaʿna aydiyahunna waqul'na ḥāsha lillahi mā hādhā basharan in hādhā illā malakun karīmun And when she ('Zulaikha' the wife of the 'Aziz'.) heard of their scheming (Malicious.) talk, she sent for them, and prepared for them a repast (Lit. Cushioned Couch.) and gave unto each one of them a knife and said (unto Joseph) "Come thou out unto them." So when they saw him, they did extol him; and (in their amazement) cut their hands, and said (exclaimed): "Hasha-lillah!" (Far from God is every imperfection!) This is not a…

item.title: Yusuf:32 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ فَذَلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِیْهِ وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدْتُهُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ وَلَئِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا اٰمُرُهٗ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ qālat fadhālikunna alladhī lum'tunnanī fīhi walaqad rāwadttuhu ʿan nafsihi fa-is'taʿṣama wala-in lam yafʿal mā āmuruhu layus'jananna walayakūnan mina l-ṣāghirīna She said, 'He is the one on whose account you blamed me. Certainly I did solicit him, but he was continent, and if he does not do what I bid him, surely he shall be imprisoned and be among the abased.'

item.title: Yusuf:32 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ فَذَلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِیْهِ وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدْتُهُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ وَلَئِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا اٰمُرُهٗ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ qālat fadhālikunna alladhī lum'tunnanī fīhi walaqad rāwadttuhu ʿan nafsihi fa-is'taʿṣama wala-in lam yafʿal mā āmuruhu layus'jananna walayakūnan mina l-ṣāghirīna She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased." See 12:30

item.title: Yusuf:32 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَتْ فَذَلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِیْهِ وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدْتُهُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ وَلَئِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا اٰمُرُهٗ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ qālat fadhālikunna alladhī lum'tunnanī fīhi walaqad rāwadttuhu ʿan nafsihi fa-is'taʿṣama wala-in lam yafʿal mā āmuruhu layus'jananna walayakūnan mina l-ṣāghirīna Said (Zulaikha.) she: "This is he about whom ye blamed me; and indeed I sought to seduce him from his (pure) self, but he did firmly abstain himself guiltless; and (now) if he doth not what I bid him, he shall certainly be imprisoned, and he shall certainly be of those brought low!" See 12:31

item.title: Yusuf:33 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُنْ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ qāla rabbi l-sij'nu aḥabbu ilayya mimmā yadʿūnanī ilayhi wa-illā taṣrif ʿannī kaydahunna aṣbu ilayhinna wa-akun mina l-jāhilīna He said, 'My Lord! The prison is dearer to me than to what they invite me. If You do not turn away their schemes from me, then I will incline towards them and become one of the senseless.'

item.title: Yusuf:33 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُنْ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ qāla rabbi l-sij'nu aḥabbu ilayya mimmā yadʿūnanī ilayhi wa-illā taṣrif ʿannī kaydahunna aṣbu ilayhinna wa-akun mina l-jāhilīna He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and (thus) be of the ignorant." See 12:30

item.title: Yusuf:33 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
