Then he took it out from his brother's sack. Thus did We devise for Joseph's sake. He could not have held his brother under the king's law unless Allah willed [otherwise]. We raise in rank whomever We please, and above every man of knowledge is One who knows best.1

item.title: Yusuf:76 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِنْ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ كَذٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِي دِينِ الْمَلِكِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَاتٍ مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِیْمٌ fabada-a bi-awʿiyatihim qabla wiʿāi akhīhi thumma is'takhrajahā min wiʿāi akhīhi kadhālika kid'nā liyūsufa mā kāna liyakhudha akhāhu fī dīni l-maliki illā an yashāa l-lahu narfaʿu darajātin man nashāu wafawqa kulli dhī ʿil'min ʿalīmun So he began (the search) with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Yusuf. He could not have taken his brother within the religion (i.e., law) of the king except that Allah willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one (more) knowing.1 See 12:73

item.title: Yusuf:76 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِنْ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ كَذٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِي دِينِ الْمَلِكِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَاتٍ مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِیْمٌ fabada-a bi-awʿiyatihim qabla wiʿāi akhīhi thumma is'takhrajahā min wiʿāi akhīhi kadhālika kid'nā liyūsufa mā kāna liyakhudha akhāhu fī dīni l-maliki illā an yashāa l-lahu narfaʿu darajātin man nashāu wafawqa kulli dhī ʿil'min ʿalīmun Then he (Joseph) began (the search) with their sacks before the sack of his brother, then he drew it out from his brother's sack; Thus did We plan (The word 'Kidna' indicates or means that it was the Divine plan & not of Joseph's own.) for Joseph; it was not (lawful) that he should take his brother under the king's law unless God willed it; We raise the degrees (of wisdom and knowledge) whomsoever…

item.title: Yusuf:77 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنْ يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ قَالَ أَنْتُمْ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ qālū in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu fa-asarrahā yūsufu fī nafsihi walam yub'dihā lahum qāla antum sharrun makānan wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā taṣifūna They said, 'If he has stolen [there is no wonder]; a brother of his had stolen before.' Thereupon Joseph kept the matter to himself and he did not disclose it to them. He said, 'You are in a worse state! And Allah knows best what you allege.'

item.title: Yusuf:77 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنْ يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ قَالَ أَنْتُمْ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ qālū in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu fa-asarrahā yūsufu fī nafsihi walam yub'dihā lahum qāla antum sharrun makānan wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā taṣifūna They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Yusuf kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them.1 He said, "You are worse in position, and Allah is most knowing of what you describe." They (Yusuf's brothers) said: If he steals, there was a brother of his (Yusuf) who did steal before (him). " But these things did Yusuf keep in himself, revealing not the secrets to them. He said (within himself): "You are in an evil situation, and Allah is the Best Knower…

item.title: Yusuf:77 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا إِنْ يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ قَالَ أَنْتُمْ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ qālū in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu fa-asarrahā yūsufu fī nafsihi walam yub'dihā lahum qāla antum sharrun makānan wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā taṣifūna They said: If he stealeth, indeed did steal (Refer to note on verse 12:76 their selling of Joseph to the merchants.) before, a brother (Joseph.) of his, but Joseph kept it a secret to himself, and disclosed it not unto them; he (Joseph.) said: "Ye are in an evil (This remark indicates Joseph's hatred and resentment against falsehood.) condition, and God knoweth best what ye allege." See 12:76

item.title: Yusuf:78 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabīran fakhudh aḥadanā makānahu innā narāka mina l-muḥ'sinīna They said, 'O emir! Indeed he has a father, a very old man; so take one of us in his place. Indeed we see that you are a virtuous man.'

item.title: Yusuf:78 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabīran fakhudh aḥadanā makānahu innā narāka mina l-muḥ'sinīna They said, "O ʿAzeez,1 indeed he has a father (who is) an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good." They said: "O 'Aziz! Verily, he has an old father (who will grieve for him); so take one of us in his place. Indeed we think that you are one of the doers of good (12:78). He said: "Allah forbid, that we should take anyone but him with whom we found our property. Indeed (if we did so), we should be wrongdoers (12:79). Yusuf's Brothers Offer Taking One of Them Instead of Binyamin As a Slave, Yusuf Rejects…

item.title: Yusuf:78 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabīran fakhudh aḥadanā makānahu innā narāka mina l-muḥ'sinīna Said they: "O' (The title of the Chief Officer - or the King.) Aziz! he hath a father, a very old (who loveth him very much), so take one of us in his place; Verily we see thee of the doers of good (to others)." See 12:76

item.title: Yusuf:79 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ أَنْ نَأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَنْ وَجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِنْدَهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَظَالِمُونَ qāla maʿādha l-lahi an nakhudha illā man wajadnā matāʿanā ʿindahu innā idhan laẓālimūna He said, 'God forbid that we should take anyone except him with whom we found our wares, for then we would indeed be wrongdoers.'

item.title: Yusuf:79 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ أَنْ نَأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَنْ وَجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِنْدَهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَظَالِمُونَ qāla maʿādha l-lahi an nakhudha illā man wajadnā matāʿanā ʿindahu innā idhan laẓālimūna He said, "(I seek) the refuge of Allah (to prevent) that we take except him with whom we found our possession. Indeed, we would then be unjust." See 12:78

item.title: Yusuf:79 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ أَنْ نَأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَنْ وَجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِنْدَهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَظَالِمُونَ qāla maʿādha l-lahi an nakhudha illā man wajadnā matāʿanā ʿindahu innā idhan laẓālimūna Said he "God protect us! (from acting a forbidden deed) that we should seize (any one) other than him (By taking an unwanted person.) with whom found we our property, for verily then we would be of the unjust ones." See 12:76

item.title: Yusuf:80 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْئَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوْۤا نَجِيًّا قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَوْثِقًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطْتُمْ فِي يُوسُفَ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ الْأَرْضَ حَتّٰی يَأْذَنَ لِي أَبِي أَوْ يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ لِي وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ falammā is'tayasū min'hu khalaṣū najiyyan qāla kabīruhum alam taʿlamū anna abākum qad akhadha ʿalaykum mawthiqan mina l-lahi wamin qablu mā farraṭtum fī yūsufa falan abraḥa l-arḍa ḥattā yadhana lī abī aw yaḥkuma l-lahu lī wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna When they had despaired of [moving] him, they withdrew to confer privately. The eldest of them said, 'Don't you know that your father has taken a [solemn] pledge from you by Allah, and earlier you have neglected your duty in regard to Joseph? So I will never leave this land until my father permits me, or Allah passes a judgement for me, and He is the…

item.title: Yusuf:80 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْئَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوْۤا نَجِيًّا قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَوْثِقًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطْتُمْ فِي يُوسُفَ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ الْأَرْضَ حَتّٰی يَأْذَنَ لِي أَبِي أَوْ يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ لِي وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ falammā is'tayasū min'hu khalaṣū najiyyan qāla kabīruhum alam taʿlamū anna abākum qad akhadha ʿalaykum mawthiqan mina l-lahi wamin qablu mā farraṭtum fī yūsufa falan abraḥa l-arḍa ḥattā yadhana lī abī aw yaḥkuma l-lahu lī wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna So when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. The eldest of them said, "Do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by Allah and (that) before you failed in (your duty to) Yusuf? So I will never leave (this) land until my father permits me or Allah decides for me,1 and He is the best of…

item.title: Yusuf:80 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْئَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوْۤا نَجِيًّا قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَوْثِقًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطْتُمْ فِي يُوسُفَ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ الْأَرْضَ حَتّٰی يَأْذَنَ لِي أَبِي أَوْ يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ لِي وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ falammā is'tayasū min'hu khalaṣū najiyyan qāla kabīruhum alam taʿlamū anna abākum qad akhadha ʿalaykum mawthiqan mina l-lahi wamin qablu mā farraṭtum fī yūsufa falan abraḥa l-arḍa ḥattā yadhana lī abī aw yaḥkuma l-lahu lī wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna And when they despaired of (moving) him, they retired whispering (to each other); Said the eldest of them: "Know ye not how your father took from you a (firm) covenant in God's name, (and) how failed ye about Joseph aforetime? So never will I leave this land until my father permitteth me or decideth God for me; And He is the Best of judges." See 12:76

item.title: Yusuf:81 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِرْجِعُوْۤا إِلَى أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوْۤا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَا إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَافِظِينَ ir'jiʿū ilā abīkum faqūlū yāabānā inna ib'naka saraqa wamā shahid'nā illā bimā ʿalim'nā wamā kunnā lil'ghaybi ḥāfiẓīna Go back to your father, and say, "Father! Your son has indeed committed theft, and we testified only to what we knew,1 and we could not have forestalled the unseen.

item.title: Yusuf:81 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِرْجِعُوْۤا إِلَى أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوْۤا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَا إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَافِظِينَ ir'jiʿū ilā abīkum faqūlū yāabānā inna ib'naka saraqa wamā shahid'nā illā bimā ʿalim'nā wamā kunnā lil'ghaybi ḥāfiẓīna Return to your father and say, 'O our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not witnesses of the unseen.1 See 12:80

item.title: Yusuf:81 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِرْجِعُوْۤا إِلَى أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوْۤا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَا إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَافِظِينَ ir'jiʿū ilā abīkum faqūlū yāabānā inna ib'naka saraqa wamā shahid'nā illā bimā ʿalim'nā wamā kunnā lil'ghaybi ḥāfiẓīna Return ye unto your father (Jacob.) and say ye: "O' our father! Verily thy son committed theft; we bear not witness but to what we have known and we could not guard against the unseen." See 12:76

item.title: Yusuf:82 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا وَالْعِيرَ الَّتِي أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ wasali l-qaryata allatī kunnā fīhā wal-ʿīra allatī aqbalnā fīhā wa-innā laṣādiqūna Ask [the people of] the town we were in, and the caravan with which we came. We indeed speak the truth." '

item.title: Yusuf:82 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا وَالْعِيرَ الَّتِي أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ wasali l-qaryata allatī kunnā fīhā wal-ʿīra allatī aqbalnā fīhā wa-innā laṣādiqūna And ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful.'" See 12:80

item.title: Yusuf:82 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَسْءَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا وَالْعِيرَ الَّتِي أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ wasali l-qaryata allatī kunnā fīhā wal-ʿīra allatī aqbalnā fīhā wa-innā laṣādiqūna And inquire thou (i.e., Jacob.) in the township in which we were and the caravan which we proceeded with; And verily we are truthful. See 12:76

item.title: Yusuf:83 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ عَسٰۤی اللَّهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun ʿasā l-lahu an yatiyanī bihim jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu He1 said, 'Rather your souls have made a matter seem decorous to you. Yet patience is graceful. Maybe Allah will bring them all [back] to me. Indeed He is the All-knowing, the All-wise.'

item.title: Yusuf:83 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ عَسٰۤی اللَّهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun ʿasā l-lahu an yatiyanī bihim jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu (Ya'qub) said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allah will bring them to me all together. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise." He (Ya'qub) said: Nay, but your own selves have beguiled you into something. So patience is most fitting (for me). May be Allah will bring them (back) all to me. Truly, He! Only He is All-Knowing, All-Wise (12:83). And he turned away from them and said: "Alas, my grief for Yusuf!" And he lost his sight because of the sorrow that he was suppressing (12:84). They said: "By Allah! You…

item.title: Yusuf:83 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ عَسٰۤی اللَّهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun ʿasā l-lahu an yatiyanī bihim jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu Said he (Jacob.) "Nay, your self have contrived the story (suitable) for you; so (my course) is comely patience; maybe God bringeth them unto me all together; Verily He is the All-Knowing, The All-Wise." (a) In verse 12:18 Jacob was justified in accusing his sons of scheming for they had actually forged the story but the justification here is because they were responsible for the misinterpretation of the law1 when they declared that from whose bag the missing article comes out, he must be punished. The law was against the one who was proved to be a thief, and the theft was not proved…

item.title: Yusuf:84 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاأَسَفَى عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ watawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāasafā ʿalā yūsufa wa-ib'yaḍḍat ʿaynāhu mina l-ḥuz'ni fahuwa kaẓīmun And he turned away from them and said, 'Alas for Joseph!' His eyes had turned white with grief, and he choked with suppressed agony.

item.title: Yusuf:84 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاأَسَفَى عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ watawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāasafā ʿalā yūsufa wa-ib'yaḍḍat ʿaynāhu mina l-ḥuz'ni fahuwa kaẓīmun And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Yusuf," and his eyes became white1 from grief, for he was (of that) a suppressor.2 See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:84 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاأَسَفَى عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ watawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāasafā ʿalā yūsufa wa-ib'yaḍḍat ʿaynāhu mina l-ḥuz'ni fahuwa kaẓīmun And he turned away from them, and said: "Alas! my grief for Joseph!" and his eyes were whitened (Lost his sight - could not see.) with the grief, and he was a represser (One who controls himself in sorrow and anger.) (of grief). See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:85 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتّٰی تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ qālū tal-lahi tafta-u tadhkuru yūsufa ḥattā takūna ḥaraḍan aw takūna mina l-hālikīna They said, 'By Allah! You will go on remembering Joseph until you wreck your health or perish.'

item.title: Yusuf:85 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتّٰی تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ qālū tal-lahi tafta-u tadhkuru yūsufa ḥattā takūna ḥaraḍan aw takūna mina l-hālikīna They said, "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Yusuf until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish." See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:85 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتّٰی تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ qālū tal-lahi tafta-u tadhkuru yūsufa ḥattā takūna ḥaraḍan aw takūna mina l-hālikīna Said they: "By God! Thou wilt not cease to remember Joseph until thou art (seriously) ill or (until) thou art of the perished ones (dead)." See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:86 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَشْكُوْۤا بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qāla innamā ashkū bathī waḥuz'nī ilā l-lahi wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna He said, 'I complain of my anguish and grief only to Allah. I know from Allah what you do not know.'

item.title: Yusuf:86 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَشْكُوْۤا بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qāla innamā ashkū bathī waḥuz'nī ilā l-lahi wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know. See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:86 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَشْكُوْۤا بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ qāla innamā ashkū bathī waḥuz'nī ilā l-lahi wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna He said: "I only complain of my distress and grief unto God, and I know from God what ye know not." See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:87 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوْۤا فَتَحَسَّسُوا مِنْ يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَايْءَسُوْۤا مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يَايْءَسُ مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ yābaniyya idh'habū fataḥassasū min yūsufa wa-akhīhi walā tāy'asū min rawḥi l-lahi innahu lā yāy'asu min rawḥi l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-kāfirūna 'Go, my sons, and look for Joseph and his brother, and do not despair of Allah's mercy. Indeed no one despairs of Allah's mercy except the faithless lot.'

item.title: Yusuf:87 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوْۤا فَتَحَسَّسُوا مِنْ يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَايْءَسُوْۤا مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يَايْءَسُ مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ yābaniyya idh'habū fataḥassasū min yūsufa wa-akhīhi walā tāy'asū min rawḥi l-lahi innahu lā yāy'asu min rawḥi l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-kāfirūna O my sons, go and find out about Yusuf and his brother and despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people." "O my sons! Go you and inquire about Yusuf and his brother, and never give up hope of Allah's mercy. Certainly no one despairs of Allah's mercy, except the people who disbelieve (12:87). Then, when they entered unto him, they said: "O 'Aziz! A hard time has hit us and our family, and we have brought but poor capital, so pay us full measure and be charitable to us.…

item.title: Yusuf:87 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: يَابَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوْۤا فَتَحَسَّسُوا مِنْ يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَايْءَسُوْۤا مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يَايْءَسُ مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ yābaniyya idh'habū fataḥassasū min yūsufa wa-akhīhi walā tāy'asū min rawḥi l-lahi innahu lā yāy'asu min rawḥi l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-kāfirūna O' my sons! go ye and inquire about Joseph and his (Ben-Yamin (Benjamin).) Brother, and despair not of God's mercy; Verily despaireth (Despair against God's mercy is counted as a major sin.) not of God's mercy but the disbelieving people. See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:88 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ falammā dakhalū ʿalayhi qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu massanā wa-ahlanā l-ḍuru waji'nā bibiḍāʿatin muz'jātin fa-awfi lanā l-kayla wataṣaddaq ʿalaynā inna l-laha yajzī l-mutaṣadiqīna Then, when they entered into his presence, they said, 'O emir! Distress has befallen our family, and us, and we have brought [just] a meager sum. Yet grant us the full measure, and be charitable to us! Indeed Allah rewards the charitable.'

item.title: Yusuf:88 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ falammā dakhalū ʿalayhi qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu massanā wa-ahlanā l-ḍuru waji'nā bibiḍāʿatin muz'jātin fa-awfi lanā l-kayla wataṣaddaq ʿalaynā inna l-laha yajzī l-mutaṣadiqīna So when they entered upon him (i.e., Yusuf), they said, "O ʿAzeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allah rewards the charitable." See 12:87

item.title: Yusuf:88 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ falammā dakhalū ʿalayhi qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu massanā wa-ahlanā l-ḍuru waji'nā bibiḍāʿatin muz'jātin fa-awfi lanā l-kayla wataṣaddaq ʿalaynā inna l-laha yajzī l-mutaṣadiqīna So when they (Brothers of Joseph.) came in unto him (Joseph.) said they: "O' Aziz! distress hath touched us and our family; and we have (now) come (but) with scanty capital: so give us full measure and bestow thou charity on us; Verily God rewardeth the charitable ones." See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:89 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُمْ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنْتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ qāla hal ʿalim'tum mā faʿaltum biyūsufa wa-akhīhi idh antum jāhilūna He said, 'Have you realized what you did to Joseph and his brother, when you were senseless?'

item.title: Yusuf:89 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُمْ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنْتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ qāla hal ʿalim'tum mā faʿaltum biyūsufa wa-akhīhi idh antum jāhilūna He said, "Do you know what you did with Yusuf and his brother when you were ignorant?" He said: "Do you know what you did with Yusuf and his brother, when you were ignorant? (12:89). They said: "Are you indeed Yusuf?" He said: "I am Yusuf, and this is my brother. Allah has indeed been gracious to us. He who has Taqwa, and is patient, then surely, Allah makes not the reward of the gooddoers to be lost (12:90). They said: "By Allah! Indeed Allah has preferred you above us, and we certainly have been sinners (12:91). He said: "No reproach on you this day; may Allah forgive you, and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy…

item.title: Yusuf:89 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُمْ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنْتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ qāla hal ʿalim'tum mā faʿaltum biyūsufa wa-akhīhi idh antum jāhilūna Said he (Joseph.) : "Know ye what ye did unto Joseph and his brother when ye were ignorant (of the consequences)." See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:90 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ يُوسُفُ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَذَا أَخِي قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ qālū a-innaka la-anta yūsufu qāla anā yūsufu wahādhā akhī qad manna l-lahu ʿalaynā innahu man yattaqi wayaṣbir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna They said, 'Are you really Joseph?!' He said, 'I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Certainly Allah has shown us favour. Indeed if one is Godwary and patient Allah does not waste the reward of the virtuous.'

item.title: Yusuf:90 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ يُوسُفُ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَذَا أَخِي قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ qālū a-innaka la-anta yūsufu qāla anā yūsufu wahādhā akhī qad manna l-lahu ʿalaynā innahu man yattaqi wayaṣbir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna They said, "Are you indeed Yusuf?" He said, "I am Yusuf, and this is my brother. Allah has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good." See 12:89

item.title: Yusuf:90 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ يُوسُفُ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَذَا أَخِي قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ qālū a-innaka la-anta yūsufu qāla anā yūsufu wahādhā akhī qad manna l-lahu ʿalaynā innahu man yattaqi wayaṣbir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna They said: "Art thou indeed Joseph?" Said he: "I am Joseph and this is my (Ben-Yamin (Benjamin).) Brother; Indeed God hath been gracious unto us; Verily he who practiceth piety and is patient (is always rewarded) for verily God wasteth not the reward of the doers of good." See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:91 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَخَاطِءِينَ qālū tal-lahi laqad ātharaka l-lahu ʿalaynā wa-in kunnā lakhāṭiīna They said, 'By Allah, Allah has certainly preferred you over us, and we have indeed been erring.'

item.title: Yusuf:91 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَخَاطِءِينَ qālū tal-lahi laqad ātharaka l-lahu ʿalaynā wa-in kunnā lakhāṭiīna They said, "By Allah, certainly has Allah preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners." See 12:89

item.title: Yusuf:91 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَخَاطِءِينَ qālū tal-lahi laqad ātharaka l-lahu ʿalaynā wa-in kunnā lakhāṭiīna Said they: "By God! indeed hath God chosen thee over us, and we were certainly guilty." See 12:83

item.title: Yusuf:92 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ qāla lā tathrība ʿalaykumu l-yawma yaghfiru l-lahu lakum wahuwa arḥamu l-rāḥimīna He said, 'There shall be no reproach on you today. Allah will forgive you, and He is the most merciful of the merciful.

item.title: Yusuf:92 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ qāla lā tathrība ʿalaykumu l-yawma yaghfiru l-lahu lakum wahuwa arḥamu l-rāḥimīna He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allah forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful. See 12:89

item.title: Yusuf:92 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ qāla lā tathrība ʿalaykumu l-yawma yaghfiru l-lahu lakum wahuwa arḥamu l-rāḥimīna He said: (This same declaration was that which the Holy Prophet Muhammad had issued on his capture of the Holy City Mecca, for all his enemies.) "(There shall be) no reproof against you (from) this day; God may forgive you, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful (ones)." The events of Joseph's story fully agree with those of the Holy Prophet's life and those of the Holy Ahl al-Bayt. When the Holy Prophet captured Mecca, he declared the same kind of amnesty in the same words to all the heathens of the town who had been the bloodthirsty enemies of his own and that of his faithful followers, the early converts to Islam.

item.title: Yusuf:93 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: اِذْهَبُوْۤا بِقَمِيصِي هَذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَى وَجْهِ أَبِي يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِي بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ idh'habū biqamīṣī hādhā fa-alqūhu ʿalā wajhi abī yati baṣīran watūnī bi-ahlikum ajmaʿīna Take this shirt of mine, and cast it upon my father's face; he will regain his sight, and bring me all your folks.'

item.title: Yusuf:93 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: اِذْهَبُوْۤا بِقَمِيصِي هَذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَى وَجْهِ أَبِي يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِي بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ idh'habū biqamīṣī hādhā fa-alqūhu ʿalā wajhi abī yati baṣīran watūnī bi-ahlikum ajmaʿīna Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together." Go with this shirt of mine, and cast it over the face of my father, his vision will return, and bring to me all your family (12:93). And when the caravan departed, their father said: "I do indeed sense the smell of Yusuf, if only you think me not senile) (12:94). They said: "By Allah! Certainly, you are in your old Dalal (error) (12:95). Ya'qub Finds the Scent of Yusuf in his Shirt! Yusuf said, 'Take this shirt of mine: فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ أَبِي يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا and cast it over the face…

item.title: Yusuf:93 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: اِذْهَبُوْۤا بِقَمِيصِي هَذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَى وَجْهِ أَبِي يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِي بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ idh'habū biqamīṣī hādhā fa-alqūhu ʿalā wajhi abī yati baṣīran watūnī bi-ahlikum ajmaʿīna Take ye this my shirt and cast it on the face of my father, he shall become seeing (recover his sight); and come ye unto me with all your family. There is sufficient evidence to the fact that Jacob knew that Joseph was alive and safe and one day they would meet him and yet the extent to which he felt the separation is given in this story. What would have been the feeling and grief of the Fourth Holy Imam Ali Ibn al-Husayn Zayn al 'Abidin who had lost not one but eighteen Josephs of his family who were massacred before his eyes at Karbala whom he would never meet in this world. The Holy…

item.title: Yusuf:94 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ اِنِّیْ لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ لَوْلَا أَنْ تُفَنِّدُونِ walammā faṣalati l-ʿīru qāla abūhum innī la-ajidu rīḥa yūsufa lawlā an tufannidūni As the caravan set off, their father said, 'I sense the scent of Joseph, if you will not consider me a dotard.'

item.title: Yusuf:94 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ اِنِّیْ لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ لَوْلَا أَنْ تُفَنِّدُونِ walammā faṣalati l-ʿīru qāla abūhum innī la-ajidu rīḥa yūsufa lawlā an tufannidūni And when the caravan departed (from Egypt), their father said,1 "Indeed, I find the smell of Yusuf (and would say that he was alive) if you did not think me weakened in mind." See 12:93

item.title: Yusuf:94 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ اِنِّیْ لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ لَوْلَا أَنْ تُفَنِّدُونِ walammā faṣalati l-ʿīru qāla abūhum innī la-ajidu rīḥa yūsufa lawlā an tufannidūni And when the caravan (with Yousuf's shirt) had left (Literally, departed.) (Egypt), their father (there in his place) said: "I feel the smell of Joseph, if ye think not that I dote." See 12:93

item.title: Yusuf:95 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِیْ ضَلَالِكَ الْقَدِيمِ qālū tal-lahi innaka lafī ḍalālika l-qadīmi They said, 'By God, you persist in your inveterate error.'

item.title: Yusuf:95 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِیْ ضَلَالِكَ الْقَدِيمِ qālū tal-lahi innaka lafī ḍalālika l-qadīmi They said, "By Allah, indeed you are in your (same) old error." See 12:93

item.title: Yusuf:95 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِیْ ضَلَالِكَ الْقَدِيمِ qālū tal-lahi innaka lafī ḍalālika l-qadīmi Said they: "By God! Verily thou art in thy error." See 12:93

item.title: Yusuf:96 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكُمْ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ falammā an jāa l-bashīru alqāhu ʿalā wajhihi fa-ir'tadda baṣīran qāla alam aqul lakum innī aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna When the bearer of good news arrived, he cast it1 on his face, and he regained his sight. He said, 'Did I not tell you, "I know from Allah what you do not know?" '

item.title: Yusuf:96 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكُمْ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ falammā an jāa l-bashīru alqāhu ʿalā wajhihi fa-ir'tadda baṣīran qāla alam aqul lakum innī aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna And when the bearer of good tidings1 arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned (once again) seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allah that which you do not know?" Then, when the bearer of the good news arrived, he cast it (the shirt) over his face, and his vision returned. He said: Did I not say to you, 'I know from Allah that which you know not?' (12:96). They said: "O our father! Ask forgiveness (from Allah) for our sins, indeed we have been sinners (12:97). He said: "I will ask…

item.title: Yusuf:96 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكُمْ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ falammā an jāa l-bashīru alqāhu ʿalā wajhihi fa-ir'tadda baṣīran qāla alam aqul lakum innī aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna So when came the bearer of glad tidings, he cast it (the shirt) on his (Jacob's) face, and (forthwith) returned (unto him) the eye-sight. He said: "Said I not unto you? Verily I know from God what ye know not." (a) The return of sight means that he turned again seeing. It implies that Jacob had lost his sight and then regained it. The attempt to attach figurative significance means he came to know the whereabouts of Joseph is unwarranted and does not tally with 'Fartadda' which means, return to a state or regaining a thing lost. (A.P.).

item.title: Yusuf:97 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا خَاطِءِينَ qālū yāabānā is'taghfir lanā dhunūbanā innā kunnā khāṭiīna They said, 'Father! Plead [with Allah] for forgiveness of our sins! We have indeed been erring.'

item.title: Yusuf:97 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا خَاطِءِينَ qālū yāabānā is'taghfir lanā dhunūbanā innā kunnā khāṭiīna They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners." See 12:96

item.title: Yusuf:97 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا خَاطِءِينَ qālū yāabānā is'taghfir lanā dhunūbanā innā kunnā khāṭiīna Said they: "O' our father! Ask thou forgiveness for us, Verily we are guilty ones." See 12:96

item.title: Yusuf:98 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ qāla sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbī innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu He said, 'I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you; indeed He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.'

item.title: Yusuf:98 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ qāla sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbī innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful." See 12:96

item.title: Yusuf:98 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ qāla sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbī innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu He said: "Soon will I ask forgiveness for you from my Lord: Verily He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful." See 12:96

item.title: Yusuf:99 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى يُوسُفَ ءَاوَى إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوْۤا مِصْرَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ falammā dakhalū ʿalā yūsufa āwā ilayhi abawayhi waqāla ud'khulū miṣ'ra in shāa l-lahu āminīna When they entered into the presence of Joseph, he set his parents close to himself, and said, 'Welcome to Egypt, in safety, God willing!'

item.title: Yusuf:99 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى يُوسُفَ ءَاوَى إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوْۤا مِصْرَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ falammā dakhalū ʿalā yūsufa āwā ilayhi abawayhi waqāla ud'khulū miṣ'ra in shāa l-lahu āminīna And when they entered upon Yusuf, he took his parents to himself (i.e., embraced them) and said, "Enter Egypt, Allah willing, safe (and secure)." Then, when they came in before Yusuf, he took his parents to himself and said: "Enter Egypt, if Allah wills, in security (12:99). And he raised his parents to the 'Arsh and they fell down before him prostrate. And he said: "O my father! This is the interpretation of my dream aforetime! My Lord has made it come true! He was indeed good to me, when He took me out of the prison, and brought you (all here) out of the bedouin life, after Shaytan had sown enmity…

item.title: Yusuf:99 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى يُوسُفَ ءَاوَى إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوْۤا مِصْرَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ falammā dakhalū ʿalā yūsufa āwā ilayhi abawayhi waqāla ud'khulū miṣ'ra in shāa l-lahu āminīna And when they entered the presence of Joseph, he accommodated his parents with himself, and said he: "Enter ye Egypt, if God willeth, (all) in security." See 12:96

item.title: Yusuf:100 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوْۤا لَهُ سُجَّدًا وَقَالَ يَاأَبَتِ هَذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَايَ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقًّا وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِي إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُمْ مِنَ الْبَدْوِ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ نَزَغَ الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِي إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِمَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ warafaʿa abawayhi ʿalā l-ʿarshi wakharrū lahu sujjadan waqāla yāabati hādhā tawīlu ru'yāya min qablu qad jaʿalahā rabbī ḥaqqan waqad aḥsana bī idh akhrajanī mina l-sij'ni wajāa bikum mina l-badwi min baʿdi an nazagha l-shayṭānu baynī wabayna ikh'watī inna rabbī laṭīfun limā yashāu innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu And he seated his parents high upon the throne, and they fell down prostrate before him. He said, 'Father! This is the fulfillment of my dream of long ago, which my Lord has made come true. He was certainly gracious to me when He brought me out of…

item.title: Yusuf:100 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوْۤا لَهُ سُجَّدًا وَقَالَ يَاأَبَتِ هَذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَايَ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقًّا وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِي إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُمْ مِنَ الْبَدْوِ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ نَزَغَ الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِي إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِمَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ warafaʿa abawayhi ʿalā l-ʿarshi wakharrū lahu sujjadan waqāla yāabati hādhā tawīlu ru'yāya min qablu qad jaʿalahā rabbī ḥaqqan waqad aḥsana bī idh akhrajanī mina l-sij'ni wajāa bikum mina l-badwi min baʿdi an nazagha l-shayṭānu baynī wabayna ikh'watī inna rabbī laṭīfun limā yashāu innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration.1 And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out…

item.title: Yusuf:100 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوْۤا لَهُ سُجَّدًا وَقَالَ يَاأَبَتِ هَذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَايَ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقًّا وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِي إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُمْ مِنَ الْبَدْوِ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ نَزَغَ الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِي إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِمَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ warafaʿa abawayhi ʿalā l-ʿarshi wakharrū lahu sujjadan waqāla yāabati hādhā tawīlu ru'yāya min qablu qad jaʿalahā rabbī ḥaqqan waqad aḥsana bī idh akhrajanī mina l-sij'ni wajāa bikum mina l-badwi min baʿdi an nazagha l-shayṭānu baynī wabayna ikh'watī inna rabbī laṭīfun limā yashāu innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu And raised he (Joseph.) his parents to the throne, and they fell down unto him prostrating and said he (Joseph.) "O' my father! this is the interpretation of my dream of a foretime! Indeed my Lord hath made it come true; and indeed He was kind unto me…

item.title: Yusuf:101 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ rabbi qad ātaytanī mina l-mul'ki waʿallamtanī min tawīli l-aḥādīthi fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi anta waliyyī fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati tawaffanī mus'liman wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna 'My Lord! You have granted me a share in the kingdom, and taught me the interpretation of dreams. Originator of the heavens and earth! You are my guardian in this world and the Hereafter! Let my death be in submission [to You], and unite me with the Righteous.'

item.title: Yusuf:101 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ rabbi qad ātaytanī mina l-mul'ki waʿallamtanī min tawīli l-aḥādīthi fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi anta waliyyī fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati tawaffanī mus'liman wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna My Lord, You have given me (something) of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous." My Lord! You have indeed bestowed on me of the sovereignty, and taught me something of the interpretation of dreams - the (Only) Creator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Wali in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die as a Muslim, and join me with the…

item.title: Yusuf:101 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ rabbi qad ātaytanī mina l-mul'ki waʿallamtanī min tawīli l-aḥādīthi fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi anta waliyyī fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati tawaffanī mus'liman wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna O' My Lord! Indeed hast Thou given me of the dominion and taught me of the interpretation of events (Proceedings.) (dreams):(O') Originator of the heavens and the earth! Thou (alone) art my guardian in this world and the hereafter; cause me die a Muslim (in submission unto Thee) and join me with the righteous. See 12:100

item.title: Yusuf:102 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوْۤا أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh ajmaʿū amrahum wahum yamkurūna These are accounts of the Unseen which We reveal to you, and you were not with them when they conspired together and schemed.

item.title: Yusuf:102 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوْۤا أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh ajmaʿū amrahum wahum yamkurūna That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, (O Muḥammad), to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired. That is of the news of the Ghayb (Unseen) which We reveal to you. You were not (present) with them when they arranged their plan together, and (while) they were plotting (12:102). And most of mankind will not believe even if you desire it eagerly (12:103). And no reward you ask of them for it; it (the Qur'an) is no less than a Reminder unto the 'Alamin (men and Jinn) (12:104). This Story is a Revelation from Allah Allah narrated to Muhammad…

item.title: Yusuf:102 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوْۤا أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh ajmaʿū amrahum wahum yamkurūna This is (one) of the tidings of the unseen (which) We reveal unto thee (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) and nor wast thou present with (The brothers of Joseph.) them (the brothers of Joseph) when they resolved their affair, and while they were devising their plans. See 12:100

item.title: Yusuf:103 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā aktharu l-nāsi walaw ḥaraṣta bimu'minīna Yet most people will not have faith, however eager you should be.

item.title: Yusuf:103 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā aktharu l-nāsi walaw ḥaraṣta bimu'minīna And most of the people, although you strive (for it), are not believers. See 12:102

item.title: Yusuf:103 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ wamā aktharu l-nāsi walaw ḥaraṣta bimu'minīna And most (This Condemns the majority to be disbelievers.) people believe (it) not, though thou desirest it. See 12:100

item.title: Yusuf:104 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَسْءَلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā tasaluhum ʿalayhi min ajrin in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna You do not ask them any reward for it: it1 is just a reminder for all the nations.

item.title: Yusuf:104 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَسْءَلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā tasaluhum ʿalayhi min ajrin in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds. See 12:102

item.title: Yusuf:104 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا تَسْءَلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā tasaluhum ʿalayhi min ajrin in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna What (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!) Thou asketh not of them a recompense for (The services of the apostleship - or preaching Qur'an.) it, for this, (it) is no other than an admonition unto (all) the worlds (of creation). See 12:100

item.title: Yusuf:105 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ waka-ayyin min āyatin fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yamurrūna ʿalayhā wahum ʿanhā muʿ'riḍūna How many a sign there is in the heavens and the earth that they pass by while they are disregardful of it!

item.title: Yusuf:105 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ waka-ayyin min āyatin fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yamurrūna ʿalayhā wahum ʿanhā muʿ'riḍūna And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away. And how many a sign in the heavens and the earth they pass by, while they are averse therefrom (12:105). And most of them believe not in Allah except that they attribute partners unto Him (12:106). Do they then feel secure from the coming against them of the covering veil of the torment of Allah, or of the coming against them of the (Final) Hour, all of a sudden while they perceive not (12:107). People Neglect to Ponder the Signs before Them Allah states that most people do not think about His signs and proofs of His Oneness…

item.title: Yusuf:105 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ waka-ayyin min āyatin fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yamurrūna ʿalayhā wahum ʿanhā muʿ'riḍūna And how many a sign in the heavens and the earth which they pass by {day and night), (and) yet they turn away from them. See 12:100

item.title: Yusuf:106 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُمْ مُشْرِكُونَ wamā yu'minu aktharuhum bil-lahi illā wahum mush'rikūna And most of them do not believe in Allah without ascribing partners to Him.

item.title: Yusuf:106 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُمْ مُشْرِكُونَ wamā yu'minu aktharuhum bil-lahi illā wahum mush'rikūna And most of them believe not in Allah except while they associate others with Him. See 12:105

item.title: Yusuf:106 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُمْ مُشْرِكُونَ wamā yu'minu aktharuhum bil-lahi illā wahum mush'rikūna And believe not most of them, in God, except as polytheists. See 12:100

item.title: Yusuf:107 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنُوا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ afa-aminū an tatiyahum ghāshiyatun min ʿadhābi l-lahi aw tatiyahumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Do they feel secure from being overtaken by a blanket punishment from Allah, or being overtaken by the Hour, suddenly, while they are unaware?

item.title: Yusuf:107 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنُوا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ afa-aminū an tatiyahum ghāshiyatun min ʿadhābi l-lahi aw tatiyahumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming (aspect) of the punishment of Allah or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive? See 12:105

item.title: Yusuf:107 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: أَفَأَمِنُوا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ afa-aminū an tatiyahum ghāshiyatun min ʿadhābi l-lahi aw tatiyahumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna What! then feel they secure that there may come unto them an overwhelming chastisement from God or (that) cometh unto them the hour suddenly while they are unaware? See 12:100

item.title: Yusuf:108 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ عَلَى بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ qul hādhihi sabīlī adʿū ilā l-lahi ʿalā baṣīratin anā wamani ittabaʿanī wasub'ḥāna l-lahi wamā anā mina l-mush'rikīna Say, 'This is my way. I summon to Allah with insight —I and he who follows me. Immaculate is Allah, and I am not one of the polytheists.'

item.title: Yusuf:108 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ عَلَى بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ qul hādhihi sabīlī adʿū ilā l-lahi ʿalā baṣīratin anā wamani ittabaʿanī wasub'ḥāna l-lahi wamā anā mina l-mush'rikīna Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allah with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allah; and I am not of those who associate others with Him." Say This is my way; I invite unto Allah with sure knowledge, I and whosoever follows me. And Glorified and Exalted be Allah. And I am not of the idolators (12:108). The Messenger's Way Allah orders His Messenger SAW to say to mankind and the Jinns that this is his way, meaning, his method, path and Sunnah, concentrating on calling to the testimony that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone…

item.title: Yusuf:108 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: قُلْ هَذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ عَلَى بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ qul hādhihi sabīlī adʿū ilā l-lahi ʿalā baṣīratin anā wamani ittabaʿanī wasub'ḥāna l-lahi wamā anā mina l-mush'rikīna Say thou (O' Our Apostle Muhammad!): "This is my way, I invite (ye all) unto God; with clear (Based on Knowledge - proof.) sight, (which) I and he who followeth me (possesses); And glory be to God, and I am not of the polytheists." I call you to God with clear sight which I and those who follow me possess. Those who follow the Holy Prophet cannot be other than mentioned in verse 33:33 and those who follow the Holy Prophet are of him in all respects.1 The Verse means that the right of calling people unto God is with the Holy Prophet and those who…

item.title: Yusuf:109 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرٰی أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim min ahli l-qurā afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun lilladhīna ittaqaw afalā taʿqilūna We did not send [any apostles] before you except as men to whom We revealed from among the people of the towns. Have they not traveled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? And the abode of the Hereafter is surely better for those who are Godwary. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: Yusuf:109 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرٰی أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim min ahli l-qurā afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun lilladhīna ittaqaw afalā taʿqilūna And We sent not before you (as messengers) except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they1 not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah; then will you not reason? And We sent not before you (as Messengers) any but men unto whom We revealed, from among the people of townships. Have they not traveled in…

item.title: Yusuf:109 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرٰی أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim min ahli l-qurā afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun lilladhīna ittaqaw afalā taʿqilūna And We sent not (apostles) before thee but men unto whom We revealed, from (among) the people of the towns; What! travel they not in the land that they might see what hath been the end of those before them? And certainly the abode of the hereafter is the best for those who guard them selves (against evil); What! Do ye not then understand? See 12:108

item.title: Yusuf:110 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا اسْتَيْئَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوْۤا جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ḥattā idhā is'tayasa l-rusulu waẓannū annahum qad kudhibū jāahum naṣrunā fanujjiya man nashāu walā yuraddu basunā ʿani l-qawmi l-muj'rimīna When the apostles lost hope1 and they thought that they had been told lies,2 Our help came to them, and We delivered whomever We wished, and Our punishment will not be averted from the guilty lot.

item.title: Yusuf:110 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا اسْتَيْئَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوْۤا جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ḥattā idhā is'tayasa l-rusulu waẓannū annahum qad kudhibū jāahum naṣrunā fanujjiya man nashāu walā yuraddu basunā ʿani l-qawmi l-muj'rimīna (They continued) until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals. (They were reprieved) until, when the Messengers gave up hope and thought that they were denied, then came to them Our help, and whomsoever We willed were rescued. And Our punishment cannot be warded off from the people who are criminals (12:110). Allah's Prophets are Aided by Victory in Times of Distress Allah states that He sends His aid and support to His…

item.title: Yusuf:110 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: حَتّٰی إِذَا اسْتَيْئَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوْۤا جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ḥattā idhā is'tayasa l-rusulu waẓannū annahum qad kudhibū jāahum naṣrunā fanujjiya man nashāu walā yuraddu basunā ʿani l-qawmi l-muj'rimīna Till, when the apostles despaired (Despaired of the conversion of the people of the belief - and knew that even these who had expressed faith were not sincere.) and deemed they were indeed belied, came unto them Our help; and delivered We whomsoever We willed; and Our wrath is not warded off from the people (who are) guilty. See 12:108

item.title: Yusuf:111 Tafsir Ali Quli Qara'i - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرٰی وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ laqad kāna fī qaṣaṣihim ʿib'ratun li-ulī l-albābi mā kāna ḥadīthan yuf'tarā walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla kulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna There is certainly a moral in their accounts for those who possess intellect. This [Qur'ān] is not a fabricated discourse; rather it is a confirmation of what was [revealed] before it, and an elaboration1 of all things, and a guidance and mercy for a people who have faith.

item.title: Yusuf:111 Tafsir Ibn Kathir - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرٰی وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ laqad kāna fī qaṣaṣihim ʿib'ratun li-ulī l-albābi mā kāna ḥadīthan yuf'tarā walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla kulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it (i.e., the Qur’ān) a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe. Indeed in their stories, there is a lesson for men of understanding. It (the Qur'an) is not a forged statement but a confirmation of that which was before it and a detailed explanation of everything and a guide and a mercy for the people who believe (12:111). A Lesson…

item.title: Yusuf:111 Tafsir Mir Ahmad Ali - bil-Quran
item.description: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرٰی وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ laqad kāna fī qaṣaṣihim ʿib'ratun li-ulī l-albābi mā kāna ḥadīthan yuf'tarā walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla kulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna Indeed (there) in the histories of theirs, is a lesson for men of understanding; it is not a tale which hath been forged, but a confirmation of what went before it, A detailed exposition of all things and a guide and a mercy unto people who believe. This verse gives the actual significance of the historic events related in the Holy Qur'an. The past being a lesson for the present events and the present reflects on the conditions of the events of the past, one confirming and explaining the other. (A.P.).
